verses.textZh: 便雅悯地亚拿突城的一位祭司，希勒家的儿子耶利米的话记在下面。
verses.textZhCnvs: 便雅悯地亚拿突城的一位祭司，希勒家的儿子耶利米的话记在下面。
verses.textZhCuv: 便雅悯地亚拿突城的祭司中，希勒家的儿子耶利米的话记在下面。
verses.textEnNiv: The words of Jeremiah son of Hilkiah, one of the priests at Anathoth in the territory of Benjamin.
verses.textEnEsv: The words of Jeremiah, the son of Hilkiah, one of the priests who were in Anathoth in the land of Benjamin,
verses.textEnNkjv: The words of Jeremiah the son of Hilkiah, of the priests who were in Anathoth in the land of Benjamin,
verses.textEnNlt: These are the words of Jeremiah son of Hilkiah, one of the priests from the town of Anathoth in the land of Benjamin.
verses.textEnNasb: The words of Jeremiah the son of Hilkiah, of the priests who were in Anathoth in the land of Benjamin,
verses.textEn: The words of Jeremiah son of Hilkiah, one of the priests at Anathoth in the territory of Benjamin.

verses.textZh: 犹大王亚们的儿子约西亚作王第十三年，耶和华的话临到耶利米。
verses.textZhCnvs: 犹大王亚们的儿子约西亚作王第十三年，耶和华的话临到耶利米。
verses.textZhCuv: 犹大王亚们的儿子约西亚在位十三年，耶和华的话临到耶利米。
verses.textEnNiv: The word of the Lord came to him in the thirteenth year of the reign of Josiah son of Amon king of Judah,
verses.textEnEsv: to whom the word of the Lord came in the days of Josiah the son of Amon, king of Judah, in the thirteenth year of his reign.
verses.textEnNkjv: to whom the word of the Lord came in the days of Josiah the son of Amon, king of Judah, in the thirteenth year of his reign.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord first gave messages to Jeremiah during the thirteenth year of the reign of Josiah son of Amon, king of Judah.
verses.textEnNasb: to whom the word of the Lord came in the days of Josiah the son of Amon, king of Judah, in the thirteenth year of his reign.
verses.textEn: The word of the Lord came to him in the thirteenth year of the reign of Josiah son of Amon king of Judah,

verses.textZh: 从犹大王约西亚的儿子约雅敬年间，直到犹大王约西亚的儿子西底家末年，就是第十一年五月，耶路撒冷人被掳的时候，耶和华的话也常临到耶利米。
verses.textZhCnvs: 从犹大王约西亚的儿子约雅敬年间，直到犹大王约西亚的儿子西底家末年，就是第十一年五月，耶路撒冷人被掳的时候，耶和华的话也常临到耶利米。
verses.textZhCuv: 从犹大王约西亚的儿子约雅敬在位的时候，直到犹大王约西亚的儿子西底家在位的末年，就是十一年五月间耶路撒冷人被掳的时候，耶和华的话也常临到耶利米。
verses.textEnNiv: and through the reign of Jehoiakim son of Josiah king of Judah, down to the fifth month of the eleventh year of Zedekiah son of Josiah king of Judah, when the people of Jerusalem went into exile.
verses.textEnEsv: It came also in the days of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah, and until the end of the eleventh year of Zedekiah, the son of Josiah, king of Judah, until the captivity of Jerusalem in the fifth month.
verses.textEnNkjv: It came also in the days of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah, until the end of the eleventh year of Zedekiah the son of Josiah, king of Judah, until the carrying away of Jerusalem captive in the fifth month.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord ’s messages continued throughout the reign of King Jehoiakim, Josiah’s son, until the eleventh year of the reign of King Zedekiah, another of Josiah’s sons. In August of that eleventh year the people of Jerusalem were taken away as captives.
verses.textEnNasb: It came also in the days of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah, until the end of the eleventh year of Zedekiah the son of Josiah, king of Judah, until the exile of Jerusalem in the fifth month.
verses.textEn: and through the reign of Jehoiakim son of Josiah king of Judah, down to the fifth month of the eleventh year of Zedekiah son of Josiah king of Judah, when the people of Jerusalem went into exile.

verses.textZh: 耶和华的话临到我，说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的话临到我，说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶利米说，耶和华的话临到我说：
verses.textEnNiv: The word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.textEnEsv: Now the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the word of the Lord came to me, saying:
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord gave me this message:
verses.textEnNasb: Now the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.textEn: The word of the Lord came to me, saying,

verses.textZh: "我使你在母腹中成形以先，就认识你； 你还未出母胎，我已把你分别为圣， 立你作列国的先知。"
verses.textZhCnvs: "我使你在母腹中成形以先，就认识你； 你还未出母胎，我已把你分别为圣， 立你作列国的先知。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我未将你造在腹中，我已晓得你； 你未出母胎，我已分别你为圣； 我已派你作列国的先知。
verses.textEnNiv: "Before I formed you in the womb I knew you, before you were born I set you apart; I appointed you as a prophet to the nations."
verses.textEnEsv: "Before I formed you in the womb I knew you, and before you were born I consecrated you; I appointed you a prophet to the nations."
verses.textEnNkjv: "Before I formed you in the womb I knew you; Before you were born I sanctified you; I ordained you a prophet to the nations."
verses.textEnNlt: "I knew you before I formed you in your mother’s womb. Before you were born I set you apart and appointed you as my prophet to the nations."
verses.textEnNasb: "Before I formed you in the womb I knew you, And before you were born I consecrated you; I have appointed you as a prophet to the nations."
verses.textEn: "Before I formed you in the womb I knew you, before you were born I set you apart; I appointed you as a prophet to the nations."

verses.textZh: 我就说："主耶和华啊！ 我不晓得说话， 因为我年轻。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我就说："主耶和华啊！ 我不晓得说话， 因为我年轻。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我就说：主耶和华啊，我不知怎样说，因为我是年幼的。
verses.textEnNiv: "Alas, Sovereign Lord ," I said, "I do not know how to speak; I am too young."
verses.textEnEsv: Then I said, "Ah, Lord God ! Behold, I do not know how to speak, for I am only a youth."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then said I: "Ah, Lord God! Behold, I cannot speak, for I am a youth."
verses.textEnNlt: "O Sovereign Lord ," I said, "I can’t speak for you! I’m too young!"
verses.textEnNasb: Then I said, "Oh, Lord God! Behold, I do not know how to speak, Because I am a youth."
verses.textEn: "Alas, Sovereign Lord ," I said, "I do not know how to speak; I am too young."

verses.textZh: 耶和华对我说： "你不要说：‘我年轻’， 因为无论我差你到谁那里，你都要去； 无论我吩咐你说甚么，你都要说。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对我说： "你不要说：‘我年轻’， 因为无论我差你到谁那里，你都要去； 无论我吩咐你说甚么，你都要说。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华对我说： 你不要说我是年幼的， 因为我差遣你到谁那里去，你都要去； 我吩咐你说什么话，你都要说。
verses.textEnNiv: But the Lord said to me, "Do not say, ‘I am too young.’ You must go to everyone I send you to and say whatever I command you.
verses.textEnEsv: But the Lord said to me, "Do not say, ‘I am only a youth’; for to all to whom I send you, you shall go, and whatever I command you, you shall speak.
verses.textEnNkjv: But the Lord said to me: "Do not say, ‘I am a youth,’ For you shall go to all to whom I send you, And whatever I command you, you shall speak.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord replied, "Don’t say, ‘I’m too young,’ for you must go wherever I send you and say whatever I tell you.
verses.textEnNasb: But the Lord said to me, "Do not say, ‘I am a youth,’ Because everywhere I send you, you shall go, And all that I command you, you shall speak.
verses.textEn: But the Lord said to me, "Do not say, ‘I am too young.’ You must go to everyone I send you to and say whatever I command you.

verses.textZh: 你不要怕他们， 因为我与你同在，要拯救你。" 这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你不要怕他们， 因为我与你同在，要拯救你。" 这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 你不要惧怕他们， 因为我与你同在， 要拯救你。 这是耶和华说的。
verses.textEnNiv: Do not be afraid of them, for I am with you and will rescue you," declares the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: Do not be afraid of them, for I am with you to deliver you, declares the Lord ."
verses.textEnNkjv: Do not be afraid of their faces, For I am with you to deliver you," says the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: And don’t be afraid of the people, for I will be with you and will protect you. I, the Lord , have spoken!"
verses.textEnNasb: "Do not be afraid of them, For I am with you to save you," declares the Lord.
verses.textEn: Do not be afraid of them, for I am with you and will rescue you," declares the Lord .

verses.textZh: 于是耶和华伸手按着我的口，对我说： "看哪！我把我的话放在你口中。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是耶和华伸手按着我的口，对我说： "看哪！我把我的话放在你口中。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是耶和华伸手按我的口，对我说： 我已将当说的话传给你。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the Lord reached out his hand and touched my mouth and said to me, "I have put my words in your mouth.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the Lord put out his hand and touched my mouth. And the Lord said to me, "Behold, I have put my words in your mouth.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Lord put forth His hand and touched my mouth, and the Lord said to me: "Behold, I have put My words in your mouth.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord reached out and touched my mouth and said, "Look, I have put my words in your mouth!
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord stretched out His hand and touched my mouth, and the Lord said to me, "Behold, I have put My words in your mouth.
verses.textEn: Then the Lord reached out his hand and touched my mouth and said to me, "I have put my words in your mouth.

verses.textZh: 今日我立你在列邦列国之上， 为要拔出、拆毁、 毁灭、倾覆， 又要建立和栽植。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 今日我立你在列邦列国之上， 为要拔出、拆毁、 毁灭、倾覆， 又要建立和栽植。"
verses.textZhCuv: 看哪，我今日立你在列邦列国之上， 为要施行拔出、拆毁、毁坏、倾覆， 又要建立、栽植。
verses.textEnNiv: See, today I appoint you over nations and kingdoms to uproot and tear down, to destroy and overthrow, to build and to plant."
verses.textEnEsv: See, I have set you this day over nations and over kingdoms, to pluck up and to break down, to destroy and to overthrow, to build and to plant."
verses.textEnNkjv: See, I have this day set you over the nations and over the kingdoms, To root out and to pull down, To destroy and to throw down, To build and to plant."
verses.textEnNlt: Today I appoint you to stand up against nations and kingdoms. Some you must uproot and tear down, destroy and overthrow. Others you must build up and plant."
verses.textEnNasb: "See, I have appointed you this day over the nations and over the kingdoms, To root out and to tear down, To destroy and to overthrow, To build and to plant."
verses.textEn: See, today I appoint you over nations and kingdoms to uproot and tear down, to destroy and overthrow, to build and to plant."

verses.textZh: 耶和华的话又临到我，说："耶利米，你看见甚么？"我说："我看见一根杏树枝子。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的话又临到我，说："耶利米，你看见甚么？"我说："我看见一根杏树枝子。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的话又临到我说：「耶利米，你看见什么？」我说：「我看见一根杏树枝。」
verses.textEnNiv: The word of the Lord came to me: "What do you see, Jeremiah?" "I see the branch of an almond tree," I replied.
verses.textEnEsv: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying, "Jeremiah, what do you see?" And I said, "I see an almond branch."
verses.textEnNkjv: Moreover the word of the Lord came to me, saying, "Jeremiah, what do you see?" And I said, "I see a branch of an almond tree."
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord said to me, "Look, Jeremiah! What do you see?" And I replied, "I see a branch from an almond tree."
verses.textEnNasb: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying, "What do you see, Jeremiah?" And I said, "I see a branch of an almond tree."
verses.textEn: The word of the Lord came to me: "What do you see, Jeremiah?" "I see the branch of an almond tree," I replied.

verses.textZh: 耶和华对我说："你看得不错，因为我要留意使我的话成就。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对我说："你看得不错，因为我要留意使我的话成就。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华对我说：「你看得不错；因为我留意保守我的话，使得成就。」
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord said to me, "You have seen correctly, for I am watching to see that my word is fulfilled."
verses.textEnEsv: Then the Lord said to me, "You have seen well, for I am watching over my word to perform it."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Lord said to me, "You have seen well, for I am ready to perform My word."
verses.textEnNlt: And the Lord said, "That’s right, and it means that I am watching, and I will certainly carry out all my plans."
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord said to me, "You have seen well, for I am watching over My word to perform it."
verses.textEn: The Lord said to me, "You have seen correctly, for I am watching to see that my word is fulfilled."

verses.textZh: 耶和华的话再次临到我，说："你看见甚么？"我说："我看见一个沸腾的锅，锅口从北面向南倾侧。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的话再次临到我，说："你看见甚么？"我说："我看见一个沸腾的锅，锅口从北面向南倾侧。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的话第二次临到我说：「你看见什么？」我说：「我看见一个烧开的锅，从北而倾。」
verses.textEnNiv: The word of the Lord came to me again: "What do you see?" "I see a pot that is boiling," I answered. "It is tilting toward us from the north."
verses.textEnEsv: The word of the Lord came to me a second time, saying, "What do you see?" And I said, "I see a boiling pot, facing away from the north."
verses.textEnNkjv: And the word of the Lord came to me the second time, saying, "What do you see?" And I said, "I see a boiling pot, and it is facing away from the north."
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord spoke to me again and asked, "What do you see now?" And I replied, "I see a pot of boiling water, spilling from the north."
verses.textEnNasb: And the word of the Lord came to me a second time, saying, "What do you see?" And I said, "I see a boiling pot, facing away from the north."
verses.textEn: The word of the Lord came to me again: "What do you see?" "I see a pot that is boiling," I answered. "It is tilting toward us from the north."

verses.textZh: 耶和华对我说："必有灾祸从北方发出，临到这地所有的居民。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对我说："必有灾祸从北方发出，临到这地所有的居民。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华对我说：「必有灾祸从北方发出，临到这地的一切居民。」
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord said to me, "From the north disaster will be poured out on all who live in the land.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the Lord said to me, "Out of the north disaster shall be let loose upon all the inhabitants of the land.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Lord said to me: "Out of the north calamity shall break forth On all the inhabitants of the land.
verses.textEnNlt: "Yes," the Lord said, "for terror from the north will boil out on the people of this land.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord said to me, "Out of the north the evil will be unleashed on all the inhabitants of the land.
verses.textEn: The Lord said to me, "From the north disaster will be poured out on all who live in the land.

verses.textZh: 看哪！我要呼召北方列国的众族，他们要来，各人在耶路撒冷的城门口，设立自己的座位，攻击耶路撒冷周围的城墙，又攻击犹大各城镇。"这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 看哪！我要呼召北方列国的众族，他们要来，各人在耶路撒冷的城门口，设立自己的座位，攻击耶路撒冷周围的城墙，又攻击犹大各城镇。"这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华说：「看哪，我要召北方列国的众族；他们要来，各安座位在耶路撒冷的城门口，周围攻击城墙，又要攻击犹大的一切城邑。
verses.textEnNiv: I am about to summon all the peoples of the northern kingdoms," declares the Lord . "Their kings will come and set up their thrones in the entrance of the gates of Jerusalem; they will come against all her surrounding walls and against all the towns of Judah.
verses.textEnEsv: For behold, I am calling all the tribes of the kingdoms of the north, declares the Lord , and they shall come, and every one shall set his throne at the entrance of the gates of Jerusalem, against all its walls all around and against all the cities of Judah.
verses.textEnNkjv: For behold, I am calling All the families of the kingdoms of the north," says the Lord; "They shall come and each one set his throne At the entrance of the gates of Jerusalem, Against all its walls all around, And against all the cities of Judah.
verses.textEnNlt: Listen! I am calling the armies of the kingdoms of the north to come to Jerusalem. I, the Lord , have spoken! "They will set their thrones at the gates of the city. They will attack its walls and all the other towns of Judah.
verses.textEnNasb: For, behold, I am calling all the families of the kingdoms of the north," declares the Lord; "and they will come and place, each one of them, his throne at the entrance of the gates of Jerusalem, and against all its walls around, and against all the cities of Judah.
verses.textEn: I am about to summon all the peoples of the northern kingdoms," declares the Lord . "Their kings will come and set up their thrones in the entrance of the gates of Jerusalem; they will come against all her surrounding walls and against all the towns of Judah.

verses.textZh: "为了他们的一切恶事，就是离弃我，向别神烧香，叩拜自己手所做的，我要宣判他们的罪。
verses.textZhCnvs: "为了他们的一切恶事，就是离弃我，向别神烧香，叩拜自己手所做的，我要宣判他们的罪。
verses.textZhCuv: 至于这民的一切恶，就是离弃我、向别神烧香、跪拜自己手所造的，我要发出我的判语，攻击他们。
verses.textEnNiv: I will pronounce my judgments on my people because of their wickedness in forsaking me, in burning incense to other gods and in worshiping what their hands have made.
verses.textEnEsv: And I will declare my judgments against them, for all their evil in forsaking me. They have made offerings to other gods and worshiped the works of their own hands.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will utter My judgments Against them concerning all their wickedness, Because they have forsaken Me, Burned incense to other gods, And worshiped the works of their own hands.
verses.textEnNlt: I will pronounce judgment on my people for all their evil— for deserting me and burning incense to other gods. Yes, they worship idols made with their own hands!
verses.textEnNasb: And I will pronounce My judgments against them concerning all their wickedness, since they have abandoned Me and have offered sacrifices to other gods, and worshiped the works of their own hands.
verses.textEn: I will pronounce my judgments on my people because of their wickedness in forsaking me, in burning incense to other gods and in worshiping what their hands have made.

verses.textZh: "因此，你要束腰，你要起来，把我吩咐你的一切话，都告诉他们。不要因他们惊惶，不然我就使你在他们面前惊惶。
verses.textZhCnvs: "因此，你要束腰，你要起来，把我吩咐你的一切话，都告诉他们。不要因他们惊惶，不然我就使你在他们面前惊惶。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以你当束腰，起来将我所吩咐你的一切话告诉他们；不要因他们惊惶，免得我使你在他们面前惊惶。
verses.textEnNiv: "Get yourself ready! Stand up and say to them whatever I command you. Do not be terrified by them, or I will terrify you before them.
verses.textEnEsv: But you, dress yourself for work; arise, and say to them everything that I command you. Do not be dismayed by them, lest I dismay you before them.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Therefore prepare yourself and arise, And speak to them all that I command you. Do not be dismayed before their faces, Lest I dismay you before them.
verses.textEnNlt: "Get up and prepare for action. Go out and tell them everything I tell you to say. Do not be afraid of them, or I will make you look foolish in front of them.
verses.textEnNasb: Now, belt your garment around your waist and arise, and speak to them all that I command you. Do not be dismayed before them, or I will make you dismayed before them.
verses.textEn: "Get yourself ready! Stand up and say to them whatever I command you. Do not be terrified by them, or I will terrify you before them.

verses.textZh: 看哪！今日我使你成为坚城、铁柱、铜墙，抵挡全地，就是抵挡犹大的君王、首领、祭司和这地的众民。
verses.textZhCnvs: 看哪！今日我使你成为坚城、铁柱、铜墙，抵挡全地，就是抵挡犹大的君王、首领、祭司和这地的众民。
verses.textZhCuv: 看哪，我今日使你成为坚城、铁柱、铜墙，与全地和犹大的君王、首领、祭司，并地上的众民反对。
verses.textEnNiv: Today I have made you a fortified city, an iron pillar and a bronze wall to stand against the whole land—against the kings of Judah, its officials, its priests and the people of the land.
verses.textEnEsv: And I, behold, I make you this day a fortified city, an iron pillar, and bronze walls, against the whole land, against the kings of Judah, its officials, its priests, and the people of the land.
verses.textEnNkjv: For behold, I have made you this day A fortified city and an iron pillar, And bronze walls against the whole land— Against the kings of Judah, Against its princes, Against its priests, And against the people of the land.
verses.textEnNlt: For see, today I have made you strong like a fortified city that cannot be captured, like an iron pillar or a bronze wall. You will stand against the whole land— the kings, officials, priests, and people of Judah.
verses.textEnNasb: Now behold, I have made you today like a fortified city and like a pillar of iron and walls of bronze against the whole land, to the kings of Judah, to its leaders, to its priests, and to the people of the land.
verses.textEn: Today I have made you a fortified city, an iron pillar and a bronze wall to stand against the whole land—against the kings of Judah, its officials, its priests and the people of the land.

verses.textZh: 他们必攻击你，却不能胜过你，因为我与你同在，要拯救你。"这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们必攻击你，却不能胜过你，因为我与你同在，要拯救你。"这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们要攻击你，却不能胜你；因为我与你同在，要拯救你。这是耶和华说的。」
verses.textEnNiv: They will fight against you but will not overcome you, for I am with you and will rescue you," declares the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: They will fight against you, but they shall not prevail against you, for I am with you, declares the Lord , to deliver you."
verses.textEnNkjv: They will fight against you, But they shall not prevail against you. For I am with you," says the Lord, "to deliver you."
verses.textEnNlt: They will fight you, but they will fail. For I am with you, and I will take care of you. I, the Lord , have spoken!"
verses.textEnNasb: And they will fight against you but they will not overcome you, for I am with you to save you," declares the Lord.
verses.textEn: They will fight against you but will not overcome you, for I am with you and will rescue you," declares the Lord .

verses.textZh: 耶和华的话临到我，说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的话临到我，说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的话临到我说：
verses.textEnNiv: The word of the Lord came to me:
verses.textEnEsv: The word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.textEnNkjv: Moreover the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord gave me another message. He said,
verses.textEnNasb: Now the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.textEn: The word of the Lord came to me:

verses.textZh: "你去在耶路撒冷人的耳中呼叫，说：‘耶和华这样说： 你年轻时的恩爱， 新婚时的爱情， 你怎样在旷野、 在未曾耕种之地跟从我， 我都记得。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你去在耶路撒冷人的耳中呼叫，说：‘耶和华这样说： 你年轻时的恩爱， 新婚时的爱情， 你怎样在旷野、 在未曾耕种之地跟从我， 我都记得。
verses.textZhCuv: 「你去向耶路撒冷人的耳中喊叫说，耶和华如此说： 你幼年的恩爱， 婚姻的爱情， 你怎样在旷野， 在未曾耕种之地跟随我， 我都记得。
verses.textEnNiv: "Go and proclaim in the hearing of Jerusalem: "This is what the Lord says: " ‘I remember the devotion of your youth, how as a bride you loved me and followed me through the wilderness, through a land not sown.
verses.textEnEsv: "Go and proclaim in the hearing of Jerusalem, Thus says the Lord , "I remember the devotion of your youth, your love as a bride, how you followed me in the wilderness, in a land not sown.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Go and cry in the hearing of Jerusalem, saying, ‘Thus says the Lord: "I remember you, The kindness of your youth, The love of your betrothal, When you went after Me in the wilderness, In a land not sown.
verses.textEnNlt: "Go and shout this message to Jerusalem. This is what the Lord says: "I remember how eager you were to please me as a young bride long ago, how you loved me and followed me even through the barren wilderness.
verses.textEnNasb: "Go and proclaim in the ears of Jerusalem, saying, ‘This is what the Lord says: "I remember regarding you the devotion of your youth, Your love when you were a bride, Your following after Me in the wilderness, Through a land not sown.
verses.textEn: "Go and proclaim in the hearing of Jerusalem: "This is what the Lord says: " ‘I remember the devotion of your youth, how as a bride you loved me and followed me through the wilderness, through a land not sown.

verses.textZh: 那时，以色列归耶和华为圣， 作他初熟的土产。 吞吃她的，都算为有罪， 灾祸必临到他们。’" 这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，以色列归耶和华为圣， 作他初熟的土产。 吞吃她的，都算为有罪， 灾祸必临到他们。’" 这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时以色列归耶和华为圣， 作为土产初熟的果子； 凡吞吃它的必算为有罪， 灾祸必临到他们。 这是耶和华说的。
verses.textEnNiv: Israel was holy to the Lord , the firstfruits of his harvest; all who devoured her were held guilty, and disaster overtook them,’ " declares the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: Israel was holy to the Lord , the firstfruits of his harvest. All who ate of it incurred guilt; disaster came upon them, declares the Lord ."
verses.textEnNkjv: Israel was holiness to the Lord, The firstfruits of His increase. All that devour him will offend; Disaster will come upon them," says the Lord.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: In those days Israel was holy to the Lord , the first of his children. All who harmed his people were declared guilty, and disaster fell on them. I, the Lord , have spoken!"
verses.textEnNasb: "Israel was holy to the Lord, The first of His harvest. All who ate of it became guilty; Evil came upon them," declares the Lord.’ "
verses.textEn: Israel was holy to the Lord , the firstfruits of his harvest; all who devoured her were held guilty, and disaster overtook them,’ " declares the Lord .

verses.textZh: 雅各家啊！以色列家的各族啊！你们要听耶和华的话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 雅各家啊！以色列家的各族啊！你们要听耶和华的话。
verses.textZhCuv: 雅各家、以色列家的各族啊，你们当听耶和华的话。
verses.textEnNiv: Hear the word of the Lord , you descendants of Jacob, all you clans of Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: Hear the word of the Lord , O house of Jacob, and all the clans of the house of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: Hear the word of the Lord, O house of Jacob and all the families of the house of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: Listen to the word of the Lord , people of Jacob—all you families of Israel!
verses.textEnNasb: Hear the word of the Lord, house of Jacob, and all the families of the house of Israel.
verses.textEn: Hear the word of the Lord , you descendants of Jacob, all you clans of Israel.

verses.textZh: 耶和华这样说： "你们列祖在我身上究竟发现了甚么不义， 使他们远离我， 随从虚无的偶像， 自己也成了虚妄呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华这样说： "你们列祖在我身上究竟发现了甚么不义， 使他们远离我， 随从虚无的偶像， 自己也成了虚妄呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华如此说： 你们的列祖见我有什么不义， 竟远离我，随从虚无的神， 自己成为虚妄的呢？
verses.textEnNiv: This is what the Lord says: "What fault did your ancestors find in me, that they strayed so far from me? They followed worthless idols and became worthless themselves.
verses.textEnEsv: Thus says the Lord : "What wrong did your fathers find in me that they went far from me, and went after worthlessness, and became worthless?
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus says the Lord: "What injustice have your fathers found in Me, That they have gone far from Me, Have followed idols, And have become idolaters?
verses.textEnNlt: This is what the Lord says: "What did your ancestors find wrong with me that led them to stray so far from me? They worshiped worthless idols, only to become worthless themselves.
verses.textEnNasb: This is what the Lord says: "What injustice did your fathers find in Me, That they went far from Me, And walked after emptiness and became empty?
verses.textEn: This is what the Lord says: "What fault did your ancestors find in me, that they strayed so far from me? They followed worthless idols and became worthless themselves.

verses.textZh: 他们也不问： ‘那领我们从埃及地上来， 引导我们走过旷野， 走过荒漠有深坑之地、 干旱死荫之地、 无人经过、无人居住之地的耶和华在哪里呢？’
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们也不问： ‘那领我们从埃及地上来， 引导我们走过旷野， 走过荒漠有深坑之地、 干旱死荫之地、 无人经过、无人居住之地的耶和华在哪里呢？’
verses.textZhCuv: 他们也不说： 那领我们从埃及地上来， 引导我们经过旷野， 沙漠有深坑之地， 和干旱死荫、无人经过、 无人居住之地的耶和华在哪里呢？
verses.textEnNiv: They did not ask, ‘Where is the Lord , who brought us up out of Egypt and led us through the barren wilderness, through a land of deserts and ravines, a land of drought and utter darkness, a land where no one travels and no one lives?’
verses.textEnEsv: They did not say, ‘Where is the Lord who brought us up from the land of Egypt, who led us in the wilderness, in a land of deserts and pits, in a land of drought and deep darkness, in a land that none passes through, where no man dwells?’
verses.textEnNkjv: Neither did they say, ‘Where is the Lord, Who brought us up out of the land of Egypt, Who led us through the wilderness, Through a land of deserts and pits, Through a land of drought and the shadow of death, Through a land that no one crossed And where no one dwelt?’
verses.textEnNlt: They did not ask, ‘Where is the Lord who brought us safely out of Egypt and led us through the barren wilderness— a land of deserts and pits, a land of drought and death, where no one lives or even travels?’
verses.textEnNasb: "They did not say, ‘Where is the Lord Who brought us up out of the land of Egypt, Who led us through the wilderness, Through a land of deserts and of pits, Through a land of drought and of deep darkness, Through a land that no one crossed And where no person lived?’
verses.textEn: They did not ask, ‘Where is the Lord , who brought us up out of Egypt and led us through the barren wilderness, through a land of deserts and ravines, a land of drought and utter darkness, a land where no one travels and no one lives?’

verses.textZh: 我领你们进入这肥美之地， 得吃其中的果子和美物； 可是你们一进来，就玷污了我的地； 你们使我的产业成为可憎恶的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我领你们进入这肥美之地， 得吃其中的果子和美物； 可是你们一进来，就玷污了我的地； 你们使我的产业成为可憎恶的。
verses.textZhCuv: 我领你们进入肥美之地， 使你们得吃其中的果子和美物； 但你们进入的时候就玷污我的地， 使我的产业成为可憎的。
verses.textEnNiv: I brought you into a fertile land to eat its fruit and rich produce. But you came and defiled my land and made my inheritance detestable.
verses.textEnEsv: And I brought you into a plentiful land to enjoy its fruits and its good things. But when you came in, you defiled my land and made my heritage an abomination.
verses.textEnNkjv: I brought you into a bountiful country, To eat its fruit and its goodness. But when you entered, you defiled My land And made My heritage an abomination.
verses.textEnNlt: "And when I brought you into a fruitful land to enjoy its bounty and goodness, you defiled my land and corrupted the possession I had promised you.
verses.textEnNasb: "I brought you into the fruitful land To eat its fruit and its good things. But you came and defiled My land, And you made My inheritance an abomination.
verses.textEn: I brought you into a fertile land to eat its fruit and rich produce. But you came and defiled my land and made my inheritance detestable.

verses.textZh: 众祭司都不问：‘耶和华在哪里？’ 律法师不认识我， 官长悖逆我， 先知奉巴力的名说预言， 跟从那无益的偶像。
verses.textZhCnvs: 众祭司都不问：‘耶和华在哪里？’ 律法师不认识我， 官长悖逆我， 先知奉巴力的名说预言， 跟从那无益的偶像。
verses.textZhCuv: 祭司都不说，耶和华在哪里呢？ 传讲律法的都不认识我。 官长违背我； 先知藉巴力说预言， 随从无益的神。
verses.textEnNiv: The priests did not ask, ‘Where is the Lord ?’ Those who deal with the law did not know me; the leaders rebelled against me. The prophets prophesied by Baal, following worthless idols.
verses.textEnEsv: The priests did not say, ‘Where is the Lord ?’ Those who handle the law did not know me; the shepherds transgressed against me; the prophets prophesied by Baal and went after things that do not profit.
verses.textEnNkjv: The priests did not say, ‘Where is the Lord?’ And those who handle the law did not know Me; The rulers also transgressed against Me; The prophets prophesied by Baal, And walked after thingsthat do not profit.
verses.textEnNlt: The priests did not ask, ‘Where is the Lord ?’ Those who taught my word ignored me, the rulers turned against me, and the prophets spoke in the name of Baal, wasting their time on worthless idols.
verses.textEnNasb: "The priests did not say, ‘Where is the Lord?’ And those who handle the Law did not know Me; The rulers also revolted against Me, And the prophets prophesied by Baal And walked after things that were of no benefit.
verses.textEn: The priests did not ask, ‘Where is the Lord ?’ Those who deal with the law did not know me; the leaders rebelled against me. The prophets prophesied by Baal, following worthless idols.

verses.textZh: 因此，我要再跟你们争辩， 也要跟你们的子孙争辩。" 这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，我要再跟你们争辩， 也要跟你们的子孙争辩。" 这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华说：我因此必与你们争辩， 也必与你们的子孙争辩。
verses.textEnNiv: "Therefore I bring charges against you again," declares the Lord . "And I will bring charges against your children’s children.
verses.textEnEsv: "Therefore I still contend with you, declares the Lord , and with your children’s children I will contend.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Therefore I will yet bring charges against you," says the Lord, "And against your children’s children I will bring charges.
verses.textEnNlt: Therefore, I will bring my case against you," says the Lord . "I will even bring charges against your children’s children in the years to come.
verses.textEnNasb: "Therefore I will still contend with you," declares the Lord, "And I will contend with your sons’ sons.
verses.textEn: "Therefore I bring charges against you again," declares the Lord . "And I will bring charges against your children’s children.

verses.textZh: "你们尽管过到基提海岛察看， 派人去基达仔细查考， 看看曾有这样的事没有。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你们尽管过到基提海岛察看， 派人去基达仔细查考， 看看曾有这样的事没有。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们且过到基提海岛去察看， 打发人往基达去留心查考， 看曾有这样的事没有。
verses.textEnNiv: Cross over to the coasts of Cyprus and look, send to Kedar and observe closely; see if there has ever been anything like this:
verses.textEnEsv: For cross to the coasts of Cyprus and see, or send to Kedar and examine with care; see if there has been such a thing.
verses.textEnNkjv: For pass beyond the coasts of Cyprus and see, Send to Kedar and consider diligently, And see if there has been such a thing.
verses.textEnNlt: "Go west and look in the land of Cyprus ; go east and search through the land of Kedar. Has anyone ever heard of anything as strange as this?
verses.textEnNasb: "For cross to the coastlands of Kittim and see, And send to Kedar and observe closely, And see if there has been anything like this!
verses.textEn: Cross over to the coasts of Cyprus and look, send to Kedar and observe closely; see if there has ever been anything like this:

verses.textZh: 有哪一国把自己的神换掉呢？ 其实那些并不是神。 我的子民竟把他们的荣耀， 换了无益的偶像。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有哪一国把自己的神换掉呢？ 其实那些并不是神。 我的子民竟把他们的荣耀， 换了无益的偶像。
verses.textZhCuv: 岂有一国换了他的神吗？ 其实这不是神！ 但我的百姓将他们的荣耀换了那无益的神。
verses.textEnNiv: Has a nation ever changed its gods? (Yet they are not gods at all.) But my people have exchanged their glorious God for worthless idols.
verses.textEnEsv: Has a nation changed its gods, even though they are no gods? But my people have changed their glory for that which does not profit.
verses.textEnNkjv: Has a nation changed its gods, Which are not gods? But My people have changed their Glory For what does not profit.
verses.textEnNlt: Has any nation ever traded its gods for new ones, even though they are not gods at all? Yet my people have exchanged their glorious God for worthless idols!
verses.textEnNasb: "Has a nation changed gods, When they were not gods? But My people have exchanged their glory For that which is of no benefit.
verses.textEn: Has a nation ever changed its gods? (Yet they are not gods at all.) But my people have exchanged their glorious God for worthless idols.

verses.textZh: 诸天哪！你们要因此震惊， 要大大战栗，极其凄凉。" 这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 诸天哪！你们要因此震惊， 要大大战栗，极其凄凉。" 这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 诸天哪，要因此惊奇， 极其恐慌，甚为凄凉！ 这是耶和华说的。
verses.textEnNiv: Be appalled at this, you heavens, and shudder with great horror," declares the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: Be appalled, O heavens, at this; be shocked, be utterly desolate, declares the Lord ,
verses.textEnNkjv: Be astonished, O heavens, at this, And be horribly afraid; Be very desolate," says the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: The heavens are shocked at such a thing and shrink back in horror and dismay," says the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: "Be appalled at this, you heavens, And shudder, be very desolate," declares the Lord.
verses.textEn: Be appalled at this, you heavens, and shudder with great horror," declares the Lord .

verses.textZh: "因为我的子民作了两件恶事， 就是离弃了我这活水的泉源， 为自己凿了池子， 是破裂不能存水的池子。
verses.textZhCnvs: "因为我的子民作了两件恶事， 就是离弃了我这活水的泉源， 为自己凿了池子， 是破裂不能存水的池子。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为我的百姓做了两件恶事， 就是离弃我这活水的泉源， 为自己凿出池子， 是破裂不能存水的池子。
verses.textEnNiv: "My people have committed two sins: They have forsaken me, the spring of living water, and have dug their own cisterns, broken cisterns that cannot hold water.
verses.textEnEsv: for my people have committed two evils: they have forsaken me, the fountain of living waters, and hewed out cisterns for themselves, broken cisterns that can hold no water.
verses.textEnNkjv: "For My people have committed two evils: They have forsaken Me, the fountain of living waters, And hewn themselves cisterns—broken cisterns that can hold no water.
verses.textEnNlt: "For my people have done two evil things: They have abandoned me— the fountain of living water. And they have dug for themselves cracked cisterns that can hold no water at all!
verses.textEnNasb: "For My people have committed two evils: They have abandoned Me, The fountain of living waters, To carve out for themselves cisterns, Broken cisterns That do not hold water.
verses.textEn: "My people have committed two sins: They have forsaken me, the spring of living water, and have dug their own cisterns, broken cisterns that cannot hold water.

verses.textZh: "以色列岂是奴隶，或是在家中生的奴仆呢？ 为甚么竟成了掠物呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: "以色列岂是奴隶，或是在家中生的奴仆呢？ 为甚么竟成了掠物呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列是仆人吗？ 是家中生的奴仆吗？ 为何成为掠物呢？
verses.textEnNiv: Is Israel a servant, a slave by birth? Why then has he become plunder?
verses.textEnEsv: "Is Israel a slave? Is he a homeborn servant? Why then has he become a prey?
verses.textEnNkjv: "Is Israel a servant? Is he a homeborn slave? Why is he plundered?
verses.textEnNlt: "Why has Israel become a slave? Why has he been carried away as plunder?
verses.textEnNasb: "Is Israel a slave? Or is he a servant born in the home? Why has he become plunder?
verses.textEn: Is Israel a servant, a slave by birth? Why then has he become plunder?

verses.textZh: 幼狮都向他咆哮， 大声吼叫， 使他的地荒凉， 城中破毁，无人居住。
verses.textZhCnvs: 幼狮都向他咆哮， 大声吼叫， 使他的地荒凉， 城中破毁，无人居住。
verses.textZhCuv: 少壮狮子向他咆哮，大声吼叫， 使他的地荒凉； 城邑也都焚烧，无人居住。
verses.textEnNiv: Lions have roared; they have growled at him. They have laid waste his land; his towns are burned and deserted.
verses.textEnEsv: The lions have roared against him; they have roared loudly. They have made his land a waste; his cities are in ruins, without inhabitant.
verses.textEnNkjv: The young lions roared at him, and growled; They made his land waste; His cities are burned, without inhabitant.
verses.textEnNlt: Strong lions have roared against him, and the land has been destroyed. The towns are now in ruins, and no one lives in them anymore.
verses.textEnNasb: "The young lions have roared at him, They have roared loudly. And they have made his land a waste; His cities have been destroyed, without inhabitant.
verses.textEn: Lions have roared; they have growled at him. They have laid waste his land; his towns are burned and deserted.

verses.textZh: 挪弗人和答比匿人 也剃光了你的头顶。
verses.textZhCnvs: 挪弗人和答比匿人 也剃光了你的头顶。
verses.textZhCuv: 挪弗人和答比匿人也打破你的头顶。
verses.textEnNiv: Also, the men of Memphis and Tahpanhes have cracked your skull.
verses.textEnEsv: Moreover, the men of Memphis and Tahpanhes have shaved the crown of your head.
verses.textEnNkjv: Also the people of Noph and Tahpanhes Have broken the crown of your head.
verses.textEnNlt: Egyptians, marching from their cities of Memphis and Tahpanhes, have destroyed Israel’s glory and power.
verses.textEnNasb: "Also the men of Memphis and Tahpanhes Have shaved your head.
verses.textEn: Also, the men of Memphis and Tahpanhes have cracked your skull.

verses.textZh: 你这不是自作自受吗？ 耶和华你的神在路上引导你时， 你却离弃了他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你这不是自作自受吗？ 耶和华你的神在路上引导你时， 你却离弃了他。
verses.textZhCuv: 这事临到你身上，不是你自招的吗？ 不是因耶和华－你神引你行路的时候， 你离弃他吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Have you not brought this on yourselves by forsaking the Lord your God when he led you in the way?
verses.textEnEsv: Have you not brought this upon yourself by forsaking the Lord your God, when he led you in the way?
verses.textEnNkjv: Have you not brought this on yourself, In that you have forsaken the Lord your God When He led you in the way?
verses.textEnNlt: And you have brought this upon yourselves by rebelling against the Lord your God, even though he was leading you on the way!
verses.textEnNasb: "Have you not done this to yourself By your abandoning the Lord your God When He led you in the way?
verses.textEn: Have you not brought this on yourselves by forsaking the Lord your God when he led you in the way?

verses.textZh: 现在，你为甚么要到埃及去， 喝西曷的水呢？ 你为甚么要到亚述去， 喝幼发拉底河的水呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在，你为甚么要到埃及去， 喝西曷的水呢？ 你为甚么要到亚述去， 喝幼发拉底河的水呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 现今你为何在埃及路上要喝西曷的水呢？ 你为何在亚述路上要喝大河的水呢？
verses.textEnNiv: Now why go to Egypt to drink water from the Nile ? And why go to Assyria to drink water from the Euphrates?
verses.textEnEsv: And now what do you gain by going to Egypt to drink the waters of the Nile? Or what do you gain by going to Assyria to drink the waters of the Euphrates?
verses.textEnNkjv: And now why take the road to Egypt, To drink the waters of Sihor? Or why take the road to Assyria, To drink the waters of the River?
verses.textEnNlt: "What have you gained by your alliances with Egypt and your covenants with Assyria? What good to you are the streams of the Nile or the waters of the Euphrates River?
verses.textEnNasb: "But now what are you doing on the road to Egypt, Except to drink the waters of the Nile? Or what are you doing on the road to Assyria, Except to drink the waters of the Euphrates River?
verses.textEn: Now why go to Egypt to drink water from the Nile ? And why go to Assyria to drink water from the Euphrates?

verses.textZh: 你自己的罪恶要惩罚你， 你背道的事必责备你。 你当知道，也要明白， 离弃耶和华你的神， 没有畏惧我的心， 是邪恶的，是痛苦的。" 这是主万军之耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你自己的罪恶要惩罚你， 你背道的事必责备你。 你当知道，也要明白， 离弃耶和华你的神， 没有畏惧我的心， 是邪恶的，是痛苦的。" 这是主万军之耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 你自己的恶必惩治你； 你背道的事必责备你。 由此可知可见，你离弃耶和华－你的神， 不存敬畏我的心， 乃为恶事，为苦事。 这是主－万军之耶和华说的。
verses.textEnNiv: Your wickedness will punish you; your backsliding will rebuke you. Consider then and realize how evil and bitter it is for you when you forsake the Lord your God and have no awe of me," declares the Lord, the Lord Almighty.
verses.textEnEsv: Your evil will chastise you, and your apostasy will reprove you. Know and see that it is evil and bitter for you to forsake the Lord your God; the fear of me is not in you, declares the Lord God of hosts.
verses.textEnNkjv: Your own wickedness will correct you, And your backslidings will rebuke you. Know therefore and see that itis an evil and bitter thing That you have forsaken the Lord your God, And the fear of Me is not in you," Says the Lord God of hosts.
verses.textEnNlt: Your wickedness will bring its own punishment. Your turning from me will shame you. You will see what an evil, bitter thing it is to abandon the Lord your God and not to fear him. I, the Lord, the Lord of Heaven’s Armies, have spoken!
verses.textEnNasb: "Your own wickedness will correct you, And your apostasies will punish you; Know therefore and see that it is evil and bitter For you to abandon the Lord your God, And the fear of Me is not in you," declares the Lord God of armies.
verses.textEn: Your wickedness will punish you; your backsliding will rebuke you. Consider then and realize how evil and bitter it is for you when you forsake the Lord your God and have no awe of me," declares the Lord, the Lord Almighty.

verses.textZh: "你从古时就折断了自己的轭， 解开了自己的绳索， 说：‘我不事奉你了。’ 你在每个高冈上， 在每棵繁茂树下， 蹲伏行淫。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你从古时就折断了自己的轭， 解开了自己的绳索， 说：‘我不事奉你了。’ 你在每个高冈上， 在每棵繁茂树下， 蹲伏行淫。
verses.textZhCuv: 我在古时折断你的轭，解开你的绳索。 你说：我必不事奉耶和华； 因为你在各高冈上、各青翠树下屈身行淫 。
verses.textEnNiv: "Long ago you broke off your yoke and tore off your bonds; you said, ‘I will not serve you!’ Indeed, on every high hill and under every spreading tree you lay down as a prostitute.
verses.textEnEsv: "For long ago I broke your yoke and burst your bonds; but you said, ‘I will not serve.’ Yes, on every high hill and under every green tree you bowed down like a whore.
verses.textEnNkjv: "For of old I have broken your yoke and burst your bonds; And you said, ‘I will not transgress,’ When on every high hill and under every green tree You lay down, playing the harlot.
verses.textEnNlt: "Long ago I broke the yoke that oppressed you and tore away the chains of your slavery, but still you said, ‘I will not serve you.’ On every hill and under every green tree, you have prostituted yourselves by bowing down to idols.
verses.textEnNasb: "For long ago I broke your yoke And tore off your restraints; But you said, ‘I will not serve!’ For on every high hill And under every leafy tree You have lain down as a prostitute.
verses.textEn: "Long ago you broke off your yoke and tore off your bonds; you said, ‘I will not serve you!’ Indeed, on every high hill and under every spreading tree you lay down as a prostitute.

verses.textZh: 我栽你时原是上等的葡萄树， 是绝对纯种的； 你怎么在我面前变为坏枝子， 成了野葡萄呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 我栽你时原是上等的葡萄树， 是绝对纯种的； 你怎么在我面前变为坏枝子， 成了野葡萄呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 然而，我栽你是上等的葡萄树， 全然是真种子； 你怎么向我变为外邦葡萄树的坏枝子呢？
verses.textEnNiv: I had planted you like a choice vine of sound and reliable stock. How then did you turn against me into a corrupt, wild vine?
verses.textEnEsv: Yet I planted you a choice vine, wholly of pure seed. How then have you turned degenerate and become a wild vine?
verses.textEnNkjv: Yet I had planted you a noble vine, a seed of highest quality. How then have you turned before Me Into the degenerate plant of an alien vine?
verses.textEnNlt: But I was the one who planted you, choosing a vine of the purest stock—the very best. How did you grow into this corrupt wild vine?
verses.textEnNasb: "Yet I planted you as a choice vine, A completely faithful seed. How then have you turned yourself before Me Into the degenerate shoots of a foreign vine?
verses.textEn: I had planted you like a choice vine of sound and reliable stock. How then did you turn against me into a corrupt, wild vine?

verses.textZh: 你虽然用碱洗涤， 多加肥皂， 你罪孽的污渍仍留在我面前。" 这是主耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你虽然用碱洗涤， 多加肥皂， 你罪孽的污渍仍留在我面前。" 这是主耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 你虽用硷、多用肥皂洗濯， 你罪孽的痕迹仍然在我面前显出。 这是主耶和华说的。
verses.textEnNiv: Although you wash yourself with soap and use an abundance of cleansing powder, the stain of your guilt is still before me," declares the Sovereign Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: Though you wash yourself with lye and use much soap, the stain of your guilt is still before me, declares the Lord God .
verses.textEnNkjv: For though you wash yourself with lye, and use much soap, Yet your iniquity is marked before Me," says the Lord God.
verses.textEnNlt: No amount of soap or lye can make you clean. I still see the stain of your guilt. I, the Sovereign Lord , have spoken!
verses.textEnNasb: "Although you wash yourself with lye And use much soap, The stain of your guilt is before Me," declares the Lord God.
verses.textEn: Although you wash yourself with soap and use an abundance of cleansing powder, the stain of your guilt is still before me," declares the Sovereign Lord .

verses.textZh: "你怎么能说：‘我没有玷污自己， 未曾跟从过巴力’呢？ 看看你在谷中的行径， 想想你所作过的！ 简直像快捷的小雌驼，在路上乱闯；
verses.textZhCnvs: "你怎么能说：‘我没有玷污自己， 未曾跟从过巴力’呢？ 看看你在谷中的行径， 想想你所作过的！ 简直像快捷的小雌驼，在路上乱闯；
verses.textZhCuv: 你怎能说： 我没有玷污、没有随从众巴力？ 你看你谷中的路，就知道你所行的如何。 你是快行的独峰驼，狂奔乱走。
verses.textEnNiv: "How can you say, ‘I am not defiled; I have not run after the Baals’? See how you behaved in the valley; consider what you have done. You are a swift she-camel running here and there,
verses.textEnEsv: How can you say, ‘I am not unclean, I have not gone after the Baals’? Look at your way in the valley; know what you have done— a restless young camel running here and there,
verses.textEnNkjv: "How can you say, ‘I am not polluted, I have not gone after the Baals’? See your way in the valley; Know what you have done: Youare a swift dromedary breaking loose in her ways,
verses.textEnNlt: "You say, ‘That’s not true! I haven’t worshiped the images of Baal!’ But how can you say that? Go and look in any valley in the land! Face the awful sins you have done. You are like a restless female camel desperately searching for a mate.
verses.textEnNasb: "How can you say, ‘I am not defiled, I have not gone after the Baals’? Look at your way in the valley! Know what you have done! You are a swift young camel running about senselessly on her ways,
verses.textEn: "How can you say, ‘I am not defiled; I have not run after the Baals’? See how you behaved in the valley; consider what you have done. You are a swift she-camel running here and there,

verses.textZh: 又像惯在旷野的野驴， 欲心一起就喘气， 牠春情发动，谁能抑制牠呢？ 寻找牠的都不必费力， 在牠的交配期间，必能找到牠。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又像惯在旷野的野驴， 欲心一起就喘气， 牠春情发动，谁能抑制牠呢？ 寻找牠的都不必费力， 在牠的交配期间，必能找到牠。
verses.textZhCuv: 你是野驴，惯在旷野， 欲心发动就吸风； 起性的时候谁能使它转去呢？ 凡寻找它的必不致疲乏； 在它的月分必能寻见。
verses.textEnNiv: a wild donkey accustomed to the desert, sniffing the wind in her craving— in her heat who can restrain her? Any males that pursue her need not tire themselves; at mating time they will find her.
verses.textEnEsv: a wild donkey used to the wilderness, in her heat sniffing the wind! Who can restrain her lust? None who seek her need weary themselves; in her month they will find her.
verses.textEnNkjv: A wild donkey used to the wilderness, That sniffs at the wind in her desire; In her time of mating, who can turn her away? All those who seek her will not weary themselves; In her month they will find her.
verses.textEnNlt: You are like a wild donkey, sniffing the wind at mating time. Who can restrain her lust? Those who desire her don’t need to search, for she goes running to them!
verses.textEnNasb: A wild donkey accustomed to the wilderness, That sniffs the wind in her passion. Who can turn her away in her mating season? None who seek her will grow weary; In her month they will find her.
verses.textEn: a wild donkey accustomed to the desert, sniffing the wind in her craving— in her heat who can restrain her? Any males that pursue her need not tire themselves; at mating time they will find her.

verses.textZh: 不要使你的脚赤露， 你的喉咙干渴！ 你却说：‘没用的！ 因为我爱外族人的神， 我要跟从他们！’
verses.textZhCnvs: 不要使你的脚赤露， 你的喉咙干渴！ 你却说：‘没用的！ 因为我爱外族人的神， 我要跟从他们！’
verses.textZhCuv: 我说：你不要使脚上无鞋， 喉咙干渴。 你倒说：这是枉然。 我喜爱别神，我必随从他们。
verses.textEnNiv: Do not run until your feet are bare and your throat is dry. But you said, ‘It’s no use! I love foreign gods, and I must go after them.’
verses.textEnEsv: Keep your feet from going unshod and your throat from thirst. But you said, ‘It is hopeless, for I have loved foreigners, and after them I will go.’
verses.textEnNkjv: Withhold your foot from being unshod, and your throat from thirst. But you said, ‘There is no hope. No! For I have loved aliens, and after them I will go.’
verses.textEnNlt: When will you stop running? When will you stop panting after other gods? But you say, ‘Save your breath. I’m in love with these foreign gods, and I can’t stop loving them now!’
verses.textEnNasb: "Keep your feet from being bare, And your throat from thirst; But you said, ‘It is hopeless! No! For I have loved strangers, And I will walk after them.’
verses.textEn: Do not run until your feet are bare and your throat is dry. But you said, ‘It’s no use! I love foreign gods, and I must go after them.’

verses.textZh: "贼被捉拿时怎样羞愧， 以色列家和他们的君王、领袖、 祭司和先知， 也都怎样羞愧。
verses.textZhCnvs: "贼被捉拿时怎样羞愧， 以色列家和他们的君王、领袖、 祭司和先知， 也都怎样羞愧。
verses.textZhCuv: 贼被捉拿，怎样羞愧， 以色列家和他们的君王、首领、 祭司、先知也都照样羞愧。
verses.textEnNiv: "As a thief is disgraced when he is caught, so the people of Israel are disgraced— they, their kings and their officials, their priests and their prophets.
verses.textEnEsv: "As a thief is shamed when caught, so the house of Israel shall be shamed: they, their kings, their officials, their priests, and their prophets,
verses.textEnNkjv: "As the thief is ashamed when he is found out, So is the house of Israel ashamed; They and their kings and their princes, and their priests and their prophets,
verses.textEnNlt: "Israel is like a thief who feels shame only when he gets caught. They, their kings, officials, priests, and prophets— all are alike in this.
verses.textEnNasb: "Like the shame of a thief when he is discovered, So the house of Israel is shamed; They, their kings, their leaders, Their priests, and their prophets,
verses.textEn: "As a thief is disgraced when he is caught, so the people of Israel are disgraced— they, their kings and their officials, their priests and their prophets.

verses.textZh: 他们对木头说：‘你是我爸爸’； 对石头说：‘你是生我的’。 他们以背向我， 不以脸向我； 然而遭遇患难时却说： ‘起来，救救我们吧！’
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们对木头说：‘你是我爸爸’； 对石头说：‘你是生我的’。 他们以背向我， 不以脸向我； 然而遭遇患难时却说： ‘起来，救救我们吧！’
verses.textZhCuv: 他们向木头说：你是我的父； 向石头说：你是生我的。 他们以背向我， 不以面向我； 及至遭遇患难的时候却说： 起来拯救我们。
verses.textEnNiv: They say to wood, ‘You are my father,’ and to stone, ‘You gave me birth.’ They have turned their backs to me and not their faces; yet when they are in trouble, they say, ‘Come and save us!’
verses.textEnEsv: who say to a tree, ‘You are my father,’ and to a stone, ‘You gave me birth.’ For they have turned their back to me, and not their face. But in the time of their trouble they say, ‘Arise and save us!’
verses.textEnNkjv: Saying to a tree, ‘You are my father,’ And to a stone, ‘You gave birth to me.’ For they have turned their back to Me, and not their face. But in the time of their trouble They will say, ‘Arise and save us.’
verses.textEnNlt: To an image carved from a piece of wood they say, ‘You are my father.’ To an idol chiseled from a block of stone they say, ‘You are my mother.’ They turn their backs on me, but in times of trouble they cry out to me, ‘Come and save us!’
verses.textEnNasb: Who say to a tree, ‘You are my father,’ And to a stone, ‘You gave me birth.’ For they have turned their backs to Me, And not their faces; But in the time of their trouble they will say, ‘Arise and save us!’
verses.textEn: They say to wood, ‘You are my father,’ and to stone, ‘You gave me birth.’ They have turned their backs to me and not their faces; yet when they are in trouble, they say, ‘Come and save us!’

verses.textZh: 你为自己所做的神在哪里？ 你遭遇患难时， 如果他们能救你，就让他们起来吧！ 犹大啊！你的城有多少， 你的神也有多少！
verses.textZhCnvs: 你为自己所做的神在哪里？ 你遭遇患难时， 如果他们能救你，就让他们起来吧！ 犹大啊！你的城有多少， 你的神也有多少！
verses.textZhCuv: 你为自己做的神在哪里呢？ 你遭遇患难的时候， 叫他们起来拯救你吧！ 犹大啊，你神的数目与你城的数目相等。
verses.textEnNiv: Where then are the gods you made for yourselves? Let them come if they can save you when you are in trouble! For you, Judah, have as many gods as you have towns.
verses.textEnEsv: But where are your gods that you made for yourself? Let them arise, if they can save you, in your time of trouble; for as many as your cities are your gods, O Judah.
verses.textEnNkjv: But where are your gods that you have made for yourselves? Let them arise, If they can save you in the time of your trouble; For accordingto the number of your cities Are your gods, O Judah.
verses.textEnNlt: But why not call on these gods you have made? When trouble comes, let them save you if they can! For you have as many gods as there are towns in Judah.
verses.textEnNasb: "But where are your gods Which you made for yourself? Let them arise, if they can save you In the time of your trouble! For as many as the number of your cities Are your gods, Judah.
verses.textEn: Where then are the gods you made for yourselves? Let them come if they can save you when you are in trouble! For you, Judah, have as many gods as you have towns.

verses.textZh: 你们为甚么跟我争辩呢？ 你们都悖逆了我！" 这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们为甚么跟我争辩呢？ 你们都悖逆了我！" 这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华说： 你们为何与我争辩呢？ 你们都违背了我。
verses.textEnNiv: "Why do you bring charges against me? You have all rebelled against me," declares the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: "Why do you contend with me? You have all transgressed against me, declares the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: "Why will you plead with Me? You all have transgressed against Me," says the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: Why do you accuse me of doing wrong? You are the ones who have rebelled," says the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: "Why do you contend with Me? You have all revolted against Me," declares the Lord.
verses.textEn: "Why do you bring charges against me? You have all rebelled against me," declares the Lord .

verses.textZh: "我责打你们的儿女也是没用， 因为他们不受管教。 你们的刀剑， 像灭命的狮子吞噬你们的先知。
verses.textZhCnvs: "我责打你们的儿女也是没用， 因为他们不受管教。 你们的刀剑， 像灭命的狮子吞噬你们的先知。
verses.textZhCuv: 我责打你们的儿女是徒然的， 他们不受惩治。 你们自己的刀吞灭你们的先知， 好像残害的狮子。
verses.textEnNiv: "In vain I punished your people; they did not respond to correction. Your sword has devoured your prophets like a ravenous lion.
verses.textEnEsv: In vain have I struck your children; they took no correction; your own sword devoured your prophets like a ravening lion.
verses.textEnNkjv: "In vain I have chastened your children; They received no correction. Your sword has devoured your prophets Like a destroying lion.
verses.textEnNlt: "I have punished your children, but they did not respond to my discipline. You yourselves have killed your prophets as a lion kills its prey.
verses.textEnNasb: "In vain I have struck your sons; They did not accept discipline. Your sword has devoured your prophets Like a destroying lion.
verses.textEn: "In vain I punished your people; they did not respond to correction. Your sword has devoured your prophets like a ravenous lion.

verses.textZh: 这世代的人哪！你们要注意耶和华的话： ‘对以色列人来说，难道我是旷野， 或是黑暗的地方？ 我的子民为甚么说：我们自由了， 不再到你那里去了？
verses.textZhCnvs: 这世代的人哪！你们要注意耶和华的话： ‘对以色列人来说，难道我是旷野， 或是黑暗的地方？ 我的子民为甚么说：我们自由了， 不再到你那里去了？
verses.textZhCuv: 这世代的人哪， 你们要看明耶和华的话。 我岂向以色列作旷野呢？ 或作幽暗之地呢？ 我的百姓为何说： 我们脱离约束，再不归向你了？
verses.textEnNiv: "You of this generation, consider the word of the Lord : "Have I been a desert to Israel or a land of great darkness? Why do my people say, ‘We are free to roam; we will come to you no more’?
verses.textEnEsv: And you, O generation, behold the word of the Lord . Have I been a wilderness to Israel, or a land of thick darkness? Why then do my people say, ‘We are free, we will come no more to you’?
verses.textEnNkjv: "O generation, see the word of the Lord! Have I been a wilderness to Israel, Or a land of darkness? Why do My people say, ‘We are lords; We will come no more to You’?
verses.textEnNlt: "O my people, listen to the words of the Lord ! Have I been like a desert to Israel? Have I been to them a land of darkness? Why then do my people say, ‘At last we are free from God! We don’t need him anymore!’
verses.textEnNasb: "You generation, look to the word of the Lord. Have I been a wilderness to Israel, Or a land of thick darkness? Why do My people say, ‘We are free to roam; We will no longer come to You’?
verses.textEn: "You of this generation, consider the word of the Lord : "Have I been a desert to Israel or a land of great darkness? Why do my people say, ‘We are free to roam; we will come to you no more’?

verses.textZh: 少女能忘记她的饰物吗？ 新妇能忘记她的华带吗？ 我的子民却忘记了我， 这些日子无法数算。
verses.textZhCnvs: 少女能忘记她的饰物吗？ 新妇能忘记她的华带吗？ 我的子民却忘记了我， 这些日子无法数算。
verses.textZhCuv: 处女岂能忘记她的妆饰呢？ 新妇岂能忘记她的美衣呢？ 我的百姓却忘记了我无数的日子！
verses.textEnNiv: Does a young woman forget her jewelry, a bride her wedding ornaments? Yet my people have forgotten me, days without number.
verses.textEnEsv: Can a virgin forget her ornaments, or a bride her attire? Yet my people have forgotten me days without number.
verses.textEnNkjv: Can a virgin forget her ornaments, Or a bride her attire? Yet My people have forgotten Me days without number.
verses.textEnNlt: Does a young woman forget her jewelry, or a bride her wedding dress? Yet for years on end my people have forgotten me.
verses.textEnNasb: "Can a virgin forget her jewelry, Or a bride her attire? Yet My people have forgotten Me For days without number.
verses.textEn: Does a young woman forget her jewelry, a bride her wedding ornaments? Yet my people have forgotten me, days without number.

verses.textZh: 你多么通晓门路， 去寻求爱情！ 就连坏女人， 你也可以把门路指教她们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你多么通晓门路， 去寻求爱情！ 就连坏女人， 你也可以把门路指教她们。
verses.textZhCuv: 你怎么修饰你的道路要求爱情呢？ 就是恶劣的妇人你也叫她们行你的路。
verses.textEnNiv: How skilled you are at pursuing love! Even the worst of women can learn from your ways.
verses.textEnEsv: "How well you direct your course to seek love! So that even to wicked women you have taught your ways.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Why do you beautify your way to seek love? Therefore you have also taught The wicked women your ways.
verses.textEnNlt: "How you plot and scheme to win your lovers. Even an experienced prostitute could learn from you!
verses.textEnNasb: "How well you prepare your way To seek love! Therefore even to the wicked women You have taught your ways.
verses.textEn: How skilled you are at pursuing love! Even the worst of women can learn from your ways.

verses.textZh: 在你衣襟上又发现无辜穷人的血， 并且你不是发现他们在挖窟窿时杀他们的。 虽然这样，
verses.textZhCnvs: 在你衣襟上又发现无辜穷人的血， 并且你不是发现他们在挖窟窿时杀他们的。 虽然这样，
verses.textZhCuv: 并且你的衣襟上有无辜穷人的血； 你杀他们并不是遇见他们挖窟窿， 乃是因这一切的事。
verses.textEnNiv: On your clothes is found the lifeblood of the innocent poor, though you did not catch them breaking in. Yet in spite of all this
verses.textEnEsv: Also on your skirts is found the lifeblood of the guiltless poor; you did not find them breaking in. Yet in spite of all these things
verses.textEnNkjv: Also on your skirts is found The blood of the lives of the poor innocents. I have not found it by secret search, But plainly on all these things.
verses.textEnNlt: Your clothing is stained with the blood of the innocent and the poor, though you didn’t catch them breaking into your houses!
verses.textEnNasb: "Also on your skirts is found The lifeblood of the innocent poor; You did not find them breaking in. But in spite of all these things,
verses.textEn: On your clothes is found the lifeblood of the innocent poor, though you did not catch them breaking in. Yet in spite of all this

verses.textZh: 你还说：我是无辜的， 他的怒气必已离开我。 看哪！我要审判你， 因为你曾说：我没有犯罪！
verses.textZhCnvs: 你还说：我是无辜的， 他的怒气必已离开我。 看哪！我要审判你， 因为你曾说：我没有犯罪！
verses.textZhCuv: 你还说：我无辜； 耶和华的怒气必定向我消了。 看哪，我必审问你； 因你自说：我没有犯罪。
verses.textEnNiv: you say, ‘I am innocent; he is not angry with me.’ But I will pass judgment on you because you say, ‘I have not sinned.’
verses.textEnEsv: you say, ‘I am innocent; surely his anger has turned from me.’ Behold, I will bring you to judgment for saying, ‘I have not sinned.’
verses.textEnNkjv: Yet you say, ‘Because I am innocent, Surely His anger shall turn from me.’ Behold, I will plead My case against you, Because you say, ‘I have not sinned.’
verses.textEnNlt: And yet you say, ‘I have done nothing wrong. Surely God isn’t angry with me!’ But now I will punish you severely because you claim you have not sinned.
verses.textEnNasb: You said, ‘I am innocent; Surely His anger is turned away from me.’ Behold, I will enter into judgment with you Because you say, ‘I have not sinned.’
verses.textEn: you say, ‘I am innocent; he is not angry with me.’ But I will pass judgment on you because you say, ‘I have not sinned.’

verses.textZh: 你为甚么要东奔西跑， 改变你的路向呢？ 你必因埃及蒙羞， 像你从前因亚述受辱一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你为甚么要东奔西跑， 改变你的路向呢？ 你必因埃及蒙羞， 像你从前因亚述受辱一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 你为何东跑西奔要更换你的路呢？ 你必因埃及蒙羞， 像从前因亚述蒙羞一样。
verses.textEnNiv: Why do you go about so much, changing your ways? You will be disappointed by Egypt as you were by Assyria.
verses.textEnEsv: How much you go about, changing your way! You shall be put to shame by Egypt as you were put to shame by Assyria.
verses.textEnNkjv: Why do you gad about so much to change your way? Also you shall be ashamed of Egypt as you were ashamed of Assyria.
verses.textEnNlt: First here, then there— you flit from one ally to another asking for help. But your new friends in Egypt will let you down, just as Assyria did before.
verses.textEnNasb: "Why do you go around so much Changing your way? Also, you will be put to shame by Egypt, Just as you were put to shame by Assyria.
verses.textEn: Why do you go about so much, changing your ways? You will be disappointed by Egypt as you were by Assyria.

verses.textZh: 你必双手抱头从埃及出来， 因为耶和华弃绝了你所倚靠的， 你靠他们必不能成功。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你必双手抱头从埃及出来， 因为耶和华弃绝了你所倚靠的， 你靠他们必不能成功。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 你也必两手抱头从埃及出来； 因为耶和华已经弃绝你所倚靠的， 你必不因他们得顺利。
verses.textEnNiv: You will also leave that place with your hands on your head, for the Lord has rejected those you trust; you will not be helped by them.
verses.textEnEsv: From it too you will come away with your hands on your head, for the Lord has rejected those in whom you trust, and you will not prosper by them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Indeed you will go forth from him With your hands on your head; For the Lord has rejected your trusted allies, And you will not prosper by them.
verses.textEnNlt: In despair, you will be led into exile with your hands on your heads, for the Lord has rejected the nations you trust. They will not help you at all.
verses.textEnNasb: "From this place as well you will go out With your hands on your head; For the Lord has rejected those in whom you trust, And you will not prosper with them."
verses.textEn: You will also leave that place with your hands on your head, for the Lord has rejected those you trust; you will not be helped by them.

verses.textZh: 耶和华说："人若是休妻， 妻子离开了他， 又嫁了别人， 前夫怎能与她复合呢？ 如果复合，那地不是大大玷污了吗？ 你曾与许多情人行淫， 还想归向我。" 这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华说："人若是休妻， 妻子离开了他， 又嫁了别人， 前夫怎能与她复合呢？ 如果复合，那地不是大大玷污了吗？ 你曾与许多情人行淫， 还想归向我。" 这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 有话说：人若休妻， 妻离他而去，作了别人的妻， 前夫岂能再收回她来？ 若收回她来，那地岂不是大大玷污了吗？ 但你和许多亲爱的行邪淫， 还可以归向我。 这是耶和华说的。
verses.textEnNiv: "If a man divorces his wife and she leaves him and marries another man, should he return to her again? Would not the land be completely defiled? But you have lived as a prostitute with many lovers— would you now return to me?" declares the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: "If a man divorces his wife and she goes from him and becomes another man’s wife, will he return to her? Would not that land be greatly polluted? You have played the whore with many lovers; and would you return to me? declares the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: "They say, ‘If a man divorces his wife, And she goes from him And becomes another man’s, May he return to her again?’ Would not that land be greatly polluted? But you have played the harlot with many lovers; Yet return to Me," says the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: "If a man divorces a woman and she goes and marries someone else, he will not take her back again, for that would surely corrupt the land. But you have prostituted yourself with many lovers, so why are you trying to come back to me?" says the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: God says, "If a husband divorces his wife And she leaves him And becomes another man’s wife, Will he return to her again? Would that land not be completely defiled? But you are a prostitute with many lovers; Yet you turn to Me," declares the Lord.
verses.textEn: "If a man divorces his wife and she leaves him and marries another man, should he return to her again? Would not the land be completely defiled? But you have lived as a prostitute with many lovers— would you now return to me?" declares the Lord .

verses.textZh: "你向光秃的高冈举目看看， 哪里没有你的淫迹？ 你坐在路边等候情人， 像阿拉伯人在旷野埋伏一样。 你以淫乱和邪恶， 把这地玷污了。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你向光秃的高冈举目看看， 哪里没有你的淫迹？ 你坐在路边等候情人， 像阿拉伯人在旷野埋伏一样。 你以淫乱和邪恶， 把这地玷污了。
verses.textZhCuv: 你向净光的高处举目观看， 你在何处没有淫行呢？ 你坐在道旁等候， 好像阿拉伯人在旷野埋伏一样， 并且你的淫行邪恶玷污了全地。
verses.textEnNiv: "Look up to the barren heights and see. Is there any place where you have not been ravished? By the roadside you sat waiting for lovers, sat like a nomad in the desert. You have defiled the land with your prostitution and wickedness.
verses.textEnEsv: Lift up your eyes to the bare heights, and see! Where have you not been ravished? By the waysides you have sat awaiting lovers like an Arab in the wilderness. You have polluted the land with your vile whoredom.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Lift up your eyes to the desolate heights and see: Where have you not lain withmen? By the road you have sat for them Like an Arabian in the wilderness; And you have polluted the land With your harlotries and your wickedness.
verses.textEnNlt: "Look at the shrines on every hilltop. Is there any place you have not been defiled by your adultery with other gods? You sit like a prostitute beside the road waiting for a customer. You sit alone like a nomad in the desert. You have polluted the land with your prostitution and your wickedness.
verses.textEnNasb: "Raise your eyes to the bare heights and see; Where have you not been violated? You have sat for them by the roads Like an Arab in the desert, And you have defiled a land With your prostitution and your wickedness.
verses.textEn: "Look up to the barren heights and see. Is there any place where you have not been ravished? By the roadside you sat waiting for lovers, sat like a nomad in the desert. You have defiled the land with your prostitution and wickedness.

verses.textZh: 所以甘霖停止， 春雨不降； 你还是一副妓女的面孔 ， 不顾羞耻。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以甘霖停止， 春雨不降； 你还是一副妓女的面孔 ， 不顾羞耻。
verses.textZhCuv: 因此甘霖停止， 春 雨不降。 你还是有娼妓之脸， 不顾羞耻。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore the showers have been withheld, and no spring rains have fallen. Yet you have the brazen look of a prostitute; you refuse to blush with shame.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore the showers have been withheld, and the spring rain has not come; yet you have the forehead of a whore; you refuse to be ashamed.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore the showers have been withheld, And there has been no latter rain. You have had a harlot’s forehead; You refuse to be ashamed.
verses.textEnNlt: That’s why even the spring rains have failed. For you are a brazen prostitute and completely shameless.
verses.textEnNasb: "Therefore the showers have been withheld, And there has been no spring rain. Yet you had a prostitute’s forehead; You refused to be ashamed.
verses.textEn: Therefore the showers have been withheld, and no spring rains have fallen. Yet you have the brazen look of a prostitute; you refuse to blush with shame.

verses.textZh: 你刚刚不是还呼叫我：‘我父啊！ 你是我年轻时的良伴；
verses.textZhCnvs: 你刚刚不是还呼叫我：‘我父啊！ 你是我年轻时的良伴；
verses.textZhCuv: 从今以后，你岂不向我呼叫说： 我父啊，你是我幼年的恩主。
verses.textEnNiv: Have you not just called to me: ‘My Father, my friend from my youth,
verses.textEnEsv: Have you not just now called to me, ‘My father, you are the friend of my youth—
verses.textEnNkjv: Will you not from this time cry to Me, ‘My Father, You are the guide of my youth?
verses.textEnNlt: Yet you say to me, ‘Father, you have been my guide since my youth.
verses.textEnNasb: "Have you not just now called to Me, ‘My Father, You are the friend of my youth?
verses.textEn: Have you not just called to me: ‘My Father, my friend from my youth,

verses.textZh: 耶和华怎会永远怀怒， 常存愤恨呢？’ 你虽然这样说了， 还是尽力去作恶。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华怎会永远怀怒， 常存愤恨呢？’ 你虽然这样说了， 还是尽力去作恶。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华岂永远怀怒，存留到底吗？ 看哪，你又发恶言又行坏事， 随自己的私意而行 。」
verses.textEnNiv: will you always be angry? Will your wrath continue forever?’ This is how you talk, but you do all the evil you can."
verses.textEnEsv: will he be angry forever, will he be indignant to the end?’ Behold, you have spoken, but you have done all the evil that you could."
verses.textEnNkjv: Will He remain angry forever? Will He keep it to the end?’ Behold, you have spoken and done evil things, As you were able."
verses.textEnNlt: Surely you won’t be angry forever! Surely you can forget about it!’ So you talk, but you keep on doing all the evil you can."
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Will He be angry forever, Or keep His anger to the end?’ Behold, you have spoken And have done evil things, And you have had your own way."
verses.textEn: will you always be angry? Will your wrath continue forever?’ This is how you talk, but you do all the evil you can."

verses.textZh: 约西亚王在位的日子，耶和华对我说："背道的以色列所作的，她怎样走上各高山，在每棵繁茂的树下行淫，你看见了没有？
verses.textZhCnvs: 约西亚王在位的日子，耶和华对我说："背道的以色列所作的，她怎样走上各高山，在每棵繁茂的树下行淫，你看见了没有？
verses.textZhCuv: 约西亚王在位的时候，耶和华又对我说：「背道的以色列所行的，你看见没有？她上各高山，在各青翠树下行淫。
verses.textEnNiv: During the reign of King Josiah, the Lord said to me, "Have you seen what faithless Israel has done? She has gone up on every high hill and under every spreading tree and has committed adultery there.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord said to me in the days of King Josiah: "Have you seen what she did, that faithless one, Israel, how she went up on every high hill and under every green tree, and there played the whore?
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord said also to me in the days of Josiah the king: "Have you seen what backsliding Israel has done? She has gone up on every high mountain and under every green tree, and there played the harlot.
verses.textEnNlt: During the reign of King Josiah, the Lord said to me, "Have you seen what fickle Israel has done? Like a wife who commits adultery, Israel has worshiped other gods on every hill and under every green tree.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord said to me in the days of King Josiah, "Have you seen what faithless Israel did? She went up on every high hill and under every leafy tree, and she prostituted herself there.
verses.textEn: During the reign of King Josiah, the Lord said to me, "Have you seen what faithless Israel has done? She has gone up on every high hill and under every spreading tree and has committed adultery there.

verses.textZh: 我以为她作了这些事以后，就必回转过来，可是她没有回转。她诡诈的妹妹犹大也看见了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我以为她作了这些事以后，就必回转过来，可是她没有回转。她诡诈的妹妹犹大也看见了。
verses.textZhCuv: 她行这些事以后，我说她必归向我，她却不归向我。她奸诈的妹妹犹大也看见了。
verses.textEnNiv: I thought that after she had done all this she would return to me but she did not, and her unfaithful sister Judah saw it.
verses.textEnEsv: And I thought, ‘After she has done all this she will return to me,’ but she did not return, and her treacherous sister Judah saw it.
verses.textEnNkjv: And I said, after she had done all these things, ‘Return to Me.’ But she did not return. And her treacherous sister Judah saw it.
verses.textEnNlt: I thought, ‘After she has done all this, she will return to me.’ But she did not return, and her faithless sister Judah saw this.
verses.textEnNasb: Yet I thought, ‘After she has done all these things she will return to Me’; but she did not return, and her treacherous sister Judah saw it.
verses.textEn: I thought that after she had done all this she would return to me but she did not, and her unfaithful sister Judah saw it.

verses.textZh: 因背道的以色列犯了淫乱，我就给她休书，把她休了。我看见她诡诈的妹妹犹大还是不惧怕，照样行淫。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因背道的以色列犯了淫乱，我就给她休书，把她休了。我看见她诡诈的妹妹犹大还是不惧怕，照样行淫。
verses.textZhCuv: 背道的以色列行淫，我为这缘故给她休书休她；我看见她奸诈的妹妹犹大，还不惧怕，也去行淫。
verses.textEnNiv: I gave faithless Israel her certificate of divorce and sent her away because of all her adulteries. Yet I saw that her unfaithful sister Judah had no fear; she also went out and committed adultery.
verses.textEnEsv: She saw that for all the adulteries of that faithless one, Israel, I had sent her away with a decree of divorce. Yet her treacherous sister Judah did not fear, but she too went and played the whore.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then I saw that for all the causes for which backsliding Israel had committed adultery, I had put her away and given her a certificate of divorce; yet her treacherous sister Judah did not fear, but went and played the harlot also.
verses.textEnNlt: She saw that I divorced faithless Israel because of her adultery. But that treacherous sister Judah had no fear, and now she, too, has left me and given herself to prostitution.
verses.textEnNasb: And I saw that for all the adulteries of faithless Israel, I had sent her away and given her a certificate of divorce, yet her treacherous sister Judah did not fear; but she went and prostituted herself also.
verses.textEn: I gave faithless Israel her certificate of divorce and sent her away because of all her adulteries. Yet I saw that her unfaithful sister Judah had no fear; she also went out and committed adultery.

verses.textZh: 因以色列把自己的淫行视作等闲，去与石头木头行淫，就把这地玷污了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因以色列把自己的淫行视作等闲，去与石头木头行淫，就把这地玷污了。
verses.textZhCuv: 因以色列轻忽了她的淫乱，和石头木头行淫，地就被玷污了。
verses.textEnNiv: Because Israel’s immorality mattered so little to her, she defiled the land and committed adultery with stone and wood.
verses.textEnEsv: Because she took her whoredom lightly, she polluted the land, committing adultery with stone and tree.
verses.textEnNkjv: So it came to pass, through her casual harlotry, that she defiled the land and committed adultery with stones and trees.
verses.textEnNlt: Israel treated it all so lightly—she thought nothing of committing adultery by worshiping idols made of wood and stone. So now the land has been polluted.
verses.textEnNasb: And because of the thoughtlessness of her prostitution, she defiled the land and committed adultery with stones and trees.
verses.textEn: Because Israel’s immorality mattered so little to her, she defiled the land and committed adultery with stone and wood.

verses.textZh: 虽然这样，她诡诈的妹妹犹大还没有全心归向我，只是假意地归我。"这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 虽然这样，她诡诈的妹妹犹大还没有全心归向我，只是假意地归我。"这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 虽有这一切的事，她奸诈的妹妹犹大还不一心归向我，不过是假意归我。这是耶和华说的。」
verses.textEnNiv: In spite of all this, her unfaithful sister Judah did not return to me with all her heart, but only in pretense," declares the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: Yet for all this her treacherous sister Judah did not return to me with her whole heart, but in pretense, declares the Lord ."
verses.textEnNkjv: And yet for all this her treacherous sister Judah has not turned to Me with her whole heart, but in pretense," says the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: But despite all this, her faithless sister Judah has never sincerely returned to me. She has only pretended to be sorry. I, the Lord , have spoken!"
verses.textEnNasb: Yet in spite of all this her treacherous sister Judah did not return to Me with all her heart, but rather in deception," declares the Lord.
verses.textEn: In spite of all this, her unfaithful sister Judah did not return to me with all her heart, but only in pretense," declares the Lord .

verses.textZh: 耶和华对我说："背道的以色列，比诡诈的犹大还显得正义。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对我说："背道的以色列，比诡诈的犹大还显得正义。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华对我说：「背道的以色列比奸诈的犹大还显为义。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord said to me, "Faithless Israel is more righteous than unfaithful Judah.
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord said to me, "Faithless Israel has shown herself more righteous than treacherous Judah.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Lord said to me, "Backsliding Israel has shown herself more righteous than treacherous Judah.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord said to me, "Even faithless Israel is less guilty than treacherous Judah!
verses.textEnNasb: And the Lord said to me, "Faithless Israel has proved herself to be more righteous than treacherous Judah.
verses.textEn: The Lord said to me, "Faithless Israel is more righteous than unfaithful Judah.

verses.textZh: 你去，把这些话向北方宣告，说： ‘背道的以色列啊，回转吧！’ 这是耶和华的宣告。 ‘我必不向你们变脸， 因为我是慈爱的， 我必不永远怀怒。’ 这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你去，把这些话向北方宣告，说： ‘背道的以色列啊，回转吧！’ 这是耶和华的宣告。 ‘我必不向你们变脸， 因为我是慈爱的， 我必不永远怀怒。’ 这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 你去向北方宣告说： 耶和华说：背道的以色列啊，回来吧！ 我必不怒目看你们； 因为我是慈爱的， 我必不永远存怒。 这是耶和华说的。
verses.textEnNiv: Go, proclaim this message toward the north: " ‘Return, faithless Israel,’ declares the Lord , ‘I will frown on you no longer, for I am faithful,’ declares the Lord , ‘I will not be angry forever.
verses.textEnEsv: Go, and proclaim these words toward the north, and say, "‘Return, faithless Israel, declares the Lord . I will not look on you in anger, for I am merciful, declares the Lord ; I will not be angry forever.
verses.textEnNkjv: Go and proclaim these words toward the north, and say: ‘Return, backsliding Israel,’ says the Lord; ‘I will not cause My anger to fall on you. For I am merciful,’ says the Lord; ‘I will not remain angry forever.
verses.textEnNlt: Therefore, go and give this message to Israel. This is what the Lord says: "O Israel, my faithless people, come home to me again, for I am merciful. I will not be angry with you forever.
verses.textEnNasb: Go and proclaim these words toward the north and say, ‘Return, faithless Israel,’ declares the Lord; ‘I will not look at you in anger. For I am gracious,’ declares the Lord; ‘I will not be angry forever.
verses.textEn: Go, proclaim this message toward the north: " ‘Return, faithless Israel,’ declares the Lord , ‘I will frown on you no longer, for I am faithful,’ declares the Lord , ‘I will not be angry forever.

verses.textZh: ‘只要你承认自己的罪孽， 就是悖逆了耶和华你的神， 在每棵繁茂的树下，滥爱外族人的神， 没有听从我的话。’ 这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: ‘只要你承认自己的罪孽， 就是悖逆了耶和华你的神， 在每棵繁茂的树下，滥爱外族人的神， 没有听从我的话。’ 这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 只要承认你的罪孽， 就是你违背耶和华－你的神， 在各青翠树下向别神东奔西跑， 没有听从我的话。 这是耶和华说的。
verses.textEnNiv: Only acknowledge your guilt— you have rebelled against the Lord your God, you have scattered your favors to foreign gods under every spreading tree, and have not obeyed me,’ " declares the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: Only acknowledge your guilt, that you rebelled against the Lord your God and scattered your favors among foreigners under every green tree, and that you have not obeyed my voice, declares the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: Only acknowledge your iniquity, That you have transgressed against the Lord your God, And have scattered your charms To alien deities under every green tree, And you have not obeyed My voice,’ says the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: Only acknowledge your guilt. Admit that you rebelled against the Lord your God and committed adultery against him by worshiping idols under every green tree. Confess that you refused to listen to my voice. I, the Lord , have spoken!
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Only acknowledge your wrongdoing, That you have revolted against the Lord your God, And have scattered your favors to the strangers under every leafy tree, And you have not obeyed My voice,’ declares the Lord.
verses.textEn: Only acknowledge your guilt— you have rebelled against the Lord your God, you have scattered your favors to foreign gods under every spreading tree, and have not obeyed me,’ " declares the Lord .

verses.textZh: ‘背道的人哪，回转吧！’ 这是耶和华的宣告。 ‘因为我才是你们的主。 我要每城取一人，每族取二人， 把你们带到锡安。
verses.textZhCnvs: ‘背道的人哪，回转吧！’ 这是耶和华的宣告。 ‘因为我才是你们的主。 我要每城取一人，每族取二人， 把你们带到锡安。
