verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华说：背道的儿女啊，回来吧！ 因为我作你们的丈夫， 并且我必将你们从一城取一人， 从一族取两人，带到锡安。
verses.textEnNiv: "Return, faithless people," declares the Lord , "for I am your husband. I will choose you—one from a town and two from a clan—and bring you to Zion.
verses.textEnEsv: Return, O faithless children, declares the Lord ; for I am your master; I will take you, one from a city and two from a family, and I will bring you to Zion.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Return, O backsliding children," says the Lord; "for I am married to you. I will take you, one from a city and two from a family, and I will bring you to Zion.
verses.textEnNlt: "Return home, you wayward children," says the Lord , "for I am your master. I will bring you back to the land of Israel — one from this town and two from that family— from wherever you are scattered.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Return, you faithless sons,’ declares the Lord; ‘For I am a master to you, And I will take you, one from a city and two from a family, And bring you to Zion.’
verses.textEn: "Return, faithless people," declares the Lord , "for I am your husband. I will choose you—one from a town and two from a clan—and bring you to Zion.

verses.textZh: "我必把合我心意的牧人赐给你们，他们要用知识和智慧牧养你们。
verses.textZhCnvs: "我必把合我心意的牧人赐给你们，他们要用知识和智慧牧养你们。
verses.textZhCuv: 我也必将合我心的牧者赐给你们。他们必以知识和智慧牧养你们。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then I will give you shepherds after my own heart, who will lead you with knowledge and understanding.
verses.textEnEsv: "‘And I will give you shepherds after my own heart, who will feed you with knowledge and understanding.
verses.textEnNkjv: And I will give you shepherds according to My heart, who will feed you with knowledge and understanding.
verses.textEnNlt: And I will give you shepherds after my own heart, who will guide you with knowledge and understanding.
verses.textEnNasb: "Then I will give you shepherds after My own heart, who will feed you knowledge and understanding.
verses.textEn: Then I will give you shepherds after my own heart, who will lead you with knowledge and understanding.

verses.textZh: 当那些日子，你们在这地繁衍增多的时候，人必不再提说耶和华的约柜，不把它放在心上，不思念它，不觉得缺少，也不再制造。’这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 当那些日子，你们在这地繁衍增多的时候，人必不再提说耶和华的约柜，不把它放在心上，不思念它，不觉得缺少，也不再制造。’这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华说：「你们在国中生养众多；当那些日子，人必不再提说耶和华的约柜，不追想，不记念，不觉缺少，也不再制造。
verses.textEnNiv: In those days, when your numbers have increased greatly in the land," declares the Lord , "people will no longer say, ‘The ark of the covenant of the Lord .’ It will never enter their minds or be remembered; it will not be missed, nor will another one be made.
verses.textEnEsv: And when you have multiplied and been fruitful in the land, in those days, declares the Lord , they shall no more say, "The ark of the covenant of the Lord ." It shall not come to mind or be remembered or missed; it shall not be made again.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Then it shall come to pass, when you are multiplied and increased in the land in those days," says the Lord, "that they will say no more, ‘The ark of the covenant of the Lord.’ It shall not come to mind, nor shall they remember it, nor shall they visit it, nor shall it be made anymore.
verses.textEnNlt: "And when your land is once more filled with people," says the Lord , "you will no longer wish for ‘the good old days’ when you possessed the Ark of the Lord ’s Covenant. You will not miss those days or even remember them, and there will be no need to rebuild the Ark.
verses.textEnNasb: And it shall be in those days when you become numerous and are fruitful in the land," declares the Lord, "they will no longer say, ‘The ark of the covenant of the Lord.’ And it will not come to mind, nor will they remember it, nor miss it, nor will it be made again.
verses.textEn: In those days, when your numbers have increased greatly in the land," declares the Lord , "people will no longer say, ‘The ark of the covenant of the Lord .’ It will never enter their minds or be remembered; it will not be missed, nor will another one be made.

verses.textZh: ‘那时，人必称耶路撒冷为耶和华的宝座，万国要聚集到她那里，因耶和华名的缘故来到耶路撒冷；他们必不再随从自己顽梗的恶心行事。
verses.textZhCnvs: ‘那时，人必称耶路撒冷为耶和华的宝座，万国要聚集到她那里，因耶和华名的缘故来到耶路撒冷；他们必不再随从自己顽梗的恶心行事。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时，人必称耶路撒冷为耶和华的宝座；万国必到耶路撒冷，在耶和华立名的地方聚集。他们必不再随从自己顽梗的恶心行事。
verses.textEnNiv: At that time they will call Jerusalem The Throne of the Lord , and all nations will gather in Jerusalem to honor the name of the Lord . No longer will they follow the stubbornness of their evil hearts.
verses.textEnEsv: At that time Jerusalem shall be called the throne of the Lord , and all nations shall gather to it, to the presence of the Lord in Jerusalem, and they shall no more stubbornly follow their own evil heart.
verses.textEnNkjv: "At that time Jerusalem shall be called The Throne of the Lord, and all the nations shall be gathered to it, to the name of the Lord, to Jerusalem. No more shall they follow the dictates of their evil hearts.
verses.textEnNlt: In that day Jerusalem will be known as ‘The Throne of the Lord .’ All nations will come there to honor the Lord . They will no longer stubbornly follow their own evil desires.
verses.textEnNasb: At that time they will call Jerusalem ‘The Throne of the Lord,’ and all the nations will assemble at it, at Jerusalem, for the name of the Lord; and they will no longer follow the stubbornness of their evil heart.
verses.textEn: At that time they will call Jerusalem The Throne of the Lord , and all nations will gather in Jerusalem to honor the name of the Lord . No longer will they follow the stubbornness of their evil hearts.

verses.textZh: 在那些日子，犹大家必与以色列家同行，他们必从北方之地一同来到我赐给你们列祖为业的地方。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 在那些日子，犹大家必与以色列家同行，他们必从北方之地一同来到我赐给你们列祖为业的地方。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 当那些日子，犹大家要和以色列家同行，从北方之地一同来到我赐给你们列祖为业之地。」
verses.textEnNiv: In those days the people of Judah will join the people of Israel, and together they will come from a northern land to the land I gave your ancestors as an inheritance.
verses.textEnEsv: In those days the house of Judah shall join the house of Israel, and together they shall come from the land of the north to the land that I gave your fathers for a heritage.
verses.textEnNkjv: "In those days the house of Judah shall walk with the house of Israel, and they shall come together out of the land of the north to the land that I have given as an inheritance to your fathers.
verses.textEnNlt: In those days the people of Judah and Israel will return together from exile in the north. They will return to the land I gave your ancestors as an inheritance forever.
verses.textEnNasb: In those days the house of Judah will walk with the house of Israel, and they will come together from the land of the north to the land that I gave your fathers as an inheritance.
verses.textEn: In those days the people of Judah will join the people of Israel, and together they will come from a northern land to the land I gave your ancestors as an inheritance.

verses.textZh: "我说： ‘我待你，像待儿女一样， 赐给你佳美之地， 就是列国中最美好的产业； 我以为你会称我为父， 不再离去不跟从我了。
verses.textZhCnvs: "我说： ‘我待你，像待儿女一样， 赐给你佳美之地， 就是列国中最美好的产业； 我以为你会称我为父， 不再离去不跟从我了。
verses.textZhCuv: 我说：我怎样将你安置在儿女之中， 赐给你美地， 就是万国中肥美的产业。 我又说：你们必称我为父， 也不再转去不跟从我。
verses.textEnNiv: "I myself said, " ‘How gladly would I treat you like my children and give you a pleasant land, the most beautiful inheritance of any nation.’ I thought you would call me ‘Father’ and not turn away from following me.
verses.textEnEsv: "‘I said, How I would set you among my sons, and give you a pleasant land, a heritage most beautiful of all nations. And I thought you would call me, My Father, and would not turn from following me.
verses.textEnNkjv: "But I said: ‘How can I put you among the children And give you a pleasant land, A beautiful heritage of the hosts of nations?’ "And I said: ‘You shall call Me, "My Father," And not turn away from Me.’
verses.textEnNlt: "I thought to myself, ‘I would love to treat you as my own children!’ I wanted nothing more than to give you this beautiful land— the finest possession in the world. I looked forward to your calling me ‘Father,’ and I wanted you never to turn from me.
verses.textEnNasb: "Then I said, ‘How I would set you among My sons And give you a pleasant land, The most beautiful inheritance of the nations!’ And I said, ‘You shall call Me, My Father, And not turn away from following Me.’
verses.textEn: "I myself said, " ‘How gladly would I treat you like my children and give you a pleasant land, the most beautiful inheritance of any nation.’ I thought you would call me ‘Father’ and not turn away from following me.

verses.textZh: 以色列家啊！ 妻子怎样行奸诈对丈夫不忠， 你也照样以奸诈待我。’" 这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列家啊！ 妻子怎样行奸诈对丈夫不忠， 你也照样以奸诈待我。’" 这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列家，你们向我行诡诈， 真像妻子行诡诈离开她丈夫一样。 这是耶和华说的。
verses.textEnNiv: But like a woman unfaithful to her husband, so you, Israel, have been unfaithful to me," declares the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: Surely, as a treacherous wife leaves her husband, so have you been treacherous to me, O house of Israel, declares the Lord .’"
verses.textEnNkjv: Surely, as a wife treacherously departs from her husband, So have you dealt treacherously with Me, O house of Israel," says the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: But you have been unfaithful to me, you people of Israel! You have been like a faithless wife who leaves her husband. I, the Lord , have spoken."
verses.textEnNasb: "However, as a woman treacherously leaves her lover, So you have dealt treacherously with Me, House of Israel," declares the Lord.
verses.textEn: But like a woman unfaithful to her husband, so you, Israel, have been unfaithful to me," declares the Lord .

verses.textZh: 在光秃的高冈听到人声， 就是以色列人哭泣恳求的声音； 因为他们改转了自己的道路， 忘记了耶和华他们的神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在光秃的高冈听到人声， 就是以色列人哭泣恳求的声音； 因为他们改转了自己的道路， 忘记了耶和华他们的神。
verses.textZhCuv: 在净光的高处听见人声， 就是以色列人哭泣恳求之声， 乃因他们走弯曲之道， 忘记耶和华－他们的神。
verses.textEnNiv: A cry is heard on the barren heights, the weeping and pleading of the people of Israel, because they have perverted their ways and have forgotten the Lord their God.
verses.textEnEsv: A voice on the bare heights is heard, the weeping and pleading of Israel’s sons because they have perverted their way; they have forgotten the Lord their God.
verses.textEnNkjv: A voice was heard on the desolate heights, Weeping and supplications of the children of Israel. For they have perverted their way; They have forgotten the Lord their God.
verses.textEnNlt: Voices are heard high on the windswept mountains, the weeping and pleading of Israel’s people. For they have chosen crooked paths and have forgotten the Lord their God.
verses.textEnNasb: A voice is heard on the bare heights, The weeping, the pleading of the sons of Israel. Because they have perverted their way, They have forgotten the Lord their God.
verses.textEn: A cry is heard on the barren heights, the weeping and pleading of the people of Israel, because they have perverted their ways and have forgotten the Lord their God.

verses.textZh: "背道的人哪，回转吧！ 我必医治你们背道的病。" "看哪！我们来到你这里， 因为你是耶和华我们的神！
verses.textZhCnvs: "背道的人哪，回转吧！ 我必医治你们背道的病。" "看哪！我们来到你这里， 因为你是耶和华我们的神！
verses.textZhCuv: 你们这背道的儿女啊，回来吧！ 我要医治你们背道的病。 看哪，我们来到你这里， 因你是耶和华－我们的神。
verses.textEnNiv: "Return, faithless people; I will cure you of backsliding." "Yes, we will come to you, for you are the Lord our God.
verses.textEnEsv: "Return, O faithless sons; I will heal your faithlessness." "Behold, we come to you, for you are the Lord our God.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Return, you backsliding children, And I will heal your backslidings." "Indeed we do come to You, For You are the Lord our God.
verses.textEnNlt: "My wayward children," says the Lord , "come back to me, and I will heal your wayward hearts." "Yes, we’re coming," the people reply, "for you are the Lord our God.
verses.textEnNasb: "Return, you faithless sons, I will heal your faithlessness." "Behold, we come to You; For You are the Lord our God.
verses.textEn: "Return, faithless people; I will cure you of backsliding." "Yes, we will come to you, for you are the Lord our God.

verses.textZh: 小山和大山上的喧嚷，真是徒然的， 以色列的救恩诚然在于耶和华我们的神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 小山和大山上的喧嚷，真是徒然的， 以色列的救恩诚然在于耶和华我们的神。
verses.textZhCuv: 仰望从小山或从大山的喧嚷中得帮助， 真是枉然的。 以色列得救，诚然在乎耶和华－我们的神。
verses.textEnNiv: Surely the idolatrous commotion on the hills and mountains is a deception; surely in the Lord our God is the salvation of Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: Truly the hills are a delusion, the orgies on the mountains. Truly in the Lord our God is the salvation of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: Truly, in vain issalvationhopedfor from the hills, Andfrom the multitude of mountains; Truly, in the Lord our God Is the salvation of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: Our worship of idols on the hills and our religious orgies on the mountains are a delusion. Only in the Lord our God will Israel ever find salvation.
verses.textEnNasb: "Certainly the hills are a deception, Commotion on the mountains. Certainly in the Lord our God Is the salvation of Israel.
verses.textEn: Surely the idolatrous commotion on the hills and mountains is a deception; surely in the Lord our God is the salvation of Israel.

verses.textZh: 从我们幼年以来，我们列祖劳苦得来的，他们的牛羊，他们的儿女，都给那可耻的偶像吞掉了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 从我们幼年以来，我们列祖劳苦得来的，他们的牛羊，他们的儿女，都给那可耻的偶像吞掉了。
verses.textZhCuv: 从我们幼年以来，那可耻的偶像将我们列祖所劳碌得来的羊群、牛群，和他们的儿女都吞吃了。
verses.textEnNiv: From our youth shameful gods have consumed the fruits of our ancestors’ labor— their flocks and herds, their sons and daughters.
verses.textEnEsv: "But from our youth the shameful thing has devoured all for which our fathers labored, their flocks and their herds, their sons and their daughters.
verses.textEnNkjv: For shame has devoured The labor of our fathers from our youth— Their flocks and their herds, Their sons and their daughters.
verses.textEnNlt: From childhood we have watched as everything our ancestors worked for— their flocks and herds, their sons and daughters— was squandered on a delusion.
verses.textEnNasb: "But the shame has consumed the product of our fathers’ labor since our youth—their flocks and their herds, their sons and their daughters.
verses.textEn: From our youth shameful gods have consumed the fruits of our ancestors’ labor— their flocks and herds, their sons and daughters.

verses.textZh: 但愿我们躺卧在羞耻中，让惭愧遮盖着我们！因为我们得罪了耶和华我们的神，从我们幼年直到现在，我们和列祖都没有听从耶和华我们的神的话。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 但愿我们躺卧在羞耻中，让惭愧遮盖着我们！因为我们得罪了耶和华我们的神，从我们幼年直到现在，我们和列祖都没有听从耶和华我们的神的话。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我们在羞耻中躺卧吧！愿惭愧将我们遮盖；因为从立国 以来，我们和我们的列祖常常得罪耶和华－我们的神，没有听从耶和华－我们神的话。
verses.textEnNiv: Let us lie down in our shame, and let our disgrace cover us. We have sinned against the Lord our God, both we and our ancestors; from our youth till this day we have not obeyed the Lord our God."
verses.textEnEsv: Let us lie down in our shame, and let our dishonor cover us. For we have sinned against the Lord our God, we and our fathers, from our youth even to this day, and we have not obeyed the voice of the Lord our God."
verses.textEnNkjv: We lie down in our shame, And our reproach covers us. For we have sinned against the Lord our God, We and our fathers, From our youth even to this day, And have not obeyed the voice of the Lord our God."
verses.textEnNlt: Let us now lie down in shame and cover ourselves with dishonor, for we and our ancestors have sinned against the Lord our God. From our childhood to this day we have never obeyed him."
verses.textEnNasb: Let us lie down in our shame, and let our humiliation cover us; for we have sinned against the Lord our God, we and our fathers, from our youth even to this day. And we have not obeyed the voice of the Lord our God."
verses.textEn: Let us lie down in our shame, and let our disgrace cover us. We have sinned against the Lord our God, both we and our ancestors; from our youth till this day we have not obeyed the Lord our God."

verses.textZh: "以色列啊！你要是回转， 就当回转归向我。" 这是耶和华的宣告。 "如果你从我面前除掉你可憎的偶像， 不到处浪荡；
verses.textZhCnvs: "以色列啊！你要是回转， 就当回转归向我。" 这是耶和华的宣告。 "如果你从我面前除掉你可憎的偶像， 不到处浪荡；
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华说：以色列啊， 你若回来归向我， 若从我眼前除掉你可憎的偶像， 你就不被迁移。
verses.textEnNiv: "If you, Israel, will return, then return to me," declares the Lord . "If you put your detestable idols out of my sight and no longer go astray,
verses.textEnEsv: "If you return, O Israel, declares the Lord , to me you should return. If you remove your detestable things from my presence, and do not waver,
verses.textEnNkjv: "If you will return, O Israel," says the Lord, "Return to Me; And if you will put away your abominations out of My sight, Then you shall not be moved.
verses.textEnNlt: "O Israel," says the Lord , "if you wanted to return to me, you could. You could throw away your detestable idols and stray away no more.
verses.textEnNasb: "If you will return, Israel," declares the Lord, "Then you should return to Me. And if you will put away your detestable things from My presence, And will not waver,
verses.textEn: "If you, Israel, will return, then return to me," declares the Lord . "If you put your detestable idols out of my sight and no longer go astray,

verses.textZh: 如果你凭真理、公正、公义， 指着永活的耶和华起誓； 列国就必因耶和华蒙福， 也必以他为荣。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果你凭真理、公正、公义， 指着永活的耶和华起誓； 列国就必因耶和华蒙福， 也必以他为荣。"
verses.textZhCuv: 你必凭诚实、公平、公义， 指着永生的耶和华起誓； 列国必因耶和华称自己为有福， 也必因他夸耀。
verses.textEnNiv: and if in a truthful, just and righteous way you swear, ‘As surely as the Lord lives,’ then the nations will invoke blessings by him and in him they will boast."
verses.textEnEsv: and if you swear, ‘As the Lord lives,’ in truth, in justice, and in righteousness, then nations shall bless themselves in him, and in him shall they glory."
verses.textEnNkjv: And you shall swear, ‘The Lord lives,’ In truth, in judgment, and in righteousness; The nations shall bless themselves in Him, And in Him they shall glory."
verses.textEnNlt: Then when you swear by my name, saying, ‘As surely as the Lord lives,’ you could do so with truth, justice, and righteousness. Then you would be a blessing to the nations of the world, and all people would come and praise my name."
verses.textEnNasb: And if you will swear, ‘As the Lord lives,’ In truth, in justice, and in righteousness; Then the nations will bless themselves in Him, And in Him they will boast."
verses.textEn: and if in a truthful, just and righteous way you swear, ‘As surely as the Lord lives,’ then the nations will invoke blessings by him and in him they will boast."

verses.textZh: 耶和华对犹大和耶路撒冷的人这样说： "你们要为自己开垦未经耕耘之地， 却不要撒种在荆棘中！
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对犹大和耶路撒冷的人这样说： "你们要为自己开垦未经耕耘之地， 却不要撒种在荆棘中！
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华对犹大和耶路撒冷人如此说： 要开垦你们的荒地， 不要撒种在荆棘中。
verses.textEnNiv: This is what the Lord says to the people of Judah and to Jerusalem: "Break up your unplowed ground and do not sow among thorns.
verses.textEnEsv: For thus says the Lord to the men of Judah and Jerusalem: "Break up your fallow ground, and sow not among thorns.
verses.textEnNkjv: For thus says the Lord to the men of Judah and Jerusalem: "Break up your fallow ground, And do not sow among thorns.
verses.textEnNlt: This is what the Lord says to the people of Judah and Jerusalem: "Plow up the hard ground of your hearts! Do not waste your good seed among thorns.
verses.textEnNasb: For this is what the Lord says to the men of Judah and to Jerusalem: " Break up your uncultivated ground, And do not sow among thorns.
verses.textEn: This is what the Lord says to the people of Judah and to Jerusalem: "Break up your unplowed ground and do not sow among thorns.

verses.textZh: 犹大人和耶路撒冷的居民哪！ 你们要为了耶和华的缘故自行割礼， 除去心里的污秽； 不然，我的忿怒必因你们的恶行， 如火一般发出来， 无人能熄灭！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 犹大人和耶路撒冷的居民哪！ 你们要为了耶和华的缘故自行割礼， 除去心里的污秽； 不然，我的忿怒必因你们的恶行， 如火一般发出来， 无人能熄灭！"
verses.textZhCuv: 犹大人和耶路撒冷的居民哪， 你们当自行割礼，归耶和华， 将心里的污秽除掉； 恐怕我的忿怒因你们的恶行发作， 如火着起， 甚至无人能以熄灭！
verses.textEnNiv: Circumcise yourselves to the Lord , circumcise your hearts, you people of Judah and inhabitants of Jerusalem, or my wrath will flare up and burn like fire because of the evil you have done— burn with no one to quench it.
verses.textEnEsv: Circumcise yourselves to the Lord ; remove the foreskin of your hearts, O men of Judah and inhabitants of Jerusalem; lest my wrath go forth like fire, and burn with none to quench it, because of the evil of your deeds."
verses.textEnNkjv: Circumcise yourselves to the Lord, And take away the foreskins of your hearts, You men of Judah and inhabitants of Jerusalem, Lest My fury come forth like fire, And burn so that no one can quench it, Because of the evil of your doings."
verses.textEnNlt: O people of Judah and Jerusalem, surrender your pride and power. Change your hearts before the Lord , or my anger will burn like an unquenchable fire because of all your sins.
verses.textEnNasb: "Circumcise yourselves to the Lord And remove the foreskins of your hearts, Men of Judah and inhabitants of Jerusalem, Or else My wrath will spread like fire And burn with no one to quench it, Because of the evil of your deeds."
verses.textEn: Circumcise yourselves to the Lord , circumcise your hearts, you people of Judah and inhabitants of Jerusalem, or my wrath will flare up and burn like fire because of the evil you have done— burn with no one to quench it.

verses.textZh: "你们应当在犹大宣告， 在耶路撒冷传扬，说： ‘要在境内吹号。’ 高声呼叫，说： ‘你们要集合起来，我们要进到坚固的城里去！’
verses.textZhCnvs: "你们应当在犹大宣告， 在耶路撒冷传扬，说： ‘要在境内吹号。’ 高声呼叫，说： ‘你们要集合起来，我们要进到坚固的城里去！’
verses.textZhCuv: 你们当传扬在犹大， 宣告在耶路撒冷说： 你们当在国中吹角，高声呼叫说： 你们当聚集！ 我们好进入坚固城！
verses.textEnNiv: "Announce in Judah and proclaim in Jerusalem and say: ‘Sound the trumpet throughout the land!’ Cry aloud and say: ‘Gather together! Let us flee to the fortified cities!’
verses.textEnEsv: Declare in Judah, and proclaim in Jerusalem, and say, "Blow the trumpet through the land; cry aloud and say, ‘Assemble, and let us go into the fortified cities!’
verses.textEnNkjv: Declare in Judah and proclaim in Jerusalem, and say: "Blow the trumpet in the land; Cry, ‘Gather together,’ And say, ‘Assemble yourselves, And let us go into the fortified cities.’
verses.textEnNlt: "Shout to Judah, and broadcast to Jerusalem! Tell them to sound the alarm throughout the land: ‘Run for your lives! Flee to the fortified cities!’
verses.textEnNasb: Declare in Judah and proclaim in Jerusalem, and say, "Blow the trumpet in the land; Cry aloud and say, ‘Assemble, and let’s go Into the fortified cities.’
verses.textEn: "Announce in Judah and proclaim in Jerusalem and say: ‘Sound the trumpet throughout the land!’ Cry aloud and say: ‘Gather together! Let us flee to the fortified cities!’

verses.textZh: 要向锡安竖起旗号， 赶快逃命，不可停留， 因为我必使灾祸与严重的毁灭， 从北方而来。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 要向锡安竖起旗号， 赶快逃命，不可停留， 因为我必使灾祸与严重的毁灭， 从北方而来。"
verses.textZhCuv: 应当向锡安竖立大旗。 要逃避，不要迟延， 因我必使灾祸与大毁灭从北方来到。
verses.textEnNiv: Raise the signal to go to Zion! Flee for safety without delay! For I am bringing disaster from the north, even terrible destruction."
verses.textEnEsv: Raise a standard toward Zion, flee for safety, stay not, for I bring disaster from the north, and great destruction.
verses.textEnNkjv: Set up the standard toward Zion. Take refuge! Do not delay! For I will bring disaster from the north, And great destruction."
verses.textEnNlt: Raise a signal flag as a warning for Jerusalem : ‘Flee now! Do not delay!’ For I am bringing terrible destruction upon you from the north."
verses.textEnNasb: "Raise a flag toward Zion! Take refuge, do not stand still, For I am bringing evil from the north, And great destruction.
verses.textEn: Raise the signal to go to Zion! Flee for safety without delay! For I am bringing disaster from the north, even terrible destruction."

verses.textZh: 狮子从牠的密林中上来了， 毁坏列国的已经动身， 从他的本处出发， 为要使你的地荒凉， 使你的城市破毁，无人居住。
verses.textZhCnvs: 狮子从牠的密林中上来了， 毁坏列国的已经动身， 从他的本处出发， 为要使你的地荒凉， 使你的城市破毁，无人居住。
verses.textZhCuv: 有狮子从密林中上来， 是毁坏列国的。 它已经动身出离本处， 要使你的地荒凉， 使你的城邑变为荒场无人居住。
verses.textEnNiv: A lion has come out of his lair; a destroyer of nations has set out. He has left his place to lay waste your land. Your towns will lie in ruins without inhabitant.
verses.textEnEsv: A lion has gone up from his thicket, a destroyer of nations has set out; he has gone out from his place to make your land a waste; your cities will be ruins without inhabitant.
verses.textEnNkjv: The lion has come up from his thicket, And the destroyer of nations is on his way. He has gone forth from his place To make your land desolate. Your cities will be laid waste, Without inhabitant.
verses.textEnNlt: A lion stalks from its den, a destroyer of nations. It has left its lair and is headed your way. It’s going to devastate your land! Your towns will lie in ruins, with no one living in them anymore.
verses.textEnNasb: "A lion has gone up from his thicket, And a destroyer of nations has set out; He has gone out from his place To make your land a waste. Your cities will be ruins, Without an inhabitant.
verses.textEn: A lion has come out of his lair; a destroyer of nations has set out. He has left his place to lay waste your land. Your towns will lie in ruins without inhabitant.

verses.textZh: 因此，你们应当披上麻布， 痛哭哀号， 因为耶和华的烈怒， 还没有离开我们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，你们应当披上麻布， 痛哭哀号， 因为耶和华的烈怒， 还没有离开我们。
verses.textZhCuv: 因此，你们当腰束麻布，大声哀号， 因为耶和华的烈怒没有向我们转消。
verses.textEnNiv: So put on sackcloth, lament and wail, for the fierce anger of the Lord has not turned away from us.
verses.textEnEsv: For this put on sackcloth, lament and wail, for the fierce anger of the Lord has not turned back from us."
verses.textEnNkjv: For this, clothe yourself with sackcloth, Lament and wail. For the fierce anger of the Lord Has not turned back from us.
verses.textEnNlt: So put on clothes of mourning and weep with broken hearts, for the fierce anger of the Lord is still upon us.
verses.textEnNasb: "For this, put on sackcloth, Mourn and wail; For the fierce anger of the Lord Has not turned away from us."
verses.textEn: So put on sackcloth, lament and wail, for the fierce anger of the Lord has not turned away from us.

verses.textZh: "到那日，君王和首领的勇气消失， 祭司也要惊惶， 先知都必诧异。" 这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: "到那日，君王和首领的勇气消失， 祭司也要惊惶， 先知都必诧异。" 这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华说：「到那时，君王和首领的心都要消灭；祭司都要惊奇，先知都要诧异。」
verses.textEnNiv: "In that day," declares the Lord , "the king and the officials will lose heart, the priests will be horrified, and the prophets will be appalled."
verses.textEnEsv: "In that day, declares the Lord , courage shall fail both king and officials. The priests shall be appalled and the prophets astounded."
verses.textEnNkjv: "And it shall come to pass in that day," says the Lord, "That the heart of the king shall perish, And the heart of the princes; The priests shall be astonished, And the prophets shall wonder."
verses.textEnNlt: "In that day," says the Lord , "the king and the officials will tremble in fear. The priests will be struck with horror, and the prophets will be appalled."
verses.textEnNasb: "And it shall come about on that day," declares the Lord, "that the heart of the king and the hearts of the leaders will fail; and the priests will tremble, and the prophets will be astonished."
verses.textEn: "In that day," declares the Lord , "the king and the officials will lose heart, the priests will be horrified, and the prophets will be appalled."

verses.textZh: 于是我说："噢！主耶和华啊！你真的欺骗了这人民，也欺骗了耶路撒冷，说：‘你们必平安无事’，其实刀剑已经架在颈项上了！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是我说："噢！主耶和华啊！你真的欺骗了这人民，也欺骗了耶路撒冷，说：‘你们必平安无事’，其实刀剑已经架在颈项上了！"
verses.textZhCuv: 我说：「哀哉！主耶和华啊，你真是大大地欺哄这百姓和耶路撒冷，说：『你们必得平安。』其实刀剑害及性命了。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then I said, "Alas, Sovereign Lord ! How completely you have deceived this people and Jerusalem by saying, ‘You will have peace,’ when the sword is at our throats!"
verses.textEnEsv: Then I said, "Ah, Lord God , surely you have utterly deceived this people and Jerusalem, saying, ‘It shall be well with you,’ whereas the sword has reached their very life."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then I said, "Ah, Lord God! Surely You have greatly deceived this people and Jerusalem, Saying, ‘You shall have peace,’ Whereas the sword reaches to the heart."
verses.textEnNlt: Then I said, "O Sovereign Lord , the people have been deceived by what you said, for you promised peace for Jerusalem. But the sword is held at their throats!"
verses.textEnNasb: Then I said, "Oh, Lord God! Surely You have utterly deceived this people and Jerusalem, saying, ‘You will have peace’; yet a sword touches the throat."
verses.textEn: Then I said, "Alas, Sovereign Lord ! How completely you have deceived this people and Jerusalem by saying, ‘You will have peace,’ when the sword is at our throats!"

verses.textZh: 到那时，必有话对这人民和耶路撒冷说："有一阵热风从旷野光秃的高冈，刮向我的子民 ，不是为簸散，也不是为扬净；
verses.textZhCnvs: 到那时，必有话对这人民和耶路撒冷说："有一阵热风从旷野光秃的高冈，刮向我的子民 ，不是为簸散，也不是为扬净；
verses.textZhCuv: 那时，必有话对这百姓和耶路撒冷说：「有一阵热风从旷野净光的高处向我的众民 刮来，不是为簸扬，也不是为扬净。
verses.textEnNiv: At that time this people and Jerusalem will be told, "A scorching wind from the barren heights in the desert blows toward my people, but not to winnow or cleanse;
verses.textEnEsv: At that time it will be said to this people and to Jerusalem, "A hot wind from the bare heights in the desert toward the daughter of my people, not to winnow or cleanse,
verses.textEnNkjv: At that time it will be said To this people and to Jerusalem, "A dry wind of the desolate heights blows in the wilderness Toward the daughter of My people— Not to fan or to cleanse—
verses.textEnNlt: The time is coming when the Lord will say to the people of Jerusalem, "My dear people, a burning wind is blowing in from the desert, and it’s not a gentle breeze useful for winnowing grain.
verses.textEnNasb: At that time it will be said to this people and to Jerusalem, "A scorching wind from the bare heights in the wilderness, in the direction of the daughter of My people—not to winnow and not to cleanse,
verses.textEn: At that time this people and Jerusalem will be told, "A scorching wind from the barren heights in the desert blows toward my people, but not to winnow or cleanse;

verses.textZh: 这过强的风要为我刮来，我就要向他们宣告我的判词。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 这过强的风要为我刮来，我就要向他们宣告我的判词。"
verses.textZhCuv: 必有一阵更大的风从这些地方为我刮来；现在我又必发出判语，攻击他们。」
verses.textEnNiv: a wind too strong for that comes from me. Now I pronounce my judgments against them."
verses.textEnEsv: a wind too full for this comes for me. Now it is I who speak in judgment upon them."
verses.textEnNkjv: A wind too strong for these will come for Me; Now I will also speak judgment against them."
verses.textEnNlt: It is a roaring blast sent by me! Now I will pronounce your destruction!"
verses.textEnNasb: a wind too strong for this—will come at My command; now I will also pronounce judgments against them."
verses.textEn: a wind too strong for that comes from me. Now I pronounce my judgments against them."

verses.textZh: 看哪！他必如密云涌聚， 他的战车如旋风， 他的马比鹰还快。 我们有祸了，我们灭亡了！
verses.textZhCnvs: 看哪！他必如密云涌聚， 他的战车如旋风， 他的马比鹰还快。 我们有祸了，我们灭亡了！
verses.textZhCuv: 看哪，仇敌必如云上来； 他的战车如旋风， 他的马匹比鹰更快。 我们有祸了！ 我们败落了！
verses.textEnNiv: Look! He advances like the clouds, his chariots come like a whirlwind, his horses are swifter than eagles. Woe to us! We are ruined!
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, he comes up like clouds; his chariots like the whirlwind; his horses are swifter than eagles— woe to us, for we are ruined!
verses.textEnNkjv: "Behold, he shall come up like clouds, And his chariots like a whirlwind. His horses are swifter than eagles. Woe to us, for we are plundered!"
verses.textEnNlt: Our enemy rushes down on us like storm clouds! His chariots are like whirlwinds. His horses are swifter than eagles. How terrible it will be, for we are doomed!
verses.textEnNasb: "Behold, he goes up like clouds, And his chariots like the whirlwind; His horses are swifter than eagles. Woe to us, for we are ruined!"
verses.textEn: Look! He advances like the clouds, his chariots come like a whirlwind, his horses are swifter than eagles. Woe to us! We are ruined!

verses.textZh: 耶路撒冷啊！洗净你心中的邪恶， 使你可以得救！ 你心存恶念， 要到几时呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶路撒冷啊！洗净你心中的邪恶， 使你可以得救！ 你心存恶念， 要到几时呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 耶路撒冷啊，你当洗去心中的恶， 使你可以得救。 恶念存在你心里要到几时呢？
verses.textEnNiv: Jerusalem, wash the evil from your heart and be saved. How long will you harbor wicked thoughts?
verses.textEnEsv: O Jerusalem, wash your heart from evil, that you may be saved. How long shall your wicked thoughts lodge within you?
verses.textEnNkjv: O Jerusalem, wash your heart from wickedness, That you may be saved. How long shall your evil thoughts lodge within you?
verses.textEnNlt: O Jerusalem, cleanse your heart that you may be saved. How long will you harbor your evil thoughts?
verses.textEnNasb: Wash your heart from evil, Jerusalem, So that you may be saved. How long will your wicked thoughts Lodge within you?
verses.textEn: Jerusalem, wash the evil from your heart and be saved. How long will you harbor wicked thoughts?

verses.textZh: 因为有声音从但宣告， 从以法莲山传出灾祸的警报。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为有声音从但宣告， 从以法莲山传出灾祸的警报。
verses.textZhCuv: 有声音从但传扬， 从以法莲山报祸患。
verses.textEnNiv: A voice is announcing from Dan, proclaiming disaster from the hills of Ephraim.
verses.textEnEsv: For a voice declares from Dan and proclaims trouble from Mount Ephraim.
verses.textEnNkjv: For a voice declares from Dan And proclaims affliction from Mount Ephraim:
verses.textEnNlt: Your destruction has been announced from Dan and the hill country of Ephraim.
verses.textEnNasb: For a voice declares from Dan, And proclaims wickedness from Mount Ephraim.
verses.textEn: A voice is announcing from Dan, proclaiming disaster from the hills of Ephraim.

verses.textZh: "要向列国提说， 向耶路撒冷宣扬： ‘围攻的人从远地而来， 向犹大的各城镇大声吶喊。
verses.textZhCnvs: "要向列国提说， 向耶路撒冷宣扬： ‘围攻的人从远地而来， 向犹大的各城镇大声吶喊。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们当传给列国， 报告攻击耶路撒冷的事说： 有探望的人从远方来到， 向犹大的城邑大声呐喊。
verses.textEnNiv: "Tell this to the nations, proclaim concerning Jerusalem: ‘A besieging army is coming from a distant land, raising a war cry against the cities of Judah.
verses.textEnEsv: Warn the nations that he is coming; announce to Jerusalem, "Besiegers come from a distant land; they shout against the cities of Judah.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Make mention to the nations, Yes, proclaim against Jerusalem, That watchers come from a far country And raise their voice against the cities of Judah.
verses.textEnNlt: "Warn the surrounding nations and announce this to Jerusalem: The enemy is coming from a distant land, raising a battle cry against the towns of Judah.
verses.textEnNasb: "Report it to the nations, now! Proclaim to Jerusalem, ‘ Enemies are coming from a remote country, And they raise their voices against the cities of Judah.
verses.textEn: "Tell this to the nations, proclaim concerning Jerusalem: ‘A besieging army is coming from a distant land, raising a war cry against the cities of Judah.

verses.textZh: 他们四面包围耶路撒冷， 好象看守田地的人一样， 因为耶路撒冷背叛了我。’" 这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们四面包围耶路撒冷， 好象看守田地的人一样， 因为耶路撒冷背叛了我。’" 这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们周围攻击耶路撒冷， 好像看守田园的， 因为她背叛了我。 这是耶和华说的。
verses.textEnNiv: They surround her like men guarding a field, because she has rebelled against me,’ " declares the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: Like keepers of a field are they against her all around, because she has rebelled against me, declares the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: Like keepers of a field they are against her all around, Because she has been rebellious against Me," says the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: They surround Jerusalem like watchmen around a field, for my people have rebelled against me," says the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Like watchmen of a field they are against her all around, Because she has rebelled against Me,’ declares the Lord.
verses.textEn: They surround her like men guarding a field, because she has rebelled against me,’ " declares the Lord .

verses.textZh: "你这一切灾祸是你的所作所为作成的， 这就是你的恶果， 实在是苦，直透心底。"
verses.textZhCnvs: "你这一切灾祸是你的所作所为作成的， 这就是你的恶果， 实在是苦，直透心底。"
verses.textZhCuv: 你的行动，你的作为，招惹这事； 这是你罪恶的结果， 实在是苦， 是害及你心了！
verses.textEnNiv: "Your own conduct and actions have brought this on you. This is your punishment. How bitter it is! How it pierces to the heart!"
verses.textEnEsv: Your ways and your deeds have brought this upon you. This is your doom, and it is bitter; it has reached your very heart."
verses.textEnNkjv: "Your ways and your doings Have procured these things for you. This is your wickedness, Because it is bitter, Because it reaches to your heart."
verses.textEnNlt: "Your own actions have brought this upon you. This punishment is bitter, piercing you to the heart!"
verses.textEnNasb: "Your ways and your deeds Have brought these things upon you. This is your evil. How bitter! How it has touched your heart!"
verses.textEn: "Your own conduct and actions have brought this on you. This is your punishment. How bitter it is! How it pierces to the heart!"

verses.textZh: 我的肺腑，我的肺腑啊！我绞痛欲绝。 我的心哪！我的心在我里面颤抖， 我不能缄默不语。 我的灵啊！我听见了号角的声音， 也听见了战争的吶喊。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的肺腑，我的肺腑啊！我绞痛欲绝。 我的心哪！我的心在我里面颤抖， 我不能缄默不语。 我的灵啊！我听见了号角的声音， 也听见了战争的吶喊。
verses.textZhCuv: 我的肺腑啊，我的肺腑啊，我心疼痛！ 我心在我里面烦躁不安。 我不能静默不言， 因为我已经听见角声和打仗的喊声。
verses.textEnNiv: Oh, my anguish, my anguish! I writhe in pain. Oh, the agony of my heart! My heart pounds within me, I cannot keep silent. For I have heard the sound of the trumpet; I have heard the battle cry.
verses.textEnEsv: My anguish, my anguish! I writhe in pain! Oh the walls of my heart! My heart is beating wildly; I cannot keep silent, for I hear the sound of the trumpet, the alarm of war.
verses.textEnNkjv: O my soul, my soul! I am pained in my very heart! My heart makes a noise in me; I cannot hold my peace, Because you have heard, O my soul, The sound of the trumpet, The alarm of war.
verses.textEnNlt: My heart, my heart—I writhe in pain! My heart pounds within me! I cannot be still. For I have heard the blast of enemy trumpets and the roar of their battle cries.
verses.textEnNasb: My soul, my soul! I am in anguish! Oh, my heart! My heart is pounding in me; I cannot keep silent, Because, my soul, you have heard The sound of the trumpet, The alarm of war.
verses.textEn: Oh, my anguish, my anguish! I writhe in pain. Oh, the agony of my heart! My heart pounds within me, I cannot keep silent. For I have heard the sound of the trumpet; I have heard the battle cry.

verses.textZh: 毁灭的消息频传， 因为全国尽都毁坏， 我的帐棚忽然毁坏， 我的幔子转瞬破裂。
verses.textZhCnvs: 毁灭的消息频传， 因为全国尽都毁坏， 我的帐棚忽然毁坏， 我的幔子转瞬破裂。
verses.textZhCuv: 毁坏的信息连络不绝， 因为全地荒废。 我的帐棚忽然毁坏； 我的幔子顷刻破裂。
verses.textEnNiv: Disaster follows disaster; the whole land lies in ruins. In an instant my tents are destroyed, my shelter in a moment.
verses.textEnEsv: Crash follows hard on crash; the whole land is laid waste. Suddenly my tents are laid waste, my curtains in a moment.
verses.textEnNkjv: Destruction upon destruction is cried, For the whole land is plundered. Suddenly my tents are plundered, And my curtains in a moment.
verses.textEnNlt: Waves of destruction roll over the land, until it lies in complete desolation. Suddenly my tents are destroyed; in a moment my shelters are crushed.
verses.textEnNasb: Disaster upon disaster is proclaimed, For the whole land is devastated; Suddenly my tents are devastated, And my curtains in an instant.
verses.textEn: Disaster follows disaster; the whole land lies in ruins. In an instant my tents are destroyed, my shelter in a moment.

verses.textZh: 我看见旗号要到几时呢？ 我听见号角的声音要到几时呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 我看见旗号要到几时呢？ 我听见号角的声音要到几时呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 我看见大旗，听见角声， 要到几时呢？
verses.textEnNiv: How long must I see the battle standard and hear the sound of the trumpet?
verses.textEnEsv: How long must I see the standard and hear the sound of the trumpet?
verses.textEnNkjv: How long will I see the standard, And hear the sound of the trumpet?
verses.textEnNlt: How long must I see the battle flags and hear the trumpets of war?
verses.textEnNasb: How long must I see the flag And hear the sound of the trumpet?
verses.textEn: How long must I see the battle standard and hear the sound of the trumpet?

verses.textZh: "我的子民愚妄， 他们连我都不认识， 是无知的儿女， 没有悟性； 他们有智慧行恶， 却没有知识行善。"
verses.textZhCnvs: "我的子民愚妄， 他们连我都不认识， 是无知的儿女， 没有悟性； 他们有智慧行恶， 却没有知识行善。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华说：我的百姓愚顽，不认识我； 他们是愚昧无知的儿女， 有智慧行恶，没有知识行善。
verses.textEnNiv: "My people are fools; they do not know me. They are senseless children; they have no understanding. They are skilled in doing evil; they know not how to do good."
verses.textEnEsv: "For my people are foolish; they know me not; they are stupid children; they have no understanding. They are ‘wise’—in doing evil! But how to do good they know not."
verses.textEnNkjv: "For My people are foolish, They have not known Me. They are silly children, And they have no understanding. They are wise to do evil, But to do good they have no knowledge."
verses.textEnNlt: "My people are foolish and do not know me," says the Lord . "They are stupid children who have no understanding. They are clever enough at doing wrong, but they have no idea how to do right!"
verses.textEnNasb: "For My people are foolish, They do not know Me; They are foolish children And have no understanding. They are skillful at doing evil, But they do not know how to do good."
verses.textEn: "My people are fools; they do not know me. They are senseless children; they have no understanding. They are skilled in doing evil; they know not how to do good."

verses.textZh: 我观看地，地是空虚混沌； 我仰视天，天上也全然无光。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我观看地，地是空虚混沌； 我仰视天，天上也全然无光。
verses.textZhCuv: 先知说：我观看地， 不料，地是空虚混沌； 我观看天，天也无光。
verses.textEnNiv: I looked at the earth, and it was formless and empty; and at the heavens, and their light was gone.
verses.textEnEsv: I looked on the earth, and behold, it was without form and void; and to the heavens, and they had no light.
verses.textEnNkjv: I beheld the earth, and indeed itwas without form, and void; And the heavens, they had no light.
verses.textEnNlt: I looked at the earth, and it was empty and formless. I looked at the heavens, and there was no light.
verses.textEnNasb: I looked at the earth, and behold, it was a formless and desolate emptiness; And to the heavens, and they had no light.
verses.textEn: I looked at the earth, and it was formless and empty; and at the heavens, and their light was gone.

verses.textZh: 我观看大山，它们尽都震动， 小山也都摇来摇去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我观看大山，它们尽都震动， 小山也都摇来摇去。
verses.textZhCuv: 我观看大山，不料，尽都震动， 小山也都摇来摇去。
verses.textEnNiv: I looked at the mountains, and they were quaking; all the hills were swaying.
verses.textEnEsv: I looked on the mountains, and behold, they were quaking, and all the hills moved to and fro.
verses.textEnNkjv: I beheld the mountains, and indeed they trembled, And all the hills moved back and forth.
verses.textEnNlt: I looked at the mountains and hills, and they trembled and shook.
verses.textEnNasb: I looked on the mountains, and behold, they were quaking, And all the hills jolted back and forth.
verses.textEn: I looked at the mountains, and they were quaking; all the hills were swaying.

verses.textZh: 我观看，毫无人迹； 空中的飞鸟也逃掉了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我观看，毫无人迹； 空中的飞鸟也逃掉了。
verses.textZhCuv: 我观看，不料，无人； 空中的飞鸟也都躲避。
verses.textEnNiv: I looked, and there were no people; every bird in the sky had flown away.
verses.textEnEsv: I looked, and behold, there was no man, and all the birds of the air had fled.
verses.textEnNkjv: I beheld, and indeed therewas no man, And all the birds of the heavens had fled.
verses.textEnNlt: I looked, and all the people were gone. All the birds of the sky had flown away.
verses.textEnNasb: I looked, and behold, there was no human, And all the birds of the sky had fled.
verses.textEn: I looked, and there were no people; every bird in the sky had flown away.

verses.textZh: 我观看，肥美田园变为荒野； 在耶和华面前，就是在他烈怒之下， 所有的城市都被拆毁。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我观看，肥美田园变为荒野； 在耶和华面前，就是在他烈怒之下， 所有的城市都被拆毁。
verses.textZhCuv: 我观看，不料，肥田变为荒地； 一切城邑在耶和华面前， 因他的烈怒都被拆毁。
verses.textEnNiv: I looked, and the fruitful land was a desert; all its towns lay in ruins before the Lord , before his fierce anger.
verses.textEnEsv: I looked, and behold, the fruitful land was a desert, and all its cities were laid in ruins before the Lord , before his fierce anger.
verses.textEnNkjv: I beheld, and indeed the fruitful land was a wilderness, And all its cities were broken down At the presence of the Lord, By His fierce anger.
verses.textEnNlt: I looked, and the fertile fields had become a wilderness. The towns lay in ruins, crushed by the Lord ’s fierce anger.
verses.textEnNasb: I looked, and behold, the fruitful land was a wilderness, And all its cities were pulled down Before the Lord, before His fierce anger.
verses.textEn: I looked, and the fruitful land was a desert; all its towns lay in ruins before the Lord , before his fierce anger.

verses.textZh: 因为耶和华这样说： "全国都必荒凉， 我却不尽行毁灭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为耶和华这样说： "全国都必荒凉， 我却不尽行毁灭。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华如此说：全地必然荒凉， 我却不毁灭净尽。
verses.textEnNiv: This is what the Lord says: "The whole land will be ruined, though I will not destroy it completely.
verses.textEnEsv: For thus says the Lord , "The whole land shall be a desolation; yet I will not make a full end.
verses.textEnNkjv: For thus says the Lord: "The whole land shall be desolate; Yet I will not make a full end.
verses.textEnNlt: This is what the Lord says: "The whole land will be ruined, but I will not destroy it completely.
verses.textEnNasb: For this is what the Lord says: "The whole land shall be a desolation, Yet I will not execute a complete destruction.
verses.textEn: This is what the Lord says: "The whole land will be ruined, though I will not destroy it completely.

verses.textZh: 因此，地要悲哀， 天必昏暗。 因为我说过，就不后悔； 我定了意，决不改变。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，地要悲哀， 天必昏暗。 因为我说过，就不后悔； 我定了意，决不改变。"
verses.textZhCuv: 因此，地要悲哀， 在上的天也必黑暗； 因为我言已出，我意已定， 必不后悔，也不转意不做。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore the earth will mourn and the heavens above grow dark, because I have spoken and will not relent, I have decided and will not turn back."
verses.textEnEsv: "For this the earth shall mourn, and the heavens above be dark; for I have spoken; I have purposed; I have not relented, nor will I turn back."
verses.textEnNkjv: For this shall the earth mourn, And the heavens above be black, Because I have spoken. I have purposed and will not relent, Nor will I turn back from it.
verses.textEnNlt: The earth will mourn and the heavens will be draped in black because of my decree against my people. I have made up my mind and will not change it."
verses.textEnNasb: "For this the earth will mourn, And the heavens above will become dark, Because I have spoken, I have purposed, And I have not changed My mind, nor will I turn from it."
verses.textEn: Therefore the earth will mourn and the heavens above grow dark, because I have spoken and will not relent, I have decided and will not turn back."

verses.textZh: 因着骑兵和弓箭手的响声， 各城的人尽都逃跑。 他们进入密林，爬上岩穴； 各城都被撇下， 无人住在其中。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因着骑兵和弓箭手的响声， 各城的人尽都逃跑。 他们进入密林，爬上岩穴； 各城都被撇下， 无人住在其中。
verses.textZhCuv: 各城的人因马兵和弓箭手的响声就都逃跑， 进入密林，爬上磐石； 各城被撇下， 无人住在其中。
verses.textEnNiv: At the sound of horsemen and archers every town takes to flight. Some go into the thickets; some climb up among the rocks. All the towns are deserted; no one lives in them.
verses.textEnEsv: At the noise of horseman and archer every city takes to flight; they enter thickets; they climb among rocks; all the cities are forsaken, and no man dwells in them.
verses.textEnNkjv: The whole city shall flee from the noise of the horsemen and bowmen. They shall go into thickets and climb up on the rocks. Every city shallbe forsaken, And not a man shall dwell in it.
verses.textEnNlt: At the noise of charioteers and archers, the people flee in terror. They hide in the bushes and run for the mountains. All the towns have been abandoned— not a person remains!
verses.textEnNasb: At the sound of the horseman and archer every city flees; They go into the thickets and climb among the rocks; Every city is abandoned, And no one lives in them.
verses.textEn: At the sound of horsemen and archers every town takes to flight. Some go into the thickets; some climb up among the rocks. All the towns are deserted; no one lives in them.

verses.textZh: 你这被毁坏的啊！你在干甚么？ 即使你穿上朱红色的服装， 佩戴黄金饰物， 用颜料画大你的眼睛， 你自炫漂亮，也是白费的。 爱你的人仍然鄙视你， 他们都在寻索你的命！
verses.textZhCnvs: 你这被毁坏的啊！你在干甚么？ 即使你穿上朱红色的服装， 佩戴黄金饰物， 用颜料画大你的眼睛， 你自炫漂亮，也是白费的。 爱你的人仍然鄙视你， 他们都在寻索你的命！
verses.textZhCuv: 你凄凉的时候要怎样行呢？ 你虽穿上朱红衣服， 佩戴黄金装饰， 用颜料修饰眼目， 这样标致是枉然的！ 恋爱你的藐视你， 并且寻索你的性命。
verses.textEnNiv: What are you doing, you devastated one? Why dress yourself in scarlet and put on jewels of gold? Why highlight your eyes with makeup? You adorn yourself in vain. Your lovers despise you; they want to kill you.
verses.textEnEsv: And you, O desolate one, what do you mean that you dress in scarlet, that you adorn yourself with ornaments of gold, that you enlarge your eyes with paint? In vain you beautify yourself. Your lovers despise you; they seek your life.
verses.textEnNkjv: "And when you are plundered, What will you do? Though you clothe yourself with crimson, Though you adorn yourself with ornaments of gold, Though you enlarge your eyes with paint, In vain you will make yourself fair; Your lovers will despise you; They will seek your life.
verses.textEnNlt: What are you doing, you who have been plundered? Why do you dress up in beautiful clothing and put on gold jewelry? Why do you brighten your eyes with mascara? Your primping will do you no good! The allies who were your lovers despise you and seek to kill you.
verses.textEnNasb: And you, desolate one, what will you do? Although you dress in scarlet, Although you adorn yourself with jewelry of gold, Although you enlarge your eyes with makeup, In vain you make yourself beautiful. Your lovers despise you; They seek your life.
verses.textEn: What are you doing, you devastated one? Why dress yourself in scarlet and put on jewels of gold? Why highlight your eyes with makeup? You adorn yourself in vain. Your lovers despise you; they want to kill you.

verses.textZh: 我听到好象妇人产痛的叫声， 正像生头胎孩子的妇人疼痛的叫声， 就是锡安居民 的声音，他们喘着气， 伸开双手，说： "哎！我有祸了！ 在那些杀人者跟前，我发昏了！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我听到好象妇人产痛的叫声， 正像生头胎孩子的妇人疼痛的叫声， 就是锡安居民 的声音，他们喘着气， 伸开双手，说： "哎！我有祸了！ 在那些杀人者跟前，我发昏了！"
verses.textZhCuv: 我听见有声音，仿佛妇人产难的声音， 好像生头胎疼痛的声音， 是锡安女子 的声音； 她喘着气、挓挲手， 说：我有祸了！ 在杀人的跟前，我的心发昏了。
verses.textEnNiv: I hear a cry as of a woman in labor, a groan as of one bearing her first child— the cry of Daughter Zion gasping for breath, stretching out her hands and saying, "Alas! I am fainting; my life is given over to murderers."
verses.textEnEsv: For I heard a cry as of a woman in labor, anguish as of one giving birth to her first child, the cry of the daughter of Zion gasping for breath, stretching out her hands, "Woe is me! I am fainting before murderers."
verses.textEnNkjv: "For I have heard a voice as of a woman in labor, The anguish as of her who brings forth her first child, The voice of the daughter of Zion bewailing herself; She spreads her hands, saying, ‘Woe is me now, for my soul is weary Because of murderers!’
verses.textEnNlt: I hear a cry, like that of a woman in labor, the groans of a woman giving birth to her first child. It is beautiful Jerusalem gasping for breath and crying out, "Help! I’m being murdered!"
verses.textEnNasb: For I heard a voice cry as of a woman in labor, The anguish as of one giving birth to her first child. The voice of the daughter of Zion gasping for breath, Stretching out her hands, saying, "Ah, woe to me, for I faint before murderers."
verses.textEn: I hear a cry as of a woman in labor, a groan as of one bearing her first child— the cry of Daughter Zion gasping for breath, stretching out her hands and saying, "Alas! I am fainting; my life is given over to murderers."

verses.textZh: "你们去走遍耶路撒冷的街道， 到处观察留意， 又在城的广场上寻觅； 如果能找到一个行正义、求诚实的人， 我就赦免这城。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你们去走遍耶路撒冷的街道， 到处观察留意， 又在城的广场上寻觅； 如果能找到一个行正义、求诚实的人， 我就赦免这城。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们当在耶路撒冷的街上跑来跑去， 在宽阔处寻找， 看看有一人行公义求诚实没有？ 若有，我就赦免这城。
verses.textEnNiv: "Go up and down the streets of Jerusalem, look around and consider, search through her squares. If you can find but one person who deals honestly and seeks the truth, I will forgive this city.
verses.textEnEsv: Run to and fro through the streets of Jerusalem, look and take note! Search her squares to see if you can find a man, one who does justice and seeks truth, that I may pardon her.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Run to and fro through the streets of Jerusalem; See now and know; And seek in her open places If you can find a man, If there is anyone who executes judgment, Who seeks the truth, And I will pardon her.
verses.textEnNlt: "Run up and down every street in Jerusalem," says the Lord . "Look high and low; search throughout the city! If you can find even one just and honest person, I will not destroy the city.
verses.textEnNasb: "Roam about through the streets of Jerusalem, And look and take notice. And seek in her public squares, If you can find a person, If there is one who does justice, who seeks honesty, Then I will forgive her.
verses.textEn: "Go up and down the streets of Jerusalem, look around and consider, search through her squares. If you can find but one person who deals honestly and seeks the truth, I will forgive this city.

verses.textZh: 城里的人虽然指着永活的耶和华起誓， 其实，他们起的誓是假的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 城里的人虽然指着永活的耶和华起誓， 其实，他们起的誓是假的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 其中的人虽然指着永生的耶和华起誓， 所起的誓实在是假的。
verses.textEnNiv: Although they say, ‘As surely as the Lord lives,’ still they are swearing falsely."
verses.textEnEsv: Though they say, "As the Lord lives," yet they swear falsely.
verses.textEnNkjv: Though they say, ‘As the Lord lives,’ Surely they swear falsely."
verses.textEnNlt: But even when they are under oath, saying, ‘As surely as the Lord lives,’ they are still telling lies!"
verses.textEnNasb: "And although they say, ‘As the Lord lives,’ Certainly they swear falsely."
verses.textEn: Although they say, ‘As surely as the Lord lives,’ still they are swearing falsely."

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊！你的眼目不是要看诚实的事吗？ 你击打他们，他们却不觉得伤痛； 你摧毁他们，他们仍不肯接受管教。 他们板着脸，脸皮比盘石还硬， 总不肯回转。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊！你的眼目不是要看诚实的事吗？ 你击打他们，他们却不觉得伤痛； 你摧毁他们，他们仍不肯接受管教。 他们板着脸，脸皮比盘石还硬， 总不肯回转。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，你的眼目不是看顾诚实吗？ 你击打他们，他们却不伤恸； 你毁灭他们，他们仍不受惩治。 他们使脸刚硬过于磐石， 不肯回头。
verses.textEnNiv: Lord , do not your eyes look for truth? You struck them, but they felt no pain; you crushed them, but they refused correction. They made their faces harder than stone and refused to repent.
verses.textEnEsv: O Lord , do not your eyes look for truth? You have struck them down, but they felt no anguish; you have consumed them, but they refused to take correction. They have made their faces harder than rock; they have refused to repent.
verses.textEnNkjv: O Lord, are not Your eyes on the truth? You have stricken them, But they have not grieved; You have consumed them, But they have refused to receive correction. They have made their faces harder than rock; They have refused to return.
verses.textEnNlt: Lord , you are searching for honesty. You struck your people, but they paid no attention. You crushed them, but they refused to be corrected. They are determined, with faces set like stone; they have refused to repent.
verses.textEnNasb: Lord, do Your eyes not look for honesty? You have struck them, But they did not weaken; You have consumed them, But they refused to accept discipline. They have made their faces harder than rock; They have refused to repent.
verses.textEn: Lord , do not your eyes look for truth? You struck them, but they felt no pain; you crushed them, but they refused correction. They made their faces harder than stone and refused to repent.

verses.textZh: 我说："这些人只是贫穷小民， 为人愚昧； 他们不晓得耶和华的道路， 也不明白他们神的法则。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我说："这些人只是贫穷小民， 为人愚昧； 他们不晓得耶和华的道路， 也不明白他们神的法则。
verses.textZhCuv: 我说：这些人实在是贫穷的，是愚昧的， 因为不晓得耶和华的作为 和他们神的法则。
verses.textEnNiv: I thought, "These are only the poor; they are foolish, for they do not know the way of the Lord , the requirements of their God.
verses.textEnEsv: Then I said, "These are only the poor; they have no sense; for they do not know the way of the Lord , the justice of their God.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore I said, "Surely these are poor. They are foolish; For they do not know the way of the Lord, The judgment of their God.
verses.textEnNlt: Then I said, "But what can we expect from the poor? They are ignorant. They don’t know the ways of the Lord . They don’t understand God’s laws.
verses.textEnNasb: Then I said, "They are only the poor, They are foolish; For they do not know the way of the Lord Or the judgment of their God.
verses.textEn: I thought, "These are only the poor; they are foolish, for they do not know the way of the Lord , the requirements of their God.

verses.textZh: 我要亲自去见那些权贵领袖， 跟他们谈谈； 因为他们晓得耶和华的道路， 也明白他们神的法则。" 谁知他们竟一起把轭折断， 挣脱绳索。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要亲自去见那些权贵领袖， 跟他们谈谈； 因为他们晓得耶和华的道路， 也明白他们神的法则。" 谁知他们竟一起把轭折断， 挣脱绳索。
verses.textZhCuv: 我要去见尊大的人，对他们说话， 因为他们晓得耶和华的作为 和他们神的法则。 哪知，这些人齐心将轭折断， 挣开绳索。
verses.textEnNiv: So I will go to the leaders and speak to them; surely they know the way of the Lord , the requirements of their God." But with one accord they too had broken off the yoke and torn off the bonds.
verses.textEnEsv: I will go to the great and will speak to them, for they know the way of the Lord , the justice of their God." But they all alike had broken the yoke; they had burst the bonds.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will go to the great men and speak to them, For they have known the way of the Lord, The judgment of their God." But these have altogether broken the yoke And burst the bonds.
verses.textEnNlt: So I will go and speak to their leaders. Surely they know the ways of the Lord and understand God’s laws." But the leaders, too, as one man, had thrown off God’s yoke and broken his chains.
verses.textEnNasb: "I will go to the great And speak to them, For they know the way of the Lord And the judgment of their God." But together they too have broken the yoke And burst the restraints.
verses.textEn: So I will go to the leaders and speak to them; surely they know the way of the Lord , the requirements of their God." But with one accord they too had broken off the yoke and torn off the bonds.

verses.textZh: 因此，狮子必从林中出来袭击他们， 旷野的豺狼要杀害他们， 豹子在他们的城边窥伺， 出城的都必被撕碎； 因为他们的过犯众多， 背道的事也无法数算。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，狮子必从林中出来袭击他们， 旷野的豺狼要杀害他们， 豹子在他们的城边窥伺， 出城的都必被撕碎； 因为他们的过犯众多， 背道的事也无法数算。
verses.textZhCuv: 因此，林中的狮子必害死他们； 晚上 的豺狼必灭绝他们； 豹子要在城外窥伺他们。 凡出城的必被撕碎； 因为他们的罪过极多， 背道的事也加增了。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore a lion from the forest will attack them, a wolf from the desert will ravage them, a leopard will lie in wait near their towns to tear to pieces any who venture out, for their rebellion is great and their backslidings many.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore a lion from the forest shall strike them down; a wolf from the desert shall devastate them. A leopard is watching their cities; everyone who goes out of them shall be torn in pieces, because their transgressions are many, their apostasies are great.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore a lion from the forest shall slay them, A wolf of the deserts shall destroy them; A leopard will watch over their cities. Everyone who goes out from there shall be torn in pieces, Because their transgressions are many; Their backslidings have increased.
verses.textEnNlt: So now a lion from the forest will attack them; a wolf from the desert will pounce on them. A leopard will lurk near their towns, tearing apart any who dare to venture out. For their rebellion is great, and their sins are many.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore a lion from the forest will kill them, A wolf of the deserts will destroy them, A leopard is watching their cities. Everyone who goes out of them will be torn in pieces, Because their wrongdoings are many, Their apostasies are numerous.
verses.textEn: Therefore a lion from the forest will attack them, a wolf from the desert will ravage them, a leopard will lie in wait near their towns to tear to pieces any who venture out, for their rebellion is great and their backslidings many.

verses.textZh: "为甚么我要赦免你？ 你的儿女离弃我， 指着那些不是神的起誓。 我使他们饱足，他们却去行淫， 一起挤在妓院里。
verses.textZhCnvs: "为甚么我要赦免你？ 你的儿女离弃我， 指着那些不是神的起誓。 我使他们饱足，他们却去行淫， 一起挤在妓院里。
verses.textZhCuv: 我怎能赦免你呢？ 你的儿女离弃我， 又指着那不是神的起誓。 我使他们饱足， 他们就行奸淫， 成群地聚集在娼妓家里。
verses.textEnNiv: "Why should I forgive you? Your children have forsaken me and sworn by gods that are not gods. I supplied all their needs, yet they committed adultery and thronged to the houses of prostitutes.
verses.textEnEsv: "How can I pardon you? Your children have forsaken me and have sworn by those who are no gods. When I fed them to the full, they committed adultery and trooped to the houses of whores.
verses.textEnNkjv: "How shall I pardon you for this? Your children have forsaken Me And sworn by those that are not gods. When I had fed them to the full, Then they committed adultery And assembled themselves by troops in the harlots’ houses.
verses.textEnNlt: "How can I pardon you? For even your children have turned from me. They have sworn by gods that are not gods at all! I fed my people until they were full. But they thanked me by committing adultery and lining up at the brothels.
verses.textEnNasb: "Why should I forgive you? Your sons have forsaken Me And sworn by those who are not gods. When I had fed them to the full, They committed adultery And stayed at the prostitute’s house.
verses.textEn: "Why should I forgive you? Your children have forsaken me and sworn by gods that are not gods. I supplied all their needs, yet they committed adultery and thronged to the houses of prostitutes.

verses.textZh: 他们像饱食的马，情欲奔放， 各向别人的妻子嘶叫。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们像饱食的马，情欲奔放， 各向别人的妻子嘶叫。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们像喂饱的马到处乱跑， 各向他邻舍的妻发嘶声。
verses.textEnNiv: They are well-fed, lusty stallions, each neighing for another man’s wife.
verses.textEnEsv: They were well-fed, lusty stallions, each neighing for his neighbor’s wife.
verses.textEnNkjv: They were like well-fed lusty stallions; Every one neighed after his neighbor’s wife.
verses.textEnNlt: They are well-fed, lusty stallions, each neighing for his neighbor’s wife.
verses.textEnNasb: "They were well-fed lusty horses, Each one neighing at his neighbor’s wife.
verses.textEn: They are well-fed, lusty stallions, each neighing for another man’s wife.

verses.textZh: 我因这些事怎能不施行惩罚呢？ 像这样的国家， 我怎能不亲自报复呢？" 这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我因这些事怎能不施行惩罚呢？ 像这样的国家， 我怎能不亲自报复呢？" 这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华说：我岂不因这些事讨罪呢？ 岂不报复这样的国民呢？
verses.textEnNiv: Should I not punish them for this?" declares the Lord . "Should I not avenge myself on such a nation as this?
verses.textEnEsv: Shall I not punish them for these things? declares the Lord ; and shall I not avenge myself on a nation such as this?
verses.textEnNkjv: Shall I not punish them for these things?" says the Lord. "And shall I not avenge Myself on such a nation as this?
verses.textEnNlt: Should I not punish them for this?" says the Lord . "Should I not avenge myself against such a nation?
verses.textEnNasb: "Shall I not punish them for these things?" declares the Lord, "And shall I not avenge Myself On a nation such as this?
verses.textEn: Should I not punish them for this?" declares the Lord . "Should I not avenge myself on such a nation as this?

verses.textZh: "你们要走进她的葡萄园 里施行毁坏， 但不可毁灭净尽，要除掉她的枝子， 因为它们不属耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你们要走进她的葡萄园 里施行毁坏， 但不可毁灭净尽，要除掉她的枝子， 因为它们不属耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要上她葡萄园的墙施行毁坏， 但不可毁坏净尽， 只可除掉她的枝子， 因为不属耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: "Go through her vineyards and ravage them, but do not destroy them completely. Strip off her branches, for these people do not belong to the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: "Go up through her vine rows and destroy, but make not a full end; strip away her branches, for they are not the Lord ’s.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Go up on her walls and destroy, But do not make a complete end. Take away her branches, For they are not the Lord’s.
verses.textEnNlt: "Go down the rows of the vineyards and destroy the grapevines, leaving a scattered few alive. Strip the branches from the vines, for these people do not belong to the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: "Go up through her vine rows and destroy, But do not execute a complete destruction; Strip away her branches, For they are not the Lord’s.
verses.textEn: "Go through her vineyards and ravage them, but do not destroy them completely. Strip off her branches, for these people do not belong to the Lord .

verses.textZh: 以色列家和犹大家， 待我实在太奸诈了。" 这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列家和犹大家， 待我实在太奸诈了。" 这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 原来以色列家和犹大家大行诡诈攻击我。 这是耶和华说的。
verses.textEnNiv: The people of Israel and the people of Judah have been utterly unfaithful to me," declares the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: For the house of Israel and the house of Judah have been utterly treacherous to me, declares the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: For the house of Israel and the house of Judah Have dealt very treacherously with Me," says the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: The people of Israel and Judah are full of treachery against me," says the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: "For the house of Israel and the house of Judah Have dealt very treacherously with Me," declares the Lord.
verses.textEn: The people of Israel and the people of Judah have been utterly unfaithful to me," declares the Lord .

verses.textZh: 他们不信耶和华， 说："他不会作甚么， 灾祸必不临到我们， 我们也不会看见刀剑和饥荒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们不信耶和华， 说："他不会作甚么， 灾祸必不临到我们， 我们也不会看见刀剑和饥荒。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们不认耶和华，说： 这并不是他， 灾祸必不临到我们； 刀剑和饥荒，我们也看不见。
verses.textEnNiv: They have lied about the Lord ; they said, "He will do nothing! No harm will come to us; we will never see sword or famine.
verses.textEnEsv: They have spoken falsely of the Lord and have said, ‘He will do nothing; no disaster will come upon us, nor shall we see sword or famine.
verses.textEnNkjv: They have lied about the Lord, And said, "Itis not He. Neither will evil come upon us, Nor shall we see sword or famine.
verses.textEnNlt: "They have lied about the Lord and said, ‘He won’t bother us! No disasters will come upon us. There will be no war or famine.
verses.textEnNasb: They have lied about the Lord And said, " Not He; Misfortune will not come upon us, Nor will we see sword or famine.
verses.textEn: They have lied about the Lord ; they said, "He will do nothing! No harm will come to us; we will never see sword or famine.

verses.textZh: 先知不过是一阵风， 主的道也不在他们里面； 他们所说的必临到他们身上。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 先知不过是一阵风， 主的道也不在他们里面； 他们所说的必临到他们身上。"
verses.textZhCuv: 先知的话必成为风； 道也不在他们里面。 这灾必临到他们身上。
verses.textEnNiv: The prophets are but wind and the word is not in them; so let what they say be done to them."
verses.textEnEsv: The prophets will become wind; the word is not in them. Thus shall it be done to them!’"
verses.textEnNkjv: And the prophets become wind, For the word is not in them. Thus shall it be done to them."
verses.textEnNlt: God’s prophets are all windbags who don’t really speak for him. Let their predictions of disaster fall on themselves!’"
verses.textEnNasb: "The prophets are as wind, And the word is not in them. So it will be done to them!"
verses.textEn: The prophets are but wind and the word is not in them; so let what they say be done to them."

verses.textZh: 因此，耶和华万军之神这样说： "因他们说了这话， 我必使我的话在你口中成为火， 使这人民成为柴， 火要把他们吞灭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，耶和华万军之神这样说： "因他们说了这话， 我必使我的话在你口中成为火， 使这人民成为柴， 火要把他们吞灭。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以耶和华－万军之神如此说： 因为百姓说这话， 我必使我的话在你口中为火，使他们为柴； 这火便将他们烧灭。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore this is what the Lord God Almighty says: "Because the people have spoken these words, I will make my words in your mouth a fire and these people the wood it consumes.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore thus says the Lord , the God of hosts: "Because you have spoken this word, behold, I am making my words in your mouth a fire, and this people wood, and the fire shall consume them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore thus says the Lord God of hosts: "Because you speak this word, Behold, I will make My words in your mouth fire, And this people wood, And it shall devour them.
verses.textEnNlt: Therefore, this is what the Lord God of Heaven’s Armies says: "Because the people are talking like this, my messages will flame out of your mouth and burn the people like kindling wood.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore, this is what the Lord, the God of armies says: "Because you have spoken this word, Behold, I am making My words fire in your mouth, And this people wood, and it will consume them.
verses.textEn: Therefore this is what the Lord God Almighty says: "Because the people have spoken these words, I will make my words in your mouth a fire and these people the wood it consumes.

verses.textZh: 以色列家啊！ 我必使一国从远方来攻击你们。" 这是耶和华的宣告。 "那国历久不衰， 从古就有； 他们的言语你们不懂得， 他们所说的你们不明白。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列家啊！ 我必使一国从远方来攻击你们。" 这是耶和华的宣告。 "那国历久不衰， 从古就有； 他们的言语你们不懂得， 他们所说的你们不明白。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华说：以色列家啊， 我必使一国的民从远方来攻击你， 是强盛的国， 是从古而有的国。 他们的言语你不晓得， 他们的话你不明白。
verses.textEnNiv: People of Israel," declares the Lord , "I am bringing a distant nation against you— an ancient and enduring nation, a people whose language you do not know, whose speech you do not understand.
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, I am bringing against you a nation from afar, O house of Israel, declares the Lord . It is an enduring nation; it is an ancient nation, a nation whose language you do not know, nor can you understand what they say.
verses.textEnNkjv: Behold, I will bring a nation against you from afar, O house of Israel," says the Lord. "It is a mighty nation, It is an ancient nation, A nation whose language you do not know, Nor can you understand what they say.
verses.textEnNlt: O Israel, I will bring a distant nation against you," says the Lord . "It is a mighty nation, an ancient nation, a people whose language you do not know, whose speech you cannot understand.
verses.textEnNasb: "Behold, I am bringing a nation against you from far away, you house of Israel," declares the Lord. "It is an enduring nation, It is an ancient nation, A nation whose language you do not know, Nor can you understand what they say.
verses.textEn: People of Israel," declares the Lord , "I am bringing a distant nation against you— an ancient and enduring nation, a people whose language you do not know, whose speech you do not understand.

verses.textZh: 他们的箭囊像敞开的坟墓， 他们尽都是勇士。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们的箭囊像敞开的坟墓， 他们尽都是勇士。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们的箭袋是敞开的坟墓； 他们都是勇士。
verses.textEnNiv: Their quivers are like an open grave; all of them are mighty warriors.
verses.textEnEsv: Their quiver is like an open tomb; they are all mighty warriors.
verses.textEnNkjv: Their quiver is like an open tomb; They are all mighty men.
verses.textEnNlt: Their weapons are deadly; their warriors are mighty.
verses.textEnNasb: "Their quiver is like an open grave, All of them are warriors.
verses.textEn: Their quivers are like an open grave; all of them are mighty warriors.

verses.textZh: 他们必吞灭你们的庄稼和粮食， 吞灭你的儿女， 你们的羊群牛群， 以及你们的葡萄和无花果； 他们也必用刀剑毁坏你们所倚仗的坚固城。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们必吞灭你们的庄稼和粮食， 吞灭你的儿女， 你们的羊群牛群， 以及你们的葡萄和无花果； 他们也必用刀剑毁坏你们所倚仗的坚固城。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们必吃尽你的庄稼和你的粮食， 是你儿女该吃的； 必吃尽你的牛羊， 吃尽你的葡萄和无花果； 又必用刀毁坏你所倚靠的坚固城。
verses.textEnNiv: They will devour your harvests and food, devour your sons and daughters; they will devour your flocks and herds, devour your vines and fig trees. With the sword they will destroy the fortified cities in which you trust.
verses.textEnEsv: They shall eat up your harvest and your food; they shall eat up your sons and your daughters; they shall eat up your flocks and your herds; they shall eat up your vines and your fig trees; your fortified cities in which you trust they shall beat down with the sword."
verses.textEnNkjv: And they shall eat up your harvest and your bread, Which your sons and daughters should eat. They shall eat up your flocks and your herds; They shall eat up your vines and your fig trees; They shall destroy your fortified cities, In which you trust, with the sword.
verses.textEnNlt: They will devour the food of your harvest; they will devour your sons and daughters. They will devour your flocks and herds; they will devour your grapes and figs. And they will destroy your fortified towns, which you think are so safe.
verses.textEnNasb: "They will devour your harvest and your food; They will devour your sons and your daughters; They will devour your flocks and your herds; They will devour your vines and your fig trees; They will demolish your fortified cities, in which you trust, with the sword.
verses.textEn: They will devour your harvests and food, devour your sons and daughters; they will devour your flocks and herds, devour your vines and fig trees. With the sword they will destroy the fortified cities in which you trust.

verses.textZh: 就是到了那时， 我也不把你们完全毁灭。" 这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 就是到了那时， 我也不把你们完全毁灭。" 这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华说：「就是到那时，我也不将你们毁灭净尽。
verses.textEnNiv: "Yet even in those days," declares the Lord , "I will not destroy you completely.
verses.textEnEsv: "But even in those days, declares the Lord , I will not make a full end of you.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Nevertheless in those days," says the Lord, "I will not make a complete end of you.
verses.textEnNlt: "Yet even in those days I will not blot you out completely," says the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: "Yet even in those days," declares the Lord, "I will not make a complete destruction of you.
verses.textEn: "Yet even in those days," declares the Lord , "I will not destroy you completely.

verses.textZh: "将来如果有人问：‘耶和华我们的神，为甚么向我们行这一切事呢？’你就要对他们说：‘你们怎样离弃我，在你们的土地上事奉外族人的神，你们也要在不属你们的土地上照样服事外族人。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: "将来如果有人问：‘耶和华我们的神，为甚么向我们行这一切事呢？’你就要对他们说：‘你们怎样离弃我，在你们的土地上事奉外族人的神，你们也要在不属你们的土地上照样服事外族人。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 百姓若说：『耶和华－我们的神为什么向我们行这一切事呢？』你就对他们说：『你们怎样离弃耶和华 ，在你们的地上事奉外邦神，也必照样在不属你们的地上事奉外邦人。』」
verses.textEnNiv: And when the people ask, ‘Why has the Lord our God done all this to us?’ you will tell them, ‘As you have forsaken me and served foreign gods in your own land, so now you will serve foreigners in a land not your own.’
verses.textEnEsv: And when your people say, ‘Why has the Lord our God done all these things to us?’ you shall say to them, ‘As you have forsaken me and served foreign gods in your land, so you shall serve foreigners in a land that is not yours.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: And it will be when you say, ‘Why does the Lord our God do all these things to us?’ then you shall answer them, ‘Just as you have forsaken Me and served foreign gods in your land, so you shall serve aliens in a land thatis not yours.’
verses.textEnNlt: "And when your people ask, ‘Why did the Lord our God do all this to us?’ you must reply, ‘You rejected him and gave yourselves to foreign gods in your own land. Now you will serve foreigners in a land that is not your own.’
verses.textEnNasb: And it shall come about when they say, ‘Why has the Lord our God done all these things to us?’ then you shall say to them, ‘Just as you have abandoned Me and served foreign gods in your land, so you will serve strangers in a land that is not yours.’
verses.textEn: And when the people ask, ‘Why has the Lord our God done all this to us?’ you will tell them, ‘As you have forsaken me and served foreign gods in your own land, so now you will serve foreigners in a land not your own.’

verses.textZh: 你们要在雅各家宣告这事， 在犹大传扬，说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要在雅各家宣告这事， 在犹大传扬，说：
verses.textZhCuv: 当传扬在雅各家， 报告在犹大说：
verses.textEnNiv: "Announce this to the descendants of Jacob and proclaim it in Judah:
verses.textEnEsv: Declare this in the house of Jacob; proclaim it in Judah:
verses.textEnNkjv: "Declare this in the house of Jacob And proclaim it in Judah, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: "Make this announcement to Israel, and say this to Judah:
verses.textEnNasb: "Declare this in the house of Jacob And proclaim it in Judah, saying,
verses.textEn: "Announce this to the descendants of Jacob and proclaim it in Judah:

verses.textZh: "愚昧无知的民哪！ 你们有眼不能看， 有耳不能听； 你们应当听这话：
verses.textZhCnvs: "愚昧无知的民哪！ 你们有眼不能看， 有耳不能听； 你们应当听这话：
verses.textZhCuv: 愚昧无知的百姓啊， 你们有眼不看， 有耳不听， 现在当听这话。
verses.textEnNiv: Hear this, you foolish and senseless people, who have eyes but do not see, who have ears but do not hear:
verses.textEnEsv: "Hear this, O foolish and senseless people, who have eyes, but see not, who have ears, but hear not.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘Hear this now, O foolish people, Without understanding, Who have eyes and see not, And who have ears and hear not:
verses.textEnNlt: Listen, you foolish and senseless people, with eyes that do not see and ears that do not hear.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Now hear this, you foolish and senseless people, Who have eyes but do not see, Who have ears but do not hear.
verses.textEn: Hear this, you foolish and senseless people, who have eyes but do not see, who have ears but do not hear:

verses.textZh: ‘你们连我都不惧怕吗？ 在我面前你们也不战兢吗？’ 这是耶和华的宣告。 ‘我以沙作海的疆界， 作永远的界限，海就不能越过； 波浪翻腾，却不能漫过； 怒涛澎湃，仍无法逾越。
verses.textZhCnvs: ‘你们连我都不惧怕吗？ 在我面前你们也不战兢吗？’ 这是耶和华的宣告。 ‘我以沙作海的疆界， 作永远的界限，海就不能越过； 波浪翻腾，却不能漫过； 怒涛澎湃，仍无法逾越。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华说：你们怎么不惧怕我呢？ 我以永远的定例， 用沙为海的界限， 水不得越过。 因此，你们在我面前还不战兢吗？ 波浪虽然翻腾，却不能逾越； 虽然匉訇，却不能过去。
verses.textEnNiv: Should you not fear me?" declares the Lord . "Should you not tremble in my presence? I made the sand a boundary for the sea, an everlasting barrier it cannot cross. The waves may roll, but they cannot prevail; they may roar, but they cannot cross it.
verses.textEnEsv: Do you not fear me? declares the Lord . Do you not tremble before me? I placed the sand as the boundary for the sea, a perpetual barrier that it cannot pass; though the waves toss, they cannot prevail; though they roar, they cannot pass over it.
verses.textEnNkjv: Do you not fear Me?’ says the Lord. ‘Will you not tremble at My presence, Who have placed the sand as the bound of the sea, By a perpetual decree, that it cannot pass beyond it? And though its waves toss to and fro, Yet they cannot prevail; Though they roar, yet they cannot pass over it.
verses.textEnNlt: Have you no respect for me? Why don’t you tremble in my presence? I, the Lord , define the ocean’s sandy shoreline as an everlasting boundary that the waters cannot cross. The waves may toss and roar, but they can never pass the boundaries I set.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Do you not fear Me?’ declares the Lord. ‘Do you not tremble in My presence? For I have placed the sand as a boundary for the sea, An eternal limit, and it will not cross over it. Though the waves toss, they cannot prevail; Though they roar, they will not cross over it.
verses.textEn: Should you not fear me?" declares the Lord . "Should you not tremble in my presence? I made the sand a boundary for the sea, an everlasting barrier it cannot cross. The waves may roll, but they cannot prevail; they may roar, but they cannot cross it.

verses.textZh: 可是这人民，竟存着顽梗悖逆的心； 背我而去。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 可是这人民，竟存着顽梗悖逆的心； 背我而去。’
verses.textZhCuv: 但这百姓有背叛忤逆的心； 他们叛我而去，
verses.textEnNiv: But these people have stubborn and rebellious hearts; they have turned aside and gone away.
verses.textEnEsv: But this people has a stubborn and rebellious heart; they have turned aside and gone away.
verses.textEnNkjv: But this people has a defiant and rebellious heart; They have revolted and departed.
verses.textEnNlt: But my people have stubborn and rebellious hearts. They have turned away and abandoned me.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘But this people has a stubborn and rebellious heart; They have turned aside and departed.
verses.textEn: But these people have stubborn and rebellious hearts; they have turned aside and gone away.

verses.textZh: 他们心里也不想想： ‘我们应当敬畏耶和华我们的神， 他按时赐雨，就是秋雨春霖， 又为我们保存定时收割的节令。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们心里也不想想： ‘我们应当敬畏耶和华我们的神， 他按时赐雨，就是秋雨春霖， 又为我们保存定时收割的节令。’
verses.textZhCuv: 心内也不说： 我们应当敬畏耶和华－我们的神； 他按时赐雨，就是秋雨春雨， 又为我们定收割的节令，永存不废。
verses.textEnNiv: They do not say to themselves, ‘Let us fear the Lord our God, who gives autumn and spring rains in season, who assures us of the regular weeks of harvest.’
verses.textEnEsv: They do not say in their hearts, ‘Let us fear the Lord our God, who gives the rain in its season, the autumn rain and the spring rain, and keeps for us the weeks appointed for the harvest.’
verses.textEnNkjv: They do not say in their heart, "Let us now fear the Lord our God, Who gives rain, both the former and the latter, in its season. He reserves for us the appointed weeks of the harvest."
verses.textEnNlt: They do not say from the heart, ‘Let us live in awe of the Lord our God, for he gives us rain each spring and fall, assuring us of a harvest when the time is right.’
verses.textEnNasb: ‘They do not say in their heart, "Let us now fear the Lord our God, Who gives rain in its season, Both the autumn rain and the spring rain, Who keeps for us The appointed weeks of the harvest."
