verses.textEn: They do not say to themselves, ‘Let us fear the Lord our God, who gives autumn and spring rains in season, who assures us of the regular weeks of harvest.’

verses.textZh: 你们的罪孽使这些都离开了， 你们的罪恶剥夺了你们的幸福。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们的罪孽使这些都离开了， 你们的罪恶剥夺了你们的幸福。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们的罪孽使这些事转离你们； 你们的罪恶使你们不能得福。
verses.textEnNiv: Your wrongdoings have kept these away; your sins have deprived you of good.
verses.textEnEsv: Your iniquities have turned these away, and your sins have kept good from you.
verses.textEnNkjv: Your iniquities have turned these things away, And your sins have withheld good from you.
verses.textEnNlt: Your wickedness has deprived you of these wonderful blessings. Your sin has robbed you of all these good things.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Your wrongdoings have turned these away, And your sins have kept good away from you.
verses.textEn: Your wrongdoings have kept these away; your sins have deprived you of good.

verses.textZh: 在我的子民中发现了恶人， 他们好象捕鸟的人蹲伏窥探， 装置网罗捕捉人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在我的子民中发现了恶人， 他们好象捕鸟的人蹲伏窥探， 装置网罗捕捉人。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为在我民中有恶人。 他们埋伏窥探，好像捕鸟的人； 他们设立圈套陷害人。
verses.textEnNiv: "Among my people are the wicked who lie in wait like men who snare birds and like those who set traps to catch people.
verses.textEnEsv: For wicked men are found among my people; they lurk like fowlers lying in wait. They set a trap; they catch men.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘For among My people are found wicked men; They lie in wait as one who sets snares; They set a trap; They catch men.
verses.textEnNlt: "Among my people are wicked men who lie in wait for victims like a hunter hiding in a blind. They continually set traps to catch people.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘For wicked people are found among My people, They watch like fowlers lying in wait; They set a trap, They catch people.
verses.textEn: "Among my people are the wicked who lie in wait like men who snare birds and like those who set traps to catch people.

verses.textZh: 笼中怎样满了雀鸟， 他们的屋里也满了诡诈； 他们就因此财雄势大。
verses.textZhCnvs: 笼中怎样满了雀鸟， 他们的屋里也满了诡诈； 他们就因此财雄势大。
verses.textZhCuv: 笼内怎样满了雀鸟， 他们的房中也照样充满诡诈； 所以他们得成为大，而且富足。
verses.textEnNiv: Like cages full of birds, their houses are full of deceit; they have become rich and powerful
verses.textEnEsv: Like a cage full of birds, their houses are full of deceit; therefore they have become great and rich;
verses.textEnNkjv: As a cage is full of birds, So their houses are full of deceit. Therefore they have become great and grown rich.
verses.textEnNlt: Like a cage filled with birds, their homes are filled with evil plots. And now they are great and rich.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Like a cage full of birds, So their houses are full of deceit; Therefore they have become great and rich.
verses.textEn: Like cages full of birds, their houses are full of deceit; they have become rich and powerful

verses.textZh: 他们肥胖光润， 作尽各种坏事； 他们不为人辩护， 不替孤儿辨屈，使他们获益， 也不为穷人伸冤。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们肥胖光润， 作尽各种坏事； 他们不为人辩护， 不替孤儿辨屈，使他们获益， 也不为穷人伸冤。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们肥胖光润， 作恶过甚，不为人伸冤！ 就是不为孤儿伸冤， 不使他亨通， 也不为穷人辨屈。
verses.textEnNiv: and have grown fat and sleek. Their evil deeds have no limit; they do not seek justice. They do not promote the case of the fatherless; they do not defend the just cause of the poor.
verses.textEnEsv: they have grown fat and sleek. They know no bounds in deeds of evil; they judge not with justice the cause of the fatherless, to make it prosper, and they do not defend the rights of the needy.
verses.textEnNkjv: They have grown fat, they are sleek; Yes, they surpass the deeds of the wicked; They do not plead the cause, The cause of the fatherless; Yet they prosper, And the right of the needy they do not defend.
verses.textEnNlt: They are fat and sleek, and there is no limit to their wicked deeds. They refuse to provide justice to orphans and deny the rights of the poor.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘They are fat, they are sleek, They also excel in deeds of wickedness; They do not plead the cause, The cause of the orphan, so that they may be successful; And they do not defend the rights of the poor.
verses.textEn: and have grown fat and sleek. Their evil deeds have no limit; they do not seek justice. They do not promote the case of the fatherless; they do not defend the just cause of the poor.

verses.textZh: 我因这些事怎能不施行惩罚呢？ 像这样的国家， 我怎能不亲自报复呢？" 这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我因这些事怎能不施行惩罚呢？ 像这样的国家， 我怎能不亲自报复呢？" 这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华说：我岂不因这些事讨罪呢？ 岂不报复这样的国民呢？
verses.textEnNiv: Should I not punish them for this?" declares the Lord . "Should I not avenge myself on such a nation as this?
verses.textEnEsv: Shall I not punish them for these things? declares the Lord , and shall I not avenge myself on a nation such as this?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Shall I not punish them for these things?’ says the Lord. ‘Shall I not avenge Myself on such a nation as this?’
verses.textEnNlt: Should I not punish them for this?" says the Lord . "Should I not avenge myself against such a nation?
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Shall I not punish them for these things?’ declares the Lord, ‘Or shall I not avenge Myself On a nation such as this?’
verses.textEn: Should I not punish them for this?" declares the Lord . "Should I not avenge myself on such a nation as this?

verses.textZh: "恐怖骇人的事在国中发生了。
verses.textZhCnvs: "恐怖骇人的事在国中发生了。
verses.textZhCuv: 国中有可惊骇、可憎恶的事：
verses.textEnNiv: "A horrible and shocking thing has happened in the land:
verses.textEnEsv: An appalling and horrible thing has happened in the land:
verses.textEnNkjv: "An astonishing and horrible thing Has been committed in the land:
verses.textEnNlt: A horrible and shocking thing has happened in this land—
verses.textEnNasb: "An appalling and horrible thing Has happened in the land:
verses.textEn: "A horrible and shocking thing has happened in the land:

verses.textZh: 先知说假预言， 祭司凭己意把持权柄。 我的子民竟喜爱这样， 到了结局你们怎么办呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 先知说假预言， 祭司凭己意把持权柄。 我的子民竟喜爱这样， 到了结局你们怎么办呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 就是先知说假预言， 祭司藉他们把持权柄； 我的百姓也喜爱这些事， 到了结局你们怎样行呢？
verses.textEnNiv: The prophets prophesy lies, the priests rule by their own authority, and my people love it this way. But what will you do in the end?
verses.textEnEsv: the prophets prophesy falsely, and the priests rule at their direction; my people love to have it so, but what will you do when the end comes?
verses.textEnNkjv: The prophets prophesy falsely, And the priests rule by their own power; And My people love tohaveit so. But what will you do in the end?
verses.textEnNlt: the prophets give false prophecies, and the priests rule with an iron hand. Worse yet, my people like it that way! But what will you do when the end comes?
verses.textEnNasb: The prophets prophesy falsely, And the priests rule on their own authority; And My people love it this way! But what will you do when the end comes?
verses.textEn: The prophets prophesy lies, the priests rule by their own authority, and my people love it this way. But what will you do in the end?

verses.textZh: "便雅悯人哪！赶快逃命， 离开耶路撒冷。 你们要在提哥亚吹角， 在伯．哈基琳升烽火； 因为灾祸和严重的毁灭， 已从北方迫近。
verses.textZhCnvs: "便雅悯人哪！赶快逃命， 离开耶路撒冷。 你们要在提哥亚吹角， 在伯．哈基琳升烽火； 因为灾祸和严重的毁灭， 已从北方迫近。
verses.textZhCuv: 便雅悯人哪，你们要逃出耶路撒冷， 在提哥亚吹角， 在伯‧哈基琳立号旗； 因为有灾祸与大毁灭从北方张望。
verses.textEnNiv: "Flee for safety, people of Benjamin! Flee from Jerusalem! Sound the trumpet in Tekoa! Raise the signal over Beth Hakkerem! For disaster looms out of the north, even terrible destruction.
verses.textEnEsv: Flee for safety, O people of Benjamin, from the midst of Jerusalem! Blow the trumpet in Tekoa, and raise a signal on Beth-haccherem, for disaster looms out of the north, and great destruction.
verses.textEnNkjv: "O you children of Benjamin, Gather yourselves to flee from the midst of Jerusalem! Blow the trumpet in Tekoa, And set up a signal-fire in Beth Haccerem; For disaster appears out of the north, And great destruction.
verses.textEnNlt: "Run for your lives, you people of Benjamin! Get out of Jerusalem! Sound the alarm in Tekoa! Send up a signal at Beth-hakkerem! A powerful army is coming from the north, coming with disaster and destruction.
verses.textEnNasb: "Flee to safety, you sons of Benjamin, From the midst of Jerusalem! Blow a trumpet in Tekoa And raise a warning signal over Beth-haccerem; For evil looks down from the north, Along with a great destruction.
verses.textEn: "Flee for safety, people of Benjamin! Flee from Jerusalem! Sound the trumpet in Tekoa! Raise the signal over Beth Hakkerem! For disaster looms out of the north, even terrible destruction.

verses.textZh: 美丽高贵的锡安居民 ， 我必除灭你们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 美丽高贵的锡安居民 ， 我必除灭你们。
verses.textZhCuv: 那秀美娇嫩的锡安女子 ， 我必剪除。
verses.textEnNiv: I will destroy Daughter Zion, so beautiful and delicate.
verses.textEnEsv: The lovely and delicately bred I will destroy, the daughter of Zion.
verses.textEnNkjv: I have likened the daughter of Zion To a lovely and delicate woman.
verses.textEnNlt: O Jerusalem, you are my beautiful and delicate daughter— but I will destroy you!
verses.textEnNasb: "The beautiful and delicate one, the daughter of Zion, I will destroy.
verses.textEn: I will destroy Daughter Zion, so beautiful and delicate.

verses.textZh: 牧人必带着他们的羊群， 来到锡安那里， 在城的四围支搭帐棚， 各在自己的地方分别牧放羊群。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 牧人必带着他们的羊群， 来到锡安那里， 在城的四围支搭帐棚， 各在自己的地方分别牧放羊群。"
verses.textZhCuv: 牧人必引他们的羊群到她那里， 在她周围支搭帐棚， 各在自己所占之地使羊吃草。
verses.textEnNiv: Shepherds with their flocks will come against her; they will pitch their tents around her, each tending his own portion."
verses.textEnEsv: Shepherds with their flocks shall come against her; they shall pitch their tents around her; they shall pasture, each in his place.
verses.textEnNkjv: The shepherds with their flocks shall come to her. They shall pitch their tents against her all around. Each one shall pasture in his own place."
verses.textEnNlt: Enemies will surround you, like shepherds camped around the city. Each chooses a place for his troops to devour.
verses.textEnNasb: "Shepherds and their flocks will come to her, They will pitch their tents around her, They will pasture, each in his place.
verses.textEn: Shepherds with their flocks will come against her; they will pitch their tents around her, each tending his own portion."

verses.textZh: "你们要备战攻击她！ 起来！我们趁着正午上去。 唉！可惜日渐西沉， 暮影拖长了！
verses.textZhCnvs: "你们要备战攻击她！ 起来！我们趁着正午上去。 唉！可惜日渐西沉， 暮影拖长了！
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要准备攻击她。 起来吧，我们可以趁午时上去。 哀哉！日已渐斜， 晚影拖长了。
verses.textEnNiv: "Prepare for battle against her! Arise, let us attack at noon! But, alas, the daylight is fading, and the shadows of evening grow long.
verses.textEnEsv: "Prepare war against her; arise, and let us attack at noon! Woe to us, for the day declines, for the shadows of evening lengthen!
verses.textEnNkjv: "Prepare war against her; Arise, and let us go up at noon. Woe to us, for the day goes away, For the shadows of the evening are lengthening.
verses.textEnNlt: They shout, ‘Prepare for battle! Attack at noon!’ ‘No, it’s too late; the day is fading, and the evening shadows are falling.’
verses.textEnNasb: ‘ Prepare for war against her; Arise, and let’s attack at noon. Woe to us, for the day declines, For the shadows of the evening lengthen!
verses.textEn: "Prepare for battle against her! Arise, let us attack at noon! But, alas, the daylight is fading, and the shadows of evening grow long.

verses.textZh: 起来！我们趁着夜间上去， 毁坏她的堡垒。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 起来！我们趁着夜间上去， 毁坏她的堡垒。"
verses.textZhCuv: 起来吧，我们夜间上去， 毁坏她的宫殿。
verses.textEnNiv: So arise, let us attack at night and destroy her fortresses!"
verses.textEnEsv: Arise, and let us attack by night and destroy her palaces!"
verses.textEnNkjv: Arise, and let us go by night, And let us destroy her palaces."
verses.textEnNlt: ‘Well then, let’s attack at night and destroy her palaces!’"
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Arise, and let’s attack by night And destroy her palaces!’ "
verses.textEn: So arise, let us attack at night and destroy her fortresses!"

verses.textZh: 因为万军之耶和华这样说： "砍下她的树木， 筑垒攻打耶路撒冷； 她是那该受惩罚的城， 其中尽是欺压的事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为万军之耶和华这样说： "砍下她的树木， 筑垒攻打耶路撒冷； 她是那该受惩罚的城， 其中尽是欺压的事。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为万军之耶和华如此说： 你们要砍伐树木， 筑垒攻打耶路撒冷。 这就是那该罚的城， 其中尽是欺压。
verses.textEnNiv: This is what the Lord Almighty says: "Cut down the trees and build siege ramps against Jerusalem. This city must be punished; it is filled with oppression.
verses.textEnEsv: For thus says the Lord of hosts: "Cut down her trees; cast up a siege mound against Jerusalem. This is the city that must be punished; there is nothing but oppression within her.
verses.textEnNkjv: For thus has the Lord of hosts said: "Cut down trees, And build a mound against Jerusalem. This is the city to be punished. She is full of oppression in her midst.
verses.textEnNlt: This is what the Lord of Heaven’s Armies says: "Cut down the trees for battering rams. Build siege ramps against the walls of Jerusalem. This is the city to be punished, for she is wicked through and through.
verses.textEnNasb: For this is what the Lord of armies says: "Cut down her trees And pile up an assault ramp against Jerusalem. This is the city to be punished, In whose midst there is only oppression.
verses.textEn: This is what the Lord Almighty says: "Cut down the trees and build siege ramps against Jerusalem. This city must be punished; it is filled with oppression.

verses.textZh: 井怎样涌出水来， 这城也怎样涌出恶来； 城中常常听到强暴和毁灭的事， 在我面前不断有病患与创伤。
verses.textZhCnvs: 井怎样涌出水来， 这城也怎样涌出恶来； 城中常常听到强暴和毁灭的事， 在我面前不断有病患与创伤。
verses.textZhCuv: 井怎样涌出水来， 这城也照样涌出恶来； 在其间常听见有强暴毁灭的事， 病患损伤也常在我面前。
verses.textEnNiv: As a well pours out its water, so she pours out her wickedness. Violence and destruction resound in her; her sickness and wounds are ever before me.
verses.textEnEsv: As a well keeps its water fresh, so she keeps fresh her evil; violence and destruction are heard within her; sickness and wounds are ever before me.
verses.textEnNkjv: As a fountain wells up with water, So she wells up with her wickedness. Violence and plundering are heard in her. Before Me continually are grief and wounds.
verses.textEnNlt: She spouts evil like a fountain. Her streets echo with the sounds of violence and destruction. I always see her sickness and sores.
verses.textEnNasb: "As a well keeps its waters fresh, So she keeps fresh her wickedness. Violence and destruction are heard in her; Sickness and wounds are constantly before Me.
verses.textEn: As a well pours out its water, so she pours out her wickedness. Violence and destruction resound in her; her sickness and wounds are ever before me.

verses.textZh: 耶路撒冷啊！应当受警戒， 免得我的心与你疏远， 免得我使你荒凉， 成为无人居住之地。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶路撒冷啊！应当受警戒， 免得我的心与你疏远， 免得我使你荒凉， 成为无人居住之地。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶路撒冷啊，你当受教， 免得我心与你生疏， 免得我使你荒凉， 成为无人居住之地。
verses.textEnNiv: Take warning, Jerusalem, or I will turn away from you and make your land desolate so no one can live in it."
verses.textEnEsv: Be warned, O Jerusalem, lest I turn from you in disgust, lest I make you a desolation, an uninhabited land."
verses.textEnNkjv: Be instructed, O Jerusalem, Lest My soul depart from you; Lest I make you desolate, A land not inhabited."
verses.textEnNlt: Listen to this warning, Jerusalem, or I will turn from you in disgust. Listen, or I will turn you into a heap of ruins, a land where no one lives."
verses.textEnNasb: "Be warned, Jerusalem, Or I shall be alienated from you, And make you a desolation, An uninhabited land."
verses.textEn: Take warning, Jerusalem, or I will turn away from you and make your land desolate so no one can live in it."

verses.textZh: 万军之耶和华这样说： "任凭他们像摘净葡萄一样对待以色列剩下的人； 你要像摘葡萄的人， 向枝子伸手，摘了又摘。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 万军之耶和华这样说： "任凭他们像摘净葡萄一样对待以色列剩下的人； 你要像摘葡萄的人， 向枝子伸手，摘了又摘。"
verses.textZhCuv: 万军之耶和华曾如此说： 敌人必掳尽以色列剩下的民， 如同摘净葡萄一样。 你要像摘葡萄的人摘了又摘，回手放在筐子里。
verses.textEnNiv: This is what the Lord Almighty says: "Let them glean the remnant of Israel as thoroughly as a vine; pass your hand over the branches again, like one gathering grapes."
verses.textEnEsv: Thus says the Lord of hosts: "They shall glean thoroughly as a vine the remnant of Israel; like a grape gatherer pass your hand again over its branches."
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus says the Lord of hosts: "They shall thoroughly glean as a vine the remnant of Israel; As a grape-gatherer, put your hand back into the branches."
verses.textEnNlt: This is what the Lord of Heaven’s Armies says: "Even the few who remain in Israel will be picked over again, as when a harvester checks each vine a second time to pick the grapes that were missed."
verses.textEnNasb: This is what the Lord of armies says: "They will thoroughly glean the remnant of Israel like the vine; Pass your hand over the branches again Like a grape gatherer."
verses.textEn: This is what the Lord Almighty says: "Let them glean the remnant of Israel as thoroughly as a vine; pass your hand over the branches again, like one gathering grapes."

verses.textZh: 我可以向谁说话，向谁警告， 使他们可以听从呢？ 他们的耳朵未受割礼， 不能听闻； 看哪！他们以耶和华的话为羞辱， 一点也不喜欢。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我可以向谁说话，向谁警告， 使他们可以听从呢？ 他们的耳朵未受割礼， 不能听闻； 看哪！他们以耶和华的话为羞辱， 一点也不喜欢。
verses.textZhCuv: 现在我可以向谁说话作见证，使他们听呢？ 他们的耳朵未受割礼，不能听见。 看哪，耶和华的话他们以为羞辱， 不以为喜悦。
verses.textEnNiv: To whom can I speak and give warning? Who will listen to me? Their ears are closed so they cannot hear. The word of the Lord is offensive to them; they find no pleasure in it.
verses.textEnEsv: To whom shall I speak and give warning, that they may hear? Behold, their ears are uncircumcised, they cannot listen; behold, the word of the Lord is to them an object of scorn; they take no pleasure in it.
verses.textEnNkjv: To whom shall I speak and give warning, That they may hear? Indeed their ear is uncircumcised, And they cannot give heed. Behold, the word of the Lord is a reproach to them; They have no delight in it.
verses.textEnNlt: To whom can I give warning? Who will listen when I speak? Their ears are closed, and they cannot hear. They scorn the word of the Lord . They don’t want to listen at all.
verses.textEnNasb: To whom shall I speak and give warning, That they may hear? Behold, their ears are closed And they cannot listen. Behold, the word of the Lord has become for them a rebuke; They take no delight in it.
verses.textEn: To whom can I speak and give warning? Who will listen to me? Their ears are closed so they cannot hear. The word of the Lord is offensive to them; they find no pleasure in it.

verses.textZh: 因此，我心里充满耶和华的忿怒， 无法容忍。 "你要把我的忿怒向街上的孩童倾倒， 又倾在联群集结的年轻人身上。 夫妻一起被捉住， 年老的、寿高的也不例外。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，我心里充满耶和华的忿怒， 无法容忍。 "你要把我的忿怒向街上的孩童倾倒， 又倾在联群集结的年轻人身上。 夫妻一起被捉住， 年老的、寿高的也不例外。
verses.textZhCuv: 因此我被耶和华的忿怒充满，难以含忍。 我要倾在街中的孩童和聚会的少年人身上， 连夫带妻， 并年老的与日子满足的都必被擒拿。
verses.textEnNiv: But I am full of the wrath of the Lord , and I cannot hold it in. "Pour it out on the children in the street and on the young men gathered together; both husband and wife will be caught in it, and the old, those weighed down with years.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore I am full of the wrath of the Lord ; I am weary of holding it in. "Pour it out upon the children in the street, and upon the gatherings of young men, also; both husband and wife shall be taken, the elderly and the very aged.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore I am full of the fury of the Lord. I am weary of holding it in. "I will pour it out on the children outside, And on the assembly of young men together; For even the husband shall be taken with the wife, The aged with himwhois full of days.
verses.textEnNlt: So now I am filled with the Lord ’s fury. Yes, I am tired of holding it in! "I will pour out my fury on children playing in the streets and on gatherings of young men, on husbands and wives and on those who are old and gray.
verses.textEnNasb: But I am full of the wrath of the Lord; I am weary of holding it in. "Pour it out on the children in the street And on the gathering of young men together; For both husband and wife shall be taken, The old and the very old.
verses.textEn: But I am full of the wrath of the Lord , and I cannot hold it in. "Pour it out on the children in the street and on the young men gathered together; both husband and wife will be caught in it, and the old, those weighed down with years.

verses.textZh: 他们的房屋、田地与妻子， 都要一起转归别人； 因为我要伸手， 攻击这地的居民。" 这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们的房屋、田地与妻子， 都要一起转归别人； 因为我要伸手， 攻击这地的居民。" 这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们的房屋、田地， 和妻子都必转归别人； 我要伸手攻击这地的居民。 这是耶和华说的。
verses.textEnNiv: Their houses will be turned over to others, together with their fields and their wives, when I stretch out my hand against those who live in the land," declares the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: Their houses shall be turned over to others, their fields and wives together, for I will stretch out my hand against the inhabitants of the land," declares the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: And their houses shall be turned over to others, Fields and wives together; For I will stretch out My hand Against the inhabitants of the land," says the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: Their homes will be turned over to their enemies, as will their fields and their wives. For I will raise my powerful fist against the people of this land," says the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: "Their houses shall be turned over to others, Their fields and their wives together; For I will stretch out My hand Against the inhabitants of the land," declares the Lord.
verses.textEn: Their houses will be turned over to others, together with their fields and their wives, when I stretch out my hand against those who live in the land," declares the Lord .

verses.textZh: "他们从最小的到最大的， 个个都贪图不义之财； 从先知到祭司， 全都行事诡诈。
verses.textZhCnvs: "他们从最小的到最大的， 个个都贪图不义之财； 从先知到祭司， 全都行事诡诈。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为他们从最小的到至大的都一味地贪婪， 从先知到祭司都行事虚谎。
verses.textEnNiv: "From the least to the greatest, all are greedy for gain; prophets and priests alike, all practice deceit.
verses.textEnEsv: "For from the least to the greatest of them, everyone is greedy for unjust gain; and from prophet to priest, everyone deals falsely.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Because from the least of them even to the greatest of them, Everyone is given to covetousness; And from the prophet even to the priest, Everyone deals falsely.
verses.textEnNlt: "From the least to the greatest, their lives are ruled by greed. From prophets to priests, they are all frauds.
verses.textEnNasb: "For from the least of them to the greatest of them, Everyone is greedy for gain, And from the prophet to the priest Everyone deals falsely.
verses.textEn: "From the least to the greatest, all are greedy for gain; prophets and priests alike, all practice deceit.

verses.textZh: 他们草率地医治我子民 的损伤， 说：‘平安了！平安了！’ 其实没有平安。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们草率地医治我子民 的损伤， 说：‘平安了！平安了！’ 其实没有平安。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们轻轻忽忽地医治我百姓的损伤， 说：平安了！平安了！ 其实没有平安。
verses.textEnNiv: They dress the wound of my people as though it were not serious. ‘Peace, peace,’ they say, when there is no peace.
verses.textEnEsv: They have healed the wound of my people lightly, saying, ‘Peace, peace,’ when there is no peace.
verses.textEnNkjv: They have also healed the hurt of My people slightly, Saying, ‘Peace, peace!’ When thereis no peace.
verses.textEnNlt: They offer superficial treatments for my people’s mortal wound. They give assurances of peace when there is no peace.
verses.textEnNasb: "They have healed the brokenness of My people superficially, Saying, ‘Peace, peace,’ But there is no peace.
verses.textEn: They dress the wound of my people as though it were not serious. ‘Peace, peace,’ they say, when there is no peace.

verses.textZh: 耶和华说： "他们行了可憎的事，本应觉得羞愧， 可是他们一点羞愧都没有， 恬不知耻。 因此他们必仆倒在倒下的人中间， 我惩罚他们的时候，他们必倒下来。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华说： "他们行了可憎的事，本应觉得羞愧， 可是他们一点羞愧都没有， 恬不知耻。 因此他们必仆倒在倒下的人中间， 我惩罚他们的时候，他们必倒下来。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们行可憎的事知道惭愧吗？ 不然，他们毫不惭愧， 也不知羞耻。 因此，他们必在仆倒的人中仆倒； 我向他们讨罪的时候， 他们必致跌倒。 这是耶和华说的。
verses.textEnNiv: Are they ashamed of their detestable conduct? No, they have no shame at all; they do not even know how to blush. So they will fall among the fallen; they will be brought down when I punish them," says the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: Were they ashamed when they committed abomination? No, they were not at all ashamed; they did not know how to blush. Therefore they shall fall among those who fall; at the time that I punish them, they shall be overthrown," says the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: Were they ashamed when they had committed abomination? No! They were not at all ashamed; Nor did they know how to blush. Therefore they shall fall among those who fall; At the time I punish them, They shall be cast down," says the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: Are they ashamed of their disgusting actions? Not at all—they don’t even know how to blush! Therefore, they will lie among the slaughtered. They will be brought down when I punish them," says the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: "Were they ashamed because of the abomination they had done? They were not ashamed at all, Nor did they know even how to be ashamed. Therefore they will fall among those who fall; At the time that I punish them, They will collapse," says the Lord.
verses.textEn: Are they ashamed of their detestable conduct? No, they have no shame at all; they do not even know how to blush. So they will fall among the fallen; they will be brought down when I punish them," says the Lord .

verses.textZh: 耶和华这样说： "你们要站在路上察看， 寻访远古的路径， 看哪一条是美善的路，就走在其中； 这样，你们心里就必得安息。 他们却说：‘我们不走在其中。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华这样说： "你们要站在路上察看， 寻访远古的路径， 看哪一条是美善的路，就走在其中； 这样，你们心里就必得安息。 他们却说：‘我们不走在其中。’
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华如此说： 你们当站在路上察看， 访问古道， 哪是善道，便行在其间； 这样，你们心里必得安息。 他们却说：我们不行在其间。
verses.textEnNiv: This is what the Lord says: "Stand at the crossroads and look; ask for the ancient paths, ask where the good way is, and walk in it, and you will find rest for your souls. But you said, ‘We will not walk in it.’
verses.textEnEsv: Thus says the Lord : "Stand by the roads, and look, and ask for the ancient paths, where the good way is; and walk in it, and find rest for your souls. But they said, ‘We will not walk in it.’
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus says the Lord: "Stand in the ways and see, And ask for the old paths, where the good way is, And walk in it; Then you will find rest for your souls. But they said, ‘We will not walk init.’
verses.textEnNlt: This is what the Lord says: "Stop at the crossroads and look around. Ask for the old, godly way, and walk in it. Travel its path, and you will find rest for your souls. But you reply, ‘No, that’s not the road we want!’
verses.textEnNasb: This is what the Lord says: "Stand by the ways and see and ask for the ancient paths, Where the good way is, and walk in it; Then you will find a resting place for your souls. But they said, ‘We will not walk in it.’
verses.textEn: This is what the Lord says: "Stand at the crossroads and look; ask for the ancient paths, ask where the good way is, and walk in it, and you will find rest for your souls. But you said, ‘We will not walk in it.’

verses.textZh: 我设立守望的人照管你们，说： ‘你们要留心听号角的声音！’ 他们却说：‘我们不听！’
verses.textZhCnvs: 我设立守望的人照管你们，说： ‘你们要留心听号角的声音！’ 他们却说：‘我们不听！’
verses.textZhCuv: 我设立守望的人照管你们， 说：要听角声。 他们却说：我们不听。
verses.textEnNiv: I appointed watchmen over you and said, ‘Listen to the sound of the trumpet!’ But you said, ‘We will not listen.’
verses.textEnEsv: I set watchmen over you, saying, ‘Pay attention to the sound of the trumpet!’ But they said, ‘We will not pay attention.’
verses.textEnNkjv: Also, I set watchmen over you, saying, ‘Listen to the sound of the trumpet!’ But they said, ‘We will not listen.’
verses.textEnNlt: I posted watchmen over you who said, ‘Listen for the sound of the alarm.’ But you replied, ‘No! We won’t pay attention!’
verses.textEnNasb: "And I set watchmen over you, saying, ‘Listen to the sound of the trumpet!’ But they said, ‘We will not listen.’
verses.textEn: I appointed watchmen over you and said, ‘Listen to the sound of the trumpet!’ But you said, ‘We will not listen.’

verses.textZh: 列国啊！因此你们要听。 以色列会众啊！要晓得他们将遭遇的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 列国啊！因此你们要听。 以色列会众啊！要晓得他们将遭遇的。
verses.textZhCuv: 列国啊，因此你们当听！ 会众啊，要知道他们必遭遇的事。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore hear, you nations; you who are witnesses, observe what will happen to them.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore hear, O nations, and know, O congregation, what will happen to them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore hear, you nations, And know, O congregation, what is among them.
verses.textEnNlt: "Therefore, listen to this, all you nations. Take note of my people’s situation.
verses.textEnNasb: "Therefore hear, you nations, And know, you congregation, what is among them.
verses.textEn: Therefore hear, you nations; you who are witnesses, observe what will happen to them.

verses.textZh: 大地啊，要听！ 我必使灾祸临到这人民， 这是他们的意图带来的结果； 因为他们没有留心听我的话， 我的律法他们也弃绝了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大地啊，要听！ 我必使灾祸临到这人民， 这是他们的意图带来的结果； 因为他们没有留心听我的话， 我的律法他们也弃绝了。
verses.textZhCuv: 地啊，当听！ 我必使灾祸临到这百姓， 就是他们意念所结的果子； 因为他们不听从我的言语， 至于我的训诲 ，他们也厌弃了。
verses.textEnNiv: Hear, you earth: I am bringing disaster on this people, the fruit of their schemes, because they have not listened to my words and have rejected my law.
verses.textEnEsv: Hear, O earth; behold, I am bringing disaster upon this people, the fruit of their devices, because they have not paid attention to my words; and as for my law, they have rejected it.
verses.textEnNkjv: Hear, O earth! Behold, I will certainly bring calamity on this people— The fruit of their thoughts, Because they have not heeded My words Nor My law, but rejected it.
verses.textEnNlt: Listen, all the earth! I will bring disaster on my people. It is the fruit of their own schemes, because they refuse to listen to me. They have rejected my word.
verses.textEnNasb: "Hear, earth: behold, I am bringing disaster on this people, The fruit of their plans, Because they have not listened to My words, And as for My Law, they have rejected it also.
verses.textEn: Hear, you earth: I am bringing disaster on this people, the fruit of their schemes, because they have not listened to my words and have rejected my law.

verses.textZh: 从示巴来的乳香， 从远地出的菖蒲，献给我有甚么益处呢？ 你们的燔祭不蒙悦纳， 你们的祭祀我不喜悦。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 从示巴来的乳香， 从远地出的菖蒲，献给我有甚么益处呢？ 你们的燔祭不蒙悦纳， 你们的祭祀我不喜悦。"
verses.textZhCuv: 从示巴出的乳香， 从远方出的菖蒲 奉来给我有何益呢？ 你们的燔祭不蒙悦纳； 你们的平安祭，我也不喜悦。
verses.textEnNiv: What do I care about incense from Sheba or sweet calamus from a distant land? Your burnt offerings are not acceptable; your sacrifices do not please me."
verses.textEnEsv: What use to me is frankincense that comes from Sheba, or sweet cane from a distant land? Your burnt offerings are not acceptable, nor your sacrifices pleasing to me.
verses.textEnNkjv: For what purpose to Me Comes frankincense from Sheba, And sweet cane from a far country? Your burnt offerings are not acceptable, Nor your sacrifices sweet to Me."
verses.textEnNlt: There’s no use offering me sweet frankincense from Sheba. Keep your fragrant calamus imported from distant lands! I will not accept your burnt offerings. Your sacrifices have no pleasing aroma for me."
verses.textEnNasb: "For what purpose does frankincense come to Me from Sheba, And the sweet cane from a distant land? Your burnt offerings are not acceptable And your sacrifices are not pleasing to Me."
verses.textEn: What do I care about incense from Sheba or sweet calamus from a distant land? Your burnt offerings are not acceptable; your sacrifices do not please me."

verses.textZh: 因此，耶和华这样说： "我要把绊脚石放在这人民的前面， 他们父子一起在其上绊倒， 邻舍与朋友也都灭亡。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，耶和华这样说： "我要把绊脚石放在这人民的前面， 他们父子一起在其上绊倒， 邻舍与朋友也都灭亡。"
verses.textZhCuv: 所以耶和华如此说： 我要将绊脚石放在这百姓前面。 父亲和儿子要一同跌在其上； 邻舍与朋友也都灭亡。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore this is what the Lord says: "I will put obstacles before this people. Parents and children alike will stumble over them; neighbors and friends will perish."
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore thus says the Lord : ‘Behold, I will lay before this people stumbling blocks against which they shall stumble; fathers and sons together, neighbor and friend shall perish.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore thus says the Lord: "Behold, I will lay stumbling blocks before this people, And the fathers and the sons together shall fall on them. The neighbor and his friend shall perish."
verses.textEnNlt: Therefore, this is what the Lord says: "I will put obstacles in my people’s path. Fathers and sons will both fall over them. Neighbors and friends will die together."
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore, this is what the Lord says: "Behold, I am placing stumbling blocks before this people. And they will stumble against them, Fathers and sons together; Neighbor and friend will perish."
verses.textEn: Therefore this is what the Lord says: "I will put obstacles before this people. Parents and children alike will stumble over them; neighbors and friends will perish."

verses.textZh: 耶和华这样说： "看哪！有一个民族从北方之地而来， 有一大国被激动从地极来到。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华这样说： "看哪！有一个民族从北方之地而来， 有一大国被激动从地极来到。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华如此说： 看哪，有一种民从北方而来， 并有一大国被激动，从地极来到。
verses.textEnNiv: This is what the Lord says: "Look, an army is coming from the land of the north; a great nation is being stirred up from the ends of the earth.
verses.textEnEsv: Thus says the Lord : "Behold, a people is coming from the north country, a great nation is stirring from the farthest parts of the earth.
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus says the Lord: "Behold, a people comes from the north country, And a great nation will be raised from the farthest parts of the earth.
verses.textEnNlt: This is what the Lord says: "Look! A great army coming from the north! A great nation is rising against you from far-off lands.
verses.textEnNasb: This is what the Lord says: "Behold, there is a people coming from the north land, And a great nation will be stirred up from the remote parts of the earth.
verses.textEn: This is what the Lord says: "Look, an army is coming from the land of the north; a great nation is being stirred up from the ends of the earth.

verses.textZh: 他们紧握弓和枪， 性情残忍，毫无怜悯； 他们的声音像海洋怒吼； 锡安的居民 哪！ 他们骑着战马， 在战场上如同一人，列阵攻击你们。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们紧握弓和枪， 性情残忍，毫无怜悯； 他们的声音像海洋怒吼； 锡安的居民 哪！ 他们骑着战马， 在战场上如同一人，列阵攻击你们。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们拿弓和枪， 性情残忍，不施怜悯； 他们的声音像海浪匉訇。 锡安城 啊， 他们骑马都摆队伍， 如上战场的人要攻击你。
verses.textEnNiv: They are armed with bow and spear; they are cruel and show no mercy. They sound like the roaring sea as they ride on their horses; they come like men in battle formation to attack you, Daughter Zion."
verses.textEnEsv: They lay hold on bow and javelin; they are cruel and have no mercy; the sound of them is like the roaring sea; they ride on horses, set in array as a man for battle, against you, O daughter of Zion!"
verses.textEnNkjv: They will lay hold on bow and spear; They are cruel and have no mercy; Their voice roars like the sea; And they ride on horses, As men of war set in array against you, O daughter of Zion."
verses.textEnNlt: They are armed with bows and spears. They are cruel and show no mercy. They sound like a roaring sea as they ride forward on horses. They are coming in battle formation, planning to destroy you, beautiful Jerusalem. "
verses.textEnNasb: "They seize bow and spear; They are cruel and have no mercy; Their voice roars like the sea, And they ride on horses, Lined up as a man for the battle Against you, daughter of Zion!"
verses.textEn: They are armed with bow and spear; they are cruel and show no mercy. They sound like the roaring sea as they ride on their horses; they come like men in battle formation to attack you, Daughter Zion."

verses.textZh: 我们听到有关他们的消息， 手就发软； 痛苦紧紧抓住我们， 我们疼痛好象正在生产的妇人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们听到有关他们的消息， 手就发软； 痛苦紧紧抓住我们， 我们疼痛好象正在生产的妇人。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们听见他们的风声，手就发软； 痛苦将我们抓住， 疼痛仿佛产难的妇人。
verses.textEnNiv: We have heard reports about them, and our hands hang limp. Anguish has gripped us, pain like that of a woman in labor.
verses.textEnEsv: We have heard the report of it; our hands fall helpless; anguish has taken hold of us, pain as of a woman in labor.
verses.textEnNkjv: We have heard the report of it; Our hands grow feeble. Anguish has taken hold of us, Pain as of a woman in labor.
verses.textEnNlt: We have heard reports about the enemy, and we wring our hands in fright. Pangs of anguish have gripped us, like those of a woman in labor.
verses.textEnNasb: We have heard the report of it; Our hands are limp. Anguish has seized us, Pain like that of a woman in childbirth.
verses.textEn: We have heard reports about them, and our hands hang limp. Anguish has gripped us, pain like that of a woman in labor.

verses.textZh: 你们不要出到田野去， 也不要在路上走， 因为四围有仇敌的刀剑和惊吓。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们不要出到田野去， 也不要在路上走， 因为四围有仇敌的刀剑和惊吓。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们不要往田野去， 也不要行在路上， 因四围有仇敌的刀剑和惊吓。
verses.textEnNiv: Do not go out to the fields or walk on the roads, for the enemy has a sword, and there is terror on every side.
verses.textEnEsv: Go not out into the field, nor walk on the road, for the enemy has a sword; terror is on every side.
verses.textEnNkjv: Do not go out into the field, Nor walk by the way. Because of the sword of the enemy, Fear is on every side.
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t go out to the fields! Don’t travel on the roads! The enemy’s sword is everywhere and terrorizes us at every turn!
verses.textEnNasb: Do not go out into the field, And do not walk on the road; For the enemy has a sword, Terror is on every side.
verses.textEn: Do not go out to the fields or walk on the roads, for the enemy has a sword, and there is terror on every side.

verses.textZh: 我的同胞 啊！应当披上麻布， 在灰尘中打滚， 悲哀如丧独生子， 号咷痛哭， 因为有行毁灭的 会突然攻击我们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的同胞 啊！应当披上麻布， 在灰尘中打滚， 悲哀如丧独生子， 号咷痛哭， 因为有行毁灭的 会突然攻击我们。
verses.textZhCuv: 我民 哪，应当腰束麻布，滚在灰中。 你要悲伤，如丧独生子痛痛哭号， 因为灭命的要忽然临到我们。
verses.textEnNiv: Put on sackcloth, my people, and roll in ashes; mourn with bitter wailing as for an only son, for suddenly the destroyer will come upon us.
verses.textEnEsv: O daughter of my people, put on sackcloth, and roll in ashes; make mourning as for an only son, most bitter lamentation, for suddenly the destroyer will come upon us.
verses.textEnNkjv: O daughter of my people, Dress in sackcloth And roll about in ashes! Make mourning asfor an only son, most bitter lamentation; For the plunderer will suddenly come upon us.
verses.textEnNlt: Oh, my people, dress yourselves in burlap and sit among the ashes. Mourn and weep bitterly, as for the loss of an only son. For suddenly the destroying armies will be upon you!
verses.textEnNasb: Daughter of my people, put on sackcloth And roll in ashes; Mourn as for an only son, A most bitter mourning. For suddenly the destroyer Will come against us.
verses.textEn: Put on sackcloth, my people, and roll in ashes; mourn with bitter wailing as for an only son, for suddenly the destroyer will come upon us.

verses.textZh: "我使你在我子民中作鉴辨和试验的 ， 好让你查察、鉴别他们的行径。"
verses.textZhCnvs: "我使你在我子民中作鉴辨和试验的 ， 好让你查察、鉴别他们的行径。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我使你在我民中为高台 ，为保障， 使你知道试验他们的行动。
verses.textEnNiv: "I have made you a tester of metals and my people the ore, that you may observe and test their ways.
verses.textEnEsv: "I have made you a tester of metals among my people, that you may know and test their ways.
verses.textEnNkjv: "I have set you as an assayer and a fortress among My people, That you may know and test their way.
verses.textEnNlt: "Jeremiah, I have made you a tester of metals, that you may determine the quality of my people.
verses.textEnNasb: "I have made you an assayer and an examiner among My people, So that you may know and put their way to the test."
verses.textEn: "I have made you a tester of metals and my people the ore, that you may observe and test their ways.

verses.textZh: 他们都是十分悖逆的人， 到处搬弄是非。 他们是铜是铁， 他们都是败坏的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们都是十分悖逆的人， 到处搬弄是非。 他们是铜是铁， 他们都是败坏的。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们都是极悖逆的， 往来谗谤人。 他们是铜是铁， 都行坏事。
verses.textEnNiv: They are all hardened rebels, going about to slander. They are bronze and iron; they all act corruptly.
verses.textEnEsv: They are all stubbornly rebellious, going about with slanders; they are bronze and iron; all of them act corruptly.
verses.textEnNkjv: They are all stubborn rebels, walking as slanderers. Theyare bronze and iron, They are all corrupters;
verses.textEnNlt: They are the worst kind of rebel, full of slander. They are as hard as bronze and iron, and they lead others into corruption.
verses.textEnNasb: All of them are stubbornly rebellious, Going about as a slanderer; They are bronze and iron. They are, all of them, corrupt.
verses.textEn: They are all hardened rebels, going about to slander. They are bronze and iron; they all act corruptly.

verses.textZh: 风箱猛烈地吹， 铅在火中销熔； 他们炼而又炼，徒劳无功， 因为邪恶的仍未除去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 风箱猛烈地吹， 铅在火中销熔； 他们炼而又炼，徒劳无功， 因为邪恶的仍未除去。
verses.textZhCuv: 风箱吹火，铅被烧毁； 他们炼而又炼，终是徒然； 因为恶劣的还未除掉。
verses.textEnNiv: The bellows blow fiercely to burn away the lead with fire, but the refining goes on in vain; the wicked are not purged out.
verses.textEnEsv: The bellows blow fiercely; the lead is consumed by the fire; in vain the refining goes on, for the wicked are not removed.
verses.textEnNkjv: The bellows blow fiercely, The lead is consumed by the fire; The smelter refines in vain, For the wicked are not drawn off.
verses.textEnNlt: The bellows fiercely fan the flames to burn out the corruption. But it does not purify them, for the wickedness remains.
verses.textEnNasb: The bellows blow fiercely, The lead is consumed by the fire; In vain the refining goes on, But the wicked are not separated.
verses.textEn: The bellows blow fiercely to burn away the lead with fire, but the refining goes on in vain; the wicked are not purged out.

verses.textZh: 人要称他们为被弃的银渣， 因为耶和华把他们弃绝了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 人要称他们为被弃的银渣， 因为耶和华把他们弃绝了。
verses.textZhCuv: 人必称他们为被弃的银渣， 因为耶和华已经弃掉他们。
verses.textEnNiv: They are called rejected silver, because the Lord has rejected them."
verses.textEnEsv: Rejected silver they are called, for the Lord has rejected them."
verses.textEnNkjv: People will call them rejected silver, Because the Lord has rejected them."
verses.textEnNlt: I will label them ‘Rejected Silver,’ for I, the Lord , am discarding them."
verses.textEnNasb: They call them rejected silver, Because the Lord has rejected them.
verses.textEn: They are called rejected silver, because the Lord has rejected them."

verses.textZh: 耶和华有话临到耶利米，说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华有话临到耶利米，说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的话临到耶利米说：
verses.textEnNiv: This is the word that came to Jeremiah from the Lord :
verses.textEnEsv: The word that came to Jeremiah from the Lord :
verses.textEnNkjv: The word that came to Jeremiah from the Lord, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord gave another message to Jeremiah. He said,
verses.textEnNasb: The word that came to Jeremiah from the Lord, saying,
verses.textEn: This is the word that came to Jeremiah from the Lord :

verses.textZh: "你要站在耶和华的殿门口，在那里宣告这话，说：‘所有进这些门来敬拜耶和华的犹大人哪！你们都要听耶和华的话。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: "你要站在耶和华的殿门口，在那里宣告这话，说：‘所有进这些门来敬拜耶和华的犹大人哪！你们都要听耶和华的话。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 「你当站在耶和华殿的门口，在那里宣传这话说：你们进这些门敬拜耶和华的一切犹大人，当听耶和华的话。
verses.textEnNiv: "Stand at the gate of the Lord ’s house and there proclaim this message: " ‘Hear the word of the Lord , all you people of Judah who come through these gates to worship the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: "Stand in the gate of the Lord ’s house, and proclaim there this word, and say, Hear the word of the Lord , all you men of Judah who enter these gates to worship the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: "Stand in the gate of the Lord’s house, and proclaim there this word, and say, ‘Hear the word of the Lord, all youof Judah who enter in at these gates to worship the Lord!’ "
verses.textEnNlt: "Go to the entrance of the Lord ’s Temple, and give this message to the people: ‘O Judah, listen to this message from the Lord ! Listen to it, all of you who worship here!
verses.textEnNasb: "Stand at the gate of the Lord’s house and proclaim there this word, and say, ‘Hear the word of the Lord, all you of Judah, who enter by these gates to worship the Lord!’ "
verses.textEn: "Stand at the gate of the Lord ’s house and there proclaim this message: " ‘Hear the word of the Lord , all you people of Judah who come through these gates to worship the Lord .

verses.textZh: 万军之耶和华以色列的神这样说："你们要改正自己的所作所为，我就让你们在这地方居住。
verses.textZhCnvs: 万军之耶和华以色列的神这样说："你们要改正自己的所作所为，我就让你们在这地方居住。
verses.textZhCuv: 万军之耶和华－以色列的神如此说：你们改正行动作为，我就使你们在这地方仍然居住。
verses.textEnNiv: This is what the Lord Almighty, the God of Israel, says: Reform your ways and your actions, and I will let you live in this place.
verses.textEnEsv: Thus says the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel: Amend your ways and your deeds, and I will let you dwell in this place.
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus says the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel: "Amend your ways and your doings, and I will cause you to dwell in this place.
verses.textEnNlt: This is what the Lord of Heaven’s Armies, the God of Israel, says: "‘Even now, if you quit your evil ways, I will let you stay in your own land.
verses.textEnNasb: This is what the Lord of armies, the God of Israel says: "Amend your ways and your deeds, and I will let you live in this place.
verses.textEn: This is what the Lord Almighty, the God of Israel, says: Reform your ways and your actions, and I will let you live in this place.

verses.textZh: 你们不要倚靠虚谎的话，说：‘这是耶和华的殿，是耶和华的殿，是耶和华的殿。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们不要倚靠虚谎的话，说：‘这是耶和华的殿，是耶和华的殿，是耶和华的殿。’
verses.textZhCuv: 你们不要倚靠虚谎的话，说：『这些是耶和华的殿，是耶和华的殿，是耶和华的殿！』
verses.textEnNiv: Do not trust in deceptive words and say, "This is the temple of the Lord , the temple of the Lord , the temple of the Lord !"
verses.textEnEsv: Do not trust in these deceptive words: ‘This is the temple of the Lord , the temple of the Lord , the temple of the Lord .’
verses.textEnNkjv: Do not trust in these lying words, saying, ‘The temple of the Lord, the temple of the Lord, the temple of the Lordare these.’
verses.textEnNlt: But don’t be fooled by those who promise you safety simply because the Lord ’s Temple is here. They chant, "The Lord ’s Temple is here! The Lord ’s Temple is here!"
verses.textEnNasb: Do not trust in deceptive words, saying, ‘ This is the temple of the Lord, the temple of the Lord, the temple of the Lord.’
verses.textEn: Do not trust in deceptive words and say, "This is the temple of the Lord , the temple of the Lord , the temple of the Lord !"

verses.textZh: 如果你们实在改正自己的所作所为，人与人之间认真施行公正；
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果你们实在改正自己的所作所为，人与人之间认真施行公正；
verses.textZhCuv: 「你们若实在改正行动作为，在人和邻舍中间诚然施行公平，
verses.textEnNiv: If you really change your ways and your actions and deal with each other justly,
verses.textEnEsv: "For if you truly amend your ways and your deeds, if you truly execute justice one with another,
verses.textEnNkjv: "For if you thoroughly amend your ways and your doings, if you thoroughly execute judgment between a man and his neighbor,
verses.textEnNlt: But I will be merciful only if you stop your evil thoughts and deeds and start treating each other with justice;
verses.textEnNasb: For if you truly amend your ways and your deeds, if you truly practice justice between a person and his neighbor,
verses.textEn: If you really change your ways and your actions and deal with each other justly,

verses.textZh: 如果你们不欺压寄居的，不欺压孤儿寡妇，不在这地方流无辜人的血，也不跟从别的神，自招祸患；
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果你们不欺压寄居的，不欺压孤儿寡妇，不在这地方流无辜人的血，也不跟从别的神，自招祸患；
verses.textZhCuv: 不欺压寄居的和孤儿寡妇，在这地方不流无辜人的血，也不随从别神陷害自己，
verses.textEnNiv: if you do not oppress the foreigner, the fatherless or the widow and do not shed innocent blood in this place, and if you do not follow other gods to your own harm,
verses.textEnEsv: if you do not oppress the sojourner, the fatherless, or the widow, or shed innocent blood in this place, and if you do not go after other gods to your own harm,
verses.textEnNkjv: if you do not oppress the stranger, the fatherless, and the widow, and do not shed innocent blood in this place, or walk after other gods to your hurt,
verses.textEnNlt: only if you stop exploiting foreigners, orphans, and widows; only if you stop your murdering; and only if you stop harming yourselves by worshiping idols.
verses.textEnNasb: if you do not oppress the stranger, the orphan, or the widow, and do not shed innocent blood in this place, nor follow other gods to your own ruin,
verses.textEn: if you do not oppress the foreigner, the fatherless or the widow and do not shed innocent blood in this place, and if you do not follow other gods to your own harm,

verses.textZh: 我就让你们在赐给你们列祖直到永远的这地方居住。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我就让你们在赐给你们列祖直到永远的这地方居住。
verses.textZhCuv: 我就使你们在这地方仍然居住，就是我古时所赐给你们列祖的地，直到永远。
verses.textEnNiv: then I will let you live in this place, in the land I gave your ancestors for ever and ever.
verses.textEnEsv: then I will let you dwell in this place, in the land that I gave of old to your fathers forever.
verses.textEnNkjv: then I will cause you to dwell in this place, in the land that I gave to your fathers forever and ever.
verses.textEnNlt: Then I will let you stay in this land that I gave to your ancestors to keep forever.
verses.textEnNasb: then I will let you live in this place, in the land that I gave to your fathers forever and ever.
verses.textEn: then I will let you live in this place, in the land I gave your ancestors for ever and ever.

verses.textZh: "可是，你们竟然倚靠虚谎无益的话。
verses.textZhCnvs: "可是，你们竟然倚靠虚谎无益的话。
verses.textZhCuv: 「看哪，你们倚靠虚谎无益的话。
verses.textEnNiv: But look, you are trusting in deceptive words that are worthless.
verses.textEnEsv: "Behold, you trust in deceptive words to no avail.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Behold, you trust in lying words that cannot profit.
verses.textEnNlt: "‘Don’t be fooled into thinking that you will never suffer because the Temple is here. It’s a lie!
verses.textEnNasb: "Behold, you are trusting in deceptive words to no avail.
verses.textEn: But look, you are trusting in deceptive words that are worthless.

verses.textZh: 你们怎可偷盗、凶杀、奸淫、起假誓、向巴力烧香，跟从你们素不认识的别神，
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们怎可偷盗、凶杀、奸淫、起假誓、向巴力烧香，跟从你们素不认识的别神，
verses.textZhCuv: 你们偷盗，杀害，奸淫，起假誓，向巴力烧香，并随从素不认识的别神，
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘Will you steal and murder, commit adultery and perjury, burn incense to Baal and follow other gods you have not known,
verses.textEnEsv: Will you steal, murder, commit adultery, swear falsely, make offerings to Baal, and go after other gods that you have not known,
verses.textEnNkjv: Will you steal, murder, commit adultery, swear falsely, burn incense to Baal, and walk after other gods whom you do not know,
verses.textEnNlt: Do you really think you can steal, murder, commit adultery, lie, and burn incense to Baal and all those other new gods of yours,
verses.textEnNasb: Will you steal, murder, commit adultery, swear falsely, offer sacrifices to Baal, and follow other gods that you have not known,
verses.textEn: " ‘Will you steal and murder, commit adultery and perjury, burn incense to Baal and follow other gods you have not known,

verses.textZh: 然后来到这称为我名下的殿，站在我面前，说：‘我们安全啦！’你们这样就可以行这一切可憎的事吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 然后来到这称为我名下的殿，站在我面前，说：‘我们安全啦！’你们这样就可以行这一切可憎的事吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 且来到这称为我名下的殿，在我面前敬拜；又说：『我们可以自由了。』你们这样的举动是要行那些可憎的事吗？
verses.textEnNiv: and then come and stand before me in this house, which bears my Name, and say, "We are safe"—safe to do all these detestable things?
verses.textEnEsv: and then come and stand before me in this house, which is called by my name, and say, ‘We are delivered!’—only to go on doing all these abominations?
verses.textEnNkjv: and then come and stand before Me in this house which is called by My name, and say, ‘We are delivered to do all these abominations’?
verses.textEnNlt: and then come here and stand before me in my Temple and chant, "We are safe!"—only to go right back to all those evils again?
verses.textEnNasb: then come and stand before Me in this house which is called by My name, and say, ‘We are saved!’—so that you may do all these abominations?
verses.textEn: and then come and stand before me in this house, which bears my Name, and say, "We are safe"—safe to do all these detestable things?

verses.textZh: 这称为我名下的殿，难道在你们眼中看为贼窝吗？但我都看见了。"这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这称为我名下的殿，难道在你们眼中看为贼窝吗？但我都看见了。"这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 这称为我名下的殿在你们眼中岂可看为贼窝吗？我都看见了。这是耶和华说的。
verses.textEnNiv: Has this house, which bears my Name, become a den of robbers to you? But I have been watching! declares the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: Has this house, which is called by my name, become a den of robbers in your eyes? Behold, I myself have seen it, declares the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: Has this house, which is called by My name, become a den of thieves in your eyes? Behold, I, even I, have seen it," says the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t you yourselves admit that this Temple, which bears my name, has become a den of thieves? Surely I see all the evil going on there. I, the Lord , have spoken!
verses.textEnNasb: Has this house, which is called by My name, become a den of robbers in your sight? Behold, I Myself have seen it," declares the Lord.
verses.textEn: Has this house, which bears my Name, become a den of robbers to you? But I have been watching! declares the Lord .

verses.textZh: "你们可以到示罗我的地方去，就是先前我名的居所，看看我因我子民以色列的邪恶，对那地方所行的。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你们可以到示罗我的地方去，就是先前我名的居所，看看我因我子民以色列的邪恶，对那地方所行的。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们且往示罗去，就是我先前立为我名的居所，察看我因这百姓以色列的罪恶向那地所行的如何。」
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘Go now to the place in Shiloh where I first made a dwelling for my Name, and see what I did to it because of the wickedness of my people Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: Go now to my place that was in Shiloh, where I made my name dwell at first, and see what I did to it because of the evil of my people Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: "But go now to My place which was in Shiloh, where I set My name at the first, and see what I did to it because of the wickedness of My people Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: "‘Go now to the place at Shiloh where I once put the Tabernacle that bore my name. See what I did there because of all the wickedness of my people, the Israelites.
verses.textEnNasb: "But go now to My place which was in Shiloh, where I made My name dwell at the beginning, and see what I did to it because of the wickedness of My people Israel.
verses.textEn: " ‘Go now to the place in Shiloh where I first made a dwelling for my Name, and see what I did to it because of the wickedness of my people Israel.

verses.textZh: 现在，因你们行了这一切事，我不断恳切告诫你们，你们却不听；我呼唤你们，你们却不答话。"这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在，因你们行了这一切事，我不断恳切告诫你们，你们却不听；我呼唤你们，你们却不答话。"这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华说：「现在因你们行了这一切的事，我也从早起来警戒你们，你们却不听从；呼唤你们，你们却不答应。
verses.textEnNiv: While you were doing all these things, declares the Lord , I spoke to you again and again, but you did not listen; I called you, but you did not answer.
verses.textEnEsv: And now, because you have done all these things, declares the Lord , and when I spoke to you persistently you did not listen, and when I called you, you did not answer,
verses.textEnNkjv: And now, because you have done all these works," says the Lord, "and I spoke to you, rising up early and speaking, but you did not hear, and I called you, but you did not answer,
verses.textEnNlt: While you were doing these wicked things, says the Lord , I spoke to you about it repeatedly, but you would not listen. I called out to you, but you refused to answer.
verses.textEnNasb: And now, because you have done all these things," declares the Lord, "and I spoke to you, speaking again and again, but you did not listen, and I called you but you did not answer,
verses.textEn: While you were doing all these things, declares the Lord , I spoke to you again and again, but you did not listen; I called you, but you did not answer.

verses.textZh: "所以我从前怎样对待示罗，将来也怎样对待你们所倚靠的那称为我名下的殿，以及我赐给你们和你们列祖的地方。
verses.textZhCnvs: "所以我从前怎样对待示罗，将来也怎样对待你们所倚靠的那称为我名下的殿，以及我赐给你们和你们列祖的地方。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以我要向这称为我名下、你们所倚靠的殿，与我所赐给你们和你们列祖的地施行，照我从前向示罗所行的一样。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore, what I did to Shiloh I will now do to the house that bears my Name, the temple you trust in, the place I gave to you and your ancestors.
verses.textEnEsv: therefore I will do to the house that is called by my name, and in which you trust, and to the place that I gave to you and to your fathers, as I did to Shiloh.
verses.textEnNkjv: therefore I will do to the house which is called by My name, in which you trust, and to this place which I gave to you and your fathers, as I have done to Shiloh.
verses.textEnNlt: So just as I destroyed Shiloh, I will now destroy this Temple that bears my name, this Temple that you trust in for help, this place that I gave to you and your ancestors.
verses.textEnNasb: therefore I will do to the house which is called by My name, in which you trust, and to the place which I gave you and your fathers, just as I did to Shiloh.
verses.textEn: Therefore, what I did to Shiloh I will now do to the house that bears my Name, the temple you trust in, the place I gave to you and your ancestors.

verses.textZh: 我必把你们从我面前赶出，像我从前赶出你们的众兄弟，以法莲所有的后裔一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必把你们从我面前赶出，像我从前赶出你们的众兄弟，以法莲所有的后裔一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 我必将你们从我眼前赶出，正如赶出你们的众弟兄，就是以法莲的一切后裔。」
verses.textEnNiv: I will thrust you from my presence, just as I did all your fellow Israelites, the people of Ephraim.’
verses.textEnEsv: And I will cast you out of my sight, as I cast out all your kinsmen, all the offspring of Ephraim.
verses.textEnNkjv: And I will cast you out of My sight, as I have cast out all your brethren— the whole posterity of Ephraim.
verses.textEnNlt: And I will send you out of my sight into exile, just as I did your relatives, the people of Israel. ’
verses.textEnNasb: I will hurl you out of My sight, just as I have hurled out all your brothers, all the descendants of Ephraim.
verses.textEn: I will thrust you from my presence, just as I did all your fellow Israelites, the people of Ephraim.’

verses.textZh: "至于你，不要为这人民祈祷，不要为他们呼求祷告，也不要为他们向我恳求，因为我不会听你。
verses.textZhCnvs: "至于你，不要为这人民祈祷，不要为他们呼求祷告，也不要为他们向我恳求，因为我不会听你。
verses.textZhCuv: 「所以，你不要为这百姓祈祷；不要为他们呼求祷告；也不要向我为他们祈求，因我不听允你。
verses.textEnNiv: "So do not pray for this people nor offer any plea or petition for them; do not plead with me, for I will not listen to you.
verses.textEnEsv: "As for you, do not pray for this people, or lift up a cry or prayer for them, and do not intercede with me, for I will not hear you.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Therefore do not pray for this people, nor lift up a cry or prayer for them, nor make intercession to Me; for I will not hear you.
verses.textEnNlt: "Pray no more for these people, Jeremiah. Do not weep or pray for them, and don’t beg me to help them, for I will not listen to you.
verses.textEnNasb: "As for you, do not pray for this people, and do not lift up a cry or prayer for them, and do not plead with Me; for I am not listening to you.
verses.textEn: "So do not pray for this people nor offer any plea or petition for them; do not plead with me, for I will not listen to you.

verses.textZh: 他们在犹大的各城中，在耶路撒冷的街道上所行的，你没有看见吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们在犹大的各城中，在耶路撒冷的街道上所行的，你没有看见吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 他们在犹大城邑中和耶路撒冷街上所行的，你没有看见吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Do you not see what they are doing in the towns of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem?
verses.textEnEsv: Do you not see what they are doing in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem?
verses.textEnNkjv: Do you not see what they do in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem?
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t you see what they are doing throughout the towns of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem?
verses.textEnNasb: Do you not see what they are doing in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem?
verses.textEn: Do you not see what they are doing in the towns of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem?

verses.textZh: 儿子捡柴，父亲生火，妇女抟面，为天后做饼，又向别的神浇奠祭，惹我发怒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 儿子捡柴，父亲生火，妇女抟面，为天后做饼，又向别的神浇奠祭，惹我发怒。
verses.textZhCuv: 孩子捡柴，父亲烧火，妇女抟面做饼，献给天后，又向别神浇奠祭，惹我发怒。」
verses.textEnNiv: The children gather wood, the fathers light the fire, and the women knead the dough and make cakes to offer to the Queen of Heaven. They pour out drink offerings to other gods to arouse my anger.
verses.textEnEsv: The children gather wood, the fathers kindle fire, and the women knead dough, to make cakes for the queen of heaven. And they pour out drink offerings to other gods, to provoke me to anger.
verses.textEnNkjv: The children gather wood, the fathers kindle the fire, and the women knead dough, to make cakes for the queen of heaven; and they pour out drink offerings to other gods, that they may provoke Me to anger.
verses.textEnNlt: No wonder I am so angry! Watch how the children gather wood and the fathers build sacrificial fires. See how the women knead dough and make cakes to offer to the Queen of Heaven. And they pour out liquid offerings to their other idol gods!
verses.textEnNasb: The children gather wood, the fathers kindle the fire, and the women knead dough to make sacrificial cakes for the queen of heaven; and they pour out drink offerings to other gods in order to provoke Me to anger.
verses.textEn: The children gather wood, the fathers light the fire, and the women knead the dough and make cakes to offer to the Queen of Heaven. They pour out drink offerings to other gods to arouse my anger.

verses.textZh: 他们害的是我吗？岂不是他们自己，以致脸上蒙羞吗？"这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们害的是我吗？岂不是他们自己，以致脸上蒙羞吗？"这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华说：「他们岂是惹我发怒呢？不是自己惹祸，以致脸上惭愧吗？」
verses.textEnNiv: But am I the one they are provoking? declares the Lord . Are they not rather harming themselves, to their own shame?
verses.textEnEsv: Is it I whom they provoke? declares the Lord . Is it not themselves, to their own shame?
verses.textEnNkjv: Do they provoke Me to anger?" says the Lord. "Dothey not provoke themselves, to the shame of their own faces?"
verses.textEnNlt: Am I the one they are hurting?" asks the Lord . "Most of all, they hurt themselves, to their own shame."
verses.textEnNasb: Are they provoking Me?" declares the Lord. "Is it not themselves instead, to their own shame?"
verses.textEn: But am I the one they are provoking? declares the Lord . Are they not rather harming themselves, to their own shame?

verses.textZh: 因此，主耶和华这样说："看哪！我的怒气和忿怒，必倒在这地方，也必倒在人口、牲畜、田野的树木和地的出产上；怒火烧起，不能熄灭。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，主耶和华这样说："看哪！我的怒气和忿怒，必倒在这地方，也必倒在人口、牲畜、田野的树木和地的出产上；怒火烧起，不能熄灭。"
verses.textZhCuv: 所以主耶和华如此说：「看哪，我必将我的怒气和忿怒倾在这地方的人和牲畜身上，并田野的树木和地里的出产上，必如火着起，不能熄灭。」
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘Therefore this is what the Sovereign Lord says: My anger and my wrath will be poured out on this place—on man and beast, on the trees of the field and on the crops of your land—and it will burn and not be quenched.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore thus says the Lord God : Behold, my anger and my wrath will be poured out on this place, upon man and beast, upon the trees of the field and the fruit of the ground; it will burn and not be quenched."
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore thus says the Lord God: "Behold, My anger and My fury will be poured out on this place—on man and on beast, on the trees of the field and on the fruit of the ground. And it will burn and not be quenched."
verses.textEnNlt: So this is what the Sovereign Lord says: "I will pour out my terrible fury on this place. Its people, animals, trees, and crops will be consumed by the unquenchable fire of my anger."
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore this is what the Lord God says: "Behold, My anger and My wrath will be poured out on this place, on human and animal life, and on the trees of the field and the fruit of the ground; and it will burn and not be quenched."
verses.textEn: " ‘Therefore this is what the Sovereign Lord says: My anger and my wrath will be poured out on this place—on man and beast, on the trees of the field and on the crops of your land—and it will burn and not be quenched.

verses.textZh: 万军之耶和华以色列的神这样说："你们尽管把燔祭加在平安祭上，自己吃祭肉吧！
verses.textZhCnvs: 万军之耶和华以色列的神这样说："你们尽管把燔祭加在平安祭上，自己吃祭肉吧！
verses.textZhCuv: 万军之耶和华－以色列的神如此说：「你们将燔祭加在平安祭上，吃肉吧！
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘This is what the Lord Almighty, the God of Israel, says: Go ahead, add your burnt offerings to your other sacrifices and eat the meat yourselves!
verses.textEnEsv: Thus says the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel: "Add your burnt offerings to your sacrifices, and eat the flesh.
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus says the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel: "Add your burnt offerings to your sacrifices and eat meat.
verses.textEnNlt: This is what the Lord of Heaven’s Armies, the God of Israel, says: "Take your burnt offerings and your other sacrifices and eat them yourselves!
verses.textEnNasb: This is what the Lord of armies, the God of Israel says: "Add your burnt offerings to your sacrifices and eat flesh.
verses.textEn: " ‘This is what the Lord Almighty, the God of Israel, says: Go ahead, add your burnt offerings to your other sacrifices and eat the meat yourselves!

verses.textZh: 因为我把你们列祖从埃及地领出来的那日，燔祭和平安祭的事，我并没有向他们提说，也没有吩咐他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为我把你们列祖从埃及地领出来的那日，燔祭和平安祭的事，我并没有向他们提说，也没有吩咐他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为我将你们列祖从埃及地领出来的那日，燔祭平安祭的事我并没有提说，也没有吩咐他们。
verses.textEnNiv: For when I brought your ancestors out of Egypt and spoke to them, I did not just give them commands about burnt offerings and sacrifices,
verses.textEnEsv: For in the day that I brought them out of the land of Egypt, I did not speak to your fathers or command them concerning burnt offerings and sacrifices.
verses.textEnNkjv: For I did not speak to your fathers, or command them in the day that I brought them out of the land of Egypt, concerning burnt offerings or sacrifices.
verses.textEnNlt: When I led your ancestors out of Egypt, it was not burnt offerings and sacrifices I wanted from them.
verses.textEnNasb: For I did not speak to your fathers, or command them on the day that I brought them out of the land of Egypt, concerning burnt offerings and sacrifices.
verses.textEn: For when I brought your ancestors out of Egypt and spoke to them, I did not just give them commands about burnt offerings and sacrifices,

verses.textZh: 我只吩咐他们这一件事，说：‘你们要听从我的话，我就作你们的神，你们也作我的子民；你们要遵行我所吩咐的一切道，好使你们蒙福。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 我只吩咐他们这一件事，说：‘你们要听从我的话，我就作你们的神，你们也作我的子民；你们要遵行我所吩咐的一切道，好使你们蒙福。’
verses.textZhCuv: 我只吩咐他们这一件说：『你们当听从我的话，我就作你们的神，你们也作我的子民。你们行我所吩咐的一切道，就可以得福。』
verses.textEnNiv: but I gave them this command: Obey me, and I will be your God and you will be my people. Walk in obedience to all I command you, that it may go well with you.
verses.textEnEsv: But this command I gave them: ‘Obey my voice, and I will be your God, and you shall be my people. And walk in all the way that I command you, that it may be well with you.’
verses.textEnNkjv: But this is what I commanded them, saying, ‘Obey My voice, and I will be your God, and you shall be My people. And walk in all the ways that I have commanded you, that it may be well with you.’
verses.textEnNlt: This is what I told them: ‘Obey me, and I will be your God, and you will be my people. Do everything as I say, and all will be well!’
verses.textEnNasb: But this is what I commanded them, saying, ‘Obey My voice, and I will be your God, and you will be My people; and you shall walk entirely in the way which I command you, so that it may go well for you.’
verses.textEn: but I gave them this command: Obey me, and I will be your God and you will be my people. Walk in obedience to all I command you, that it may go well with you.

verses.textZh: 他们却没有听从，也不留心，反倒按着他们的计谋，随从自己顽梗的恶心行事，向后不向前。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们却没有听从，也不留心，反倒按着他们的计谋，随从自己顽梗的恶心行事，向后不向前。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们却不听从，不侧耳而听，竟随从自己的计谋和顽梗的恶心，向后不向前。
verses.textEnNiv: But they did not listen or pay attention; instead, they followed the stubborn inclinations of their evil hearts. They went backward and not forward.
verses.textEnEsv: But they did not obey or incline their ear, but walked in their own counsels and the stubbornness of their evil hearts, and went backward and not forward.
verses.textEnNkjv: Yet they did not obey or incline their ear, but followed the counsels and the dictates of their evil hearts, and went backward and not forward.
verses.textEnNlt: "But my people would not listen to me. They kept doing whatever they wanted, following the stubborn desires of their evil hearts. They went backward instead of forward.
verses.textEnNasb: Yet they did not obey or incline their ear, but walked by their own advice and in the stubbornness of their evil hearts, and they went backward and not forward.
verses.textEn: But they did not listen or pay attention; instead, they followed the stubborn inclinations of their evil hearts. They went backward and not forward.

verses.textZh: 自从你们列祖出埃及地的那日直到今日，我差遣我的仆人众先知到你们那里去，而且是每日不断差遣。
verses.textZhCnvs: 自从你们列祖出埃及地的那日直到今日，我差遣我的仆人众先知到你们那里去，而且是每日不断差遣。
verses.textZhCuv: 自从你们列祖出埃及地的那日，直到今日，我差遣我的仆人众先知到你们那里去，每日从早起来差遣他们。
verses.textEnNiv: From the time your ancestors left Egypt until now, day after day, again and again I sent you my servants the prophets.
verses.textEnEsv: From the day that your fathers came out of the land of Egypt to this day, I have persistently sent all my servants the prophets to them, day after day.
verses.textEnNkjv: Since the day that your fathers came out of the land of Egypt until this day, I have even sent to you all My servants the prophets, daily rising up early and sending them.
verses.textEnNlt: From the day your ancestors left Egypt until now, I have continued to send my servants, the prophets—day in and day out.
verses.textEnNasb: Since the day that your fathers came out of the land of Egypt until this day, I have sent you all My servants the prophets, sending them daily, again and again.
verses.textEn: From the time your ancestors left Egypt until now, day after day, again and again I sent you my servants the prophets.

verses.textZh: 你们 却没有听从，毫不留心，反倒硬着颈项行恶，比你们 的列祖还厉害。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们 却没有听从，毫不留心，反倒硬着颈项行恶，比你们 的列祖还厉害。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们却不听从，不侧耳而听，竟硬着颈项行恶，比你们列祖更甚。
verses.textEnNiv: But they did not listen to me or pay attention. They were stiff-necked and did more evil than their ancestors.’
verses.textEnEsv: Yet they did not listen to me or incline their ear, but stiffened their neck. They did worse than their fathers.
verses.textEnNkjv: Yet they did not obey Me or incline their ear, but stiffened their neck. They did worse than their fathers.
verses.textEnNlt: But my people have not listened to me or even tried to hear. They have been stubborn and sinful—even worse than their ancestors.
verses.textEnNasb: Yet they did not listen to Me or incline their ear, but stiffened their neck; they did more evil than their fathers.
verses.textEn: But they did not listen to me or pay attention. They were stiff-necked and did more evil than their ancestors.’

verses.textZh: "你要把这一切话告诉他们，他们却不听从你；你呼叫他们，他们也不回应。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你要把这一切话告诉他们，他们却不听从你；你呼叫他们，他们也不回应。
verses.textZhCuv: 「你要将这一切的话告诉他们，他们却不听从；呼唤他们，他们却不答应。
verses.textEnNiv: "When you tell them all this, they will not listen to you; when you call to them, they will not answer.
verses.textEnEsv: "So you shall speak all these words to them, but they will not listen to you. You shall call to them, but they will not answer you.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Therefore you shall speak all these words to them, but they will not obey you. You shall also call to them, but they will not answer you.
verses.textEnNlt: "Tell them all this, but do not expect them to listen. Shout out your warnings, but do not expect them to respond.
verses.textEnNasb: "So you shall speak all these words to them, but they will not listen to you; and you shall call to them, but they will not answer you.
verses.textEn: "When you tell them all this, they will not listen to you; when you call to them, they will not answer.

verses.textZh: 然而，你要对他们说：‘这就是不听从耶和华他们神的话，不受管教的国；诚实丧尽，并已从他们的口中断绝了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 然而，你要对他们说：‘这就是不听从耶和华他们神的话，不受管教的国；诚实丧尽，并已从他们的口中断绝了。
verses.textZhCuv: 你要对他们说：这就是不听从耶和华－他们神的话、不受教训的国民；从他们的口中，诚实灭绝了。」
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore say to them, ‘This is the nation that has not obeyed the Lord its God or responded to correction. Truth has perished; it has vanished from their lips.
verses.textEnEsv: And you shall say to them, ‘This is the nation that did not obey the voice of the Lord their God, and did not accept discipline; truth has perished; it is cut off from their lips.
verses.textEnNkjv: "So you shall say to them, ‘This is a nation that does not obey the voice of the Lord their God nor receive correction. Truth has perished and has been cut off from their mouth.
verses.textEnNlt: Say to them, ‘This is the nation whose people will not obey the Lord their God and who refuse to be taught. Truth has vanished from among them; it is no longer heard on their lips.
verses.textEnNasb: And you shall say to them, ‘This is the nation that did not obey the voice of the Lord their God or accept discipline; trustworthiness has perished and has been eliminated from their mouth.
verses.textEn: Therefore say to them, ‘This is the nation that has not obeyed the Lord its God or responded to correction. Truth has perished; it has vanished from their lips.

verses.textZh: "‘你要剪去头发，并且把它拋掉， 上到光秃的高冈举哀， 因为耶和华摈斥、弃绝了 他所憎恨的世代。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: "‘你要剪去头发，并且把它拋掉， 上到光秃的高冈举哀， 因为耶和华摈斥、弃绝了 他所憎恨的世代。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶路撒冷啊，要剪发抛弃， 在净光的高处举哀； 因为耶和华丢掉离弃了惹他忿怒的世代。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘Cut off your hair and throw it away; take up a lament on the barren heights, for the Lord has rejected and abandoned this generation that is under his wrath.
verses.textEnEsv: "‘Cut off your hair and cast it away; raise a lamentation on the bare heights, for the Lord has rejected and forsaken the generation of his wrath.’
verses.textEnNkjv: Cut off your hair and cast it away, and take up a lamentation on the desolate heights; for the Lord has rejected and forsaken the generation of His wrath.’
verses.textEnNlt: Shave your head in mourning, and weep alone on the mountains. For the Lord has rejected and forsaken this generation that has provoked his fury.’
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Cut off your hair and throw it away, And take up a song of mourning on the bare heights; For the Lord has rejected and forsaken The generation of His wrath.’
verses.textEn: " ‘Cut off your hair and throw it away; take up a lament on the barren heights, for the Lord has rejected and abandoned this generation that is under his wrath.

verses.textZh: "因为犹大人行了我看为恶的事，把他们可憎的偶像安放在称为我名下的殿中，污渎了这殿。"这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: "因为犹大人行了我看为恶的事，把他们可憎的偶像安放在称为我名下的殿中，污渎了这殿。"这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华说：「犹大人行我眼中看为恶的事，将可憎之物设立在称为我名下的殿中，污秽这殿。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘The people of Judah have done evil in my eyes, declares the Lord . They have set up their detestable idols in the house that bears my Name and have defiled it.
verses.textEnEsv: "For the sons of Judah have done evil in my sight, declares the Lord . They have set their detestable things in the house that is called by my name, to defile it.
verses.textEnNkjv: For the children of Judah have done evil in My sight," says the Lord. "They have set their abominations in the house which is called by My name, to pollute it.
verses.textEnNlt: "The people of Judah have sinned before my very eyes," says the Lord . "They have set up their abominable idols right in the Temple that bears my name, defiling it.
verses.textEnNasb: For the sons of Judah have done that which is evil in My sight," declares the Lord. "They have put their detestable things in the house which is called by My name, to defile it.
verses.textEn: " ‘The people of Judah have done evil in my eyes, declares the Lord . They have set up their detestable idols in the house that bears my Name and have defiled it.

verses.textZh: "他们在欣嫩子谷中，建造了陀斐特的邱坛，用火焚烧自己的儿女；这不是我吩咐的，我也没有在心里想过。
verses.textZhCnvs: "他们在欣嫩子谷中，建造了陀斐特的邱坛，用火焚烧自己的儿女；这不是我吩咐的，我也没有在心里想过。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们在欣嫩子谷建筑陀斐特的邱坛，好在火中焚烧自己的儿女。这并不是我所吩咐的，也不是我心所起的意。」
verses.textEnNiv: They have built the high places of Topheth in the Valley of Ben Hinnom to burn their sons and daughters in the fire—something I did not command, nor did it enter my mind.
verses.textEnEsv: And they have built the high places of Topheth, which is in the Valley of the Son of Hinnom, to burn their sons and their daughters in the fire, which I did not command, nor did it come into my mind.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they have built the high places of Tophet, which is in the Valley of the Son of Hinnom, to burn their sons and their daughters in the fire, which I did not command, nor did it come into My heart.
verses.textEnNlt: They have built pagan shrines at Topheth, the garbage dump in the valley of Ben-Hinnom, and there they burn their sons and daughters in the fire. I have never commanded such a horrible deed; it never even crossed my mind to command such a thing!
verses.textEnNasb: They have built the high places of Topheth, which is in the Valley of Ben-hinnom, to burn their sons and their daughters in the fire, which I did not command, and it did not come into My mind.
verses.textEn: They have built the high places of Topheth in the Valley of Ben Hinnom to burn their sons and daughters in the fire—something I did not command, nor did it enter my mind.

verses.textZh: 因此，看哪！日子快到，人必不再称这地方为陀斐特或欣嫩子谷，却要称它为‘杀戮谷’；人必在陀斐特埋葬尸体，甚至无处可容。"这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，看哪！日子快到，人必不再称这地方为陀斐特或欣嫩子谷，却要称它为‘杀戮谷’；人必在陀斐特埋葬尸体，甚至无处可容。"这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华说：「因此，日子将到，这地方不再称为陀斐特和欣嫩子谷，反倒称为杀戮谷。因为要在陀斐特葬埋尸首，甚至无处可葬；
verses.textEnNiv: So beware, the days are coming, declares the Lord , when people will no longer call it Topheth or the Valley of Ben Hinnom, but the Valley of Slaughter, for they will bury the dead in Topheth until there is no more room.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore, behold, the days are coming, declares the Lord , when it will no more be called Topheth, or the Valley of the Son of Hinnom, but the Valley of Slaughter; for they will bury in Topheth, because there is no room elsewhere.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Therefore behold, the days are coming," says the Lord, "when it will no more be called Tophet, or the Valley of the Son of Hinnom, but the Valley of Slaughter; for they will bury in Tophet until there is no room.
verses.textEnNlt: So beware, for the time is coming," says the Lord , "when that garbage dump will no longer be called Topheth or the valley of Ben-Hinnom, but the Valley of Slaughter. They will bury the bodies in Topheth until there is no more room for them.
verses.textEnNasb: "Therefore, behold, days are coming," declares the Lord, "when it will no longer be called Topheth, or the Valley of Ben-hinnom, but the Valley of the Slaughter; for they will bury in Topheth because there is no other place.
verses.textEn: So beware, the days are coming, declares the Lord , when people will no longer call it Topheth or the Valley of Ben Hinnom, but the Valley of Slaughter, for they will bury the dead in Topheth until there is no more room.

verses.textZh: "这人民的尸体，也必给空中的飞鸟和地上的野兽作食物，没有人来驱赶。
verses.textZhCnvs: "这人民的尸体，也必给空中的飞鸟和地上的野兽作食物，没有人来驱赶。
verses.textZhCuv: 并且这百姓的尸首必给空中的飞鸟和地上的野兽作食物，并无人哄赶。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the carcasses of this people will become food for the birds and the wild animals, and there will be no one to frighten them away.
verses.textEnEsv: And the dead bodies of this people will be food for the birds of the air, and for the beasts of the earth, and none will frighten them away.
verses.textEnNkjv: The corpses of this people will be food for the birds of the heaven and for the beasts of the earth. And no one will frighten themaway.
verses.textEnNlt: The bodies of my people will be food for the vultures and wild animals, and no one will be left to scare them away.
verses.textEnNasb: The dead bodies of this people will be food for the birds of the sky and for the animals of the earth; and no one will frighten them away.
verses.textEn: Then the carcasses of this people will become food for the birds and the wild animals, and there will be no one to frighten them away.

verses.textZh: 那时，我必在犹大的城市中和耶路撒冷的街道上，使欢欣和快乐的声音、新郎和新妇的声音止息，因为这地必要变为荒场。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，我必在犹大的城市中和耶路撒冷的街道上，使欢欣和快乐的声音、新郎和新妇的声音止息，因为这地必要变为荒场。"
verses.textZhCuv: 那时，我必使犹大城邑中和耶路撒冷街上，欢喜和快乐的声音，新郎和新妇的声音，都止息了，因为地必成为荒场。」
verses.textEnNiv: I will bring an end to the sounds of joy and gladness and to the voices of bride and bridegroom in the towns of Judah and the streets of Jerusalem, for the land will become desolate.
verses.textEnEsv: And I will silence in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem the voice of mirth and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom and the voice of the bride, for the land shall become a waste.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then I will cause to cease from the cities of Judah and from the streets of Jerusalem the voice of mirth and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom and the voice of the bride. For the land shall be desolate.
