verses.textEnNlt: I will put an end to the happy singing and laughter in the streets of Jerusalem. The joyful voices of bridegrooms and brides will no longer be heard in the towns of Judah. The land will lie in complete desolation.
verses.textEnNasb: Then I will eliminate from the cities of Judah and from the streets of Jerusalem the voice of joy and the voice of gladness, the voice of the groom and the voice of the bride; for the land will become a site of ruins.
verses.textEn: I will bring an end to the sounds of joy and gladness and to the voices of bride and bridegroom in the towns of Judah and the streets of Jerusalem, for the land will become desolate.

verses.textZh: "到那一天 ，敌人要把犹大列王、首领、祭司、先知和耶路撒冷居民的骸骨，都从他们的坟墓里取出来，
verses.textZhCnvs: "到那一天 ，敌人要把犹大列王、首领、祭司、先知和耶路撒冷居民的骸骨，都从他们的坟墓里取出来，
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华说：「到那时，人必将犹大王的骸骨和他首领的骸骨、祭司的骸骨、先知的骸骨，并耶路撒冷居民的骸骨，都从坟墓中取出来，
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘At that time, declares the Lord , the bones of the kings and officials of Judah, the bones of the priests and prophets, and the bones of the people of Jerusalem will be removed from their graves.
verses.textEnEsv: "At that time, declares the Lord , the bones of the kings of Judah, the bones of its officials, the bones of the priests, the bones of the prophets, and the bones of the inhabitants of Jerusalem shall be brought out of their tombs.
verses.textEnNkjv: "At that time," says the Lord, "they shall bring out the bones of the kings of Judah, and the bones of its princes, and the bones of the priests, and the bones of the prophets, and the bones of the inhabitants of Jerusalem, out of their graves.
verses.textEnNlt: "In that day," says the Lord , "the enemy will break open the graves of the kings and officials of Judah, and the graves of the priests, prophets, and common people of Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNasb: "At that time," declares the Lord, "they will bring out the bones of the kings of Judah, the bones of its leaders, the bones of the priests, the bones of the prophets, and the bones of the inhabitants of Jerusalem from their graves.
verses.textEn: " ‘At that time, declares the Lord , the bones of the kings and officials of Judah, the bones of the priests and prophets, and the bones of the people of Jerusalem will be removed from their graves.

verses.textZh: 拋散在太阳、月亮和天上的万象之下，就是他们从前所爱慕、服事、跟随、求问、敬拜的。这些骸骨必不再被收殓埋葬，必在地面上成为粪肥。
verses.textZhCnvs: 拋散在太阳、月亮和天上的万象之下，就是他们从前所爱慕、服事、跟随、求问、敬拜的。这些骸骨必不再被收殓埋葬，必在地面上成为粪肥。
verses.textZhCuv: 抛散在日头、月亮，和天上众星之下，就是他们从前所喜爱、所事奉、所随从、所求问、所敬拜的。这些骸骨不再收殓，不再葬埋，必在地面上成为粪土；
verses.textEnNiv: They will be exposed to the sun and the moon and all the stars of the heavens, which they have loved and served and which they have followed and consulted and worshiped. They will not be gathered up or buried, but will be like dung lying on the ground.
verses.textEnEsv: And they shall be spread before the sun and the moon and all the host of heaven, which they have loved and served, which they have gone after, and which they have sought and worshiped. And they shall not be gathered or buried. They shall be as dung on the surface of the ground.
verses.textEnNkjv: They shall spread them before the sun and the moon and all the host of heaven, which they have loved and which they have served and after which they have walked, which they have sought and which they have worshiped. They shall not be gathered nor buried; they shall be like refuse on the face of the earth.
verses.textEnNlt: They will spread out their bones on the ground before the sun, moon, and stars—the gods my people have loved, served, and worshiped. Their bones will not be gathered up again or buried but will be scattered on the ground like manure.
verses.textEnNasb: They will spread them out to the sun, the moon, and to all the heavenly lights, which they have loved, which they have served, which they have followed, which they have sought, and which they have worshiped. They will not be gathered nor buried; they will be like dung on the face of the ground.
verses.textEn: They will be exposed to the sun and the moon and all the stars of the heavens, which they have loved and served and which they have followed and consulted and worshiped. They will not be gathered up or buried, but will be like dung lying on the ground.

verses.textZh: 这邪恶的家族剩下的余民，在我驱逐他们到的各地，宁可选择死，也不要存活。"这是万军之耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这邪恶的家族剩下的余民，在我驱逐他们到的各地，宁可选择死，也不要存活。"这是万军之耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 并且这恶族所剩下的民在我所赶他们到的各处，宁可拣死不拣生。这是万军之耶和华说的。」
verses.textEnNiv: Wherever I banish them, all the survivors of this evil nation will prefer death to life, declares the Lord Almighty.’
verses.textEnEsv: Death shall be preferred to life by all the remnant that remains of this evil family in all the places where I have driven them, declares the Lord of hosts.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then death shall be chosen rather than life by all the residue of those who remain of this evil family, who remain in all the places where I have driven them," says the Lord of hosts.
verses.textEnNlt: And the people of this evil nation who survive will wish to die rather than live where I will send them. I, the Lord of Heaven’s Armies, have spoken!
verses.textEnNasb: And death will be chosen rather than life by all the remnant that remains of this evil family, that remains in all the places to which I have driven them," declares the Lord of armies.
verses.textEn: Wherever I banish them, all the survivors of this evil nation will prefer death to life, declares the Lord Almighty.’

verses.textZh: "你要对他们说：‘耶和华这样说： 人跌倒了，不再起来吗？ 人偏离了，不再回转吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: "你要对他们说：‘耶和华这样说： 人跌倒了，不再起来吗？ 人偏离了，不再回转吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 你要对他们说，耶和华如此说： 人跌倒，不再起来吗？ 人转去，不再转来吗？
verses.textEnNiv: "Say to them, ‘This is what the Lord says: " ‘When people fall down, do they not get up? When someone turns away, do they not return?
verses.textEnEsv: "You shall say to them, Thus says the Lord : When men fall, do they not rise again? If one turns away, does he not return?
verses.textEnNkjv: "Moreover you shall say to them, ‘Thus says the Lord: "Will they fall and not rise? Will one turn away and not return?
verses.textEnNlt: "Jeremiah, say to the people, ‘This is what the Lord says: "‘When people fall down, don’t they get up again? When they discover they’re on the wrong road, don’t they turn back?
verses.textEnNasb: "You shall say to them, ‘This is what the Lord says: "Do people fall and not get up? Does one turn away and not repent?
verses.textEn: "Say to them, ‘This is what the Lord says: " ‘When people fall down, do they not get up? When someone turns away, do they not return?

verses.textZh: 这人民为甚么背道， 耶路撒冷为甚么长久偏离？ 他们定意行诡诈， 不肯回转。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这人民为甚么背道， 耶路撒冷为甚么长久偏离？ 他们定意行诡诈， 不肯回转。
verses.textZhCuv: 这耶路撒冷的民，为何恒久背道呢？ 他们守定诡诈，不肯回头。
verses.textEnNiv: Why then have these people turned away? Why does Jerusalem always turn away? They cling to deceit; they refuse to return.
verses.textEnEsv: Why then has this people turned away in perpetual backsliding? They hold fast to deceit; they refuse to return.
verses.textEnNkjv: Why has this people slidden back, Jerusalem, in a perpetual backsliding? They hold fast to deceit, They refuse to return.
verses.textEnNlt: Then why do these people stay on their self-destructive path? Why do the people of Jerusalem refuse to turn back? They cling tightly to their lies and will not turn around.
verses.textEnNasb: "Why has this people, Jerusalem, Turned away in continual apostasy? They hold on to deceit, They refuse to return.
verses.textEn: Why then have these people turned away? Why does Jerusalem always turn away? They cling to deceit; they refuse to return.

verses.textZh: 我留心听， 但他们都不说真实的话。 没有人为自己的恶行后悔， 说："我究竟作了甚么？" 他们各人继续走自己偏差的路， 像战马直冲入战场。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我留心听， 但他们都不说真实的话。 没有人为自己的恶行后悔， 说："我究竟作了甚么？" 他们各人继续走自己偏差的路， 像战马直冲入战场。
verses.textZhCuv: 我留心听，听见他们说不正直的话。 无人悔改恶行，说： 我做的是什么呢？ 他们各人转奔己路， 如马直闯战场。
verses.textEnNiv: I have listened attentively, but they do not say what is right. None of them repent of their wickedness, saying, "What have I done?" Each pursues their own course like a horse charging into battle.
verses.textEnEsv: I have paid attention and listened, but they have not spoken rightly; no man relents of his evil, saying, ‘What have I done?’ Everyone turns to his own course, like a horse plunging headlong into battle.
verses.textEnNkjv: I listened and heard, But they do not speak aright. No man repented of his wickedness, Saying, ‘What have I done?’ Everyone turned to his own course, As the horse rushes into the battle.
verses.textEnNlt: I listen to their conversations and don’t hear a word of truth. Is anyone sorry for doing wrong? Does anyone say, "What a terrible thing I have done"? No! All are running down the path of sin as swiftly as a horse galloping into battle!
verses.textEnNasb: "I have listened and heard, They have spoken what is not right; No one repented of his wickedness, Saying, ‘What have I done?’ Everyone turned to his own course, Like a horse charging into the battle.
verses.textEn: I have listened attentively, but they do not say what is right. None of them repent of their wickedness, saying, "What have I done?" Each pursues their own course like a horse charging into battle.

verses.textZh: 连空中的鹳鸟也知道自己来去的季候； 斑鸠、燕子和白鹤也谨守迁移的时令； 我的子民却不晓得耶和华的法则。
verses.textZhCnvs: 连空中的鹳鸟也知道自己来去的季候； 斑鸠、燕子和白鹤也谨守迁移的时令； 我的子民却不晓得耶和华的法则。
verses.textZhCuv: 空中的鹳鸟知道来去的定期； 斑鸠燕子与白鹤也守候当来的时令； 我的百姓却不知道耶和华的法则。
verses.textEnNiv: Even the stork in the sky knows her appointed seasons, and the dove, the swift and the thrush observe the time of their migration. But my people do not know the requirements of the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: Even the stork in the heavens knows her times, and the turtledove, swallow, and crane keep the time of their coming, but my people know not the rules of the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: "Even the stork in the heavens Knows her appointed times; And the turtledove, the swift, and the swallow Observe the time of their coming. But My people do not know the judgment of the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: Even the stork that flies across the sky knows the time of her migration, as do the turtledove, the swallow, and the crane. They all return at the proper time each year. But not my people! They do not know the Lord ’s laws.
verses.textEnNasb: "Even the stork in the sky Knows her seasons; And the turtledove, the swallow, and the crane Keep to the time of their migration; But My people do not know The judgment of the Lord.
verses.textEn: Even the stork in the sky knows her appointed seasons, and the dove, the swift and the thrush observe the time of their migration. But my people do not know the requirements of the Lord .

verses.textZh: 你们怎可以说："我们是智慧人， 我们有耶和华的律法"呢？ 事实上，经学家虚假的笔 已把律法变成谎言了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们怎可以说："我们是智慧人， 我们有耶和华的律法"呢？ 事实上，经学家虚假的笔 已把律法变成谎言了。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们怎么说：我们有智慧， 耶和华的律法在我们这里？ 看哪，文士的假笔舞弄虚假。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘How can you say, "We are wise, for we have the law of the Lord ," when actually the lying pen of the scribes has handled it falsely?
verses.textEnEsv: "How can you say, ‘We are wise, and the law of the Lord is with us’? But behold, the lying pen of the scribes has made it into a lie.
verses.textEnNkjv: "How can you say, ‘We are wise, And the law of the Lordis with us’? Look, the false pen of the scribe certainly works falsehood.
verses.textEnNlt: "‘How can you say, "We are wise because we have the word of the Lord ," when your teachers have twisted it by writing lies?
verses.textEnNasb: "How can you say, ‘We are wise, And the Law of the Lord is with us’? But behold, the lying pen of the scribes Has made it into a lie.
verses.textEn: " ‘How can you say, "We are wise, for we have the law of the Lord ," when actually the lying pen of the scribes has handled it falsely?

verses.textZh: 智慧人必蒙羞， 惊惶失措。 看哪！他们弃绝了耶和华的话， 他们还有甚么智慧呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 智慧人必蒙羞， 惊惶失措。 看哪！他们弃绝了耶和华的话， 他们还有甚么智慧呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 智慧人惭愧，惊惶，被擒拿； 他们弃掉耶和华的话， 心里还有什么智慧呢？
verses.textEnNiv: The wise will be put to shame; they will be dismayed and trapped. Since they have rejected the word of the Lord , what kind of wisdom do they have?
verses.textEnEsv: The wise men shall be put to shame; they shall be dismayed and taken; behold, they have rejected the word of the Lord , so what wisdom is in them?
verses.textEnNkjv: The wise men are ashamed, They are dismayed and taken. Behold, they have rejected the word of the Lord; So what wisdom do they have?
verses.textEnNlt: These wise teachers will fall into the trap of their own foolishness, for they have rejected the word of the Lord . Are they so wise after all?
verses.textEnNasb: "The wise men are put to shame, They are dismayed and caught; Behold, they have rejected the word of the Lord, So what kind of wisdom do they have?
verses.textEn: The wise will be put to shame; they will be dismayed and trapped. Since they have rejected the word of the Lord , what kind of wisdom do they have?

verses.textZh: 因此，我必把他们的妻子给别人， 把他们的田地给别的主人， 因为他们从最小的到最大的， 个个都贪图不义之财； 从先知到祭司， 全都行事诡诈。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，我必把他们的妻子给别人， 把他们的田地给别的主人， 因为他们从最小的到最大的， 个个都贪图不义之财； 从先知到祭司， 全都行事诡诈。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以我必将他们的妻子给别人， 将他们的田地给别人为业； 因为他们从最小的到至大的都一味地贪婪， 从先知到祭司都行事虚谎。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore I will give their wives to other men and their fields to new owners. From the least to the greatest, all are greedy for gain; prophets and priests alike, all practice deceit.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore I will give their wives to others and their fields to conquerors, because from the least to the greatest everyone is greedy for unjust gain; from prophet to priest, everyone deals falsely.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore I will give their wives to others, And their fields to those who will inherit them; Because from the least even to the greatest Everyone is given to covetousness; From the prophet even to the priest Everyone deals falsely.
verses.textEnNlt: I will give their wives to others and their farms to strangers. From the least to the greatest, their lives are ruled by greed. Yes, even my prophets and priests are like that. They are all frauds.
verses.textEnNasb: "Therefore I will give their wives to others, Their fields to new owners; Because from the least even to the greatest Everyone is greedy for gain; From the prophet even to the priest, Everyone practices deceit.
verses.textEn: Therefore I will give their wives to other men and their fields to new owners. From the least to the greatest, all are greedy for gain; prophets and priests alike, all practice deceit.

verses.textZh: 他们草率地医治我子民 的损伤， 说："平安了！平安了！" 其实没有平安。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们草率地医治我子民 的损伤， 说："平安了！平安了！" 其实没有平安。’
verses.textZhCuv: 他们轻轻忽忽地医治我百姓的损伤，说： 平安了！平安了！ 其实没有平安。
verses.textEnNiv: They dress the wound of my people as though it were not serious. "Peace, peace," they say, when there is no peace.
verses.textEnEsv: They have healed the wound of my people lightly, saying, ‘Peace, peace,’ when there is no peace.
verses.textEnNkjv: For they have healed the hurt of the daughter of My people slightly, Saying, ‘Peace, peace!’ When thereis no peace.
verses.textEnNlt: They offer superficial treatments for my people’s mortal wound. They give assurances of peace when there is no peace.
verses.textEnNasb: "They have healed the brokenness of the daughter of My people superficially, Saying, ‘Peace, peace,’ But there is no peace.
verses.textEn: They dress the wound of my people as though it were not serious. "Peace, peace," they say, when there is no peace.

verses.textZh: 耶和华说： ‘他们行了可憎的事，本应觉得羞愧， 可是他们一点羞愧都没有， 恬不知耻。 因此他们必仆倒在倒下的人中间； 我惩罚他们的时候，他们必倒下来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华说： ‘他们行了可憎的事，本应觉得羞愧， 可是他们一点羞愧都没有， 恬不知耻。 因此他们必仆倒在倒下的人中间； 我惩罚他们的时候，他们必倒下来。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们行可憎的事知道惭愧吗？ 不然，他们毫不惭愧， 也不知羞耻。 因此他们必在仆倒的人中仆倒； 我向他们讨罪的时候， 他们必致跌倒。 这是耶和华说的。
verses.textEnNiv: Are they ashamed of their detestable conduct? No, they have no shame at all; they do not even know how to blush. So they will fall among the fallen; they will be brought down when they are punished, says the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: Were they ashamed when they committed abomination? No, they were not at all ashamed; they did not know how to blush. Therefore they shall fall among the fallen; when I punish them, they shall be overthrown, says the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: Were they ashamed when they had committed abomination? No! They were not at all ashamed, Nor did they know how to blush. Therefore they shall fall among those who fall; In the time of their punishment They shall be cast down," says the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: Are they ashamed of these disgusting actions? Not at all—they don’t even know how to blush! Therefore, they will lie among the slaughtered. They will be brought down when I punish them, says the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: "Were they ashamed because of the abomination they had done? They were not ashamed at all, And they did not know how to be ashamed; Therefore they will fall among those who fall; At the time of their punishment they will collapse," Says the Lord.
verses.textEn: Are they ashamed of their detestable conduct? No, they have no shame at all; they do not even know how to blush. So they will fall among the fallen; they will be brought down when they are punished, says the Lord .

verses.textZh: 我要彻底除掉他们的庄稼； 葡萄树上必没有葡萄， 无花果树上必没有无花果， 叶子也必枯干。 我赐给他们的，都离开他们过去了。’" 这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要彻底除掉他们的庄稼； 葡萄树上必没有葡萄， 无花果树上必没有无花果， 叶子也必枯干。 我赐给他们的，都离开他们过去了。’" 这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华说：我必使他们全然灭绝； 葡萄树上必没有葡萄， 无花果树上必没有果子， 叶子也必枯干。 我所赐给他们的， 必离开他们过去。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘I will take away their harvest, declares the Lord . There will be no grapes on the vine. There will be no figs on the tree, and their leaves will wither. What I have given them will be taken from them. ’ "
verses.textEnEsv: When I would gather them, declares the Lord , there are no grapes on the vine, nor figs on the fig tree; even the leaves are withered, and what I gave them has passed away from them."
verses.textEnNkjv: "I will surely consume them," says the Lord. "No grapes shallbe on the vine, Nor figs on the fig tree, And the leaf shall fade; And thethings I have given them shall pass away from them." ’ "
verses.textEnNlt: I will surely consume them. There will be no more harvests of figs and grapes. Their fruit trees will all die. Whatever I gave them will soon be gone. I, the Lord , have spoken!’
verses.textEnNasb: "I will certainly snatch them away," declares the Lord. "There will be no grapes on the vine And no figs on the fig tree, And the leaf will wither; And what I have given them will pass away." ’ "
verses.textEn: " ‘I will take away their harvest, declares the Lord . There will be no grapes on the vine. There will be no figs on the tree, and their leaves will wither. What I have given them will be taken from them. ’ "

verses.textZh: 我们为甚么坐着不动呢？ 你们要集合起来，我们要进入坚固的城里去， 在那里灭亡吧！ 因为耶和华我们的神要我们灭亡， 又把毒水给我们喝， 因我们得罪了耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们为甚么坐着不动呢？ 你们要集合起来，我们要进入坚固的城里去， 在那里灭亡吧！ 因为耶和华我们的神要我们灭亡， 又把毒水给我们喝， 因我们得罪了耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们为何静坐不动呢？ 我们当聚集，进入坚固城， 在那里静默不言； 因为耶和华－我们的神使我们静默不言， 又将苦胆水给我们喝， 都因我们得罪了耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: Why are we sitting here? Gather together! Let us flee to the fortified cities and perish there! For the Lord our God has doomed us to perish and given us poisoned water to drink, because we have sinned against him.
verses.textEnEsv: Why do we sit still? Gather together; let us go into the fortified cities and perish there, for the Lord our God has doomed us to perish and has given us poisoned water to drink, because we have sinned against the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: "Why do we sit still? Assemble yourselves, And let us enter the fortified cities, And let us be silent there. For the Lord our God has put us to silence And given us water of gall to drink, Because we have sinned against the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: "Then the people will say, ‘Why should we wait here to die? Come, let’s go to the fortified towns and die there. For the Lord our God has decreed our destruction and has given us a cup of poison to drink because we sinned against the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: Why are we sitting still? Assemble yourselves, and let’s go into the fortified cities And perish there, For the Lord our God has doomed us And given us poisoned water to drink, Because we have sinned against the Lord.
verses.textEn: Why are we sitting here? Gather together! Let us flee to the fortified cities and perish there! For the Lord our God has doomed us to perish and given us poisoned water to drink, because we have sinned against him.

verses.textZh: 我们期待平安，却得不到好处； 期待得医治的时候，不料，只有惊慌。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们期待平安，却得不到好处； 期待得医治的时候，不料，只有惊慌。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们指望平安， 却得不着好处； 指望痊愈的时候， 不料，受了惊惶。
verses.textEnNiv: We hoped for peace but no good has come, for a time of healing but there is only terror.
verses.textEnEsv: We looked for peace, but no good came; for a time of healing, but behold, terror.
verses.textEnNkjv: "We looked for peace, but no good came; And for a time of health, and there was trouble!
verses.textEnNlt: We hoped for peace, but no peace came. We hoped for a time of healing, but found only terror.’
verses.textEnNasb: We waited for peace, but no good came; For a time of healing, but behold, terror!
verses.textEn: We hoped for peace but no good has come, for a time of healing but there is only terror.

verses.textZh: 从但那里听见敌人战马的喷气声， 全地因听见壮马的嘶鸣声震动。 他们来是要吞灭土地和地上所有的， 要吞灭城和城中的居民。
verses.textZhCnvs: 从但那里听见敌人战马的喷气声， 全地因听见壮马的嘶鸣声震动。 他们来是要吞灭土地和地上所有的， 要吞灭城和城中的居民。
verses.textZhCuv: 听见从但那里敌人的马喷鼻气， 他的壮马发嘶声， 全地就都震动； 因为他们来吞灭这地和其上所有的， 吞灭这城与其中的居民。
verses.textEnNiv: The snorting of the enemy’s horses is heard from Dan; at the neighing of their stallions the whole land trembles. They have come to devour the land and everything in it, the city and all who live there.
verses.textEnEsv: "The snorting of their horses is heard from Dan; at the sound of the neighing of their stallions the whole land quakes. They come and devour the land and all that fills it, the city and those who dwell in it.
verses.textEnNkjv: The snorting of His horses was heard from Dan. The whole land trembled at the sound of the neighing of His strong ones; For they have come and devoured the land and all that is in it, The city and those who dwell in it."
verses.textEnNlt: "The snorting of the enemies’ warhorses can be heard all the way from the land of Dan in the north! The neighing of their stallions makes the whole land tremble. They are coming to devour the land and everything in it— cities and people alike.
verses.textEnNasb: From Dan there is heard the snorting of his horses; At the sound of the neighing of his stallions The whole land quakes; For they come and devour the land and its fullness, The city and its inhabitants.
verses.textEn: The snorting of the enemy’s horses is heard from Dan; at the neighing of their stallions the whole land trembles. They have come to devour the land and everything in it, the city and all who live there.

verses.textZh: "看哪！我要打发毒蛇到你们中间， 是没有法术能制伏的， 牠们必咬你们。" 这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: "看哪！我要打发毒蛇到你们中间， 是没有法术能制伏的， 牠们必咬你们。" 这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 看哪，我必使毒蛇到你们中间， 是不服法术的， 必咬你们。 这是耶和华说的。
verses.textEnNiv: "See, I will send venomous snakes among you, vipers that cannot be charmed, and they will bite you," declares the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: For behold, I am sending among you serpents, adders that cannot be charmed, and they shall bite you," declares the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: "For behold, I will send serpents among you, Vipers which cannot be charmed, And they shall bite you," says the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: I will send these enemy troops among you like poisonous snakes you cannot charm. They will bite you, and you will die. I, the Lord , have spoken!"
verses.textEnNasb: "For behold, I am sending serpents among you, Vipers for which there is no charm; And they will bite you," declares the Lord.
verses.textEn: "See, I will send venomous snakes among you, vipers that cannot be charmed, and they will bite you," declares the Lord .

verses.textZh: 我的愁苦无法医治 ， 我的心在我里面悲痛欲绝。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的愁苦无法医治 ， 我的心在我里面悲痛欲绝。
verses.textZhCuv: 我有忧愁，愿能自慰； 我心在我里面发昏。
verses.textEnNiv: You who are my Comforter in sorrow, my heart is faint within me.
verses.textEnEsv: My joy is gone; grief is upon me; my heart is sick within me.
verses.textEnNkjv: I would comfort myself in sorrow; My heart is faint in me.
verses.textEnNlt: My grief is beyond healing; my heart is broken.
verses.textEnNasb: My sorrow is beyond healing, My heart is faint within me!
verses.textEn: You who are my Comforter in sorrow, my heart is faint within me.

verses.textZh: 听啊！我同胞 的呼救声， 从遥远之地传来： "耶和华不在锡安吗？ 锡安的王不在其中吗？" "他们为甚么以自己雕刻的偶像， 和列国虚无的偶像，来惹我发怒呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 听啊！我同胞 的呼救声， 从遥远之地传来： "耶和华不在锡安吗？ 锡安的王不在其中吗？" "他们为甚么以自己雕刻的偶像， 和列国虚无的偶像，来惹我发怒呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 听啊，是我百姓的哀声从极远之地而来， 说：耶和华不在锡安吗？ 锡安的王不在其中吗？ 耶和华说：他们为什么以雕刻的偶像 和外邦虚无的神惹我发怒呢？
verses.textEnNiv: Listen to the cry of my people from a land far away: "Is the Lord not in Zion? Is her King no longer there?" "Why have they aroused my anger with their images, with their worthless foreign idols?"
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, the cry of the daughter of my people from the length and breadth of the land: "Is the Lord not in Zion? Is her King not in her?" "Why have they provoked me to anger with their carved images and with their foreign idols?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Listen! The voice, The cry of the daughter of my people From a far country: "Is not the Lord in Zion? Is not her King in her?" "Why have they provoked Me to anger With their carved images— With foreign idols?"
verses.textEnNlt: Listen to the weeping of my people; it can be heard all across the land. "Has the Lord abandoned Jerusalem? " the people ask. "Is her King no longer there?" "Oh, why have they provoked my anger with their carved idols and their worthless foreign gods?" says the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: Behold, listen! The cry of the daughter of my people from a distant land: "Is the Lord not in Zion? Is her King not within her?" "Why have they provoked Me with their carved images, with foreign idols?"
verses.textEn: Listen to the cry of my people from a land far away: "Is the Lord not in Zion? Is her King no longer there?" "Why have they aroused my anger with their images, with their worthless foreign idols?"

verses.textZh: "收割期已过，夏天也结束； 但我们仍未获救。"
verses.textZhCnvs: "收割期已过，夏天也结束； 但我们仍未获救。"
verses.textZhCuv: 麦秋已过，夏令已完， 我们还未得救！
verses.textEnNiv: "The harvest is past, the summer has ended, and we are not saved."
verses.textEnEsv: "The harvest is past, the summer is ended, and we are not saved."
verses.textEnNkjv: "The harvest is past, The summer is ended, And we are not saved!"
verses.textEnNlt: "The harvest is finished, and the summer is gone," the people cry, "yet we are not saved!"
verses.textEnNasb: "Harvest is past, summer is over, And we are not saved."
verses.textEn: "The harvest is past, the summer has ended, and we are not saved."

verses.textZh: 因着我的同胞 被压碎，我的心破碎了； 我悲伤痛哭，惊慌抓住了我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因着我的同胞 被压碎，我的心破碎了； 我悲伤痛哭，惊慌抓住了我。
verses.textZhCuv: 先知说：因我百姓的损伤， 我也受了损伤。 我哀痛，惊惶将我抓住。
verses.textEnNiv: Since my people are crushed, I am crushed; I mourn, and horror grips me.
verses.textEnEsv: For the wound of the daughter of my people is my heart wounded; I mourn, and dismay has taken hold on me.
verses.textEnNkjv: For the hurt of the daughter of my people I am hurt. I am mourning; Astonishment has taken hold of me.
verses.textEnNlt: I hurt with the hurt of my people. I mourn and am overcome with grief.
verses.textEnNasb: I am broken over the brokenness of the daughter of my people. I mourn, dismay has taken hold of me.
verses.textEn: Since my people are crushed, I am crushed; I mourn, and horror grips me.

verses.textZh: 难道基列没有乳香吗？ 难道那里没有医生吗？ 我的同胞 为甚么总不痊愈呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 难道基列没有乳香吗？ 难道那里没有医生吗？ 我的同胞 为甚么总不痊愈呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 在基列岂没有乳香呢？ 在那里岂没有医生呢？ 我百姓为何不得痊愈呢？
verses.textEnNiv: Is there no balm in Gilead? Is there no physician there? Why then is there no healing for the wound of my people?
verses.textEnEsv: Is there no balm in Gilead? Is there no physician there? Why then has the health of the daughter of my people not been restored?
verses.textEnNkjv: Isthere no balm in Gilead, Isthere no physician there? Why then is there no recovery For the health of the daughter of my people?
verses.textEnNlt: Is there no medicine in Gilead? Is there no physician there? Why is there no healing for the wounds of my people?
verses.textEnNasb: Is there no balm in Gilead? Is there no physician there? Why then has not the health of the daughter of my people been restored?
verses.textEn: Is there no balm in Gilead? Is there no physician there? Why then is there no healing for the wound of my people?

verses.textZh: 但愿我的头是水井， 我的眼是泪的泉源； 我好为我同胞 中被杀的， 昼夜哭泣。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但愿我的头是水井， 我的眼是泪的泉源； 我好为我同胞 中被杀的， 昼夜哭泣。
verses.textZhCuv: 但愿我的头为水， 我的眼为泪的泉源， 我好为我百姓 中被杀的人昼夜哭泣。
verses.textEnNiv: Oh, that my head were a spring of water and my eyes a fountain of tears! I would weep day and night for the slain of my people.
verses.textEnEsv: Oh that my head were waters, and my eyes a fountain of tears, that I might weep day and night for the slain of the daughter of my people!
verses.textEnNkjv: Oh, that my head were waters, And my eyes a fountain of tears, That I might weep day and night For the slain of the daughter of my people!
verses.textEnNlt: If only my head were a pool of water and my eyes a fountain of tears, I would weep day and night for all my people who have been slaughtered.
verses.textEnNasb: Oh, that my head were waters And my eyes a fountain of tears, That I might weep day and night For those slain of the daughter of my people!
verses.textEn: Oh, that my head were a spring of water and my eyes a fountain of tears! I would weep day and night for the slain of my people.

verses.textZh: 但愿我在旷野有一个旅客住宿的地方， 好使我离开我的同胞， 可以离他们而去； 因为他们都是行奸淫的， 是行诡诈之徒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但愿我在旷野有一个旅客住宿的地方， 好使我离开我的同胞， 可以离他们而去； 因为他们都是行奸淫的， 是行诡诈之徒。
verses.textZhCuv: 惟愿我在旷野有行路人住宿之处， 使我可以离开我的民出去； 因他们都是行奸淫的， 是行诡诈的一党。
verses.textEnNiv: Oh, that I had in the desert a lodging place for travelers, so that I might leave my people and go away from them; for they are all adulterers, a crowd of unfaithful people.
verses.textEnEsv: Oh that I had in the desert a travelers’ lodging place, that I might leave my people and go away from them! For they are all adulterers, a company of treacherous men.
verses.textEnNkjv: Oh, that I had in the wilderness A lodging place for travelers; That I might leave my people, And go from them! For they are all adulterers, An assembly of treacherous men.
verses.textEnNlt: Oh, that I could go away and forget my people and live in a travelers’ shack in the desert. For they are all adulterers— a pack of treacherous liars.
verses.textEnNasb: Oh that I had in the desert A travelers’ lodging place; So that I might leave my people And go away from them! For all of them are adulterers, An assembly of treacherous people.
verses.textEn: Oh, that I had in the desert a lodging place for travelers, so that I might leave my people and go away from them; for they are all adulterers, a crowd of unfaithful people.

verses.textZh: "他们弯曲舌头，像弯弓一样； 在这地得势的是虚谎，不是诚实； 因为他们变本加厉地作恶， 连我也不认识。" 这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: "他们弯曲舌头，像弯弓一样； 在这地得势的是虚谎，不是诚实； 因为他们变本加厉地作恶， 连我也不认识。" 这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们弯起舌头像弓一样， 为要说谎话。 他们在国中增长势力， 不是为行诚实， 乃是恶上加恶， 并不认识我。 这是耶和华说的。
verses.textEnNiv: "They make ready their tongue like a bow, to shoot lies; it is not by truth that they triumph in the land. They go from one sin to another; they do not acknowledge me," declares the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: They bend their tongue like a bow; falsehood and not truth has grown strong in the land; for they proceed from evil to evil, and they do not know me, declares the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: "And like their bow they have bent their tongues for lies. They are not valiant for the truth on the earth. For they proceed from evil to evil, And they do not know Me," says the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: "My people bend their tongues like bows to shoot out lies. They refuse to stand up for the truth. They only go from bad to worse. They do not know me," says the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: "They bend their tongues like their bows; Lies and not truth prevail in the land; For they proceed from evil to evil, And they do not know Me," declares the Lord.
verses.textEn: "They make ready their tongue like a bow, to shoot lies; it is not by truth that they triumph in the land. They go from one sin to another; they do not acknowledge me," declares the Lord .

verses.textZh: "你们各人要提防自己的邻舍， 不要信靠兄弟； 因为每一个兄弟都在欺骗人， 每一个邻舍都搬弄是非。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你们各人要提防自己的邻舍， 不要信靠兄弟； 因为每一个兄弟都在欺骗人， 每一个邻舍都搬弄是非。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们各人当谨防邻舍， 不可信靠弟兄； 因为弟兄尽行欺骗， 邻舍都往来谗谤人。
verses.textEnNiv: "Beware of your friends; do not trust anyone in your clan. For every one of them is a deceiver, and every friend a slanderer.
verses.textEnEsv: Let everyone beware of his neighbor, and put no trust in any brother, for every brother is a deceiver, and every neighbor goes about as a slanderer.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Everyone take heed to his neighbor, And do not trust any brother; For every brother will utterly supplant, And every neighbor will walk with slanderers.
verses.textEnNlt: "Beware of your neighbor! Don’t even trust your brother! For brother takes advantage of brother, and friend slanders friend.
verses.textEnNasb: "Let everyone be on guard against his neighbor, And do not trust any brother; Because every brother utterly betrays, And every neighbor goes about as a slanderer.
verses.textEn: "Beware of your friends; do not trust anyone in your clan. For every one of them is a deceiver, and every friend a slanderer.

verses.textZh: 他们各人都欺骗自己的邻舍， 不说诚实话。 他们训练自己的舌头说谎话， 竭力作孽，以致他们不能回转 。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们各人都欺骗自己的邻舍， 不说诚实话。 他们训练自己的舌头说谎话， 竭力作孽，以致他们不能回转 。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们各人欺哄邻舍，不说真话； 他们教舌头学习说谎， 劳劳碌碌地作孽。
verses.textEnNiv: Friend deceives friend, and no one speaks the truth. They have taught their tongues to lie; they weary themselves with sinning.
verses.textEnEsv: Everyone deceives his neighbor, and no one speaks the truth; they have taught their tongue to speak lies; they weary themselves committing iniquity.
verses.textEnNkjv: Everyone will deceive his neighbor, And will not speak the truth; They have taught their tongue to speak lies; They weary themselves to commit iniquity.
verses.textEnNlt: They all fool and defraud each other; no one tells the truth. With practiced tongues they tell lies; they wear themselves out with all their sinning.
verses.textEnNasb: "Everyone deceives his neighbor And does not speak the truth. They have taught their tongue to speak lies; They weary themselves committing wrongdoing.
verses.textEn: Friend deceives friend, and no one speaks the truth. They have taught their tongues to lie; they weary themselves with sinning.

verses.textZh: 欺凌加上欺凌，诡诈加上诡诈 ， 他们不肯认识我。" 这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 欺凌加上欺凌，诡诈加上诡诈 ， 他们不肯认识我。" 这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 你的住处在诡诈的人中； 他们因行诡诈，不肯认识我。 这是耶和华说的。
verses.textEnNiv: You live in the midst of deception; in their deceit they refuse to acknowledge me," declares the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: Heaping oppression upon oppression, and deceit upon deceit, they refuse to know me, declares the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: Your dwelling place is in the midst of deceit; Through deceit they refuse to know Me," says the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: They pile lie upon lie and utterly refuse to acknowledge me," says the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: "Your dwelling is in the midst of deceit; Through deceit they refuse to know Me," declares the Lord.
verses.textEn: You live in the midst of deception; in their deceit they refuse to acknowledge me," declares the Lord .

verses.textZh: 因此，万军之耶和华这样说： "看哪！我要熬炼他们，试验他们； 因我子民 的罪恶，我还可以作甚么呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，万军之耶和华这样说： "看哪！我要熬炼他们，试验他们； 因我子民 的罪恶，我还可以作甚么呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 所以万军之耶和华如此说： 看哪，我要将他们熔化熬炼； 不然，我因我百姓的罪该怎样行呢？
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore this is what the Lord Almighty says: "See, I will refine and test them, for what else can I do because of the sin of my people?
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore thus says the Lord of hosts: "Behold, I will refine them and test them, for what else can I do, because of my people?
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore thus says the Lord of hosts: "Behold, I will refine them and try them; For how shall I deal with the daughter of My people?
verses.textEnNlt: Therefore, this is what the Lord of Heaven’s Armies says: "See, I will melt them down in a crucible and test them like metal. What else can I do with my people?
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore this is what the Lord of armies says: "Behold, I will refine them and put them to the test; For what else can I do, because of the daughter of My people?
verses.textEn: Therefore this is what the Lord Almighty says: "See, I will refine and test them, for what else can I do because of the sin of my people?

verses.textZh: 他们的舌头是杀人的利箭， 嘴里说的是诡诈； 跟邻舍说话满口甜言蜜语， 心底里却设计陷害他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们的舌头是杀人的利箭， 嘴里说的是诡诈； 跟邻舍说话满口甜言蜜语， 心底里却设计陷害他。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们的舌头是毒箭，说话诡诈； 人与邻舍口说和平话， 心却谋害他。
verses.textEnNiv: Their tongue is a deadly arrow; it speaks deceitfully. With their mouths they all speak cordially to their neighbors, but in their hearts they set traps for them.
verses.textEnEsv: Their tongue is a deadly arrow; it speaks deceitfully; with his mouth each speaks peace to his neighbor, but in his heart he plans an ambush for him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Their tongue is an arrow shot out; It speaks deceit; One speaks peaceably to his neighbor with his mouth, But in his heart he lies in wait.
verses.textEnNlt: For their tongues shoot lies like poisoned arrows. They speak friendly words to their neighbors while scheming in their heart to kill them.
verses.textEnNasb: "Their tongue is a deadly arrow; It speaks deceit; With his mouth one speaks peace to his neighbor, But inwardly he sets an ambush for him.
verses.textEn: Their tongue is a deadly arrow; it speaks deceitfully. With their mouths they all speak cordially to their neighbors, but in their hearts they set traps for them.

verses.textZh: 我因这些事怎能不惩罚他们呢？ 像这样的国家， 我怎能不亲自报复呢？" 这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我因这些事怎能不惩罚他们呢？ 像这样的国家， 我怎能不亲自报复呢？" 这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华说：我岂不因这些事讨他们的罪呢？ 岂不报复这样的国民呢？
verses.textEnNiv: Should I not punish them for this?" declares the Lord . "Should I not avenge myself on such a nation as this?"
verses.textEnEsv: Shall I not punish them for these things? declares the Lord , and shall I not avenge myself on a nation such as this?
verses.textEnNkjv: Shall I not punish them for these things?" says the Lord. "Shall I not avenge Myself on such a nation as this?"
verses.textEnNlt: Should I not punish them for this?" says the Lord . "Should I not avenge myself against such a nation?"
verses.textEnNasb: "Shall I not punish them for these things?" declares the Lord. "Shall I not avenge Myself On a nation such as this?
verses.textEn: Should I not punish them for this?" declares the Lord . "Should I not avenge myself on such a nation as this?"

verses.textZh: 我要为众山哭泣哀号， 为旷野的草场唱哀歌； 因为都已成为荒凉，无人经过， 也听不到牲畜的叫声； 无论空中的飞鸟，地上的走兽， 都逃走跑掉了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要为众山哭泣哀号， 为旷野的草场唱哀歌； 因为都已成为荒凉，无人经过， 也听不到牲畜的叫声； 无论空中的飞鸟，地上的走兽， 都逃走跑掉了。
verses.textZhCuv: 我要为山岭哭泣悲哀， 为旷野的草场扬声哀号； 因为都已干焦，甚至无人经过。 人也听不见牲畜鸣叫， 空中的飞鸟和地上的野兽都已逃去。
verses.textEnNiv: I will weep and wail for the mountains and take up a lament concerning the wilderness grasslands. They are desolate and untraveled, and the lowing of cattle is not heard. The birds have all fled and the animals are gone.
verses.textEnEsv: "I will take up weeping and wailing for the mountains, and a lamentation for the pastures of the wilderness, because they are laid waste so that no one passes through, and the lowing of cattle is not heard; both the birds of the air and the beasts have fled and are gone.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will take up a weeping and wailing for the mountains, And for the dwelling places of the wilderness a lamentation, Because they are burned up, So that no one can pass through; Nor can men hear the voice of the cattle. Both the birds of the heavens and the beasts have fled; They are gone.
verses.textEnNlt: I will weep for the mountains and wail for the wilderness pastures. For they are desolate and empty of life; the lowing of cattle is heard no more; the birds and wild animals have all fled.
verses.textEnNasb: "I will take up a weeping and wailing for the mountains, And for the pastures of the wilderness a song of mourning, Because they are laid waste so that no one passes through, And the sound of the livestock is not heard; Both the birds of the sky and the animals have fled; they are gone.
verses.textEn: I will weep and wail for the mountains and take up a lament concerning the wilderness grasslands. They are desolate and untraveled, and the lowing of cattle is not heard. The birds have all fled and the animals are gone.

verses.textZh: "我要使耶路撒冷变成乱堆， 成为野狗的巢穴； 我要使犹大的城市荒凉， 无人居住。"
verses.textZhCnvs: "我要使耶路撒冷变成乱堆， 成为野狗的巢穴； 我要使犹大的城市荒凉， 无人居住。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我必使耶路撒冷变为乱堆，为野狗的住处， 也必使犹大的城邑变为荒场，无人居住。
verses.textEnNiv: "I will make Jerusalem a heap of ruins, a haunt of jackals; and I will lay waste the towns of Judah so no one can live there."
verses.textEnEsv: I will make Jerusalem a heap of ruins, a lair of jackals, and I will make the cities of Judah a desolation, without inhabitant."
verses.textEnNkjv: "I will make Jerusalem a heap of ruins, a den of jackals. I will make the cities of Judah desolate, without an inhabitant."
verses.textEnNlt: "I will make Jerusalem into a heap of ruins," says the Lord . "It will be a place haunted by jackals. The towns of Judah will be ghost towns, with no one living in them."
verses.textEnNasb: "I will make Jerusalem a heap of ruins, A haunt of jackals; And I will make the cities of Judah a desolation without inhabitant."
verses.textEn: "I will make Jerusalem a heap of ruins, a haunt of jackals; and I will lay waste the towns of Judah so no one can live there."

verses.textZh: 谁是智慧人可以解明这事？耶和华的口向谁说过，以致他可以传讲这事？为甚么这地被毁坏，像旷野般荒凉，无人经过呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 谁是智慧人可以解明这事？耶和华的口向谁说过，以致他可以传讲这事？为甚么这地被毁坏，像旷野般荒凉，无人经过呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 谁是智慧人，可以明白这事？耶和华的口向谁说过，使他可以传说？遍地为何灭亡，干焦好像旷野，甚至无人经过呢？
verses.textEnNiv: Who is wise enough to understand this? Who has been instructed by the Lord and can explain it? Why has the land been ruined and laid waste like a desert that no one can cross?
verses.textEnEsv: Who is the man so wise that he can understand this? To whom has the mouth of the Lord spoken, that he may declare it? Why is the land ruined and laid waste like a wilderness, so that no one passes through?
verses.textEnNkjv: Who is the wise man who may understand this? And whoishe to whom the mouth of the Lord has spoken, that he may declare it? Why does the land perish and burn up like a wilderness, so that no one can pass through?
verses.textEnNlt: Who is wise enough to understand all this? Who has been instructed by the Lord and can explain it to others? Why has the land been so ruined that no one dares to travel through it?
verses.textEnNasb: Who is the wise person who may understand this? And who is he to whom the mouth of the Lord has spoken, that he may declare it? Why is the land destroyed, laid waste like the desert, so that no one passes through?
verses.textEn: Who is wise enough to understand this? Who has been instructed by the Lord and can explain it? Why has the land been ruined and laid waste like a desert that no one can cross?

verses.textZh: 耶和华说："这是因为他们离弃了我摆在他们面前的律法，不听从我的话，没有遵行我的律法；
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华说："这是因为他们离弃了我摆在他们面前的律法，不听从我的话，没有遵行我的律法；
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华说：「因为这百姓离弃我在他们面前所设立的律法，没有遵行，也没有听从我的话；
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord said, "It is because they have forsaken my law, which I set before them; they have not obeyed me or followed my law.
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord says: "Because they have forsaken my law that I set before them, and have not obeyed my voice or walked in accord with it,
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Lord said, "Because they have forsaken My law which I set before them, and have not obeyed My voice, nor walked according to it,
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord replies, "This has happened because my people have abandoned my instructions; they have refused to obey what I said.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord said, "Because they have abandoned My Law which I put before them, and have not obeyed My voice nor walked according to it,
verses.textEn: The Lord said, "It is because they have forsaken my law, which I set before them; they have not obeyed me or followed my law.

verses.textZh: 反而随从自己顽梗的心行事，照他们列祖所教训的，随从众巴力。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 反而随从自己顽梗的心行事，照他们列祖所教训的，随从众巴力。"
verses.textZhCuv: 只随从自己顽梗的心行事，照他们列祖所教训的随从众巴力。」
verses.textEnNiv: Instead, they have followed the stubbornness of their hearts; they have followed the Baals, as their ancestors taught them."
verses.textEnEsv: but have stubbornly followed their own hearts and have gone after the Baals, as their fathers taught them.
verses.textEnNkjv: but they have walked according to the dictates of their own hearts and after the Baals, which their fathers taught them,"
verses.textEnNlt: Instead, they have stubbornly followed their own desires and worshiped the images of Baal, as their ancestors taught them.
verses.textEnNasb: but have followed the stubbornness of their heart and the Baals, as their fathers taught them,"
verses.textEn: Instead, they have followed the stubbornness of their hearts; they have followed the Baals, as their ancestors taught them."

verses.textZh: 因此，万军之耶和华以色列的神这样说："看哪！我要使这人民吃苦堇，喝毒水。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，万军之耶和华以色列的神这样说："看哪！我要使这人民吃苦堇，喝毒水。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以万军之耶和华－以色列的神如此说：「看哪，我必将茵陈给这百姓吃，又将苦胆水给他们喝。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore this is what the Lord Almighty, the God of Israel, says: "See, I will make this people eat bitter food and drink poisoned water.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore thus says the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel: Behold, I will feed this people with bitter food, and give them poisonous water to drink.
verses.textEnNkjv: therefore thus says the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel: "Behold, I will feed them, this people, with wormwood, and give them water of gall to drink.
verses.textEnNlt: So now, this is what the Lord of Heaven’s Armies, the God of Israel, says: Look! I will feed them with bitterness and give them poison to drink.
verses.textEnNasb: therefore this is what the Lord of armies, the God of Israel says: "Behold, I will feed this people wormwood; and I will give them poisoned water to drink.
verses.textEn: Therefore this is what the Lord Almighty, the God of Israel, says: "See, I will make this people eat bitter food and drink poisoned water.

verses.textZh: 我要把他们分散在列国中，就是他们和他们的列祖都不认识的列国；我要使刀剑追杀他们，直到把他们灭绝。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要把他们分散在列国中，就是他们和他们的列祖都不认识的列国；我要使刀剑追杀他们，直到把他们灭绝。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我要把他们散在列邦中，就是他们和他们列祖素不认识的列邦。我也要使刀剑追杀他们，直到将他们灭尽。」
verses.textEnNiv: I will scatter them among nations that neither they nor their ancestors have known, and I will pursue them with the sword until I have made an end of them."
verses.textEnEsv: I will scatter them among the nations whom neither they nor their fathers have known, and I will send the sword after them, until I have consumed them."
verses.textEnNkjv: I will scatter them also among the Gentiles, whom neither they nor their fathers have known. And I will send a sword after them until I have consumed them."
verses.textEnNlt: I will scatter them around the world, in places they and their ancestors never heard of, and even there I will chase them with the sword until I have destroyed them completely."
verses.textEnNasb: I will also scatter them among the nations, whom neither they nor their fathers have known; and I will send the sword after them until I have put an end to them."
verses.textEn: I will scatter them among nations that neither they nor their ancestors have known, and I will pursue them with the sword until I have made an end of them."

verses.textZh: 万军之耶和华这样说： "你们要思想， 要把唱哀歌的妇女召来， 把那些擅长哀哭的妇女请来；
verses.textZhCnvs: 万军之耶和华这样说： "你们要思想， 要把唱哀歌的妇女召来， 把那些擅长哀哭的妇女请来；
verses.textZhCuv: 万军之耶和华如此说： 你们应当思想， 将善唱哀歌的妇女召来， 又打发人召善哭的妇女来，
verses.textEnNiv: This is what the Lord Almighty says: "Consider now! Call for the wailing women to come; send for the most skillful of them.
verses.textEnEsv: Thus says the Lord of hosts: "Consider, and call for the mourning women to come; send for the skillful women to come;
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus says the Lord of hosts: "Consider and call for the mourning women, That they may come; And send for skillful wailing women, That they may come.
verses.textEnNlt: This is what the Lord of Heaven’s Armies says: "Consider all this, and call for the mourners. Send for the women who mourn at funerals.
verses.textEnNasb: This is what the Lord of armies says: "Consider and call for the mourning women, that they may come; And send for the skillful women, that they may come!
verses.textEn: This is what the Lord Almighty says: "Consider now! Call for the wailing women to come; send for the most skillful of them.

verses.textZh: 叫他们赶快为我们举哀， 使我们的眼流下眼泪， 使我们的眼皮涌出泪水。
verses.textZhCnvs: 叫他们赶快为我们举哀， 使我们的眼流下眼泪， 使我们的眼皮涌出泪水。
verses.textZhCuv: 叫她们速速为我们举哀， 使我们眼泪汪汪， 使我们的眼皮涌出水来。
verses.textEnNiv: Let them come quickly and wail over us till our eyes overflow with tears and water streams from our eyelids.
verses.textEnEsv: let them make haste and raise a wailing over us, that our eyes may run down with tears and our eyelids flow with water.
verses.textEnNkjv: Let them make haste And take up a wailing for us, That our eyes may run with tears, And our eyelids gush with water.
verses.textEnNlt: Quick! Begin your weeping! Let the tears flow from your eyes.
verses.textEnNasb: "Have them hurry and take up a wailing for us, So that our eyes may shed tears, And our eyelids flow with water.
verses.textEn: Let them come quickly and wail over us till our eyes overflow with tears and water streams from our eyelids.

verses.textZh: 因为从锡安可以听到哀声，说： ‘我们何等衰败！ 我们多么羞耻！ 因我们丢弃了这地， 我们的家园被拆毁了。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为从锡安可以听到哀声，说： ‘我们何等衰败！ 我们多么羞耻！ 因我们丢弃了这地， 我们的家园被拆毁了。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 因为听见哀声出于锡安，说： 我们怎样败落了！ 我们大大地惭愧！ 我们撇下地土； 人也拆毁了我们的房屋。
verses.textEnNiv: The sound of wailing is heard from Zion: ‘How ruined we are! How great is our shame! We must leave our land because our houses are in ruins.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: For a sound of wailing is heard from Zion: ‘How we are ruined! We are utterly shamed, because we have left the land, because they have cast down our dwellings.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: For a voice of wailing is heard from Zion: ‘How we are plundered! We are greatly ashamed, Because we have forsaken the land, Because we have been cast out of our dwellings.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: Hear the people of Jerusalem crying in despair, ‘We are ruined! We are completely humiliated! We must leave our land, because our homes have been torn down.’"
verses.textEnNasb: "For a voice of wailing is heard from Zion: ‘How devastated we are! We are put to great shame, For we have abandoned the land Because they have torn down our homes.’ "
verses.textEn: The sound of wailing is heard from Zion: ‘How ruined we are! How great is our shame! We must leave our land because our houses are in ruins.’ "

verses.textZh: 妇女们哪！你们要听耶和华的话， 你们的耳朵要领受他口中的话； 要教导你们的女儿举哀， 各人要彼此学习哀歌。
verses.textZhCnvs: 妇女们哪！你们要听耶和华的话， 你们的耳朵要领受他口中的话； 要教导你们的女儿举哀， 各人要彼此学习哀歌。
verses.textZhCuv: 妇女们哪，你们当听耶和华的话， 领受他口中的言语； 又当教导你们的儿女举哀， 各人教导邻舍唱哀歌。
verses.textEnNiv: Now, you women, hear the word of the Lord ; open your ears to the words of his mouth. Teach your daughters how to wail; teach one another a lament.
verses.textEnEsv: Hear, O women, the word of the Lord , and let your ear receive the word of his mouth; teach to your daughters a lament, and each to her neighbor a dirge.
verses.textEnNkjv: Yet hear the word of the Lord, O women, And let your ear receive the word of His mouth; Teach your daughters wailing, And everyone her neighbor a lamentation.
verses.textEnNlt: Listen, you women, to the words of the Lord ; open your ears to what he has to say. Teach your daughters to wail; teach one another how to lament.
verses.textEnNasb: Now hear the word of the Lord, you women, And let your ears receive the word of His mouth; Teach your daughters wailing, And have every woman teach her neighbor a song of mourning.
verses.textEn: Now, you women, hear the word of the Lord ; open your ears to the words of his mouth. Teach your daughters how to wail; teach one another a lament.

verses.textZh: 因为死亡从窗户上来， 进入我们的堡垒； 要从街上剪除孩童， 从广场上剪除年轻人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为死亡从窗户上来， 进入我们的堡垒； 要从街上剪除孩童， 从广场上剪除年轻人。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为死亡上来， 进了我们的窗户， 入了我们的宫殿； 要从外边剪除孩童， 从街上剪除少年人。
verses.textEnNiv: Death has climbed in through our windows and has entered our fortresses; it has removed the children from the streets and the young men from the public squares.
verses.textEnEsv: For death has come up into our windows; it has entered our palaces, cutting off the children from the streets and the young men from the squares.
verses.textEnNkjv: For death has come through our windows, Has entered our palaces, To kill off the children— nolongertobe outside! And the young men— nolonger on the streets!
verses.textEnNlt: For death has crept in through our windows and has entered our mansions. It has killed off the flower of our youth: Children no longer play in the streets, and young men no longer gather in the squares.
verses.textEnNasb: For death has come up through our windows; It has entered our palaces To eliminate the children from the streets, The young men from the public squares.
verses.textEn: Death has climbed in through our windows and has entered our fortresses; it has removed the children from the streets and the young men from the public squares.

verses.textZh: 你要这样说 ： "人的尸体横卧着， 像田野上的粪肥， 又像遗留在收割者后面的麦穗， 无人拾取。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要这样说 ： "人的尸体横卧着， 像田野上的粪肥， 又像遗留在收割者后面的麦穗， 无人拾取。"
verses.textZhCuv: 你当说，耶和华如此说： 人的尸首必倒在田野像粪土， 又像收割的人遗落的一把禾稼， 无人收取。
verses.textEnNiv: Say, "This is what the Lord declares: " ‘Dead bodies will lie like dung on the open field, like cut grain behind the reaper, with no one to gather them.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: Speak: "Thus declares the Lord , ‘The dead bodies of men shall fall like dung upon the open field, like sheaves after the reaper, and none shall gather them.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: Speak, "Thus says the Lord: ‘Even the carcasses of men shall fall as refuse on the open field, Like cuttings after the harvester, And no one shall gather them.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: This is what the Lord says: "Bodies will be scattered across the fields like clumps of manure, like bundles of grain after the harvest. No one will be left to bury them."
verses.textEnNasb: Speak, "This is what the Lord says: ‘The corpses of people will fall like dung on the open field, And like the sheaf after the reaper, But no one will gather them.’ "
verses.textEn: Say, "This is what the Lord declares: " ‘Dead bodies will lie like dung on the open field, like cut grain behind the reaper, with no one to gather them.’ "

verses.textZh: 耶和华这样说："智慧人不可夸耀自己的智慧，勇士不可夸耀自己的勇力，财主不可夸耀自己的财富。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华这样说："智慧人不可夸耀自己的智慧，勇士不可夸耀自己的勇力，财主不可夸耀自己的财富。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华如此说：「智慧人不要因他的智慧夸口，勇士不要因他的勇力夸口，财主不要因他的财物夸口。
verses.textEnNiv: This is what the Lord says: "Let not the wise boast of their wisdom or the strong boast of their strength or the rich boast of their riches,
verses.textEnEsv: Thus says the Lord : "Let not the wise man boast in his wisdom, let not the mighty man boast in his might, let not the rich man boast in his riches,
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus says the Lord: "Let not the wise man glory in his wisdom, Let not the mighty man glory in his might, Nor let the rich man glory in his riches;
verses.textEnNlt: This is what the Lord says: "Don’t let the wise boast in their wisdom, or the powerful boast in their power, or the rich boast in their riches.
verses.textEnNasb: This is what the Lord says: "Let no wise man boast of his wisdom, nor let the mighty man boast of his might, nor a rich man boast of his riches;
verses.textEn: This is what the Lord says: "Let not the wise boast of their wisdom or the strong boast of their strength or the rich boast of their riches,

verses.textZh: 夸口的却要因了解我，认识我而夸口；认识我是耶和华，我在地上施行慈爱、公正、公义；因为我喜悦这些事。"这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 夸口的却要因了解我，认识我而夸口；认识我是耶和华，我在地上施行慈爱、公正、公义；因为我喜悦这些事。"这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 夸口的却因他有聪明，认识我是耶和华，又知道我喜悦在世上施行慈爱、公平，和公义，以此夸口。这是耶和华说的。」
verses.textEnNiv: but let the one who boasts boast about this: that they have the understanding to know me, that I am the Lord , who exercises kindness, justice and righteousness on earth, for in these I delight," declares the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: but let him who boasts boast in this, that he understands and knows me, that I am the Lord who practices steadfast love, justice, and righteousness in the earth. For in these things I delight, declares the Lord ."
verses.textEnNkjv: But let him who glories glory in this, That he understands and knows Me, That I am the Lord, exercising lovingkindness, judgment, and righteousness in the earth. For in these I delight," says the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: But those who wish to boast should boast in this alone: that they truly know me and understand that I am the Lord who demonstrates unfailing love and who brings justice and righteousness to the earth, and that I delight in these things. I, the Lord , have spoken!
verses.textEnNasb: but let the one who boasts boast of this, that he understands and knows Me, that I am the Lord who exercises mercy, justice, and righteousness on the earth; for I delight in these things," declares the Lord.
verses.textEn: but let the one who boasts boast about this: that they have the understanding to know me, that I am the Lord , who exercises kindness, justice and righteousness on earth, for in these I delight," declares the Lord .

verses.textZh: "看哪！日子快到 ，我必惩罚所有只在身体受过割礼，内心却未受割礼的人，
verses.textZhCnvs: "看哪！日子快到 ，我必惩罚所有只在身体受过割礼，内心却未受割礼的人，
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华说：「看哪，日子将到，我要刑罚一切受过割礼、心却未受割礼的，
verses.textEnNiv: "The days are coming," declares the Lord , "when I will punish all who are circumcised only in the flesh—
verses.textEnEsv: "Behold, the days are coming, declares the Lord , when I will punish all those who are circumcised merely in the flesh—
verses.textEnNkjv: "Behold, the days are coming," says the Lord, "that I will punish all whoare circumcised with the uncircumcised—
verses.textEnNlt: "A time is coming," says the Lord , "when I will punish all those who are circumcised in body but not in spirit—
verses.textEnNasb: "Behold, the days are coming," declares the Lord, "that I will punish all who are circumcised and yet uncircumcised—
verses.textEn: "The days are coming," declares the Lord , "when I will punish all who are circumcised only in the flesh—

verses.textZh: 就是埃及、犹大、以东、亚扪、摩押和所有剃除鬓发，住在旷野的人；因为列国的人都没有受过割礼，甚至以色列全家的内心也没有受过割礼。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 就是埃及、犹大、以东、亚扪、摩押和所有剃除鬓发，住在旷野的人；因为列国的人都没有受过割礼，甚至以色列全家的内心也没有受过割礼。"
verses.textZhCuv: 就是埃及、犹大、以东、亚扪人、摩押人，和一切住在旷野剃周围头发的；因为列国人都没有受割礼，以色列人心中也没有受割礼。」
verses.textEnNiv: Egypt, Judah, Edom, Ammon, Moab and all who live in the wilderness in distant places. For all these nations are really uncircumcised, and even the whole house of Israel is uncircumcised in heart."
verses.textEnEsv: Egypt, Judah, Edom, the sons of Ammon, Moab, and all who dwell in the desert who cut the corners of their hair, for all these nations are uncircumcised, and all the house of Israel are uncircumcised in heart."
verses.textEnNkjv: Egypt, Judah, Edom, the people of Ammon, Moab, and all whoare in the farthest corners, who dwell in the wilderness. For all these nations are uncircumcised, and all the house of Israel are uncircumcised in the heart."
verses.textEnNlt: the Egyptians, Edomites, Ammonites, Moabites, the people who live in the desert in remote places, and yes, even the people of Judah. And like all these pagan nations, the people of Israel also have uncircumcised hearts."
verses.textEnNasb: Egypt, Judah, Edom, the sons of Ammon, Moab, and all those inhabiting the desert who trim the hair on their temples; for all the nations are uncircumcised, and all the house of Israel are uncircumcised of heart."
verses.textEn: Egypt, Judah, Edom, Ammon, Moab and all who live in the wilderness in distant places. For all these nations are really uncircumcised, and even the whole house of Israel is uncircumcised in heart."

verses.textZh: 以色列家啊！你们要听耶和华对你们所说的话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列家啊！你们要听耶和华对你们所说的话。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列家啊，要听耶和华对你们所说的话。
verses.textEnNiv: Hear what the Lord says to you, people of Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: Hear the word that the Lord speaks to you, O house of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: Hear the word which the Lord speaks to you, O house of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: Hear the word that the Lord speaks to you, O Israel!
verses.textEnNasb: Hear the word which the Lord speaks to you, house of Israel.
verses.textEn: Hear what the Lord says to you, people of Israel.

verses.textZh: 耶和华这样说： "你们不要学习列国的行径， 列国因天象惊惶， 你们却不要因这些惊惶。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华这样说： "你们不要学习列国的行径， 列国因天象惊惶， 你们却不要因这些惊惶。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华如此说： 你们不要效法列国的行为， 也不要为天象惊惶， 因列国为此事惊惶。
verses.textEnNiv: This is what the Lord says: "Do not learn the ways of the nations or be terrified by signs in the heavens, though the nations are terrified by them.
verses.textEnEsv: Thus says the Lord : "Learn not the way of the nations, nor be dismayed at the signs of the heavens because the nations are dismayed at them,
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus says the Lord: "Do not learn the way of the Gentiles; Do not be dismayed at the signs of heaven, For the Gentiles are dismayed at them.
verses.textEnNlt: This is what the Lord says: "Do not act like the other nations, who try to read their future in the stars. Do not be afraid of their predictions, even though other nations are terrified by them.
verses.textEnNasb: This is what the Lord says: "Do not learn the way of the nations, And do not be terrified by the signs of the heavens, Although the nations are terrified by them;
verses.textEn: This is what the Lord says: "Do not learn the ways of the nations or be terrified by signs in the heavens, though the nations are terrified by them.

verses.textZh: 因为万民所信奉的都是虚空， 只是从林中砍下的树木， 是匠人用凿刀制成的产品。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为万民所信奉的都是虚空， 只是从林中砍下的树木， 是匠人用凿刀制成的产品。
verses.textZhCuv: 众民的风俗是虚空的； 他们在树林中用斧子砍伐一棵树， 匠人用手工造成偶像。
verses.textEnNiv: For the practices of the peoples are worthless; they cut a tree out of the forest, and a craftsman shapes it with his chisel.
verses.textEnEsv: for the customs of the peoples are vanity. A tree from the forest is cut down and worked with an axe by the hands of a craftsman.
verses.textEnNkjv: For the customs of the peoples are futile; For one cuts a tree from the forest, The work of the hands of the workman, with the ax.
verses.textEnNlt: Their ways are futile and foolish. They cut down a tree, and a craftsman carves an idol.
verses.textEnNasb: For the customs of the peoples are futile; For it is wood cut from the forest, The work of the hands of a craftsman with a cutting tool.
verses.textEn: For the practices of the peoples are worthless; they cut a tree out of the forest, and a craftsman shapes it with his chisel.

verses.textZh: 他们用金银把它修饰， 用钉子和锤子把它钉牢， 使它不动摇。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们用金银把它修饰， 用钉子和锤子把它钉牢， 使它不动摇。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们用金银妆饰它， 用钉子和锤子钉稳， 使它不动摇。
verses.textEnNiv: They adorn it with silver and gold; they fasten it with hammer and nails so it will not totter.
verses.textEnEsv: They decorate it with silver and gold; they fasten it with hammer and nails so that it cannot move.
verses.textEnNkjv: They decorate it with silver and gold; They fasten it with nails and hammers So that it will not topple.
verses.textEnNlt: They decorate it with gold and silver and then fasten it securely with hammer and nails so it won’t fall over.
verses.textEnNasb: "They decorate the idol with silver and gold; They fasten it with nails and hammers So that it will not totter.
verses.textEn: They adorn it with silver and gold; they fasten it with hammer and nails so it will not totter.

verses.textZh: 它们像瓜田里的稻草人， 不能说话； 它们必须要人抬着走， 因为它们不能走路。 你们不要害怕它们， 因它们不能降祸， 也不能降福。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 它们像瓜田里的稻草人， 不能说话； 它们必须要人抬着走， 因为它们不能走路。 你们不要害怕它们， 因它们不能降祸， 也不能降福。"
verses.textZhCuv: 它好像棕树，是旋成的， 不能说话，不能行走， 必须有人抬着。 你们不要怕它； 它不能降祸， 也无力降福。
verses.textEnNiv: Like a scarecrow in a cucumber field, their idols cannot speak; they must be carried because they cannot walk. Do not fear them; they can do no harm nor can they do any good."
verses.textEnEsv: Their idols are like scarecrows in a cucumber field, and they cannot speak; they have to be carried, for they cannot walk. Do not be afraid of them, for they cannot do evil, neither is it in them to do good."
verses.textEnNkjv: They are upright, like a palm tree, And they cannot speak; They must be carried, Because they cannot go bythemselves. Do not be afraid of them, For they cannot do evil, Nor can they do any good."
verses.textEnNlt: Their gods are like helpless scarecrows in a cucumber field! They cannot speak, and they need to be carried because they cannot walk. Do not be afraid of such gods, for they can neither harm you nor do you any good."
verses.textEnNasb: "They are like a scarecrow in a cucumber field, And they cannot speak; They must be carried, Because they cannot walk! Do not fear them, For they can do no harm, Nor can they do any good."
verses.textEn: Like a scarecrow in a cucumber field, their idols cannot speak; they must be carried because they cannot walk. Do not fear them; they can do no harm nor can they do any good."

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊！没有可以跟你相比的； 你是伟大的，你的名大有能力。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊！没有可以跟你相比的； 你是伟大的，你的名大有能力。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，没有能比你的！ 你本为大，有大能大力的名。
verses.textEnNiv: No one is like you, Lord ; you are great, and your name is mighty in power.
verses.textEnEsv: There is none like you, O Lord ; you are great, and your name is great in might.
verses.textEnNkjv: Inasmuch as thereis none like You, O Lord (You are great, and Your name is great in might),
verses.textEnNlt: Lord , there is no one like you! For you are great, and your name is full of power.
verses.textEnNasb: There is none like You, Lord; You are great, and Your name is great in might.
verses.textEn: No one is like you, Lord ; you are great, and your name is mighty in power.

verses.textZh: 万国的王啊！谁敢不敬畏你呢？ 这是你应得的。 因为在列国所有的智慧人中， 以及在他们的全国里， 没有可以跟你相比的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 万国的王啊！谁敢不敬畏你呢？ 这是你应得的。 因为在列国所有的智慧人中， 以及在他们的全国里， 没有可以跟你相比的。
verses.textZhCuv: 万国的王啊，谁不敬畏你？ 敬畏你本是合宜的； 因为在列国的智慧人中， 虽有政权的尊荣， 也不能比你。
verses.textEnNiv: Who should not fear you, King of the nations? This is your due. Among all the wise leaders of the nations and in all their kingdoms, there is no one like you.
verses.textEnEsv: Who would not fear you, O King of the nations? For this is your due; for among all the wise ones of the nations and in all their kingdoms there is none like you.
verses.textEnNkjv: Who would not fear You, O King of the nations? For this is Your rightful due. For among all the wise men of the nations, And in all their kingdoms, Thereis none like You.
verses.textEnNlt: Who would not fear you, O King of nations? That title belongs to you alone! Among all the wise people of the earth and in all the kingdoms of the world, there is no one like you.
verses.textEnNasb: Who would not fear You, O King of the nations? For it is Your due! For among all the wise men of the nations And in all their kingdoms, There is none like You.
verses.textEn: Who should not fear you, King of the nations? This is your due. Among all the wise leaders of the nations and in all their kingdoms, there is no one like you.

verses.textZh: 他们全是顽梗愚昧， 他们所领受的教导是来自那些虚无、 木做的偶像。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们全是顽梗愚昧， 他们所领受的教导是来自那些虚无、 木做的偶像。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们尽都是畜类，是愚昧的。 偶像的训诲算什么呢？ 偶像不过是木头。
verses.textEnNiv: They are all senseless and foolish; they are taught by worthless wooden idols.
verses.textEnEsv: They are both stupid and foolish; the instruction of idols is but wood!
verses.textEnNkjv: But they are altogether dull-hearted and foolish; A wooden idol is a worthless doctrine.
verses.textEnNlt: People who worship idols are stupid and foolish. The things they worship are made of wood!
verses.textEnNasb: But they are altogether stupid and foolish; The instruction from idols is nothing but wood!
verses.textEn: They are all senseless and foolish; they are taught by worthless wooden idols.

verses.textZh: 那些偶像镶有经过锤炼的银片， 银子是从他施运来的， 也有从乌法运来的金子， 都是匠人和金匠手作的产品。 它们穿著蓝色和紫色的衣服， 全都是巧匠的作品。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那些偶像镶有经过锤炼的银片， 银子是从他施运来的， 也有从乌法运来的金子， 都是匠人和金匠手作的产品。 它们穿著蓝色和紫色的衣服， 全都是巧匠的作品。
verses.textZhCuv: 有银子打成片，是从他施带来的， 并有从乌法来的金子， 都是匠人和银匠的手工， 又有蓝色紫色料的衣服， 都是巧匠的工作。
verses.textEnNiv: Hammered silver is brought from Tarshish and gold from Uphaz. What the craftsman and goldsmith have made is then dressed in blue and purple— all made by skilled workers.
verses.textEnEsv: Beaten silver is brought from Tarshish, and gold from Uphaz. They are the work of the craftsman and of the hands of the goldsmith; their clothing is violet and purple; they are all the work of skilled men.
verses.textEnNkjv: Silver is beaten into plates; It is brought from Tarshish, And gold from Uphaz, The work of the craftsman And of the hands of the metalsmith; Blue and purple are their clothing; They are all the work of skillful men.
verses.textEnNlt: They bring beaten sheets of silver from Tarshish and gold from Uphaz, and they give these materials to skillful craftsmen who make their idols. Then they dress these gods in royal blue and purple robes made by expert tailors.
verses.textEnNasb: Beaten silver is brought from Tarshish, And gold from Uphaz, The work of a craftsman and of the hands of a goldsmith; Their clothing is of violet and purple; They are all the work of skilled people.
verses.textEn: Hammered silver is brought from Tarshish and gold from Uphaz. What the craftsman and goldsmith have made is then dressed in blue and purple— all made by skilled workers.

verses.textZh: 只有耶和华是真神； 他是永活的神，是永远的君王。 他一发怒，大地就震动， 万国都不能承受他的忿怒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 只有耶和华是真神； 他是永活的神，是永远的君王。 他一发怒，大地就震动， 万国都不能承受他的忿怒。
verses.textZhCuv: 惟耶和华是真神， 是活神，是永远的王。 他一发怒，大地震动； 他一恼恨，列国都担当不起。 （
verses.textEnNiv: But the Lord is the true God; he is the living God, the eternal King. When he is angry, the earth trembles; the nations cannot endure his wrath.
verses.textEnEsv: But the Lord is the true God; he is the living God and the everlasting King. At his wrath the earth quakes, and the nations cannot endure his indignation.
verses.textEnNkjv: But the Lordis the true God; He is the living God and the everlasting King. At His wrath the earth will tremble, And the nations will not be able to endure His indignation.
verses.textEnNlt: But the Lord is the only true God. He is the living God and the everlasting King! The whole earth trembles at his anger. The nations cannot stand up to his wrath.
verses.textEnNasb: But the Lord is the true God; He is the living God and the everlasting King. The earth quakes at His wrath, And the nations cannot endure His indignation.
verses.textEn: But the Lord is the true God; he is the living God, the eternal King. When he is angry, the earth trembles; the nations cannot endure his wrath.

verses.textZh: 你们要对他们这样说："那些没有创造天地的神，必从地上、从天下消灭。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要对他们这样说："那些没有创造天地的神，必从地上、从天下消灭。"
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要对他们如此说：不是那创造天地的神，必从地上从天下被除灭！）
verses.textEnNiv: "Tell them this: ‘These gods, who did not make the heavens and the earth, will perish from the earth and from under the heavens.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: Thus shall you say to them: "The gods who did not make the heavens and the earth shall perish from the earth and from under the heavens."
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus you shall say to them: "The gods that have not made the heavens and the earth shall perish from the earth and from under these heavens."
verses.textEnNlt: Say this to those who worship other gods: "Your so-called gods, who did not make the heavens and earth, will vanish from the earth and from under the heavens."
verses.textEnNasb: This is what you shall say to them: "The gods that did not make the heavens and the earth will perish from the earth and from under these heavens."
verses.textEn: "Tell them this: ‘These gods, who did not make the heavens and the earth, will perish from the earth and from under the heavens.’ "

verses.textZh: 耶和华用自己的能力创造了大地， 用自己的智慧坚立了世界， 又用自己的聪明展开了诸天。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华用自己的能力创造了大地， 用自己的智慧坚立了世界， 又用自己的聪明展开了诸天。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华用能力创造大地， 用智慧建立世界， 用聪明铺张穹苍。
verses.textEnNiv: But God made the earth by his power; he founded the world by his wisdom and stretched out the heavens by his understanding.
verses.textEnEsv: It is he who made the earth by his power, who established the world by his wisdom, and by his understanding stretched out the heavens.
verses.textEnNkjv: He has made the earth by His power, He has established the world by His wisdom, And has stretched out the heavens at His discretion.
verses.textEnNlt: But the Lord made the earth by his power, and he preserves it by his wisdom. With his own understanding he stretched out the heavens.
verses.textEnNasb: It is He who made the earth by His power, Who established the world by His wisdom; And by His understanding He has stretched out the heavens.
verses.textEn: But God made the earth by his power; he founded the world by his wisdom and stretched out the heavens by his understanding.

verses.textZh: 他一发声，空中众水就澎湃； 他使云雾从地极上腾； 他造了闪电和雷雨， 又使风从他的仓库里吹出来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他一发声，空中众水就澎湃； 他使云雾从地极上腾； 他造了闪电和雷雨， 又使风从他的仓库里吹出来。
verses.textZhCuv: 他一发声，空中便有多水激动； 他使云雾从地极上腾； 他造电随雨而闪， 从他府库中带出风来。
verses.textEnNiv: When he thunders, the waters in the heavens roar; he makes clouds rise from the ends of the earth. He sends lightning with the rain and brings out the wind from his storehouses.
verses.textEnEsv: When he utters his voice, there is a tumult of waters in the heavens, and he makes the mist rise from the ends of the earth. He makes lightning for the rain, and he brings forth the wind from his storehouses.
verses.textEnNkjv: When He utters His voice, Thereis a multitude of waters in the heavens: "And He causes the vapors to ascend from the ends of the earth. He makes lightning for the rain, He brings the wind out of His treasuries."
verses.textEnNlt: When he speaks in the thunder, the heavens roar with rain. He causes the clouds to rise over the earth. He sends the lightning with the rain and releases the wind from his storehouses.
verses.textEnNasb: When He utters His voice, there is a roar of waters in the heavens, And He makes the clouds ascend from the end of the earth; He makes lightning for the rain, And brings out the wind from His storehouses.
verses.textEn: When he thunders, the waters in the heavens roar; he makes clouds rise from the ends of the earth. He sends lightning with the rain and brings out the wind from his storehouses.

verses.textZh: 人人都是顽梗无知； 所有的金匠都因偶像羞愧， 因为他们铸造的像都是虚假、没有气息的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 人人都是顽梗无知； 所有的金匠都因偶像羞愧， 因为他们铸造的像都是虚假、没有气息的。
verses.textZhCuv: 各人都成了畜类，毫无知识； 各银匠都因他雕刻的偶像羞愧。 他所铸的偶像本是虚假的， 其中并无气息，
verses.textEnNiv: Everyone is senseless and without knowledge; every goldsmith is shamed by his idols. The images he makes are a fraud; they have no breath in them.
verses.textEnEsv: Every man is stupid and without knowledge; every goldsmith is put to shame by his idols, for his images are false, and there is no breath in them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Everyone is dull-hearted, without knowledge; Every metalsmith is put to shame by an image; For his molded image is falsehood, And thereis no breath in them.
verses.textEnNlt: The whole human race is foolish and has no knowledge! The craftsmen are disgraced by the idols they make, for their carefully shaped works are a fraud. These idols have no breath or power.
verses.textEnNasb: Every person is stupid, devoid of knowledge; Every goldsmith is put to shame by his idols, For his cast metal images are deceitful, And there is no breath in them.
verses.textEn: Everyone is senseless and without knowledge; every goldsmith is shamed by his idols. The images he makes are a fraud; they have no breath in them.

verses.textZh: 偶像都是虚无的，是荒谬可笑的作品； 到了讨罪的时候，它们必被除灭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 偶像都是虚无的，是荒谬可笑的作品； 到了讨罪的时候，它们必被除灭。
verses.textZhCuv: 都是虚无的， 是迷惑人的工作； 到追讨的时候必被除灭。
verses.textEnNiv: They are worthless, the objects of mockery; when their judgment comes, they will perish.
verses.textEnEsv: They are worthless, a work of delusion; at the time of their punishment they shall perish.
verses.textEnNkjv: They are futile, a work of errors; In the time of their punishment they shall perish.
verses.textEnNlt: Idols are worthless; they are ridiculous lies! On the day of reckoning they will all be destroyed.
verses.textEnNasb: They are worthless, a work of mockery; At the time of their punishment they will perish.
verses.textEn: They are worthless, the objects of mockery; when their judgment comes, they will perish.

verses.textZh: 那作雅各产业的并不像这些偶像， 因为他是万物的创造者； 以色列是属他的民族， 万军之耶和华是他的名。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那作雅各产业的并不像这些偶像， 因为他是万物的创造者； 以色列是属他的民族， 万军之耶和华是他的名。
verses.textZhCuv: 雅各的分不像这些， 因他是造作万有的主。 以色列也是他产业的支派， 万军之耶和华是他的名。
verses.textEnNiv: He who is the Portion of Jacob is not like these, for he is the Maker of all things, including Israel, the people of his inheritance— the Lord Almighty is his name.
verses.textEnEsv: Not like these is he who is the portion of Jacob, for he is the one who formed all things, and Israel is the tribe of his inheritance; the Lord of hosts is his name.
verses.textEnNkjv: The Portion of Jacob is not like them, For He is the Maker of all things, And Israel is the tribe of His inheritance; The Lord of hosts is His name.
verses.textEnNlt: But the God of Israel is no idol! He is the Creator of everything that exists, including Israel, his own special possession. The Lord of Heaven’s Armies is his name!
verses.textEnNasb: The Portion of Jacob is not like these; For He is the Maker of everything, And Israel is the tribe of His inheritance; The Lord of armies is His name.
verses.textEn: He who is the Portion of Jacob is not like these, for he is the Maker of all things, including Israel, the people of his inheritance— the Lord Almighty is his name.

verses.textZh: 住在被围困的城中的人哪！ 你们从地上拾起自己的行囊。
verses.textZhCnvs: 住在被围困的城中的人哪！ 你们从地上拾起自己的行囊。
verses.textZhCuv: 受围困的人哪，当收拾你的财物， 从国中带出去。
verses.textEnNiv: Gather up your belongings to leave the land, you who live under siege.
verses.textEnEsv: Gather up your bundle from the ground, O you who dwell under siege!
verses.textEnNkjv: Gather up your wares from the land, O inhabitant of the fortress!
verses.textEnNlt: Pack your bags and prepare to leave; the siege is about to begin.
verses.textEnNasb: Pick up your bundle from the ground, You who live under siege!
verses.textEn: Gather up your belongings to leave the land, you who live under siege.

verses.textZh: 因为耶和华这样说： "看哪！在这时候， 我要把这地的居民投掷出去； 又使他们受困苦， 以致他们被压倒。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为耶和华这样说： "看哪！在这时候， 我要把这地的居民投掷出去； 又使他们受困苦， 以致他们被压倒。"
verses.textZhCuv: 因为耶和华如此说： 这时候，我必将此地的居民， 好像用机弦甩出去， 又必加害在他们身上， 使他们觉悟。
verses.textEnNiv: For this is what the Lord says: "At this time I will hurl out those who live in this land; I will bring distress on them so that they may be captured."
verses.textEnEsv: For thus says the Lord : "Behold, I am slinging out the inhabitants of the land at this time, and I will bring distress on them, that they may feel it."
verses.textEnNkjv: For thus says the Lord: "Behold, I will throw out at this time The inhabitants of the land, And will distress them, That they may find itso."
verses.textEnNlt: For this is what the Lord says: "Suddenly, I will fling out all you who live in this land. I will pour great troubles upon you, and at last you will feel my anger."
verses.textEnNasb: For this is what the Lord says: "Behold, I am slinging out the inhabitants of the land At this time, And I will cause them distress, So that they may be found."
verses.textEn: For this is what the Lord says: "At this time I will hurl out those who live in this land; I will bring distress on them so that they may be captured."

verses.textZh: 因我的损伤，我有祸了！ 我的创伤不能医治； 但我说："这是我的痛苦， 我必须忍受。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 因我的损伤，我有祸了！ 我的创伤不能医治； 但我说："这是我的痛苦， 我必须忍受。"
verses.textZhCuv: 民说：祸哉！我受损伤； 我的伤痕极其重大。 我却说：这真是我的痛苦， 必须忍受。
