verses.textEnNiv: Woe to me because of my injury! My wound is incurable! Yet I said to myself, "This is my sickness, and I must endure it."
verses.textEnEsv: Woe is me because of my hurt! My wound is grievous. But I said, "Truly this is an affliction, and I must bear it."
verses.textEnNkjv: Woe is me for my hurt! My wound is severe. But I say, "Truly this is an infirmity, And I must bear it."
verses.textEnNlt: My wound is severe, and my grief is great. My sickness is incurable, but I must bear it.
verses.textEnNasb: Woe to me, because of my injury! My wound is incurable. But I said, "This certainly is a sickness, And I must endure it."
verses.textEn: Woe to me because of my injury! My wound is incurable! Yet I said to myself, "This is my sickness, and I must endure it."

verses.textZh: 我的帐棚毁坏， 我的绳索都折断了； 我的儿女都离我而去，不在这里了； 再没有人支搭我的帐棚， 挂起我的幔子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的帐棚毁坏， 我的绳索都折断了； 我的儿女都离我而去，不在这里了； 再没有人支搭我的帐棚， 挂起我的幔子。
verses.textZhCuv: 我的帐棚毁坏； 我的绳索折断。 我的儿女离我出去，没有了。 无人再支搭我的帐棚，挂起我的幔子。
verses.textEnNiv: My tent is destroyed; all its ropes are snapped. My children are gone from me and are no more; no one is left now to pitch my tent or to set up my shelter.
verses.textEnEsv: My tent is destroyed, and all my cords are broken; my children have gone from me, and they are not; there is no one to spread my tent again and to set up my curtains.
verses.textEnNkjv: My tent is plundered, And all my cords are broken; My children have gone from me, And they are no more. Thereis no one to pitch my tent anymore, Or set up my curtains.
verses.textEnNlt: My home is gone, and no one is left to help me rebuild it. My children have been taken away, and I will never see them again.
verses.textEnNasb: My tent is destroyed, And all my ropes are broken. My sons have gone from me and are no more. There is no one to stretch out my tent again Or to set up my curtains.
verses.textEn: My tent is destroyed; all its ropes are snapped. My children are gone from me and are no more; no one is left now to pitch my tent or to set up my shelter.

verses.textZh: 牧人都是顽梗的， 他们不求问耶和华； 因此，他们不得亨通， 他们所有的羊群都四散。
verses.textZhCnvs: 牧人都是顽梗的， 他们不求问耶和华； 因此，他们不得亨通， 他们所有的羊群都四散。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为牧人都成为畜类， 没有求问耶和华， 所以不得顺利； 他们的羊群也都分散。
verses.textEnNiv: The shepherds are senseless and do not inquire of the Lord ; so they do not prosper and all their flock is scattered.
verses.textEnEsv: For the shepherds are stupid and do not inquire of the Lord ; therefore they have not prospered, and all their flock is scattered.
verses.textEnNkjv: For the shepherds have become dull-hearted, And have not sought the Lord; Therefore they shall not prosper, And all their flocks shall be scattered.
verses.textEnNlt: The shepherds of my people have lost their senses. They no longer seek wisdom from the Lord . Therefore, they fail completely, and their flocks are scattered.
verses.textEnNasb: For the shepherds have become stupid And have not sought the Lord. Therefore they have not prospered, And all their flock is scattered.
verses.textEn: The shepherds are senseless and do not inquire of the Lord ; so they do not prosper and all their flock is scattered.

verses.textZh: 听哪！有风声传来， 有大骚动从北方之地而来， 要使犹大的城市荒凉， 成为野狗的巢穴。
verses.textZhCnvs: 听哪！有风声传来， 有大骚动从北方之地而来， 要使犹大的城市荒凉， 成为野狗的巢穴。
verses.textZhCuv: 有风声！看哪，敌人来了！ 有大扰乱从北方出来， 要使犹大城邑变为荒凉， 成为野狗的住处。
verses.textEnNiv: Listen! The report is coming— a great commotion from the land of the north! It will make the towns of Judah desolate, a haunt of jackals.
verses.textEnEsv: A voice, a rumor! Behold, it comes!— a great commotion out of the north country to make the cities of Judah a desolation, a lair of jackals.
verses.textEnNkjv: Behold, the noise of the report has come, And a great commotion out of the north country, To make the cities of Judah desolate, a den of jackals.
verses.textEnNlt: Listen! Hear the terrifying roar of great armies as they roll down from the north. The towns of Judah will be destroyed and become a haunt for jackals.
verses.textEnNasb: The sound of a report! Behold, it is coming— A great roar from the land of the north— To make the cities of Judah A desolation, a haunt of jackals.
verses.textEn: Listen! The report is coming— a great commotion from the land of the north! It will make the towns of Judah desolate, a haunt of jackals.

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊！我知道 人的道路是不由自己的； 人行走时，也不能确定自己的脚步。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊！我知道 人的道路是不由自己的； 人行走时，也不能确定自己的脚步。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，我晓得人的道路不由自己， 行路的人也不能定自己的脚步。
verses.textEnNiv: Lord , I know that people’s lives are not their own; it is not for them to direct their steps.
verses.textEnEsv: I know, O Lord , that the way of man is not in himself, that it is not in man who walks to direct his steps.
verses.textEnNkjv: O Lord, I know the way of man is not in himself; Itis not in man who walks to direct his own steps.
verses.textEnNlt: I know, Lord , that our lives are not our own. We are not able to plan our own course.
verses.textEnNasb: I know, Lord, that a person’s way is not in himself, Nor is it in a person who walks to direct his steps.
verses.textEn: Lord , I know that people’s lives are not their own; it is not for them to direct their steps.

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊！求你只按着公正惩治我， 不要按着你的忿怒施行惩治，免得你使我衰微。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊！求你只按着公正惩治我， 不要按着你的忿怒施行惩治，免得你使我衰微。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，求你从宽惩治我， 不要在你的怒中惩治我， 恐怕使我归于无有。
verses.textEnNiv: Discipline me, Lord , but only in due measure— not in your anger, or you will reduce me to nothing.
verses.textEnEsv: Correct me, O Lord , but in justice; not in your anger, lest you bring me to nothing.
verses.textEnNkjv: O Lord, correct me, but with justice; Not in Your anger, lest You bring me to nothing.
verses.textEnNlt: So correct me, Lord , but please be gentle. Do not correct me in anger, for I would die.
verses.textEnNasb: Correct me, Lord, but with justice; Not with Your anger, or You will bring me to nothing.
verses.textEn: Discipline me, Lord , but only in due measure— not in your anger, or you will reduce me to nothing.

verses.textZh: 愿你把你的烈怒倾倒在不认识你的列国， 和不求告你名的万族身上； 因为他们吞吃了雅各， 他们吞吃了他，把他消灭， 使他的住处荒凉。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿你把你的烈怒倾倒在不认识你的列国， 和不求告你名的万族身上； 因为他们吞吃了雅各， 他们吞吃了他，把他消灭， 使他的住处荒凉。
verses.textZhCuv: 愿你将忿怒倾在不认识你的列国中， 和不求告你名的各族上； 因为他们吞了雅各，不但吞了，而且灭绝， 把他的住处变为荒场。
verses.textEnNiv: Pour out your wrath on the nations that do not acknowledge you, on the peoples who do not call on your name. For they have devoured Jacob; they have devoured him completely and destroyed his homeland.
verses.textEnEsv: Pour out your wrath on the nations that know you not, and on the peoples that call not on your name, for they have devoured Jacob; they have devoured him and consumed him, and have laid waste his habitation.
verses.textEnNkjv: Pour out Your fury on the Gentiles, who do not know You, And on the families who do not call on Your name; For they have eaten up Jacob, Devoured him and consumed him, And made his dwelling place desolate.
verses.textEnNlt: Pour out your wrath on the nations that refuse to acknowledge you— on the peoples that do not call upon your name. For they have devoured your people Israel ; they have devoured and consumed them, making the land a desolate wilderness.
verses.textEnNasb: Pour out Your wrath on the nations that do not know You, And on the families who do not call upon Your name; For they have devoured Jacob; They have devoured him and consumed him, And have laid waste his settlement.
verses.textEn: Pour out your wrath on the nations that do not acknowledge you, on the peoples who do not call on your name. For they have devoured Jacob; they have devoured him completely and destroyed his homeland.

verses.textZh: 耶和华有话临到耶利米，说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华有话临到耶利米，说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的话临到耶利米说：
verses.textEnNiv: This is the word that came to Jeremiah from the Lord :
verses.textEnEsv: The word that came to Jeremiah from the Lord :
verses.textEnNkjv: The word that came to Jeremiah from the Lord, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord gave another message to Jeremiah. He said,
verses.textEnNasb: The word that came to Jeremiah from the Lord, saying,
verses.textEn: This is the word that came to Jeremiah from the Lord :

verses.textZh: "你要告诉犹大人和耶路撒冷的居民：‘你们要听从这约的话。’
verses.textZhCnvs: "你要告诉犹大人和耶路撒冷的居民：‘你们要听从这约的话。’
verses.textZhCuv: 「当听这约的话，告诉犹大人和耶路撒冷的居民，
verses.textEnNiv: "Listen to the terms of this covenant and tell them to the people of Judah and to those who live in Jerusalem.
verses.textEnEsv: "Hear the words of this covenant, and speak to the men of Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Hear the words of this covenant, and speak to the men of Judah and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem;
verses.textEnNlt: "Remind the people of Judah and Jerusalem about the terms of my covenant with them.
verses.textEnNasb: "Hear the words of this covenant, and speak to the men of Judah and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem;
verses.textEn: "Listen to the terms of this covenant and tell them to the people of Judah and to those who live in Jerusalem.

verses.textZh: 你要对他们说：‘耶和华以色列的神这样说：不听从这约的话的，必受咒诅。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要对他们说：‘耶和华以色列的神这样说：不听从这约的话的，必受咒诅。
verses.textZhCuv: 对他们说，耶和华－以色列的神如此说：不听从这约之话的人必受咒诅。
verses.textEnNiv: Tell them that this is what the Lord , the God of Israel, says: ‘Cursed is the one who does not obey the terms of this covenant—
verses.textEnEsv: You shall say to them, Thus says the Lord , the God of Israel: Cursed be the man who does not hear the words of this covenant
verses.textEnNkjv: and say to them, ‘Thus says the Lord God of Israel: "Cursed is the man who does not obey the words of this covenant
verses.textEnNlt: Say to them, ‘This is what the Lord , the God of Israel, says: Cursed is anyone who does not obey the terms of my covenant!
verses.textEnNasb: and say to them, ‘This is what the Lord, the God of Israel says: "Cursed is the one who does not obey the words of this covenant
verses.textEn: Tell them that this is what the Lord , the God of Israel, says: ‘Cursed is the one who does not obey the terms of this covenant—

verses.textZh: 这约就是我把你们的列祖从埃及地、从铁炉那里领出来的那天所吩咐他们的，说：你们要听从我的话，照着我吩咐你们的一切话去行；这样，你们就作我的子民，我也作你们的神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这约就是我把你们的列祖从埃及地、从铁炉那里领出来的那天所吩咐他们的，说：你们要听从我的话，照着我吩咐你们的一切话去行；这样，你们就作我的子民，我也作你们的神。
verses.textZhCuv: 这约是我将你们列祖从埃及地领出来、脱离铁炉的那日所吩咐他们的，说：『你们要听从我的话，照我一切所吩咐的去行。』这样，你们就作我的子民，我也作你们的神；
verses.textEnNiv: the terms I commanded your ancestors when I brought them out of Egypt, out of the iron-smelting furnace.’ I said, ‘Obey me and do everything I command you, and you will be my people, and I will be your God.
verses.textEnEsv: that I commanded your fathers when I brought them out of the land of Egypt, from the iron furnace, saying, Listen to my voice, and do all that I command you. So shall you be my people, and I will be your God,
verses.textEnNkjv: which I commanded your fathers in the day I brought them out of the land of Egypt, from the iron furnace, saying, ‘Obey My voice, and do according to all that I command you; so shall you be My people, and I will be your God,’
verses.textEnNlt: For I said to your ancestors when I brought them out of the iron-smelting furnace of Egypt, "If you obey me and do whatever I command you, then you will be my people, and I will be your God."
verses.textEnNasb: which I commanded your forefathers on the day that I brought them out of the land of Egypt, from the iron furnace, saying, ‘Listen to My voice, and do according to all that I command you; so you shall be My people, and I will be your God,’
verses.textEn: the terms I commanded your ancestors when I brought them out of Egypt, out of the iron-smelting furnace.’ I said, ‘Obey me and do everything I command you, and you will be my people, and I will be your God.

verses.textZh: 我好履行向你们列祖所起的誓，就是把流奶与蜜之地赐给他们，好象今天一样。’"于是我回答说："耶和华啊！阿们。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我好履行向你们列祖所起的誓，就是把流奶与蜜之地赐给他们，好象今天一样。’"于是我回答说："耶和华啊！阿们。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我好坚定向你们列祖所起的誓，给他们流奶与蜜之地，正如今日一样。」我就回答说：「耶和华啊，阿们！」
verses.textEnNiv: Then I will fulfill the oath I swore to your ancestors, to give them a land flowing with milk and honey’—the land you possess today." I answered, "Amen, Lord ."
verses.textEnEsv: that I may confirm the oath that I swore to your fathers, to give them a land flowing with milk and honey, as at this day." Then I answered, "So be it, Lord ."
verses.textEnNkjv: that I may establish the oath which I have sworn to your fathers, to give them ‘a land flowing with milk and honey,’ as itis this day." ’ " And I answered and said, "So be it, Lord."
verses.textEnNlt: I said this so I could keep my promise to your ancestors to give you a land flowing with milk and honey—the land you live in today.’" Then I replied, "Amen, Lord ! May it be so."
verses.textEnNasb: in order to confirm the oath which I swore to your forefathers, to give them a land flowing with milk and honey, as it is this day." ’ " Then I replied, "Amen, Lord."
verses.textEn: Then I will fulfill the oath I swore to your ancestors, to give them a land flowing with milk and honey’—the land you possess today." I answered, "Amen, Lord ."

verses.textZh: 耶和华又对我说："你要在犹大各城中和耶路撒冷的街道上，宣告这一切话，说：‘你们要听从、遵行这约的话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华又对我说："你要在犹大各城中和耶路撒冷的街道上，宣告这一切话，说：‘你们要听从、遵行这约的话。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华对我说：「你要在犹大城邑中和耶路撒冷街市上，宣告这一切话说：你们当听从遵行这约的话。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord said to me, "Proclaim all these words in the towns of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem: ‘Listen to the terms of this covenant and follow them.
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord said to me, "Proclaim all these words in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem: Hear the words of this covenant and do them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Lord said to me, "Proclaim all these words in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem, saying: ‘Hear the words of this covenant and do them.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord said, "Broadcast this message in the streets of Jerusalem. Go from town to town throughout the land and say, ‘Remember the ancient covenant, and do everything it requires.
verses.textEnNasb: And the Lord said to me, "Proclaim all these words in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem, saying, ‘Hear the words of this covenant and do them.
verses.textEn: The Lord said to me, "Proclaim all these words in the towns of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem: ‘Listen to the terms of this covenant and follow them.

verses.textZh: 因为自从我领你们的列祖出埃及地那一天，我已郑重警告他们，直到今日，我仍不断警告他们，说："你们要听从我的话。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为自从我领你们的列祖出埃及地那一天，我已郑重警告他们，直到今日，我仍不断警告他们，说："你们要听从我的话。"
verses.textZhCuv: 因为我将你们列祖从埃及地领出来的那日，直到今日，都是从早起来，切切告诫他们说：『你们当听从我的话。』
verses.textEnNiv: From the time I brought your ancestors up from Egypt until today, I warned them again and again, saying, "Obey me."
verses.textEnEsv: For I solemnly warned your fathers when I brought them up out of the land of Egypt, warning them persistently, even to this day, saying, Obey my voice.
verses.textEnNkjv: For I earnestly exhorted your fathers in the day I brought them up out of the land of Egypt, until this day, rising early and exhorting, saying, "Obey My voice."
verses.textEnNlt: For I solemnly warned your ancestors when I brought them out of Egypt, "Obey me!" I have repeated this warning over and over to this day,
verses.textEnNasb: For I solemnly warned your fathers on the day I brought them up from the land of Egypt, even to this day, warning them persistently, saying, "Listen to My voice."
verses.textEn: From the time I brought your ancestors up from Egypt until today, I warned them again and again, saying, "Obey me."

verses.textZh: 他们却不听从，毫不留心，各人随从自己顽梗的恶心行事。所以，我使这约中一切咒诅的话临到他们身上。我曾吩咐他们遵行这约，他们却不遵行。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们却不听从，毫不留心，各人随从自己顽梗的恶心行事。所以，我使这约中一切咒诅的话临到他们身上。我曾吩咐他们遵行这约，他们却不遵行。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们却不听从，不侧耳而听，竟随从自己顽梗的恶心去行。所以我使这约中一切咒诅的话临到他们身上；这约是我吩咐他们行的，他们却不去行。」
verses.textEnNiv: But they did not listen or pay attention; instead, they followed the stubbornness of their evil hearts. So I brought on them all the curses of the covenant I had commanded them to follow but that they did not keep.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: Yet they did not obey or incline their ear, but everyone walked in the stubbornness of his evil heart. Therefore I brought upon them all the words of this covenant, which I commanded them to do, but they did not."
verses.textEnNkjv: Yet they did not obey or incline their ear, but everyone followed the dictates of his evil heart; therefore I will bring upon them all the words of this covenant, which I commanded them to do, but which they have not done.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: but your ancestors did not listen or even pay attention. Instead, they stubbornly followed their own evil desires. And because they refused to obey, I brought upon them all the curses described in this covenant.’"
verses.textEnNasb: Yet they did not obey or incline their ear, but walked in the stubbornness of their evil heart, each one of them; therefore I brought on them all the words of this covenant which I commanded them to do, but they did not.’ "
verses.textEn: But they did not listen or pay attention; instead, they followed the stubbornness of their evil hearts. So I brought on them all the curses of the covenant I had commanded them to follow but that they did not keep.’ "

verses.textZh: 耶和华又对我说："在犹大人和耶路撒冷的居民中间，有背叛的阴谋。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华又对我说："在犹大人和耶路撒冷的居民中间，有背叛的阴谋。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华对我说：「在犹大人和耶路撒冷居民中有同谋背叛的事。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the Lord said to me, "There is a conspiracy among the people of Judah and those who live in Jerusalem.
verses.textEnEsv: Again the Lord said to me, "A conspiracy exists among the men of Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Lord said to me, "A conspiracy has been found among the men of Judah and among the inhabitants of Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNlt: Again the Lord spoke to me and said, "I have discovered a conspiracy against me among the people of Judah and Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord said to me, "A conspiracy has been found among the men of Judah and among the inhabitants of Jerusalem.
verses.textEn: Then the Lord said to me, "There is a conspiracy among the people of Judah and those who live in Jerusalem.

verses.textZh: 他们回到他们祖先所犯的罪孽中。他们的祖先不肯听从我的话，却随从事奉别的神。以色列家和犹大家都违犯了我和他们列祖所立的约。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们回到他们祖先所犯的罪孽中。他们的祖先不肯听从我的话，却随从事奉别的神。以色列家和犹大家都违犯了我和他们列祖所立的约。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们转去效法他们的先祖，不肯听我的话，犯罪作孽，又随从别神，事奉它。以色列家和犹大家背了我与他们列祖所立的约。」
verses.textEnNiv: They have returned to the sins of their ancestors, who refused to listen to my words. They have followed other gods to serve them. Both Israel and Judah have broken the covenant I made with their ancestors.
verses.textEnEsv: They have turned back to the iniquities of their forefathers, who refused to hear my words. They have gone after other gods to serve them. The house of Israel and the house of Judah have broken my covenant that I made with their fathers.
verses.textEnNkjv: They have turned back to the iniquities of their forefathers who refused to hear My words, and they have gone after other gods to serve them; the house of Israel and the house of Judah have broken My covenant which I made with their fathers."
verses.textEnNlt: They have returned to the sins of their ancestors. They have refused to listen to me and are worshiping other gods. Israel and Judah have both broken the covenant I made with their ancestors.
verses.textEnNasb: They have turned back to the wrongdoings of their ancestors who refused to hear My words, and they have followed other gods to serve them. The house of Israel and the house of Judah have broken My covenant which I made with their fathers."
verses.textEn: They have returned to the sins of their ancestors, who refused to listen to my words. They have followed other gods to serve them. Both Israel and Judah have broken the covenant I made with their ancestors.

verses.textZh: 因此耶和华这样说："看哪！我必使灾祸临到他们身上，是他们不能逃脱的；他们虽然向我哀求，我必不听他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此耶和华这样说："看哪！我必使灾祸临到他们身上，是他们不能逃脱的；他们虽然向我哀求，我必不听他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以耶和华如此说：「我必使灾祸临到他们，是他们不能逃脱的。他们必向我哀求，我却不听。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore this is what the Lord says: ‘I will bring on them a disaster they cannot escape. Although they cry out to me, I will not listen to them.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore, thus says the Lord , Behold, I am bringing disaster upon them that they cannot escape. Though they cry to me, I will not listen to them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore thus says the Lord: "Behold, I will surely bring calamity on them which they will not be able to escape; and though they cry out to Me, I will not listen to them.
verses.textEnNlt: Therefore, this is what the Lord says: I am going to bring calamity upon them, and they will not escape. Though they beg for mercy, I will not listen to their cries.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore this is what the Lord says: "Behold, I am bringing disaster on them which they will not be able to escape; though they will cry out to Me, I will not listen to them.
verses.textEn: Therefore this is what the Lord says: ‘I will bring on them a disaster they cannot escape. Although they cry out to me, I will not listen to them.

verses.textZh: 那时，犹大各城的人和耶路撒冷的居民，都必去哀求他们烧香供奉的神，只是在他们遭难的时候，这些神却完全不能拯救他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，犹大各城的人和耶路撒冷的居民，都必去哀求他们烧香供奉的神，只是在他们遭难的时候，这些神却完全不能拯救他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时，犹大城邑的人和耶路撒冷的居民要去哀求他们烧香所供奉的神；只是遭难的时候，这些神毫不拯救他们。
verses.textEnNiv: The towns of Judah and the people of Jerusalem will go and cry out to the gods to whom they burn incense, but they will not help them at all when disaster strikes.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the cities of Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem will go and cry to the gods to whom they make offerings, but they cannot save them in the time of their trouble.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the cities of Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem will go and cry out to the gods to whom they offer incense, but they will not save them at all in the time of their trouble.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the people of Judah and Jerusalem will pray to their idols and burn incense before them. But the idols will not save them when disaster strikes!
verses.textEnNasb: Then the cities of Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem will go and cry out to the gods to whom they burn incense, but they certainly will not save them in the time of their disaster.
verses.textEn: The towns of Judah and the people of Jerusalem will go and cry out to the gods to whom they burn incense, but they will not help them at all when disaster strikes.

verses.textZh: 犹大啊！你的城有多少，你的神也有多少；耶路撒冷的街道有多少，你为那可耻的巴力所设立烧香的祭坛也有多少。
verses.textZhCnvs: 犹大啊！你的城有多少，你的神也有多少；耶路撒冷的街道有多少，你为那可耻的巴力所设立烧香的祭坛也有多少。
verses.textZhCuv: 犹大啊，你神的数目与你城的数目相等；你为那可耻的巴力所筑烧香的坛也与耶路撒冷街道的数目相等。
verses.textEnNiv: You, Judah, have as many gods as you have towns; and the altars you have set up to burn incense to that shameful god Baal are as many as the streets of Jerusalem.’
verses.textEnEsv: For your gods have become as many as your cities, O Judah, and as many as the streets of Jerusalem are the altars you have set up to shame, altars to make offerings to Baal.
verses.textEnNkjv: For accordingto the number of your cities were your gods, O Judah; and accordingto the number of the streets of Jerusalem you have set up altars to that shameful thing, altars to burn incense to Baal.
verses.textEnNlt: Look now, people of Judah; you have as many gods as you have towns. You have as many altars of shame—altars for burning incense to your god Baal—as there are streets in Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNasb: For your gods are as many as your cities, Judah; and as many as the streets of Jerusalem are the altars you have set up to the shameful thing, altars for burning incense to Baal.
verses.textEn: You, Judah, have as many gods as you have towns; and the altars you have set up to burn incense to that shameful god Baal are as many as the streets of Jerusalem.’

verses.textZh: "至于你，不要为这人民祈祷，不要为他们呼求祷告，因为他们遭难向我呼求的时候，我必不听他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: "至于你，不要为这人民祈祷，不要为他们呼求祷告，因为他们遭难向我呼求的时候，我必不听他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 「所以你不要为这百姓祈祷，不要为他们呼求祷告；因为他们遭难向我哀求的时候，我必不应允。
verses.textEnNiv: "Do not pray for this people or offer any plea or petition for them, because I will not listen when they call to me in the time of their distress.
verses.textEnEsv: "Therefore do not pray for this people, or lift up a cry or prayer on their behalf, for I will not listen when they call to me in the time of their trouble.
verses.textEnNkjv: "So do not pray for this people, or lift up a cry or prayer for them; for I will not hear them in the time that they cry out to Me because of their trouble.
verses.textEnNlt: "Pray no more for these people, Jeremiah. Do not weep or pray for them, for I will not listen to them when they cry out to me in distress.
verses.textEnNasb: "So as for you, do not pray for this people, nor lift up a cry or prayer for them; for I will not listen when they call to Me because of their disaster.
verses.textEn: "Do not pray for this people or offer any plea or petition for them, because I will not listen when they call to me in the time of their distress.

verses.textZh: "我所爱的既然行了罪大恶极的事， 还有甚么资格在我的殿里呢？ 难道祭肉可以消除你的灾祸， 使你得着欢乐吗？"
verses.textZhCnvs: "我所爱的既然行了罪大恶极的事， 还有甚么资格在我的殿里呢？ 难道祭肉可以消除你的灾祸， 使你得着欢乐吗？"
verses.textZhCuv: 我所亲爱的，既行许多淫乱，圣肉也离了你，你在我殿中做什么呢？你作恶就喜乐。
verses.textEnNiv: "What is my beloved doing in my temple as she, with many others, works out her evil schemes? Can consecrated meat avert your punishment? When you engage in your wickedness, then you rejoice. "
verses.textEnEsv: What right has my beloved in my house, when she has done many vile deeds? Can even sacrificial flesh avert your doom? Can you then exult?
verses.textEnNkjv: "What has My beloved to do in My house, Having done lewd deeds with many? And the holy flesh has passed from you. When you do evil, then you rejoice.
verses.textEnNlt: "What right do my beloved people have to come to my Temple, when they have done so many immoral things? Can their vows and sacrifices prevent their destruction? They actually rejoice in doing evil!
verses.textEnNasb: "What right has My beloved in My house When she has carried out many evil schemes? Can the sacrificial flesh take away from you your disaster, So that you can rejoice?"
verses.textEn: "What is my beloved doing in my temple as she, with many others, works out her evil schemes? Can consecrated meat avert your punishment? When you engage in your wickedness, then you rejoice. "

verses.textZh: 耶和华曾称你的名字为 壮丽、多结美果的青橄榄树； 现在他必藉风暴雷轰， 把它燃点起来， 它的枝子也都折断。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华曾称你的名字为 壮丽、多结美果的青橄榄树； 现在他必藉风暴雷轰， 把它燃点起来， 它的枝子也都折断。
verses.textZhCuv: 从前耶和华给你起名叫青橄榄树，又华美又结好果子；如今他用哄嚷之声，点火在其上，枝子也被折断。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord called you a thriving olive tree with fruit beautiful in form. But with the roar of a mighty storm he will set it on fire, and its branches will be broken.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord once called you ‘a green olive tree, beautiful with good fruit.’ But with the roar of a great tempest he will set fire to it, and its branches will be consumed.
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord called your name, Green Olive Tree, Lovely and of Good Fruit. With the noise of a great tumult He has kindled fire on it, And its branches are broken.
verses.textEnNlt: I, the Lord , once called them a thriving olive tree, beautiful to see and full of good fruit. But now I have sent the fury of their enemies to burn them with fire, leaving them charred and broken.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord named you "A green olive tree, beautiful in fruit and form"; With the noise of a great tumult He has set fire to it, And its branches are worthless.
verses.textEn: The Lord called you a thriving olive tree with fruit beautiful in form. But with the roar of a mighty storm he will set it on fire, and its branches will be broken.

verses.textZh: 那栽种你的万军之耶和华，已经宣布降灾攻击你，是因以色列家和犹大家自己所行的恶；他们向巴力烧香，惹我发怒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那栽种你的万军之耶和华，已经宣布降灾攻击你，是因以色列家和犹大家自己所行的恶；他们向巴力烧香，惹我发怒。
verses.textZhCuv: 原来栽培你的万军之耶和华已经说，要降祸攻击你，是因以色列家和犹大家行恶，向巴力烧香，惹我发怒，是自作自受。」
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord Almighty, who planted you, has decreed disaster for you, because the people of both Israel and Judah have done evil and aroused my anger by burning incense to Baal.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord of hosts, who planted you, has decreed disaster against you, because of the evil that the house of Israel and the house of Judah have done, provoking me to anger by making offerings to Baal."
verses.textEnNkjv: "For the Lord of hosts, who planted you, has pronounced doom against you for the evil of the house of Israel and of the house of Judah, which they have done against themselves to provoke Me to anger in offering incense to Baal."
verses.textEnNlt: "I, the Lord of Heaven’s Armies, who planted this olive tree, have ordered it destroyed. For the people of Israel and Judah have done evil, arousing my anger by burning incense to Baal."
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord of armies, who planted you, has pronounced evil against you because of the evil of the house of Israel and the house of Judah, which they have done to provoke Me by offering sacrifices to Baal.
verses.textEn: The Lord Almighty, who planted you, has decreed disaster for you, because the people of both Israel and Judah have done evil and aroused my anger by burning incense to Baal.

verses.textZh: 耶和华把他们的阴谋指示我，我就知道了；那时，你把他们所行的给我指明。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华把他们的阴谋指示我，我就知道了；那时，你把他们所行的给我指明。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华指示我，我就知道； 你将他们所行的给我指明。
verses.textEnNiv: Because the Lord revealed their plot to me, I knew it, for at that time he showed me what they were doing.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord made it known to me and I knew; then you showed me their deeds.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the Lord gave me knowledge ofit, and I know it; for You showed me their doings.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord told me about the plots my enemies were making against me.
verses.textEnNasb: Moreover, the Lord made it known to me and I knew it; Then You showed me their deeds.
verses.textEn: Because the Lord revealed their plot to me, I knew it, for at that time he showed me what they were doing.

verses.textZh: 至于我，我却像一只驯良的羊羔，被牵到屠宰之地；我并不知道他们设计谋害我。他们说： "我们来把这树和果子 都毁灭吧， 把它从活人之地剪除， 使它的名不再被人记念。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 至于我，我却像一只驯良的羊羔，被牵到屠宰之地；我并不知道他们设计谋害我。他们说： "我们来把这树和果子 都毁灭吧， 把它从活人之地剪除， 使它的名不再被人记念。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我却像柔顺的羊羔被牵到宰杀之地； 我并不知道他们设计谋害我， 说：我们把树连果子都灭了吧！ 将他从活人之地剪除， 使他的名不再被纪念。
verses.textEnNiv: I had been like a gentle lamb led to the slaughter; I did not realize that they had plotted against me, saying, "Let us destroy the tree and its fruit; let us cut him off from the land of the living, that his name be remembered no more."
verses.textEnEsv: But I was like a gentle lamb led to the slaughter. I did not know it was against me they devised schemes, saying, "Let us destroy the tree with its fruit, let us cut him off from the land of the living, that his name be remembered no more."
verses.textEnNkjv: But I was like a docile lamb brought to the slaughter; and I did not know that they had devised schemes against me, saying, "Let us destroy the tree with its fruit, and let us cut him off from the land of the living, that his name may be remembered no more."
verses.textEnNlt: I was like a lamb being led to the slaughter. I had no idea that they were planning to kill me! "Let’s destroy this man and all his words," they said. "Let’s cut him down, so his name will be forgotten forever."
verses.textEnNasb: But I was like a gentle lamb led to the slaughter; And I did not know that they had devised plots against me, saying, "Let’s destroy the tree with its fruit, And let’s cut him off from the land of the living, So that his name will no longer be remembered."
verses.textEn: I had been like a gentle lamb led to the slaughter; I did not realize that they had plotted against me, saying, "Let us destroy the tree and its fruit; let us cut him off from the land of the living, that his name be remembered no more."

verses.textZh: 但万军之耶和华啊！你是凭公义审判人， 试验人肺腑和心肠的。 求你让我看见你在他们身上施行的报复， 因为我已经把我的案件向你陈明了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但万军之耶和华啊！你是凭公义审判人， 试验人肺腑和心肠的。 求你让我看见你在他们身上施行的报复， 因为我已经把我的案件向你陈明了。
verses.textZhCuv: 按公义判断、察验人肺腑心肠的万军之耶和华啊， 我却要见你在他们身上报仇， 因我将我的案件向你禀明了。
verses.textEnNiv: But you, Lord Almighty, who judge righteously and test the heart and mind, let me see your vengeance on them, for to you I have committed my cause.
verses.textEnEsv: But, O Lord of hosts, who judges righteously, who tests the heart and the mind, let me see your vengeance upon them, for to you have I committed my cause.
verses.textEnNkjv: But, O Lord of hosts, You who judge righteously, Testing the mind and the heart, Let me see Your vengeance on them, For to You I have revealed my cause.
verses.textEnNlt: O Lord of Heaven’s Armies, you make righteous judgments, and you examine the deepest thoughts and secrets. Let me see your vengeance against them, for I have committed my cause to you.
verses.textEnNasb: But, Lord of armies, who judges righteously, Who puts the feelings and the heart to the test, Let me see Your vengeance on them, For to You I have committed my cause.
verses.textEn: But you, Lord Almighty, who judge righteously and test the heart and mind, let me see your vengeance on them, for to you I have committed my cause.

verses.textZh: 因此耶和华指责那些亚拿突人，他们寻索你命，向你恐吓说："不要奉耶和华的名说预言，免得你死在我们手中。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此耶和华指责那些亚拿突人，他们寻索你命，向你恐吓说："不要奉耶和华的名说预言，免得你死在我们手中。"
verses.textZhCuv: 所以，耶和华论到寻索你命的亚拿突人如此说：「他们说：你不要奉耶和华的名说预言，免得你死在我们手中。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore this is what the Lord says about the people of Anathoth who are threatening to kill you, saying, "Do not prophesy in the name of the Lord or you will die by our hands"—
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore thus says the Lord concerning the men of Anathoth, who seek your life, and say, "Do not prophesy in the name of the Lord , or you will die by our hand"—
verses.textEnNkjv: "Therefore thus says the Lord concerning the men of Anathoth who seek your life, saying, ‘Do not prophesy in the name of the Lord, lest you die by our hand’—
verses.textEnNlt: This is what the Lord says about the men of Anathoth who wanted me dead. They had said, "We will kill you if you do not stop prophesying in the Lord ’s name."
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore this is what the Lord says concerning the people of Anathoth, who are seeking your life, saying: "Do not prophesy in the name of the Lord, so that you do not die by our hand";
verses.textEn: Therefore this is what the Lord says about the people of Anathoth who are threatening to kill you, saying, "Do not prophesy in the name of the Lord or you will die by our hands"—

verses.textZh: 万军之耶和华这样说："看哪！我要惩罚他们；他们的年轻人必死在刀下，他们的儿女必因饥荒而死。
verses.textZhCnvs: 万军之耶和华这样说："看哪！我要惩罚他们；他们的年轻人必死在刀下，他们的儿女必因饥荒而死。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以万军之耶和华如此说：看哪，我必刑罚他们；他们的少年人必被刀剑杀死，他们的儿女必因饥荒灭亡，
verses.textEnNiv: therefore this is what the Lord Almighty says: "I will punish them. Their young men will die by the sword, their sons and daughters by famine.
verses.textEnEsv: therefore thus says the Lord of hosts: "Behold, I will punish them. The young men shall die by the sword, their sons and their daughters shall die by famine,
verses.textEnNkjv: therefore thus says the Lord of hosts: ‘Behold, I will punish them. The young men shall die by the sword, their sons and their daughters shall die by famine;
verses.textEnNlt: So this is what the Lord of Heaven’s Armies says about them: "I will punish them! Their young men will die in battle, and their boys and girls will starve to death.
verses.textEnNasb: therefore, this is what the Lord of armies says: "Behold, I am going to punish them! The young men will die by the sword, their sons and daughters will die by famine;
verses.textEn: therefore this is what the Lord Almighty says: "I will punish them. Their young men will die by the sword, their sons and daughters by famine.

verses.textZh: 他们中间必没有余剩的，因为在惩罚他们的年日，我必使灾祸临到亚拿突人身上。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们中间必没有余剩的，因为在惩罚他们的年日，我必使灾祸临到亚拿突人身上。"
verses.textZhCuv: 并且没有余剩的人留给他们；因为在追讨之年，我必使灾祸临到亚拿突人。」
verses.textEnNiv: Not even a remnant will be left to them, because I will bring disaster on the people of Anathoth in the year of their punishment."
verses.textEnEsv: and none of them shall be left. For I will bring disaster upon the men of Anathoth, the year of their punishment."
verses.textEnNkjv: and there shall be no remnant of them, for I will bring catastrophe on the men of Anathoth, even the year of their punishment.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: Not one of these plotters from Anathoth will survive, for I will bring disaster upon them when their time of punishment comes."
verses.textEnNasb: and a remnant will not be left to them, because I will bring disaster on the people of Anathoth—the year of their punishment."
verses.textEn: Not even a remnant will be left to them, because I will bring disaster on the people of Anathoth in the year of their punishment."

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊！我跟你争辩的时候， 总是你有理； 然而我还要跟你讨论有关公正的问题。 恶人的道路为甚么亨通？ 所有行诡诈的为甚么都得享安逸？
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊！我跟你争辩的时候， 总是你有理； 然而我还要跟你讨论有关公正的问题。 恶人的道路为甚么亨通？ 所有行诡诈的为甚么都得享安逸？
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，我与你争辩的时候， 你显为义； 但有一件，我还要与你理论： 恶人的道路为何亨通呢？ 大行诡诈的为何得安逸呢？
verses.textEnNiv: You are always righteous, Lord , when I bring a case before you. Yet I would speak with you about your justice: Why does the way of the wicked prosper? Why do all the faithless live at ease?
verses.textEnEsv: Righteous are you, O Lord , when I complain to you; yet I would plead my case before you. Why does the way of the wicked prosper? Why do all who are treacherous thrive?
verses.textEnNkjv: Righteous are You, O Lord, when I plead with You; Yet let me talk with You about Your judgments. Why does the way of the wicked prosper? Why are those happy who deal so treacherously?
verses.textEnNlt: Lord , you always give me justice when I bring a case before you. So let me bring you this complaint: Why are the wicked so prosperous? Why are evil people so happy?
verses.textEnNasb: Righteous are You, Lord, when I plead my case with You; Nevertheless I would discuss matters of justice with You: Why has the way of the wicked prospered? Why are all those who deal in treachery at ease?
verses.textEn: You are always righteous, Lord , when I bring a case before you. Yet I would speak with you about your justice: Why does the way of the wicked prosper? Why do all the faithless live at ease?

verses.textZh: 你栽种了他们，他们也扎了根， 并且长大，结出果实； 他们的口中有你， 心里却没有你 。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你栽种了他们，他们也扎了根， 并且长大，结出果实； 他们的口中有你， 心里却没有你 。
verses.textZhCuv: 你栽培了他们， 他们也扎了根， 长大，而且结果。 他们的口是与你相近， 心却与你远离。
verses.textEnNiv: You have planted them, and they have taken root; they grow and bear fruit. You are always on their lips but far from their hearts.
verses.textEnEsv: You plant them, and they take root; they grow and produce fruit; you are near in their mouth and far from their heart.
verses.textEnNkjv: You have planted them, yes, they have taken root; They grow, yes, they bear fruit. You are near in their mouth But far from their mind.
verses.textEnNlt: You have planted them, and they have taken root and prospered. Your name is on their lips, but you are far from their hearts.
verses.textEnNasb: You have planted them, they have also taken root; They grow, they have also produced fruit. You are near to their lips But far from their mind.
verses.textEn: You have planted them, and they have taken root; they grow and bear fruit. You are always on their lips but far from their hearts.

verses.textZh: 但耶和华啊！你认识我，了解我， 你察验了我对你的心意。 求你把他们拉出来，好象将宰的羊一般； 求你把他们分别出来，留待宰杀的日子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但耶和华啊！你认识我，了解我， 你察验了我对你的心意。 求你把他们拉出来，好象将宰的羊一般； 求你把他们分别出来，留待宰杀的日子。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，你晓得我，看见我， 察验我向你是怎样的心。 求你将他们拉出来， 好像将宰的羊， 叫他们等候杀戮的日子。
verses.textEnNiv: Yet you know me, Lord ; you see me and test my thoughts about you. Drag them off like sheep to be butchered! Set them apart for the day of slaughter!
verses.textEnEsv: But you, O Lord , know me; you see me, and test my heart toward you. Pull them out like sheep for the slaughter, and set them apart for the day of slaughter.
verses.textEnNkjv: But You, O Lord, know me; You have seen me, And You have tested my heart toward You. Pull them out like sheep for the slaughter, And prepare them for the day of slaughter.
verses.textEnNlt: But as for me, Lord , you know my heart. You see me and test my thoughts. Drag these people away like sheep to be butchered! Set them aside to be slaughtered!
verses.textEnNasb: But You know me, Lord; You see me And examine my heart’s attitude toward You. Drag them off like sheep for the slaughter, And set them apart for a day of slaughter!
verses.textEn: Yet you know me, Lord ; you see me and test my thoughts about you. Drag them off like sheep to be butchered! Set them apart for the day of slaughter!

verses.textZh: 这地悲哀， 田野的青草都枯干，要等到几时呢？ 由于这地居民的恶行， 走兽和飞鸟都灭绝了； 因为他们说："神看不见我们的结局。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 这地悲哀， 田野的青草都枯干，要等到几时呢？ 由于这地居民的恶行， 走兽和飞鸟都灭绝了； 因为他们说："神看不见我们的结局。"
verses.textZhCuv: 这地悲哀， 通国的青草枯干，要到几时呢？ 因其上居民的恶行， 牲畜和飞鸟都灭绝了。 他们曾说：他看不见我们的结局。
verses.textEnNiv: How long will the land lie parched and the grass in every field be withered? Because those who live in it are wicked, the animals and birds have perished. Moreover, the people are saying, "He will not see what happens to us."
verses.textEnEsv: How long will the land mourn and the grass of every field wither? For the evil of those who dwell in it the beasts and the birds are swept away, because they said, "He will not see our latter end."
verses.textEnNkjv: How long will the land mourn, And the herbs of every field wither? The beasts and birds are consumed, For the wickedness of those who dwell there, Because they said, "He will not see our final end."
verses.textEnNlt: How long must this land mourn? Even the grass in the fields has withered. The wild animals and birds have disappeared because of the evil in the land. For the people have said, "The Lord doesn’t see what’s ahead for us!"
verses.textEnNasb: How long is the land to mourn, And the vegetation of the countryside to dry up? Due to the wickedness of those who live in it, Animals and birds have been snatched away, Because people have said, "He will not see our final end."
verses.textEn: How long will the land lie parched and the grass in every field be withered? Because those who live in it are wicked, the animals and birds have perished. Moreover, the people are saying, "He will not see what happens to us."

verses.textZh: 耶和华说："如果你与徒步的人同跑，尚且觉得疲倦， 怎能跟马赛跑呢？ 你在平安稳妥之地，尚且跌倒， 在约旦河边的丛林怎么办呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华说："如果你与徒步的人同跑，尚且觉得疲倦， 怎能跟马赛跑呢？ 你在平安稳妥之地，尚且跌倒， 在约旦河边的丛林怎么办呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华说：你若与步行的人同跑， 尚且觉累， 怎能与马赛跑呢？ 你在平安之地，虽然安稳， 在约旦河边的丛林要怎样行呢？
verses.textEnNiv: "If you have raced with men on foot and they have worn you out, how can you compete with horses? If you stumble in safe country, how will you manage in the thickets by the Jordan?
verses.textEnEsv: "If you have raced with men on foot, and they have wearied you, how will you compete with horses? And if in a safe land you are so trusting, what will you do in the thicket of the Jordan?
verses.textEnNkjv: "If you have run with the footmen, and they have wearied you, Then how can you contend with horses? And if in the land of peace, Inwhich you trusted, theyweariedyou, Then how will you do in the floodplain of the Jordan?
verses.textEnNlt: "If racing against mere men makes you tired, how will you race against horses? If you stumble and fall on open ground, what will you do in the thickets near the Jordan?
verses.textEnNasb: "If you have run with infantrymen and they have tired you out, How can you compete with horses? If you fall down in a land of peace, How will you do in the thicket by the Jordan?
verses.textEn: "If you have raced with men on foot and they have worn you out, how can you compete with horses? If you stumble in safe country, how will you manage in the thickets by the Jordan?

verses.textZh: 因为连你的兄弟、你的父家， 都以诡诈待你， 连他们也在你后面高声喊叫。 虽然他们对你说好话， 你也不可信他们。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为连你的兄弟、你的父家， 都以诡诈待你， 连他们也在你后面高声喊叫。 虽然他们对你说好话， 你也不可信他们。"
verses.textZhCuv: 因为连你弟兄和你父家都用奸诈待你。 他们也在你后边大声喊叫， 虽向你说好话， 你也不要信他们。
verses.textEnNiv: Your relatives, members of your own family— even they have betrayed you; they have raised a loud cry against you. Do not trust them, though they speak well of you.
verses.textEnEsv: For even your brothers and the house of your father, even they have dealt treacherously with you; they are in full cry after you; do not believe them, though they speak friendly words to you."
verses.textEnNkjv: For even your brothers, the house of your father, Even they have dealt treacherously with you; Yes, they have called a multitude after you. Do not believe them, Even though they speak smooth words to you.
verses.textEnNlt: Even your brothers, members of your own family, have turned against you. They plot and raise complaints against you. Do not trust them, no matter how pleasantly they speak.
verses.textEnNasb: "For even your brothers and the household of your father, Even they have dealt treacherously with you, Even they have called aloud after you. Do not believe them, though they say nice things to you."
verses.textEn: Your relatives, members of your own family— even they have betrayed you; they have raised a loud cry against you. Do not trust them, though they speak well of you.

verses.textZh: "我撇下了我的家， 丢弃了我的产业； 我把我心爱的 交在她仇敌的手中。
verses.textZhCnvs: "我撇下了我的家， 丢弃了我的产业； 我把我心爱的 交在她仇敌的手中。
verses.textZhCuv: 我离了我的殿宇， 撇弃我的产业， 将我心里所亲爱的交在她仇敌的手中。
verses.textEnNiv: "I will forsake my house, abandon my inheritance; I will give the one I love into the hands of her enemies.
verses.textEnEsv: "I have forsaken my house; I have abandoned my heritage; I have given the beloved of my soul into the hands of her enemies.
verses.textEnNkjv: "I have forsaken My house, I have left My heritage; I have given the dearly beloved of My soul into the hand of her enemies.
verses.textEnNlt: "I have abandoned my people, my special possession. I have surrendered my dearest ones to their enemies.
verses.textEnNasb: "I have forsaken My house, I have abandoned My inheritance; I have handed the beloved of My soul Over to her enemies.
verses.textEn: "I will forsake my house, abandon my inheritance; I will give the one I love into the hands of her enemies.

verses.textZh: 我的产业对我， 就像树林中的狮子向我咆哮， 因此我恨恶她。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的产业对我， 就像树林中的狮子向我咆哮， 因此我恨恶她。
verses.textZhCuv: 我的产业向我如林中的狮子， 她发声攻击我， 因此我恨恶她。
verses.textEnNiv: My inheritance has become to me like a lion in the forest. She roars at me; therefore I hate her.
verses.textEnEsv: My heritage has become to me like a lion in the forest; she has lifted up her voice against me; therefore I hate her.
verses.textEnNkjv: My heritage is to Me like a lion in the forest; It cries out against Me; Therefore I have hated it.
verses.textEnNlt: My chosen people have roared at me like a lion of the forest, so I have treated them with contempt.
verses.textEnNasb: "My inheritance has become to Me Like a lion in the forest; She has roared against Me; Therefore I have come to hate her.
verses.textEn: My inheritance has become to me like a lion in the forest. She roars at me; therefore I hate her.

verses.textZh: 我的产业对我，不就像一只带斑点的鸷鸟， 其他的鸷鸟都四围攻击她？ 你们去聚集田野各样的走兽， 带牠们来吃吧！
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的产业对我，不就像一只带斑点的鸷鸟， 其他的鸷鸟都四围攻击她？ 你们去聚集田野各样的走兽， 带牠们来吃吧！
verses.textZhCuv: 我的产业向我岂如斑点的鸷鸟呢？ 鸷鸟岂在她四围攻击她呢？ 你们要去聚集田野的百兽， 带来吞吃吧！
verses.textEnNiv: Has not my inheritance become to me like a speckled bird of prey that other birds of prey surround and attack? Go and gather all the wild beasts; bring them to devour.
verses.textEnEsv: Is my heritage to me like a hyena’s lair? Are the birds of prey against her all around? Go, assemble all the wild beasts; bring them to devour.
verses.textEnNkjv: My heritage is to Me like a speckled vulture; The vultures all around are against her. Come, assemble all the beasts of the field, Bring them to devour!
verses.textEnNlt: My chosen people act like speckled vultures, but they themselves are surrounded by vultures. Bring on the wild animals to pick their corpses clean!
verses.textEnNasb: "Is My inheritance like a speckled bird of prey to Me? Are the birds of prey against her on every side? Go, gather all the animals of the field, Bring them to devour!
verses.textEn: Has not my inheritance become to me like a speckled bird of prey that other birds of prey surround and attack? Go and gather all the wild beasts; bring them to devour.

verses.textZh: 许多牧人毁坏了我的葡萄园， 践踏了我的田地； 他们使我美好的田地 变为荒凉的旷野。
verses.textZhCnvs: 许多牧人毁坏了我的葡萄园， 践踏了我的田地； 他们使我美好的田地 变为荒凉的旷野。
verses.textZhCuv: 许多牧人毁坏我的葡萄园， 践踏我的分， 使我美好的分变为荒凉的旷野。
verses.textEnNiv: Many shepherds will ruin my vineyard and trample down my field; they will turn my pleasant field into a desolate wasteland.
verses.textEnEsv: Many shepherds have destroyed my vineyard; they have trampled down my portion; they have made my pleasant portion a desolate wilderness.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Many rulers have destroyed My vineyard, They have trodden My portion underfoot; They have made My pleasant portion a desolate wilderness.
verses.textEnNlt: "Many rulers have ravaged my vineyard, trampling down the vines and turning all its beauty into a barren wilderness.
verses.textEnNasb: "Many shepherds have ruined My vineyard, They have trampled down My field; They have made My pleasant field A desolate wilderness.
verses.textEn: Many shepherds will ruin my vineyard and trample down my field; they will turn my pleasant field into a desolate wasteland.

verses.textZh: 他们使地荒凉， 在我面前一片荒凉悲哀； 全地荒凉， 却无人关心。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们使地荒凉， 在我面前一片荒凉悲哀； 全地荒凉， 却无人关心。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们使地荒凉； 地既荒凉，便向我悲哀。 全地荒凉，因无人介意。
verses.textEnNiv: It will be made a wasteland, parched and desolate before me; the whole land will be laid waste because there is no one who cares.
verses.textEnEsv: They have made it a desolation; desolate, it mourns to me. The whole land is made desolate, but no man lays it to heart.
verses.textEnNkjv: They have made it desolate; Desolate, it mourns to Me; The whole land is made desolate, Because no one takes it to heart.
verses.textEnNlt: They have made it an empty wasteland; I hear its mournful cry. The whole land is desolate, and no one even cares.
verses.textEnNasb: " It has been made a desolation; Desolate, it mourns before Me; The whole land has been made desolate, Because no one takes it to heart.
verses.textEn: It will be made a wasteland, parched and desolate before me; the whole land will be laid waste because there is no one who cares.

verses.textZh: 在旷野一切光秃的高冈上， 行毁灭的已经来到了； 因为耶和华的刀。 从地这边直到地那边，要吞灭一切； 人人都没有平安。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在旷野一切光秃的高冈上， 行毁灭的已经来到了； 因为耶和华的刀。 从地这边直到地那边，要吞灭一切； 人人都没有平安。
verses.textZhCuv: 灭命的都来到旷野中一切净光的高处； 耶和华的刀从地这边直到地那边尽行杀灭。 凡有血气的都不得平安。
verses.textEnNiv: Over all the barren heights in the desert destroyers will swarm, for the sword of the Lord will devour from one end of the land to the other; no one will be safe.
verses.textEnEsv: Upon all the bare heights in the desert destroyers have come, for the sword of the Lord devours from one end of the land to the other; no flesh has peace.
verses.textEnNkjv: The plunderers have come On all the desolate heights in the wilderness, For the sword of the Lord shall devour From one end of the land to the other end of the land; No flesh shall have peace.
verses.textEnNlt: On all the bare hilltops, destroying armies can be seen. The sword of the Lord devours people from one end of the nation to the other. No one will escape!
verses.textEnNasb: "On all the bare heights in the wilderness Destroyers have come, For the sword of the Lord is devouring From one end of the land even to the other; There is no peace for anyone.
verses.textEn: Over all the barren heights in the desert destroyers will swarm, for the sword of the Lord will devour from one end of the land to the other; no one will be safe.

verses.textZh: 他们种的是小麦，收的却是荆棘； 虽然筋疲力竭，却一无所获。 因耶和华的烈怒， 他们必为自己的 出产羞愧 。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们种的是小麦，收的却是荆棘； 虽然筋疲力竭，却一无所获。 因耶和华的烈怒， 他们必为自己的 出产羞愧 。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们种的是麦子， 收的是荆棘； 劳劳苦苦却毫无益处。 因耶和华的烈怒， 你们必为自己的土产羞愧。
verses.textEnNiv: They will sow wheat but reap thorns; they will wear themselves out but gain nothing. They will bear the shame of their harvest because of the Lord ’s fierce anger."
verses.textEnEsv: They have sown wheat and have reaped thorns; they have tired themselves out but profit nothing. They shall be ashamed of their harvests because of the fierce anger of the Lord ."
verses.textEnNkjv: They have sown wheat but reaped thorns; They have put themselves to pain but do not profit. But be ashamed of your harvest Because of the fierce anger of the Lord."
verses.textEnNlt: My people have planted wheat but are harvesting thorns. They have worn themselves out, but it has done them no good. They will harvest a crop of shame because of the fierce anger of the Lord ."
verses.textEnNasb: "They have sown wheat but have harvested thorns, They have strained themselves to no profit. So be ashamed of your produce Because of the fierce anger of the Lord."
verses.textEn: They will sow wheat but reap thorns; they will wear themselves out but gain nothing. They will bear the shame of their harvest because of the Lord ’s fierce anger."

verses.textZh: 耶和华这样说："至于所有邪恶的邻国，他们侵犯我赐给我子民以色列的产业；看哪！我要把他们从本地拔出来，也要把犹大家从他们中间拔出来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华这样说："至于所有邪恶的邻国，他们侵犯我赐给我子民以色列的产业；看哪！我要把他们从本地拔出来，也要把犹大家从他们中间拔出来。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华如此说：「一切恶邻，就是占据我使百姓以色列所承受产业的，我要将他们拔出本地，又要将犹大家从他们中间拔出来。
verses.textEnNiv: This is what the Lord says: "As for all my wicked neighbors who seize the inheritance I gave my people Israel, I will uproot them from their lands and I will uproot the people of Judah from among them.
verses.textEnEsv: Thus says the Lord concerning all my evil neighbors who touch the heritage that I have given my people Israel to inherit: "Behold, I will pluck them up from their land, and I will pluck up the house of Judah from among them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus says the Lord: "Against all My evil neighbors who touch the inheritance which I have caused My people Israel to inherit—behold, I will pluck them out of their land and pluck out the house of Judah from among them.
verses.textEnNlt: Now this is what the Lord says: "I will uproot from their land all the evil nations reaching out for the possession I gave my people Israel. And I will uproot Judah from among them.
verses.textEnNasb: This is what the Lord says concerning all My wicked neighbors who do harm to the inheritance with which I have endowed My people Israel: "Behold, I am going to drive them out of their land, and I will drive the house of Judah out from among them.
verses.textEn: This is what the Lord says: "As for all my wicked neighbors who seize the inheritance I gave my people Israel, I will uproot them from their lands and I will uproot the people of Judah from among them.

verses.textZh: 但我把他们拔出来以后，我必再怜悯他们，把他们领回来，各自归回自己的产业，自己的故乡。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但我把他们拔出来以后，我必再怜悯他们，把他们领回来，各自归回自己的产业，自己的故乡。
verses.textZhCuv: 我拔出他们以后，我必转过来怜悯他们，把他们再带回来，各归本业，各归故土。
verses.textEnNiv: But after I uproot them, I will again have compassion and will bring each of them back to their own inheritance and their own country.
verses.textEnEsv: And after I have plucked them up, I will again have compassion on them, and I will bring them again each to his heritage and each to his land.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then it shall be, after I have plucked them out, that I will return and have compassion on them and bring them back, everyone to his heritage and everyone to his land.
verses.textEnNlt: But afterward I will return and have compassion on all of them. I will bring them home to their own lands again, each nation to its own possession.
verses.textEnNasb: And it will come about that after I have driven them out, I will again have compassion on them; and I will bring them back, each one to his inheritance and each one to his land.
verses.textEn: But after I uproot them, I will again have compassion and will bring each of them back to their own inheritance and their own country.

verses.textZh: 如果那些邻近的国家真的学习我子民的道路，指着我的名起誓，说：‘我指着永活的耶和华起誓！’正如他们从前教导我的子民指着巴力起誓一样，他们就必在我的子民中间被建立起来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果那些邻近的国家真的学习我子民的道路，指着我的名起誓，说：‘我指着永活的耶和华起誓！’正如他们从前教导我的子民指着巴力起誓一样，他们就必在我的子民中间被建立起来。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们若殷勤学习我百姓的道，指着我的名起誓说：『我指着永生的耶和华起誓』，正如他们从前教我百姓指着巴力起誓，他们就必建立在我百姓中间。
verses.textEnNiv: And if they learn well the ways of my people and swear by my name, saying, ‘As surely as the Lord lives’—even as they once taught my people to swear by Baal—then they will be established among my people.
verses.textEnEsv: And it shall come to pass, if they will diligently learn the ways of my people, to swear by my name, ‘As the Lord lives,’ even as they taught my people to swear by Baal, then they shall be built up in the midst of my people.
verses.textEnNkjv: And it shall be, if they will learn carefully the ways of My people, to swear by My name, ‘As the Lord lives,’ as they taught My people to swear by Baal, then they shall be established in the midst of My people.
verses.textEnNlt: And if these nations truly learn the ways of my people, and if they learn to swear by my name, saying, ‘As surely as the Lord lives’ (just as they taught my people to swear by the name of Baal), then they will be given a place among my people.
verses.textEnNasb: Then, if they will really learn the ways of My people, to swear by My name, ‘As the Lord lives,’ just as they taught My people to swear by Baal, they will be built up in the midst of My people.
verses.textEn: And if they learn well the ways of my people and swear by my name, saying, ‘As surely as the Lord lives’—even as they once taught my people to swear by Baal—then they will be established among my people.

verses.textZh: 他们如果有不听从的，我就把那国拔出来，把她拔除消灭。"这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们如果有不听从的，我就把那国拔出来，把她拔除消灭。"这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们若是不听，我必拔出那国，拔出而且毁灭。这是耶和华说的。」
verses.textEnNiv: But if any nation does not listen, I will completely uproot and destroy it," declares the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: But if any nation will not listen, then I will utterly pluck it up and destroy it, declares the Lord ."
verses.textEnNkjv: But if they do not obey, I will utterly pluck up and destroy that nation," says the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: But any nation who refuses to obey me will be uprooted and destroyed. I, the Lord , have spoken!"
verses.textEnNasb: But if they do not listen, then I will drive out that nation, drive it out and destroy it," declares the Lord.
verses.textEn: But if any nation does not listen, I will completely uproot and destroy it," declares the Lord .

verses.textZh: 耶和华这样对我说："你去为自己买一根麻布腰带，束在腰上，但不要把它放在水中。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华这样对我说："你去为自己买一根麻布腰带，束在腰上，但不要把它放在水中。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华对我如此说：「你去买一根麻布带子束腰，不可放在水中。」
verses.textEnNiv: This is what the Lord said to me: "Go and buy a linen belt and put it around your waist, but do not let it touch water."
verses.textEnEsv: Thus says the Lord to me, "Go and buy a linen loincloth and put it around your waist, and do not dip it in water."
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus the Lord said to me: "Go and get yourself a linen sash, and put it around your waist, but do not put it in water."
verses.textEnNlt: This is what the Lord said to me: "Go and buy a linen loincloth and put it on, but do not wash it."
verses.textEnNasb: This is what the Lord said to me: "Go and buy yourself a linen undergarment and put it around your waist, but do not put it in water."
verses.textEn: This is what the Lord said to me: "Go and buy a linen belt and put it around your waist, but do not let it touch water."

verses.textZh: 我就照着耶和华的话，买了一根腰带，束在腰上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我就照着耶和华的话，买了一根腰带，束在腰上。
verses.textZhCuv: 我就照着耶和华的话，买了一根带子束腰。
verses.textEnNiv: So I bought a belt, as the Lord directed, and put it around my waist.
verses.textEnEsv: So I bought a loincloth according to the word of the Lord , and put it around my waist.
verses.textEnNkjv: So I got a sash according to the word of the Lord, and put it around my waist.
verses.textEnNlt: So I bought the loincloth as the Lord directed me, and I put it on.
verses.textEnNasb: So I bought the undergarment in accordance with the word of the Lord, and put it around my waist.
verses.textEn: So I bought a belt, as the Lord directed, and put it around my waist.

verses.textZh: 耶和华的话第二次临到我，说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的话第二次临到我，说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的话第二次临到我说：
verses.textEnNiv: Then the word of the Lord came to me a second time:
verses.textEnEsv: And the word of the Lord came to me a second time,
verses.textEnNkjv: And the word of the Lord came to me the second time, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord gave me another message:
verses.textEnNasb: Then the word of the Lord came to me a second time, saying,
verses.textEn: Then the word of the Lord came to me a second time:

verses.textZh: "拿你买来束在腰上的腰带，起来，往幼发拉底河去，把腰带藏在那里的岩石缝中。"
verses.textZhCnvs: "拿你买来束在腰上的腰带，起来，往幼发拉底河去，把腰带藏在那里的岩石缝中。"
verses.textZhCuv: 「要拿着你所买的腰带，就是你腰上的带子，起来往幼发拉底河去，将腰带藏在那里的磐石穴中。」
verses.textEnNiv: "Take the belt you bought and are wearing around your waist, and go now to Perath and hide it there in a crevice in the rocks."
verses.textEnEsv: "Take the loincloth that you have bought, which is around your waist, and arise, go to the Euphrates and hide it there in a cleft of the rock."
verses.textEnNkjv: "Take the sash that you acquired, which is around your waist, and arise, go to the Euphrates, and hide it there in a hole in the rock."
verses.textEnNlt: "Take the linen loincloth you are wearing, and go to the Euphrates River. Hide it there in a hole in the rocks."
verses.textEnNasb: "Take the undergarment that you bought, which is around your waist, and arise, go to the Euphrates and hide it there in a crevice of the rock."
verses.textEn: "Take the belt you bought and are wearing around your waist, and go now to Perath and hide it there in a crevice in the rocks."

verses.textZh: 我就照着耶和华所吩咐我的，去把腰带藏在幼发拉底河那里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我就照着耶和华所吩咐我的，去把腰带藏在幼发拉底河那里。
verses.textZhCuv: 我就去，照着耶和华所吩咐我的，将腰带藏在幼发拉底河边。
verses.textEnNiv: So I went and hid it at Perath, as the Lord told me.
verses.textEnEsv: So I went and hid it by the Euphrates, as the Lord commanded me.
verses.textEnNkjv: So I went and hid it by the Euphrates, as the Lord commanded me.
verses.textEnNlt: So I went and hid it by the Euphrates as the Lord had instructed me.
verses.textEnNasb: So I went and hid it by the Euphrates, as the Lord had commanded me.
verses.textEn: So I went and hid it at Perath, as the Lord told me.

verses.textZh: 过了多日，耶和华对我说："起来，往幼发拉底河去，把我吩咐你藏在那里的腰带取出来。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 过了多日，耶和华对我说："起来，往幼发拉底河去，把我吩咐你藏在那里的腰带取出来。"
verses.textZhCuv: 过了多日，耶和华对我说：「你起来往幼发拉底河去，将我吩咐你藏在那里的腰带取出来。」
verses.textEnNiv: Many days later the Lord said to me, "Go now to Perath and get the belt I told you to hide there."
verses.textEnEsv: And after many days the Lord said to me, "Arise, go to the Euphrates, and take from there the loincloth that I commanded you to hide there."
verses.textEnNkjv: Now it came to pass after many days that the Lord said to me, "Arise, go to the Euphrates, and take from there the sash which I commanded you to hide there."
verses.textEnNlt: A long time afterward the Lord said to me, "Go back to the Euphrates and get the loincloth I told you to hide there."
verses.textEnNasb: After many days the Lord said to me, "Arise, go to the Euphrates and take from there the undergarment which I commanded you to hide there."
verses.textEn: Many days later the Lord said to me, "Go now to Perath and get the belt I told you to hide there."

verses.textZh: 于是我往幼发拉底河去，在那里挖掘，把腰带从我埋藏的地方取出来；看哪！腰带已经腐烂了，完全没用了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是我往幼发拉底河去，在那里挖掘，把腰带从我埋藏的地方取出来；看哪！腰带已经腐烂了，完全没用了。
verses.textZhCuv: 我就往幼发拉底河去，将腰带从我所藏的地方刨出来，见腰带已经变坏，毫无用了。
verses.textEnNiv: So I went to Perath and dug up the belt and took it from the place where I had hidden it, but now it was ruined and completely useless.
verses.textEnEsv: Then I went to the Euphrates, and dug, and I took the loincloth from the place where I had hidden it. And behold, the loincloth was spoiled; it was good for nothing.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then I went to the Euphrates and dug, and I took the sash from the place where I had hidden it; and there was the sash, ruined. It was profitable for nothing.
verses.textEnNlt: So I went to the Euphrates and dug it out of the hole where I had hidden it. But now it was rotting and falling apart. The loincloth was good for nothing.
verses.textEnNasb: Then I went to the Euphrates and dug, and I took the undergarment from the place where I had hidden it; and behold, the undergarment was ruined, it was completely useless.
verses.textEn: So I went to Perath and dug up the belt and took it from the place where I had hidden it, but now it was ruined and completely useless.

verses.textZh: 那时，耶和华的话临到我，说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，耶和华的话临到我，说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的话临到我说：
verses.textEnNiv: Then the word of the Lord came to me:
verses.textEnEsv: Then the word of the Lord came to me:
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: Then I received this message from the Lord :
verses.textEnNasb: Then the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.textEn: Then the word of the Lord came to me:

verses.textZh: "耶和华这样说：‘我必照样败坏犹大的尊荣和耶路撒冷极大的尊荣。
verses.textZhCnvs: "耶和华这样说：‘我必照样败坏犹大的尊荣和耶路撒冷极大的尊荣。
verses.textZhCuv: 「耶和华如此说：我必照样败坏犹大的骄傲和耶路撒冷的大骄傲。
verses.textEnNiv: "This is what the Lord says: ‘In the same way I will ruin the pride of Judah and the great pride of Jerusalem.
verses.textEnEsv: "Thus says the Lord : Even so will I spoil the pride of Judah and the great pride of Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Thus says the Lord: ‘In this manner I will ruin the pride of Judah and the great pride of Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNlt: "This is what the Lord says: This shows how I will rot away the pride of Judah and Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNasb: "This is what the Lord says: ‘To the same extent I will destroy the pride of Judah and the great pride of Jerusalem.
verses.textEn: "This is what the Lord says: ‘In the same way I will ruin the pride of Judah and the great pride of Jerusalem.

verses.textZh: 这邪恶的人民，不肯听从我的话，他们随着自己顽梗的心行事，随从别的神，事奉敬拜他们；所以他们必像这根腰带，毫无用处。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这邪恶的人民，不肯听从我的话，他们随着自己顽梗的心行事，随从别的神，事奉敬拜他们；所以他们必像这根腰带，毫无用处。
verses.textZhCuv: 这恶民不肯听我的话，按自己顽梗的心而行，随从别神，事奉敬拜，他们也必像这腰带变为无用。」
verses.textEnNiv: These wicked people, who refuse to listen to my words, who follow the stubbornness of their hearts and go after other gods to serve and worship them, will be like this belt—completely useless!
verses.textEnEsv: This evil people, who refuse to hear my words, who stubbornly follow their own heart and have gone after other gods to serve them and worship them, shall be like this loincloth, which is good for nothing.
verses.textEnNkjv: This evil people, who refuse to hear My words, who follow the dictates of their hearts, and walk after other gods to serve them and worship them, shall be just like this sash which is profitable for nothing.
verses.textEnNlt: These wicked people refuse to listen to me. They stubbornly follow their own desires and worship other gods. Therefore, they will become like this loincloth—good for nothing!
verses.textEnNasb: This wicked people, who refuse to listen to My words, who walk in the stubbornness of their hearts and have followed other gods to serve them and to bow down to them, let them be just like this undergarment which is completely useless.
verses.textEn: These wicked people, who refuse to listen to my words, who follow the stubbornness of their hearts and go after other gods to serve and worship them, will be like this belt—completely useless!

verses.textZh: 因为腰带怎样紧贴着人的腰，我也曾怎样使以色列全家和犹大全家紧贴着我，好使他们作我的子民，叫我得名声，得赞美，得荣耀；可是他们却不听从。’"这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为腰带怎样紧贴着人的腰，我也曾怎样使以色列全家和犹大全家紧贴着我，好使他们作我的子民，叫我得名声，得赞美，得荣耀；可是他们却不听从。’"这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华说：「腰带怎样紧贴人腰，照样，我也使以色列全家和犹大全家紧贴我，好叫他们属我为子民，使我得名声，得颂赞，得荣耀；他们却不肯听。」
verses.textEnNiv: For as a belt is bound around the waist, so I bound all the people of Israel and all the people of Judah to me,’ declares the Lord , ‘to be my people for my renown and praise and honor. But they have not listened.’
verses.textEnEsv: For as the loincloth clings to the waist of a man, so I made the whole house of Israel and the whole house of Judah cling to me, declares the Lord , that they might be for me a people, a name, a praise, and a glory, but they would not listen.
verses.textEnNkjv: For as the sash clings to the waist of a man, so I have caused the whole house of Israel and the whole house of Judah to cling to Me,’ says the Lord, ‘that they may become My people, for renown, for praise, and for glory; but they would not hear.’
verses.textEnNlt: As a loincloth clings to a man’s waist, so I created Judah and Israel to cling to me, says the Lord . They were to be my people, my pride, my glory—an honor to my name. But they would not listen to me.
verses.textEnNasb: For as the undergarment clings to the waist of a man, so I made the entire household of Israel and the entire household of Judah cling to Me,’ declares the Lord, ‘so that they might be My people, for renown, for praise, and for glory; but they did not listen.’
verses.textEn: For as a belt is bound around the waist, so I bound all the people of Israel and all the people of Judah to me,’ declares the Lord , ‘to be my people for my renown and praise and honor. But they have not listened.’

verses.textZh: "你要对他们说这话：‘耶和华以色列的神这样说：每一个酒瓶都要盛满酒。’如果他们对你说：‘难道我们不清楚知道每一个酒瓶都要盛满酒吗？’
verses.textZhCnvs: "你要对他们说这话：‘耶和华以色列的神这样说：每一个酒瓶都要盛满酒。’如果他们对你说：‘难道我们不清楚知道每一个酒瓶都要盛满酒吗？’
verses.textZhCuv: 「所以你要对他们说：『耶和华－以色列的神如此说：各坛都要盛满了酒。』他们必对你说：『我们岂不确知各坛都要盛满了酒呢？』
verses.textEnNiv: "Say to them: ‘This is what the Lord , the God of Israel, says: Every wineskin should be filled with wine.’ And if they say to you, ‘Don’t we know that every wineskin should be filled with wine?’
verses.textEnEsv: "You shall speak to them this word: ‘Thus says the Lord , the God of Israel, "Every jar shall be filled with wine."’ And they will say to you, ‘Do we not indeed know that every jar will be filled with wine?’
verses.textEnNkjv: "Therefore you shall speak to them this word: ‘Thus says the Lord God of Israel: "Every bottle shall be filled with wine." ’ And they will say to you, ‘Do we not certainly know that every bottle will be filled with wine?’
verses.textEnNlt: "So tell them, ‘This is what the Lord , the God of Israel, says: May all your jars be filled with wine.’ And they will reply, ‘Of course! Jars are made to be filled with wine!’
verses.textEnNasb: "Therefore you are to speak this word to them. ‘This is what the Lord, the God of Israel says: "Every jug is to be filled with wine." ’ And when they say to you, ‘Do we not very well know that every jug is to be filled with wine?’
verses.textEn: "Say to them: ‘This is what the Lord , the God of Israel, says: Every wineskin should be filled with wine.’ And if they say to you, ‘Don’t we know that every wineskin should be filled with wine?’

verses.textZh: 你就要对他们说：‘耶和华这样说：看哪！我要使这地所有的居民，就是那些坐大卫王位的君王，以及祭司、先知和耶路撒冷所有的居民，都完全醉倒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你就要对他们说：‘耶和华这样说：看哪！我要使这地所有的居民，就是那些坐大卫王位的君王，以及祭司、先知和耶路撒冷所有的居民，都完全醉倒。
verses.textZhCuv: 你就要对他们说：『耶和华如此说：我必使这地的一切居民，就是坐大卫宝座的君王和祭司，与先知，并耶路撒冷的一切居民，都酩酊大醉。』」
verses.textEnNiv: then tell them, ‘This is what the Lord says: I am going to fill with drunkenness all who live in this land, including the kings who sit on David’s throne, the priests, the prophets and all those living in Jerusalem.
verses.textEnEsv: Then you shall say to them, ‘Thus says the Lord : Behold, I will fill with drunkenness all the inhabitants of this land: the kings who sit on David’s throne, the priests, the prophets, and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Then you shall say to them, ‘Thus says the Lord: "Behold, I will fill all the inhabitants of this land—even the kings who sit on David’s throne, the priests, the prophets, and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem— with drunkenness!
verses.textEnNlt: "Then tell them, ‘No, this is what the Lord means: I will fill everyone in this land with drunkenness—from the king sitting on David’s throne to the priests and the prophets, right down to the common people of Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNasb: then say to them, ‘This is what the Lord says: "Behold, I am going to fill all the inhabitants of this land—the kings who sit for David on his throne, the priests, the prophets, and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem—with drunkenness!
verses.textEn: then tell them, ‘This is what the Lord says: I am going to fill with drunkenness all who live in this land, including the kings who sit on David’s throne, the priests, the prophets and all those living in Jerusalem.

verses.textZh: 我要使他们彼此碰撞，连父子也要互相碰撞；我必不爱惜、不可怜，也不怜悯他们，我必把他们灭绝。’"这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要使他们彼此碰撞，连父子也要互相碰撞；我必不爱惜、不可怜，也不怜悯他们，我必把他们灭绝。’"这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华说：「我要使他们彼此相碰，就是父与子彼此相碰；我必不可怜，不顾惜，不怜悯，以致灭绝他们。」
verses.textEnNiv: I will smash them one against the other, parents and children alike, declares the Lord . I will allow no pity or mercy or compassion to keep me from destroying them.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: And I will dash them one against another, fathers and sons together, declares the Lord . I will not pity or spare or have compassion, that I should not destroy them.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: And I will dash them one against another, even the fathers and the sons together," says the Lord. "I will not pity nor spare nor have mercy, but will destroy them." ’ "
verses.textEnNlt: I will smash them against each other, even parents against children, says the Lord . I will not let my pity or mercy or compassion keep me from destroying them.’"
verses.textEnNasb: Then I will smash them against each other, both the fathers and the sons together," declares the Lord. "I will not have compassion nor be troubled nor take pity so as to keep from destroying them." ’ "
verses.textEn: I will smash them one against the other, parents and children alike, declares the Lord . I will allow no pity or mercy or compassion to keep me from destroying them.’ "

verses.textZh: 你们要听，要留心听，不要骄傲； 因为是耶和华说的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要听，要留心听，不要骄傲； 因为是耶和华说的。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们当听，当侧耳而听。 不要骄傲，因为耶和华已经说了。
verses.textEnNiv: Hear and pay attention, do not be arrogant, for the Lord has spoken.
verses.textEnEsv: Hear and give ear; be not proud, for the Lord has spoken.
verses.textEnNkjv: Hear and give ear: Do not be proud, For the Lord has spoken.
verses.textEnNlt: Listen and pay attention! Do not be arrogant, for the Lord has spoken.
verses.textEnNasb: Listen and pay attention, do not be haughty; For the Lord has spoken.
verses.textEn: Hear and pay attention, do not be arrogant, for the Lord has spoken.

verses.textZh: 耶和华你们的神还没有使黑暗临到以前， 你们的脚还没有在昏暗的山上绊倒之前， 你们要把荣耀归给他。 你们期待光明， 他却把光明变为死荫， 使光明变成黝黑。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华你们的神还没有使黑暗临到以前， 你们的脚还没有在昏暗的山上绊倒之前， 你们要把荣耀归给他。 你们期待光明， 他却把光明变为死荫， 使光明变成黝黑。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华－你们的神未使黑暗来到， 你们的脚未在昏暗山上绊跌之先， 当将荣耀归给他； 免得你们盼望光明， 他使光明变为死荫， 成为幽暗。
verses.textEnNiv: Give glory to the Lord your God before he brings the darkness, before your feet stumble on the darkening hills. You hope for light, but he will turn it to utter darkness and change it to deep gloom.
verses.textEnEsv: Give glory to the Lord your God before he brings darkness, before your feet stumble on the twilight mountains, and while you look for light he turns it into gloom and makes it deep darkness.
verses.textEnNkjv: Give glory to the Lord your God Before He causes darkness, And before your feet stumble On the dark mountains, And while you are looking for light, He turns it into the shadow of death And makes it dense darkness.
verses.textEnNlt: Give glory to the Lord your God before it is too late. Acknowledge him before he brings darkness upon you, causing you to stumble and fall on the darkening mountains. For then, when you look for light, you will find only terrible darkness and gloom.
verses.textEnNasb: Give glory to the Lord your God Before He brings darkness And before your feet stumble On the mountains in the dark, And while you are hoping for light He makes it into gloom, And turns it into thick darkness.
verses.textEn: Give glory to the Lord your God before he brings the darkness, before your feet stumble on the darkening hills. You hope for light, but he will turn it to utter darkness and change it to deep gloom.

verses.textZh: 如果你们不听从， 我必因你们的骄傲暗暗哭泣； 我的眼必痛哭流泪， 因为耶和华的羊群被掳去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果你们不听从， 我必因你们的骄傲暗暗哭泣； 我的眼必痛哭流泪， 因为耶和华的羊群被掳去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们若不听这话， 我必因你们的骄傲在暗地哭泣； 我眼必痛哭流泪， 因为耶和华的群众被掳去了。
verses.textEnNiv: If you do not listen, I will weep in secret because of your pride; my eyes will weep bitterly, overflowing with tears, because the Lord ’s flock will be taken captive.
verses.textEnEsv: But if you will not listen, my soul will weep in secret for your pride; my eyes will weep bitterly and run down with tears, because the Lord ’s flock has been taken captive.
verses.textEnNkjv: But if you will not hear it, My soul will weep in secret for your pride; My eyes will weep bitterly And run down with tears, Because the Lord’s flock has been taken captive.
verses.textEnNlt: And if you still refuse to listen, I will weep alone because of your pride. My eyes will overflow with tears, because the Lord ’s flock will be led away into exile.
verses.textEnNasb: But if you do not listen to it, My soul will weep in secret for such pride; And my eyes will shed And stream down tears, Because the flock of the Lord has been taken captive.
verses.textEn: If you do not listen, I will weep in secret because of your pride; my eyes will weep bitterly, overflowing with tears, because the Lord ’s flock will be taken captive.

verses.textZh: 你要对君王和太后说： "你们应从宝座下来， 因为华丽的冠冕 已经从你们的头上脱下来了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要对君王和太后说： "你们应从宝座下来， 因为华丽的冠冕 已经从你们的头上脱下来了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 你要对君王和太后说： 你们当自卑，坐在下边； 因你们的头巾， 就是你们的华冠，已经脱落了。
verses.textEnNiv: Say to the king and to the queen mother, "Come down from your thrones, for your glorious crowns will fall from your heads."
verses.textEnEsv: Say to the king and the queen mother: "Take a lowly seat, for your beautiful crown has come down from your head."
verses.textEnNkjv: Say to the king and to the queen mother, "Humble yourselves; Sit down, For your rule shall collapse, the crown of your glory."
verses.textEnNlt: Say to the king and his mother, "Come down from your thrones and sit in the dust, for your glorious crowns will soon be snatched from your heads."
verses.textEnNasb: Say to the king and the queen mother, "Take a lowly seat, For your beautiful crown Has come down from your head."
verses.textEn: Say to the king and to the queen mother, "Come down from your thrones, for your glorious crowns will fall from your heads."

verses.textZh: 南地的城市已被围困， 没有人能解围； 整个犹大都被掳走， 全被掳去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 南地的城市已被围困， 没有人能解围； 整个犹大都被掳走， 全被掳去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 南方的城尽都关闭， 无人开放； 犹大全被掳掠， 且掳掠净尽。
verses.textEnNiv: The cities in the Negev will be shut up, and there will be no one to open them. All Judah will be carried into exile, carried completely away.
verses.textEnEsv: The cities of the Negeb are shut up, with none to open them; all Judah is taken into exile, wholly taken into exile.
verses.textEnNkjv: The cities of the South shall be shut up, And no one shall open them; Judah shall be carried away captive, all of it; It shall be wholly carried away captive.
verses.textEnNlt: The towns of the Negev will close their gates, and no one will be able to open them. The people of Judah will be taken away as captives. All will be carried into exile.
verses.textEnNasb: The cities of the Negev have been locked up, And there is no one to open them; All Judah has been taken into exile, Wholly taken into exile.
verses.textEn: The cities in the Negev will be shut up, and there will be no one to open them. All Judah will be carried into exile, carried completely away.

verses.textZh: 耶路撒冷啊！你要举目观看 那些从北方来的人。 从前交给你的羊群， 就是你引以为荣的群羊，现今在哪里呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶路撒冷啊！你要举目观看 那些从北方来的人。 从前交给你的羊群， 就是你引以为荣的群羊，现今在哪里呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要举目观看从北方来的人。 先前赐给你的群众， 就是你佳美的群众， 如今在哪里呢？
verses.textEnNiv: Look up and see those who are coming from the north. Where is the flock that was entrusted to you, the sheep of which you boasted?
verses.textEnEsv: "Lift up your eyes and see those who come from the north. Where is the flock that was given you, your beautiful flock?
