verses.textEnNkjv: Lift up your eyes and see Those who come from the north. Where is the flock that was given to you, Your beautiful sheep?
verses.textEnNlt: Open up your eyes and see the armies marching down from the north! Where is your flock— your beautiful flock— that he gave you to care for?
verses.textEnNasb: "Raise your eyes and see Those coming from the north. Where is the flock that was given you, Your beautiful sheep?
verses.textEn: Look up and see those who are coming from the north. Where is the flock that was entrusted to you, the sheep of which you boasted?

verses.textZh: 耶和华立你自己结交 的盟友 为首领管辖你， 那时，你还有甚么话说呢？ 痛苦岂不把你抓住， 好象妇女生产时的痛苦一样吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华立你自己结交 的盟友 为首领管辖你， 那时，你还有甚么话说呢？ 痛苦岂不把你抓住， 好象妇女生产时的痛苦一样吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华立你自己所交的朋友为首，辖制你， 那时你还有什么话说呢？ 痛苦岂不将你抓住像产难的妇人吗？
verses.textEnNiv: What will you say when the Lord sets over you those you cultivated as your special allies? Will not pain grip you like that of a woman in labor?
verses.textEnEsv: What will you say when they set as head over you those whom you yourself have taught to be friends to you? Will not pangs take hold of you like those of a woman in labor?
verses.textEnNkjv: What will you say when He punishes you? For you have taught them Tobe chieftains, to be head over you. Will not pangs seize you, Like a woman in labor?
verses.textEnNlt: What will you say when the Lord takes the allies you have cultivated and appoints them as your rulers? Pangs of anguish will grip you, like those of a woman in labor!
verses.textEnNasb: "What will you say when He appoints over you— And you yourself had taught them— Former companions to be head over you? Will sharp pains not take hold of you Like a woman in childbirth?
verses.textEn: What will you say when the Lord sets over you those you cultivated as your special allies? Will not pain grip you like that of a woman in labor?

verses.textZh: 如果你心里问： "这些事为甚么发生在我身上呢？" 这是由于你极大的罪孽； 你的袍子被掀起， 你的下体 暴露出来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果你心里问： "这些事为甚么发生在我身上呢？" 这是由于你极大的罪孽； 你的袍子被掀起， 你的下体 暴露出来。
verses.textZhCuv: 你若心里说：这一切事为何临到我呢？ 你的衣襟揭起， 你的脚跟受伤， 是因你的罪孽甚多。
verses.textEnNiv: And if you ask yourself, "Why has this happened to me?"— it is because of your many sins that your skirts have been torn off and your body mistreated.
verses.textEnEsv: And if you say in your heart, ‘Why have these things come upon me?’ it is for the greatness of your iniquity that your skirts are lifted up and you suffer violence.
verses.textEnNkjv: And if you say in your heart, "Why have these things come upon me?" For the greatness of your iniquity Your skirts have been uncovered, Your heels made bare.
verses.textEnNlt: You may ask yourself, "Why is all this happening to me?" It is because of your many sins! That is why you have been stripped and raped by invading armies.
verses.textEnNasb: "If you say in your heart, ‘Why have these things happened to me?’ Because of the magnitude of your wrongdoing Your skirts have been removed And your heels have suffered violence.
verses.textEn: And if you ask yourself, "Why has this happened to me?"— it is because of your many sins that your skirts have been torn off and your body mistreated.

verses.textZh: 古实人怎能改变他的肤色？ 花豹怎能改变牠的斑点？ 你们这些惯作坏事的人， 又怎能行善呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 古实人怎能改变他的肤色？ 花豹怎能改变牠的斑点？ 你们这些惯作坏事的人， 又怎能行善呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 古实人岂能改变皮肤呢？ 豹岂能改变斑点呢？ 若能，你们这习惯行恶的便能行善了。
verses.textEnNiv: Can an Ethiopian change his skin or a leopard its spots? Neither can you do good who are accustomed to doing evil.
verses.textEnEsv: Can the Ethiopian change his skin or the leopard his spots? Then also you can do good who are accustomed to do evil.
verses.textEnNkjv: Can the Ethiopian change his skin or the leopard its spots? Then may you also do good who are accustomed to do evil.
verses.textEnNlt: Can an Ethiopian change the color of his skin? Can a leopard take away its spots? Neither can you start doing good, for you have always done evil.
verses.textEnNasb: "Can the Ethiopian change his skin, Or the leopard his spots? Then you as well can do good Who are accustomed to doing evil.
verses.textEn: Can an Ethiopian change his skin or a leopard its spots? Neither can you do good who are accustomed to doing evil.

verses.textZh: "因此，我要使你们 四散， 像被旷野的风吹走的碎秸一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: "因此，我要使你们 四散， 像被旷野的风吹走的碎秸一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以我必用旷野的风吹散他们， 像吹过的碎秸一样。
verses.textEnNiv: "I will scatter you like chaff driven by the desert wind.
verses.textEnEsv: I will scatter you like chaff driven by the wind from the desert.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Therefore I will scatter them like stubble That passes away by the wind of the wilderness.
verses.textEnNlt: "I will scatter you like chaff that is blown away by the desert winds.
verses.textEnNasb: "Therefore I will scatter them like drifting straw To the desert wind.
verses.textEn: "I will scatter you like chaff driven by the desert wind.

verses.textZh: 这是你应得的，是我量给你的分。" 这是耶和华的宣告。 "因为你忘记了我， 去倚靠虚假的偶像；
verses.textZhCnvs: 这是你应得的，是我量给你的分。" 这是耶和华的宣告。 "因为你忘记了我， 去倚靠虚假的偶像；
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华说：这是你所当得的， 是我量给你的分； 因为你忘记我， 倚靠虚假 。
verses.textEnNiv: This is your lot, the portion I have decreed for you," declares the Lord , "because you have forgotten me and trusted in false gods.
verses.textEnEsv: This is your lot, the portion I have measured out to you, declares the Lord , because you have forgotten me and trusted in lies.
verses.textEnNkjv: This is your lot, The portion of your measures from Me," says the Lord, "Because you have forgotten Me And trusted in falsehood.
verses.textEnNlt: This is your allotment, the portion I have assigned to you," says the Lord , "for you have forgotten me, putting your trust in false gods.
verses.textEnNasb: "This is your lot, the portion measured to you From Me," declares the Lord, "Because you have forgotten Me And trusted in falsehood.
verses.textEn: This is your lot, the portion I have decreed for you," declares the Lord , "because you have forgotten me and trusted in false gods.

verses.textZh: 所以，我必把你的袍子掀到你的脸上， 使人看见你的丑态。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以，我必把你的袍子掀到你的脸上， 使人看见你的丑态。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以我要揭起你的衣襟， 蒙在你脸上， 显出你的丑陋。
verses.textEnNiv: I will pull up your skirts over your face that your shame may be seen—
verses.textEnEsv: I myself will lift up your skirts over your face, and your shame will be seen.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore I will uncover your skirts over your face, That your shame may appear.
verses.textEnNlt: I myself will strip you and expose you to shame.
verses.textEnNasb: "So I Myself have stripped your skirts off over your face, So that your shame will be seen.
verses.textEn: I will pull up your skirts over your face that your shame may be seen—

verses.textZh: 你的奸淫，你淫荡的叫声， 你邪淫的恶行， 在山上，在田野间， 你那些可憎的事我都看见了。 耶路撒冷啊，你有祸了！ 你这样不洁净要到几时呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你的奸淫，你淫荡的叫声， 你邪淫的恶行， 在山上，在田野间， 你那些可憎的事我都看见了。 耶路撒冷啊，你有祸了！ 你这样不洁净要到几时呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 你那些可憎恶之事－ 就是在田野的山上行奸淫， 发嘶声，做淫乱的事－ 我都看见了。 耶路撒冷啊，你有祸了！ 你不肯洁净，还要到几时呢？
verses.textEnNiv: your adulteries and lustful neighings, your shameless prostitution! I have seen your detestable acts on the hills and in the fields. Woe to you, Jerusalem! How long will you be unclean?"
verses.textEnEsv: I have seen your abominations, your adulteries and neighings, your lewd whorings, on the hills in the field. Woe to you, O Jerusalem! How long will it be before you are made clean?"
verses.textEnNkjv: I have seen your adulteries And your lustful neighings, The lewdness of your harlotry, Your abominations on the hills in the fields. Woe to you, O Jerusalem! Will you still not be made clean?"
verses.textEnNlt: I have seen your adultery and lust, and your disgusting idol worship out in the fields and on the hills. What sorrow awaits you, Jerusalem! How long before you are pure?"
verses.textEnNasb: "As for your adulteries and your lustful neighings, The outrageous sin of your prostitution On the hills in the field, I have seen your abominations. Woe to you, Jerusalem! How long will you remain unclean?"
verses.textEn: your adulteries and lustful neighings, your shameless prostitution! I have seen your detestable acts on the hills and in the fields. Woe to you, Jerusalem! How long will you be unclean?"

verses.textZh: 耶和华的话临到耶利米，是关于旱灾的事：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的话临到耶利米，是关于旱灾的事：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华论到干旱之灾的话临到耶利米：
verses.textEnNiv: This is the word of the Lord that came to Jeremiah concerning the drought:
verses.textEnEsv: The word of the Lord that came to Jeremiah concerning the drought:
verses.textEnNkjv: The word of the Lord that came to Jeremiah concerning the droughts.
verses.textEnNlt: This message came to Jeremiah from the Lord , explaining why he was holding back the rain:
verses.textEnNasb: That which came as the word of the Lord to Jeremiah regarding the drought:
verses.textEn: This is the word of the Lord that came to Jeremiah concerning the drought:

verses.textZh: "犹大悲哀， 她的城镇 衰落， 人人都坐在地上悲伤痛哭； 耶路撒冷的哀声上达于天。
verses.textZhCnvs: "犹大悲哀， 她的城镇 衰落， 人人都坐在地上悲伤痛哭； 耶路撒冷的哀声上达于天。
verses.textZhCuv: 犹大悲哀，城门衰败。 众人披上黑衣坐在地上； 耶路撒冷的哀声上达。
verses.textEnNiv: "Judah mourns, her cities languish; they wail for the land, and a cry goes up from Jerusalem.
verses.textEnEsv: "Judah mourns, and her gates languish; her people lament on the ground, and the cry of Jerusalem goes up.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Judah mourns, And her gates languish; They mourn for the land, And the cry of Jerusalem has gone up.
verses.textEnNlt: "Judah wilts; commerce at the city gates grinds to a halt. All the people sit on the ground in mourning, and a great cry rises from Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNasb: "Judah mourns And her gates languish; Her people sit on the ground in mourning garments, And the cry of Jerusalem has ascended.
verses.textEn: "Judah mourns, her cities languish; they wail for the land, and a cry goes up from Jerusalem.

verses.textZh: 他们的显贵差派童仆去打水； 童仆来到池边，却找不到水， 就拿着空的器皿回来； 他们失望难过，蒙着自己的头。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们的显贵差派童仆去打水； 童仆来到池边，却找不到水， 就拿着空的器皿回来； 他们失望难过，蒙着自己的头。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们的贵胄打发家僮打水； 他们来到水池， 见没有水，就拿着空器皿， 蒙羞惭愧，抱头而回。
verses.textEnNiv: The nobles send their servants for water; they go to the cisterns but find no water. They return with their jars unfilled; dismayed and despairing, they cover their heads.
verses.textEnEsv: Her nobles send their servants for water; they come to the cisterns; they find no water; they return with their vessels empty; they are ashamed and confounded and cover their heads.
verses.textEnNkjv: Their nobles have sent their lads for water; They went to the cisterns and found no water. They returned with their vessels empty; They were ashamed and confounded And covered their heads.
verses.textEnNlt: The nobles send servants to get water, but all the wells are dry. The servants return with empty pitchers, confused and desperate, covering their heads in grief.
verses.textEnNasb: "Their nobles have sent their servants for water; They have come to the cisterns and found no water. They have returned with their containers empty; They have been put to shame and humiliated, And they cover their heads,
verses.textEn: The nobles send their servants for water; they go to the cisterns but find no water. They return with their jars unfilled; dismayed and despairing, they cover their heads.

verses.textZh: 土地干裂， 因为地上没有雨水； 农夫失望， 都蒙着自己的头。
verses.textZhCnvs: 土地干裂， 因为地上没有雨水； 农夫失望， 都蒙着自己的头。
verses.textZhCuv: 耕地的也蒙羞抱头； 因为无雨降在地上， 地都干裂。
verses.textEnNiv: The ground is cracked because there is no rain in the land; the farmers are dismayed and cover their heads.
verses.textEnEsv: Because of the ground that is dismayed, since there is no rain on the land, the farmers are ashamed; they cover their heads.
verses.textEnNkjv: Because the ground is parched, For there was no rain in the land, The plowmen were ashamed; They covered their heads.
verses.textEnNlt: The ground is parched and cracked for lack of rain. The farmers are deeply troubled; they, too, cover their heads.
verses.textEnNasb: Because the ground is cracked, For there has been no rain on the land. The farmers have been put to shame, They have covered their heads.
verses.textEn: The ground is cracked because there is no rain in the land; the farmers are dismayed and cover their heads.

verses.textZh: 甚至母鹿在田野生产了小鹿，也得把牠丢弃， 因为没有青草。
verses.textZhCnvs: 甚至母鹿在田野生产了小鹿，也得把牠丢弃， 因为没有青草。
verses.textZhCuv: 田野的母鹿生下小鹿，就撇弃， 因为无草。
verses.textEnNiv: Even the doe in the field deserts her newborn fawn because there is no grass.
verses.textEnEsv: Even the doe in the field forsakes her newborn fawn because there is no grass.
verses.textEnNkjv: Yes, the deer also gave birth in the field, But left because there was no grass.
verses.textEnNlt: Even the doe abandons her newborn fawn because there is no grass in the field.
verses.textEnNasb: "For even the doe in the field has given birth only to abandon her young, Because there is no grass.
verses.textEn: Even the doe in the field deserts her newborn fawn because there is no grass.

verses.textZh: 野驴站在光秃的高冈上， 像野狗喘着气； 牠们双目发呆， 因为没有青草。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 野驴站在光秃的高冈上， 像野狗喘着气； 牠们双目发呆， 因为没有青草。"
verses.textZhCuv: 野驴站在净光的高处，喘气好像野狗； 因为无草，眼目失明。
verses.textEnNiv: Wild donkeys stand on the barren heights and pant like jackals; their eyes fail for lack of food."
verses.textEnEsv: The wild donkeys stand on the bare heights; they pant for air like jackals; their eyes fail because there is no vegetation.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the wild donkeys stood in the desolate heights; They sniffed at the wind like jackals; Their eyes failed because therewas no grass."
verses.textEnNlt: The wild donkeys stand on the bare hills panting like thirsty jackals. They strain their eyes looking for grass, but there is none to be found."
verses.textEnNasb: "The wild donkeys stand on the bare heights; They pant for air like jackals, Their eyes fail Because there is no vegetation.
verses.textEn: Wild donkeys stand on the barren heights and pant like jackals; their eyes fail for lack of food."

verses.textZh: "耶和华啊！即使我们的罪孽指证我们， 还求你因你名的缘故施行拯救。 我们实在多次背道， 得罪了你。
verses.textZhCnvs: "耶和华啊！即使我们的罪孽指证我们， 还求你因你名的缘故施行拯救。 我们实在多次背道， 得罪了你。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，我们的罪孽虽然作见证告我们， 还求你为你名的缘故行事。 我们本是多次背道，得罪了你。
verses.textEnNiv: Although our sins testify against us, do something, Lord , for the sake of your name. For we have often rebelled; we have sinned against you.
verses.textEnEsv: "Though our iniquities testify against us, act, O Lord , for your name’s sake; for our backslidings are many; we have sinned against you.
verses.textEnNkjv: O Lord, though our iniquities testify against us, Do it for Your name’s sake; For our backslidings are many, We have sinned against You.
verses.textEnNlt: The people say, "Our wickedness has caught up with us, Lord , but help us for the sake of your own reputation. We have turned away from you and sinned against you again and again.
verses.textEnNasb: "Though our wrongdoings testify against us, Lord, act for the sake of Your name! Our apostasies have indeed been many, We have sinned against You.
verses.textEn: Although our sins testify against us, do something, Lord , for the sake of your name. For we have often rebelled; we have sinned against you.

verses.textZh: 以色列的盼望啊！ 以色列遭难时的拯救者啊！ 你为甚么在本地像一个寄居的人， 又像个只住宿一夜的旅客呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列的盼望啊！ 以色列遭难时的拯救者啊！ 你为甚么在本地像一个寄居的人， 又像个只住宿一夜的旅客呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列所盼望、在患难时作他救主的啊， 你为何在这地像寄居的， 又像行路的只住一宵呢？
verses.textEnNiv: You who are the hope of Israel, its Savior in times of distress, why are you like a stranger in the land, like a traveler who stays only a night?
verses.textEnEsv: O you hope of Israel, its savior in time of trouble, why should you be like a stranger in the land, like a traveler who turns aside to tarry for a night?
verses.textEnNkjv: O the Hope of Israel, his Savior in time of trouble, Why should You be like a stranger in the land, And like a traveler who turns aside to tarry for a night?
verses.textEnNlt: O Hope of Israel, our Savior in times of trouble, why are you like a stranger to us? Why are you like a traveler passing through the land, stopping only for the night?
verses.textEnNasb: "Hope of Israel, Its Savior in time of distress, Why are You like a stranger in the land, Or like a traveler who has pitched his tent for the night?
verses.textEn: You who are the hope of Israel, its Savior in times of distress, why are you like a stranger in the land, like a traveler who stays only a night?

verses.textZh: 你为甚么像个受惊的人， 又像个不能拯救人的勇士呢？ 耶和华啊！你是在我们中间， 我们是称为你名下的人， 求你不要离弃我们。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你为甚么像个受惊的人， 又像个不能拯救人的勇士呢？ 耶和华啊！你是在我们中间， 我们是称为你名下的人， 求你不要离弃我们。"
verses.textZhCuv: 你为何像受惊的人， 像不能救人的勇士呢？ 耶和华啊，你仍在我们中间； 我们也称为你名下的人， 求你不要离开我们。
verses.textEnNiv: Why are you like a man taken by surprise, like a warrior powerless to save? You are among us, Lord , and we bear your name; do not forsake us!
verses.textEnEsv: Why should you be like a man confused, like a mighty warrior who cannot save? Yet you, O Lord , are in the midst of us, and we are called by your name; do not leave us."
verses.textEnNkjv: Why should You be like a man astonished, Like a mighty one who cannot save? Yet You, O Lord, are in our midst, And we are called by Your name; Do not leave us!
verses.textEnNlt: Are you also confused? Is our champion helpless to save us? You are right here among us, Lord . We are known as your people. Please don’t abandon us now!"
verses.textEnNasb: "Why are You like a confused person, Like a warrior who cannot save? Yet You are in our midst, Lord, And we are called by Your name; Do not leave us!"
verses.textEn: Why are you like a man taken by surprise, like a warrior powerless to save? You are among us, Lord , and we bear your name; do not forsake us!

verses.textZh: 耶和华论到这人民这样说："他们喜爱这样流荡，不约束自己的脚；因此耶和华不悦纳他们，现在就要记念他们的罪孽，并要惩罚他们的罪恶。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华论到这人民这样说："他们喜爱这样流荡，不约束自己的脚；因此耶和华不悦纳他们，现在就要记念他们的罪孽，并要惩罚他们的罪恶。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华对这百姓如此说： 这百姓喜爱妄行 ， 不禁止脚步， 所以耶和华不悦纳他们。 现今要记念他们的罪孽， 追讨他们的罪恶。
verses.textEnNiv: This is what the Lord says about this people: "They greatly love to wander; they do not restrain their feet. So the Lord does not accept them; he will now remember their wickedness and punish them for their sins."
verses.textEnEsv: Thus says the Lord concerning this people: "They have loved to wander thus; they have not restrained their feet; therefore the Lord does not accept them; now he will remember their iniquity and punish their sins."
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus says the Lord to this people: "Thus they have loved to wander; They have not restrained their feet. Therefore the Lord does not accept them; He will remember their iniquity now, And punish their sins."
verses.textEnNlt: So this is what the Lord says to his people: "You love to wander far from me and do not restrain yourselves. Therefore, I will no longer accept you as my people. Now I will remember all your wickedness and will punish you for your sins."
verses.textEnNasb: This is what the Lord says to this people: "So much they have loved to wander; they have not restrained their feet. Therefore the Lord does not accept them; now He will remember their wrongdoing and call their sins to account."
verses.textEn: This is what the Lord says about this people: "They greatly love to wander; they do not restrain their feet. So the Lord does not accept them; he will now remember their wickedness and punish them for their sins."

verses.textZh: 耶和华对我说："不要为这人民祈求好处；
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对我说："不要为这人民祈求好处；
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华又对我说：「不要为这百姓祈祷求好处。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the Lord said to me, "Do not pray for the well-being of this people.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord said to me: "Do not pray for the welfare of this people.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Lord said to me, "Do not pray for this people, for their good.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord said to me, "Do not pray for these people anymore.
verses.textEnNasb: So the Lord said to me, "Do not pray for a good outcome on behalf of this people.
verses.textEn: Then the Lord said to me, "Do not pray for the well-being of this people.

verses.textZh: 即使他们禁食，我也不会听他们的呼求；即使他们献上燔祭和素祭，我也不会悦纳；我却要用刀剑、饥荒和瘟疫去灭尽他们。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 即使他们禁食，我也不会听他们的呼求；即使他们献上燔祭和素祭，我也不会悦纳；我却要用刀剑、饥荒和瘟疫去灭尽他们。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们禁食的时候，我不听他们的呼求；他们献燔祭和素祭，我也不悦纳；我却要用刀剑、饥荒、瘟疫灭绝他们。」
verses.textEnNiv: Although they fast, I will not listen to their cry; though they offer burnt offerings and grain offerings, I will not accept them. Instead, I will destroy them with the sword, famine and plague."
verses.textEnEsv: Though they fast, I will not hear their cry, and though they offer burnt offering and grain offering, I will not accept them. But I will consume them by the sword, by famine, and by pestilence."
verses.textEnNkjv: When they fast, I will not hear their cry; and when they offer burnt offering and grain offering, I will not accept them. But I will consume them by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence."
verses.textEnNlt: When they fast, I will pay no attention. When they present their burnt offerings and grain offerings to me, I will not accept them. Instead, I will devour them with war, famine, and disease."
verses.textEnNasb: When they fast, I am not going to listen to their cry; and when they offer burnt offering and grain offering, I am not going to accept them. Rather, I am going to put an end to them by the sword, famine, and plague."
verses.textEn: Although they fast, I will not listen to their cry; though they offer burnt offerings and grain offerings, I will not accept them. Instead, I will destroy them with the sword, famine and plague."

verses.textZh: 我就说："唉，主耶和华啊！你看，那些先知常对他们说：‘你们必不会看见刀剑，也必不会有饥荒；因为我耶和华要在这地方赐给你们恒久的平安。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我就说："唉，主耶和华啊！你看，那些先知常对他们说：‘你们必不会看见刀剑，也必不会有饥荒；因为我耶和华要在这地方赐给你们恒久的平安。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 我就说：「唉！主耶和华啊，那些先知常对他们说：『你们必不看见刀剑，也不遭遇饥荒；耶和华要在这地方赐你们长久的平安。』」
verses.textEnNiv: But I said, "Alas, Sovereign Lord ! The prophets keep telling them, ‘You will not see the sword or suffer famine. Indeed, I will give you lasting peace in this place.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: Then I said: "Ah, Lord God , behold, the prophets say to them, ‘You shall not see the sword, nor shall you have famine, but I will give you assured peace in this place.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then I said, "Ah, Lord God! Behold, the prophets say to them, ‘You shall not see the sword, nor shall you have famine, but I will give you assured peace in this place.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: Then I said, "O Sovereign Lord , their prophets are telling them, ‘All is well—no war or famine will come. The Lord will surely send you peace.’"
verses.textEnNasb: But I said, "Oh, Lord God! Behold, the prophets are telling them, ‘You will not see a sword, nor will you have famine; on the contrary, I will give you lasting peace in this place.’ "
verses.textEn: But I said, "Alas, Sovereign Lord ! The prophets keep telling them, ‘You will not see the sword or suffer famine. Indeed, I will give you lasting peace in this place.’ "

verses.textZh: 耶和华对我说："那些先知借我的名说假预言；我并没有差遣他们，没有吩咐他们，也没有向他们说话。他们对你们所预言的，是虚假的异象、占卜的预兆、虚无的事，和他们自己心里的诡诈。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对我说："那些先知借我的名说假预言；我并没有差遣他们，没有吩咐他们，也没有向他们说话。他们对你们所预言的，是虚假的异象、占卜的预兆、虚无的事，和他们自己心里的诡诈。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华对我说：「那些先知托我的名说假预言，我并没有打发他们，没有吩咐他们，也没有对他们说话；他们向你们预言的，乃是虚假的异象和占卜，并虚无的事，以及本心的诡诈。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the Lord said to me, "The prophets are prophesying lies in my name. I have not sent them or appointed them or spoken to them. They are prophesying to you false visions, divinations, idolatries and the delusions of their own minds.
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord said to me: "The prophets are prophesying lies in my name. I did not send them, nor did I command them or speak to them. They are prophesying to you a lying vision, worthless divination, and the deceit of their own minds.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Lord said to me, "The prophets prophesy lies in My name. I have not sent them, commanded them, nor spoken to them; they prophesy to you a false vision, divination, a worthless thing, and the deceit of their heart.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord said, "These prophets are telling lies in my name. I did not send them or tell them to speak. I did not give them any messages. They prophesy of visions and revelations they have never seen or heard. They speak foolishness made up in their own lying hearts.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord said to me, "The prophets are prophesying falsehood in My name. I have neither sent them nor commanded them, nor spoken to them; they are prophesying to you a false vision, divination, futility, and the deception of their own minds.
verses.textEn: Then the Lord said to me, "The prophets are prophesying lies in my name. I have not sent them or appointed them or spoken to them. They are prophesying to you false visions, divinations, idolatries and the delusions of their own minds.

verses.textZh: 因此，耶和华这样说："关于那些借我名说预言的先知，我并没有差遣他们，他们竟说：‘这地必不会有刀剑和饥荒。’那些先知必被刀剑和饥荒灭绝。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，耶和华这样说："关于那些借我名说预言的先知，我并没有差遣他们，他们竟说：‘这地必不会有刀剑和饥荒。’那些先知必被刀剑和饥荒灭绝。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以耶和华如此说：论到托我名说预言的那些先知，我并没有打发他们；他们还说这地不能有刀剑饥荒，其实那些先知必被刀剑饥荒灭绝。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore this is what the Lord says about the prophets who are prophesying in my name: I did not send them, yet they are saying, ‘No sword or famine will touch this land.’ Those same prophets will perish by sword and famine.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore thus says the Lord concerning the prophets who prophesy in my name although I did not send them, and who say, ‘Sword and famine shall not come upon this land’: By sword and famine those prophets shall be consumed.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore thus says the Lord concerning the prophets who prophesy in My name, whom I did not send, and who say, ‘Sword and famine shall not be in this land’—‘By sword and famine those prophets shall be consumed!
verses.textEnNlt: Therefore, this is what the Lord says: I will punish these lying prophets, for they have spoken in my name even though I never sent them. They say that no war or famine will come, but they themselves will die by war and famine!
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore this is what the Lord says concerning the prophets who are prophesying in My name, although it was not I who sent them—yet they keep saying: ‘There will be no sword or famine in this land’—by sword and famine those prophets shall meet their end!
verses.textEn: Therefore this is what the Lord says about the prophets who are prophesying in my name: I did not send them, yet they are saying, ‘No sword or famine will touch this land.’ Those same prophets will perish by sword and famine.

verses.textZh: 至于那些听他们说预言的人民，必因刀剑和饥荒被拋弃在耶路撒冷的街上，没有人埋葬他们，也没有人埋葬他们的妻子和儿女。我必要把他们作恶应得的报应倒在他们身上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 至于那些听他们说预言的人民，必因刀剑和饥荒被拋弃在耶路撒冷的街上，没有人埋葬他们，也没有人埋葬他们的妻子和儿女。我必要把他们作恶应得的报应倒在他们身上。
verses.textZhCuv: 听他们说预言的百姓必因饥荒刀剑抛在耶路撒冷的街道上，无人葬埋。他们连妻子带儿女，都是如此。我必将他们的恶倒在他们身上 。」
verses.textEnNiv: And the people they are prophesying to will be thrown out into the streets of Jerusalem because of the famine and sword. There will be no one to bury them, their wives, their sons and their daughters. I will pour out on them the calamity they deserve.
verses.textEnEsv: And the people to whom they prophesy shall be cast out in the streets of Jerusalem, victims of famine and sword, with none to bury them—them, their wives, their sons, and their daughters. For I will pour out their evil upon them.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the people to whom they prophesy shall be cast out in the streets of Jerusalem because of the famine and the sword; they will have no one to bury them—them nor their wives, their sons nor their daughters—for I will pour their wickedness on them.’
verses.textEnNlt: As for the people to whom they prophesy—their bodies will be thrown out into the streets of Jerusalem, victims of famine and war. There will be no one left to bury them. Husbands, wives, sons, and daughters—all will be gone. For I will pour out their own wickedness on them.
verses.textEnNasb: And the people to whom they are prophesying will be thrown out into the streets of Jerusalem because of the famine and the sword; and there will be no one to bury them—neither them, nor their wives, nor their sons, nor their daughters. For I will pour out their own wickedness upon them.
verses.textEn: And the people they are prophesying to will be thrown out into the streets of Jerusalem because of the famine and sword. There will be no one to bury them, their wives, their sons and their daughters. I will pour out on them the calamity they deserve.

verses.textZh: "你要对他们说这话： ‘愿我的眼泪直流， 日夜不停； 因为我的同胞 遭受极大的毁灭， 受到很严重的打击。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你要对他们说这话： ‘愿我的眼泪直流， 日夜不停； 因为我的同胞 遭受极大的毁灭， 受到很严重的打击。
verses.textZhCuv: 你要将这话对他们说： 愿我眼泪汪汪， 昼夜不息， 因为我百姓 受了裂口破坏的大伤。
verses.textEnNiv: "Speak this word to them: " ‘Let my eyes overflow with tears night and day without ceasing; for the Virgin Daughter, my people, has suffered a grievous wound, a crushing blow.
verses.textEnEsv: "You shall say to them this word: ‘Let my eyes run down with tears night and day, and let them not cease, for the virgin daughter of my people is shattered with a great wound, with a very grievous blow.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Therefore you shall say this word to them: ‘Let my eyes flow with tears night and day, And let them not cease; For the virgin daughter of my people Has been broken with a mighty stroke, with a very severe blow.
verses.textEnNlt: Now, Jeremiah, say this to them: "Night and day my eyes overflow with tears. I cannot stop weeping, for my virgin daughter—my precious people— has been struck down and lies mortally wounded.
verses.textEnNasb: "You will say this word to them, ‘Let my eyes stream down tears night and day, And let them not cease; For the virgin daughter of my people has been crushed with a mighty blow, With a sorely infected wound.
verses.textEn: "Speak this word to them: " ‘Let my eyes overflow with tears night and day without ceasing; for the Virgin Daughter, my people, has suffered a grievous wound, a crushing blow.

verses.textZh: 如果我出到田间， 就看见那些被刀剑所杀的人； 如果我走进城里， 就看见因饥荒而来的各种疾病。 连先知和祭司 也流亡到他们素不认识的地方。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果我出到田间， 就看见那些被刀剑所杀的人； 如果我走进城里， 就看见因饥荒而来的各种疾病。 连先知和祭司 也流亡到他们素不认识的地方。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 我若出往田间， 就见有被刀杀的； 我若进入城内， 就见有因饥荒患病的； 连先知带祭司在国中往来， 也是毫无知识 。
verses.textEnNiv: If I go into the country, I see those slain by the sword; if I go into the city, I see the ravages of famine. Both prophet and priest have gone to a land they know not.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: If I go out into the field, behold, those pierced by the sword! And if I enter the city, behold, the diseases of famine! For both prophet and priest ply their trade through the land and have no knowledge.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: If I go out to the field, Then behold, those slain with the sword! And if I enter the city, Then behold, those sick from famine! Yes, both prophet and priest go about in a land they do not know.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: If I go out into the fields, I see the bodies of people slaughtered by the enemy. If I walk the city streets, I see people who have died of starvation. The prophets and priests continue with their work, but they don’t know what they’re doing."
verses.textEnNasb: ‘If I go out to the country, There are those killed by the sword! Or if I enter the city, There are diseases from famine! For both prophet and priest Have wandered around in the land that they do not know.’ "
verses.textEn: If I go into the country, I see those slain by the sword; if I go into the city, I see the ravages of famine. Both prophet and priest have gone to a land they know not.’ "

verses.textZh: 你真的弃绝犹大吗？ 你真的讨厌锡安吗？ 你为甚么击打我们，使我们无法医治呢？ 我们期待平安，却得不到好处； 期待得医治的时候，不料，只有惊慌。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你真的弃绝犹大吗？ 你真的讨厌锡安吗？ 你为甚么击打我们，使我们无法医治呢？ 我们期待平安，却得不到好处； 期待得医治的时候，不料，只有惊慌。
verses.textZhCuv: 你全然弃掉犹大吗？ 你心厌恶锡安吗？ 为何击打我们，以致无法医治呢？ 我们指望平安，却得不着好处； 指望痊愈，不料，受了惊惶。
verses.textEnNiv: Have you rejected Judah completely? Do you despise Zion? Why have you afflicted us so that we cannot be healed? We hoped for peace but no good has come, for a time of healing but there is only terror.
verses.textEnEsv: Have you utterly rejected Judah? Does your soul loathe Zion? Why have you struck us down so that there is no healing for us? We looked for peace, but no good came; for a time of healing, but behold, terror.
verses.textEnNkjv: Have You utterly rejected Judah? Has Your soul loathed Zion? Why have You stricken us so that thereis no healing for us? We looked for peace, but therewas no good; And for the time of healing, and there was trouble.
verses.textEnNlt: Lord , have you completely rejected Judah? Do you really hate Jerusalem? Why have you wounded us past all hope of healing? We hoped for peace, but no peace came. We hoped for a time of healing, but found only terror.
verses.textEnNasb: Have You completely rejected Judah? Or have You loathed Zion? Why have You stricken us so that we are beyond healing? We waited for peace, but nothing good came; And for a time of healing, but behold, terror!
verses.textEn: Have you rejected Judah completely? Do you despise Zion? Why have you afflicted us so that we cannot be healed? We hoped for peace but no good has come, for a time of healing but there is only terror.

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊！我们承认我们的罪恶， 和我们列祖的罪孽； 我们实在得罪了你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊！我们承认我们的罪恶， 和我们列祖的罪孽； 我们实在得罪了你。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，我们承认自己的罪恶， 和我们列祖的罪孽， 因我们得罪了你。
verses.textEnNiv: We acknowledge our wickedness, Lord , and the guilt of our ancestors; we have indeed sinned against you.
verses.textEnEsv: We acknowledge our wickedness, O Lord , and the iniquity of our fathers, for we have sinned against you.
verses.textEnNkjv: We acknowledge, O Lord, our wickedness And the iniquity of our fathers, For we have sinned against You.
verses.textEnNlt: Lord , we confess our wickedness and that of our ancestors, too. We all have sinned against you.
verses.textEnNasb: We know our wickedness, Lord, The wrongdoing of our fathers, for we have sinned against You.
verses.textEn: We acknowledge our wickedness, Lord , and the guilt of our ancestors; we have indeed sinned against you.

verses.textZh: 求你为你名的缘故，不要厌弃我们！ 不要叫你荣耀的宝座蒙羞！ 求你记念你和我们所立的约，不要废除！
verses.textZhCnvs: 求你为你名的缘故，不要厌弃我们！ 不要叫你荣耀的宝座蒙羞！ 求你记念你和我们所立的约，不要废除！
verses.textZhCuv: 求你为你名的缘故， 不厌恶我们， 不辱没你荣耀的宝座。 求你追念， 不要背了与我们所立的约。
verses.textEnNiv: For the sake of your name do not despise us; do not dishonor your glorious throne. Remember your covenant with us and do not break it.
verses.textEnEsv: Do not spurn us, for your name’s sake; do not dishonor your glorious throne; remember and do not break your covenant with us.
verses.textEnNkjv: Do not abhor us, for Your name’s sake; Do not disgrace the throne of Your glory. Remember, do not break Your covenant with us.
verses.textEnNlt: For the sake of your reputation, Lord , do not abandon us. Do not disgrace your own glorious throne. Please remember us, and do not break your covenant with us.
verses.textEnNasb: Do not despise us, for the sake of Your own name; Do not disgrace the throne of Your glory. Remember and do not annul Your covenant with us.
verses.textEn: For the sake of your name do not despise us; do not dishonor your glorious throne. Remember your covenant with us and do not break it.

verses.textZh: 列国虚无的偶像中，有可以降雨的吗？ 天能自降甘霖吗？ 耶和华我们的神啊！能够这样作的，不是只有你吗？ 所以我们仰望你， 因为这一切都是你所作的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 列国虚无的偶像中，有可以降雨的吗？ 天能自降甘霖吗？ 耶和华我们的神啊！能够这样作的，不是只有你吗？ 所以我们仰望你， 因为这一切都是你所作的。
verses.textZhCuv: 外邦人虚无的神中有能降雨的吗？ 天能自降甘霖吗？ 耶和华－我们的神啊， 能如此的不是你吗？ 所以，我们仍要等候你， 因为这一切都是你所造的。
verses.textEnNiv: Do any of the worthless idols of the nations bring rain? Do the skies themselves send down showers? No, it is you, Lord our God. Therefore our hope is in you, for you are the one who does all this.
verses.textEnEsv: Are there any among the false gods of the nations that can bring rain? Or can the heavens give showers? Are you not he, O Lord our God? We set our hope on you, for you do all these things.
verses.textEnNkjv: Are there any among the idols of the nations that can cause rain? Or can the heavens give showers? Are You not He, O Lord our God? Therefore we will wait for You, Since You have made all these.
verses.textEnNlt: Can any of the worthless foreign gods send us rain? Does it fall from the sky by itself? No, you are the one, O Lord our God! Only you can do such things. So we will wait for you to help us.
verses.textEnNasb: Are there any among the idols of the nations who give rain? Or can the heavens grant showers? Is it not You, Lord our God? Therefore we wait for You, For You are the one who has done all these things.
verses.textEn: Do any of the worthless idols of the nations bring rain? Do the skies themselves send down showers? No, it is you, Lord our God. Therefore our hope is in you, for you are the one who does all this.

verses.textZh: 耶和华对我说："即使摩西和撒母耳站在我面前代求，我的心也不会转向这人民。你把他们从我面前赶走，叫他们出去！
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对我说："即使摩西和撒母耳站在我面前代求，我的心也不会转向这人民。你把他们从我面前赶走，叫他们出去！
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华对我说：「虽有摩西和撒母耳站在我面前代求，我的心也不顾惜这百姓。你将他们从我眼前赶出，叫他们去吧！
verses.textEnNiv: Then the Lord said to me: "Even if Moses and Samuel were to stand before me, my heart would not go out to this people. Send them away from my presence! Let them go!
verses.textEnEsv: Then the Lord said to me, "Though Moses and Samuel stood before me, yet my heart would not turn toward this people. Send them out of my sight, and let them go!
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Lord said to me, "Even if Moses and Samuel stood before Me, My mind would not be favorable toward this people. Cast them out of My sight, and let them go forth.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord said to me, "Even if Moses and Samuel stood before me pleading for these people, I wouldn’t help them. Away with them! Get them out of my sight!
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord said to me, "Even if Moses and Samuel were to stand before Me, My heart would not be with this people. Send them away from My presence and have them go!
verses.textEn: Then the Lord said to me: "Even if Moses and Samuel were to stand before me, my heart would not go out to this people. Send them away from my presence! Let them go!

verses.textZh: 如果他们问你：‘我们要去哪里？’你就告诉他们：‘耶和华这样说： 该死亡的，就死亡； 该被刀剑所杀的，就被刀剑所杀； 该遭遇饥荒的，就遭遇饥荒； 该被掳的，就被掳去！’
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果他们问你：‘我们要去哪里？’你就告诉他们：‘耶和华这样说： 该死亡的，就死亡； 该被刀剑所杀的，就被刀剑所杀； 该遭遇饥荒的，就遭遇饥荒； 该被掳的，就被掳去！’
verses.textZhCuv: 他们问你说：『我们往哪里去呢？』你便告诉他们，耶和华如此说： 定为死亡的，必致死亡； 定为刀杀的，必交刀杀； 定为饥荒的，必遭饥荒； 定为掳掠的，必被掳掠。」
verses.textEnNiv: And if they ask you, ‘Where shall we go?’ tell them, ‘This is what the Lord says: " ‘Those destined for death, to death; those for the sword, to the sword; those for starvation, to starvation; those for captivity, to captivity.’
verses.textEnEsv: And when they ask you, ‘Where shall we go?’ you shall say to them, ‘Thus says the Lord : "‘Those who are for pestilence, to pestilence, and those who are for the sword, to the sword; those who are for famine, to famine, and those who are for captivity, to captivity.’
verses.textEnNkjv: And it shall be, if they say to you, ‘Where should we go?’ then you shall tell them, ‘Thus says the Lord: "Such as are for death, to death; And such as are for the sword, to the sword; And such as are for the famine, to the famine; And such as are for the captivity, to the captivity." ’
verses.textEnNlt: And if they say to you, ‘But where can we go?’ tell them, ‘This is what the Lord says: "‘Those who are destined for death, to death; those who are destined for war, to war; those who are destined for famine, to famine; those who are destined for captivity, to captivity.’
verses.textEnNasb: And it shall be that when they say to you, ‘Where should we go?’ then you are to tell them, ‘This is what the Lord says: "Those destined for death, to death; And those destined for the sword, to the sword; And those destined for famine, to famine; And those destined for captivity, to captivity." ’
verses.textEn: And if they ask you, ‘Where shall we go?’ tell them, ‘This is what the Lord says: " ‘Those destined for death, to death; those for the sword, to the sword; those for starvation, to starvation; those for captivity, to captivity.’

verses.textZh: 我要命定四种刑罚对付他们，就是刀剑杀戮，尸体被野狗拖走，被空中的飞鸟和地上的走兽吞吃与毁灭。"这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要命定四种刑罚对付他们，就是刀剑杀戮，尸体被野狗拖走，被空中的飞鸟和地上的走兽吞吃与毁灭。"这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华说：「我命定四样害他们，就是刀剑杀戮、狗类撕裂、空中的飞鸟，和地上的野兽吞吃毁灭；
verses.textEnNiv: "I will send four kinds of destroyers against them," declares the Lord , "the sword to kill and the dogs to drag away and the birds and the wild animals to devour and destroy.
verses.textEnEsv: I will appoint over them four kinds of destroyers, declares the Lord : the sword to kill, the dogs to tear, and the birds of the air and the beasts of the earth to devour and destroy.
verses.textEnNkjv: "And I will appoint over them four forms ofdestruction," says the Lord: "the sword to slay, the dogs to drag, the birds of the heavens and the beasts of the earth to devour and destroy.
verses.textEnNlt: "I will send four kinds of destroyers against them," says the Lord . "I will send the sword to kill, the dogs to drag away, the vultures to devour, and the wild animals to finish up what is left.
verses.textEnNasb: And I will appoint over them four kinds of doom," declares the Lord: "the sword to kill, the dogs to drag away, and the birds of the sky and the animals of the earth to devour and destroy.
verses.textEn: "I will send four kinds of destroyers against them," declares the Lord , "the sword to kill and the dogs to drag away and the birds and the wild animals to devour and destroy.

verses.textZh: "因犹大王希西家的儿子玛拿西在耶路撒冷的所作所为，我必使地上万国看见他们的遭遇就惊恐。"
verses.textZhCnvs: "因犹大王希西家的儿子玛拿西在耶路撒冷的所作所为，我必使地上万国看见他们的遭遇就惊恐。"
verses.textZhCuv: 又必使他们在天下万国中抛来抛去，都因犹大王希西家的儿子玛拿西在耶路撒冷所行的事。」
verses.textEnNiv: I will make them abhorrent to all the kingdoms of the earth because of what Manasseh son of Hezekiah king of Judah did in Jerusalem.
verses.textEnEsv: And I will make them a horror to all the kingdoms of the earth because of what Manasseh the son of Hezekiah, king of Judah, did in Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will hand them over to trouble, to all kingdoms of the earth, because of Manasseh the son of Hezekiah, king of Judah, for what he did in Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNlt: Because of the wicked things Manasseh son of Hezekiah, king of Judah, did in Jerusalem, I will make my people an object of horror to all the kingdoms of the earth.
verses.textEnNasb: I will make them an object of terror among all the kingdoms of the earth because of Manasseh, the son of Hezekiah, the king of Judah, for what he did in Jerusalem.
verses.textEn: I will make them abhorrent to all the kingdoms of the earth because of what Manasseh son of Hezekiah king of Judah did in Jerusalem.

verses.textZh: "耶路撒冷啊！谁会可怜你呢？ 谁会为你悲伤呢？ 谁会转身向你问安呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: "耶路撒冷啊！谁会可怜你呢？ 谁会为你悲伤呢？ 谁会转身向你问安呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 耶路撒冷啊，谁可怜你呢？ 谁为你悲伤呢？ 谁转身问你的安呢？
verses.textEnNiv: "Who will have pity on you, Jerusalem? Who will mourn for you? Who will stop to ask how you are?
verses.textEnEsv: "Who will have pity on you, O Jerusalem, or who will grieve for you? Who will turn aside to ask about your welfare?
verses.textEnNkjv: "For who will have pity on you, O Jerusalem? Or who will bemoan you? Or who will turn aside to ask how you are doing?
verses.textEnNlt: "Who will feel sorry for you, Jerusalem? Who will weep for you? Who will even bother to ask how you are?
verses.textEnNasb: "Indeed, who will have pity on you, Jerusalem, Or who will mourn for you, Or who will turn aside to ask about your welfare?
verses.textEn: "Who will have pity on you, Jerusalem? Who will mourn for you? Who will stop to ask how you are?

verses.textZh: 你离弃了我， 你转身背着我； 因此我要伸手攻击你，毁灭你， 我不会再回心转意。" 这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你离弃了我， 你转身背着我； 因此我要伸手攻击你，毁灭你， 我不会再回心转意。" 这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华说：你弃绝了我， 转身退后； 因此我伸手攻击你，毁坏你。 我后悔甚不耐烦。
verses.textEnNiv: You have rejected me," declares the Lord . "You keep on backsliding. So I will reach out and destroy you; I am tired of holding back.
verses.textEnEsv: You have rejected me, declares the Lord ; you keep going backward, so I have stretched out my hand against you and destroyed you— I am weary of relenting.
verses.textEnNkjv: You have forsaken Me," says the Lord, "You have gone backward. Therefore I will stretch out My hand against you and destroy you; I am weary of relenting!
verses.textEnNlt: You have abandoned me and turned your back on me," says the Lord . "Therefore, I will raise my fist to destroy you. I am tired of always giving you another chance.
verses.textEnNasb: "You who have forsaken Me," declares the Lord, "You keep going backward. So I will stretch out My hand against you and destroy you; I am tired of relenting!
verses.textEn: You have rejected me," declares the Lord . "You keep on backsliding. So I will reach out and destroy you; I am tired of holding back.

verses.textZh: "我在这地的城门口， 用簸箕簸了我的子民， 使他们丧掉儿女，使他们灭亡； 他们仍不转离自己所行的路。
verses.textZhCnvs: "我在这地的城门口， 用簸箕簸了我的子民， 使他们丧掉儿女，使他们灭亡； 他们仍不转离自己所行的路。
verses.textZhCuv: 我在境内各城门口 ， 用簸箕簸了我的百姓， 使他们丧掉儿女。 我毁灭他们， 他们仍不转离所行的道。
verses.textEnNiv: I will winnow them with a winnowing fork at the city gates of the land. I will bring bereavement and destruction on my people, for they have not changed their ways.
verses.textEnEsv: I have winnowed them with a winnowing fork in the gates of the land; I have bereaved them; I have destroyed my people; they did not turn from their ways.
verses.textEnNkjv: And I will winnow them with a winnowing fan in the gates of the land; I will bereave them of children; I will destroy My people, Since they do not return from their ways.
verses.textEnNlt: I will winnow you like grain at the gates of your cities and take away the children you hold dear. I will destroy my own people, because they refuse to change their evil ways.
verses.textEnNasb: "I will winnow them with a winnowing fork At the gates of the land; I will bereave them of children, I will destroy My people; They did not repent of their ways.
verses.textEn: I will winnow them with a winnowing fork at the city gates of the land. I will bring bereavement and destruction on my people, for they have not changed their ways.

verses.textZh: 我使他们寡妇的数目 比海沙还多； 我使行毁灭的在午间临到我的子民， 打击年轻人的母亲， 使痛苦的惊恐忽然临到她们身上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我使他们寡妇的数目 比海沙还多； 我使行毁灭的在午间临到我的子民， 打击年轻人的母亲， 使痛苦的惊恐忽然临到她们身上。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们的寡妇在我面前比海沙更多； 我使灭命的午间来， 攻击少年人的母亲， 使痛苦惊吓忽然临到她身上。
verses.textEnNiv: I will make their widows more numerous than the sand of the sea. At midday I will bring a destroyer against the mothers of their young men; suddenly I will bring down on them anguish and terror.
verses.textEnEsv: I have made their widows more in number than the sand of the seas; I have brought against the mothers of young men a destroyer at noonday; I have made anguish and terror fall upon them suddenly.
verses.textEnNkjv: Their widows will be increased to Me more than the sand of the seas; I will bring against them, Against the mother of the young men, A plunderer at noonday; I will cause anguish and terror to fall on them suddenly.
verses.textEnNlt: There will be more widows than the grains of sand on the seashore. At noontime I will bring a destroyer against the mothers of young men. I will cause anguish and terror to come upon them suddenly.
verses.textEnNasb: "Their widows will be more numerous before Me Than the sand of the seas; I will bring against them, against the mother of a young man, A destroyer at noon; I will suddenly bring down on her Shock and horror.
verses.textEn: I will make their widows more numerous than the sand of the sea. At midday I will bring a destroyer against the mothers of their young men; suddenly I will bring down on them anguish and terror.

verses.textZh: 那生过七个子女的母亲衰竭疲弱， 几乎气绝； 还在白昼，她的太阳已经西落， 她必惭愧蒙羞。 我必使他们余剩的人在敌人面前死于刀下。" 这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那生过七个子女的母亲衰竭疲弱， 几乎气绝； 还在白昼，她的太阳已经西落， 她必惭愧蒙羞。 我必使他们余剩的人在敌人面前死于刀下。" 这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 生过七子的妇人力衰气绝； 尚在白昼，日头忽落； 她抱愧蒙羞。 其余的人， 我必在他们敌人跟前，交与刀剑。 这是耶和华说的。
verses.textEnNiv: The mother of seven will grow faint and breathe her last. Her sun will set while it is still day; she will be disgraced and humiliated. I will put the survivors to the sword before their enemies," declares the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: She who bore seven has grown feeble; she has fainted away; her sun went down while it was yet day; she has been shamed and disgraced. And the rest of them I will give to the sword before their enemies, declares the Lord ."
verses.textEnNkjv: "She languishes who has borne seven; She has breathed her last; Her sun has gone down While itwas yet day; She has been ashamed and confounded. And the remnant of them I will deliver to the sword Before their enemies," says the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: The mother of seven grows faint and gasps for breath; her sun has gone down while it is still day. She sits childless now, disgraced and humiliated. And I will hand over those who are left to be killed by the enemy. I, the Lord , have spoken!"
verses.textEnNasb: "She who gave birth to seven sons withers away; Her breathing is labored. Her sun has set while it was still day; She has been shamed and humiliated. So I will turn over their survivors to the sword Before their enemies," declares the Lord.
verses.textEn: The mother of seven will grow faint and breathe her last. Her sun will set while it is still day; she will be disgraced and humiliated. I will put the survivors to the sword before their enemies," declares the Lord .

verses.textZh: 我母亲哪！我有祸了，因为你生了我， 这个跟全地相争相斗的人。 我从没有借钱给人，也没有向人借钱， 可是人人都咒骂我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我母亲哪！我有祸了，因为你生了我， 这个跟全地相争相斗的人。 我从没有借钱给人，也没有向人借钱， 可是人人都咒骂我。
verses.textZhCuv: 我的母亲哪，我有祸了！因你生我作为遍地相争相竞的人。我素来没有借贷与人，人也没有借贷与我，人人却都咒骂我。
verses.textEnNiv: Alas, my mother, that you gave me birth, a man with whom the whole land strives and contends! I have neither lent nor borrowed, yet everyone curses me.
verses.textEnEsv: Woe is me, my mother, that you bore me, a man of strife and contention to the whole land! I have not lent, nor have I borrowed, yet all of them curse me.
verses.textEnNkjv: Woe is me, my mother, That you have borne me, A man of strife and a man of contention to the whole earth! I have neither lent for interest, Nor have men lent to me for interest. Every one of them curses me.
verses.textEnNlt: Then I said, "What sorrow is mine, my mother. Oh, that I had died at birth! I am hated everywhere I go. I am neither a lender who threatens to foreclose nor a borrower who refuses to pay— yet they all curse me."
verses.textEnNasb: Woe to me, my mother, that you have given birth to me As a man of strife and a man of contention to all the land! I have not lent, nor have people lent money to me, Yet everyone curses me.
verses.textEn: Alas, my mother, that you gave me birth, a man with whom the whole land strives and contends! I have neither lent nor borrowed, yet everyone curses me.

verses.textZh: 耶和华说："我必为你的好处释放你； 在遭遇祸患和灾难的时候， 我必叫你的仇敌恳求你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华说："我必为你的好处释放你； 在遭遇祸患和灾难的时候， 我必叫你的仇敌恳求你。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华说：「我必要坚固你，使你得好处。灾祸苦难临到的时候，我必要使仇敌央求你。（
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord said, "Surely I will deliver you for a good purpose; surely I will make your enemies plead with you in times of disaster and times of distress.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord said, "Have I not set you free for their good? Have I not pleaded for you before the enemy in the time of trouble and in the time of distress?
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord said: "Surely it will be well with your remnant; Surely I will cause the enemy to intercede with you In the time of adversity and in the time of affliction.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord replied, "I will take care of you, Jeremiah. Your enemies will ask you to plead on their behalf in times of trouble and distress.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord said, "I will certainly set you free for purposes of good; I will certainly make the enemy plead with you In a time of disaster and a time of distress.
verses.textEn: The Lord said, "Surely I will deliver you for a good purpose; surely I will make your enemies plead with you in times of disaster and times of distress.

verses.textZh: 谁可以折断铁， 就是从北方来的铁和铜呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 谁可以折断铁， 就是从北方来的铁和铜呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 人岂能将铜与铁，就是北方的铁折断呢？）
verses.textEnNiv: "Can a man break iron— iron from the north—or bronze?
verses.textEnEsv: Can one break iron, iron from the north, and bronze?
verses.textEnNkjv: Can anyone break iron, The northern iron and the bronze?
verses.textEnNlt: Can a man break a bar of iron from the north, or a bar of bronze?
verses.textEnNasb: "Can anyone smash iron, Iron from the north, or bronze?
verses.textEn: "Can a man break iron— iron from the north—or bronze?

verses.textZh: 因你在四境之内所犯的一切罪， 我必把你的财产和宝物， 白白给敌人作掠物。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因你在四境之内所犯的一切罪， 我必把你的财产和宝物， 白白给敌人作掠物。
verses.textZhCuv: 「我必因你在四境之内所犯的一切罪，把你的货物财宝当掠物，白白地交给仇敌。
verses.textEnNiv: "Your wealth and your treasures I will give as plunder, without charge, because of all your sins throughout your country.
verses.textEnEsv: "Your wealth and your treasures I will give as spoil, without price, for all your sins, throughout all your territory.
verses.textEnNkjv: Your wealth and your treasures I will give as plunder without price, Because of all your sins, Throughout your territories.
verses.textEnNlt: At no cost to them, I will hand over your wealth and treasures as plunder to your enemies, for sin runs rampant in your land.
verses.textEnNasb: "I will give your wealth and your treasures As plunder without cost, For all your sins And within all your borders.
verses.textEn: "Your wealth and your treasures I will give as plunder, without charge, because of all your sins throughout your country.

verses.textZh: 我必使你在你不认识的地方， 服事你的仇敌 ； 因为我的怒火燃烧起来， 要烧灭你们。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必使你在你不认识的地方， 服事你的仇敌 ； 因为我的怒火燃烧起来， 要烧灭你们。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我也必使仇敌带这掠物到你所不认识的地去，因我怒中起的火要将你们焚烧。」
verses.textEnNiv: I will enslave you to your enemies in a land you do not know, for my anger will kindle a fire that will burn against you."
verses.textEnEsv: I will make you serve your enemies in a land that you do not know, for in my anger a fire is kindled that shall burn forever."
verses.textEnNkjv: And I will make you cross over with your enemies Into a land which you do not know; For a fire is kindled in My anger, Which shall burn upon you."
verses.textEnNlt: I will tell your enemies to take you as captives to a foreign land. For my anger blazes like a fire that will burn forever. "
verses.textEnNasb: "Then I will make your enemies bring your possessions Into a land that you do not know; For a fire has been kindled in My anger, And it will burn upon you."
verses.textEn: I will enslave you to your enemies in a land you do not know, for my anger will kindle a fire that will burn against you."

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊！你知道这一切； 求你记念我，看顾我， 替我向那些逼迫我的人报复。 求你忍怒，不要取去我的性命； 要知道，我为你的缘故受了侮辱。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊！你知道这一切； 求你记念我，看顾我， 替我向那些逼迫我的人报复。 求你忍怒，不要取去我的性命； 要知道，我为你的缘故受了侮辱。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，你是知道的； 求你记念我，眷顾我， 向逼迫我的人为我报仇； 不要向他们忍怒取我的命， 要知道我为你的缘故受了凌辱。
verses.textEnNiv: Lord , you understand; remember me and care for me. Avenge me on my persecutors. You are long-suffering—do not take me away; think of how I suffer reproach for your sake.
verses.textEnEsv: O Lord , you know; remember me and visit me, and take vengeance for me on my persecutors. In your forbearance take me not away; know that for your sake I bear reproach.
verses.textEnNkjv: O Lord, You know; Remember me and visit me, And take vengeance for me on my persecutors. In Your enduring patience, do not take me away. Know that for Your sake I have suffered rebuke.
verses.textEnNlt: Then I said, " Lord , you know what’s happening to me. Please step in and help me. Punish my persecutors! Please give me time; don’t let me die young. It’s for your sake that I am suffering.
verses.textEnNasb: You know, Lord; Remember me, take notice of me, And take vengeance for me on my persecutors. Do not, in view of Your patience, take me away; Know that for Your sake I endure reproach.
verses.textEn: Lord , you understand; remember me and care for me. Avenge me on my persecutors. You are long-suffering—do not take me away; think of how I suffer reproach for your sake.

verses.textZh: 我一得到你的话，就把它们吃了； 你的话成了我心中的欢喜快乐； 耶和华万军的神啊！ 因为我是称为你名下的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我一得到你的话，就把它们吃了； 你的话成了我心中的欢喜快乐； 耶和华万军的神啊！ 因为我是称为你名下的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华－万军之神啊， 我得着你的言语就当食物吃了； 你的言语是我心中的欢喜快乐， 因我是称为你名下的人。
verses.textEnNiv: When your words came, I ate them; they were my joy and my heart’s delight, for I bear your name, Lord God Almighty.
verses.textEnEsv: Your words were found, and I ate them, and your words became to me a joy and the delight of my heart, for I am called by your name, O Lord , God of hosts.
verses.textEnNkjv: Your words were found, and I ate them, And Your word was to me the joy and rejoicing of my heart; For I am called by Your name, O Lord God of hosts.
verses.textEnNlt: When I discovered your words, I devoured them. They are my joy and my heart’s delight, for I bear your name, O Lord God of Heaven’s Armies.
verses.textEnNasb: Your words were found and I ate them, And Your words became a joy to me and the delight of my heart; For I have been called by Your name, Lord God of armies.
verses.textEn: When your words came, I ate them; they were my joy and my heart’s delight, for I bear your name, Lord God Almighty.

verses.textZh: 我没有坐在欢笑者的集会中一同欢乐； 因为你的手在我身上， 你使我满了忿怒， 我就独自静坐。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我没有坐在欢笑者的集会中一同欢乐； 因为你的手在我身上， 你使我满了忿怒， 我就独自静坐。
verses.textZhCuv: 我没有坐在宴乐人的会中， 也没有欢乐； 我因你的感动 独自静坐， 因你使我满心愤恨。
verses.textEnNiv: I never sat in the company of revelers, never made merry with them; I sat alone because your hand was on me and you had filled me with indignation.
verses.textEnEsv: I did not sit in the company of revelers, nor did I rejoice; I sat alone, because your hand was upon me, for you had filled me with indignation.
verses.textEnNkjv: I did not sit in the assembly of the mockers, Nor did I rejoice; I sat alone because of Your hand, For You have filled me with indignation.
verses.textEnNlt: I never joined the people in their merry feasts. I sat alone because your hand was on me. I was filled with indignation at their sins.
verses.textEnNasb: I did not sit in a circle of revelers and celebrate. Because of Your hand upon me I sat alone, For You filled me with indignation.
verses.textEn: I never sat in the company of revelers, never made merry with them; I sat alone because your hand was on me and you had filled me with indignation.

verses.textZh: 我的痛苦为甚么长久不止呢？ 我的创伤为甚么无法医治，不得痊愈呢？ 你对我真的像叫人失望、 靠不住的溪流吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的痛苦为甚么长久不止呢？ 我的创伤为甚么无法医治，不得痊愈呢？ 你对我真的像叫人失望、 靠不住的溪流吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 我的痛苦为何长久不止呢？ 我的伤痕为何无法医治、不能痊愈呢？ 难道你待我有诡诈，像流干的河道吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Why is my pain unending and my wound grievous and incurable? You are to me like a deceptive brook, like a spring that fails.
verses.textEnEsv: Why is my pain unceasing, my wound incurable, refusing to be healed? Will you be to me like a deceitful brook, like waters that fail?
verses.textEnNkjv: Why is my pain perpetual And my wound incurable, Which refuses to be healed? Will You surely be to me like an unreliable stream, As waters that fail?
verses.textEnNlt: Why then does my suffering continue? Why is my wound so incurable? Your help seems as uncertain as a seasonal brook, like a spring that has gone dry."
verses.textEnNasb: Why has my pain been endless And my wound incurable, refusing to be healed? Will You indeed be to me like a deceptive stream With water that is unreliable?
verses.textEn: Why is my pain unending and my wound grievous and incurable? You are to me like a deceptive brook, like a spring that fails.

verses.textZh: 因此，耶和华这样说： "如果你回转，我必让你回来， 你就可以侍立在我面前。 如果你说宝贵的话，不说无价值的话， 就必作我的口。 他们要归向你， 你却不要归向他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，耶和华这样说： "如果你回转，我必让你回来， 你就可以侍立在我面前。 如果你说宝贵的话，不说无价值的话， 就必作我的口。 他们要归向你， 你却不要归向他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华如此说：你若归回， 我就将你再带来， 使你站在我面前； 你若将宝贵的和下贱的分别出来， 你就可以当作我的口。 他们必归向你， 你却不可归向他们。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore this is what the Lord says: "If you repent, I will restore you that you may serve me; if you utter worthy, not worthless, words, you will be my spokesman. Let this people turn to you, but you must not turn to them.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore thus says the Lord : "If you return, I will restore you, and you shall stand before me. If you utter what is precious, and not what is worthless, you shall be as my mouth. They shall turn to you, but you shall not turn to them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore thus says the Lord: "If you return, Then I will bring you back; You shall stand before Me; If you take out the precious from the vile, You shall be as My mouth. Let them return to you, But you must not return to them.
verses.textEnNlt: This is how the Lord responds: "If you return to me, I will restore you so you can continue to serve me. If you speak good words rather than worthless ones, you will be my spokesman. You must influence them; do not let them influence you!
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore, this is what the Lord says: "If you return, then I will restore you— You will stand before Me; And if you extract the precious from the worthless, You will become My spokesman. They, for their part, may turn to you, But as for you, you are not to turn to them.
verses.textEn: Therefore this is what the Lord says: "If you repent, I will restore you that you may serve me; if you utter worthy, not worthless, words, you will be my spokesman. Let this people turn to you, but you must not turn to them.

verses.textZh: 我要使你成为坚固的铜墙抵挡这人民， 他们必攻击你，却不能胜过你； 因为我与你同在， 要拯救你，搭救你。" 这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要使你成为坚固的铜墙抵挡这人民， 他们必攻击你，却不能胜过你； 因为我与你同在， 要拯救你，搭救你。" 这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 我必使你向这百姓成为坚固的铜墙； 他们必攻击你，却不能胜你； 因我与你同在，要拯救你，搭救你。 这是耶和华说的。
verses.textEnNiv: I will make you a wall to this people, a fortified wall of bronze; they will fight against you but will not overcome you, for I am with you to rescue and save you," declares the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: And I will make you to this people a fortified wall of bronze; they will fight against you, but they shall not prevail over you, for I am with you to save you and deliver you, declares the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: And I will make you to this people a fortified bronze wall; And they will fight against you, But they shall not prevail against you; For I am with you to save you And deliver you," says the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: They will fight against you like an attacking army, but I will make you as secure as a fortified wall of bronze. They will not conquer you, for I am with you to protect and rescue you. I, the Lord , have spoken!
verses.textEnNasb: "Then I will make you to this people A fortified wall of bronze; And though they fight against you, They will not prevail over you; For I am with you to save you And rescue you," declares the Lord.
verses.textEn: I will make you a wall to this people, a fortified wall of bronze; they will fight against you but will not overcome you, for I am with you to rescue and save you," declares the Lord .

verses.textZh: "我必搭救你脱离恶人的手， 救赎你脱离强暴人的掌握 。"
verses.textZhCnvs: "我必搭救你脱离恶人的手， 救赎你脱离强暴人的掌握 。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我必搭救你脱离恶人的手， 救赎你脱离强暴人的手。
verses.textEnNiv: "I will save you from the hands of the wicked and deliver you from the grasp of the cruel."
verses.textEnEsv: I will deliver you out of the hand of the wicked, and redeem you from the grasp of the ruthless."
verses.textEnNkjv: "I will deliver you from the hand of the wicked, And I will redeem you from the grip of the terrible."
verses.textEnNlt: Yes, I will certainly keep you safe from these wicked men. I will rescue you from their cruel hands."
verses.textEnNasb: "So I will rescue you from the hand of the wicked, And I will redeem you from the grasp of the violent."
verses.textEn: "I will save you from the hands of the wicked and deliver you from the grasp of the cruel."

verses.textZh: 耶和华的话临到我，说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的话临到我，说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的话又临到我说：
verses.textEnNiv: Then the word of the Lord came to me:
verses.textEnEsv: The word of the Lord came to me:
verses.textEnNkjv: The word of the Lord also came to me, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord gave me another message. He said,
verses.textEnNasb: The word of the Lord also came to me, saying,
verses.textEn: Then the word of the Lord came to me:

verses.textZh: "在这地方你不可娶妻，不可生儿育女。"
verses.textZhCnvs: "在这地方你不可娶妻，不可生儿育女。"
verses.textZhCuv: 「你在这地方不可娶妻，生儿养女。
verses.textEnNiv: "You must not marry and have sons or daughters in this place."
verses.textEnEsv: "You shall not take a wife, nor shall you have sons or daughters in this place.
verses.textEnNkjv: "You shall not take a wife, nor shall you have sons or daughters in this place."
verses.textEnNlt: "Do not get married or have children in this place.
verses.textEnNasb: "You shall not take a wife for yourself nor have sons or daughters in this place."
verses.textEn: "You must not marry and have sons or daughters in this place."

verses.textZh: 因为论到这地方出生的儿女，和在这地生养他们的父母，耶和华这样说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为论到这地方出生的儿女，和在这地生养他们的父母，耶和华这样说：
verses.textZhCuv: 因为论到在这地方所生的儿女，又论到在这国中生养他们的父母，耶和华如此说：
verses.textEnNiv: For this is what the Lord says about the sons and daughters born in this land and about the women who are their mothers and the men who are their fathers:
verses.textEnEsv: For thus says the Lord concerning the sons and daughters who are born in this place, and concerning the mothers who bore them and the fathers who fathered them in this land:
verses.textEnNkjv: For thus says the Lord concerning the sons and daughters who are born in this place, and concerning their mothers who bore them and their fathers who begot them in this land:
verses.textEnNlt: For this is what the Lord says about the children born here in this city and about their mothers and fathers:
verses.textEnNasb: For this is what the Lord says concerning the sons and daughters born in this place, and concerning their mothers who give birth to them, and their fathers who father them in this land:
verses.textEn: For this is what the Lord says about the sons and daughters born in this land and about the women who are their mothers and the men who are their fathers:

verses.textZh: "他们都必死于致命的疫症，没有人为他们哀哭，他们的尸体也没有人埋葬，必在地面上成为粪肥。他们必被刀剑和饥荒所灭，他们的尸体成了空中飞鸟和地上走兽的食物。"
verses.textZhCnvs: "他们都必死于致命的疫症，没有人为他们哀哭，他们的尸体也没有人埋葬，必在地面上成为粪肥。他们必被刀剑和饥荒所灭，他们的尸体成了空中飞鸟和地上走兽的食物。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们必死得甚苦，无人哀哭，必不得葬埋，必在地上像粪土，必被刀剑和饥荒灭绝；他们的尸首必给空中的飞鸟和地上的野兽作食物。」
verses.textEnNiv: "They will die of deadly diseases. They will not be mourned or buried but will be like dung lying on the ground. They will perish by sword and famine, and their dead bodies will become food for the birds and the wild animals."
verses.textEnEsv: They shall die of deadly diseases. They shall not be lamented, nor shall they be buried. They shall be as dung on the surface of the ground. They shall perish by the sword and by famine, and their dead bodies shall be food for the birds of the air and for the beasts of the earth.
verses.textEnNkjv: "They shall die gruesome deaths; they shall not be lamented nor shall they be buried, but they shall be like refuse on the face of the earth. They shall be consumed by the sword and by famine, and their corpses shall be meat for the birds of heaven and for the beasts of the earth."
verses.textEnNlt: They will die from terrible diseases. No one will mourn for them or bury them, and they will lie scattered on the ground like manure. They will die from war and famine, and their bodies will be food for the vultures and wild animals."
verses.textEnNasb: "They will die of deadly diseases, they will not be mourned or buried; they will be like dung on the surface of the ground. And they will perish by sword and famine, and their dead bodies will become food for the birds of the sky and for the animals of the earth."
verses.textEn: "They will die of deadly diseases. They will not be mourned or buried but will be like dung lying on the ground. They will perish by sword and famine, and their dead bodies will become food for the birds and the wild animals."

verses.textZh: 耶和华这样说："你不可进入丧家，也不可去为他们哀哭悲伤；因为我已经从这人民身上收回我的平安、慈爱和怜悯。"这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华这样说："你不可进入丧家，也不可去为他们哀哭悲伤；因为我已经从这人民身上收回我的平安、慈爱和怜悯。"这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华如此说：「不要进入丧家，不要去哀哭，也不要为他们悲伤，因我已将我的平安、慈爱、怜悯从这百姓夺去了。这是耶和华说的。
verses.textEnNiv: For this is what the Lord says: "Do not enter a house where there is a funeral meal; do not go to mourn or show sympathy, because I have withdrawn my blessing, my love and my pity from this people," declares the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: "For thus says the Lord : Do not enter the house of mourning, or go to lament or grieve for them, for I have taken away my peace from this people, my steadfast love and mercy, declares the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: For thus says the Lord: "Do not enter the house of mourning, nor go to lament or bemoan them; for I have taken away My peace from this people," says the Lord, "lovingkindness and mercies.
verses.textEnNlt: This is what the Lord says: "Do not go to funerals to mourn and show sympathy for these people, for I have removed my protection and peace from them. I have taken away my unfailing love and my mercy.
verses.textEnNasb: For this is what the Lord says: "Do not enter a house of mourning, or go to mourn or to console them; for I have withdrawn My peace from this people," declares the Lord, "and My favor and compassion.
verses.textEn: For this is what the Lord says: "Do not enter a house where there is a funeral meal; do not go to mourn or show sympathy, because I have withdrawn my blessing, my love and my pity from this people," declares the Lord .

verses.textZh: "尊大的和卑微的都必死在这地；没有人埋葬他们，没有人为他们哀哭，也没有人为他们割伤自己，剃光头发。
verses.textZhCnvs: "尊大的和卑微的都必死在这地；没有人埋葬他们，没有人为他们哀哭，也没有人为他们割伤自己，剃光头发。
verses.textZhCuv: 连大带小，都必在这地死亡，不得葬埋。人必不为他们哀哭，不用刀划身，也不使头光秃。
verses.textEnNiv: "Both high and low will die in this land. They will not be buried or mourned, and no one will cut themselves or shave their head for the dead.
verses.textEnEsv: Both great and small shall die in this land. They shall not be buried, and no one shall lament for them or cut himself or make himself bald for them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Both the great and the small shall die in this land. They shall not be buried; neither shall men lament for them, cut themselves, nor make themselves bald for them.
verses.textEnNlt: Both the great and the lowly will die in this land. No one will bury them or mourn for them. Their friends will not cut themselves in sorrow or shave their heads in sadness.
verses.textEnNasb: Both great people and small will die in this land; they will not be buried, people will not mourn for them, nor will anyone make cuts on himself or have his head shaved for them.
verses.textEn: "Both high and low will die in this land. They will not be buried or mourned, and no one will cut themselves or shave their head for the dead.

verses.textZh: 没有人为哀悼的人擘饼，为死者安慰他们；丧父或丧母的人，都没有人给他们喝一杯安慰酒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 没有人为哀悼的人擘饼，为死者安慰他们；丧父或丧母的人，都没有人给他们喝一杯安慰酒。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们有丧事，人必不为他们擘饼，因死人安慰他们；他们丧父丧母，人也不给他们一杯酒安慰他们。
verses.textEnNiv: No one will offer food to comfort those who mourn for the dead—not even for a father or a mother—nor will anyone give them a drink to console them.
verses.textEnEsv: No one shall break bread for the mourner, to comfort him for the dead, nor shall anyone give him the cup of consolation to drink for his father or his mother.
verses.textEnNkjv: Nor shall men break bread in mourning for them, to comfort them for the dead; nor shall men give them the cup of consolation to drink for their father or their mother.
verses.textEnNlt: No one will offer a meal to comfort those who mourn for the dead—not even at the death of a mother or father. No one will send a cup of wine to console them.
verses.textEnNasb: People will not break bread in mourning for them, to comfort anyone for the dead, nor give them a cup of consolation to drink for anyone’s father or mother.
verses.textEn: No one will offer food to comfort those who mourn for the dead—not even for a father or a mother—nor will anyone give them a drink to console them.

verses.textZh: 你也不可进入欢宴之家，跟他们同坐，一起吃喝。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你也不可进入欢宴之家，跟他们同坐，一起吃喝。
verses.textZhCuv: 你不可进入宴乐的家，与他们同坐吃喝。
verses.textEnNiv: "And do not enter a house where there is feasting and sit down to eat and drink.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall not go into the house of feasting to sit with them, to eat and drink.
verses.textEnNkjv: Also you shall not go into the house of feasting to sit with them, to eat and drink."
verses.textEnNlt: "And do not go to their feasts and parties. Do not eat and drink with them at all.
verses.textEnNasb: Moreover, you shall not go into a house of feasting to sit with them to eat and drink."
verses.textEn: "And do not enter a house where there is feasting and sit down to eat and drink.

verses.textZh: 因为万军之耶和华以色列的神这样说：‘看哪！我必在你们眼前，在你们还活着的日子，使欢笑和快乐的声音，新郎和新娘的声音，都从这地方止息了。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为万军之耶和华以色列的神这样说：‘看哪！我必在你们眼前，在你们还活着的日子，使欢笑和快乐的声音，新郎和新娘的声音，都从这地方止息了。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 因为万军之耶和华－以色列的神如此说：你们还活着的日子在你们眼前，我必使欢喜和快乐的声音，新郎和新妇的声音，从这地方止息了。
verses.textEnNiv: For this is what the Lord Almighty, the God of Israel, says: Before your eyes and in your days I will bring an end to the sounds of joy and gladness and to the voices of bride and bridegroom in this place.
verses.textEnEsv: For thus says the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel: Behold, I will silence in this place, before your eyes and in your days, the voice of mirth and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom and the voice of the bride.
verses.textEnNkjv: For thus says the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel: "Behold, I will cause to cease from this place, before your eyes and in your days, the voice of mirth and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom and the voice of the bride.
verses.textEnNlt: For this is what the Lord of Heaven’s Armies, the God of Israel, says: In your own lifetime, before your very eyes, I will put an end to the happy singing and laughter in this land. The joyful voices of bridegrooms and brides will no longer be heard.
verses.textEnNasb: For this is what the Lord of armies, the God of Israel says: "Behold, I am going to eliminate from this place, before your eyes and in your time, the voice of rejoicing and the voice of joy, the voice of the groom and the voice of the bride.
verses.textEn: For this is what the Lord Almighty, the God of Israel, says: Before your eyes and in your days I will bring an end to the sounds of joy and gladness and to the voices of bride and bridegroom in this place.

verses.textZh: "你向这人民传讲这一切时，如果他们问你：‘耶和华为甚么宣告这一切严重的灾祸对付我们呢？我们有甚么罪孽？我们犯了甚么罪，得罪了耶和华我们的神呢？’
verses.textZhCnvs: "你向这人民传讲这一切时，如果他们问你：‘耶和华为甚么宣告这一切严重的灾祸对付我们呢？我们有甚么罪孽？我们犯了甚么罪，得罪了耶和华我们的神呢？’
verses.textZhCuv: 「你将这一切的话指示这百姓。他们问你说：『耶和华为什么说，要降这大灾祸攻击我们呢？我们有什么罪孽呢？我们向耶和华－我们的神犯了什么罪呢？』
verses.textEnNiv: "When you tell these people all this and they ask you, ‘Why has the Lord decreed such a great disaster against us? What wrong have we done? What sin have we committed against the Lord our God?’
verses.textEnEsv: "And when you tell this people all these words, and they say to you, ‘Why has the Lord pronounced all this great evil against us? What is our iniquity? What is the sin that we have committed against the Lord our God?’
verses.textEnNkjv: "And it shall be, when you show this people all these words, and they say to you, ‘Why has the Lord pronounced all this great disaster against us? Or what is our iniquity? Or what is our sin that we have committed against the Lord our God?’
verses.textEnNlt: "When you tell the people all these things, they will ask, ‘Why has the Lord decreed such terrible things against us? What have we done to deserve such treatment? What is our sin against the Lord our God?’
verses.textEnNasb: "Now it will happen that, when you tell this people all these words, they will say to you, ‘For what reason has the Lord declared all this great disaster against us? And what is our wrongdoing, or what is our sin that we have committed against the Lord our God?’
verses.textEn: "When you tell these people all this and they ask you, ‘Why has the Lord decreed such a great disaster against us? What wrong have we done? What sin have we committed against the Lord our God?’

verses.textZh: 你就要回答他们：‘因为你们的列祖离弃了我 ，他们随从别的神，事奉敬拜他们；他们离弃了我，不遵守我的律法。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你就要回答他们：‘因为你们的列祖离弃了我 ，他们随从别的神，事奉敬拜他们；他们离弃了我，不遵守我的律法。
verses.textZhCuv: 你就对他们说：『耶和华说：因为你们列祖离弃我，随从别神，事奉敬拜，不遵守我的律法，
verses.textEnNiv: then say to them, ‘It is because your ancestors forsook me,’ declares the Lord , ‘and followed other gods and served and worshiped them. They forsook me and did not keep my law.
verses.textEnEsv: then you shall say to them: ‘Because your fathers have forsaken me, declares the Lord , and have gone after other gods and have served and worshiped them, and have forsaken me and have not kept my law,
verses.textEnNkjv: then you shall say to them, ‘Because your fathers have forsaken Me,’ says the Lord; ‘they have walked after other gods and have served them and worshiped them, and have forsaken Me and not kept My law.
verses.textEnNlt: "Then you will give them the Lord ’s reply: ‘It is because your ancestors were unfaithful to me. They worshiped other gods and served them. They abandoned me and did not obey my word.
verses.textEnNasb: Then you are to say to them, ‘It is because your forefathers have abandoned Me,’ declares the Lord, ‘and have followed other gods, and served and worshiped them; but they have abandoned Me and have not kept My Law.
verses.textEn: then say to them, ‘It is because your ancestors forsook me,’ declares the Lord , ‘and followed other gods and served and worshiped them. They forsook me and did not keep my law.

verses.textZh: 至于你们，你们作坏事比你们的列祖更厉害；看哪！你们各人都随从自己顽梗的恶心行事，不听从我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 至于你们，你们作坏事比你们的列祖更厉害；看哪！你们各人都随从自己顽梗的恶心行事，不听从我。
verses.textZhCuv: 而且你们行恶比你们列祖更甚；因为各人随从自己顽梗的恶心行事，甚至不听从我，
verses.textEnNiv: But you have behaved more wickedly than your ancestors. See how all of you are following the stubbornness of your evil hearts instead of obeying me.
verses.textEnEsv: and because you have done worse than your fathers, for behold, every one of you follows his stubborn, evil will, refusing to listen to me.
verses.textEnNkjv: And you have done worse than your fathers, for behold, each one follows the dictates of his own evil heart, so that no one listens to Me.
verses.textEnNlt: And you are even worse than your ancestors! You stubbornly follow your own evil desires and refuse to listen to me.
verses.textEnNasb: You too have done evil, even more than your forefathers; for behold, each one of you is following the stubbornness of his own evil heart, without listening to Me.
verses.textEn: But you have behaved more wickedly than your ancestors. See how all of you are following the stubbornness of your evil hearts instead of obeying me.

verses.textZh: 因此，我要把你们从这地赶出去，去到你们和你们列祖所不认识的地；你们在那里必昼夜事奉别的神，因为我不再向你们施恩。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，我要把你们从这地赶出去，去到你们和你们列祖所不认识的地；你们在那里必昼夜事奉别的神，因为我不再向你们施恩。’
verses.textZhCuv: 所以我必将你们从这地赶出，直赶到你们和你们列祖素不认识的地。你们在那里必昼夜事奉别神，因为我必不向你们施恩。』」
verses.textEnNiv: So I will throw you out of this land into a land neither you nor your ancestors have known, and there you will serve other gods day and night, for I will show you no favor.’
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore I will hurl you out of this land into a land that neither you nor your fathers have known, and there you shall serve other gods day and night, for I will show you no favor.’
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore I will cast you out of this land into a land that you do not know, neither you nor your fathers; and there you shall serve other gods day and night, where I will not show you favor.’
verses.textEnNlt: So I will throw you out of this land and send you into a foreign land where you and your ancestors have never been. There you can worship idols day and night—and I will grant you no favors!’
verses.textEnNasb: So I will hurl you off this land to the land which you have not known, neither you nor your fathers; and there you will serve other gods day and night, because I will show you no compassion.’
verses.textEn: So I will throw you out of this land into a land neither you nor your ancestors have known, and there you will serve other gods day and night, for I will show you no favor.’

verses.textZh: "看哪！日子快到，人必不再指着那领以色列人从埃及地上来的永活的耶和华起誓。"这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: "看哪！日子快到，人必不再指着那领以色列人从埃及地上来的永活的耶和华起誓。"这是耶和华的宣告。
