verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华说：「日子将到，人必不再指着那领以色列人从埃及地上来之永生的耶和华起誓，
verses.textEnNiv: "However, the days are coming," declares the Lord , "when it will no longer be said, ‘As surely as the Lord lives, who brought the Israelites up out of Egypt,’
verses.textEnEsv: "Therefore, behold, the days are coming, declares the Lord , when it shall no longer be said, ‘As the Lord lives who brought up the people of Israel out of the land of Egypt,’
verses.textEnNkjv: "Therefore behold, the days are coming," says the Lord, "that it shall no more be said, ‘The Lord lives who brought up the children of Israel from the land of Egypt,’
verses.textEnNlt: "But the time is coming," says the Lord , "when people who are taking an oath will no longer say, ‘As surely as the Lord lives, who rescued the people of Israel from the land of Egypt.’
verses.textEnNasb: "Therefore behold, days are coming," declares the Lord, "when it will no longer be said, ‘As the Lord lives, who brought up the sons of Israel out of the land of Egypt,’
verses.textEn: "However, the days are coming," declares the Lord , "when it will no longer be said, ‘As surely as the Lord lives, who brought the Israelites up out of Egypt,’

verses.textZh: "他们却要指着那领以色列人从北方之地，从他们被赶逐到的各国上来的永活的耶和华起誓。因我要领他们回到自己的土地，就是我从前赐给他们列祖的。
verses.textZhCnvs: "他们却要指着那领以色列人从北方之地，从他们被赶逐到的各国上来的永活的耶和华起誓。因我要领他们回到自己的土地，就是我从前赐给他们列祖的。
verses.textZhCuv: 却要指着那领以色列人从北方之地，并赶他们到的各国上来之永生的耶和华起誓，并且我要领他们再入我从前赐给他们列祖之地。」
verses.textEnNiv: but it will be said, ‘As surely as the Lord lives, who brought the Israelites up out of the land of the north and out of all the countries where he had banished them.’ For I will restore them to the land I gave their ancestors.
verses.textEnEsv: but ‘As the Lord lives who brought up the people of Israel out of the north country and out of all the countries where he had driven them.’ For I will bring them back to their own land that I gave to their fathers.
verses.textEnNkjv: but, ‘The Lord lives who brought up the children of Israel from the land of the north and from all the lands where He had driven them.’ For I will bring them back into their land which I gave to their fathers.
verses.textEnNlt: Instead, they will say, ‘As surely as the Lord lives, who brought the people of Israel back to their own land from the land of the north and from all the countries to which he had exiled them.’ For I will bring them back to this land that I gave their ancestors.
verses.textEnNasb: but, ‘As the Lord lives, who brought up the sons of Israel from the land of the north and from all the lands where He had banished them.’ For I will restore them to their own land which I gave to their fathers.
verses.textEn: but it will be said, ‘As surely as the Lord lives, who brought the Israelites up out of the land of the north and out of all the countries where he had banished them.’ For I will restore them to the land I gave their ancestors.

verses.textZh: "看哪！我要差人去叫许多渔夫来，捕捉以色列人；然后我要差人去叫许多猎人来，从各大山、小山和岩石的裂缝里，猎取他们。"这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: "看哪！我要差人去叫许多渔夫来，捕捉以色列人；然后我要差人去叫许多猎人来，从各大山、小山和岩石的裂缝里，猎取他们。"这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华说：「我要召许多打鱼的把以色列人打上来，然后我要召许多打猎的，从各山上、各冈上、各石穴中猎取他们。
verses.textEnNiv: "But now I will send for many fishermen," declares the Lord , "and they will catch them. After that I will send for many hunters, and they will hunt them down on every mountain and hill and from the crevices of the rocks.
verses.textEnEsv: "Behold, I am sending for many fishers, declares the Lord , and they shall catch them. And afterward I will send for many hunters, and they shall hunt them from every mountain and every hill, and out of the clefts of the rocks.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Behold, I will send for many fishermen," says the Lord, "and they shall fish them; and afterward I will send for many hunters, and they shall hunt them from every mountain and every hill, and out of the holes of the rocks.
verses.textEnNlt: "But now I am sending for many fishermen who will catch them," says the Lord . "I am sending for hunters who will hunt them down in the mountains, hills, and caves.
verses.textEnNasb: "Behold, I am going to send for many fishermen," declares the Lord, "and they will fish for them; and afterward I will send for many hunters, and they will hunt them from every mountain and every hill and from the clefts of the rocks.
verses.textEn: "But now I will send for many fishermen," declares the Lord , "and they will catch them. After that I will send for many hunters, and they will hunt them down on every mountain and hill and from the crevices of the rocks.

verses.textZh: "因为我的眼察看他们所行的一切；在我面前这一切都无法隐藏，他们的罪孽不能从我眼前遮掩起来。
verses.textZhCnvs: "因为我的眼察看他们所行的一切；在我面前这一切都无法隐藏，他们的罪孽不能从我眼前遮掩起来。
verses.textZhCuv: 因我的眼目察看他们的一切行为；他们不能在我面前遮掩，他们的罪孽也不能在我眼前隐藏。
verses.textEnNiv: My eyes are on all their ways; they are not hidden from me, nor is their sin concealed from my eyes.
verses.textEnEsv: For my eyes are on all their ways. They are not hidden from me, nor is their iniquity concealed from my eyes.
verses.textEnNkjv: For My eyes are on all their ways; they are not hidden from My face, nor is their iniquity hidden from My eyes.
verses.textEnNlt: I am watching them closely, and I see every sin. They cannot hope to hide from me.
verses.textEnNasb: For My eyes are on all their ways; they are not hidden from My face, nor is their wrongdoing concealed from My eyes.
verses.textEn: My eyes are on all their ways; they are not hidden from me, nor is their sin concealed from my eyes.

verses.textZh: 首先我要加倍报应他们的罪孽和罪恶，因为他们用自己那些毫无生气、可憎的偶像 玷污了我的土地，他们那些可厌之物充满了我的产业。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 首先我要加倍报应他们的罪孽和罪恶，因为他们用自己那些毫无生气、可憎的偶像 玷污了我的土地，他们那些可厌之物充满了我的产业。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我先要加倍报应他们的罪孽和罪恶；因为他们用可憎之尸玷污我的地土，又用可厌之物充满我的产业。」
verses.textEnNiv: I will repay them double for their wickedness and their sin, because they have defiled my land with the lifeless forms of their vile images and have filled my inheritance with their detestable idols."
verses.textEnEsv: But first I will doubly repay their iniquity and their sin, because they have polluted my land with the carcasses of their detestable idols, and have filled my inheritance with their abominations."
verses.textEnNkjv: And first I will repay double for their iniquity and their sin, because they have defiled My land; they have filled My inheritance with the carcasses of their detestable and abominable idols."
verses.textEnNlt: I will double their punishment for all their sins, because they have defiled my land with lifeless images of their detestable gods and have filled my territory with their evil deeds."
verses.textEnNasb: I will first repay them double for their wrongdoing and their sin, because they have defiled My land; they have filled My inheritance with the carcasses of their detestable idols and their abominations."
verses.textEn: I will repay them double for their wickedness and their sin, because they have defiled my land with the lifeless forms of their vile images and have filled my inheritance with their detestable idols."

verses.textZh: 耶和华，我的力量、我的堡垒、 我遭难时的避难所啊！ 万国要从地极前来朝见你，说： "我们列祖所承受的只是虚假的偶像， 是虚空、一无用处的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华，我的力量、我的堡垒、 我遭难时的避难所啊！ 万国要从地极前来朝见你，说： "我们列祖所承受的只是虚假的偶像， 是虚空、一无用处的。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，你是我的力量， 是我的保障； 在苦难之日是我的避难所。 列国人必从地极来到你这里， 说：我们列祖所承受的， 不过是虚假，是虚空无益之物。
verses.textEnNiv: Lord , my strength and my fortress, my refuge in time of distress, to you the nations will come from the ends of the earth and say, "Our ancestors possessed nothing but false gods, worthless idols that did them no good.
verses.textEnEsv: O Lord , my strength and my stronghold, my refuge in the day of trouble, to you shall the nations come from the ends of the earth and say: "Our fathers have inherited nothing but lies, worthless things in which there is no profit.
verses.textEnNkjv: O Lord, my strength and my fortress, My refuge in the day of affliction, The Gentiles shall come to You From the ends of the earth and say, "Surely our fathers have inherited lies, Worthlessness and unprofitable things."
verses.textEnNlt: Lord , you are my strength and fortress, my refuge in the day of trouble! Nations from around the world will come to you and say, "Our ancestors left us a foolish heritage, for they worshiped worthless idols.
verses.textEnNasb: Lord, my strength and my stronghold, And my refuge in the day of distress, To You the nations will come From the ends of the earth and say, "Our fathers have inherited nothing but falsehood, Futility, and things of no benefit."
verses.textEn: Lord , my strength and my fortress, my refuge in time of distress, to you the nations will come from the ends of the earth and say, "Our ancestors possessed nothing but false gods, worthless idols that did them no good.

verses.textZh: 人岂能为自己制造神呢？ 其实这些偶像并不是神。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 人岂能为自己制造神呢？ 其实这些偶像并不是神。"
verses.textZhCuv: 人岂可为自己制造神呢？ 其实这不是神。
verses.textEnNiv: Do people make their own gods? Yes, but they are not gods!"
verses.textEnEsv: Can man make for himself gods? Such are not gods!"
verses.textEnNkjv: Will a man make gods for himself, Which are not gods?
verses.textEnNlt: Can people make their own gods? These are not real gods at all!"
verses.textEnNasb: Can a person make gods for himself? But they are not gods!
verses.textEn: Do people make their own gods? Yes, but they are not gods!"

verses.textZh: "因此，看哪！我要使他们知道， 这一次我必叫他们认识 我的手和我的能力， 他们就知道我的名是耶和华。"
verses.textZhCnvs: "因此，看哪！我要使他们知道， 这一次我必叫他们认识 我的手和我的能力， 他们就知道我的名是耶和华。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华说：「我要使他们知道，就是这一次使他们知道我的手和我的能力。他们就知道我的名是耶和华了。」
verses.textEnNiv: "Therefore I will teach them— this time I will teach them my power and might. Then they will know that my name is the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: "Therefore, behold, I will make them know, this once I will make them know my power and my might, and they shall know that my name is the Lord ."
verses.textEnNkjv: "Therefore behold, I will this once cause them to know, I will cause them to know My hand and My might; And they shall know that My name is the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord says, "Now I will show them my power; now I will show them my might. At last they will know and understand that I am the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: "Therefore behold, I am going to make them know— This time I will make them know My power and My might; And they will know that My name is the Lord."
verses.textEn: "Therefore I will teach them— this time I will teach them my power and might. Then they will know that my name is the Lord .

verses.textZh: "犹大的罪是用铁笔铭记的，是用金钢钻刻在他们的心版上，和他们 祭坛的角上。
verses.textZhCnvs: "犹大的罪是用铁笔铭记的，是用金钢钻刻在他们的心版上，和他们 祭坛的角上。
verses.textZhCuv: 犹大的罪是用铁笔、用金钢钻记录的，铭刻在他们的心版上和坛角上。
verses.textEnNiv: "Judah’s sin is engraved with an iron tool, inscribed with a flint point, on the tablets of their hearts and on the horns of their altars.
verses.textEnEsv: "The sin of Judah is written with a pen of iron; with a point of diamond it is engraved on the tablet of their heart, and on the horns of their altars,
verses.textEnNkjv: "The sin of Judah is written with a pen of iron; With the point of a diamond itis engraved On the tablet of their heart, And on the horns of your altars,
verses.textEnNlt: "The sin of Judah is inscribed with an iron chisel— engraved with a diamond point on their stony hearts and on the corners of their altars.
verses.textEnNasb: The sin of Judah is written with an iron stylus; With a diamond point it is engraved on the tablet of their hearts And on the horns of their altars,
verses.textEn: "Judah’s sin is engraved with an iron tool, inscribed with a flint point, on the tablets of their hearts and on the horns of their altars.

verses.textZh: 他们的儿女也怀念着 那些在各高冈上、 在繁茂树旁的祭坛和亚舍拉。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们的儿女也怀念着 那些在各高冈上、 在繁茂树旁的祭坛和亚舍拉。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们的儿女记念他们高冈上、青翠树旁的坛和木偶。
verses.textEnNiv: Even their children remember their altars and Asherah poles beside the spreading trees and on the high hills.
verses.textEnEsv: while their children remember their altars and their Asherim, beside every green tree and on the high hills,
verses.textEnNkjv: While their children remember Their altars and their wooden images By the green trees on the high hills.
verses.textEnNlt: Even their children go to worship at their pagan altars and Asherah poles, beneath every green tree and on every high hill.
verses.textEnNasb: As they remember their children, So they remember their altars and their Asherim By green trees on the high hills.
verses.textEn: Even their children remember their altars and Asherah poles beside the spreading trees and on the high hills.

verses.textZh: 我在田野的山哪！ 因你在四境之内所犯的罪， 我必把你的财产、一切宝物和你的邱坛， 给敌人作掠物。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我在田野的山哪！ 因你在四境之内所犯的罪， 我必把你的财产、一切宝物和你的邱坛， 给敌人作掠物。
verses.textZhCuv: 我田野的山哪，我必因你在四境之内所犯的罪，把你的货物、财宝，并邱坛当掠物交给仇敌；
verses.textEnNiv: My mountain in the land and your wealth and all your treasures I will give away as plunder, together with your high places, because of sin throughout your country.
verses.textEnEsv: on the mountains in the open country. Your wealth and all your treasures I will give for spoil as the price of your high places for sin throughout all your territory.
verses.textEnNkjv: O My mountain in the field, I will give as plunder your wealth, all your treasures, And your high places of sin within all your borders.
verses.textEnNlt: So I will hand over my holy mountain— along with all your wealth and treasures and your pagan shrines— as plunder to your enemies, for sin runs rampant in your land.
verses.textEnNasb: Mountain of Mine in the countryside, I will turn over your wealth and all your treasures as plunder, Your high places for sin throughout your borders.
verses.textEn: My mountain in the land and your wealth and all your treasures I will give away as plunder, together with your high places, because of sin throughout your country.

verses.textZh: 因你自己的缘故，我赐给你的产业，你必失掉； 我必使你在你不认识的地方， 服事你的仇敌； 因为你们惹起我的怒火， 我的怒火必燃烧到永远。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 因你自己的缘故，我赐给你的产业，你必失掉； 我必使你在你不认识的地方， 服事你的仇敌； 因为你们惹起我的怒火， 我的怒火必燃烧到永远。"
verses.textZhCuv: 并且你因自己的罪必失去我所赐给你的产业。我也必使你在你所不认识的地上服事你的仇敌；因为你使我怒中起火，直烧到永远。
verses.textEnNiv: Through your own fault you will lose the inheritance I gave you. I will enslave you to your enemies in a land you do not know, for you have kindled my anger, and it will burn forever."
verses.textEnEsv: You shall loosen your hand from your heritage that I gave to you, and I will make you serve your enemies in a land that you do not know, for in my anger a fire is kindled that shall burn forever."
verses.textEnNkjv: And you, even yourself, Shall let go of your heritage which I gave you; And I will cause you to serve your enemies In the land which you do not know; For you have kindled a fire in My anger which shall burn forever."
verses.textEnNlt: The wonderful possession I have reserved for you will slip from your hands. I will tell your enemies to take you as captives to a foreign land. For my anger blazes like a fire that will burn forever."
verses.textEnNasb: And you will, even of yourself, let go of your inheritance That I gave you; And I will make you serve your enemies In the land which you do not know; For you have kindled a fire in My anger Which will burn forever.
verses.textEn: Through your own fault you will lose the inheritance I gave you. I will enslave you to your enemies in a land you do not know, for you have kindled my anger, and it will burn forever."

verses.textZh: 耶和华这样说： "倚靠世人， 恃凭肉体为自己的力量， 心里偏离耶和华的， 这人该受咒诅。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华这样说： "倚靠世人， 恃凭肉体为自己的力量， 心里偏离耶和华的， 这人该受咒诅。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华如此说： 倚靠人血肉的膀臂， 心中离弃耶和华的， 那人有祸了！
verses.textEnNiv: This is what the Lord says: "Cursed is the one who trusts in man, who draws strength from mere flesh and whose heart turns away from the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: Thus says the Lord : "Cursed is the man who trusts in man and makes flesh his strength, whose heart turns away from the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus says the Lord: "Cursed is the man who trusts in man And makes flesh his strength, Whose heart departs from the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: This is what the Lord says: "Cursed are those who put their trust in mere humans, who rely on human strength and turn their hearts away from the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: This is what the Lord says: "Cursed is the man who trusts in mankind And makes flesh his strength, And whose heart turns away from the Lord.
verses.textEn: This is what the Lord says: "Cursed is the one who trusts in man, who draws strength from mere flesh and whose heart turns away from the Lord .

verses.textZh: 他必像沙漠中的灌木， 福乐来到，他也必看不见， 却要住在旷野干旱之地、 无人居住的咸地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他必像沙漠中的灌木， 福乐来到，他也必看不见， 却要住在旷野干旱之地、 无人居住的咸地。
verses.textZhCuv: 因他必像沙漠的杜松， 不见福乐来到， 却要住旷野干旱之处， 无人居住的硷地。
verses.textEnNiv: That person will be like a bush in the wastelands; they will not see prosperity when it comes. They will dwell in the parched places of the desert, in a salt land where no one lives.
verses.textEnEsv: He is like a shrub in the desert, and shall not see any good come. He shall dwell in the parched places of the wilderness, in an uninhabited salt land.
verses.textEnNkjv: For he shall be like a shrub in the desert, And shall not see when good comes, But shall inhabit the parched places in the wilderness, In a salt land whichis not inhabited.
verses.textEnNlt: They are like stunted shrubs in the desert, with no hope for the future. They will live in the barren wilderness, in an uninhabited salty land.
verses.textEnNasb: "For he will be like a bush in the desert, And will not see when prosperity comes, But will live in stony wastes in the wilderness, A land of salt that is not inhabited.
verses.textEn: That person will be like a bush in the wastelands; they will not see prosperity when it comes. They will dwell in the parched places of the desert, in a salt land where no one lives.

verses.textZh: 但倚靠耶和华， 以耶和华为他所信赖的， 这人是有福的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但倚靠耶和华， 以耶和华为他所信赖的， 这人是有福的。
verses.textZhCuv: 倚靠耶和华、以耶和华为可靠的， 那人有福了！
verses.textEnNiv: "But blessed is the one who trusts in the Lord , whose confidence is in him.
verses.textEnEsv: "Blessed is the man who trusts in the Lord , whose trust is the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: "Blessed is the man who trusts in the Lord, And whose hope is the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: "But blessed are those who trust in the Lord and have made the Lord their hope and confidence.
verses.textEnNasb: "Blessed is the man who trusts in the Lord, And whose trust is the Lord.
verses.textEn: "But blessed is the one who trusts in the Lord , whose confidence is in him.

verses.textZh: 他必像一棵树，栽种在水边， 树根伸进河里； 炎热来到，并不害怕， 树叶仍然繁茂； 在荒旱之年，它不挂虑， 并且不断结果子。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他必像一棵树，栽种在水边， 树根伸进河里； 炎热来到，并不害怕， 树叶仍然繁茂； 在荒旱之年，它不挂虑， 并且不断结果子。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他必像树栽于水旁， 在河边扎根， 炎热来到，并不惧怕， 叶子仍必青翠， 在干旱之年毫无挂虑， 而且结果不止。
verses.textEnNiv: They will be like a tree planted by the water that sends out its roots by the stream. It does not fear when heat comes; its leaves are always green. It has no worries in a year of drought and never fails to bear fruit."
verses.textEnEsv: He is like a tree planted by water, that sends out its roots by the stream, and does not fear when heat comes, for its leaves remain green, and is not anxious in the year of drought, for it does not cease to bear fruit."
verses.textEnNkjv: For he shall be like a tree planted by the waters, Which spreads out its roots by the river, And will not fear when heat comes; But its leaf will be green, And will not be anxious in the year of drought, Nor will cease from yielding fruit.
verses.textEnNlt: They are like trees planted along a riverbank, with roots that reach deep into the water. Such trees are not bothered by the heat or worried by long months of drought. Their leaves stay green, and they never stop producing fruit.
verses.textEnNasb: "For he will be like a tree planted by the water That extends its roots by a stream, And does not fear when the heat comes; But its leaves will be green, And it will not be anxious in a year of drought, Nor cease to yield fruit.
verses.textEn: They will be like a tree planted by the water that sends out its roots by the stream. It does not fear when heat comes; its leaves are always green. It has no worries in a year of drought and never fails to bear fruit."

verses.textZh: 人心比万物都诡诈， 无法医治； 谁能识透呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 人心比万物都诡诈， 无法医治； 谁能识透呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 人心比万物都诡诈， 坏到极处， 谁能识透呢？
verses.textEnNiv: The heart is deceitful above all things and beyond cure. Who can understand it?
verses.textEnEsv: The heart is deceitful above all things, and desperately sick; who can understand it?
verses.textEnNkjv: "The heart is deceitful above all things, And desperately wicked; Who can know it?
verses.textEnNlt: "The human heart is the most deceitful of all things, and desperately wicked. Who really knows how bad it is?
verses.textEnNasb: "The heart is more deceitful than all else And is desperately sick; Who can understand it?
verses.textEn: The heart is deceitful above all things and beyond cure. Who can understand it?

verses.textZh: "我耶和华是察透人心， 试验人肺腑的， 要照着各人的行为， 和各人所作的事应得的结果报应各人。"
verses.textZhCnvs: "我耶和华是察透人心， 试验人肺腑的， 要照着各人的行为， 和各人所作的事应得的结果报应各人。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我－耶和华是鉴察人心、试验人肺腑的， 要照各人所行的和他做事的结果报应他。
verses.textEnNiv: "I the Lord search the heart and examine the mind, to reward each person according to their conduct, according to what their deeds deserve."
verses.textEnEsv: "I the Lord search the heart and test the mind, to give every man according to his ways, according to the fruit of his deeds."
verses.textEnNkjv: I, the Lord, search the heart, I test the mind, Even to give every man according to his ways, According to the fruit of his doings.
verses.textEnNlt: But I, the Lord , search all hearts and examine secret motives. I give all people their due rewards, according to what their actions deserve."
verses.textEnNasb: "I, the Lord, search the heart, I test the mind, To give to each person according to his ways, According to the results of his deeds.
verses.textEn: "I the Lord search the heart and examine the mind, to reward each person according to their conduct, according to what their deeds deserve."

verses.textZh: 使用不公正的方法发财的， 就像一只鹧鸪孵了不是自己所生的蛋； 到了中年，那财富必离开他， 最后他必成为一个愚昧人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 使用不公正的方法发财的， 就像一只鹧鸪孵了不是自己所生的蛋； 到了中年，那财富必离开他， 最后他必成为一个愚昧人。
verses.textZhCuv: 那不按正道得财的， 好像鹧鸪抱不是自己下的蛋； 到了中年，那财都必离开他， 他终久成为愚顽人。
verses.textEnNiv: Like a partridge that hatches eggs it did not lay are those who gain riches by unjust means. When their lives are half gone, their riches will desert them, and in the end they will prove to be fools.
verses.textEnEsv: Like the partridge that gathers a brood that she did not hatch, so is he who gets riches but not by justice; in the midst of his days they will leave him, and at his end he will be a fool.
verses.textEnNkjv: "As a partridge that broods but does not hatch, Sois he who gets riches, but not by right; It will leave him in the midst of his days, And at his end he will be a fool."
verses.textEnNlt: Like a partridge that hatches eggs she has not laid, so are those who get their wealth by unjust means. At midlife they will lose their riches; in the end, they will become poor old fools.
verses.textEnNasb: "As a partridge that hatches eggs which it has not laid, So is a person who makes a fortune, but unjustly; In the middle of his days it will abandon him, And in the end he will be a fool."
verses.textEn: Like a partridge that hatches eggs it did not lay are those who gain riches by unjust means. When their lives are half gone, their riches will desert them, and in the end they will prove to be fools.

verses.textZh: 我们的圣所是荣耀的宝座， 从起初就矗立在高处。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们的圣所是荣耀的宝座， 从起初就矗立在高处。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们的圣所是荣耀的宝座， 从太初安置在高处。
verses.textEnNiv: A glorious throne, exalted from the beginning, is the place of our sanctuary.
verses.textEnEsv: A glorious throne set on high from the beginning is the place of our sanctuary.
verses.textEnNkjv: A glorious high throne from the beginning Is the place of our sanctuary.
verses.textEnNlt: But we worship at your throne— eternal, high, and glorious!
verses.textEnNasb: A glorious throne on high from the beginning Is the place of our sanctuary.
verses.textEn: A glorious throne, exalted from the beginning, is the place of our sanctuary.

verses.textZh: 耶和华以色列的盼望啊！ 离弃你的，都必蒙羞； 偏离你 的，他们的名字必写在沙土上， 因为他们离弃了耶和华这活水的源头。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华以色列的盼望啊！ 离弃你的，都必蒙羞； 偏离你 的，他们的名字必写在沙土上， 因为他们离弃了耶和华这活水的源头。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华－以色列的盼望啊， 凡离弃你的必致蒙羞。 耶和华说：离开我的， 他们的名字必写在土里， 因为他们离弃我这活水的泉源。
verses.textEnNiv: Lord , you are the hope of Israel; all who forsake you will be put to shame. Those who turn away from you will be written in the dust because they have forsaken the Lord , the spring of living water.
verses.textEnEsv: O Lord , the hope of Israel, all who forsake you shall be put to shame; those who turn away from you shall be written in the earth, for they have forsaken the Lord , the fountain of living water.
verses.textEnNkjv: O Lord, the hope of Israel, All who forsake You shall be ashamed. "Those who depart from Me Shall be written in the earth, Because they have forsaken the Lord, The fountain of living waters."
verses.textEnNlt: O Lord , the hope of Israel, all who turn away from you will be disgraced. They will be buried in the dust of the earth, for they have abandoned the Lord , the fountain of living water.
verses.textEnNasb: Lord, the hope of Israel, All who abandon You will be put to shame. Those who turn away on earth will be written down, Because they have forsaken the fountain of living water, that is the Lord.
verses.textEn: Lord , you are the hope of Israel; all who forsake you will be put to shame. Those who turn away from you will be written in the dust because they have forsaken the Lord , the spring of living water.

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊！求你医治我，我就得医治； 求你拯救我，我就得拯救； 因为你是我所赞美的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊！求你医治我，我就得医治； 求你拯救我，我就得拯救； 因为你是我所赞美的。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，求你医治我，我便痊愈， 拯救我，我便得救； 因你是我所赞美的。
verses.textEnNiv: Heal me, Lord , and I will be healed; save me and I will be saved, for you are the one I praise.
verses.textEnEsv: Heal me, O Lord , and I shall be healed; save me, and I shall be saved, for you are my praise.
verses.textEnNkjv: Heal me, O Lord, and I shall be healed; Save me, and I shall be saved, For You are my praise.
verses.textEnNlt: O Lord , if you heal me, I will be truly healed; if you save me, I will be truly saved. My praises are for you alone!
verses.textEnNasb: Heal me, Lord, and I will be healed; Save me and I will be saved, For You are my praise.
verses.textEn: Heal me, Lord , and I will be healed; save me and I will be saved, for you are the one I praise.

verses.textZh: 看哪！他们常常对我说： "耶和华的话在哪里？使它应验 吧！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 看哪！他们常常对我说： "耶和华的话在哪里？使它应验 吧！"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们对我说：耶和华的话在哪里呢？ 叫这话应验吧！
verses.textEnNiv: They keep saying to me, "Where is the word of the Lord ? Let it now be fulfilled!"
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, they say to me, "Where is the word of the Lord ? Let it come!"
verses.textEnNkjv: Indeed they say to me, "Where is the word of the Lord? Let it come now!"
verses.textEnNlt: People scoff at me and say, "What is this ‘message from the Lord ’ you talk about? Why don’t your predictions come true?"
verses.textEnNasb: Look, they keep saying to me, "Where is the word of the Lord? Let it come now!"
verses.textEn: They keep saying to me, "Where is the word of the Lord ? Let it now be fulfilled!"

verses.textZh: 至于我，我没有急忙离弃那跟从你作牧人的职分 ， 也没有想望灾难的日子， 这是你知道的； 我嘴里所出的话都在你面前。
verses.textZhCnvs: 至于我，我没有急忙离弃那跟从你作牧人的职分 ， 也没有想望灾难的日子， 这是你知道的； 我嘴里所出的话都在你面前。
verses.textZhCuv: 至于我，那跟从你作牧人的职分， 我并没有急忙离弃， 也没有想那灾殃的日子； 这是你知道的。 我口中所出的言语都在你面前。
verses.textEnNiv: I have not run away from being your shepherd; you know I have not desired the day of despair. What passes my lips is open before you.
verses.textEnEsv: I have not run away from being your shepherd, nor have I desired the day of sickness. You know what came out of my lips; it was before your face.
verses.textEnNkjv: As for me, I have not hurried away from being a shepherd who follows You, Nor have I desired the woeful day; You know what came out of my lips; It was right there before You.
verses.textEnNlt: Lord , I have not abandoned my job as a shepherd for your people. I have not urged you to send disaster. You have heard everything I’ve said.
verses.textEnNasb: But as for me, I have not hurried away from being a shepherd following after You, Nor have I longed for the disastrous day; You Yourself know that the utterance of my lips Was in Your presence.
verses.textEn: I have not run away from being your shepherd; you know I have not desired the day of despair. What passes my lips is open before you.

verses.textZh: 求你不要使我因你惊恐， 在灾祸的日子，你是我的避难所。
verses.textZhCnvs: 求你不要使我因你惊恐， 在灾祸的日子，你是我的避难所。
verses.textZhCuv: 不要使我因你惊恐； 当灾祸的日子，你是我的避难所。
verses.textEnNiv: Do not be a terror to me; you are my refuge in the day of disaster.
verses.textEnEsv: Be not a terror to me; you are my refuge in the day of disaster.
verses.textEnNkjv: Do not be a terror to me; You are my hope in the day of doom.
verses.textEnNlt: Lord , don’t terrorize me! You alone are my hope in the day of disaster.
verses.textEnNasb: Do not be a terror to me; You are my refuge in a day of disaster.
verses.textEn: Do not be a terror to me; you are my refuge in the day of disaster.

verses.textZh: 愿那些迫害我的蒙羞，却不要叫我蒙羞； 愿他们惊恐，却不要使我惊恐； 求你使灾祸的日子临到他们，加倍毁灭他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿那些迫害我的蒙羞，却不要叫我蒙羞； 愿他们惊恐，却不要使我惊恐； 求你使灾祸的日子临到他们，加倍毁灭他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 愿那些逼迫我的蒙羞， 却不要使我蒙羞； 使他们惊惶， 却不要使我惊惶； 使灾祸的日子临到他们， 以加倍的毁坏毁坏他们。
verses.textEnNiv: Let my persecutors be put to shame, but keep me from shame; let them be terrified, but keep me from terror. Bring on them the day of disaster; destroy them with double destruction.
verses.textEnEsv: Let those be put to shame who persecute me, but let me not be put to shame; let them be dismayed, but let me not be dismayed; bring upon them the day of disaster; destroy them with double destruction!
verses.textEnNkjv: Let them be ashamed who persecute me, But do not let me be put to shame; Let them be dismayed, But do not let me be dismayed. Bring on them the day of doom, And destroy them with double destruction!
verses.textEnNlt: Bring shame and dismay on all who persecute me, but don’t let me experience shame and dismay. Bring a day of terror on them. Yes, bring double destruction upon them!
verses.textEnNasb: Let those who persecute me be put to shame, but as for me, let me not be put to shame; Let them be dismayed, but let me not be dismayed. Bring on them a day of disaster, And crush them with double destruction!
verses.textEn: Let my persecutors be put to shame, but keep me from shame; let them be terrified, but keep me from terror. Bring on them the day of disaster; destroy them with double destruction.

verses.textZh: 耶和华对我这样说："你去站在犹大列王出入的城门 ，又站在耶路撒冷的各城门口，
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对我这样说："你去站在犹大列王出入的城门 ，又站在耶路撒冷的各城门口，
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华对我如此说：「你去站在平民的门口，就是犹大君王出入的门，又站在耶路撒冷的各门口，
verses.textEnNiv: This is what the Lord said to me: "Go and stand at the Gate of the People, through which the kings of Judah go in and out; stand also at all the other gates of Jerusalem.
verses.textEnEsv: Thus said the Lord to me: "Go and stand in the People’s Gate, by which the kings of Judah enter and by which they go out, and in all the gates of Jerusalem,
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus the Lord said to me: "Go and stand in the gate of the children of the people, by which the kings of Judah come in and by which they go out, and in all the gates of Jerusalem;
verses.textEnNlt: This is what the Lord said to me: "Go and stand in the gates of Jerusalem, first in the gate where the king goes in and out, and then in each of the other gates.
verses.textEnNasb: This is what the Lord said to me: "Go and stand at the public gate, through which the kings of Judah come in and go out, as well as at all the gates of Jerusalem;
verses.textEn: This is what the Lord said to me: "Go and stand at the Gate of the People, through which the kings of Judah go in and out; stand also at all the other gates of Jerusalem.

verses.textZh: 对他们说：‘耶路撒冷诸王、犹大众民和所有进入这些城门的犹大居民哪！你们要听他耶和华的话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 对他们说：‘耶路撒冷诸王、犹大众民和所有进入这些城门的犹大居民哪！你们要听他耶和华的话。
verses.textZhCuv: 对他们说：『你们这犹大君王和犹大众人，并耶路撒冷的一切居民，凡从这些门进入的都当听耶和华的话。
verses.textEnNiv: Say to them, ‘Hear the word of the Lord , you kings of Judah and all people of Judah and everyone living in Jerusalem who come through these gates.
verses.textEnEsv: and say: ‘Hear the word of the Lord , you kings of Judah, and all Judah, and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem, who enter by these gates.
verses.textEnNkjv: and say to them, ‘Hear the word of the Lord, you kings of Judah, and all Judah, and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem, who enter by these gates.
verses.textEnNlt: Say to all the people, ‘Listen to this message from the Lord , you kings of Judah and all you people of Judah and everyone living in Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNasb: and say to them, ‘Listen to the word of the Lord, you kings of Judah, and all Judah, and all inhabitants of Jerusalem who come in through these gates.
verses.textEn: Say to them, ‘Hear the word of the Lord , you kings of Judah and all people of Judah and everyone living in Jerusalem who come through these gates.

verses.textZh: 耶和华这样说：为了自己的性命，你们要谨慎，不可在安息日挑担子，不可挑进耶路撒冷的城门。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华这样说：为了自己的性命，你们要谨慎，不可在安息日挑担子，不可挑进耶路撒冷的城门。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华如此说：你们要谨慎，不要在安息日担什么担子进入耶路撒冷的各门；
verses.textEnNiv: This is what the Lord says: Be careful not to carry a load on the Sabbath day or bring it through the gates of Jerusalem.
verses.textEnEsv: Thus says the Lord : Take care for the sake of your lives, and do not bear a burden on the Sabbath day or bring it in by the gates of Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus says the Lord: "Take heed to yourselves, and bear no burden on the Sabbath day, nor bring it in by the gates of Jerusalem;
verses.textEnNlt: This is what the Lord says: Listen to my warning! Stop carrying on your trade at Jerusalem’s gates on the Sabbath day.
verses.textEnNasb: This is what the Lord says: "Take care for yourselves, and do not carry any load on the Sabbath day or bring anything in through the gates of Jerusalem.
verses.textEn: This is what the Lord says: Be careful not to carry a load on the Sabbath day or bring it through the gates of Jerusalem.

verses.textZh: 也不可在安息日从你们家里挑担子出来；甚么工都不可作，却要守安息日为圣日，正如我吩咐你们列祖的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 也不可在安息日从你们家里挑担子出来；甚么工都不可作，却要守安息日为圣日，正如我吩咐你们列祖的。
verses.textZhCuv: 也不要在安息日从家中担出担子去。无论何工都不可做，只要以安息日为圣日，正如我所吩咐你们列祖的。』
verses.textEnNiv: Do not bring a load out of your houses or do any work on the Sabbath, but keep the Sabbath day holy, as I commanded your ancestors.
verses.textEnEsv: And do not carry a burden out of your houses on the Sabbath or do any work, but keep the Sabbath day holy, as I commanded your fathers.
verses.textEnNkjv: nor carry a burden out of your houses on the Sabbath day, nor do any work, but hallow the Sabbath day, as I commanded your fathers.
verses.textEnNlt: Do not do your work on the Sabbath, but make it a holy day. I gave this command to your ancestors,
verses.textEnNasb: You shall not bring a load out of your houses on the Sabbath day nor do any work, but keep the Sabbath day holy, just as I commanded your forefathers.
verses.textEn: Do not bring a load out of your houses or do any work on the Sabbath, but keep the Sabbath day holy, as I commanded your ancestors.

verses.textZh: 你们的列祖却没有听从，毫不在意，反而硬着颈项不肯听，不受管教。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们的列祖却没有听从，毫不在意，反而硬着颈项不肯听，不受管教。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们却不听从，不侧耳而听，竟硬着颈项不听，不受教训。」
verses.textEnNiv: Yet they did not listen or pay attention; they were stiff-necked and would not listen or respond to discipline.
verses.textEnEsv: Yet they did not listen or incline their ear, but stiffened their neck, that they might not hear and receive instruction.
verses.textEnNkjv: But they did not obey nor incline their ear, but made their neck stiff, that they might not hear nor receive instruction.
verses.textEnNlt: but they did not listen or obey. They stubbornly refused to pay attention or accept my discipline.
verses.textEnNasb: Yet they did not listen or incline their ears, but stiffened their necks so as not to listen or accept discipline.
verses.textEn: Yet they did not listen or pay attention; they were stiff-necked and would not listen or respond to discipline.

verses.textZh: 耶和华宣告说："但如果你们真心听从我，不在安息日挑担子进入这城的城门，并且守安息日为圣日，在那日不作任何工作；
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华宣告说："但如果你们真心听从我，不在安息日挑担子进入这城的城门，并且守安息日为圣日，在那日不作任何工作；
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华说：「你们若留意听从我，在安息日不担什么担子进入这城的各门，只以安息日为圣日，在那日无论何工都不做；
verses.textEnNiv: But if you are careful to obey me, declares the Lord , and bring no load through the gates of this city on the Sabbath, but keep the Sabbath day holy by not doing any work on it,
verses.textEnEsv: "‘But if you listen to me, declares the Lord , and bring in no burden by the gates of this city on the Sabbath day, but keep the Sabbath day holy and do no work on it,
verses.textEnNkjv: "And it shall be, if you heed Me carefully," says the Lord, "to bring no burden through the gates of this city on the Sabbath day, but hallow the Sabbath day, to do no work in it,
verses.textEnNlt: "‘But if you obey me, says the Lord , and do not carry on your trade at the gates or work on the Sabbath day, and if you keep it holy,
verses.textEnNasb: "But it will come about, if you give your attention to Me," declares the Lord, "to bring no load in through the gates of this city on the Sabbath day, but to keep the Sabbath day holy by doing no work on it,
verses.textEn: But if you are careful to obey me, declares the Lord , and bring no load through the gates of this city on the Sabbath, but keep the Sabbath day holy by not doing any work on it,

verses.textZh: 这样，就必有坐大卫王位的列王，并有众领袖随着，进入这城的城门；列王和众领袖乘着车，骑着马，跟犹大人和耶路撒冷的居民一同进入这城。这城必永远有人居住。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这样，就必有坐大卫王位的列王，并有众领袖随着，进入这城的城门；列王和众领袖乘着车，骑着马，跟犹大人和耶路撒冷的居民一同进入这城。这城必永远有人居住。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时就有坐大卫宝座的君王和首领，他们与犹大人，并耶路撒冷的居民，或坐车，或骑马，进入这城的各门，而且这城必存到永远。
verses.textEnNiv: then kings who sit on David’s throne will come through the gates of this city with their officials. They and their officials will come riding in chariots and on horses, accompanied by the men of Judah and those living in Jerusalem, and this city will be inhabited forever.
verses.textEnEsv: then there shall enter by the gates of this city kings and princes who sit on the throne of David, riding in chariots and on horses, they and their officials, the men of Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem. And this city shall be inhabited forever.
verses.textEnNkjv: then shall enter the gates of this city kings and princes sitting on the throne of David, riding in chariots and on horses, they and their princes, accompanied by the men of Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem; and this city shall remain forever.
verses.textEnNlt: then kings and their officials will go in and out of these gates forever. There will always be a descendant of David sitting on the throne here in Jerusalem. Kings and their officials will always ride in and out among the people of Judah in chariots and on horses, and this city will remain forever.
verses.textEnNasb: then there will come in through the gates of this city kings and officials sitting on the throne of David, riding in chariots and on horses, they and their officials, the men of Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and this city will be inhabited forever.
verses.textEn: then kings who sit on David’s throne will come through the gates of this city with their officials. They and their officials will come riding in chariots and on horses, accompanied by the men of Judah and those living in Jerusalem, and this city will be inhabited forever.

verses.textZh: 必有人从犹大的各城和耶路撒冷周围的各处，从便雅悯地、低地、山地和南地而来；他们带着燔祭、平安祭、素祭、乳香和感恩祭到耶和华的殿里去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 必有人从犹大的各城和耶路撒冷周围的各处，从便雅悯地、低地、山地和南地而来；他们带着燔祭、平安祭、素祭、乳香和感恩祭到耶和华的殿里去。
verses.textZhCuv: 也必有人从犹大城邑和耶路撒冷四围的各处，从便雅悯地、高原、山地，并南地而来，都带燔祭、平安祭、素祭，和乳香，并感谢祭，到耶和华的殿去。
verses.textEnNiv: People will come from the towns of Judah and the villages around Jerusalem, from the territory of Benjamin and the western foothills, from the hill country and the Negev, bringing burnt offerings and sacrifices, grain offerings and incense, and bringing thank offerings to the house of the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: And people shall come from the cities of Judah and the places around Jerusalem, from the land of Benjamin, from the Shephelah, from the hill country, and from the Negeb, bringing burnt offerings and sacrifices, grain offerings and frankincense, and bringing thank offerings to the house of the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: And they shall come from the cities of Judah and from the places around Jerusalem, from the land of Benjamin and from the lowland, from the mountains and from the South, bringing burnt offerings and sacrifices, grain offerings and incense, bringing sacrifices of praise to the house of the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: And from all around Jerusalem, from the towns of Judah and Benjamin, from the western foothills and the hill country and the Negev, the people will come with their burnt offerings and sacrifices. They will bring their grain offerings, frankincense, and thanksgiving offerings to the Lord ’s Temple.
verses.textEnNasb: They will come in from the cities of Judah and from the areas surrounding Jerusalem, from the land of Benjamin, from the lowland, from the hill country, and from the Negev, bringing burnt offerings, sacrifices, grain offerings, and frankincense, and bringing sacrifices of thanksgiving to the house of the Lord.
verses.textEn: People will come from the towns of Judah and the villages around Jerusalem, from the territory of Benjamin and the western foothills, from the hill country and the Negev, bringing burnt offerings and sacrifices, grain offerings and incense, and bringing thank offerings to the house of the Lord .

verses.textZh: 但如果你们不听从我，不守安息日为圣日，仍在安息日挑担子，进入耶路撒冷的城门；这样，我就必在耶路撒冷的各城门点起火来，烧毁耶路撒冷的堡垒，没有人能够扑灭。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 但如果你们不听从我，不守安息日为圣日，仍在安息日挑担子，进入耶路撒冷的城门；这样，我就必在耶路撒冷的各城门点起火来，烧毁耶路撒冷的堡垒，没有人能够扑灭。"
verses.textZhCuv: 你们若不听从我，不以安息日为圣日，仍在安息日担担子，进入耶路撒冷的各门，我必在各门中点火；这火也必烧毁耶路撒冷的宫殿，不能熄灭。」
verses.textEnNiv: But if you do not obey me to keep the Sabbath day holy by not carrying any load as you come through the gates of Jerusalem on the Sabbath day, then I will kindle an unquenchable fire in the gates of Jerusalem that will consume her fortresses.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: But if you do not listen to me, to keep the Sabbath day holy, and not to bear a burden and enter by the gates of Jerusalem on the Sabbath day, then I will kindle a fire in its gates, and it shall devour the palaces of Jerusalem and shall not be quenched.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: "But if you will not heed Me to hallow the Sabbath day, such as not carrying a burden when entering the gates of Jerusalem on the Sabbath day, then I will kindle a fire in its gates, and it shall devour the palaces of Jerusalem, and it shall not be quenched." ’ "
verses.textEnNlt: "‘But if you do not listen to me and refuse to keep the Sabbath holy, and if on the Sabbath day you bring loads of merchandise through the gates of Jerusalem just as on other days, then I will set fire to these gates. The fire will spread to the palaces, and no one will be able to put out the roaring flames.’"
verses.textEnNasb: But if you do not listen to Me, to keep the Sabbath day holy by not carrying a load and coming in through the gates of Jerusalem on the Sabbath day, then I will set fire to its gates, and it will devour the palaces of Jerusalem and not go out." ’ "
verses.textEn: But if you do not obey me to keep the Sabbath day holy by not carrying any load as you come through the gates of Jerusalem on the Sabbath day, then I will kindle an unquenchable fire in the gates of Jerusalem that will consume her fortresses.’ "

verses.textZh: 耶和华有话临到耶利米，说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华有话临到耶利米，说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的话临到耶利米说：
verses.textEnNiv: This is the word that came to Jeremiah from the Lord :
verses.textEnEsv: The word that came to Jeremiah from the Lord :
verses.textEnNkjv: The word which came to Jeremiah from the Lord, saying:
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord gave another message to Jeremiah. He said,
verses.textEnNasb: The word that came to Jeremiah from the Lord, saying,
verses.textEn: This is the word that came to Jeremiah from the Lord :

verses.textZh: "起来，下到陶匠的家里去，在那里我要使你听到我的话。"
verses.textZhCnvs: "起来，下到陶匠的家里去，在那里我要使你听到我的话。"
verses.textZhCuv: 「你起来，下到窑匠的家里去，我在那里要使你听我的话。」
verses.textEnNiv: "Go down to the potter’s house, and there I will give you my message."
verses.textEnEsv: "Arise, and go down to the potter’s house, and there I will let you hear my words."
verses.textEnNkjv: "Arise and go down to the potter’s house, and there I will cause you to hear My words."
verses.textEnNlt: "Go down to the potter’s shop, and I will speak to you there."
verses.textEnNasb: "Arise and go down to the potter’s house, and there I will announce My words to you."
verses.textEn: "Go down to the potter’s house, and there I will give you my message."

verses.textZh: 我就下到陶匠的家里去，见他正在转盘旁工作。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我就下到陶匠的家里去，见他正在转盘旁工作。
verses.textZhCuv: 我就下到窑匠的家里去，正遇他转轮做器皿。
verses.textEnNiv: So I went down to the potter’s house, and I saw him working at the wheel.
verses.textEnEsv: So I went down to the potter’s house, and there he was working at his wheel.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then I went down to the potter’s house, and there he was, making something at the wheel.
verses.textEnNlt: So I did as he told me and found the potter working at his wheel.
verses.textEnNasb: So I went down to the potter’s house, and there he was, making something on the wheel.
verses.textEn: So I went down to the potter’s house, and I saw him working at the wheel.

verses.textZh: 陶匠用他手中的泥所做的器皿坏了，他就用这泥再做别的器皿，照着自己的意思去作。
verses.textZhCnvs: 陶匠用他手中的泥所做的器皿坏了，他就用这泥再做别的器皿，照着自己的意思去作。
verses.textZhCuv: 窑匠用泥做的器皿，在他手中做坏了，他又用这泥另做别的器皿；窑匠看怎样好，就怎样做。
verses.textEnNiv: But the pot he was shaping from the clay was marred in his hands; so the potter formed it into another pot, shaping it as seemed best to him.
verses.textEnEsv: And the vessel he was making of clay was spoiled in the potter’s hand, and he reworked it into another vessel, as it seemed good to the potter to do.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the vessel that he made of clay was marred in the hand of the potter; so he made it again into another vessel, as it seemed good to the potter to make.
verses.textEnNlt: But the jar he was making did not turn out as he had hoped, so he crushed it into a lump of clay again and started over.
verses.textEnNasb: But the vessel that he was making of clay was spoiled in the hand of the potter; so he remade it into another vessel, as it pleased the potter to make.
verses.textEn: But the pot he was shaping from the clay was marred in his hands; so the potter formed it into another pot, shaping it as seemed best to him.

verses.textZh: 于是耶和华的话临到我，说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是耶和华的话临到我，说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的话就临到我说：
verses.textEnNiv: Then the word of the Lord came to me.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the word of the Lord came to me:
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the word of the Lord came to me, saying:
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord gave me this message:
verses.textEnNasb: Then the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.textEn: Then the word of the Lord came to me.

verses.textZh: "以色列家啊！难道我不能待你们像这陶匠所作的一样吗？"这是耶和华的宣告。"看哪！泥在陶匠的手中怎样，以色列家啊！你们在我的手中也必怎样。
verses.textZhCnvs: "以色列家啊！难道我不能待你们像这陶匠所作的一样吗？"这是耶和华的宣告。"看哪！泥在陶匠的手中怎样，以色列家啊！你们在我的手中也必怎样。
verses.textZhCuv: 「耶和华说：以色列家啊，我待你们，岂不能照这窑匠弄泥吗？以色列家啊，泥在窑匠的手中怎样，你们在我的手中也怎样。
verses.textEnNiv: He said, "Can I not do with you, Israel, as this potter does?" declares the Lord . "Like clay in the hand of the potter, so are you in my hand, Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: "O house of Israel, can I not do with you as this potter has done? declares the Lord . Behold, like the clay in the potter’s hand, so are you in my hand, O house of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: "O house of Israel, can I not do with you as this potter?" says the Lord. "Look, as the clay is in the potter’s hand, so are you in My hand, O house of Israel!
verses.textEnNlt: "O Israel, can I not do to you as this potter has done to his clay? As the clay is in the potter’s hand, so are you in my hand.
verses.textEnNasb: "Am I not able, house of Israel, to deal with you as this potter does?" declares the Lord. "Behold, like the clay in the potter’s hand, so are you in My hand, house of Israel.
verses.textEn: He said, "Can I not do with you, Israel, as this potter does?" declares the Lord . "Like clay in the hand of the potter, so are you in my hand, Israel.

verses.textZh: 我甚么时候宣布要拔出、拆毁、毁灭一邦或一国，
verses.textZhCnvs: 我甚么时候宣布要拔出、拆毁、毁灭一邦或一国，
verses.textZhCuv: 我何时论到一邦或一国说，要拔出、拆毁、毁坏；
verses.textEnNiv: If at any time I announce that a nation or kingdom is to be uprooted, torn down and destroyed,
verses.textEnEsv: If at any time I declare concerning a nation or a kingdom, that I will pluck up and break down and destroy it,
verses.textEnNkjv: The instant I speak concerning a nation and concerning a kingdom, to pluck up, to pull down, and to destroy it,
verses.textEnNlt: If I announce that a certain nation or kingdom is to be uprooted, torn down, and destroyed,
verses.textEnNasb: At one moment I might speak concerning a nation or concerning a kingdom to uproot it, to tear it down, or to destroy it;
verses.textEn: If at any time I announce that a nation or kingdom is to be uprooted, torn down and destroyed,

verses.textZh: 如果我论到的那一邦转离他们的恶行，我就必回心转意，不把我原定的灾祸降给他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果我论到的那一邦转离他们的恶行，我就必回心转意，不把我原定的灾祸降给他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 我所说的那一邦，若是转意离开他们的恶，我就必后悔，不将我想要施行的灾祸降与他们。
verses.textEnNiv: and if that nation I warned repents of its evil, then I will relent and not inflict on it the disaster I had planned.
verses.textEnEsv: and if that nation, concerning which I have spoken, turns from its evil, I will relent of the disaster that I intended to do to it.
verses.textEnNkjv: if that nation against whom I have spoken turns from its evil, I will relent of the disaster that I thought to bring upon it.
verses.textEnNlt: but then that nation renounces its evil ways, I will not destroy it as I had planned.
verses.textEnNasb: if that nation against which I have spoken turns from its evil, I will relent of the disaster that I planned to bring on it.
verses.textEn: and if that nation I warned repents of its evil, then I will relent and not inflict on it the disaster I had planned.

verses.textZh: 同样，我甚么时候宣布要建立、栽植一邦或一国，
verses.textZhCnvs: 同样，我甚么时候宣布要建立、栽植一邦或一国，
verses.textZhCuv: 我何时论到一邦或一国说，要建立、栽植；
verses.textEnNiv: And if at another time I announce that a nation or kingdom is to be built up and planted,
verses.textEnEsv: And if at any time I declare concerning a nation or a kingdom that I will build and plant it,
verses.textEnNkjv: And the instant I speak concerning a nation and concerning a kingdom, to build and to plant it,
verses.textEnNlt: And if I announce that I will plant and build up a certain nation or kingdom,
verses.textEnNasb: Or at another moment I might speak concerning a nation or concerning a kingdom to build up or to plant it;
verses.textEn: And if at another time I announce that a nation or kingdom is to be built up and planted,

verses.textZh: 如果他们行我眼中看为恶的事，不听从我的话，我就必回心转意，不把我应许的好处赐给他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果他们行我眼中看为恶的事，不听从我的话，我就必回心转意，不把我应许的好处赐给他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们若行我眼中看为恶的事，不听从我的话，我就必后悔，不将我所说的福气赐给他们。
verses.textEnNiv: and if it does evil in my sight and does not obey me, then I will reconsider the good I had intended to do for it.
verses.textEnEsv: and if it does evil in my sight, not listening to my voice, then I will relent of the good that I had intended to do to it.
verses.textEnNkjv: if it does evil in My sight so that it does not obey My voice, then I will relent concerning the good with which I said I would benefit it.
verses.textEnNlt: but then that nation turns to evil and refuses to obey me, I will not bless it as I said I would.
verses.textEnNasb: if it does evil in My sight by not obeying My voice, then I will relent of the good with which I said that I would bless it.
verses.textEn: and if it does evil in my sight and does not obey me, then I will reconsider the good I had intended to do for it.

verses.textZh: "现在你要对犹大人和耶路撒冷的居民说：‘耶和华这样说：看哪！我正在制造灾祸对付你们，拟定计划惩罚你们。你们各人要回转，离开自己的恶道，改正你们的行径和作为。’
verses.textZhCnvs: "现在你要对犹大人和耶路撒冷的居民说：‘耶和华这样说：看哪！我正在制造灾祸对付你们，拟定计划惩罚你们。你们各人要回转，离开自己的恶道，改正你们的行径和作为。’
verses.textZhCuv: 现在你要对犹大人和耶路撒冷的居民说：『耶和华如此说：我造出灾祸攻击你们，定意刑罚你们。你们各人当回头离开所行的恶道，改正你们的行动作为。』
verses.textEnNiv: "Now therefore say to the people of Judah and those living in Jerusalem, ‘This is what the Lord says: Look! I am preparing a disaster for you and devising a plan against you. So turn from your evil ways, each one of you, and reform your ways and your actions.’
verses.textEnEsv: Now, therefore, say to the men of Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem: ‘Thus says the Lord , Behold, I am shaping disaster against you and devising a plan against you. Return, every one from his evil way, and amend your ways and your deeds.’
verses.textEnNkjv: "Now therefore, speak to the men of Judah and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, saying, ‘Thus says the Lord: "Behold, I am fashioning a disaster and devising a plan against you. Return now every one from his evil way, and make your ways and your doings good." ’ "
verses.textEnNlt: "Therefore, Jeremiah, go and warn all Judah and Jerusalem. Say to them, ‘This is what the Lord says: I am planning disaster for you instead of good. So turn from your evil ways, each of you, and do what is right.’"
verses.textEnNasb: So now, speak to the men of Judah and against the inhabitants of Jerusalem, saying, ‘This is what the Lord says: "Behold, I am forming a disaster against you and devising a plan against you. Now turn back, each of you from his evil way, and correct your ways and your deeds!" ’
verses.textEn: "Now therefore say to the people of Judah and those living in Jerusalem, ‘This is what the Lord says: Look! I am preparing a disaster for you and devising a plan against you. So turn from your evil ways, each one of you, and reform your ways and your actions.’

verses.textZh: 他们却说：‘没用的！我们要随着自己的计划而行，各人要按着自己顽梗的恶心行事。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们却说：‘没用的！我们要随着自己的计划而行，各人要按着自己顽梗的恶心行事。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 「他们却说：『这是枉然。我们要照自己的计谋去行。』各人随自己顽梗的恶心做事。」
verses.textEnNiv: But they will reply, ‘It’s no use. We will continue with our own plans; we will all follow the stubbornness of our evil hearts.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: "But they say, ‘That is in vain! We will follow our own plans, and will every one act according to the stubbornness of his evil heart.’
verses.textEnNkjv: And they said, "That is hopeless! So we will walk according to our own plans, and we will every one obey the dictates of his evil heart."
verses.textEnNlt: But the people replied, "Don’t waste your breath. We will continue to live as we want to, stubbornly following our own evil desires."
verses.textEnNasb: But they will say, ‘It’s hopeless! For we are going to follow our own plans, and each of us will persist in the stubbornness of his evil heart.’
verses.textEn: But they will reply, ‘It’s no use. We will continue with our own plans; we will all follow the stubbornness of our evil hearts.’ "

verses.textZh: 因此耶和华这样说： "你们问一问列国， 有谁听见过像这样的事呢？ 童女以色列竟行了一件非常骇人的事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此耶和华这样说： "你们问一问列国， 有谁听见过像这样的事呢？ 童女以色列竟行了一件非常骇人的事。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以，耶和华如此说： 你们且往各国访问， 有谁听见这样的事？ 以色列民 行了一件极可憎恶的事。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore this is what the Lord says: "Inquire among the nations: Who has ever heard anything like this? A most horrible thing has been done by Virgin Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: "Therefore thus says the Lord : Ask among the nations, Who has heard the like of this? The virgin Israel has done a very horrible thing.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore thus says the Lord: "Ask now among the Gentiles, Who has heard such things? The virgin of Israel has done a very horrible thing.
verses.textEnNlt: So this is what the Lord says: "Has anyone ever heard of such a thing, even among the pagan nations? My virgin daughter Israel has done something terrible!
verses.textEnNasb: "Therefore this is what the Lord says: ‘Just ask among the nations, Who ever heard anything like this? The virgin of Israel Has done a most appalling thing.
verses.textEn: Therefore this is what the Lord says: "Inquire among the nations: Who has ever heard anything like this? A most horrible thing has been done by Virgin Israel.

verses.textZh: 黎巴嫩山上岩石的积雪融化过吗？ 从远处流下清凉的溪水干涸过吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 黎巴嫩山上岩石的积雪融化过吗？ 从远处流下清凉的溪水干涸过吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 黎巴嫩的雪从田野的磐石上岂能断绝呢？ 从远处流下的凉水岂能干涸呢？
verses.textEnNiv: Does the snow of Lebanon ever vanish from its rocky slopes? Do its cool waters from distant sources ever stop flowing?
verses.textEnEsv: Does the snow of Lebanon leave the crags of Sirion? Do the mountain waters run dry, the cold flowing streams?
verses.textEnNkjv: Will aman leave the snow water of Lebanon, Whichcomes from the rock of the field? Will the cold flowing waters be forsaken for strange waters?
verses.textEnNlt: Does the snow ever disappear from the mountaintops of Lebanon? Do the cold streams flowing from those distant mountains ever run dry?
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Does the snow of Lebanon leave the rock of the open country alone? Or is the cold flowing water from a foreign land ever dried up?
verses.textEn: Does the snow of Lebanon ever vanish from its rocky slopes? Do its cool waters from distant sources ever stop flowing?

verses.textZh: 但我的子民竟忘记我， 向虚无的偶像烧香， 以致他们在自己的路上、 在古道上绊倒， 行走小路，不是修建过的大道。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但我的子民竟忘记我， 向虚无的偶像烧香， 以致他们在自己的路上、 在古道上绊倒， 行走小路，不是修建过的大道。
verses.textZhCuv: 我的百姓竟忘记我， 向假神烧香， 使他们在所行的路上，在古道上绊跌， 使他们行没有修筑的斜路，
verses.textEnNiv: Yet my people have forgotten me; they burn incense to worthless idols, which made them stumble in their ways, in the ancient paths. They made them walk in byways, on roads not built up.
verses.textEnEsv: But my people have forgotten me; they make offerings to false gods; they made them stumble in their ways, in the ancient roads, and to walk into side roads, not the highway,
verses.textEnNkjv: "Because My people have forgotten Me, They have burned incense to worthless idols. And they have caused themselves to stumble in their ways, From the ancient paths, To walk in pathways and not on a highway,
verses.textEnNlt: But my people are not so reliable, for they have deserted me; they burn incense to worthless idols. They have stumbled off the ancient highways and walk in muddy paths.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘For My people have forgotten Me, They burn incense to worthless gods. And they have stumbled in their ways, In the ancient roads, To walk on paths, Not on a highway,
verses.textEn: Yet my people have forgotten me; they burn incense to worthless idols, which made them stumble in their ways, in the ancient paths. They made them walk in byways, on roads not built up.

verses.textZh: 他们的土地变为荒凉， 成为永远被人嗤笑的对象； 经过这地的， 都必惊骇摇头。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们的土地变为荒凉， 成为永远被人嗤笑的对象； 经过这地的， 都必惊骇摇头。
verses.textZhCuv: 以致他们的地令人惊骇， 常常嗤笑； 凡经过这地的必惊骇摇头。
verses.textEnNiv: Their land will be an object of horror and of lasting scorn; all who pass by will be appalled and will shake their heads.
verses.textEnEsv: making their land a horror, a thing to be hissed at forever. Everyone who passes by it is horrified and shakes his head.
verses.textEnNkjv: To make their land desolate and a perpetual hissing; Everyone who passes by it will be astonished And shake his head.
verses.textEnNlt: Therefore, their land will become desolate, a monument to their stupidity. All who pass by will be astonished and will shake their heads in amazement.
verses.textEnNasb: To make their land a desolation, An object of perpetual hissing; Everyone who passes by it will be astonished And shake his head.
verses.textEn: Their land will be an object of horror and of lasting scorn; all who pass by will be appalled and will shake their heads.

verses.textZh: 在他们的敌人面前， 我要像东风吹散他们； 在他们遭难的日子， 我必使他们只见我的背，不见我的面。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 在他们的敌人面前， 我要像东风吹散他们； 在他们遭难的日子， 我必使他们只见我的背，不见我的面。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我必在仇敌面前分散他们， 好像用东风吹散一样。 遭难的日子，我必以背向他们， 不以面向他们。
verses.textEnNiv: Like a wind from the east, I will scatter them before their enemies; I will show them my back and not my face in the day of their disaster."
verses.textEnEsv: Like the east wind I will scatter them before the enemy. I will show them my back, not my face, in the day of their calamity."
verses.textEnNkjv: I will scatter them as with an east wind before the enemy; I will show them the back and not the face In the day of their calamity."
verses.textEnNlt: I will scatter my people before their enemies as the east wind scatters dust. And in all their trouble I will turn my back on them and refuse to notice their distress."
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Like an east wind I will scatter them Before the enemy; I will show them My back and not My face In the day of their disaster.’ "
verses.textEn: Like a wind from the east, I will scatter them before their enemies; I will show them my back and not my face in the day of their disaster."

verses.textZh: 他们说："来吧！我们来设计对付耶利米；因为祭司的律法、智慧人的谋略、先知的话都不会断绝。来吧！我们用舌头攻击他，不理会他的一切话。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们说："来吧！我们来设计对付耶利米；因为祭司的律法、智慧人的谋略、先知的话都不会断绝。来吧！我们用舌头攻击他，不理会他的一切话。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们就说：「来吧！我们可以设计谋害耶利米；因为我们有祭司讲律法，智慧人设谋略，先知说预言，都不能断绝。来吧！我们可以用舌头击打他，不要理会他的一切话。」
verses.textEnNiv: They said, "Come, let’s make plans against Jeremiah; for the teaching of the law by the priest will not cease, nor will counsel from the wise, nor the word from the prophets. So come, let’s attack him with our tongues and pay no attention to anything he says."
verses.textEnEsv: Then they said, "Come, let us make plots against Jeremiah, for the law shall not perish from the priest, nor counsel from the wise, nor the word from the prophet. Come, let us strike him with the tongue, and let us not pay attention to any of his words."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they said, "Come and let us devise plans against Jeremiah; for the law shall not perish from the priest, nor counsel from the wise, nor the word from the prophet. Come and let us attack him with the tongue, and let us not give heed to any of his words."
verses.textEnNlt: Then the people said, "Come on, let’s plot a way to stop Jeremiah. We have plenty of priests and wise men and prophets. We don’t need him to teach the word and give us advice and prophecies. Let’s spread rumors about him and ignore what he says."
verses.textEnNasb: Then they said, "Come and let’s devise plans against Jeremiah. Certainly the Law is not going to be lost by the priest, nor advice by the wise, nor the divine word by the prophet! Come, and let’s strike at him with our tongue, and let’s pay no attention to any of his words."
verses.textEn: They said, "Come, let’s make plans against Jeremiah; for the teaching of the law by the priest will not cease, nor will counsel from the wise, nor the word from the prophets. So come, let’s attack him with our tongues and pay no attention to anything he says."

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊！求你倾听我的申诉， 听那些指控我的人的声音。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊！求你倾听我的申诉， 听那些指控我的人的声音。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，求你理会我， 且听那些与我争竞之人的话。
verses.textEnNiv: Listen to me, Lord ; hear what my accusers are saying!
verses.textEnEsv: Hear me, O Lord , and listen to the voice of my adversaries.
verses.textEnNkjv: Give heed to me, O Lord, And listen to the voice of those who contend with me!
verses.textEnNlt: Lord , hear me and help me! Listen to what my enemies are saying.
verses.textEnNasb: Give Your attention to me, Lord, And listen to what my opponents are saying!
verses.textEn: Listen to me, Lord ; hear what my accusers are saying!

verses.textZh: 良善的应得恶报吗？ 他们竟然挖陷坑害我。 求你记念我怎样站在你面前， 为他们说好话， 使你的烈怒离开他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 良善的应得恶报吗？ 他们竟然挖陷坑害我。 求你记念我怎样站在你面前， 为他们说好话， 使你的烈怒离开他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 岂可以恶报善呢？ 他们竟挖坑要害我的性命！ 求你记念我怎样站在你面前为他们代求， 要使你的忿怒向他们转消。
verses.textEnNiv: Should good be repaid with evil? Yet they have dug a pit for me. Remember that I stood before you and spoke in their behalf to turn your wrath away from them.
verses.textEnEsv: Should good be repaid with evil? Yet they have dug a pit for my life. Remember how I stood before you to speak good for them, to turn away your wrath from them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Shall evil be repaid for good? For they have dug a pit for my life. Remember that I stood before You To speak good for them, To turn away Your wrath from them.
verses.textEnNlt: Should they repay evil for good? They have dug a pit to kill me, though I pleaded for them and tried to protect them from your anger.
verses.textEnNasb: Should good be repaid with evil? For they have dug a pit for me. Remember how I stood before You To speak good in their behalf, So as to turn Your wrath away from them.
verses.textEn: Should good be repaid with evil? Yet they have dug a pit for me. Remember that I stood before you and spoke in their behalf to turn your wrath away from them.

verses.textZh: 因此，愿你使他们的儿女遭受饥荒， 把他们交给刀剑 ； 愿他们的妻子丧夫失子； 愿他们的男人被杀死， 他们的壮丁在战场上被刀剑击杀。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，愿你使他们的儿女遭受饥荒， 把他们交给刀剑 ； 愿他们的妻子丧夫失子； 愿他们的男人被杀死， 他们的壮丁在战场上被刀剑击杀。
verses.textZhCuv: 故此，愿你将他们的儿女交与饥荒和刀剑； 愿他们的妻无子，且作寡妇； 又愿他们的男人被死亡所灭， 他们的少年人在阵上被刀击杀。
verses.textEnNiv: So give their children over to famine; hand them over to the power of the sword. Let their wives be made childless and widows; let their men be put to death, their young men slain by the sword in battle.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore deliver up their children to famine; give them over to the power of the sword; let their wives become childless and widowed. May their men meet death by pestilence, their youths be struck down by the sword in battle.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore deliver up their children to the famine, And pour out their blood By the force of the sword; Let their wives become widows And bereaved of their children. Let their men be put to death, Their young men be slain By the sword in battle.
verses.textEnNlt: So let their children starve! Let them die by the sword! Let their wives become childless widows. Let their old men die in a plague, and let their young men be killed in battle!
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore, give their children over to famine And turn them over to the power of the sword; And let their wives become childless and widowed. Let their men also be slaughtered to death, Their young men struck and killed by the sword in battle.
verses.textEn: So give their children over to famine; hand them over to the power of the sword. Let their wives be made childless and widows; let their men be put to death, their young men slain by the sword in battle.

verses.textZh: 你使侵略者忽然临到他们的时候， 愿人从他们的屋里听见呼救声； 因为他们挖陷坑要捉拿我， 埋藏网罗要绊我的脚。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你使侵略者忽然临到他们的时候， 愿人从他们的屋里听见呼救声； 因为他们挖陷坑要捉拿我， 埋藏网罗要绊我的脚。
verses.textZhCuv: 你使敌军忽然临到他们的时候， 愿人听见哀声从他们的屋内发出； 因他们挖坑要捉拿我， 暗设网罗要绊我的脚。
verses.textEnNiv: Let a cry be heard from their houses when you suddenly bring invaders against them, for they have dug a pit to capture me and have hidden snares for my feet.
verses.textEnEsv: May a cry be heard from their houses, when you bring the plunderer suddenly upon them! For they have dug a pit to take me and laid snares for my feet.
verses.textEnNkjv: Let a cry be heard from their houses, When You bring a troop suddenly upon them; For they have dug a pit to take me, And hidden snares for my feet.
verses.textEnNlt: Let screaming be heard from their homes as warriors come suddenly upon them. For they have dug a pit for me and have hidden traps along my path.
verses.textEnNasb: May a cry be heard from their houses When You suddenly bring raiders upon them; For they have dug a pit to capture me And hidden snares for my feet.
verses.textEn: Let a cry be heard from their houses when you suddenly bring invaders against them, for they have dug a pit to capture me and have hidden snares for my feet.

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊！至于你， 你知道他们要杀我的一切计谋。 求你不要赦免他们的罪孽， 不要从你面前涂抹他们的罪！ 使他们在你面前绊倒； 求你在发怒的时候，对付他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊！至于你， 你知道他们要杀我的一切计谋。 求你不要赦免他们的罪孽， 不要从你面前涂抹他们的罪！ 使他们在你面前绊倒； 求你在发怒的时候，对付他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，他们要杀我的那一切计谋， 你都知道。 不要赦免他们的罪孽， 也不要从你面前涂抹他们的罪恶， 要叫他们在你面前跌倒； 愿你发怒的时候罚办他们。
verses.textEnNiv: But you, Lord , know all their plots to kill me. Do not forgive their crimes or blot out their sins from your sight. Let them be overthrown before you; deal with them in the time of your anger.
verses.textEnEsv: Yet you, O Lord , know all their plotting to kill me. Forgive not their iniquity, nor blot out their sin from your sight. Let them be overthrown before you; deal with them in the time of your anger.
verses.textEnNkjv: Yet, Lord, You know all their counsel Which is against me, to slay me. Provide no atonement for their iniquity, Nor blot out their sin from Your sight; But let them be overthrown before You. Deal thus with them In the time of Your anger.
verses.textEnNlt: Lord , you know all about their murderous plots against me. Don’t forgive their crimes and blot out their sins. Let them die before you. Deal with them in your anger.
verses.textEnNasb: But You, Lord, know All their deadly schemes against me; Do not forgive their wrongdoing Or wipe out their sin from Your sight. But may they be overthrown before You; Deal with them in the time of Your anger!
verses.textEn: But you, Lord , know all their plots to kill me. Do not forgive their crimes or blot out their sins from your sight. Let them be overthrown before you; deal with them in the time of your anger.

verses.textZh: 耶和华这样说："你去跟陶匠买一个瓦瓶，要带着几位人民的长老和年长的祭司，
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华这样说："你去跟陶匠买一个瓦瓶，要带着几位人民的长老和年长的祭司，
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华如此说：「你去买窑匠的瓦瓶，又带百姓中的长老和祭司中的长老，
verses.textEnNiv: This is what the Lord says: "Go and buy a clay jar from a potter. Take along some of the elders of the people and of the priests
verses.textEnEsv: Thus says the Lord , "Go, buy a potter’s earthenware flask, and take some of the elders of the people and some of the elders of the priests,
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus says the Lord: "Go and get a potter’s earthen flask, and take some of the elders of the people and some of the elders of the priests.
verses.textEnNlt: This is what the Lord said to me: "Go and buy a clay jar. Then ask some of the leaders of the people and of the priests to follow you.
verses.textEnNasb: This is what the Lord says: "Go and buy a potter’s earthenware jar, and take some of the elders of the people and some of the senior priests.
verses.textEn: This is what the Lord says: "Go and buy a clay jar from a potter. Take along some of the elders of the people and of the priests

verses.textZh: 出到欣嫩子谷，哈珥西 门的入口，在那里你要宣告我将对你说的话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 出到欣嫩子谷，哈珥西 门的入口，在那里你要宣告我将对你说的话。
verses.textZhCuv: 出去到欣嫩子谷、哈珥西 的门口那里，宣告我所吩咐你的话，
verses.textEnNiv: and go out to the Valley of Ben Hinnom, near the entrance of the Potsherd Gate. There proclaim the words I tell you,
verses.textEnEsv: and go out to the Valley of the Son of Hinnom at the entry of the Potsherd Gate, and proclaim there the words that I tell you.
verses.textEnNkjv: And go out to the Valley of the Son of Hinnom, which is by the entry of the Potsherd Gate; and proclaim there the words that I will tell you,
verses.textEnNlt: Go out through the Gate of Broken Pots to the garbage dump in the valley of Ben-Hinnom, and give them this message.
verses.textEnNasb: Then go out to the Valley of Ben-hinnom, which is by the entrance of the Potsherd Gate, and proclaim there the words that I tell you,
verses.textEn: and go out to the Valley of Ben Hinnom, near the entrance of the Potsherd Gate. There proclaim the words I tell you,

verses.textZh: 你要说：‘犹大列王和耶路撒冷的居民哪！你们要听耶和华的话。万军之耶和华以色列的神这样说：看哪！我必使灾祸临到这地方；凡听见的，都必耳鸣。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要说：‘犹大列王和耶路撒冷的居民哪！你们要听耶和华的话。万军之耶和华以色列的神这样说：看哪！我必使灾祸临到这地方；凡听见的，都必耳鸣。
verses.textZhCuv: 说：『犹大君王和耶路撒冷的居民哪，当听耶和华的话。万军之耶和华－以色列的神如此说：我必使灾祸临到这地方，凡听见的人都必耳鸣；
verses.textEnNiv: and say, ‘Hear the word of the Lord , you kings of Judah and people of Jerusalem. This is what the Lord Almighty, the God of Israel, says: Listen! I am going to bring a disaster on this place that will make the ears of everyone who hears of it tingle.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall say, ‘Hear the word of the Lord , O kings of Judah and inhabitants of Jerusalem. Thus says the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel: Behold, I am bringing such disaster upon this place that the ears of everyone who hears of it will tingle.
verses.textEnNkjv: and say, ‘Hear the word of the Lord, O kings of Judah and inhabitants of Jerusalem. Thus says the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel: "Behold, I will bring such a catastrophe on this place, that whoever hears of it, his ears will tingle.
verses.textEnNlt: Say to them, ‘Listen to this message from the Lord , you kings of Judah and citizens of Jerusalem! This is what the Lord of Heaven’s Armies, the God of Israel, says: I will bring a terrible disaster on this place, and the ears of those who hear about it will ring!
verses.textEnNasb: and say, ‘Hear the word of the Lord, you kings of Judah and inhabitants of Jerusalem. This is what the Lord of armies, the God of Israel says: "Behold I am going to bring a disaster upon this place, at which the ears of everyone that hears of it will tingle.
verses.textEn: and say, ‘Hear the word of the Lord , you kings of Judah and people of Jerusalem. This is what the Lord Almighty, the God of Israel, says: Listen! I am going to bring a disaster on this place that will make the ears of everyone who hears of it tingle.

verses.textZh: 因为他们离弃了我，把这地方玷污了，在这地方向列神烧香。这些神是他们和他们的列祖，以及犹大列王所不认识的；他们又使这地方洒满无辜人的血。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为他们离弃了我，把这地方玷污了，在这地方向列神烧香。这些神是他们和他们的列祖，以及犹大列王所不认识的；他们又使这地方洒满无辜人的血。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为他们和他们列祖，并犹大君王离弃我，将这地方看为平常，在这里向素不认识的别神烧香，又使这地方满了无辜人的血，
verses.textEnNiv: For they have forsaken me and made this a place of foreign gods; they have burned incense in it to gods that neither they nor their ancestors nor the kings of Judah ever knew, and they have filled this place with the blood of the innocent.
verses.textEnEsv: Because the people have forsaken me and have profaned this place by making offerings in it to other gods whom neither they nor their fathers nor the kings of Judah have known; and because they have filled this place with the blood of innocents,
verses.textEnNkjv: "Because they have forsaken Me and made this an alien place, because they have burned incense in it to other gods whom neither they, their fathers, nor the kings of Judah have known, and have filled this place with the blood of the innocents
verses.textEnNlt: "‘For Israel has forsaken me and turned this valley into a place of wickedness. The people burn incense to foreign gods—idols never before acknowledged by this generation, by their ancestors, or by the kings of Judah. And they have filled this place with the blood of innocent children.
verses.textEnNasb: Since they have abandoned Me and have made this place foreign, and have burned sacrifices in it to other gods that neither they nor their forefathers nor the kings of Judah had ever known, and since they have filled this place with the blood of the innocent
verses.textEn: For they have forsaken me and made this a place of foreign gods; they have burned incense in it to gods that neither they nor their ancestors nor the kings of Judah ever knew, and they have filled this place with the blood of the innocent.

verses.textZh: 他们筑了巴力的邱坛，好用火焚烧自己的儿女，作燔祭献给巴力。这不是我吩咐的，我没有提说过，也没有在我心里想过。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们筑了巴力的邱坛，好用火焚烧自己的儿女，作燔祭献给巴力。这不是我吩咐的，我没有提说过，也没有在我心里想过。
verses.textZhCuv: 又建筑巴力的邱坛，好在火中焚烧自己的儿子，作为燔祭献给巴力。这不是我所吩咐的，不是我所提说的，也不是我心所起的意。
verses.textEnNiv: They have built the high places of Baal to burn their children in the fire as offerings to Baal—something I did not command or mention, nor did it enter my mind.
verses.textEnEsv: and have built the high places of Baal to burn their sons in the fire as burnt offerings to Baal, which I did not command or decree, nor did it come into my mind—
verses.textEnNkjv: (they have also built the high places of Baal, to burn their sons with fire for burnt offerings to Baal, which I did not command or speak, nor did it come into My mind),
verses.textEnNlt: They have built pagan shrines to Baal, and there they burn their sons as sacrifices to Baal. I have never commanded such a horrible deed; it never even crossed my mind to command such a thing!
verses.textEnNasb: and have built the high places of Baal to burn their sons in the fire as burnt offerings to Baal, a thing which I did not command nor speak of, nor did it ever enter My mind;
verses.textEn: They have built the high places of Baal to burn their children in the fire as offerings to Baal—something I did not command or mention, nor did it enter my mind.

verses.textZh: 因此，看哪！日子快到，这地方必不再称为陀斐特或欣嫩子谷，而要称为杀戮谷。’这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，看哪！日子快到，这地方必不再称为陀斐特或欣嫩子谷，而要称为杀戮谷。’这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华说：因此，日子将到，这地方不再称为陀斐特和欣嫩子谷，反倒称为杀戮谷。
verses.textEnNiv: So beware, the days are coming, declares the Lord , when people will no longer call this place Topheth or the Valley of Ben Hinnom, but the Valley of Slaughter.
verses.textEnEsv: therefore, behold, days are coming, declares the Lord , when this place shall no more be called Topheth, or the Valley of the Son of Hinnom, but the Valley of Slaughter.
verses.textEnNkjv: therefore behold, the days are coming," says the Lord, "that this place shall no more be called Tophet or the Valley of the Son of Hinnom, but the Valley of Slaughter.
verses.textEnNlt: So beware, for the time is coming, says the Lord , when this garbage dump will no longer be called Topheth or the valley of Ben-Hinnom, but the Valley of Slaughter.
verses.textEnNasb: therefore, behold, days are coming," declares the Lord, "when this place will no longer be called Topheth or the Valley of Ben-hinnom, but rather the Valley of Slaughter.
verses.textEn: So beware, the days are coming, declares the Lord , when people will no longer call this place Topheth or the Valley of Ben Hinnom, but the Valley of Slaughter.

verses.textZh: ‘我要在这地方使犹大和耶路撒冷的计谋失败，也必使他们在仇敌面前倒毙于刀下，死在寻索他们性命的人手中。我要把他们的尸体给空中的飞鸟和地上的野兽作食物。
verses.textZhCnvs: ‘我要在这地方使犹大和耶路撒冷的计谋失败，也必使他们在仇敌面前倒毙于刀下，死在寻索他们性命的人手中。我要把他们的尸体给空中的飞鸟和地上的野兽作食物。
verses.textZhCuv: 我必在这地方使犹大和耶路撒冷的计谋落空，也必使他们在仇敌面前倒于刀下，并寻索其命的人手下。他们的尸首，我必给空中的飞鸟和地上的野兽作食物。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘In this place I will ruin the plans of Judah and Jerusalem. I will make them fall by the sword before their enemies, at the hands of those who want to kill them, and I will give their carcasses as food to the birds and the wild animals.
verses.textEnEsv: And in this place I will make void the plans of Judah and Jerusalem, and will cause their people to fall by the sword before their enemies, and by the hand of those who seek their life. I will give their dead bodies for food to the birds of the air and to the beasts of the earth.
verses.textEnNkjv: And I will make void the counsel of Judah and Jerusalem in this place, and I will cause them to fall by the sword before their enemies and by the hands of those who seek their lives; their corpses I will give as meat for the birds of the heaven and for the beasts of the earth.
verses.textEnNlt: "‘For I will upset the careful plans of Judah and Jerusalem. I will allow the people to be slaughtered by invading armies, and I will leave their dead bodies as food for the vultures and wild animals.
verses.textEnNasb: And I will frustrate the planning of Judah and Jerusalem in this place, and I will make them fall by the sword before their enemies and by the hand of those who seek their life; and I will make their carcasses food for the birds of the sky and the animals of the earth.
verses.textEn: " ‘In this place I will ruin the plans of Judah and Jerusalem. I will make them fall by the sword before their enemies, at the hands of those who want to kill them, and I will give their carcasses as food to the birds and the wild animals.

verses.textZh: 我要使这城变为荒凉，成为被人嗤笑的对象；每一个经过这里的，都必因这城所遭受的一切创伤而惊骇，并且嗤笑她。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要使这城变为荒凉，成为被人嗤笑的对象；每一个经过这里的，都必因这城所遭受的一切创伤而惊骇，并且嗤笑她。
verses.textZhCuv: 我必使这城令人惊骇嗤笑；凡经过的人，必因这城所遭的灾惊骇嗤笑。
verses.textEnNiv: I will devastate this city and make it an object of horror and scorn; all who pass by will be appalled and will scoff because of all its wounds.
