verses.textEnEsv: And I will make this city a horror, a thing to be hissed at. Everyone who passes by it will be horrified and will hiss because of all its wounds.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will make this city desolate and a hissing; everyone who passes by it will be astonished and hiss because of all its plagues.
verses.textEnNlt: I will reduce Jerusalem to ruins, making it a monument to their stupidity. All who pass by will be astonished and will gasp at the destruction they see there.
verses.textEnNasb: I will also turn this city into an object of horror and hissing; everyone who passes by it will be appalled and hiss because of all its disasters.
verses.textEn: I will devastate this city and make it an object of horror and scorn; all who pass by will be appalled and will scoff because of all its wounds.

verses.textZh: 在他们被围困和受压迫之中，就是在仇敌和寻索他们性命的人压迫他们的时候，我必使他们吞吃自己的儿女的肉，各人也彼此吃对方的肉。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 在他们被围困和受压迫之中，就是在仇敌和寻索他们性命的人压迫他们的时候，我必使他们吞吃自己的儿女的肉，各人也彼此吃对方的肉。’
verses.textZhCuv: 我必使他们在围困窘迫之中，就是仇敌和寻索其命的人窘迫他们的时候，各人吃自己儿女的肉和朋友的肉。』
verses.textEnNiv: I will make them eat the flesh of their sons and daughters, and they will eat one another’s flesh because their enemies will press the siege so hard against them to destroy them.’
verses.textEnEsv: And I will make them eat the flesh of their sons and their daughters, and everyone shall eat the flesh of his neighbor in the siege and in the distress, with which their enemies and those who seek their life afflict them.’
verses.textEnNkjv: And I will cause them to eat the flesh of their sons and the flesh of their daughters, and everyone shall eat the flesh of his friend in the siege and in the desperation with which their enemies and those who seek their lives shall drive them to despair." ’
verses.textEnNlt: I will see to it that your enemies lay siege to the city until all the food is gone. Then those trapped inside will eat their own sons and daughters and friends. They will be driven to utter despair.’
verses.textEnNasb: And I will make them eat the flesh of their sons and the flesh of their daughters, and they will eat one another’s flesh during the siege and in the hardship with which their enemies and those who seek their life will torment them." ’
verses.textEn: I will make them eat the flesh of their sons and daughters, and they will eat one another’s flesh because their enemies will press the siege so hard against them to destroy them.’

verses.textZh: "然后你要在跟你同去的人眼前，把那瓶子打碎，
verses.textZhCnvs: "然后你要在跟你同去的人眼前，把那瓶子打碎，
verses.textZhCuv: 「你要在同去的人眼前打碎那瓶，
verses.textEnNiv: "Then break the jar while those who go with you are watching,
verses.textEnEsv: "Then you shall break the flask in the sight of the men who go with you,
verses.textEnNkjv: "Then you shall break the flask in the sight of the men who go with you,
verses.textEnNlt: "As these men watch you, Jeremiah, smash the jar you brought.
verses.textEnNasb: "Then you are to break the jar in the sight of the men who accompany you,
verses.textEn: "Then break the jar while those who go with you are watching,

verses.textZh: 并对他们说：‘万军之耶和华这样说：我必照样打碎这人民和这城，好象人打碎陶匠的瓦器一样，不能再修补。人必在陀斐特埋葬尸体，甚至无处可埋葬。
verses.textZhCnvs: 并对他们说：‘万军之耶和华这样说：我必照样打碎这人民和这城，好象人打碎陶匠的瓦器一样，不能再修补。人必在陀斐特埋葬尸体，甚至无处可埋葬。
verses.textZhCuv: 对他们说：『万军之耶和华如此说：我要照样打碎这民和这城，正如人打碎窑匠的瓦器，以致不能再囫囵。并且人要在陀斐特葬埋尸首，甚至无处可葬。
verses.textEnNiv: and say to them, ‘This is what the Lord Almighty says: I will smash this nation and this city just as this potter’s jar is smashed and cannot be repaired. They will bury the dead in Topheth until there is no more room.
verses.textEnEsv: and shall say to them, ‘Thus says the Lord of hosts: So will I break this people and this city, as one breaks a potter’s vessel, so that it can never be mended. Men shall bury in Topheth because there will be no place else to bury.
verses.textEnNkjv: and say to them, ‘Thus says the Lord of hosts: "Even so I will break this people and this city, as one breaks a potter’s vessel, which cannot be made whole again; and they shall bury them in Tophet till thereis no place to bury.
verses.textEnNlt: Then say to them, ‘This is what the Lord of Heaven’s Armies says: As this jar lies shattered, so I will shatter the people of Judah and Jerusalem beyond all hope of repair. They will bury the bodies here in Topheth, the garbage dump, until there is no more room for them.
verses.textEnNasb: and say to them, ‘This is what the Lord of armies says: "To the same extent I will break this people and this city, just as one breaks a potter’s vessel, which cannot again be repaired; and they will bury their dead in Topheth, because there is no other place for burial.
verses.textEn: and say to them, ‘This is what the Lord Almighty says: I will smash this nation and this city just as this potter’s jar is smashed and cannot be repaired. They will bury the dead in Topheth until there is no more room.

verses.textZh: 我必照样对待这地方和这地方的居民，使这城像陀斐特一样。’这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必照样对待这地方和这地方的居民，使这城像陀斐特一样。’这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华说：我必向这地方和其中的居民如此行，使这城与陀斐特一样。
verses.textEnNiv: This is what I will do to this place and to those who live here, declares the Lord . I will make this city like Topheth.
verses.textEnEsv: Thus will I do to this place, declares the Lord , and to its inhabitants, making this city like Topheth.
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus I will do to this place," says the Lord, "and to its inhabitants, and make this city like Tophet.
verses.textEnNlt: This is what I will do to this place and its people, says the Lord . I will cause this city to become defiled like Topheth.
verses.textEnNasb: This is how I will treat this place and its inhabitants," declares the Lord, "so as to make this city like Topheth.
verses.textEn: This is what I will do to this place and to those who live here, declares the Lord . I will make this city like Topheth.

verses.textZh: ‘耶路撒冷的房屋和犹大列王的宫殿，都要像陀斐特一样成为不洁；人曾在这一切房屋宫殿的屋顶上，向天上的万象烧香，向别神浇奠祭。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: ‘耶路撒冷的房屋和犹大列王的宫殿，都要像陀斐特一样成为不洁；人曾在这一切房屋宫殿的屋顶上，向天上的万象烧香，向别神浇奠祭。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶路撒冷的房屋和犹大君王的宫殿是已经被玷污的，就是他们在其上向天上的万象烧香、向别神浇奠祭的宫殿房屋，都必与陀斐特一样。』」
verses.textEnNiv: The houses in Jerusalem and those of the kings of Judah will be defiled like this place, Topheth—all the houses where they burned incense on the roofs to all the starry hosts and poured out drink offerings to other gods.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: The houses of Jerusalem and the houses of the kings of Judah— all the houses on whose roofs offerings have been offered to all the host of heaven, and drink offerings have been poured out to other gods—shall be defiled like the place of Topheth.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: And the houses of Jerusalem and the houses of the kings of Judah shall be defiled like the place of Tophet, because of all the houses on whose roofs they have burned incense to all the host of heaven, and poured out drink offerings to other gods." ’ "
verses.textEnNlt: Yes, all the houses in Jerusalem, including the palace of Judah’s kings, will become like Topheth—all the houses where you burned incense on the rooftops to your star gods, and where liquid offerings were poured out to your idols.’"
verses.textEnNasb: The houses of Jerusalem and the houses of the kings of Judah will be defiled like the place Topheth, because of all the houses on whose rooftops they burned sacrifices to all the heavenly lights and poured out drink offerings to other gods." ’ "
verses.textEn: The houses in Jerusalem and those of the kings of Judah will be defiled like this place, Topheth—all the houses where they burned incense on the roofs to all the starry hosts and poured out drink offerings to other gods.’ "

verses.textZh: 耶利米从陀斐特，就是从耶和华差遣他去说预言的地方回来，他站在耶和华殿的院中，对众民说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶利米从陀斐特，就是从耶和华差遣他去说预言的地方回来，他站在耶和华殿的院中，对众民说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶利米从陀斐特－就是耶和华差他去说预言的地方－回来，站在耶和华殿的院中，对众人说：
verses.textEnNiv: Jeremiah then returned from Topheth, where the Lord had sent him to prophesy, and stood in the court of the Lord ’s temple and said to all the people,
verses.textEnEsv: Then Jeremiah came from Topheth, where the Lord had sent him to prophesy, and he stood in the court of the Lord ’s house and said to all the people:
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Jeremiah came from Tophet, where the Lord had sent him to prophesy; and he stood in the court of the Lord’s house and said to all the people,
verses.textEnNlt: Then Jeremiah returned from Topheth, the garbage dump where he had delivered this message, and he stopped in front of the Temple of the Lord . He said to the people there,
verses.textEnNasb: Then Jeremiah came from Topheth, where the Lord had sent him to prophesy; and he stood in the courtyard of the Lord’s house and said to all the people,
verses.textEn: Jeremiah then returned from Topheth, where the Lord had sent him to prophesy, and stood in the court of the Lord ’s temple and said to all the people,

verses.textZh: "万军之耶和华以色列的神这样说：‘看哪！我必使我宣告攻击这城的一切灾祸，临到这城和她附近的一切城镇，因为他们硬着颈项，不听从我的话。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: "万军之耶和华以色列的神这样说：‘看哪！我必使我宣告攻击这城的一切灾祸，临到这城和她附近的一切城镇，因为他们硬着颈项，不听从我的话。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 「万军之耶和华－以色列的神如此说：我必使我所说的一切灾祸临到这城和属城的一切城邑，因为他们硬着颈项不听我的话。」
verses.textEnNiv: "This is what the Lord Almighty, the God of Israel, says: ‘Listen! I am going to bring on this city and all the villages around it every disaster I pronounced against them, because they were stiff-necked and would not listen to my words.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: "Thus says the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel, behold, I am bringing upon this city and upon all its towns all the disaster that I have pronounced against it, because they have stiffened their neck, refusing to hear my words."
verses.textEnNkjv: "Thus says the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel: ‘Behold, I will bring on this city and on all her towns all the doom that I have pronounced against it, because they have stiffened their necks that they might not hear My words.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: "This is what the Lord of Heaven’s Armies, the God of Israel, says: ‘I will bring disaster upon this city and its surrounding towns as I promised, because you have stubbornly refused to listen to me.’"
verses.textEnNasb: "This is what the Lord of armies, the God of Israel says: ‘Behold, I am going to bring on this city and all its towns the entire disaster that I have declared against it, because they have stiffened their necks so as not to listen to My words.’ "
verses.textEn: "This is what the Lord Almighty, the God of Israel, says: ‘Listen! I am going to bring on this city and all the villages around it every disaster I pronounced against them, because they were stiff-necked and would not listen to my words.’ "

verses.textZh: 音麦的儿子巴施户珥祭司，就是耶和华殿的总管，他听见了耶利米预言这些事，
verses.textZhCnvs: 音麦的儿子巴施户珥祭司，就是耶和华殿的总管，他听见了耶利米预言这些事，
verses.textZhCuv: 祭司音麦的儿子巴施户珥作耶和华殿的总管，听见耶利米预言这些事，
verses.textEnNiv: When the priest Pashhur son of Immer, the official in charge of the temple of the Lord , heard Jeremiah prophesying these things,
verses.textEnEsv: Now Pashhur the priest, the son of Immer, who was chief officer in the house of the Lord , heard Jeremiah prophesying these things.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Pashhur the son of Immer, the priest who was also chief governor in the house of the Lord, heard that Jeremiah prophesied these things.
verses.textEnNlt: Now Pashhur son of Immer, the priest in charge of the Temple of the Lord , heard what Jeremiah was prophesying.
verses.textEnNasb: When Pashhur the priest, the son of Immer, who was chief overseer in the house of the Lord, heard Jeremiah prophesying these things,
verses.textEn: When the priest Pashhur son of Immer, the official in charge of the temple of the Lord , heard Jeremiah prophesying these things,

verses.textZh: 就殴打耶利米先知，把他枷锁在耶和华殿里，朝向便雅悯的上门内。
verses.textZhCnvs: 就殴打耶利米先知，把他枷锁在耶和华殿里，朝向便雅悯的上门内。
verses.textZhCuv: 他就打先知耶利米，用耶和华殿里便雅悯高门内的枷，将他枷在那里。
verses.textEnNiv: he had Jeremiah the prophet beaten and put in the stocks at the Upper Gate of Benjamin at the Lord ’s temple.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Pashhur beat Jeremiah the prophet, and put him in the stocks that were in the upper Benjamin Gate of the house of the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Pashhur struck Jeremiah the prophet, and put him in the stocks that were in the high gate of Benjamin, which was by the house of the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: So he arrested Jeremiah the prophet and had him whipped and put in stocks at the Benjamin Gate of the Lord ’s Temple.
verses.textEnNasb: Pashhur had Jeremiah the prophet beaten and put him in the stocks that were at the upper Benjamin Gate, which was by the house of the Lord.
verses.textEn: he had Jeremiah the prophet beaten and put in the stocks at the Upper Gate of Benjamin at the Lord ’s temple.

verses.textZh: 次日，巴施户珥把耶利米从枷锁上解下来，耶利米就对他说："耶和华不再称你的名为巴施户珥，却要称你为玛歌珥．米撒毕 。
verses.textZhCnvs: 次日，巴施户珥把耶利米从枷锁上解下来，耶利米就对他说："耶和华不再称你的名为巴施户珥，却要称你为玛歌珥．米撒毕 。
verses.textZhCuv: 次日，巴施户珥将耶利米开枷释放。于是耶利米对他说：「耶和华不是叫你的名为巴施户珥，乃是叫你玛歌珥‧米撒毕 ，
verses.textEnNiv: The next day, when Pashhur released him from the stocks, Jeremiah said to him, "The Lord ’s name for you is not Pashhur, but Terror on Every Side.
verses.textEnEsv: The next day, when Pashhur released Jeremiah from the stocks, Jeremiah said to him, "The Lord does not call your name Pashhur, but Terror on Every Side.
verses.textEnNkjv: And it happened on the next day that Pashhur brought Jeremiah out of the stocks. Then Jeremiah said to him, "The Lord has not called your name Pashhur, but Magor-Missabib.
verses.textEnNlt: The next day, when Pashhur finally released him, Jeremiah said, "Pashhur, the Lord has changed your name. From now on you are to be called ‘The Man Who Lives in Terror.’
verses.textEnNasb: Then on the next day, when Pashhur released Jeremiah from the stocks, Jeremiah said to him, "Pashhur is not the name the Lord has called you, but rather Magor-missabib.
verses.textEn: The next day, when Pashhur released him from the stocks, Jeremiah said to him, "The Lord ’s name for you is not Pashhur, but Terror on Every Side.

verses.textZh: 因为耶和华这样说：‘看哪！我要使你自己和你所有的朋友都惊惶失措；他们必倒在他们仇敌的刀下，你也必亲眼看见。我要把全犹大交在巴比伦王手中；他要把他们掳到巴比伦去，或用刀击杀他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为耶和华这样说：‘看哪！我要使你自己和你所有的朋友都惊惶失措；他们必倒在他们仇敌的刀下，你也必亲眼看见。我要把全犹大交在巴比伦王手中；他要把他们掳到巴比伦去，或用刀击杀他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 因耶和华如此说：『我必使你自觉惊吓，你也必使众朋友惊吓；他们必倒在仇敌的刀下，你也必亲眼看见；我必将犹大人全交在巴比伦王的手中，他要将他们掳到巴比伦去，也要用刀将他们杀戮。
verses.textEnNiv: For this is what the Lord says: ‘I will make you a terror to yourself and to all your friends; with your own eyes you will see them fall by the sword of their enemies. I will give all Judah into the hands of the king of Babylon, who will carry them away to Babylon or put them to the sword.
verses.textEnEsv: For thus says the Lord : Behold, I will make you a terror to yourself and to all your friends. They shall fall by the sword of their enemies while you look on. And I will give all Judah into the hand of the king of Babylon. He shall carry them captive to Babylon, and shall strike them down with the sword.
verses.textEnNkjv: For thus says the Lord: ‘Behold, I will make you a terror to yourself and to all your friends; and they shall fall by the sword of their enemies, and your eyes shall see it. I will give all Judah into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he shall carry them captive to Babylon and slay them with the sword.
verses.textEnNlt: For this is what the Lord says: ‘I will send terror upon you and all your friends, and you will watch as they are slaughtered by the swords of the enemy. I will hand the people of Judah over to the king of Babylon. He will take them captive to Babylon or run them through with the sword.
verses.textEnNasb: For this is what the Lord says: ‘Behold, I am going to make you a horror to yourself and to all your friends; and while your eyes look on, they will fall by the sword of their enemies. So I will hand all Judah over to the king of Babylon, and he will take them away as exiles to Babylon and will kill them with the sword.
verses.textEn: For this is what the Lord says: ‘I will make you a terror to yourself and to all your friends; with your own eyes you will see them fall by the sword of their enemies. I will give all Judah into the hands of the king of Babylon, who will carry them away to Babylon or put them to the sword.

verses.textZh: 我要把这城的一切财物、一切劳碌得来的、一切珍宝和犹大列王的一切宝物，都交在他们仇敌的手中；仇敌要把这一切抢劫掠夺，带回巴比伦去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要把这城的一切财物、一切劳碌得来的、一切珍宝和犹大列王的一切宝物，都交在他们仇敌的手中；仇敌要把这一切抢劫掠夺，带回巴比伦去。
verses.textZhCuv: 并且我要将这城中的一切货财和劳碌得来的，并一切珍宝，以及犹大君王所有的宝物，都交在他们仇敌的手中；仇敌要当作掠物带到巴比伦去。
verses.textEnNiv: I will deliver all the wealth of this city into the hands of their enemies—all its products, all its valuables and all the treasures of the kings of Judah. They will take it away as plunder and carry it off to Babylon.
verses.textEnEsv: Moreover, I will give all the wealth of the city, all its gains, all its prized belongings, and all the treasures of the kings of Judah into the hand of their enemies, who shall plunder them and seize them and carry them to Babylon.
verses.textEnNkjv: Moreover I will deliver all the wealth of this city, all its produce, and all its precious things; all the treasures of the kings of Judah I will give into the hand of their enemies, who will plunder them, seize them, and carry them to Babylon.
verses.textEnNlt: And I will let your enemies plunder Jerusalem. All the famed treasures of the city—the precious jewels and gold and silver of your kings—will be carried off to Babylon.
verses.textEnNasb: I will also give all the wealth of this city, all its produce and all its valuable things—even all the treasures of the kings of Judah I will hand over to their enemies, and they will plunder them, take them away, and bring them to Babylon.
verses.textEn: I will deliver all the wealth of this city into the hands of their enemies—all its products, all its valuables and all the treasures of the kings of Judah. They will take it away as plunder and carry it off to Babylon.

verses.textZh: 巴施户珥啊！你和所有住在你家里的人，都要被掳去；你和你所有的朋友，就是你向他们说假预言的，都要到巴比伦去，死在那里，也葬在那里。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 巴施户珥啊！你和所有住在你家里的人，都要被掳去；你和你所有的朋友，就是你向他们说假预言的，都要到巴比伦去，死在那里，也葬在那里。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 你这巴施户珥和一切住在你家中的人都必被掳去；你和你的众朋友，就是你向他们说假预言的，都必到巴比伦去，要死在那里，葬在那里。』」
verses.textEnNiv: And you, Pashhur, and all who live in your house will go into exile to Babylon. There you will die and be buried, you and all your friends to whom you have prophesied lies.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: And you, Pashhur, and all who dwell in your house, shall go into captivity. To Babylon you shall go, and there you shall die, and there you shall be buried, you and all your friends, to whom you have prophesied falsely."
verses.textEnNkjv: And you, Pashhur, and all who dwell in your house, shall go into captivity. You shall go to Babylon, and there you shall die, and be buried there, you and all your friends, to whom you have prophesied lies.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: As for you, Pashhur, you and all your household will go as captives to Babylon. There you will die and be buried, you and all your friends to whom you prophesied that everything would be all right.’"
verses.textEnNasb: And you, Pashhur, and all who live in your house will go into captivity; and you will enter Babylon, and there you will die and there you will be buried, you and all your friends to whom you have falsely prophesied.’ "
verses.textEn: And you, Pashhur, and all who live in your house will go into exile to Babylon. There you will die and be buried, you and all your friends to whom you have prophesied lies.’ "

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊！你愚弄了我，我受了愚弄； 你比我强大，你胜了我。 我整天成了别人讥笑的对象， 人人都嘲弄我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊！你愚弄了我，我受了愚弄； 你比我强大，你胜了我。 我整天成了别人讥笑的对象， 人人都嘲弄我。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，你曾劝导我， 我也听了你的劝导。 你比我有力量，且胜了我。 我终日成为笑话， 人人都戏弄我。
verses.textEnNiv: You deceived me, Lord , and I was deceived ; you overpowered me and prevailed. I am ridiculed all day long; everyone mocks me.
verses.textEnEsv: O Lord , you have deceived me, and I was deceived; you are stronger than I, and you have prevailed. I have become a laughingstock all the day; everyone mocks me.
verses.textEnNkjv: O Lord, You induced me, and I was persuaded; You are stronger than I, and have prevailed. I am in derision daily; Everyone mocks me.
verses.textEnNlt: O Lord , you misled me, and I allowed myself to be misled. You are stronger than I am, and you overpowered me. Now I am mocked every day; everyone laughs at me.
verses.textEnNasb: Lord, You persuaded me and I let myself be persuaded; You have overcome me and prevailed. I have become a laughingstock all day long; Everyone mocks me.
verses.textEn: You deceived me, Lord , and I was deceived ; you overpowered me and prevailed. I am ridiculed all day long; everyone mocks me.

verses.textZh: 因为我每次发言，都大声呼叫； 我呼喊，说："有强暴和毁灭！" 耶和华的话使我整天受人辱骂和讥讽。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为我每次发言，都大声呼叫； 我呼喊，说："有强暴和毁灭！" 耶和华的话使我整天受人辱骂和讥讽。
verses.textZhCuv: 我每逢讲论的时候，就发出哀声， 我喊叫说：有强暴和毁灭！ 因为耶和华的话终日成了我的凌辱、讥刺。
verses.textEnNiv: Whenever I speak, I cry out proclaiming violence and destruction. So the word of the Lord has brought me insult and reproach all day long.
verses.textEnEsv: For whenever I speak, I cry out, I shout, "Violence and destruction!" For the word of the Lord has become for me a reproach and derision all day long.
verses.textEnNkjv: For when I spoke, I cried out; I shouted, "Violence and plunder!" Because the word of the Lord was made to me A reproach and a derision daily.
verses.textEnNlt: When I speak, the words burst out. "Violence and destruction!" I shout. So these messages from the Lord have made me a household joke.
verses.textEnNasb: For each time I speak, I cry aloud; I proclaim violence and destruction, Because for me the word of the Lord has resulted In taunting and derision all day long.
verses.textEn: Whenever I speak, I cry out proclaiming violence and destruction. So the word of the Lord has brought me insult and reproach all day long.

verses.textZh: 如果我说："我不再提起他， 也不再奉他的名说话"， 他的话就像火在我心中焚烧， 被困在我的骨里； 我不能再抑制， 实在不能了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果我说："我不再提起他， 也不再奉他的名说话"， 他的话就像火在我心中焚烧， 被困在我的骨里； 我不能再抑制， 实在不能了。
verses.textZhCuv: 我若说：我不再提耶和华， 也不再奉他的名讲论， 我便心里觉得 似乎有烧着的火闭塞在我骨中， 我就含忍不住，不能自禁。
verses.textEnNiv: But if I say, "I will not mention his word or speak anymore in his name," his word is in my heart like a fire, a fire shut up in my bones. I am weary of holding it in; indeed, I cannot.
verses.textEnEsv: If I say, "I will not mention him, or speak any more in his name," there is in my heart as it were a burning fire shut up in my bones, and I am weary with holding it in, and I cannot.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then I said, "I will not make mention of Him, Nor speak anymore in His name." But Hisword was in my heart like a burning fire Shut up in my bones; I was weary of holding it back, And I could not.
verses.textEnNlt: But if I say I’ll never mention the Lord or speak in his name, his word burns in my heart like a fire. It’s like a fire in my bones! I am worn out trying to hold it in! I can’t do it!
verses.textEnNasb: But if I say, "I will not remember Him Nor speak anymore in His name," Then in my heart it becomes like a burning fire Shut up in my bones; And I am tired of holding it in, And I cannot endure it.
verses.textEn: But if I say, "I will not mention his word or speak anymore in his name," his word is in my heart like a fire, a fire shut up in my bones. I am weary of holding it in; indeed, I cannot.

verses.textZh: 我听见许多人耳语： "玛歌珥．米撒毕！ 告发他，我们要告发他！" 我所有的知己朋友都等着看我行差踏错， 他们说："希望他会上当，我们就可以胜过他， 向他报复。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我听见许多人耳语： "玛歌珥．米撒毕！ 告发他，我们要告发他！" 我所有的知己朋友都等着看我行差踏错， 他们说："希望他会上当，我们就可以胜过他， 向他报复。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我听见了许多人的谗谤， 四围都是惊吓； 就是我知己的朋友也都窥探我， 愿我跌倒，说： 告他吧，我们也要告他！ 或者他被引诱， 我们就能胜他， 在他身上报仇。
verses.textEnNiv: I hear many whispering, "Terror on every side! Denounce him! Let’s denounce him!" All my friends are waiting for me to slip, saying, "Perhaps he will be deceived; then we will prevail over him and take our revenge on him."
verses.textEnEsv: For I hear many whispering. Terror is on every side! "Denounce him! Let us denounce him!" say all my close friends, watching for my fall. "Perhaps he will be deceived; then we can overcome him and take our revenge on him."
verses.textEnNkjv: For I heard many mocking: "Fear on every side!" "Report," theysay, "and we will report it!" All my acquaintances watched for my stumbling, saying, "Perhaps he can be induced; Then we will prevail against him, And we will take our revenge on him."
verses.textEnNlt: I have heard the many rumors about me. They call me "The Man Who Lives in Terror." They threaten, "If you say anything, we will report it." Even my old friends are watching me, waiting for a fatal slip. "He will trap himself," they say, "and then we will get our revenge on him."
verses.textEnNasb: For I have heard the whispering of many, "Terror on every side! Denounce him; let’s denounce him!" All my trusted friends, Watching for my fall, say: "Perhaps he will be persuaded, so that we may prevail against him And take our revenge on him."
verses.textEn: I hear many whispering, "Terror on every side! Denounce him! Let’s denounce him!" All my friends are waiting for me to slip, saying, "Perhaps he will be deceived; then we will prevail over him and take our revenge on him."

verses.textZh: 但耶和华与我同在，像一个威武可畏的勇士， 因此，逼迫我的都必跌倒，不能得胜。 他们必大大蒙羞，因为他们失败了； 这永远的耻辱是人不能忘记的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但耶和华与我同在，像一个威武可畏的勇士， 因此，逼迫我的都必跌倒，不能得胜。 他们必大大蒙羞，因为他们失败了； 这永远的耻辱是人不能忘记的。
verses.textZhCuv: 然而，耶和华与我同在， 好像甚可怕的勇士。 因此，逼迫我的必都绊跌， 不能得胜； 他们必大大蒙羞， 就是受永不忘记的羞辱， 因为他们行事没有智慧。
verses.textEnNiv: But the Lord is with me like a mighty warrior; so my persecutors will stumble and not prevail. They will fail and be thoroughly disgraced; their dishonor will never be forgotten.
verses.textEnEsv: But the Lord is with me as a dread warrior; therefore my persecutors will stumble; they will not overcome me. They will be greatly shamed, for they will not succeed. Their eternal dishonor will never be forgotten.
verses.textEnNkjv: But the Lordis with me as a mighty, awesome One. Therefore my persecutors will stumble, and will not prevail. They will be greatly ashamed, for they will not prosper. Their everlasting confusion will never be forgotten.
verses.textEnNlt: But the Lord stands beside me like a great warrior. Before him my persecutors will stumble. They cannot defeat me. They will fail and be thoroughly humiliated. Their dishonor will never be forgotten.
verses.textEnNasb: But the Lord is with me like a powerful champion; Therefore my persecutors will stumble and not prevail. They will be put to great shame because they have failed, An everlasting disgrace that will not be forgotten.
verses.textEn: But the Lord is with me like a mighty warrior; so my persecutors will stumble and not prevail. They will fail and be thoroughly disgraced; their dishonor will never be forgotten.

verses.textZh: 万军之耶和华啊！你试验义人， 察看人的心肠肺腑； 求你让我看见你在他们身上施行的报复， 因为我已经把我的案件向你陈明了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 万军之耶和华啊！你试验义人， 察看人的心肠肺腑； 求你让我看见你在他们身上施行的报复， 因为我已经把我的案件向你陈明了。
verses.textZhCuv: 试验义人、察看人肺腑心肠的万军之耶和华啊， 求你容我见你在他们身上报仇， 因我将我的案件向你禀明了。
verses.textEnNiv: Lord Almighty, you who examine the righteous and probe the heart and mind, let me see your vengeance on them, for to you I have committed my cause.
verses.textEnEsv: O Lord of hosts, who tests the righteous, who sees the heart and the mind, let me see your vengeance upon them, for to you have I committed my cause.
verses.textEnNkjv: But, O Lord of hosts, You who test the righteous, And see the mind and heart, Let me see Your vengeance on them; For I have pleaded my cause before You.
verses.textEnNlt: O Lord of Heaven’s Armies, you test those who are righteous, and you examine the deepest thoughts and secrets. Let me see your vengeance against them, for I have committed my cause to you.
verses.textEnNasb: Yet, Lord of armies, who tests the righteous, Who sees the mind and the heart; Let me see Your vengeance on them, For to You I have disclosed my cause.
verses.textEn: Lord Almighty, you who examine the righteous and probe the heart and mind, let me see your vengeance on them, for to you I have committed my cause.

verses.textZh: 你们要歌颂耶和华， 赞美耶和华； 因为他救了穷乏人的性命， 脱离恶人的手。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要歌颂耶和华， 赞美耶和华； 因为他救了穷乏人的性命， 脱离恶人的手。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要向耶和华唱歌； 赞美耶和华！ 因他救了穷人的性命脱离恶人的手。
verses.textEnNiv: Sing to the Lord ! Give praise to the Lord ! He rescues the life of the needy from the hands of the wicked.
verses.textEnEsv: Sing to the Lord ; praise the Lord ! For he has delivered the life of the needy from the hand of evildoers.
verses.textEnNkjv: Sing to the Lord! Praise the Lord! For He has delivered the life of the poor From the hand of evildoers.
verses.textEnNlt: Sing to the Lord ! Praise the Lord ! For though I was poor and needy, he rescued me from my oppressors.
verses.textEnNasb: Sing to the Lord, praise the Lord! For He has saved the soul of the needy one From the hand of evildoers.
verses.textEn: Sing to the Lord ! Give praise to the Lord ! He rescues the life of the needy from the hands of the wicked.

verses.textZh: 愿我生的那一天受咒诅！ 愿我母亲生我的那一天不蒙祝福！
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿我生的那一天受咒诅！ 愿我母亲生我的那一天不蒙祝福！
verses.textZhCuv: 愿我生的那日受咒诅； 愿我母亲产我的那日不蒙福！
verses.textEnNiv: Cursed be the day I was born! May the day my mother bore me not be blessed!
verses.textEnEsv: Cursed be the day on which I was born! The day when my mother bore me, let it not be blessed!
verses.textEnNkjv: Cursed be the day in which I was born! Let the day not be blessed in which my mother bore me!
verses.textEnNlt: Yet I curse the day I was born! May no one celebrate the day of my birth.
verses.textEnNasb: Cursed be the day when I was born; May the day when my mother gave birth to me not be blessed!
verses.textEn: Cursed be the day I was born! May the day my mother bore me not be blessed!

verses.textZh: 那向我父亲报喜信： "你得了一个男孩"，叫我父亲十分高兴的， 愿那人受咒诅！
verses.textZhCnvs: 那向我父亲报喜信： "你得了一个男孩"，叫我父亲十分高兴的， 愿那人受咒诅！
verses.textZhCuv: 给我父亲报信说「你得了儿子」， 使我父亲甚欢喜的， 愿那人受咒诅。
verses.textEnNiv: Cursed be the man who brought my father the news, who made him very glad, saying, "A child is born to you—a son!"
verses.textEnEsv: Cursed be the man who brought the news to my father, "A son is born to you," making him very glad.
verses.textEnNkjv: Let the man be cursed Who brought news to my father, saying, "A male child has been born to you!" Making him very glad.
verses.textEnNlt: I curse the messenger who told my father, "Good news—you have a son!"
verses.textEnNasb: Cursed be the man who brought the news To my father, saying, "A boy has been born to you!" And made him very happy.
verses.textEn: Cursed be the man who brought my father the news, who made him very glad, saying, "A child is born to you—a son!"

verses.textZh: 愿那人像耶和华所倾覆而不顾惜的城市， 愿他早晨听见哀号， 午间听见战争的吶喊。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿那人像耶和华所倾覆而不顾惜的城市， 愿他早晨听见哀号， 午间听见战争的吶喊。
verses.textZhCuv: 愿那人像耶和华所倾覆而不后悔的城邑； 愿他早晨听见哀声， 晌午听见呐喊；
verses.textEnNiv: May that man be like the towns the Lord overthrew without pity. May he hear wailing in the morning, a battle cry at noon.
verses.textEnEsv: Let that man be like the cities that the Lord overthrew without pity; let him hear a cry in the morning and an alarm at noon,
verses.textEnNkjv: And let that man be like the cities Which the Lord overthrew, and did not relent; Let him hear the cry in the morning And the shouting at noon,
verses.textEnNlt: Let him be destroyed like the cities of old that the Lord overthrew without mercy. Terrify him all day long with battle shouts,
verses.textEnNasb: But may that man be like the cities Which the Lord overthrew without relenting, And may he hear an outcry in the morning And an alarm for war at noon;
verses.textEn: May that man be like the towns the Lord overthrew without pity. May he hear wailing in the morning, a battle cry at noon.

verses.textZh: 因为他没有使我死于母腹， 好使我的母亲成了我的坟墓， 我永远留在母腹中。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为他没有使我死于母腹， 好使我的母亲成了我的坟墓， 我永远留在母腹中。
verses.textZhCuv: 因他在我未出胎的时候不杀我， 使我母亲成了我的坟墓， 胎就时常重大。
verses.textEnNiv: For he did not kill me in the womb, with my mother as my grave, her womb enlarged forever.
verses.textEnEsv: because he did not kill me in the womb; so my mother would have been my grave, and her womb forever great.
verses.textEnNkjv: Because he did not kill me from the womb, That my mother might have been my grave, And her womb always enlarged withme.
verses.textEnNlt: because he did not kill me at birth. Oh, that I had died in my mother’s womb, that her body had been my grave!
verses.textEnNasb: Because he did not kill me before birth, So that my mother would have been my grave, And her womb forever pregnant.
verses.textEn: For he did not kill me in the womb, with my mother as my grave, her womb enlarged forever.

verses.textZh: 我为甚么要出母胎， 经历劳苦和忧伤， 并且我的年日都消逝在羞辱之中呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 我为甚么要出母胎， 经历劳苦和忧伤， 并且我的年日都消逝在羞辱之中呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 我为何出胎见劳碌愁苦， 使我的年日因羞愧消灭呢？
verses.textEnNiv: Why did I ever come out of the womb to see trouble and sorrow and to end my days in shame?
verses.textEnEsv: Why did I come out from the womb to see toil and sorrow, and spend my days in shame?
verses.textEnNkjv: Why did I come forth from the womb to see labor and sorrow, That my days should be consumed with shame?
verses.textEnNlt: Why was I ever born? My entire life has been filled with trouble, sorrow, and shame.
verses.textEnNasb: Why did I ever come out of the womb To look at trouble and sorrow, So that my days have been spent in shame?
verses.textEn: Why did I ever come out of the womb to see trouble and sorrow and to end my days in shame?

verses.textZh: 耶和华有话临到耶利米。那时，西底家王差遣玛基雅的儿子巴施户珥，和玛西雅的儿子西番雅祭司去见耶利米，说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华有话临到耶利米。那时，西底家王差遣玛基雅的儿子巴施户珥，和玛西雅的儿子西番雅祭司去见耶利米，说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的话临到耶利米。那时，西底家王打发玛基雅的儿子巴施户珥和玛西雅的儿子祭司西番雅去见耶利米，说：
verses.textEnNiv: The word came to Jeremiah from the Lord when King Zedekiah sent to him Pashhur son of Malkijah and the priest Zephaniah son of Maaseiah. They said:
verses.textEnEsv: This is the word that came to Jeremiah from the Lord , when King Zedekiah sent to him Pashhur the son of Malchiah and Zephaniah the priest, the son of Maaseiah, saying,
verses.textEnNkjv: The word which came to Jeremiah from the Lord when King Zedekiah sent to him Pashhur the son of Melchiah, and Zephaniah the son of Maaseiah, the priest, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord spoke through Jeremiah when King Zedekiah sent Pashhur son of Malkijah and Zephaniah son of Maaseiah, the priest, to speak with him. They begged Jeremiah,
verses.textEnNasb: The word that came to Jeremiah from the Lord when King Zedekiah sent to him Pashhur the son of Malchijah and Zephaniah the priest, the son of Maaseiah, saying,
verses.textEn: The word came to Jeremiah from the Lord when King Zedekiah sent to him Pashhur son of Malkijah and the priest Zephaniah son of Maaseiah. They said:

verses.textZh: "请你替我们求问耶和华，因为巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒来攻击我们；也许耶和华会为我们行奇事，使尼布甲尼撒离开我们回去。"
verses.textZhCnvs: "请你替我们求问耶和华，因为巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒来攻击我们；也许耶和华会为我们行奇事，使尼布甲尼撒离开我们回去。"
verses.textZhCuv: 「请你为我们求问耶和华；因为巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒来攻击我们，或者耶和华照他一切奇妙的作为待我们，使巴比伦王离开我们上去。」
verses.textEnNiv: "Inquire now of the Lord for us because Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon is attacking us. Perhaps the Lord will perform wonders for us as in times past so that he will withdraw from us."
verses.textEnEsv: "Inquire of the Lord for us, for Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon is making war against us. Perhaps the Lord will deal with us according to all his wonderful deeds and will make him withdraw from us."
verses.textEnNkjv: "Please inquire of the Lord for us, for Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon makes war against us. Perhaps the Lord will deal with us according to all His wonderful works, that theking may go away from us."
verses.textEnNlt: "Please speak to the Lord for us and ask him to help us. King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylon is attacking Judah. Perhaps the Lord will be gracious and do a mighty miracle as he has done in the past. Perhaps he will force Nebuchadnezzar to withdraw his armies."
verses.textEnNasb: "Please inquire of the Lord in our behalf, because Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon is making war against us; perhaps the Lord will deal with us in accordance with all His wonderful acts, so that the enemy will withdraw from us."
verses.textEn: "Inquire now of the Lord for us because Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon is attacking us. Perhaps the Lord will perform wonders for us as in times past so that he will withdraw from us."

verses.textZh: 耶利米就对他们说："你们要对西底家这样说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶利米就对他们说："你们要对西底家这样说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶利米对他们说：「你们当对西底家这样说：
verses.textEnNiv: But Jeremiah answered them, "Tell Zedekiah,
verses.textEnEsv: Then Jeremiah said to them: "Thus you shall say to Zedekiah,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Jeremiah said to them, "Thus you shall say to Zedekiah,
verses.textEnNlt: Jeremiah replied, "Go back to King Zedekiah and tell him,
verses.textEnNasb: But Jeremiah said to them, "You shall say to Zedekiah as follows:
verses.textEn: But Jeremiah answered them, "Tell Zedekiah,

verses.textZh: ‘耶和华以色列的神这样说：看哪！我必使你们手中的武器，就是你们用来与城外围困你们的巴比伦王和迦勒底人作战的武器，转回堆积在这城的中心。
verses.textZhCnvs: ‘耶和华以色列的神这样说：看哪！我必使你们手中的武器，就是你们用来与城外围困你们的巴比伦王和迦勒底人作战的武器，转回堆积在这城的中心。
verses.textZhCuv: 『耶和华－以色列的神如此说：我要使你们手中的兵器，就是你们在城外与巴比伦王和围困你们的迦勒底人打仗的兵器翻转过来，又要使这些都聚集在这城中。
verses.textEnNiv: ‘This is what the Lord , the God of Israel, says: I am about to turn against you the weapons of war that are in your hands, which you are using to fight the king of Babylon and the Babylonians who are outside the wall besieging you. And I will gather them inside this city.
verses.textEnEsv: ‘Thus says the Lord , the God of Israel: Behold, I will turn back the weapons of war that are in your hands and with which you are fighting against the king of Babylon and against the Chaldeans who are besieging you outside the walls. And I will bring them together into the midst of this city.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘Thus says the Lord God of Israel: "Behold, I will turn back the weapons of war that are in your hands, with which you fight against the king of Babylon and the Chaldeans who besiege you outside the walls; and I will assemble them in the midst of this city.
verses.textEnNlt: ‘This is what the Lord , the God of Israel, says: I will make your weapons useless against the king of Babylon and the Babylonians who are outside your walls attacking you. In fact, I will bring your enemies right into the heart of this city.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘This is what the Lord, the God of Israel says: "Behold, I am going to turn back the weapons of war that are in your hands, with which you are making war against the king of Babylon and the Chaldeans who are besieging you outside the wall; and I will gather them into the middle of this city.
verses.textEn: ‘This is what the Lord , the God of Israel, says: I am about to turn against you the weapons of war that are in your hands, which you are using to fight the king of Babylon and the Babylonians who are outside the wall besieging you. And I will gather them inside this city.

verses.textZh: 我必在怒气、烈怒和忿怒中，用伸出来的手和强有力的膀臂，亲自攻击你们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必在怒气、烈怒和忿怒中，用伸出来的手和强有力的膀臂，亲自攻击你们。
verses.textZhCuv: 并且我要在怒气、忿怒，和大恼恨中，用伸出来的手，并大能的膀臂，亲自攻击你们；
verses.textEnNiv: I myself will fight against you with an outstretched hand and a mighty arm in furious anger and in great wrath.
verses.textEnEsv: I myself will fight against you with outstretched hand and strong arm, in anger and in fury and in great wrath.
verses.textEnNkjv: I Myself will fight against you with an outstretched hand and with a strong arm, even in anger and fury and great wrath.
verses.textEnNlt: I myself will fight against you with a strong hand and a powerful arm, for I am very angry. You have made me furious!
verses.textEnNasb: And I Myself will make war against you with an outstretched hand and a mighty arm, and in anger, wrath, and great indignation.
verses.textEn: I myself will fight against you with an outstretched hand and a mighty arm in furious anger and in great wrath.

verses.textZh: 我要击打住在这城的人和牲畜，他们都要因极大的瘟疫而死。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要击打住在这城的人和牲畜，他们都要因极大的瘟疫而死。
verses.textZhCuv: 又要击打这城的居民，连人带牲畜都必遭遇大瘟疫死亡。
verses.textEnNiv: I will strike down those who live in this city—both man and beast—and they will die of a terrible plague.
verses.textEnEsv: And I will strike down the inhabitants of this city, both man and beast. They shall die of a great pestilence.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will strike the inhabitants of this city, both man and beast; they shall die of a great pestilence.
verses.textEnNlt: I will send a terrible plague upon this city, and both people and animals will die.
verses.textEnNasb: I will also strike the inhabitants of this city, both the people and the animals; they will die of a great plague.
verses.textEn: I will strike down those who live in this city—both man and beast—and they will die of a terrible plague.

verses.textZh: 然后，我必把犹大王西底家和他的臣民，就是在这城里经过瘟疫、刀剑之灾和饥荒而幸存的人，都交在巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒和他们的仇敌，以及寻索他们性命的人的手中。尼布甲尼撒要用刀剑击杀他们，绝不顾惜，不留情，不怜悯。’"这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 然后，我必把犹大王西底家和他的臣民，就是在这城里经过瘟疫、刀剑之灾和饥荒而幸存的人，都交在巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒和他们的仇敌，以及寻索他们性命的人的手中。尼布甲尼撒要用刀剑击杀他们，绝不顾惜，不留情，不怜悯。’"这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 以后我要将犹大王西底家和他的臣仆百姓，就是在城内，从瘟疫、刀剑、饥荒中剩下的人，都交在巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒的手中和他们仇敌，并寻索其命的人手中。巴比伦王必用刀击杀他们，不顾惜，不可怜，不怜悯。这是耶和华说的。』
verses.textEnNiv: After that, declares the Lord , I will give Zedekiah king of Judah, his officials and the people in this city who survive the plague, sword and famine, into the hands of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon and to their enemies who want to kill them. He will put them to the sword; he will show them no mercy or pity or compassion.’
verses.textEnEsv: Afterward, declares the Lord , I will give Zedekiah king of Judah and his servants and the people in this city who survive the pestilence, sword, and famine into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon and into the hand of their enemies, into the hand of those who seek their lives. He shall strike them down with the edge of the sword. He shall not pity them or spare them or have compassion.’
verses.textEnNkjv: And afterward," says the Lord, "I will deliver Zedekiah king of Judah, his servants and the people, and such as are left in this city from the pestilence and the sword and the famine, into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, into the hand of their enemies, and into the hand of those who seek their life; and he shall strike them with the edge of the sword. He shall not spare them, or have pity or mercy." ’
verses.textEnNlt: And after all that, says the Lord , I will hand over King Zedekiah, his staff, and everyone else in the city who survives the disease, war, and famine. I will hand them over to King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylon and to their other enemies. He will slaughter them and show them no mercy, pity, or compassion.’
verses.textEnNasb: Then afterward," declares the Lord, "I will hand Zedekiah king of Judah, his servants, and the people, that is, those who survive in this city from the plague, the sword, and the famine, over to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, to their enemies, and to those who seek their lives; and he will strike and kill them with the edge of the sword. He will not spare them nor have pity nor compassion." ’
verses.textEn: After that, declares the Lord , I will give Zedekiah king of Judah, his officials and the people in this city who survive the plague, sword and famine, into the hands of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon and to their enemies who want to kill them. He will put them to the sword; he will show them no mercy or pity or compassion.’

verses.textZh: 耶和华又吩咐耶利米："你要对这人民说：‘耶和华这样说：看哪！我把生命的路和死亡的路摆在你们面前。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华又吩咐耶利米："你要对这人民说：‘耶和华这样说：看哪！我把生命的路和死亡的路摆在你们面前。
verses.textZhCuv: 「你要对这百姓说：『耶和华如此说：看哪，我将生命的路和死亡的路摆在你们面前。
verses.textEnNiv: "Furthermore, tell the people, ‘This is what the Lord says: See, I am setting before you the way of life and the way of death.
verses.textEnEsv: "And to this people you shall say: ‘Thus says the Lord : Behold, I set before you the way of life and the way of death.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Now you shall say to this people, ‘Thus says the Lord: "Behold, I set before you the way of life and the way of death.
verses.textEnNlt: "Tell all the people, ‘This is what the Lord says: Take your choice of life or death!
verses.textEnNasb: "You shall also say to this people, ‘This is what the Lord says: "Behold, I am setting before you the way of life and the way of death.
verses.textEn: "Furthermore, tell the people, ‘This is what the Lord says: See, I am setting before you the way of life and the way of death.

verses.textZh: 凡留在这城里的，必因刀剑、饥荒、瘟疫而死；但出去向围困你们的迦勒底人投降的，必可以活着，捡回自己的性命。
verses.textZhCnvs: 凡留在这城里的，必因刀剑、饥荒、瘟疫而死；但出去向围困你们的迦勒底人投降的，必可以活着，捡回自己的性命。
verses.textZhCuv: 住在这城里的必遭刀剑、饥荒、瘟疫而死；但出去归降围困你们迦勒底人的必得存活，要以自己的命为掠物。
verses.textEnNiv: Whoever stays in this city will die by the sword, famine or plague. But whoever goes out and surrenders to the Babylonians who are besieging you will live; they will escape with their lives.
verses.textEnEsv: He who stays in this city shall die by the sword, by famine, and by pestilence, but he who goes out and surrenders to the Chaldeans who are besieging you shall live and shall have his life as a prize of war.
verses.textEnNkjv: He who remains in this city shall die by the sword, by famine, and by pestilence; but he who goes out and defects to the Chaldeans who besiege you, he shall live, and his life shall be as a prize to him.
verses.textEnNlt: Everyone who stays in Jerusalem will die from war, famine, or disease, but those who go out and surrender to the Babylonians will live. Their reward will be life!
verses.textEnNasb: Anyone who stays in this city will die by the sword, by famine, or by plague; but anyone who leaves and goes over to the Chaldeans who are besieging you will live, and he will have his own life as plunder.
verses.textEn: Whoever stays in this city will die by the sword, famine or plague. But whoever goes out and surrenders to the Babylonians who are besieging you will live; they will escape with their lives.

verses.textZh: 因为我已经决意向这城降祸不降福；这城必交在巴比伦王的手中，他必放火把城烧毁。’"这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为我已经决意向这城降祸不降福；这城必交在巴比伦王的手中，他必放火把城烧毁。’"这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华说：我向这城变脸，降祸不降福；这城必交在巴比伦王的手中，他必用火焚烧。』」
verses.textEnNiv: I have determined to do this city harm and not good, declares the Lord . It will be given into the hands of the king of Babylon, and he will destroy it with fire.’
verses.textEnEsv: For I have set my face against this city for harm and not for good, declares the Lord : it shall be given into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he shall burn it with fire.’
verses.textEnNkjv: For I have set My face against this city for adversity and not for good," says the Lord. "It shall be given into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he shall burn it with fire." ’
verses.textEnNlt: For I have decided to bring disaster and not good upon this city, says the Lord . It will be handed over to the king of Babylon, and he will reduce it to ashes.’
verses.textEnNasb: For I have set My face against this city for harm and not for good," declares the Lord. "It will be handed over to the king of Babylon and he will burn it with fire." ’
verses.textEn: I have determined to do this city harm and not good, declares the Lord . It will be given into the hands of the king of Babylon, and he will destroy it with fire.’

verses.textZh: "你要对犹大王室说： ‘你们要听耶和华的话。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你要对犹大王室说： ‘你们要听耶和华的话。
verses.textZhCuv: 「至于犹大王的家，你们当听耶和华的话。
verses.textEnNiv: "Moreover, say to the royal house of Judah, ‘Hear the word of the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: "And to the house of the king of Judah say, ‘Hear the word of the Lord ,
verses.textEnNkjv: "And concerning the house of the king of Judah, say, ‘Hear the word of the Lord,
verses.textEnNlt: "Say to the royal family of Judah, ‘Listen to this message from the Lord !
verses.textEnNasb: "Then say to the household of the king of Judah, ‘Hear the word of the Lord,
verses.textEn: "Moreover, say to the royal house of Judah, ‘Hear the word of the Lord .

verses.textZh: 大卫家啊！耶和华这样说： 你们每早晨应秉公审判， 解救被抢夺的脱离欺压者的手； 免得我的烈怒因你们 的恶行发作， 如火焚烧，无人能熄灭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫家啊！耶和华这样说： 你们每早晨应秉公审判， 解救被抢夺的脱离欺压者的手； 免得我的烈怒因你们 的恶行发作， 如火焚烧，无人能熄灭。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫家啊，耶和华如此说： 你们每早晨要施行公平， 拯救被抢夺的脱离欺压人的手， 恐怕我的忿怒因你们的恶行发作， 如火着起，甚至无人能以熄灭。
verses.textEnNiv: This is what the Lord says to you, house of David: " ‘Administer justice every morning; rescue from the hand of the oppressor the one who has been robbed, or my wrath will break out and burn like fire because of the evil you have done— burn with no one to quench it.
verses.textEnEsv: O house of David! Thus says the Lord : "‘Execute justice in the morning, and deliver from the hand of the oppressor him who has been robbed, lest my wrath go forth like fire, and burn with none to quench it, because of your evil deeds.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: O house of David! Thus says the Lord: "Execute judgment in the morning; And deliver himwhois plundered Out of the hand of the oppressor, Lest My fury go forth like fire And burn so that no one can quench it, Because of the evil of your doings.
verses.textEnNlt: This is what the Lord says to the dynasty of David: "‘Give justice each morning to the people you judge! Help those who have been robbed; rescue them from their oppressors. Otherwise, my anger will burn like an unquenchable fire because of all your sins.
verses.textEnNasb: house of David, this is what the Lord says: "Administer justice every morning; And save the person who has been robbed from the power of his oppressor, So that My wrath will not spread like fire And burn, with no one to extinguish it, Because of the evil of their deeds.
verses.textEn: This is what the Lord says to you, house of David: " ‘Administer justice every morning; rescue from the hand of the oppressor the one who has been robbed, or my wrath will break out and burn like fire because of the evil you have done— burn with no one to quench it.

verses.textZh: 看哪！在山谷上、在岩石平原上的耶路撒冷啊！ 我要攻击你。’ 这是耶和华的宣告。 ‘你们说：谁能下来攻击我们， 谁能进入我们的住处呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 看哪！在山谷上、在岩石平原上的耶路撒冷啊！ 我要攻击你。’ 这是耶和华的宣告。 ‘你们说：谁能下来攻击我们， 谁能进入我们的住处呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华说：住山谷和平原磐石上的居民， 你们说：谁能下来攻击我们？ 谁能进入我们的住处呢？ 看哪，我与你们为敌。
verses.textEnNiv: I am against you, Jerusalem, you who live above this valley on the rocky plateau, declares the Lord — you who say, "Who can come against us? Who can enter our refuge?"
verses.textEnEsv: "Behold, I am against you, O inhabitant of the valley, O rock of the plain, declares the Lord ; you who say, ‘Who shall come down against us, or who shall enter our habitations?’
verses.textEnNkjv: "Behold, I am against you, O inhabitant of the valley, And rock of the plain," says the Lord, "Who say, ‘Who shall come down against us? Or who shall enter our dwellings?’
verses.textEnNlt: I will personally fight against the people in Jerusalem, that mighty fortress— the people who boast, "No one can touch us here. No one can break in here."
verses.textEnNasb: "Behold, I am against you, you inhabitant of the valley, You rocky plain," declares the Lord, "You who say, ‘Who will come down against us? Or who will enter our dwellings?’
verses.textEn: I am against you, Jerusalem, you who live above this valley on the rocky plateau, declares the Lord — you who say, "Who can come against us? Who can enter our refuge?"

verses.textZh: 我必照着你们所作的事应得的结果惩罚你们； 我要在耶路撒冷的树林中放火， 吞灭她四围的一切。’" 这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必照着你们所作的事应得的结果惩罚你们； 我要在耶路撒冷的树林中放火， 吞灭她四围的一切。’" 这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华又说： 我必按你们做事的结果刑罚你们； 我也必使火在耶路撒冷的林中着起， 将她四围所有的尽行烧灭。」
verses.textEnNiv: I will punish you as your deeds deserve, declares the Lord . I will kindle a fire in your forests that will consume everything around you.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: I will punish you according to the fruit of your deeds, declares the Lord ; I will kindle a fire in her forest, and it shall devour all that is around her."
verses.textEnNkjv: But I will punish you according to the fruit of your doings," says the Lord; "I will kindle a fire in its forest, And it shall devour all things around it." ’ "
verses.textEnNlt: And I myself will punish you for your sinfulness, says the Lord . I will light a fire in your forests that will burn up everything around you.’"
verses.textEnNasb: "But I will punish you according to the results of your deeds," declares the Lord, "And I will kindle a fire in its forest So that it may devour all its surroundings." ’ "
verses.textEn: I will punish you as your deeds deserve, declares the Lord . I will kindle a fire in your forests that will consume everything around you.’ "

verses.textZh: 耶和华这样说："你下到犹大王的宫中，在那里宣讲这些话，
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华这样说："你下到犹大王的宫中，在那里宣讲这些话，
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华如此说：「你下到犹大王的宫中，在那里说这话，
verses.textEnNiv: This is what the Lord says: "Go down to the palace of the king of Judah and proclaim this message there:
verses.textEnEsv: Thus says the Lord : "Go down to the house of the king of Judah and speak there this word,
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus says the Lord: "Go down to the house of the king of Judah, and there speak this word,
verses.textEnNlt: This is what the Lord said to me: "Go over and speak directly to the king of Judah. Say to him,
verses.textEnNasb: This is what the Lord says: "Go down to the house of the king of Judah and there speak this word,
verses.textEn: This is what the Lord says: "Go down to the palace of the king of Judah and proclaim this message there:

verses.textZh: 说：‘坐大卫王位的犹大王啊！你和你的臣仆，以及从这些门进来的人民，都要听耶和华的话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 说：‘坐大卫王位的犹大王啊！你和你的臣仆，以及从这些门进来的人民，都要听耶和华的话。
verses.textZhCuv: 说：『坐大卫宝座的犹大王啊，你和你的臣仆，并进入城门的百姓，都当听耶和华的话。
verses.textEnNiv: ‘Hear the word of the Lord to you, king of Judah, you who sit on David’s throne—you, your officials and your people who come through these gates.
verses.textEnEsv: and say, ‘Hear the word of the Lord , O king of Judah, who sits on the throne of David, you, and your servants, and your people who enter these gates.
verses.textEnNkjv: and say, ‘Hear the word of the Lord, O king of Judah, you who sit on the throne of David, you and your servants and your people who enter these gates!
verses.textEnNlt: ‘Listen to this message from the Lord , you king of Judah, sitting on David’s throne. Let your attendants and your people listen, too.
verses.textEnNasb: and say, ‘Hear the word of the Lord, O king of Judah, who sits on David’s throne, you and your servants and your people who enter these gates.
verses.textEn: ‘Hear the word of the Lord to you, king of Judah, you who sit on David’s throne—you, your officials and your people who come through these gates.

verses.textZh: 耶和华这样说：你们要施行公正和公义，解救被抢夺的脱离欺压者的手，不可虐待或以强暴对待寄居的、孤儿和寡妇，也不可在这地方流无辜人的血。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华这样说：你们要施行公正和公义，解救被抢夺的脱离欺压者的手，不可虐待或以强暴对待寄居的、孤儿和寡妇，也不可在这地方流无辜人的血。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华如此说：你们要施行公平和公义，拯救被抢夺的脱离欺压人的手，不可亏负寄居的和孤儿寡妇，不可以强暴待他们，在这地方也不可流无辜人的血。
verses.textEnNiv: This is what the Lord says: Do what is just and right. Rescue from the hand of the oppressor the one who has been robbed. Do no wrong or violence to the foreigner, the fatherless or the widow, and do not shed innocent blood in this place.
verses.textEnEsv: Thus says the Lord : Do justice and righteousness, and deliver from the hand of the oppressor him who has been robbed. And do no wrong or violence to the resident alien, the fatherless, and the widow, nor shed innocent blood in this place.
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus says the Lord: "Execute judgment and righteousness, and deliver the plundered out of the hand of the oppressor. Do no wrong and do no violence to the stranger, the fatherless, or the widow, nor shed innocent blood in this place.
verses.textEnNlt: This is what the Lord says: Be fair-minded and just. Do what is right! Help those who have been robbed; rescue them from their oppressors. Quit your evil deeds! Do not mistreat foreigners, orphans, and widows. Stop murdering the innocent!
verses.textEnNasb: This is what the Lord says: "Do justice and righteousness, and save one who has been robbed from the power of his oppressor. And do not mistreat or do violence to the stranger, the orphan, or the widow; and do not shed innocent blood in this place.
verses.textEn: This is what the Lord says: Do what is just and right. Rescue from the hand of the oppressor the one who has been robbed. Do no wrong or violence to the foreigner, the fatherless or the widow, and do not shed innocent blood in this place.

verses.textZh: 如果你们切实地行这些事，就必有坐大卫王位的列王，乘着车，骑着马，与自己的臣仆和人民进入这王宫的各门。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果你们切实地行这些事，就必有坐大卫王位的列王，乘着车，骑着马，与自己的臣仆和人民进入这王宫的各门。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们若认真行这事，就必有坐大卫宝座的君王和他的臣仆百姓，或坐车或骑马，从这城的各门进入。
verses.textEnNiv: For if you are careful to carry out these commands, then kings who sit on David’s throne will come through the gates of this palace, riding in chariots and on horses, accompanied by their officials and their people.
verses.textEnEsv: For if you will indeed obey this word, then there shall enter the gates of this house kings who sit on the throne of David, riding in chariots and on horses, they and their servants and their people.
verses.textEnNkjv: For if you indeed do this thing, then shall enter the gates of this house, riding on horses and in chariots, accompanied by servants and people, kings who sit on the throne of David.
verses.textEnNlt: If you obey me, there will always be a descendant of David sitting on the throne here in Jerusalem. The king will ride through the palace gates in chariots and on horses, with his parade of attendants and subjects.
verses.textEnNasb: For if you will indeed perform this instruction, then kings will enter the gates of this house, sitting in David’s place on his throne, riding in chariots and on horses, the king himself, his servants, and his people.
verses.textEn: For if you are careful to carry out these commands, then kings who sit on David’s throne will come through the gates of this palace, riding in chariots and on horses, accompanied by their officials and their people.

verses.textZh: 如果你们不听从这些话，我指着自己起誓，这宫殿必变为废墟。’"这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果你们不听从这些话，我指着自己起誓，这宫殿必变为废墟。’"这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们若不听这些话，耶和华说：我指着自己起誓，这城必变为荒场。』
verses.textEnNiv: But if you do not obey these commands, declares the Lord , I swear by myself that this palace will become a ruin.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: But if you will not obey these words, I swear by myself, declares the Lord , that this house shall become a desolation.
verses.textEnNkjv: But if you will not hear these words, I swear by Myself," says the Lord, "that this house shall become a desolation." ’ "
verses.textEnNlt: But if you refuse to pay attention to this warning, I swear by my own name, says the Lord , that this palace will become a pile of rubble.’"
verses.textEnNasb: But if you will not obey these words, I swear by Myself," declares the Lord, "that this house will become a place of ruins." ’ "
verses.textEn: But if you do not obey these commands, declares the Lord , I swear by myself that this palace will become a ruin.’ "

verses.textZh: 因为耶和华论到犹大王的宫殿这样说： "虽然在我看来，你好象基列， 好象黎巴嫩的山峰； 我却要使你变为旷野， 变为无人居住的城市。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为耶和华论到犹大王的宫殿这样说： "虽然在我看来，你好象基列， 好象黎巴嫩的山峰； 我却要使你变为旷野， 变为无人居住的城市。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华论到犹大王的家如此说： 我看你如基列， 如黎巴嫩顶； 然而，我必使你变为旷野， 为无人居住的城邑。
verses.textEnNiv: For this is what the Lord says about the palace of the king of Judah: "Though you are like Gilead to me, like the summit of Lebanon, I will surely make you like a wasteland, like towns not inhabited.
verses.textEnEsv: For thus says the Lord concerning the house of the king of Judah: "‘You are like Gilead to me, like the summit of Lebanon, yet surely I will make you a desert, an uninhabited city.
verses.textEnNkjv: For thus says the Lord to the house of the king of Judah: "You are Gilead to Me, The head of Lebanon; Yet I surely will make you a wilderness, Cities which are not inhabited.
verses.textEnNlt: Now this is what the Lord says concerning Judah’s royal palace: "I love you as much as fruitful Gilead and the green forests of Lebanon. But I will turn you into a desert, with no one living within your walls.
verses.textEnNasb: For this is what the Lord says concerning the house of the king of Judah: "You are like Gilead to Me, Like the summit of Lebanon; Yet most assuredly I will make you a wilderness, Cities that are not inhabited.
verses.textEn: For this is what the Lord says about the palace of the king of Judah: "Though you are like Gilead to me, like the summit of Lebanon, I will surely make you like a wasteland, like towns not inhabited.

verses.textZh: 我要指派毁灭者， 各有兵器攻击你； 他们必砍下你最好的香柏树， 丢进火里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要指派毁灭者， 各有兵器攻击你； 他们必砍下你最好的香柏树， 丢进火里。
verses.textZhCuv: 我要预备行毁灭的人， 各拿器械攻击你； 他们要砍下你佳美的香柏树， 扔在火中。
verses.textEnNiv: I will send destroyers against you, each man with his weapons, and they will cut up your fine cedar beams and throw them into the fire.
verses.textEnEsv: I will prepare destroyers against you, each with his weapons, and they shall cut down your choicest cedars and cast them into the fire.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will prepare destroyers against you, Everyone with his weapons; They shall cut down your choice cedars And cast them into the fire.
verses.textEnNlt: I will call for wreckers, who will bring out their tools to dismantle you. They will tear out all your fine cedar beams and throw them on the fire.
verses.textEnNasb: "For I will set apart destroyers against you, Each with his weapons; And they will cut down your choicest cedars And throw them on the fire.
verses.textEn: I will send destroyers against you, each man with his weapons, and they will cut up your fine cedar beams and throw them into the fire.

verses.textZh: 多国的人必经过这城，彼此发问：‘耶和华为甚么这样对待这大城呢？’
verses.textZhCnvs: 多国的人必经过这城，彼此发问：‘耶和华为甚么这样对待这大城呢？’
verses.textZhCuv: 「许多国的民要经过这城，各人对邻舍说：『耶和华为何向这大城如此行呢？』
verses.textEnNiv: "People from many nations will pass by this city and will ask one another, ‘Why has the Lord done such a thing to this great city?’
verses.textEnEsv: "‘And many nations will pass by this city, and every man will say to his neighbor, "Why has the Lord dealt thus with this great city?"
verses.textEnNkjv: And many nations will pass by this city; and everyone will say to his neighbor, ‘Why has the Lord done so to this great city?’
verses.textEnNlt: "People from many nations will pass by the ruins of this city and say to one another, ‘Why did the Lord destroy such a great city?’
verses.textEnNasb: "Many nations will pass by this city; and they will say to one another, ‘Why has the Lord done this to this great city?’
verses.textEn: "People from many nations will pass by this city and will ask one another, ‘Why has the Lord done such a thing to this great city?’

verses.textZh: 必有人说：‘是因为他们离弃了耶和华他们神的约，并且敬拜事奉别神。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 必有人说：‘是因为他们离弃了耶和华他们神的约，并且敬拜事奉别神。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们必回答说：『是因离弃了耶和华－他们神的约，事奉敬拜别神。』」
verses.textEnNiv: And the answer will be: ‘Because they have forsaken the covenant of the Lord their God and have worshiped and served other gods.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: And they will answer, "Because they have forsaken the covenant of the Lord their God and worshiped other gods and served them."’"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they will answer, ‘Because they have forsaken the covenant of the Lord their God, and worshiped other gods and served them.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: And the answer will be, ‘Because they violated their covenant with the Lord their God by worshiping other gods.’"
verses.textEnNasb: Then they will answer, ‘Because they abandoned the covenant of the Lord their God and bowed down to other gods and served them.’ "
verses.textEn: And the answer will be: ‘Because they have forsaken the covenant of the Lord their God and have worshiped and served other gods.’ "

verses.textZh: 不要为那已死的人哀哭， 不要为他悲伤； 却要为那远去的人大大哀哭， 因为他不得再回来， 也不能再见自己的国土。
verses.textZhCnvs: 不要为那已死的人哀哭， 不要为他悲伤； 却要为那远去的人大大哀哭， 因为他不得再回来， 也不能再见自己的国土。
verses.textZhCuv: 不要为死人哭号； 不要为他悲伤， 却要为离家出外的人大大哭号； 因为他不得再回来， 也不得再见他的本国。
verses.textEnNiv: Do not weep for the dead king or mourn his loss; rather, weep bitterly for him who is exiled, because he will never return nor see his native land again.
verses.textEnEsv: Weep not for him who is dead, nor grieve for him, but weep bitterly for him who goes away, for he shall return no more to see his native land.
verses.textEnNkjv: Weep not for the dead, nor bemoan him; Weep bitterly for him who goes away, For he shall return no more, Nor see his native country.
verses.textEnNlt: Do not weep for the dead king or mourn his loss. Instead, weep for the captive king being led away! For he will never return to see his native land again.
verses.textEnNasb: Do not weep for the dead or mourn for him, But weep deeply for the one who goes away; For he will never return Or see his native land.
verses.textEn: Do not weep for the dead king or mourn his loss; rather, weep bitterly for him who is exiled, because he will never return nor see his native land again.

verses.textZh: 因为论到犹大王约西亚的儿子，就是继承他父亲约西亚作王的沙龙，耶和华这样说："他离开了这地方，必不得再回来；
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为论到犹大王约西亚的儿子，就是继承他父亲约西亚作王的沙龙，耶和华这样说："他离开了这地方，必不得再回来；
verses.textZhCuv: 因为耶和华论到从这地方出去的犹大王约西亚的儿子沙龙 ，就是接续他父亲约西亚作王的，这样说：「他必不得再回到这里来，
verses.textEnNiv: For this is what the Lord says about Shallum son of Josiah, who succeeded his father as king of Judah but has gone from this place: "He will never return.
verses.textEnEsv: For thus says the Lord concerning Shallum the son of Josiah, king of Judah, who reigned instead of Josiah his father, and who went away from this place: "He shall return here no more,
verses.textEnNkjv: For thus says the Lord concerning Shallum the son of Josiah, king of Judah, who reigned instead of Josiah his father, who went from this place: "He shall not return here anymore,
verses.textEnNlt: For this is what the Lord says about Jehoahaz, who succeeded his father, King Josiah, and was taken away as a captive: "He will never return.
verses.textEnNasb: For this is what the Lord says regarding Shallum the son of Josiah, king of Judah, who became king in the place of his father Josiah, who went out from this place: "He will never return there;
verses.textEn: For this is what the Lord says about Shallum son of Josiah, who succeeded his father as king of Judah but has gone from this place: "He will never return.

verses.textZh: 因为他要死在被掳去的地方，不得再见这地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为他要死在被掳去的地方，不得再见这地。
verses.textZhCuv: 却要死在被掳去的地方，必不得再见这地。」
verses.textEnNiv: He will die in the place where they have led him captive; he will not see this land again."
verses.textEnEsv: but in the place where they have carried him captive, there shall he die, and he shall never see this land again."
verses.textEnNkjv: but he shall die in the place where they have led him captive, and shall see this land no more.
verses.textEnNlt: He will die in a distant land and will never again see his own country."
verses.textEnNasb: but in the place where they took him into exile, there he will die and he will not see this land again.
verses.textEn: He will die in the place where they have led him captive; he will not see this land again."

verses.textZh: "用不义的手段建造自己房屋、 用不公正的方法建筑自己楼房的， 有祸了！ 他使自己的同胞白白作工， 不把工资付给他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: "用不义的手段建造自己房屋、 用不公正的方法建筑自己楼房的， 有祸了！ 他使自己的同胞白白作工， 不把工资付给他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 那行不义盖房、行不公造楼、 白白使用人的手工不给工价的有祸了！
verses.textEnNiv: "Woe to him who builds his palace by unrighteousness, his upper rooms by injustice, making his own people work for nothing, not paying them for their labor.
verses.textEnEsv: "Woe to him who builds his house by unrighteousness, and his upper rooms by injustice, who makes his neighbor serve him for nothing and does not give him his wages,
verses.textEnNkjv: "Woe to him who builds his house by unrighteousness And his chambers by injustice, Who uses his neighbor’s service without wages And gives him nothing for his work,
verses.textEnNlt: And the Lord says, "What sorrow awaits Jehoiakim, who builds his palace with forced labor. He builds injustice into its walls, for he makes his neighbors work for nothing. He does not pay them for their labor.
verses.textEnNasb: "Woe to him who builds his house without righteousness, And his upstairs rooms without justice, Who uses his neighbor’s services without pay And does not give him his wages,
verses.textEn: "Woe to him who builds his palace by unrighteousness, his upper rooms by injustice, making his own people work for nothing, not paying them for their labor.

verses.textZh: 他说：‘我要为自己建造宏伟的房屋、 宽敞的楼房。’ 他又为房屋装设宽阔的窗户， 用香柏木作镶板， 并且漆上红色。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他说：‘我要为自己建造宏伟的房屋、 宽敞的楼房。’ 他又为房屋装设宽阔的窗户， 用香柏木作镶板， 并且漆上红色。
verses.textZhCuv: 他说：我要为自己盖广大的房、宽敞的楼， 为自己开窗户。 这楼房的护墙板是香柏木的， 楼房是丹色油漆的。
verses.textEnNiv: He says, ‘I will build myself a great palace with spacious upper rooms.’ So he makes large windows in it, panels it with cedar and decorates it in red.
verses.textEnEsv: who says, ‘I will build myself a great house with spacious upper rooms,’ who cuts out windows for it, paneling it with cedar and painting it with vermilion.
verses.textEnNkjv: Who says, ‘I will build myself a wide house with spacious chambers, And cut out windows for it, Paneling it with cedar And painting it with vermilion.’
verses.textEnNlt: He says, ‘I will build a magnificent palace with huge rooms and many windows. I will panel it throughout with fragrant cedar and paint it a lovely red.’
verses.textEnNasb: Who says, ‘I will build myself a large house With spacious upstairs rooms, And cut out its windows, Paneling it with cedar and painting it bright red.’
verses.textEn: He says, ‘I will build myself a great palace with spacious upper rooms.’ So he makes large windows in it, panels it with cedar and decorates it in red.

verses.textZh: 难道你是用香柏木争胜来表明王的身分吗？ 你父亲不是也吃也喝， 也施行公正和公义吗？ 那时他得享福乐。
verses.textZhCnvs: 难道你是用香柏木争胜来表明王的身分吗？ 你父亲不是也吃也喝， 也施行公正和公义吗？ 那时他得享福乐。
verses.textZhCuv: 难道你作王是在乎造香柏木楼房争胜吗？ 你的父亲岂不是也吃也喝、 也施行公平和公义吗？ 那时他得了福乐。
verses.textEnNiv: "Does it make you a king to have more and more cedar? Did not your father have food and drink? He did what was right and just, so all went well with him.
verses.textEnEsv: Do you think you are a king because you compete in cedar? Did not your father eat and drink and do justice and righteousness? Then it was well with him.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Shall you reign because you enclose yourself in cedar? Did not your father eat and drink, And do justice and righteousness? Then itwas well with him.
verses.textEnNlt: But a beautiful cedar palace does not make a great king! Your father, Josiah, also had plenty to eat and drink. But he was just and right in all his dealings. That is why God blessed him.
verses.textEnNasb: "Do you become a king because you are competing in cedar? Did your father not eat and drink And do justice and righteousness? Then it was well for him.
verses.textEn: "Does it make you a king to have more and more cedar? Did not your father have food and drink? He did what was right and just, so all went well with him.

verses.textZh: 他为困苦和贫穷人伸冤， 那时他得享福乐。 这不是认识我的真义吗？" 这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他为困苦和贫穷人伸冤， 那时他得享福乐。 这不是认识我的真义吗？" 这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 他为困苦和穷乏人伸冤， 那时就得了福乐。 认识我不在乎此吗？ 这是耶和华说的。
verses.textEnNiv: He defended the cause of the poor and needy, and so all went well. Is that not what it means to know me?" declares the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: He judged the cause of the poor and needy; then it was well. Is not this to know me? declares the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: He judged the cause of the poor and needy; Then itwas well. Was not this knowing Me?" says the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: He gave justice and help to the poor and needy, and everything went well for him. Isn’t that what it means to know me?" says the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: "He pled the cause of the afflicted and the poor, Then it was well. Is that not what it means to know Me?" Declares the Lord.
verses.textEn: He defended the cause of the poor and needy, and so all went well. Is that not what it means to know me?" declares the Lord .

verses.textZh: "但你的眼你的心甚么都不顾， 只顾你的不义之财， 只知流无辜人的血， 施行欺压和迫害的事。"
verses.textZhCnvs: "但你的眼你的心甚么都不顾， 只顾你的不义之财， 只知流无辜人的血， 施行欺压和迫害的事。"
verses.textZhCuv: 惟有你的眼和你的心专顾贪婪， 流无辜人的血， 行欺压和强暴。
verses.textEnNiv: "But your eyes and your heart are set only on dishonest gain, on shedding innocent blood and on oppression and extortion."
verses.textEnEsv: But you have eyes and heart only for your dishonest gain, for shedding innocent blood, and for practicing oppression and violence."
verses.textEnNkjv: "Yet your eyes and your heart are for nothing but your covetousness, For shedding innocent blood, And practicing oppression and violence."
verses.textEnNlt: "But you! You have eyes only for greed and dishonesty! You murder the innocent, oppress the poor, and reign ruthlessly."
verses.textEnNasb: "But your eyes and your heart Are intent only upon your own dishonest gain, And on shedding innocent blood, And on practicing oppression and extortion."
verses.textEn: "But your eyes and your heart are set only on dishonest gain, on shedding innocent blood and on oppression and extortion."

verses.textZh: 因此，论到犹大王约西亚的儿子约雅敬，耶和华这样说： "人必不为他哀伤，说： ‘哀哉，我哥哥！’‘哀哉，我姊姊！’ 人必不为他哀伤，说： ‘哀哉，主上！’‘哀哉，尊荣的王！’
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，论到犹大王约西亚的儿子约雅敬，耶和华这样说： "人必不为他哀伤，说： ‘哀哉，我哥哥！’‘哀哉，我姊姊！’ 人必不为他哀伤，说： ‘哀哉，主上！’‘哀哉，尊荣的王！’
verses.textZhCuv: 所以，耶和华论到犹大王约西亚的儿子约雅敬如此说： 人必不为他举哀说： 哀哉！我的哥哥； 或说：哀哉！我的姐姐； 也不为他举哀说： 哀哉！我的主； 或说：哀哉！我主的荣华。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore this is what the Lord says about Jehoiakim son of Josiah king of Judah: "They will not mourn for him: ‘Alas, my brother! Alas, my sister!’ They will not mourn for him: ‘Alas, my master! Alas, his splendor!’
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore thus says the Lord concerning Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah: "They shall not lament for him, saying, ‘Ah, my brother!’ or ‘Ah, sister!’ They shall not lament for him, saying, ‘Ah, lord!’ or ‘Ah, his majesty!’
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore thus says the Lord concerning Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah: "They shall not lament for him, Saying, ‘Alas, my brother!’ or ‘Alas, my sister!’ They shall not lament for him, Saying, ‘Alas, master!’ or ‘Alas, his glory!’
verses.textEnNlt: Therefore, this is what the Lord says about Jehoiakim, son of King Josiah: "The people will not mourn for him, crying to one another, ‘Alas, my brother! Alas, my sister!’ His subjects will not mourn for him, crying, ‘Alas, our master is dead! Alas, his splendor is gone!’
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore this is what the Lord says regarding Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah: "They will not mourn for him: ‘Oh, my brother!’ or, ‘Oh, sister!’ They will not mourn for him: ‘Oh, for the master!’ or, ‘Oh, for his splendor!’
verses.textEn: Therefore this is what the Lord says about Jehoiakim son of Josiah king of Judah: "They will not mourn for him: ‘Alas, my brother! Alas, my sister!’ They will not mourn for him: ‘Alas, my master! Alas, his splendor!’

verses.textZh: 他像驴子一样被埋葬， 被拖走，拋在耶路撒冷城门外。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他像驴子一样被埋葬， 被拖走，拋在耶路撒冷城门外。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他被埋葬，好像埋驴一样， 要拉出去扔在耶路撒冷的城门之外。
verses.textEnNiv: He will have the burial of a donkey— dragged away and thrown outside the gates of Jerusalem."
verses.textEnEsv: With the burial of a donkey he shall be buried, dragged and dumped beyond the gates of Jerusalem."
verses.textEnNkjv: He shall be buried with the burial of a donkey, Dragged and cast out beyond the gates of Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNlt: He will be buried like a dead donkey— dragged out of Jerusalem and dumped outside the gates!
verses.textEnNasb: "He will be buried with a donkey’s burial, Dragged off and thrown out beyond the gates of Jerusalem.
verses.textEn: He will have the burial of a donkey— dragged away and thrown outside the gates of Jerusalem."

verses.textZh: "耶路撒冷啊，上黎巴嫩哀叫吧！ 在巴珊扬声吧！ 从亚巴琳哀叫吧！ 因为你的盟友都毁灭了。
verses.textZhCnvs: "耶路撒冷啊，上黎巴嫩哀叫吧！ 在巴珊扬声吧！ 从亚巴琳哀叫吧！ 因为你的盟友都毁灭了。
verses.textZhCuv: 你要上黎巴嫩哀号， 在巴珊扬声， 从亚巴琳哀号， 因为你所亲爱的都毁灭了。
verses.textEnNiv: "Go up to Lebanon and cry out, let your voice be heard in Bashan, cry out from Abarim, for all your allies are crushed.
verses.textEnEsv: "Go up to Lebanon, and cry out, and lift up your voice in Bashan; cry out from Abarim, for all your lovers are destroyed.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Go up to Lebanon, and cry out, And lift up your voice in Bashan; Cry from Abarim, For all your lovers are destroyed.
verses.textEnNlt: Weep for your allies in Lebanon. Shout for them in Bashan. Search for them in the regions east of the river. See, they are all destroyed. Not one is left to help you.
verses.textEnNasb: "Go up to Lebanon and cry out, And raise your voice in Bashan; Cry out also from Abarim, For all your lovers have been crushed.
verses.textEn: "Go up to Lebanon and cry out, let your voice be heard in Bashan, cry out from Abarim, for all your allies are crushed.

verses.textZh: 你安定的时候，我曾警告过你， 你却说：‘我不听！’ 从你幼年以来，你就是这样， 不听从我的话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你安定的时候，我曾警告过你， 你却说：‘我不听！’ 从你幼年以来，你就是这样， 不听从我的话。
verses.textZhCuv: 你兴盛的时候，我对你说话； 你却说：我不听。 你自幼年以来总是这样， 不听从我的话。
verses.textEnNiv: I warned you when you felt secure, but you said, ‘I will not listen!’ This has been your way from your youth; you have not obeyed me.
verses.textEnEsv: I spoke to you in your prosperity, but you said, ‘I will not listen.’ This has been your way from your youth, that you have not obeyed my voice.
verses.textEnNkjv: I spoke to you in your prosperity, But you said, ‘I will not hear.’ This hasbeen your manner from your youth, That you did not obey My voice.
verses.textEnNlt: I warned you when you were prosperous, but you replied, ‘Don’t bother me.’ You have been that way since childhood— you simply will not obey me!
verses.textEnNasb: "I spoke to you in your prosperity; But you said, ‘I will not listen!’ This has been your way from your youth, That you have not obeyed My voice.
verses.textEn: I warned you when you felt secure, but you said, ‘I will not listen!’ This has been your way from your youth; you have not obeyed me.

verses.textZh: 风要卷走你所有的牧人， 你的盟友要被掳去； 那时，因你的一切恶行， 你必蒙羞受辱。
verses.textZhCnvs: 风要卷走你所有的牧人， 你的盟友要被掳去； 那时，因你的一切恶行， 你必蒙羞受辱。
verses.textZhCuv: 你的牧人要被风吞吃， 你所亲爱的必被掳去； 那时你必因你一切的恶抱愧蒙羞。
verses.textEnNiv: The wind will drive all your shepherds away, and your allies will go into exile. Then you will be ashamed and disgraced because of all your wickedness.
verses.textEnEsv: The wind shall shepherd all your shepherds, and your lovers shall go into captivity; then you will be ashamed and confounded because of all your evil.
verses.textEnNkjv: The wind shall eat up all your rulers, And your lovers shall go into captivity; Surely then you will be ashamed and humiliated For all your wickedness.
verses.textEnNlt: And now the wind will blow away your allies. All your friends will be taken away as captives. Surely then you will see your wickedness and be ashamed.
verses.textEnNasb: "The wind will sweep away all your shepherds, And your lovers will go into captivity; Then you will certainly be ashamed and humiliated Because of all your wickedness.
verses.textEn: The wind will drive all your shepherds away, and your allies will go into exile. Then you will be ashamed and disgraced because of all your wickedness.

verses.textZh: 住在黎巴嫩，在香柏林中搭窝的啊！ 有痛苦临到你，像产妇剧痛的时候， 你要怎样呻吟呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 住在黎巴嫩，在香柏林中搭窝的啊！ 有痛苦临到你，像产妇剧痛的时候， 你要怎样呻吟呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 你这住黎巴嫩、在香柏树上搭窝的， 有痛苦临到你， 好像疼痛临到产难的妇人， 那时你何等可怜！
verses.textEnNiv: You who live in ‘Lebanon, ’ who are nestled in cedar buildings, how you will groan when pangs come upon you, pain like that of a woman in labor!
verses.textEnEsv: O inhabitant of Lebanon, nested among the cedars, how you will be pitied when pangs come upon you, pain as of a woman in labor!"
verses.textEnNkjv: O inhabitant of Lebanon, Making your nest in the cedars, How gracious will you be when pangs come upon you, Like the pain of a woman in labor?
verses.textEnNlt: It may be nice to live in a beautiful palace paneled with wood from the cedars of Lebanon, but soon you will groan with pangs of anguish— anguish like that of a woman in labor.
verses.textEnNasb: "You who live in Lebanon, Nested in the cedars, How you will groan when sharp pains come on you, Pain like a woman in childbirth!
verses.textEn: You who live in ‘Lebanon, ’ who are nestled in cedar buildings, how you will groan when pangs come upon you, pain like that of a woman in labor!

verses.textZh: "我指着我的永生起誓 ，犹大王约雅敬的儿子哥尼雅，虽然你是我右手上的印戒，我也要把你从手上脱下来，
verses.textZhCnvs: "我指着我的永生起誓 ，犹大王约雅敬的儿子哥尼雅，虽然你是我右手上的印戒，我也要把你从手上脱下来，
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华说：「犹大王约雅敬的儿子哥尼雅 ，虽是我右手上带印的戒指，我凭我的永生起誓，也必将你从其上摘下来，
