verses.textEnNiv: "As surely as I live," declares the Lord , "even if you, Jehoiachin son of Jehoiakim king of Judah, were a signet ring on my right hand, I would still pull you off.
verses.textEnEsv: "As I live, declares the Lord , though Coniah the son of Jehoiakim, king of Judah, were the signet ring on my right hand, yet I would tear you off
verses.textEnNkjv: "As I live," says the Lord, "though Coniah the son of Jehoiakim, king of Judah, were the signet on My right hand, yet I would pluck you off;
verses.textEnNlt: "As surely as I live," says the Lord , "I will abandon you, Jehoiachin son of Jehoiakim, king of Judah. Even if you were the signet ring on my right hand, I would pull you off.
verses.textEnNasb: "As I live," declares the Lord, "even if Coniah the son of Jehoiakim king of Judah were a signet ring on My right hand, yet I would pull you off;
verses.textEn: "As surely as I live," declares the Lord , "even if you, Jehoiachin son of Jehoiakim king of Judah, were a signet ring on my right hand, I would still pull you off.

verses.textZh: 交在那些寻索你性命和你们惧怕的人手中，就是交在巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒和迦勒底人手中。
verses.textZhCnvs: 交在那些寻索你性命和你们惧怕的人手中，就是交在巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒和迦勒底人手中。
verses.textZhCuv: 并且我必将你交给寻索你命的人和你所惧怕的人手中，就是巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒和迦勒底人的手中。
verses.textEnNiv: I will deliver you into the hands of those who want to kill you, those you fear—Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon and the Babylonians.
verses.textEnEsv: and give you into the hand of those who seek your life, into the hand of those of whom you are afraid, even into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon and into the hand of the Chaldeans.
verses.textEnNkjv: and I will give you into the hand of those who seek your life, and into the hand ofthose whose face you fear—the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon and the hand of the Chaldeans.
verses.textEnNlt: I will hand you over to those who seek to kill you, those you so desperately fear—to King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylon and the mighty Babylonian army.
verses.textEnNasb: and I will hand you over to those who are seeking your life, yes, to those of whom you are frightened, that is, to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon and the Chaldeans.
verses.textEn: I will deliver you into the hands of those who want to kill you, those you fear—Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon and the Babylonians.

verses.textZh: 我要把你和生你的母亲驱赶到异地去，你们不是生在那里，却要死在那里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要把你和生你的母亲驱赶到异地去，你们不是生在那里，却要死在那里。
verses.textZhCuv: 我也必将你和生你的母亲赶到别国，并不是你们生的地方；你们必死在那里，
verses.textEnNiv: I will hurl you and the mother who gave you birth into another country, where neither of you was born, and there you both will die.
verses.textEnEsv: I will hurl you and the mother who bore you into another country, where you were not born, and there you shall die.
verses.textEnNkjv: So I will cast you out, and your mother who bore you, into another country where you were not born; and there you shall die.
verses.textEnNlt: I will expel you and your mother from this land, and you will die in a foreign country, not in your native land.
verses.textEnNasb: I will hurl you and your mother who gave birth to you into another country where you were not born, and there you will die.
verses.textEn: I will hurl you and the mother who gave you birth into another country, where neither of you was born, and there you both will die.

verses.textZh: 你们 渴望归回本国，却不得回去。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们 渴望归回本国，却不得回去。"
verses.textZhCuv: 但心中甚想归回之地，必不得归回。」
verses.textEnNiv: You will never come back to the land you long to return to."
verses.textEnEsv: But to the land to which they will long to return, there they shall not return."
verses.textEnNkjv: But to the land to which they desire to return, there they shall not return.
verses.textEnNlt: You will never again return to the land you yearn for.
verses.textEnNasb: But as for the land to which they long to return, they will not return to it.
verses.textEn: You will never come back to the land you long to return to."

verses.textZh: 哥尼雅这个人是被鄙视、 被摔碎的瓶子， 是没有人喜悦的器皿吗？ 他和他的后裔为甚么被驱赶， 被拋弃到他们不认识的地去呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 哥尼雅这个人是被鄙视、 被摔碎的瓶子， 是没有人喜悦的器皿吗？ 他和他的后裔为甚么被驱赶， 被拋弃到他们不认识的地去呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 哥尼雅这人是被轻看、破坏的器皿吗？ 是无人喜爱的器皿吗？ 他和他的后裔为何被赶到不认识之地呢？
verses.textEnNiv: Is this man Jehoiachin a despised, broken pot, an object no one wants? Why will he and his children be hurled out, cast into a land they do not know?
verses.textEnEsv: Is this man Coniah a despised, broken pot, a vessel no one cares for? Why are he and his children hurled and cast into a land that they do not know?
verses.textEnNkjv: "Is this man Coniah a despised, broken idol— A vessel in which is no pleasure? Why are they cast out, he and his descendants, And cast into a land which they do not know?
verses.textEnNlt: "Why is this man Jehoiachin like a discarded, broken jar? Why are he and his children to be exiled to a foreign land?
verses.textEnNasb: "Is this man Coniah a despised, shattered jar? Or is he an undesirable vessel? Why have he and his descendants been hurled out And cast into a land that they had not known?
verses.textEn: Is this man Jehoiachin a despised, broken pot, an object no one wants? Why will he and his children be hurled out, cast into a land they do not know?

verses.textZh: 大地啊！大地啊！大地啊！ 要听耶和华的话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大地啊！大地啊！大地啊！ 要听耶和华的话。
verses.textZhCuv: 地啊，地啊，地啊，当听耶和华的话！
verses.textEnNiv: O land, land, land, hear the word of the Lord !
verses.textEnEsv: O land, land, land, hear the word of the Lord !
verses.textEnNkjv: O earth, earth, earth, Hear the word of the Lord!
verses.textEnNlt: O earth, earth, earth! Listen to this message from the Lord !
verses.textEnNasb: "O land, land, land, Hear the word of the Lord!
verses.textEn: O land, land, land, hear the word of the Lord !

verses.textZh: 耶和华这样说： "你们要写下，这人算为无子， 他的一生毫无成就； 因为他的后裔中没有一人可以成功， 能坐在大卫的王位上， 再次统治犹大。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华这样说： "你们要写下，这人算为无子， 他的一生毫无成就； 因为他的后裔中没有一人可以成功， 能坐在大卫的王位上， 再次统治犹大。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华如此说： 要写明这人算为无子， 是平生不得亨通的； 因为他后裔中再无一人得亨通， 能坐在大卫的宝座上治理犹大。
verses.textEnNiv: This is what the Lord says: "Record this man as if childless, a man who will not prosper in his lifetime, for none of his offspring will prosper, none will sit on the throne of David or rule anymore in Judah."
verses.textEnEsv: Thus says the Lord : "Write this man down as childless, a man who shall not succeed in his days, for none of his offspring shall succeed in sitting on the throne of David and ruling again in Judah."
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus says the Lord: ‘Write this man down as childless, A man who shall not prosper in his days; For none of his descendants shall prosper, Sitting on the throne of David, And ruling anymore in Judah.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: This is what the Lord says: ‘Let the record show that this man Jehoiachin was childless. He is a failure, for none of his children will succeed him on the throne of David to rule over Judah.’
verses.textEnNasb: This is what the Lord says: ‘Write this man down as childless, A man who will not prosper in his days; For no man among his descendants will prosper Sitting on the throne of David Or ruling again in Judah.’ "
verses.textEn: This is what the Lord says: "Record this man as if childless, a man who will not prosper in his lifetime, for none of his offspring will prosper, none will sit on the throne of David or rule anymore in Judah."

verses.textZh: "那些残杀和赶散我牧场上的羊群的牧人，有祸了！"这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: "那些残杀和赶散我牧场上的羊群的牧人，有祸了！"这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华说：「那些残害、赶散我草场之羊的牧人有祸了！」
verses.textEnNiv: "Woe to the shepherds who are destroying and scattering the sheep of my pasture!" declares the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: "Woe to the shepherds who destroy and scatter the sheep of my pasture!" declares the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: "Woe to the shepherds who destroy and scatter the sheep of My pasture!" says the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: "What sorrow awaits the leaders of my people—the shepherds of my sheep—for they have destroyed and scattered the very ones they were expected to care for," says the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: "Woe to the shepherds who are causing the sheep of My pasture to perish and are scattering them!" declares the Lord.
verses.textEn: "Woe to the shepherds who are destroying and scattering the sheep of my pasture!" declares the Lord .

verses.textZh: 因此，耶和华以色列的神论到牧养他 子民的牧人这样说："你们使我的羊群四散，把牠们赶走，并没有看顾牠们；看哪！我必因你们的恶行惩罚你们。"这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，耶和华以色列的神论到牧养他 子民的牧人这样说："你们使我的羊群四散，把牠们赶走，并没有看顾牠们；看哪！我必因你们的恶行惩罚你们。"这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华－以色列的神斥责那些牧养他百姓的牧人，如此说：「你们赶散我的羊群，并没有看顾他们；我必讨你们这行恶的罪。这是耶和华说的。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore this is what the Lord , the God of Israel, says to the shepherds who tend my people: "Because you have scattered my flock and driven them away and have not bestowed care on them, I will bestow punishment on you for the evil you have done," declares the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore thus says the Lord , the God of Israel, concerning the shepherds who care for my people: "You have scattered my flock and have driven them away, and you have not attended to them. Behold, I will attend to you for your evil deeds, declares the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore thus says the Lord God of Israel against the shepherds who feed My people: "You have scattered My flock, driven them away, and not attended to them. Behold, I will attend to you for the evil of your doings," says the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: Therefore, this is what the Lord , the God of Israel, says to these shepherds: "Instead of caring for my flock and leading them to safety, you have deserted them and driven them to destruction. Now I will pour out judgment on you for the evil you have done to them.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore this is what the Lord, the God of Israel says concerning the shepherds who are tending My people: "You have scattered My flock and driven them away, and have not been concerned about them; behold, I am going to call you to account for the evil of your deeds," declares the Lord.
verses.textEn: Therefore this is what the Lord , the God of Israel, says to the shepherds who tend my people: "Because you have scattered my flock and driven them away and have not bestowed care on them, I will bestow punishment on you for the evil you have done," declares the Lord .

verses.textZh: "我要亲自把我羊群中余剩的，从我把牠们赶逐到的各地，招聚出来，领牠们归回自己的羊圈，使牠们繁殖增多。
verses.textZhCnvs: "我要亲自把我羊群中余剩的，从我把牠们赶逐到的各地，招聚出来，领牠们归回自己的羊圈，使牠们繁殖增多。
verses.textZhCuv: 我要将我羊群中所余剩的，从我赶他们到的各国内招聚出来，领他们归回本圈；他们也必生养众多。
verses.textEnNiv: "I myself will gather the remnant of my flock out of all the countries where I have driven them and will bring them back to their pasture, where they will be fruitful and increase in number.
verses.textEnEsv: Then I will gather the remnant of my flock out of all the countries where I have driven them, and I will bring them back to their fold, and they shall be fruitful and multiply.
verses.textEnNkjv: "But I will gather the remnant of My flock out of all countries where I have driven them, and bring them back to their folds; and they shall be fruitful and increase.
verses.textEnNlt: But I will gather together the remnant of my flock from the countries where I have driven them. I will bring them back to their own sheepfold, and they will be fruitful and increase in number.
verses.textEnNasb: "Then I Myself will gather the remnant of My flock out of all the countries where I have driven them, and bring them back to their pasture, and they will be fruitful and multiply.
verses.textEn: "I myself will gather the remnant of my flock out of all the countries where I have driven them and will bring them back to their pasture, where they will be fruitful and increase in number.

verses.textZh: 我要兴起牧人，牧养牠们；牠们必不再恐惧惊慌，一个也不会失掉。"这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要兴起牧人，牧养牠们；牠们必不再恐惧惊慌，一个也不会失掉。"这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 我必设立照管他们的牧人，牧养他们。他们不再惧怕，不再惊惶，也不缺少一个；这是耶和华说的。」
verses.textEnNiv: I will place shepherds over them who will tend them, and they will no longer be afraid or terrified, nor will any be missing," declares the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: I will set shepherds over them who will care for them, and they shall fear no more, nor be dismayed, neither shall any be missing, declares the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: I will set up shepherds over them who will feed them; and they shall fear no more, nor be dismayed, nor shall they be lacking," says the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: Then I will appoint responsible shepherds who will care for them, and they will never be afraid again. Not a single one will be lost or missing. I, the Lord , have spoken!
verses.textEnNasb: I will also raise up shepherds over them and they will tend them; and they will not be afraid any longer, nor be terrified, nor will any be missing," declares the Lord.
verses.textEn: I will place shepherds over them who will tend them, and they will no longer be afraid or terrified, nor will any be missing," declares the Lord .

verses.textZh: "看哪！日子快到 ， 我必给大卫兴起一个公义的苗裔； 他必执政为王，行事有智慧， 在地上施行公正和公义。
verses.textZhCnvs: "看哪！日子快到 ， 我必给大卫兴起一个公义的苗裔； 他必执政为王，行事有智慧， 在地上施行公正和公义。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华说：「日子将到，我要给大卫兴起一个公义的苗裔；他必掌王权，行事有智慧，在地上施行公平和公义。
verses.textEnNiv: "The days are coming," declares the Lord , "when I will raise up for David a righteous Branch, a King who will reign wisely and do what is just and right in the land.
verses.textEnEsv: "Behold, the days are coming, declares the Lord , when I will raise up for David a righteous Branch, and he shall reign as king and deal wisely, and shall execute justice and righteousness in the land.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Behold, the days are coming," says the Lord, "That I will raise to David a Branch of righteousness; A King shall reign and prosper, And execute judgment and righteousness in the earth.
verses.textEnNlt: "For the time is coming," says the Lord , "when I will raise up a righteous descendant from King David’s line. He will be a King who rules with wisdom. He will do what is just and right throughout the land.
verses.textEnNasb: "Behold, the days are coming," declares the Lord, "When I will raise up for David a righteous Branch; And He will reign as king and act wisely And do justice and righteousness in the land.
verses.textEn: "The days are coming," declares the Lord , "when I will raise up for David a righteous Branch, a King who will reign wisely and do what is just and right in the land.

verses.textZh: 在他执政的日子，犹大必得救， 以色列也必安然居住。 人要称他的名字为‘耶和华我们的义’。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 在他执政的日子，犹大必得救， 以色列也必安然居住。 人要称他的名字为‘耶和华我们的义’。"
verses.textZhCuv: 在他的日子，犹大必得救，以色列也安然居住。他的名必称为『耶和华－我们的义』。」
verses.textEnNiv: In his days Judah will be saved and Israel will live in safety. This is the name by which he will be called: The Lord Our Righteous Savior.
verses.textEnEsv: In his days Judah will be saved, and Israel will dwell securely. And this is the name by which he will be called: ‘The Lord is our righteousness.’
verses.textEnNkjv: In His days Judah will be saved, And Israel will dwell safely; Now this is His name by which He will be called: THE LORD OUR RIGHTEOUSNESS.
verses.textEnNlt: And this will be his name: ‘The Lord Is Our Righteousness.’ In that day Judah will be saved, and Israel will live in safety.
verses.textEnNasb: "In His days Judah will be saved, And Israel will live securely; And this is His name by which He will be called, ‘The Lord Our Righteousness.’
verses.textEn: In his days Judah will be saved and Israel will live in safety. This is the name by which he will be called: The Lord Our Righteous Savior.

verses.textZh: "因此，看哪！日子快到 ，人不再指着那领以色列人从埃及地上来的永活的耶和华起誓，
verses.textZhCnvs: "因此，看哪！日子快到 ，人不再指着那领以色列人从埃及地上来的永活的耶和华起誓，
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华说：「日子将到，人必不再指着那领以色列人从埃及地上来永生的耶和华起誓，
verses.textEnNiv: "So then, the days are coming," declares the Lord , "when people will no longer say, ‘As surely as the Lord lives, who brought the Israelites up out of Egypt,’
verses.textEnEsv: "Therefore, behold, the days are coming, declares the Lord , when they shall no longer say, ‘As the Lord lives who brought up the people of Israel out of the land of Egypt,’
verses.textEnNkjv: "Therefore, behold, the days are coming," says the Lord, "that they shall no longer say, ‘As the Lord lives who brought up the children of Israel from the land of Egypt,’
verses.textEnNlt: "In that day," says the Lord , "when people are taking an oath, they will no longer say, ‘As surely as the Lord lives, who rescued the people of Israel from the land of Egypt.’
verses.textEnNasb: "Therefore behold, the days are coming," declares the Lord, "when they will no longer say, ‘As the Lord lives, who brought the sons of Israel up from the land of Egypt,’
verses.textEn: "So then, the days are coming," declares the Lord , "when people will no longer say, ‘As surely as the Lord lives, who brought the Israelites up out of Egypt,’

verses.textZh: 却要指着那领以色列家的后裔从北方之地、从他 把他们赶逐到的各地上来的、永活的耶和华起誓。他们就必住在自己的地方。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 却要指着那领以色列家的后裔从北方之地、从他 把他们赶逐到的各地上来的、永活的耶和华起誓。他们就必住在自己的地方。"
verses.textZhCuv: 却要指着那领以色列家的后裔从北方和赶他们到的各国中上来、永生的耶和华起誓。他们必住在本地。」
verses.textEnNiv: but they will say, ‘As surely as the Lord lives, who brought the descendants of Israel up out of the land of the north and out of all the countries where he had banished them.’ Then they will live in their own land."
verses.textEnEsv: but ‘As the Lord lives who brought up and led the offspring of the house of Israel out of the north country and out of all the countries where he had driven them.’ Then they shall dwell in their own land."
verses.textEnNkjv: but, ‘As the Lord lives who brought up and led the descendants of the house of Israel from the north country and from all the countries where I had driven them.’ And they shall dwell in their own land."
verses.textEnNlt: Instead, they will say, ‘As surely as the Lord lives, who brought the people of Israel back to their own land from the land of the north and from all the countries to which he had exiled them.’ Then they will live in their own land."
verses.textEnNasb: but, ‘As the Lord lives, who brought up and led the descendants of the household of Israel back from the north land and from all the countries where I had driven them.’ Then they will live on their own soil."
verses.textEn: but they will say, ‘As surely as the Lord lives, who brought the descendants of Israel up out of the land of the north and out of all the countries where he had banished them.’ Then they will live in their own land."

verses.textZh: 论到那些先知， 我的心在我里面破碎， 我全身的骨头都发抖。 因为耶和华的缘故， 又因为他的圣言的缘故， 我就像一个醉酒的人， 像一个被酒灌醉的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 论到那些先知， 我的心在我里面破碎， 我全身的骨头都发抖。 因为耶和华的缘故， 又因为他的圣言的缘故， 我就像一个醉酒的人， 像一个被酒灌醉的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 论到那些先知， 我心在我里面忧伤， 我骨头都发颤； 因耶和华和他的圣言， 我像醉酒的人， 像被酒所胜的人。
verses.textEnNiv: Concerning the prophets: My heart is broken within me; all my bones tremble. I am like a drunken man, like a strong man overcome by wine, because of the Lord and his holy words.
verses.textEnEsv: Concerning the prophets: My heart is broken within me; all my bones shake; I am like a drunken man, like a man overcome by wine, because of the Lord and because of his holy words.
verses.textEnNkjv: My heart within me is broken Because of the prophets; All my bones shake. I am like a drunken man, And like a man whom wine has overcome, Because of the Lord, And because of His holy words.
verses.textEnNlt: My heart is broken because of the false prophets, and my bones tremble. I stagger like a drunkard, like someone overcome by wine, because of the holy words the Lord has spoken against them.
verses.textEnNasb: As for the prophets: My heart is broken within me, All my bones tremble; I have become like a drunken man, And like a man overcome by wine, Because of the Lord And because of His holy words.
verses.textEn: Concerning the prophets: My heart is broken within me; all my bones tremble. I am like a drunken man, like a strong man overcome by wine, because of the Lord and his holy words.

verses.textZh: 因为这地满了行淫的人； 因受咒诅，地就悲哀， 旷野的草场都枯干了； 他们走的路是邪恶的， 他们的权力误用了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为这地满了行淫的人； 因受咒诅，地就悲哀， 旷野的草场都枯干了； 他们走的路是邪恶的， 他们的权力误用了。
verses.textZhCuv: 地满了行淫的人！ 因妄自赌咒，地就悲哀； 旷野的草场都枯干了。 他们所行的道乃是恶的； 他们的勇力使得不正。
verses.textEnNiv: The land is full of adulterers; because of the curse the land lies parched and the pastures in the wilderness are withered. The prophets follow an evil course and use their power unjustly.
verses.textEnEsv: For the land is full of adulterers; because of the curse the land mourns, and the pastures of the wilderness are dried up. Their course is evil, and their might is not right.
verses.textEnNkjv: For the land is full of adulterers; For because of a curse the land mourns. The pleasant places of the wilderness are dried up. Their course of life is evil, And their might is not right.
verses.textEnNlt: For the land is full of adultery, and it lies under a curse. The land itself is in mourning— its wilderness pastures are dried up. For they all do evil and abuse what power they have.
verses.textEnNasb: For the land is full of adulterers; For the land mourns because of the curse. The pastures of the wilderness have dried up. Their course is evil And their might is not right.
verses.textEn: The land is full of adulterers; because of the curse the land lies parched and the pastures in the wilderness are withered. The prophets follow an evil course and use their power unjustly.

verses.textZh: "先知和祭司都不敬虔， 甚至在我殿里我也看见他们的邪恶。" 这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: "先知和祭司都不敬虔， 甚至在我殿里我也看见他们的邪恶。" 这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 连先知带祭司都是亵渎的， 就是在我殿中我也看见他们的恶。 这是耶和华说的。
verses.textEnNiv: "Both prophet and priest are godless; even in my temple I find their wickedness," declares the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: "Both prophet and priest are ungodly; even in my house I have found their evil, declares the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: "For both prophet and priest are profane; Yes, in My house I have found their wickedness," says the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: "Even the priests and prophets are ungodly, wicked men. I have seen their despicable acts right here in my own Temple," says the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: "For both prophet and priest are defiled; Even in My house I have found their wickedness," declares the Lord.
verses.textEn: "Both prophet and priest are godless; even in my temple I find their wickedness," declares the Lord .

verses.textZh: "因此，他们的路必像滑地； 他们必被赶逐到黑暗中， 必在那里仆倒。 因为到了惩罚他们的年日， 我必使灾祸临到他们。" 这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: "因此，他们的路必像滑地； 他们必被赶逐到黑暗中， 必在那里仆倒。 因为到了惩罚他们的年日， 我必使灾祸临到他们。" 这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 因此，他们的道路必像黑暗中的滑地， 他们必被追赶，在这路中仆倒； 因为当追讨之年， 我必使灾祸临到他们。 这是耶和华说的。
verses.textEnNiv: "Therefore their path will become slippery; they will be banished to darkness and there they will fall. I will bring disaster on them in the year they are punished," declares the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore their way shall be to them like slippery paths in the darkness, into which they shall be driven and fall, for I will bring disaster upon them in the year of their punishment, declares the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: "Therefore their way shall be to them Like slippery ways; In the darkness they shall be driven on And fall in them; For I will bring disaster on them, The year of their punishment," says the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: "Therefore, the paths they take will become slippery. They will be chased through the dark, and there they will fall. For I will bring disaster upon them at the time fixed for their punishment. I, the Lord , have spoken!
verses.textEnNasb: "Therefore their way will be like slippery paths to them, They will be driven away into the gloom and fall down in it; For I will bring disaster upon them, The year of their punishment," declares the Lord.
verses.textEn: "Therefore their path will become slippery; they will be banished to darkness and there they will fall. I will bring disaster on them in the year they are punished," declares the Lord .

verses.textZh: "在撒玛利亚的先知中， 我看见可厌的事： 他们竟奉巴力的名说预言， 使我的子民以色列走错了路。
verses.textZhCnvs: "在撒玛利亚的先知中， 我看见可厌的事： 他们竟奉巴力的名说预言， 使我的子民以色列走错了路。
verses.textZhCuv: 我在撒马利亚的先知中曾见愚妄； 他们藉巴力说预言， 使我的百姓以色列走错了路。
verses.textEnNiv: "Among the prophets of Samaria I saw this repulsive thing: They prophesied by Baal and led my people Israel astray.
verses.textEnEsv: In the prophets of Samaria I saw an unsavory thing: they prophesied by Baal and led my people Israel astray.
verses.textEnNkjv: "And I have seen folly in the prophets of Samaria: They prophesied by Baal And caused My people Israel to err.
verses.textEnNlt: "I saw that the prophets of Samaria were terribly evil, for they prophesied in the name of Baal and led my people of Israel into sin.
verses.textEnNasb: "Moreover, among the prophets of Samaria I saw an offensive thing: They prophesied by Baal and led My people Israel astray.
verses.textEn: "Among the prophets of Samaria I saw this repulsive thing: They prophesied by Baal and led my people Israel astray.

verses.textZh: 在耶路撒冷的先知中， 我看见可怕的事。 他们犯奸淫，行事虚假， 坚固恶人的手， 以致没有人离弃恶行； 在我看来，他们都像所多玛人， 耶路撒冷的居民也像蛾摩拉人一样。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 在耶路撒冷的先知中， 我看见可怕的事。 他们犯奸淫，行事虚假， 坚固恶人的手， 以致没有人离弃恶行； 在我看来，他们都像所多玛人， 耶路撒冷的居民也像蛾摩拉人一样。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我在耶路撒冷的先知中曾见可憎恶的事； 他们行奸淫，做事虚妄， 又坚固恶人的手， 甚至无人回头离开他的恶。 他们在我面前都像所多玛； 耶路撒冷的居民都像蛾摩拉。
verses.textEnNiv: And among the prophets of Jerusalem I have seen something horrible: They commit adultery and live a lie. They strengthen the hands of evildoers, so that not one of them turns from their wickedness. They are all like Sodom to me; the people of Jerusalem are like Gomorrah."
verses.textEnEsv: But in the prophets of Jerusalem I have seen a horrible thing: they commit adultery and walk in lies; they strengthen the hands of evildoers, so that no one turns from his evil; all of them have become like Sodom to me, and its inhabitants like Gomorrah."
verses.textEnNkjv: Also I have seen a horrible thing in the prophets of Jerusalem: They commit adultery and walk in lies; They also strengthen the hands of evildoers, So that no one turns back from his wickedness. All of them are like Sodom to Me, And her inhabitants like Gomorrah.
verses.textEnNlt: But now I see that the prophets of Jerusalem are even worse! They commit adultery and love dishonesty. They encourage those who are doing evil so that no one turns away from their sins. These prophets are as wicked as the people of Sodom and Gomorrah once were."
verses.textEnNasb: "Also among the prophets of Jerusalem I have seen a horrible thing: The committing of adultery and walking in deceit; And they strengthen the hands of evildoers, So that no one has turned back from his wickedness. All of them have become to Me like Sodom, And her inhabitants like Gomorrah.
verses.textEn: And among the prophets of Jerusalem I have seen something horrible: They commit adultery and live a lie. They strengthen the hands of evildoers, so that not one of them turns from their wickedness. They are all like Sodom to me; the people of Jerusalem are like Gomorrah."

verses.textZh: 因此，论到这些先知，万军之耶和华这样说： "看哪！我必使他们吃苦堇，喝毒水， 因为有不敬虔的风气， 从耶路撒冷的先知中散播出来，遍及全地。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，论到这些先知，万军之耶和华这样说： "看哪！我必使他们吃苦堇，喝毒水， 因为有不敬虔的风气， 从耶路撒冷的先知中散播出来，遍及全地。"
verses.textZhCuv: 所以万军之耶和华论到先知如此说： 我必将茵陈给他们吃， 又将苦胆水给他们喝； 因为亵渎的事出于耶路撒冷的先知，流行遍地。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore this is what the Lord Almighty says concerning the prophets: "I will make them eat bitter food and drink poisoned water, because from the prophets of Jerusalem ungodliness has spread throughout the land."
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore thus says the Lord of hosts concerning the prophets: "Behold, I will feed them with bitter food and give them poisoned water to drink, for from the prophets of Jerusalem ungodliness has gone out into all the land."
verses.textEnNkjv: "Therefore thus says the Lord of hosts concerning the prophets: ‘Behold, I will feed them with wormwood, And make them drink the water of gall; For from the prophets of Jerusalem Profaneness has gone out into all the land.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: Therefore, this is what the Lord of Heaven’s Armies says concerning the prophets: "I will feed them with bitterness and give them poison to drink. For it is because of Jerusalem’s prophets that wickedness has filled this land."
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore this is what the Lord of armies says concerning the prophets: ‘Behold, I am going to feed them wormwood And make them drink poisonous water, For from the prophets of Jerusalem Ungodliness has spread into all the land.’ "
verses.textEn: Therefore this is what the Lord Almighty says concerning the prophets: "I will make them eat bitter food and drink poisoned water, because from the prophets of Jerusalem ungodliness has spread throughout the land."

verses.textZh: 万军之耶和华这样说： "不要听从这些向你们说预言的先知所说的话， 他们使你们存有虚幻的希望； 他们所讲的异象是出于自己的心思， 不是出于耶和华的口。
verses.textZhCnvs: 万军之耶和华这样说： "不要听从这些向你们说预言的先知所说的话， 他们使你们存有虚幻的希望； 他们所讲的异象是出于自己的心思， 不是出于耶和华的口。
verses.textZhCuv: 万军之耶和华如此说：「这些先知向你们说预言，你们不要听他们的话。他们以虚空教训你们，所说的异象是出于自己的心，不是出于耶和华的口。
verses.textEnNiv: This is what the Lord Almighty says: "Do not listen to what the prophets are prophesying to you; they fill you with false hopes. They speak visions from their own minds, not from the mouth of the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: Thus says the Lord of hosts: "Do not listen to the words of the prophets who prophesy to you, filling you with vain hopes. They speak visions of their own minds, not from the mouth of the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus says the Lord of hosts: "Do not listen to the words of the prophets who prophesy to you. They make you worthless; They speak a vision of their own heart, Not from the mouth of the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: This is what the Lord of Heaven’s Armies says to his people: "Do not listen to these prophets when they prophesy to you, filling you with futile hopes. They are making up everything they say. They do not speak for the Lord !
verses.textEnNasb: This is what the Lord of armies says: "Do not listen to the words of the prophets who are prophesying to you. They are leading you into futility; They tell a vision of their own imagination, Not from the mouth of the Lord.
verses.textEn: This is what the Lord Almighty says: "Do not listen to what the prophets are prophesying to you; they fill you with false hopes. They speak visions from their own minds, not from the mouth of the Lord .

verses.textZh: 他们不断对那些藐视我的人说： ‘耶和华说：你们必平安无事！’ 又对所有随从自己顽梗的心行事的人说： ‘灾祸必不临到你们！’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们不断对那些藐视我的人说： ‘耶和华说：你们必平安无事！’ 又对所有随从自己顽梗的心行事的人说： ‘灾祸必不临到你们！’"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们常对藐视我的人说：『耶和华说：你们必享平安』；又对一切按自己顽梗之心而行的人说：『必没有灾祸临到你们。』」
verses.textEnNiv: They keep saying to those who despise me, ‘The Lord says: You will have peace.’ And to all who follow the stubbornness of their hearts they say, ‘No harm will come to you.’
verses.textEnEsv: They say continually to those who despise the word of the Lord , ‘It shall be well with you’; and to everyone who stubbornly follows his own heart, they say, ‘No disaster shall come upon you.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: They continually say to those who despise Me, ‘The Lord has said, "You shall have peace" ’; And to everyone who walks according to the dictates of his own heart, they say, ‘No evil shall come upon you.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: They keep saying to those who despise my word, ‘Don’t worry! The Lord says you will have peace!’ And to those who stubbornly follow their own desires, they say, ‘No harm will come your way!’
verses.textEnNasb: "They keep saying to those who despise Me, ‘The Lord has said, "You will have peace" ’; And as for everyone who walks in the stubbornness of his own heart, They say, ‘Disaster will not come on you.’
verses.textEn: They keep saying to those who despise me, ‘The Lord says: You will have peace.’ And to all who follow the stubbornness of their hearts they say, ‘No harm will come to you.’

verses.textZh: 可是他们中间有谁曾参与耶和华的议会， 看见或听见他的话呢？ 有谁曾留心听他的话而实在听见呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 可是他们中间有谁曾参与耶和华的议会， 看见或听见他的话呢？ 有谁曾留心听他的话而实在听见呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 有谁站在耶和华的会中 得以听见并会悟他的话呢？ 有谁留心听他的话呢？
verses.textEnNiv: But which of them has stood in the council of the Lord to see or to hear his word? Who has listened and heard his word?
verses.textEnEsv: For who among them has stood in the council of the Lord to see and to hear his word, or who has paid attention to his word and listened?
verses.textEnNkjv: For who has stood in the counsel of the Lord, And has perceived and heard His word? Who has marked His word and heard it?
verses.textEnNlt: "Have any of these prophets been in the Lord ’s presence to hear what he is really saying? Has even one of them cared enough to listen?
verses.textEnNasb: "But who has stood in the council of the Lord, That he should see and hear His word? Who has paid attention to His word and listened?
verses.textEn: But which of them has stood in the council of the Lord to see or to hear his word? Who has listened and heard his word?

verses.textZh: 看哪！耶和华的旋风， 在震怒中发出， 是旋转的狂风， 必卷到恶人的头上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 看哪！耶和华的旋风， 在震怒中发出， 是旋转的狂风， 必卷到恶人的头上。
verses.textZhCuv: 看哪！耶和华的忿怒 好像暴风，已经发出； 是暴烈的旋风， 必转到恶人的头上。
verses.textEnNiv: See, the storm of the Lord will burst out in wrath, a whirlwind swirling down on the heads of the wicked.
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, the storm of the Lord ! Wrath has gone forth, a whirling tempest; it will burst upon the head of the wicked.
verses.textEnNkjv: Behold, a whirlwind of the Lord has gone forth in fury— A violent whirlwind! It will fall violently on the head of the wicked.
verses.textEnNlt: Look! The Lord ’s anger bursts out like a storm, a whirlwind that swirls down on the heads of the wicked.
verses.textEnNasb: "Behold, the storm of the Lord has gone forth in wrath, Even a whirling tempest; It will swirl down on the head of the wicked.
verses.textEn: See, the storm of the Lord will burst out in wrath, a whirlwind swirling down on the heads of the wicked.

verses.textZh: 耶和华的怒气必不转消， 直到他作成和实现他心中的计划。 在末后的日子， 你们就会完全明白这事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的怒气必不转消， 直到他作成和实现他心中的计划。 在末后的日子， 你们就会完全明白这事。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的怒气必不转消， 直到他心中所拟定的成就了。 末后的日子你们要全然明白。
verses.textEnNiv: The anger of the Lord will not turn back until he fully accomplishes the purposes of his heart. In days to come you will understand it clearly.
verses.textEnEsv: The anger of the Lord will not turn back until he has executed and accomplished the intents of his heart. In the latter days you will understand it clearly.
verses.textEnNkjv: The anger of the Lord will not turn back Until He has executed and performed the thoughts of His heart. In the latter days you will understand it perfectly.
verses.textEnNlt: The anger of the Lord will not diminish until it has finished all he has planned. In the days to come you will understand all this very clearly.
verses.textEnNasb: "The anger of the Lord will not turn back Until He has performed and carried out the purposes of His heart; In the last days you will clearly understand it.
verses.textEn: The anger of the Lord will not turn back until he fully accomplishes the purposes of his heart. In days to come you will understand it clearly.

verses.textZh: "我没有差派这些先知， 但他们自己到处跑； 我没有对他们说话， 他们竟擅自说预言。
verses.textZhCnvs: "我没有差派这些先知， 但他们自己到处跑； 我没有对他们说话， 他们竟擅自说预言。
verses.textZhCuv: 我没有打发那些先知， 他们竟自奔跑； 我没有对他们说话， 他们竟自预言。
verses.textEnNiv: I did not send these prophets, yet they have run with their message; I did not speak to them, yet they have prophesied.
verses.textEnEsv: "I did not send the prophets, yet they ran; I did not speak to them, yet they prophesied.
verses.textEnNkjv: "I have not sent these prophets, yet they ran. I have not spoken to them, yet they prophesied.
verses.textEnNlt: "I have not sent these prophets, yet they run around claiming to speak for me. I have given them no message, yet they go on prophesying.
verses.textEnNasb: "I did not send these prophets, But they ran. I did not speak to them, But they prophesied.
verses.textEn: I did not send these prophets, yet they have run with their message; I did not speak to them, yet they have prophesied.

verses.textZh: 如果他们曾参与我的议会， 就必向我的子民宣告我的信息， 使他们转离他们的恶道， 离开他们的恶行。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果他们曾参与我的议会， 就必向我的子民宣告我的信息， 使他们转离他们的恶道， 离开他们的恶行。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们若是站在我的会中， 就必使我的百姓听我的话， 又使他们回头离开恶道和他们所行的恶。
verses.textEnNiv: But if they had stood in my council, they would have proclaimed my words to my people and would have turned them from their evil ways and from their evil deeds.
verses.textEnEsv: But if they had stood in my council, then they would have proclaimed my words to my people, and they would have turned them from their evil way, and from the evil of their deeds.
verses.textEnNkjv: But if they had stood in My counsel, And had caused My people to hear My words, Then they would have turned them from their evil way And from the evil of their doings.
verses.textEnNlt: If they had stood before me and listened to me, they would have spoken my words, and they would have turned my people from their evil ways and deeds.
verses.textEnNasb: "But if they had stood in My council, Then they would have announced My words to My people, And would have turned them back from their evil way And from the evil of their deeds.
verses.textEn: But if they had stood in my council, they would have proclaimed my words to my people and would have turned them from their evil ways and from their evil deeds.

verses.textZh: 难道我只是近处的神吗？ 不也是远处的神吗？" 这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 难道我只是近处的神吗？ 不也是远处的神吗？" 这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华说：「我岂为近处的神呢？不也为远处的神吗？」
verses.textEnNiv: "Am I only a God nearby," declares the Lord , "and not a God far away?
verses.textEnEsv: "Am I a God at hand, declares the Lord , and not a God far away?
verses.textEnNkjv: "Am I a God near at hand," says the Lord, "And not a God afar off?
verses.textEnNlt: Am I a God who is only close at hand?" says the Lord . "No, I am far away at the same time.
verses.textEnNasb: "Am I a God who is near," declares the Lord, "And not a God far off?
verses.textEn: "Am I only a God nearby," declares the Lord , "and not a God far away?

verses.textZh: "人怎能躲藏在隐密处， 以致我看不见他呢？ 。 我岂不是充满天地吗？" 这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: "人怎能躲藏在隐密处， 以致我看不见他呢？ 。 我岂不是充满天地吗？" 这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华说：「人岂能在隐密处藏身，使我看不见他呢？」耶和华说：「我岂不充满天地吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Who can hide in secret places so that I cannot see them?" declares the Lord . "Do not I fill heaven and earth?" declares the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: Can a man hide himself in secret places so that I cannot see him? declares the Lord . Do I not fill heaven and earth? declares the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: Can anyone hide himself in secret places, So I shall not see him?" says the Lord; "Do I not fill heaven and earth?" says the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: Can anyone hide from me in a secret place? Am I not everywhere in all the heavens and earth?" says the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: "Can a person hide himself in hiding places So that I do not see him?" declares the Lord. "Do I not fill the heavens and the earth?" declares the Lord.
verses.textEn: Who can hide in secret places so that I cannot see them?" declares the Lord . "Do not I fill heaven and earth?" declares the Lord .

verses.textZh: "那些先知所说的话我都听见了，他们冒我的名说虚假的预言：‘我作了梦！我作了梦！’
verses.textZhCnvs: "那些先知所说的话我都听见了，他们冒我的名说虚假的预言：‘我作了梦！我作了梦！’
verses.textZhCuv: 我已听见那些先知所说的，就是托我名说的假预言，他们说：『我做了梦！我做了梦！』
verses.textEnNiv: "I have heard what the prophets say who prophesy lies in my name. They say, ‘I had a dream! I had a dream!’
verses.textEnEsv: I have heard what the prophets have said who prophesy lies in my name, saying, ‘I have dreamed, I have dreamed!’
verses.textEnNkjv: "I have heard what the prophets have said who prophesy lies in My name, saying, ‘I have dreamed, I have dreamed!’
verses.textEnNlt: "I have heard these prophets say, ‘Listen to the dream I had from God last night.’ And then they proceed to tell lies in my name.
verses.textEnNasb: "I have heard what the prophets have said who prophesy falsely in My name, saying, ‘I had a dream, I had a dream!’
verses.textEn: "I have heard what the prophets say who prophesy lies in my name. They say, ‘I had a dream! I had a dream!’

verses.textZh: 那些先知心里存着这样的意念要到几时呢？他们说虚假的预言，说出自己心中的诡诈；
verses.textZhCnvs: 那些先知心里存着这样的意念要到几时呢？他们说虚假的预言，说出自己心中的诡诈；
verses.textZhCuv: 说假预言的先知，就是预言本心诡诈的先知，他们这样存心要到几时呢？
verses.textEnNiv: How long will this continue in the hearts of these lying prophets, who prophesy the delusions of their own minds?
verses.textEnEsv: How long shall there be lies in the heart of the prophets who prophesy lies, and who prophesy the deceit of their own heart,
verses.textEnNkjv: How long will this be in the heart of the prophets who prophesy lies? Indeed theyare prophets of the deceit of their own heart,
verses.textEnNlt: How long will this go on? If they are prophets, they are prophets of deceit, inventing everything they say.
verses.textEnNasb: How long? Is there anything in the hearts of the prophets who prophesy falsehood, these prophets of the deceitfulness of their own heart,
verses.textEn: How long will this continue in the hearts of these lying prophets, who prophesy the delusions of their own minds?

verses.textZh: 他们以为借着互相传述自己的梦，就可以使我的子民忘记我的名，好象他们的列祖因巴力忘记了我的名一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们以为借着互相传述自己的梦，就可以使我的子民忘记我的名，好象他们的列祖因巴力忘记了我的名一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们各人将所做的梦对邻舍述说，想要使我的百姓忘记我的名，正如他们列祖因巴力忘记我的名一样。
verses.textEnNiv: They think the dreams they tell one another will make my people forget my name, just as their ancestors forgot my name through Baal worship.
verses.textEnEsv: who think to make my people forget my name by their dreams that they tell one another, even as their fathers forgot my name for Baal?
verses.textEnNkjv: who try to make My people forget My name by their dreams which everyone tells his neighbor, as their fathers forgot My name for Baal.
verses.textEnNlt: By telling these false dreams, they are trying to get my people to forget me, just as their ancestors did by worshiping the idols of Baal.
verses.textEnNasb: who intend to make My people forget My name by their dreams which they report to one another, just as their fathers forgot My name because of Baal?
verses.textEn: They think the dreams they tell one another will make my people forget my name, just as their ancestors forgot my name through Baal worship.

verses.textZh: 作了梦的先知，让他把梦述说出来；但得了我话语的先知，该忠实地传讲我的话。禾秆怎能和麦子相比呢？"这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 作了梦的先知，让他把梦述说出来；但得了我话语的先知，该忠实地传讲我的话。禾秆怎能和麦子相比呢？"这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 得梦的先知可以述说那梦；得我话的人可以诚实讲说我的话。糠秕怎能与麦子比较呢？这是耶和华说的。」
verses.textEnNiv: Let the prophet who has a dream recount the dream, but let the one who has my word speak it faithfully. For what has straw to do with grain?" declares the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: Let the prophet who has a dream tell the dream, but let him who has my word speak my word faithfully. What has straw in common with wheat? declares the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: "The prophet who has a dream, let him tell a dream; And he who has My word, let him speak My word faithfully. What is the chaff to the wheat?" says the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: "Let these false prophets tell their dreams, but let my true messengers faithfully proclaim my every word. There is a difference between straw and grain!
verses.textEnNasb: The prophet who has a dream may report his dream, but let him who has My word speak My word truthfully. What does straw have in common with grain?" declares the Lord.
verses.textEn: Let the prophet who has a dream recount the dream, but let the one who has my word speak it faithfully. For what has straw to do with grain?" declares the Lord .

verses.textZh: "我的话不是像火，不是像能打碎岩石的大锤吗？"这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: "我的话不是像火，不是像能打碎岩石的大锤吗？"这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华说：「我的话岂不像火，又像能打碎磐石的大锤吗？」
verses.textEnNiv: "Is not my word like fire," declares the Lord , "and like a hammer that breaks a rock in pieces?
verses.textEnEsv: Is not my word like fire, declares the Lord , and like a hammer that breaks the rock in pieces?
verses.textEnNkjv: "Is not My word like a fire?" says the Lord, "And like a hammer that breaks the rock in pieces?
verses.textEnNlt: Does not my word burn like fire?" says the Lord . "Is it not like a mighty hammer that smashes a rock to pieces?
verses.textEnNasb: "Is My word not like fire?" declares the Lord, "and like a hammer which shatters a rock?
verses.textEn: "Is not my word like fire," declares the Lord , "and like a hammer that breaks a rock in pieces?

verses.textZh: "所以，看哪！那些先知互相偷取对方的话，当作我的话，我要对付他们。"这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: "所以，看哪！那些先知互相偷取对方的话，当作我的话，我要对付他们。"这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华说：「那些先知各从邻舍偷窃我的言语，因此我必与他们反对。」
verses.textEnNiv: "Therefore," declares the Lord , "I am against the prophets who steal from one another words supposedly from me.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore, behold, I am against the prophets, declares the Lord , who steal my words from one another.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Therefore behold, I am against the prophets," says the Lord, "who steal My words every one from his neighbor.
verses.textEnNlt: "Therefore," says the Lord , "I am against these prophets who steal messages from each other and claim they are from me.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore behold, I am against the prophets," declares the Lord, "who steal My words from each other.
verses.textEn: "Therefore," declares the Lord , "I am against the prophets who steal from one another words supposedly from me.

verses.textZh: "看哪！那些先知用自己的舌头说：‘这是耶和华的宣告’，我要对付他们。"这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: "看哪！那些先知用自己的舌头说：‘这是耶和华的宣告’，我要对付他们。"这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华说：「那些先知用舌头，说是耶和华说的；我必与他们反对。」
verses.textEnNiv: Yes," declares the Lord , "I am against the prophets who wag their own tongues and yet declare, ‘The Lord declares.’
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, I am against the prophets, declares the Lord , who use their tongues and declare, ‘declares the Lord .’
verses.textEnNkjv: Behold, I am against the prophets," says the Lord, "who use their tongues and say, ‘He says.’
verses.textEnNlt: I am against these smooth-tongued prophets who say, ‘This prophecy is from the Lord !’
verses.textEnNasb: Behold, I am against the prophets," declares the Lord, "who use their tongues and declare, ‘The Lord declares!’
verses.textEn: Yes," declares the Lord , "I am against the prophets who wag their own tongues and yet declare, ‘The Lord declares.’

verses.textZh: "看哪！那些藉虚假的梦说预言的，我要对付他们。"这是耶和华的宣告。"他们述说这些梦，以虚谎和夸张的话使我的子民走错了路。我没有差派他们，也没有吩咐他们；他们对这人民毫无益处。"这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: "看哪！那些藉虚假的梦说预言的，我要对付他们。"这是耶和华的宣告。"他们述说这些梦，以虚谎和夸张的话使我的子民走错了路。我没有差派他们，也没有吩咐他们；他们对这人民毫无益处。"这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华说：「那些以幻梦为预言，又述说这梦，以谎言和矜夸使我百姓走错了路的，我必与他们反对。我没有打发他们，也没有吩咐他们。他们与这百姓毫无益处。这是耶和华说的。」
verses.textEnNiv: Indeed, I am against those who prophesy false dreams," declares the Lord . "They tell them and lead my people astray with their reckless lies, yet I did not send or appoint them. They do not benefit these people in the least," declares the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, I am against those who prophesy lying dreams, declares the Lord , and who tell them and lead my people astray by their lies and their recklessness, when I did not send them or charge them. So they do not profit this people at all, declares the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: Behold, I am against those who prophesy false dreams," says the Lord, "and tell them, and cause My people to err by their lies and by their recklessness. Yet I did not send them or command them; therefore they shall not profit this people at all," says the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: I am against these false prophets. Their imaginary dreams are flagrant lies that lead my people into sin. I did not send or appoint them, and they have no message at all for my people. I, the Lord , have spoken!
verses.textEnNasb: Behold, I am against those who have prophesied false dreams," declares the Lord, "and reported them and led My people astray by their lies and reckless boasting; yet I did not send them nor command them, nor do they provide this people the slightest benefit," declares the Lord.
verses.textEn: Indeed, I am against those who prophesy false dreams," declares the Lord . "They tell them and lead my people astray with their reckless lies, yet I did not send or appoint them. They do not benefit these people in the least," declares the Lord .

verses.textZh: "如果这人民、或先知、或祭司问你说：‘耶和华有甚么默示呢？’你要回答他们：‘你们就是重担 ，我要丢弃你们。’"这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: "如果这人民、或先知、或祭司问你说：‘耶和华有甚么默示呢？’你要回答他们：‘你们就是重担 ，我要丢弃你们。’"这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 「无论是百姓，是先知，是祭司，问你说：『耶和华有什么默示呢？』你就对他们说：『什么默示啊？耶和华说：我要撇弃你们。』
verses.textEnNiv: "When these people, or a prophet or a priest, ask you, ‘What is the message from the Lord ?’ say to them, ‘What message? I will forsake you, declares the Lord .’
verses.textEnEsv: "When one of this people, or a prophet or a priest asks you, ‘What is the burden of the Lord ?’ you shall say to them, ‘You are the burden, and I will cast you off, declares the Lord .’
verses.textEnNkjv: "So when these people or the prophet or the priest ask you, saying, ‘What is the oracle of the Lord?’ you shall then say to them, ‘What oracle?’ I will even forsake you," says the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: "Suppose one of the people or one of the prophets or priests asks you, ‘What prophecy has the Lord burdened you with now?’ You must reply, ‘You are the burden! The Lord says he will abandon you!’
verses.textEnNasb: "Now when this people or the prophet or a priest asks you, saying, ‘What is the pronouncement of the Lord?’ then you shall say to them, ‘What pronouncement?’ The Lord declares, ‘I will abandon you.’
verses.textEn: "When these people, or a prophet or a priest, ask you, ‘What is the message from the Lord ?’ say to them, ‘What message? I will forsake you, declares the Lord .’

verses.textZh: "无论是先知、是祭司，或是人民，凡说‘这是耶和华的默示’的，我都要惩罚那人和他的家。"
verses.textZhCnvs: "无论是先知、是祭司，或是人民，凡说‘这是耶和华的默示’的，我都要惩罚那人和他的家。"
verses.textZhCuv: 无论是先知，是祭司，是百姓，说『耶和华的默示』，我必刑罚那人和他的家。
verses.textEnNiv: If a prophet or a priest or anyone else claims, ‘This is a message from the Lord ,’ I will punish them and their household.
verses.textEnEsv: And as for the prophet, priest, or one of the people who says, ‘The burden of the Lord ,’ I will punish that man and his household.
verses.textEnNkjv: "And asfor the prophet and the priest and the people who say, ‘The oracle of the Lord!’ I will even punish that man and his house.
verses.textEnNlt: "If any prophet, priest, or anyone else says, ‘I have a prophecy from the Lord ,’ I will punish that person along with his entire family.
verses.textEnNasb: Then as for the prophet or the priest or the people who say, ‘The pronouncement of the Lord,’ I will bring punishment upon that person and his household.
verses.textEn: If a prophet or a priest or anyone else claims, ‘This is a message from the Lord ,’ I will punish them and their household.

verses.textZh: 你们各人对自己的邻舍，对自己的兄弟要这样说："耶和华回答了甚么？耶和华说了甚么？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们各人对自己的邻舍，对自己的兄弟要这样说："耶和华回答了甚么？耶和华说了甚么？"
verses.textZhCuv: 你们各人要对邻舍，各人要对弟兄如此说：『耶和华回答什么？』『耶和华说了什么呢？』
verses.textEnNiv: This is what each of you keeps saying to your friends and other Israelites: ‘What is the Lord ’s answer?’ or ‘What has the Lord spoken?’
verses.textEnEsv: Thus shall you say, every one to his neighbor and every one to his brother, ‘What has the Lord answered?’ or ‘What has the Lord spoken?’
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus every one of you shall say to his neighbor, and every one to his brother, ‘What has the Lord answered?’ and, ‘What has the Lord spoken?’
verses.textEnNlt: You should keep asking each other, ‘What is the Lord ’s answer?’ or ‘What is the Lord saying?’
verses.textEnNasb: This is what each one of you will say to his neighbor and to his brother: ‘What has the Lord answered?’ or, ‘What has the Lord spoken?’
verses.textEn: This is what each of you keeps saying to your friends and other Israelites: ‘What is the Lord ’s answer?’ or ‘What has the Lord spoken?’

verses.textZh: 你们不可再提耶和华的默示，你们各人所说的话将成为自己的重担；因为你们曲解永活的神万军之耶和华我们神的话了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们不可再提耶和华的默示，你们各人所说的话将成为自己的重担；因为你们曲解永活的神万军之耶和华我们神的话了。
verses.textZhCuv: 『耶和华的默示』你们不可再提，各人所说的话必作自己的重担 ，因为你们谬用永生神、万军之耶和华－我们神的言语。
verses.textEnNiv: But you must not mention ‘a message from the Lord ’ again, because each one’s word becomes their own message. So you distort the words of the living God, the Lord Almighty, our God.
verses.textEnEsv: But ‘the burden of the Lord ’ you shall mention no more, for the burden is every man’s own word, and you pervert the words of the living God, the Lord of hosts, our God.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the oracle of the Lord you shall mention no more. For every man’s word will be his oracle, for you have perverted the words of the living God, the Lord of hosts, our God.
verses.textEnNlt: But stop using this phrase, ‘prophecy from the Lord .’ For people are using it to give authority to their own ideas, turning upside down the words of our God, the living God, the Lord of Heaven’s Armies.
verses.textEnNasb: For you will no longer remember the pronouncement of the Lord, because every person’s own word will become the pronouncement, and you have perverted the words of the living God, the Lord of armies, our God.
verses.textEn: But you must not mention ‘a message from the Lord ’ again, because each one’s word becomes their own message. So you distort the words of the living God, the Lord Almighty, our God.

verses.textZh: 你们要对神的先知 说："耶和华回答了你甚么？耶和华说了甚么呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要对神的先知 说："耶和华回答了你甚么？耶和华说了甚么呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要对先知如此说：『耶和华回答你什么？』『耶和华说了什么呢？』
verses.textEnNiv: This is what you keep saying to a prophet: ‘What is the Lord ’s answer to you?’ or ‘What has the Lord spoken?’
verses.textEnEsv: Thus you shall say to the prophet, ‘What has the Lord answered you?’ or ‘What has the Lord spoken?’
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus you shall say to the prophet, ‘What has the Lord answered you?’ and, ‘What has the Lord spoken?’
verses.textEnNlt: "This is what you should say to the prophets: ‘What is the Lord ’s answer?’ or ‘What is the Lord saying?’
verses.textEnNasb: This is what you will say to that prophet: ‘What has the Lord answered you?’ and, ‘What has the Lord spoken?’
verses.textEn: This is what you keep saying to a prophet: ‘What is the Lord ’s answer to you?’ or ‘What has the Lord spoken?’

verses.textZh: 如果你们仍说："这是耶和华的默示"，耶和华就必这样说："你们既然说‘这是耶和华的默示’这句话，而我又曾差派人去告诉你们不可再说‘这是耶和华的默示’；
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果你们仍说："这是耶和华的默示"，耶和华就必这样说："你们既然说‘这是耶和华的默示’这句话，而我又曾差派人去告诉你们不可再说‘这是耶和华的默示’；
verses.textZhCuv: 你们若说『耶和华的默示』，耶和华就如此说：『因你们说「耶和华的默示」这句话，我也打发人到你们那里去，告诉你们不可说「耶和华的默示」。』
verses.textEnNiv: Although you claim, ‘This is a message from the Lord ,’ this is what the Lord says: You used the words, ‘This is a message from the Lord ,’ even though I told you that you must not claim, ‘This is a message from the Lord .’
verses.textEnEsv: But if you say, ‘The burden of the Lord ,’ thus says the Lord , ‘Because you have said these words, "The burden of the Lord ," when I sent to you, saying, "You shall not say, ‘The burden of the Lord ,’"
verses.textEnNkjv: But since you say, ‘The oracle of the Lord!’ therefore thus says the Lord: ‘Because you say this word, "The oracle of the Lord!" and I have sent to you, saying, "Do not say, ‘The oracle of the Lord!’ "
verses.textEnNlt: But suppose they respond, ‘This is a prophecy from the Lord !’ Then you should say, ‘This is what the Lord says: Because you have used this phrase, "prophecy from the Lord ," even though I warned you not to use it,
verses.textEnNasb: And if you say, ‘The pronouncement of the Lord!’ for that reason the Lord says this: ‘Because you said this word, "The pronouncement of the Lord!" I have also sent word to you, saying, "You shall not say, ‘The pronouncement of the Lord!’ " ’
verses.textEn: Although you claim, ‘This is a message from the Lord ,’ this is what the Lord says: You used the words, ‘This is a message from the Lord ,’ even though I told you that you must not claim, ‘This is a message from the Lord .’

verses.textZh: 因此，看哪！我必把你们当作重担举起来 ，把你们连同我赐给你们和你们列祖的城都从我面前丢弃。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，看哪！我必把你们当作重担举起来 ，把你们连同我赐给你们和你们列祖的城都从我面前丢弃。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以我必全然忘记你们，将你们和我所赐给你们并你们列祖的城撇弃了；
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore, I will surely forget you and cast you out of my presence along with the city I gave to you and your ancestors.
verses.textEnEsv: therefore, behold, I will surely lift you up and cast you away from my presence, you and the city that I gave to you and your fathers.
verses.textEnNkjv: therefore behold, I, even I, will utterly forget you and forsake you, and the city that I gave you and your fathers, and willcastyou out of My presence.
verses.textEnNlt: I will forget you completely. I will expel you from my presence, along with this city that I gave to you and your ancestors.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore behold, I will certainly forget you and thrust you away from My presence, along with the city which I gave you and your fathers.
verses.textEn: Therefore, I will surely forget you and cast you out of my presence along with the city I gave to you and your ancestors.

verses.textZh: 我必使你们蒙受永远的凌辱、永远的羞耻，是不能忘记的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必使你们蒙受永远的凌辱、永远的羞耻，是不能忘记的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 又必使永远的凌辱和长久的羞耻临到你们，是不能忘记的。」
verses.textEnNiv: I will bring on you everlasting disgrace—everlasting shame that will not be forgotten."
verses.textEnEsv: And I will bring upon you everlasting reproach and perpetual shame, which shall not be forgotten.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: And I will bring an everlasting reproach upon you, and a perpetual shame, which shall not be forgotten.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: And I will make you an object of ridicule, and your name will be infamous throughout the ages.’"
verses.textEnNasb: I will put an everlasting disgrace on you and an everlasting humiliation which will not be forgotten."
verses.textEn: I will bring on you everlasting disgrace—everlasting shame that will not be forgotten."

verses.textZh: 巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒把犹大王约雅敬的儿子耶哥尼雅，和犹大的众领袖、工匠与铁匠从耶路撒冷掳到巴比伦去。这事以后，耶和华使我看见在耶和华的殿前面摆着两筐无花果。
verses.textZhCnvs: 巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒把犹大王约雅敬的儿子耶哥尼雅，和犹大的众领袖、工匠与铁匠从耶路撒冷掳到巴比伦去。这事以后，耶和华使我看见在耶和华的殿前面摆着两筐无花果。
verses.textZhCuv: 巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒将犹大王约雅敬的儿子耶哥尼雅和犹大的首领，并工匠、铁匠从耶路撒冷掳去，带到巴比伦。这事以后，耶和华指给我看，有两筐无花果放在耶和华的殿前。
verses.textEnNiv: After Jehoiachin son of Jehoiakim king of Judah and the officials, the skilled workers and the artisans of Judah were carried into exile from Jerusalem to Babylon by Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, the Lord showed me two baskets of figs placed in front of the temple of the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: After Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon had taken into exile from Jerusalem Jeconiah the son of Jehoiakim, king of Judah, together with the officials of Judah, the craftsmen, and the metal workers, and had brought them to Babylon, the Lord showed me this vision: behold, two baskets of figs placed before the temple of the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord showed me, and there were two baskets of figs set before the temple of the Lord, after Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon had carried away captive Jeconiah the son of Jehoiakim, king of Judah, and the princes of Judah with the craftsmen and smiths, from Jerusalem, and had brought them to Babylon.
verses.textEnNlt: After King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylon exiled Jehoiachin son of Jehoiakim, king of Judah, to Babylon along with the officials of Judah and all the craftsmen and artisans, the Lord gave me this vision. I saw two baskets of figs placed in front of the Lord ’s Temple in Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNasb: After Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon had taken into exile Jeconiah the son of Jehoiakim, king of Judah, and the officials of Judah with the craftsmen and metalworkers from Jerusalem and had brought them to Babylon, the Lord showed me: behold, two baskets of figs placed before the temple of the Lord.
verses.textEn: After Jehoiachin son of Jehoiakim king of Judah and the officials, the skilled workers and the artisans of Judah were carried into exile from Jerusalem to Babylon by Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, the Lord showed me two baskets of figs placed in front of the temple of the Lord .

verses.textZh: 一筐是极好的无花果，像初熟的无花果；另一筐是极坏的无花果，坏到不能吃。
verses.textZhCnvs: 一筐是极好的无花果，像初熟的无花果；另一筐是极坏的无花果，坏到不能吃。
verses.textZhCuv: 一筐是极好的无花果，好像是初熟的；一筐是极坏的无花果，坏得不可吃。
verses.textEnNiv: One basket had very good figs, like those that ripen early; the other basket had very bad figs, so bad they could not be eaten.
verses.textEnEsv: One basket had very good figs, like first-ripe figs, but the other basket had very bad figs, so bad that they could not be eaten.
verses.textEnNkjv: One basket had very good figs, like the figs thatare first ripe; and the other basket had very bad figs which could not be eaten, they were so bad.
verses.textEnNlt: One basket was filled with fresh, ripe figs, while the other was filled with bad figs that were too rotten to eat.
verses.textEnNasb: One basket had very good figs, like first-ripe figs, and the other basket had very bad figs which could not be eaten due to rottenness.
verses.textEn: One basket had very good figs, like those that ripen early; the other basket had very bad figs, so bad they could not be eaten.

verses.textZh: 于是耶和华问我："耶利米啊，你看见甚么？"我回答："我看见无花果。那些好的无花果极好，坏的却极坏，坏到不能吃。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是耶和华问我："耶利米啊，你看见甚么？"我回答："我看见无花果。那些好的无花果极好，坏的却极坏，坏到不能吃。"
verses.textZhCuv: 于是耶和华问我说：「耶利米你看见什么？」我说：「我看见无花果，好的极好，坏的极坏，坏得不可吃。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then the Lord asked me, "What do you see, Jeremiah?" "Figs," I answered. "The good ones are very good, but the bad ones are so bad they cannot be eaten."
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord said to me, "What do you see, Jeremiah?" I said, "Figs, the good figs very good, and the bad figs very bad, so bad that they cannot be eaten."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Lord said to me, "What do you see, Jeremiah?" And I said, "Figs, the good figs, very good; and the bad, very bad, which cannot be eaten, they are so bad."
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord said to me, "What do you see, Jeremiah?" I replied, "Figs, some very good and some very bad, too rotten to eat."
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord said to me, "What do you see, Jeremiah?" And I said, "Figs: the good figs are very good, and the bad ones, very bad, which cannot be eaten due to rottenness."
verses.textEn: Then the Lord asked me, "What do you see, Jeremiah?" "Figs," I answered. "The good ones are very good, but the bad ones are so bad they cannot be eaten."

verses.textZh: 耶和华的话临到我，说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的话临到我，说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的话临到我说：
verses.textEnNiv: Then the word of the Lord came to me:
verses.textEnEsv: Then the word of the Lord came to me:
verses.textEnNkjv: Again the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord gave me this message:
verses.textEnNasb: Then the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.textEn: Then the word of the Lord came to me:

verses.textZh: "耶和华以色列的神这样说：‘被掳去的犹大人，就是我打发离开这地方到迦勒底人之地去的，我必看他们如同这些好的无花果一样，眷顾他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: "耶和华以色列的神这样说：‘被掳去的犹大人，就是我打发离开这地方到迦勒底人之地去的，我必看他们如同这些好的无花果一样，眷顾他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 「耶和华－以色列的神如此说：被掳去的犹大人，就是我打发离开这地到迦勒底人之地去的，我必看顾他们如这好无花果，使他们得好处。
verses.textEnNiv: "This is what the Lord , the God of Israel, says: ‘Like these good figs, I regard as good the exiles from Judah, whom I sent away from this place to the land of the Babylonians.
verses.textEnEsv: "Thus says the Lord , the God of Israel: Like these good figs, so I will regard as good the exiles from Judah, whom I have sent away from this place to the land of the Chaldeans.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Thus says the Lord, the God of Israel: ‘Like these good figs, so will I acknowledge those who are carried away captive from Judah, whom I have sent out of this place for theirown good, into the land of the Chaldeans.
verses.textEnNlt: "This is what the Lord , the God of Israel, says: The good figs represent the exiles I sent from Judah to the land of the Babylonians.
verses.textEnNasb: "This is what the Lord, the God of Israel says: ‘Like these good figs, so I will regard as good the captives of Judah, whom I have sent out of this place into the land of the Chaldeans.
verses.textEn: "This is what the Lord , the God of Israel, says: ‘Like these good figs, I regard as good the exiles from Judah, whom I sent away from this place to the land of the Babylonians.

verses.textZh: 我必关注他们，眷顾他们，领他们归回这地。我必建立他们，必不拆毁；我必栽植他们，必不拔除。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必关注他们，眷顾他们，领他们归回这地。我必建立他们，必不拆毁；我必栽植他们，必不拔除。
verses.textZhCuv: 我要眷顾他们，使他们得好处，领他们归回这地。我也要建立他们，必不拆毁；栽植他们，并不拔出。
verses.textEnNiv: My eyes will watch over them for their good, and I will bring them back to this land. I will build them up and not tear them down; I will plant them and not uproot them.
verses.textEnEsv: I will set my eyes on them for good, and I will bring them back to this land. I will build them up, and not tear them down; I will plant them, and not pluck them up.
verses.textEnNkjv: For I will set My eyes on them for good, and I will bring them back to this land; I will build them and not pull them down, and I will plant them and not pluck them up.
verses.textEnNlt: I will watch over and care for them, and I will bring them back here again. I will build them up and not tear them down. I will plant them and not uproot them.
verses.textEnNasb: For I will set My eyes on them for good, and I will bring them back to this land; and I will build them up and not overthrow them, and I will plant them and not uproot them.
verses.textEn: My eyes will watch over them for their good, and I will bring them back to this land. I will build them up and not tear them down; I will plant them and not uproot them.

verses.textZh: 我必赐给他们一颗认识我的心，知道我就是耶和华；他们要作我的子民，我要亲自作他们的神，因为他们必一心归向我。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必赐给他们一颗认识我的心，知道我就是耶和华；他们要作我的子民，我要亲自作他们的神，因为他们必一心归向我。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 我要赐他们认识我的心，知道我是耶和华。他们要作我的子民，我要作他们的神，因为他们要一心归向我。」
verses.textEnNiv: I will give them a heart to know me, that I am the Lord . They will be my people, and I will be their God, for they will return to me with all their heart.
verses.textEnEsv: I will give them a heart to know me, that I am the Lord , and they shall be my people and I will be their God, for they shall return to me with their whole heart.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then I will give them a heart to know Me, that I am the Lord; and they shall be My people, and I will be their God, for they shall return to Me with their whole heart.
verses.textEnNlt: I will give them hearts that recognize me as the Lord . They will be my people, and I will be their God, for they will return to me wholeheartedly.
verses.textEnNasb: I will also give them a heart to know Me, for I am the Lord; and they will be My people, and I will be their God, for they will return to Me wholeheartedly.
verses.textEn: I will give them a heart to know me, that I am the Lord . They will be my people, and I will be their God, for they will return to me with all their heart.

verses.textZh: "但耶和华这样说：‘我怎样处置那些坏到不能吃的坏无花果，我也必照样对待犹大王西底家、他的众领袖和耶路撒冷的余民，不论是余剩在这地的，或是住在埃及地的。
verses.textZhCnvs: "但耶和华这样说：‘我怎样处置那些坏到不能吃的坏无花果，我也必照样对待犹大王西底家、他的众领袖和耶路撒冷的余民，不论是余剩在这地的，或是住在埃及地的。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华如此说：「我必将犹大王西底家和他的首领，以及剩在这地耶路撒冷的余民，并住在埃及地的犹大人都交出来，好像那极坏、坏得不可吃的无花果。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘But like the bad figs, which are so bad they cannot be eaten,’ says the Lord , ‘so will I deal with Zedekiah king of Judah, his officials and the survivors from Jerusalem, whether they remain in this land or live in Egypt.
verses.textEnEsv: "But thus says the Lord : Like the bad figs that are so bad they cannot be eaten, so will I treat Zedekiah the king of Judah, his officials, the remnant of Jerusalem who remain in this land, and those who dwell in the land of Egypt.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘And as the bad figs which cannot be eaten, they are so bad’—surely thus says the Lord—‘so will I give up Zedekiah the king of Judah, his princes, the residue of Jerusalem who remain in this land, and those who dwell in the land of Egypt.
verses.textEnNlt: "But the bad figs," the Lord said, "represent King Zedekiah of Judah, his officials, all the people left in Jerusalem, and those who live in Egypt. I will treat them like bad figs, too rotten to eat.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘But like the bad figs which cannot be eaten due to rottenness,’ indeed, this is what the Lord says, ‘so will I give up Zedekiah king of Judah and his officials, and the remnant of Jerusalem who remain in this land, and the ones who live in the land of Egypt.
verses.textEn: " ‘But like the bad figs, which are so bad they cannot be eaten,’ says the Lord , ‘so will I deal with Zedekiah king of Judah, his officials and the survivors from Jerusalem, whether they remain in this land or live in Egypt.

verses.textZh: 我必使他们成为地上万国所惊恐、所讨厌的；在我赶逐他们到的各地方，成为被人羞辱、讥笑、嘲弄、咒诅的对象。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必使他们成为地上万国所惊恐、所讨厌的；在我赶逐他们到的各地方，成为被人羞辱、讥笑、嘲弄、咒诅的对象。
verses.textZhCuv: 我必使他们交出来，在天下万国中抛来抛去，遭遇灾祸；在我赶逐他们到的各处成为凌辱、笑谈、讥刺、咒诅。
verses.textEnNiv: I will make them abhorrent and an offense to all the kingdoms of the earth, a reproach and a byword, a curse and an object of ridicule, wherever I banish them.
verses.textEnEsv: I will make them a horror to all the kingdoms of the earth, to be a reproach, a byword, a taunt, and a curse in all the places where I shall drive them.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will deliver them to trouble into all the kingdoms of the earth, for their harm, tobe a reproach and a byword, a taunt and a curse, in all places where I shall drive them.
verses.textEnNlt: I will make them an object of horror and a symbol of evil to every nation on earth. They will be disgraced and mocked, taunted and cursed, wherever I scatter them.
verses.textEnNasb: I will make them an object of terror and an evil for all the kingdoms of the earth, as a disgrace and a proverb, a taunt and a curse in all the places where I will scatter them.
verses.textEn: I will make them abhorrent and an offense to all the kingdoms of the earth, a reproach and a byword, a curse and an object of ridicule, wherever I banish them.

verses.textZh: 我必打发刀剑、饥荒、瘟疫去攻击他们，直到他们从我赐给他们和他们列祖的土地上都消灭了。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必打发刀剑、饥荒、瘟疫去攻击他们，直到他们从我赐给他们和他们列祖的土地上都消灭了。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 我必使刀剑、饥荒、瘟疫临到他们，直到他们从我所赐给他们和他们列祖之地灭绝。」
verses.textEnNiv: I will send the sword, famine and plague against them until they are destroyed from the land I gave to them and their ancestors.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: And I will send sword, famine, and pestilence upon them, until they shall be utterly destroyed from the land that I gave to them and their fathers."
verses.textEnNkjv: And I will send the sword, the famine, and the pestilence among them, till they are consumed from the land that I gave to them and their fathers.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: And I will send war, famine, and disease until they have vanished from the land of Israel, which I gave to them and their ancestors."
verses.textEnNasb: And I will send the sword, the famine, and the plague upon them until they are eliminated from the land which I gave to them and their forefathers.’ "
verses.textEn: I will send the sword, famine and plague against them until they are destroyed from the land I gave to them and their ancestors.’ "

verses.textZh: 犹大王约西亚的儿子约雅敬第四年，就是巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒第一年，有话临到耶利米，是关于犹大众民的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 犹大王约西亚的儿子约雅敬第四年，就是巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒第一年，有话临到耶利米，是关于犹大众民的。
verses.textZhCuv: 犹大王约西亚的儿子约雅敬第四年，就是巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒的元年，耶和华论犹大众民的话临到耶利米。
verses.textEnNiv: The word came to Jeremiah concerning all the people of Judah in the fourth year of Jehoiakim son of Josiah king of Judah, which was the first year of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon.
verses.textEnEsv: The word that came to Jeremiah concerning all the people of Judah, in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah (that was the first year of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon),
verses.textEnNkjv: The word that came to Jeremiah concerning all the people of Judah, in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah (which was the first year of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon),
verses.textEnNlt: This message for all the people of Judah came to Jeremiah from the Lord during the fourth year of Jehoiakim’s reign over Judah. This was the year when King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylon began his reign.
verses.textEnNasb: The word that came to Jeremiah concerning all the people of Judah, in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah (that was the first year of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon),
verses.textEn: The word came to Jeremiah concerning all the people of Judah in the fourth year of Jehoiakim son of Josiah king of Judah, which was the first year of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon.

verses.textZh: 耶利米先知就把这话告诉犹大众民和耶路撒冷所有的居民，说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶利米先知就把这话告诉犹大众民和耶路撒冷所有的居民，说：
verses.textZhCuv: 先知耶利米就将这话对犹大众人和耶路撒冷的一切居民说：
verses.textEnNiv: So Jeremiah the prophet said to all the people of Judah and to all those living in Jerusalem:
verses.textEnEsv: which Jeremiah the prophet spoke to all the people of Judah and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem:
verses.textEnNkjv: which Jeremiah the prophet spoke to all the people of Judah and to all the inhabitants of Jerusalem, saying:
verses.textEnNlt: Jeremiah the prophet said to all the people in Judah and Jerusalem,
verses.textEnNasb: the word which Jeremiah the prophet spoke to all the people of Judah and to all the inhabitants of Jerusalem, saying,
verses.textEn: So Jeremiah the prophet said to all the people of Judah and to all those living in Jerusalem:

verses.textZh: "从犹大王亚们的儿子约西亚第十三年直到今日，这二十三年来，常有耶和华的话临到我，我也不断对你们传讲，你们却不听从。
verses.textZhCnvs: "从犹大王亚们的儿子约西亚第十三年直到今日，这二十三年来，常有耶和华的话临到我，我也不断对你们传讲，你们却不听从。
verses.textZhCuv: 「从犹大王亚们的儿子约西亚十三年直到今日，这二十三年之内，常有耶和华的话临到我；我也对你们传说，就是从早起来传说，只是你们没有听从。
verses.textEnNiv: For twenty-three years—from the thirteenth year of Josiah son of Amon king of Judah until this very day—the word of the Lord has come to me and I have spoken to you again and again, but you have not listened.
verses.textEnEsv: "For twenty-three years, from the thirteenth year of Josiah the son of Amon, king of Judah, to this day, the word of the Lord has come to me, and I have spoken persistently to you, but you have not listened.
verses.textEnNkjv: "From the thirteenth year of Josiah the son of Amon, king of Judah, even to this day, this is the twenty-third year in which the word of the Lord has come to me; and I have spoken to you, rising early and speaking, but you have not listened.
verses.textEnNlt: "For the past twenty-three years—from the thirteenth year of the reign of Josiah son of Amon, king of Judah, until now—the Lord has been giving me his messages. I have faithfully passed them on to you, but you have not listened.
verses.textEnNasb: "From the thirteenth year of Josiah the son of Amon, king of Judah, even to this day, these twenty-three years the word of the Lord has come to me, and I have spoken to you again and again, but you have not listened.
verses.textEn: For twenty-three years—from the thirteenth year of Josiah son of Amon king of Judah until this very day—the word of the Lord has come to me and I have spoken to you again and again, but you have not listened.

verses.textZh: 耶和华虽然不断差遣他的仆人众先知到你们那里去；但你们却没有听从，毫不留心。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华虽然不断差遣他的仆人众先知到你们那里去；但你们却没有听从，毫不留心。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华也从早起来，差遣他的仆人众先知到你们这里来（只是你们没有听从，也没有侧耳而听），
verses.textEnNiv: And though the Lord has sent all his servants the prophets to you again and again, you have not listened or paid any attention.
verses.textEnEsv: You have neither listened nor inclined your ears to hear, although the Lord persistently sent to you all his servants the prophets,
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Lord has sent to you all His servants the prophets, rising early and sending them, but you have not listened nor inclined your ear to hear.
verses.textEnNlt: "Again and again the Lord has sent you his servants, the prophets, but you have not listened or even paid attention.
verses.textEnNasb: And the Lord has sent to you all His servants the prophets again and again, but you have not listened nor inclined your ear to hear,
verses.textEn: And though the Lord has sent all his servants the prophets to you again and again, you have not listened or paid any attention.

verses.textZh: 他们对你们说：‘你们各人要悔改，离开自己的恶道和邪恶的行为，就可以住在耶和华赐给你们和你们列祖的土地上，直到永永远远。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们对你们说：‘你们各人要悔改，离开自己的恶道和邪恶的行为，就可以住在耶和华赐给你们和你们列祖的土地上，直到永永远远。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 说：『你们各人当回头，离开恶道和所作的恶，便可居住耶和华古时所赐给你们和你们列祖之地，直到永远。
verses.textEnNiv: They said, "Turn now, each of you, from your evil ways and your evil practices, and you can stay in the land the Lord gave to you and your ancestors for ever and ever.
verses.textEnEsv: saying, ‘Turn now, every one of you, from his evil way and evil deeds, and dwell upon the land that the Lord has given to you and your fathers from of old and forever.
verses.textEnNkjv: They said, ‘Repent now everyone of his evil way and his evil doings, and dwell in the land that the Lord has given to you and your fathers forever and ever.
verses.textEnNlt: Each time the message was this: ‘Turn from the evil road you are traveling and from the evil things you are doing. Only then will I let you live in this land that the Lord gave to you and your ancestors forever.
verses.textEnNasb: saying, ‘Turn now, everyone from his evil way and from the evil of your deeds, and live on the land which the Lord has given to you and your forefathers forever and ever;
verses.textEn: They said, "Turn now, each of you, from your evil ways and your evil practices, and you can stay in the land the Lord gave to you and your ancestors for ever and ever.

verses.textZh: "你们不要随从别的神，不要事奉敬拜他们，也不可容你们手所作的惹我发怒；这样，我就不会使祸患临到你们。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你们不要随从别的神，不要事奉敬拜他们，也不可容你们手所作的惹我发怒；这样，我就不会使祸患临到你们。
verses.textZhCuv: 不可随从别神事奉敬拜，以你们手所做的惹我发怒；这样，我就不加害与你们。
verses.textEnNiv: Do not follow other gods to serve and worship them; do not arouse my anger with what your hands have made. Then I will not harm you."
verses.textEnEsv: Do not go after other gods to serve and worship them, or provoke me to anger with the work of your hands. Then I will do you no harm.’
verses.textEnNkjv: Do not go after other gods to serve them and worship them, and do not provoke Me to anger with the works of your hands; and I will not harm you.’
verses.textEnNlt: Do not provoke my anger by worshiping idols you made with your own hands. Then I will not harm you.’
verses.textEnNasb: and do not follow other gods to serve them and to worship them, and do not provoke Me to anger with the work of your hands, then I will do you no harm.’
verses.textEn: Do not follow other gods to serve and worship them; do not arouse my anger with what your hands have made. Then I will not harm you."

verses.textZh: 但你们没有听从我，竟容你们手所作的惹我发怒，自招祸害。"这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但你们没有听从我，竟容你们手所作的惹我发怒，自招祸害。"这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 然而你们没有听从我，竟以手所做的惹我发怒，陷害自己。这是耶和华说的。』」
verses.textEnNiv: "But you did not listen to me," declares the Lord , "and you have aroused my anger with what your hands have made, and you have brought harm to yourselves."
verses.textEnEsv: Yet you have not listened to me, declares the Lord , that you might provoke me to anger with the work of your hands to your own harm.
verses.textEnNkjv: Yet you have not listened to Me," says the Lord, "that you might provoke Me to anger with the works of your hands to your own hurt.
verses.textEnNlt: "But you would not listen to me," says the Lord . "You made me furious by worshiping idols you made with your own hands, bringing on yourselves all the disasters you now suffer.
verses.textEnNasb: Yet you have not listened to Me," declares the Lord, "in order to provoke Me to anger with the work of your hands to your own harm.
verses.textEn: "But you did not listen to me," declares the Lord , "and you have aroused my anger with what your hands have made, and you have brought harm to yourselves."

verses.textZh: 因此，万军之耶和华这样说："因为你们没有听从我的话，
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，万军之耶和华这样说："因为你们没有听从我的话，
verses.textZhCuv: 所以万军之耶和华如此说：「因为你们没有听从我的话，
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore the Lord Almighty says this: "Because you have not listened to my words,
verses.textEnEsv: "Therefore thus says the Lord of hosts: Because you have not obeyed my words,
verses.textEnNkjv: "Therefore thus says the Lord of hosts: ‘Because you have not heard My words,
verses.textEnNlt: And now the Lord of Heaven’s Armies says: Because you have not listened to me,
verses.textEnNasb: "Therefore this is what the Lord of armies says: ‘Because you have not obeyed My words,
verses.textEn: Therefore the Lord Almighty says this: "Because you have not listened to my words,

verses.textZh: 看哪！我要打发人去征召北方的众族，和我的仆人巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒，领他们来攻击这地和这地的居民，以及周围的列国；我要把他们彻底消灭，使他们成为令人惊骇，受人嗤笑的对象，和永远荒废的地方。"这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 看哪！我要打发人去征召北方的众族，和我的仆人巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒，领他们来攻击这地和这地的居民，以及周围的列国；我要把他们彻底消灭，使他们成为令人惊骇，受人嗤笑的对象，和永远荒废的地方。"这是耶和华的宣告。
