verses.textZhCuv: 我必召北方的众族和我仆人巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒来攻击这地和这地的居民，并四围一切的国民。我要将他们尽行灭绝，以致他们令人惊骇、嗤笑，并且永久荒凉。这是耶和华说的。
verses.textEnNiv: I will summon all the peoples of the north and my servant Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon," declares the Lord , "and I will bring them against this land and its inhabitants and against all the surrounding nations. I will completely destroy them and make them an object of horror and scorn, and an everlasting ruin.
verses.textEnEsv: behold, I will send for all the tribes of the north, declares the Lord , and for Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon, my servant, and I will bring them against this land and its inhabitants, and against all these surrounding nations. I will devote them to destruction, and make them a horror, a hissing, and an everlasting desolation.
verses.textEnNkjv: behold, I will send and take all the families of the north,’ says the Lord, ‘and Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon, My servant, and will bring them against this land, against its inhabitants, and against these nations all around, and will utterly destroy them, and make them an astonishment, a hissing, and perpetual desolations.
verses.textEnNlt: I will gather together all the armies of the north under King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylon, whom I have appointed as my deputy. I will bring them all against this land and its people and against the surrounding nations. I will completely destroy you and make you an object of horror and contempt and a ruin forever.
verses.textEnNasb: behold, I will send and take all the families of the north,’ declares the Lord, ‘and I will send to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, My servant, and will bring them against this land and against its inhabitants and against all these surrounding nations; and I will completely destroy them and make them an object of horror and hissing, and an everlasting place of ruins.
verses.textEn: I will summon all the peoples of the north and my servant Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon," declares the Lord , "and I will bring them against this land and its inhabitants and against all the surrounding nations. I will completely destroy them and make them an object of horror and scorn, and an everlasting ruin.

verses.textZh: "我要从他们中间除掉欢喜和快乐的声音，新郎和新妇的声音，推磨的声音和灯的亮光。
verses.textZhCnvs: "我要从他们中间除掉欢喜和快乐的声音，新郎和新妇的声音，推磨的声音和灯的亮光。
verses.textZhCuv: 我又要使欢喜和快乐的声音，新郎和新妇的声音，推磨的声音和灯的亮光，从他们中间止息。
verses.textEnNiv: I will banish from them the sounds of joy and gladness, the voices of bride and bridegroom, the sound of millstones and the light of the lamp.
verses.textEnEsv: Moreover, I will banish from them the voice of mirth and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom and the voice of the bride, the grinding of the millstones and the light of the lamp.
verses.textEnNkjv: Moreover I will take from them the voice of mirth and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom and the voice of the bride, the sound of the millstones and the light of the lamp.
verses.textEnNlt: I will take away your happy singing and laughter. The joyful voices of bridegrooms and brides will no longer be heard. Your millstones will fall silent, and the lights in your homes will go out.
verses.textEnNasb: Moreover, I will eliminate from them the voice of jubilation and the voice of joy, the voice of the groom and the voice of the bride, the sound of the millstones and the light of the lamp.
verses.textEn: I will banish from them the sounds of joy and gladness, the voices of bride and bridegroom, the sound of millstones and the light of the lamp.

verses.textZh: 这地要全变为荒废，令人惊骇；这些国家要服事巴比伦王七十年。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这地要全变为荒废，令人惊骇；这些国家要服事巴比伦王七十年。
verses.textZhCuv: 这全地必然荒凉，令人惊骇。这些国民要服事巴比伦王七十年。
verses.textEnNiv: This whole country will become a desolate wasteland, and these nations will serve the king of Babylon seventy years.
verses.textEnEsv: This whole land shall become a ruin and a waste, and these nations shall serve the king of Babylon seventy years.
verses.textEnNkjv: And this whole land shall be a desolation and an astonishment, and these nations shall serve the king of Babylon seventy years.
verses.textEnNlt: This entire land will become a desolate wasteland. Israel and her neighboring lands will serve the king of Babylon for seventy years.
verses.textEnNasb: This entire land will be a place of ruins and an object of horror, and these nations will serve the king of Babylon for seventy years.
verses.textEn: This whole country will become a desolate wasteland, and these nations will serve the king of Babylon seventy years.

verses.textZh: "七十年满了以后，我要按着他们的罪孽惩罚巴比伦王和那国，就是迦勒底人之地，使它永远荒凉。"这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: "七十年满了以后，我要按着他们的罪孽惩罚巴比伦王和那国，就是迦勒底人之地，使它永远荒凉。"这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 七十年满了以后，我必刑罚巴比伦王和那国民，并迦勒底人之地，因他们的罪孽使那地永远荒凉。这是耶和华说的。
verses.textEnNiv: "But when the seventy years are fulfilled, I will punish the king of Babylon and his nation, the land of the Babylonians, for their guilt," declares the Lord , "and will make it desolate forever.
verses.textEnEsv: Then after seventy years are completed, I will punish the king of Babylon and that nation, the land of the Chaldeans, for their iniquity, declares the Lord , making the land an everlasting waste.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘Then it will come to pass, when seventy years are completed, that I will punish the king of Babylon and that nation, the land of the Chaldeans, for their iniquity,’ says the Lord; ‘and I will make it a perpetual desolation.
verses.textEnNlt: "Then, after the seventy years of captivity are over, I will punish the king of Babylon and his people for their sins," says the Lord . "I will make the country of the Babylonians a wasteland forever.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Then it will be when seventy years are completed I will punish the king of Babylon and that nation,’ declares the Lord, ‘for their wrongdoing, and the land of the Chaldeans; and I will make it an everlasting desolation.
verses.textEn: "But when the seventy years are fulfilled, I will punish the king of Babylon and his nation, the land of the Babylonians, for their guilt," declares the Lord , "and will make it desolate forever.

verses.textZh: "我必使我所说攻击那地的一切话应验在那地；我所说的，就是一切记录在这书上的，是耶利米攻击列国所说的预言。
verses.textZhCnvs: "我必使我所说攻击那地的一切话应验在那地；我所说的，就是一切记录在这书上的，是耶利米攻击列国所说的预言。
verses.textZhCuv: 我也必使我向那地所说的话，就是记在这书上的话，是耶利米向这些国民说的预言，都临到那地。
verses.textEnNiv: I will bring on that land all the things I have spoken against it, all that are written in this book and prophesied by Jeremiah against all the nations.
verses.textEnEsv: I will bring upon that land all the words that I have uttered against it, everything written in this book, which Jeremiah prophesied against all the nations.
verses.textEnNkjv: So I will bring on that land all My words which I have pronounced against it, all that is written in this book, which Jeremiah has prophesied concerning all the nations.
verses.textEnNlt: I will bring upon them all the terrors I have promised in this book—all the penalties announced by Jeremiah against the nations.
verses.textEnNasb: I will bring upon that land all My words which I have pronounced against it, all that is written in this book which Jeremiah has prophesied against all the nations.
verses.textEn: I will bring on that land all the things I have spoken against it, all that are written in this book and prophesied by Jeremiah against all the nations.

verses.textZh: 因为许多国家和大君王将要奴役迦勒底人，我必按着他们的作为和他们手所作的报应他们。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为许多国家和大君王将要奴役迦勒底人，我必按着他们的作为和他们手所作的报应他们。"
verses.textZhCuv: 因为有多国和大君王必使迦勒底人作奴仆；我也必照他们的行为，按他们手所做的报应他们。」
verses.textEnNiv: They themselves will be enslaved by many nations and great kings; I will repay them according to their deeds and the work of their hands."
verses.textEnEsv: For many nations and great kings shall make slaves even of them, and I will recompense them according to their deeds and the work of their hands."
verses.textEnNkjv: (For many nations and great kings shall be served by them also; and I will repay them according to their deeds and according to the works of their own hands.)’ "
verses.textEnNlt: Many nations and great kings will enslave the Babylonians, just as they enslaved my people. I will punish them in proportion to the suffering they cause my people."
verses.textEnNasb: ( For many nations and great kings will make slaves of them, even them; and I will repay them according to their deeds and according to the work of their hands.)’ "
verses.textEn: They themselves will be enslaved by many nations and great kings; I will repay them according to their deeds and the work of their hands."

verses.textZh: 耶和华以色列的神对我这样说："你从我的手中拿这杯烈怒的酒，给列国喝，就是我差遣你去的列国。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华以色列的神对我这样说："你从我的手中拿这杯烈怒的酒，给列国喝，就是我差遣你去的列国。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华－以色列的神对我如此说：「你从我手中接这杯忿怒的酒，使我所差遣你去的各国的民喝。
verses.textEnNiv: This is what the Lord , the God of Israel, said to me: "Take from my hand this cup filled with the wine of my wrath and make all the nations to whom I send you drink it.
verses.textEnEsv: Thus the Lord , the God of Israel, said to me: "Take from my hand this cup of the wine of wrath, and make all the nations to whom I send you drink it.
verses.textEnNkjv: For thus says the Lord God of Israel to me: "Take this wine cup of fury from My hand, and cause all the nations, to whom I send you, to drink it.
verses.textEnNlt: This is what the Lord , the God of Israel, said to me: "Take from my hand this cup filled to the brim with my anger, and make all the nations to whom I send you drink from it.
verses.textEnNasb: For this is what the Lord, the God of Israel, says to me: "Take this cup of the wine of wrath from My hand and give it to all the nations to whom I send you, to drink from it.
verses.textEn: This is what the Lord , the God of Israel, said to me: "Take from my hand this cup filled with the wine of my wrath and make all the nations to whom I send you drink it.

verses.textZh: 他们喝了，就会东倒西歪，疯狂乱性，因为我打发刀剑到他们中间去。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们喝了，就会东倒西歪，疯狂乱性，因为我打发刀剑到他们中间去。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们喝了就要东倒西歪，并要发狂，因我使刀剑临到他们中间。」
verses.textEnNiv: When they drink it, they will stagger and go mad because of the sword I will send among them."
verses.textEnEsv: They shall drink and stagger and be crazed because of the sword that I am sending among them."
verses.textEnNkjv: And they will drink and stagger and go mad because of the sword that I will send among them."
verses.textEnNlt: When they drink from it, they will stagger, crazed by the warfare I will send against them."
verses.textEnNasb: Then they will drink and loudly vomit and act insanely because of the sword that I am going to send among them."
verses.textEn: When they drink it, they will stagger and go mad because of the sword I will send among them."

verses.textZh: 于是我从耶和华的手中接过这杯，给列国喝，就是耶和华差遣我去的列国，
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是我从耶和华的手中接过这杯，给列国喝，就是耶和华差遣我去的列国，
verses.textZhCuv: 我就从耶和华的手中接了这杯，给耶和华所差遣我去的各国的民喝，
verses.textEnNiv: So I took the cup from the Lord ’s hand and made all the nations to whom he sent me drink it:
verses.textEnEsv: So I took the cup from the Lord ’s hand, and made all the nations to whom the Lord sent me drink it:
verses.textEnNkjv: Then I took the cup from the Lord’s hand, and made all the nations drink, to whom the Lord had sent me:
verses.textEnNlt: So I took the cup of anger from the Lord and made all the nations drink from it—every nation to which the Lord sent me.
verses.textEnNasb: So I took the cup from the Lord’s hand and gave it to all the nations to whom the Lord sent me, to drink from it:
verses.textEn: So I took the cup from the Lord ’s hand and made all the nations to whom he sent me drink it:

verses.textZh: 包括耶路撒冷、犹大的城镇，和她的君王、领袖，使这些城镇荒废，成为令人惊骇、被人嗤笑、咒骂的对象，好象今天一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 包括耶路撒冷、犹大的城镇，和她的君王、领袖，使这些城镇荒废，成为令人惊骇、被人嗤笑、咒骂的对象，好象今天一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 就是耶路撒冷和犹大的城邑，并耶路撒冷的君王与首领，使这城邑荒凉，令人惊骇、嗤笑、咒诅，正如今日一样。
verses.textEnNiv: Jerusalem and the towns of Judah, its kings and officials, to make them a ruin and an object of horror and scorn, a curse —as they are today;
verses.textEnEsv: Jerusalem and the cities of Judah, its kings and officials, to make them a desolation and a waste, a hissing and a curse, as at this day;
verses.textEnNkjv: Jerusalem and the cities of Judah, its kings and its princes, to make them a desolation, an astonishment, a hissing, and a curse, as itis this day;
verses.textEnNlt: I went to Jerusalem and the other towns of Judah, and their kings and officials drank from the cup. From that day until this, they have been a desolate ruin, an object of horror, contempt, and cursing.
verses.textEnNasb: to Jerusalem and the cities of Judah, and its kings and its officials, to make them places of ruins, objects of horror, hissing, and a curse, as it is this day;
verses.textEn: Jerusalem and the towns of Judah, its kings and officials, to make them a ruin and an object of horror and scorn, a curse —as they are today;

verses.textZh: 又包括法老，就是埃及王，和他的臣仆、王侯，以及全体人民，
verses.textZhCnvs: 又包括法老，就是埃及王，和他的臣仆、王侯，以及全体人民，
verses.textZhCuv: 又有埃及王法老和他的臣仆、首领，以及他的众民，
verses.textEnNiv: Pharaoh king of Egypt, his attendants, his officials and all his people,
verses.textEnEsv: Pharaoh king of Egypt, his servants, his officials, all his people,
verses.textEnNkjv: Pharaoh king of Egypt, his servants, his princes, and all his people;
verses.textEnNlt: I gave the cup to Pharaoh, king of Egypt, his attendants, his officials, and all his people,
verses.textEnNasb: to Pharaoh king of Egypt, his servants, his officials, and all his people;
verses.textEn: Pharaoh king of Egypt, his attendants, his officials and all his people,

verses.textZh: 并所有外族的人；还有乌斯地的众王、非利士人之地的众王，就是亚实基伦、迦萨，以革伦和亚实突余剩的人的王；
verses.textZhCnvs: 并所有外族的人；还有乌斯地的众王、非利士人之地的众王，就是亚实基伦、迦萨，以革伦和亚实突余剩的人的王；
verses.textZhCuv: 并杂族的人民和乌斯地的诸王，与非利士地的诸王（亚实基伦、迦萨、以革伦，以及亚实突剩下的人）；
verses.textEnNiv: and all the foreign people there; all the kings of Uz; all the kings of the Philistines (those of Ashkelon, Gaza, Ekron, and the people left at Ashdod);
verses.textEnEsv: and all the mixed tribes among them; all the kings of the land of Uz and all the kings of the land of the Philistines ( Ashkelon, Gaza, Ekron, and the remnant of Ashdod);
verses.textEnNkjv: all the mixed multitude, all the kings of the land of Uz, all the kings of the land of the Philistines (namely, Ashkelon, Gaza, Ekron, and the remnant of Ashdod);
verses.textEnNlt: along with all the foreigners living in that land. I also gave it to all the kings of the land of Uz and the kings of the Philistine cities of Ashkelon, Gaza, Ekron, and what remains of Ashdod.
verses.textEnNasb: and to all the foreign people, all the kings of the land of Uz, all the kings of the land of the Philistines (that is, Ashkelon, Gaza, Ekron, and the remnant of Ashdod);
verses.textEn: and all the foreign people there; all the kings of Uz; all the kings of the Philistines (those of Ashkelon, Gaza, Ekron, and the people left at Ashdod);

verses.textZh: 并有以东、摩押、亚扪、
verses.textZhCnvs: 并有以东、摩押、亚扪、
verses.textZhCuv: 以东、摩押、亚扪人、
verses.textEnNiv: Edom, Moab and Ammon;
verses.textEnEsv: Edom, Moab, and the sons of Ammon;
verses.textEnNkjv: Edom, Moab, and the people of Ammon;
verses.textEnNlt: Then I gave the cup to the nations of Edom, Moab, and Ammon,
verses.textEnNasb: to Edom, Moab, and the sons of Ammon;
verses.textEn: Edom, Moab and Ammon;

verses.textZh: 推罗的列王、西顿的列王、海外岛屿的列王、
verses.textZhCnvs: 推罗的列王、西顿的列王、海外岛屿的列王、
verses.textZhCuv: 泰尔的诸王、西顿的诸王、海岛的诸王、
verses.textEnNiv: all the kings of Tyre and Sidon; the kings of the coastlands across the sea;
verses.textEnEsv: all the kings of Tyre, all the kings of Sidon, and the kings of the coastland across the sea;
verses.textEnNkjv: all the kings of Tyre, all the kings of Sidon, and the kings of the coastlands which are across the sea;
verses.textEnNlt: and the kings of Tyre and Sidon, and the kings of the regions across the sea.
verses.textEnNasb: and to all the kings of Tyre, all the kings of Sidon, and the kings of the coastlands which are beyond the sea;
verses.textEn: all the kings of Tyre and Sidon; the kings of the coastlands across the sea;

verses.textZh: 底但、提玛、布斯，所有剃除鬓发的部落、
verses.textZhCnvs: 底但、提玛、布斯，所有剃除鬓发的部落、
verses.textZhCuv: 底但、提玛、布斯，和一切剃周围头发的；
verses.textEnNiv: Dedan, Tema, Buz and all who are in distant places ;
verses.textEnEsv: Dedan, Tema, Buz, and all who cut the corners of their hair;
verses.textEnNkjv: Dedan, Tema, Buz, and all whoare in the farthest corners;
verses.textEnNlt: I gave it to Dedan, Tema, and Buz, and to the people who live in distant places.
verses.textEnNasb: and to Dedan, Tema, Buz, and all who trim the corners of their hair;
verses.textEn: Dedan, Tema, Buz and all who are in distant places ;

verses.textZh: 阿拉伯的列王、住在沙漠的外族人的列王、
verses.textZhCnvs: 阿拉伯的列王、住在沙漠的外族人的列王、
verses.textZhCuv: 阿拉伯的诸王、住旷野杂族人民的诸王、
verses.textEnNiv: all the kings of Arabia and all the kings of the foreign people who live in the wilderness;
verses.textEnEsv: all the kings of Arabia and all the kings of the mixed tribes who dwell in the desert;
verses.textEnNkjv: all the kings of Arabia and all the kings of the mixed multitude who dwell in the desert;
verses.textEnNlt: I gave it to the kings of Arabia, the kings of the nomadic tribes of the desert,
verses.textEnNasb: and to all the kings of Arabia and all the kings of the foreign people who live in the desert;
verses.textEn: all the kings of Arabia and all the kings of the foreign people who live in the wilderness;

verses.textZh: 心利的列王、以拦的列王、玛代的列王、
verses.textZhCnvs: 心利的列王、以拦的列王、玛代的列王、
verses.textZhCuv: 心利的诸王、以拦的诸王、米底亚的诸王、
verses.textEnNiv: all the kings of Zimri, Elam and Media;
verses.textEnEsv: all the kings of Zimri, all the kings of Elam, and all the kings of Media;
verses.textEnNkjv: all the kings of Zimri, all the kings of Elam, and all the kings of the Medes;
verses.textEnNlt: and to the kings of Zimri, Elam, and Media.
verses.textEnNasb: and to all the kings of Zimri, all the kings of Elam, and all the kings of Media;
verses.textEn: all the kings of Zimri, Elam and Media;

verses.textZh: 北方远近的列王，一个一个，以及地上的万国，就是在这地面上的列国，都喝了；他们喝了以后，示沙克王也要喝。
verses.textZhCnvs: 北方远近的列王，一个一个，以及地上的万国，就是在这地面上的列国，都喝了；他们喝了以后，示沙克王也要喝。
verses.textZhCuv: 北方远近的诸王，以及天下地上的万国喝了，以后示沙克 王也要喝。
verses.textEnNiv: and all the kings of the north, near and far, one after the other—all the kingdoms on the face of the earth. And after all of them, the king of Sheshak will drink it too.
verses.textEnEsv: all the kings of the north, far and near, one after another, and all the kingdoms of the world that are on the face of the earth. And after them the king of Babylon shall drink.
verses.textEnNkjv: all the kings of the north, far and near, one with another; and all the kingdoms of the world which are on the face of the earth. Also the king of Sheshach shall drink after them.
verses.textEnNlt: And I gave it to the kings of the northern countries, far and near, one after the other—all the kingdoms of the world. And finally, the king of Babylon himself drank from the cup of the Lord ’s anger.
verses.textEnNasb: and to all the kings of the north, near and far, one with another; and all the kingdoms of the earth which are on the face of the ground; and the king of Sheshach shall drink it after them.
verses.textEn: and all the kings of the north, near and far, one after the other—all the kingdoms on the face of the earth. And after all of them, the king of Sheshak will drink it too.

verses.textZh: "你要对他们说：‘万军之耶和华以色列的神这样说：你们要喝，并要喝醉，呕吐，以致跌倒，不能再起来，因为我打发刀剑到你们中间去。’
verses.textZhCnvs: "你要对他们说：‘万军之耶和华以色列的神这样说：你们要喝，并要喝醉，呕吐，以致跌倒，不能再起来，因为我打发刀剑到你们中间去。’
verses.textZhCuv: 「你要对他们说：『万军之耶和华－以色列的神如此说：你们要喝，且要喝醉，要呕吐，且要跌倒，不得再起来，都因我使刀剑临到你们中间。』
verses.textEnNiv: "Then tell them, ‘This is what the Lord Almighty, the God of Israel, says: Drink, get drunk and vomit, and fall to rise no more because of the sword I will send among you.’
verses.textEnEsv: "Then you shall say to them, ‘Thus says the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel: Drink, be drunk and vomit, fall and rise no more, because of the sword that I am sending among you.’
verses.textEnNkjv: "Therefore you shall say to them, ‘Thus says the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel: "Drink, be drunk, and vomit! Fall and rise no more, because of the sword which I will send among you." ’
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord said to me, "Now tell them, ‘This is what the Lord of Heaven’s Armies, the God of Israel, says: Drink from this cup of my anger. Get drunk and vomit; fall to rise no more, for I am sending terrible wars against you.’
verses.textEnNasb: "And you shall say to them, ‘This is what the Lord of armies, the God of Israel says: "Drink, be drunk, vomit, fall down, and do not get up, because of the sword which I am sending among you." ’
verses.textEn: "Then tell them, ‘This is what the Lord Almighty, the God of Israel, says: Drink, get drunk and vomit, and fall to rise no more because of the sword I will send among you.’

verses.textZh: 如果他们不肯从你的手中接过这杯来喝，你就要对他们说：‘万军之耶和华这样说：你们一定要喝。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果他们不肯从你的手中接过这杯来喝，你就要对他们说：‘万军之耶和华这样说：你们一定要喝。
verses.textZhCuv: 「他们若不肯从你手接这杯喝，你就要对他们说：『万军之耶和华如此说：你们一定要喝！
verses.textEnNiv: But if they refuse to take the cup from your hand and drink, tell them, ‘This is what the Lord Almighty says: You must drink it!
verses.textEnEsv: "And if they refuse to accept the cup from your hand to drink, then you shall say to them, ‘Thus says the Lord of hosts: You must drink!
verses.textEnNkjv: And it shall be, if they refuse to take the cup from your hand to drink, then you shall say to them, ‘Thus says the Lord of hosts: "You shall certainly drink!
verses.textEnNlt: And if they refuse to accept the cup, tell them, ‘The Lord of Heaven’s Armies says: You have no choice but to drink from it.
verses.textEnNasb: And if they refuse to take the cup from your hand to drink, then you shall say to them, ‘This is what the Lord of armies says: "You shall certainly drink!
verses.textEn: But if they refuse to take the cup from your hand and drink, tell them, ‘This is what the Lord Almighty says: You must drink it!

verses.textZh: 因为，看哪！我既然在那称为我名下的城中先降灾祸，你们真可免受惩罚吗？你们必不能免受惩罚，因为我要呼唤刀剑来攻击这地所有的居民。’"这是万军之耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为，看哪！我既然在那称为我名下的城中先降灾祸，你们真可免受惩罚吗？你们必不能免受惩罚，因为我要呼唤刀剑来攻击这地所有的居民。’"这是万军之耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 我既从称为我名下的城起首施行灾祸，你们能尽免刑罚吗？你们必不能免，因为我要命刀剑临到地上一切的居民。这是万军之耶和华说的。』
verses.textEnNiv: See, I am beginning to bring disaster on the city that bears my Name, and will you indeed go unpunished? You will not go unpunished, for I am calling down a sword on all who live on the earth, declares the Lord Almighty.’
verses.textEnEsv: For behold, I begin to work disaster at the city that is called by my name, and shall you go unpunished? You shall not go unpunished, for I am summoning a sword against all the inhabitants of the earth, declares the Lord of hosts.’
verses.textEnNkjv: For behold, I begin to bring calamity on the city which is called by My name, and should you be utterly unpunished? You shall not be unpunished, for I will call for a sword on all the inhabitants of the earth," says the Lord of hosts.’
verses.textEnNlt: I have begun to punish Jerusalem, the city that bears my name. Now should I let you go unpunished? No, you will not escape disaster. I will call for war against all the nations of the earth. I, the Lord of Heaven’s Armies, have spoken!’
verses.textEnNasb: For behold, I am beginning to inflict disaster on this city which is called by My name, so should you be completely free from punishment? You will not be free from punishment, for I am summoning a sword against all the inhabitants of the earth," declares the Lord of armies.’
verses.textEn: See, I am beginning to bring disaster on the city that bears my Name, and will you indeed go unpunished? You will not go unpunished, for I am calling down a sword on all who live on the earth, declares the Lord Almighty.’

verses.textZh: "因此你要对他们宣讲这一切话，对他们说： ‘耶和华必从高天吼叫， 从他的圣所发声； 他必大声吼叫攻击自己的羊圈； 他要对地上所有的居民呼喊， 像那些踹葡萄的人呼喊一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: "因此你要对他们宣讲这一切话，对他们说： ‘耶和华必从高天吼叫， 从他的圣所发声； 他必大声吼叫攻击自己的羊圈； 他要对地上所有的居民呼喊， 像那些踹葡萄的人呼喊一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 「所以你要向他们预言这一切的话，攻击他们，说： 耶和华必从高天吼叫， 从圣所发声， 向自己的羊群大声吼叫； 他要向地上一切的居民呐喊， 像踹葡萄的一样。
verses.textEnNiv: "Now prophesy all these words against them and say to them: " ‘The Lord will roar from on high; he will thunder from his holy dwelling and roar mightily against his land. He will shout like those who tread the grapes, shout against all who live on the earth.
verses.textEnEsv: "You, therefore, shall prophesy against them all these words, and say to them: "‘The Lord will roar from on high, and from his holy habitation utter his voice; he will roar mightily against his fold, and shout, like those who tread grapes, against all the inhabitants of the earth.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Therefore prophesy against them all these words, and say to them: ‘The Lord will roar from on high, And utter His voice from His holy habitation; He will roar mightily against His fold. He will give a shout, as those who tread thegrapes, Against all the inhabitants of the earth.
verses.textEnNlt: "Now prophesy all these things, and say to them, "‘The Lord will roar against his own land from his holy dwelling in heaven. He will shout like those who tread grapes; he will shout against everyone on earth.
verses.textEnNasb: "Therefore you shall prophesy against them all these words, and you shall say to them, ‘The Lord will roar from on high And raise His voice from His holy dwelling; He will roar forcefully against His fold. He will shout like those who tread the grapes, Against all the inhabitants of the earth.
verses.textEn: "Now prophesy all these words against them and say to them: " ‘The Lord will roar from on high; he will thunder from his holy dwelling and roar mightily against his land. He will shout like those who tread the grapes, shout against all who live on the earth.

verses.textZh: 吶喊的声音要传到地极， 因为耶和华要控告列国， 也要审判万人； 至于恶人，他必把他们交给刀剑。’" 这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 吶喊的声音要传到地极， 因为耶和华要控告列国， 也要审判万人； 至于恶人，他必把他们交给刀剑。’" 这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 必有响声达到地极， 因为耶和华与列国相争； 凡有血气的，他必审问； 至于恶人，他必交给刀剑。 这是耶和华说的。
verses.textEnNiv: The tumult will resound to the ends of the earth, for the Lord will bring charges against the nations; he will bring judgment on all mankind and put the wicked to the sword,’ " declares the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: The clamor will resound to the ends of the earth, for the Lord has an indictment against the nations; he is entering into judgment with all flesh, and the wicked he will put to the sword, declares the Lord .’
verses.textEnNkjv: A noise will come to the ends of the earth— For the Lord has a controversy with the nations; He will plead His case with all flesh. He will give those whoare wicked to the sword,’ says the Lord."
verses.textEnNlt: His cry of judgment will reach the ends of the earth, for the Lord will bring his case against all the nations. He will judge all the people of the earth, slaughtering the wicked with the sword. I, the Lord , have spoken!’"
verses.textEnNasb: ‘A clamor has come to the end of the earth, Because the Lord has a controversy with the nations. He is entering into judgment with humanity; As for the wicked, He has turned them over to the sword,’ declares the Lord."
verses.textEn: The tumult will resound to the ends of the earth, for the Lord will bring charges against the nations; he will bring judgment on all mankind and put the wicked to the sword,’ " declares the Lord .

verses.textZh: 万军之耶和华这样说： "看哪！必有灾祸发出， 从这国直到那国； 必有大风暴从地极刮起。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 万军之耶和华这样说： "看哪！必有灾祸发出， 从这国直到那国； 必有大风暴从地极刮起。"
verses.textZhCuv: 万军之耶和华如此说： 看哪，必有灾祸从这国发到那国， 并有大暴风从地极刮起。
verses.textEnNiv: This is what the Lord Almighty says: "Look! Disaster is spreading from nation to nation; a mighty storm is rising from the ends of the earth."
verses.textEnEsv: "Thus says the Lord of hosts: Behold, disaster is going forth from nation to nation, and a great tempest is stirring from the farthest parts of the earth!
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus says the Lord of hosts: "Behold, disaster shall go forth From nation to nation, And a great whirlwind shall be raised up From the farthest parts of the earth.
verses.textEnNlt: This is what the Lord of Heaven’s Armies says: "Look! Disaster will fall upon nation after nation! A great whirlwind of fury is rising from the most distant corners of the earth!"
verses.textEnNasb: This is what the Lord of armies says: "Behold, evil is going out From nation to nation, And a great storm is being stirred up From the remotest parts of the earth.
verses.textEn: This is what the Lord Almighty says: "Look! Disaster is spreading from nation to nation; a mighty storm is rising from the ends of the earth."

verses.textZh: 到那日，从地的这边到地的那边，都必有被耶和华刺死的人；必没有人为他们悲哀，没有人收殓他们、埋葬他们；他们都必在地面上成为粪肥。
verses.textZhCnvs: 到那日，从地的这边到地的那边，都必有被耶和华刺死的人；必没有人为他们悲哀，没有人收殓他们、埋葬他们；他们都必在地面上成为粪肥。
verses.textZhCuv: 「到那日，从地这边直到地那边都有耶和华所杀戮的。必无人哀哭，不得收殓，不得葬埋，必在地上成为粪土。
verses.textEnNiv: At that time those slain by the Lord will be everywhere—from one end of the earth to the other. They will not be mourned or gathered up or buried, but will be like dung lying on the ground.
verses.textEnEsv: "And those pierced by the Lord on that day shall extend from one end of the earth to the other. They shall not be lamented, or gathered, or buried; they shall be dung on the surface of the ground.
verses.textEnNkjv: And at that day the slain of the Lord shall be from one end of the earth even to the other end of the earth. They shall not be lamented, or gathered, or buried; they shall become refuse on the ground.
verses.textEnNlt: In that day those the Lord has slaughtered will fill the earth from one end to the other. No one will mourn for them or gather up their bodies to bury them. They will be scattered on the ground like manure.
verses.textEnNasb: "Those put to death by the Lord on that day will be from one end of the earth to the other. They will not be mourned, gathered, or buried; they will be like dung on the face of the ground.
verses.textEn: At that time those slain by the Lord will be everywhere—from one end of the earth to the other. They will not be mourned or gathered up or buried, but will be like dung lying on the ground.

verses.textZh: 牧人啊，你们要哀号，呼叫！ 羊群的领袖啊，你们要在灰尘中打滚！ 因为你们被宰杀的日子已经到了； 我要粉碎你们， 你们要跌倒，像珍贵的器皿跌碎一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 牧人啊，你们要哀号，呼叫！ 羊群的领袖啊，你们要在灰尘中打滚！ 因为你们被宰杀的日子已经到了； 我要粉碎你们， 你们要跌倒，像珍贵的器皿跌碎一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 牧人哪，你们当哀号，呼喊； 群众的头目啊，你们要滚在灰中； 因为你们被杀戮分散的日子足足来到。 你们要跌碎，好像美器打碎一样。
verses.textEnNiv: Weep and wail, you shepherds; roll in the dust, you leaders of the flock. For your time to be slaughtered has come; you will fall like the best of the rams.
verses.textEnEsv: "Wail, you shepherds, and cry out, and roll in ashes, you lords of the flock, for the days of your slaughter and dispersion have come, and you shall fall like a choice vessel.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Wail, shepherds, and cry! Roll about intheashes, You leaders of the flock! For the days of your slaughter and your dispersions are fulfilled; You shall fall like a precious vessel.
verses.textEnNlt: Weep and moan, you evil shepherds! Roll in the dust, you leaders of the flock! The time of your slaughter has arrived; you will fall and shatter like a fragile vase.
verses.textEnNasb: "Wail, you shepherds, and cry out; Wallow in the dust, you masters of the flock; For the days of your slaughter and your dispersions have come, And you will fall like a precious vessel.
verses.textEn: Weep and wail, you shepherds; roll in the dust, you leaders of the flock. For your time to be slaughtered has come; you will fall like the best of the rams.

verses.textZh: 牧人无处逃避， 羊群的领袖无法逃脱。
verses.textZhCnvs: 牧人无处逃避， 羊群的领袖无法逃脱。
verses.textZhCuv: 牧人无路逃跑； 群众的头目也无法逃脱。
verses.textEnNiv: The shepherds will have nowhere to flee, the leaders of the flock no place to escape.
verses.textEnEsv: No refuge will remain for the shepherds, nor escape for the lords of the flock.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the shepherds will have no way to flee, Nor the leaders of the flock to escape.
verses.textEnNlt: You will find no place to hide; there will be no way to escape.
verses.textEnNasb: " There will be no sanctuary for the shepherds, Nor escape for the masters of the flock.
verses.textEn: The shepherds will have nowhere to flee, the leaders of the flock no place to escape.

verses.textZh: 听啊！牧人的哀叫， 羊群的领袖的悲号， 因为耶和华正在毁坏他们的牧场。
verses.textZhCnvs: 听啊！牧人的哀叫， 羊群的领袖的悲号， 因为耶和华正在毁坏他们的牧场。
verses.textZhCuv: 听啊，有牧人呼喊， 有群众头目哀号的声音， 因为耶和华使他们的草场变为荒场。
verses.textEnNiv: Hear the cry of the shepherds, the wailing of the leaders of the flock, for the Lord is destroying their pasture.
verses.textEnEsv: A voice—the cry of the shepherds, and the wail of the lords of the flock! For the Lord is laying waste their pasture,
verses.textEnNkjv: A voice of the cry of the shepherds, And a wailing of the leaders to the flock willbeheard. For the Lord has plundered their pasture,
verses.textEnNlt: Listen to the frantic cries of the shepherds. The leaders of the flock are wailing in despair, for the Lord is ruining their pastures.
verses.textEnNasb: "Hear the sound of the cry of the shepherds, And the wailing of the masters of the flock! For the Lord is destroying their pasture,
verses.textEn: Hear the cry of the shepherds, the wailing of the leaders of the flock, for the Lord is destroying their pasture.

verses.textZh: 因为耶和华猛烈的怒气， 平静的羊圈毁坏了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为耶和华猛烈的怒气， 平静的羊圈毁坏了。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华发出猛烈的怒气， 平安的羊圈就都寂静无声。
verses.textEnNiv: The peaceful meadows will be laid waste because of the fierce anger of the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: and the peaceful folds are devastated because of the fierce anger of the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: And the peaceful dwellings are cut down Because of the fierce anger of the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: Peaceful meadows will be turned into a wasteland by the Lord ’s fierce anger.
verses.textEnNasb: And the peaceful grazing places are devastated Because of the fierce anger of the Lord.
verses.textEn: The peaceful meadows will be laid waste because of the fierce anger of the Lord .

verses.textZh: 他像狮子离开了洞穴， 他们的国土实在变成荒野， 因为欺压人的刀剑 ， 和他猛烈的怒气临到他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他像狮子离开了洞穴， 他们的国土实在变成荒野， 因为欺压人的刀剑 ， 和他猛烈的怒气临到他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 他离了隐密处像狮子一样， 他们的地，因刀剑凶猛的欺压， 又因他猛烈的怒气都成为可惊骇的。」
verses.textEnNiv: Like a lion he will leave his lair, and their land will become desolate because of the sword of the oppressor and because of the Lord ’s fierce anger.
verses.textEnEsv: Like a lion he has left his lair, for their land has become a waste because of the sword of the oppressor, and because of his fierce anger."
verses.textEnNkjv: He has left His lair like the lion; For their land is desolate Because of the fierceness of the Oppressor, And because of His fierce anger."
verses.textEnNlt: He has left his den like a strong lion seeking its prey, and their land will be made desolate by the sword of the enemy and the Lord ’s fierce anger.
verses.textEnNasb: "He has left His hiding place like the lion; For their land has become a horror Because of the fierceness of the oppressing sword And because of His fierce anger."
verses.textEn: Like a lion he will leave his lair, and their land will become desolate because of the sword of the oppressor and because of the Lord ’s fierce anger.

verses.textZh: 犹大王约西亚的儿子约雅敬开始执政的时候，有这话从耶和华那里临到耶利米，说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 犹大王约西亚的儿子约雅敬开始执政的时候，有这话从耶和华那里临到耶利米，说：
verses.textZhCuv: 犹大王约西亚的儿子约雅敬登基的时候，有这话从耶和华临到耶利米说：
verses.textEnNiv: Early in the reign of Jehoiakim son of Josiah king of Judah, this word came from the Lord :
verses.textEnEsv: In the beginning of the reign of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah, this word came from the Lord :
verses.textEnNkjv: In the beginning of the reign of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah, this word came from the Lord, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: This message came to Jeremiah from the Lord early in the reign of Jehoiakim son of Josiah, king of Judah.
verses.textEnNasb: In the beginning of the reign of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah, this word came from the Lord, saying,
verses.textEn: Early in the reign of Jehoiakim son of Josiah king of Judah, this word came from the Lord :

verses.textZh: "耶和华这样说：‘你要站在耶和华殿的院子里，对来自犹大各城，到耶和华殿敬拜的人，把我吩咐你对他们说的一切话，一字不漏告诉他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: "耶和华这样说：‘你要站在耶和华殿的院子里，对来自犹大各城，到耶和华殿敬拜的人，把我吩咐你对他们说的一切话，一字不漏告诉他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 「耶和华如此说：你站在耶和华殿的院内，对犹大众城邑的人，就是到耶和华殿来礼拜的，说我所吩咐你的一切话，一字不可删减。
verses.textEnNiv: "This is what the Lord says: Stand in the courtyard of the Lord ’s house and speak to all the people of the towns of Judah who come to worship in the house of the Lord . Tell them everything I command you; do not omit a word.
verses.textEnEsv: "Thus says the Lord : Stand in the court of the Lord ’s house, and speak to all the cities of Judah that come to worship in the house of the Lord all the words that I command you to speak to them; do not hold back a word.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Thus says the Lord: ‘Stand in the court of the Lord’s house, and speak to all the cities of Judah, which come to worship in the Lord’s house, all the words that I command you to speak to them. Do not diminish a word.
verses.textEnNlt: "This is what the Lord says: Stand in the courtyard in front of the Temple of the Lord , and make an announcement to the people who have come there to worship from all over Judah. Give them my entire message; include every word.
verses.textEnNasb: "This is what the Lord says: ‘Stand in the courtyard of the Lord’s house, and speak to all the cities of Judah who have come to worship in the Lord’s house all the words that I have commanded you to speak to them. Do not omit a word!
verses.textEn: "This is what the Lord says: Stand in the courtyard of the Lord ’s house and speak to all the people of the towns of Judah who come to worship in the house of the Lord . Tell them everything I command you; do not omit a word.

verses.textZh: 或者他们肯听从，各人转离自己的恶道，我就回心转意，不把我因为他们的恶行原想要施行的灾祸，降给他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 或者他们肯听从，各人转离自己的恶道，我就回心转意，不把我因为他们的恶行原想要施行的灾祸，降给他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 或者他们肯听从，各人回头离开恶道，使我后悔不将我因他们所行的恶，想要施行的灾祸降与他们。
verses.textEnNiv: Perhaps they will listen and each will turn from their evil ways. Then I will relent and not inflict on them the disaster I was planning because of the evil they have done.
verses.textEnEsv: It may be they will listen, and every one turn from his evil way, that I may relent of the disaster that I intend to do to them because of their evil deeds.
verses.textEnNkjv: Perhaps everyone will listen and turn from his evil way, that I may relent concerning the calamity which I purpose to bring on them because of the evil of their doings.’
verses.textEnNlt: Perhaps they will listen and turn from their evil ways. Then I will change my mind about the disaster I am ready to pour out on them because of their sins.
verses.textEnNasb: Perhaps they will listen and everyone will turn from his evil way, and I will relent of the disaster which I am planning to inflict on them because of the evil of their deeds.’
verses.textEn: Perhaps they will listen and each will turn from their evil ways. Then I will relent and not inflict on them the disaster I was planning because of the evil they have done.

verses.textZh: 你要对他们说：耶和华这样说：如果你们不听从我，不遵行我设立在你们面前的律法，
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要对他们说：耶和华这样说：如果你们不听从我，不遵行我设立在你们面前的律法，
verses.textZhCuv: 你要对他们说，耶和华如此说：『你们若不听从我，不遵行我设立在你们面前的律法，
verses.textEnNiv: Say to them, ‘This is what the Lord says: If you do not listen to me and follow my law, which I have set before you,
verses.textEnEsv: You shall say to them, ‘Thus says the Lord : If you will not listen to me, to walk in my law that I have set before you,
verses.textEnNkjv: And you shall say to them, ‘Thus says the Lord: "If you will not listen to Me, to walk in My law which I have set before you,
verses.textEnNlt: "Say to them, ‘This is what the Lord says: If you will not listen to me and obey my word I have given you,
verses.textEnNasb: And you shall say to them, ‘This is what the Lord says: "If you do not listen to Me, to walk in My Law which I have set before you,
verses.textEn: Say to them, ‘This is what the Lord says: If you do not listen to me and follow my law, which I have set before you,

verses.textZh: 不听从我差遣到你们那里去的我的仆人众先知的话 ，
verses.textZhCnvs: 不听从我差遣到你们那里去的我的仆人众先知的话 ，
verses.textZhCuv: 不听我从早起来差遣到你们那里去我仆人众先知的话（你们还是没有听从），
verses.textEnNiv: and if you do not listen to the words of my servants the prophets, whom I have sent to you again and again (though you have not listened),
verses.textEnEsv: and to listen to the words of my servants the prophets whom I send to you urgently, though you have not listened,
verses.textEnNkjv: to heed the words of My servants the prophets whom I sent to you, both rising up early and sending them (but you have not heeded),
verses.textEnNlt: and if you will not listen to my servants, the prophets—for I sent them again and again to warn you, but you would not listen to them—
verses.textEnNasb: to listen to the words of My servants the prophets, whom I have been sending to you again and again, but you have not listened;
verses.textEn: and if you do not listen to the words of my servants the prophets, whom I have sent to you again and again (though you have not listened),

verses.textZh: 我就必使这殿像示罗一样，使这城成为地上列国咒诅的对象。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我就必使这殿像示罗一样，使这城成为地上列国咒诅的对象。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 我就必使这殿如示罗，使这城为地上万国所咒诅的。』」
verses.textEnNiv: then I will make this house like Shiloh and this city a curse among all the nations of the earth.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: then I will make this house like Shiloh, and I will make this city a curse for all the nations of the earth.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: then I will make this house like Shiloh, and will make this city a curse to all the nations of the earth." ’ "
verses.textEnNlt: then I will destroy this Temple as I destroyed Shiloh, the place where the Tabernacle was located. And I will make Jerusalem an object of cursing in every nation on earth.’"
verses.textEnNasb: then I will make this house like Shiloh, and I will make this city a curse to all the nations of the earth." ’ "
verses.textEn: then I will make this house like Shiloh and this city a curse among all the nations of the earth.’ "

verses.textZh: 耶利米在耶和华殿里所说的这些话，众祭司、众先知和众民都听见了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶利米在耶和华殿里所说的这些话，众祭司、众先知和众民都听见了。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶利米在耶和华殿中说的这些话，祭司、先知与众民都听见了。
verses.textEnNiv: The priests, the prophets and all the people heard Jeremiah speak these words in the house of the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: The priests and the prophets and all the people heard Jeremiah speaking these words in the house of the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: So the priests and the prophets and all the people heard Jeremiah speaking these words in the house of the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: The priests, the prophets, and all the people listened to Jeremiah as he spoke in front of the Lord ’s Temple.
verses.textEnNasb: The priests and the prophets and all the people heard Jeremiah speaking these words in the house of the Lord.
verses.textEn: The priests, the prophets and all the people heard Jeremiah speak these words in the house of the Lord .

verses.textZh: 耶利米说完了耶和华吩咐他对众民所说的一切话，众祭司、众先知和众民就抓住他，说："你必要死！
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶利米说完了耶和华吩咐他对众民所说的一切话，众祭司、众先知和众民就抓住他，说："你必要死！
verses.textZhCuv: 耶利米说完了耶和华所吩咐他对众人说的一切话，祭司、先知与众民都来抓住他，说：「你必要死！
verses.textEnNiv: But as soon as Jeremiah finished telling all the people everything the Lord had commanded him to say, the priests, the prophets and all the people seized him and said, "You must die!
verses.textEnEsv: And when Jeremiah had finished speaking all that the Lord had commanded him to speak to all the people, then the priests and the prophets and all the people laid hold of him, saying, "You shall die!
verses.textEnNkjv: Now it happened, when Jeremiah had made an end of speaking all that the Lord had commanded him to speak to all the people, that the priests and the prophets and all the people seized him, saying, "You will surely die!
verses.textEnNlt: But when Jeremiah had finished his message, saying everything the Lord had told him to say, the priests and prophets and all the people at the Temple mobbed him. "Kill him!" they shouted.
verses.textEnNasb: Yet when Jeremiah finished speaking everything that the Lord had commanded him to speak to all the people, then the priests and the prophets and all the people seized him, saying, "You must die!
verses.textEn: But as soon as Jeremiah finished telling all the people everything the Lord had commanded him to say, the priests, the prophets and all the people seized him and said, "You must die!

verses.textZh: 你为甚么奉耶和华的名预言，说：‘这殿必像示罗一样，这城必变为荒场，没有人居住呢？’"于是众民在耶和华的殿里集合到耶利米那里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你为甚么奉耶和华的名预言，说：‘这殿必像示罗一样，这城必变为荒场，没有人居住呢？’"于是众民在耶和华的殿里集合到耶利米那里。
verses.textZhCuv: 你为何托耶和华的名预言，说这殿必如示罗，这城必变为荒场无人居住呢？」于是众民都在耶和华的殿中聚集到耶利米那里。
verses.textEnNiv: Why do you prophesy in the Lord ’s name that this house will be like Shiloh and this city will be desolate and deserted?" And all the people crowded around Jeremiah in the house of the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: Why have you prophesied in the name of the Lord , saying, ‘This house shall be like Shiloh, and this city shall be desolate, without inhabitant’?" And all the people gathered around Jeremiah in the house of the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: Why have you prophesied in the name of the Lord, saying, ‘This house shall be like Shiloh, and this city shall be desolate, without an inhabitant’?" And all the people were gathered against Jeremiah in the house of the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: "What right do you have to prophesy in the Lord ’s name that this Temple will be destroyed like Shiloh? What do you mean, saying that Jerusalem will be destroyed and left with no inhabitants?" And all the people threatened him as he stood in front of the Temple.
verses.textEnNasb: Why have you prophesied in the name of the Lord, saying, ‘This house will be like Shiloh and this city will be in ruins, without inhabitant’?" And all the people gathered to Jeremiah at the house of the Lord.
verses.textEn: Why do you prophesy in the Lord ’s name that this house will be like Shiloh and this city will be desolate and deserted?" And all the people crowded around Jeremiah in the house of the Lord .

verses.textZh: 犹大的领袖听见了这些事，就从王宫上到耶和华的殿，坐在耶和华殿里新门的入口。
verses.textZhCnvs: 犹大的领袖听见了这些事，就从王宫上到耶和华的殿，坐在耶和华殿里新门的入口。
verses.textZhCuv: 犹大的首领听见这事，就从王宫上到耶和华的殿，坐在耶和华殿的新门口。
verses.textEnNiv: When the officials of Judah heard about these things, they went up from the royal palace to the house of the Lord and took their places at the entrance of the New Gate of the Lord ’s house.
verses.textEnEsv: When the officials of Judah heard these things, they came up from the king’s house to the house of the Lord and took their seat in the entry of the New Gate of the house of the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: When the princes of Judah heard these things, they came up from the king’s house to the house of the Lord and sat down in the entry of the New Gate of the Lord’s house.
verses.textEnNlt: When the officials of Judah heard what was happening, they rushed over from the palace and sat down at the New Gate of the Temple to hold court.
verses.textEnNasb: When the officials of Judah heard these things, they came up from the king’s house to the house of the Lord and sat at the entrance of the New Gate of the Lord’shouse.
verses.textEn: When the officials of Judah heard about these things, they went up from the royal palace to the house of the Lord and took their places at the entrance of the New Gate of the Lord ’s house.

verses.textZh: 祭司和先知对领袖和众民说："这人应该处死，因为他说预言攻击这城，正如你们亲耳听见的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 祭司和先知对领袖和众民说："这人应该处死，因为他说预言攻击这城，正如你们亲耳听见的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 祭司、先知对首领和众民说：「这人是该死的；因为他说预言攻击这城，正如你们亲耳所听见的。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then the priests and the prophets said to the officials and all the people, "This man should be sentenced to death because he has prophesied against this city. You have heard it with your own ears!"
verses.textEnEsv: Then the priests and the prophets said to the officials and to all the people, "This man deserves the sentence of death, because he has prophesied against this city, as you have heard with your own ears."
verses.textEnNkjv: And the priests and the prophets spoke to the princes and all the people, saying, "This man deserves to die! For he has prophesied against this city, as you have heard with your ears."
verses.textEnNlt: The priests and prophets presented their accusations to the officials and the people. "This man should die!" they said. "You have heard with your own ears what a traitor he is, for he has prophesied against this city."
verses.textEnNasb: Then the priests and the prophets spoke to the officials and to all the people, saying, "A death sentence for this man! For he has prophesied against this city, just as you have heard with your own ears!"
verses.textEn: Then the priests and the prophets said to the officials and all the people, "This man should be sentenced to death because he has prophesied against this city. You have heard it with your own ears!"

verses.textZh: 耶利米对众领袖和众民说："耶和华差遣我预言你们所听见，一切攻击这殿和这城的话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶利米对众领袖和众民说："耶和华差遣我预言你们所听见，一切攻击这殿和这城的话。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶利米就对众首领和众民说：「耶和华差遣我预言，攻击这殿和这城，说你们所听见的这一切话。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Jeremiah said to all the officials and all the people: "The Lord sent me to prophesy against this house and this city all the things you have heard.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Jeremiah spoke to all the officials and all the people, saying, "The Lord sent me to prophesy against this house and this city all the words you have heard.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Jeremiah spoke to all the princes and all the people, saying: "The Lord sent me to prophesy against this house and against this city with all the words that you have heard.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Jeremiah spoke to the officials and the people in his own defense. "The Lord sent me to prophesy against this Temple and this city," he said. "The Lord gave me every word that I have spoken.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Jeremiah spoke to all the officials and to all the people, saying, "The Lord sent me to prophesy against this house and against this city all the words that you have heard.
verses.textEn: Then Jeremiah said to all the officials and all the people: "The Lord sent me to prophesy against this house and this city all the things you have heard.

verses.textZh: 现在，你们要改善你们所行所作的，听从耶和华你们的神的话，耶和华就必回心转意，不把所说的灾祸降给你们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在，你们要改善你们所行所作的，听从耶和华你们的神的话，耶和华就必回心转意，不把所说的灾祸降给你们。
verses.textZhCuv: 现在要改正你们的行动作为，听从耶和华－你们神的话，他就必后悔，不将所说的灾祸降与你们。
verses.textEnNiv: Now reform your ways and your actions and obey the Lord your God. Then the Lord will relent and not bring the disaster he has pronounced against you.
verses.textEnEsv: Now therefore mend your ways and your deeds, and obey the voice of the Lord your God, and the Lord will relent of the disaster that he has pronounced against you.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now therefore, amend your ways and your doings, and obey the voice of the Lord your God; then the Lord will relent concerning the doom that He has pronounced against you.
verses.textEnNlt: But if you stop your sinning and begin to obey the Lord your God, he will change his mind about this disaster that he has announced against you.
verses.textEnNasb: Now then, reform your ways and your deeds and obey the voice of the Lord your God; and the Lord will relent of the disaster which He has pronounced against you.
verses.textEn: Now reform your ways and your actions and obey the Lord your God. Then the Lord will relent and not bring the disaster he has pronounced against you.

verses.textZh: 至于我，我在你们手中；你们看怎样好，怎样对，就怎样待我吧！
verses.textZhCnvs: 至于我，我在你们手中；你们看怎样好，怎样对，就怎样待我吧！
verses.textZhCuv: 至于我，我在你们手中，你们眼看何为善，何为正，就那样待我吧！
verses.textEnNiv: As for me, I am in your hands; do with me whatever you think is good and right.
verses.textEnEsv: But as for me, behold, I am in your hands. Do with me as seems good and right to you.
verses.textEnNkjv: As for me, here I am, in your hand; do with me as seems good and proper to you.
verses.textEnNlt: As for me, I am in your hands—do with me as you think best.
verses.textEnNasb: But as for me, behold, I am in your hands; do with me as is good and right in your sight.
verses.textEn: As for me, I am in your hands; do with me whatever you think is good and right.

verses.textZh: 不过你们要确实知道，如果你们杀死我，就必使无辜的人的血归到你们和这城，以及这城的居民头上，因为耶和华实在差遣了我到你们中间，把这一切话传到你们耳中。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 不过你们要确实知道，如果你们杀死我，就必使无辜的人的血归到你们和这城，以及这城的居民头上，因为耶和华实在差遣了我到你们中间，把这一切话传到你们耳中。"
verses.textZhCuv: 但你们要确实地知道，若把我治死，就使无辜人的血归到你们和这城，并其中的居民了；因为耶和华实在差遣我到你们这里来，将这一切话传与你们耳中。」
verses.textEnNiv: Be assured, however, that if you put me to death, you will bring the guilt of innocent blood on yourselves and on this city and on those who live in it, for in truth the Lord has sent me to you to speak all these words in your hearing."
verses.textEnEsv: Only know for certain that if you put me to death, you will bring innocent blood upon yourselves and upon this city and its inhabitants, for in truth the Lord sent me to you to speak all these words in your ears."
verses.textEnNkjv: But know for certain that if you put me to death, you will surely bring innocent blood on yourselves, on this city, and on its inhabitants; for truly the Lord has sent me to you to speak all these words in your hearing."
verses.textEnNlt: But if you kill me, rest assured that you will be killing an innocent man! The responsibility for such a deed will lie on you, on this city, and on every person living in it. For it is absolutely true that the Lord sent me to speak every word you have heard."
verses.textEnNasb: Only know for certain that if you put me to death, you will bring innocent blood on yourselves, and on this city and its inhabitants; for truly the Lord has sent me to you to speak all these words so that you hear them."
verses.textEn: Be assured, however, that if you put me to death, you will bring the guilt of innocent blood on yourselves and on this city and on those who live in it, for in truth the Lord has sent me to you to speak all these words in your hearing."

verses.textZh: 于是众领袖和众民对祭司和先知说："这人不应该处死，因为他奉耶和华我们神的名对我们说话。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是众领袖和众民对祭司和先知说："这人不应该处死，因为他奉耶和华我们神的名对我们说话。"
verses.textZhCuv: 首领和众民就对祭司、先知说：「这人是不该死的，因为他是奉耶和华－我们神的名向我们说话。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then the officials and all the people said to the priests and the prophets, "This man should not be sentenced to death! He has spoken to us in the name of the Lord our God."
verses.textEnEsv: Then the officials and all the people said to the priests and the prophets, "This man does not deserve the sentence of death, for he has spoken to us in the name of the Lord our God."
verses.textEnNkjv: So the princes and all the people said to the priests and the prophets, "This man does not deserve to die. For he has spoken to us in the name of the Lord our God."
verses.textEnNlt: Then the officials and the people said to the priests and prophets, "This man does not deserve the death sentence, for he has spoken to us in the name of the Lord our God."
verses.textEnNasb: Then the officials and all the people said to the priests and the prophets, "No death sentence for this man! For he has spoken to us in the name of the Lord our God."
verses.textEn: Then the officials and all the people said to the priests and the prophets, "This man should not be sentenced to death! He has spoken to us in the name of the Lord our God."

verses.textZh: 那地的长老中有几个人起来，对集合在场的全体人民说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 那地的长老中有几个人起来，对集合在场的全体人民说：
verses.textZhCuv: 国中的长老就有几个人起来，对聚会的众民说：
verses.textEnNiv: Some of the elders of the land stepped forward and said to the entire assembly of people,
verses.textEnEsv: And certain of the elders of the land arose and spoke to all the assembled people, saying,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then certain of the elders of the land rose up and spoke to all the assembly of the people, saying:
verses.textEnNlt: Then some of the wise old men stood and spoke to all the people assembled there.
verses.textEnNasb: Then some of the elders of the land rose up and spoke to all the assembly of the people, saying,
verses.textEn: Some of the elders of the land stepped forward and said to the entire assembly of people,

verses.textZh: "在犹大王希西家的日子，摩利沙人弥迦对犹大的众民说预言：‘万军之耶和华这样说：锡安要像田地被耕犁，耶路撒冷必成为废墟，这殿的山必变为杂树丛生的高冈。’
verses.textZhCnvs: "在犹大王希西家的日子，摩利沙人弥迦对犹大的众民说预言：‘万军之耶和华这样说：锡安要像田地被耕犁，耶路撒冷必成为废墟，这殿的山必变为杂树丛生的高冈。’
verses.textZhCuv: 「当犹大王希西家的日子，有摩利沙人弥迦对犹大众人预言说： 万军之耶和华如此说： 锡安必被耕种像一块田； 耶路撒冷必变为乱堆； 这殿的山必像丛林的高处。
verses.textEnNiv: "Micah of Moresheth prophesied in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah. He told all the people of Judah, ‘This is what the Lord Almighty says: " ‘Zion will be plowed like a field, Jerusalem will become a heap of rubble, the temple hill a mound overgrown with thickets.’
verses.textEnEsv: "Micah of Moresheth prophesied in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah, and said to all the people of Judah: ‘Thus says the Lord of hosts, "‘Zion shall be plowed as a field; Jerusalem shall become a heap of ruins, and the mountain of the house a wooded height.’
verses.textEnNkjv: "Micah of Moresheth prophesied in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah, and spoke to all the people of Judah, saying, ‘Thus says the Lord of hosts: "Zion shall be plowed like a field, Jerusalem shall become heaps of ruins, And the mountain of the temple Like the bare hills of the forest." ’
verses.textEnNlt: They said, "Remember when Micah of Moresheth prophesied during the reign of King Hezekiah of Judah. He told the people of Judah, ‘This is what the Lord of Heaven’s Armies says: Mount Zion will be plowed like an open field; Jerusalem will be reduced to ruins! A thicket will grow on the heights where the Temple now stands.’
verses.textEnNasb: " Micah of Moresheth used to prophesy in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah; and he spoke to all the people of Judah, saying, ‘This is what the Lord of armies has said: "Zion will be plowed like a field, And Jerusalem will become heaps of ruins, And the mountain of the house like the high places of a forest." ’
verses.textEn: "Micah of Moresheth prophesied in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah. He told all the people of Judah, ‘This is what the Lord Almighty says: " ‘Zion will be plowed like a field, Jerusalem will become a heap of rubble, the temple hill a mound overgrown with thickets.’

verses.textZh: 犹大王希西家和犹大众人可曾把他处死呢？希西家不是敬畏耶和华，求他开恩，以致耶和华回心转意，没有把他所说的灾祸降在他们身上吗？但我们现在竟自招大祸。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 犹大王希西家和犹大众人可曾把他处死呢？希西家不是敬畏耶和华，求他开恩，以致耶和华回心转意，没有把他所说的灾祸降在他们身上吗？但我们现在竟自招大祸。"
verses.textZhCuv: 犹大王希西家和犹大众人岂是把他治死呢？希西家岂不是敬畏耶和华、恳求他的恩吗？耶和华就后悔，不把自己所说的灾祸降与他们。若治死这人，我们就作了大恶，自害己命。」 （
verses.textEnNiv: "Did Hezekiah king of Judah or anyone else in Judah put him to death? Did not Hezekiah fear the Lord and seek his favor? And did not the Lord relent, so that he did not bring the disaster he pronounced against them? We are about to bring a terrible disaster on ourselves!"
verses.textEnEsv: Did Hezekiah king of Judah and all Judah put him to death? Did he not fear the Lord and entreat the favor of the Lord , and did not the Lord relent of the disaster that he had pronounced against them? But we are about to bring great disaster upon ourselves."
verses.textEnNkjv: Did Hezekiah king of Judah and all Judah ever put him to death? Did he not fear the Lord and seek the Lord’s favor? And the Lord relented concerning the doom which He had pronounced against them. But we are doing great evil against ourselves."
verses.textEnNlt: But did King Hezekiah and the people kill him for saying this? No, they turned from their sins and worshiped the Lord . They begged him for mercy. Then the Lord changed his mind about the terrible disaster he had pronounced against them. So we are about to do ourselves great harm."
verses.textEnNasb: Did Hezekiah king of Judah and all Judah actually put him to death? Did he not fear the Lord and plead for the favor of the Lord, and the Lord relented of the disaster which He had pronounced against them? But we are committing a great evil against our own lives!"
verses.textEn: "Did Hezekiah king of Judah or anyone else in Judah put him to death? Did not Hezekiah fear the Lord and seek his favor? And did not the Lord relent, so that he did not bring the disaster he pronounced against them? We are about to bring a terrible disaster on ourselves!"

verses.textZh: 曾有一个人，就是基列．耶琳人示玛雅的儿子乌利亚，他奉耶和华的名说预言，攻击这城和这地，他的预言和耶利米所说的一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 曾有一个人，就是基列．耶琳人示玛雅的儿子乌利亚，他奉耶和华的名说预言，攻击这城和这地，他的预言和耶利米所说的一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 又有一个人奉耶和华的名说预言，是基列‧耶琳人示玛雅的儿子乌利亚，他照耶利米的一切话说预言，攻击这城和这地。
verses.textEnNiv: (Now Uriah son of Shemaiah from Kiriath Jearim was another man who prophesied in the name of the Lord ; he prophesied the same things against this city and this land as Jeremiah did.
verses.textEnEsv: There was another man who prophesied in the name of the Lord , Uriah the son of Shemaiah from Kiriath-jearim. He prophesied against this city and against this land in words like those of Jeremiah.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now there was also a man who prophesied in the name of the Lord, Urijah the son of Shemaiah of Kirjath Jearim, who prophesied against this city and against this land according to all the words of Jeremiah.
verses.textEnNlt: At this time Uriah son of Shemaiah from Kiriath-jearim was also prophesying for the Lord . And he predicted the same terrible disaster against the city and nation as Jeremiah did.
verses.textEnNasb: Indeed, there was also a man who used to prophesy in the name of the Lord, Uriah the son of Shemaiah from Kiriath-jearim; and he prophesied against this city and against this land words similar to all those of Jeremiah.
verses.textEn: (Now Uriah son of Shemaiah from Kiriath Jearim was another man who prophesied in the name of the Lord ; he prophesied the same things against this city and this land as Jeremiah did.

verses.textZh: 约雅敬王和他所有的勇士，以及犹大的众领袖听见了乌利亚的话，王就想要杀他。乌利亚听见了，就惧怕，就逃往埃及去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约雅敬王和他所有的勇士，以及犹大的众领袖听见了乌利亚的话，王就想要杀他。乌利亚听见了，就惧怕，就逃往埃及去。
verses.textZhCuv: 约雅敬王和他众勇士、众首领听见了乌利亚的话，王就想要把他治死。乌利亚听见就惧怕，逃往埃及去了。
verses.textEnNiv: When King Jehoiakim and all his officers and officials heard his words, the king was determined to put him to death. But Uriah heard of it and fled in fear to Egypt.
verses.textEnEsv: And when King Jehoiakim, with all his warriors and all the officials, heard his words, the king sought to put him to death. But when Uriah heard of it, he was afraid and fled and escaped to Egypt.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when Jehoiakim the king, with all his mighty men and all the princes, heard his words, the king sought to put him to death; but when Urijah heard it, he was afraid and fled, and went to Egypt.
verses.textEnNlt: When King Jehoiakim and the army officers and officials heard what he was saying, the king sent someone to kill him. But Uriah heard about the plan and escaped in fear to Egypt.
verses.textEnNasb: When King Jehoiakim and all his warriors and all the officials heard his words, then the king sought to put him to death; but Uriah heard about it, and he was afraid, so he fled and went to Egypt.
verses.textEn: When King Jehoiakim and all his officers and officials heard his words, the king was determined to put him to death. But Uriah heard of it and fled in fear to Egypt.

verses.textZh: 约雅敬王打发人到埃及去，就是派亚革波的儿子以利拿单和一些人同到埃及去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约雅敬王打发人到埃及去，就是派亚革波的儿子以利拿单和一些人同到埃及去。
verses.textZhCuv: 约雅敬王便打发亚革波的儿子以利拿单，带领几个人往埃及去。
verses.textEnNiv: King Jehoiakim, however, sent Elnathan son of Akbor to Egypt, along with some other men.
verses.textEnEsv: Then King Jehoiakim sent to Egypt certain men, Elnathan the son of Achbor and others with him,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Jehoiakim the king sent men to Egypt: Elnathan the son of Achbor, and other men whowent with him to Egypt.
verses.textEnNlt: Then King Jehoiakim sent Elnathan son of Acbor to Egypt along with several other men to capture Uriah.
verses.textEnNasb: Then King Jehoiakim sent men to Egypt: Elnathan the son of Achbor and certain men with him, to Egypt.
verses.textEn: King Jehoiakim, however, sent Elnathan son of Akbor to Egypt, along with some other men.

verses.textZh: 他们就把乌利亚从埃及带出来，送到约雅敬王那里。王用刀杀死他，把他的尸体拋在平民的坟地里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们就把乌利亚从埃及带出来，送到约雅敬王那里。王用刀杀死他，把他的尸体拋在平民的坟地里。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们就从埃及将乌利亚带出来，送到约雅敬王那里；王用刀杀了他，把他的尸首抛在平民的坟地中。）
verses.textEnNiv: They brought Uriah out of Egypt and took him to King Jehoiakim, who had him struck down with a sword and his body thrown into the burial place of the common people.)
verses.textEnEsv: and they took Uriah from Egypt and brought him to King Jehoiakim, who struck him down with the sword and dumped his dead body into the burial place of the common people.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they brought Urijah from Egypt and brought him to Jehoiakim the king, who killed him with the sword and cast his dead body into the graves of the common people.
verses.textEnNlt: They took him prisoner and brought him back to King Jehoiakim. The king then killed Uriah with a sword and had him buried in an unmarked grave.
verses.textEnNasb: And they brought Uriah from Egypt and led him to King Jehoiakim, who killed him with a sword and threw his dead body into the burial place of the common people.
verses.textEn: They brought Uriah out of Egypt and took him to King Jehoiakim, who had him struck down with a sword and his body thrown into the burial place of the common people.)

verses.textZh: 然而沙番的儿子亚希甘却保护耶利米，不许人把耶利米交在人民的手中处死。
verses.textZhCnvs: 然而沙番的儿子亚希甘却保护耶利米，不许人把耶利米交在人民的手中处死。
verses.textZhCuv: 然而，沙番的儿子亚希甘保护耶利米，不交在百姓的手中治死他。
verses.textEnNiv: Furthermore, Ahikam son of Shaphan supported Jeremiah, and so he was not handed over to the people to be put to death.
verses.textEnEsv: But the hand of Ahikam the son of Shaphan was with Jeremiah so that he was not given over to the people to be put to death.
verses.textEnNkjv: Nevertheless the hand of Ahikam the son of Shaphan was with Jeremiah, so that they should not give him into the hand of the people to put him to death.
verses.textEnNlt: Nevertheless, Ahikam son of Shaphan stood up for Jeremiah and persuaded the court not to turn him over to the mob to be killed.
verses.textEnNasb: But the hand of Ahikam the son of Shaphan was with Jeremiah, so that he was not handed over to the people to put him to death.
verses.textEn: Furthermore, Ahikam son of Shaphan supported Jeremiah, and so he was not handed over to the people to be put to death.

verses.textZh: 犹大王约西亚的儿子西底家 开始执政的时候，有这话从耶和华那里临到耶利米，说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 犹大王约西亚的儿子西底家 开始执政的时候，有这话从耶和华那里临到耶利米，说：
verses.textZhCuv: 犹大王约西亚的儿子约雅敬 登基的时候，有这话从耶和华临到耶利米说：
verses.textEnNiv: Early in the reign of Zedekiah son of Josiah king of Judah, this word came to Jeremiah from the Lord :
verses.textEnEsv: In the beginning of the reign of Zedekiah the son of Josiah, king of Judah, this word came to Jeremiah from the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: In the beginning of the reign of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah, this word came to Jeremiah from the Lord, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: This message came to Jeremiah from the Lord early in the reign of Zedekiah son of Josiah, king of Judah.
verses.textEnNasb: In the beginning of the reign of Zedekiah the son of Josiah, king of Judah, this word came to Jeremiah from the Lord, saying—
verses.textEn: Early in the reign of Zedekiah son of Josiah king of Judah, this word came to Jeremiah from the Lord :

verses.textZh: "耶和华对我这样说：‘你要用绳套和木头做轭，套在自己的颈上。
verses.textZhCnvs: "耶和华对我这样说：‘你要用绳套和木头做轭，套在自己的颈上。
verses.textZhCuv: 「耶和华对我如此说：你做绳索与轭，加在自己的颈项上，
verses.textEnNiv: This is what the Lord said to me: "Make a yoke out of straps and crossbars and put it on your neck.
verses.textEnEsv: Thus the Lord said to me: "Make yourself straps and yoke-bars, and put them on your neck.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Thus says the Lord to me: ‘Make for yourselves bonds and yokes, and put them on your neck,
verses.textEnNlt: This is what the Lord said to me: "Make a yoke, and fasten it on your neck with leather straps.
verses.textEnNasb: this is what the Lord has said to me: "Make for yourself restraints and yokes and put them on your neck,
verses.textEn: This is what the Lord said to me: "Make a yoke out of straps and crossbars and put it on your neck.

verses.textZh: 然后借着那些前来耶路撒冷朝见犹大王西底家的使臣的手，把轭送到以东王、摩押王、亚扪王、推罗王、西顿王那里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 然后借着那些前来耶路撒冷朝见犹大王西底家的使臣的手，把轭送到以东王、摩押王、亚扪王、推罗王、西顿王那里。
verses.textZhCuv: 藉那些来到耶路撒冷见犹大王西底家的使臣之手，把绳索与轭送到以东王、摩押王、亚扪王、泰尔王、西顿王那里，
verses.textEnNiv: Then send word to the kings of Edom, Moab, Ammon, Tyre and Sidon through the envoys who have come to Jerusalem to Zedekiah king of Judah.
verses.textEnEsv: Send word to the king of Edom, the king of Moab, the king of the sons of Ammon, the king of Tyre, and the king of Sidon by the hand of the envoys who have come to Jerusalem to Zedekiah king of Judah.
verses.textEnNkjv: and send them to the king of Edom, the king of Moab, the king of the Ammonites, the king of Tyre, and the king of Sidon, by the hand of the messengers who come to Jerusalem to Zedekiah king of Judah.
verses.textEnNlt: Then send messages to the kings of Edom, Moab, Ammon, Tyre, and Sidon through their ambassadors who have come to see King Zedekiah in Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNasb: and send word to the king of Edom, the king of Moab, the king of the sons of Ammon, the king of Tyre, and to the king of Sidon by the messengers who come to Jerusalem to Zedekiah king of Judah.
verses.textEn: Then send word to the kings of Edom, Moab, Ammon, Tyre and Sidon through the envoys who have come to Jerusalem to Zedekiah king of Judah.

verses.textZh: 你要吩咐使臣对他们的王说：万军之耶和华以色列的神这样说：你们要这样对你们的王说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要吩咐使臣对他们的王说：万军之耶和华以色列的神这样说：你们要这样对你们的王说：
verses.textZhCuv: 且嘱咐使臣，传与他们的主人说，万军之耶和华－以色列的神如此说：
verses.textEnNiv: Give them a message for their masters and say, ‘This is what the Lord Almighty, the God of Israel, says: "Tell this to your masters:
verses.textEnEsv: Give them this charge for their masters: ‘Thus says the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel: This is what you shall say to your masters:
verses.textEnNkjv: And command them to say to their masters, "Thus says the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel—thus you shall say to your masters:
verses.textEnNlt: Give them this message for their masters: ‘This is what the Lord of Heaven’s Armies, the God of Israel, says:
verses.textEnNasb: Order them to go to their masters, saying, ‘This is what the Lord of armies, the God of Israel says: "This is what you shall say to your masters:
verses.textEn: Give them a message for their masters and say, ‘This is what the Lord Almighty, the God of Israel, says: "Tell this to your masters:

verses.textZh: 是我用大能和伸出来的膀臂创造了大地，以及地面上的人和兽；我看给谁适合，就把地给谁。
verses.textZhCnvs: 是我用大能和伸出来的膀臂创造了大地，以及地面上的人和兽；我看给谁适合，就把地给谁。
verses.textZhCuv: 我用大能和伸出来的膀臂，创造大地和地上的人民、牲畜。我看给谁相宜，就把地给谁。
verses.textEnNiv: With my great power and outstretched arm I made the earth and its people and the animals that are on it, and I give it to anyone I please.
verses.textEnEsv: "It is I who by my great power and my outstretched arm have made the earth, with the men and animals that are on the earth, and I give it to whomever it seems right to me.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘I have made the earth, the man and the beast that are on the ground, by My great power and by My outstretched arm, and have given it to whom it seemed proper to Me.
verses.textEnNlt: With my great strength and powerful arm I made the earth and all its people and every animal. I can give these things of mine to anyone I choose.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘I have made the earth, mankind, and the animals which are on the face of the earth by My great power and by My outstretched arm, and I will give it to the one who is pleasing in My sight.
verses.textEn: With my great power and outstretched arm I made the earth and its people and the animals that are on it, and I give it to anyone I please.

verses.textZh: 现在我已经亲自把这一切国家都交在我仆人巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒的手中，连田野的走兽，我也交给他，供他奴役。
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在我已经亲自把这一切国家都交在我仆人巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒的手中，连田野的走兽，我也交给他，供他奴役。
verses.textZhCuv: 现在我将这些地都交给我仆人巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒的手，我也将田野的走兽给他使用。
verses.textEnNiv: Now I will give all your countries into the hands of my servant Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon; I will make even the wild animals subject to him.
verses.textEnEsv: Now I have given all these lands into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar, the king of Babylon, my servant, and I have given him also the beasts of the field to serve him.
verses.textEnNkjv: And now I have given all these lands into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon, My servant; and the beasts of the field I have also given him to serve him.
verses.textEnNlt: Now I will give your countries to King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylon, who is my servant. I have put everything, even the wild animals, under his control.
verses.textEnNasb: And now I have handed all these lands over to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, My servant, and I have also given him the animals of the field to serve him.
verses.textEn: Now I will give all your countries into the hands of my servant Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon; I will make even the wild animals subject to him.

verses.textZh: 列国都要服事他和他的儿子、孙子，直到他本国遭报的时候来到；那时，许多国家和大君王都要奴役他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 列国都要服事他和他的儿子、孙子，直到他本国遭报的时候来到；那时，许多国家和大君王都要奴役他。
verses.textZhCuv: 列国都必服事他和他的儿孙，直到他本国遭报的日期来到。那时，多国和大君王要使他作他们的奴仆。
verses.textEnNiv: All nations will serve him and his son and his grandson until the time for his land comes; then many nations and great kings will subjugate him.
verses.textEnEsv: All the nations shall serve him and his son and his grandson, until the time of his own land comes. Then many nations and great kings shall make him their slave.
verses.textEnNkjv: So all nations shall serve him and his son and his son’s son, until the time of his land comes; and then many nations and great kings shall make him serve them.
verses.textEnNlt: All the nations will serve him, his son, and his grandson until his time is up. Then many nations and great kings will conquer and rule over Babylon.
verses.textEnNasb: All the nations shall serve him and his son and his grandson until the time of his own land comes; then many nations and great kings will make him their servant.
verses.textEn: All nations will serve him and his son and his grandson until the time for his land comes; then many nations and great kings will subjugate him.

verses.textZh: "‘无论哪一国、哪一邦，不服事巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒，不把颈项放在巴比伦王的轭下，我必用刀剑、饥荒和瘟疫去惩罚那国，直到我借着巴比伦王的手把他们完全消灭。’这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: "‘无论哪一国、哪一邦，不服事巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒，不把颈项放在巴比伦王的轭下，我必用刀剑、饥荒和瘟疫去惩罚那国，直到我借着巴比伦王的手把他们完全消灭。’这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 「无论哪一邦哪一国，不肯服事这巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒，也不把颈项放在巴比伦王的轭下，我必用刀剑、饥荒、瘟疫刑罚那邦，直到我藉巴比伦王的手将他们毁灭。这是耶和华说的。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘ "If, however, any nation or kingdom will not serve Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon or bow its neck under his yoke, I will punish that nation with the sword, famine and plague, declares the Lord , until I destroy it by his hand.
verses.textEnEsv: "‘"But if any nation or kingdom will not serve this Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and put its neck under the yoke of the king of Babylon, I will punish that nation with the sword, with famine, and with pestilence, declares the Lord , until I have consumed it by his hand.
verses.textEnNkjv: And it shall be, that the nation and kingdom which will not serve Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon, and which will not put its neck under the yoke of the king of Babylon, that nation I will punish,’ says the Lord, ‘with the sword, the famine, and the pestilence, until I have consumed them by his hand.
verses.textEnNlt: So you must submit to Babylon’s king and serve him; put your neck under Babylon’s yoke! I will punish any nation that refuses to be his slave, says the Lord . I will send war, famine, and disease upon that nation until Babylon has conquered it.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘And it will be that the nation or the kingdom which will not serve him, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and will not put its neck under the yoke of the king of Babylon, I will punish that nation with the sword, with famine, and with plague,’ declares the Lord, ‘until I have eliminated it by his hand.
verses.textEn: " ‘ "If, however, any nation or kingdom will not serve Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon or bow its neck under his yoke, I will punish that nation with the sword, famine and plague, declares the Lord , until I destroy it by his hand.

verses.textZh: ‘至于你们，不可听从你们的先知，也不可听从占卜的、解梦的、算命的和行邪术的；他们告诉你们说：你们必不会服事巴比伦王。
verses.textZhCnvs: ‘至于你们，不可听从你们的先知，也不可听从占卜的、解梦的、算命的和行邪术的；他们告诉你们说：你们必不会服事巴比伦王。
verses.textZhCuv: 至于你们，不可听从你们的先知和占卜的、圆梦的、观兆的，以及行邪术的；他们告诉你们说：『你们不致服事巴比伦王。』
verses.textEnNiv: So do not listen to your prophets, your diviners, your interpreters of dreams, your mediums or your sorcerers who tell you, ‘You will not serve the king of Babylon.’
verses.textEnEsv: So do not listen to your prophets, your diviners, your dreamers, your fortune-tellers, or your sorcerers, who are saying to you, ‘You shall not serve the king of Babylon.’
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore do not listen to your prophets, your diviners, your dreamers, your soothsayers, or your sorcerers, who speak to you, saying, "You shall not serve the king of Babylon."
verses.textEnNlt: "‘Do not listen to your false prophets, fortune-tellers, interpreters of dreams, mediums, and sorcerers who say, "The king of Babylon will not conquer you."
verses.textEnNasb: And as for you, do not listen to your prophets, your diviners, your dreamers, your soothsayers, or your sorcerers who talk to you, saying, "You will not serve the king of Babylon."
verses.textEn: So do not listen to your prophets, your diviners, your interpreters of dreams, your mediums or your sorcerers who tell you, ‘You will not serve the king of Babylon.’

verses.textZh: 因为他们向你们说虚假的预言，使你们远离你们的土地；我要赶逐你们，你们必要灭亡。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为他们向你们说虚假的预言，使你们远离你们的土地；我要赶逐你们，你们必要灭亡。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们向你们说假预言，要叫你们迁移，远离本地，以致我将你们赶出去，使你们灭亡。
verses.textEnNiv: They prophesy lies to you that will only serve to remove you far from your lands; I will banish you and you will perish.
verses.textEnEsv: For it is a lie that they are prophesying to you, with the result that you will be removed far from your land, and I will drive you out, and you will perish.
verses.textEnNkjv: For they prophesy a lie to you, to remove you far from your land; and I will drive you out, and you will perish.
verses.textEnNlt: They are all liars, and their lies will lead to your being driven out of your land. I will drive you out and send you far away to die.
verses.textEnNasb: For they are prophesying a lie to you in order to remove you far from your land; and I will drive you away and you will perish.
verses.textEn: They prophesy lies to you that will only serve to remove you far from your lands; I will banish you and you will perish.

verses.textZh: 但哪一国肯把颈项放在巴比伦王的轭下，服事他，我就必使那国仍留在本土，可以在那里耕种和居住。’"这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但哪一国肯把颈项放在巴比伦王的轭下，服事他，我就必使那国仍留在本土，可以在那里耕种和居住。’"这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 但哪一邦肯把颈项放在巴比伦王的轭下服事他，我必使那邦仍在本地存留，得以耕种居住。这是耶和华说的。」
verses.textEnNiv: But if any nation will bow its neck under the yoke of the king of Babylon and serve him, I will let that nation remain in its own land to till it and to live there, declares the Lord ." ’ "
verses.textEnEsv: But any nation that will bring its neck under the yoke of the king of Babylon and serve him, I will leave on its own land, to work it and dwell there, declares the Lord ."’"
verses.textEnNkjv: But the nations that bring their necks under the yoke of the king of Babylon and serve him, I will let them remain in their own land,’ says the Lord, ‘and they shall till it and dwell in it.’ " ’ "
verses.textEnNlt: But the people of any nation that submits to the king of Babylon will be allowed to stay in their own country to farm the land as usual. I, the Lord , have spoken!’"
verses.textEnNasb: But the nation that will bring its neck under the yoke of the king of Babylon and serve him, I will let remain on its land,’ declares the Lord, ‘and they will cultivate it and live in it.’ " ’ "
verses.textEn: But if any nation will bow its neck under the yoke of the king of Babylon and serve him, I will let that nation remain in its own land to till it and to live there, declares the Lord ." ’ "

verses.textZh: 我照着这一切话对犹大王西底家说："你们要把颈项放在巴比伦王的轭下，服事他和他的人民，就可以生存。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我照着这一切话对犹大王西底家说："你们要把颈项放在巴比伦王的轭下，服事他和他的人民，就可以生存。
