verses.textZhCuv: 我就照这一切的话对犹大王西底家说：「要把你们的颈项放在巴比伦王的轭下，服事他和他的百姓，便得存活。
verses.textEnNiv: I gave the same message to Zedekiah king of Judah. I said, "Bow your neck under the yoke of the king of Babylon; serve him and his people, and you will live.
verses.textEnEsv: To Zedekiah king of Judah I spoke in like manner: "Bring your necks under the yoke of the king of Babylon, and serve him and his people and live.
verses.textEnNkjv: I also spoke to Zedekiah king of Judah according to all these words, saying, "Bring your necks under the yoke of the king of Babylon, and serve him and his people, and live!
verses.textEnNlt: Then I repeated this same message to King Zedekiah of Judah. "If you want to live, submit to the yoke of the king of Babylon and his people.
verses.textEnNasb: I spoke words like all these to Zedekiah king of Judah, saying, "Bring your necks under the yoke of the king of Babylon and serve him and his people, and live!
verses.textEn: I gave the same message to Zedekiah king of Judah. I said, "Bow your neck under the yoke of the king of Babylon; serve him and his people, and you will live.

verses.textZh: 你和你的人民为甚么要因刀剑、饥荒和瘟疫而死，正如耶和华论到不肯服事巴比伦王的国家所说的一样呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 你和你的人民为甚么要因刀剑、饥荒和瘟疫而死，正如耶和华论到不肯服事巴比伦王的国家所说的一样呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 你和你的百姓为何要因刀剑、饥荒、瘟疫死亡，正如耶和华论到不服事巴比伦王的那国说的话呢？
verses.textEnNiv: Why will you and your people die by the sword, famine and plague with which the Lord has threatened any nation that will not serve the king of Babylon?
verses.textEnEsv: Why will you and your people die by the sword, by famine, and by pestilence, as the Lord has spoken concerning any nation that will not serve the king of Babylon?
verses.textEnNkjv: Why will you die, you and your people, by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence, as the Lord has spoken against the nation that will not serve the king of Babylon?
verses.textEnNlt: Why do you insist on dying—you and your people? Why should you choose war, famine, and disease, which the Lord will bring against every nation that refuses to submit to Babylon’s king?
verses.textEnNasb: Why should you die, you and your people, by the sword, famine, and plague, as the Lord has spoken to the nation that will not serve the king of Babylon?
verses.textEn: Why will you and your people die by the sword, famine and plague with which the Lord has threatened any nation that will not serve the king of Babylon?

verses.textZh: 不要听从那些对你们说‘你们必不会服事巴比伦王’的先知的话，因为他们向你们说的是虚假的预言。
verses.textZhCnvs: 不要听从那些对你们说‘你们必不会服事巴比伦王’的先知的话，因为他们向你们说的是虚假的预言。
verses.textZhCuv: 不可听那些先知对你们所说的话；他们说：『你们不致服事巴比伦王』，其实他们向你们说假预言。
verses.textEnNiv: Do not listen to the words of the prophets who say to you, ‘You will not serve the king of Babylon,’ for they are prophesying lies to you.
verses.textEnEsv: Do not listen to the words of the prophets who are saying to you, ‘You shall not serve the king of Babylon,’ for it is a lie that they are prophesying to you.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore do not listen to the words of the prophets who speak to you, saying, ‘You shall not serve the king of Babylon,’ for they prophesy a lie to you;
verses.textEnNlt: Do not listen to the false prophets who keep telling you, ‘The king of Babylon will not conquer you.’ They are liars.
verses.textEnNasb: So do not listen to the words of the prophets who talk to you, saying, ‘You will not serve the king of Babylon,’ for they are prophesying a lie to you;
verses.textEn: Do not listen to the words of the prophets who say to you, ‘You will not serve the king of Babylon,’ for they are prophesying lies to you.

verses.textZh: 我并没有差遣他们 ，他们却冒我的名说虚假的预言，以致我赶逐你们，使你们和那些向你们说虚假预言的先知都一同灭亡。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我并没有差遣他们 ，他们却冒我的名说虚假的预言，以致我赶逐你们，使你们和那些向你们说虚假预言的先知都一同灭亡。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华说：『我并没有打发他们，他们却托我的名说假预言，好使我将你们和向你们说预言的那些先知赶出去，一同灭亡。』」
verses.textEnNiv: ‘I have not sent them,’ declares the Lord . ‘They are prophesying lies in my name. Therefore, I will banish you and you will perish, both you and the prophets who prophesy to you.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: I have not sent them, declares the Lord , but they are prophesying falsely in my name, with the result that I will drive you out and you will perish, you and the prophets who are prophesying to you."
verses.textEnNkjv: for I have not sent them," says the Lord, "yet they prophesy a lie in My name, that I may drive you out, and that you may perish, you and the prophets who prophesy to you."
verses.textEnNlt: This is what the Lord says: ‘I have not sent these prophets! They are telling you lies in my name, so I will drive you from this land. You will all die—you and all these prophets, too.’"
verses.textEnNasb: for I have not sent them," declares the Lord, "but they are prophesying falsely in My name, so that I will drive you away and that you will perish, you and the prophets who prophesy to you."
verses.textEn: ‘I have not sent them,’ declares the Lord . ‘They are prophesying lies in my name. Therefore, I will banish you and you will perish, both you and the prophets who prophesy to you.’ "

verses.textZh: 我又对众祭司和这众民说："耶和华这样说：‘你们的先知对你们预言，说：耶和华殿中的器皿快要从巴比伦送回来了。他们的话，你们不要听从，因为他们对你们说的是虚假的预言。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我又对众祭司和这众民说："耶和华这样说：‘你们的先知对你们预言，说：耶和华殿中的器皿快要从巴比伦送回来了。他们的话，你们不要听从，因为他们对你们说的是虚假的预言。
verses.textZhCuv: 我又对祭司和这众民说：「耶和华如此说：你们不可听那先知对你们所说的预言。他们说：『耶和华殿中的器皿快要从巴比伦带回来』；其实他们向你们说假预言。
verses.textEnNiv: Then I said to the priests and all these people, "This is what the Lord says: Do not listen to the prophets who say, ‘Very soon now the articles from the Lord ’s house will be brought back from Babylon.’ They are prophesying lies to you.
verses.textEnEsv: Then I spoke to the priests and to all this people, saying, "Thus says the Lord : Do not listen to the words of your prophets who are prophesying to you, saying, ‘Behold, the vessels of the Lord ’s house will now shortly be brought back from Babylon,’ for it is a lie that they are prophesying to you.
verses.textEnNkjv: Also I spoke to the priests and to all this people, saying, "Thus says the Lord: ‘Do not listen to the words of your prophets who prophesy to you, saying, "Behold, the vessels of the Lord’s house will now shortly be brought back from Babylon"; for they prophesy a lie to you.
verses.textEnNlt: Then I spoke to the priests and the people and said, "This is what the Lord says: ‘Do not listen to your prophets who claim that soon the gold articles taken from my Temple will be returned from Babylon. It is all a lie!
verses.textEnNasb: Then I spoke to the priests and to all this people, saying: "This is what the Lord says: ‘Do not listen to the words of your prophets who prophesy to you, saying, "Behold, the vessels of the Lord’s house will now shortly be brought back from Babylon"; for they are prophesying a lie to you.
verses.textEn: Then I said to the priests and all these people, "This is what the Lord says: Do not listen to the prophets who say, ‘Very soon now the articles from the Lord ’s house will be brought back from Babylon.’ They are prophesying lies to you.

verses.textZh: 你们不要听从他们，只要服事巴比伦王，就可以生存。为甚么要使这城变为废墟呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们不要听从他们，只要服事巴比伦王，就可以生存。为甚么要使这城变为废墟呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 不可听从他们，只管服事巴比伦王便得存活。这城何致变为荒场呢？
verses.textEnNiv: Do not listen to them. Serve the king of Babylon, and you will live. Why should this city become a ruin?
verses.textEnEsv: Do not listen to them; serve the king of Babylon and live. Why should this city become a desolation?
verses.textEnNkjv: Do not listen to them; serve the king of Babylon, and live! Why should this city be laid waste?
verses.textEnNlt: Do not listen to them. Surrender to the king of Babylon, and you will live. Why should this whole city be destroyed?
verses.textEnNasb: Do not listen to them; serve the king of Babylon, and live! Why should this city become a place of ruins?
verses.textEn: Do not listen to them. Serve the king of Babylon, and you will live. Why should this city become a ruin?

verses.textZh: 如果他们是真先知，如果他们有耶和华的话，就让他们向万军之耶和华祈求，使那些留在耶和华殿中和犹大王宫中，以及在耶路撒冷中的器皿，不会被送到巴比伦去。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果他们是真先知，如果他们有耶和华的话，就让他们向万军之耶和华祈求，使那些留在耶和华殿中和犹大王宫中，以及在耶路撒冷中的器皿，不会被送到巴比伦去。’
verses.textZhCuv: 他们若果是先知，有耶和华的话临到他们，让他们祈求万军之耶和华，使那在耶和华殿中和犹大王宫内，并耶路撒冷剩下的器皿，不被带到巴比伦去。（
verses.textEnNiv: If they are prophets and have the word of the Lord , let them plead with the Lord Almighty that the articles remaining in the house of the Lord and in the palace of the king of Judah and in Jerusalem not be taken to Babylon.
verses.textEnEsv: If they are prophets, and if the word of the Lord is with them, then let them intercede with the Lord of hosts, that the vessels that are left in the house of the Lord , in the house of the king of Judah, and in Jerusalem may not go to Babylon.
verses.textEnNkjv: But if they are prophets, and if the word of the Lord is with them, let them now make intercession to the Lord of hosts, that the vessels which are left in the house of the Lord, in the house of the king of Judah, and at Jerusalem, do not go to Babylon.’
verses.textEnNlt: If they really are prophets and speak the Lord ’s messages, let them pray to the Lord of Heaven’s Armies. Let them pray that the articles remaining in the Lord ’s Temple and in the king’s palace and in the palaces of Jerusalem will not be carried away to Babylon!’
verses.textEnNasb: But if they are prophets, and if the word of the Lord is with them, have them now plead with the Lord of armies that the vessels which are left in the house of the Lord and the house of the king of Judah and in Jerusalem do not go to Babylon.
verses.textEn: If they are prophets and have the word of the Lord , let them plead with the Lord Almighty that the articles remaining in the house of the Lord and in the palace of the king of Judah and in Jerusalem not be taken to Babylon.

verses.textZh: 因为万军之耶和华这样说，论到这些柱子、铜海、盆座和留在这城其余的器皿，
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为万军之耶和华这样说，论到这些柱子、铜海、盆座和留在这城其余的器皿，
verses.textZhCuv: 因为万军之耶和华论到柱子、铜海、盆座，并剩在这城里的器皿，
verses.textEnNiv: For this is what the Lord Almighty says about the pillars, the bronze Sea, the movable stands and the other articles that are left in this city,
verses.textEnEsv: For thus says the Lord of hosts concerning the pillars, the sea, the stands, and the rest of the vessels that are left in this city,
verses.textEnNkjv: "For thus says the Lord of hosts concerning the pillars, concerning the Sea, concerning the carts, and concerning the remainder of the vessels that remain in this city,
verses.textEnNlt: "For the Lord of Heaven’s Armies has spoken about the pillars in front of the Temple, the great bronze basin called the Sea, the water carts, and all the other ceremonial articles.
verses.textEnNasb: For this is what the Lord of armies says concerning the pillars, concerning the sea, concerning the kettle stands, and concerning the rest of the vessels that are left in this city,
verses.textEn: For this is what the Lord Almighty says about the pillars, the bronze Sea, the movable stands and the other articles that are left in this city,

verses.textZh: 就是巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒把犹大王约雅敬的儿子耶哥尼雅，以及犹大和耶路撒冷所有的贵族，从耶路撒冷掳到巴比伦去的时候，没有拿走的器皿；
verses.textZhCnvs: 就是巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒把犹大王约雅敬的儿子耶哥尼雅，以及犹大和耶路撒冷所有的贵族，从耶路撒冷掳到巴比伦去的时候，没有拿走的器皿；
verses.textZhCuv: 就是巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒掳掠犹大王约雅敬的儿子耶哥尼雅，和犹大、耶路撒冷一切贵胄的时候所没有掠去的器皿。）
verses.textEnNiv: which Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon did not take away when he carried Jehoiachin son of Jehoiakim king of Judah into exile from Jerusalem to Babylon, along with all the nobles of Judah and Jerusalem—
verses.textEnEsv: which Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon did not take away, when he took into exile from Jerusalem to Babylon Jeconiah the son of Jehoiakim, king of Judah, and all the nobles of Judah and Jerusalem—
verses.textEnNkjv: which Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon did not take, when he carried away captive Jeconiah the son of Jehoiakim, king of Judah, from Jerusalem to Babylon, and all the nobles of Judah and Jerusalem—
verses.textEnNlt: King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylon left them here when he exiled Jehoiachin son of Jehoiakim, king of Judah, to Babylon, along with all the other nobles of Judah and Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNasb: which Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon did not take when he led into exile Jeconiah the son of Jehoiakim, king of Judah, from Jerusalem to Babylon, and all the nobles of Judah and Jerusalem—
verses.textEn: which Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon did not take away when he carried Jehoiachin son of Jehoiakim king of Judah into exile from Jerusalem to Babylon, along with all the nobles of Judah and Jerusalem—

verses.textZh: 论到那些留在耶和华殿中和犹大王宫中，以及在耶路撒冷中的器皿，万军之耶和华以色列的神这样说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 论到那些留在耶和华殿中和犹大王宫中，以及在耶路撒冷中的器皿，万军之耶和华以色列的神这样说：
verses.textZhCuv: 论到那在耶和华殿中和犹大王宫内，并耶路撒冷剩下的器皿，万军之耶和华－以色列的神如此说：
verses.textEnNiv: yes, this is what the Lord Almighty, the God of Israel, says about the things that are left in the house of the Lord and in the palace of the king of Judah and in Jerusalem:
verses.textEnEsv: thus says the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel, concerning the vessels that are left in the house of the Lord , in the house of the king of Judah, and in Jerusalem:
verses.textEnNkjv: yes, thus says the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel, concerning the vessels that remain in the house of the Lord, and in the house of the king of Judah and of Jerusalem:
verses.textEnNlt: Yes, this is what the Lord of Heaven’s Armies, the God of Israel, says about the precious things still in the Temple, in the palace of Judah’s king, and in Jerusalem:
verses.textEnNasb: Yes, this is what the Lord of armies, the God of Israel, says concerning the vessels that are left in the house of the Lord and in the house of the king of Judah and in Jerusalem:
verses.textEn: yes, this is what the Lord Almighty, the God of Israel, says about the things that are left in the house of the Lord and in the palace of the king of Judah and in Jerusalem:

verses.textZh: ‘这些器皿必被送到巴比伦，存在那里，直到我眷顾这些器皿的日子。那时，我必把它们带上来，放回这地方。’"这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: ‘这些器皿必被送到巴比伦，存在那里，直到我眷顾这些器皿的日子。那时，我必把它们带上来，放回这地方。’"这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 必被带到巴比伦存在那里，直到我眷顾以色列人的日子。那时，我必将这器皿带回来，交还此地。这是耶和华说的。」
verses.textEnNiv: ‘They will be taken to Babylon and there they will remain until the day I come for them,’ declares the Lord . ‘Then I will bring them back and restore them to this place.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: They shall be carried to Babylon and remain there until the day when I visit them, declares the Lord . Then I will bring them back and restore them to this place."
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘They shall be carried to Babylon, and there they shall be until the day that I visit them,’ says the Lord. ‘Then I will bring them up and restore them to this place.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: ‘They will all be carried away to Babylon and will stay there until I send for them,’ says the Lord . ‘Then I will bring them back to Jerusalem again.’"
verses.textEnNasb: "They will be brought to Babylon and will be there until the day I visit them," declares the Lord. "Then I will bring them back and restore them to this place." ’ "
verses.textEn: ‘They will be taken to Babylon and there they will remain until the day I come for them,’ declares the Lord . ‘Then I will bring them back and restore them to this place.’ "

verses.textZh: 当年，就是犹大王西底家开始执政的第四年五月，基遍人押朔的儿子哈拿尼雅先知，在耶和华殿中，当着祭司和众民的面前对我说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 当年，就是犹大王西底家开始执政的第四年五月，基遍人押朔的儿子哈拿尼雅先知，在耶和华殿中，当着祭司和众民的面前对我说：
verses.textZhCuv: 当年，就是犹大王西底家登基第四年五月，基遍人押朔的儿子，先知哈拿尼雅，在耶和华的殿中当着祭司和众民对我说：
verses.textEnNiv: In the fifth month of that same year, the fourth year, early in the reign of Zedekiah king of Judah, the prophet Hananiah son of Azzur, who was from Gibeon, said to me in the house of the Lord in the presence of the priests and all the people:
verses.textEnEsv: In that same year, at the beginning of the reign of Zedekiah king of Judah, in the fifth month of the fourth year, Hananiah the son of Azzur, the prophet from Gibeon, spoke to me in the house of the Lord , in the presence of the priests and all the people, saying,
verses.textEnNkjv: And it happened in the same year, at the beginning of the reign of Zedekiah king of Judah, in the fourth year and in the fifth month, that Hananiah the son of Azur the prophet, who was from Gibeon, spoke to me in the house of the Lord in the presence of the priests and of all the people, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: One day in late summer of that same year—the fourth year of the reign of Zedekiah, king of Judah—Hananiah son of Azzur, a prophet from Gibeon, addressed me publicly in the Temple while all the priests and people listened. He said,
verses.textEnNasb: Now in the same year, in the beginning of the reign of Zedekiah king of Judah, in the fourth year, in the fifth month, Hananiah the prophet the son of Azzur, who was from Gibeon, spoke to me at the house of the Lord in the sight of the priests and all the people, saying,
verses.textEn: In the fifth month of that same year, the fourth year, early in the reign of Zedekiah king of Judah, the prophet Hananiah son of Azzur, who was from Gibeon, said to me in the house of the Lord in the presence of the priests and all the people:

verses.textZh: "万军之耶和华以色列的神这样说：‘我已经折断了巴比伦王的轭。
verses.textZhCnvs: "万军之耶和华以色列的神这样说：‘我已经折断了巴比伦王的轭。
verses.textZhCuv: 「万军之耶和华－以色列的神如此说：我已经折断巴比伦王的轭。
verses.textEnNiv: "This is what the Lord Almighty, the God of Israel, says: ‘I will break the yoke of the king of Babylon.
verses.textEnEsv: "Thus says the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel: I have broken the yoke of the king of Babylon.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Thus speaks the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel, saying: ‘I have broken the yoke of the king of Babylon.
verses.textEnNlt: "This is what the Lord of Heaven’s Armies, the God of Israel, says: ‘I will remove the yoke of the king of Babylon from your necks.
verses.textEnNasb: "This is what the Lord of armies, the God of Israel says: ‘I have broken the yoke of the king of Babylon.
verses.textEn: "This is what the Lord Almighty, the God of Israel, says: ‘I will break the yoke of the king of Babylon.

verses.textZh: 在两年之内，我必把耶和华殿中的一切器皿，就是巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒从这地方掠到巴比伦去的，都带回这地方。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在两年之内，我必把耶和华殿中的一切器皿，就是巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒从这地方掠到巴比伦去的，都带回这地方。
verses.textZhCuv: 二年之内，我要将巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒从这地掠到巴比伦的器皿，就是耶和华殿中的一切器皿都带回此地。
verses.textEnNiv: Within two years I will bring back to this place all the articles of the Lord ’s house that Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon removed from here and took to Babylon.
verses.textEnEsv: Within two years I will bring back to this place all the vessels of the Lord ’s house, which Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon took away from this place and carried to Babylon.
verses.textEnNkjv: Within two full years I will bring back to this place all the vessels of the Lord’s house, that Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon took away from this place and carried to Babylon.
verses.textEnNlt: Within two years I will bring back all the Temple treasures that King Nebuchadnezzar carried off to Babylon.
verses.textEnNasb: Within two years I am going to bring back to this place all the vessels of the Lord’s house, which Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon took from this place and brought to Babylon.
verses.textEn: Within two years I will bring back to this place all the articles of the Lord ’s house that Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon removed from here and took to Babylon.

verses.textZh: 我也必把犹大王约雅敬的儿子耶哥尼雅，和所有被掳到巴比伦去的犹大人，都带回这地方，因为我必折断巴比伦王的轭。’这是耶和华的宣告。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我也必把犹大王约雅敬的儿子耶哥尼雅，和所有被掳到巴比伦去的犹大人，都带回这地方，因为我必折断巴比伦王的轭。’这是耶和华的宣告。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我又要将犹大王约雅敬的儿子耶哥尼雅和被掳到巴比伦去的一切犹大人带回此地，因为我要折断巴比伦王的轭。这是耶和华说的。」
verses.textEnNiv: I will also bring back to this place Jehoiachin son of Jehoiakim king of Judah and all the other exiles from Judah who went to Babylon,’ declares the Lord , ‘for I will break the yoke of the king of Babylon.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: I will also bring back to this place Jeconiah the son of Jehoiakim, king of Judah, and all the exiles from Judah who went to Babylon, declares the Lord , for I will break the yoke of the king of Babylon."
verses.textEnNkjv: And I will bring back to this place Jeconiah the son of Jehoiakim, king of Judah, with all the captives of Judah who went to Babylon,’ says the Lord, ‘for I will break the yoke of the king of Babylon.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: And I will bring back Jehoiachin son of Jehoiakim, king of Judah, and all the other captives that were taken to Babylon. I will surely break the yoke that the king of Babylon has put on your necks. I, the Lord , have spoken!’"
verses.textEnNasb: I am also going to bring back to this place Jeconiah the son of Jehoiakim, king of Judah, and all the exiles of Judah who went to Babylon,’ declares the Lord, ‘for I will break the yoke of the king of Babylon.’ "
verses.textEn: I will also bring back to this place Jehoiachin son of Jehoiakim king of Judah and all the other exiles from Judah who went to Babylon,’ declares the Lord , ‘for I will break the yoke of the king of Babylon.’ "

verses.textZh: 耶利米先知当着祭司和站在耶和华殿里的众民面前，对哈拿尼雅先知说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶利米先知当着祭司和站在耶和华殿里的众民面前，对哈拿尼雅先知说：
verses.textZhCuv: 先知耶利米当着祭司和站在耶和华殿里的众民对先知哈拿尼雅说：
verses.textEnNiv: Then the prophet Jeremiah replied to the prophet Hananiah before the priests and all the people who were standing in the house of the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: Then the prophet Jeremiah spoke to Hananiah the prophet in the presence of the priests and all the people who were standing in the house of the Lord ,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the prophet Jeremiah spoke to the prophet Hananiah in the presence of the priests and in the presence of all the people who stood in the house of the Lord,
verses.textEnNlt: Jeremiah responded to Hananiah as they stood in front of all the priests and people at the Temple.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Jeremiah the prophet spoke to the prophet Hananiah in the sight of the priests and in the sight of all the people who were standing at the house of the Lord,
verses.textEn: Then the prophet Jeremiah replied to the prophet Hananiah before the priests and all the people who were standing in the house of the Lord .

verses.textZh: "阿们！愿耶和华这样行，愿耶和华使你预言的话应验，把耶和华殿中的器皿和所有被掳的人，都从巴比伦带回这地方来。
verses.textZhCnvs: "阿们！愿耶和华这样行，愿耶和华使你预言的话应验，把耶和华殿中的器皿和所有被掳的人，都从巴比伦带回这地方来。
verses.textZhCuv: 「阿们！愿耶和华如此行，愿耶和华成就你所预言的话，将耶和华殿中的器皿和一切被掳去的人从巴比伦带回此地。
verses.textEnNiv: He said, "Amen! May the Lord do so! May the Lord fulfill the words you have prophesied by bringing the articles of the Lord ’s house and all the exiles back to this place from Babylon.
verses.textEnEsv: and the prophet Jeremiah said, "Amen! May the Lord do so; may the Lord make the words that you have prophesied come true, and bring back to this place from Babylon the vessels of the house of the Lord , and all the exiles.
verses.textEnNkjv: and the prophet Jeremiah said, "Amen! The Lord do so; the Lord perform your words which you have prophesied, to bring back the vessels of the Lord’s house and all who were carried away captive, from Babylon to this place.
verses.textEnNlt: He said, "Amen! May your prophecies come true! I hope the Lord does everything you say. I hope he does bring back from Babylon the treasures of this Temple and all the captives.
verses.textEnNasb: and Jeremiah the prophet said, "Amen! May the Lord do so; may the Lord fulfill your words which you have prophesied, to bring back the vessels of the Lord’s house and all the exiles, from Babylon to this place.
verses.textEn: He said, "Amen! May the Lord do so! May the Lord fulfill the words you have prophesied by bringing the articles of the Lord ’s house and all the exiles back to this place from Babylon.

verses.textZh: 不过，你应该听我向你和众民耳中所说的这话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 不过，你应该听我向你和众民耳中所说的这话。
verses.textZhCuv: 然而我向你和众民耳中所要说的话，你应当听。
verses.textEnNiv: Nevertheless, listen to what I have to say in your hearing and in the hearing of all the people:
verses.textEnEsv: Yet hear now this word that I speak in your hearing and in the hearing of all the people.
verses.textEnNkjv: Nevertheless hear now this word that I speak in your hearing and in the hearing of all the people:
verses.textEnNlt: But listen now to the solemn words I speak to you in the presence of all these people.
verses.textEnNasb: Yet hear now this word which I am going to speak so that you and all the people can hear it!
verses.textEn: Nevertheless, listen to what I have to say in your hearing and in the hearing of all the people:

verses.textZh: 自古以来，在你我以前的先知，已经预言有战争、灾祸和瘟疫要临到许多地方和强国。
verses.textZhCnvs: 自古以来，在你我以前的先知，已经预言有战争、灾祸和瘟疫要临到许多地方和强国。
verses.textZhCuv: 从古以来，在你我以前的先知，向多国和大邦说预言，论到争战、灾祸、瘟疫的事。
verses.textEnNiv: From early times the prophets who preceded you and me have prophesied war, disaster and plague against many countries and great kingdoms.
verses.textEnEsv: The prophets who preceded you and me from ancient times prophesied war, famine, and pestilence against many countries and great kingdoms.
verses.textEnNkjv: The prophets who have been before me and before you of old prophesied against many countries and great kingdoms—of war and disaster and pestilence.
verses.textEnNlt: The ancient prophets who preceded you and me spoke against many nations, always warning of war, disaster, and disease.
verses.textEnNasb: The prophets who were before me and before you from ancient times also prophesied against many lands and against great kingdoms regarding war, disaster, and plague.
verses.textEn: From early times the prophets who preceded you and me have prophesied war, disaster and plague against many countries and great kingdoms.

verses.textZh: 但预言平安的先知，除非他的话应验，人才会承认他确实是耶和华所差遣的先知。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 但预言平安的先知，除非他的话应验，人才会承认他确实是耶和华所差遣的先知。"
verses.textZhCuv: 先知预言的平安，到话语成就的时候，人便知道他真是耶和华所差来的。」
verses.textEnNiv: But the prophet who prophesies peace will be recognized as one truly sent by the Lord only if his prediction comes true."
verses.textEnEsv: As for the prophet who prophesies peace, when the word of that prophet comes to pass, then it will be known that the Lord has truly sent the prophet."
verses.textEnNkjv: As for the prophet who prophesies of peace, when the word of the prophet comes to pass, the prophet will be known as one whom the Lord has truly sent."
verses.textEnNlt: So a prophet who predicts peace must show he is right. Only when his predictions come true can we know that he is really from the Lord ."
verses.textEnNasb: As for the prophet who prophesies of peace, when the word of the prophet comes to pass, then that prophet will be known as one whom the Lord has truly sent."
verses.textEn: But the prophet who prophesies peace will be recognized as one truly sent by the Lord only if his prediction comes true."

verses.textZh: 于是哈拿尼雅先知把耶利米先知颈项上的轭取下来，折断了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是哈拿尼雅先知把耶利米先知颈项上的轭取下来，折断了。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是，先知哈拿尼雅将先知耶利米颈项上的轭取下来，折断了。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the prophet Hananiah took the yoke off the neck of the prophet Jeremiah and broke it,
verses.textEnEsv: Then the prophet Hananiah took the yoke-bars from the neck of Jeremiah the prophet and broke them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Hananiah the prophet took the yoke off the prophet Jeremiah’s neck and broke it.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Hananiah the prophet took the yoke off Jeremiah’s neck and broke it in pieces.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Hananiah the prophet took the yoke from the neck of Jeremiah the prophet and broke it.
verses.textEn: Then the prophet Hananiah took the yoke off the neck of the prophet Jeremiah and broke it,

verses.textZh: 哈拿尼雅又当着众民面前说："耶和华这样说：‘两年之内，我必这样从列国的颈项上，折断巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒的轭。’"于是耶利米先知就走了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 哈拿尼雅又当着众民面前说："耶和华这样说：‘两年之内，我必这样从列国的颈项上，折断巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒的轭。’"于是耶利米先知就走了。
verses.textZhCuv: 哈拿尼雅又当着众民说：「耶和华如此说：二年之内我必照样从列国人的颈项上折断巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒的轭。」于是先知耶利米就走了。
verses.textEnNiv: and he said before all the people, "This is what the Lord says: ‘In the same way I will break the yoke of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon off the neck of all the nations within two years.’ " At this, the prophet Jeremiah went on his way.
verses.textEnEsv: And Hananiah spoke in the presence of all the people, saying, "Thus says the Lord : Even so will I break the yoke of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon from the neck of all the nations within two years." But Jeremiah the prophet went his way.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Hananiah spoke in the presence of all the people, saying, "Thus says the Lord: ‘Even so I will break the yoke of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon from the neck of all nations within the space of two full years.’ " And the prophet Jeremiah went his way.
verses.textEnNlt: And Hananiah said again to the crowd that had gathered, "This is what the Lord says: ‘Just as this yoke has been broken, within two years I will break the yoke of oppression from all the nations now subject to King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylon.’" With that, Jeremiah left the Temple area.
verses.textEnNasb: Hananiah spoke in the sight of all the people, saying, "This is what the Lord says: ‘Even so within two full years I will break the yoke of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon from the neck of all the nations.’ " Then Jeremiah the prophet went his way.
verses.textEn: and he said before all the people, "This is what the Lord says: ‘In the same way I will break the yoke of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon off the neck of all the nations within two years.’ " At this, the prophet Jeremiah went on his way.

verses.textZh: 哈拿尼雅先知把耶利米先知颈项上的轭折断了以后，耶和华的话就临到耶利米，说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 哈拿尼雅先知把耶利米先知颈项上的轭折断了以后，耶和华的话就临到耶利米，说：
verses.textZhCuv: 先知哈拿尼雅把先知耶利米颈项上的轭折断以后，耶和华的话临到耶利米说：
verses.textEnNiv: After the prophet Hananiah had broken the yoke off the neck of the prophet Jeremiah, the word of the Lord came to Jeremiah:
verses.textEnEsv: Sometime after the prophet Hananiah had broken the yoke-bars from off the neck of Jeremiah the prophet, the word of the Lord came to Jeremiah:
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the word of the Lord came to Jeremiah, after Hananiah the prophet had broken the yoke from the neck of the prophet Jeremiah, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: Soon after this confrontation with Hananiah, the Lord gave this message to Jeremiah:
verses.textEnNasb: Then the word of the Lord came to Jeremiah after Hananiah the prophet had broken the yoke from the neck of Jeremiah the prophet, saying,
verses.textEn: After the prophet Hananiah had broken the yoke off the neck of the prophet Jeremiah, the word of the Lord came to Jeremiah:

verses.textZh: "你去告诉哈拿尼雅说：‘耶和华这样说：你折断了木轭，却要换来铁轭。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你去告诉哈拿尼雅说：‘耶和华这样说：你折断了木轭，却要换来铁轭。
verses.textZhCuv: 「你去告诉哈拿尼雅说，耶和华如此说：你折断木轭，却换了铁轭！
verses.textEnNiv: "Go and tell Hananiah, ‘This is what the Lord says: You have broken a wooden yoke, but in its place you will get a yoke of iron.
verses.textEnEsv: "Go, tell Hananiah, ‘Thus says the Lord : You have broken wooden bars, but you have made in their place bars of iron.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Go and tell Hananiah, saying, ‘Thus says the Lord: "You have broken the yokes of wood, but you have made in their place yokes of iron."
verses.textEnNlt: "Go and tell Hananiah, ‘This is what the Lord says: You have broken a wooden yoke, but you have replaced it with a yoke of iron.
verses.textEnNasb: "Go and speak to Hananiah, saying, ‘This is what the Lord says: "You have broken the yokes of wood, but in their place you have made yokes of iron."
verses.textEn: "Go and tell Hananiah, ‘This is what the Lord says: You have broken a wooden yoke, but in its place you will get a yoke of iron.

verses.textZh: 因为万军之耶和华以色列的神这样说：我要把铁轭套在这些国家的颈项上，使他们服事巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒；他们要服事他，连田野的走兽，我也交给他了。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为万军之耶和华以色列的神这样说：我要把铁轭套在这些国家的颈项上，使他们服事巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒；他们要服事他，连田野的走兽，我也交给他了。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 因为万军之耶和华－以色列的神如此说：我已将铁轭加在这些国的颈项上，使他们服事巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒，他们总要服事他；我也把田野的走兽给了他。」
verses.textEnNiv: This is what the Lord Almighty, the God of Israel, says: I will put an iron yoke on the necks of all these nations to make them serve Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and they will serve him. I will even give him control over the wild animals.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: For thus says the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel: I have put upon the neck of all these nations an iron yoke to serve Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and they shall serve him, for I have given to him even the beasts of the field.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: For thus says the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel: "I have put a yoke of iron on the neck of all these nations, that they may serve Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon; and they shall serve him. I have given him the beasts of the field also." ’ "
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord of Heaven’s Armies, the God of Israel, says: I have put a yoke of iron on the necks of all these nations, forcing them into slavery under King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylon. I have put everything, even the wild animals, under his control.’"
verses.textEnNasb: For this is what the Lord of armies, the God of Israel says: "I have put a yoke of iron on the neck of all these nations, to serve Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon; and they shall serve him. And I have also given him the animals of the field." ’ "
verses.textEn: This is what the Lord Almighty, the God of Israel, says: I will put an iron yoke on the necks of all these nations to make them serve Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and they will serve him. I will even give him control over the wild animals.’ "

verses.textZh: 耶利米先知就对哈拿尼雅先知说："哈拿尼雅啊！你要听，耶和华并没有差遣你，你竟使这人民信靠谎言。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶利米先知就对哈拿尼雅先知说："哈拿尼雅啊！你要听，耶和华并没有差遣你，你竟使这人民信靠谎言。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是先知耶利米对先知哈拿尼雅说：「哈拿尼雅啊，你应当听！耶和华并没有差遣你，你竟使这百姓倚靠谎言。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the prophet Jeremiah said to Hananiah the prophet, "Listen, Hananiah! The Lord has not sent you, yet you have persuaded this nation to trust in lies.
verses.textEnEsv: And Jeremiah the prophet said to the prophet Hananiah, "Listen, Hananiah, the Lord has not sent you, and you have made this people trust in a lie.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the prophet Jeremiah said to Hananiah the prophet, "Hear now, Hananiah, the Lord has not sent you, but you make this people trust in a lie.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Jeremiah the prophet said to Hananiah, "Listen, Hananiah! The Lord has not sent you, but the people believe your lies.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Jeremiah the prophet said to Hananiah the prophet, "Listen now, Hananiah: the Lord has not sent you, and you have made this people trust in a lie.
verses.textEn: Then the prophet Jeremiah said to Hananiah the prophet, "Listen, Hananiah! The Lord has not sent you, yet you have persuaded this nation to trust in lies.

verses.textZh: 因此耶和华这样说：‘看哪！我必使你离开人世；你今年一定死，因为你说了悖逆耶和华的话。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此耶和华这样说：‘看哪！我必使你离开人世；你今年一定死，因为你说了悖逆耶和华的话。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 所以耶和华如此说：看哪，我要叫你去世，你今年必死，因为你向耶和华说了叛逆的话。」
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore this is what the Lord says: ‘I am about to remove you from the face of the earth. This very year you are going to die, because you have preached rebellion against the Lord .’ "
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore thus says the Lord : ‘Behold, I will remove you from the face of the earth. This year you shall die, because you have uttered rebellion against the Lord .’"
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore thus says the Lord: ‘Behold, I will cast you from the face of the earth. This year you shall die, because you have taught rebellion against the Lord.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: Therefore, this is what the Lord says: ‘You must die. Your life will end this very year because you have rebelled against the Lord .’"
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore, this is what the Lord says: ‘Behold, I am going to remove you from the face of the earth. This year you are going to die, because you spoke falsely against the Lord.’ "
verses.textEn: Therefore this is what the Lord says: ‘I am about to remove you from the face of the earth. This very year you are going to die, because you have preached rebellion against the Lord .’ "

verses.textZh: 这样，在当年七月，哈拿尼雅先知就死了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这样，在当年七月，哈拿尼雅先知就死了。
verses.textZhCuv: 这样，先知哈拿尼雅当年七月间就死了。
verses.textEnNiv: In the seventh month of that same year, Hananiah the prophet died.
verses.textEnEsv: In that same year, in the seventh month, the prophet Hananiah died.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Hananiah the prophet died the same year in the seventh month.
verses.textEnNlt: Two months later the prophet Hananiah died.
verses.textEnNasb: So Hananiah the prophet died in the same year, in the seventh month.
verses.textEn: In the seventh month of that same year, Hananiah the prophet died.

verses.textZh: 以下这一封信，是耶利米先知从耶路撒冷寄给被掳的祭司、先知和众民，以及尚存的长老，就是尼布甲尼撒从耶路撒冷掳到巴比伦去的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以下这一封信，是耶利米先知从耶路撒冷寄给被掳的祭司、先知和众民，以及尚存的长老，就是尼布甲尼撒从耶路撒冷掳到巴比伦去的。
verses.textZhCuv: 先知耶利米从耶路撒冷寄信与被掳的祭司、先知，和众民，并生存的长老，就是尼布甲尼撒从耶路撒冷掳到巴比伦去的。（

verses.textEnEsv: These are the words of the letter that Jeremiah the prophet sent from Jerusalem to the surviving elders of the exiles, and to the priests, the prophets, and all the people, whom Nebuchadnezzar had taken into exile from Jerusalem to Babylon.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now these are the words of the letter that Jeremiah the prophet sent from Jerusalem to the remainder of the elders who were carried away captive—to the priests, the prophets, and all the people whom Nebuchadnezzar had carried away captive from Jerusalem to Babylon.
verses.textEnNlt: Jeremiah wrote a letter from Jerusalem to the elders, priests, prophets, and all the people who had been exiled to Babylon by King Nebuchadnezzar.
verses.textEnNasb: Now these are the words of the letter which Jeremiah the prophet sent from Jerusalem to the rest of the elders of the exile, the priests, the prophets, and all the people whom Nebuchadnezzar had taken into exile from Jerusalem to Babylon.
verses.textEn: This is the text of the letter that the prophet Jeremiah sent from Jerusalem to the surviving elders among the exiles and to the priests, the prophets and all the other people Nebuchadnezzar had carried into exile from Jerusalem to Babylon.

verses.textZh: 这是在耶哥尼雅王、太后、宫中的臣宰、犹大和耶路撒冷的领袖、工匠和铁匠从耶路撒冷被掳走以后。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这是在耶哥尼雅王、太后、宫中的臣宰、犹大和耶路撒冷的领袖、工匠和铁匠从耶路撒冷被掳走以后。
verses.textZhCuv: 这在耶哥尼雅王和太后、太监，并犹大、耶路撒冷的首领，以及工匠、铁匠都离了耶路撒冷以后。）
verses.textEnNiv: (This was after King Jehoiachin and the queen mother, the court officials and the leaders of Judah and Jerusalem, the skilled workers and the artisans had gone into exile from Jerusalem.)
verses.textEnEsv: This was after King Jeconiah and the queen mother, the eunuchs, the officials of Judah and Jerusalem, the craftsmen, and the metal workers had departed from Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNkjv: (This happened after Jeconiah the king, the queen mother, the eunuchs, the princes of Judah and Jerusalem, the craftsmen, and the smiths had departed from Jerusalem.)
verses.textEnNlt: This was after King Jehoiachin, the queen mother, the court officials, the other officials of Judah, and all the craftsmen and artisans had been deported from Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNasb: (This was after King Jeconiah and the queen mother, the high officials, the leaders of Judah and Jerusalem, the craftsmen, and the metalworkers had departed from Jerusalem.)
verses.textEn: (This was after King Jehoiachin and the queen mother, the court officials and the leaders of Judah and Jerusalem, the skilled workers and the artisans had gone into exile from Jerusalem.)

verses.textZh: 这封信是由沙番的儿子以利亚萨和希勒家的儿子基玛利带去的；他们是犹大王西底家差往巴比伦，去见巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒的。信上说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 这封信是由沙番的儿子以利亚萨和希勒家的儿子基玛利带去的；他们是犹大王西底家差往巴比伦，去见巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒的。信上说：
verses.textZhCuv: 他藉沙番的儿子以利亚萨和希勒家的儿子基玛利的手寄去。他们二人是犹大王西底家打发往巴比伦去见尼布甲尼撒王的。
verses.textEnNiv: He entrusted the letter to Elasah son of Shaphan and to Gemariah son of Hilkiah, whom Zedekiah king of Judah sent to King Nebuchadnezzar in Babylon. It said:
verses.textEnEsv: The letter was sent by the hand of Elasah the son of Shaphan and Gemariah the son of Hilkiah, whom Zedekiah king of Judah sent to Babylon to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon. It said:
verses.textEnNkjv: Theletterwassent by the hand of Elasah the son of Shaphan, and Gemariah the son of Hilkiah, whom Zedekiah king of Judah sent to Babylon, to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: He sent the letter with Elasah son of Shaphan and Gemariah son of Hilkiah when they went to Babylon as King Zedekiah’s ambassadors to Nebuchadnezzar. This is what Jeremiah’s letter said:
verses.textEnNasb: The letter was sent by the hand of Elasah the son of Shaphan and Gemariah the son of Hilkiah, whom Zedekiah king of Judah sent to Babylon to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, saying,
verses.textEn: He entrusted the letter to Elasah son of Shaphan and to Gemariah son of Hilkiah, whom Zedekiah king of Judah sent to King Nebuchadnezzar in Babylon. It said:

verses.textZh: "万军之耶和华以色列的神对所有被掳的，就是耶和华 把他们从耶路撒冷掳到巴比伦去的人，这样说：
verses.textZhCnvs: "万军之耶和华以色列的神对所有被掳的，就是耶和华 把他们从耶路撒冷掳到巴比伦去的人，这样说：
verses.textZhCuv: 信上说：「万军之耶和华－以色列的神对一切被掳去的（就是我使他们从耶路撒冷被掳到巴比伦的人）如此说：
verses.textEnNiv: This is what the Lord Almighty, the God of Israel, says to all those I carried into exile from Jerusalem to Babylon:
verses.textEnEsv: "Thus says the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel, to all the exiles whom I have sent into exile from Jerusalem to Babylon:
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus says the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel, to all who were carried away captive, whom I have caused to be carried away from Jerusalem to Babylon:
verses.textEnNlt: This is what the Lord of Heaven’s Armies, the God of Israel, says to all the captives he has exiled to Babylon from Jerusalem:
verses.textEnNasb: "This is what the Lord of armies, the God of Israel, says to all the exiles whom I have sent into exile from Jerusalem to Babylon:
verses.textEn: This is what the Lord Almighty, the God of Israel, says to all those I carried into exile from Jerusalem to Babylon:

verses.textZh: ‘你们要建造房屋，定居下来；要栽种园子，吃园中的果子。
verses.textZhCnvs: ‘你们要建造房屋，定居下来；要栽种园子，吃园中的果子。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要盖造房屋，住在其中；栽种田园，吃其中所产的；
verses.textEnNiv: "Build houses and settle down; plant gardens and eat what they produce.
verses.textEnEsv: Build houses and live in them; plant gardens and eat their produce.
verses.textEnNkjv: Build houses and dwell inthem; plant gardens and eat their fruit.
verses.textEnNlt: "Build homes, and plan to stay. Plant gardens, and eat the food they produce.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Build houses and live in them; and plant gardens and eat their produce.
verses.textEn: "Build houses and settle down; plant gardens and eat what they produce.

verses.textZh: 你们要娶妻，生养儿女；要为你们的儿子娶媳妇，把你们的女儿出嫁，好让他们也生养儿女。你们要在那里增多，不可减少。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要娶妻，生养儿女；要为你们的儿子娶媳妇，把你们的女儿出嫁，好让他们也生养儿女。你们要在那里增多，不可减少。
verses.textZhCuv: 娶妻生儿女，为你们的儿子娶妻，使你们的女儿嫁人，生儿养女。在那里生养众多，不致减少。
verses.textEnNiv: Marry and have sons and daughters; find wives for your sons and give your daughters in marriage, so that they too may have sons and daughters. Increase in number there; do not decrease.
verses.textEnEsv: Take wives and have sons and daughters; take wives for your sons, and give your daughters in marriage, that they may bear sons and daughters; multiply there, and do not decrease.
verses.textEnNkjv: Take wives and beget sons and daughters; and take wives for your sons and give your daughters to husbands, so that they may bear sons and daughters—that you may be increased there, and not diminished.
verses.textEnNlt: Marry and have children. Then find spouses for them so that you may have many grandchildren. Multiply! Do not dwindle away!
verses.textEnNasb: Take wives and father sons and daughters, and take wives for your sons and give your daughters to husbands, so that they may give birth to sons and daughters; and grow in numbers there and do not decrease.
verses.textEn: Marry and have sons and daughters; find wives for your sons and give your daughters in marriage, so that they too may have sons and daughters. Increase in number there; do not decrease.

verses.textZh: 我把你们掳到的那城，你们要为她求平安，为她向耶和华祈祷；因为她得平安，你们也得平安。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 我把你们掳到的那城，你们要为她求平安，为她向耶和华祈祷；因为她得平安，你们也得平安。’
verses.textZhCuv: 我所使你们被掳到的那城，你们要为那城求平安，为那城祷告耶和华；因为那城得平安，你们也随着得平安。
verses.textEnNiv: Also, seek the peace and prosperity of the city to which I have carried you into exile. Pray to the Lord for it, because if it prospers, you too will prosper."
verses.textEnEsv: But seek the welfare of the city where I have sent you into exile, and pray to the Lord on its behalf, for in its welfare you will find your welfare.
verses.textEnNkjv: And seek the peace of the city where I have caused you to be carried away captive, and pray to the Lord for it; for in its peace you will have peace.
verses.textEnNlt: And work for the peace and prosperity of the city where I sent you into exile. Pray to the Lord for it, for its welfare will determine your welfare."
verses.textEnNasb: Seek the prosperity of the city where I have sent you into exile, and pray to the Lord in its behalf; for in its prosperity will be your prosperity.’
verses.textEn: Also, seek the peace and prosperity of the city to which I have carried you into exile. Pray to the Lord for it, because if it prospers, you too will prosper."

verses.textZh: "万军之耶和华以色列的神这样说：‘不要被你们中间的先知和作占卜的欺骗，也不要听信自己所作的梦 。
verses.textZhCnvs: "万军之耶和华以色列的神这样说：‘不要被你们中间的先知和作占卜的欺骗，也不要听信自己所作的梦 。
verses.textZhCuv: 万军之耶和华－以色列的神如此说：不要被你们中间的先知和占卜的诱惑，也不要听信自己所做的梦；
verses.textEnNiv: Yes, this is what the Lord Almighty, the God of Israel, says: "Do not let the prophets and diviners among you deceive you. Do not listen to the dreams you encourage them to have.
verses.textEnEsv: For thus says the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel: Do not let your prophets and your diviners who are among you deceive you, and do not listen to the dreams that they dream,
verses.textEnNkjv: For thus says the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel: Do not let your prophets and your diviners who are in your midst deceive you, nor listen to your dreams which you cause to be dreamed.
verses.textEnNlt: This is what the Lord of Heaven’s Armies, the God of Israel, says: "Do not let your prophets and fortune-tellers who are with you in the land of Babylon trick you. Do not listen to their dreams,
verses.textEnNasb: For this is what the Lord of armies, the God of Israel says: ‘Do not let your prophets who are in your midst or your diviners deceive you, and do not listen to their interpretations of your dreams which you dream.
verses.textEn: Yes, this is what the Lord Almighty, the God of Israel, says: "Do not let the prophets and diviners among you deceive you. Do not listen to the dreams you encourage them to have.

verses.textZh: 因为他们冒我名对你们说虚假的预言，我并没有差派他们。’这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为他们冒我名对你们说虚假的预言，我并没有差派他们。’这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为他们托我的名对你们说假预言，我并没有差遣他们。这是耶和华说的。
verses.textEnNiv: They are prophesying lies to you in my name. I have not sent them," declares the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: for it is a lie that they are prophesying to you in my name; I did not send them, declares the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: For they prophesy falsely to you in My name; I have not sent them, says the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: because they are telling you lies in my name. I have not sent them," says the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: For they prophesy falsely to you in My name; I have not sent them,’ declares the Lord.
verses.textEn: They are prophesying lies to you in my name. I have not sent them," declares the Lord .

verses.textZh: "耶和华这样说：‘为巴比伦所定的七十年满了以后，我必眷顾你们，向你们实行我满有恩惠的诺言，把你们带回这地方来。
verses.textZhCnvs: "耶和华这样说：‘为巴比伦所定的七十年满了以后，我必眷顾你们，向你们实行我满有恩惠的诺言，把你们带回这地方来。
verses.textZhCuv: 「耶和华如此说：为巴比伦所定的七十年满了以后，我要眷顾你们，向你们成就我的恩言，使你们仍回此地。
verses.textEnNiv: This is what the Lord says: "When seventy years are completed for Babylon, I will come to you and fulfill my good promise to bring you back to this place.
verses.textEnEsv: "For thus says the Lord : When seventy years are completed for Babylon, I will visit you, and I will fulfill to you my promise and bring you back to this place.
verses.textEnNkjv: For thus says the Lord: After seventy years are completed at Babylon, I will visit you and perform My good word toward you, and cause you to return to this place.
verses.textEnNlt: This is what the Lord says: "You will be in Babylon for seventy years. But then I will come and do for you all the good things I have promised, and I will bring you home again.
verses.textEnNasb: "For this is what the Lord says: ‘When seventy years have been completed for Babylon, I will visit you and fulfill My good word to you, to bring you back to this place.
verses.textEn: This is what the Lord says: "When seventy years are completed for Babylon, I will come to you and fulfill my good promise to bring you back to this place.

verses.textZh: 因我自己知道我为你们所定的计划，是使你们得平安，而不是遭受灾祸的计划；要赐给你们美好的前程和盼望。’这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因我自己知道我为你们所定的计划，是使你们得平安，而不是遭受灾祸的计划；要赐给你们美好的前程和盼望。’这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华说：我知道我向你们所怀的意念是赐平安的意念，不是降灾祸的意念，要叫你们末后有指望。
verses.textEnNiv: For I know the plans I have for you," declares the Lord , "plans to prosper you and not to harm you, plans to give you hope and a future.
verses.textEnEsv: For I know the plans I have for you, declares the Lord , plans for welfare and not for evil, to give you a future and a hope.
verses.textEnNkjv: For I know the thoughts that I think toward you, says the Lord, thoughts of peace and not of evil, to give you a future and a hope.
verses.textEnNlt: For I know the plans I have for you," says the Lord . "They are plans for good and not for disaster, to give you a future and a hope.
verses.textEnNasb: For I know the plans that I have for you,’ declares the Lord, ‘plans for prosperity and not for disaster, to give you a future and a hope.
verses.textEn: For I know the plans I have for you," declares the Lord , "plans to prosper you and not to harm you, plans to give you hope and a future.

verses.textZh: ‘你们要呼求我，要来向我祷告，我就必应允你们。
verses.textZhCnvs: ‘你们要呼求我，要来向我祷告，我就必应允你们。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要呼求我，祷告我，我就应允你们。
verses.textEnNiv: Then you will call on me and come and pray to me, and I will listen to you.
verses.textEnEsv: Then you will call upon me and come and pray to me, and I will hear you.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then you will call upon Me and go and pray to Me, and I will listen to you.
verses.textEnNlt: In those days when you pray, I will listen.
verses.textEnNasb: Then you will call upon Me and come and pray to Me, and I will listen to you.
verses.textEn: Then you will call on me and come and pray to me, and I will listen to you.

verses.textZh: 你们要寻找我，只要一心寻求，就必寻见。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要寻找我，只要一心寻求，就必寻见。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们寻求我，若专心寻求我，就必寻见。
verses.textEnNiv: You will seek me and find me when you seek me with all your heart.
verses.textEnEsv: You will seek me and find me, when you seek me with all your heart.
verses.textEnNkjv: And you will seek Me and find Me, when you search for Me with all your heart.
verses.textEnNlt: If you look for me wholeheartedly, you will find me.
verses.textEnNasb: And you will seek Me and find Me when you search for Me with all your heart.
verses.textEn: You will seek me and find me when you seek me with all your heart.

verses.textZh: 我必给你们寻见 ；我必使你们被掳的归回，从我赶逐你们去的各国各地，把你们集合起来，带回我掳你们离开的地方去。’这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必给你们寻见 ；我必使你们被掳的归回，从我赶逐你们去的各国各地，把你们集合起来，带回我掳你们离开的地方去。’这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华说：我必被你们寻见，我也必使你们被掳的人归回，将你们从各国中和我所赶你们到的各处招聚了来，又将你们带回我使你们被掳掠离开的地方。这是耶和华说的。
verses.textEnNiv: I will be found by you," declares the Lord , "and will bring you back from captivity. I will gather you from all the nations and places where I have banished you," declares the Lord , "and will bring you back to the place from which I carried you into exile."
verses.textEnEsv: I will be found by you, declares the Lord , and I will restore your fortunes and gather you from all the nations and all the places where I have driven you, declares the Lord , and I will bring you back to the place from which I sent you into exile.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will be found by you, says the Lord, and I will bring you back from your captivity; I will gather you from all the nations and from all the places where I have driven you, says the Lord, and I will bring you to the place from which I cause you to be carried away captive.
verses.textEnNlt: I will be found by you," says the Lord . "I will end your captivity and restore your fortunes. I will gather you out of the nations where I sent you and will bring you home again to your own land."
verses.textEnNasb: I will let Myself be found by you,’ declares the Lord, ‘and I will restore your fortunes and gather you from all the nations and all the places where I have driven you,’ declares the Lord, ‘and I will bring you back to the place from where I sent you into exile.’
verses.textEn: I will be found by you," declares the Lord , "and will bring you back from captivity. I will gather you from all the nations and places where I have banished you," declares the Lord , "and will bring you back to the place from which I carried you into exile."

verses.textZh: "你们既然说：‘耶和华在巴比伦为我们兴起了先知’，
verses.textZhCnvs: "你们既然说：‘耶和华在巴比伦为我们兴起了先知’，
verses.textZhCuv: 「你们说：『耶和华在巴比伦为我们兴起先知』；
verses.textEnNiv: You may say, "The Lord has raised up prophets for us in Babylon,"
verses.textEnEsv: "Because you have said, ‘The Lord has raised up prophets for us in Babylon,’
verses.textEnNkjv: Because you have said, "The Lord has raised up prophets for us in Babylon"—
verses.textEnNlt: You claim that the Lord has raised up prophets for you in Babylon.
verses.textEnNasb: "Because you have said, ‘The Lord has raised up prophets for us in Babylon’—
verses.textEn: You may say, "The Lord has raised up prophets for us in Babylon,"

verses.textZh: 所以耶和华论到那坐大卫王位的君王和住在这城里的众民，就是没有和你们一同被掳去的众兄弟，这样说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以耶和华论到那坐大卫王位的君王和住在这城里的众民，就是没有和你们一同被掳去的众兄弟，这样说：
verses.textZhCuv: 所以耶和华论到坐大卫宝座的王和住在这城里的一切百姓，就是未曾与你们一同被掳的弟兄，
verses.textEnNiv: but this is what the Lord says about the king who sits on David’s throne and all the people who remain in this city, your fellow citizens who did not go with you into exile—
verses.textEnEsv: thus says the Lord concerning the king who sits on the throne of David, and concerning all the people who dwell in this city, your kinsmen who did not go out with you into exile:
verses.textEnNkjv: therefore thus says the Lord concerning the king who sits on the throne of David, concerning all the people who dwell in this city, and concerning your brethren who have not gone out with you into captivity—
verses.textEnNlt: But this is what the Lord says about the king who sits on David’s throne and all those still living here in Jerusalem—your relatives who were not exiled to Babylon.
verses.textEnNasb: for this is what the Lord says concerning the king who sits on the throne of David, and concerning all the people who live in this city, your brothers who did not go with you into exile—
verses.textEn: but this is what the Lord says about the king who sits on David’s throne and all the people who remain in this city, your fellow citizens who did not go with you into exile—

verses.textZh: ‘万军之耶和华这样说：看哪！我必打发刀剑、饥荒、瘟疫临到他们；我必使他们像腐烂的无花果，坏到不能吃。
verses.textZhCnvs: ‘万军之耶和华这样说：看哪！我必打发刀剑、饥荒、瘟疫临到他们；我必使他们像腐烂的无花果，坏到不能吃。
verses.textZhCuv: 万军之耶和华如此说：『看哪，我必使刀剑、饥荒、瘟疫临到他们，使他们像极坏的无花果，坏得不可吃。
verses.textEnNiv: yes, this is what the Lord Almighty says: "I will send the sword, famine and plague against them and I will make them like figs that are so bad they cannot be eaten.
verses.textEnEsv: ‘Thus says the Lord of hosts, behold, I am sending on them sword, famine, and pestilence, and I will make them like vile figs that are so rotten they cannot be eaten.
verses.textEnNkjv: thus says the Lord of hosts: Behold, I will send on them the sword, the famine, and the pestilence, and will make them like rotten figs that cannot be eaten, they are so bad.
verses.textEnNlt: This is what the Lord of Heaven’s Armies says: "I will send war, famine, and disease upon them and make them like bad figs, too rotten to eat.
verses.textEnNasb: this is what the Lord of armies says: ‘Behold, I am sending upon them the sword, famine, and plague; and I will make them like rotten figs that cannot be eaten due to rottenness.
verses.textEn: yes, this is what the Lord Almighty says: "I will send the sword, famine and plague against them and I will make them like figs that are so bad they cannot be eaten.

verses.textZh: 我必用刀剑、饥荒、瘟疫追赶他们，使他们成为地上万国所惊惧的，在我赶逐他们到的各国中，成为令人惊骇、被人咒骂、嗤笑、羞辱的对象。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必用刀剑、饥荒、瘟疫追赶他们，使他们成为地上万国所惊惧的，在我赶逐他们到的各国中，成为令人惊骇、被人咒骂、嗤笑、羞辱的对象。
verses.textZhCuv: 我必用刀剑、饥荒、瘟疫追赶他们，使他们在天下万国抛来抛去，在我所赶他们到的各国中，令人咒诅、惊骇、嗤笑、羞辱。
verses.textEnNiv: I will pursue them with the sword, famine and plague and will make them abhorrent to all the kingdoms of the earth, a curse and an object of horror, of scorn and reproach, among all the nations where I drive them.
verses.textEnEsv: I will pursue them with sword, famine, and pestilence, and will make them a horror to all the kingdoms of the earth, to be a curse, a terror, a hissing, and a reproach among all the nations where I have driven them,
verses.textEnNkjv: And I will pursue them with the sword, with famine, and with pestilence; and I will deliver them to trouble among all the kingdoms of the earth—to be a curse, an astonishment, a hissing, and a reproach among all the nations where I have driven them,
verses.textEnNlt: Yes, I will pursue them with war, famine, and disease, and I will scatter them around the world. In every nation where I send them, I will make them an object of damnation, horror, contempt, and mockery.
verses.textEnNasb: I will pursue them with the sword, with famine, and with plague; and I will make them an object of terror to all the kingdoms of the earth, to be a curse and an object of horror and hissing, and a disgrace among all the nations where I have driven them,
verses.textEn: I will pursue them with the sword, famine and plague and will make them abhorrent to all the kingdoms of the earth, a curse and an object of horror, of scorn and reproach, among all the nations where I drive them.

verses.textZh: 因为他们不听从我的话 ，就是我不断差遣到他们那里去，我的仆人众先知所说的话；同样，你们也没有听从。’这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为他们不听从我的话 ，就是我不断差遣到他们那里去，我的仆人众先知所说的话；同样，你们也没有听从。’这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华说：这是因为他们没有听从我的话，就是我从早起来差遣我仆人众先知去说的，无奈他们不听。这是耶和华说的。
verses.textEnNiv: For they have not listened to my words," declares the Lord , "words that I sent to them again and again by my servants the prophets. And you exiles have not listened either," declares the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: because they did not pay attention to my words, declares the Lord , that I persistently sent to you by my servants the prophets, but you would not listen, declares the Lord .’
verses.textEnNkjv: because they have not heeded My words, says the Lord, which I sent to them by My servants the prophets, rising up early and sending them; neither would you heed, says the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: For they refuse to listen to me, though I have spoken to them repeatedly through the prophets I sent. And you who are in exile have not listened either," says the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: because they have not listened to My words,’ declares the Lord, ‘which I sent to them again and again by My servants the prophets; but you did not listen,’ declares the Lord.
verses.textEn: For they have not listened to my words," declares the Lord , "words that I sent to them again and again by my servants the prophets. And you exiles have not listened either," declares the Lord .

verses.textZh: "你们这所有被掳去的，就是我从耶路撒冷赶逐到巴比伦去的，要听耶和华的话。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你们这所有被掳去的，就是我从耶路撒冷赶逐到巴比伦去的，要听耶和华的话。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以你们一切被掳去的，就是我从耶路撒冷打发到巴比伦去的，当听耶和华的话。』」
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore, hear the word of the Lord , all you exiles whom I have sent away from Jerusalem to Babylon.
verses.textEnEsv: Hear the word of the Lord , all you exiles whom I sent away from Jerusalem to Babylon:
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore hear the word of the Lord, all you of the captivity, whom I have sent from Jerusalem to Babylon.
verses.textEnNlt: Therefore, listen to this message from the Lord , all you captives there in Babylon.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘You, therefore, hear the word of the Lord, all you exiles, whom I have sent away from Jerusalem to Babylon.
verses.textEn: Therefore, hear the word of the Lord , all you exiles whom I have sent away from Jerusalem to Babylon.

verses.textZh: "万军之耶和华以色列的神这样说：‘论到冒我的名向你们说虚假预言的哥赖雅的儿子亚哈和玛西雅的儿子西底家，我要把他们交在巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒的手中，他要在你们眼前击杀他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: "万军之耶和华以色列的神这样说：‘论到冒我的名向你们说虚假预言的哥赖雅的儿子亚哈和玛西雅的儿子西底家，我要把他们交在巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒的手中，他要在你们眼前击杀他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 万军之耶和华－以色列的神论到哥赖雅的儿子亚哈，并玛西雅的儿子西底家，如此说：「他们是托我名向你们说假预言的，我必将他们交在巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒的手中；他要在你们眼前杀害他们。
verses.textEnNiv: This is what the Lord Almighty, the God of Israel, says about Ahab son of Kolaiah and Zedekiah son of Maaseiah, who are prophesying lies to you in my name: "I will deliver them into the hands of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and he will put them to death before your very eyes.
verses.textEnEsv: ‘Thus says the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel, concerning Ahab the son of Kolaiah and Zedekiah the son of Maaseiah, who are prophesying a lie to you in my name: Behold, I will deliver them into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and he shall strike them down before your eyes.
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus says the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel, concerning Ahab the son of Kolaiah, and Zedekiah the son of Maaseiah, who prophesy a lie to you in My name: Behold, I will deliver them into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and he shall slay them before your eyes.
verses.textEnNlt: This is what the Lord of Heaven’s Armies, the God of Israel, says about your prophets—Ahab son of Kolaiah and Zedekiah son of Maaseiah—who are telling you lies in my name: "I will turn them over to Nebuchadnezzar for execution before your eyes.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘This is what the Lord of armies, the God of Israel says concerning Ahab the son of Kolaiah and concerning Zedekiah the son of Maaseiah, who are prophesying to you falsely in My name: "Behold, I am going to hand them over to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and he will kill them before your eyes.
verses.textEn: This is what the Lord Almighty, the God of Israel, says about Ahab son of Kolaiah and Zedekiah son of Maaseiah, who are prophesying lies to you in my name: "I will deliver them into the hands of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and he will put them to death before your very eyes.

verses.textZh: 所有被掳到巴比伦的犹大人，都要因他们的遭遇这样咒诅人，说："愿耶和华使你像巴比伦王用火烧死的西底家和亚哈一样。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 所有被掳到巴比伦的犹大人，都要因他们的遭遇这样咒诅人，说："愿耶和华使你像巴比伦王用火烧死的西底家和亚哈一样。"
verses.textZhCuv: 住巴比伦一切被掳的犹大人必藉这二人赌咒说：『愿耶和华使你像巴比伦王在火中烧的西底家和亚哈一样。』
verses.textEnNiv: Because of them, all the exiles from Judah who are in Babylon will use this curse: ‘May the Lord treat you like Zedekiah and Ahab, whom the king of Babylon burned in the fire.’
verses.textEnEsv: Because of them this curse shall be used by all the exiles from Judah in Babylon: "The Lord make you like Zedekiah and Ahab, whom the king of Babylon roasted in the fire,"
verses.textEnNkjv: And because of them a curse shall be taken up by all the captivity of Judah who are in Babylon, saying, "The Lord make you like Zedekiah and Ahab, whom the king of Babylon roasted in the fire";
verses.textEnNlt: Their terrible fate will become proverbial, so that the Judean exiles will curse someone by saying, ‘May the Lord make you like Zedekiah and Ahab, whom the king of Babylon burned alive!’
verses.textEnNasb: Because of them a curse will be used by all the exiles from Judah who are in Babylon, saying, ‘May the Lord make you like Zedekiah and Ahab, whom the king of Babylon roasted in the fire,’
verses.textEn: Because of them, all the exiles from Judah who are in Babylon will use this curse: ‘May the Lord treat you like Zedekiah and Ahab, whom the king of Babylon burned in the fire.’

verses.textZh: 因为他们二人在以色列中行了无耻的事，他们和邻舍的妻子通奸，又冒我的名说虚假的话，是我没有吩咐他们说的。我知道一切，也可以作证。’这是耶和华的宣告。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为他们二人在以色列中行了无耻的事，他们和邻舍的妻子通奸，又冒我的名说虚假的话，是我没有吩咐他们说的。我知道一切，也可以作证。’这是耶和华的宣告。"
verses.textZhCuv: 这二人是在以色列中行了丑事，与邻舍的妻行淫，又假托我名说我未曾吩咐他们的话。知道的是我，作见证的也是我。这是耶和华说的。」
verses.textEnNiv: For they have done outrageous things in Israel; they have committed adultery with their neighbors’ wives, and in my name they have uttered lies—which I did not authorize. I know it and am a witness to it," declares the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: because they have done an outrageous thing in Israel, they have committed adultery with their neighbors’ wives, and they have spoken in my name lying words that I did not command them. I am the one who knows, and I am witness, declares the Lord .’"
verses.textEnNkjv: because they have done disgraceful things in Israel, have committed adultery with their neighbors’ wives, and have spoken lying words in My name, which I have not commanded them. Indeed I know, and am a witness, says the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: For these men have done terrible things among my people. They have committed adultery with their neighbors’ wives and have lied in my name, saying things I did not command. I am a witness to this. I, the Lord , have spoken."
verses.textEnNasb: because they acted foolishly in Israel, and committed adultery with their neighbors’ wives, and falsely spoke words in My name which I did not command them. I am He who knows, and a witness," declares the Lord.’ "
verses.textEn: For they have done outrageous things in Israel; they have committed adultery with their neighbors’ wives, and in my name they have uttered lies—which I did not authorize. I know it and am a witness to it," declares the Lord .

verses.textZh: ‘万军之耶和华以色列的神这样说：你曾用自己的名寄信给在耶路撒冷的众民、玛西雅祭司的儿子西番雅，和众祭司，说：
verses.textZhCnvs: ‘万军之耶和华以色列的神这样说：你曾用自己的名寄信给在耶路撒冷的众民、玛西雅祭司的儿子西番雅，和众祭司，说：
verses.textZhCuv: 万军之耶和华－以色列的神如此说：你曾用自己的名寄信给耶路撒冷的众民和祭司玛西雅的儿子西番雅，并众祭司，说：
verses.textEnNiv: "This is what the Lord Almighty, the God of Israel, says: You sent letters in your own name to all the people in Jerusalem, to the priest Zephaniah son of Maaseiah, and to all the other priests. You said to Zephaniah,
verses.textEnEsv: "Thus says the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel: You have sent letters in your name to all the people who are in Jerusalem, and to Zephaniah the son of Maaseiah the priest, and to all the priests, saying,
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus speaks the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel, saying: You have sent letters in your name to all the people who are at Jerusalem, to Zephaniah the son of Maaseiah the priest, and to all the priests, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: "This is what the Lord of Heaven’s Armies, the God of Israel, says: You wrote a letter on your own authority to Zephaniah son of Maaseiah, the priest, and you sent copies to the other priests and people in Jerusalem. You wrote to Zephaniah,
verses.textEnNasb: "This is what the Lord of armies, the God of Israel says: ‘Because you have sent letters in your own name to all the people who are in Jerusalem, and to the priest Zephaniah the son of Maaseiah, and to all the priests, saying,
verses.textEn: "This is what the Lord Almighty, the God of Israel, says: You sent letters in your own name to all the people in Jerusalem, to the priest Zephaniah son of Maaseiah, and to all the other priests. You said to Zephaniah,

verses.textZh: 耶和华已经立了你西番雅为祭司，代替耶何耶大，作耶和华殿中的总管，你就应把所有妄自说预言的人，都带上脚镣枷锁。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华已经立了你西番雅为祭司，代替耶何耶大，作耶和华殿中的总管，你就应把所有妄自说预言的人，都带上脚镣枷锁。
verses.textZhCuv: 『耶和华已经立你西番雅为祭司，代替祭司耶何耶大，使耶和华殿中有官长，好将一切狂妄自称为先知的人用枷枷住，用锁锁住。
verses.textEnNiv: ‘The Lord has appointed you priest in place of Jehoiada to be in charge of the house of the Lord ; you should put any maniac who acts like a prophet into the stocks and neck-irons.
verses.textEnEsv: ‘The Lord has made you priest instead of Jehoiada the priest, to have charge in the house of the Lord over every madman who prophesies, to put him in the stocks and neck irons.
verses.textEnNkjv: "The Lord has made you priest instead of Jehoiada the priest, so that there should be officers in the house of the Lord over every man who is demented and considers himself a prophet, that you should put him in prison and in the stocks.
verses.textEnNlt: "The Lord has appointed you to replace Jehoiada as the priest in charge of the house of the Lord . You are responsible to put into stocks and neck irons any crazy man who claims to be a prophet.
verses.textEnNasb: "The Lord has made you priest instead of Jehoiada the priest, to be the overseer of the house of the Lord for every insane person who prophesies, to put him in the stocks and in the iron collar.
verses.textEn: ‘The Lord has appointed you priest in place of Jehoiada to be in charge of the house of the Lord ; you should put any maniac who acts like a prophet into the stocks and neck-irons.

verses.textZh: 现在，亚拿突人耶利米向你们说预言，你为甚么不斥责他呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在，亚拿突人耶利米向你们说预言，你为甚么不斥责他呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 现在亚拿突人耶利米向你们自称为先知，你们为何没有责备他呢？
verses.textEnNiv: So why have you not reprimanded Jeremiah from Anathoth, who poses as a prophet among you?
verses.textEnEsv: Now why have you not rebuked Jeremiah of Anathoth who is prophesying to you?
verses.textEnNkjv: Now therefore, why have you not rebuked Jeremiah of Anathoth who makes himself a prophet to you?
verses.textEnNlt: So why have you done nothing to stop Jeremiah from Anathoth, who pretends to be a prophet among you?
verses.textEnNasb: So now, why have you not rebuked Jeremiah of Anathoth who prophesies to you,
verses.textEn: So why have you not reprimanded Jeremiah from Anathoth, who poses as a prophet among you?

verses.textZh: 因为他寄信给我们在巴比伦的人说：被掳的时期必会长久，所以你们要建造房屋，定居下来，也要栽植园子，吃园中的果子。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为他寄信给我们在巴比伦的人说：被掳的时期必会长久，所以你们要建造房屋，定居下来，也要栽植园子，吃园中的果子。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 因为他寄信给我们在巴比伦的人说：被掳的事必长久。你们要盖造房屋，住在其中；栽种田园，吃其中所产的。』」
verses.textEnNiv: He has sent this message to us in Babylon: It will be a long time. Therefore build houses and settle down; plant gardens and eat what they produce.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: For he has sent to us in Babylon, saying, "Your exile will be long; build houses and live in them, and plant gardens and eat their produce."’"
verses.textEnNkjv: For he has sent to us in Babylon, saying, ‘This captivityis long; build houses and dwell inthem, and plant gardens and eat their fruit.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: Jeremiah sent a letter here to Babylon, predicting that our captivity will be a long one. He said, ‘Build homes, and plan to stay. Plant gardens, and eat the food they produce.’"
verses.textEnNasb: seeing that he has sent word to us in Babylon, saying, ‘ The exile will be long; build houses and live in them, and plant gardens and eat their produce’ ?" ’ "
verses.textEn: He has sent this message to us in Babylon: It will be a long time. Therefore build houses and settle down; plant gardens and eat what they produce.’ "

verses.textZh: 所以耶和华这样说：看哪！我必惩罚尼希兰人示玛雅和他的后代；他必不会有子孙住在这人民中间，也必不能看见我要为我的子民所作的美事，因为他说了悖逆耶和华的话。’"这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以耶和华这样说：看哪！我必惩罚尼希兰人示玛雅和他的后代；他必不会有子孙住在这人民中间，也必不能看见我要为我的子民所作的美事，因为他说了悖逆耶和华的话。’"这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 「你当寄信给一切被掳的人说：『耶和华论到尼希兰人示玛雅说：因为示玛雅向你们说预言，我并没有差遣他，他使你们倚靠谎言；
verses.textEnNiv: "Send this message to all the exiles: ‘This is what the Lord says about Shemaiah the Nehelamite: Because Shemaiah has prophesied to you, even though I did not send him, and has persuaded you to trust in lies,
verses.textEnEsv: "Send to all the exiles, saying, ‘Thus says the Lord concerning Shemaiah of Nehelam: Because Shemaiah had prophesied to you when I did not send him, and has made you trust in a lie,
verses.textEnNkjv: Send to all those in captivity, saying, Thus says the Lord concerning Shemaiah the Nehelamite: Because Shemaiah has prophesied to you, and I have not sent him, and he has caused you to trust in a lie—
verses.textEnNlt: "Send an open letter to all the exiles in Babylon. Tell them, ‘This is what the Lord says concerning Shemaiah the Nehelamite: Since he has prophesied to you when I did not send him and has tricked you into believing his lies,
verses.textEnNasb: "Send word to all the exiles, saying, ‘This is what the Lord says concerning Shemaiah the Nehelamite: "Because Shemaiah has prophesied to you, although I did not send him, and he has made you trust in a lie,"
verses.textEn: "Send this message to all the exiles: ‘This is what the Lord says about Shemaiah the Nehelamite: Because Shemaiah has prophesied to you, even though I did not send him, and has persuaded you to trust in lies,

verses.textZhCnvs: 所以耶和华如此说：我必刑罚尼希兰人示玛雅和他的后裔，他必无一人存留住在这民中，也不得见我所要赐与我百姓的福乐，因为他向耶和华说了叛逆的话。这是耶和华说的。』」
verses.textZhCuv: 所以耶和华如此说：我必刑罚尼希兰人示玛雅和他的后裔，他必无一人存留住在这民中，也不得见我所要赐与我百姓的福乐，因为他向耶和华说了叛逆的话。这是耶和华说的。』」
verses.textEnNiv: this is what the Lord says: I will surely punish Shemaiah the Nehelamite and his descendants. He will have no one left among this people, nor will he see the good things I will do for my people, declares the Lord , because he has preached rebellion against me.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: therefore thus says the Lord : Behold, I will punish Shemaiah of Nehelam and his descendants. He shall not have anyone living among this people, and he shall not see the good that I will do to my people, declares the Lord , for he has spoken rebellion against the Lord .’"
verses.textEnNkjv: therefore thus says the Lord: Behold, I will punish Shemaiah the Nehelamite and his family: he shall not have anyone to dwell among this people, nor shall he see the good that I will do for My people, says the Lord, because he has taught rebellion against the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: I will punish him and his family. None of his descendants will see the good things I will do for my people, for he has incited you to rebel against me. I, the Lord , have spoken!’"

verses.textZh: "耶和华以色列的神这样说：‘你要把我对你说过的一切话都写在书上。
verses.textZhCnvs: "耶和华以色列的神这样说：‘你要把我对你说过的一切话都写在书上。
verses.textZhCuv: 「耶和华－以色列的神如此说：你将我对你说过的一切话都写在书上。
verses.textEnNiv: "This is what the Lord , the God of Israel, says: ‘Write in a book all the words I have spoken to you.
verses.textEnEsv: "Thus says the Lord , the God of Israel: Write in a book all the words that I have spoken to you.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Thus speaks the Lord God of Israel, saying: ‘Write in a book for yourself all the words that I have spoken to you.
verses.textEnNlt: "This is what the Lord , the God of Israel, says: Write down for the record everything I have said to you, Jeremiah.
verses.textEnNasb: "This is what the Lord, the God of Israel says: ‘Write all the words which I have spoken to you in a book.
verses.textEn: "This is what the Lord , the God of Israel, says: ‘Write in a book all the words I have spoken to you.

verses.textZh: 看哪！日子快到 ，我必使我的子民以色列和犹大被掳的人归回。’耶和华说：‘我必使他们回到我赐给他们列祖之地，他们要重得这地为业。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 看哪！日子快到 ，我必使我的子民以色列和犹大被掳的人归回。’耶和华说：‘我必使他们回到我赐给他们列祖之地，他们要重得这地为业。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华说：日子将到，我要使我的百姓以色列和犹大被掳的人归回；我也要使他们回到我所赐给他们列祖之地，他们就得这地为业。这是耶和华说的。」
verses.textEnNiv: The days are coming,’ declares the Lord , ‘when I will bring my people Israel and Judah back from captivity and restore them to the land I gave their ancestors to possess,’ says the Lord ."
verses.textEnEsv: For behold, days are coming, declares the Lord , when I will restore the fortunes of my people, Israel and Judah, says the Lord , and I will bring them back to the land that I gave to their fathers, and they shall take possession of it."
verses.textEnNkjv: For behold, the days are coming,’ says the Lord, ‘that I will bring back from captivity My people Israel and Judah,’ says the Lord. ‘And I will cause them to return to the land that I gave to their fathers, and they shall possess it.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: For the time is coming when I will restore the fortunes of my people of Israel and Judah. I will bring them home to this land that I gave to their ancestors, and they will possess it again. I, the Lord , have spoken!"
verses.textEnNasb: For behold, days are coming,’ declares the Lord, ‘when I will restore the fortunes of My people Israel and Judah.’ The Lord says, ‘I will also bring them back to the land that I gave to their forefathers, and they shall take possession of it.’ "
verses.textEn: The days are coming,’ declares the Lord , ‘when I will bring my people Israel and Judah back from captivity and restore them to the land I gave their ancestors to possess,’ says the Lord ."

verses.textEnNlt: This is the message the Lord gave concerning Israel and Judah.

verses.textZh: "耶和华这样说： ‘我听见了战栗喊叫的声音， 一片恐慌，没有平安。
verses.textZhCnvs: "耶和华这样说： ‘我听见了战栗喊叫的声音， 一片恐慌，没有平安。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华如此说：我们听见声音， 是战抖惧怕而不平安的声音。
verses.textEnNiv: "This is what the Lord says: " ‘Cries of fear are heard— terror, not peace.
verses.textEnEsv: "Thus says the Lord : We have heard a cry of panic, of terror, and no peace.
verses.textEnNkjv: "For thus says the Lord: ‘We have heard a voice of trembling, Of fear, and not of peace.
verses.textEnNlt: This is what the Lord says: "I hear cries of fear; there is terror and no peace.
verses.textEnNasb: "For this is what the Lord says: ‘ I have heard a sound of terror, Of fear, and there is no peace.
verses.textEn: "This is what the Lord says: " ‘Cries of fear are heard— terror, not peace.

verses.textZh: 你们去问问，去看看： 男人会生孩子吗？ 为甚么我看见所有的壮汉， 都用手抱着腹部，像正在生产的妇人， 每张脸都变成苍白呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们去问问，去看看： 男人会生孩子吗？ 为甚么我看见所有的壮汉， 都用手抱着腹部，像正在生产的妇人， 每张脸都变成苍白呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 你们且访问看看， 男人有产难吗？ 我怎么看见人人用手掐腰， 像产难的妇人， 脸面都变青了呢？
verses.textEnNiv: Ask and see: Can a man bear children? Then why do I see every strong man with his hands on his stomach like a woman in labor, every face turned deathly pale?
verses.textEnEsv: Ask now, and see, can a man bear a child? Why then do I see every man with his hands on his stomach like a woman in labor? Why has every face turned pale?
verses.textEnNkjv: Ask now, and see, Whether a man is ever in labor with child? So why do I see every man with his hands on his loins Like a woman in labor, And all faces turned pale?
verses.textEnNlt: Now let me ask you a question: Do men give birth to babies? Then why do they stand there, ashen-faced, hands pressed against their sides like a woman in labor?
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Ask now, and see If a male can give birth. Why do I see every man With his hands on his waist, as a woman in childbirth? And why have all faces turned pale?
verses.textEn: Ask and see: Can a man bear children? Then why do I see every strong man with his hands on his stomach like a woman in labor, every face turned deathly pale?

verses.textZh: 哀哉！那日大而可畏， 无可比拟； 这是雅各受苦的时期， 但他必被救出来。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 哀哉！那日大而可畏， 无可比拟； 这是雅各受苦的时期， 但他必被救出来。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 哀哉！那日为大， 无日可比； 这是雅各遭难的时候， 但他必被救出来。
verses.textEnNiv: How awful that day will be! No other will be like it. It will be a time of trouble for Jacob, but he will be saved out of it.
verses.textEnEsv: Alas! That day is so great there is none like it; it is a time of distress for Jacob; yet he shall be saved out of it.
verses.textEnNkjv: Alas! For that day is great, So that none is like it; And it is the time of Jacob’s trouble, But he shall be saved out of it.
verses.textEnNlt: In all history there has never been such a time of terror. It will be a time of trouble for my people Israel. Yet in the end they will be saved!
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Woe, for that day is great, There is none like it; And it is the time of Jacob’s distress, Yet he will be saved from it.
verses.textEn: How awful that day will be! No other will be like it. It will be a time of trouble for Jacob, but he will be saved out of it.

verses.textZh: "万军之耶和华宣告说：‘当那日，我必从他们 的颈项上折断仇敌的轭，扯断他们 的绳套；他们必不再作外族人的奴隶。
verses.textZhCnvs: "万军之耶和华宣告说：‘当那日，我必从他们 的颈项上折断仇敌的轭，扯断他们 的绳套；他们必不再作外族人的奴隶。
verses.textZhCuv: 万军之耶和华说：「到那日，我必从你颈项上折断仇敌的轭，扭开他的绳索；外邦人不得再使你作他们的奴仆。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘In that day,’ declares the Lord Almighty, ‘I will break the yoke off their necks and will tear off their bonds; no longer will foreigners enslave them.
verses.textEnEsv: "And it shall come to pass in that day, declares the Lord of hosts, that I will break his yoke from off your neck, and I will burst your bonds, and foreigners shall no more make a servant of him.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘For it shall come to pass in that day,’ Says the Lord of hosts, ‘That I will break his yoke from your neck, And will burst your bonds; Foreigners shall no more enslave them.
verses.textEnNlt: For in that day," says the Lord of Heaven’s Armies, "I will break the yoke from their necks and snap their chains. Foreigners will no longer be their masters.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘It shall come about on that day,’ declares the Lord of armies, ‘that I will break his yoke from their necks and will tear to pieces their restraints; and strangers will no longer make them their slaves.
