verses.textEn: " ‘In that day,’ declares the Lord Almighty, ‘I will break the yoke off their necks and will tear off their bonds; no longer will foreigners enslave them.

verses.textZh: 他们却要事奉耶和华他们的神，和我为他们兴起的大卫王。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们却要事奉耶和华他们的神，和我为他们兴起的大卫王。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们却要事奉耶和华－你们的神和我为你们所要兴起的王大卫。」
verses.textEnNiv: Instead, they will serve the Lord their God and David their king, whom I will raise up for them.
verses.textEnEsv: But they shall serve the Lord their God and David their king, whom I will raise up for them.
verses.textEnNkjv: But they shall serve the Lord their God, And David their king, Whom I will raise up for them.
verses.textEnNlt: For my people will serve the Lord their God and their king descended from David— the king I will raise up for them.
verses.textEnNasb: But they shall serve the Lord their God and David their king, whom I will raise up for them.
verses.textEn: Instead, they will serve the Lord their God and David their king, whom I will raise up for them.

verses.textZh: 所以，我的仆人雅各啊！你不要惧怕。’ 这是耶和华的宣告。 ‘以色列啊！你不要惊慌。 因为我必拯救你从远方回来， 必拯救你的后裔脱离他们被掳之地。 雅各必归回，得享平静安逸， 没有人可以使他害怕。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以，我的仆人雅各啊！你不要惧怕。’ 这是耶和华的宣告。 ‘以色列啊！你不要惊慌。 因为我必拯救你从远方回来， 必拯救你的后裔脱离他们被掳之地。 雅各必归回，得享平静安逸， 没有人可以使他害怕。
verses.textZhCuv: 故此，耶和华说： 我的仆人雅各啊，不要惧怕； 以色列啊，不要惊惶； 因我要从远方拯救你， 从被掳到之地拯救你的后裔； 雅各必回来得享平靖安逸， 无人使他害怕。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘So do not be afraid, Jacob my servant; do not be dismayed, Israel,’ declares the Lord . ‘I will surely save you out of a distant place, your descendants from the land of their exile. Jacob will again have peace and security, and no one will make him afraid.
verses.textEnEsv: "Then fear not, O Jacob my servant, declares the Lord , nor be dismayed, O Israel; for behold, I will save you from far away, and your offspring from the land of their captivity. Jacob shall return and have quiet and ease, and none shall make him afraid.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘Therefore do not fear, O My servant Jacob,’ says the Lord, ‘Nor be dismayed, O Israel; For behold, I will save you from afar, And your seed from the land of their captivity. Jacob shall return, have rest and be quiet, And no one shall make him afraid.
verses.textEnNlt: "So do not be afraid, Jacob, my servant; do not be dismayed, Israel," says the Lord . "For I will bring you home again from distant lands, and your children will return from their exile. Israel will return to a life of peace and quiet, and no one will terrorize them.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘And do not fear, Jacob My servant,’ declares the Lord, ‘And do not be dismayed, Israel; For behold, I am going to save you from far away, And your descendants from the land of their captivity. And Jacob will return and be at peace, without anxiety, And no one will make him afraid.
verses.textEn: " ‘So do not be afraid, Jacob my servant; do not be dismayed, Israel,’ declares the Lord . ‘I will surely save you out of a distant place, your descendants from the land of their exile. Jacob will again have peace and security, and no one will make him afraid.

verses.textZh: 因为我与你同在， 要拯救你； 我要消灭我赶散你去的列国， 却必不消灭你。 我要按公正惩治你， 决不能免你受罚。’" 这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为我与你同在， 要拯救你； 我要消灭我赶散你去的列国， 却必不消灭你。 我要按公正惩治你， 决不能免你受罚。’" 这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 因我与你同在，要拯救你， 也要将所赶散你到的那些国灭绝净尽， 却不将你灭绝净尽，倒要从宽惩治你， 万不能不罚你 。 这是耶和华说的。
verses.textEnNiv: I am with you and will save you,’ declares the Lord . ‘Though I completely destroy all the nations among which I scatter you, I will not completely destroy you. I will discipline you but only in due measure; I will not let you go entirely unpunished.’
verses.textEnEsv: For I am with you to save you, declares the Lord ; I will make a full end of all the nations among whom I scattered you, but of you I will not make a full end. I will discipline you in just measure, and I will by no means leave you unpunished.
verses.textEnNkjv: For I am with you,’ says the Lord, ‘to save you; Though I make a full end of all nations where I have scattered you, Yet I will not make a complete end of you. But I will correct you in justice, And will not let you go altogether unpunished.’
verses.textEnNlt: For I am with you and will save you," says the Lord . "I will completely destroy the nations where I have scattered you, but I will not completely destroy you. I will discipline you, but with justice; I cannot let you go unpunished."
verses.textEnNasb: ‘For I am with you,’ declares the Lord, ‘to save you; For I will completely destroy all the nations where I have scattered you, Only I will not destroy you completely. But I will discipline you fairly And will by no means leave you unpunished.’
verses.textEn: I am with you and will save you,’ declares the Lord . ‘Though I completely destroy all the nations among which I scatter you, I will not completely destroy you. I will discipline you but only in due measure; I will not let you go entirely unpunished.’

verses.textZh: "耶和华这样说： ‘你的损伤无法痊愈， 你的创伤不能医治。
verses.textZhCnvs: "耶和华这样说： ‘你的损伤无法痊愈， 你的创伤不能医治。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华如此说： 你的损伤无法医治； 你的伤痕极其重大。
verses.textEnNiv: "This is what the Lord says: " ‘Your wound is incurable, your injury beyond healing.
verses.textEnEsv: "For thus says the Lord : Your hurt is incurable, and your wound is grievous.
verses.textEnNkjv: "For thus says the Lord: ‘Your affliction is incurable, Your wound is severe.
verses.textEnNlt: This is what the Lord says: "Your injury is incurable— a terrible wound.
verses.textEnNasb: "For this is what the Lord says: ‘Your broken limb is irreparable, And your wound is incurable.
verses.textEn: "This is what the Lord says: " ‘Your wound is incurable, your injury beyond healing.

verses.textZh: 没有人为你申诉， 你的伤处无药可救， 你不得医治。
verses.textZhCnvs: 没有人为你申诉， 你的伤处无药可救， 你不得医治。
verses.textZhCuv: 无人为你分诉， 使你的伤痕得以缠裹； 你没有医治的良药。
verses.textEnNiv: There is no one to plead your cause, no remedy for your sore, no healing for you.
verses.textEnEsv: There is none to uphold your cause, no medicine for your wound, no healing for you.
verses.textEnNkjv: Thereis no one to plead your cause, That you may be bound up; You have no healing medicines.
verses.textEnNlt: There is no one to help you or to bind up your injury. No medicine can heal you.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘There is no one to plead your cause; No healing for your sore, No recovery for you.
verses.textEn: There is no one to plead your cause, no remedy for your sore, no healing for you.

verses.textZh: 你所有的盟友都忘记了你， 不再关心你； 我击打了你，好象仇敌击打你， 又好象残暴的人惩罚你一样； 都因你的罪孽甚多， 你的罪恶无数。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你所有的盟友都忘记了你， 不再关心你； 我击打了你，好象仇敌击打你， 又好象残暴的人惩罚你一样； 都因你的罪孽甚多， 你的罪恶无数。
verses.textZhCuv: 你所亲爱的都忘记你， 不来探问 你。 我因你的罪孽甚大，罪恶众多， 曾用仇敌加的伤害伤害你， 用残忍者的惩治惩治你。
verses.textEnNiv: All your allies have forgotten you; they care nothing for you. I have struck you as an enemy would and punished you as would the cruel, because your guilt is so great and your sins so many.
verses.textEnEsv: All your lovers have forgotten you; they care nothing for you; for I have dealt you the blow of an enemy, the punishment of a merciless foe, because your guilt is great, because your sins are flagrant.
verses.textEnNkjv: All your lovers have forgotten you; They do not seek you; For I have wounded you with the wound of an enemy, With the chastisement of a cruel one, For the multitude of your iniquities, Because your sins have increased.
verses.textEnNlt: All your lovers—your allies—have left you and do not care about you anymore. I have wounded you cruelly, as though I were your enemy. For your sins are many, and your guilt is great.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘All your lovers have forgotten you, They do not seek you; For I have wounded you with the wound of an enemy, With the punishment of a cruel one, Because your wrongdoing is great, And your sins are numerous.
verses.textEn: All your allies have forgotten you; they care nothing for you. I have struck you as an enemy would and punished you as would the cruel, because your guilt is so great and your sins so many.

verses.textZh: 你为甚么因你的损伤哀叫呢？ 你的病痛无法痊愈。 我这样对你， 是因你的罪孽甚多， 你的罪恶无数。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你为甚么因你的损伤哀叫呢？ 你的病痛无法痊愈。 我这样对你， 是因你的罪孽甚多， 你的罪恶无数。
verses.textZhCuv: 你为何因损伤哀号呢？ 你的痛苦无法医治。 我因你的罪孽甚大，罪恶众多， 曾将这些加在你身上。
verses.textEnNiv: Why do you cry out over your wound, your pain that has no cure? Because of your great guilt and many sins I have done these things to you.
verses.textEnEsv: Why do you cry out over your hurt? Your pain is incurable. Because your guilt is great, because your sins are flagrant, I have done these things to you.
verses.textEnNkjv: Why do you cry about your affliction? Your sorrow is incurable. Because of the multitude of your iniquities, Because your sins have increased, I have done these things to you.
verses.textEnNlt: Why do you protest your punishment— this wound that has no cure? I have had to punish you because your sins are many and your guilt is great.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Why do you cry out over your injury? Your pain is incurable. Because your wrongdoing is great And your sins are numerous, I have done these things to you.
verses.textEn: Why do you cry out over your wound, your pain that has no cure? Because of your great guilt and many sins I have done these things to you.

verses.textZh: 但是，吞吃你的，必被吞吃； 你所有的敌人全都要被掳走； 抢掠你的，必成为被抢掠之物； 掠夺你的，我必使他们成为被掠夺之物。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但是，吞吃你的，必被吞吃； 你所有的敌人全都要被掳走； 抢掠你的，必成为被抢掠之物； 掠夺你的，我必使他们成为被掠夺之物。
verses.textZhCuv: 故此，凡吞吃你的必被吞吃； 你的敌人个个都被掳去； 掳掠你的必成为掳物； 抢夺你的必成为掠物。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘But all who devour you will be devoured; all your enemies will go into exile. Those who plunder you will be plundered; all who make spoil of you I will despoil.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore all who devour you shall be devoured, and all your foes, every one of them, shall go into captivity; those who plunder you shall be plundered, and all who prey on you I will make a prey.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘Therefore all those who devour you shall be devoured; And all your adversaries, every one of them, shall go into captivity; Those who plunder you shall become plunder, And all who prey upon you I will make a prey.
verses.textEnNlt: "But all who devour you will be devoured, and all your enemies will be sent into exile. All who plunder you will be plundered, and all who attack you will be attacked.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Therefore all who devour you will be devoured; And all your adversaries, every one of them, will go into captivity; And those who plunder you will become plunder, And all who plunder you I will turn into plunder.
verses.textEn: " ‘But all who devour you will be devoured; all your enemies will go into exile. Those who plunder you will be plundered; all who make spoil of you I will despoil.

verses.textZh: 虽然人都说你是被放逐的， 是没有人关心的锡安； 我却必使你康复， 医治你的创伤。’" 这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 虽然人都说你是被放逐的， 是没有人关心的锡安； 我却必使你康复， 医治你的创伤。’" 这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华说：我必使你痊愈， 医好你的伤痕， 都因人称你为被赶散的， 说：这是锡安，无人来探问 的！
verses.textEnNiv: But I will restore you to health and heal your wounds,’ declares the Lord , ‘because you are called an outcast, Zion for whom no one cares.’
verses.textEnEsv: For I will restore health to you, and your wounds I will heal, declares the Lord , because they have called you an outcast: ‘It is Zion, for whom no one cares!’
verses.textEnNkjv: For I will restore health to you And heal you of your wounds,’ says the Lord, ‘Because they called you an outcast saying: "This is Zion; No one seeks her." ’
verses.textEnNlt: I will give you back your health and heal your wounds," says the Lord . "For you are called an outcast— ‘Jerusalem for whom no one cares.’"
verses.textEnNasb: ‘For I will restore you to health And I will heal you of your wounds,’ declares the Lord, ‘Because they have called you an outcast, saying: "It is Zion; no one cares for her." ’
verses.textEn: But I will restore you to health and heal your wounds,’ declares the Lord , ‘because you are called an outcast, Zion for whom no one cares.’

verses.textZh: "耶和华这样说： ‘看哪！我必复兴雅各的帐棚， 也必怜悯他的居所； 城市必在废墟上重建， 堡垒必立在原来的地点上。
verses.textZhCnvs: "耶和华这样说： ‘看哪！我必复兴雅各的帐棚， 也必怜悯他的居所； 城市必在废墟上重建， 堡垒必立在原来的地点上。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华如此说： 我必使雅各被掳去的帐棚归回， 也必顾惜他的住处。 城必建造在原旧的山冈； 宫殿也照旧有人居住。
verses.textEnNiv: "This is what the Lord says: " ‘I will restore the fortunes of Jacob’s tents and have compassion on his dwellings; the city will be rebuilt on her ruins, and the palace will stand in its proper place.
verses.textEnEsv: "Thus says the Lord : Behold, I will restore the fortunes of the tents of Jacob and have compassion on his dwellings; the city shall be rebuilt on its mound, and the palace shall stand where it used to be.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Thus says the Lord: ‘Behold, I will bring back the captivity of Jacob’s tents, And have mercy on his dwelling places; The city shall be built upon its own mound, And the palace shall remain according to its own plan.
verses.textEnNlt: This is what the Lord says: "When I bring Israel home again from captivity and restore their fortunes, Jerusalem will be rebuilt on its ruins, and the palace reconstructed as before.
verses.textEnNasb: "This is what the Lord says: ‘Behold, I will restore the fortunes of the tents of Jacob And have compassion on his dwellings; And the city will be rebuilt on its ruins, And the palace will stand on its rightful place.
verses.textEn: "This is what the Lord says: " ‘I will restore the fortunes of Jacob’s tents and have compassion on his dwellings; the city will be rebuilt on her ruins, and the palace will stand in its proper place.

verses.textZh: 必有感谢的歌声， 和欢笑的声音从其中发出来。 我必使他们人数增多，不会减少； 我必使他们得尊荣，不再被人轻看。
verses.textZhCnvs: 必有感谢的歌声， 和欢笑的声音从其中发出来。 我必使他们人数增多，不会减少； 我必使他们得尊荣，不再被人轻看。
verses.textZhCuv: 必有感谢和欢乐的声音从其中发出， 我要使他们增多，不致减少； 使他们尊荣，不致卑微。
verses.textEnNiv: From them will come songs of thanksgiving and the sound of rejoicing. I will add to their numbers, and they will not be decreased; I will bring them honor, and they will not be disdained.
verses.textEnEsv: Out of them shall come songs of thanksgiving, and the voices of those who celebrate. I will multiply them, and they shall not be few; I will make them honored, and they shall not be small.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then out of them shall proceed thanksgiving And the voice of those who make merry; I will multiply them, and they shall not diminish; I will also glorify them, and they shall not be small.
verses.textEnNlt: There will be joy and songs of thanksgiving, and I will multiply my people, not diminish them; I will honor them, not despise them.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘From them will come a song of thanksgiving And the voices of those who celebrate; And I will multiply them and they will not decrease; I will honor them and they will not be insignificant.
verses.textEn: From them will come songs of thanksgiving and the sound of rejoicing. I will add to their numbers, and they will not be decreased; I will bring them honor, and they will not be disdained.

verses.textZh: 他们的子孙必像以前一样蒙恩， 他们的国家必在我面前坚立； 我必惩罚所有压迫他们的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们的子孙必像以前一样蒙恩， 他们的国家必在我面前坚立； 我必惩罚所有压迫他们的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们的儿女要如往日； 他们的会众坚立在我面前； 凡欺压他们的，我必刑罚他。
verses.textEnNiv: Their children will be as in days of old, and their community will be established before me; I will punish all who oppress them.
verses.textEnEsv: Their children shall be as they were of old, and their congregation shall be established before me, and I will punish all who oppress them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Their children also shall be as before, And their congregation shall be established before Me; And I will punish all who oppress them.
verses.textEnNlt: Their children will prosper as they did long ago. I will establish them as a nation before me, and I will punish anyone who hurts them.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘ Their children also will be as before, And their congregation will be established before Me; And I will punish all their oppressors.
verses.textEn: Their children will be as in days of old, and their community will be established before me; I will punish all who oppress them.

verses.textZh: 他们的元首必是他们自己的人， 他们的统治者必出自他们中间； 我必使他近前来，他也必亲近我， 不然，谁敢冒生命的危险来亲近我呢？’ 这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们的元首必是他们自己的人， 他们的统治者必出自他们中间； 我必使他近前来，他也必亲近我， 不然，谁敢冒生命的危险来亲近我呢？’ 这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们的君王必是属乎他们的； 掌权的必从他们中间而出。 我要使他就近我， 他也要亲近我； 不然，谁有胆量亲近我呢？ 这是耶和华说的。
verses.textEnNiv: Their leader will be one of their own; their ruler will arise from among them. I will bring him near and he will come close to me— for who is he who will devote himself to be close to me?’ declares the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: Their prince shall be one of themselves; their ruler shall come out from their midst; I will make him draw near, and he shall approach me, for who would dare of himself to approach me? declares the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: Their nobles shall be from among them, And their governor shall come from their midst; Then I will cause him to draw near, And he shall approach Me; For who is this who pledged his heart to approach Me?’ says the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: They will have their own ruler again, and he will come from their own people. I will invite him to approach me," says the Lord , "for who would dare to come unless invited?
verses.textEnNasb: ‘ Their leader shall be one of them, And their ruler will come out from their midst; And I will bring him near and he shall approach Me; For who would dare to risk his life to approach Me?’ declares the Lord.
verses.textEn: Their leader will be one of their own; their ruler will arise from among them. I will bring him near and he will come close to me— for who is he who will devote himself to be close to me?’ declares the Lord .

verses.textZh: ‘你们要作我的子民， 我要作你们的神。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: ‘你们要作我的子民， 我要作你们的神。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要作我的子民， 我要作你们的神。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘So you will be my people, and I will be your God.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: And you shall be my people, and I will be your God."
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘You shall be My people, And I will be your God.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: You will be my people, and I will be your God."
verses.textEnNasb: ‘You shall be My people, And I will be your God.’ "
verses.textEn: " ‘So you will be my people, and I will be your God.’ "

verses.textZh: 看哪！耶和华的旋风， 在震怒中发出， 是横扫的狂风， 必卷到恶人的头上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 看哪！耶和华的旋风， 在震怒中发出， 是横扫的狂风， 必卷到恶人的头上。
verses.textZhCuv: 看哪，耶和华的忿怒 好像暴风已经发出； 是扫灭的暴风， 必转到恶人的头上。
verses.textEnNiv: See, the storm of the Lord will burst out in wrath, a driving wind swirling down on the heads of the wicked.
verses.textEnEsv: Behold the storm of the Lord ! Wrath has gone forth, a whirling tempest; it will burst upon the head of the wicked.
verses.textEnNkjv: Behold, the whirlwind of the Lord Goes forth with fury, A continuing whirlwind; It will fall violently on the head of the wicked.
verses.textEnNlt: Look! The Lord ’s anger bursts out like a storm, a driving wind that swirls down on the heads of the wicked.
verses.textEnNasb: Behold, the tempest of the Lord! Wrath has gone forth, A sweeping tempest; It will whirl upon the head of the wicked.
verses.textEn: See, the storm of the Lord will burst out in wrath, a driving wind swirling down on the heads of the wicked.

verses.textZh: 耶和华的烈怒必不转消， 直到他作成和实现他心中的计划。 在末后的日子， 你们就会明白这事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的烈怒必不转消， 直到他作成和实现他心中的计划。 在末后的日子， 你们就会明白这事。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的烈怒必不转消， 直到他心中所拟定的成就了； 末后的日子你们要明白。
verses.textEnNiv: The fierce anger of the Lord will not turn back until he fully accomplishes the purposes of his heart. In days to come you will understand this.
verses.textEnEsv: The fierce anger of the Lord will not turn back until he has executed and accomplished the intentions of his mind. In the latter days you will understand this.
verses.textEnNkjv: The fierce anger of the Lord will not return until He has done it, And until He has performed the intents of His heart. In the latter days you will consider it.
verses.textEnNlt: The fierce anger of the Lord will not diminish until it has finished all he has planned. In the days to come you will understand all this.
verses.textEnNasb: The fierce anger of the Lord will not turn back Until He has performed and accomplished The intent of His heart. In the latter days you will understand this.
verses.textEn: The fierce anger of the Lord will not turn back until he fully accomplishes the purposes of his heart. In days to come you will understand this.

verses.textZh: "到那时，我必作以色列各家族的神，他们要作我的子民。"这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: "到那时，我必作以色列各家族的神，他们要作我的子民。"这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华说：「那时，我必作以色列各家的神；他们必作我的子民。」
verses.textEnNiv: "At that time," declares the Lord , "I will be the God of all the families of Israel, and they will be my people."
verses.textEnEsv: "At that time, declares the Lord , I will be the God of all the clans of Israel, and they shall be my people."
verses.textEnNkjv: "At the same time," says the Lord, "I will be the God of all the families of Israel, and they shall be My people."
verses.textEnNlt: "In that day," says the Lord , "I will be the God of all the families of Israel, and they will be my people.
verses.textEnNasb: "At that time," declares the Lord, "I will be the God of all the families of Israel, and they shall be My people."
verses.textEn: "At that time," declares the Lord , "I will be the God of all the families of Israel, and they will be my people."

verses.textZh: 耶和华这样说： "在刀剑下幸存的人民， 在旷野蒙受了恩宠； 以色列来到她安息之处。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华这样说： "在刀剑下幸存的人民， 在旷野蒙受了恩宠； 以色列来到她安息之处。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华如此说： 脱离刀剑的就是以色列人。 我使他享安息的时候， 他曾在旷野蒙恩。
verses.textEnNiv: This is what the Lord says: "The people who survive the sword will find favor in the wilderness; I will come to give rest to Israel."
verses.textEnEsv: Thus says the Lord : "The people who survived the sword found grace in the wilderness; when Israel sought for rest,
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus says the Lord: "The people who survived the sword Found grace in the wilderness— Israel, when I went to give him rest."
verses.textEnNlt: This is what the Lord says: "Those who survive the coming destruction will find blessings even in the barren land, for I will give rest to the people of Israel."
verses.textEnNasb: This is what the Lord says: "The people who survived the sword Found grace in the wilderness— Israel, when it went to find its rest."
verses.textEn: This is what the Lord says: "The people who survive the sword will find favor in the wilderness; I will come to give rest to Israel."

verses.textZh: 耶和华在古时 曾向以色列 显现，说： "我以永远的爱爱你， 因此，我对你的慈爱延续不息 。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华在古时 曾向以色列 显现，说： "我以永远的爱爱你， 因此，我对你的慈爱延续不息 。
verses.textZhCuv: 古时 耶和华向以色列 显现，说： 我以永远的爱爱你， 因此我以慈爱吸引你。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord appeared to us in the past, saying: "I have loved you with an everlasting love; I have drawn you with unfailing kindness.
verses.textEnEsv: the Lord appeared to him from far away. I have loved you with an everlasting love; therefore I have continued my faithfulness to you.
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord has appeared of old to me, saying: "Yes, I have loved you with an everlasting love; Therefore with lovingkindness I have drawn you.
verses.textEnNlt: Long ago the Lord said to Israel: "I have loved you, my people, with an everlasting love. With unfailing love I have drawn you to myself.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord appeared to him long ago, saying, "I have loved you with an everlasting love; Therefore I have drawn you out with kindness.
verses.textEn: The Lord appeared to us in the past, saying: "I have loved you with an everlasting love; I have drawn you with unfailing kindness.

verses.textZh: 童女以色列啊！ 我要再次建立你，你就必被建立。 你要再次拿起铃鼓， 出去和那些欢乐的人一同跳舞。
verses.textZhCnvs: 童女以色列啊！ 我要再次建立你，你就必被建立。 你要再次拿起铃鼓， 出去和那些欢乐的人一同跳舞。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列的民 哪， 我要再建立你，你就被建立； 你必再以击鼓为美， 与欢乐的人一同跳舞而出；
verses.textEnNiv: I will build you up again, and you, Virgin Israel, will be rebuilt. Again you will take up your timbrels and go out to dance with the joyful.
verses.textEnEsv: Again I will build you, and you shall be built, O virgin Israel! Again you shall adorn yourself with tambourines and shall go forth in the dance of the merrymakers.
verses.textEnNkjv: Again I will build you, and you shall be rebuilt, O virgin of Israel! You shall again be adorned with your tambourines, And shall go forth in the dances of those who rejoice.
verses.textEnNlt: I will rebuild you, my virgin Israel. You will again be happy and dance merrily with your tambourines.
verses.textEnNasb: "I will build you again and you will be rebuilt, Virgin of Israel! You will take up your tambourines again, And go out to the dances of the revelers.
verses.textEn: I will build you up again, and you, Virgin Israel, will be rebuilt. Again you will take up your timbrels and go out to dance with the joyful.

verses.textZh: 你要再次在撒玛利亚的众山上栽种葡萄园， 栽种的人栽种了，必可享用所结的果子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要再次在撒玛利亚的众山上栽种葡萄园， 栽种的人栽种了，必可享用所结的果子。
verses.textZhCuv: 又必在撒马利亚的山上栽种葡萄园， 栽种的人要享用所结的果子。
verses.textEnNiv: Again you will plant vineyards on the hills of Samaria; the farmers will plant them and enjoy their fruit.
verses.textEnEsv: Again you shall plant vineyards on the mountains of Samaria; the planters shall plant and shall enjoy the fruit.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall yet plant vines on the mountains of Samaria; The planters shall plant and eat them as ordinary food.
verses.textEnNlt: Again you will plant your vineyards on the mountains of Samaria and eat from your own gardens there.
verses.textEnNasb: "Again you will plant vineyards On the hills of Samaria; The planters will plant And will enjoy the fruit.
verses.textEn: Again you will plant vineyards on the hills of Samaria; the farmers will plant them and enjoy their fruit.

verses.textZh: 因为有一天，守望的人要在以法莲山上呼叫，说： ‘起来吧！我们上锡安去朝见耶和华我们的神。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为有一天，守望的人要在以法莲山上呼叫，说： ‘起来吧！我们上锡安去朝见耶和华我们的神。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 日子必到，以法莲山上守望的人必呼叫说： 起来吧！我们可以上锡安， 到耶和华－我们的神那里去。
verses.textEnNiv: There will be a day when watchmen cry out on the hills of Ephraim, ‘Come, let us go up to Zion, to the Lord our God.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: For there shall be a day when watchmen will call in the hill country of Ephraim: ‘Arise, and let us go up to Zion, to the Lord our God.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: For there shall be a day When the watchmen will cry on Mount Ephraim, ‘Arise, and let us go up to Zion, To the Lord our God.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: The day will come when watchmen will shout from the hill country of Ephraim, ‘Come, let us go up to Jerusalem to worship the Lord our God.’"
verses.textEnNasb: "For there will be a day when watchmen On the hills of Ephraim call out, ‘Arise, and let’s go up to Zion, To the Lord our God.’ "
verses.textEn: There will be a day when watchmen cry out on the hills of Ephraim, ‘Come, let us go up to Zion, to the Lord our God.’ "

verses.textZh: 耶和华这样说： "你们要为雅各喜乐欢呼， 要为那在列国为首的呼喊。 你们要宣告，要颂赞，说： ‘耶和华啊！求你拯救你的子民， 就是以色列的余民。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华这样说： "你们要为雅各喜乐欢呼， 要为那在列国为首的呼喊。 你们要宣告，要颂赞，说： ‘耶和华啊！求你拯救你的子民， 就是以色列的余民。’
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华如此说： 你们当为雅各欢乐歌唱， 因万国中为首的欢呼。 当传扬颂赞说： 耶和华啊， 求你拯救你的百姓以色列所剩下的人。
verses.textEnNiv: This is what the Lord says: "Sing with joy for Jacob; shout for the foremost of the nations. Make your praises heard, and say, ‘ Lord , save your people, the remnant of Israel.’
verses.textEnEsv: For thus says the Lord : "Sing aloud with gladness for Jacob, and raise shouts for the chief of the nations; proclaim, give praise, and say, ‘O Lord , save your people, the remnant of Israel.’
verses.textEnNkjv: For thus says the Lord: "Sing with gladness for Jacob, And shout among the chief of the nations; Proclaim, give praise, and say, ‘O Lord, save Your people, The remnant of Israel!’
verses.textEnNlt: Now this is what the Lord says: "Sing with joy for Israel. Shout for the greatest of nations! Shout out with praise and joy: ‘Save your people, O Lord , the remnant of Israel!’
verses.textEnNasb: For this is what the Lord says: "Sing aloud with joy for Jacob, And be joyful with the chief of the nations; Proclaim, give praise, and say, ‘Lord, save Your people, The remnant of Israel!’
verses.textEn: This is what the Lord says: "Sing with joy for Jacob; shout for the foremost of the nations. Make your praises heard, and say, ‘ Lord , save your people, the remnant of Israel.’

verses.textZh: 看哪！我必把他们从北方之地领回来， 把他们从地极招集起来； 在他们中间有瞎眼的、瘸腿的、 孕妇、产妇，都在一起； 他们成群结队返回这里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 看哪！我必把他们从北方之地领回来， 把他们从地极招集起来； 在他们中间有瞎眼的、瘸腿的、 孕妇、产妇，都在一起； 他们成群结队返回这里。
verses.textZhCuv: 我必将他们从北方领来， 从地极招聚； 同着他们来的有瞎子、瘸子、孕妇、产妇； 他们必成为大帮回到这里来。
verses.textEnNiv: See, I will bring them from the land of the north and gather them from the ends of the earth. Among them will be the blind and the lame, expectant mothers and women in labor; a great throng will return.
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, I will bring them from the north country and gather them from the farthest parts of the earth, among them the blind and the lame, the pregnant woman and she who is in labor, together; a great company, they shall return here.
verses.textEnNkjv: Behold, I will bring them from the north country, And gather them from the ends of the earth, Among them the blind and the lame, The woman with child And the one who labors with child, together; A great throng shall return there.
verses.textEnNlt: For I will bring them from the north and from the distant corners of the earth. I will not forget the blind and lame, the expectant mothers and women in labor. A great company will return!
verses.textEnNasb: "Behold, I am bringing them from the north country, And I will gather them from the remote parts of the earth, Among them those who are blind and those who limp, The pregnant woman and she who is in labor, together; They will return here as a great assembly.
verses.textEn: See, I will bring them from the land of the north and gather them from the ends of the earth. Among them will be the blind and the lame, expectant mothers and women in labor; a great throng will return.

verses.textZh: 我引导他们的时候， 他们必哭着而来，并且向我乞恩恳求。 我要使他们走在溪水旁， 行在平直的路上，他们必不会绊跌； 因为我是以色列的父亲， 以法莲是我的长子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我引导他们的时候， 他们必哭着而来，并且向我乞恩恳求。 我要使他们走在溪水旁， 行在平直的路上，他们必不会绊跌； 因为我是以色列的父亲， 以法莲是我的长子。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们要哭泣而来。 我要照他们恳求的引导他们， 使他们在河水旁走正直的路， 在其上不致绊跌； 因为我是以色列的父， 以法莲是我的长子。
verses.textEnNiv: They will come with weeping; they will pray as I bring them back. I will lead them beside streams of water on a level path where they will not stumble, because I am Israel’s father, and Ephraim is my firstborn son.
verses.textEnEsv: With weeping they shall come, and with pleas for mercy I will lead them back, I will make them walk by brooks of water, in a straight path in which they shall not stumble, for I am a father to Israel, and Ephraim is my firstborn.
verses.textEnNkjv: They shall come with weeping, And with supplications I will lead them. I will cause them to walk by the rivers of waters, In a straight way in which they shall not stumble; For I am a Father to Israel, And Ephraim is My firstborn.
verses.textEnNlt: Tears of joy will stream down their faces, and I will lead them home with great care. They will walk beside quiet streams and on smooth paths where they will not stumble. For I am Israel’s father, and Ephraim is my oldest child.
verses.textEnNasb: "They will come with weeping, And by pleading I will bring them; I will lead them by streams of waters, On a straight path on which they will not stumble; For I am a father to Israel, And Ephraim is My firstborn."
verses.textEn: They will come with weeping; they will pray as I bring them back. I will lead them beside streams of water on a level path where they will not stumble, because I am Israel’s father, and Ephraim is my firstborn son.

verses.textZh: "列国啊！你们要听耶和华的话， 要在远方的海岛传扬，说： ‘那赶散以色列的神，必再招集他们； 必看守他们，像牧人看守自己的羊群一样。’
verses.textZhCnvs: "列国啊！你们要听耶和华的话， 要在远方的海岛传扬，说： ‘那赶散以色列的神，必再招集他们； 必看守他们，像牧人看守自己的羊群一样。’
verses.textZhCuv: 列国啊，要听耶和华的话， 传扬在远处的海岛说： 赶散以色列的必招聚他， 又看守他，好像牧人看守羊群。
verses.textEnNiv: "Hear the word of the Lord , you nations; proclaim it in distant coastlands: ‘He who scattered Israel will gather them and will watch over his flock like a shepherd.’
verses.textEnEsv: "Hear the word of the Lord , O nations, and declare it in the coastlands far away; say, ‘He who scattered Israel will gather him, and will keep him as a shepherd keeps his flock.’
verses.textEnNkjv: "Hear the word of the Lord, O nations, And declare it in the isles afar off, and say, ‘He who scattered Israel will gather him, And keep him as a shepherd does his flock.’
verses.textEnNlt: "Listen to this message from the Lord , you nations of the world; proclaim it in distant coastlands: The Lord , who scattered his people, will gather them and watch over them as a shepherd does his flock.
verses.textEnNasb: Hear the word of the Lord, you nations, And declare it in the coastlands far away, And say, "He who scattered Israel will gather him, And He will keep him as a shepherd keeps his flock."
verses.textEn: "Hear the word of the Lord , you nations; proclaim it in distant coastlands: ‘He who scattered Israel will gather them and will watch over his flock like a shepherd.’

verses.textZh: 因为耶和华买赎了雅各， 从比他更强的人手中把他救赎了出来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为耶和华买赎了雅各， 从比他更强的人手中把他救赎了出来。
verses.textZhCuv: 因耶和华救赎了雅各， 救赎他脱离比他更强之人的手。
verses.textEnNiv: For the Lord will deliver Jacob and redeem them from the hand of those stronger than they.
verses.textEnEsv: For the Lord has ransomed Jacob and has redeemed him from hands too strong for him.
verses.textEnNkjv: For the Lord has redeemed Jacob, And ransomed him from the hand of one stronger than he.
verses.textEnNlt: For the Lord has redeemed Israel from those too strong for them.
verses.textEnNasb: For the Lord has ransomed Jacob And redeemed him from the hand of him who was stronger than he.
verses.textEn: For the Lord will deliver Jacob and redeem them from the hand of those stronger than they.

verses.textZh: 他们必来到锡安的高处欢呼； 他们必容光焕发，因为耶和华赐他们各样的美物， 就是五谷、新酒和油， 还有羊羔和牛犊。 他们必像有水灌溉的园子， 永不再枯干。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们必来到锡安的高处欢呼； 他们必容光焕发，因为耶和华赐他们各样的美物， 就是五谷、新酒和油， 还有羊羔和牛犊。 他们必像有水灌溉的园子， 永不再枯干。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们要来到锡安的高处歌唱， 又流归耶和华施恩之地， 就是有五谷、新酒，和油， 并羊羔、牛犊之地。 他们的心必像浇灌的园子； 他们也不再有一点愁烦。
verses.textEnNiv: They will come and shout for joy on the heights of Zion; they will rejoice in the bounty of the Lord — the grain, the new wine and the olive oil, the young of the flocks and herds. They will be like a well-watered garden, and they will sorrow no more.
verses.textEnEsv: They shall come and sing aloud on the height of Zion, and they shall be radiant over the goodness of the Lord , over the grain, the wine, and the oil, and over the young of the flock and the herd; their life shall be like a watered garden, and they shall languish no more.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore they shall come and sing in the height of Zion, Streaming to the goodness of the Lord— For wheat and new wine and oil, For the young of the flock and the herd; Their souls shall be like a well-watered garden, And they shall sorrow no more at all.
verses.textEnNlt: They will come home and sing songs of joy on the heights of Jerusalem. They will be radiant because of the Lord ’s good gifts— the abundant crops of grain, new wine, and olive oil, and the healthy flocks and herds. Their life will be like a watered garden, and all their sorrows will be gone.
verses.textEnNasb: "They will come and shout for joy on the height of Zion, And they will be radiant over the bounty of the Lord— Over the grain, the new wine, the oil, And over the young of the flock and the herd. And their life will be like a watered garden, And they will never languish again.
verses.textEn: They will come and shout for joy on the heights of Zion; they will rejoice in the bounty of the Lord — the grain, the new wine and the olive oil, the young of the flocks and herds. They will be like a well-watered garden, and they will sorrow no more.

verses.textZh: 那时，童女必欢乐跳舞， 年轻的和年老的一起欢乐。 我必使他们的悲哀变为喜乐， 我必安慰他们， 使他们从忧愁中得着欢乐。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，童女必欢乐跳舞， 年轻的和年老的一起欢乐。 我必使他们的悲哀变为喜乐， 我必安慰他们， 使他们从忧愁中得着欢乐。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时，处女必欢乐跳舞； 年少的、年老的，也必一同欢乐； 因为我要使他们的悲哀变为欢喜， 并要安慰他们，使他们的愁烦转为快乐。
verses.textEnNiv: Then young women will dance and be glad, young men and old as well. I will turn their mourning into gladness; I will give them comfort and joy instead of sorrow.
verses.textEnEsv: Then shall the young women rejoice in the dance, and the young men and the old shall be merry. I will turn their mourning into joy; I will comfort them, and give them gladness for sorrow.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Then shall the virgin rejoice in the dance, And the young men and the old, together; For I will turn their mourning to joy, Will comfort them, And make them rejoice rather than sorrow.
verses.textEnNlt: The young women will dance for joy, and the men—old and young—will join in the celebration. I will turn their mourning into joy. I will comfort them and exchange their sorrow for rejoicing.
verses.textEnNasb: "Then the virgin will rejoice in the dance, And the young men and the old together; For I will turn their mourning into joy And comfort them, and give them joy for their sorrow.
verses.textEn: Then young women will dance and be glad, young men and old as well. I will turn their mourning into gladness; I will give them comfort and joy instead of sorrow.

verses.textZh: 我必用肥脂使祭司的心满足； 我的子民必因我的美物饱足。" 这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必用肥脂使祭司的心满足； 我的子民必因我的美物饱足。" 这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 我必以肥油使祭司的心满足； 我的百姓也要因我的恩惠知足。 这是耶和华说的。
verses.textEnNiv: I will satisfy the priests with abundance, and my people will be filled with my bounty," declares the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: I will feast the soul of the priests with abundance, and my people shall be satisfied with my goodness, declares the Lord ."
verses.textEnNkjv: I will satiate the soul of the priests with abundance, And My people shall be satisfied with My goodness, says the Lord."
verses.textEnNlt: The priests will enjoy abundance, and my people will feast on my good gifts. I, the Lord , have spoken!"
verses.textEnNasb: "I will refresh the soul of the priests with abundance, And My people will be satisfied with My goodness," declares the Lord.
verses.textEn: I will satisfy the priests with abundance, and my people will be filled with my bounty," declares the Lord .

verses.textZh: 耶和华这样说： "在拉玛听见有声音， 是痛哭哀号的声音； 拉结为她的儿女哀哭， 不肯受安慰， 因为他们都不在了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华这样说： "在拉玛听见有声音， 是痛哭哀号的声音； 拉结为她的儿女哀哭， 不肯受安慰， 因为他们都不在了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华如此说： 在拉玛听见号咷痛哭的声音， 是拉结哭她儿女，不肯受安慰， 因为他们都不在了。
verses.textEnNiv: This is what the Lord says: "A voice is heard in Ramah, mourning and great weeping, Rachel weeping for her children and refusing to be comforted, because they are no more."
verses.textEnEsv: Thus says the Lord : "A voice is heard in Ramah, lamentation and bitter weeping. Rachel is weeping for her children; she refuses to be comforted for her children, because they are no more."
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus says the Lord: "A voice was heard in Ramah, Lamentation and bitter weeping, Rachel weeping for her children, Refusing to be comforted for her children, Because they are no more."
verses.textEnNlt: This is what the Lord says: "A cry is heard in Ramah— deep anguish and bitter weeping. Rachel weeps for her children, refusing to be comforted— for her children are gone."
verses.textEnNasb: This is what the Lord says: "A voice is heard in Ramah, Lamenting and bitter weeping. Rachel is weeping for her children; She refuses to be comforted for her children, Because they are no more."
verses.textEn: This is what the Lord says: "A voice is heard in Ramah, mourning and great weeping, Rachel weeping for her children and refusing to be comforted, because they are no more."

verses.textZh: 耶和华这样说： "止住你的声音，不要哭泣， 抑制你的眼睛不要再流泪， 因为你所作的必有果效； 他们必从仇敌之地回来。" 这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华这样说： "止住你的声音，不要哭泣， 抑制你的眼睛不要再流泪， 因为你所作的必有果效； 他们必从仇敌之地回来。" 这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华如此说： 你禁止声音不要哀哭， 禁止眼目不要流泪， 因你所做之工必有赏赐； 他们必从敌国归回。 这是耶和华说的。
verses.textEnNiv: This is what the Lord says: "Restrain your voice from weeping and your eyes from tears, for your work will be rewarded," declares the Lord . "They will return from the land of the enemy.
verses.textEnEsv: Thus says the Lord : "Keep your voice from weeping, and your eyes from tears, for there is a reward for your work, declares the Lord , and they shall come back from the land of the enemy.
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus says the Lord: "Refrain your voice from weeping, And your eyes from tears; For your work shall be rewarded, says the Lord, And they shall come back from the land of the enemy.
verses.textEnNlt: But now this is what the Lord says: "Do not weep any longer, for I will reward you," says the Lord . "Your children will come back to you from the distant land of the enemy.
verses.textEnNasb: This is what the Lord says: "Restrain your voice from weeping And your eyes from tears; For your work will be rewarded," declares the Lord, "And they will return from the land of the enemy.
verses.textEn: This is what the Lord says: "Restrain your voice from weeping and your eyes from tears, for your work will be rewarded," declares the Lord . "They will return from the land of the enemy.

verses.textZh: "你的前途必有希望； 你的儿女必返回自己的地方。" 这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你的前途必有希望； 你的儿女必返回自己的地方。" 这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华说：你末后必有指望； 你的儿女必回到自己的境界。
verses.textEnNiv: So there is hope for your descendants," declares the Lord . "Your children will return to their own land.
verses.textEnEsv: There is hope for your future, declares the Lord , and your children shall come back to their own country.
verses.textEnNkjv: There is hope in your future, says the Lord, That your children shall come back to their own border.
verses.textEnNlt: There is hope for your future," says the Lord . "Your children will come again to their own land.
verses.textEnNasb: "There is hope for your future," declares the Lord, "And your children will return to their own territory.
verses.textEn: So there is hope for your descendants," declares the Lord . "Your children will return to their own land.

verses.textZh: "我清楚听见以法莲为自己哀叹，说： ‘你管教了我， 我像一头不驯服的牛犊受管教； 求你使我回转，我就得以回转， 因为你是耶和华我的神。
verses.textZhCnvs: "我清楚听见以法莲为自己哀叹，说： ‘你管教了我， 我像一头不驯服的牛犊受管教； 求你使我回转，我就得以回转， 因为你是耶和华我的神。
verses.textZhCuv: 我听见以法莲为自己悲叹说： 你责罚我，我便受责罚， 像不惯负轭的牛犊一样。 求你使我回转，我便回转， 因为你是耶和华－我的神。
verses.textEnNiv: "I have surely heard Ephraim’s moaning: ‘You disciplined me like an unruly calf, and I have been disciplined. Restore me, and I will return, because you are the Lord my God.
verses.textEnEsv: I have heard Ephraim grieving, ‘You have disciplined me, and I was disciplined, like an untrained calf; bring me back that I may be restored, for you are the Lord my God.
verses.textEnNkjv: "I have surely heard Ephraim bemoaning himself: ‘You have chastised me, and I was chastised, Like an untrained bull; Restore me, and I will return, For You are the Lord my God.
verses.textEnNlt: I have heard Israel saying, ‘You disciplined me severely, like a calf that needs training for the yoke. Turn me again to you and restore me, for you alone are the Lord my God.
verses.textEnNasb: "I have certainly heard Ephraim grieving, ‘You have disciplined me, and I was corrected, Like an untrained calf; Bring me back that I may be restored, For You are the Lord my God.
verses.textEn: "I have surely heard Ephraim’s moaning: ‘You disciplined me like an unruly calf, and I have been disciplined. Restore me, and I will return, because you are the Lord my God.

verses.textZh: 我回转以后，就深深悔悟； 我醒觉以后，就拍腿悔恨。 因为我承受年幼时的耻辱， 我感到羞耻和惭愧。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 我回转以后，就深深悔悟； 我醒觉以后，就拍腿悔恨。 因为我承受年幼时的耻辱， 我感到羞耻和惭愧。’
verses.textZhCuv: 我回转以后就真正懊悔； 受教以后就拍腿叹息； 我因担当幼年的凌辱就抱愧蒙羞。
verses.textEnNiv: After I strayed, I repented; after I came to understand, I beat my breast. I was ashamed and humiliated because I bore the disgrace of my youth.’
verses.textEnEsv: For after I had turned away, I relented, and after I was instructed, I struck my thigh; I was ashamed, and I was confounded, because I bore the disgrace of my youth.’
verses.textEnNkjv: Surely, after my turning, I repented; And after I was instructed, I struck myself on the thigh; I was ashamed, yes, even humiliated, Because I bore the reproach of my youth.’
verses.textEnNlt: I turned away from God, but then I was sorry. I kicked myself for my stupidity! I was thoroughly ashamed of all I did in my younger days.’
verses.textEnNasb: ‘For after I turned back, I repented; And after I was instructed, I slapped my thigh; I was ashamed and also humiliated Because I bore the shame of my youth.’
verses.textEn: After I strayed, I repented; after I came to understand, I beat my breast. I was ashamed and humiliated because I bore the disgrace of my youth.’

verses.textZh: 以法莲是我亲爱的儿子吗？ 是我喜悦的孩子吗？ 每逢我说话攻击他， 我必再次记念他。 因此，我的心恋慕他； 我必定怜悯他。" 这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以法莲是我亲爱的儿子吗？ 是我喜悦的孩子吗？ 每逢我说话攻击他， 我必再次记念他。 因此，我的心恋慕他； 我必定怜悯他。" 这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华说：以法莲是我的爱子吗？ 是可喜悦的孩子吗？ 我每逢责备他，仍深顾念他； 所以我的心肠恋慕他； 我必要怜悯他。
verses.textEnNiv: Is not Ephraim my dear son, the child in whom I delight? Though I often speak against him, I still remember him. Therefore my heart yearns for him; I have great compassion for him," declares the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: Is Ephraim my dear son? Is he my darling child? For as often as I speak against him, I do remember him still. Therefore my heart yearns for him; I will surely have mercy on him, declares the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: Is Ephraim My dear son? Ishe a pleasant child? For though I spoke against him, I earnestly remember him still; Therefore My heart yearns for him; I will surely have mercy on him, says the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: "Is not Israel still my son, my darling child?" says the Lord . "I often have to punish him, but I still love him. That’s why I long for him and surely will have mercy on him.
verses.textEnNasb: "Is Ephraim My dear son? Is he a delightful child? Indeed, as often as I have spoken against him, I certainly still remember him; Therefore My heart yearns for him; I will certainly have mercy on him," declares the Lord.
verses.textEn: Is not Ephraim my dear son, the child in whom I delight? Though I often speak against him, I still remember him. Therefore my heart yearns for him; I have great compassion for him," declares the Lord .

verses.textZh: 你要为自己设立路标， 竖立路牌； 你要留心大路， 就是你走过的路。 童女以色列啊，回转吧！ 回到你这些城市那里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要为自己设立路标， 竖立路牌； 你要留心大路， 就是你走过的路。 童女以色列啊，回转吧！ 回到你这些城市那里。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列民 哪， 你当为自己设立指路碑， 竖起引路柱。 你要留心向大路， 就是你所去的原路； 你当回转，回转到你这些城邑。
verses.textEnNiv: "Set up road signs; put up guideposts. Take note of the highway, the road that you take. Return, Virgin Israel, return to your towns.
verses.textEnEsv: "Set up road markers for yourself; make yourself guideposts; consider well the highway, the road by which you went. Return, O virgin Israel, return to these your cities.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Set up signposts, Make landmarks; Set your heart toward the highway, The way in which you went. Turn back, O virgin of Israel, Turn back to these your cities.
verses.textEnNlt: Set up road signs; put up guideposts. Mark well the path by which you came. Come back again, my virgin Israel; return to your towns here.
verses.textEnNasb: "Set up roadmarks for yourself, Place guideposts for yourself; Direct your mind to the highway, The way by which you went. Return, O virgin of Israel, Return to these your cities.
verses.textEn: "Set up road signs; put up guideposts. Take note of the highway, the road that you take. Return, Virgin Israel, return to your towns.

verses.textZh: 转离正道的女儿哪， 你转来转去要到几时呢？ 因为耶和华在地上创造了一件新事， 就是女的要环绕男的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 转离正道的女儿哪， 你转来转去要到几时呢？ 因为耶和华在地上创造了一件新事， 就是女的要环绕男的。
verses.textZhCuv: 背道的民 哪， 你反来复去要到几时呢？ 耶和华在地上造了一件新事， 就是女子护卫男子。
verses.textEnNiv: How long will you wander, unfaithful Daughter Israel? The Lord will create a new thing on earth— the woman will return to the man."
verses.textEnEsv: How long will you waver, O faithless daughter? For the Lord has created a new thing on the earth: a woman encircles a man."
verses.textEnNkjv: How long will you gad about, O you backsliding daughter? For the Lord has created a new thing in the earth— A woman shall encompass a man."
verses.textEnNlt: How long will you wander, my wayward daughter? For the Lord will cause something new to happen— Israel will embrace her God. "
verses.textEnNasb: "How long will you waver, You rebellious daughter? For the Lord has created a new thing on the earth: A woman will shelter a man."
verses.textEn: How long will you wander, unfaithful Daughter Israel? The Lord will create a new thing on earth— the woman will return to the man."

verses.textZh: 万军之耶和华以色列的神这样说："我使被掳的人归回的时候，他们在犹大地，在犹大的城镇里，必再说这样的话：‘公义的居所啊，圣山哪，愿耶和华赐福给你！’
verses.textZhCnvs: 万军之耶和华以色列的神这样说："我使被掳的人归回的时候，他们在犹大地，在犹大的城镇里，必再说这样的话：‘公义的居所啊，圣山哪，愿耶和华赐福给你！’
verses.textZhCuv: 万军之耶和华－以色列的神如此说：「我使被掳之人归回的时候，他们在犹大地和其中的城邑必再这样说： 公义的居所啊， 圣山哪，愿耶和华赐福给你。
verses.textEnNiv: This is what the Lord Almighty, the God of Israel, says: "When I bring them back from captivity, the people in the land of Judah and in its towns will once again use these words: ‘The Lord bless you, you prosperous city, you sacred mountain.’
verses.textEnEsv: Thus says the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel: "Once more they shall use these words in the land of Judah and in its cities, when I restore their fortunes: "‘The Lord bless you, O habitation of righteousness, O holy hill!’
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus says the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel: "They shall again use this speech in the land of Judah and in its cities, when I bring back their captivity: ‘The Lord bless you, O home of justice, and mountain of holiness!’
verses.textEnNlt: This is what the Lord of Heaven’s Armies, the God of Israel, says: "When I bring them back from captivity, the people of Judah and its towns will again say, ‘The Lord bless you, O righteous home, O holy mountain!’
verses.textEnNasb: This is what the Lord of armies, the God of Israel says: "Once again they will speak this word in the land of Judah and in its cities when I restore their fortunes, ‘The Lord bless you, O place of righteousness, O holy hill!’
verses.textEn: This is what the Lord Almighty, the God of Israel, says: "When I bring them back from captivity, the people in the land of Judah and in its towns will once again use these words: ‘The Lord bless you, you prosperous city, you sacred mountain.’

verses.textZh: 犹大各城的人、耕地的和领着群畜游牧的，都要一起住在犹大。
verses.textZhCnvs: 犹大各城的人、耕地的和领着群畜游牧的，都要一起住在犹大。
verses.textZhCuv: 犹大和属犹大城邑的人，农夫和放羊的人，要一同住在其中。
verses.textEnNiv: People will live together in Judah and all its towns—farmers and those who move about with their flocks.
verses.textEnEsv: And Judah and all its cities shall dwell there together, and the farmers and those who wander with their flocks.
verses.textEnNkjv: And there shall dwell in Judah itself, and in all its cities together, farmers and those going out with flocks.
verses.textEnNlt: Townspeople and farmers and shepherds alike will live together in peace and happiness.
verses.textEnNasb: Judah and all its cities will live together in it, the farmers and those who travel with flocks.
verses.textEn: People will live together in Judah and all its towns—farmers and those who move about with their flocks.

verses.textZh: 疲倦的人，我必使他振作；愁苦的人，我必使他满足。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 疲倦的人，我必使他振作；愁苦的人，我必使他满足。"
verses.textZhCuv: 疲乏的人，我使他饱饫；愁烦的人，我使他知足。」
verses.textEnNiv: I will refresh the weary and satisfy the faint."
verses.textEnEsv: For I will satisfy the weary soul, and every languishing soul I will replenish."
verses.textEnNkjv: For I have satiated the weary soul, and I have replenished every sorrowful soul."
verses.textEnNlt: For I have given rest to the weary and joy to the sorrowing."
verses.textEnNasb: For I give plenty of water to the weary ones, and refresh everyone who languishes."
verses.textEn: I will refresh the weary and satisfy the faint."

verses.textZh: 这时，我醒过来，四周观看；我睡得很香甜。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这时，我醒过来，四周观看；我睡得很香甜。
verses.textZhCuv: 先知说：「我醒了，觉着睡得香甜！」
verses.textEnNiv: At this I awoke and looked around. My sleep had been pleasant to me.
verses.textEnEsv: At this I awoke and looked, and my sleep was pleasant to me.
verses.textEnNkjv: After this I awoke and looked around, and my sleep was sweet to me.
verses.textEnNlt: At this, I woke up and looked around. My sleep had been very sweet.
verses.textEnNasb: At this I awoke and looked, and my sleep had been pleasant to me.
verses.textEn: At this I awoke and looked around. My sleep had been pleasant to me.

verses.textZh: "看哪！日子快到 ，我必使以色列家和犹大家人口和牲畜繁衍。
verses.textZhCnvs: "看哪！日子快到 ，我必使以色列家和犹大家人口和牲畜繁衍。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华说：「日子将到，我要把人的种和牲畜的种播种在以色列家和犹大家。
verses.textEnNiv: "The days are coming," declares the Lord , "when I will plant the kingdoms of Israel and Judah with the offspring of people and of animals.
verses.textEnEsv: "Behold, the days are coming, declares the Lord , when I will sow the house of Israel and the house of Judah with the seed of man and the seed of beast.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Behold, the days are coming, says the Lord, that I will sow the house of Israel and the house of Judah with the seed of man and the seed of beast.
verses.textEnNlt: "The day is coming," says the Lord , "when I will greatly increase the human population and the number of animals here in Israel and Judah.
verses.textEnNasb: "Behold, days are coming," declares the Lord, "when I will sow the house of Israel and the house of Judah with the seed of mankind and the seed of animals.
verses.textEn: "The days are coming," declares the Lord , "when I will plant the kingdoms of Israel and Judah with the offspring of people and of animals.

verses.textZh: 我先前怎样留意把他们拔出、拆毁、倾覆、毁灭和降灾；将来我也必照样留意把他们建立和栽种起来。"这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我先前怎样留意把他们拔出、拆毁、倾覆、毁灭和降灾；将来我也必照样留意把他们建立和栽种起来。"这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 我先前怎样留意将他们拔出、拆毁、毁坏、倾覆、苦害，也必照样留意将他们建立、栽植。这是耶和华说的。
verses.textEnNiv: Just as I watched over them to uproot and tear down, and to overthrow, destroy and bring disaster, so I will watch over them to build and to plant," declares the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: And it shall come to pass that as I have watched over them to pluck up and break down, to overthrow, destroy, and bring harm, so I will watch over them to build and to plant, declares the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: And it shall come to pass, that as I have watched over them to pluck up, to break down, to throw down, to destroy, and to afflict, so I will watch over them to build and to plant, says the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: In the past I deliberately uprooted and tore down this nation. I overthrew it, destroyed it, and brought disaster upon it. But in the future I will just as deliberately plant it and build it up. I, the Lord , have spoken!
verses.textEnNasb: And just as I have watched over them to uproot them, tear them down, ruin, destroy, and bring disaster on them, so I will watch over them to build and to plant them," declares the Lord.
verses.textEn: Just as I watched over them to uproot and tear down, and to overthrow, destroy and bring disaster, so I will watch over them to build and to plant," declares the Lord .

verses.textZh: "在那些日子，人必不再说： ‘父亲吃了酸葡萄， 儿子的牙齿酸倒了。’
verses.textZhCnvs: "在那些日子，人必不再说： ‘父亲吃了酸葡萄， 儿子的牙齿酸倒了。’
verses.textZhCuv: 当那些日子，人不再说： 父亲吃了酸葡萄， 儿子的牙酸倒了。
verses.textEnNiv: "In those days people will no longer say, ‘The parents have eaten sour grapes, and the children’s teeth are set on edge.’
verses.textEnEsv: In those days they shall no longer say: "‘The fathers have eaten sour grapes, and the children’s teeth are set on edge.’
verses.textEnNkjv: In those days they shall say no more: ‘The fathers have eaten sour grapes, And the children’s teeth are set on edge.’
verses.textEnNlt: "The people will no longer quote this proverb: ‘The parents have eaten sour grapes, but their children’s mouths pucker at the taste.’
verses.textEnNasb: "In those days they will no longer say, ‘The fathers have eaten sour grapes, But it is the children’s teeth that have become blunt.’
verses.textEn: "In those days people will no longer say, ‘The parents have eaten sour grapes, and the children’s teeth are set on edge.’

verses.textZh: 因为各人必因自己的罪孽死亡；吃酸葡萄的，那人的牙齿必酸倒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为各人必因自己的罪孽死亡；吃酸葡萄的，那人的牙齿必酸倒。
verses.textZhCuv: 但各人必因自己的罪死亡；凡吃酸葡萄的，自己的牙必酸倒。」
verses.textEnNiv: Instead, everyone will die for their own sin; whoever eats sour grapes—their own teeth will be set on edge.
verses.textEnEsv: But everyone shall die for his own iniquity. Each man who eats sour grapes, his teeth shall be set on edge.
verses.textEnNkjv: But every one shall die for his own iniquity; every man who eats the sour grapes, his teeth shall be set on edge.
verses.textEnNlt: All people will die for their own sins—those who eat the sour grapes will be the ones whose mouths will pucker.
verses.textEnNasb: But everyone will die for his own wrongdoing; each person who eats the sour grapes, his own teeth will become blunt.
verses.textEn: Instead, everyone will die for their own sin; whoever eats sour grapes—their own teeth will be set on edge.

verses.textZh: "看哪！日子快到 ，我要与以色列家和犹大家订立新的约。
verses.textZhCnvs: "看哪！日子快到 ，我要与以色列家和犹大家订立新的约。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华说：「日子将到，我要与以色列家和犹大家另立新约，
verses.textEnNiv: "The days are coming," declares the Lord , "when I will make a new covenant with the people of Israel and with the people of Judah.
verses.textEnEsv: "Behold, the days are coming, declares the Lord , when I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel and the house of Judah,
verses.textEnNkjv: "Behold, the days are coming, says the Lord, when I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel and with the house of Judah—
verses.textEnNlt: "The day is coming," says the Lord , "when I will make a new covenant with the people of Israel and Judah.
verses.textEnNasb: "Behold, days are coming," declares the Lord, "when I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel and the house of Judah,
verses.textEn: "The days are coming," declares the Lord , "when I will make a new covenant with the people of Israel and with the people of Judah.

verses.textZh: 这新约不像从前我拉他们祖先的手，领他们出埃及地的日子，与他们所立的约；我虽然是他们的丈夫，他们却违背了我的约。"这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这新约不像从前我拉他们祖先的手，领他们出埃及地的日子，与他们所立的约；我虽然是他们的丈夫，他们却违背了我的约。"这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 不像我拉着他们祖宗的手，领他们出埃及地的时候，与他们所立的约。我虽作他们的丈夫，他们却背了我的约。这是耶和华说的。」
verses.textEnNiv: It will not be like the covenant I made with their ancestors when I took them by the hand to lead them out of Egypt, because they broke my covenant, though I was a husband to them, " declares the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: not like the covenant that I made with their fathers on the day when I took them by the hand to bring them out of the land of Egypt, my covenant that they broke, though I was their husband, declares the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: not according to the covenant that I made with their fathers in the day that I took them by the hand to lead them out of the land of Egypt, My covenant which they broke, though I was a husband to them, says the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: This covenant will not be like the one I made with their ancestors when I took them by the hand and brought them out of the land of Egypt. They broke that covenant, though I loved them as a husband loves his wife," says the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: not like the covenant which I made with their fathers on the day I took them by the hand to bring them out of the land of Egypt, My covenant which they broke, although I was a husband to them," declares the Lord.
verses.textEn: It will not be like the covenant I made with their ancestors when I took them by the hand to lead them out of Egypt, because they broke my covenant, though I was a husband to them, " declares the Lord .

verses.textZh: "但那些日子以后，我要与以色列家所立的约是这样 ：我要把我的律法放在他们里面，写在他们的心里。我要作他们的神，他们要作我的子民。
verses.textZhCnvs: "但那些日子以后，我要与以色列家所立的约是这样 ：我要把我的律法放在他们里面，写在他们的心里。我要作他们的神，他们要作我的子民。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华说：「那些日子以后，我与以色列家所立的约乃是这样：我要将我的律法放在他们里面，写在他们心上。我要作他们的神，他们要作我的子民。
verses.textEnNiv: "This is the covenant I will make with the people of Israel after that time," declares the Lord . "I will put my law in their minds and write it on their hearts. I will be their God, and they will be my people.
verses.textEnEsv: For this is the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel after those days, declares the Lord : I will put my law within them, and I will write it on their hearts. And I will be their God, and they shall be my people.
verses.textEnNkjv: But this is the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel after those days, says the Lord: I will put My law in their minds, and write it on their hearts; and I will be their God, and they shall be My people.
verses.textEnNlt: "But this is the new covenant I will make with the people of Israel after those days," says the Lord . "I will put my instructions deep within them, and I will write them on their hearts. I will be their God, and they will be my people.
verses.textEnNasb: "For this is the covenant which I will make with the house of Israel after those days," declares the Lord: "I will put My law within them and write it on their heart; and I will be their God, and they shall be My people.
verses.textEn: "This is the covenant I will make with the people of Israel after that time," declares the Lord . "I will put my law in their minds and write it on their hearts. I will be their God, and they will be my people.

verses.textZh: 他们各人必不再教导自己的邻舍和自己的同胞，说：‘你们要认识耶和华。’因为所有的人，从最小到最大的都必认识我。我也要赦免他们的罪孽，不再记着他们的罪恶。"这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们各人必不再教导自己的邻舍和自己的同胞，说：‘你们要认识耶和华。’因为所有的人，从最小到最大的都必认识我。我也要赦免他们的罪孽，不再记着他们的罪恶。"这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们各人不再教导自己的邻舍和自己的弟兄说：『你该认识耶和华』，因为他们从最小的到至大的都必认识我。我要赦免他们的罪孽，不再记念他们的罪恶。这是耶和华说的。」
verses.textEnNiv: No longer will they teach their neighbor, or say to one another, ‘Know the Lord ,’ because they will all know me, from the least of them to the greatest," declares the Lord . "For I will forgive their wickedness and will remember their sins no more."
verses.textEnEsv: And no longer shall each one teach his neighbor and each his brother, saying, ‘Know the Lord ,’ for they shall all know me, from the least of them to the greatest, declares the Lord . For I will forgive their iniquity, and I will remember their sin no more."
verses.textEnNkjv: No more shall every man teach his neighbor, and every man his brother, saying, ‘Know the Lord,’ for they all shall know Me, from the least of them to the greatest of them, says the Lord. For I will forgive their iniquity, and their sin I will remember no more."
verses.textEnNlt: And they will not need to teach their neighbors, nor will they need to teach their relatives, saying, ‘You should know the Lord .’ For everyone, from the least to the greatest, will know me already," says the Lord . "And I will forgive their wickedness, and I will never again remember their sins."
verses.textEnNasb: They will not teach again, each one his neighbor and each one his brother, saying, ‘Know the Lord,’ for they will all know Me, from the least of them to the greatest of them," declares the Lord, "for I will forgive their wrongdoing, and their sin I will no longer remember."
verses.textEn: No longer will they teach their neighbor, or say to one another, ‘Know the Lord ,’ because they will all know me, from the least of them to the greatest," declares the Lord . "For I will forgive their wickedness and will remember their sins no more."

verses.textZh: 那使太阳白昼发光， 派定月亮和星辰照耀黑夜， 又搅动海洋，使海浪澎湃的， 万军之耶和华是他的名， 他这样说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 那使太阳白昼发光， 派定月亮和星辰照耀黑夜， 又搅动海洋，使海浪澎湃的， 万军之耶和华是他的名， 他这样说：
verses.textZhCuv: 那使太阳白日发光， 使星月有定例，黑夜发亮， 又搅动大海，使海中波浪匉訇的， 万军之耶和华是他的名。 他如此说：
verses.textEnNiv: This is what the Lord says, he who appoints the sun to shine by day, who decrees the moon and stars to shine by night, who stirs up the sea so that its waves roar— the Lord Almighty is his name:
verses.textEnEsv: Thus says the Lord , who gives the sun for light by day and the fixed order of the moon and the stars for light by night, who stirs up the sea so that its waves roar— the Lord of hosts is his name:
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus says the Lord, Who gives the sun for a light by day, The ordinances of the moon and the stars for a light by night, Who disturbs the sea, And its waves roar (The Lord of hosts is His name):
verses.textEnNlt: It is the Lord who provides the sun to light the day and the moon and stars to light the night, and who stirs the sea into roaring waves. His name is the Lord of Heaven’s Armies, and this is what he says:
verses.textEnNasb: This is what the Lord says, He who gives the sun for light by day And the fixed order of the moon and the stars for light by night, Who stirs up the sea so that its waves roar— The Lord of armies is His name:
verses.textEn: This is what the Lord says, he who appoints the sun to shine by day, who decrees the moon and stars to shine by night, who stirs up the sea so that its waves roar— the Lord Almighty is his name:

verses.textZh: "这些定律若能从我面前废掉， 以色列的后裔也就会在我面前断绝， 永远不再成为一个国家。" 这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: "这些定律若能从我面前废掉， 以色列的后裔也就会在我面前断绝， 永远不再成为一个国家。" 这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 这些定例若能在我面前废掉， 以色列的后裔也就在我面前断绝， 永远不再成国。 这是耶和华说的。
verses.textEnNiv: "Only if these decrees vanish from my sight," declares the Lord , "will Israel ever cease being a nation before me."
verses.textEnEsv: "If this fixed order departs from before me, declares the Lord , then shall the offspring of Israel cease from being a nation before me forever."
verses.textEnNkjv: "If those ordinances depart From before Me, says the Lord, Then the seed of Israel shall also cease From being a nation before Me forever."
verses.textEnNlt: "I am as likely to reject my people Israel as I am to abolish the laws of nature!"
verses.textEnNasb: "If this fixed order departs From Me," declares the Lord, "Then the descendants of Israel also will cease To be a nation before Me forever."
verses.textEn: "Only if these decrees vanish from my sight," declares the Lord , "will Israel ever cease being a nation before me."

verses.textZh: 耶和华这样说： "人若能量度在上的诸天， 测透地下面的根基， 我也就会因以色列后裔所作的一切， 弃绝他们众人。" 这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华这样说： "人若能量度在上的诸天， 测透地下面的根基， 我也就会因以色列后裔所作的一切， 弃绝他们众人。" 这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华如此说： 若能量度上天， 寻察下地的根基， 我就因以色列后裔一切所行的弃绝他们。 这是耶和华说的。
verses.textEnNiv: This is what the Lord says: "Only if the heavens above can be measured and the foundations of the earth below be searched out will I reject all the descendants of Israel because of all they have done," declares the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: Thus says the Lord : "If the heavens above can be measured, and the foundations of the earth below can be explored, then I will cast off all the offspring of Israel for all that they have done, declares the Lord ."
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus says the Lord: "If heaven above can be measured, And the foundations of the earth searched out beneath, I will also cast off all the seed of Israel For all that they have done, says the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: This is what the Lord says: "Just as the heavens cannot be measured and the foundations of the earth cannot be explored, so I will not consider casting them away for the evil they have done. I, the Lord , have spoken!
verses.textEnNasb: This is what the Lord says: "If the heavens above can be measured And the foundations of the earth searched out below, Then I will also reject all the descendants of Israel For everything that they have done," declares the Lord.
verses.textEn: This is what the Lord says: "Only if the heavens above can be measured and the foundations of the earth below be searched out will I reject all the descendants of Israel because of all they have done," declares the Lord .

verses.textZh: "看哪！日子快到 ，这城从哈楠业城楼直到角门，必为耶和华重建起来。
verses.textZhCnvs: "看哪！日子快到 ，这城从哈楠业城楼直到角门，必为耶和华重建起来。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华说：「日子将到，这城必为耶和华建造，从哈楠业楼直到角门。
verses.textEnNiv: "The days are coming," declares the Lord , "when this city will be rebuilt for me from the Tower of Hananel to the Corner Gate.
verses.textEnEsv: "Behold, the days are coming, declares the Lord , when the city shall be rebuilt for the Lord from the Tower of Hananel to the Corner Gate.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Behold, the days are coming, says the Lord, that the city shall be built for the Lord from the Tower of Hananel to the Corner Gate.
verses.textEnNlt: "The day is coming," says the Lord , "when all Jerusalem will be rebuilt for me, from the Tower of Hananel to the Corner Gate.
verses.textEnNasb: "Behold, days are coming," declares the Lord, "when the city will be rebuilt for the Lord from the Tower of Hananel to the Corner Gate.
verses.textEn: "The days are coming," declares the Lord , "when this city will be rebuilt for me from the Tower of Hananel to the Corner Gate.

verses.textZh: 量度的准绳还要往外量，直到迦立山，绕到歌亚。
verses.textZhCnvs: 量度的准绳还要往外量，直到迦立山，绕到歌亚。
verses.textZhCuv: 准绳要往外量出，直到迦立山，又转到歌亚。
verses.textEnNiv: The measuring line will stretch from there straight to the hill of Gareb and then turn to Goah.
verses.textEnEsv: And the measuring line shall go out farther, straight to the hill Gareb, and shall then turn to Goah.
verses.textEnNkjv: The surveyor’s line shall again extend straight forward over the hill Gareb; then it shall turn toward Goath.
verses.textEnNlt: A measuring line will be stretched out over the hill of Gareb and across to Goah.
verses.textEnNasb: The measuring line will go out farther straight ahead, to the hill Gareb; then it will turn to Goah.
verses.textEn: The measuring line will stretch from there straight to the hill of Gareb and then turn to Goah.

verses.textZh: 拋尸和倒灰的整个山谷，以及从汲沦溪直到东边马门拐角一带所有的墓地，都必归耶和华为圣，永远不再拔出，不再倾覆。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 拋尸和倒灰的整个山谷，以及从汲沦溪直到东边马门拐角一带所有的墓地，都必归耶和华为圣，永远不再拔出，不再倾覆。"
verses.textZhCuv: 抛尸的全谷和倒灰之处，并一切田地，直到汲沦溪，又直到东方马门的拐角，都要归耶和华为圣，不再拔出，不再倾覆，直到永远。」
verses.textEnNiv: The whole valley where dead bodies and ashes are thrown, and all the terraces out to the Kidron Valley on the east as far as the corner of the Horse Gate, will be holy to the Lord . The city will never again be uprooted or demolished."
verses.textEnEsv: The whole valley of the dead bodies and the ashes, and all the fields as far as the brook Kidron, to the corner of the Horse Gate toward the east, shall be sacred to the Lord . It shall not be plucked up or overthrown anymore forever."
verses.textEnNkjv: And the whole valley of the dead bodies and of the ashes, and all the fields as far as the Brook Kidron, to the corner of the Horse Gate toward the east, shallbe holy to the Lord. It shall not be plucked up or thrown down anymore forever."
verses.textEnNlt: And the entire area—including the graveyard and ash dump in the valley, and all the fields out to the Kidron Valley on the east as far as the Horse Gate—will be holy to the Lord . The city will never again be captured or destroyed."
verses.textEnNasb: And the entire valley of the dead bodies and of the ashes, and all the fields as far as the brook Kidron to the corner of the Horse Gate toward the east, shall be holy to the Lord; it will not be uprooted or overthrown ever again."
verses.textEn: The whole valley where dead bodies and ashes are thrown, and all the terraces out to the Kidron Valley on the east as far as the corner of the Horse Gate, will be holy to the Lord . The city will never again be uprooted or demolished."

verses.textZh: 犹大王西底家第十年，就是尼布甲尼撒第十八年，从耶和华那里有话临到耶利米。
verses.textZhCnvs: 犹大王西底家第十年，就是尼布甲尼撒第十八年，从耶和华那里有话临到耶利米。
verses.textZhCuv: 犹大王西底家第十年，就是尼布甲尼撒十八年，耶和华的话临到耶利米。
verses.textEnNiv: This is the word that came to Jeremiah from the Lord in the tenth year of Zedekiah king of Judah, which was the eighteenth year of Nebuchadnezzar.
verses.textEnEsv: The word that came to Jeremiah from the Lord in the tenth year of Zedekiah king of Judah, which was the eighteenth year of Nebuchadnezzar.
verses.textEnNkjv: The word that came to Jeremiah from the Lord in the tenth year of Zedekiah king of Judah, which was the eighteenth year of Nebuchadnezzar.
verses.textEnNlt: The following message came to Jeremiah from the Lord in the tenth year of the reign of Zedekiah, king of Judah. This was also the eighteenth year of the reign of King Nebuchadnezzar.
verses.textEnNasb: The word that came to Jeremiah from the Lord in the tenth year of Zedekiah king of Judah, which was the eighteenth year of Nebuchadnezzar.
verses.textEn: This is the word that came to Jeremiah from the Lord in the tenth year of Zedekiah king of Judah, which was the eighteenth year of Nebuchadnezzar.

verses.textZh: 那时，巴比伦王的军队正在围困耶路撒冷，耶利米先知被囚禁在犹大王宫中卫兵的院子里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，巴比伦王的军队正在围困耶路撒冷，耶利米先知被囚禁在犹大王宫中卫兵的院子里。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时巴比伦王的军队围困耶路撒冷，先知耶利米囚在护卫兵的院内，在犹大王的宫中；
verses.textEnNiv: The army of the king of Babylon was then besieging Jerusalem, and Jeremiah the prophet was confined in the courtyard of the guard in the royal palace of Judah.
verses.textEnEsv: At that time the army of the king of Babylon was besieging Jerusalem, and Jeremiah the prophet was shut up in the court of the guard that was in the palace of the king of Judah.
verses.textEnNkjv: For then the king of Babylon’s army besieged Jerusalem, and Jeremiah the prophet was shut up in the court of the prison, which wasin the king of Judah’s house.
verses.textEnNlt: Jerusalem was then under siege from the Babylonian army, and Jeremiah was imprisoned in the courtyard of the guard in the royal palace.
verses.textEnNasb: Now at that time the army of the king of Babylon was besieging Jerusalem, and Jeremiah the prophet was imprisoned in the courtyard of the guard, which was at the house of the king of Judah,
verses.textEn: The army of the king of Babylon was then besieging Jerusalem, and Jeremiah the prophet was confined in the courtyard of the guard in the royal palace of Judah.

verses.textZh: 因为犹大王西底家把他囚禁起来，说："你为甚么预言：‘耶和华这样说：看哪！我必把这城交在巴比伦王的手中，他必攻取这城；
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为犹大王西底家把他囚禁起来，说："你为甚么预言：‘耶和华这样说：看哪！我必把这城交在巴比伦王的手中，他必攻取这城；
verses.textZhCuv: 因为犹大王西底家已将他囚禁，说：「你为什么预言说，耶和华如此说：『我必将这城交在巴比伦王的手中，他必攻取这城。
verses.textEnNiv: Now Zedekiah king of Judah had imprisoned him there, saying, "Why do you prophesy as you do? You say, ‘This is what the Lord says: I am about to give this city into the hands of the king of Babylon, and he will capture it.
verses.textEnEsv: For Zedekiah king of Judah had imprisoned him, saying, "Why do you prophesy and say, ‘Thus says the Lord : Behold, I am giving this city into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he shall capture it;
verses.textEnNkjv: For Zedekiah king of Judah had shut him up, saying, "Why do you prophesy and say, ‘Thus says the Lord: "Behold, I will give this city into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he shall take it;
verses.textEnNlt: King Zedekiah had put him there, asking why he kept giving this prophecy: "This is what the Lord says: ‘I am about to hand this city over to the king of Babylon, and he will take it.
verses.textEnNasb: because Zedekiah king of Judah had imprisoned him, saying, "Why do you prophesy, saying, ‘This is what the Lord says: "Behold, I am going to hand this city over to the king of Babylon, and he will take it;
verses.textEn: Now Zedekiah king of Judah had imprisoned him there, saying, "Why do you prophesy as you do? You say, ‘This is what the Lord says: I am about to give this city into the hands of the king of Babylon, and he will capture it.

verses.textZh: 犹大王西底家必不能逃脱迦勒底人的手，他必交在巴比伦王的手中；他们必面对面彼此说话，眼对眼互相对看。
verses.textZhCnvs: 犹大王西底家必不能逃脱迦勒底人的手，他必交在巴比伦王的手中；他们必面对面彼此说话，眼对眼互相对看。
verses.textZhCuv: 犹大王西底家必不能逃脱迦勒底人的手，定要交在巴比伦王的手中，要口对口彼此说话，眼对眼彼此相看。
verses.textEnNiv: Zedekiah king of Judah will not escape the Babylonians but will certainly be given into the hands of the king of Babylon, and will speak with him face to face and see him with his own eyes.
verses.textEnEsv: Zedekiah king of Judah shall not escape out of the hand of the Chaldeans, but shall surely be given into the hand of the king of Babylon, and shall speak with him face to face and see him eye to eye.
verses.textEnNkjv: and Zedekiah king of Judah shall not escape from the hand of the Chaldeans, but shall surely be delivered into the hand of the king of Babylon, and shall speak with him face to face, and see him eye to eye;
verses.textEnNlt: King Zedekiah will be captured by the Babylonians and taken to meet the king of Babylon face to face.
verses.textEnNasb: and Zedekiah king of Judah will not escape from the hand of the Chaldeans, but he will certainly be handed over to the king of Babylon, and he will speak with him face to face and see him eye to eye.
verses.textEn: Zedekiah king of Judah will not escape the Babylonians but will certainly be given into the hands of the king of Babylon, and will speak with him face to face and see him with his own eyes.

verses.textZh: 巴比伦王必把西底家带到巴比伦去；西底家必留在那里，直到我眷顾他的时候 。即使你们和迦勒底人作战，你们必不能战胜’？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 巴比伦王必把西底家带到巴比伦去；西底家必留在那里，直到我眷顾他的时候 。即使你们和迦勒底人作战，你们必不能战胜’？"
verses.textZhCuv: 巴比伦王必将西底家带到巴比伦；西底家必住在那里，直到我眷顾他的时候。你们虽与迦勒底人争战，却不顺利。这是耶和华说的。』」
verses.textEnNiv: He will take Zedekiah to Babylon, where he will remain until I deal with him, declares the Lord . If you fight against the Babylonians, you will not succeed.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: And he shall take Zedekiah to Babylon, and there he shall remain until I visit him, declares the Lord . Though you fight against the Chaldeans, you shall not succeed’?"
verses.textEnNkjv: then he shall lead Zedekiah to Babylon, and there he shall be until I visit him," says the Lord; "though you fight with the Chaldeans, you shall not succeed" ’?"
verses.textEnNlt: He will take Zedekiah to Babylon, and I will deal with him there,’ says the Lord . ‘If you fight against the Babylonians, you will never succeed.’"
verses.textEnNasb: Then he will take Zedekiah to Babylon, and he will be there until I visit him," declares the Lord. "If you fight against the Chaldeans, you will not succeed" ’?"
verses.textEn: He will take Zedekiah to Babylon, where he will remain until I deal with him, declares the Lord . If you fight against the Babylonians, you will not succeed.’ "

verses.textZh: 耶利米说："耶和华的话临到我，说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶利米说："耶和华的话临到我，说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶利米说：「耶和华的话临到我说：
verses.textEnNiv: Jeremiah said, "The word of the Lord came to me:
verses.textEnEsv: Jeremiah said, "The word of the Lord came to me:
verses.textEnNkjv: And Jeremiah said, "The word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: At that time the Lord sent me a message. He said,
verses.textEnNasb: And Jeremiah said, "The word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.textEn: Jeremiah said, "The word of the Lord came to me:

verses.textZh: ‘看哪！你叔叔沙龙的儿子哈拿篾必来见你，说：请你买下我在亚拿突的那块田地，因为你有近亲的权利和义务去买那田地。’
verses.textZhCnvs: ‘看哪！你叔叔沙龙的儿子哈拿篾必来见你，说：请你买下我在亚拿突的那块田地，因为你有近亲的权利和义务去买那田地。’
verses.textZhCuv: 『你叔叔沙龙的儿子哈拿篾必来见你，说：我在亚拿突的那块地，求你买来；因你买这地是合乎赎回之理。』」
verses.textEnNiv: Hanamel son of Shallum your uncle is going to come to you and say, ‘Buy my field at Anathoth, because as nearest relative it is your right and duty to buy it.’
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, Hanamel the son of Shallum your uncle will come to you and say, ‘Buy my field that is at Anathoth, for the right of redemption by purchase is yours.’
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘Behold, Hanamel the son of Shallum your uncle will come to you, saying, "Buy my field which is in Anathoth, for the right of redemption is yours to buy it." ’
verses.textEnNlt: "Your cousin Hanamel son of Shallum will come and say to you, ‘Buy my field at Anathoth. By law you have the right to buy it before it is offered to anyone else.’"
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Behold, Hanamel the son of Shallum your uncle is coming to you, saying, "Buy for yourself my field which is at Anathoth, for you have the right of redemption to buy it." ’
verses.textEn: Hanamel son of Shallum your uncle is going to come to you and say, ‘Buy my field at Anathoth, because as nearest relative it is your right and duty to buy it.’

verses.textZh: 我叔叔的儿子哈拿篾果然照着耶和华的话，到卫兵的院子里来见我，对我说：‘请你买下我在便雅悯境内亚拿突的那块田地，因为你有那产业的继承权，以及近亲的权利和义务；请你把它买下吧。’于是我知道这是耶和华的话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我叔叔的儿子哈拿篾果然照着耶和华的话，到卫兵的院子里来见我，对我说：‘请你买下我在便雅悯境内亚拿突的那块田地，因为你有那产业的继承权，以及近亲的权利和义务；请你把它买下吧。’于是我知道这是耶和华的话。
verses.textZhCuv: 我叔叔的儿子哈拿篾果然照耶和华的话来到护卫兵的院内，对我说：「我在便雅悯境内、亚拿突的那块地，求你买来；因你买来是合乎承受之理，是你当赎的。你为自己买来吧！」我－耶利米就知道这是耶和华的话。
verses.textEnNiv: "Then, just as the Lord had said, my cousin Hanamel came to me in the courtyard of the guard and said, ‘Buy my field at Anathoth in the territory of Benjamin. Since it is your right to redeem it and possess it, buy it for yourself.’ "I knew that this was the word of the Lord ;
