verses.textEnEsv: Then Hanamel my cousin came to me in the court of the guard, in accordance with the word of the Lord , and said to me, ‘Buy my field that is at Anathoth in the land of Benjamin, for the right of possession and redemption is yours; buy it for yourself.’ Then I knew that this was the word of the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Hanamel my uncle’s son came to me in the court of the prison according to the word of the Lord, and said to me, ‘Please buy my field that is in Anathoth, which is in the country of Benjamin; for the right of inheritance is yours, and the redemption yours; buy it for yourself.’ Then I knew that this was the word of the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: Then, just as the Lord had said he would, my cousin Hanamel came and visited me in the prison. He said, "Please buy my field at Anathoth in the land of Benjamin. By law you have the right to buy it before it is offered to anyone else, so buy it for yourself." Then I knew that the message I had heard was from the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: Then my uncle’s son Hanamel came to me in the courtyard of the guard in accordance with the word of the Lord and said to me, ‘Buy my field, please, that is at Anathoth, which is in the land of Benjamin; for you have the right of possession and the redemption is yours; buy it for yourself.’ Then I knew that this was the word of the Lord.
verses.textEn: "Then, just as the Lord had said, my cousin Hanamel came to me in the courtyard of the guard and said, ‘Buy my field at Anathoth in the territory of Benjamin. Since it is your right to redeem it and possess it, buy it for yourself.’ "I knew that this was the word of the Lord ;

verses.textZh: 我就向我叔叔的儿子哈拿篾，买下了在亚拿突的那块田地，称了一百九十三克银子给他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我就向我叔叔的儿子哈拿篾，买下了在亚拿突的那块田地，称了一百九十三克银子给他。
verses.textZhCuv: 我便向我叔叔的儿子哈拿篾买了亚拿突的那块地，平了十七舍客勒银子给他。
verses.textEnNiv: so I bought the field at Anathoth from my cousin Hanamel and weighed out for him seventeen shekels of silver.
verses.textEnEsv: "And I bought the field at Anathoth from Hanamel my cousin, and weighed out the money to him, seventeen shekels of silver.
verses.textEnNkjv: So I bought the field from Hanamel, the son of my uncle who was in Anathoth, and weighed outto him the money—seventeen shekels of silver.
verses.textEnNlt: So I bought the field at Anathoth, paying Hanamel seventeen pieces of silver for it.
verses.textEnNasb: "So I bought the field which was in Anathoth from Hanamel my uncle’s son, and I weighed out the silver for him, seventeen shekels of silver.
verses.textEn: so I bought the field at Anathoth from my cousin Hanamel and weighed out for him seventeen shekels of silver.

verses.textZh: "我在契约上签了名，把契封好了，又请了证人作证，就用天平把银子称给他。
verses.textZhCnvs: "我在契约上签了名，把契封好了，又请了证人作证，就用天平把银子称给他。
verses.textZhCuv: 我在契上画押，将契封缄，又请见证人来，并用天平将银子平给他。
verses.textEnNiv: I signed and sealed the deed, had it witnessed, and weighed out the silver on the scales.
verses.textEnEsv: I signed the deed, sealed it, got witnesses, and weighed the money on scales.
verses.textEnNkjv: And I signed the deed and sealed it, took witnesses, and weighed the money on the scales.
verses.textEnNlt: I signed and sealed the deed of purchase before witnesses, weighed out the silver, and paid him.
verses.textEnNasb: And I signed and sealed the deed, and called in witnesses, and weighed out the silver on the scales.
verses.textEn: I signed and sealed the deed, had it witnessed, and weighed out the silver on the scales.

verses.textZh: 然后我取了买卖契约，一份是封好的，一份是没有加封的，上面都有各种细则和条件。
verses.textZhCnvs: 然后我取了买卖契约，一份是封好的，一份是没有加封的，上面都有各种细则和条件。
verses.textZhCuv: 我便将照例按规所立的买契，就是封缄的那一张和敞着的那一张，
verses.textEnNiv: I took the deed of purchase—the sealed copy containing the terms and conditions, as well as the unsealed copy—
verses.textEnEsv: Then I took the sealed deed of purchase, containing the terms and conditions and the open copy.
verses.textEnNkjv: So I took the purchase deed, both that which was sealed according to the law and custom, and that which was open;
verses.textEnNlt: Then I took the sealed deed and an unsealed copy of the deed, which contained the terms and conditions of the purchase,
verses.textEnNasb: Then I took the deeds of purchase, both the sealed copy containing the terms and conditions and the open copy;
verses.textEn: I took the deed of purchase—the sealed copy containing the terms and conditions, as well as the unsealed copy—

verses.textZh: 当着我叔叔的儿子哈拿篾眼前，当着那些在买卖契约上签名作证的人眼前，以及当着所有坐在卫兵院子里的犹大人眼前，我把买卖契约交给了玛西雅的孙子、尼利亚的儿子巴录。
verses.textZhCnvs: 当着我叔叔的儿子哈拿篾眼前，当着那些在买卖契约上签名作证的人眼前，以及当着所有坐在卫兵院子里的犹大人眼前，我把买卖契约交给了玛西雅的孙子、尼利亚的儿子巴录。
verses.textZhCuv: 当着我叔叔的儿子哈拿篾和画押作见证的人，并坐在护卫兵院内的一切犹大人眼前，交给玛西雅的孙子尼利亚的儿子巴录。
verses.textEnNiv: and I gave this deed to Baruch son of Neriah, the son of Mahseiah, in the presence of my cousin Hanamel and of the witnesses who had signed the deed and of all the Jews sitting in the courtyard of the guard.
verses.textEnEsv: And I gave the deed of purchase to Baruch the son of Neriah son of Mahseiah, in the presence of Hanamel my cousin, in the presence of the witnesses who signed the deed of purchase, and in the presence of all the Judeans who were sitting in the court of the guard.
verses.textEnNkjv: and I gave the purchase deed to Baruch the son of Neriah, son of Mahseiah, in the presence of Hanamel my uncle’s son, and in the presence of the witnesses who signed the purchase deed, before all the Jews who sat in the court of the prison.
verses.textEnNlt: and I handed them to Baruch son of Neriah and grandson of Mahseiah. I did all this in the presence of my cousin Hanamel, the witnesses who had signed the deed, and all the men of Judah who were there in the courtyard of the guardhouse.
verses.textEnNasb: and I gave the deed of purchase to Baruch the son of Neriah, the son of Mahseiah, in the sight of Hanamel my uncle’s son and in the sight of the witnesses who signed the deed of purchase, in the sight of all the Jews who were sitting in the courtyard of the guard.
verses.textEn: and I gave this deed to Baruch son of Neriah, the son of Mahseiah, in the presence of my cousin Hanamel and of the witnesses who had signed the deed and of all the Jews sitting in the courtyard of the guard.

verses.textZh: 我当着这些人眼前吩咐巴录说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 我当着这些人眼前吩咐巴录说：
verses.textZhCuv: 当着他们众人眼前，我嘱咐巴录说：
verses.textEnNiv: "In their presence I gave Baruch these instructions:
verses.textEnEsv: I charged Baruch in their presence, saying,
verses.textEnNkjv: "Then I charged Baruch before them, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: Then I said to Baruch as they all listened,
verses.textEnNasb: And I commanded Baruch in their sight, saying,
verses.textEn: "In their presence I gave Baruch these instructions:

verses.textZh: ‘万军之耶和华以色列的神这样说：你要拿这两份买卖契约，就是那封好的和没有加封的，放在一个瓦器里，使它们可以长久保存。
verses.textZhCnvs: ‘万军之耶和华以色列的神这样说：你要拿这两份买卖契约，就是那封好的和没有加封的，放在一个瓦器里，使它们可以长久保存。
verses.textZhCuv: 「万军之耶和华－以色列的神如此说：要将这封缄的和敞着的两张契放在瓦器里，可以存留多日。
verses.textEnNiv: ‘This is what the Lord Almighty, the God of Israel, says: Take these documents, both the sealed and unsealed copies of the deed of purchase, and put them in a clay jar so they will last a long time.
verses.textEnEsv: ‘Thus says the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel: Take these deeds, both this sealed deed of purchase and this open deed, and put them in an earthenware vessel, that they may last for a long time.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘Thus says the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel: "Take these deeds, both this purchase deed which is sealed and this deed which is open, and put them in an earthen vessel, that they may last many days."
verses.textEnNlt: "This is what the Lord of Heaven’s Armies, the God of Israel, says: ‘Take both this sealed deed and the unsealed copy, and put them into a pottery jar to preserve them for a long time.’
verses.textEnNasb: ‘This is what the Lord of armies, the God of Israel says: "Take these deeds, this sealed deed of purchase and this open deed, and put them in an earthenware jar, so that they may last a long time."
verses.textEn: ‘This is what the Lord Almighty, the God of Israel, says: Take these documents, both the sealed and unsealed copies of the deed of purchase, and put them in a clay jar so they will last a long time.

verses.textZh: 因为万军之耶和华以色列的神这样说：将来在这地必再有人买房屋、田地和葡萄园。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为万军之耶和华以色列的神这样说：将来在这地必再有人买房屋、田地和葡萄园。’
verses.textZhCuv: 因为万军之耶和华－以色列的神如此说：将来在这地必有人再买房屋、田地，和葡萄园。」
verses.textEnNiv: For this is what the Lord Almighty, the God of Israel, says: Houses, fields and vineyards will again be bought in this land.’
verses.textEnEsv: For thus says the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel: Houses and fields and vineyards shall again be bought in this land.’
verses.textEnNkjv: For thus says the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel: "Houses and fields and vineyards shall be possessed again in this land." ’
verses.textEnNlt: For this is what the Lord of Heaven’s Armies, the God of Israel, says: ‘Someday people will again own property here in this land and will buy and sell houses and vineyards and fields.’"
verses.textEnNasb: For this is what the Lord of armies, the God of Israel says: "Houses and fields and vineyards will again be purchased in this land." ’
verses.textEn: For this is what the Lord Almighty, the God of Israel, says: Houses, fields and vineyards will again be bought in this land.’

verses.textZh: "我把买卖契约交给尼利亚的儿子巴录以后，就向耶和华祷告，说：
verses.textZhCnvs: "我把买卖契约交给尼利亚的儿子巴录以后，就向耶和华祷告，说：
verses.textZhCuv: 我将买契交给尼利亚的儿子巴录以后，便祷告耶和华说：
verses.textEnNiv: "After I had given the deed of purchase to Baruch son of Neriah, I prayed to the Lord :
verses.textEnEsv: "After I had given the deed of purchase to Baruch the son of Neriah, I prayed to the Lord , saying:
verses.textEnNkjv: "Now when I had delivered the purchase deed to Baruch the son of Neriah, I prayed to the Lord, saying:
verses.textEnNlt: Then after I had given the papers to Baruch, I prayed to the Lord :
verses.textEnNasb: "After giving the deed of purchase to Baruch the son of Neriah, I prayed to the Lord, saying,
verses.textEn: "After I had given the deed of purchase to Baruch son of Neriah, I prayed to the Lord :

verses.textZh: ‘主耶和华啊！你看，你曾用大能和伸出来的膀臂创造了天地；在你并没有难成的事。
verses.textZhCnvs: ‘主耶和华啊！你看，你曾用大能和伸出来的膀臂创造了天地；在你并没有难成的事。
verses.textZhCuv: 「主耶和华啊，你曾用大能和伸出来的膀臂创造天地，在你没有难成的事。
verses.textEnNiv: "Ah, Sovereign Lord , you have made the heavens and the earth by your great power and outstretched arm. Nothing is too hard for you.
verses.textEnEsv: ‘Ah, Lord God ! It is you who have made the heavens and the earth by your great power and by your outstretched arm! Nothing is too hard for you.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘Ah, Lord God! Behold, You have made the heavens and the earth by Your great power and outstretched arm. There is nothing too hard for You.
verses.textEnNlt: "O Sovereign Lord ! You made the heavens and earth by your strong hand and powerful arm. Nothing is too hard for you!
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Oh, Lord God! Behold, You Yourself have made the heavens and the earth by Your great power and by Your outstretched arm! Nothing is too difficult for You,
verses.textEn: "Ah, Sovereign Lord , you have made the heavens and the earth by your great power and outstretched arm. Nothing is too hard for you.

verses.textZh: 你向千万人施慈爱，又把父亲的罪孽都报应在他们的儿女身上。你是伟大、有能力的神，万军之耶和华是你 的名。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你向千万人施慈爱，又把父亲的罪孽都报应在他们的儿女身上。你是伟大、有能力的神，万军之耶和华是你 的名。
verses.textZhCuv: 你施慈爱与千万人，又将父亲的罪孽报应在他后世子孙的怀中，是至大全能的神，万军之耶和华是你的名。
verses.textEnNiv: You show love to thousands but bring the punishment for the parents’ sins into the laps of their children after them. Great and mighty God, whose name is the Lord Almighty,
verses.textEnEsv: You show steadfast love to thousands, but you repay the guilt of fathers to their children after them, O great and mighty God, whose name is the Lord of hosts,
verses.textEnNkjv: You show lovingkindness to thousands, and repay the iniquity of the fathers into the bosom of their children after them—the Great, the Mighty God, whose name is the Lord of hosts.
verses.textEnNlt: You show unfailing love to thousands, but you also bring the consequences of one generation’s sin upon the next. You are the great and powerful God, the Lord of Heaven’s Armies.
verses.textEnNasb: who shows mercy to thousands, but repays the wrongdoing of fathers into the laps of their children after them, great and mighty God. The Lord of armies is His name;
verses.textEn: You show love to thousands but bring the punishment for the parents’ sins into the laps of their children after them. Great and mighty God, whose name is the Lord Almighty,

verses.textZh: 你的计划伟大，你的作为满有能力；你的眼睛睁开，察看世人一切所行的，要照着各人的行为，和各人所作的事应得的结果来报应各人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你的计划伟大，你的作为满有能力；你的眼睛睁开，察看世人一切所行的，要照着各人的行为，和各人所作的事应得的结果来报应各人。
verses.textZhCuv: 谋事有大略，行事有大能，注目观看世人一切的举动，为要照各人所行的和他做事的结果报应他。
verses.textEnNiv: great are your purposes and mighty are your deeds. Your eyes are open to the ways of all mankind; you reward each person according to their conduct and as their deeds deserve.
verses.textEnEsv: great in counsel and mighty in deed, whose eyes are open to all the ways of the children of man, rewarding each one according to his ways and according to the fruit of his deeds.
verses.textEnNkjv: Youare great in counsel and mighty in work, for Your eyes are open to all the ways of the sons of men, to give everyone according to his ways and according to the fruit of his doings.
verses.textEnNlt: You have all wisdom and do great and mighty miracles. You see the conduct of all people, and you give them what they deserve.
verses.textEnNasb: great in counsel and mighty in deed, whose eyes are open to all the ways of the sons of mankind, giving to everyone according to his ways and according to the fruit of his deeds;
verses.textEn: great are your purposes and mighty are your deeds. Your eyes are open to the ways of all mankind; you reward each person according to their conduct and as their deeds deserve.

verses.textZh: 你曾在埃及地行神迹奇事，你在以色列和全人类中间直到今日也是这样，使你自己得了名声，好象今日一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你曾在埃及地行神迹奇事，你在以色列和全人类中间直到今日也是这样，使你自己得了名声，好象今日一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 在埃及地显神迹奇事，直到今日在以色列和别人中间也是如此，使自己得了名声，正如今日一样。
verses.textEnNiv: You performed signs and wonders in Egypt and have continued them to this day, in Israel and among all mankind, and have gained the renown that is still yours.
verses.textEnEsv: You have shown signs and wonders in the land of Egypt, and to this day in Israel and among all mankind, and have made a name for yourself, as at this day.
verses.textEnNkjv: You have set signs and wonders in the land of Egypt, to this day, and in Israel and among other men; and You have made Yourself a name, as it is this day.
verses.textEnNlt: You performed miraculous signs and wonders in the land of Egypt—things still remembered to this day! And you have continued to do great miracles in Israel and all around the world. You have made your name famous to this day.
verses.textEnNasb: who has accomplished signs and wonders in the land of Egypt, and even to this day both in Israel and among mankind; and You have made a name for Yourself, as at this day.
verses.textEn: You performed signs and wonders in Egypt and have continued them to this day, in Israel and among all mankind, and have gained the renown that is still yours.

verses.textZh: 你曾用神迹奇事、有力的手、伸出来的膀臂，和大而可畏的事，把你的子民以色列从埃及地领出来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你曾用神迹奇事、有力的手、伸出来的膀臂，和大而可畏的事，把你的子民以色列从埃及地领出来。
verses.textZhCuv: 用神迹奇事和大能的手，并伸出来的膀臂与大可畏的事，领你的百姓以色列出了埃及。
verses.textEnNiv: You brought your people Israel out of Egypt with signs and wonders, by a mighty hand and an outstretched arm and with great terror.
verses.textEnEsv: You brought your people Israel out of the land of Egypt with signs and wonders, with a strong hand and outstretched arm, and with great terror.
verses.textEnNkjv: You have brought Your people Israel out of the land of Egypt with signs and wonders, with a strong hand and an outstretched arm, and with great terror;
verses.textEnNlt: "You brought Israel out of Egypt with mighty signs and wonders, with a strong hand and powerful arm, and with overwhelming terror.
verses.textEnNasb: You brought Your people Israel out of the land of Egypt with signs and with wonders, and with a strong hand and an outstretched arm, and with great terror;
verses.textEn: You brought your people Israel out of Egypt with signs and wonders, by a mighty hand and an outstretched arm and with great terror.

verses.textZh: 你把这地赐给他们，就是你向他们列祖起誓，要赐给他们的流奶与蜜之地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你把这地赐给他们，就是你向他们列祖起誓，要赐给他们的流奶与蜜之地。
verses.textZhCuv: 将这地赐给他们，就是你向他们列祖起誓应许赐给他们流奶与蜜之地。
verses.textEnNiv: You gave them this land you had sworn to give their ancestors, a land flowing with milk and honey.
verses.textEnEsv: And you gave them this land, which you swore to their fathers to give them, a land flowing with milk and honey.
verses.textEnNkjv: You have given them this land, of which You swore to their fathers to give them— "a land flowing with milk and honey."
verses.textEnNlt: You gave the people of Israel this land that you had promised their ancestors long before—a land flowing with milk and honey.
verses.textEnNasb: and You gave them this land, which You swore to their forefathers to give them, a land flowing with milk and honey.
verses.textEn: You gave them this land you had sworn to give their ancestors, a land flowing with milk and honey.

verses.textZh: 他们进去，得到这地为业，却不听从你的话，也不遵行你的律法；你吩咐他们行的一切事，他们都没有行，因此你使这一切灾祸临到他们身上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们进去，得到这地为业，却不听从你的话，也不遵行你的律法；你吩咐他们行的一切事，他们都没有行，因此你使这一切灾祸临到他们身上。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们进入这地得了为业，却不听从你的话，也不遵行你的律法；你一切所吩咐他们行的，他们一无所行，因此你使这一切的灾祸临到他们。
verses.textEnNiv: They came in and took possession of it, but they did not obey you or follow your law; they did not do what you commanded them to do. So you brought all this disaster on them.
verses.textEnEsv: And they entered and took possession of it. But they did not obey your voice or walk in your law. They did nothing of all you commanded them to do. Therefore you have made all this disaster come upon them.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they came in and took possession of it, but they have not obeyed Your voice or walked in Your law. They have done nothing of all that You commanded them to do; therefore You have caused all this calamity to come upon them.
verses.textEnNlt: Our ancestors came and conquered it and lived in it, but they refused to obey you or follow your word. They have not done anything you commanded. That is why you have sent this terrible disaster upon them.
verses.textEnNasb: They came in and took possession of it, but they did not obey Your voice or walk in Your Law; they did not do anything that You commanded them to do; therefore You have made all this disaster happen to them.
verses.textEn: They came in and took possession of it, but they did not obey you or follow your law; they did not do what you commanded them to do. So you brought all this disaster on them.

verses.textZh: 看哪！敌人已经迫近，筑垒攻取这城。这城要因刀剑、饥荒和瘟疫的缘故，交在攻击他们的迦勒底人手中；你所说的都实现了，你也亲眼看见了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 看哪！敌人已经迫近，筑垒攻取这城。这城要因刀剑、饥荒和瘟疫的缘故，交在攻击他们的迦勒底人手中；你所说的都实现了，你也亲眼看见了。
verses.textZhCuv: 看哪，敌人已经来到，筑垒要攻取这城；城也因刀剑、饥荒、瘟疫交在攻城的迦勒底人手中。你所说的话都成就了，你也看见了。
verses.textEnNiv: "See how the siege ramps are built up to take the city. Because of the sword, famine and plague, the city will be given into the hands of the Babylonians who are attacking it. What you said has happened, as you now see.
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, the siege mounds have come up to the city to take it, and because of sword and famine and pestilence the city is given into the hands of the Chaldeans who are fighting against it. What you spoke has come to pass, and behold, you see it.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘Look, the siege mounds! They have come to the city to take it; and the city has been given into the hand of the Chaldeans who fight against it, because of the sword and famine and pestilence. What You have spoken has happened; there You see it!
verses.textEnNlt: "See how the siege ramps have been built against the city walls! Through war, famine, and disease, the city will be handed over to the Babylonians, who will conquer it. Everything has happened just as you said.
verses.textEnNasb: Behold, the assault ramps have reached the city to take it; and the city has been handed over to the Chaldeans who fight against it, because of the sword, the famine, and the plague; and what You have spoken has come to pass; and behold, You see it.
verses.textEn: "See how the siege ramps are built up to take the city. Because of the sword, famine and plague, the city will be given into the hands of the Babylonians who are attacking it. What you said has happened, as you now see.

verses.textZh: 但主耶和华啊！是你对我说："你要用银子买下那块田地，请证人作证。"其实这城已经交在迦勒底人的手中了。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 但主耶和华啊！是你对我说："你要用银子买下那块田地，请证人作证。"其实这城已经交在迦勒底人的手中了。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 主耶和华啊，你对我说：要用银子为自己买那块地，又请见证人。其实这城已交在迦勒底人的手中了。」
verses.textEnNiv: And though the city will be given into the hands of the Babylonians, you, Sovereign Lord , say to me, ‘Buy the field with silver and have the transaction witnessed.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: Yet you, O Lord God , have said to me, "Buy the field for money and get witnesses"—though the city is given into the hands of the Chaldeans.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: And You have said to me, O Lord God, "Buy the field for money, and take witnesses"!—yet the city has been given into the hand of the Chaldeans.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: And yet, O Sovereign Lord , you have told me to buy the field—paying good money for it before these witnesses—even though the city will soon be handed over to the Babylonians."
verses.textEnNasb: Yet You have said to me, Lord God, "Buy for yourself the field with money and call in witnesses"—although the city has been handed over to the Chaldeans.’ "
verses.textEn: And though the city will be given into the hands of the Babylonians, you, Sovereign Lord , say to me, ‘Buy the field with silver and have the transaction witnessed.’ "

verses.textZh: 耶和华的话临到耶利米，说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的话临到耶利米，说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的话临到耶利米说：
verses.textEnNiv: Then the word of the Lord came to Jeremiah:
verses.textEnEsv: The word of the Lord came to Jeremiah:
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the word of the Lord came to Jeremiah, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: Then this message came to Jeremiah from the Lord :
verses.textEnNasb: Then the word of the Lord came to Jeremiah, saying,
verses.textEn: Then the word of the Lord came to Jeremiah:

verses.textZh: "看哪！我是耶和华，是全人类的神；在我有难成的事吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: "看哪！我是耶和华，是全人类的神；在我有难成的事吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 「我是耶和华，是凡有血气者的神，岂有我难成的事吗？
verses.textEnNiv: "I am the Lord , the God of all mankind. Is anything too hard for me?
verses.textEnEsv: "Behold, I am the Lord , the God of all flesh. Is anything too hard for me?
verses.textEnNkjv: "Behold, I am the Lord, the God of all flesh. Is there anything too hard for Me?
verses.textEnNlt: "I am the Lord , the God of all the peoples of the world. Is anything too hard for me?
verses.textEnNasb: "Behold, I am the Lord, the God of all flesh; is anything too difficult for Me?"
verses.textEn: "I am the Lord , the God of all mankind. Is anything too hard for me?

verses.textZh: 因此耶和华这样说：‘看哪！我必把这城交在迦勒底人的手中，交在巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒的手中，他必攻取这城。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此耶和华这样说：‘看哪！我必把这城交在迦勒底人的手中，交在巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒的手中，他必攻取这城。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华如此说：我必将这城交付迦勒底人的手和巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒的手，他必攻取这城。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore this is what the Lord says: I am about to give this city into the hands of the Babylonians and to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, who will capture it.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore, thus says the Lord : Behold, I am giving this city into the hands of the Chaldeans and into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and he shall capture it.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore thus says the Lord: ‘Behold, I will give this city into the hand of the Chaldeans, into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and he shall take it.
verses.textEnNlt: Therefore, this is what the Lord says: I will hand this city over to the Babylonians and to Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon, and he will capture it.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore this is what the Lord says: "Behold, I am going to hand this city over to the Chaldeans and to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and he will take it.
verses.textEn: Therefore this is what the Lord says: I am about to give this city into the hands of the Babylonians and to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, who will capture it.

verses.textZh: 攻打这城的迦勒底人必进来，放火烧城，城中的房屋都必烧光，因为这城的居民曾在那些房屋的屋顶上向巴力烧香，向别神浇奠祭，惹我发怒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 攻打这城的迦勒底人必进来，放火烧城，城中的房屋都必烧光，因为这城的居民曾在那些房屋的屋顶上向巴力烧香，向别神浇奠祭，惹我发怒。
verses.textZhCuv: 攻城的迦勒底人必来放火焚烧这城和其中的房屋。在这房屋上，人曾向巴力烧香，向别神浇奠，惹我发怒。
verses.textEnNiv: The Babylonians who are attacking this city will come in and set it on fire; they will burn it down, along with the houses where the people aroused my anger by burning incense on the roofs to Baal and by pouring out drink offerings to other gods.
verses.textEnEsv: The Chaldeans who are fighting against this city shall come and set this city on fire and burn it, with the houses on whose roofs offerings have been made to Baal and drink offerings have been poured out to other gods, to provoke me to anger.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Chaldeans who fight against this city shall come and set fire to this city and burn it, with the houses on whose roofs they have offered incense to Baal and poured out drink offerings to other gods, to provoke Me to anger;
verses.textEnNlt: The Babylonians outside the walls will come in and set fire to the city. They will burn down all these houses where the people provoked my anger by burning incense to Baal on the rooftops and by pouring out liquid offerings to other gods.
verses.textEnNasb: And the Chaldeans who are fighting against this city will enter and set this city on fire and burn it, with the houses where people have offered incense to Baal on their roofs and poured out drink offerings to other gods, to provoke Me to anger.
verses.textEn: The Babylonians who are attacking this city will come in and set it on fire; they will burn it down, along with the houses where the people aroused my anger by burning incense on the roofs to Baal and by pouring out drink offerings to other gods.

verses.textZh: 事实上，以色列人和犹大人自幼以来，就专行我眼中看为恶的事；以色列人的手所作的，无不惹我发怒。’这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 事实上，以色列人和犹大人自幼以来，就专行我眼中看为恶的事；以色列人的手所作的，无不惹我发怒。’这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列人和犹大人自从幼年以来，专行我眼中看为恶的事；以色列人尽以手所做的惹我发怒。这是耶和华说的。
verses.textEnNiv: "The people of Israel and Judah have done nothing but evil in my sight from their youth; indeed, the people of Israel have done nothing but arouse my anger with what their hands have made, declares the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: For the children of Israel and the children of Judah have done nothing but evil in my sight from their youth. The children of Israel have done nothing but provoke me to anger by the work of their hands, declares the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: because the children of Israel and the children of Judah have done only evil before Me from their youth. For the children of Israel have provoked Me only to anger with the work of their hands,’ says the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: Israel and Judah have done nothing but wrong since their earliest days. They have infuriated me with all their evil deeds," says the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: For the sons of Israel and the sons of Judah have been doing only evil in My sight since their youth; for the sons of Israel have been only provoking Me to anger by the work of their hands," declares the Lord.
verses.textEn: "The people of Israel and Judah have done nothing but evil in my sight from their youth; indeed, the people of Israel have done nothing but arouse my anger with what their hands have made, declares the Lord .

verses.textZh: ‘因为这城自从建造的那天，直到今日，都不断惹起我的怒气和烈怒，以致我要把她从我面前除掉。
verses.textZhCnvs: ‘因为这城自从建造的那天，直到今日，都不断惹起我的怒气和烈怒，以致我要把她从我面前除掉。
verses.textZhCuv: 这城自从建造的那日直到今日，常惹我的怒气和忿怒，使我将这城从我面前除掉；
verses.textEnNiv: From the day it was built until now, this city has so aroused my anger and wrath that I must remove it from my sight.
verses.textEnEsv: This city has aroused my anger and wrath, from the day it was built to this day, so that I will remove it from my sight
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘For this city has been to Me aprovocationof My anger and My fury from the day that they built it, even to this day; so I will remove it from before My face
verses.textEnNlt: "From the time this city was built until now, it has done nothing but anger me, so I am determined to get rid of it.
verses.textEnNasb: "Indeed this city has been to Me a provocation of My anger and My wrath since the day that they built it, even to this day, so that it should be removed from My sight,
verses.textEn: From the day it was built until now, this city has so aroused my anger and wrath that I must remove it from my sight.

verses.textZh: 这是因为以色列人和犹大人的一切恶行，就是他们和他们的君王、领袖、祭司、先知，以及犹大每一个人和耶路撒冷居民所行的，都惹我发怒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这是因为以色列人和犹大人的一切恶行，就是他们和他们的君王、领袖、祭司、先知，以及犹大每一个人和耶路撒冷居民所行的，都惹我发怒。
verses.textZhCuv: 是因以色列人和犹大人一切的邪恶，就是他们和他们的君王、首领、祭司、先知，并犹大的众人，以及耶路撒冷的居民所行的，惹我发怒。
verses.textEnNiv: The people of Israel and Judah have provoked me by all the evil they have done—they, their kings and officials, their priests and prophets, the people of Judah and those living in Jerusalem.
verses.textEnEsv: because of all the evil of the children of Israel and the children of Judah that they did to provoke me to anger— their kings and their officials, their priests and their prophets, the men of Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNkjv: because of all the evil of the children of Israel and the children of Judah, which they have done to provoke Me to anger— they, their kings, their princes, their priests, their prophets, the men of Judah, and the inhabitants of Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNlt: "The sins of Israel and Judah—the sins of the people of Jerusalem, the kings, the officials, the priests, and the prophets—have stirred up my anger.
verses.textEnNasb: because of all the evil of the sons of Israel and the sons of Judah which they have done to provoke Me to anger—they, their kings, their leaders, their priests, their prophets, the men of Judah, and the inhabitants of Jerusalem.
verses.textEn: The people of Israel and Judah have provoked me by all the evil they have done—they, their kings and officials, their priests and prophets, the people of Judah and those living in Jerusalem.

verses.textZh: 他们以背向我，不以脸向我；我不断教导他们，他们却不肯听从，不接受管教；
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们以背向我，不以脸向我；我不断教导他们，他们却不肯听从，不接受管教；
verses.textZhCuv: 他们以背向我，不以面向我；我虽从早起来教训他们，他们却不听从，不受教训，
verses.textEnNiv: They turned their backs to me and not their faces; though I taught them again and again, they would not listen or respond to discipline.
verses.textEnEsv: They have turned to me their back and not their face. And though I have taught them persistently, they have not listened to receive instruction.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they have turned to Me the back, and not the face; though I taught them, rising up early and teaching them, yet they have not listened to receive instruction.
verses.textEnNlt: My people have turned their backs on me and have refused to return. Even though I diligently taught them, they would not receive instruction or obey.
verses.textEnNasb: They have turned their back to Me and not their face; though I taught them, teaching again and again, they would not listen to accept discipline.
verses.textEn: They turned their backs to me and not their faces; though I taught them again and again, they would not listen or respond to discipline.

verses.textZh: 竟把他们可憎的偶像安放在称为我名下的殿中，污秽了这殿。
verses.textZhCnvs: 竟把他们可憎的偶像安放在称为我名下的殿中，污秽了这殿。
verses.textZhCuv: 竟把可憎之物设立在称为我名下的殿中，污秽了这殿。
verses.textEnNiv: They set up their vile images in the house that bears my Name and defiled it.
verses.textEnEsv: They set up their abominations in the house that is called by my name, to defile it.
verses.textEnNkjv: But they set their abominations in the house which is called by My name, to defile it.
verses.textEnNlt: They have set up their abominable idols right in my own Temple, defiling it.
verses.textEnNasb: But they put their detestable things in the house which is called by My name, to defile it.
verses.textEn: They set up their vile images in the house that bears my Name and defiled it.

verses.textZh: 他们在欣嫩子谷中，建造了巴力的邱坛，使自己的儿女经火献给摩洛。这不是我吩咐的，也没有在我心里想过；他们竟行了这可憎恶的事，使犹大犯罪。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们在欣嫩子谷中，建造了巴力的邱坛，使自己的儿女经火献给摩洛。这不是我吩咐的，也没有在我心里想过；他们竟行了这可憎恶的事，使犹大犯罪。’
verses.textZhCuv: 他们在欣嫩子谷建筑巴力的邱坛，好使自己的儿女经火归摩洛；他们行这可憎的事，使犹大陷在罪里，这并不是我所吩咐的，也不是我心所起的意。」
verses.textEnNiv: They built high places for Baal in the Valley of Ben Hinnom to sacrifice their sons and daughters to Molek, though I never commanded—nor did it enter my mind—that they should do such a detestable thing and so make Judah sin.
verses.textEnEsv: They built the high places of Baal in the Valley of the Son of Hinnom, to offer up their sons and daughters to Molech, though I did not command them, nor did it enter into my mind, that they should do this abomination, to cause Judah to sin.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they built the high places of Baal which are in the Valley of the Son of Hinnom, to cause their sons and their daughters to pass through thefire to Molech, which I did not command them, nor did it come into My mind that they should do this abomination, to cause Judah to sin.’
verses.textEnNlt: They have built pagan shrines to Baal in the valley of Ben-Hinnom, and there they sacrifice their sons and daughters to Molech. I have never commanded such a horrible deed; it never even crossed my mind to command such a thing. What an incredible evil, causing Judah to sin so greatly!
verses.textEnNasb: They built the high places of Baal that are in the Valley of Ben-hinnom to make their sons and their daughters pass through the fire to Molech, which I had not commanded them, nor had it entered My mind that they should do this abomination, to mislead Judah to sin.
verses.textEn: They built high places for Baal in the Valley of Ben Hinnom to sacrifice their sons and daughters to Molek, though I never commanded—nor did it enter my mind—that they should do such a detestable thing and so make Judah sin.

verses.textZh: "论到这城，就是你们说：‘因为刀剑、饥荒和瘟疫的缘故，交在巴比伦王手中的’，现在耶和华以色列的神却这样说：
verses.textZhCnvs: "论到这城，就是你们说：‘因为刀剑、饥荒和瘟疫的缘故，交在巴比伦王手中的’，现在耶和华以色列的神却这样说：
verses.textZhCuv: 现在论到这城，就是你们所说、已经因刀剑、饥荒、瘟疫交在巴比伦王手中的，耶和华－以色列的神如此说：
verses.textEnNiv: "You are saying about this city, ‘By the sword, famine and plague it will be given into the hands of the king of Babylon’; but this is what the Lord , the God of Israel, says:
verses.textEnEsv: "Now therefore thus says the Lord , the God of Israel, concerning this city of which you say, ‘It is given into the hand of the king of Babylon by sword, by famine, and by pestilence’:
verses.textEnNkjv: "Now therefore, thus says the Lord, the God of Israel, concerning this city of which you say, ‘It shall be delivered into the hand of the king of Babylon by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence’:
verses.textEnNlt: "Now I want to say something more about this city. You have been saying, ‘It will fall to the king of Babylon through war, famine, and disease.’ But this is what the Lord , the God of Israel, says:
verses.textEnNasb: "Now therefore the Lord God of Israel says the following concerning this city of which you say, ‘It has been handed over to the king of Babylon by sword, by famine, and by plague’:
verses.textEn: "You are saying about this city, ‘By the sword, famine and plague it will be given into the hands of the king of Babylon’; but this is what the Lord , the God of Israel, says:

verses.textZh: ‘看哪！我曾在怒气、烈怒和大忿怒中，把以色列人赶逐到各地，将来我必从那里把他们招聚出来，领他们回到这地方，使他们安然居住。
verses.textZhCnvs: ‘看哪！我曾在怒气、烈怒和大忿怒中，把以色列人赶逐到各地，将来我必从那里把他们招聚出来，领他们回到这地方，使他们安然居住。
verses.textZhCuv: 「我在怒气、忿怒，和大恼恨中，将以色列人赶到各国。日后我必从那里将他们招聚出来，领他们回到此地，使他们安然居住。
verses.textEnNiv: I will surely gather them from all the lands where I banish them in my furious anger and great wrath; I will bring them back to this place and let them live in safety.
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, I will gather them from all the countries to which I drove them in my anger and my wrath and in great indignation. I will bring them back to this place, and I will make them dwell in safety.
verses.textEnNkjv: Behold, I will gather them out of all countries where I have driven them in My anger, in My fury, and in great wrath; I will bring them back to this place, and I will cause them to dwell safely.
verses.textEnNlt: I will certainly bring my people back again from all the countries where I will scatter them in my fury. I will bring them back to this very city and let them live in peace and safety.
verses.textEnNasb: Behold, I am going to gather them out of all the lands to which I have driven them in My anger, in My wrath, and in great indignation; and I will bring them back to this place and have them live in safety.
verses.textEn: I will surely gather them from all the lands where I banish them in my furious anger and great wrath; I will bring them back to this place and let them live in safety.

verses.textZh: 他们必作我的子民，我也必作他们的神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们必作我的子民，我也必作他们的神。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们要作我的子民，我要作他们的神。
verses.textEnNiv: They will be my people, and I will be their God.
verses.textEnEsv: And they shall be my people, and I will be their God.
verses.textEnNkjv: They shall be My people, and I will be their God;
verses.textEnNlt: They will be my people, and I will be their God.
verses.textEnNasb: They shall be My people, and I will be their God;
verses.textEn: They will be my people, and I will be their God.

verses.textZh: 我要使他们有同一的心志和同一的行为，终生敬畏我，使他们和他们的子孙都得到福乐。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要使他们有同一的心志和同一的行为，终生敬畏我，使他们和他们的子孙都得到福乐。
verses.textZhCuv: 我要使他们彼此同心同道，好叫他们永远敬畏我，使他们和他们后世的子孙得福乐，
verses.textEnNiv: I will give them singleness of heart and action, so that they will always fear me and that all will then go well for them and for their children after them.
verses.textEnEsv: I will give them one heart and one way, that they may fear me forever, for their own good and the good of their children after them.
verses.textEnNkjv: then I will give them one heart and one way, that they may fear Me forever, for the good of them and their children after them.
verses.textEnNlt: And I will give them one heart and one purpose: to worship me forever, for their own good and for the good of all their descendants.
verses.textEnNasb: and I will give them one heart and one way, so that they will fear Me always, for their own good and for the good of their children after them.
verses.textEn: I will give them singleness of heart and action, so that they will always fear me and that all will then go well for them and for their children after them.

verses.textZh: 我要和他们立永远的约，我必不离开他们，必使他们得到福乐；我也必把敬畏我的心赐给他们，使他们不会离开我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要和他们立永远的约，我必不离开他们，必使他们得到福乐；我也必把敬畏我的心赐给他们，使他们不会离开我。
verses.textZhCuv: 又要与他们立永远的约，必随着他们施恩，并不离开他们，且使他们有敬畏我的心，不离开我。
verses.textEnNiv: I will make an everlasting covenant with them: I will never stop doing good to them, and I will inspire them to fear me, so that they will never turn away from me.
verses.textEnEsv: I will make with them an everlasting covenant, that I will not turn away from doing good to them. And I will put the fear of me in their hearts, that they may not turn from me.
verses.textEnNkjv: And I will make an everlasting covenant with them, that I will not turn away from doing them good; but I will put My fear in their hearts so that they will not depart from Me.
verses.textEnNlt: And I will make an everlasting covenant with them: I will never stop doing good for them. I will put a desire in their hearts to worship me, and they will never leave me.
verses.textEnNasb: I will make an everlasting covenant with them that I will not turn away from them, to do them good; and I will put the fear of Me in their hearts, so that they will not turn away from Me.
verses.textEn: I will make an everlasting covenant with them: I will never stop doing good to them, and I will inspire them to fear me, so that they will never turn away from me.

verses.textZh: 我必喜欢他们，使他们得到福乐；我必全心全意、真诚地把他们栽种在这地上。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必喜欢他们，使他们得到福乐；我必全心全意、真诚地把他们栽种在这地上。’
verses.textZhCuv: 我必欢喜施恩与他们，要尽心尽意、诚诚实实将他们栽于此地。
verses.textEnNiv: I will rejoice in doing them good and will assuredly plant them in this land with all my heart and soul.
verses.textEnEsv: I will rejoice in doing them good, and I will plant them in this land in faithfulness, with all my heart and all my soul.
verses.textEnNkjv: Yes, I will rejoice over them to do them good, and I will assuredly plant them in this land, with all My heart and with all My soul.’
verses.textEnNlt: I will find joy doing good for them and will faithfully and wholeheartedly replant them in this land.
verses.textEnNasb: I will rejoice over them to do them good and will faithfully plant them in this land with all My heart and all My soul.
verses.textEn: I will rejoice in doing them good and will assuredly plant them in this land with all my heart and soul.

verses.textZh: "因为耶和华这样说：‘我怎样使这一切大灾祸临到这人民，我也必照样使我应许他们的福乐临到他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: "因为耶和华这样说：‘我怎样使这一切大灾祸临到这人民，我也必照样使我应许他们的福乐临到他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 「因为耶和华如此说：我怎样使这一切大祸临到这百姓，我也要照样使我所应许他们的一切福乐都临到他们。
verses.textEnNiv: "This is what the Lord says: As I have brought all this great calamity on this people, so I will give them all the prosperity I have promised them.
verses.textEnEsv: "For thus says the Lord : Just as I have brought all this great disaster upon this people, so I will bring upon them all the good that I promise them.
verses.textEnNkjv: "For thus says the Lord: ‘Just as I have brought all this great calamity on this people, so I will bring on them all the good that I have promised them.
verses.textEnNlt: "This is what the Lord says: Just as I have brought all these calamities on them, so I will do all the good I have promised them.
verses.textEnNasb: For this is what the Lord says: ‘Just as I brought all this great disaster on this people, so I am going to bring on them all the good that I am promising them.
verses.textEn: "This is what the Lord says: As I have brought all this great calamity on this people, so I will give them all the prosperity I have promised them.

verses.textZh: 你们说："这地荒凉，没有人烟，也没有牲畜，是交在迦勒底人手中的。"但将来在这地上，必有人买卖田地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们说："这地荒凉，没有人烟，也没有牲畜，是交在迦勒底人手中的。"但将来在这地上，必有人买卖田地。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们说，这地是荒凉、无人民、无牲畜，是交付迦勒底人手之地。日后在这境内，必有人置买田地。
verses.textEnNiv: Once more fields will be bought in this land of which you say, ‘It is a desolate waste, without people or animals, for it has been given into the hands of the Babylonians.’
verses.textEnEsv: Fields shall be bought in this land of which you are saying, ‘It is a desolation, without man or beast; it is given into the hand of the Chaldeans.’
verses.textEnNkjv: And fields will be bought in this land of which you say, "Itis desolate, without man or beast; it has been given into the hand of the Chaldeans."
verses.textEnNlt: Fields will again be bought and sold in this land about which you now say, ‘It has been ravaged by the Babylonians, a desolate land where people and animals have all disappeared.’
verses.textEnNasb: And fields will be purchased in this land of which you say, "It is a desolation, without man or animal; it has been handed over to the Chaldeans."
verses.textEn: Once more fields will be bought in this land of which you say, ‘It is a desolate waste, without people or animals, for it has been given into the hands of the Babylonians.’

verses.textZh: 在便雅悯地，在耶路撒冷周围的各处，在犹大各城，以及在山地、高地和南地的各城，人必用银子买卖田地，在地契上签名，把契封好，又请证人作证；因为我必使他们被掳的人归回。’"这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在便雅悯地，在耶路撒冷周围的各处，在犹大各城，以及在山地、高地和南地的各城，人必用银子买卖田地，在地契上签名，把契封好，又请证人作证；因为我必使他们被掳的人归回。’"这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 在便雅悯地、耶路撒冷四围的各处、犹大的城邑、山地的城邑、高原的城邑，并南地的城邑，人必用银子买田地，在契上画押，将契封缄，请出见证人，因为我必使被掳的人归回。这是耶和华说的。」
verses.textEnNiv: Fields will be bought for silver, and deeds will be signed, sealed and witnessed in the territory of Benjamin, in the villages around Jerusalem, in the towns of Judah and in the towns of the hill country, of the western foothills and of the Negev, because I will restore their fortunes, declares the Lord ."
verses.textEnEsv: Fields shall be bought for money, and deeds shall be signed and sealed and witnessed, in the land of Benjamin, in the places about Jerusalem, and in the cities of Judah, in the cities of the hill country, in the cities of the Shephelah, and in the cities of the Negeb; for I will restore their fortunes, declares the Lord ."
verses.textEnNkjv: Men will buy fields for money, sign deeds and seal them, and take witnesses, in the land of Benjamin, in the places around Jerusalem, in the cities of Judah, in the cities of the mountains, in the cities of the lowland, and in the cities of the South; for I will cause their captives to return,’ says the Lord."
verses.textEnNlt: Yes, fields will once again be bought and sold—deeds signed and sealed and witnessed—in the land of Benjamin and here in Jerusalem, in the towns of Judah and in the hill country, in the foothills of Judah and in the Negev, too. For someday I will restore prosperity to them. I, the Lord , have spoken!"
verses.textEnNasb: People will buy fields for money, sign and seal deeds, and call in witnesses in the land of Benjamin, in the areas surrounding Jerusalem, in the cities of Judah, in the cities of the hill country, in the cities of the lowland, and in the cities of the Negev; for I will restore their fortunes,’ declares the Lord."
verses.textEn: Fields will be bought for silver, and deeds will be signed, sealed and witnessed in the territory of Benjamin, in the villages around Jerusalem, in the towns of Judah and in the towns of the hill country, of the western foothills and of the Negev, because I will restore their fortunes, declares the Lord ."

verses.textZh: 耶利米还监禁在卫兵院子里的时候，耶和华的话第二次临到他，说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶利米还监禁在卫兵院子里的时候，耶和华的话第二次临到他，说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶利米还囚在护卫兵的院内，耶和华的话第二次临到他说：
verses.textEnNiv: While Jeremiah was still confined in the courtyard of the guard, the word of the Lord came to him a second time:
verses.textEnEsv: The word of the Lord came to Jeremiah a second time, while he was still shut up in the court of the guard:
verses.textEnNkjv: Moreover the word of the Lord came to Jeremiah a second time, while he was still shut up in the court of the prison, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: While Jeremiah was still confined in the courtyard of the guard, the Lord gave him this second message:
verses.textEnNasb: Then the word of the Lord came to Jeremiah the second time, while he was still confined in the courtyard of the guard, saying,
verses.textEn: While Jeremiah was still confined in the courtyard of the guard, the word of the Lord came to him a second time:

verses.textZh: "那创造、塑造和坚定大地的是耶和华，耶和华是他的名。他这样说：
verses.textZhCnvs: "那创造、塑造和坚定大地的是耶和华，耶和华是他的名。他这样说：
verses.textZhCuv: 「成就的是耶和华，造作、为要建立的也是耶和华；耶和华是他的名。他如此说：
verses.textEnNiv: "This is what the Lord says, he who made the earth, the Lord who formed it and established it—the Lord is his name:
verses.textEnEsv: "Thus says the Lord who made the earth, the Lord who formed it to establish it— the Lord is his name:
verses.textEnNkjv: "Thus says the Lord who made it, the Lord who formed it to establish it (the Lordis His name):
verses.textEnNlt: "This is what the Lord says—the Lord who made the earth, who formed and established it, whose name is the Lord :
verses.textEnNasb: "This is what the Lord says, He who made the earth, the Lord who formed it to create it, He whose name is the Lord:
verses.textEn: "This is what the Lord says, he who made the earth, the Lord who formed it and established it—the Lord is his name:

verses.textZh: ‘你呼求我，我就应允你，并且把你所不知道的那些伟大奥秘的事告诉你。’
verses.textZhCnvs: ‘你呼求我，我就应允你，并且把你所不知道的那些伟大奥秘的事告诉你。’
verses.textZhCuv: 你求告我，我就应允你，并将你所不知道、又大又难的事指示你。
verses.textEnNiv: ‘Call to me and I will answer you and tell you great and unsearchable things you do not know.’
verses.textEnEsv: Call to me and I will answer you, and will tell you great and hidden things that you have not known.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘Call to Me, and I will answer you, and show you great and mighty things, which you do not know.’
verses.textEnNlt: Ask me and I will tell you remarkable secrets you do not know about things to come.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Call to Me and I will answer you, and I will tell you great and mighty things, which you do not know.’
verses.textEn: ‘Call to me and I will answer you and tell you great and unsearchable things you do not know.’

verses.textZh: 论到这城里的房屋和犹大王的宫殿，就是为了抵挡敌人的攻城土垒和刀剑而拆毁的，耶和华以色列的神这样说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 论到这城里的房屋和犹大王的宫殿，就是为了抵挡敌人的攻城土垒和刀剑而拆毁的，耶和华以色列的神这样说：
verses.textZhCuv: 论到这城中的房屋和犹大王的宫室，就是拆毁为挡敌人高垒和刀剑的，耶和华－以色列的神如此说：
verses.textEnNiv: For this is what the Lord , the God of Israel, says about the houses in this city and the royal palaces of Judah that have been torn down to be used against the siege ramps and the sword
verses.textEnEsv: For thus says the Lord , the God of Israel, concerning the houses of this city and the houses of the kings of Judah that were torn down to make a defense against the siege mounds and against the sword:
verses.textEnNkjv: "For thus says the Lord, the God of Israel, concerning the houses of this city and the houses of the kings of Judah, which have been pulled down tofortify against the siege mounds and the sword:
verses.textEnNlt: For this is what the Lord , the God of Israel, says: You have torn down the houses of this city and even the king’s palace to get materials to strengthen the walls against the siege ramps and swords of the enemy.
verses.textEnNasb: For this is what the Lord, the God of Israel says concerning the houses of this city, and concerning the houses of the kings of Judah which have been torn down to make a defense against the assault ramps and the sword:
verses.textEn: For this is what the Lord , the God of Israel, says about the houses in this city and the royal palaces of Judah that have been torn down to be used against the siege ramps and the sword

verses.textZh: ‘这城的居民出去和迦勒底人争战，就必使这些房屋充满死尸，就是我在怒气和烈怒中击杀的。因为他们的一切恶行，我掩面不顾这城。
verses.textZhCnvs: ‘这城的居民出去和迦勒底人争战，就必使这些房屋充满死尸，就是我在怒气和烈怒中击杀的。因为他们的一切恶行，我掩面不顾这城。
verses.textZhCuv: 人要与迦勒底人争战，正是拿死尸充满这房屋，就是我在怒气和忿怒中所杀的人，因他们的一切恶，我就掩面不顾这城。
verses.textEnNiv: in the fight with the Babylonians : ‘They will be filled with the dead bodies of the people I will slay in my anger and wrath. I will hide my face from this city because of all its wickedness.
verses.textEnEsv: They are coming in to fight against the Chaldeans and to fill them with the dead bodies of men whom I shall strike down in my anger and my wrath, for I have hidden my face from this city because of all their evil.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘They come to fight with the Chaldeans, but only to fill their places with the dead bodies of men whom I will slay in My anger and My fury, all for whose wickedness I have hidden My face from this city.
verses.textEnNlt: You expect to fight the Babylonians, but the men of this city are already as good as dead, for I have determined to destroy them in my terrible anger. I have abandoned them because of all their wickedness.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘While they are coming to fight the Chaldeans and to fill their houses with the bodies of people whom I have struck down in My anger and My wrath, and I have hidden My face from this city because of all their wickedness:
verses.textEn: in the fight with the Babylonians : ‘They will be filled with the dead bodies of the people I will slay in my anger and wrath. I will hide my face from this city because of all its wickedness.

verses.textZh: 看哪！我必使这城的伤口痊愈康复，我必医治城中的居民，并且使他们享有十分的平安和稳妥。
verses.textZhCnvs: 看哪！我必使这城的伤口痊愈康复，我必医治城中的居民，并且使他们享有十分的平安和稳妥。
verses.textZhCuv: 看哪，我要使这城得以痊愈安舒，使城中的人得医治，又将丰盛的平安和诚实显明与他们。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘Nevertheless, I will bring health and healing to it; I will heal my people and will let them enjoy abundant peace and security.
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, I will bring to it health and healing, and I will heal them and reveal to them abundance of prosperity and security.
verses.textEnNkjv: Behold, I will bring it health and healing; I will heal them and reveal to them the abundance of peace and truth.
verses.textEnNlt: "Nevertheless, the time will come when I will heal Jerusalem’s wounds and give it prosperity and true peace.
verses.textEnNasb: Behold, I am going to bring to it healing and a remedy, and I will heal them; and I will reveal to them an abundance of peace and truth.
verses.textEn: " ‘Nevertheless, I will bring health and healing to it; I will heal my people and will let them enjoy abundant peace and security.

verses.textZh: 我必使犹大被掳的和以色列被掳的都归回，并且建立他们像起初一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必使犹大被掳的和以色列被掳的都归回，并且建立他们像起初一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 我也要使犹大被掳的和以色列被掳的归回，并建立他们和起初一样。
verses.textEnNiv: I will bring Judah and Israel back from captivity and will rebuild them as they were before.
verses.textEnEsv: I will restore the fortunes of Judah and the fortunes of Israel, and rebuild them as they were at first.
verses.textEnNkjv: And I will cause the captives of Judah and the captives of Israel to return, and will rebuild those places as at the first.
verses.textEnNlt: I will restore the fortunes of Judah and Israel and rebuild their towns.
verses.textEnNasb: And I will restore the fortunes of Judah and the fortunes of Israel, and will rebuild them as they were at first.
verses.textEn: I will bring Judah and Israel back from captivity and will rebuild them as they were before.

verses.textZh: 我必洁净他们得罪我的一切罪孽，并且赦免他们得罪我和悖逆我的一切罪孽。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必洁净他们得罪我的一切罪孽，并且赦免他们得罪我和悖逆我的一切罪孽。
verses.textZhCuv: 我要除净他们的一切罪，就是向我所犯的罪；又要赦免他们的一切罪，就是干犯我、违背我的罪。
verses.textEnNiv: I will cleanse them from all the sin they have committed against me and will forgive all their sins of rebellion against me.
verses.textEnEsv: I will cleanse them from all the guilt of their sin against me, and I will forgive all the guilt of their sin and rebellion against me.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will cleanse them from all their iniquity by which they have sinned against Me, and I will pardon all their iniquities by which they have sinned and by which they have transgressed against Me.
verses.textEnNlt: I will cleanse them of their sins against me and forgive all their sins of rebellion.
verses.textEnNasb: And I will cleanse them from all their wrongdoing by which they have sinned against Me, and I will forgive all their wrongdoings by which they have sinned against Me and revolted against Me.
verses.textEn: I will cleanse them from all the sin they have committed against me and will forgive all their sins of rebellion against me.

verses.textZh: 这城必在地上万国面前使我得名声，得喜乐 ，得颂赞，得荣耀，因为万国必听见我向这城的人所施的一切福乐。他们因我向这城所施的一切福乐和平安，就都恐惧战兢。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 这城必在地上万国面前使我得名声，得喜乐 ，得颂赞，得荣耀，因为万国必听见我向这城的人所施的一切福乐。他们因我向这城所施的一切福乐和平安，就都恐惧战兢。’
verses.textZhCuv: 这城要在地上万国人面前使我得颂赞，得荣耀，名为可喜可乐之城。万国人因听见我向这城所赐的福乐、所施的恩惠平安，就惧怕战兢。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then this city will bring me renown, joy, praise and honor before all nations on earth that hear of all the good things I do for it; and they will be in awe and will tremble at the abundant prosperity and peace I provide for it.’
verses.textEnEsv: And this city shall be to me a name of joy, a praise and a glory before all the nations of the earth who shall hear of all the good that I do for them. They shall fear and tremble because of all the good and all the prosperity I provide for it.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then it shall be to Me a name of joy, a praise, and an honor before all nations of the earth, who shall hear all the good that I do to them; they shall fear and tremble for all the goodness and all the prosperity that I provide for it.’
verses.textEnNlt: Then this city will bring me joy, glory, and honor before all the nations of the earth! The people of the world will see all the good I do for my people, and they will tremble with awe at the peace and prosperity I provide for them.
verses.textEnNasb: It will be to Me a name of joy, praise, and glory before all the nations of the earth, which will hear of all the good that I do for them, and they will be frightened and tremble because of all the good and all the peace that I make for it.’
verses.textEn: Then this city will bring me renown, joy, praise and honor before all nations on earth that hear of all the good things I do for it; and they will be in awe and will tremble at the abundant prosperity and peace I provide for it.’

verses.textZh: "耶和华这样说：‘论到这地方，你们说："这地荒废，没有人烟，也没有牲畜。"但在这荒凉、没有人烟、没有居民、也没有牲畜的犹大各城和耶路撒冷的街上，必再听见
verses.textZhCnvs: "耶和华这样说：‘论到这地方，你们说："这地荒废，没有人烟，也没有牲畜。"但在这荒凉、没有人烟、没有居民、也没有牲畜的犹大各城和耶路撒冷的街上，必再听见
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华如此说：「你们论这地方，说是荒废无人民无牲畜之地，但在这荒凉无人民无牲畜的犹大城邑和耶路撒冷的街上，
verses.textEnNiv: "This is what the Lord says: ‘You say about this place, "It is a desolate waste, without people or animals." Yet in the towns of Judah and the streets of Jerusalem that are deserted, inhabited by neither people nor animals, there will be heard once more
verses.textEnEsv: "Thus says the Lord : In this place of which you say, ‘It is a waste without man or beast,’ in the cities of Judah and the streets of Jerusalem that are desolate, without man or inhabitant or beast, there shall be heard again
verses.textEnNkjv: "Thus says the Lord: ‘Again there shall be heard in this place— of which you say, "It is desolate, without man and without beast"—in the cities of Judah, in the streets of Jerusalem that are desolate, without man and without inhabitant and without beast,
verses.textEnNlt: "This is what the Lord says: You have said, ‘This is a desolate land where people and animals have all disappeared.’ Yet in the empty streets of Jerusalem and Judah’s other towns, there will be heard once more
verses.textEnNasb: "This is what the Lord says: ‘Yet again there will be heard in this place, of which you say, "It is a waste, without man and without animal," that is, in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem that are deserted, without man and without inhabitant and without animal,
verses.textEn: "This is what the Lord says: ‘You say about this place, "It is a desolate waste, without people or animals." Yet in the towns of Judah and the streets of Jerusalem that are deserted, inhabited by neither people nor animals, there will be heard once more

verses.textZh: 欢喜和快乐的声音，新郎和新妇的声音；还要听见那些带着感恩祭到耶和华殿的人的声音说："你们要称谢万军之耶和华，因为耶和华是至善的，他的慈爱永远长存。"因为我必使这地被掳的归回，像起初一样。’"这是耶和华说的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 欢喜和快乐的声音，新郎和新妇的声音；还要听见那些带着感恩祭到耶和华殿的人的声音说："你们要称谢万军之耶和华，因为耶和华是至善的，他的慈爱永远长存。"因为我必使这地被掳的归回，像起初一样。’"这是耶和华说的。
verses.textZhCuv: 必再听见有欢喜和快乐的声音、新郎和新妇的声音，并听见有人说： 要称谢万军之耶和华， 因耶和华本为善； 他的慈爱永远长存！ 又有奉感谢祭到耶和华殿中之人的声音；因为我必使这地被掳的人归回，和起初一样。这是耶和华说的。」
verses.textEnNiv: the sounds of joy and gladness, the voices of bride and bridegroom, and the voices of those who bring thank offerings to the house of the Lord , saying, "Give thanks to the Lord Almighty, for the Lord is good; his love endures forever." For I will restore the fortunes of the land as they were before,’ says the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: the voice of mirth and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom and the voice of the bride, the voices of those who sing, as they bring thank offerings to the house of the Lord : "‘Give thanks to the Lord of hosts, for the Lord is good, for his steadfast love endures forever!’ For I will restore the fortunes of the land as at first, says the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: the voice of joy and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom and the voice of the bride, the voice of those who will say: "Praise the Lord of hosts, For the Lordis good, For His mercy endures forever"— and of those whowill bring the sacrifice of praise into the house of the Lord. For I will cause the captives of the land to return as at the first,’ says the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: the sounds of joy and laughter. The joyful voices of bridegrooms and brides will be heard again, along with the joyous songs of people bringing thanksgiving offerings to the Lord . They will sing, ‘Give thanks to the Lord of Heaven’s Armies, for the Lord is good. His faithful love endures forever!’ For I will restore the prosperity of this land to what it was in the past, says the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: the voice of joy and the voice of gladness, the voice of the groom and the voice of the bride, the voice of those who say, "Give thanks to the Lord of armies, For the Lord is good, For His mercy is everlasting," as they bring a thanksgiving offering into the house of the Lord. For I will restore the fortunes of the land as they were at first,’ says the Lord.
