For I will restore the fortunes of the land as they were before,’ says the Lord .

verses.textZh: "万军之耶和华这样说：‘在这荒废、没有人烟、没有牲畜的地方，和这地所有城中，必再有牧人放羊的牧场。
verses.textZhCnvs: "万军之耶和华这样说：‘在这荒废、没有人烟、没有牲畜的地方，和这地所有城中，必再有牧人放羊的牧场。
verses.textZhCuv: 万军之耶和华如此说：「在这荒废无人民无牲畜之地，并其中所有的城邑，必再有牧人的住处；他们要使羊群躺卧在那里。
verses.textEnNiv: "This is what the Lord Almighty says: ‘In this place, desolate and without people or animals—in all its towns there will again be pastures for shepherds to rest their flocks.
verses.textEnEsv: "Thus says the Lord of hosts: In this place that is waste, without man or beast, and in all of its cities, there shall again be habitations of shepherds resting their flocks.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Thus says the Lord of hosts: ‘In this place which is desolate, without man and without beast, and in all its cities, there shall again be a dwelling place of shepherds causing their flocks to lie down.
verses.textEnNlt: "This is what the Lord of Heaven’s Armies says: This land—though it is now desolate and has no people and animals—will once more have pastures where shepherds can lead their flocks.
verses.textEnNasb: "This is what the Lord of armies says: ‘There will again be in this place which is waste, without man or animal, and in all its cities, a pasture for shepherds who rest their flocks.
verses.textEn: "This is what the Lord Almighty says: ‘In this place, desolate and without people or animals—in all its towns there will again be pastures for shepherds to rest their flocks.

verses.textZh: 在山地、高地和南地的各城，在便雅悯地，在耶路撒冷周围的各处，以及在犹大的各城里，必再有牧人数点经过手下的羊群。’"这是耶和华说的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在山地、高地和南地的各城，在便雅悯地，在耶路撒冷周围的各处，以及在犹大的各城里，必再有牧人数点经过手下的羊群。’"这是耶和华说的。
verses.textZhCuv: 在山地的城邑、高原的城邑、南地的城邑、便雅悯地、耶路撒冷四围的各处，和犹大的城邑必再有羊群从数点的人手下经过。这是耶和华说的。」
verses.textEnNiv: In the towns of the hill country, of the western foothills and of the Negev, in the territory of Benjamin, in the villages around Jerusalem and in the towns of Judah, flocks will again pass under the hand of the one who counts them,’ says the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: In the cities of the hill country, in the cities of the Shephelah, and in the cities of the Negeb, in the land of Benjamin, the places about Jerusalem, and in the cities of Judah, flocks shall again pass under the hands of the one who counts them, says the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: In the cities of the mountains, in the cities of the lowland, in the cities of the South, in the land of Benjamin, in the places around Jerusalem, and in the cities of Judah, the flocks shall again pass under the hands of him who counts them,’ says the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: Once again shepherds will count their flocks in the towns of the hill country, the foothills of Judah, the Negev, the land of Benjamin, the vicinity of Jerusalem, and all the towns of Judah. I, the Lord , have spoken!
verses.textEnNasb: In the cities of the hill country, in the cities of the lowland, in the cities of the Negev, in the land of Benjamin, in the areas surrounding Jerusalem, and in the cities of Judah, the flocks will again pass under the hands of the one who counts them,’ says the Lord.
verses.textEn: In the towns of the hill country, of the western foothills and of the Negev, in the territory of Benjamin, in the villages around Jerusalem and in the towns of Judah, flocks will again pass under the hand of the one who counts them,’ says the Lord .

verses.textZh: "看哪！日子快到 ，我必实践我向以色列家和犹大家应许赐福的诺言。
verses.textZhCnvs: "看哪！日子快到 ，我必实践我向以色列家和犹大家应许赐福的诺言。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华说：「日子将到，我应许以色列家和犹大家的恩言必然成就。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘The days are coming,’ declares the Lord , ‘when I will fulfill the good promise I made to the people of Israel and Judah.
verses.textEnEsv: "Behold, the days are coming, declares the Lord , when I will fulfill the promise I made to the house of Israel and the house of Judah.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘Behold, the days are coming,’ says the Lord, ‘that I will perform that good thing which I have promised to the house of Israel and to the house of Judah:
verses.textEnNlt: "The day will come, says the Lord , when I will do for Israel and Judah all the good things I have promised them.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Behold, days are coming,’ declares the Lord, ‘when I will fulfill the good word which I have spoken concerning the house of Israel and the house of Judah.
verses.textEn: " ‘The days are coming,’ declares the Lord , ‘when I will fulfill the good promise I made to the people of Israel and Judah.

verses.textZh: 在那些日子、那时候，我必使大卫公义的苗裔长起来；他必在地上施行公正和公义。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在那些日子、那时候，我必使大卫公义的苗裔长起来；他必在地上施行公正和公义。
verses.textZhCuv: 当那日子，那时候，我必使大卫公义的苗裔长起来；他必在地上施行公平和公义。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘In those days and at that time I will make a righteous Branch sprout from David’s line; he will do what is just and right in the land.
verses.textEnEsv: In those days and at that time I will cause a righteous Branch to spring up for David, and he shall execute justice and righteousness in the land.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘In those days and at that time I will cause to grow up to David A Branch of righteousness; He shall execute judgment and righteousness in the earth.
verses.textEnNlt: "In those days and at that time I will raise up a righteous descendant from King David’s line. He will do what is just and right throughout the land.
verses.textEnNasb: In those days and at that time I will make a righteous Branch of David sprout; and He shall execute justice and righteousness on the earth.
verses.textEn: " ‘In those days and at that time I will make a righteous Branch sprout from David’s line; he will do what is just and right in the land.

verses.textZh: 在那些日子，犹大必得救，耶路撒冷必安然居住；这城必被称为‘耶和华是我们的公义’。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在那些日子，犹大必得救，耶路撒冷必安然居住；这城必被称为‘耶和华是我们的公义’。
verses.textZhCuv: 在那日子犹大必得救，耶路撒冷必安然居住，他的名必称为『耶和华－我们的义』。
verses.textEnNiv: In those days Judah will be saved and Jerusalem will live in safety. This is the name by which it will be called: The Lord Our Righteous Savior.’
verses.textEnEsv: In those days Judah will be saved, and Jerusalem will dwell securely. And this is the name by which it will be called: ‘The Lord is our righteousness.’
verses.textEnNkjv: In those days Judah will be saved, And Jerusalem will dwell safely. And this isthename by which she will be called: THE LORD OUR RIGHTEOUSNESS.’
verses.textEnNlt: In that day Judah will be saved, and Jerusalem will live in safety. And this will be its name: ‘The Lord Is Our Righteousness.’
verses.textEnNasb: In those days Judah will be saved and Jerusalem will live in safety; and this is the name by which it will be called: the Lord is our righteousness.’
verses.textEn: In those days Judah will be saved and Jerusalem will live in safety. This is the name by which it will be called: The Lord Our Righteous Savior.’

verses.textZh: 因为耶和华这样说：‘大卫家必不断有人坐在以色列家的王位上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为耶和华这样说：‘大卫家必不断有人坐在以色列家的王位上。
verses.textZhCuv: 「因为耶和华如此说：大卫必永不断人坐在以色列家的宝座上；
verses.textEnNiv: For this is what the Lord says: ‘David will never fail to have a man to sit on the throne of Israel,
verses.textEnEsv: "For thus says the Lord : David shall never lack a man to sit on the throne of the house of Israel,
verses.textEnNkjv: "For thus says the Lord: ‘David shall never lack a man to sit on the throne of the house of Israel;
verses.textEnNlt: For this is what the Lord says: David will have a descendant sitting on the throne of Israel forever.
verses.textEnNasb: For this is what the Lord says: ‘ David shall not lack a man to sit on the throne of the house of Israel;
verses.textEn: For this is what the Lord says: ‘David will never fail to have a man to sit on the throne of Israel,

verses.textZh: 利未人的祭司也必不断有人在我面前献上燔祭和烧素祭；献祭的事永不止息。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 利未人的祭司也必不断有人在我面前献上燔祭和烧素祭；献祭的事永不止息。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 祭司、利未人在我面前也不断人献燔祭、烧素祭，时常办理献祭的事。」
verses.textEnNiv: nor will the Levitical priests ever fail to have a man to stand before me continually to offer burnt offerings, to burn grain offerings and to present sacrifices.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: and the Levitical priests shall never lack a man in my presence to offer burnt offerings, to burn grain offerings, and to make sacrifices forever."
verses.textEnNkjv: nor shall the priests, the Levites, lack a man to offer burnt offerings before Me, to kindle grain offerings, and to sacrifice continually.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: And there will always be Levitical priests to offer burnt offerings and grain offerings and sacrifices to me."
verses.textEnNasb: and the Levitical priests shall not lack a man before Me to offer burnt offerings, to burn grain offerings, and to prepare sacrifices continually.’ "
verses.textEn: nor will the Levitical priests ever fail to have a man to stand before me continually to offer burnt offerings, to burn grain offerings and to present sacrifices.’ "

verses.textZh: 耶和华说的话临到耶利米，说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华说的话临到耶利米，说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的话临到耶利米说：
verses.textEnNiv: The word of the Lord came to Jeremiah:
verses.textEnEsv: The word of the Lord came to Jeremiah:
verses.textEnNkjv: And the word of the Lord came to Jeremiah, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: Then this message came to Jeremiah from the Lord :
verses.textEnNasb: And the word of the Lord came to Jeremiah, saying,
verses.textEn: The word of the Lord came to Jeremiah:

verses.textZh: "耶和华这样说：‘你们若能废掉我所立白昼和黑夜的约，使白昼和黑夜不按时更替，
verses.textZhCnvs: "耶和华这样说：‘你们若能废掉我所立白昼和黑夜的约，使白昼和黑夜不按时更替，
verses.textZhCuv: 「耶和华如此说：你们若能废弃我所立白日黑夜的约，使白日黑夜不按时轮转，
verses.textEnNiv: "This is what the Lord says: ‘If you can break my covenant with the day and my covenant with the night, so that day and night no longer come at their appointed time,
verses.textEnEsv: "Thus says the Lord : If you can break my covenant with the day and my covenant with the night, so that day and night will not come at their appointed time,
verses.textEnNkjv: "Thus says the Lord: ‘If you can break My covenant with the day and My covenant with the night, so that there will not be day and night in their season,
verses.textEnNlt: "This is what the Lord says: If you can break my covenant with the day and the night so that one does not follow the other,
verses.textEnNasb: "This is what the Lord says: ‘If you can break My covenant for the day and My covenant for the night, so that day and night do not occur at their proper time,
verses.textEn: "This is what the Lord says: ‘If you can break my covenant with the day and my covenant with the night, so that day and night no longer come at their appointed time,

verses.textZh: 就能废掉我和我仆人大卫所立的约，使他没有儿子在他的王位上作王；也能废掉我和那些事奉我的利未支派的祭司所立的约。
verses.textZhCnvs: 就能废掉我和我仆人大卫所立的约，使他没有儿子在他的王位上作王；也能废掉我和那些事奉我的利未支派的祭司所立的约。
verses.textZhCuv: 就能废弃我与我仆人大卫所立的约，使他没有儿子在他的宝座上为王，并能废弃我与事奉我的祭司、利未人所立的约。
verses.textEnNiv: then my covenant with David my servant—and my covenant with the Levites who are priests ministering before me—can be broken and David will no longer have a descendant to reign on his throne.
verses.textEnEsv: then also my covenant with David my servant may be broken, so that he shall not have a son to reign on his throne, and my covenant with the Levitical priests my ministers.
verses.textEnNkjv: then My covenant may also be broken with David My servant, so that he shall not have a son to reign on his throne, and with the Levites, the priests, My ministers.
verses.textEnNlt: only then will my covenant with my servant David be broken. Only then will he no longer have a descendant to reign on his throne. The same is true for my covenant with the Levitical priests who minister before me.
verses.textEnNasb: then My covenant with David My servant may also be broken, so that he will not have a son to reign on his throne, and with the Levitical priests, My ministers.
verses.textEn: then my covenant with David my servant—and my covenant with the Levites who are priests ministering before me—can be broken and David will no longer have a descendant to reign on his throne.

verses.textZh: 我却必使我仆人大卫的后裔和事奉我的利未人增多，像天上的万象不能数算、海边的沙粒不能斗量。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我却必使我仆人大卫的后裔和事奉我的利未人增多，像天上的万象不能数算、海边的沙粒不能斗量。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 天上的万象不能数算，海边的尘沙也不能斗量；我必照样使我仆人大卫的后裔和事奉我的利未人多起来。」
verses.textEnNiv: I will make the descendants of David my servant and the Levites who minister before me as countless as the stars in the sky and as measureless as the sand on the seashore.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: As the host of heaven cannot be numbered and the sands of the sea cannot be measured, so I will multiply the offspring of David my servant, and the Levitical priests who minister to me."
verses.textEnNkjv: As the host of heaven cannot be numbered, nor the sand of the sea measured, so will I multiply the descendants of David My servant and the Levites who minister to Me.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: And as the stars of the sky cannot be counted and the sand on the seashore cannot be measured, so I will multiply the descendants of my servant David and the Levites who minister before me."
verses.textEnNasb: As the heavenly lights cannot be counted, and the sand of the sea cannot be measured, so I will multiply the descendants of My servant David and the Levites who serve Me.’ "
verses.textEn: I will make the descendants of David my servant and the Levites who minister before me as countless as the stars in the sky and as measureless as the sand on the seashore.’ "

verses.textZh: 耶和华的话临到耶利米，说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的话临到耶利米，说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的话临到耶利米说：
verses.textEnNiv: The word of the Lord came to Jeremiah:
verses.textEnEsv: The word of the Lord came to Jeremiah:
verses.textEnNkjv: Moreover the word of the Lord came to Jeremiah, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord gave another message to Jeremiah. He said,
verses.textEnNasb: And the word of the Lord came to Jeremiah, saying,
verses.textEn: The word of the Lord came to Jeremiah:

verses.textZh: "你没有留意列国的人民说甚么吗？他们说：‘耶和华所拣选的这两个家族，他已经弃绝了。’他们藐视我的子民，不再把他们看为一个国家。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你没有留意列国的人民说甚么吗？他们说：‘耶和华所拣选的这两个家族，他已经弃绝了。’他们藐视我的子民，不再把他们看为一个国家。
verses.textZhCuv: 「你没有揣摩这百姓的话吗？他们说：『耶和华所拣选的二族，他已经弃绝了。』他们这样藐视我的百姓，以为不再成国。
verses.textEnNiv: "Have you not noticed that these people are saying, ‘The Lord has rejected the two kingdoms he chose’? So they despise my people and no longer regard them as a nation.
verses.textEnEsv: "Have you not observed that these people are saying, ‘The Lord has rejected the two clans that he chose’? Thus they have despised my people so that they are no longer a nation in their sight.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Have you not considered what these people have spoken, saying, ‘The two families which the Lord has chosen, He has also cast them off’? Thus they have despised My people, as if they should no more be a nation before them.
verses.textEnNlt: "Have you noticed what people are saying?—‘The Lord chose Judah and Israel and then abandoned them!’ They are sneering and saying that Israel is not worthy to be counted as a nation.
verses.textEnNasb: "Have you not observed what these people have asserted, saying, ‘The two families which the Lord chose, He has rejected them’? So they despise My people as no longer being a nation in their sight.
verses.textEn: "Have you not noticed that these people are saying, ‘The Lord has rejected the two kingdoms he chose’? So they despise my people and no longer regard them as a nation.

verses.textZh: 耶和华这样说：‘我若没有设立白昼和黑夜的约，或立定天地的定律，
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华这样说：‘我若没有设立白昼和黑夜的约，或立定天地的定律，
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华如此说：若是我立白日黑夜的约不能存住，若是我未曾安排天地的定例，
verses.textEnNiv: This is what the Lord says: ‘If I have not made my covenant with day and night and established the laws of heaven and earth,
verses.textEnEsv: Thus says the Lord : If I have not established my covenant with day and night and the fixed order of heaven and earth,
verses.textEnNkjv: "Thus says the Lord: ‘If My covenant is not with day and night, andif I have not appointed the ordinances of heaven and earth,
verses.textEnNlt: But this is what the Lord says: I would no more reject my people than I would change my laws that govern night and day, earth and sky.
verses.textEnNasb: This is what the Lord says: ‘If My covenant for day and night does not continue, and I have not established the fixed patterns of heaven and earth,
verses.textEn: This is what the Lord says: ‘If I have not made my covenant with day and night and established the laws of heaven and earth,

verses.textZh: 我就会弃绝雅各的后裔，和我仆人大卫的后裔，不从大卫的后裔中选人出来统治亚伯拉罕、以撒和雅各的后裔。我却必使他们被掳的人归回，也必怜悯他们。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我就会弃绝雅各的后裔，和我仆人大卫的后裔，不从大卫的后裔中选人出来统治亚伯拉罕、以撒和雅各的后裔。我却必使他们被掳的人归回，也必怜悯他们。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 我就弃绝雅各的后裔和我仆人大卫的后裔，不使大卫的后裔治理亚伯拉罕、以撒、雅各的后裔；因为我必使他们被掳的人归回，也必怜悯他们。」
verses.textEnNiv: then I will reject the descendants of Jacob and David my servant and will not choose one of his sons to rule over the descendants of Abraham, Isaac and Jacob. For I will restore their fortunes and have compassion on them.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: then I will reject the offspring of Jacob and David my servant and will not choose one of his offspring to rule over the offspring of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. For I will restore their fortunes and will have mercy on them."
verses.textEnNkjv: then I will cast away the descendants of Jacob and David My servant, so that I will not take any of his descendants tobe rulers over the descendants of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. For I will cause their captives to return, and will have mercy on them.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: I will never abandon the descendants of Jacob or David, my servant, or change the plan that David’s descendants will rule the descendants of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. Instead, I will restore them to their land and have mercy on them."
verses.textEnNasb: then I would reject the descendants of Jacob and David My servant, so as not to take from his descendants rulers over the descendants of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. But I will restore their fortunes and have mercy on them.’ "
verses.textEn: then I will reject the descendants of Jacob and David my servant and will not choose one of his sons to rule over the descendants of Abraham, Isaac and Jacob. For I will restore their fortunes and have compassion on them.’ "

verses.textZh: 巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒率领他的全军，以及他统治的地上各国各族，攻打耶路撒冷和周围一切城镇的时候，从耶和华那里有话临到耶利米，说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒率领他的全军，以及他统治的地上各国各族，攻打耶路撒冷和周围一切城镇的时候，从耶和华那里有话临到耶利米，说：
verses.textZhCuv: 巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒率领他的全军和地上属他的各国各邦，攻打耶路撒冷和属耶路撒冷所有的城邑。那时，耶和华的话临到耶利米说：
verses.textEnNiv: While Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon and all his army and all the kingdoms and peoples in the empire he ruled were fighting against Jerusalem and all its surrounding towns, this word came to Jeremiah from the Lord :
verses.textEnEsv: The word that came to Jeremiah from the Lord , when Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon and all his army and all the kingdoms of the earth under his dominion and all the peoples were fighting against Jerusalem and all of its cities:
verses.textEnNkjv: The word which came to Jeremiah from the Lord, when Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon and all his army, all the kingdoms of the earth under his dominion, and all the people, fought against Jerusalem and all its cities, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylon came with all the armies from the kingdoms he ruled, and he fought against Jerusalem and the towns of Judah. At that time this message came to Jeremiah from the Lord :
verses.textEnNasb: The word that came to Jeremiah from the Lord, when Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon and all his army, with all the kingdoms of the earth that were under his control and all the peoples, were fighting against Jerusalem and all its cities, saying,
verses.textEn: While Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon and all his army and all the kingdoms and peoples in the empire he ruled were fighting against Jerusalem and all its surrounding towns, this word came to Jeremiah from the Lord :

verses.textZh: "耶和华以色列的神这样说：‘你去告诉犹大王西底家说：耶和华这样说：看哪！我要把这城交在巴比伦王的手中，他要用火烧城。
verses.textZhCnvs: "耶和华以色列的神这样说：‘你去告诉犹大王西底家说：耶和华这样说：看哪！我要把这城交在巴比伦王的手中，他要用火烧城。
verses.textZhCuv: 「耶和华－以色列的神说，你去告诉犹大王西底家，耶和华如此说：我要将这城交付巴比伦王的手，他必用火焚烧。
verses.textEnNiv: "This is what the Lord , the God of Israel, says: Go to Zedekiah king of Judah and tell him, ‘This is what the Lord says: I am about to give this city into the hands of the king of Babylon, and he will burn it down.
verses.textEnEsv: "Thus says the Lord , the God of Israel: Go and speak to Zedekiah king of Judah and say to him, ‘Thus says the Lord : Behold, I am giving this city into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he shall burn it with fire.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Thus says the Lord, the God of Israel: ‘Go and speak to Zedekiah king of Judah and tell him, "Thus says the Lord: ‘Behold, I will give this city into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he shall burn it with fire.
verses.textEnNlt: "Go to King Zedekiah of Judah, and tell him, ‘This is what the Lord , the God of Israel, says: I am about to hand this city over to the king of Babylon, and he will burn it down.
verses.textEnNasb: "This is what the Lord, the God of Israel says: ‘Go and speak to Zedekiah king of Judah and say to him, "This is what the Lord says: ‘Behold, I am handing this city over to the king of Babylon, and he will burn it with fire.
verses.textEn: "This is what the Lord , the God of Israel, says: Go to Zedekiah king of Judah and tell him, ‘This is what the Lord says: I am about to give this city into the hands of the king of Babylon, and he will burn it down.

verses.textZh: 你必逃不出他的手，必被拿住，交在他的手中。你必亲眼看见巴比伦王，他必亲口和你说话；你也必到巴比伦去。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 你必逃不出他的手，必被拿住，交在他的手中。你必亲眼看见巴比伦王，他必亲口和你说话；你也必到巴比伦去。’
verses.textZhCuv: 你必不能逃脱他的手，定被拿住，交在他的手中。你的眼要见巴比伦王的眼，他要口对口和你说话，你也必到巴比伦去。
verses.textEnNiv: You will not escape from his grasp but will surely be captured and given into his hands. You will see the king of Babylon with your own eyes, and he will speak with you face to face. And you will go to Babylon.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall not escape from his hand but shall surely be captured and delivered into his hand. You shall see the king of Babylon eye to eye and speak with him face to face. And you shall go to Babylon.’
verses.textEnNkjv: And you shall not escape from his hand, but shall surely be taken and delivered into his hand; your eyes shall see the eyes of the king of Babylon, he shall speak with you face to face, and you shall go to Babylon.’ " ’
verses.textEnNlt: You will not escape his grasp but will be captured and taken to meet the king of Babylon face to face. Then you will be exiled to Babylon.
verses.textEnNasb: And as for you, you will not escape from his hand, for you will assuredly be caught and handed over to him; and you will see the king of Babylon eye to eye, and he will speak with you face to face, and you will go to Babylon.’ " ’
verses.textEn: You will not escape from his grasp but will surely be captured and given into his hands. You will see the king of Babylon with your own eyes, and he will speak with you face to face. And you will go to Babylon.

verses.textZh: 但犹大王西底家啊，你还要听耶和华的话！耶和华论到你这样说：‘你必不会死在刀下；
verses.textZhCnvs: 但犹大王西底家啊，你还要听耶和华的话！耶和华论到你这样说：‘你必不会死在刀下；
verses.textZhCuv: 犹大王西底家啊，你还要听耶和华的话。耶和华论到你如此说：你必不被刀剑杀死，
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘Yet hear the Lord ’s promise to you, Zedekiah king of Judah. This is what the Lord says concerning you: You will not die by the sword;
verses.textEnEsv: Yet hear the word of the Lord , O Zedekiah king of Judah! Thus says the Lord concerning you: ‘You shall not die by the sword.
verses.textEnNkjv: Yet hear the word of the Lord, O Zedekiah king of Judah! Thus says the Lord concerning you: ‘You shall not die by the sword.
verses.textEnNlt: "‘But listen to this promise from the Lord , O Zedekiah, king of Judah. This is what the Lord says: You will not be killed in war
verses.textEnNasb: Yet hear the word of the Lord, Zedekiah king of Judah! This is what the Lord says concerning you: ‘You will not die by the sword.
verses.textEn: " ‘Yet hear the Lord ’s promise to you, Zedekiah king of Judah. This is what the Lord says concerning you: You will not die by the sword;

verses.textZh: 你必平平安安死去。人怎样为你的列祖，就是在你以前的君王，焚烧香料，也必照样为你焚烧香料；人必为你哀悼，说："哀哉，主上！"’这话是我说的。"这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你必平平安安死去。人怎样为你的列祖，就是在你以前的君王，焚烧香料，也必照样为你焚烧香料；人必为你哀悼，说："哀哉，主上！"’这话是我说的。"这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 你必平安而死，人必为你焚烧物件，好像为你列祖，就是在你以前的先王焚烧一般。人必为你举哀说：『哀哉！我主啊。』耶和华说：这话是我说的。」
verses.textEnNiv: you will die peacefully. As people made a funeral fire in honor of your predecessors, the kings who ruled before you, so they will make a fire in your honor and lament, "Alas, master!" I myself make this promise, declares the Lord .’ "
verses.textEnEsv: You shall die in peace. And as spices were burned for your fathers, the former kings who were before you, so people shall burn spices for you and lament for you, saying, "Alas, lord!"’ For I have spoken the word, declares the Lord ."
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall die in peace; as in the ceremonies of your fathers, the former kings who were before you, so they shall burn incense for you and lament for you, saying, "Alas, lord!" For I have pronounced the word, says the Lord.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: but will die peacefully. People will burn incense in your memory, just as they did for your ancestors, the kings who preceded you. They will mourn for you, crying, "Alas, our master is dead!" This I have decreed, says the Lord .’"
verses.textEnNasb: You will die in peace; and as spices were burned for your fathers, the former kings who were before you, so they will burn spices for you; and they will mourn for you, crying, "Oh, my lord!" ’ For I have spoken the word," declares the Lord.
verses.textEn: you will die peacefully. As people made a funeral fire in honor of your predecessors, the kings who ruled before you, so they will make a fire in your honor and lament, "Alas, master!" I myself make this promise, declares the Lord .’ "

verses.textZh: 于是耶利米先知在耶路撒冷把这一切话都告诉了犹大王西底家。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是耶利米先知在耶路撒冷把这一切话都告诉了犹大王西底家。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是，先知耶利米在耶路撒冷将这一切话告诉犹大王西底家。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Jeremiah the prophet told all this to Zedekiah king of Judah, in Jerusalem,
verses.textEnEsv: Then Jeremiah the prophet spoke all these words to Zedekiah king of Judah, in Jerusalem,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Jeremiah the prophet spoke all these words to Zedekiah king of Judah in Jerusalem,
verses.textEnNlt: So Jeremiah the prophet delivered the message to King Zedekiah of Judah.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Jeremiah the prophet spoke all these words to Zedekiah king of Judah in Jerusalem
verses.textEn: Then Jeremiah the prophet told all this to Zedekiah king of Judah, in Jerusalem,

verses.textZh: 那时，巴比伦王的军队正在攻打耶路撒冷和犹大剩下的城镇，就是拉吉和亚西加，因为在犹大的各城中，只剩下这两座坚固的城了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，巴比伦王的军队正在攻打耶路撒冷和犹大剩下的城镇，就是拉吉和亚西加，因为在犹大的各城中，只剩下这两座坚固的城了。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时，巴比伦王的军队正攻打耶路撒冷，又攻打犹大所剩下的城邑，就是拉吉和亚西加。原来犹大的坚固城只剩下这两座。
verses.textEnNiv: while the army of the king of Babylon was fighting against Jerusalem and the other cities of Judah that were still holding out—Lachish and Azekah. These were the only fortified cities left in Judah.
verses.textEnEsv: when the army of the king of Babylon was fighting against Jerusalem and against all the cities of Judah that were left, Lachish and Azekah, for these were the only fortified cities of Judah that remained.
verses.textEnNkjv: when the king of Babylon’s army fought against Jerusalem and all the cities of Judah that were left, against Lachish and Azekah; for only these fortified cities remained of the cities of Judah.
verses.textEnNlt: At this time the Babylonian army was besieging Jerusalem, Lachish, and Azekah—the only fortified cities of Judah not yet captured.
verses.textEnNasb: when the army of the king of Babylon was fighting against Jerusalem and all the remaining cities of Judah, that is, Lachish and Azekah, for they alone remained as fortified cities among the cities of Judah.
verses.textEn: while the army of the king of Babylon was fighting against Jerusalem and the other cities of Judah that were still holding out—Lachish and Azekah. These were the only fortified cities left in Judah.

verses.textZh: 所有立了约的领袖和众民都同意释放各人自己的奴婢，谁也不再使他们作奴仆。他们都同意了，并且把奴婢释放了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所有立了约的领袖和众民都同意释放各人自己的奴婢，谁也不再使他们作奴仆。他们都同意了，并且把奴婢释放了。
verses.textZhCuv: 所有立约的首领和众民就任他的仆人婢女自由出去，谁也不再叫他们作奴仆。大家都顺从，将他们释放了；
verses.textEnNiv: The word came to Jeremiah from the Lord after King Zedekiah had made a covenant with all the people in Jerusalem to proclaim freedom for the slaves.
verses.textEnEsv: The word that came to Jeremiah from the Lord , after King Zedekiah had made a covenant with all the people in Jerusalem to make a proclamation of liberty to them,
verses.textEnNkjv: Thisis the word that came to Jeremiah from the Lord, after King Zedekiah had made a covenant with all the people who were at Jerusalem to proclaim liberty to them:
verses.textEnNlt: This message came to Jeremiah from the Lord after King Zedekiah made a covenant with the people, proclaiming freedom for the slaves.
verses.textEnNasb: The word that came to Jeremiah from the Lord after King Zedekiah had made a covenant with all the people who were in Jerusalem, to proclaim release to them:
verses.textEn: The word came to Jeremiah from the Lord after King Zedekiah had made a covenant with all the people in Jerusalem to proclaim freedom for the slaves.

verses.textZh: 但后来他们反悔，把他们释放了的奴婢叫回来，强迫他们再作奴婢。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但后来他们反悔，把他们释放了的奴婢叫回来，强迫他们再作奴婢。
verses.textZhCuv: 后来却又反悔，叫所任去自由的仆人婢女回来，勉强他们仍为仆婢。
verses.textEnNiv: Everyone was to free their Hebrew slaves, both male and female; no one was to hold a fellow Hebrew in bondage.
verses.textEnEsv: that everyone should set free his Hebrew slaves, male and female, so that no one should enslave a Jew, his brother.
verses.textEnNkjv: that every man should set free his male and female slave—a Hebrew man or woman— that no one should keep a Jewish brother in bondage.
verses.textEnNlt: He had ordered all the people to free their Hebrew slaves—both men and women. No one was to keep a fellow Judean in bondage.
verses.textEnNasb: that each person was to set his male servant free and each his female servant, a Hebrew man or a Hebrew woman, so that no one would keep them, his Jewish brother or sister, in bondage.
verses.textEn: Everyone was to free their Hebrew slaves, both male and female; no one was to hold a fellow Hebrew in bondage.

verses.textZh: 于是耶和华有话临到耶利米，说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是耶和华有话临到耶利米，说：
verses.textZhCuv: 因此耶和华的话临到耶利米说：
verses.textEnNiv: So all the officials and people who entered into this covenant agreed that they would free their male and female slaves and no longer hold them in bondage. They agreed, and set them free.
verses.textEnEsv: And they obeyed, all the officials and all the people who had entered into the covenant that everyone would set free his slave, male or female, so that they would not be enslaved again. They obeyed and set them free.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now when all the princes and all the people, who had entered into the covenant, heard that everyone should set free his male and female slaves, that no one should keep them in bondage anymore, they obeyed and let them go.
verses.textEnNlt: The officials and all the people had obeyed the king’s command,
verses.textEnNasb: And all the officials and all the people obeyed who had entered into the covenant that each person was to set his male servant free and each his female servant, so that no one would keep them in bondage any longer; they obeyed, and set them free.
verses.textEn: So all the officials and people who entered into this covenant agreed that they would free their male and female slaves and no longer hold them in bondage. They agreed, and set them free.

verses.textZh: "耶和华以色列的神这样说：‘我把你们的列祖从埃及地为奴之家领出来的那日子，就和他们立了约，说：
verses.textZhCnvs: "耶和华以色列的神这样说：‘我把你们的列祖从埃及地为奴之家领出来的那日子，就和他们立了约，说：
verses.textZhCuv: 「耶和华－以色列的神如此说：我将你们的列祖从埃及地为奴之家领出来的时候，与他们立约说：
verses.textEnNiv: But afterward they changed their minds and took back the slaves they had freed and enslaved them again.
verses.textEnEsv: But afterward they turned around and took back the male and female slaves they had set free, and brought them into subjection as slaves.
verses.textEnNkjv: But afterward they changed their minds and made the male and female slaves return, whom they had set free, and brought them into subjection as male and female slaves.
verses.textEnNlt: but later they changed their minds. They took back the men and women they had freed, forcing them to be slaves again.
verses.textEnNasb: But afterward they turned around and took back the male servants and the female servants whom they had set free, and brought them into subjection as male servants and as female servants.
verses.textEn: But afterward they changed their minds and took back the slaves they had freed and enslaved them again.

verses.textZh: "一个希伯来兄弟卖了身给你，服事了你六年，到第七年，你们各人就应释放他，容他自由离去。"但你们的列祖不听从我，毫不在意。
verses.textZhCnvs: "一个希伯来兄弟卖了身给你，服事了你六年，到第七年，你们各人就应释放他，容他自由离去。"但你们的列祖不听从我，毫不在意。
verses.textZhCuv: 『你的一个希伯来弟兄若卖给你，服事你六年，到第七年你们各人就要任他自由出去。』只是你们列祖不听从我，也不侧耳而听。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the word of the Lord came to Jeremiah:
verses.textEnEsv: The word of the Lord came to Jeremiah from the Lord :
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore the word of the Lord came to Jeremiah from the Lord, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: So the Lord gave them this message through Jeremiah:
verses.textEnNasb: Then the word of the Lord came to Jeremiah from the Lord, saying,
verses.textEn: Then the word of the Lord came to Jeremiah:

verses.textZh: 现今你们悔改，行我眼中看为正的事，各人向自己的同胞宣告自由，并且在称为我名下的殿中，在我面前立了约。
verses.textZhCnvs: 现今你们悔改，行我眼中看为正的事，各人向自己的同胞宣告自由，并且在称为我名下的殿中，在我面前立了约。
verses.textZhCuv: 如今你们回转，行我眼中看为正的事，各人向邻舍宣告自由，并且在称为我名下的殿中、在我面前立约。
verses.textEnNiv: "This is what the Lord , the God of Israel, says: I made a covenant with your ancestors when I brought them out of Egypt, out of the land of slavery. I said,
verses.textEnEsv: "Thus says the Lord , the God of Israel: I myself made a covenant with your fathers when I brought them out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of slavery, saying,
verses.textEnNkjv: "Thus says the Lord, the God of Israel: ‘I made a covenant with your fathers in the day that I brought them out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: "This is what the Lord , the God of Israel, says: I made a covenant with your ancestors long ago when I rescued them from their slavery in Egypt.
verses.textEnNasb: "This is what the Lord, the God of Israel says: ‘I made a covenant with your forefathers on the day that I brought them out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage, saying,
verses.textEn: "This is what the Lord , the God of Israel, says: I made a covenant with your ancestors when I brought them out of Egypt, out of the land of slavery. I said,

verses.textZh: 你们却又反悔，亵渎我的名；各人把得了释放随意离去的奴婢叫回来，强迫他们再作奴婢。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们却又反悔，亵渎我的名；各人把得了释放随意离去的奴婢叫回来，强迫他们再作奴婢。’
verses.textZhCuv: 你们却又反悔，亵渎我的名，各人叫所任去随意自由的仆人婢女回来，勉强他们仍为仆婢。
verses.textEnNiv: ‘Every seventh year each of you must free any fellow Hebrews who have sold themselves to you. After they have served you six years, you must let them go free.’ Your ancestors, however, did not listen to me or pay attention to me.
verses.textEnEsv: ‘At the end of seven years each of you must set free the fellow Hebrew who has been sold to you and has served you six years; you must set him free from your service.’ But your fathers did not listen to me or incline their ears to me.
verses.textEnNkjv: "At the end of seven years let every man set free his Hebrew brother, who has been sold to him; and when he has served you six years, you shall let him go free from you." But your fathers did not obey Me nor incline their ear.
verses.textEnNlt: I told them that every Hebrew slave must be freed after serving six years. But your ancestors paid no attention to me.
verses.textEnNasb: "At the end of seven years each of you shall set free his Hebrew brother who has been sold to you and has served you for six years, and you shall send him out free from you." But your forefathers did not obey Me nor incline their ear to Me.
verses.textEn: ‘Every seventh year each of you must free any fellow Hebrews who have sold themselves to you. After they have served you six years, you must let them go free.’ Your ancestors, however, did not listen to me or pay attention to me.

verses.textZh: "所以，耶和华这样说：‘你们各人没有听从我，向兄弟、同胞宣告自由；看哪！我现在向你们宣告自由，容让你们遭受刀剑、瘟疫和饥荒，使你们成为地上万国所惊惧的。’这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: "所以，耶和华这样说：‘你们各人没有听从我，向兄弟、同胞宣告自由；看哪！我现在向你们宣告自由，容让你们遭受刀剑、瘟疫和饥荒，使你们成为地上万国所惊惧的。’这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以耶和华如此说：你们没有听从我，各人向弟兄邻舍宣告自由。看哪！我向你们宣告一样自由，就是使你们自由于刀剑、饥荒、瘟疫之下，并且使你们在天下万国中抛来抛去。这是耶和华说的。
verses.textEnNiv: Recently you repented and did what is right in my sight: Each of you proclaimed freedom to your own people. You even made a covenant before me in the house that bears my Name.
verses.textEnEsv: You recently repented and did what was right in my eyes by proclaiming liberty, each to his neighbor, and you made a covenant before me in the house that is called by my name,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then you recently turned and did what was right in My sight—every man proclaiming liberty to his neighbor; and you made a covenant before Me in the house which is called by My name.
verses.textEnNlt: Recently you repented and did what was right, following my command. You freed your slaves and made a solemn covenant with me in the Temple that bears my name.
verses.textEnNasb: Although recently you had turned and done what is right in My sight, each one proclaiming release to his neighbor, and you had made a covenant before Me in the house which is called by My name.
verses.textEn: Recently you repented and did what is right in my sight: Each of you proclaimed freedom to your own people. You even made a covenant before me in the house that bears my Name.

verses.textZh: ‘我必把那些违犯我的约的人交出去；他们没有履行在我面前和我立约的誓言，就是他们把牛犊劈开两半，并且从两半中间走过去时立下的。
verses.textZhCnvs: ‘我必把那些违犯我的约的人交出去；他们没有履行在我面前和我立约的誓言，就是他们把牛犊劈开两半，并且从两半中间走过去时立下的。
verses.textZhCuv: 我必将他们交在仇敌和寻索其命的人手中；他们的尸首必给空中的飞鸟和地上的野兽作食物。
verses.textEnNiv: But now you have turned around and profaned my name; each of you has taken back the male and female slaves you had set free to go where they wished. You have forced them to become your slaves again.
verses.textEnEsv: but then you turned around and profaned my name when each of you took back his male and female slaves, whom you had set free according to their desire, and you brought them into subjection to be your slaves.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then you turned around and profaned My name, and every one of you brought back his male and female slaves, whom you had set at liberty, at their pleasure, and brought them back into subjection, to be your male and female slaves.’
verses.textEnNlt: But now you have shrugged off your oath and defiled my name by taking back the men and women you had freed, forcing them to be slaves once again.
verses.textEnNasb: Yet you turned and profaned My name, and each person took back his male servant and each his female servant whom you had set free according to their desire, and you brought them into subjection to be your male and female servants.’
verses.textEn: But now you have turned around and profaned my name; each of you has taken back the male and female slaves you had set free to go where they wished. You have forced them to become your slaves again.

verses.textZh: 那些从牛犊两半中间走过去的人，就是犹大的领袖、耶路撒冷的领袖、宫中的臣宰、祭司和这地的众民。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那些从牛犊两半中间走过去的人，就是犹大的领袖、耶路撒冷的领袖、宫中的臣宰、祭司和这地的众民。
verses.textZhCuv: 并且我必将犹大王西底家和他的首领交在他们仇敌和寻索其命的人，与那暂离你们而去巴比伦王军队的手中。
verses.textEnNiv: "Therefore this is what the Lord says: You have not obeyed me; you have not proclaimed freedom to your own people. So I now proclaim ‘freedom’ for you, declares the Lord —‘freedom’ to fall by the sword, plague and famine. I will make you abhorrent to all the kingdoms of the earth.
verses.textEnEsv: "Therefore, thus says the Lord : You have not obeyed me by proclaiming liberty, every one to his brother and to his neighbor; behold, I proclaim to you liberty to the sword, to pestilence, and to famine, declares the Lord . I will make you a horror to all the kingdoms of the earth.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Therefore thus says the Lord: ‘You have not obeyed Me in proclaiming liberty, every one to his brother and every one to his neighbor. Behold, I proclaim liberty to you,’ says the Lord— ‘to the sword, to pestilence, and to famine! And I will deliver you to trouble among all the kingdoms of the earth.
verses.textEnNlt: "Therefore, this is what the Lord says: Since you have not obeyed me by setting your countrymen free, I will set you free to be destroyed by war, disease, and famine. You will be an object of horror to all the nations of the earth.
verses.textEnNasb: "Therefore this is what the Lord says: ‘You have not obeyed Me in proclaiming release, each one to his brother and each to his neighbor. Behold, I am proclaiming a release to you,’ declares the Lord, ‘to the sword, to the plague, and to the famine; and I will make you a terror to all the kingdoms of the earth.
verses.textEn: "Therefore this is what the Lord says: You have not obeyed me; you have not proclaimed freedom to your own people. So I now proclaim ‘freedom’ for you, declares the Lord —‘freedom’ to fall by the sword, plague and famine. I will make you abhorrent to all the kingdoms of the earth.

verses.textZh: 我必把他们交在他们仇敌的手中，和那些寻索他们性命的人的手中；他们的尸体必给空中的飞鸟和地上的走兽作食物。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必把他们交在他们仇敌的手中，和那些寻索他们性命的人的手中；他们的尸体必给空中的飞鸟和地上的走兽作食物。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华说：我必吩咐他们回到这城，攻打这城，将城攻取，用火焚烧。我也要使犹大的城邑变为荒场，无人居住。」
verses.textEnNiv: Those who have violated my covenant and have not fulfilled the terms of the covenant they made before me, I will treat like the calf they cut in two and then walked between its pieces.
verses.textEnEsv: And the men who transgressed my covenant and did not keep the terms of the covenant that they made before me, I will make them like the calf that they cut in two and passed between its parts—
verses.textEnNkjv: And I will give the men who have transgressed My covenant, who have not performed the words of the covenant which they made before Me, when they cut the calf in two and passed between the parts of it—
verses.textEnNlt: Because you have broken the terms of our covenant, I will cut you apart just as you cut apart the calf when you walked between its halves to solemnize your vows.
verses.textEnNasb: I will give the people who have violated My covenant, who have not fulfilled the words of the covenant which they made before Me, when they cut the calf in two and passed between its parts—
verses.textEn: Those who have violated my covenant and have not fulfilled the terms of the covenant they made before me, I will treat like the calf they cut in two and then walked between its pieces.

verses.textZh: 我也必把犹大王西底家和众领袖交在他们仇敌的手中，和那些寻索他们性命的人的手中，以及那些从你们面前暂时撤退的巴比伦王的军队的手中。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我也必把犹大王西底家和众领袖交在他们仇敌的手中，和那些寻索他们性命的人的手中，以及那些从你们面前暂时撤退的巴比伦王的军队的手中。
verses.textZhCuv: 我也必把犹大王西底家和众领袖交在他们仇敌的手中，和那些寻索他们性命的人的手中，以及那些从你们面前暂时撤退的巴比伦王的军队的手中。
verses.textEnNiv: The leaders of Judah and Jerusalem, the court officials, the priests and all the people of the land who walked between the pieces of the calf,
verses.textEnEsv: the officials of Judah, the officials of Jerusalem, the eunuchs, the priests, and all the people of the land who passed between the parts of the calf.
verses.textEnNkjv: the princes of Judah, the princes of Jerusalem, the eunuchs, the priests, and all the people of the land who passed between the parts of the calf—
verses.textEnNlt: Yes, I will cut you apart, whether you are officials of Judah or Jerusalem, court officials, priests, or common people—for you have broken your oath.
verses.textEnNasb: the officials of Judah and the officials of Jerusalem, the high officials and the priests, and all the people of the land who passed between the parts of the calf—
verses.textEn: The leaders of Judah and Jerusalem, the court officials, the priests and all the people of the land who walked between the pieces of the calf,

verses.textZh: 看哪！我必下令，使他们回到这城来；他们必攻打、夺取这城，用火焚烧；我必使犹大的城镇都荒凉，没有人居住。’"这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 看哪！我必下令，使他们回到这城来；他们必攻打、夺取这城，用火焚烧；我必使犹大的城镇都荒凉，没有人居住。’"这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 看哪！我必下令，使他们回到这城来；他们必攻打、夺取这城，用火焚烧；我必使犹大的城镇都荒凉，没有人居住。’"这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textEnNiv: I will deliver into the hands of their enemies who want to kill them. Their dead bodies will become food for the birds and the wild animals.
verses.textEnEsv: And I will give them into the hand of their enemies and into the hand of those who seek their lives. Their dead bodies shall be food for the birds of the air and the beasts of the earth.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will give them into the hand of their enemies and into the hand of those who seek their life. Their dead bodies shall be for meat for the birds of the heaven and the beasts of the earth.
verses.textEnNlt: I will give you to your enemies, and they will kill you. Your bodies will be food for the vultures and wild animals.
verses.textEnNasb: I will hand them over to their enemies and to those who seek their lives. And their dead bodies will be food for the birds of the sky and the animals of the earth.
verses.textEn: I will deliver into the hands of their enemies who want to kill them. Their dead bodies will become food for the birds and the wild animals.

verses.textEnNiv: "I will deliver Zedekiah king of Judah and his officials into the hands of their enemies who want to kill them, to the army of the king of Babylon, which has withdrawn from you.
verses.textEnEsv: And Zedekiah king of Judah and his officials I will give into the hand of their enemies and into the hand of those who seek their lives, into the hand of the army of the king of Babylon which has withdrawn from you.
verses.textEnNkjv: And I will give Zedekiah king of Judah and his princes into the hand of their enemies, into the hand of those who seek their life, and into the hand of the king of Babylon’s army which has gone back from you.
verses.textEnNlt: "I will hand over King Zedekiah of Judah and his officials to the army of the king of Babylon. And although they have left Jerusalem for a while,
verses.textEnNasb: Zedekiah king of Judah and his officials I will also hand over to their enemies and to those who seek their lives, and to the army of the king of Babylon which has withdrawn from you.
verses.textEn: "I will deliver Zedekiah king of Judah and his officials into the hands of their enemies who want to kill them, to the army of the king of Babylon, which has withdrawn from you.

verses.textEnNiv: I am going to give the order, declares the Lord , and I will bring them back to this city. They will fight against it, take it and burn it down. And I will lay waste the towns of Judah so no one can live there."
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, I will command, declares the Lord , and will bring them back to this city. And they will fight against it and take it and burn it with fire. I will make the cities of Judah a desolation without inhabitant."
verses.textEnNkjv: Behold, I will command,’ says the Lord, ‘and cause them to return to this city. They will fight against it and take it and burn it with fire; and I will make the cities of Judah a desolation without inhabitant.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: I will call the Babylonian armies back again. They will fight against this city and will capture it and burn it down. I will see to it that all the towns of Judah are destroyed, with no one living there."
verses.textEnNasb: Behold, I am going to give a command,’ declares the Lord, ‘and I will bring them back to this city, and they will fight against it and take it and burn it with fire; and I will make the cities of Judah a desolation without inhabitant.’ "
verses.textEn: I am going to give the order, declares the Lord , and I will bring them back to this city. They will fight against it, take it and burn it down. And I will lay waste the towns of Judah so no one can live there."

verses.textZh: 在犹大王约西亚的儿子约雅敬作王的日子，耶和华有话临到耶利米，说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 在犹大王约西亚的儿子约雅敬作王的日子，耶和华有话临到耶利米，说：
verses.textZhCuv: 当犹大王约西亚之子约雅敬的时候，耶和华的话临到耶利米说：
verses.textEnNiv: This is the word that came to Jeremiah from the Lord during the reign of Jehoiakim son of Josiah king of Judah:
verses.textEnEsv: The word that came to Jeremiah from the Lord in the days of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah:
verses.textEnNkjv: The word which came to Jeremiah from the Lord in the days of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: This is the message the Lord gave Jeremiah when Jehoiakim son of Josiah was king of Judah:
verses.textEnNasb: The word that came to Jeremiah from the Lord in the days of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah, saying,
verses.textEn: This is the word that came to Jeremiah from the Lord during the reign of Jehoiakim son of Josiah king of Judah:

verses.textZh: "你去见利甲族的人，和他们交谈，领他们进入耶和华殿里的一个房间，给他们酒喝。"
verses.textZhCnvs: "你去见利甲族的人，和他们交谈，领他们进入耶和华殿里的一个房间，给他们酒喝。"
verses.textZhCuv: 「你去见利甲族的人，和他们说话，领他们进入耶和华殿的一间屋子，给他们酒喝。」
verses.textEnNiv: "Go to the Rekabite family and invite them to come to one of the side rooms of the house of the Lord and give them wine to drink."
verses.textEnEsv: "Go to the house of the Rechabites and speak with them and bring them to the house of the Lord , into one of the chambers; then offer them wine to drink."
verses.textEnNkjv: "Go to the house of the Rechabites, speak to them, and bring them into the house of the Lord, into one of the chambers, and give them wine to drink."
verses.textEnNlt: "Go to the settlement where the families of the Recabites live, and invite them to the Lord ’s Temple. Take them into one of the inner rooms, and offer them some wine."
verses.textEnNasb: "Go to the house of the Rechabites and speak to them, and bring them into the house of the Lord, into one of the chambers, and give them wine to drink."
verses.textEn: "Go to the Rekabite family and invite them to come to one of the side rooms of the house of the Lord and give them wine to drink."

verses.textZh: 于是我把哈巴洗尼雅的孙子、雅利米雅的儿子雅撒尼亚，以及他的兄弟、他的众子和利甲全族的人，
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是我把哈巴洗尼雅的孙子、雅利米雅的儿子雅撒尼亚，以及他的兄弟、他的众子和利甲全族的人，
verses.textZhCuv: 我就将哈巴洗尼雅的孙子雅利米雅的儿子雅撒尼亚和他弟兄，并他众子，以及利甲全族的人，
verses.textEnNiv: So I went to get Jaazaniah son of Jeremiah, the son of Habazziniah, and his brothers and all his sons—the whole family of the Rekabites.
verses.textEnEsv: So I took Jaazaniah the son of Jeremiah, son of Habazziniah and his brothers and all his sons and the whole house of the Rechabites.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then I took Jaazaniah the son of Jeremiah, the son of Habazziniah, his brothers and all his sons, and the whole house of the Rechabites,
verses.textEnNlt: So I went to see Jaazaniah son of Jeremiah and grandson of Habazziniah and all his brothers and sons—representing all the Recabite families.
verses.textEnNasb: So I took Jaazaniah the son of Jeremiah, son of Habazziniah, and his brothers and all his sons, and all the household of the Rechabites,
verses.textEn: So I went to get Jaazaniah son of Jeremiah, the son of Habazziniah, and his brothers and all his sons—the whole family of the Rekabites.

verses.textZh: 都领进耶和华的殿里，进了神人伊基大利的儿子哈难众子的房间；这房间是在众领袖的房间旁边，在沙龙的儿子守卫殿门的玛西雅的房间上面。
verses.textZhCnvs: 都领进耶和华的殿里，进了神人伊基大利的儿子哈难众子的房间；这房间是在众领袖的房间旁边，在沙龙的儿子守卫殿门的玛西雅的房间上面。
verses.textZhCuv: 领到耶和华的殿，进入神人伊基大利的儿子哈难众子的屋子。那屋子在首领的屋子旁边，在沙龙之子把门的玛西雅屋子以上。
verses.textEnNiv: I brought them into the house of the Lord , into the room of the sons of Hanan son of Igdaliah the man of God. It was next to the room of the officials, which was over that of Maaseiah son of Shallum the doorkeeper.
verses.textEnEsv: I brought them to the house of the Lord into the chamber of the sons of Hanan the son of Igdaliah, the man of God, which was near the chamber of the officials, above the chamber of Maaseiah the son of Shallum, keeper of the threshold.
verses.textEnNkjv: and I brought them into the house of the Lord, into the chamber of the sons of Hanan the son of Igdaliah, a man of God, which was by the chamber of the princes, above the chamber of Maaseiah the son of Shallum, the keeper of the door.
verses.textEnNlt: I took them to the Temple, and we went into the room assigned to the sons of Hanan son of Igdaliah, a man of God. This room was located next to the one used by the Temple officials, directly above the room of Maaseiah son of Shallum, the Temple gatekeeper.
verses.textEnNasb: and I brought them into the house of the Lord, into the chamber of the sons of Hanan the son of Igdaliah, the man of God, which was next to the chamber of the officials, which was above the chamber of Maaseiah the son of Shallum, the doorkeeper.
verses.textEn: I brought them into the house of the Lord , into the room of the sons of Hanan son of Igdaliah the man of God. It was next to the room of the officials, which was over that of Maaseiah son of Shallum the doorkeeper.

verses.textZh: 然后我把盛满酒的酒壶和酒杯，摆放在利甲族人的面前，对他们说："请喝酒！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 然后我把盛满酒的酒壶和酒杯，摆放在利甲族人的面前，对他们说："请喝酒！"
verses.textZhCuv: 于是我在利甲族人面前设摆盛满酒的碗和杯，对他们说：「请你们喝酒。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then I set bowls full of wine and some cups before the Rekabites and said to them, "Drink some wine."
verses.textEnEsv: Then I set before the Rechabites pitchers full of wine, and cups, and I said to them, "Drink wine."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then I set before the sons of the house of the Rechabites bowls full of wine, and cups; and I said to them, "Drink wine."
verses.textEnNlt: I set cups and jugs of wine before them and invited them to have a drink,
verses.textEnNasb: Then I set before the men of the house of the Rechabites pitchers full of wine, and cups; and I said to them, "Drink wine!"
verses.textEn: Then I set bowls full of wine and some cups before the Rekabites and said to them, "Drink some wine."

verses.textZh: 但他们说："我们不喝酒，因为我们的祖先利甲的儿子约拿达曾吩咐我们说：‘你们和你们的子孙永远都不可喝酒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但他们说："我们不喝酒，因为我们的祖先利甲的儿子约拿达曾吩咐我们说：‘你们和你们的子孙永远都不可喝酒。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们却说：「我们不喝酒；因为我们先祖利甲的儿子约拿达曾吩咐我们说：『你们与你们的子孙永不可喝酒，
verses.textEnNiv: But they replied, "We do not drink wine, because our forefather Jehonadab son of Rekab gave us this command: ‘Neither you nor your descendants must ever drink wine.
verses.textEnEsv: But they answered, "We will drink no wine, for Jonadab the son of Rechab, our father, commanded us, ‘You shall not drink wine, neither you nor your sons forever.
verses.textEnNkjv: But they said, "We will drink no wine, for Jonadab the son of Rechab, our father, commanded us, saying, ‘You shall drink no wine, you nor your sons, forever.
verses.textEnNlt: but they refused. "No," they said, "we don’t drink wine, because our ancestor Jehonadab son of Recab gave us this command: ‘You and your descendants must never drink wine.
verses.textEnNasb: But they said, "We will not drink wine, for Jonadab the son of Rechab, our father, commanded us, saying, ‘You shall not drink wine, you or your sons, forever.
verses.textEn: But they replied, "We do not drink wine, because our forefather Jehonadab son of Rekab gave us this command: ‘Neither you nor your descendants must ever drink wine.

verses.textZh: 你们也不可建造房屋，不可撒种，不可栽种或拥有葡萄园；你们一生的日子只可住帐棚，使你们在寄居的地上活得长久。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们也不可建造房屋，不可撒种，不可栽种或拥有葡萄园；你们一生的日子只可住帐棚，使你们在寄居的地上活得长久。’
verses.textZhCuv: 也不可盖房、撒种、栽种葡萄园，但一生的年日要住帐棚，使你们的日子在寄居之地得以延长。』
verses.textEnNiv: Also you must never build houses, sow seed or plant vineyards; you must never have any of these things, but must always live in tents. Then you will live a long time in the land where you are nomads.’
verses.textEnEsv: You shall not build a house; you shall not sow seed; you shall not plant or have a vineyard; but you shall live in tents all your days, that you may live many days in the land where you sojourn.’
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall not build a house, sow seed, plant a vineyard, nor have anyofthese; but all your days you shall dwell in tents, that you may live many days in the land where you are sojourners.’
verses.textEnNlt: And do not build houses or plant crops or vineyards, but always live in tents. If you follow these commands, you will live long, good lives in the land.’
verses.textEnNasb: You shall not build a house, and you shall not sow seed nor plant a vineyard, nor own one; but you shall live in tents all your days, so that you may live many days in the land where you live as strangers.’
verses.textEn: Also you must never build houses, sow seed or plant vineyards; you must never have any of these things, but must always live in tents. Then you will live a long time in the land where you are nomads.’

verses.textZh: 我们的祖先利甲的儿子约拿达吩咐我们的一切话，我们都听从了；我们和我们的妻子儿女，终生都不喝酒，
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们的祖先利甲的儿子约拿达吩咐我们的一切话，我们都听从了；我们和我们的妻子儿女，终生都不喝酒，
verses.textZhCuv: 凡我们先祖利甲的儿子约拿达所吩咐我们的话，我们都听从了。我们和我们的妻子儿女一生的年日都不喝酒，
verses.textEnNiv: We have obeyed everything our forefather Jehonadab son of Rekab commanded us. Neither we nor our wives nor our sons and daughters have ever drunk wine
verses.textEnEsv: We have obeyed the voice of Jonadab the son of Rechab, our father, in all that he commanded us, to drink no wine all our days, ourselves, our wives, our sons, or our daughters,
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus we have obeyed the voice of Jonadab the son of Rechab, our father, in all that he charged us, to drink no wine all our days, we, our wives, our sons, or our daughters,
verses.textEnNlt: So we have obeyed him in all these things. We have never had a drink of wine to this day, nor have our wives, our sons, or our daughters.
verses.textEnNasb: And we have obeyed the voice of Jonadab the son of Rechab, our father, in all that he commanded us, not to drink wine all our days, we, our wives, our sons, or our daughters,
verses.textEn: We have obeyed everything our forefather Jehonadab son of Rekab commanded us. Neither we nor our wives nor our sons and daughters have ever drunk wine

verses.textZh: 不建造房屋居住，也没有葡萄园、田地和种子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 不建造房屋居住，也没有葡萄园、田地和种子。
verses.textZhCuv: 也不盖房居住，也没有葡萄园、田地，和种子，
verses.textEnNiv: or built houses to live in or had vineyards, fields or crops.
verses.textEnEsv: and not to build houses to dwell in. We have no vineyard or field or seed,
verses.textEnNkjv: nor to build ourselves houses to dwell in; nor do we have vineyard, field, or seed.
verses.textEnNlt: We haven’t built houses or owned vineyards or farms or planted crops.
verses.textEnNasb: nor to build ourselves houses to live in; and we do not have a vineyard, a field, or seed.
verses.textEn: or built houses to live in or had vineyards, fields or crops.

verses.textZh: 我们只住帐棚；我们听从祖先约拿达吩咐我们的一切话，并且照着去行。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们只住帐棚；我们听从祖先约拿达吩咐我们的一切话，并且照着去行。
verses.textZhCuv: 但住帐棚，听从我们先祖约拿达的话，照他所吩咐我们的去行。
verses.textEnNiv: We have lived in tents and have fully obeyed everything our forefather Jehonadab commanded us.
verses.textEnEsv: but we have lived in tents and have obeyed and done all that Jonadab our father commanded us.
verses.textEnNkjv: But we have dwelt in tents, and have obeyed and done according to all that Jonadab our father commanded us.
verses.textEnNlt: We have lived in tents and have fully obeyed all the commands of Jehonadab, our ancestor.
verses.textEnNasb: But we have lived only in tents, and have obeyed and have done according to all that our father Jonadab commanded us.
verses.textEn: We have lived in tents and have fully obeyed everything our forefather Jehonadab commanded us.

verses.textZh: 但是，巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒上来攻打这地的时候，我们就说：‘来吧！为了迦勒底和亚兰人的军队的缘故，我们到耶路撒冷去。’这样，我们才住在耶路撒冷。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 但是，巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒上来攻打这地的时候，我们就说：‘来吧！为了迦勒底和亚兰人的军队的缘故，我们到耶路撒冷去。’这样，我们才住在耶路撒冷。"
verses.textZhCuv: 巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒上此地来，我们因怕迦勒底的军队和亚兰的军队，就说：『来吧，我们到耶路撒冷去。』这样，我们才住在耶路撒冷。」
verses.textEnNiv: But when Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon invaded this land, we said, ‘Come, we must go to Jerusalem to escape the Babylonian and Aramean armies.’ So we have remained in Jerusalem."
verses.textEnEsv: But when Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up against the land, we said, ‘Come, and let us go to Jerusalem for fear of the army of the Chaldeans and the army of the Syrians.’ So we are living in Jerusalem."
verses.textEnNkjv: But it came to pass, when Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up into the land, that we said, ‘Come, let us go to Jerusalem for fear of the army of the Chaldeans and for fear of the army of the Syrians.’ So we dwell at Jerusalem."
verses.textEnNlt: But when King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylon attacked this country, we were afraid of the Babylonian and Syrian armies. So we decided to move to Jerusalem. That is why we are here."
verses.textEnNasb: However, when Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up against the land, we said, ‘Come, and let’s go to Jerusalem away from the army of the Chaldeans and the army of the Arameans.’ So we have lived in Jerusalem."
verses.textEn: But when Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon invaded this land, we said, ‘Come, we must go to Jerusalem to escape the Babylonian and Aramean armies.’ So we have remained in Jerusalem."

verses.textZh: "万军之耶和华以色列的神这样说：你去对犹大人和耶路撒冷的居民说：‘你们不接受管教，不听我的话吗？’这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: "万军之耶和华以色列的神这样说：你去对犹大人和耶路撒冷的居民说：‘你们不接受管教，不听我的话吗？’这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 「万军之耶和华－以色列的神如此说：你去对犹大人和耶路撒冷的居民说，耶和华说：你们不受教训，不听从我的话吗？
verses.textEnNiv: "This is what the Lord Almighty, the God of Israel, says: Go and tell the people of Judah and those living in Jerusalem, ‘Will you not learn a lesson and obey my words?’ declares the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: "Thus says the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel: Go and say to the people of Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem, Will you not receive instruction and listen to my words? declares the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: "Thus says the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel: ‘Go and tell the men of Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem, "Will you not receive instruction to obey My words?" says the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: "This is what the Lord of Heaven’s Armies, the God of Israel, says: Go and say to the people in Judah and Jerusalem, ‘Come and learn a lesson about how to obey me.
verses.textEnNasb: "This is what the Lord of armies, the God of Israel says: ‘Go and say to the people of Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem, "Will you not accept instruction by listening to My words?" declares the Lord.
verses.textEn: "This is what the Lord Almighty, the God of Israel, says: Go and tell the people of Judah and those living in Jerusalem, ‘Will you not learn a lesson and obey my words?’ declares the Lord .

verses.textZh: ‘利甲的儿子约拿达吩咐他的子孙不可喝酒的话，他们已经实行了，他们直到今日都不喝酒，因为他们听从了他们祖先的吩咐。至于我，我不断告诫你们，你们却不听从我。
verses.textZhCnvs: ‘利甲的儿子约拿达吩咐他的子孙不可喝酒的话，他们已经实行了，他们直到今日都不喝酒，因为他们听从了他们祖先的吩咐。至于我，我不断告诫你们，你们却不听从我。
verses.textZhCuv: 利甲的儿子约拿达所吩咐他子孙不可喝酒的话，他们已经遵守，直到今日也不喝酒，因为他们听从先祖的吩咐。我从早起来警戒你们，你们却不听从我。
verses.textEnNiv: ‘Jehonadab son of Rekab ordered his descendants not to drink wine and this command has been kept. To this day they do not drink wine, because they obey their forefather’s command. But I have spoken to you again and again, yet you have not obeyed me.
verses.textEnEsv: The command that Jonadab the son of Rechab gave to his sons, to drink no wine, has been kept, and they drink none to this day, for they have obeyed their father’s command. I have spoken to you persistently, but you have not listened to me.
verses.textEnNkjv: "The words of Jonadab the son of Rechab, which he commanded his sons, not to drink wine, are performed; for to this day they drink none, and obey their father’s commandment. But although I have spoken to you, rising early and speaking, you did not obey Me.
verses.textEnNlt: The Recabites do not drink wine to this day because their ancestor Jehonadab told them not to. But I have spoken to you again and again, and you refuse to obey me.
verses.textEnNasb: "The words of Jonadab the son of Rechab have been followed, which he commanded his sons: not to drink wine. And they do not drink wine to this day, for they have obeyed their father’s command. But I have spoken to you again and again, yet you have not listened to Me.
verses.textEn: ‘Jehonadab son of Rekab ordered his descendants not to drink wine and this command has been kept. To this day they do not drink wine, because they obey their forefather’s command. But I have spoken to you again and again, yet you have not obeyed me.

verses.textZh: 我不断差遣我的仆人众先知到你们那里去，对你们说：你们各人要悔改，离开自己的恶道，改正你们的行为，不可随从事奉别神；这样，你们就可以住在我赐给你们和你们列祖的土地上。只是你们毫不在意，也没有听从我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我不断差遣我的仆人众先知到你们那里去，对你们说：你们各人要悔改，离开自己的恶道，改正你们的行为，不可随从事奉别神；这样，你们就可以住在我赐给你们和你们列祖的土地上。只是你们毫不在意，也没有听从我。
verses.textZhCuv: 我从早起来，差遣我的仆人众先知去，说：『你们各人当回头，离开恶道，改正行为，不随从事奉别神，就必住在我所赐给你们和你们列祖的地上。』只是你们没有听从我，也没有侧耳而听。
verses.textEnNiv: Again and again I sent all my servants the prophets to you. They said, "Each of you must turn from your wicked ways and reform your actions; do not follow other gods to serve them. Then you will live in the land I have given to you and your ancestors." But you have not paid attention or listened to me.
verses.textEnEsv: I have sent to you all my servants the prophets, sending them persistently, saying, ‘Turn now every one of you from his evil way, and amend your deeds, and do not go after other gods to serve them, and then you shall dwell in the land that I gave to you and your fathers.’ But you did not incline your ear or listen to me.
verses.textEnNkjv: I have also sent to you all My servants the prophets, rising up early and sending them, saying, ‘Turn now everyone from his evil way, amend your doings, and do not go after other gods to serve them; then you will dwell in the land which I have given you and your fathers.’ But you have not inclined your ear, nor obeyed Me.
verses.textEnNlt: Time after time I sent you prophets, who told you, "Turn from your wicked ways, and start doing things right. Stop worshiping other gods so that you might live in peace here in the land I have given to you and your ancestors." But you would not listen to me or obey me.
verses.textEnNasb: Also I have sent to you all My servants the prophets, sending them again and again, saying: ‘Turn now every person from his evil way and amend your deeds, and do not follow other gods to worship them. Then you will live in the land which I have given to you and to your forefathers; but you have not inclined your ear or listened to Me.
verses.textEn: Again and again I sent all my servants the prophets to you. They said, "Each of you must turn from your wicked ways and reform your actions; do not follow other gods to serve them. Then you will live in the land I have given to you and your ancestors." But you have not paid attention or listened to me.

verses.textZh: 利甲的儿子约拿达的子孙实行了他们祖先吩咐他们的命令，但这人民没有听从我。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 利甲的儿子约拿达的子孙实行了他们祖先吩咐他们的命令，但这人民没有听从我。’
verses.textZhCuv: 利甲的儿子约拿达的子孙能遵守先人所吩咐他们的命，这百姓却没有听从我！
verses.textEnNiv: The descendants of Jehonadab son of Rekab have carried out the command their forefather gave them, but these people have not obeyed me.’
verses.textEnEsv: The sons of Jonadab the son of Rechab have kept the command that their father gave them, but this people has not obeyed me.
verses.textEnNkjv: Surely the sons of Jonadab the son of Rechab have performed the commandment of their father, which he commanded them, but this people has not obeyed Me." ’
verses.textEnNlt: The descendants of Jehonadab son of Recab have obeyed their ancestor completely, but you have refused to listen to me.’
verses.textEnNasb: Indeed, the sons of Jonadab the son of Rechab have followed the command of their father which he commanded them, but this people has not listened to Me.’ " ’
verses.textEn: The descendants of Jehonadab son of Rekab have carried out the command their forefather gave them, but these people have not obeyed me.’

verses.textZh: 因此，耶和华万军的神、以色列的神这样说：‘看哪！我必使我对他们预告过的一切灾祸，临到犹大人和耶路撒冷所有的居民，因为我对他们说话，他们却不听从；我呼唤他们，他们却不回应。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，耶和华万军的神、以色列的神这样说：‘看哪！我必使我对他们预告过的一切灾祸，临到犹大人和耶路撒冷所有的居民，因为我对他们说话，他们却不听从；我呼唤他们，他们却不回应。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 因此，耶和华－万军之神、以色列的神如此说：我要使我所说的一切灾祸临到犹大人和耶路撒冷的一切居民。因为我对他们说话，他们没有听从；我呼唤他们，他们没有答应。」
verses.textEnNiv: "Therefore this is what the Lord God Almighty, the God of Israel, says: ‘Listen! I am going to bring on Judah and on everyone living in Jerusalem every disaster I pronounced against them. I spoke to them, but they did not listen; I called to them, but they did not answer.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore, thus says the Lord , the God of hosts, the God of Israel: Behold, I am bringing upon Judah and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem all the disaster that I have pronounced against them, because I have spoken to them and they have not listened, I have called to them and they have not answered."
verses.textEnNkjv: "Therefore thus says the Lord God of hosts, the God of Israel: ‘Behold, I will bring on Judah and on all the inhabitants of Jerusalem all the doom that I have pronounced against them; because I have spoken to them but they have not heard, and I have called to them but they have not answered.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: "Therefore, this is what the Lord God of Heaven’s Armies, the God of Israel, says: ‘Because you refuse to listen or answer when I call, I will send upon Judah and Jerusalem all the disasters I have threatened.’"
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore this is what the Lord says, the God of armies, the God of Israel: ‘Behold, I am bringing on Judah and on all the inhabitants of Jerusalem all the disaster that I have pronounced against them; because I spoke to them but they did not listen, and I have called them but they did not answer.’ "
verses.textEn: "Therefore this is what the Lord God Almighty, the God of Israel, says: ‘Listen! I am going to bring on Judah and on everyone living in Jerusalem every disaster I pronounced against them. I spoke to them, but they did not listen; I called to them, but they did not answer.’ "

verses.textZh: 耶利米对利甲族人说："万军之耶和华以色列的神这样说：‘因为你们听从了你们祖先约拿达的吩咐，谨守他的一切命令，又照着他吩咐你们的一切去行。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶利米对利甲族人说："万军之耶和华以色列的神这样说：‘因为你们听从了你们祖先约拿达的吩咐，谨守他的一切命令，又照着他吩咐你们的一切去行。’
verses.textZhCuv: 耶利米对利甲族的人说：「万军之耶和华－以色列的神如此说：因你们听从你们先祖约拿达的吩咐，谨守他的一切诫命，照他所吩咐你们的去行，
verses.textEnNiv: Then Jeremiah said to the family of the Rekabites, "This is what the Lord Almighty, the God of Israel, says: ‘You have obeyed the command of your forefather Jehonadab and have followed all his instructions and have done everything he ordered.’
verses.textEnEsv: But to the house of the Rechabites Jeremiah said, "Thus says the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel: Because you have obeyed the command of Jonadab your father and kept all his precepts and done all that he commanded you,
verses.textEnNkjv: And Jeremiah said to the house of the Rechabites, "Thus says the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel: ‘Because you have obeyed the commandment of Jonadab your father, and kept all his precepts and done according to all that he commanded you,
verses.textEnNlt: Then Jeremiah turned to the Recabites and said, "This is what the Lord of Heaven’s Armies, the God of Israel, says: ‘You have obeyed your ancestor Jehonadab in every respect, following all his instructions.’
verses.textEnNasb: Then Jeremiah said to the house of the Rechabites, "This is what the Lord of armies, the God of Israel says: ‘Because you have obeyed the command of Jonadab your father, kept all his commands, and done according to all that he commanded you,
verses.textEn: Then Jeremiah said to the family of the Rekabites, "This is what the Lord Almighty, the God of Israel, says: ‘You have obeyed the command of your forefather Jehonadab and have followed all his instructions and have done everything he ordered.’

verses.textZh: 所以，万军之耶和华以色列的神这样说：‘利甲的儿子约拿达必永远不断有人在我面前侍立。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以，万军之耶和华以色列的神这样说：‘利甲的儿子约拿达必永远不断有人在我面前侍立。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 所以万军之耶和华－以色列的神如此说：利甲的儿子约拿达必永不缺人侍立在我面前。」
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore this is what the Lord Almighty, the God of Israel, says: ‘Jehonadab son of Rekab will never fail to have a descendant to serve me.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: therefore thus says the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel: Jonadab the son of Rechab shall never lack a man to stand before me."
verses.textEnNkjv: therefore thus says the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel: "Jonadab the son of Rechab shall not lack a man to stand before Me forever." ’ "
verses.textEnNlt: Therefore, this is what the Lord of Heaven’s Armies, the God of Israel, says: ‘Jehonadab son of Recab will always have descendants who serve me.’"
verses.textEnNasb: therefore this is what the Lord of armies, the God of Israel says: "Jonadab the son of Rechab will not lack a man to stand before Me always." ’ "
verses.textEn: Therefore this is what the Lord Almighty, the God of Israel, says: ‘Jehonadab son of Rekab will never fail to have a descendant to serve me.’ "

verses.textZh: 犹大王约西亚的儿子约雅敬第四年，耶和华那里有这话临到耶利米，说：
