verses.textZhCuv: 犹大王约西亚的儿子约雅敬第四年，耶和华的话临到耶利米说：
verses.textEnNiv: In the fourth year of Jehoiakim son of Josiah king of Judah, this word came to Jeremiah from the Lord :
verses.textEnEsv: In the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah, this word came to Jeremiah from the Lord :
verses.textEnNkjv: Now it came to pass in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah, that this word came to Jeremiah from the Lord, saying:
verses.textEnNlt: During the fourth year that Jehoiakim son of Josiah was king in Judah, the Lord gave this message to Jeremiah:
verses.textEnNasb: In the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah, this word came to Jeremiah from the Lord, saying,
verses.textEn: In the fourth year of Jehoiakim son of Josiah king of Judah, this word came to Jeremiah from the Lord :

verses.textZh: "你取一卷书卷来，在上面写下我在约西亚作王的时候开始，直到今日，对你所说论到以色列和犹大，以及列国的一切话。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你取一卷书卷来，在上面写下我在约西亚作王的时候开始，直到今日，对你所说论到以色列和犹大，以及列国的一切话。
verses.textZhCuv: 「你取一书卷，将我对你说攻击以色列和犹大，并各国的一切话，从我对你说话的那日，就是从约西亚的日子起直到今日，都写在其上。
verses.textEnNiv: "Take a scroll and write on it all the words I have spoken to you concerning Israel, Judah and all the other nations from the time I began speaking to you in the reign of Josiah till now.
verses.textEnEsv: "Take a scroll and write on it all the words that I have spoken to you against Israel and Judah and all the nations, from the day I spoke to you, from the days of Josiah until today.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Take a scroll of a book and write on it all the words that I have spoken to you against Israel, against Judah, and against all the nations, from the day I spoke to you, from the days of Josiah even to this day.
verses.textEnNlt: "Get a scroll, and write down all my messages against Israel, Judah, and the other nations. Begin with the first message back in the days of Josiah, and write down every message, right up to the present time.
verses.textEnNasb: "Take a scroll and write on it all the words which I have spoken to you concerning Israel, Judah, and all the nations, from the day I first spoke to you, from the days of Josiah, even to this day.
verses.textEn: "Take a scroll and write on it all the words I have spoken to you concerning Israel, Judah and all the other nations from the time I began speaking to you in the reign of Josiah till now.

verses.textZh: 或者犹大家听见我想要降给他们的一切灾祸，各人就回转，离开自己的恶道，我就赦免他们的罪孽和罪恶。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 或者犹大家听见我想要降给他们的一切灾祸，各人就回转，离开自己的恶道，我就赦免他们的罪孽和罪恶。"
verses.textZhCuv: 或者犹大家听见我想要降与他们的一切灾祸，各人就回头，离开恶道，我好赦免他们的罪孽和罪恶。」
verses.textEnNiv: Perhaps when the people of Judah hear about every disaster I plan to inflict on them, they will each turn from their wicked ways; then I will forgive their wickedness and their sin."
verses.textEnEsv: It may be that the house of Judah will hear all the disaster that I intend to do to them, so that every one may turn from his evil way, and that I may forgive their iniquity and their sin."
verses.textEnNkjv: It may be that the house of Judah will hear all the adversities which I purpose to bring upon them, that everyone may turn from his evil way, that I may forgive their iniquity and their sin."
verses.textEnNlt: Perhaps the people of Judah will repent when they hear again all the terrible things I have planned for them. Then I will be able to forgive their sins and wrongdoings."
verses.textEnNasb: Perhaps the house of Judah will listen to all the disaster which I plan to carry out against them, so that every person will turn from his evil way; then I will forgive their wrongdoing and their sin."
verses.textEn: Perhaps when the people of Judah hear about every disaster I plan to inflict on them, they will each turn from their wicked ways; then I will forgive their wickedness and their sin."

verses.textZh: 于是耶利米把尼利亚的儿子巴录叫了来，巴录就从耶利米口中，把耶和华向耶利米所说的一切话，都写在书卷上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是耶利米把尼利亚的儿子巴录叫了来，巴录就从耶利米口中，把耶和华向耶利米所说的一切话，都写在书卷上。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以，耶利米召了尼利亚的儿子巴录来；巴录就从耶利米口中，将耶和华对耶利米所说的一切话写在书卷上。
verses.textEnNiv: So Jeremiah called Baruch son of Neriah, and while Jeremiah dictated all the words the Lord had spoken to him, Baruch wrote them on the scroll.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Jeremiah called Baruch the son of Neriah, and Baruch wrote on a scroll at the dictation of Jeremiah all the words of the Lord that he had spoken to him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Jeremiah called Baruch the son of Neriah; and Baruch wrote on a scroll of a book, at the instruction of Jeremiah, all the words of the Lord which He had spoken to him.
verses.textEnNlt: So Jeremiah sent for Baruch son of Neriah, and as Jeremiah dictated all the prophecies that the Lord had given him, Baruch wrote them on a scroll.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Jeremiah called Baruch the son of Neriah, and Baruch wrote on a scroll at the dictation of Jeremiah all the words of the Lord which He had spoken to him.
verses.textEn: So Jeremiah called Baruch son of Neriah, and while Jeremiah dictated all the words the Lord had spoken to him, Baruch wrote them on the scroll.

verses.textZh: 耶利米吩咐巴录说："我被阻止，不能进耶和华的殿里去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶利米吩咐巴录说："我被阻止，不能进耶和华的殿里去。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶利米吩咐巴录说：「我被拘管，不能进耶和华的殿。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Jeremiah told Baruch, "I am restricted; I am not allowed to go to the Lord ’s temple.
verses.textEnEsv: And Jeremiah ordered Baruch, saying, "I am banned from going to the house of the Lord ,
verses.textEnNkjv: And Jeremiah commanded Baruch, saying, "I am confined, I cannot go into the house of the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Jeremiah said to Baruch, "I am a prisoner here and unable to go to the Temple.
verses.textEnNasb: Jeremiah then commanded Baruch, saying, "I am restricted; I cannot go into the house of the Lord.
verses.textEn: Then Jeremiah told Baruch, "I am restricted; I am not allowed to go to the Lord ’s temple.

verses.textZh: 所以你要进去，趁禁食的日子，在耶和华的殿里，向众人宣读书卷上的话，就是你从我口中所录下耶和华的话。你要向从犹大各城来的人宣读。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以你要进去，趁禁食的日子，在耶和华的殿里，向众人宣读书卷上的话，就是你从我口中所录下耶和华的话。你要向从犹大各城来的人宣读。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以你要去趁禁食的日子，在耶和华殿中将耶和华的话，就是你从我口中所写在书卷上的话，念给百姓和一切从犹大城邑出来的人听。
verses.textEnNiv: So you go to the house of the Lord on a day of fasting and read to the people from the scroll the words of the Lord that you wrote as I dictated. Read them to all the people of Judah who come in from their towns.
verses.textEnEsv: so you are to go, and on a day of fasting in the hearing of all the people in the Lord ’s house you shall read the words of the Lord from the scroll that you have written at my dictation. You shall read them also in the hearing of all the men of Judah who come out of their cities.
verses.textEnNkjv: You go, therefore, and read from the scroll which you have written at my instruction, the words of the Lord, in the hearing of the people in the Lord’s house on the day of fasting. And you shall also read them in the hearing of all Judah who come from their cities.
verses.textEnNlt: So you go to the Temple on the next day of fasting, and read the messages from the Lord that I have had you write on this scroll. Read them so the people who are there from all over Judah will hear them.
verses.textEnNasb: So you go and read from the scroll, which you have written at my dictation, the words of the Lord to the people at the Lord’s house on a day of fasting. And you shall also read them to all the people of Judah who come from their cities.
verses.textEn: So you go to the house of the Lord on a day of fasting and read to the people from the scroll the words of the Lord that you wrote as I dictated. Read them to all the people of Judah who come in from their towns.

verses.textZh: 也许他们会向耶和华恳求，各人回转，离开自己的恶道，因为耶和华向这人民所说要发的怒气和烈怒是很大的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 也许他们会向耶和华恳求，各人回转，离开自己的恶道，因为耶和华向这人民所说要发的怒气和烈怒是很大的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 或者他们在耶和华面前恳求各人回头，离开恶道，因为耶和华向这百姓所说要发的怒气和忿怒是大的。」
verses.textEnNiv: Perhaps they will bring their petition before the Lord and will each turn from their wicked ways, for the anger and wrath pronounced against this people by the Lord are great."
verses.textEnEsv: It may be that their plea for mercy will come before the Lord , and that every one will turn from his evil way, for great is the anger and wrath that the Lord has pronounced against this people."
verses.textEnNkjv: It may be that they will present their supplication before the Lord, and everyone will turn from his evil way. For great is the anger and the fury that the Lord has pronounced against this people."
verses.textEnNlt: Perhaps even yet they will turn from their evil ways and ask the Lord ’s forgiveness before it is too late. For the Lord has threatened them with his terrible anger."
verses.textEnNasb: Perhaps their pleading will come before the Lord, and everyone will turn from his evil way; for great is the anger and the wrath that the Lord has pronounced against this people."
verses.textEn: Perhaps they will bring their petition before the Lord and will each turn from their wicked ways, for the anger and wrath pronounced against this people by the Lord are great."

verses.textZh: 尼利亚的儿子巴录就照着耶利米先知吩咐的一切去行，在耶和华的殿里宣读书上耶和华的话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 尼利亚的儿子巴录就照着耶利米先知吩咐的一切去行，在耶和华的殿里宣读书上耶和华的话。
verses.textZhCuv: 尼利亚的儿子巴录就照先知耶利米一切所吩咐的去行，在耶和华的殿中从书上念耶和华的话。
verses.textEnNiv: Baruch son of Neriah did everything Jeremiah the prophet told him to do; at the Lord ’s temple he read the words of the Lord from the scroll.
verses.textEnEsv: And Baruch the son of Neriah did all that Jeremiah the prophet ordered him about reading from the scroll the words of the Lord in the Lord ’s house.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Baruch the son of Neriah did according to all that Jeremiah the prophet commanded him, reading from the book the words of the Lord in the Lord’s house.
verses.textEnNlt: Baruch did as Jeremiah told him and read these messages from the Lord to the people at the Temple.
verses.textEnNasb: So Baruch the son of Neriah acted in accordance with all that Jeremiah the prophet commanded him, reading from the book the words of the Lord in the Lord’s house.
verses.textEn: Baruch son of Neriah did everything Jeremiah the prophet told him to do; at the Lord ’s temple he read the words of the Lord from the scroll.

verses.textZh: 犹大王约西亚的儿子约雅敬第五年九月，耶路撒冷的众民，和所有从犹大各城来到耶路撒冷的人民，都在耶和华面前宣告禁食。
verses.textZhCnvs: 犹大王约西亚的儿子约雅敬第五年九月，耶路撒冷的众民，和所有从犹大各城来到耶路撒冷的人民，都在耶和华面前宣告禁食。
verses.textZhCuv: 犹大王约西亚的儿子约雅敬第五年九月，耶路撒冷的众民和那从犹大城邑来到耶路撒冷的众民，在耶和华面前宣告禁食的日子，
verses.textEnNiv: In the ninth month of the fifth year of Jehoiakim son of Josiah king of Judah, a time of fasting before the Lord was proclaimed for all the people in Jerusalem and those who had come from the towns of Judah.
verses.textEnEsv: In the fifth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah, in the ninth month, all the people in Jerusalem and all the people who came from the cities of Judah to Jerusalem proclaimed a fast before the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: Now it came to pass in the fifth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah, in the ninth month, that they proclaimed a fast before the Lord to all the people in Jerusalem, and to all the people who came from the cities of Judah to Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNlt: He did this on a day of sacred fasting held in late autumn, during the fifth year of the reign of Jehoiakim son of Josiah. People from all over Judah had come to Jerusalem to attend the services at the Temple on that day.
verses.textEnNasb: Now in the fifth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah, in the ninth month, all the people in Jerusalem and all the people who came from the cities of Judah to Jerusalem proclaimed a fast before the Lord.
verses.textEn: In the ninth month of the fifth year of Jehoiakim son of Josiah king of Judah, a time of fasting before the Lord was proclaimed for all the people in Jerusalem and those who had come from the towns of Judah.

verses.textZh: 巴录就在耶和华的殿里，向众民宣读书上耶利米的话。那时他是在沙番的儿子书记基玛利雅的房间里，这房间是在上院，靠近耶和华殿里新门的入口。
verses.textZhCnvs: 巴录就在耶和华的殿里，向众民宣读书上耶利米的话。那时他是在沙番的儿子书记基玛利雅的房间里，这房间是在上院，靠近耶和华殿里新门的入口。
verses.textZhCuv: 巴录就在耶和华殿的上院，耶和华殿的新门口，沙番的儿子文士基玛利雅的屋内，念书上耶利米的话给众民听。
verses.textEnNiv: From the room of Gemariah son of Shaphan the secretary, which was in the upper courtyard at the entrance of the New Gate of the temple, Baruch read to all the people at the Lord ’s temple the words of Jeremiah from the scroll.
verses.textEnEsv: Then, in the hearing of all the people, Baruch read the words of Jeremiah from the scroll, in the house of the Lord , in the chamber of Gemariah the son of Shaphan the secretary, which was in the upper court, at the entry of the New Gate of the Lord ’s house.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Baruch read from the book the words of Jeremiah in the house of the Lord, in the chamber of Gemariah the son of Shaphan the scribe, in the upper court at the entry of the New Gate of the Lord’s house, in the hearing of all the people.
verses.textEnNlt: Baruch read Jeremiah’s words on the scroll to all the people. He stood in front of the Temple room of Gemariah, son of Shaphan the secretary. This room was just off the upper courtyard of the Temple, near the New Gate entrance.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Baruch read to all the people from the book the words of Jeremiah in the house of the Lord in the chamber of Gemariah the son of Shaphan the scribe, in the upper courtyard, at the entry of the New Gate of the Lord’s house.
verses.textEn: From the room of Gemariah son of Shaphan the secretary, which was in the upper courtyard at the entrance of the New Gate of the temple, Baruch read to all the people at the Lord ’s temple the words of Jeremiah from the scroll.

verses.textZh: 沙番的孙子基玛利雅的儿子米该亚，听见了书上耶和华的一切话，
verses.textZhCnvs: 沙番的孙子基玛利雅的儿子米该亚，听见了书上耶和华的一切话，
verses.textZhCuv: 沙番的孙子、基玛利雅的儿子米该亚听见书上耶和华的一切话，
verses.textEnNiv: When Micaiah son of Gemariah, the son of Shaphan, heard all the words of the Lord from the scroll,
verses.textEnEsv: When Micaiah the son of Gemariah, son of Shaphan, heard all the words of the Lord from the scroll,
verses.textEnNkjv: When Michaiah the son of Gemariah, the son of Shaphan, heard all the words of the Lord from the book,
verses.textEnNlt: When Micaiah son of Gemariah and grandson of Shaphan heard the messages from the Lord ,
verses.textEnNasb: Now when Micaiah the son of Gemariah, the son of Shaphan, had heard all the words of the Lord from the book,
verses.textEn: When Micaiah son of Gemariah, the son of Shaphan, heard all the words of the Lord from the scroll,

verses.textZh: 就下到王宫，进入书记的房间里；所有领袖都在那里坐着，他们是书记以利沙玛、示玛雅的儿子第莱雅、亚革波的儿子以利拿单、沙番的儿子基玛利雅、哈拿尼雅的儿子西底家和所有其余的领袖。
verses.textZhCnvs: 就下到王宫，进入书记的房间里；所有领袖都在那里坐着，他们是书记以利沙玛、示玛雅的儿子第莱雅、亚革波的儿子以利拿单、沙番的儿子基玛利雅、哈拿尼雅的儿子西底家和所有其余的领袖。
verses.textZhCuv: 他就下到王宫，进入文士的屋子。众首领，就是文士以利沙玛、示玛雅的儿子第莱雅、亚革波的儿子以利拿单、沙番的儿子基玛利雅、哈拿尼雅的儿子西底家，和其余的首领都坐在那里。
verses.textEnNiv: he went down to the secretary’s room in the royal palace, where all the officials were sitting: Elishama the secretary, Delaiah son of Shemaiah, Elnathan son of Akbor, Gemariah son of Shaphan, Zedekiah son of Hananiah, and all the other officials.
verses.textEnEsv: he went down to the king’s house, into the secretary’s chamber, and all the officials were sitting there: Elishama the secretary, Delaiah the son of Shemaiah, Elnathan the son of Achbor, Gemariah the son of Shaphan, Zedekiah the son of Hananiah, and all the officials.
verses.textEnNkjv: he then went down to the king’s house, into the scribe’s chamber; and there all the princes were sitting— Elishama the scribe, Delaiah the son of Shemaiah, Elnathan the son of Achbor, Gemariah the son of Shaphan, Zedekiah the son of Hananiah, and all the princes.
verses.textEnNlt: he went down to the secretary’s room in the palace where the administrative officials were meeting. Elishama the secretary was there, along with Delaiah son of Shemaiah, Elnathan son of Acbor, Gemariah son of Shaphan, Zedekiah son of Hananiah, and all the other officials.
verses.textEnNasb: he went down to the king’s house, into the scribe’s chamber. And behold, all the officials were sitting there—Elishama the scribe, Delaiah the son of Shemaiah, Elnathan the son of Achbor, Gemariah the son of Shaphan, Zedekiah the son of Hananiah, and all the other officials.
verses.textEn: he went down to the secretary’s room in the royal palace, where all the officials were sitting: Elishama the secretary, Delaiah son of Shemaiah, Elnathan son of Akbor, Gemariah son of Shaphan, Zedekiah son of Hananiah, and all the other officials.

verses.textZh: 米该亚就把所听见的一切都告诉他们，就是巴录向众人宣读那书的时候，他所听见的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 米该亚就把所听见的一切都告诉他们，就是巴录向众人宣读那书的时候，他所听见的。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是米该亚对他们述说他所听见的一切话，就是巴录向百姓念那书的时候所听见的。
verses.textEnNiv: After Micaiah told them everything he had heard Baruch read to the people from the scroll,
verses.textEnEsv: And Micaiah told them all the words that he had heard, when Baruch read the scroll in the hearing of the people.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Michaiah declared to them all the words that he had heard when Baruch read the book in the hearing of the people.
verses.textEnNlt: When Micaiah told them about the messages Baruch was reading to the people,
verses.textEnNasb: And Micaiah declared to them all the words that he had heard when Baruch read from the book to the people.
verses.textEn: After Micaiah told them everything he had heard Baruch read to the people from the scroll,

verses.textZh: 于是所有的领袖差派古示的曾孙、示利米雅的孙子、尼探雅的儿子犹底，去见巴录，说："请你把向众人宣读的那书卷亲自拿来。"尼利亚的儿子巴录就把书卷亲自带到他们那里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是所有的领袖差派古示的曾孙、示利米雅的孙子、尼探雅的儿子犹底，去见巴录，说："请你把向众人宣读的那书卷亲自拿来。"尼利亚的儿子巴录就把书卷亲自带到他们那里。
verses.textZhCuv: 众首领就打发古示的曾孙、示利米雅的孙子、尼探雅的儿子犹底到巴录那里，对他说：「你将所念给百姓听的书卷拿在手中到我们这里来。」尼利亚的儿子巴录就手拿书卷来到他们那里。
verses.textEnNiv: all the officials sent Jehudi son of Nethaniah, the son of Shelemiah, the son of Cushi, to say to Baruch, "Bring the scroll from which you have read to the people and come." So Baruch son of Neriah went to them with the scroll in his hand.
verses.textEnEsv: Then all the officials sent Jehudi the son of Nethaniah, son of Shelemiah, son of Cushi, to say to Baruch, "Take in your hand the scroll that you read in the hearing of the people, and come." So Baruch the son of Neriah took the scroll in his hand and came to them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore all the princes sent Jehudi the son of Nethaniah, the son of Shelemiah, the son of Cushi, to Baruch, saying, "Take in your hand the scroll from which you have read in the hearing of the people, and come." So Baruch the son of Neriah took the scroll in his hand and came to them.
verses.textEnNlt: the officials sent Jehudi son of Nethaniah, grandson of Shelemiah and great-grandson of Cushi, to ask Baruch to come and read the messages to them, too. So Baruch took the scroll and went to them.
verses.textEnNasb: Then all the officials sent Jehudi the son of Nethaniah, who was the son of Shelemiah, the son of Cushi, to Baruch, saying, "Take in your hand the scroll from which you have read to the people and come." So Baruch the son of Neriah took the scroll in his hand and came to them.
verses.textEn: all the officials sent Jehudi son of Nethaniah, the son of Shelemiah, the son of Cushi, to say to Baruch, "Bring the scroll from which you have read to the people and come." So Baruch son of Neriah went to them with the scroll in his hand.

verses.textZh: 他们对他说："请坐下，念给我们听。"巴录就向他们宣读。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们对他说："请坐下，念给我们听。"巴录就向他们宣读。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们对他说：「请你坐下，念给我们听。」巴录就念给他们听。
verses.textEnNiv: They said to him, "Sit down, please, and read it to us." So Baruch read it to them.
verses.textEnEsv: And they said to him, "Sit down and read it." So Baruch read it to them.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they said to him, "Sit down now, and read it in our hearing." So Baruch read it in their hearing.
verses.textEnNlt: "Sit down and read the scroll to us," the officials said, and Baruch did as they requested.
verses.textEnNasb: And they said to him, "Sit down, please, and read it to us." So Baruch read it to them.
verses.textEn: They said to him, "Sit down, please, and read it to us." So Baruch read it to them.

verses.textZh: 他们听见这一切话，就惊惧起来，面面相觑，对巴录说："我们必须把这一切话禀告王。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们听见这一切话，就惊惧起来，面面相觑，对巴录说："我们必须把这一切话禀告王。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们听见这一切话就害怕，面面相观，对巴录说：「我们必须将这一切话告诉王。」
verses.textEnNiv: When they heard all these words, they looked at each other in fear and said to Baruch, "We must report all these words to the king."
verses.textEnEsv: When they heard all the words, they turned one to another in fear. And they said to Baruch, "We must report all these words to the king."
verses.textEnNkjv: Now it happened, when they had heard all the words, that they looked in fear from one to another, and said to Baruch, "We will surely tell the king of all these words."
verses.textEnNlt: When they heard all the messages, they looked at one another in alarm. "We must tell the king what we have heard," they said to Baruch.
verses.textEnNasb: When they had heard all the words, they turned in fear one to another. And they said to Baruch, "We will certainly report all these words to the king."
verses.textEn: When they heard all these words, they looked at each other in fear and said to Baruch, "We must report all these words to the king."

verses.textZh: 他们向巴录说："请告诉我们，你怎样写下这一切话，是耶利米亲口说的吗？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们向巴录说："请告诉我们，你怎样写下这一切话，是耶利米亲口说的吗？"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们问巴录说：「请你告诉我们，你怎样从他口中写这一切话呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: Then they asked Baruch, "Tell us, how did you come to write all this? Did Jeremiah dictate it?"
verses.textEnEsv: Then they asked Baruch, "Tell us, please, how did you write all these words? Was it at his dictation?"
verses.textEnNkjv: And they asked Baruch, saying, "Tell us now, how did you write all these words—at his instruction?"
verses.textEnNlt: "But first, tell us how you got these messages. Did they come directly from Jeremiah?"
verses.textEnNasb: Then they asked Baruch, saying, "Tell us, please, how did you write all these words? Was it at Jeremiah’s dictation?"
verses.textEn: Then they asked Baruch, "Tell us, how did you come to write all this? Did Jeremiah dictate it?"

verses.textZh: 巴录对他们说："这一切话是他亲口向我讲述的，我就用墨写在书上。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 巴录对他们说："这一切话是他亲口向我讲述的，我就用墨写在书上。"
verses.textZhCuv: 巴录回答说：「他用口向我说这一切话，我就用笔墨写在书上。」
verses.textEnNiv: "Yes," Baruch replied, "he dictated all these words to me, and I wrote them in ink on the scroll."
verses.textEnEsv: Baruch answered them, "He dictated all these words to me, while I wrote them with ink on the scroll."
verses.textEnNkjv: So Baruch answered them, "He proclaimed with his mouth all these words to me, and I wrote them with ink in the book."
verses.textEnNlt: So Baruch explained, "Jeremiah dictated them, and I wrote them down in ink, word for word, on this scroll."
verses.textEnNasb: And Baruch said to them, "He dictated all these words to me, and I wrote them with ink on the book."
verses.textEn: "Yes," Baruch replied, "he dictated all these words to me, and I wrote them in ink on the scroll."

verses.textZh: 众领袖对巴录说："你和耶利米都要去躲藏起来；不要给人知道你们在甚么地方。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 众领袖对巴录说："你和耶利米都要去躲藏起来；不要给人知道你们在甚么地方。"
verses.textZhCuv: 众首领对巴录说：「你和耶利米要去藏起来，不可叫人知道你们在哪里。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then the officials said to Baruch, "You and Jeremiah, go and hide. Don’t let anyone know where you are."
verses.textEnEsv: Then the officials said to Baruch, "Go and hide, you and Jeremiah, and let no one know where you are."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the princes said to Baruch, "Go and hide, you and Jeremiah; and let no one know where you are."
verses.textEnNlt: "You and Jeremiah should both hide," the officials told Baruch. "Don’t tell anyone where you are!"
verses.textEnNasb: Then the officials said to Baruch, "Go, hide yourself, you and Jeremiah, and do not let anyone know where you are."
verses.textEn: Then the officials said to Baruch, "You and Jeremiah, go and hide. Don’t let anyone know where you are."

verses.textZh: 众领袖把书卷存在书记以利沙玛的房间里，然后进内院去见王，把这一切话都禀告给王听。
verses.textZhCnvs: 众领袖把书卷存在书记以利沙玛的房间里，然后进内院去见王，把这一切话都禀告给王听。
verses.textZhCuv: 众首领进院见王，却先把书卷存在文士以利沙玛的屋内，以后将这一切话说给王听。
verses.textEnNiv: After they put the scroll in the room of Elishama the secretary, they went to the king in the courtyard and reported everything to him.
verses.textEnEsv: So they went into the court to the king, having put the scroll in the chamber of Elishama the secretary, and they reported all the words to the king.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they went to the king, into the court; but they stored the scroll in the chamber of Elishama the scribe, and told all the words in the hearing of the king.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the officials left the scroll for safekeeping in the room of Elishama the secretary and went to tell the king what had happened.
verses.textEnNasb: So they came to the king in the courtyard, but they had deposited the scroll in the chamber of Elishama the scribe; and they reported all the words to the king.
verses.textEn: After they put the scroll in the room of Elishama the secretary, they went to the king in the courtyard and reported everything to him.

verses.textZh: 于是王差派犹底去把书卷拿来；犹底就从书记以利沙玛的房间里把书卷取来，向王和所有侍立在王左右的领袖宣读。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是王差派犹底去把书卷拿来；犹底就从书记以利沙玛的房间里把书卷取来，向王和所有侍立在王左右的领袖宣读。
verses.textZhCuv: 王就打发犹底去拿这书卷来，他便从文士以利沙玛的屋内取来，念给王和王左右侍立的众首领听。
verses.textEnNiv: The king sent Jehudi to get the scroll, and Jehudi brought it from the room of Elishama the secretary and read it to the king and all the officials standing beside him.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the king sent Jehudi to get the scroll, and he took it from the chamber of Elishama the secretary. And Jehudi read it to the king and all the officials who stood beside the king.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the king sent Jehudi to bring the scroll, and he took it from Elishama the scribe’s chamber. And Jehudi read it in the hearing of the king and in the hearing of all the princes who stood beside the king.
verses.textEnNlt: The king sent Jehudi to get the scroll. Jehudi brought it from Elishama’s room and read it to the king as all his officials stood by.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the king sent Jehudi to get the scroll, and he took it out of the chamber of Elishama the scribe. And Jehudi read it to the king as well as to all the officials who were standing beside the king.
verses.textEn: The king sent Jehudi to get the scroll, and Jehudi brought it from the room of Elishama the secretary and read it to the king and all the officials standing beside him.

verses.textZh: 那时正是九月，王坐在冬宫里，在他面前有一盆炭火烧着。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时正是九月，王坐在冬宫里，在他面前有一盆炭火烧着。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时正是九月，王坐在过冬的房屋里，王的前面火盆中有烧着的火。
verses.textEnNiv: It was the ninth month and the king was sitting in the winter apartment, with a fire burning in the firepot in front of him.
verses.textEnEsv: It was the ninth month, and the king was sitting in the winter house, and there was a fire burning in the fire pot before him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the king was sitting in the winter house in the ninth month, with afire burning on the hearth before him.
verses.textEnNlt: It was late autumn, and the king was in a winterized part of the palace, sitting in front of a fire to keep warm.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the king was sitting in the winter house in the ninth month, with a fire burning in the brazier before him.
verses.textEn: It was the ninth month and the king was sitting in the winter apartment, with a fire burning in the firepot in front of him.

verses.textZh: 每逢犹底宣读完三四段，王就用书记的小刀把书割破，丢进盆中的火里，直到全卷都在盆中的火里烧尽了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 每逢犹底宣读完三四段，王就用书记的小刀把书割破，丢进盆中的火里，直到全卷都在盆中的火里烧尽了。
verses.textZhCuv: 犹底念了三四篇 ，王就用文士的刀将书卷割破，扔在火盆中，直到全卷在火中烧尽了。
verses.textEnNiv: Whenever Jehudi had read three or four columns of the scroll, the king cut them off with a scribe’s knife and threw them into the firepot, until the entire scroll was burned in the fire.
verses.textEnEsv: As Jehudi read three or four columns, the king would cut them off with a knife and throw them into the fire in the fire pot, until the entire scroll was consumed in the fire that was in the fire pot.
verses.textEnNkjv: And it happened, when Jehudi had read three or four columns, thattheking cut it with the scribe’s knife and cast it into the fire that was on the hearth, until all the scroll was consumed in the fire that was on the hearth.
verses.textEnNlt: Each time Jehudi finished reading three or four columns, the king took a knife and cut off that section of the scroll. He then threw it into the fire, section by section, until the whole scroll was burned up.
verses.textEnNasb: And when Jehudi had read three or four columns, the king cut it with a scribe’s knife and threw it into the fire that was in the brazier, until all of the scroll was consumed in the fire that was in the brazier.
verses.textEn: Whenever Jehudi had read three or four columns of the scroll, the king cut them off with a scribe’s knife and threw them into the firepot, until the entire scroll was burned in the fire.

verses.textZh: 王和他所有听见这一切话的臣仆，都不惊惧，也不撕裂衣服。
verses.textZhCnvs: 王和他所有听见这一切话的臣仆，都不惊惧，也不撕裂衣服。
verses.textZhCuv: 王和听见这一切话的臣仆都不惧怕，也不撕裂衣服。
verses.textEnNiv: The king and all his attendants who heard all these words showed no fear, nor did they tear their clothes.
verses.textEnEsv: Yet neither the king nor any of his servants who heard all these words was afraid, nor did they tear their garments.
verses.textEnNkjv: Yet they were not afraid, nor did they tear their garments, the king nor any of his servants who heard all these words.
verses.textEnNlt: Neither the king nor his attendants showed any signs of fear or repentance at what they heard.
verses.textEnNasb: Yet the king and all his servants who heard all these words did not tremble in fear, nor did they tear their garments.
verses.textEn: The king and all his attendants who heard all these words showed no fear, nor did they tear their clothes.

verses.textZh: 虽然以利拿单、第莱雅和基玛利雅恳求王不要烧这书卷，王却不听他们，
verses.textZhCnvs: 虽然以利拿单、第莱雅和基玛利雅恳求王不要烧这书卷，王却不听他们，
verses.textZhCuv: 以利拿单和第莱雅，并基玛利雅恳求王不要烧这书卷，他却不听。
verses.textEnNiv: Even though Elnathan, Delaiah and Gemariah urged the king not to burn the scroll, he would not listen to them.
verses.textEnEsv: Even when Elnathan and Delaiah and Gemariah urged the king not to burn the scroll, he would not listen to them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Nevertheless Elnathan, Delaiah, and Gemariah implored the king not to burn the scroll; but he would not listen to them.
verses.textEnNlt: Even when Elnathan, Delaiah, and Gemariah begged the king not to burn the scroll, he wouldn’t listen.
verses.textEnNasb: Even though Elnathan, Delaiah, and Gemariah urged the king not to burn the scroll, he would not listen to them.
verses.textEn: Even though Elnathan, Delaiah and Gemariah urged the king not to burn the scroll, he would not listen to them.

verses.textZh: 更吩咐王子耶拉篾、亚次列的儿子西莱雅和亚伯叠的儿子示利米雅，去捉拿文士巴录和耶利米先知；但耶和华把他们隐藏起来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 更吩咐王子耶拉篾、亚次列的儿子西莱雅和亚伯叠的儿子示利米雅，去捉拿文士巴录和耶利米先知；但耶和华把他们隐藏起来。
verses.textZhCuv: 王就吩咐哈米勒的儿子 耶拉篾和亚斯列的儿子西莱雅，并亚伯叠的儿子示利米雅，去捉拿文士巴录和先知耶利米。耶和华却将他们隐藏。
verses.textEnNiv: Instead, the king commanded Jerahmeel, a son of the king, Seraiah son of Azriel and Shelemiah son of Abdeel to arrest Baruch the scribe and Jeremiah the prophet. But the Lord had hidden them.
verses.textEnEsv: And the king commanded Jerahmeel the king’s son and Seraiah the son of Azriel and Shelemiah the son of Abdeel to seize Baruch the secretary and Jeremiah the prophet, but the Lord hid them.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the king commanded Jerahmeel the king’s son, Seraiah the son of Azriel, and Shelemiah the son of Abdeel, to seize Baruch the scribe and Jeremiah the prophet, but the Lord hid them.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the king commanded his son Jerahmeel, Seraiah son of Azriel, and Shelemiah son of Abdeel to arrest Baruch and Jeremiah. But the Lord had hidden them.
verses.textEnNasb: And the king commanded Jerahmeel the king’s son, Seraiah the son of Azriel, and Shelemiah the son of Abdeel to seize Baruch the scribe and Jeremiah the prophet, but the Lord hid them.
verses.textEn: Instead, the king commanded Jerahmeel, a son of the king, Seraiah son of Azriel and Shelemiah son of Abdeel to arrest Baruch the scribe and Jeremiah the prophet. But the Lord had hidden them.

verses.textZh: 王烧了那载有巴录从耶利米口中录下的话的书卷以后，耶和华的话又临到耶利米，说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 王烧了那载有巴录从耶利米口中录下的话的书卷以后，耶和华的话又临到耶利米，说：
verses.textZhCuv: 王烧了书卷（其上有巴录从耶利米口中所写的话）以后，耶和华的话临到耶利米说：
verses.textEnNiv: After the king burned the scroll containing the words that Baruch had written at Jeremiah’s dictation, the word of the Lord came to Jeremiah:
verses.textEnEsv: Now after the king had burned the scroll with the words that Baruch wrote at Jeremiah’s dictation, the word of the Lord came to Jeremiah:
verses.textEnNkjv: Now after the king had burned the scroll with the words which Baruch had written at the instruction of Jeremiah, the word of the Lord came to Jeremiah, saying:
verses.textEnNlt: After the king had burned the scroll on which Baruch had written Jeremiah’s words, the Lord gave Jeremiah another message. He said,
verses.textEnNasb: Then the word of the Lord came to Jeremiah after the king had burned the scroll and the words which Baruch had written at the dictation of Jeremiah, saying,
verses.textEn: After the king burned the scroll containing the words that Baruch had written at Jeremiah’s dictation, the word of the Lord came to Jeremiah:

verses.textZh: "你再取一书卷来，把犹大王约雅敬烧掉的前一书卷里原来的一切话，都写在书卷上面。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你再取一书卷来，把犹大王约雅敬烧掉的前一书卷里原来的一切话，都写在书卷上面。
verses.textZhCuv: 「你再取一卷，将犹大王约雅敬所烧第一卷上的一切话写在其上。
verses.textEnNiv: "Take another scroll and write on it all the words that were on the first scroll, which Jehoiakim king of Judah burned up.
verses.textEnEsv: "Take another scroll and write on it all the former words that were in the first scroll, which Jehoiakim the king of Judah has burned.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Take yet another scroll, and write on it all the former words that were in the first scroll which Jehoiakim the king of Judah has burned.
verses.textEnNlt: "Get another scroll, and write everything again just as you did on the scroll King Jehoiakim burned.
verses.textEnNasb: "Take again another scroll and write on it all the previous words that were on the first scroll, which Jehoiakim the king of Judah burned.
verses.textEn: "Take another scroll and write on it all the words that were on the first scroll, which Jehoiakim king of Judah burned up.

verses.textZh: 论到犹大王约雅敬你要说：‘耶和华这样说：你烧了那书卷，说：你为甚么在上面写着说：巴比伦王一定来，毁灭这地，使地上的人畜都灭绝呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 论到犹大王约雅敬你要说：‘耶和华这样说：你烧了那书卷，说：你为甚么在上面写着说：巴比伦王一定来，毁灭这地，使地上的人畜都灭绝呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 论到犹大王约雅敬你要说，耶和华如此说：你烧了书卷，说：『你为什么在其上写着，说巴比伦王必要来毁灭这地，使这地上绝了人民牲畜呢？』
verses.textEnNiv: Also tell Jehoiakim king of Judah, ‘This is what the Lord says: You burned that scroll and said, "Why did you write on it that the king of Babylon would certainly come and destroy this land and wipe from it both man and beast?"
verses.textEnEsv: And concerning Jehoiakim king of Judah you shall say, ‘Thus says the Lord , You have burned this scroll, saying, "Why have you written in it that the king of Babylon will certainly come and destroy this land, and will cut off from it man and beast?"
verses.textEnNkjv: And you shall say to Jehoiakim king of Judah, ‘Thus says the Lord: "You have burned this scroll, saying, ‘Why have you written in it that the king of Babylon will certainly come and destroy this land, and cause man and beast to cease from here?’ "
verses.textEnNlt: Then say to the king, ‘This is what the Lord says: You burned the scroll because it said the king of Babylon would destroy this land and empty it of people and animals.
verses.textEnNasb: And concerning Jehoiakim king of Judah you shall say, ‘This is what the Lord says: "You have burned this scroll, saying, ‘Why have you written on it that the king of Babylon will certainly come and destroy this land, and will make mankind and animals disappear from it?’ "
verses.textEn: Also tell Jehoiakim king of Judah, ‘This is what the Lord says: You burned that scroll and said, "Why did you write on it that the king of Babylon would certainly come and destroy this land and wipe from it both man and beast?"

verses.textZh: 因此，耶和华论到犹大王约雅敬这样说：他的后代必没有人坐在大卫的王位上；他的尸体必拋弃在外，日间受炎热，夜间受寒霜。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，耶和华论到犹大王约雅敬这样说：他的后代必没有人坐在大卫的王位上；他的尸体必拋弃在外，日间受炎热，夜间受寒霜。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以耶和华论到犹大王约雅敬说：他后裔中必没有人坐在大卫的宝座上；他的尸首必被抛弃，白日受炎热，黑夜受寒霜。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore this is what the Lord says about Jehoiakim king of Judah: He will have no one to sit on the throne of David; his body will be thrown out and exposed to the heat by day and the frost by night.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore thus says the Lord concerning Jehoiakim king of Judah: He shall have none to sit on the throne of David, and his dead body shall be cast out to the heat by day and the frost by night.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore thus says the Lord concerning Jehoiakim king of Judah: "He shall have no one to sit on the throne of David, and his dead body shall be cast out to the heat of the day and the frost of the night.
verses.textEnNlt: Now this is what the Lord says about King Jehoiakim of Judah: He will have no heirs to sit on the throne of David. His dead body will be thrown out to lie unburied—exposed to the heat of the day and the frost of the night.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore this is what the Lord says concerning Jehoiakim king of Judah: "He shall have no one to sit on the throne of David, and his dead body shall be thrown out to the heat of the day and the frost of the night.
verses.textEn: Therefore this is what the Lord says about Jehoiakim king of Judah: He will have no one to sit on the throne of David; his body will be thrown out and exposed to the heat by day and the frost by night.

verses.textZh: 我必惩罚他和他的后裔，以及他臣仆的罪孽；我必使我对他们预告过的一切灾祸，临到他们和耶路撒冷的居民，以及犹大人的身上；他们却不听从。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必惩罚他和他的后裔，以及他臣仆的罪孽；我必使我对他们预告过的一切灾祸，临到他们和耶路撒冷的居民，以及犹大人的身上；他们却不听从。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 我必因他和他后裔，并他臣仆的罪孽刑罚他们。我要使我所说的一切灾祸临到他们和耶路撒冷的居民，并犹大人；只是他们不听。」
verses.textEnNiv: I will punish him and his children and his attendants for their wickedness; I will bring on them and those living in Jerusalem and the people of Judah every disaster I pronounced against them, because they have not listened.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: And I will punish him and his offspring and his servants for their iniquity. I will bring upon them and upon the inhabitants of Jerusalem and upon the people of Judah all the disaster that I have pronounced against them, but they would not hear.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: I will punish him, his family, and his servants for their iniquity; and I will bring on them, on the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and on the men of Judah all the doom that I have pronounced against them; but they did not heed." ’ "
verses.textEnNlt: I will punish him and his family and his attendants for their sins. I will pour out on them and on all the people of Jerusalem and Judah all the disasters I promised, for they would not listen to my warnings.’"
verses.textEnNasb: I will also punish him, his descendants, and his servants for their wrongdoing, and I will bring on them and the inhabitants of Jerusalem and the people of Judah all the disaster that I have declared to them—but they did not listen." ’ "
verses.textEn: I will punish him and his children and his attendants for their wickedness; I will bring on them and those living in Jerusalem and the people of Judah every disaster I pronounced against them, because they have not listened.’ "

verses.textZh: 于是耶利米取了另一卷书卷，交给尼利亚的儿子文士巴录；巴录就从耶利米的口中，把犹大王约雅敬在火中烧掉的那书上的一切话，都写在书卷上，还加上很多类似的话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是耶利米取了另一卷书卷，交给尼利亚的儿子文士巴录；巴录就从耶利米的口中，把犹大王约雅敬在火中烧掉的那书上的一切话，都写在书卷上，还加上很多类似的话。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是，耶利米又取一书卷交给尼利亚的儿子文士巴录，他就从耶利米的口中写了犹大王约雅敬所烧前卷上的一切话，另外又添了许多相仿的话。
verses.textEnNiv: So Jeremiah took another scroll and gave it to the scribe Baruch son of Neriah, and as Jeremiah dictated, Baruch wrote on it all the words of the scroll that Jehoiakim king of Judah had burned in the fire. And many similar words were added to them.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Jeremiah took another scroll and gave it to Baruch the scribe, the son of Neriah, who wrote on it at the dictation of Jeremiah all the words of the scroll that Jehoiakim king of Judah had burned in the fire. And many similar words were added to them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Jeremiah took another scroll and gave it to Baruch the scribe, the son of Neriah, who wrote on it at the instruction of Jeremiah all the words of the book which Jehoiakim king of Judah had burned in the fire. And besides, there were added to them many similar words.
verses.textEnNlt: So Jeremiah took another scroll and dictated again to his secretary, Baruch. He wrote everything that had been on the scroll King Jehoiakim had burned in the fire. Only this time he added much more!
verses.textEnNasb: Then Jeremiah took another scroll and gave it to the scribe Baruch the son of Neriah, and he wrote on it at the dictation of Jeremiah all the words of the book which Jehoiakim king of Judah had burned in the fire; and many similar words were added to them.
verses.textEn: So Jeremiah took another scroll and gave it to the scribe Baruch son of Neriah, and as Jeremiah dictated, Baruch wrote on it all the words of the scroll that Jehoiakim king of Judah had burned in the fire. And many similar words were added to them.

verses.textZh: 约西亚的儿子西底家代替约雅敬的儿子哥尼雅作王；西底家是巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒所立在犹大地作王的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约西亚的儿子西底家代替约雅敬的儿子哥尼雅作王；西底家是巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒所立在犹大地作王的。
verses.textZhCuv: 约西亚的儿子西底家代替约雅敬的儿子哥尼雅为王，是巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒立在犹大地作王的。
verses.textEnNiv: Zedekiah son of Josiah was made king of Judah by Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon; he reigned in place of Jehoiachin son of Jehoiakim.
verses.textEnEsv: Zedekiah the son of Josiah, whom Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon made king in the land of Judah, reigned instead of Coniah the son of Jehoiakim.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now King Zedekiah the son of Josiah reigned instead of Coniah the son of Jehoiakim, whom Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon made king in the land of Judah.
verses.textEnNlt: Zedekiah son of Josiah succeeded Jehoiachin son of Jehoiakim as the king of Judah. He was appointed by King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylon.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Zedekiah the son of Josiah whom Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon had made king in the land of Judah, reigned as king in place of Coniah the son of Jehoiakim.
verses.textEn: Zedekiah son of Josiah was made king of Judah by Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon; he reigned in place of Jehoiachin son of Jehoiakim.

verses.textZh: 西底家和他的臣仆，以及那地的人民，都不听从耶和华藉耶利米先知所传的话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 西底家和他的臣仆，以及那地的人民，都不听从耶和华藉耶利米先知所传的话。
verses.textZhCuv: 但西底家和他的臣仆，并国中的百姓，都不听从耶和华藉先知耶利米所说的话。
verses.textEnNiv: Neither he nor his attendants nor the people of the land paid any attention to the words the Lord had spoken through Jeremiah the prophet.
verses.textEnEsv: But neither he nor his servants nor the people of the land listened to the words of the Lord that he spoke through Jeremiah the prophet.
verses.textEnNkjv: But neither he nor his servants nor the people of the land gave heed to the words of the Lord which He spoke by the prophet Jeremiah.
verses.textEnNlt: But neither King Zedekiah nor his attendants nor the people who were left in the land listened to what the Lord said through Jeremiah.
verses.textEnNasb: But neither he nor his servants nor the people of the land listened to the words of the Lord which He spoke through Jeremiah the prophet.
verses.textEn: Neither he nor his attendants nor the people of the land paid any attention to the words the Lord had spoken through Jeremiah the prophet.

verses.textZh: 西底家王差派示利米雅的儿子犹甲和玛西雅祭司的儿子西番雅，去见耶利米先知，说："请你为我们向耶和华我们的神祷告。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 西底家王差派示利米雅的儿子犹甲和玛西雅祭司的儿子西番雅，去见耶利米先知，说："请你为我们向耶和华我们的神祷告。"
verses.textZhCuv: 西底家王打发示利米雅的儿子犹甲和祭司玛西雅的儿子西番雅去见先知耶利米，说：「求你为我们祷告耶和华－我们的神。」
verses.textEnNiv: King Zedekiah, however, sent Jehukal son of Shelemiah with the priest Zephaniah son of Maaseiah to Jeremiah the prophet with this message: "Please pray to the Lord our God for us."
verses.textEnEsv: King Zedekiah sent Jehucal the son of Shelemiah, and Zephaniah the priest, the son of Maaseiah, to Jeremiah the prophet, saying, "Please pray for us to the Lord our God."
verses.textEnNkjv: And Zedekiah the king sent Jehucal the son of Shelemiah, and Zephaniah the son of Maaseiah, the priest, to the prophet Jeremiah, saying, "Pray now to the Lord our God for us."
verses.textEnNlt: Nevertheless, King Zedekiah sent Jehucal son of Shelemiah, and Zephaniah the priest, son of Maaseiah, to ask Jeremiah, "Please pray to the Lord our God for us."
verses.textEnNasb: Yet King Zedekiah sent Jehucal the son of Shelemiah, and the priest Zephaniah the son of Maaseiah, to Jeremiah the prophet, saying, "Please pray to the Lord our God in our behalf."
verses.textEn: King Zedekiah, however, sent Jehukal son of Shelemiah with the priest Zephaniah son of Maaseiah to Jeremiah the prophet with this message: "Please pray to the Lord our God for us."

verses.textZh: 那时，耶利米还可以在民众中间自由行动，因为他们还没有把他关进监狱里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，耶利米还可以在民众中间自由行动，因为他们还没有把他关进监狱里。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时耶利米在民中出入，因为他们还没有把他囚在监里。
verses.textEnNiv: Now Jeremiah was free to come and go among the people, for he had not yet been put in prison.
verses.textEnEsv: Now Jeremiah was still going in and out among the people, for he had not yet been put in prison.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Jeremiah was coming and going among the people, for they had not yet put him in prison.
verses.textEnNlt: Jeremiah had not yet been imprisoned, so he could come and go among the people as he pleased.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Jeremiah was still coming and going among the people, for they had not yet put him in prison.
verses.textEn: Now Jeremiah was free to come and go among the people, for he had not yet been put in prison.

verses.textZh: 法老的军队已经从埃及出来；那些围困耶路撒冷的迦勒底人听见了他们的风声，就从耶路撒冷撤退了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 法老的军队已经从埃及出来；那些围困耶路撒冷的迦勒底人听见了他们的风声，就从耶路撒冷撤退了。
verses.textZhCuv: 法老的军队已经从埃及出来，那围困耶路撒冷的迦勒底人听见他们的风声，就拔营离开耶路撒冷去了。
verses.textEnNiv: Pharaoh’s army had marched out of Egypt, and when the Babylonians who were besieging Jerusalem heard the report about them, they withdrew from Jerusalem.
verses.textEnEsv: The army of Pharaoh had come out of Egypt. And when the Chaldeans who were besieging Jerusalem heard news about them, they withdrew from Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Pharaoh’s army came up from Egypt; and when the Chaldeans who were besieging Jerusalem heard news of them, they departed from Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNlt: At this time the army of Pharaoh Hophra of Egypt appeared at the southern border of Judah. When the Babylonian army heard about it, they withdrew from their siege of Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNasb: Meanwhile, Pharaoh’s army had set out from Egypt; and when the Chaldeans who had been besieging Jerusalem heard the report about them, they withdrew from Jerusalem.
verses.textEn: Pharaoh’s army had marched out of Egypt, and when the Babylonians who were besieging Jerusalem heard the report about them, they withdrew from Jerusalem.

verses.textZh: 那时，耶和华的话临到耶利米先知，
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，耶和华的话临到耶利米先知，
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的话临到先知耶利米说：
verses.textEnNiv: Then the word of the Lord came to Jeremiah the prophet:
verses.textEnEsv: Then the word of the Lord came to Jeremiah the prophet:
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the word of the Lord came to the prophet Jeremiah, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord gave this message to Jeremiah:
verses.textEnNasb: Then the word of the Lord came to Jeremiah the prophet, saying,
verses.textEn: Then the word of the Lord came to Jeremiah the prophet:

verses.textZh: "耶和华以色列的神这样说：你们要对差派你们来求问我的犹大王这样说：‘看哪！那出来帮助你们的法老的军队，必回到他们的埃及本地去。
verses.textZhCnvs: "耶和华以色列的神这样说：你们要对差派你们来求问我的犹大王这样说：‘看哪！那出来帮助你们的法老的军队，必回到他们的埃及本地去。
verses.textZhCuv: 「耶和华－以色列的神如此说：犹大王打发你们来求问我，你们要如此对他说：『那出来帮助你们法老的军队必回埃及本国去。
verses.textEnNiv: "This is what the Lord , the God of Israel, says: Tell the king of Judah, who sent you to inquire of me, ‘Pharaoh’s army, which has marched out to support you, will go back to its own land, to Egypt.
verses.textEnEsv: "Thus says the Lord , God of Israel: Thus shall you say to the king of Judah who sent you to me to inquire of me, ‘Behold, Pharaoh’s army that came to help you is about to return to Egypt, to its own land.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Thus says the Lord, the God of Israel, ‘Thus you shall say to the king of Judah, who sent you to Me to inquire of Me: "Behold, Pharaoh’s army which has come up to help you will return to Egypt, to their own land.
verses.textEnNlt: "This is what the Lord , the God of Israel, says: The king of Judah sent you to ask me what is going to happen. Tell him, ‘Pharaoh’s army is about to return to Egypt, though he came here to help you.
verses.textEnNasb: "This is what the Lord, the God of Israel says: ‘This is what you are to say to the king of Judah, who sent you to Me to inquire of Me: "Behold, Pharaoh’s army, which has come out to help you, is going to return to its own land of Egypt.
verses.textEn: "This is what the Lord , the God of Israel, says: Tell the king of Judah, who sent you to inquire of me, ‘Pharaoh’s army, which has marched out to support you, will go back to its own land, to Egypt.

verses.textZh: 迦勒底人必回来，攻击这城，占领这城，放火烧毁这城。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 迦勒底人必回来，攻击这城，占领这城，放火烧毁这城。’
verses.textZhCuv: 迦勒底人必再来攻打这城，并要攻取，用火焚烧。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the Babylonians will return and attack this city; they will capture it and burn it down.’
verses.textEnEsv: And the Chaldeans shall come back and fight against this city. They shall capture it and burn it with fire.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Chaldeans shall come back and fight against this city, and take it and burn it with fire." ’
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Babylonians will come back and capture this city and burn it to the ground.’
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Chaldeans will return and fight against this city, and they will capture it and burn it with fire." ’
verses.textEn: Then the Babylonians will return and attack this city; they will capture it and burn it down.’

verses.textZh: 耶和华这样说：你们不要自己欺骗自己，说：‘迦勒底人必定离开我们！’因为他们必不离开。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华这样说：你们不要自己欺骗自己，说：‘迦勒底人必定离开我们！’因为他们必不离开。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华如此说：你们不要自欺说「迦勒底人必定离开我们」，因为他们必不离开。
verses.textEnNiv: "This is what the Lord says: Do not deceive yourselves, thinking, ‘The Babylonians will surely leave us.’ They will not!
verses.textEnEsv: Thus says the Lord , Do not deceive yourselves, saying, "The Chaldeans will surely go away from us," for they will not go away.
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus says the Lord: ‘Do not deceive yourselves, saying, "The Chaldeans will surely depart from us," for they will not depart.
verses.textEnNlt: "This is what the Lord says: Do not fool yourselves into thinking that the Babylonians are gone for good. They aren’t!
verses.textEnNasb: This is what the Lord says: ‘Do not deceive yourselves, saying, "The Chaldeans will certainly go away from us," for they will not go.
verses.textEn: "This is what the Lord says: Do not deceive yourselves, thinking, ‘The Babylonians will surely leave us.’ They will not!

verses.textZh: 即使你们击败了那攻打你们的迦勒底全军，他们中间只剩下一些受重伤的人，他们也必各从自己的帐棚里起来，放火烧毁这城。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 即使你们击败了那攻打你们的迦勒底全军，他们中间只剩下一些受重伤的人，他们也必各从自己的帐棚里起来，放火烧毁这城。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 你们即便杀败了与你们争战的迦勒底全军，但剩下受伤的人也必各人从帐棚里起来，用火焚烧这城。』」
verses.textEnNiv: Even if you were to defeat the entire Babylonian army that is attacking you and only wounded men were left in their tents, they would come out and burn this city down."
verses.textEnEsv: For even if you should defeat the whole army of Chaldeans who are fighting against you, and there remained of them only wounded men, every man in his tent, they would rise up and burn this city with fire.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: For though you had defeated the whole army of the Chaldeans who fight against you, and there remained only wounded men among them, they would rise up, every man in his tent, and burn the city with fire.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: Even if you were to destroy the entire Babylonian army, leaving only a handful of wounded survivors, they would still stagger from their tents and burn this city to the ground!"
verses.textEnNasb: For even if you had defeated the entire army of Chaldeans who were fighting against you, and there were only wounded men left among them, each man in his tent, they would rise up and burn this city with fire.’ "
verses.textEn: Even if you were to defeat the entire Babylonian army that is attacking you and only wounded men were left in their tents, they would come out and burn this city down."

verses.textZh: 迦勒底人的军队因惧怕法老的军队而从耶路撒冷撤退的时候，
verses.textZhCnvs: 迦勒底人的军队因惧怕法老的军队而从耶路撒冷撤退的时候，
verses.textZhCuv: 迦勒底的军队因怕法老的军队，拔营离开耶路撒冷的时候，
verses.textEnNiv: After the Babylonian army had withdrawn from Jerusalem because of Pharaoh’s army,
verses.textEnEsv: Now when the Chaldean army had withdrawn from Jerusalem at the approach of Pharaoh’s army,
verses.textEnNkjv: And it happened, when the army of the Chaldeans left thesiege of Jerusalem for fear of Pharaoh’s army,
verses.textEnNlt: When the Babylonian army left Jerusalem because of Pharaoh’s approaching army,
verses.textEnNasb: Now it happened when the army of the Chaldeans had withdrawn from Jerusalem because of Pharaoh’s army,
verses.textEn: After the Babylonian army had withdrawn from Jerusalem because of Pharaoh’s army,

verses.textZh: 耶利米离开耶路撒冷，往便雅悯地去，要在那里，在同乡中间，取得自己的产业。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶利米离开耶路撒冷，往便雅悯地去，要在那里，在同乡中间，取得自己的产业。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶利米就杂在民中出离耶路撒冷，要往便雅悯地去，在那里得自己的地业。
verses.textEnNiv: Jeremiah started to leave the city to go to the territory of Benjamin to get his share of the property among the people there.
verses.textEnEsv: Jeremiah set out from Jerusalem to go to the land of Benjamin to receive his portion there among the people.
verses.textEnNkjv: that Jeremiah went out of Jerusalem to go into the land of Benjamin to claim his property there among the people.
verses.textEnNlt: Jeremiah started to leave the city on his way to the territory of Benjamin, to claim his share of the property among his relatives there.
verses.textEnNasb: that Jeremiah left Jerusalem to go to the land of Benjamin in order to take possession of some property there among the people.
verses.textEn: Jeremiah started to leave the city to go to the territory of Benjamin to get his share of the property among the people there.

verses.textZh: 他到了便雅悯门，那里有一个守卫的长官，名叫伊利雅，是哈拿尼雅的孙子、示利米雅的儿子；他拿住耶利米先知，说："你想去投降迦勒底人！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他到了便雅悯门，那里有一个守卫的长官，名叫伊利雅，是哈拿尼雅的孙子、示利米雅的儿子；他拿住耶利米先知，说："你想去投降迦勒底人！"
verses.textZhCuv: 他到了便雅悯门那里，有守门官名叫伊利雅，是哈拿尼亚的孙子、示利米雅的儿子，他就拿住先知耶利米，说：「你是投降迦勒底人哪！」
verses.textEnNiv: But when he reached the Benjamin Gate, the captain of the guard, whose name was Irijah son of Shelemiah, the son of Hananiah, arrested him and said, "You are deserting to the Babylonians!"
verses.textEnEsv: When he was at the Benjamin Gate, a sentry there named Irijah the son of Shelemiah, son of Hananiah, seized Jeremiah the prophet, saying, "You are deserting to the Chaldeans."
verses.textEnNkjv: And when he was in the Gate of Benjamin, a captain of the guard was there whose name was Irijah the son of Shelemiah, the son of Hananiah; and he seized Jeremiah the prophet, saying, "You are defecting to the Chaldeans!"
verses.textEnNlt: But as he was walking through the Benjamin Gate, a sentry arrested him and said, "You are defecting to the Babylonians!" The sentry making the arrest was Irijah son of Shelemiah, grandson of Hananiah.
verses.textEnNasb: While he was at the Gate of Benjamin, a captain of the guard whose name was Irijah, the son of Shelemiah the son of Hananiah was there; and he arrested Jeremiah the prophet, saying, "You are deserting to the Chaldeans!"
verses.textEn: But when he reached the Benjamin Gate, the captain of the guard, whose name was Irijah son of Shelemiah, the son of Hananiah, arrested him and said, "You are deserting to the Babylonians!"

verses.textZh: 耶利米说："这是谎话！我并不是去投降迦勒底人。"但伊利雅不听他，仍拿住他，把他带到众领袖那里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶利米说："这是谎话！我并不是去投降迦勒底人。"但伊利雅不听他，仍拿住他，把他带到众领袖那里。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶利米说：「你这是谎话，我并不是投降迦勒底人。」伊利雅不听他的话，就拿住他，解到首领那里。
verses.textEnNiv: "That’s not true!" Jeremiah said. "I am not deserting to the Babylonians." But Irijah would not listen to him; instead, he arrested Jeremiah and brought him to the officials.
verses.textEnEsv: And Jeremiah said, "It is a lie; I am not deserting to the Chaldeans." But Irijah would not listen to him, and seized Jeremiah and brought him to the officials.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Jeremiah said, "False! I am not defecting to the Chaldeans." But he did not listen to him. So Irijah seized Jeremiah and brought him to the princes.
verses.textEnNlt: "That’s not true!" Jeremiah protested. "I had no intention of doing any such thing." But Irijah wouldn’t listen, and he took Jeremiah before the officials.
verses.textEnNasb: But Jeremiah said, "A lie! I am not deserting to the Chaldeans"; yet he would not listen to him. So Irijah arrested Jeremiah and brought him to the officials.
verses.textEn: "That’s not true!" Jeremiah said. "I am not deserting to the Babylonians." But Irijah would not listen to him; instead, he arrested Jeremiah and brought him to the officials.

verses.textZh: 众领袖都恼怒耶利米，就打他，并且把他关进监里，就是在书记约拿单的房子里，因为他们已把这房子改作监狱。
verses.textZhCnvs: 众领袖都恼怒耶利米，就打他，并且把他关进监里，就是在书记约拿单的房子里，因为他们已把这房子改作监狱。
verses.textZhCuv: 首领恼怒耶利米，就打了他，将他囚在文士约拿单的房屋中，因为他们以这房屋当作监牢。
verses.textEnNiv: They were angry with Jeremiah and had him beaten and imprisoned in the house of Jonathan the secretary, which they had made into a prison.
verses.textEnEsv: And the officials were enraged at Jeremiah, and they beat him and imprisoned him in the house of Jonathan the secretary, for it had been made a prison.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore the princes were angry with Jeremiah, and they struck him and put him in prison in the house of Jonathan the scribe. For they had made that the prison.
verses.textEnNlt: They were furious with Jeremiah and had him flogged and imprisoned in the house of Jonathan the secretary. Jonathan’s house had been converted into a prison.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the officials were angry at Jeremiah and they beat him, and put him in prison in the house of Jonathan the scribe, for they had made it into the prison.
verses.textEn: They were angry with Jeremiah and had him beaten and imprisoned in the house of Jonathan the secretary, which they had made into a prison.

verses.textZh: 耶利米进了地牢里的一个囚房，在那里监禁了多日。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶利米进了地牢里的一个囚房，在那里监禁了多日。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶利米来到狱中，进入牢房，在那里囚了多日。
verses.textEnNiv: Jeremiah was put into a vaulted cell in a dungeon, where he remained a long time.
verses.textEnEsv: When Jeremiah had come to the dungeon cells and remained there many days,
verses.textEnNkjv: When Jeremiah entered the dungeon and the cells, and Jeremiah had remained there many days,
verses.textEnNlt: Jeremiah was put into a dungeon cell, where he remained for many days.
verses.textEnNasb: For Jeremiah had come into the dungeon, that is, the vaulted cell; and Jeremiah stayed there many days.
verses.textEn: Jeremiah was put into a vaulted cell in a dungeon, where he remained a long time.

verses.textZh: 后来，西底家王派人去把他带出来；王在自己的宫中私下问他，说："从耶和华那里有话来吗？"耶利米回答："有！"又说："你必交在巴比伦王的手中。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 后来，西底家王派人去把他带出来；王在自己的宫中私下问他，说："从耶和华那里有话来吗？"耶利米回答："有！"又说："你必交在巴比伦王的手中。"
verses.textZhCuv: 西底家王打发人提出他来，在自己的宫内私下问他说：「从耶和华有什么话临到没有？」耶利米说：「有！」又说：「你必交在巴比伦王手中。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then King Zedekiah sent for him and had him brought to the palace, where he asked him privately, "Is there any word from the Lord ?" "Yes," Jeremiah replied, "you will be delivered into the hands of the king of Babylon."
verses.textEnEsv: King Zedekiah sent for him and received him. The king questioned him secretly in his house and said, "Is there any word from the Lord ?" Jeremiah said, "There is." Then he said, "You shall be delivered into the hand of the king of Babylon."
verses.textEnNkjv: then Zedekiah the king sent and took him out. The king asked him secretly in his house, and said, "Is there any word from the Lord?" And Jeremiah said, "There is." Then he said, "You shall be delivered into the hand of the king of Babylon!"
verses.textEnNlt: Later King Zedekiah secretly requested that Jeremiah come to the palace, where the king asked him, "Do you have any messages from the Lord ?" "Yes, I do!" said Jeremiah. "You will be defeated by the king of Babylon."
verses.textEnNasb: Now King Zedekiah sent men and took him out; and in his palace the king secretly asked him and said, "Is there a word from the Lord?" And Jeremiah said, "There is!" Then he said, "You will be handed over to the king of Babylon!"
verses.textEn: Then King Zedekiah sent for him and had him brought to the palace, where he asked him privately, "Is there any word from the Lord ?" "Yes," Jeremiah replied, "you will be delivered into the hands of the king of Babylon."

verses.textZh: 耶利米再对西底家王说："我有甚么得罪你，或你的臣仆，或这人民，你竟然把我送进监狱里呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶利米再对西底家王说："我有甚么得罪你，或你的臣仆，或这人民，你竟然把我送进监狱里呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 耶利米又对西底家王说：「我在什么事上得罪你，或你的臣仆，或这百姓，你竟将我囚在监里呢？
verses.textEnNiv: Then Jeremiah said to King Zedekiah, "What crime have I committed against you or your attendants or this people, that you have put me in prison?
verses.textEnEsv: Jeremiah also said to King Zedekiah, "What wrong have I done to you or your servants or this people, that you have put me in prison?
verses.textEnNkjv: Moreover Jeremiah said to King Zedekiah, "What offense have I committed against you, against your servants, or against this people, that you have put me in prison?
verses.textEnNlt: Then Jeremiah asked the king, "What crime have I committed? What have I done against you, your attendants, or the people that I should be imprisoned like this?
verses.textEnNasb: Moreover, Jeremiah said to King Zedekiah, "In what way have I sinned against you, or your servants, or this people, that you have put me in prison?
verses.textEn: Then Jeremiah said to King Zedekiah, "What crime have I committed against you or your attendants or this people, that you have put me in prison?

verses.textZh: 你们的先知曾向你们预言说：‘巴比伦王必不会来攻击你们和这地。’他们现今在哪里呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们的先知曾向你们预言说：‘巴比伦王必不会来攻击你们和这地。’他们现今在哪里呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 对你们预言巴比伦王必不来攻击你们和这地的先知，现今在哪里呢？
verses.textEnNiv: Where are your prophets who prophesied to you, ‘The king of Babylon will not attack you or this land’?
verses.textEnEsv: Where are your prophets who prophesied to you, saying, ‘The king of Babylon will not come against you and against this land’?
verses.textEnNkjv: Where now are your prophets who prophesied to you, saying, ‘The king of Babylon will not come against you or against this land’?
verses.textEnNlt: Where are your prophets now who told you the king of Babylon would not attack you or this land?
verses.textEnNasb: And where are your prophets who prophesied to you, saying, ‘The king of Babylon will not come against you or against this land’?
verses.textEn: Where are your prophets who prophesied to you, ‘The king of Babylon will not attack you or this land’?

verses.textZh: 我主我王啊！现在求你垂听，求你容我向你恳求！不要把我送回书记约拿单的房子去，免得我死在那里。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我主我王啊！现在求你垂听，求你容我向你恳求！不要把我送回书记约拿单的房子去，免得我死在那里。"
verses.textZhCuv: 主－我的王啊，求你现在垂听，准我在你面前的恳求：不要使我回到文士约拿单的房屋中，免得我死在那里。」
verses.textEnNiv: But now, my lord the king, please listen. Let me bring my petition before you: Do not send me back to the house of Jonathan the secretary, or I will die there."
verses.textEnEsv: Now hear, please, O my lord the king: let my humble plea come before you and do not send me back to the house of Jonathan the secretary, lest I die there."
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore please hear now, O my lord the king. Please, let my petition be accepted before you, and do not make me return to the house of Jonathan the scribe, lest I die there."
verses.textEnNlt: Listen, my lord the king, I beg you. Don’t send me back to the dungeon in the house of Jonathan the secretary, for I will die there."
verses.textEnNasb: But now, please listen, my lord the king; please let my plea come before you and do not make me return to the house of Jonathan the scribe, so that I will not die there."
verses.textEn: But now, my lord the king, please listen. Let me bring my petition before you: Do not send me back to the house of Jonathan the secretary, or I will die there."

verses.textZh: 于是西底家王下令，把耶利米拘留在卫兵的院子里；他们每天从饼铺街拿一个饼给他，直到城里的饼都吃光了。耶利米就这样留在卫兵的院子里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是西底家王下令，把耶利米拘留在卫兵的院子里；他们每天从饼铺街拿一个饼给他，直到城里的饼都吃光了。耶利米就这样留在卫兵的院子里。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是，西底家王下令，他们就把耶利米交在护卫兵的院中，每天从饼铺街取一个饼给他，直到城中的饼用尽了。这样，耶利米仍在护卫兵的院中。
verses.textEnNiv: King Zedekiah then gave orders for Jeremiah to be placed in the courtyard of the guard and given a loaf of bread from the street of the bakers each day until all the bread in the city was gone. So Jeremiah remained in the courtyard of the guard.
verses.textEnEsv: So King Zedekiah gave orders, and they committed Jeremiah to the court of the guard. And a loaf of bread was given him daily from the bakers’ street, until all the bread of the city was gone. So Jeremiah remained in the court of the guard.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Zedekiah the king commanded that they should commit Jeremiah to the court of the prison, and that they should give him daily a piece of bread from the bakers’ street, until all the bread in the city was gone. Thus Jeremiah remained in the court of the prison.
verses.textEnNlt: So King Zedekiah commanded that Jeremiah not be returned to the dungeon. Instead, he was imprisoned in the courtyard of the guard in the royal palace. The king also commanded that Jeremiah be given a loaf of fresh bread every day as long as there was any left in the city. So Jeremiah was put in the palace prison.
verses.textEnNasb: Then King Zedekiah gave a command, and they placed Jeremiah in custody in the courtyard of the guardhouse, and gave him a loaf of bread daily from the bakers’ street, until all the bread in the city was gone. So Jeremiah remained in the courtyard of the guardhouse.
verses.textEn: King Zedekiah then gave orders for Jeremiah to be placed in the courtyard of the guard and given a loaf of bread from the street of the bakers each day until all the bread in the city was gone. So Jeremiah remained in the courtyard of the guard.

verses.textZh: "耶和华这样说：‘凡留在这城里的，必因刀剑、饥荒、瘟疫而死；但出去向迦勒底人投降的，必可以活着；他们必捡回自己的性命，得以生存。’
verses.textZhCnvs: "耶和华这样说：‘凡留在这城里的，必因刀剑、饥荒、瘟疫而死；但出去向迦勒底人投降的，必可以活着；他们必捡回自己的性命，得以生存。’
verses.textZhCuv: 「耶和华如此说：住在这城里的必遭刀剑、饥荒、瘟疫而死；但出去归降迦勒底人的必得存活，就是以自己命为掠物的，必得存活。
verses.textEnNiv: "This is what the Lord says: ‘Whoever stays in this city will die by the sword, famine or plague, but whoever goes over to the Babylonians will live. They will escape with their lives; they will live.’
verses.textEnEsv: "Thus says the Lord : He who stays in this city shall die by the sword, by famine, and by pestilence, but he who goes out to the Chaldeans shall live. He shall have his life as a prize of war, and live.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Thus says the Lord: ‘He who remains in this city shall die by the sword, by famine, and by pestilence; but he who goes over to the Chaldeans shall live; his life shall be as a prize to him, and he shall live.’
verses.textEnNlt: "This is what the Lord says: ‘Everyone who stays in Jerusalem will die from war, famine, or disease, but those who surrender to the Babylonians will live. Their reward will be life. They will live!’
verses.textEnNasb: "This is what the Lord says: ‘Anyone who stays in this city will die by the sword, by famine, or by plague; but anyone who surrenders to the Chaldeans will live and have his own life as plunder, and stay alive.’
verses.textEn: "This is what the Lord says: ‘Whoever stays in this city will die by the sword, famine or plague, but whoever goes over to the Babylonians will live. They will escape with their lives; they will live.’

verses.textZh: 耶和华这样说：‘这城必交在巴比伦王军队的手中，巴比伦王必攻取这城。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华这样说：‘这城必交在巴比伦王军队的手中，巴比伦王必攻取这城。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华如此说：这城必要交在巴比伦王军队的手中，他必攻取这城。」
verses.textEnNiv: And this is what the Lord says: ‘This city will certainly be given into the hands of the army of the king of Babylon, who will capture it.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: Thus says the Lord : This city shall surely be given into the hand of the army of the king of Babylon and be taken."
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus says the Lord: ‘This city shall surely be given into the hand of the king of Babylon’s army, which shall take it.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord also says: ‘The city of Jerusalem will certainly be handed over to the army of the king of Babylon, who will capture it.’"
verses.textEnNasb: This is what the Lord says: ‘This city will certainly be handed over to the army of the king of Babylon and he will capture it.’ "
verses.textEn: And this is what the Lord says: ‘This city will certainly be given into the hands of the army of the king of Babylon, who will capture it.’ "

verses.textZh: 于是众领袖对王说："这人应该处死，因为他向这城里剩下的军兵和众民说了这样的话，使他们的手都软弱无力。这人不是为这人民求平安，却是惹来灾祸的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是众领袖对王说："这人应该处死，因为他向这城里剩下的军兵和众民说了这样的话，使他们的手都软弱无力。这人不是为这人民求平安，却是惹来灾祸的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 于是首领对王说：「求你将这人治死；因他向城里剩下的兵丁和众民说这样的话，使他们的手发软。这人不是求这百姓得平安，乃是叫他们受灾祸。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then the officials said to the king, "This man should be put to death. He is discouraging the soldiers who are left in this city, as well as all the people, by the things he is saying to them. This man is not seeking the good of these people but their ruin."
verses.textEnEsv: Then the officials said to the king, "Let this man be put to death, for he is weakening the hands of the soldiers who are left in this city, and the hands of all the people, by speaking such words to them. For this man is not seeking the welfare of this people, but their harm."
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore the princes said to the king, "Please, let this man be put to death, for thus he weakens the hands of the men of war who remain in this city, and the hands of all the people, by speaking such words to them. For this man does not seek the welfare of this people, but their harm."
verses.textEnNlt: So these officials went to the king and said, "Sir, this man must die! That kind of talk will undermine the morale of the few fighting men we have left, as well as that of all the people. This man is a traitor!"
verses.textEnNasb: Then the officials said to the king, "Please have this man put to death, since he is discouraging the men of war who are left in this city and all the people, by speaking words like these to them; for this man is not seeking the well-being of this people, but rather their harm."
verses.textEn: Then the officials said to the king, "This man should be put to death. He is discouraging the soldiers who are left in this city, as well as all the people, by the things he is saying to them. This man is not seeking the good of these people but their ruin."

verses.textZh: 西底家王说："看哪！他在你们手中；王不能作甚么反对你们。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 西底家王说："看哪！他在你们手中；王不能作甚么反对你们。"
verses.textZhCuv: 西底家王说：「他在你们手中，无论何事，王也不能与你们反对。」
verses.textEnNiv: "He is in your hands," King Zedekiah answered. "The king can do nothing to oppose you."
verses.textEnEsv: King Zedekiah said, "Behold, he is in your hands, for the king can do nothing against you."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Zedekiah the king said, "Look, he is in your hand. For the king can do nothing against you."
verses.textEnNlt: King Zedekiah agreed. "All right," he said. "Do as you like. I can’t stop you."
verses.textEnNasb: And King Zedekiah said, "Behold, he is in your hands; for the king can do nothing against you."
verses.textEn: "He is in your hands," King Zedekiah answered. "The king can do nothing to oppose you."

verses.textZh: 他们就拿住耶利米，把他丢在王子玛基雅的井里，那井是在卫兵的院子里的；他们用绳子把耶利米缒下去。井里没有水，只有淤泥；耶利米就陷在淤泥中。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们就拿住耶利米，把他丢在王子玛基雅的井里，那井是在卫兵的院子里的；他们用绳子把耶利米缒下去。井里没有水，只有淤泥；耶利米就陷在淤泥中。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们就拿住耶利米，下在哈米勒的儿子 玛基雅的牢狱里；那牢狱在护卫兵的院中。他们用绳子将耶利米系下去。牢狱里没有水，只有淤泥，耶利米就陷在淤泥中。
verses.textEnNiv: So they took Jeremiah and put him into the cistern of Malkijah, the king’s son, which was in the courtyard of the guard. They lowered Jeremiah by ropes into the cistern; it had no water in it, only mud, and Jeremiah sank down into the mud.
verses.textEnEsv: So they took Jeremiah and cast him into the cistern of Malchiah, the king’s son, which was in the court of the guard, letting Jeremiah down by ropes. And there was no water in the cistern, but only mud, and Jeremiah sank in the mud.
verses.textEnNkjv: So they took Jeremiah and cast him into the dungeon of Malchiah the king’s son, which was in the court of the prison, and they let Jeremiah down with ropes. And in the dungeon therewas no water, but mire. So Jeremiah sank in the mire.
verses.textEnNlt: So the officials took Jeremiah from his cell and lowered him by ropes into an empty cistern in the prison yard. It belonged to Malkijah, a member of the royal family. There was no water in the cistern, but there was a thick layer of mud at the bottom, and Jeremiah sank down into it.
verses.textEnNasb: So they took Jeremiah and threw him into the cistern of Malchijah the king’s son, which was in the courtyard of the guardhouse; and they let Jeremiah down with ropes. Now in the cistern there was no water but only mud, and Jeremiah sank into the mud.
verses.textEn: So they took Jeremiah and put him into the cistern of Malkijah, the king’s son, which was in the courtyard of the guard. They lowered Jeremiah by ropes into the cistern; it had no water in it, only mud, and Jeremiah sank down into the mud.

verses.textZh: "我主我王啊！这些人对耶利米先知所作的一切真是恶毒，他们把他丢在井里；在那地方他必饿死，因为城里再没有粮食了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: "我主我王啊！这些人对耶利米先知所作的一切真是恶毒，他们把他丢在井里；在那地方他必饿死，因为城里再没有粮食了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 「主－我的王啊，这些人向先知耶利米一味地行恶，将他下在牢狱中；他在那里必因饥饿而死，因为城中再没有粮食。」
verses.textEnNiv: "My lord the king, these men have acted wickedly in all they have done to Jeremiah the prophet. They have thrown him into a cistern, where he will starve to death when there is no longer any bread in the city."
verses.textEnEsv: "My lord the king, these men have done evil in all that they did to Jeremiah the prophet by casting him into the cistern, and he will die there of hunger, for there is no bread left in the city."
verses.textEnNkjv: "My lord the king, these men have done evil in all that they have done to Jeremiah the prophet, whom they have cast into the dungeon, and he is likely to die from hunger in the place where he is. For thereis no more bread in the city."
verses.textEnNlt: "My lord the king," he said, "these men have done a very evil thing in putting Jeremiah the prophet into the cistern. He will soon die of hunger, for almost all the bread in the city is gone."
verses.textEnNasb: "My lord the king, these men have acted wickedly in all that they have done to Jeremiah the prophet whom they have thrown into the cistern; and he will die right where he is because of the famine, for there is no more bread in the city."
verses.textEn: "My lord the king, these men have acted wickedly in all they have done to Jeremiah the prophet. They have thrown him into a cistern, where he will starve to death when there is no longer any bread in the city."

verses.textZh: 于是王吩咐古实人以伯．米勒说："你从这里带三十个人，在耶利米先知未死以前，把他从井里拉上来。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是王吩咐古实人以伯．米勒说："你从这里带三十个人，在耶利米先知未死以前，把他从井里拉上来。"
verses.textZhCuv: 王就吩咐古实人以伯‧米勒说：「你从这里带领三十人，趁着先知耶利米未死以前，将他从牢狱中提上来。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then the king commanded Ebed-Melek the Cushite, "Take thirty men from here with you and lift Jeremiah the prophet out of the cistern before he dies."
verses.textEnEsv: Then the king commanded Ebed-melech the Ethiopian, "Take thirty men with you from here, and lift Jeremiah the prophet out of the cistern before he dies."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the king commanded Ebed-Melech the Ethiopian, saying, "Take from here thirty men with you, and lift Jeremiah the prophet out of the dungeon before he dies."
verses.textEnNlt: So the king told Ebed-melech, "Take thirty of my men with you, and pull Jeremiah out of the cistern before he dies."
verses.textEnNasb: Then the king commanded Ebed-melech the Ethiopian, saying, "Take thirty men from here under your authority and bring Jeremiah the prophet up from the cistern before he dies."
verses.textEn: Then the king commanded Ebed-Melek the Cushite, "Take thirty men from here with you and lift Jeremiah the prophet out of the cistern before he dies."

verses.textZh: 以伯．米勒就带人进王宫去，到储物室下面的一个房间，从那里取了些破布烂衣，用绳子缒下井里给耶利米。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以伯．米勒就带人进王宫去，到储物室下面的一个房间，从那里取了些破布烂衣，用绳子缒下井里给耶利米。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是以伯‧米勒带领这些人同去，进入王宫，到库房以下，从那里取了些碎布和破烂的衣服，用绳子缒下牢狱去到耶利米那里。
verses.textEnNiv: So Ebed-Melek took the men with him and went to a room under the treasury in the palace. He took some old rags and worn-out clothes from there and let them down with ropes to Jeremiah in the cistern.
verses.textEnEsv: So Ebed-melech took the men with him and went to the house of the king, to a wardrobe in the storehouse, and took from there old rags and worn-out clothes, which he let down to Jeremiah in the cistern by ropes.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Ebed-Melech took the men with him and went into the house of the king under the treasury, and took from there old clothes and old rags, and let them down by ropes into the dungeon to Jeremiah.
verses.textEnNlt: So Ebed-melech took the men with him and went to a room in the palace beneath the treasury, where he found some old rags and discarded clothing. He carried these to the cistern and lowered them to Jeremiah on a rope.
verses.textEnNasb: So Ebed-melech took the men under his authority and went into the king’s palace to a place beneath the storeroom, and took from there worn-out clothes and worn-out rags, and let them down by ropes into the cistern to Jeremiah.
verses.textEn: So Ebed-Melek took the men with him and went to a room under the treasury in the palace. He took some old rags and worn-out clothes from there and let them down with ropes to Jeremiah in the cistern.

verses.textZh: 古实人以伯．米勒对耶利米说："把这些破布烂衣垫在你的腋下，然后束上绳子。"耶利米就这样作了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 古实人以伯．米勒对耶利米说："把这些破布烂衣垫在你的腋下，然后束上绳子。"耶利米就这样作了。
verses.textZhCuv: 古实人以伯‧米勒对耶利米说：「你用这些碎布和破烂的衣服放在绳子上，垫你的胳肢窝。」耶利米就照样行了。
verses.textEnNiv: Ebed-Melek the Cushite said to Jeremiah, "Put these old rags and worn-out clothes under your arms to pad the ropes." Jeremiah did so,
verses.textEnEsv: Then Ebed-melech the Ethiopian said to Jeremiah, "Put the rags and clothes between your armpits and the ropes." Jeremiah did so.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Ebed-Melech the Ethiopian said to Jeremiah, "Please put these old clothes and rags under your armpits, under the ropes." And Jeremiah did so.
verses.textEnNlt: Ebed-melech called down to Jeremiah, "Put these rags under your armpits to protect you from the ropes." Then when Jeremiah was ready,
verses.textEnNasb: Then Ebed-melech the Ethiopian said to Jeremiah, "Now put these worn-out clothes and rags under your armpits under the ropes"; and Jeremiah did so.
verses.textEn: Ebed-Melek the Cushite said to Jeremiah, "Put these old rags and worn-out clothes under your arms to pad the ropes." Jeremiah did so,

verses.textZh: 于是他们用绳子把耶利米从井里拉出来；这样，耶利米可以住在卫兵的院子里。
