verses.textEnEsv: Then Ishmael took captive all the rest of the people who were in Mizpah, the king’s daughters and all the people who were left at Mizpah, whom Nebuzaradan, the captain of the guard, had committed to Gedaliah the son of Ahikam. Ishmael the son of Nethaniah took them captive and set out to cross over to the Ammonites.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Ishmael carried away captive all the rest of the people who were in Mizpah, the king’s daughters and all the people who remained in Mizpah, whom Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard had committed to Gedaliah the son of Ahikam. And Ishmael the son of Nethaniah carried them away captive and departed to go over to the Ammonites.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Ishmael made captives of the king’s daughters and the other people who had been left under Gedaliah’s care in Mizpah by Nebuzaradan, the captain of the guard. Taking them with him, he started back toward the land of Ammon.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Ishmael took captive all the remnant of the people who were in Mizpah, the king’s daughters and all the people who were left in Mizpah, whom Nebuzaradan the captain of the bodyguard had put in the custody of Gedaliah the son of Ahikam. Ishmael the son of Nethaniah took them captive and proceeded to cross over to the sons of Ammon.
verses.textEn: Ishmael made captives of all the rest of the people who were in Mizpah—the king’s daughters along with all the others who were left there, over whom Nebuzaradan commander of the imperial guard had appointed Gedaliah son of Ahikam. Ishmael son of Nethaniah took them captive and set out to cross over to the Ammonites.

verses.textZh: 加利亚的儿子约哈难和与他一起的众将领，听见了尼探雅的儿子以实玛利所行的一切恶事，
verses.textZhCnvs: 加利亚的儿子约哈难和与他一起的众将领，听见了尼探雅的儿子以实玛利所行的一切恶事，
verses.textZhCuv: 加利亚的儿子约哈难和同着他的众军长听见尼探雅的儿子以实玛利所行的一切恶，
verses.textEnNiv: When Johanan son of Kareah and all the army officers who were with him heard about all the crimes Ishmael son of Nethaniah had committed,
verses.textEnEsv: But when Johanan the son of Kareah and all the leaders of the forces with him heard of all the evil that Ishmael the son of Nethaniah had done,
verses.textEnNkjv: But when Johanan the son of Kareah and all the captains of the forces that were with him heard of all the evil that Ishmael the son of Nethaniah had done,
verses.textEnNlt: But when Johanan son of Kareah and the other military leaders heard about Ishmael’s crimes,
verses.textEnNasb: But Johanan the son of Kareah and all the commanders of the forces that were with him heard about all the evil that Ishmael the son of Nethaniah had done.
verses.textEn: When Johanan son of Kareah and all the army officers who were with him heard about all the crimes Ishmael son of Nethaniah had committed,

verses.textZh: 就率领所有的人，去攻打尼探雅的儿子以实玛利，在基遍的大水池边追上他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 就率领所有的人，去攻打尼探雅的儿子以实玛利，在基遍的大水池边追上他。
verses.textZhCuv: 就带领众人前往，要和尼探雅的儿子以实玛利争战，在基遍的大水旁 遇见他。
verses.textEnNiv: they took all their men and went to fight Ishmael son of Nethaniah. They caught up with him near the great pool in Gibeon.
verses.textEnEsv: they took all their men and went to fight against Ishmael the son of Nethaniah. They came upon him at the great pool that is in Gibeon.
verses.textEnNkjv: they took all the men and went to fight with Ishmael the son of Nethaniah; and they found him by the great pool that is in Gibeon.
verses.textEnNlt: they took all their men and set out to stop him. They caught up with him at the large pool near Gibeon.
verses.textEnNasb: So they took all the men and went to fight with Ishmael the son of Nethaniah and they found him by the large pool that is in Gibeon.
verses.textEn: they took all their men and went to fight Ishmael son of Nethaniah. They caught up with him near the great pool in Gibeon.

verses.textZh: 在以实玛利那里的众民，看见了加利亚的儿子约哈难和与他一起的众将领，就都欢喜。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在以实玛利那里的众民，看见了加利亚的儿子约哈难和与他一起的众将领，就都欢喜。
verses.textZhCuv: 以实玛利那里的众人看见加利亚的儿子约哈难和同着他的众军长，就都欢喜。
verses.textEnNiv: When all the people Ishmael had with him saw Johanan son of Kareah and the army officers who were with him, they were glad.
verses.textEnEsv: And when all the people who were with Ishmael saw Johanan the son of Kareah and all the leaders of the forces with him, they rejoiced.
verses.textEnNkjv: So it was, when all the people who were with Ishmael saw Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces who were with him, that they were glad.
verses.textEnNlt: The people Ishmael had captured shouted for joy when they saw Johanan and the other military leaders.
verses.textEnNasb: Now as soon as all the people who were with Ishmael saw Johanan the son of Kareah and all the commanders of the forces that were with him, they were joyful.
verses.textEn: When all the people Ishmael had with him saw Johanan son of Kareah and the army officers who were with him, they were glad.

verses.textZh: 于是以实玛利从米斯巴掳去的众民都转身，归到加利亚的儿子约哈难那里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是以实玛利从米斯巴掳去的众民都转身，归到加利亚的儿子约哈难那里。
verses.textZhCuv: 这样，以实玛利从米斯巴所掳去的众人都转身归加利亚的儿子约哈难去了。
verses.textEnNiv: All the people Ishmael had taken captive at Mizpah turned and went over to Johanan son of Kareah.
verses.textEnEsv: So all the people whom Ishmael had carried away captive from Mizpah turned around and came back, and went to Johanan the son of Kareah.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then all the people whom Ishmael had carried away captive from Mizpah turned around and came back, and went to Johanan the son of Kareah.
verses.textEnNlt: And all the captives from Mizpah escaped and began to help Johanan.
verses.textEnNasb: So all the people whom Ishmael had taken captive from Mizpah turned around and came back, and went to Johanan the son of Kareah.
verses.textEn: All the people Ishmael had taken captive at Mizpah turned and went over to Johanan son of Kareah.

verses.textZh: 尼探雅的儿子以实玛利带着八个人逃脱了约哈难的手，到亚扪那里去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 尼探雅的儿子以实玛利带着八个人逃脱了约哈难的手，到亚扪那里去。
verses.textZhCuv: 尼探雅的儿子以实玛利和八个人脱离约哈难的手，逃往亚扪人那里去了。
verses.textEnNiv: But Ishmael son of Nethaniah and eight of his men escaped from Johanan and fled to the Ammonites.
verses.textEnEsv: But Ishmael the son of Nethaniah escaped from Johanan with eight men, and went to the Ammonites.
verses.textEnNkjv: But Ishmael the son of Nethaniah escaped from Johanan with eight men and went to the Ammonites.
verses.textEnNlt: Meanwhile, Ishmael and eight of his men escaped from Johanan into the land of Ammon.
verses.textEnNasb: But Ishmael the son of Nethaniah escaped from Johanan with eight men, and went to the sons of Ammon.
verses.textEn: But Ishmael son of Nethaniah and eight of his men escaped from Johanan and fled to the Ammonites.

verses.textZh: 加利亚的儿子约哈难和与他一起的众将领，就夺回了全部余民，包括军兵、妇女、孩童和宫中的臣宰，就是尼探雅的儿子以实玛利在刺杀亚希甘的儿子基大利以后，从米斯巴掳走的。约哈难把这些人都从基遍带回来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 加利亚的儿子约哈难和与他一起的众将领，就夺回了全部余民，包括军兵、妇女、孩童和宫中的臣宰，就是尼探雅的儿子以实玛利在刺杀亚希甘的儿子基大利以后，从米斯巴掳走的。约哈难把这些人都从基遍带回来。
verses.textZhCuv: 尼探雅的儿子以实玛利杀了亚希甘的儿子基大利，从米斯巴将剩下的一切百姓、兵丁、妇女、孩童、太监掳到基遍之后，加利亚的儿子约哈难和同着他的众军长将他们都夺回来，
verses.textEnNiv: Then Johanan son of Kareah and all the army officers who were with him led away all the people of Mizpah who had survived, whom Johanan had recovered from Ishmael son of Nethaniah after Ishmael had assassinated Gedaliah son of Ahikam—the soldiers, women, children and court officials he had recovered from Gibeon.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Johanan the son of Kareah and all the leaders of the forces with him took from Mizpah all the rest of the people whom he had recovered from Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, after he had struck down Gedaliah the son of Ahikam—soldiers, women, children, and eunuchs, whom Johanan brought back from Gibeon.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces that were with him, took from Mizpah all the rest of the people whom he had recovered from Ishmael the son of Nethaniah after he had murdered Gedaliah the son of Ahikam—the mighty men of war and the women and the children and the eunuchs, whom he had brought back from Gibeon.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Johanan son of Kareah and the other military leaders took all the people they had rescued in Gibeon—the soldiers, women, children, and court officials whom Ishmael had captured after he killed Gedaliah.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Johanan the son of Kareah and all the commanders of the forces that were with him took from Mizpah all the remnant of the people whom he had recovered from Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, after he had struck and killed Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, that is, the men who were soldiers, the women, the children, and the high officials, whom he had brought back from Gibeon.
verses.textEn: Then Johanan son of Kareah and all the army officers who were with him led away all the people of Mizpah who had survived, whom Johanan had recovered from Ishmael son of Nethaniah after Ishmael had assassinated Gedaliah son of Ahikam—the soldiers, women, children and court officials he had recovered from Gibeon.

verses.textZh: 他们去到伯利恒附近的基罗特金罕，停留在那里，想要往埃及去，
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们去到伯利恒附近的基罗特金罕，停留在那里，想要往埃及去，
verses.textZhCuv: 带到靠近伯利恒的金罕寓 住下，要进入埃及去；
verses.textEnNiv: And they went on, stopping at Geruth Kimham near Bethlehem on their way to Egypt
verses.textEnEsv: And they went and stayed at Geruth Chimham near Bethlehem, intending to go to Egypt
verses.textEnNkjv: And they departed and dwelt in the habitation of Chimham, which is near Bethlehem, as they went on their way to Egypt,
verses.textEnNlt: They took them all to the village of Geruth-kimham near Bethlehem, where they prepared to leave for Egypt.
verses.textEnNasb: And they went and stayed in Geruth Chimham, which is beside Bethlehem, in order to proceed into Egypt
verses.textEn: And they went on, stopping at Geruth Kimham near Bethlehem on their way to Egypt

verses.textZh: 躲避迦勒底人。他们惧怕迦勒底人，因为尼探雅的儿子以实玛利杀了巴比伦王指派管理那地的亚希甘的儿子基大利。
verses.textZhCnvs: 躲避迦勒底人。他们惧怕迦勒底人，因为尼探雅的儿子以实玛利杀了巴比伦王指派管理那地的亚希甘的儿子基大利。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为尼探雅的儿子以实玛利杀了巴比伦王所立为省长的亚希甘的儿子基大利，约哈难惧怕迦勒底人。
verses.textEnNiv: to escape the Babylonians. They were afraid of them because Ishmael son of Nethaniah had killed Gedaliah son of Ahikam, whom the king of Babylon had appointed as governor over the land.
verses.textEnEsv: because of the Chaldeans. For they were afraid of them, because Ishmael the son of Nethaniah had struck down Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, whom the king of Babylon had made governor over the land.
verses.textEnNkjv: because of the Chaldeans; for they were afraid of them, because Ishmael the son of Nethaniah had murdered Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, whom the king of Babylon had made governor in the land.
verses.textEnNlt: They were afraid of what the Babylonians would do when they heard that Ishmael had killed Gedaliah, the governor appointed by the Babylonian king.
verses.textEnNasb: because of the Chaldeans; for they were afraid of them, since Ishmael the son of Nethaniah had struck and killed Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, whom the king of Babylon had appointed over the land.
verses.textEn: to escape the Babylonians. They were afraid of them because Ishmael son of Nethaniah had killed Gedaliah son of Ahikam, whom the king of Babylon had appointed as governor over the land.

verses.textZh: 所有的将领，包括加利亚的儿子约哈难和何沙雅的儿子耶撒尼亚，以及全体人民，从最小的到最大的，都上前来，
verses.textZhCnvs: 所有的将领，包括加利亚的儿子约哈难和何沙雅的儿子耶撒尼亚，以及全体人民，从最小的到最大的，都上前来，
verses.textZhCuv: 众军长和加利亚的儿子约哈难，并何沙雅的儿子耶撒尼亚 以及众百姓，从最小的到至大的都进前来，
verses.textEnNiv: Then all the army officers, including Johanan son of Kareah and Jezaniah son of Hoshaiah, and all the people from the least to the greatest approached
verses.textEnEsv: Then all the commanders of the forces, and Johanan the son of Kareah and Jezaniah the son of Hoshaiah, and all the people from the least to the greatest, came near
verses.textEnNkjv: Now all the captains of the forces, Johanan the son of Kareah, Jezaniah the son of Hoshaiah, and all the people, from the least to the greatest, came near
verses.textEnNlt: Then all the military leaders, including Johanan son of Kareah and Jezaniah son of Hoshaiah, and all the people, from the least to the greatest, approached
verses.textEnNasb: Then all the commanders of the forces, Johanan the son of Kareah, Jezaniah the son of Hoshaiah, and all the people from the small to the great approached
verses.textEn: Then all the army officers, including Johanan son of Kareah and Jezaniah son of Hoshaiah, and all the people from the least to the greatest approached

verses.textZh: 对耶利米先知说："求你容我们向你恳求，请为我们这余剩的民向耶和华你的神祷告；因为我们从前人数众多，现在剩下的极少，就像你现在亲眼所见的一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 对耶利米先知说："求你容我们向你恳求，请为我们这余剩的民向耶和华你的神祷告；因为我们从前人数众多，现在剩下的极少，就像你现在亲眼所见的一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 对先知耶利米说：「求你准我们在你面前祈求，为我们这剩下的人祷告耶和华－你的神。我们本来众多，现在剩下的极少，这是你亲眼所见的。
verses.textEnNiv: Jeremiah the prophet and said to him, "Please hear our petition and pray to the Lord your God for this entire remnant. For as you now see, though we were once many, now only a few are left.
verses.textEnEsv: and said to Jeremiah the prophet, "Let our plea for mercy come before you, and pray to the Lord your God for us, for all this remnant— because we are left with but a few, as your eyes see us—
verses.textEnNkjv: and said to Jeremiah the prophet, "Please, let our petition be acceptable to you, and pray for us to the Lord your God, for all this remnant (since we are left but a few of many, as you can see),
verses.textEnNlt: Jeremiah the prophet. They said, "Please pray to the Lord your God for us. As you can see, we are only a tiny remnant compared to what we were before.
verses.textEnNasb: and said to Jeremiah the prophet, "Please let our pleading come before you, and pray for us to the Lord your God for all this remnant—since we have been left only a few out of many, just as your own eyes now see us—
verses.textEn: Jeremiah the prophet and said to him, "Please hear our petition and pray to the Lord your God for this entire remnant. For as you now see, though we were once many, now only a few are left.

verses.textZh: 请为我们求耶和华你的神指示我们当走的路和该作的事。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 请为我们求耶和华你的神指示我们当走的路和该作的事。"
verses.textZhCuv: 愿耶和华－你的神指示我们所当走的路，所当做的事。」
verses.textEnNiv: Pray that the Lord your God will tell us where we should go and what we should do."
verses.textEnEsv: that the Lord your God may show us the way we should go, and the thing that we should do."
verses.textEnNkjv: that the Lord your God may show us the way in which we should walk and the thing we should do."
verses.textEnNlt: Pray that the Lord your God will show us what to do and where to go."
verses.textEnNasb: that the Lord your God will tell us the way in which we should walk, and the thing that we should do."
verses.textEn: Pray that the Lord your God will tell us where we should go and what we should do."

verses.textZh: 耶利米先知对他们说："我听见了！我必照着你们的话祷告耶和华你们的神。耶和华回答你们所说的一切话，我必告诉你们，一句也不会向你们隐瞒。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶利米先知对他们说："我听见了！我必照着你们的话祷告耶和华你们的神。耶和华回答你们所说的一切话，我必告诉你们，一句也不会向你们隐瞒。"
verses.textZhCuv: 先知耶利米对他们说：「我已经听见你们了，我必照着你们的话祷告耶和华－你们的神。耶和华无论回答什么，我必都告诉你们，毫不隐瞒。」
verses.textEnNiv: "I have heard you," replied Jeremiah the prophet. "I will certainly pray to the Lord your God as you have requested; I will tell you everything the Lord says and will keep nothing back from you."
verses.textEnEsv: Jeremiah the prophet said to them, "I have heard you. Behold, I will pray to the Lord your God according to your request, and whatever the Lord answers you I will tell you. I will keep nothing back from you."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Jeremiah the prophet said to them, "I have heard. Indeed, I will pray to the Lord your God according to your words, and it shall be, that whatever the Lord answers you, I will declare it to you. I will keep nothing back from you."
verses.textEnNlt: "All right," Jeremiah replied. "I will pray to the Lord your God, as you have asked, and I will tell you everything he says. I will hide nothing from you."
verses.textEnNasb: Then Jeremiah the prophet said to them, "I have heard you. Behold, I am going to pray to the Lord your God in accordance with your words; and I will tell you the whole message which the Lord gives you as an answer. I will not withhold a word from you."
verses.textEn: "I have heard you," replied Jeremiah the prophet. "I will certainly pray to the Lord your God as you have requested; I will tell you everything the Lord says and will keep nothing back from you."

verses.textZh: 于是他们对耶利米说："我们若不照着耶和华你的神差遣你到我们这里来所说的一切话去作，愿耶和华作真实和诚信的见证，指控我们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是他们对耶利米说："我们若不照着耶和华你的神差遣你到我们这里来所说的一切话去作，愿耶和华作真实和诚信的见证，指控我们。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是他们对耶利米说：「我们若不照耶和华－你的神差遣你来说的一切话行，愿耶和华在我们中间作真实诚信的见证。
verses.textEnNiv: Then they said to Jeremiah, "May the Lord be a true and faithful witness against us if we do not act in accordance with everything the Lord your God sends you to tell us.
verses.textEnEsv: Then they said to Jeremiah, "May the Lord be a true and faithful witness against us if we do not act according to all the word with which the Lord your God sends you to us.
verses.textEnNkjv: So they said to Jeremiah, "Let the Lord be a true and faithful witness between us, if we do not do according to everything which the Lord your God sends us by you.
verses.textEnNlt: Then they said to Jeremiah, "May the Lord your God be a faithful witness against us if we refuse to obey whatever he tells us to do!
verses.textEnNasb: Then they said to Jeremiah, "May the Lord be a true and faithful witness against us if we do not act in accordance with the whole message with which the Lord your God will send you to us.
verses.textEn: Then they said to Jeremiah, "May the Lord be a true and faithful witness against us if we do not act in accordance with everything the Lord your God sends you to tell us.

verses.textZh: 不论是甜是苦，我们都愿听从耶和华我们神的话，因为是我们委派你向他祈求的；我们听从耶和华我们神的话，就必凡事亨通。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 不论是甜是苦，我们都愿听从耶和华我们神的话，因为是我们委派你向他祈求的；我们听从耶和华我们神的话，就必凡事亨通。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我们现在请你到耶和华－我们的神面前，他说的无论是好是歹，我们都必听从；我们听从耶和华－我们神的话，就可以得福。」
verses.textEnNiv: Whether it is favorable or unfavorable, we will obey the Lord our God, to whom we are sending you, so that it will go well with us, for we will obey the Lord our God."
verses.textEnEsv: Whether it is good or bad, we will obey the voice of the Lord our God to whom we are sending you, that it may be well with us when we obey the voice of the Lord our God."
verses.textEnNkjv: Whether itis pleasing or displeasing, we will obey the voice of the Lord our God to whom we send you, that it may be well with us when we obey the voice of the Lord our God."
verses.textEnNlt: Whether we like it or not, we will obey the Lord our God to whom we are sending you with our plea. For if we obey him, everything will turn out well for us."
verses.textEnNasb: Whether it is pleasant or unpleasant, we will listen to the voice of the Lord our God to whom we are sending you, so that it may go well for us when we listen to the voice of the Lord our God."
verses.textEn: Whether it is favorable or unfavorable, we will obey the Lord our God, to whom we are sending you, so that it will go well with us, for we will obey the Lord our God."

verses.textZh: 过了十天，耶和华的话临到耶利米。
verses.textZhCnvs: 过了十天，耶和华的话临到耶利米。
verses.textZhCuv: 过了十天，耶和华的话临到耶利米。
verses.textEnNiv: Ten days later the word of the Lord came to Jeremiah.
verses.textEnEsv: At the end of ten days the word of the Lord came to Jeremiah.
verses.textEnNkjv: And it happened after ten days that the word of the Lord came to Jeremiah.
verses.textEnNlt: Ten days later the Lord gave his reply to Jeremiah.
verses.textEnNasb: Now at the end of ten days the word of the Lord came to Jeremiah.
verses.textEn: Ten days later the word of the Lord came to Jeremiah.

verses.textZh: 耶利米就把加利亚的儿子约哈难，和所有与他一起的将领，以及全体人民，从最小的到最大的，都叫了来，
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶利米就把加利亚的儿子约哈难，和所有与他一起的将领，以及全体人民，从最小的到最大的，都叫了来，
verses.textZhCuv: 他就将加利亚的儿子约哈难和同着他的众军长，并众百姓，从最小的到至大的都叫了来，
verses.textEnNiv: So he called together Johanan son of Kareah and all the army officers who were with him and all the people from the least to the greatest.
verses.textEnEsv: Then he summoned Johanan the son of Kareah and all the commanders of the forces who were with him, and all the people from the least to the greatest,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he called Johanan the son of Kareah, all the captains of the forces which were with him, and all the people from the least even to the greatest,
verses.textEnNlt: So he called for Johanan son of Kareah and the other military leaders, and for all the people, from the least to the greatest.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he called for Johanan the son of Kareah and all the commanders of the forces that were with him, and for all the people from the small to the great,
verses.textEn: So he called together Johanan son of Kareah and all the army officers who were with him and all the people from the least to the greatest.

verses.textZh: 对他们说："耶和华以色列的神，就是你们委派我去为你们向他恳求的那位，这样说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 对他们说："耶和华以色列的神，就是你们委派我去为你们向他恳求的那位，这样说：
verses.textZhCuv: 对他们说：「耶和华－以色列的神，就是你们请我在他面前为你们祈求的主，如此说：
verses.textEnNiv: He said to them, "This is what the Lord , the God of Israel, to whom you sent me to present your petition, says:
verses.textEnEsv: and said to them, "Thus says the Lord , the God of Israel, to whom you sent me to present your plea for mercy before him:
verses.textEnNkjv: and said to them, "Thus says the Lord, the God of Israel, to whom you sent me to present your petition before Him:
verses.textEnNlt: He said to them, "You sent me to the Lord , the God of Israel, with your request, and this is his reply:
verses.textEnNasb: and said to them, "This is what the Lord says, the God of Israel, to whom you sent me to present your plea before Him:
verses.textEn: He said to them, "This is what the Lord , the God of Israel, to whom you sent me to present your petition, says:

verses.textZh: ‘你们若决意住在这地，我就建立你们，必不拆毁；栽植你们，必不拔除；因我为那已经降在你们身上的灾祸回心转意。
verses.textZhCnvs: ‘你们若决意住在这地，我就建立你们，必不拆毁；栽植你们，必不拔除；因我为那已经降在你们身上的灾祸回心转意。
verses.textZhCuv: 『你们若仍住在这地，我就建立你们，必不拆毁，栽植你们，并不拔出，因我为降与你们的灾祸后悔了。
verses.textEnNiv: ‘If you stay in this land, I will build you up and not tear you down; I will plant you and not uproot you, for I have relented concerning the disaster I have inflicted on you.
verses.textEnEsv: If you will remain in this land, then I will build you up and not pull you down; I will plant you, and not pluck you up; for I relent of the disaster that I did to you.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘If you will still remain in this land, then I will build you and not pull you down, and I will plant you and not pluck you up. For I relent concerning the disaster that I have brought upon you.
verses.textEnNlt: ‘Stay here in this land. If you do, I will build you up and not tear you down; I will plant you and not uproot you. For I am sorry about all the punishment I have had to bring upon you.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘If you will indeed stay in this land, then I will build you up and not tear you down, and I will plant you and not uproot you; for I will relent of the disaster that I have inflicted on you.
verses.textEn: ‘If you stay in this land, I will build you up and not tear you down; I will plant you and not uproot you, for I have relented concerning the disaster I have inflicted on you.

verses.textZh: 你们所怕的巴比伦王，你们不要惧怕他；你们不要惧怕他 ，因为我与你们同在，要拯救你们，要搭救你们脱离他的手。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们所怕的巴比伦王，你们不要惧怕他；你们不要惧怕他 ，因为我与你们同在，要拯救你们，要搭救你们脱离他的手。
verses.textZhCuv: 不要怕你们所怕的巴比伦王。』」耶和华说：「不要怕他！因为我与你们同在，要拯救你们脱离他的手。
verses.textEnNiv: Do not be afraid of the king of Babylon, whom you now fear. Do not be afraid of him, declares the Lord , for I am with you and will save you and deliver you from his hands.
verses.textEnEsv: Do not fear the king of Babylon, of whom you are afraid. Do not fear him, declares the Lord , for I am with you, to save you and to deliver you from his hand.
verses.textEnNkjv: Do not be afraid of the king of Babylon, of whom you are afraid; do not be afraid of him,’ says the Lord, ‘for I am with you, to save you and deliver you from his hand.
verses.textEnNlt: Do not fear the king of Babylon anymore,’ says the Lord . ‘For I am with you and will save you and rescue you from his power.
verses.textEnNasb: Do not be afraid of the king of Babylon, whom you are now fearing; do not be afraid of him,’ declares the Lord, ‘for I am with you to save you and rescue you from his hand.
verses.textEn: Do not be afraid of the king of Babylon, whom you now fear. Do not be afraid of him, declares the Lord , for I am with you and will save you and deliver you from his hands.

verses.textZh: 我要向你们施怜悯，他也会怜悯你们，使你们归回自己的土地。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要向你们施怜悯，他也会怜悯你们，使你们归回自己的土地。’
verses.textZhCuv: 我也要使他发怜悯，好怜悯你们，叫你们归回本地。
verses.textEnNiv: I will show you compassion so that he will have compassion on you and restore you to your land.’
verses.textEnEsv: I will grant you mercy, that he may have mercy on you and let you remain in your own land.
verses.textEnNkjv: And I will show you mercy, that he may have mercy on you and cause you to return to your own land.’
verses.textEnNlt: I will be merciful to you by making him kind, so he will let you stay here in your land.’
verses.textEnNasb: I will also show you compassion, so that he will have compassion on you and restore you to your own soil.
verses.textEn: I will show you compassion so that he will have compassion on you and restore you to your land.’

verses.textZh: 但是，你们若说：‘我们不住在这地’，不听从耶和华你们的神的话，
verses.textZhCnvs: 但是，你们若说：‘我们不住在这地’，不听从耶和华你们的神的话，
verses.textZhCuv: 倘若你们说：『我们不住在这地』，以致不听从耶和华－你们神的话，
verses.textEnNiv: "However, if you say, ‘We will not stay in this land,’ and so disobey the Lord your God,
verses.textEnEsv: But if you say, ‘We will not remain in this land,’ disobeying the voice of the Lord your God
verses.textEnNkjv: "But if you say, ‘We will not dwell in this land,’ disobeying the voice of the Lord your God,
verses.textEnNlt: "But if you refuse to obey the Lord your God, and if you say, ‘We will not stay here;
verses.textEnNasb: But if you are going to say, "We will not stay in this land," so as not to listen to the voice of the Lord your God,
verses.textEn: "However, if you say, ‘We will not stay in this land,’ and so disobey the Lord your God,

verses.textZh: 或说：‘不！我们要去埃及地，在那里看不到战争，听不见号角的声音，也不会因缺乏粮食而饥饿；我们要留在那里。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 或说：‘不！我们要去埃及地，在那里看不到战争，听不见号角的声音，也不会因缺乏粮食而饥饿；我们要留在那里。’
verses.textZhCuv: 说：『我们不住这地，却要进入埃及地，在那里看不见争战，听不见角声，也不致无食饥饿。我们必住在那里。』
verses.textEnNiv: and if you say, ‘No, we will go and live in Egypt, where we will not see war or hear the trumpet or be hungry for bread,’
verses.textEnEsv: and saying, ‘No, we will go to the land of Egypt, where we shall not see war or hear the sound of the trumpet or be hungry for bread, and we will dwell there,’
verses.textEnNkjv: saying, ‘No, but we will go to the land of Egypt where we shall see no war, nor hear the sound of the trumpet, nor be hungry for bread, and there we will dwell’—
verses.textEnNlt: instead, we will go to Egypt where we will be free from war, the call to arms, and hunger,’
verses.textEnNasb: saying, "No, but we will go to the land of Egypt, where we will not see war, or hear the sound of a trumpet, or hunger for bread, and we will stay there";
verses.textEn: and if you say, ‘No, we will go and live in Egypt, where we will not see war or hear the trumpet or be hungry for bread,’

verses.textZh: 这样，犹大余剩的人哪，你们现在要听耶和华的话！万军之耶和华以色列的神这样说：‘你们若决意去埃及，到那里寄居，
verses.textZhCnvs: 这样，犹大余剩的人哪，你们现在要听耶和华的话！万军之耶和华以色列的神这样说：‘你们若决意去埃及，到那里寄居，
verses.textZhCuv: 你们所剩下的犹大人哪，现在要听耶和华的话。万军之耶和华－以色列的神如此说：『你们若定意要进入埃及，在那里寄居，
verses.textEnNiv: then hear the word of the Lord , you remnant of Judah. This is what the Lord Almighty, the God of Israel, says: ‘If you are determined to go to Egypt and you do go to settle there,
verses.textEnEsv: then hear the word of the Lord , O remnant of Judah. Thus says the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel: If you set your faces to enter Egypt and go to live there,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then hear now the word of the Lord, O remnant of Judah! Thus says the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel: ‘If you wholly set your faces to enter Egypt, and go to dwell there,
verses.textEnNlt: then hear the Lord ’s message to the remnant of Judah. This is what the Lord of Heaven’s Armies, the God of Israel, says: ‘If you are determined to go to Egypt and live there,
verses.textEnNasb: then in that case listen to the word of the Lord, you remnant of Judah. This is what the Lord of armies, the God of Israel says: "If you really set your minds to enter Egypt and go in to reside there,
verses.textEn: then hear the word of the Lord , you remnant of Judah. This is what the Lord Almighty, the God of Israel, says: ‘If you are determined to go to Egypt and you do go to settle there,

verses.textZh: 你们惧怕的刀剑必在埃及地追上你们；你们恐惧的饥荒必在埃及紧随着你们；你们必死在那里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们惧怕的刀剑必在埃及地追上你们；你们恐惧的饥荒必在埃及紧随着你们；你们必死在那里。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们所惧怕的刀剑在埃及地必追上你们！你们所惧怕的饥荒在埃及要紧紧地跟随你们！你们必死在那里！
verses.textEnNiv: then the sword you fear will overtake you there, and the famine you dread will follow you into Egypt, and there you will die.
verses.textEnEsv: then the sword that you fear shall overtake you there in the land of Egypt, and the famine of which you are afraid shall follow close after you to Egypt, and there you shall die.
verses.textEnNkjv: then it shall be that the sword which you feared shall overtake you there in the land of Egypt; the famine of which you were afraid shall follow close after you there in Egypt; and there you shall die.
verses.textEnNlt: the very war and famine you fear will catch up to you, and you will die there.
verses.textEnNasb: then the sword, of which you are afraid, will overtake you there in the land of Egypt; and the famine, about which you are anxious, will follow closely after you there in Egypt, and you will die there.
verses.textEn: then the sword you fear will overtake you there, and the famine you dread will follow you into Egypt, and there you will die.

verses.textZh: 所有决意去埃及，在那里寄居的人，必因刀剑、饥荒和瘟疫而死；他们没有一人能幸存，或避过我降在他们身上的灾祸。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 所有决意去埃及，在那里寄居的人，必因刀剑、饥荒和瘟疫而死；他们没有一人能幸存，或避过我降在他们身上的灾祸。’
verses.textZhCuv: 凡定意要进入埃及在那里寄居的必遭刀剑、饥荒、瘟疫而死，无一人存留，逃脱我所降与他们的灾祸。』
verses.textEnNiv: Indeed, all who are determined to go to Egypt to settle there will die by the sword, famine and plague; not one of them will survive or escape the disaster I will bring on them.’
verses.textEnEsv: All the men who set their faces to go to Egypt to live there shall die by the sword, by famine, and by pestilence. They shall have no remnant or survivor from the disaster that I will bring upon them.
verses.textEnNkjv: So shall it be with all the men who set their faces to go to Egypt to dwell there. They shall die by the sword, by famine, and by pestilence. And none of them shall remain or escape from the disaster that I will bring upon them.’
verses.textEnNlt: That is the fate awaiting every one of you who insists on going to live in Egypt. Yes, you will die from war, famine, and disease. None of you will escape the disaster I will bring upon you there.’
verses.textEnNasb: So all the people who set their minds to go to Egypt to reside there will die by the sword, by famine, or by plague; and they will have no refugees or survivors from the disaster that I am going to bring on them." ’ "
verses.textEn: Indeed, all who are determined to go to Egypt to settle there will die by the sword, famine and plague; not one of them will survive or escape the disaster I will bring on them.’

verses.textZh: "因为万军之耶和华以色列的神这样说：‘我从前怎样把我的怒气和烈怒倾倒在耶路撒冷的居民身上，现在你们进入埃及的时候，我也必照样把我的烈怒倾倒在你们身上。你们就必成为令人惊骇、被人咒骂、咒诅和羞辱的对象。你们必不能再看见这地方。
verses.textZhCnvs: "因为万军之耶和华以色列的神这样说：‘我从前怎样把我的怒气和烈怒倾倒在耶路撒冷的居民身上，现在你们进入埃及的时候，我也必照样把我的烈怒倾倒在你们身上。你们就必成为令人惊骇、被人咒骂、咒诅和羞辱的对象。你们必不能再看见这地方。
verses.textZhCuv: 「万军之耶和华－以色列的神如此说：『我怎样将我的怒气和忿怒倾在耶路撒冷的居民身上，你们进入埃及的时候，我也必照样将我的忿怒倾在你们身上，以致你们令人辱骂、惊骇、咒诅、羞辱，你们不得再见这地方。』
verses.textEnNiv: This is what the Lord Almighty, the God of Israel, says: ‘As my anger and wrath have been poured out on those who lived in Jerusalem, so will my wrath be poured out on you when you go to Egypt. You will be a curse and an object of horror, a curse and an object of reproach; you will never see this place again.’
verses.textEnEsv: "For thus says the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel: As my anger and my wrath were poured out on the inhabitants of Jerusalem, so my wrath will be poured out on you when you go to Egypt. You shall become an execration, a horror, a curse, and a taunt. You shall see this place no more.
verses.textEnNkjv: "For thus says the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel: ‘As My anger and My fury have been poured out on the inhabitants of Jerusalem, so will My fury be poured out on you when you enter Egypt. And you shall be an oath, an astonishment, a curse, and a reproach; and you shall see this place no more.’
verses.textEnNlt: "This is what the Lord of Heaven’s Armies, the God of Israel, says: ‘Just as my anger and fury have been poured out on the people of Jerusalem, so they will be poured out on you when you enter Egypt. You will be an object of damnation, horror, cursing, and mockery. And you will never see your homeland again.’
verses.textEnNasb: For this is what the Lord of armies, the God of Israel says: "As My anger and wrath have gushed out on the inhabitants of Jerusalem, so My wrath will gush out on you when you enter Egypt. And you will become a curse, an object of horror, an imprecation, and a disgrace; and you will not see this place again."
verses.textEn: This is what the Lord Almighty, the God of Israel, says: ‘As my anger and wrath have been poured out on those who lived in Jerusalem, so will my wrath be poured out on you when you go to Egypt. You will be a curse and an object of horror, a curse and an object of reproach; you will never see this place again.’

verses.textZh: 犹大余剩的人哪，耶和华曾对你们说：‘你们不要去埃及。’你们要确实知道，我今天已经警告你们了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 犹大余剩的人哪，耶和华曾对你们说：‘你们不要去埃及。’你们要确实知道，我今天已经警告你们了。
verses.textZhCuv: 所剩下的犹大人哪，耶和华论到你们说：『不要进入埃及去。』你们要确实地知道我今日警教你们了。
verses.textEnNiv: "Remnant of Judah, the Lord has told you, ‘Do not go to Egypt.’ Be sure of this: I warn you today
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord has said to you, O remnant of Judah, ‘Do not go to Egypt.’ Know for a certainty that I have warned you this day
verses.textEnNkjv: "The Lord has said concerning you, O remnant of Judah, ‘Do not go to Egypt!’ Know certainly that I have admonished you this day.
verses.textEnNlt: "Listen, you remnant of Judah. The Lord has told you: ‘Do not go to Egypt!’ Don’t forget this warning I have given you today.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord has spoken to you, you remnant of Judah, "Do not go to Egypt!" You know for certain that I have admonished you today.
verses.textEn: "Remnant of Judah, the Lord has told you, ‘Do not go to Egypt.’ Be sure of this: I warn you today

verses.textZh: 你们实在自己欺骗自己，因为是你们委派我去见耶和华你们的神，你们说：‘请为我们向耶和华我们的神祷告；无论耶和华我们的神说甚么，你都要告诉我们，我们就必照着去作。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们实在自己欺骗自己，因为是你们委派我去见耶和华你们的神，你们说：‘请为我们向耶和华我们的神祷告；无论耶和华我们的神说甚么，你都要告诉我们，我们就必照着去作。’
verses.textZhCuv: 你们行诡诈自害；因为你们请我到耶和华－你们的神那里，说：『求你为我们祷告耶和华－我们神，照耶和华－我们的神一切所说的告诉我们，我们就必遵行。』
verses.textEnNiv: that you made a fatal mistake when you sent me to the Lord your God and said, ‘Pray to the Lord our God for us; tell us everything he says and we will do it.’
verses.textEnEsv: that you have gone astray at the cost of your lives. For you sent me to the Lord your God, saying, ‘Pray for us to the Lord our God, and whatever the Lord our God says, declare to us and we will do it.’
verses.textEnNkjv: For you were hypocrites in your hearts when you sent me to the Lord your God, saying, ‘Pray for us to the Lord our God, and according to all that the Lord your God says, so declare to us and we will do it.’
verses.textEnNlt: For you were not being honest when you sent me to pray to the Lord your God for you. You said, ‘Just tell us what the Lord our God says, and we will do it!’
verses.textEnNasb: For you have only deceived yourselves; for it is you who sent me to the Lord your God, saying, "Pray for us to the Lord our God; and whatever the Lord our God says, tell us so, and we will do it."
verses.textEn: that you made a fatal mistake when you sent me to the Lord your God and said, ‘Pray to the Lord our God for us; tell us everything he says and we will do it.’

verses.textZh: 我今天告诉了你们，你们却不听从耶和华你们的神派我来告诉你们的一切话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我今天告诉了你们，你们却不听从耶和华你们的神派我来告诉你们的一切话。
verses.textZhCuv: 我今日将这话告诉你们，耶和华－你们的神为你们的事差遣我到你们那里说的，你们却一样没有听从。
verses.textEnNiv: I have told you today, but you still have not obeyed the Lord your God in all he sent me to tell you.
verses.textEnEsv: And I have this day declared it to you, but you have not obeyed the voice of the Lord your God in anything that he sent me to tell you.
verses.textEnNkjv: And I have this day declared it to you, but you have not obeyed the voice of the Lord your God, or anything which He has sent you by me.
verses.textEnNlt: And today I have told you exactly what he said, but you will not obey the Lord your God any better now than you have in the past.
verses.textEnNasb: So I have told you today, but you have not obeyed the Lord your God in whatever He has sent me to tell you.
verses.textEn: I have told you today, but you still have not obeyed the Lord your God in all he sent me to tell you.

verses.textZh: 现在你们要确实知道，在你们想去寄居的那地方，你们必因刀剑、饥荒和瘟疫而死。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在你们要确实知道，在你们想去寄居的那地方，你们必因刀剑、饥荒和瘟疫而死。"
verses.textZhCuv: 现在你们要确实地知道，你们在所要去寄居之地必遭刀剑、饥荒、瘟疫而死。」
verses.textEnNiv: So now, be sure of this: You will die by the sword, famine and plague in the place where you want to go to settle."
verses.textEnEsv: Now therefore know for a certainty that you shall die by the sword, by famine, and by pestilence in the place where you desire to go to live."
verses.textEnNkjv: Now therefore, know certainly that you shall die by the sword, by famine, and by pestilence in the place where you desire to go to dwell."
verses.textEnNlt: So you can be sure that you will die from war, famine, and disease in Egypt, where you insist on going."
verses.textEnNasb: And now you shall know for certain that you will die by the sword, by famine, or by plague in the place where you desire to go to reside.
verses.textEn: So now, be sure of this: You will die by the sword, famine and plague in the place where you want to go to settle."

verses.textZh: 耶利米向众民说完了耶和华他们的神吩咐他的一切话，就是耶和华他们的神差遣他去对他们说的一切话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶利米向众民说完了耶和华他们的神吩咐他的一切话，就是耶和华他们的神差遣他去对他们说的一切话。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶利米向众百姓说完了耶和华－他们神的一切话，就是耶和华－他们神差遣他去所说的一切话。
verses.textEnNiv: When Jeremiah had finished telling the people all the words of the Lord their God—everything the Lord had sent him to tell them—
verses.textEnEsv: When Jeremiah finished speaking to all the people all these words of the Lord their God, with which the Lord their God had sent him to them,
verses.textEnNkjv: Now it happened, when Jeremiah had stopped speaking to all the people all the words of the Lord their God, for which the Lord their God had sent him to them, all these words,
verses.textEnNlt: When Jeremiah had finished giving this message from the Lord their God to all the people,
verses.textEnNasb: But as soon as Jeremiah, whom the Lord their God had sent to them, had finished telling all the people all the words of the Lord their God—that is, all these words—
verses.textEn: When Jeremiah had finished telling the people all the words of the Lord their God—everything the Lord had sent him to tell them—

verses.textZh: 何沙雅的儿子亚撒利雅，和加利亚的儿子约哈难，以及所有狂傲的人，就对耶利米说："你在说谎！耶和华我们的神并没有差遣你来说：‘你们不可去埃及，在那里寄居。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 何沙雅的儿子亚撒利雅，和加利亚的儿子约哈难，以及所有狂傲的人，就对耶利米说："你在说谎！耶和华我们的神并没有差遣你来说：‘你们不可去埃及，在那里寄居。’
verses.textZhCuv: 何沙雅的儿子亚撒利雅和加利亚的儿子约哈难，并一切狂傲的人，就对耶利米说：「你说谎言！耶和华－我们的神并没有差遣你来说：『你们不可进入埃及，在那里寄居。』
verses.textEnNiv: Azariah son of Hoshaiah and Johanan son of Kareah and all the arrogant men said to Jeremiah, "You are lying! The Lord our God has not sent you to say, ‘You must not go to Egypt to settle there.’
verses.textEnEsv: Azariah the son of Hoshaiah and Johanan the son of Kareah and all the insolent men said to Jeremiah, "You are telling a lie. The Lord our God did not send you to say, ‘Do not go to Egypt to live there,’
verses.textEnNkjv: that Azariah the son of Hoshaiah, Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the proud men spoke, saying to Jeremiah, "You speak falsely! The Lord our God has not sent you to say, ‘Do not go to Egypt to dwell there.’
verses.textEnNlt: Azariah son of Hoshaiah and Johanan son of Kareah and all the other proud men said to Jeremiah, "You lie! The Lord our God hasn’t forbidden us to go to Egypt!
verses.textEnNasb: Azariah the son of Hoshaiah, Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the arrogant men said to Jeremiah, "You are telling a lie! The Lord our God has not sent you to say, ‘You are not to enter Egypt to reside there’;
verses.textEn: Azariah son of Hoshaiah and Johanan son of Kareah and all the arrogant men said to Jeremiah, "You are lying! The Lord our God has not sent you to say, ‘You must not go to Egypt to settle there.’

verses.textZh: 只是尼利亚的儿子巴录怂恿你来反对我们，为要把我们交在迦勒底人的手中，好使我们被杀害，或被掳到巴比伦去。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 只是尼利亚的儿子巴录怂恿你来反对我们，为要把我们交在迦勒底人的手中，好使我们被杀害，或被掳到巴比伦去。"
verses.textZhCuv: 这是尼利亚的儿子巴录挑唆你害我们，要将我们交在迦勒底人的手中，使我们有被杀的，有被掳到巴比伦去的。」
verses.textEnNiv: But Baruch son of Neriah is inciting you against us to hand us over to the Babylonians, so they may kill us or carry us into exile to Babylon."
verses.textEnEsv: but Baruch the son of Neriah has set you against us, to deliver us into the hand of the Chaldeans, that they may kill us or take us into exile in Babylon."
verses.textEnNkjv: But Baruch the son of Neriah has set you against us, to deliver us into the hand of the Chaldeans, that they may put us to death or carry us away captive to Babylon."
verses.textEnNlt: Baruch son of Neriah has convinced you to say this, because he wants us to stay here and be killed by the Babylonians or be carried off into exile."
verses.textEnNasb: but Baruch the son of Neriah is inciting you against us in order to hand us over to the Chaldeans, so they will put us to death or exile us to Babylon!"
verses.textEn: But Baruch son of Neriah is inciting you against us to hand us over to the Babylonians, so they may kill us or carry us into exile to Babylon."

verses.textZh: 于是加利亚的儿子约哈难和众将领，以及众民，都不听从耶和华要他们留在犹大地的命令。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是加利亚的儿子约哈难和众将领，以及众民，都不听从耶和华要他们留在犹大地的命令。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是加利亚的儿子约哈难和一切军长，并众百姓，不听从耶和华的话住在犹大地。
verses.textEnNiv: So Johanan son of Kareah and all the army officers and all the people disobeyed the Lord ’s command to stay in the land of Judah.
verses.textEnEsv: So Johanan the son of Kareah and all the commanders of the forces and all the people did not obey the voice of the Lord , to remain in the land of Judah.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Johanan the son of Kareah, all the captains of the forces, and all the people would not obey the voice of the Lord, to remain in the land of Judah.
verses.textEnNlt: So Johanan and the other military leaders and all the people refused to obey the Lord ’s command to stay in Judah.
verses.textEnNasb: So Johanan the son of Kareah and all the commanders of the forces, and all the people, did not obey the voice of the Lord to stay in the land of Judah.
verses.textEn: So Johanan son of Kareah and all the army officers and all the people disobeyed the Lord ’s command to stay in the land of Judah.

verses.textZh: 相反地，加利亚的儿子约哈难和众将领却率领犹大所有余剩的人，就是那些从被赶逐到各国回来住在犹大地的，
verses.textZhCnvs: 相反地，加利亚的儿子约哈难和众将领却率领犹大所有余剩的人，就是那些从被赶逐到各国回来住在犹大地的，
verses.textZhCuv: 都带入埃及地，到了答比匿。这是因他们不听从耶和华的话。
verses.textEnNiv: Instead, Johanan son of Kareah and all the army officers led away all the remnant of Judah who had come back to live in the land of Judah from all the nations where they had been scattered.
verses.textEnEsv: But Johanan the son of Kareah and all the commanders of the forces took all the remnant of Judah who had returned to live in the land of Judah from all the nations to which they had been driven—
verses.textEnNkjv: But Johanan the son of Kareah and all the captains of the forces took all the remnant of Judah who had returned to dwell in the land of Judah, from all nations where they had been driven—
verses.textEnNlt: Johanan and the other leaders took with them all the people who had returned from the nearby countries to which they had fled.
verses.textEnNasb: Instead, Johanan the son of Kareah and all the commanders of the forces took the entire remnant of Judah who had returned from all the nations to which they had been scattered, in order to reside in the land of Judah—
verses.textEn: Instead, Johanan son of Kareah and all the army officers led away all the remnant of Judah who had come back to live in the land of Judah from all the nations where they had been scattered.

verses.textZh: 包括男人、女人、孩童和王的众公主，以及护卫长尼布撒拉旦留给沙番的孙子、亚希甘的儿子基大利管理的众人，还有耶利米先知和尼利亚的儿子巴录，
verses.textZhCnvs: 包括男人、女人、孩童和王的众公主，以及护卫长尼布撒拉旦留给沙番的孙子、亚希甘的儿子基大利管理的众人，还有耶利米先知和尼利亚的儿子巴录，
verses.textZhCuv: 在答比匿，耶和华的话临到耶利米说：
verses.textEnNiv: They also led away all those whom Nebuzaradan commander of the imperial guard had left with Gedaliah son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan—the men, the women, the children and the king’s daughters. And they took Jeremiah the prophet and Baruch son of Neriah along with them.
verses.textEnEsv: the men, the women, the children, the princesses, and every person whom Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard had left with Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, son of Shaphan; also Jeremiah the prophet and Baruch the son of Neriah.
verses.textEnNkjv: men, women, children, the king’s daughters, and every person whom Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard had left with Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan, and Jeremiah the prophet and Baruch the son of Neriah.
verses.textEnNlt: In the crowd were men, women, and children, the king’s daughters, and all those whom Nebuzaradan, the captain of the guard, had left with Gedaliah. The prophet Jeremiah and Baruch were also included.
verses.textEnNasb: the men, the women, the children, the king’s daughters, and every person whom Nebuzaradan the captain of the bodyguard had left with Gedaliah the son of Ahikam and grandson of Shaphan, together with Jeremiah the prophet and Baruch the son of Neriah—
verses.textEn: They also led away all those whom Nebuzaradan commander of the imperial guard had left with Gedaliah son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan—the men, the women, the children and the king’s daughters. And they took Jeremiah the prophet and Baruch son of Neriah along with them.

verses.textZh: 把他们都带进埃及地，去到答比匿，没有听从耶和华的话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 把他们都带进埃及地，去到答比匿，没有听从耶和华的话。
verses.textZhCuv: 「你在犹大人眼前要用手拿几块大石头，藏在砌砖的灰泥中，就是在答比匿法老的宫门那里，
verses.textEnNiv: So they entered Egypt in disobedience to the Lord and went as far as Tahpanhes.
verses.textEnEsv: And they came into the land of Egypt, for they did not obey the voice of the Lord . And they arrived at Tahpanhes.
verses.textEnNkjv: So they went to the land of Egypt, for they did not obey the voice of the Lord. And they went as far as Tahpanhes.
verses.textEnNlt: The people refused to obey the voice of the Lord and went to Egypt, going as far as the city of Tahpanhes.
verses.textEnNasb: and they entered the land of Egypt (for they did not obey the voice of the Lord) and went in as far as Tahpanhes.
verses.textEn: So they entered Egypt in disobedience to the Lord and went as far as Tahpanhes.

verses.textZh: 在答比匿耶和华的话临到耶利米，说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 在答比匿耶和华的话临到耶利米，说：
verses.textZhCuv: 对他们说：『万军之耶和华－以色列的神如此说：我必召我的仆人巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒来。在所藏的石头上我要安置他的宝座；他必将光华的宝帐支搭在其上。
verses.textEnNiv: In Tahpanhes the word of the Lord came to Jeremiah:
verses.textEnEsv: Then the word of the Lord came to Jeremiah in Tahpanhes:
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the word of the Lord came to Jeremiah in Tahpanhes, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: Then at Tahpanhes, the Lord gave another message to Jeremiah. He said,
verses.textEnNasb: Then the word of the Lord came to Jeremiah in Tahpanhes, saying,
verses.textEn: In Tahpanhes the word of the Lord came to Jeremiah:

verses.textZh: "你要在犹大人眼前亲手拿几块大石头，埋藏在答比匿法老宫殿门前砖窑的灰泥中；
verses.textZhCnvs: "你要在犹大人眼前亲手拿几块大石头，埋藏在答比匿法老宫殿门前砖窑的灰泥中；
verses.textZhCuv: 他要来攻击埃及地，定为死亡的，必致死亡；定为掳掠的，必被掳掠；定为刀杀的，必交刀杀。
verses.textEnNiv: "While the Jews are watching, take some large stones with you and bury them in clay in the brick pavement at the entrance to Pharaoh’s palace in Tahpanhes.
verses.textEnEsv: "Take in your hands large stones and hide them in the mortar in the pavement that is at the entrance to Pharaoh’s palace in Tahpanhes, in the sight of the men of Judah,
verses.textEnNkjv: "Take large stones in your hand, and hide them in the sight of the men of Judah, in the clay in the brick courtyard which is at the entrance to Pharaoh’s house in Tahpanhes;
verses.textEnNlt: "While the people of Judah are watching, take some large rocks and bury them under the pavement stones at the entrance of Pharaoh’s palace here in Tahpanhes.
verses.textEnNasb: "Take some large stones in your hands and hide them in the mortar in the brick terrace which is at the entrance of Pharaoh’s palace in Tahpanhes, in the sight of some of the Jews;
verses.textEn: "While the Jews are watching, take some large stones with you and bury them in clay in the brick pavement at the entrance to Pharaoh’s palace in Tahpanhes.

verses.textZh: 然后对他们说：‘万军之耶和华以色列的神这样说：看哪！我要派人去领我的仆人巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒来；我要在我所埋藏的这些石头上安设他的王位；他必在上面张开他的帐篷。
verses.textZhCnvs: 然后对他们说：‘万军之耶和华以色列的神这样说：看哪！我要派人去领我的仆人巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒来；我要在我所埋藏的这些石头上安设他的王位；他必在上面张开他的帐篷。
verses.textZhCuv: 我要在埃及神的庙中使火着起，巴比伦王要将庙宇焚烧，神像掳去；他要得 埃及地，好像牧人披上外衣，从那里安然而去。
verses.textEnNiv: Then say to them, ‘This is what the Lord Almighty, the God of Israel, says: I will send for my servant Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and I will set his throne over these stones I have buried here; he will spread his royal canopy above them.
verses.textEnEsv: and say to them, ‘Thus says the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel: Behold, I will send and take Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon, my servant, and I will set his throne above these stones that I have hidden, and he will spread his royal canopy over them.
verses.textEnNkjv: and say to them, ‘Thus says the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel: "Behold, I will send and bring Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon, My servant, and will set his throne above these stones that I have hidden. And he will spread his royal pavilion over them.
verses.textEnNlt: Then say to the people of Judah, ‘This is what the Lord of Heaven’s Armies, the God of Israel, says: I will certainly bring my servant Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon, here to Egypt. I will set his throne over these stones that I have hidden. He will spread his royal canopy over them.
verses.textEnNasb: and say to them, ‘This is what the Lord of armies, the God of Israel says: "Behold, I am going to send men and get My servant Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon, and I am going to set his throne over these stones that I have hidden; and he will spread his canopy over them.
verses.textEn: Then say to them, ‘This is what the Lord Almighty, the God of Israel, says: I will send for my servant Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and I will set his throne over these stones I have buried here; he will spread his royal canopy above them.

verses.textZh: 他必来攻打埃及地；那些注定死亡的，必要死亡；那些注定被掳的，必要被掳；那些注定被刀杀的，必被刀杀。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他必来攻打埃及地；那些注定死亡的，必要死亡；那些注定被掳的，必要被掳；那些注定被刀杀的，必被刀杀。
verses.textZhCuv: 他必打碎埃及地伯‧示麦的柱像，用火焚烧埃及神的庙宇。』」
verses.textEnNiv: He will come and attack Egypt, bringing death to those destined for death, captivity to those destined for captivity, and the sword to those destined for the sword.
verses.textEnEsv: He shall come and strike the land of Egypt, giving over to the pestilence those who are doomed to the pestilence, to captivity those who are doomed to captivity, and to the sword those who are doomed to the sword.
verses.textEnNkjv: When he comes, he shall strike the land of Egypt anddeliver to death thoseappointed for death, and to captivity thoseappointed for captivity, and to the sword thoseappointed for the sword.
verses.textEnNlt: And when he comes, he will destroy the land of Egypt. He will bring death to those destined for death, captivity to those destined for captivity, and war to those destined for war.
verses.textEnNasb: He will also come and strike the land of Egypt; those who are meant for death will be given over to death, and those for captivity to captivity, and those for the sword to the sword.
verses.textEn: He will come and attack Egypt, bringing death to those destined for death, captivity to those destined for captivity, and the sword to those destined for the sword.

verses.textZh: 他 必焚烧埃及的神庙，把它们烧毁，并且掳掠；他必得着埃及地，好象牧人披上衣服那么容易；他必安然离开那里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他 必焚烧埃及的神庙，把它们烧毁，并且掳掠；他必得着埃及地，好象牧人披上衣服那么容易；他必安然离开那里。
verses.textZhCuv: 他 必焚烧埃及的神庙，把它们烧毁，并且掳掠；他必得着埃及地，好象牧人披上衣服那么容易；他必安然离开那里。
verses.textEnNiv: He will set fire to the temples of the gods of Egypt; he will burn their temples and take their gods captive. As a shepherd picks his garment clean of lice, so he will pick Egypt clean and depart.
verses.textEnEsv: I shall kindle a fire in the temples of the gods of Egypt, and he shall burn them and carry them away captive. And he shall clean the land of Egypt as a shepherd cleans his cloak of vermin, and he shall go away from there in peace.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will kindle a fire in the houses of the gods of Egypt, and he shall burn them and carry them away captive. And he shall array himself with the land of Egypt, as a shepherd puts on his garment, and he shall go out from there in peace.
verses.textEnNlt: He will set fire to the temples of Egypt’s gods; he will burn the temples and carry the idols away as plunder. He will pick clean the land of Egypt as a shepherd picks fleas from his cloak. And he himself will leave unharmed.
verses.textEnNasb: And I shall set fire to the temples of the gods of Egypt, and he will burn them and take them captive. So he will wrap himself with the land of Egypt as a shepherd wraps himself with his garment, and he will depart from there safely.
verses.textEn: He will set fire to the temples of the gods of Egypt; he will burn their temples and take their gods captive. As a shepherd picks his garment clean of lice, so he will pick Egypt clean and depart.

verses.textZh: 他必打碎埃及地伯．示麦 的神柱，放火烧毁埃及神庙。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他必打碎埃及地伯．示麦 的神柱，放火烧毁埃及神庙。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 他必打碎埃及地伯．示麦 的神柱，放火烧毁埃及神庙。’"
verses.textEnNiv: There in the temple of the sun in Egypt he will demolish the sacred pillars and will burn down the temples of the gods of Egypt.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: He shall break the obelisks of Heliopolis, which is in the land of Egypt, and the temples of the gods of Egypt he shall burn with fire.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: He shall also break the sacred pillars of Beth Shemesh that are in the land of Egypt; and the houses of the gods of the Egyptians he shall burn with fire." ’ "
verses.textEnNlt: He will break down the sacred pillars standing in the temple of the sun in Egypt, and he will burn down the temples of Egypt’s gods.’"
verses.textEnNasb: He will also smash to pieces the obelisks of Heliopolis, which is in the land of Egypt; and the temples of the gods of Egypt he will burn with fire." ’ "
verses.textEn: There in the temple of the sun in Egypt he will demolish the sacred pillars and will burn down the temples of the gods of Egypt.’ "

verses.textZh: 以下的话临到耶利米，论到所有住在埃及地的犹大人，就是那些住在密夺、答比匿、挪弗和巴忒罗地的人，说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 以下的话临到耶利米，论到所有住在埃及地的犹大人，就是那些住在密夺、答比匿、挪弗和巴忒罗地的人，说：
verses.textZhCuv: 有临到耶利米的话，论及一切住在埃及地的犹大人，就是住在密夺、答比匿、挪弗、巴忒罗境内的犹大人，说：
verses.textEnNiv: This word came to Jeremiah concerning all the Jews living in Lower Egypt—in Migdol, Tahpanhes and Memphis—and in Upper Egypt:
verses.textEnEsv: The word that came to Jeremiah concerning all the Judeans who lived in the land of Egypt, at Migdol, at Tahpanhes, at Memphis, and in the land of Pathros,
verses.textEnNkjv: The word that came to Jeremiah concerning all the Jews who dwell in the land of Egypt, who dwell at Migdol, at Tahpanhes, at Noph, and in the country of Pathros, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: This is the message Jeremiah received concerning the Judeans living in northern Egypt in the cities of Migdol, Tahpanhes, and Memphis, and in southern Egypt as well:
verses.textEnNasb: The word that came to Jeremiah for all the Jews living in the land of Egypt, those who were living in Migdol, Tahpanhes, Memphis, and the land of Pathros, saying,
verses.textEn: This word came to Jeremiah concerning all the Jews living in Lower Egypt—in Migdol, Tahpanhes and Memphis—and in Upper Egypt:

verses.textZh: "万军之耶和华以色列的神这样说：‘你们都亲眼看见我降在耶路撒冷和犹大各城的一切灾祸。看哪！那些城镇今天仍然荒凉，没有人居住，
verses.textZhCnvs: "万军之耶和华以色列的神这样说：‘你们都亲眼看见我降在耶路撒冷和犹大各城的一切灾祸。看哪！那些城镇今天仍然荒凉，没有人居住，
verses.textZhCuv: 「万军之耶和华－以色列的神如此说：我所降与耶路撒冷和犹大各城的一切灾祸你们都看见了。那些城邑今日荒凉，无人居住；
verses.textEnNiv: "This is what the Lord Almighty, the God of Israel, says: You saw the great disaster I brought on Jerusalem and on all the towns of Judah. Today they lie deserted and in ruins
verses.textEnEsv: "Thus says the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel: You have seen all the disaster that I brought upon Jerusalem and upon all the cities of Judah. Behold, this day they are a desolation, and no one dwells in them,
verses.textEnNkjv: "Thus says the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel: ‘You have seen all the calamity that I have brought on Jerusalem and on all the cities of Judah; and behold, this day they are a desolation, and no one dwells in them,
verses.textEnNlt: "This is what the Lord of Heaven’s Armies, the God of Israel, says: You saw the calamity I brought on Jerusalem and all the towns of Judah. They now lie deserted and in ruins.
verses.textEnNasb: "This is what the Lord of armies, the God of Israel says: ‘You yourselves have seen all the disaster that I have brought on Jerusalem and all the cities of Judah; and behold, this day they are in ruins and no one lives in them,
verses.textEn: "This is what the Lord Almighty, the God of Israel, says: You saw the great disaster I brought on Jerusalem and on all the towns of Judah. Today they lie deserted and in ruins

verses.textZh: 这是因为他们所行的恶事的缘故；他们向别神烧香，事奉它们，惹我发怒。这些神是他们和你们，以及你们的列祖所不认识的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这是因为他们所行的恶事的缘故；他们向别神烧香，事奉它们，惹我发怒。这些神是他们和你们，以及你们的列祖所不认识的。
verses.textZhCuv: 这是因居民所行的恶，去烧香事奉别神，就是他们和你们，并你们列祖所不认识的神，惹我发怒。
verses.textEnNiv: because of the evil they have done. They aroused my anger by burning incense to and worshiping other gods that neither they nor you nor your ancestors ever knew.
verses.textEnEsv: because of the evil that they committed, provoking me to anger, in that they went to make offerings and serve other gods that they knew not, neither they, nor you, nor your fathers.
verses.textEnNkjv: because of their wickedness which they have committed to provoke Me to anger, in that they went to burn incense and to serve other gods whom they did not know, they nor you nor your fathers.
verses.textEnNlt: They provoked my anger with all their wickedness. They burned incense and worshiped other gods—gods that neither they nor you nor any of your ancestors had ever even known.
verses.textEnNasb: because of their wickedness which they committed to provoke Me to anger by continuing to burn sacrifices and to serve other gods whom they had not known, neither they, you, nor your fathers.
verses.textEn: because of the evil they have done. They aroused my anger by burning incense to and worshiping other gods that neither they nor you nor your ancestors ever knew.

verses.textZh: 虽然我不断差遣我的仆人众先知到你们那里去，说：你们千万不可行我所恨恶，这可憎的事！
verses.textZhCnvs: 虽然我不断差遣我的仆人众先知到你们那里去，说：你们千万不可行我所恨恶，这可憎的事！
verses.textZhCuv: 我从早起来差遣我的仆人众先知去说，你们切不要行我所厌恶这可憎之事。
verses.textEnNiv: Again and again I sent my servants the prophets, who said, ‘Do not do this detestable thing that I hate!’
verses.textEnEsv: Yet I persistently sent to you all my servants the prophets, saying, ‘Oh, do not do this abomination that I hate!’
verses.textEnNkjv: However I have sent to you all My servants the prophets, rising early and sending them, saying, "Oh, do not do this abominable thing that I hate!"
verses.textEnNlt: "Again and again I sent my servants, the prophets, to plead with them, ‘Don’t do these horrible things that I hate so much.’
verses.textEnNasb: Yet I sent you all My servants the prophets again and again, saying, "Oh, do not do this abominable thing which I hate."
verses.textEn: Again and again I sent my servants the prophets, who said, ‘Do not do this detestable thing that I hate!’

verses.textZh: 他们却不听从，毫不留心，不肯离开他们的恶行，仍向别神烧香。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们却不听从，毫不留心，不肯离开他们的恶行，仍向别神烧香。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们却不听从，不侧耳而听，不转离恶事，仍向别神烧香。
verses.textEnNiv: But they did not listen or pay attention; they did not turn from their wickedness or stop burning incense to other gods.
verses.textEnEsv: But they did not listen or incline their ear, to turn from their evil and make no offerings to other gods.
verses.textEnNkjv: But they did not listen or incline their ear to turn from their wickedness, to burn no incense to other gods.
verses.textEnNlt: But my people would not listen or turn back from their wicked ways. They kept on burning incense to these gods.
verses.textEnNasb: But they did not listen or incline their ears to turn from their wickedness, so as not to burn sacrifices to other gods.
verses.textEn: But they did not listen or pay attention; they did not turn from their wickedness or stop burning incense to other gods.

verses.textZh: 因此，我必倾出我的烈怒和怒气，在犹大的各城镇和耶路撒冷的街上烧起，以致它们都荒凉废弃，像今天一样。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，我必倾出我的烈怒和怒气，在犹大的各城镇和耶路撒冷的街上烧起，以致它们都荒凉废弃，像今天一样。’
verses.textZhCuv: 因此，我的怒气和忿怒都倒出来，在犹大城邑中和耶路撒冷的街市上，如火着起，以致都荒废凄凉，正如今日一样。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore, my fierce anger was poured out; it raged against the towns of Judah and the streets of Jerusalem and made them the desolate ruins they are today.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore my wrath and my anger were poured out and kindled in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem, and they became a waste and a desolation, as at this day.
verses.textEnNkjv: So My fury and My anger were poured out and kindled in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem; and they are wasted and desolate, as it is this day.’
verses.textEnNlt: And so my fury boiled over and fell like fire on the towns of Judah and into the streets of Jerusalem, and they are still a desolate ruin today.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore My wrath and My anger gushed out and burned in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem, so they have become ruins and a desolation as it is this day.
verses.textEn: Therefore, my fierce anger was poured out; it raged against the towns of Judah and the streets of Jerusalem and made them the desolate ruins they are today.

verses.textZh: 现在，耶和华万军的神以色列的神这样说：‘你们为甚么自己招来这样的大灾祸，使你们的男人、女人、孩童和婴儿都从犹大中除灭，一个余剩的人也不留下呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在，耶和华万军的神以色列的神这样说：‘你们为甚么自己招来这样的大灾祸，使你们的男人、女人、孩童和婴儿都从犹大中除灭，一个余剩的人也不留下呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 现在耶和华－万军之神、以色列的神如此说：你们为何作这大恶自害己命，使你们的男人、妇女、婴孩，和吃奶的都从犹大中剪除、不留一人呢？
verses.textEnNiv: "Now this is what the Lord God Almighty, the God of Israel, says: Why bring such great disaster on yourselves by cutting off from Judah the men and women, the children and infants, and so leave yourselves without a remnant?
verses.textEnEsv: And now thus says the Lord God of hosts, the God of Israel: Why do you commit this great evil against yourselves, to cut off from you man and woman, infant and child, from the midst of Judah, leaving you no remnant?
verses.textEnNkjv: "Now therefore, thus says the Lord, the God of hosts, the God of Israel: ‘Why do you commit this great evil against yourselves, to cut off from you man and woman, child and infant, out of Judah, leaving none to remain,
verses.textEnNlt: "And now the Lord God of Heaven’s Armies, the God of Israel, asks you: Why are you destroying yourselves? For not one of you will survive—not a man, woman, or child among you who has come here from Judah, not even the babies in your arms.
verses.textEnNasb: Now then, this is what the Lord God of armies, the God of Israel says: "Why are you doing great harm to yourselves, to eliminate from yourselves man and woman, child and infant from among Judah, leaving yourselves without a remnant,
verses.textEn: "Now this is what the Lord God Almighty, the God of Israel, says: Why bring such great disaster on yourselves by cutting off from Judah the men and women, the children and infants, and so leave yourselves without a remnant?

verses.textZh: 为甚么因你们手所作的，在你们来寄居的埃及地向别神烧香，惹我发怒，以致你们被除灭，成为地上万国咒诅和羞辱的对象呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 为甚么因你们手所作的，在你们来寄居的埃及地向别神烧香，惹我发怒，以致你们被除灭，成为地上万国咒诅和羞辱的对象呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 就是因你们手所做的，在所去寄居的埃及地向别神烧香惹我发怒，使你们被剪除，在天下万国中令人咒诅羞辱。
verses.textEnNiv: Why arouse my anger with what your hands have made, burning incense to other gods in Egypt, where you have come to live? You will destroy yourselves and make yourselves a curse and an object of reproach among all the nations on earth.
verses.textEnEsv: Why do you provoke me to anger with the works of your hands, making offerings to other gods in the land of Egypt where you have come to live, so that you may be cut off and become a curse and a taunt among all the nations of the earth?
verses.textEnNkjv: in that you provoke Me to wrath with the works of your hands, burning incense to other gods in the land of Egypt where you have gone to dwell, that you may cut yourselves off and be a curse and a reproach among all the nations of the earth?
verses.textEnNlt: Why provoke my anger by burning incense to the idols you have made here in Egypt? You will only destroy yourselves and make yourselves an object of cursing and mockery for all the nations of the earth.
verses.textEnNasb: provoking Me to anger with the works of your hands, burning sacrifices to other gods in the land of Egypt where you are entering to reside, so that you may be eliminated and become a curse and a disgrace among all the nations of the earth?
verses.textEn: Why arouse my anger with what your hands have made, burning incense to other gods in Egypt, where you have come to live? You will destroy yourselves and make yourselves a curse and an object of reproach among all the nations on earth.

verses.textZh: 你们列祖的恶行、犹大列王的恶行、他们妻子的恶行、你们自己的恶行和你们妻子的恶行，就是在犹大地和耶路撒冷街上所行的，你们忘记了吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们列祖的恶行、犹大列王的恶行、他们妻子的恶行、你们自己的恶行和你们妻子的恶行，就是在犹大地和耶路撒冷街上所行的，你们忘记了吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 你们列祖的恶行，犹大列王和他们后妃的恶行，你们自己和你们妻子的恶行，就是在犹大地、耶路撒冷街上所行的，你们都忘了吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Have you forgotten the wickedness committed by your ancestors and by the kings and queens of Judah and the wickedness committed by you and your wives in the land of Judah and the streets of Jerusalem?
verses.textEnEsv: Have you forgotten the evil of your fathers, the evil of the kings of Judah, the evil of their wives, your own evil, and the evil of your wives, which they committed in the land of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem?
verses.textEnNkjv: Have you forgotten the wickedness of your fathers, the wickedness of the kings of Judah, the wickedness of their wives, your own wickedness, and the wickedness of your wives, which they committed in the land of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem?
verses.textEnNlt: Have you forgotten the sins of your ancestors, the sins of the kings and queens of Judah, and the sins you and your wives committed in Judah and Jerusalem?
verses.textEnNasb: Have you forgotten the wickedness of your fathers, the wickedness of the kings of Judah and the wickedness of their wives, your own wickedness and the wickedness of your wives, which they committed in the land of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem?
verses.textEn: Have you forgotten the wickedness committed by your ancestors and by the kings and queens of Judah and the wickedness committed by you and your wives in the land of Judah and the streets of Jerusalem?

verses.textZh: 直到今日，他们还没有痛悔，没有畏惧，也没有遵行我在你们和你们列祖面前所立的律法和条例。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 直到今日，他们还没有痛悔，没有畏惧，也没有遵行我在你们和你们列祖面前所立的律法和条例。’
verses.textZhCuv: 到如今还没有懊悔，没有惧怕，没有遵行我在你们和你们列祖面前所设立的法度律例。
verses.textEnNiv: To this day they have not humbled themselves or shown reverence, nor have they followed my law and the decrees I set before you and your ancestors.
verses.textEnEsv: They have not humbled themselves even to this day, nor have they feared, nor walked in my law and my statutes that I set before you and before your fathers.
verses.textEnNkjv: They have not been humbled, to this day, nor have they feared; they have not walked in My law or in My statutes that I set before you and your fathers.’
verses.textEnNlt: To this very hour you have shown no remorse or reverence. No one has chosen to follow my word and the decrees I gave to you and your ancestors before you.
verses.textEnNasb: Yet they have not become contrite even to this day, nor have they feared, nor walked in My Law or My statutes, which I placed before you and before your fathers." ’
verses.textEn: To this day they have not humbled themselves or shown reverence, nor have they followed my law and the decrees I set before you and your ancestors.

verses.textZh: "因此万军之耶和华以色列的神这样说：‘看哪！我决意向你们降下灾祸，把全犹大都除灭。
verses.textZhCnvs: "因此万军之耶和华以色列的神这样说：‘看哪！我决意向你们降下灾祸，把全犹大都除灭。
verses.textZhCuv: 「所以万军之耶和华－以色列的神如此说：我必向你们变脸降灾，以致剪除犹大众人。
verses.textEnNiv: "Therefore this is what the Lord Almighty, the God of Israel, says: I am determined to bring disaster on you and to destroy all Judah.
verses.textEnEsv: "Therefore thus says the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel: Behold, I will set my face against you for harm, to cut off all Judah.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Therefore thus says the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel: ‘Behold, I will set My face against you for catastrophe and for cutting off all Judah.
verses.textEnNlt: "Therefore, this is what the Lord of Heaven’s Armies, the God of Israel, says: I am determined to destroy every one of you!
verses.textEnNasb: "Therefore this is what the Lord of armies, the God of Israel says: ‘Behold, I am going to set My face against you for a disaster, even to eliminate all Judah.
verses.textEn: "Therefore this is what the Lord Almighty, the God of Israel, says: I am determined to bring disaster on you and to destroy all Judah.

verses.textZh: 那些决意去埃及地，在那里寄居的犹大余剩的人，我必把他们除去；他们必在埃及地灭绝；他们必倒在刀下，必因饥荒灭亡；他们从最小的到最大的都必因刀剑和饥荒而死，以致成了令人惊骇、被人咒骂、咒诅和羞辱的对象。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那些决意去埃及地，在那里寄居的犹大余剩的人，我必把他们除去；他们必在埃及地灭绝；他们必倒在刀下，必因饥荒灭亡；他们从最小的到最大的都必因刀剑和饥荒而死，以致成了令人惊骇、被人咒骂、咒诅和羞辱的对象。
verses.textZhCuv: 那定意进入埃及地、在那里寄居的，就是所剩下的犹大人，我必使他们尽都灭绝，必在埃及地仆倒，必因刀剑饥荒灭绝；从最小的到至大的都必遭刀剑饥荒而死，以致令人辱骂、惊骇、咒诅、羞辱。
verses.textEnNiv: I will take away the remnant of Judah who were determined to go to Egypt to settle there. They will all perish in Egypt; they will fall by the sword or die from famine. From the least to the greatest, they will die by sword or famine. They will become a curse and an object of horror, a curse and an object of reproach.
verses.textEnEsv: I will take the remnant of Judah who have set their faces to come to the land of Egypt to live, and they shall all be consumed. In the land of Egypt they shall fall; by the sword and by famine they shall be consumed. From the least to the greatest, they shall die by the sword and by famine, and they shall become an oath, a horror, a curse, and a taunt.
verses.textEnNkjv: And I will take the remnant of Judah who have set their faces to go into the land of Egypt to dwell there, and they shall all be consumed and fall in the land of Egypt. They shall be consumed by the sword and by famine. They shall die, from the least to the greatest, by the sword and by famine; and they shall be an oath, an astonishment, a curse and a reproach!
verses.textEnNlt: I will take this remnant of Judah—those who were determined to come here and live in Egypt—and I will consume them. They will fall here in Egypt, killed by war and famine. All will die, from the least to the greatest. They will be an object of damnation, horror, cursing, and mockery.
verses.textEnNasb: And I will take away the remnant of Judah who have set their minds on entering the land of Egypt to reside there, and they will all meet their end in the land of Egypt; they will fall by the sword or meet their end by famine. From the small to the great, they will die by the sword and famine; and they will become a curse, an object of horror, an imprecation, and a disgrace.
verses.textEn: I will take away the remnant of Judah who were determined to go to Egypt to settle there. They will all perish in Egypt; they will fall by the sword or die from famine. From the least to the greatest, they will die by sword or famine. They will become a curse and an object of horror, a curse and an object of reproach.

verses.textZh: 我必用刀剑、饥荒和瘟疫惩罚那些住在埃及地的人，好象惩罚耶路撒冷一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必用刀剑、饥荒和瘟疫惩罚那些住在埃及地的人，好象惩罚耶路撒冷一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 我怎样用刀剑、饥荒、瘟疫刑罚耶路撒冷，也必照样刑罚那些住在埃及地的犹大人；
verses.textEnNiv: I will punish those who live in Egypt with the sword, famine and plague, as I punished Jerusalem.
verses.textEnEsv: I will punish those who dwell in the land of Egypt, as I have punished Jerusalem, with the sword, with famine, and with pestilence,
verses.textEnNkjv: For I will punish those who dwell in the land of Egypt, as I have punished Jerusalem, by the sword, by famine, and by pestilence,
verses.textEnNlt: I will punish them in Egypt just as I punished them in Jerusalem, by war, famine, and disease.
verses.textEnNasb: And I will punish those who live in the land of Egypt, just as I have punished Jerusalem, with the sword, with famine, and with plague.
verses.textEn: I will punish those who live in Egypt with the sword, famine and plague, as I punished Jerusalem.

verses.textZh: 那些去埃及地，在那里寄居的犹大余剩的人，必不能逃脱，不能幸存，不能返回他们心里渴望回去居住的犹大地；除了一些逃脱了的人以外，一个都不能返回。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 那些去埃及地，在那里寄居的犹大余剩的人，必不能逃脱，不能幸存，不能返回他们心里渴望回去居住的犹大地；除了一些逃脱了的人以外，一个都不能返回。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 甚至那进入埃及地寄居的，就是所剩下的犹大人，都不得逃脱，也不得存留归回犹大地。他们心中甚想归回居住之地；除了逃脱的以外，一个都不能归回。」
verses.textEnNiv: None of the remnant of Judah who have gone to live in Egypt will escape or survive to return to the land of Judah, to which they long to return and live; none will return except a few fugitives."
verses.textEnEsv: so that none of the remnant of Judah who have come to live in the land of Egypt shall escape or survive or return to the land of Judah, to which they desire to return to dwell there. For they shall not return, except some fugitives."
verses.textEnNkjv: so that none of the remnant of Judah who have gone into the land of Egypt to dwell there shall escape or survive, lest they return to the land of Judah, to which they desire to return and dwell. For none shall return except those who escape.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: Of that remnant who fled to Egypt, hoping someday to return to Judah, there will be no survivors. Even though they long to return home, only a handful will do so."
verses.textEnNasb: So there will be no survivor or refugee for the remnant of Judah who have entered the land of Egypt to reside there and then to return to the land of Judah, to which they are longing to return to live; for none will return except a few refugees.’ "
verses.textEn: None of the remnant of Judah who have gone to live in Egypt will escape or survive to return to the land of Judah, to which they long to return and live; none will return except a few fugitives."

verses.textZh: 那些知道自己的妻子曾向别神烧香的众人，和一大群站在那里的妇女，以及住在埃及地巴忒罗的众民，回答耶利米说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 那些知道自己的妻子曾向别神烧香的众人，和一大群站在那里的妇女，以及住在埃及地巴忒罗的众民，回答耶利米说：
verses.textZhCuv: 那些住在埃及地巴忒罗知道自己妻子向别神烧香的，与旁边站立的众妇女，聚集成群，回答耶利米说：
verses.textEnNiv: Then all the men who knew that their wives were burning incense to other gods, along with all the women who were present—a large assembly—and all the people living in Lower and Upper Egypt, said to Jeremiah,
verses.textEnEsv: Then all the men who knew that their wives had made offerings to other gods, and all the women who stood by, a great assembly, all the people who lived in Pathros in the land of Egypt, answered Jeremiah:
verses.textEnNkjv: Then all the men who knew that their wives had burned incense to other gods, with all the women who stood by, a great multitude, and all the people who dwelt in the land of Egypt, in Pathros, answered Jeremiah, saying:
verses.textEnNlt: Then all the women present and all the men who knew that their wives had burned incense to idols—a great crowd of all the Judeans living in northern Egypt and southern Egypt —answered Jeremiah,
verses.textEnNasb: Then all the men who were aware that their wives were burning sacrifices to other gods, along with all the women who were standing by, as a large assembly, including all the people who were living in Pathros in the land of Egypt, responded to Jeremiah, saying,
verses.textEn: Then all the men who knew that their wives were burning incense to other gods, along with all the women who were present—a large assembly—and all the people living in Lower and Upper Egypt, said to Jeremiah,

verses.textZh: "你奉耶和华的名对我们所说的话，我们不听从。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你奉耶和华的名对我们所说的话，我们不听从。
verses.textZhCuv: 「论到你奉耶和华的名向我们所说的话，我们必不听从。
verses.textEnNiv: "We will not listen to the message you have spoken to us in the name of the Lord !
verses.textEnEsv: "As for the word that you have spoken to us in the name of the Lord , we will not listen to you.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Asfor the word that you have spoken to us in the name of the Lord, we will not listen to you!
verses.textEnNlt: "We will not listen to your messages from the Lord !
verses.textEnNasb: "As for the message that you have spoken to us in the name of the Lord, we are not going to listen to you!
verses.textEn: "We will not listen to the message you have spoken to us in the name of the Lord !

verses.textZh: 我们口中说过的一切话，我们一定去作，我们要向天后烧香，浇奠祭，好象我们自己和我们的列祖，以及我们的君王和领袖，在犹大的各城和耶路撒冷的街上所行的一样。那时我们吃得饱，得享福乐，不见灾祸。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们口中说过的一切话，我们一定去作，我们要向天后烧香，浇奠祭，好象我们自己和我们的列祖，以及我们的君王和领袖，在犹大的各城和耶路撒冷的街上所行的一样。那时我们吃得饱，得享福乐，不见灾祸。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们定要成就我们口中所出的一切话，向天后烧香、浇奠祭，按着我们与我们列祖、君王、首领在犹大的城邑中和耶路撒冷的街市上素常所行的一样；因为那时我们吃饱饭、享福乐，并不见灾祸。
verses.textEnNiv: We will certainly do everything we said we would: We will burn incense to the Queen of Heaven and will pour out drink offerings to her just as we and our ancestors, our kings and our officials did in the towns of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem. At that time we had plenty of food and were well off and suffered no harm.
verses.textEnEsv: But we will do everything that we have vowed, make offerings to the queen of heaven and pour out drink offerings to her, as we did, both we and our fathers, our kings and our officials, in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem. For then we had plenty of food, and prospered, and saw no disaster.
verses.textEnNkjv: But we will certainly do whatever has gone out of our own mouth, to burn incense to the queen of heaven and pour out drink offerings to her, as we have done, we and our fathers, our kings and our princes, in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem. For then we had plenty of food, were well-off, and saw no trouble.
verses.textEnNlt: We will do whatever we want. We will burn incense and pour out liquid offerings to the Queen of Heaven just as much as we like—just as we, and our ancestors, and our kings and officials have always done in the towns of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem. For in those days we had plenty to eat, and we were well off and had no troubles!
verses.textEnNasb: But we will certainly carry out every word that has proceeded from our mouths, by burning sacrifices to the queen of heaven and pouring out drink offerings to her, just as we ourselves, our forefathers, our kings, and our leaders did in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem; for then we had plenty of food and were well off and saw no misfortune.
verses.textEn: We will certainly do everything we said we would: We will burn incense to the Queen of Heaven and will pour out drink offerings to her just as we and our ancestors, our kings and our officials did in the towns of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem. At that time we had plenty of food and were well off and suffered no harm.

verses.textZh: 但是，自从我们停止向天后烧香和浇奠祭以后，我们就样样都缺乏，又因刀剑和饥荒灭亡。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 但是，自从我们停止向天后烧香和浇奠祭以后，我们就样样都缺乏，又因刀剑和饥荒灭亡。"
verses.textZhCuv: 自从我们停止向天后烧香、浇奠祭，我们倒缺乏一切，又因刀剑饥荒灭绝。」
verses.textEnNiv: But ever since we stopped burning incense to the Queen of Heaven and pouring out drink offerings to her, we have had nothing and have been perishing by sword and famine."
