verses.textEnEsv: But since we left off making offerings to the queen of heaven and pouring out drink offerings to her, we have lacked everything and have been consumed by the sword and by famine."
verses.textEnNkjv: But since we stopped burning incense to the queen of heaven and pouring out drink offerings to her, we have lacked everything and have been consumed by the sword and by famine."
verses.textEnNlt: But ever since we quit burning incense to the Queen of Heaven and stopped worshiping her with liquid offerings, we have been in great trouble and have been dying from war and famine."
verses.textEnNasb: But since we stopped burning sacrifices to the queen of heaven and pouring out drink offerings to her, we have lacked everything, and have met our end by the sword and by famine."
verses.textEn: But ever since we stopped burning incense to the Queen of Heaven and pouring out drink offerings to her, we have had nothing and have been perishing by sword and famine."

verses.textZh: 那些妇女又说："我们不错是向天后烧香和浇奠祭，难道我们的丈夫不知道我们照着天后的形象制饼供奉她，向她浇奠祭吗？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 那些妇女又说："我们不错是向天后烧香和浇奠祭，难道我们的丈夫不知道我们照着天后的形象制饼供奉她，向她浇奠祭吗？"
verses.textZhCuv: 妇女说：「我们向天后烧香、浇奠祭，做天后像的饼供奉她，向她浇奠祭，是外乎我们的丈夫吗？」
verses.textEnNiv: The women added, "When we burned incense to the Queen of Heaven and poured out drink offerings to her, did not our husbands know that we were making cakes impressed with her image and pouring out drink offerings to her?"
verses.textEnEsv: And the women said, "When we made offerings to the queen of heaven and poured out drink offerings to her, was it without our husbands’ approval that we made cakes for her bearing her image and poured out drink offerings to her?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Thewomenalsosaid, "And when we burned incense to the queen of heaven and poured out drink offerings to her, did we make cakes for her, to worship her, and pour out drink offerings to her without our husbands’ permission?"
verses.textEnNlt: "Besides," the women added, "do you suppose that we were burning incense and pouring out liquid offerings to the Queen of Heaven, and making cakes marked with her image, without our husbands knowing it and helping us? Of course not!"
verses.textEnNasb: "And," said the women, "when we were burning sacrifices to the queen of heaven and pouring out drink offerings to her, was it without our husbands that we made for her sacrificial cakes in her image, and poured out drink offerings to her?"
verses.textEn: The women added, "When we burned incense to the Queen of Heaven and poured out drink offerings to her, did not our husbands know that we were making cakes impressed with her image and pouring out drink offerings to her?"

verses.textZh: 耶利米对全体人民，对那些用这话答复他的男人、女人和众民说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶利米对全体人民，对那些用这话答复他的男人、女人和众民说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶利米对一切那样回答他的男人妇女说：
verses.textEnNiv: Then Jeremiah said to all the people, both men and women, who were answering him,
verses.textEnEsv: Then Jeremiah said to all the people, men and women, all the people who had given him this answer:
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Jeremiah spoke to all the people—the men, the women, and all the people who had given him that answer—saying:
verses.textEnNlt: Then Jeremiah said to all of them, men and women alike, who had given him that answer,
verses.textEnNasb: Then Jeremiah said to all the people, to the men and women—even to all the people who were giving him such an answer—saying,
verses.textEn: Then Jeremiah said to all the people, both men and women, who were answering him,

verses.textZh: "你们和你们的列祖，以及你们的君王、领袖，和全国的人民，在犹大的各城和耶路撒冷的街上烧的香，耶和华怎能忘记，他心里怎能不想起呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: "你们和你们的列祖，以及你们的君王、领袖，和全国的人民，在犹大的各城和耶路撒冷的街上烧的香，耶和华怎能忘记，他心里怎能不想起呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 「你们与你们列祖、君王、首领，并国内的百姓，在犹大城邑中和耶路撒冷街市上所烧的香，耶和华岂不记念，心中岂不思想吗？
verses.textEnNiv: "Did not the Lord remember and call to mind the incense burned in the towns of Judah and the streets of Jerusalem by you and your ancestors, your kings and your officials and the people of the land?
verses.textEnEsv: "As for the offerings that you offered in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem, you and your fathers, your kings and your officials, and the people of the land, did not the Lord remember them? Did it not come into his mind?
verses.textEnNkjv: "The incense that you burned in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem, you and your fathers, your kings and your princes, and the people of the land, did not the Lord remember them, and did it not come into His mind?
verses.textEnNlt: "Do you think the Lord did not know that you and your ancestors, your kings and officials, and all the people were burning incense to idols in the towns of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem?
verses.textEnNasb: "As for the smoking sacrifices that you burned in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem, you and your forefathers, your kings and your leaders, and the people of the land, did the Lord not remember them, and did all of this not come into His mind?
verses.textEn: "Did not the Lord remember and call to mind the incense burned in the towns of Judah and the streets of Jerusalem by you and your ancestors, your kings and your officials and the people of the land?

verses.textZh: 耶和华再不能容忍你们邪恶的行为，和你们所行可憎的事；故此，你们的土地荒凉，成了令人惊骇、被人咒诅的对象，没有人居住，好象今天一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华再不能容忍你们邪恶的行为，和你们所行可憎的事；故此，你们的土地荒凉，成了令人惊骇、被人咒诅的对象，没有人居住，好象今天一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华因你们所作的恶、所行可憎的事，不能再容忍，所以你们的地荒凉，令人惊骇咒诅，无人居住，正如今日一样。
verses.textEnNiv: When the Lord could no longer endure your wicked actions and the detestable things you did, your land became a curse and a desolate waste without inhabitants, as it is today.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord could no longer bear your evil deeds and the abominations that you committed. Therefore your land has become a desolation and a waste and a curse, without inhabitant, as it is this day.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the Lord could no longer bear it, because of the evil of your doings and because of the abominations which you committed. Therefore your land is a desolation, an astonishment, a curse, and without an inhabitant, as itis this day.
verses.textEnNlt: It was because the Lord could no longer bear all the disgusting things you were doing that he made your land an object of cursing—a desolate ruin without inhabitants—as it is today.
verses.textEnNasb: So the Lord was no longer able to endure it, because of the evil of your deeds, because of the abominations which you have committed; so your land has become a place of ruins, an object of horror, and a curse, without an inhabitant, as it is this day.
verses.textEn: When the Lord could no longer endure your wicked actions and the detestable things you did, your land became a curse and a desolate waste without inhabitants, as it is today.

verses.textZh: 因为你们向别神烧香，得罪了耶和华，不听从耶和华的话，不遵行他的律法、条例和法度，所以这灾祸临到你们，好象今天一样。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为你们向别神烧香，得罪了耶和华，不听从耶和华的话，不遵行他的律法、条例和法度，所以这灾祸临到你们，好象今天一样。"
verses.textZhCuv: 你们烧香，得罪耶和华，没有听从他的话，没有遵行他的律法、条例、法度，所以你们遭遇这灾祸，正如今日一样。」
verses.textEnNiv: Because you have burned incense and have sinned against the Lord and have not obeyed him or followed his law or his decrees or his stipulations, this disaster has come upon you, as you now see."
verses.textEnEsv: It is because you made offerings and because you sinned against the Lord and did not obey the voice of the Lord or walk in his law and in his statutes and in his testimonies that this disaster has happened to you, as at this day."
verses.textEnNkjv: Because you have burned incense and because you have sinned against the Lord, and have not obeyed the voice of the Lord or walked in His law, in His statutes or in His testimonies, therefore this calamity has happened to you, as at this day."
verses.textEnNlt: All these terrible things happened to you because you have burned incense to idols and sinned against the Lord . You have refused to obey him and have not followed his instructions, his decrees, and his laws."
verses.textEnNasb: Since you have burned sacrifices and have sinned against the Lord and not obeyed the voice of the Lord nor walked in His Law, His statutes, or His testimonies, therefore this disaster has happened to you, as it has this day."
verses.textEn: Because you have burned incense and have sinned against the Lord and have not obeyed him or followed his law or his decrees or his stipulations, this disaster has come upon you, as you now see."

verses.textZh: 耶利米又对众民和众妇女说："在埃及地所有的犹大人哪，要听耶和华的话！
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶利米又对众民和众妇女说："在埃及地所有的犹大人哪，要听耶和华的话！
verses.textZhCuv: 耶利米又对众民和众妇女说：「你们在埃及地的一切犹大人当听耶和华的话。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Jeremiah said to all the people, including the women, "Hear the word of the Lord , all you people of Judah in Egypt.
verses.textEnEsv: Jeremiah said to all the people and all the women, "Hear the word of the Lord , all you of Judah who are in the land of Egypt.
verses.textEnNkjv: Moreover Jeremiah said to all the people and to all the women, "Hear the word of the Lord, all Judah who are in the land of Egypt!
verses.textEnNlt: Then Jeremiah said to them all, including the women, "Listen to this message from the Lord , all you citizens of Judah who live in Egypt.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Jeremiah said to all the people, including all the women, "Hear the word of the Lord, all Judah who are in the land of Egypt!
verses.textEn: Then Jeremiah said to all the people, including the women, "Hear the word of the Lord , all you people of Judah in Egypt.

verses.textZh: 万军之耶和华以色列的神这样说：‘你们和你们的妻子亲口说过：我们一定要实行我们的愿，向天后烧香，浇奠祭。你们果然亲手作了。现在你们只管持定你们所许的愿，只管实行你们的誓言吧！’
verses.textZhCnvs: 万军之耶和华以色列的神这样说：‘你们和你们的妻子亲口说过：我们一定要实行我们的愿，向天后烧香，浇奠祭。你们果然亲手作了。现在你们只管持定你们所许的愿，只管实行你们的誓言吧！’
verses.textZhCuv: 万军之耶和华－以色列的神如此说：你们和你们的妻都口中说、手里做，说：『我们定要偿还所许的愿，向天后烧香、浇奠祭。』现在你们只管坚定所许的愿而偿还吧！
verses.textEnNiv: This is what the Lord Almighty, the God of Israel, says: You and your wives have done what you said you would do when you promised, ‘We will certainly carry out the vows we made to burn incense and pour out drink offerings to the Queen of Heaven.’ "Go ahead then, do what you promised! Keep your vows!
verses.textEnEsv: Thus says the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel: You and your wives have declared with your mouths, and have fulfilled it with your hands, saying, ‘We will surely perform our vows that we have made, to make offerings to the queen of heaven and to pour out drink offerings to her.’ Then confirm your vows and perform your vows!
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus says the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel, saying: ‘You and your wives have spoken with your mouths and fulfilled with your hands, saying, "We will surely keep our vows that we have made, to burn incense to the queen of heaven and pour out drink offerings to her." You will surely keep your vows and perform your vows!’
verses.textEnNlt: This is what the Lord of Heaven’s Armies, the God of Israel, says: ‘You and your wives have said, "We will keep our promises to burn incense and pour out liquid offerings to the Queen of Heaven," and you have proved by your actions that you meant it. So go ahead and carry out your promises and vows to her!’
verses.textEnNasb: This is what the Lord of armies, the God of Israel says: ‘As for you and your wives, you have spoken with your mouths and fulfilled it with your hands, saying, "We will certainly perform our vows that we have vowed, to burn sacrifices to the queen of heaven and pour out drink offerings to her." By all means fulfill your vows, and be sure to perform your vows!’
verses.textEn: This is what the Lord Almighty, the God of Israel, says: You and your wives have done what you said you would do when you promised, ‘We will certainly carry out the vows we made to burn incense and pour out drink offerings to the Queen of Heaven.’ "Go ahead then, do what you promised! Keep your vows!

verses.textZh: 但所有住在埃及地的犹大人哪，你们要听耶和华的话！耶和华说：‘看哪！我指着我伟大的名起誓：在埃及全地每一个犹大人的口中，再不会呼唤我的名，说：我指着永活的主耶和华起誓。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但所有住在埃及地的犹大人哪，你们要听耶和华的话！耶和华说：‘看哪！我指着我伟大的名起誓：在埃及全地每一个犹大人的口中，再不会呼唤我的名，说：我指着永活的主耶和华起誓。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以你们住在埃及地的一切犹大人当听耶和华的话。耶和华说：我指着我的大名起誓，在埃及全地，我的名不再被犹大一个人的口称呼说：『我指着主－永生的耶和华起誓。』
verses.textEnNiv: But hear the word of the Lord , all you Jews living in Egypt: ‘I swear by my great name,’ says the Lord , ‘that no one from Judah living anywhere in Egypt will ever again invoke my name or swear, "As surely as the Sovereign Lord lives."
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore hear the word of the Lord , all you of Judah who dwell in the land of Egypt: Behold, I have sworn by my great name, says the Lord , that my name shall no more be invoked by the mouth of any man of Judah in all the land of Egypt, saying, ‘As the Lord God lives.’
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore hear the word of the Lord, all Judah who dwell in the land of Egypt: ‘Behold, I have sworn by My great name,’ says the Lord, ‘that My name shall no more be named in the mouth of any man of Judah in all the land of Egypt, saying, "The Lord God lives."
verses.textEnNlt: "But listen to this message from the Lord , all you Judeans now living in Egypt: ‘I have sworn by my great name,’ says the Lord , ‘that my name will no longer be spoken by any of the Judeans in the land of Egypt. None of you may invoke my name or use this oath: "As surely as the Sovereign Lord lives."
verses.textEnNasb: In return, hear the word of the Lord, all Judah who are living in the land of Egypt: ‘Behold, I have sworn by My great name,’ says the Lord, ‘that My name shall never be invoked again by the mouth of anyone of Judah in all the land of Egypt, saying, "As the Lord God lives."
verses.textEn: But hear the word of the Lord , all you Jews living in Egypt: ‘I swear by my great name,’ says the Lord , ‘that no one from Judah living anywhere in Egypt will ever again invoke my name or swear, "As surely as the Sovereign Lord lives."

verses.textZh: 看哪！我要留意向他们降祸不降福；在埃及地所有的犹大人都必因刀剑和饥荒灭亡，直到灭绝。
verses.textZhCnvs: 看哪！我要留意向他们降祸不降福；在埃及地所有的犹大人都必因刀剑和饥荒灭亡，直到灭绝。
verses.textZhCuv: 我向他们留意降祸不降福；在埃及地的一切犹大人必因刀剑、饥荒所灭，直到灭尽。
verses.textEnNiv: For I am watching over them for harm, not for good; the Jews in Egypt will perish by sword and famine until they are all destroyed.
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, I am watching over them for disaster and not for good. All the men of Judah who are in the land of Egypt shall be consumed by the sword and by famine, until there is an end of them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Behold, I will watch over them for adversity and not for good. And all the men of Judah who are in the land of Egypt shall be consumed by the sword and by famine, until there is an end to them.
verses.textEnNlt: For I will watch over you to bring you disaster and not good. Everyone from Judah who is now living in Egypt will suffer war and famine until all of you are dead.
verses.textEnNasb: Behold, I am watching over them for harm and not for good, and all the people of Judah who are in the land of Egypt will meet their end by the sword or by famine until they are completely gone.
verses.textEn: For I am watching over them for harm, not for good; the Jews in Egypt will perish by sword and famine until they are all destroyed.

verses.textZh: 那些逃脱刀剑的，必从埃及地返回犹大地；他们人数很少。这样，所有去埃及地在那里寄居的犹大余剩的人，就知道谁的话实现：我的，还是他们的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那些逃脱刀剑的，必从埃及地返回犹大地；他们人数很少。这样，所有去埃及地在那里寄居的犹大余剩的人，就知道谁的话实现：我的，还是他们的。
verses.textZhCuv: 脱离刀剑、从埃及地归回犹大地的人数很少；那进入埃及地要在那里寄居的，就是所剩下的犹大人，必知道是谁的话立得住，是我的话呢？是他们的话呢？
verses.textEnNiv: Those who escape the sword and return to the land of Judah from Egypt will be very few. Then the whole remnant of Judah who came to live in Egypt will know whose word will stand—mine or theirs.
verses.textEnEsv: And those who escape the sword shall return from the land of Egypt to the land of Judah, few in number; and all the remnant of Judah, who came to the land of Egypt to live, shall know whose word will stand, mine or theirs.
verses.textEnNkjv: Yet a small number who escape the sword shall return from the land of Egypt to the land of Judah; and all the remnant of Judah, who have gone to the land of Egypt to dwell there, shall know whose words will stand, Mine or theirs.
verses.textEnNlt: Only a small number will escape death and return to Judah from Egypt. Then all those who came to Egypt will find out whose words are true—mine or theirs!
verses.textEnNasb: Those who escape the sword will return from the land of Egypt to the land of Judah few in number. Then all the remnant of Judah who have gone to the land of Egypt to reside there will know whose word will stand, Mine or theirs.
verses.textEn: Those who escape the sword and return to the land of Judah from Egypt will be very few. Then the whole remnant of Judah who came to live in Egypt will know whose word will stand—mine or theirs.

verses.textZh: "‘我要在这地方惩罚你们，这是给你们的征兆，好使你们知道我说要降祸给你们的话，一定实现。’这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: "‘我要在这地方惩罚你们，这是给你们的征兆，好使你们知道我说要降祸给你们的话，一定实现。’这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华说：我在这地方刑罚你们，必有预兆，使你们知道我降祸与你们的话必要立得住。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘This will be the sign to you that I will punish you in this place,’ declares the Lord , ‘so that you will know that my threats of harm against you will surely stand.’
verses.textEnEsv: This shall be the sign to you, declares the Lord , that I will punish you in this place, in order that you may know that my words will surely stand against you for harm:
verses.textEnNkjv: And this shallbe a sign to you,’ says the Lord, ‘that I will punish you in this place, that you may know that My words will surely stand against you for adversity.’
verses.textEnNlt: "‘And this is the proof I give you,’ says the Lord , ‘that all I have threatened will happen to you and that I will punish you here.’
verses.textEnNasb: And this will be the sign to you,’ declares the Lord, ‘that I am going to punish you in this place, so that you may know that My words will assuredly stand against you for harm.’
verses.textEn: " ‘This will be the sign to you that I will punish you in this place,’ declares the Lord , ‘so that you will know that my threats of harm against you will surely stand.’

verses.textZh: 耶和华这样说：‘看哪！我必把埃及王法老合弗拉交在他仇敌的手中，和那些寻索他性命的人的手中，像我把犹大王西底家交在他仇敌，那寻索他性命的巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒的手中一样。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华这样说：‘看哪！我必把埃及王法老合弗拉交在他仇敌的手中，和那些寻索他性命的人的手中，像我把犹大王西底家交在他仇敌，那寻索他性命的巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒的手中一样。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华如此说：我必将埃及王法老合弗拉交在他仇敌和寻索其命的人手中，像我将犹大王西底家交在他仇敌和寻索其命的巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒手中一样。」
verses.textEnNiv: This is what the Lord says: ‘I am going to deliver Pharaoh Hophra king of Egypt into the hands of his enemies who want to kill him, just as I gave Zedekiah king of Judah into the hands of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, the enemy who wanted to kill him.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: Thus says the Lord , Behold, I will give Pharaoh Hophra king of Egypt into the hand of his enemies and into the hand of those who seek his life, as I gave Zedekiah king of Judah into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, who was his enemy and sought his life."
verses.textEnNkjv: "Thus says the Lord: ‘Behold, I will give Pharaoh Hophra king of Egypt into the hand of his enemies and into the hand of those who seek his life, as I gave Zedekiah king of Judah into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, his enemy who sought his life.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: This is what the Lord says: ‘I will turn Pharaoh Hophra, king of Egypt, over to his enemies who want to kill him, just as I turned King Zedekiah of Judah over to King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylon.’"
verses.textEnNasb: This is what the Lord says: ‘Behold, I am going to hand Pharaoh Hophra king of Egypt over to his enemies, to those who seek his life, just as I handed Zedekiah king of Judah over to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, who was his enemy and was seeking his life.’ "
verses.textEn: This is what the Lord says: ‘I am going to deliver Pharaoh Hophra king of Egypt into the hands of his enemies who want to kill him, just as I gave Zedekiah king of Judah into the hands of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, the enemy who wanted to kill him.’ "

verses.textZh: 以下是犹大王约西亚的儿子约雅敬第四年，耶利米先知对尼利亚的儿子巴录所说的话 ：
verses.textZhCnvs: 以下是犹大王约西亚的儿子约雅敬第四年，耶利米先知对尼利亚的儿子巴录所说的话 ：
verses.textZhCuv: 犹大王约西亚的儿子约雅敬第四年，尼利亚的儿子巴录将先知耶利米口中所说的话写在书上。耶利米说：
verses.textEnNiv: When Baruch son of Neriah wrote on a scroll the words Jeremiah the prophet dictated in the fourth year of Jehoiakim son of Josiah king of Judah, Jeremiah said this to Baruch:
verses.textEnEsv: The word that Jeremiah the prophet spoke to Baruch the son of Neriah, when he wrote these words in a book at the dictation of Jeremiah, in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah:
verses.textEnNkjv: The word that Jeremiah the prophet spoke to Baruch the son of Neriah, when he had written these words in a book at the instruction of Jeremiah, in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: The prophet Jeremiah gave a message to Baruch son of Neriah in the fourth year of the reign of Jehoiakim son of Josiah, after Baruch had written down everything Jeremiah had dictated to him. He said,
verses.textEnNasb: This is the message which Jeremiah the prophet spoke to Baruch the son of Neriah, when he had written these words in a book at Jeremiah’s dictation, in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah, saying:
verses.textEn: When Baruch son of Neriah wrote on a scroll the words Jeremiah the prophet dictated in the fourth year of Jehoiakim son of Josiah king of Judah, Jeremiah said this to Baruch:

verses.textZh: "巴录啊！耶和华以色列的神这样说：
verses.textZhCnvs: "巴录啊！耶和华以色列的神这样说：
verses.textZhCuv: 「巴录啊，耶和华－以色列的神说：
verses.textEnNiv: "This is what the Lord , the God of Israel, says to you, Baruch:
verses.textEnEsv: "Thus says the Lord , the God of Israel, to you, O Baruch:
verses.textEnNkjv: "Thus says the Lord, the God of Israel, to you, O Baruch:
verses.textEnNlt: "This is what the Lord , the God of Israel, says to you, Baruch:
verses.textEnNasb: "This is what the Lord, the God of Israel says to you, Baruch:
verses.textEn: "This is what the Lord , the God of Israel, says to you, Baruch:

verses.textZh: ‘你曾说：我有祸了！因为耶和华在我的痛苦上加添忧愁。我因唉哼而困乏，得不着安宁。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: ‘你曾说：我有祸了！因为耶和华在我的痛苦上加添忧愁。我因唉哼而困乏，得不着安宁。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 巴录 曾说：『哀哉！耶和华将忧愁加在我的痛苦上，我因唉哼而困乏，不得安歇。』
verses.textEnNiv: You said, ‘Woe to me! The Lord has added sorrow to my pain; I am worn out with groaning and find no rest.’
verses.textEnEsv: You said, ‘Woe is me! For the Lord has added sorrow to my pain. I am weary with my groaning, and I find no rest.’
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘You said, "Woe is me now! For the Lord has added grief to my sorrow. I fainted in my sighing, and I find no rest." ’
verses.textEnNlt: You have said, ‘I am overwhelmed with trouble! Haven’t I had enough pain already? And now the Lord has added more! I am worn out from sighing and can find no rest.’
verses.textEnNasb: ‘You said, "Oh, woe to me! For the Lord has added grief to my pain; I am weary with my groaning and have found no rest." ’
verses.textEn: You said, ‘Woe to me! The Lord has added sorrow to my pain; I am worn out with groaning and find no rest.’

verses.textZh: 耶和华对耶利米说："你要这样对他说：‘耶和华这样说：看哪！我所建立的，我必拆毁；我所栽种的，我必拔除。我必这样对待全地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对耶利米说："你要这样对他说：‘耶和华这样说：看哪！我所建立的，我必拆毁；我所栽种的，我必拔除。我必这样对待全地。
verses.textZhCuv: 你要这样告诉他，耶和华如此说：我所建立的，我必拆毁；我所栽植的，我必拔出；在全地我都如此行。
verses.textEnNiv: But the Lord has told me to say to you, ‘This is what the Lord says: I will overthrow what I have built and uproot what I have planted, throughout the earth.
verses.textEnEsv: Thus shall you say to him, Thus says the Lord : Behold, what I have built I am breaking down, and what I have planted I am plucking up—that is, the whole land.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Thus you shall say to him, ‘Thus says the Lord: "Behold, what I have built I will break down, and what I have planted I will pluck up, that is, this whole land.
verses.textEnNlt: "Baruch, this is what the Lord says: ‘I will destroy this nation that I built. I will uproot what I planted.
verses.textEnNasb: This is what you are to say to him: ‘This is what the Lord says: "Behold, what I have built I am going to tear down, and what I have planted I am going to uproot, that is, all the people of the land."
verses.textEn: But the Lord has told me to say to you, ‘This is what the Lord says: I will overthrow what I have built and uproot what I have planted, throughout the earth.

verses.textZh: 你要为自己图谋大事吗？不要图谋！看哪！我必使灾祸降在全人类身上，但无论你到甚么地方去，我必使你捡回自己的性命。’"这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要为自己图谋大事吗？不要图谋！看哪！我必使灾祸降在全人类身上，但无论你到甚么地方去，我必使你捡回自己的性命。’"这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 你为自己图谋大事吗？不要图谋！我必使灾祸临到凡有血气的。但你无论往哪里去，我必使你以自己的命为掠物。这是耶和华说的。」
verses.textEnNiv: Should you then seek great things for yourself? Do not seek them. For I will bring disaster on all people, declares the Lord , but wherever you go I will let you escape with your life.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: And do you seek great things for yourself? Seek them not, for behold, I am bringing disaster upon all flesh, declares the Lord . But I will give you your life as a prize of war in all places to which you may go."
verses.textEnNkjv: And do you seek great things for yourself? Do not seek them; for behold, I will bring adversity on all flesh," says the Lord. "But I will give your life to you as a prize in all places, wherever you go." ’ "
verses.textEnNlt: Are you seeking great things for yourself? Don’t do it! I will bring great disaster upon all these people; but I will give you your life as a reward wherever you go. I, the Lord , have spoken!’"
verses.textEnNasb: But as for you, are you seeking great things for yourself? Do not seek them; for behold, I am going to bring disaster on all flesh,’ declares the Lord, ‘but I will give your life to you as plunder in all the places where you may go.’ "
verses.textEn: Should you then seek great things for yourself? Do not seek them. For I will bring disaster on all people, declares the Lord , but wherever you go I will let you escape with your life.’ "

verses.textZh: 耶和华论到列国的话临到耶利米先知。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华论到列国的话临到耶利米先知。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华论列国的话临到先知耶利米。
verses.textEnNiv: This is the word of the Lord that came to Jeremiah the prophet concerning the nations:
verses.textEnEsv: The word of the Lord that came to Jeremiah the prophet concerning the nations.
verses.textEnNkjv: The word of the Lord which came to Jeremiah the prophet against the nations.
verses.textEnNlt: The following messages were given to Jeremiah the prophet from the Lord concerning foreign nations.
verses.textEnNasb: That which came as the word of the Lord to Jeremiah the prophet concerning the nations.
verses.textEn: This is the word of the Lord that came to Jeremiah the prophet concerning the nations:

verses.textZh: 以下的话是关于埃及，论到埃及王法老尼哥的军队，这军队在犹大王约西亚的儿子约雅敬第四年，被巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒在靠近幼发拉底河的迦基米施击败。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以下的话是关于埃及，论到埃及王法老尼哥的军队，这军队在犹大王约西亚的儿子约雅敬第四年，被巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒在靠近幼发拉底河的迦基米施击败。
verses.textZhCuv: 论到关乎埃及王法老尼哥的军队：这军队安营在幼发拉底河边的迦基米施，是巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒在犹大王约西亚的儿子约雅敬第四年所打败的。
verses.textEnNiv: Concerning Egypt: This is the message against the army of Pharaoh Necho king of Egypt, which was defeated at Carchemish on the Euphrates River by Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon in the fourth year of Jehoiakim son of Josiah king of Judah:
verses.textEnEsv: About Egypt. Concerning the army of Pharaoh Neco, king of Egypt, which was by the river Euphrates at Carchemish and which Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon defeated in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah:
verses.textEnNkjv: Against Egypt. Concerning the army of Pharaoh Necho, king of Egypt, which was by the River Euphrates in Carchemish, and which Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon defeated in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah:
verses.textEnNlt: This message concerning Egypt was given in the fourth year of the reign of Jehoiakim son of Josiah, the king of Judah, on the occasion of the battle of Carchemish when Pharaoh Neco, king of Egypt, and his army were defeated beside the Euphrates River by King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylon.
verses.textEnNasb: To Egypt, concerning the army of Pharaoh Neco king of Egypt, which was by the river Euphrates at Carchemish, which Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon defeated in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah:
verses.textEn: Concerning Egypt: This is the message against the army of Pharaoh Necho king of Egypt, which was defeated at Carchemish on the Euphrates River by Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon in the fourth year of Jehoiakim son of Josiah king of Judah:

verses.textZh: "要准备好大小的盾牌， 踏上战场。
verses.textZhCnvs: "要准备好大小的盾牌， 踏上战场。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要预备大小盾牌， 往前上阵。
verses.textEnNiv: "Prepare your shields, both large and small, and march out for battle!
verses.textEnEsv: "Prepare buckler and shield, and advance for battle!
verses.textEnNkjv: "Order the buckler and shield, And draw near to battle!
verses.textEnNlt: "Prepare your shields, and advance into battle!
verses.textEnNasb: "Set up the buckler and shield, And advance to the battle!
verses.textEn: "Prepare your shields, both large and small, and march out for battle!

verses.textZh: 要装备马匹，骑上战马； 站好岗位，戴上头盔； 磨快枪矛，穿上铁甲。
verses.textZhCnvs: 要装备马匹，骑上战马； 站好岗位，戴上头盔； 磨快枪矛，穿上铁甲。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们套上车， 骑上马！ 顶盔站立， 磨枪贯甲！
verses.textEnNiv: Harness the horses, mount the steeds! Take your positions with helmets on! Polish your spears, put on your armor!
verses.textEnEsv: Harness the horses; mount, O horsemen! Take your stations with your helmets, polish your spears, put on your armor!
verses.textEnNkjv: Harness the horses, And mount up, you horsemen! Stand forth with your helmets, Polish the spears, Put on the armor!
verses.textEnNlt: Harness the horses, and mount the stallions. Take your positions. Put on your helmets. Sharpen your spears, and prepare your armor.
verses.textEnNasb: "Harness the horses, And mount the steeds, Take your stand with helmets on! Polish the spears, Put on the coats of armor!
verses.textEn: Harness the horses, mount the steeds! Take your positions with helmets on! Polish your spears, put on your armor!

verses.textZh: 但为甚么我看见他们惊惶， 转身退后呢？ 他们的勇士被击败了， 他们急速奔逃，不敢回转。 四围都是惊慌。" 这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但为甚么我看见他们惊惶， 转身退后呢？ 他们的勇士被击败了， 他们急速奔逃，不敢回转。 四围都是惊慌。" 这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 我为何看见他们惊惶转身退后呢？ 他们的勇士打败了， 急忙逃跑，并不回头； 惊吓四围都有！ 这是耶和华说的。
verses.textEnNiv: What do I see? They are terrified, they are retreating, their warriors are defeated. They flee in haste without looking back, and there is terror on every side," declares the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: Why have I seen it? They are dismayed and have turned backward. Their warriors are beaten down and have fled in haste; they look not back— terror on every side! declares the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: Why have I seen them dismayed and turned back? Their mighty ones are beaten down; They have speedily fled, And did not look back, For fear was all around," says the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: But what do I see? The Egyptian army flees in terror. The bravest of its fighting men run without a backward glance. They are terrorized at every turn," says the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: "Why have I seen it? They are terrified, They are retreating, And their warriors are defeated And have taken refuge in flight, Without facing back. Terror is on every side!" Declares the Lord.
verses.textEn: What do I see? They are terrified, they are retreating, their warriors are defeated. They flee in haste without looking back, and there is terror on every side," declares the Lord .

verses.textZh: "快跑的跑不掉， 勇士也不能逃脱； 他们在北方、在幼发拉底河边， 都绊跌仆倒。
verses.textZhCnvs: "快跑的跑不掉， 勇士也不能逃脱； 他们在北方、在幼发拉底河边， 都绊跌仆倒。
verses.textZhCuv: 不要容快跑的逃避； 不要容勇士逃脱 ； 他们在北方幼发拉底河边绊跌仆倒。
verses.textEnNiv: "The swift cannot flee nor the strong escape. In the north by the River Euphrates they stumble and fall.
verses.textEnEsv: "The swift cannot flee away, nor the warrior escape; in the north by the river Euphrates they have stumbled and fallen.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Do not let the swift flee away, Nor the mighty man escape; They will stumble and fall Toward the north, by the River Euphrates.
verses.textEnNlt: "The swiftest runners cannot flee; the mightiest warriors cannot escape. By the Euphrates River to the north, they stumble and fall.
verses.textEnNasb: Let not the swift man flee, Nor the warrior escape. In the north beside the river Euphrates They have stumbled and fallen.
verses.textEn: "The swift cannot flee nor the strong escape. In the north by the River Euphrates they stumble and fall.

verses.textZh: 那像尼罗河上涨， 像江河的水翻腾的是谁呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 那像尼罗河上涨， 像江河的水翻腾的是谁呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 像尼罗河涨发， 像江河之水翻腾的是谁呢？
verses.textEnNiv: "Who is this that rises like the Nile, like rivers of surging waters?
verses.textEnEsv: "Who is this, rising like the Nile, like rivers whose waters surge?
verses.textEnNkjv: "Who is this coming up like a flood, Whose waters move like the rivers?
verses.textEnNlt: "Who is this, rising like the Nile at floodtime, overflowing all the land?
verses.textEnNasb: Who is this that rises like the Nile, Like the rivers whose waters surge?
verses.textEn: "Who is this that rises like the Nile, like rivers of surging waters?

verses.textZh: 埃及像尼罗河上涨， 像江河的水翻腾； 它说：‘我要上涨，淹盖大地； 我要毁灭城镇和城里的居民。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 埃及像尼罗河上涨， 像江河的水翻腾； 它说：‘我要上涨，淹盖大地； 我要毁灭城镇和城里的居民。’
verses.textZhCuv: 埃及像尼罗河涨发， 像江河的水翻腾。 他说：我要涨发遮盖遍地； 我要毁灭城邑和其中的居民。
verses.textEnNiv: Egypt rises like the Nile, like rivers of surging waters. She says, ‘I will rise and cover the earth; I will destroy cities and their people.’
verses.textEnEsv: Egypt rises like the Nile, like rivers whose waters surge. He said, ‘I will rise, I will cover the earth, I will destroy cities and their inhabitants.’
verses.textEnNkjv: Egypt rises up like a flood, And its waters move like the rivers; And he says, ‘I will go up and cover the earth, I will destroy the city and its inhabitants.’
verses.textEnNlt: It is the Egyptian army, overflowing all the land, boasting that it will cover the earth like a flood, destroying cities and their people.
verses.textEnNasb: Egypt rises like the Nile, And like the rivers whose waters surge; And He has said, "I will rise and cover that land; I will destroy the city and its inhabitants."
verses.textEn: Egypt rises like the Nile, like rivers of surging waters. She says, ‘I will rise and cover the earth; I will destroy cities and their people.’

verses.textZh: 马匹啊，上前吧！ 战车啊，狂奔吧！ 勇士啊，就是紧握盾牌的古实人和弗人， 以及拉弓的吕底亚人哪，上阵吧！
verses.textZhCnvs: 马匹啊，上前吧！ 战车啊，狂奔吧！ 勇士啊，就是紧握盾牌的古实人和弗人， 以及拉弓的吕底亚人哪，上阵吧！
verses.textZhCuv: 马匹上去吧！ 车辆急行吧！ 勇士，就是手拿盾牌的古实人和弗人 ， 并拉弓的路德族，都出去吧！
verses.textEnNiv: Charge, you horses! Drive furiously, you charioteers! March on, you warriors—men of Cush and Put who carry shields, men of Lydia who draw the bow.
verses.textEnEsv: Advance, O horses, and rage, O chariots! Let the warriors go out: men of Cush and Put who handle the shield, men of Lud, skilled in handling the bow.
verses.textEnNkjv: Come up, O horses, and rage, O chariots! And let the mighty men come forth: The Ethiopians and the Libyans who handle the shield, And the Lydians who handle and bend the bow.
verses.textEnNlt: Charge, you horses and chariots; attack, you mighty warriors of Egypt! Come, all you allies from Ethiopia, Libya, and Lydia who are skilled with the shield and bow!
verses.textEnNasb: Go up, you horses, and drive wildly, you chariots, So that the warriors may march forward: Cush and Put, who handle the shield, And the Lydians, who handle and bend the bow.
verses.textEn: Charge, you horses! Drive furiously, you charioteers! March on, you warriors—men of Cush and Put who carry shields, men of Lydia who draw the bow.

verses.textZh: 那是主万军之耶和华的日子， 是报仇的日子， 他要向自己的敌人报仇； 刀剑必吞噬、饱餐他们的肉， 痛饮他们的血。 因为在北方，靠近幼发拉底河之地， 主万军之耶和华要屠宰敌人像杀祭牲一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那是主万军之耶和华的日子， 是报仇的日子， 他要向自己的敌人报仇； 刀剑必吞噬、饱餐他们的肉， 痛饮他们的血。 因为在北方，靠近幼发拉底河之地， 主万军之耶和华要屠宰敌人像杀祭牲一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 那日是主－万军之耶和华报仇的日子， 要向敌人报仇。 刀剑必吞吃得饱， 饮血饮足； 因为主－万军之耶和华 在北方幼发拉底河边有献祭的事。
verses.textEnNiv: But that day belongs to the Lord, the Lord Almighty— a day of vengeance, for vengeance on his foes. The sword will devour till it is satisfied, till it has quenched its thirst with blood. For the Lord, the Lord Almighty, will offer sacrifice in the land of the north by the River Euphrates.
verses.textEnEsv: That day is the day of the Lord God of hosts, a day of vengeance, to avenge himself on his foes. The sword shall devour and be sated and drink its fill of their blood. For the Lord God of hosts holds a sacrifice in the north country by the river Euphrates.
verses.textEnNkjv: For this is the day of the Lord God of hosts, A day of vengeance, That He may avenge Himself on His adversaries. The sword shall devour; It shall be satiated and made drunk with their blood; For the Lord God of hosts has a sacrifice In the north country by the River Euphrates.
verses.textEnNlt: For this is the day of the Lord, the Lord of Heaven’s Armies, a day of vengeance on his enemies. The sword will devour until it is satisfied, yes, until it is drunk with your blood! The Lord, the Lord of Heaven’s Armies, will receive a sacrifice today in the north country beside the Euphrates River.
verses.textEnNasb: For that day belongs to the Lord God of armies, A day of vengeance, so as to avenge Himself on His foes; And the sword will devour and be satisfied, And drink its fill of their blood; For there will be a slaughter for the Lord God of armies, In the land of the north at the river Euphrates.
verses.textEn: But that day belongs to the Lord, the Lord Almighty— a day of vengeance, for vengeance on his foes. The sword will devour till it is satisfied, till it has quenched its thirst with blood. For the Lord, the Lord Almighty, will offer sacrifice in the land of the north by the River Euphrates.

verses.textZh: 埃及的人民哪， 上基列去取乳香吧！ 你虽多用药物都是无效， 你必不得医治。
verses.textZhCnvs: 埃及的人民哪， 上基列去取乳香吧！ 你虽多用药物都是无效， 你必不得医治。
verses.textZhCuv: 埃及的民 哪， 可以上基列取乳香去； 你虽多服良药， 总是徒然，不得治好。
verses.textEnNiv: "Go up to Gilead and get balm, Virgin Daughter Egypt. But you try many medicines in vain; there is no healing for you.
verses.textEnEsv: Go up to Gilead, and take balm, O virgin daughter of Egypt! In vain you have used many medicines; there is no healing for you.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Go up to Gilead and take balm, O virgin, the daughter of Egypt; In vain you will use many medicines; You shall not be cured.
verses.textEnNlt: "Go up to Gilead to get medicine, O virgin daughter of Egypt! But your many treatments will bring you no healing.
verses.textEnNasb: Go up to Gilead and obtain balm, Virgin daughter of Egypt! You have used many remedies in vain; There is no healing for you.
verses.textEn: "Go up to Gilead and get balm, Virgin Daughter Egypt. But you try many medicines in vain; there is no healing for you.

verses.textZh: 列国听见你的羞耻， 大地满了你的哀号； 因为勇士和勇士相碰， 双方一同仆倒。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 列国听见你的羞耻， 大地满了你的哀号； 因为勇士和勇士相碰， 双方一同仆倒。"
verses.textZhCuv: 列国听见你的羞辱， 遍地满了你的哀声； 勇士与勇士彼此相碰， 一齐跌倒。
verses.textEnNiv: The nations will hear of your shame; your cries will fill the earth. One warrior will stumble over another; both will fall down together."
verses.textEnEsv: The nations have heard of your shame, and the earth is full of your cry; for warrior has stumbled against warrior; they have both fallen together."
verses.textEnNkjv: The nations have heard of your shame, And your cry has filled the land; For the mighty man has stumbled against the mighty; They both have fallen together."
verses.textEnNlt: The nations have heard of your shame. The earth is filled with your cries of despair. Your mightiest warriors will run into each other and fall down together."
verses.textEnNasb: The nations have heard of your shame, And the earth is full of your cry of distress; For one warrior has stumbled over another, And both of them have fallen down together.
verses.textEn: The nations will hear of your shame; your cries will fill the earth. One warrior will stumble over another; both will fall down together."

verses.textZh: 以下是耶和华对耶利米先知所说的话，论到巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒要来攻打埃及地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以下是耶和华对耶利米先知所说的话，论到巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒要来攻打埃及地。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华对先知耶利米所说的话，论到巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒要来攻击埃及地：
verses.textEnNiv: This is the message the Lord spoke to Jeremiah the prophet about the coming of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon to attack Egypt:
verses.textEnEsv: The word that the Lord spoke to Jeremiah the prophet about the coming of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon to strike the land of Egypt:
verses.textEnNkjv: The word that the Lord spoke to Jeremiah the prophet, how Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon would come and strike the land of Egypt.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord gave the prophet Jeremiah this message about King Nebuchadnezzar’s plans to attack Egypt.
verses.textEnNasb: This is the message which the Lord spoke to Jeremiah the prophet about the coming of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon to strike the land of Egypt:
verses.textEn: This is the message the Lord spoke to Jeremiah the prophet about the coming of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon to attack Egypt:

verses.textZh: "你们要在埃及传扬，在密夺宣告， 在挪弗和答比匿宣扬，说： ‘要站好岗位，作好准备， 因为刀剑要吞灭你周围的人！’
verses.textZhCnvs: "你们要在埃及传扬，在密夺宣告， 在挪弗和答比匿宣扬，说： ‘要站好岗位，作好准备， 因为刀剑要吞灭你周围的人！’
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要传扬在埃及，宣告在密夺， 报告在挪弗、答比匿说： 要站起出队，自作准备， 因为刀剑在你四围施行吞灭的事。
verses.textEnNiv: "Announce this in Egypt, and proclaim it in Migdol; proclaim it also in Memphis and Tahpanhes: ‘Take your positions and get ready, for the sword devours those around you.’
verses.textEnEsv: "Declare in Egypt, and proclaim in Migdol; proclaim in Memphis and Tahpanhes; say, ‘Stand ready and be prepared, for the sword shall devour around you.’
verses.textEnNkjv: "Declare in Egypt, and proclaim in Migdol; Proclaim in Noph and in Tahpanhes; Say, ‘Stand fast and prepare yourselves, For the sword devours all around you.’
verses.textEnNlt: "Shout it out in Egypt! Publish it in the cities of Migdol, Memphis, and Tahpanhes! Mobilize for battle, for the sword will devour everyone around you.
verses.textEnNasb: "Declare in Egypt and proclaim in Migdol, Proclaim also in Memphis and Tahpanhes; Say, ‘Take your stand and get yourself ready, For the sword has devoured those around you.’
verses.textEn: "Announce this in Egypt, and proclaim it in Migdol; proclaim it also in Memphis and Tahpanhes: ‘Take your positions and get ready, for the sword devours those around you.’

verses.textZh: 你的壮士为甚么俯伏？ 他们站立不住 ，是因耶和华把他们推倒了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你的壮士为甚么俯伏？ 他们站立不住 ，是因耶和华把他们推倒了。
verses.textZhCuv: 你的壮士为何被冲去呢？ 他们站立不住； 因为耶和华驱逐他们，
verses.textEnNiv: Why will your warriors be laid low? They cannot stand, for the Lord will push them down.
verses.textEnEsv: Why are your mighty ones face down? They do not stand because the Lord thrust them down.
verses.textEnNkjv: Why are your valiant men swept away? They did not stand Because the Lord drove them away.
verses.textEnNlt: Why have your warriors fallen? They cannot stand, for the Lord has knocked them down.
verses.textEnNasb: "Why have your powerful ones been cut down? They do not stand because the Lord has thrust them away.
verses.textEn: Why will your warriors be laid low? They cannot stand, for the Lord will push them down.

verses.textZh: 他使众人绊跌，倒在一起； 他们说： ‘起来！我们要回到我们本族， 和我们出生之地那里去， 躲避欺压者的刀剑。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 他使众人绊跌，倒在一起； 他们说： ‘起来！我们要回到我们本族， 和我们出生之地那里去， 躲避欺压者的刀剑。’
verses.textZhCuv: 使多人绊跌； 他们也彼此撞倒，说： 起来吧！我们再往本民本地去， 好躲避欺压的刀剑。
verses.textEnNiv: They will stumble repeatedly; they will fall over each other. They will say, ‘Get up, let us go back to our own people and our native lands, away from the sword of the oppressor.’
verses.textEnEsv: He made many stumble, and they fell, and they said one to another, ‘Arise, and let us go back to our own people and to the land of our birth, because of the sword of the oppressor.’
verses.textEnNkjv: He made many fall; Yes, one fell upon another. And they said, ‘Arise! Let us go back to our own people And to the land of our nativity From the oppressing sword.’
verses.textEnNlt: They stumble and fall over each other and say among themselves, ‘Come, let’s go back to our people, to the land of our birth. Let’s get away from the sword of the enemy!’
verses.textEnNasb: "They have repeatedly stumbled; Indeed, they have fallen, one against another. Then they said, ‘Get up, and let’s go back To our own people and our native land, Away from the sword of the oppressor!’
verses.textEn: They will stumble repeatedly; they will fall over each other. They will say, ‘Get up, let us go back to our own people and our native lands, away from the sword of the oppressor.’

verses.textZh: 他们在那里喊叫： ‘埃及王法老不过是喧哗的声音； 他已失去机会。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们在那里喊叫： ‘埃及王法老不过是喧哗的声音； 他已失去机会。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们在那里喊叫说： 埃及王法老不过是个声音 ； 他已错过所定的时候了。
verses.textEnNiv: There they will exclaim, ‘Pharaoh king of Egypt is only a loud noise; he has missed his opportunity.’
verses.textEnEsv: Call the name of Pharaoh, king of Egypt, ‘Noisy one who lets the hour go by.’
verses.textEnNkjv: They cried there, ‘Pharaoh, king of Egypt, isbut a noise. He has passed by the appointed time!’
verses.textEnNlt: There they will say, ‘Pharaoh, the king of Egypt, is a loudmouth who missed his opportunity!’
verses.textEnNasb: " They shouted there, ‘Pharaoh king of Egypt is nothing but a big noise; He has let the appointed time pass by!’
verses.textEn: There they will exclaim, ‘Pharaoh king of Egypt is only a loud noise; he has missed his opportunity.’

verses.textZh: 名叫万军之耶和华的王宣告说： "我指着我的永生起誓， 必有一位要来， 像群山中的他泊山， 像海边的迦密山一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 名叫万军之耶和华的王宣告说： "我指着我的永生起誓， 必有一位要来， 像群山中的他泊山， 像海边的迦密山一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 君王－名为万军之耶和华的说： 我指着我的永生起誓： 尼布甲尼撒 来的势派 必像他泊在众山之中， 像迦密在海边一样。
verses.textEnNiv: "As surely as I live," declares the King, whose name is the Lord Almighty, "one will come who is like Tabor among the mountains, like Carmel by the sea.
verses.textEnEsv: "As I live, declares the King, whose name is the Lord of hosts, like Tabor among the mountains and like Carmel by the sea, shall one come.
verses.textEnNkjv: "As I live," says the King, Whose name is the Lord of hosts, "Surely as Tabor is among the mountains And as Carmel by the sea, so he shall come.
verses.textEnNlt: "As surely as I live," says the King, whose name is the Lord of Heaven’s Armies, "one is coming against Egypt who is as tall as Mount Tabor, or as Mount Carmel by the sea!
verses.textEnNasb: "As I live," declares the King, Whose name is the Lord of armies, "One certainly shall come who is like Tabor among the mountains, Or like Carmel by the sea.
verses.textEn: "As surely as I live," declares the King, whose name is the Lord Almighty, "one will come who is like Tabor among the mountains, like Carmel by the sea.

verses.textZh: 住在埃及的人民哪！ 要为自己预备被掳时所需的器物； 因为挪弗必成为荒场， 必被烧毁，无人居住。
verses.textZhCnvs: 住在埃及的人民哪！ 要为自己预备被掳时所需的器物； 因为挪弗必成为荒场， 必被烧毁，无人居住。
verses.textZhCuv: 住在埃及的民哪 ， 要预备掳去时所用的物件； 因为挪弗必成为荒场， 且被烧毁，无人居住。
verses.textEnNiv: Pack your belongings for exile, you who live in Egypt, for Memphis will be laid waste and lie in ruins without inhabitant.
verses.textEnEsv: Prepare yourselves baggage for exile, O inhabitants of Egypt! For Memphis shall become a waste, a ruin, without inhabitant.
verses.textEnNkjv: O you daughter dwelling in Egypt, Prepare yourself to go into captivity! For Noph shall be waste and desolate, without inhabitant.
verses.textEnNlt: Pack up! Get ready to leave for exile, you citizens of Egypt! The city of Memphis will be destroyed, without a single inhabitant.
verses.textEnNasb: "Make your baggage ready for exile, Daughter living in Egypt, For Memphis will become a desolation; It will be destroyed and deprived of inhabitants.
verses.textEn: Pack your belongings for exile, you who live in Egypt, for Memphis will be laid waste and lie in ruins without inhabitant.

verses.textZh: 埃及是一头肥美的母牛犊， 但北方的牛虫已经来到牠身上 。
verses.textZhCnvs: 埃及是一头肥美的母牛犊， 但北方的牛虫已经来到牠身上 。
verses.textZhCuv: 埃及是肥美的母牛犊； 但出于北方的毁灭 来到了！来到了！
verses.textEnNiv: "Egypt is a beautiful heifer, but a gadfly is coming against her from the north.
verses.textEnEsv: "A beautiful heifer is Egypt, but a biting fly from the north has come upon her.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Egypt is a very pretty heifer, But destruction comes, it comes from the north.
verses.textEnNlt: Egypt is as sleek as a beautiful heifer, but a horsefly from the north is on its way!
verses.textEnNasb: "Egypt is a pretty heifer, But a horsefly is coming from the north—it is coming!
verses.textEn: "Egypt is a beautiful heifer, but a gadfly is coming against her from the north.

verses.textZh: 它中间的雇佣兵像棚里的肥牛犊， 他们一同转身逃跑， 没有一个站立得住； 因为他们遭灾的日子、受惩罚的时候， 已经临到他们身上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 它中间的雇佣兵像棚里的肥牛犊， 他们一同转身逃跑， 没有一个站立得住； 因为他们遭灾的日子、受惩罚的时候， 已经临到他们身上。
verses.textZhCuv: 其中的雇勇好像圈里的肥牛犊， 他们转身退后， 一齐逃跑，站立不住； 因为他们遭难的日子、 追讨的时候已经临到。
verses.textEnNiv: The mercenaries in her ranks are like fattened calves. They too will turn and flee together, they will not stand their ground, for the day of disaster is coming upon them, the time for them to be punished.
verses.textEnEsv: Even her hired soldiers in her midst are like fattened calves; yes, they have turned and fled together; they did not stand, for the day of their calamity has come upon them, the time of their punishment.
verses.textEnNkjv: Also her mercenaries are in her midst like fat bulls, For they also are turned back, They have fled away together. They did not stand, For the day of their calamity had come upon them, The time of their punishment.
verses.textEnNlt: Egypt’s mercenaries have become like fattened calves. They, too, will turn and run, for it is a day of great disaster for Egypt, a time of great punishment.
verses.textEnNasb: "Also her mercenaries in her midst Are like fattened calves, For they too have turned away and have fled together; They did not stand their ground. For the day of their disaster has come upon them, The time of their punishment.
verses.textEn: The mercenaries in her ranks are like fattened calves. They too will turn and flee together, they will not stand their ground, for the day of disaster is coming upon them, the time for them to be punished.

verses.textZh: 它逃走的声音像蛇行的响声， 因为敌人要成队而来， 像砍伐树木的，拿着斧子前来攻击它。
verses.textZhCnvs: 它逃走的声音像蛇行的响声， 因为敌人要成队而来， 像砍伐树木的，拿着斧子前来攻击它。
verses.textZhCuv: 其中的声音好像蛇行一样。 敌人要成队而来，如砍伐树木的手拿斧子攻击他。
verses.textEnNiv: Egypt will hiss like a fleeing serpent as the enemy advances in force; they will come against her with axes, like men who cut down trees.
verses.textEnEsv: "She makes a sound like a serpent gliding away; for her enemies march in force and come against her with axes like those who fell trees.
verses.textEnNkjv: Her noise shall go like a serpent, For they shall march with an army And come against her with axes, Like those who chop wood.
verses.textEnNlt: Egypt flees, silent as a serpent gliding away. The invading army marches in; they come against her with axes like woodsmen.
verses.textEnNasb: "Its sound moves along like a serpent; For they move on like an army And come to her as woodcutters with axes.
verses.textEn: Egypt will hiss like a fleeing serpent as the enemy advances in force; they will come against her with axes, like men who cut down trees.

verses.textZh: 他们要砍伐它的森林。 这是耶和华的宣告； 它的森林虽然茂密难以通过， 但敌人比蝗虫还多，无法数算。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们要砍伐它的森林。 这是耶和华的宣告； 它的森林虽然茂密难以通过， 但敌人比蝗虫还多，无法数算。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华说： 埃及的树林虽然不能寻察 ， 敌人却要砍伐， 因他们多于蝗虫，不可胜数。
verses.textEnNiv: They will chop down her forest," declares the Lord , "dense though it be. They are more numerous than locusts, they cannot be counted.
verses.textEnEsv: They shall cut down her forest, declares the Lord , though it is impenetrable, because they are more numerous than locusts; they are without number.
verses.textEnNkjv: "They shall cut down her forest," says the Lord, "Though it cannot be searched, Because they are innumerable, And more numerous than grasshoppers.
verses.textEnNlt: They will cut down her people like trees," says the Lord , "for they are more numerous than locusts.
verses.textEnNasb: "They have cut down her forest," declares the Lord; "Certainly it will no longer be found, Even though they are more numerous than locusts And are without number.
verses.textEn: They will chop down her forest," declares the Lord , "dense though it be. They are more numerous than locusts, they cannot be counted.

verses.textZh: 埃及的人民必蒙羞受辱， 必交在北方的民族的手中。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 埃及的人民必蒙羞受辱， 必交在北方的民族的手中。"
verses.textZhCuv: 埃及的民 必然蒙羞， 必交在北方人的手中。
verses.textEnNiv: Daughter Egypt will be put to shame, given into the hands of the people of the north."
verses.textEnEsv: The daughter of Egypt shall be put to shame; she shall be delivered into the hand of a people from the north."
verses.textEnNkjv: The daughter of Egypt shall be ashamed; She shall be delivered into the hand Of the people of the north."
verses.textEnNlt: Egypt will be humiliated; she will be handed over to people from the north."
verses.textEnNasb: "The daughter of Egypt has been put to shame, Turned over to the power of the people of the north."
verses.textEn: Daughter Egypt will be put to shame, given into the hands of the people of the north."

verses.textZh: 万军之耶和华以色列的神说："看哪！我必惩罚挪的亚扪神、法老和那些倚靠法老的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 万军之耶和华以色列的神说："看哪！我必惩罚挪的亚扪神、法老和那些倚靠法老的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 万军之耶和华－以色列的神说：「我必刑罚挪的亚扪 和法老，并埃及与埃及的神，以及君王，也必刑罚法老和倚靠他的人。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord Almighty, the God of Israel, says: "I am about to bring punishment on Amon god of Thebes, on Pharaoh, on Egypt and her gods and her kings, and on those who rely on Pharaoh.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord of hosts, the God of Israel, said: "Behold, I am bringing punishment upon Amon of Thebes, and Pharaoh and Egypt and her gods and her kings, upon Pharaoh and those who trust in him.
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord of hosts, the God of Israel, says: "Behold, I will bring punishment on Amon of No, and Pharaoh and Egypt, with their gods and their kings—Pharaoh and those who trust in him.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord of Heaven’s Armies, the God of Israel, says: "I will punish Amon, the god of Thebes, and all the other gods of Egypt. I will punish its rulers and Pharaoh, too, and all who trust in him.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord of armies, the God of Israel says: "Behold, I am going to punish Amon of Thebes, and Pharaoh, and Egypt along with her gods and her kings, indeed, Pharaoh and those who trust in him.
verses.textEn: The Lord Almighty, the God of Israel, says: "I am about to bring punishment on Amon god of Thebes, on Pharaoh, on Egypt and her gods and her kings, and on those who rely on Pharaoh.

verses.textZh: 我必把他们交在那些寻索他们性命的人的手里，就是交在巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒和他的臣仆的手中。但以后，埃及必再有人居住，像从前一样。"这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必把他们交在那些寻索他们性命的人的手里，就是交在巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒和他的臣仆的手中。但以后，埃及必再有人居住，像从前一样。"这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 我要将他们交付寻索其命之人的手和巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒与他臣仆的手；以后埃及必再有人居住，与从前一样。这是耶和华说的。」
verses.textEnNiv: I will give them into the hands of those who want to kill them—Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon and his officers. Later, however, Egypt will be inhabited as in times past," declares the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: I will deliver them into the hand of those who seek their life, into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon and his officers. Afterward Egypt shall be inhabited as in the days of old, declares the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: And I will deliver them into the hand of those who seek their lives, into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon and the hand of his servants. Afterward it shall be inhabited as in the days of old," says the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: I will hand them over to those who want them killed—to King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylon and his army. But afterward the land will recover from the ravages of war. I, the Lord , have spoken!
verses.textEnNasb: I shall hand them over to those who are seeking their lives, that is, to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon and to his officers. Afterward, however, it will be inhabited as in the days of old," declares the Lord.
verses.textEn: I will give them into the hands of those who want to kill them—Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon and his officers. Later, however, Egypt will be inhabited as in times past," declares the Lord .

verses.textZh: "至于你，我的仆人雅各啊！你不要惧怕。 以色列啊！你不要惊慌。 因为我必从远方拯救你回来， 从被掳之地必拯救你的后裔脱离他们被掳之地。 雅各必归回，得享平静安逸， 没有人可以使他害怕。
verses.textZhCnvs: "至于你，我的仆人雅各啊！你不要惧怕。 以色列啊！你不要惊慌。 因为我必从远方拯救你回来， 从被掳之地必拯救你的后裔脱离他们被掳之地。 雅各必归回，得享平静安逸， 没有人可以使他害怕。
verses.textZhCuv: 我的仆人雅各啊，不要惧怕！ 以色列啊，不要惊惶！ 因我要从远方拯救你， 从被掳到之地拯救你的后裔。 雅各必回来，得享平靖安逸， 无人使他害怕。
verses.textEnNiv: "Do not be afraid, Jacob my servant; do not be dismayed, Israel. I will surely save you out of a distant place, your descendants from the land of their exile. Jacob will again have peace and security, and no one will make him afraid.
verses.textEnEsv: "But fear not, O Jacob my servant, nor be dismayed, O Israel, for behold, I will save you from far away, and your offspring from the land of their captivity. Jacob shall return and have quiet and ease, and none shall make him afraid.
verses.textEnNkjv: "But do not fear, O My servant Jacob, And do not be dismayed, O Israel! For behold, I will save you from afar, And your offspring from the land of their captivity; Jacob shall return, have rest and be at ease; No one shall make him afraid.
verses.textEnNlt: "But do not be afraid, Jacob, my servant; do not be dismayed, Israel. For I will bring you home again from distant lands, and your children will return from their exile. Israel will return to a life of peace and quiet, and no one will terrorize them.
verses.textEnNasb: "But as for you, Jacob My servant, do not fear, Nor be dismayed, Israel! For, see, I am going to save you from far away, And your descendants from the land of their captivity; And Jacob will return and be undisturbed And secure, with no one making him afraid.
verses.textEn: "Do not be afraid, Jacob my servant; do not be dismayed, Israel. I will surely save you out of a distant place, your descendants from the land of their exile. Jacob will again have peace and security, and no one will make him afraid.

verses.textZh: 我的仆人雅各啊！你不要惧怕。 因为我与你同在； 我要消灭我赶逐你去的列国。 却必不消灭你。 我要按公正惩治你， 决不能免你受罚。" 这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的仆人雅各啊！你不要惧怕。 因为我与你同在； 我要消灭我赶逐你去的列国。 却必不消灭你。 我要按公正惩治你， 决不能免你受罚。" 这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 我的仆人雅各啊，不要惧怕！ 因我与你同在。 我要将我所赶你到的那些国灭绝净尽， 却不将你灭绝净尽， 倒要从宽惩治你， 万不能不罚你 。 这是耶和华说的。
verses.textEnNiv: Do not be afraid, Jacob my servant, for I am with you," declares the Lord . "Though I completely destroy all the nations among which I scatter you, I will not completely destroy you. I will discipline you but only in due measure; I will not let you go entirely unpunished."
verses.textEnEsv: Fear not, O Jacob my servant, declares the Lord , for I am with you. I will make a full end of all the nations to which I have driven you, but of you I will not make a full end. I will discipline you in just measure, and I will by no means leave you unpunished."
verses.textEnNkjv: Do not fear, O Jacob My servant," says the Lord, "For I am with you; For I will make a complete end of all the nations To which I have driven you, But I will not make a complete end of you. I will rightly correct you, For I will not leave you wholly unpunished."
verses.textEnNlt: Do not be afraid, Jacob, my servant, for I am with you," says the Lord . "I will completely destroy the nations to which I have exiled you, but I will not completely destroy you. I will discipline you, but with justice; I cannot let you go unpunished."
verses.textEnNasb: "Jacob My servant, do not fear," declares the Lord, "For I am with you. For I will make a complete destruction of all the nations Where I have driven you, Yet I will not make a complete destruction of you; But I will correct you properly And by no means leave you unpunished."
verses.textEn: Do not be afraid, Jacob my servant, for I am with you," declares the Lord . "Though I completely destroy all the nations among which I scatter you, I will not completely destroy you. I will discipline you but only in due measure; I will not let you go entirely unpunished."

verses.textZh: 在法老攻击迦萨以先，耶和华论到非利士人的话临到耶利米先知。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在法老攻击迦萨以先，耶和华论到非利士人的话临到耶利米先知。
verses.textZhCuv: 法老攻击迦萨之先，有耶和华论非利士人的话临到先知耶利米。
verses.textEnNiv: This is the word of the Lord that came to Jeremiah the prophet concerning the Philistines before Pharaoh attacked Gaza:
verses.textEnEsv: The word of the Lord that came to Jeremiah the prophet concerning the Philistines, before Pharaoh struck down Gaza.
verses.textEnNkjv: The word of the Lord that came to Jeremiah the prophet against the Philistines, before Pharaoh attacked Gaza.
verses.textEnNlt: This is the Lord ’s message to the prophet Jeremiah concerning the Philistines of Gaza, before it was captured by the Egyptian army.
verses.textEnNasb: The word of the Lord that came to Jeremiah the prophet concerning the Philistines, before Pharaoh conquered Gaza.
verses.textEn: This is the word of the Lord that came to Jeremiah the prophet concerning the Philistines before Pharaoh attacked Gaza:

verses.textZh: 耶和华这样说： "看哪！有水从北方涨起， 成为一股泛滥的洪流， 淹没大地和地上的一切， 淹没城镇和住在城中的居民。 人必呼喊， 地上所有的居民必哀号。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华这样说： "看哪！有水从北方涨起， 成为一股泛滥的洪流， 淹没大地和地上的一切， 淹没城镇和住在城中的居民。 人必呼喊， 地上所有的居民必哀号。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华如此说： 有水从北方发起，成为涨溢的河， 要涨过遍地和其中所有的， 并城和其中所住的。 人必呼喊； 境内的居民都必哀号。
verses.textEnNiv: This is what the Lord says: "See how the waters are rising in the north; they will become an overflowing torrent. They will overflow the land and everything in it, the towns and those who live in them. The people will cry out; all who dwell in the land will wail
verses.textEnEsv: "Thus says the Lord : Behold, waters are rising out of the north, and shall become an overflowing torrent; they shall overflow the land and all that fills it, the city and those who dwell in it. Men shall cry out, and every inhabitant of the land shall wail.
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus says the Lord: "Behold, waters rise out of the north, And shall be an overflowing flood; They shall overflow the land and all that is in it, The city and those who dwell within; Then the men shall cry, And all the inhabitants of the land shall wail.
verses.textEnNlt: This is what the Lord says: "A flood is coming from the north to overflow the land. It will destroy the land and everything in it— cities and people alike. People will scream in terror, and everyone in the land will wail.
verses.textEnNasb: This is what the Lord says: "Behold, waters are going to rise from the north And become an overflowing torrent, And overflow the land and everything that is in it, The city and those who live in it; And the people will cry out, And every inhabitant of the land will wail.
verses.textEn: This is what the Lord says: "See how the waters are rising in the north; they will become an overflowing torrent. They will overflow the land and everything in it, the towns and those who live in them. The people will cry out; all who dwell in the land will wail

verses.textZh: 因为听见战马的蹄声， 还有战车辚辚和车轮辘辘的响声， 作父亲的双手酸软无力， 不能照顾他们的儿女。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为听见战马的蹄声， 还有战车辚辚和车轮辘辘的响声， 作父亲的双手酸软无力， 不能照顾他们的儿女。
verses.textZhCuv: 听见敌人壮马蹄跳的响声 和战车隆隆、车轮轰轰； 为父的手就发软， 不回头看顾儿女。
verses.textEnNiv: at the sound of the hooves of galloping steeds, at the noise of enemy chariots and the rumble of their wheels. Parents will not turn to help their children; their hands will hang limp.
verses.textEnEsv: At the noise of the stamping of the hoofs of his stallions, at the rushing of his chariots, at the rumbling of their wheels, the fathers look not back to their children, so feeble are their hands,
verses.textEnNkjv: At the noise of the stamping hooves of his strong horses, At the rushing of his chariots, At the rumbling of his wheels, The fathers will not look back for their children, Lacking courage,
verses.textEnNlt: Hear the clatter of stallions’ hooves and the rumble of wheels as the chariots rush by. Terrified fathers run madly, without a backward glance at their helpless children.
verses.textEnNasb: "Because of the noise of the galloping hoofs of his stallions, The roar of his chariots, and the rumbling of his wheels, The fathers have not turned back for their children, Because of the debility of their hands,
verses.textEn: at the sound of the hooves of galloping steeds, at the noise of enemy chariots and the rumble of their wheels. Parents will not turn to help their children; their hands will hang limp.

verses.textZh: 日子将到，非利士人必全遭毁灭， 所有曾援助推罗和西顿仍然幸存的人必被剪除， 因为耶和华要毁灭非利士人， 就是迦斐托岛余剩的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 日子将到，非利士人必全遭毁灭， 所有曾援助推罗和西顿仍然幸存的人必被剪除， 因为耶和华要毁灭非利士人， 就是迦斐托岛余剩的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为日子将到， 要毁灭一切非利士人， 剪除帮助泰尔、西顿所剩下的人。 原来耶和华必毁灭非利士人， 就是迦斐托海岛余剩的人。
verses.textEnNiv: For the day has come to destroy all the Philistines and to remove all survivors who could help Tyre and Sidon. The Lord is about to destroy the Philistines, the remnant from the coasts of Caphtor.
verses.textEnEsv: because of the day that is coming to destroy all the Philistines, to cut off from Tyre and Sidon every helper that remains. For the Lord is destroying the Philistines, the remnant of the coastland of Caphtor.
verses.textEnNkjv: Because of the day that comes to plunder all the Philistines, To cut off from Tyre and Sidon every helper who remains; For the Lord shall plunder the Philistines, The remnant of the country of Caphtor.
verses.textEnNlt: "The time has come for the Philistines to be destroyed, along with their allies from Tyre and Sidon. Yes, the Lord is destroying the remnant of the Philistines, those colonists from the island of Crete.
verses.textEnNasb: Because of the day that is coming To destroy all the Philistines, To eliminate from Tyre and Sidon Every surviving ally; For the Lord is going to destroy the Philistines, The remnant of the coastland of Caphtor.
verses.textEn: For the day has come to destroy all the Philistines and to remove all survivors who could help Tyre and Sidon. The Lord is about to destroy the Philistines, the remnant from the coasts of Caphtor.

verses.textZh: 迦萨成了秃头的， 亚实基伦静默无声 ， 在它们的平原上 余剩的人哪， 你们划伤自己的身体要到几时呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 迦萨成了秃头的， 亚实基伦静默无声 ， 在它们的平原上 余剩的人哪， 你们划伤自己的身体要到几时呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 迦萨成了光秃； 平原中所剩的亚实基伦归于无有。 你用刀划身，要到几时呢？
verses.textEnNiv: Gaza will shave her head in mourning; Ashkelon will be silenced. You remnant on the plain, how long will you cut yourselves?
verses.textEnEsv: Baldness has come upon Gaza; Ashkelon has perished. O remnant of their valley, how long will you gash yourselves?
verses.textEnNkjv: Baldness has come upon Gaza, Ashkelon is cut off With the remnant of their valley. How long will you cut yourself?
verses.textEnNlt: Gaza will be humiliated, its head shaved bald; Ashkelon will lie silent. You remnant from the Mediterranean coast, how long will you cut yourselves in mourning?
verses.textEnNasb: "Baldness has come upon Gaza; Ashkelon has been destroyed. Remnant of their valley, How long will you gash yourself?
verses.textEn: Gaza will shave her head in mourning; Ashkelon will be silenced. You remnant on the plain, how long will you cut yourselves?

verses.textZh: 耶和华的刀剑哪， 你要到几时才可停下来呢？ 请你入鞘吧！ 休息静止吧！
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的刀剑哪， 你要到几时才可停下来呢？ 请你入鞘吧！ 休息静止吧！
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的刀剑哪，你到几时才止息呢？ 你要入鞘，安靖不动。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘Alas, sword of the Lord , how long till you rest? Return to your sheath; cease and be still.’
verses.textEnEsv: Ah, sword of the Lord ! How long till you are quiet? Put yourself into your scabbard; rest and be still!
verses.textEnNkjv: "O you sword of the Lord, How long until you are quiet? Put yourself up into your scabbard, Rest and be still!
verses.textEnNlt: "Now, O sword of the Lord , when will you be at rest again? Go back into your sheath; rest and be still.
verses.textEnNasb: "Ah, sword of the Lord, How long will you not be quiet? Withdraw into your sheath; Rest and stay still.
verses.textEn: " ‘Alas, sword of the Lord , how long till you rest? Return to your sheath; cease and be still.’

verses.textZh: 但耶和华既吩咐了它， 又怎能停下来呢？ 他指派了它去攻击亚实基伦和沿海一带。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但耶和华既吩咐了它， 又怎能停下来呢？ 他指派了它去攻击亚实基伦和沿海一带。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华既吩咐你攻击亚实基伦和海边之地， 他已经派定你，焉能止息呢？
verses.textEnNiv: But how can it rest when the Lord has commanded it, when he has ordered it to attack Ashkelon and the coast?"
verses.textEnEsv: How can it be quiet when the Lord has given it a charge? Against Ashkelon and against the seashore he has appointed it."
verses.textEnNkjv: How can it be quiet, Seeing the Lord has given it a charge Against Ashkelon and against the seashore? There He has appointed it."
verses.textEnNlt: "But how can it be still when the Lord has sent it on a mission? For the city of Ashkelon and the people living along the sea must be destroyed."
verses.textEnNasb: "How can it be quiet, When the Lord has given it an order? Against Ashkelon and against the sea shore— There He has summoned it."
verses.textEn: But how can it rest when the Lord has commanded it, when he has ordered it to attack Ashkelon and the coast?"

verses.textZh: 论到摩押， 万军之耶和华以色列的神这样说： "尼波有祸了！因为它变为荒凉； 基列亭蒙受羞辱，被占领了； 这城堡 蒙受羞辱，被毁坏。
verses.textZhCnvs: 论到摩押， 万军之耶和华以色列的神这样说： "尼波有祸了！因为它变为荒凉； 基列亭蒙受羞辱，被占领了； 这城堡 蒙受羞辱，被毁坏。
verses.textZhCuv: 论摩押。万军之耶和华－以色列的神如此说： 尼波有祸了！因变为荒场。 基列亭蒙羞被攻取； 米斯迦蒙羞被毁坏；
verses.textEnNiv: Concerning Moab: This is what the Lord Almighty, the God of Israel, says: "Woe to Nebo, for it will be ruined. Kiriathaim will be disgraced and captured; the stronghold will be disgraced and shattered.
verses.textEnEsv: Concerning Moab. Thus says the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel: "Woe to Nebo, for it is laid waste! Kiriathaim is put to shame, it is taken; the fortress is put to shame and broken down;
verses.textEnNkjv: Against Moab. Thus says the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel: "Woe to Nebo! For it is plundered, Kirjathaim is shamed and taken; The high stronghold is shamed and dismayed—
verses.textEnNlt: This message was given concerning Moab. This is what the Lord of Heaven’s Armies, the God of Israel, says: "What sorrow awaits the city of Nebo; it will soon lie in ruins. The city of Kiriathaim will be humiliated and captured; the fortress will be humiliated and broken down.
verses.textEnNasb: Concerning Moab. This is what the Lord of armies, the God of Israel says: "Woe to Nebo, for it has been destroyed; Kiriathaim has been put to shame, it has been captured; The high stronghold has been put to shame and shattered.
verses.textEn: Concerning Moab: This is what the Lord Almighty, the God of Israel, says: "Woe to Nebo, for it will be ruined. Kiriathaim will be disgraced and captured; the stronghold will be disgraced and shattered.

verses.textZh: 摩押不再被人称赞； 敌人在希实本计谋害它，说： ‘来吧！我们要把它剪除， 使它不再成国！’ 玛得缅哪！你也要静默无声； 刀剑必追赶你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩押不再被人称赞； 敌人在希实本计谋害它，说： ‘来吧！我们要把它剪除， 使它不再成国！’ 玛得缅哪！你也要静默无声； 刀剑必追赶你。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩押不再被称赞。 有人在希实本设计谋害她，说： 来吧！我们将她剪除，不再成国。 玛得缅哪，你也必默默无声； 刀剑必追赶你。
verses.textEnNiv: Moab will be praised no more; in Heshbon people will plot her downfall: ‘Come, let us put an end to that nation.’ You, the people of Madmen, will also be silenced; the sword will pursue you.
verses.textEnEsv: the renown of Moab is no more. In Heshbon they planned disaster against her: ‘Come, let us cut her off from being a nation!’ You also, O Madmen, shall be brought to silence; the sword shall pursue you.
verses.textEnNkjv: No more praise of Moab. In Heshbon they have devised evil against her: ‘Come, and let us cut her off as a nation.’ You also shall be cut down, O Madmen! The sword shall pursue you;
verses.textEnNlt: No one will ever brag about Moab again, for in Heshbon there is a plot to destroy her. ‘Come,’ they say, ‘we will cut her off from being a nation.’ The town of Madmen, too, will be silenced; the sword will follow you there.
verses.textEnNasb: "There is no longer praise for Moab; In Heshbon they have devised disaster against her: ‘Come and let’s cut her off from being a nation!’ You too, Madmen, will be silenced; The sword will follow you.
verses.textEn: Moab will be praised no more; in Heshbon people will plot her downfall: ‘Come, let us put an end to that nation.’ You, the people of Madmen, will also be silenced; the sword will pursue you.

verses.textZh: 从何罗念传出哀号的声音，说： ‘荒凉了，大大毁灭了！’
verses.textZhCnvs: 从何罗念传出哀号的声音，说： ‘荒凉了，大大毁灭了！’
verses.textZhCuv: 从何罗念有喊荒凉大毁灭的哀声：
verses.textEnNiv: Cries of anguish arise from Horonaim, cries of great havoc and destruction.
verses.textEnEsv: "A voice! A cry from Horonaim, ‘Desolation and great destruction!’
verses.textEnNkjv: A voice of crying shallbe from Horonaim: ‘Plundering and great destruction!’
verses.textEnNlt: Listen to the cries from Horonaim, cries of devastation and great destruction.
verses.textEnNasb: "The sound of an outcry from Horonaim, ‘Devastation and great destruction!’
verses.textEn: Cries of anguish arise from Horonaim, cries of great havoc and destruction.

verses.textZh: 摩押毁灭了， 它的孩童发出哀叫 。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩押毁灭了， 它的孩童发出哀叫 。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩押毁灭了！ 她的孩童 发哀声，使人听见。
verses.textEnNiv: Moab will be broken; her little ones will cry out.
verses.textEnEsv: Moab is destroyed; her little ones have made a cry.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Moab is destroyed; Her little ones have caused a cry to be heard;
verses.textEnNlt: All Moab is destroyed. Her little ones will cry out.
verses.textEnNasb: "Moab is broken, Her little ones have sounded out a cry of distress.
verses.textEn: Moab will be broken; her little ones will cry out.

verses.textZh: 在上鲁希的路上， 摩押人随走随哭； 从何罗念下来的途中， 听见他们因城被毁发出凄惨的哀号声。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 在上鲁希的路上， 摩押人随走随哭； 从何罗念下来的途中， 听见他们因城被毁发出凄惨的哀号声。"
verses.textZhCuv: 人上鲁希坡随走随哭， 因为在何罗念的下坡听见毁灭的哀声。
verses.textEnNiv: They go up the hill to Luhith, weeping bitterly as they go; on the road down to Horonaim anguished cries over the destruction are heard.
verses.textEnEsv: For at the ascent of Luhith they go up weeping; for at the descent of Horonaim they have heard the distressed cry of destruction.
verses.textEnNkjv: For in the Ascent of Luhith they ascend with continual weeping; For in the descent of Horonaim the enemies have heard a cry of destruction.
verses.textEnNlt: Her refugees weep bitterly, climbing the slope to Luhith. They cry out in terror, descending the slope to Horonaim.
verses.textEnNasb: "For they will go up by the ascent of Luhith With continual weeping; For at the descent of Horonaim They have heard the anguished cry of destruction.
verses.textEn: They go up the hill to Luhith, weeping bitterly as they go; on the road down to Horonaim anguished cries over the destruction are heard.

verses.textZh: 你们要逃跑，赶快逃命吧！ 你们好象旷野的灌木。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要逃跑，赶快逃命吧！ 你们好象旷野的灌木。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要奔逃，自救性命， 独自居住，好像旷野的杜松。
verses.textEnNiv: Flee! Run for your lives; become like a bush in the desert.
verses.textEnEsv: Flee! Save yourselves! You will be like a juniper in the desert!
verses.textEnNkjv: "Flee, save your lives! And be like the juniper in the wilderness.
verses.textEnNlt: Flee for your lives! Hide in the wilderness!
verses.textEnNasb: "Flee, save yourselves, So that you may be like a juniper in the wilderness.
verses.textEn: Flee! Run for your lives; become like a bush in the desert.

verses.textZh: 你因为倚靠你的成就和财富， 就必被攻取； 基抹必被掳去， 事奉它的祭司和领袖都必一同被掳去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你因为倚靠你的成就和财富， 就必被攻取； 基抹必被掳去， 事奉它的祭司和领袖都必一同被掳去。
verses.textZhCuv: 你因倚靠自己所做的和自己的财宝必被攻取。 基抹和属他的祭司、首领也要一同被掳去。
verses.textEnNiv: Since you trust in your deeds and riches, you too will be taken captive, and Chemosh will go into exile, together with his priests and officials.
verses.textEnEsv: For, because you trusted in your works and your treasures, you also shall be taken; and Chemosh shall go into exile with his priests and his officials.
verses.textEnNkjv: For because you have trusted in your works and your treasures, You also shall be taken. And Chemosh shall go forth into captivity, His priests and his princes together.
verses.textEnNlt: Because you have trusted in your wealth and skill, you will be taken captive. Your god Chemosh, with his priests and officials, will be hauled off to distant lands!
verses.textEnNasb: "For because of your trust in your own achievements and treasures, You yourself will also be captured; And Chemosh will go off into exile Together with his priests and his leaders.
verses.textEn: Since you trust in your deeds and riches, you too will be taken captive, and Chemosh will go into exile, together with his priests and officials.

verses.textZh: 行毁灭的必来攻击一切城镇， 没有一座城可以幸免； 山谷必被蹂躏， 平原必受破坏， 正如耶和华所说的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 行毁灭的必来攻击一切城镇， 没有一座城可以幸免； 山谷必被蹂躏， 平原必受破坏， 正如耶和华所说的。
verses.textZhCuv: 行毁灭的必来到各城， 并无一城得免。 山谷必致败落， 平原必被毁坏； 正如耶和华所说的。
verses.textEnNiv: The destroyer will come against every town, and not a town will escape. The valley will be ruined and the plateau destroyed, because the Lord has spoken.
verses.textEnEsv: The destroyer shall come upon every city, and no city shall escape; the valley shall perish, and the plain shall be destroyed, as the Lord has spoken.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the plunderer shall come against every city; No one shall escape. The valley also shall perish, And the plain shall be destroyed, As the Lord has spoken.
verses.textEnNlt: "All the towns will be destroyed, and no one will escape— either on the plateaus or in the valleys, for the Lord has spoken.
verses.textEnNasb: "A destroyer will come to every city, So that no city will escape; The valley also will be ruined And the plateau will be destroyed, As the Lord has said.
verses.textEn: The destroyer will come against every town, and not a town will escape. The valley will be ruined and the plateau destroyed, because the Lord has spoken.

verses.textZh: 你们要在摩押上面撒盐， 因为它必成为废墟 ； 它的城镇必成为荒凉， 没有人在里面居住。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要在摩押上面撒盐， 因为它必成为废墟 ； 它的城镇必成为荒凉， 没有人在里面居住。
verses.textZhCuv: 要将翅膀给摩押， 使她可以飞去。 她的城邑必致荒凉， 无人居住。 （
verses.textEnNiv: Put salt on Moab, for she will be laid waste ; her towns will become desolate, with no one to live in them.
verses.textEnEsv: "Give wings to Moab, for she would fly away; her cities shall become a desolation, with no inhabitant in them.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Give wings to Moab, That she may flee and get away; For her cities shall be desolate, Without any to dwell in them.
verses.textEnNlt: Oh, that Moab had wings so she could fly away, for her towns will be left empty, with no one living in them.
verses.textEnNasb: "Give wings to Moab, For she will flee away; And her cities will become a desolation, Without inhabitants in them.
verses.textEn: Put salt on Moab, for she will be laid waste ; her towns will become desolate, with no one to live in them.

verses.textZh: 不努力去作耶和华的工作的，该受咒诅； 不使自己的刀剑见血的，应受咒诅。
verses.textZhCnvs: 不努力去作耶和华的工作的，该受咒诅； 不使自己的刀剑见血的，应受咒诅。
verses.textZhCuv: 懒惰为耶和华行事的，必受咒诅；禁止刀剑不经血的，必受咒诅。）
verses.textEnNiv: "A curse on anyone who is lax in doing the Lord ’s work! A curse on anyone who keeps their sword from bloodshed!
verses.textEnEsv: "Cursed is he who does the work of the Lord with slackness, and cursed is he who keeps back his sword from bloodshed.
verses.textEnNkjv: Cursed is he who does the work of the Lord deceitfully, And cursed is he who keeps back his sword from blood.
verses.textEnNlt: Cursed are those who refuse to do the Lord ’s work, who hold back their swords from shedding blood!
verses.textEnNasb: "Cursed is the one who does the Lord’s work negligently, And cursed is the one who restrains his sword from blood.
verses.textEn: "A curse on anyone who is lax in doing the Lord ’s work! A curse on anyone who keeps their sword from bloodshed!

verses.textZh: 摩押自年幼以来常享安逸， 像不受搅扰的酒在缸里澄清， 从没有倒进另一个缸里去， 它也从没有被人掳去。 因此它仍保留着原味， 它的芬芳没有改变失去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩押自年幼以来常享安逸， 像不受搅扰的酒在缸里澄清， 从没有倒进另一个缸里去， 它也从没有被人掳去。 因此它仍保留着原味， 它的芬芳没有改变失去。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩押自幼年以来常享安逸， 如酒在渣滓上澄清， 没有从这器皿倒在那器皿里， 也未曾被掳去。 因此，它的原味尚存， 香气未变。
verses.textEnNiv: "Moab has been at rest from youth, like wine left on its dregs, not poured from one jar to another— she has not gone into exile. So she tastes as she did, and her aroma is unchanged.
verses.textEnEsv: "Moab has been at ease from his youth and has settled on his dregs; he has not been emptied from vessel to vessel, nor has he gone into exile; so his taste remains in him, and his scent is not changed.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Moab has been at ease from his youth; He has settled on his dregs, And has not been emptied from vessel to vessel, Nor has he gone into captivity. Therefore his taste remained in him, And his scent has not changed.
verses.textEnNlt: "From his earliest history, Moab has lived in peace, never going into exile. He is like wine that has been allowed to settle. He has not been poured from flask to flask, and he is now fragrant and smooth.
