verses.textEnNasb: "Moab has been at ease since his youth; He has also been peaceful, like wine on its dregs, And he has not been poured from vessel to vessel, Nor has he gone into exile. Therefore he retains his flavor, And his aroma has not changed.
verses.textEn: "Moab has been at rest from youth, like wine left on its dregs, not poured from one jar to another— she has not gone into exile. So she tastes as she did, and her aroma is unchanged.

verses.textZh: "看哪！日子快到 ，我必差派倒酒的人到它那里去，把它倒出来，直至倒空，又把酒缸打碎。
verses.textZhCnvs: "看哪！日子快到 ，我必差派倒酒的人到它那里去，把它倒出来，直至倒空，又把酒缸打碎。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华说：「日子将到，我必打发倒酒的往她那里去，将她倒出来，倒空她的器皿，打碎她的坛子。
verses.textEnNiv: But days are coming," declares the Lord , "when I will send men who pour from pitchers, and they will pour her out; they will empty her pitchers and smash her jars.
verses.textEnEsv: "Therefore, behold, the days are coming, declares the Lord , when I shall send to him pourers who will pour him, and empty his vessels and break his jars in pieces.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Therefore behold, the days are coming," says the Lord, "That I shall send him wine-workers Who will tip him over And empty his vessels And break the bottles.
verses.textEnNlt: But the time is coming soon," says the Lord , "when I will send men to pour him from his jar. They will pour him out, then shatter the jar!
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore behold, the days are coming," declares the Lord, "when I will send to him those who tip vessels, and they will tip him over, and they will pour out his vessels and smash his jars.
verses.textEn: But days are coming," declares the Lord , "when I will send men who pour from pitchers, and they will pour her out; they will empty her pitchers and smash her jars.

verses.textZh: 摩押必因基抹羞愧，好象以色列家因他们可倚靠的伯特利的神像羞愧一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩押必因基抹羞愧，好象以色列家因他们可倚靠的伯特利的神像羞愧一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩押必因基抹羞愧，像以色列家从前倚靠伯特利的神羞愧一样。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Moab will be ashamed of Chemosh, as Israel was ashamed when they trusted in Bethel.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Moab shall be ashamed of Chemosh, as the house of Israel was ashamed of Bethel, their confidence.
verses.textEnNkjv: Moab shall be ashamed of Chemosh, As the house of Israel was ashamed of Bethel, their confidence.
verses.textEnNlt: At last Moab will be ashamed of his idol Chemosh, as the people of Israel were ashamed of their gold calf at Bethel.
verses.textEnNasb: And Moab will be ashamed of Chemosh, just as the house of Israel was ashamed of Bethel, their confidence.
verses.textEn: Then Moab will be ashamed of Chemosh, as Israel was ashamed when they trusted in Bethel.

verses.textZh: 你们怎么说：‘我们是勇士， 是善战的武士’？
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们怎么说：‘我们是勇士， 是善战的武士’？
verses.textZhCuv: 你们怎么说： 我们是勇士，是有勇力打仗的呢？
verses.textEnNiv: "How can you say, ‘We are warriors, men valiant in battle’?
verses.textEnEsv: "How do you say, ‘We are heroes and mighty men of war’?
verses.textEnNkjv: "How can you say, ‘We are mighty And strong men for the war’?
verses.textEnNlt: "You used to boast, ‘We are heroes, mighty men of war.’
verses.textEnNasb: "How can you say, ‘We are warriors, And men competent for battle’?
verses.textEn: "How can you say, ‘We are warriors, men valiant in battle’?

verses.textZh: 摩押被毁灭；敌人上来攻击它的城镇； 摩押最精锐的少年下去被屠杀。" 这是君王的宣告，他的名是万军之耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩押被毁灭；敌人上来攻击它的城镇； 摩押最精锐的少年下去被屠杀。" 这是君王的宣告，他的名是万军之耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩押变为荒场， 敌人上去进了她的城邑。 她所特选的少年人下去遭了杀戮； 这是君王－名为万军之耶和华说的。
verses.textEnNiv: Moab will be destroyed and her towns invaded; her finest young men will go down in the slaughter," declares the King, whose name is the Lord Almighty.
verses.textEnEsv: The destroyer of Moab and his cities has come up, and the choicest of his young men have gone down to slaughter, declares the King, whose name is the Lord of hosts.
verses.textEnNkjv: Moab is plundered and gone up from her cities; Her chosen young men have gone down to the slaughter," says the King, Whose name is the Lord of hosts.
verses.textEnNlt: But now Moab and his towns will be destroyed. His most promising youth are doomed to slaughter," says the King, whose name is the Lord of Heaven’s Armies.
verses.textEnNasb: "Moab has been destroyed and men have gone up to his cities; His choicest young men have also gone down to the slaughter," Declares the King, whose name is the Lord of armies.
verses.textEn: Moab will be destroyed and her towns invaded; her finest young men will go down in the slaughter," declares the King, whose name is the Lord Almighty.

verses.textZh: "摩押的灾难已经临近了， 它的祸患迅速来到。
verses.textZhCnvs: "摩押的灾难已经临近了， 它的祸患迅速来到。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩押的灾殃临近； 她的苦难速速来到。
verses.textEnNiv: "The fall of Moab is at hand; her calamity will come quickly.
verses.textEnEsv: The calamity of Moab is near at hand, and his affliction hastens swiftly.
verses.textEnNkjv: "The calamity of Moab is near at hand, And his affliction comes quickly.
verses.textEnNlt: "Destruction is coming fast for Moab; calamity threatens ominously.
verses.textEnNasb: "The disaster of Moab will soon come, And his catastrophe has hurried quickly.
verses.textEn: "The fall of Moab is at hand; her calamity will come quickly.

verses.textZh: 所有在它四围的， 所有认识它名的， 你们都要为它哀悼，说： ‘那有能力的权杖、 华美的杖竟然折断了！’
verses.textZhCnvs: 所有在它四围的， 所有认识它名的， 你们都要为它哀悼，说： ‘那有能力的权杖、 华美的杖竟然折断了！’
verses.textZhCuv: 凡在她四围的和认识她名的， 你们都要为她悲伤，说： 那结实的杖和那美好的棍， 何竟折断了呢？
verses.textEnNiv: Mourn for her, all who live around her, all who know her fame; say, ‘How broken is the mighty scepter, how broken the glorious staff!’
verses.textEnEsv: Grieve for him, all you who are around him, and all who know his name; say, ‘How the mighty scepter is broken, the glorious staff.’
verses.textEnNkjv: Bemoan him, all you who are around him; And all you who know his name, Say, ‘How the strong staff is broken, The beautiful rod!’
verses.textEnNlt: You friends of Moab, weep for him and cry! See how the strong scepter is broken, how the beautiful staff is shattered!
verses.textEnNasb: "Mourn for him, all you who live around him, And all of you who know his name; Say, ‘How the mighty scepter has been broken, A staff of splendor!’
verses.textEn: Mourn for her, all who live around her, all who know her fame; say, ‘How broken is the mighty scepter, how broken the glorious staff!’

verses.textZh: 住在底本的人民哪！ 要从你们荣耀的位上下来， 坐在干旱的地上 ， 因为毁灭摩押的要上来攻击你们， 摧毁你们的坚固城。
verses.textZhCnvs: 住在底本的人民哪！ 要从你们荣耀的位上下来， 坐在干旱的地上 ， 因为毁灭摩押的要上来攻击你们， 摧毁你们的坚固城。
verses.textZhCuv: 住在底本的民哪 ， 要从你荣耀的位上下来， 坐受干渴； 因毁灭摩押的上来攻击你， 毁坏了你的保障。
verses.textEnNiv: "Come down from your glory and sit on the parched ground, you inhabitants of Daughter Dibon, for the one who destroys Moab will come up against you and ruin your fortified cities.
verses.textEnEsv: "Come down from your glory, and sit on the parched ground, O inhabitant of Dibon! For the destroyer of Moab has come up against you; he has destroyed your strongholds.
verses.textEnNkjv: "O daughter inhabiting Dibon, Come down from your glory, And sit in thirst; For the plunderer of Moab has come against you, He has destroyed your strongholds.
verses.textEnNlt: "Come down from your glory and sit in the dust, you people of Dibon, for those who destroy Moab will shatter Dibon, too. They will tear down all your towers.
verses.textEnNasb: "Come down from your glory And sit on the parched ground, O daughter living in Dibon, For the destroyer of Moab has come up against you, He has ruined your strongholds.
verses.textEn: "Come down from your glory and sit on the parched ground, you inhabitants of Daughter Dibon, for the one who destroys Moab will come up against you and ruin your fortified cities.

verses.textZh: 亚罗珥的居民哪！ 要站在路旁观望， 询问那些正在逃跑的男女，说： ‘发生了甚么事？’
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚罗珥的居民哪！ 要站在路旁观望， 询问那些正在逃跑的男女，说： ‘发生了甚么事？’
verses.textZhCuv: 住亚罗珥的啊， 要站在道旁观望， 问逃避的男人和逃脱的女人说： 是什么事呢？
verses.textEnNiv: Stand by the road and watch, you who live in Aroer. Ask the man fleeing and the woman escaping, ask them, ‘What has happened?’
verses.textEnEsv: Stand by the way and watch, O inhabitant of Aroer! Ask him who flees and her who escapes; say, ‘What has happened?’
verses.textEnNkjv: O inhabitant of Aroer, Stand by the way and watch; Ask him who flees And her who escapes; Say, ‘What has happened?’
verses.textEnNlt: You people of Aroer, stand beside the road and watch. Shout to those who flee from Moab, ‘What has happened there?’
verses.textEnNasb: "Stand by the road and keep watch, You inhabitant of Aroer; Ask him who flees and her who escapes And say, ‘What has happened?’
verses.textEn: Stand by the road and watch, you who live in Aroer. Ask the man fleeing and the woman escaping, ask them, ‘What has happened?’

verses.textZh: 摩押蒙受羞辱，因为它已被毁灭了。 你们要哀号喊叫， 要在亚嫩河宣告： ‘摩押毁灭了。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩押蒙受羞辱，因为它已被毁灭了。 你们要哀号喊叫， 要在亚嫩河宣告： ‘摩押毁灭了。’
verses.textZhCuv: 摩押因毁坏蒙羞； 你们要哀号呼喊， 要在亚嫩旁报告说： 摩押变为荒场！
verses.textEnNiv: Moab is disgraced, for she is shattered. Wail and cry out! Announce by the Arnon that Moab is destroyed.
verses.textEnEsv: Moab is put to shame, for it is broken; wail and cry! Tell it beside the Arnon, that Moab is laid waste.
verses.textEnNkjv: Moab is shamed, for he is broken down. Wail and cry! Tell it in Arnon, that Moab is plundered.
verses.textEnNlt: "And the reply comes back, ‘Moab lies in ruins, disgraced; weep and wail! Tell it by the banks of the Arnon River: Moab has been destroyed!’
verses.textEnNasb: "Moab has been put to shame, for it has been shattered. Wail and cry out; Declare by the Arnon That Moab has been destroyed.
verses.textEn: Moab is disgraced, for she is shattered. Wail and cry out! Announce by the Arnon that Moab is destroyed.

verses.textZh: 审判临到了平原之地，就是何伦、雅杂、米法押、
verses.textZhCnvs: 审判临到了平原之地，就是何伦、雅杂、米法押、
verses.textZhCuv: 「刑罚临到平原之地的何伦、雅杂、米法押、
verses.textEnNiv: Judgment has come to the plateau— to Holon, Jahzah and Mephaath,
verses.textEnEsv: "Judgment has come upon the tableland, upon Holon, and Jahzah, and Mephaath,
verses.textEnNkjv: "And judgment has come on the plain country: On Holon and Jahzah and Mephaath,
verses.textEnNlt: Judgment has been poured out on the towns of the plateau— on Holon and Jahaz and Mephaath,
verses.textEnNasb: "Judgment has also come upon the plain, upon Holon, Jahzah, and against Mephaath,
verses.textEn: Judgment has come to the plateau— to Holon, Jahzah and Mephaath,

verses.textZh: 底本、尼波、伯．低比拉太音、
verses.textZhCnvs: 底本、尼波、伯．低比拉太音、
verses.textZhCuv: 底本、尼波、伯‧低比拉太音、
verses.textEnNiv: to Dibon, Nebo and Beth Diblathaim,
verses.textEnEsv: and Dibon, and Nebo, and Beth-diblathaim,
verses.textEnNkjv: On Dibon and Nebo and Beth Diblathaim,
verses.textEnNlt: on Dibon and Nebo and Beth-diblathaim,
verses.textEnNasb: against Dibon, Nebo, and Beth-diblathaim,
verses.textEn: to Dibon, Nebo and Beth Diblathaim,

verses.textZh: 基列亭、伯．迦末、伯．米恩、
verses.textZhCnvs: 基列亭、伯．迦末、伯．米恩、
verses.textZhCuv: 基列亭、伯‧迦末、伯‧米恩、
verses.textEnNiv: to Kiriathaim, Beth Gamul and Beth Meon,
verses.textEnEsv: and Kiriathaim, and Beth-gamul, and Beth-meon,
verses.textEnNkjv: On Kirjathaim and Beth Gamul and Beth Meon,
verses.textEnNlt: on Kiriathaim and Beth-gamul and Beth-meon,
verses.textEnNasb: against Kiriathaim, Beth-gamul, and Beth-meon,
verses.textEn: to Kiriathaim, Beth Gamul and Beth Meon,

verses.textZh: 加略、波斯拉和摩押地远近所有城市。
verses.textZhCnvs: 加略、波斯拉和摩押地远近所有城市。
verses.textZhCuv: 加略、波斯拉，和摩押地远近所有的城邑。
verses.textEnNiv: to Kerioth and Bozrah— to all the towns of Moab, far and near.
verses.textEnEsv: and Kerioth, and Bozrah, and all the cities of the land of Moab, far and near.
verses.textEnNkjv: On Kerioth and Bozrah, On all the cities of the land of Moab, Far or near.
verses.textEnNlt: on Kerioth and Bozrah— all the towns of Moab, far and near.
verses.textEnNasb: against Kerioth, Bozrah, and all the cities of the land of Moab, far and near.
verses.textEn: to Kerioth and Bozrah— to all the towns of Moab, far and near.

verses.textZh: 摩押的角被砍下，它的膀臂被折断了。"这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩押的角被砍下，它的膀臂被折断了。"这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩押的角砍断了，摩押的膀臂折断了。这是耶和华说的。」
verses.textEnNiv: Moab’s horn is cut off; her arm is broken," declares the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: The horn of Moab is cut off, and his arm is broken, declares the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: The horn of Moab is cut off, And his arm is broken," says the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: "The strength of Moab has ended. His arm has been broken," says the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: The horn of Moab has been cut off, and his arm broken," declares the Lord.
verses.textEn: Moab’s horn is cut off; her arm is broken," declares the Lord .

verses.textZh: 你们要使摩押沉醉，因为它向耶和华妄自尊大；摩押必跌在自己所吐之物上面，也必成为被人讥笑的对象。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要使摩押沉醉，因为它向耶和华妄自尊大；摩押必跌在自己所吐之物上面，也必成为被人讥笑的对象。
verses.textZhCuv: 「你们要使摩押沉醉，因她向耶和华夸大。她要在自己所吐之中打滚，又要被人嗤笑。
verses.textEnNiv: "Make her drunk, for she has defied the Lord . Let Moab wallow in her vomit; let her be an object of ridicule.
verses.textEnEsv: "Make him drunk, because he magnified himself against the Lord , so that Moab shall wallow in his vomit, and he too shall be held in derision.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Make him drunk, Because he exalted himself against the Lord. Moab shall wallow in his vomit, And he shall also be in derision.
verses.textEnNlt: "Let him stagger and fall like a drunkard, for he has rebelled against the Lord . Moab will wallow in his own vomit, ridiculed by all.
verses.textEnNasb: "Make him drunk, for he has become arrogant toward the Lord; so Moab will vomit, and he also will become a laughingstock.
verses.textEn: "Make her drunk, for she has defied the Lord . Let Moab wallow in her vomit; let her be an object of ridicule.

verses.textZh: 摩押啊，以色列不是曾经成为你讥笑的对象吗？它岂是被捕获的强盗，以致你每逢提到它，总是摇头嘲笑。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩押啊，以色列不是曾经成为你讥笑的对象吗？它岂是被捕获的强盗，以致你每逢提到它，总是摇头嘲笑。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩押啊，你不曾嗤笑以色列吗？她岂是在贼中查出来的呢？你每逢提到她便摇头。
verses.textEnNiv: Was not Israel the object of your ridicule? Was she caught among thieves, that you shake your head in scorn whenever you speak of her?
verses.textEnEsv: Was not Israel a derision to you? Was he found among thieves, that whenever you spoke of him you wagged your head?
verses.textEnNkjv: For was not Israel a derision to you? Was he found among thieves? For whenever you speak of him, You shake yourheadin scorn.
verses.textEnNlt: Did you not ridicule the people of Israel? Were they caught in the company of thieves that you should despise them as you do?
verses.textEnNasb: Now was Israel not a laughingstock to you? Or was he caught among thieves? For whenever you speak about him you shake your head in scorn.
verses.textEn: Was not Israel the object of your ridicule? Was she caught among thieves, that you shake your head in scorn whenever you speak of her?

verses.textZh: 摩押的居民哪！ 你们要离弃城镇，住在山岩里， 像鸽子在峡谷的边上筑巢。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩押的居民哪！ 你们要离弃城镇，住在山岩里， 像鸽子在峡谷的边上筑巢。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩押的居民哪， 要离开城邑，住在山崖里， 像鸽子在深渊口上搭窝。
verses.textEnNiv: Abandon your towns and dwell among the rocks, you who live in Moab. Be like a dove that makes its nest at the mouth of a cave.
verses.textEnEsv: "Leave the cities, and dwell in the rock, O inhabitants of Moab! Be like the dove that nests in the sides of the mouth of a gorge.
verses.textEnNkjv: You who dwell in Moab, Leave the cities and dwell in the rock, And be like the dove which makes her nest In the sides of the cave’s mouth.
verses.textEnNlt: "You people of Moab, flee from your towns and live in the caves. Hide like doves that nest in the clefts of the rocks.
verses.textEnNasb: "Leave the cities and live among the rocky cliffs, You inhabitants of Moab, And be like a dove that nests Beyond the mouth of the chasm.
verses.textEn: Abandon your towns and dwell among the rocks, you who live in Moab. Be like a dove that makes its nest at the mouth of a cave.

verses.textZh: 我们听说摩押的骄傲， 它非常骄傲； 我们听到它的狂妄、骄傲、傲慢和心里的自高。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们听说摩押的骄傲， 它非常骄傲； 我们听到它的狂妄、骄傲、傲慢和心里的自高。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们听说摩押人骄傲， 是极其骄傲； 听说他自高自傲， 并且狂妄，居心自大。
verses.textEnNiv: "We have heard of Moab’s pride— how great is her arrogance!— of her insolence, her pride, her conceit and the haughtiness of her heart.
verses.textEnEsv: We have heard of the pride of Moab— he is very proud— of his loftiness, his pride, and his arrogance, and the haughtiness of his heart.
verses.textEnNkjv: "We have heard the pride of Moab (He is exceedingly proud), Of his loftiness and arrogance and pride, And of the haughtiness of his heart."
verses.textEnNlt: We have all heard of the pride of Moab, for his pride is very great. We know of his lofty pride, his arrogance, and his haughty heart.
verses.textEnNasb: "We have heard of the pride of Moab—he is very proud— Of his haughtiness, his pride, his arrogance, and his self-exaltation.
verses.textEn: "We have heard of Moab’s pride— how great is her arrogance!— of her insolence, her pride, her conceit and the haughtiness of her heart.

verses.textZh: "我洞悉它的狂傲 ， 它的狂傲毫无根据， 它的夸耀不能成事。
verses.textZhCnvs: "我洞悉它的狂傲 ， 它的狂傲毫无根据， 它的夸耀不能成事。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华说： 我知道他的忿怒是虚空的； 他夸大的话一无所成。
verses.textEnNiv: I know her insolence but it is futile," declares the Lord , "and her boasts accomplish nothing.
verses.textEnEsv: I know his insolence, declares the Lord ; his boasts are false, his deeds are false.
verses.textEnNkjv: "I know his wrath," says the Lord, "But it is not right; His lies have made nothing right.
verses.textEnNlt: I know about his insolence," says the Lord , "but his boasts are empty— as empty as his deeds.
verses.textEnNasb: "I know his fury," declares the Lord, "But it is futile; His idle boasts have accomplished nothing.
verses.textEn: I know her insolence but it is futile," declares the Lord , "and her boasts accomplish nothing.

verses.textZh: 因此我要为摩押哀号， 为全摩押喊叫， 为吉珥．哈列设人 唉哼。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此我要为摩押哀号， 为全摩押喊叫， 为吉珥．哈列设人 唉哼。
verses.textZhCuv: 因此，我要为摩押哀号， 为摩押全地呼喊； 人必为吉珥‧哈列设人叹息。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore I wail over Moab, for all Moab I cry out, I moan for the people of Kir Hareseth.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore I wail for Moab; I cry out for all Moab; for the men of Kir-hareseth I mourn.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore I will wail for Moab, And I will cry out for all Moab; I will mourn for the men of Kir Heres.
verses.textEnNlt: So now I wail for Moab; yes, I will mourn for Moab. My heart is broken for the men of Kir-hareseth.
verses.textEnNasb: "Therefore I will wail for Moab, For all of Moab I will cry out; I will moan for the men of Kir-heres.
verses.textEn: Therefore I wail over Moab, for all Moab I cry out, I moan for the people of Kir Hareseth.

verses.textZh: 西比玛的葡萄树啊！ 我要你哀哭比人为雅谢哀哭更厉害。 你的枝子伸展过海， 延伸到雅谢 ； 那行毁灭的要来摧毁你夏天的果子和你的葡萄。
verses.textZhCnvs: 西比玛的葡萄树啊！ 我要你哀哭比人为雅谢哀哭更厉害。 你的枝子伸展过海， 延伸到雅谢 ； 那行毁灭的要来摧毁你夏天的果子和你的葡萄。
verses.textZhCuv: 西比玛的葡萄树啊，我为你哀哭， 甚于雅谢人哀哭。 你的枝子蔓延过海， 直长到雅谢海。 那行毁灭的已经临到你夏天的果子 和你所摘的葡萄。
verses.textEnNiv: I weep for you, as Jazer weeps, you vines of Sibmah. Your branches spread as far as the sea ; they reached as far as Jazer. The destroyer has fallen on your ripened fruit and grapes.
verses.textEnEsv: More than for Jazer I weep for you, O vine of Sibmah! Your branches passed over the sea, reached to the Sea of Jazer; on your summer fruits and your grapes the destroyer has fallen.
verses.textEnNkjv: O vine of Sibmah! I will weep for you with the weeping of Jazer. Your plants have gone over the sea, They reach to the sea of Jazer. The plunderer has fallen on your summer fruit and your vintage.
verses.textEnNlt: "You people of Sibmah, rich in vineyards, I will weep for you even more than I did for Jazer. Your spreading vines once reached as far as the Dead Sea, but the destroyer has stripped you bare! He has harvested your grapes and summer fruits.
verses.textEnNasb: "More than the weeping for Jazer I will weep for you, O vine of Sibmah! Your tendrils stretched across the sea, They reached to the sea of Jazer; Upon your summer fruits and your grape harvest The destroyer has fallen.
verses.textEn: I weep for you, as Jazer weeps, you vines of Sibmah. Your branches spread as far as the sea ; they reached as far as Jazer. The destroyer has fallen on your ripened fruit and grapes.

verses.textZh: 摩押肥沃的土地上不再有欢喜和快乐； 我使榨酒池不再流出酒； 再没有人欢呼踹酒； 有人呼喊，却不是踹酒的欢呼声。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩押肥沃的土地上不再有欢喜和快乐； 我使榨酒池不再流出酒； 再没有人欢呼踹酒； 有人呼喊，却不是踹酒的欢呼声。
verses.textZhCuv: 肥田和摩押地的欢喜快乐都被夺去； 我使酒榨的酒绝流， 无人踹酒欢呼； 那欢呼却变为仇敌的呐喊 。
verses.textEnNiv: Joy and gladness are gone from the orchards and fields of Moab. I have stopped the flow of wine from the presses; no one treads them with shouts of joy. Although there are shouts, they are not shouts of joy.
verses.textEnEsv: Gladness and joy have been taken away from the fruitful land of Moab; I have made the wine cease from the winepresses; no one treads them with shouts of joy; the shouting is not the shout of joy.
verses.textEnNkjv: Joy and gladness are taken From the plentiful field And from the land of Moab; I have caused wine to fail from the winepresses; No one will tread with joyous shouting— Not joyous shouting!
verses.textEnNlt: Joy and gladness are gone from fruitful Moab. The presses yield no wine. No one treads the grapes with shouts of joy. There is shouting, yes, but not of joy.
verses.textEnNasb: "So joy and rejoicing are removed From the fruitful field, and from the land of Moab. And I have eliminated the wine from the wine presses; No one will tread them with shouting, The shouting will not be shouts of joy.
verses.textEn: Joy and gladness are gone from the orchards and fields of Moab. I have stopped the flow of wine from the presses; no one treads them with shouts of joy. Although there are shouts, they are not shouts of joy.

verses.textZh: "希实本的哀叫传到以利亚利，他们发出的声音传到雅杂，从琐珥达到何罗念和伊基拉．施利施亚；因为连宁林的河水也都干涸了。
verses.textZhCnvs: "希实本的哀叫传到以利亚利，他们发出的声音传到雅杂，从琐珥达到何罗念和伊基拉．施利施亚；因为连宁林的河水也都干涸了。
verses.textZhCuv: 「希实本人发的哀声达到以利亚利，直达到雅杂；从琐珥达到何罗念，直到伊基拉‧施利施亚，因为宁林的水必然干涸。」
verses.textEnNiv: "The sound of their cry rises from Heshbon to Elealeh and Jahaz, from Zoar as far as Horonaim and Eglath Shelishiyah, for even the waters of Nimrim are dried up.
verses.textEnEsv: "From the outcry at Heshbon even to Elealeh, as far as Jahaz they utter their voice, from Zoar to Horonaim and Eglath-shelishiyah. For the waters of Nimrim also have become desolate.
verses.textEnNkjv: "From the cry of Heshbon to Elealeh and to Jahaz They have uttered their voice, From Zoar to Horonaim, Like a three-year-old heifer; For the waters of Nimrim also shall be desolate.
verses.textEnNlt: "Instead, their awful cries of terror can be heard from Heshbon clear across to Elealeh and Jahaz; from Zoar all the way to Horonaim and Eglath-shelishiyah. Even the waters of Nimrim are dried up now.
verses.textEnNasb: From the outcry at Heshbon to Elealeh, to Jahaz they have raised their voice, from Zoar to Horonaim, and to Eglath-shelishiyah; for even the waters of Nimrim will become desolate.
verses.textEn: "The sound of their cry rises from Heshbon to Elealeh and Jahaz, from Zoar as far as Horonaim and Eglath Shelishiyah, for even the waters of Nimrim are dried up.

verses.textZh: 我要灭绝在摩押那些邱坛上献祭和向他们的神烧香的。"这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要灭绝在摩押那些邱坛上献祭和向他们的神烧香的。"这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华说：「我必在摩押地使那在邱坛献祭的，和那向他的神烧香的都断绝了。
verses.textEnNiv: In Moab I will put an end to those who make offerings on the high places and burn incense to their gods," declares the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: And I will bring to an end in Moab, declares the Lord , him who offers sacrifice in the high place and makes offerings to his god.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Moreover," says the Lord, "I will cause to cease in Moab The one who offers sacrifices in the high places And burns incense to his gods.
verses.textEnNlt: "I will put an end to Moab," says the Lord , "for the people offer sacrifices at the pagan shrines and burn incense to their false gods.
verses.textEnNasb: And I will put an end to Moab," declares the Lord, "the one who offers sacrifice on the high place and the one who burns incense to his gods.
verses.textEn: In Moab I will put an end to those who make offerings on the high places and burn incense to their gods," declares the Lord .

verses.textZh: "因此，我的心为摩押呜咽，好象人用笛吹挽歌；我的心为吉珥．哈列设人呜咽，好象人用笛吹挽歌；因为他们所得的财宝都失掉了。
verses.textZhCnvs: "因此，我的心为摩押呜咽，好象人用笛吹挽歌；我的心为吉珥．哈列设人呜咽，好象人用笛吹挽歌；因为他们所得的财宝都失掉了。
verses.textZhCuv: 我心腹为摩押哀鸣如箫，我心肠为吉珥‧哈列设人也是如此，因摩押人所得的财物都灭没了。
verses.textEnNiv: "So my heart laments for Moab like the music of a pipe; it laments like a pipe for the people of Kir Hareseth. The wealth they acquired is gone.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore my heart moans for Moab like a flute, and my heart moans like a flute for the men of Kir-hareseth. Therefore the riches they gained have perished.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore My heart shall wail like flutes for Moab, And like flutes My heart shall wail For the men of Kir Heres. Therefore the riches they have acquired have perished.
verses.textEnNlt: My heart moans like a flute for Moab and Kir-hareseth, for all their wealth has disappeared.
verses.textEnNasb: "Therefore My heart makes a sound like flutes for Moab; My heart also makes a sound like flutes for the men of Kir-heres. Therefore they have lost the abundance it produced.
verses.textEn: "So my heart laments for Moab like the music of a pipe; it laments like a pipe for the people of Kir Hareseth. The wealth they acquired is gone.

verses.textZh: 他们各人的头都剃光了，胡须也剃掉了，他们割伤了自己的手，腰束麻布。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们各人的头都剃光了，胡须也剃掉了，他们割伤了自己的手，腰束麻布。
verses.textZhCuv: 「各人头上光秃，胡须剪短，手有划伤，腰束麻布。
verses.textEnNiv: Every head is shaved and every beard cut off; every hand is slashed and every waist is covered with sackcloth.
verses.textEnEsv: "For every head is shaved and every beard cut off. On all the hands are gashes, and around the waist is sackcloth.
verses.textEnNkjv: "For every head shallbe bald, and every beard clipped; On all the hands shallbe cuts, and on the loins sackcloth—
verses.textEnNlt: The people shave their heads and beards in mourning. They slash their hands and put on clothes made of burlap.
verses.textEnNasb: For every head is shaved bald, and every beard cut short; there are gashes on all the hands, and sackcloth around the waists.
verses.textEn: Every head is shaved and every beard cut off; every hand is slashed and every waist is covered with sackcloth.

verses.textZh: 摩押境内一切房顶上和广场上，处处都有哀哭的声音；因为我击碎了摩押，好象打碎没有人要的器皿。"这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩押境内一切房顶上和广场上，处处都有哀哭的声音；因为我击碎了摩押，好象打碎没有人要的器皿。"这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 在摩押的各房顶上和街市上处处有人哀哭；因我打碎摩押，好像打碎无人喜悦的器皿。这是耶和华说的。
verses.textEnNiv: On all the roofs in Moab and in the public squares there is nothing but mourning, for I have broken Moab like a jar that no one wants," declares the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: On all the housetops of Moab and in the squares there is nothing but lamentation, for I have broken Moab like a vessel for which no one cares, declares the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: A general lamentation On all the housetops of Moab, And in its streets; For I have broken Moab like a vessel in which is no pleasure," says the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: There is crying and sorrow in every Moabite home and on every street. For I have smashed Moab like an old, unwanted jar.
verses.textEnNasb: On all the housetops of Moab and in its public squares there is mourning everywhere; for I have broken Moab like an undesirable vessel," declares the Lord.
verses.textEn: On all the roofs in Moab and in the public squares there is nothing but mourning, for I have broken Moab like a jar that no one wants," declares the Lord .

verses.textZh: 摩押的毁灭多么厉害，他们的哀号多么凄惨！摩押怎样蒙羞转背！这样摩押就成了它四围众人讥笑和惊骇的对象。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩押的毁灭多么厉害，他们的哀号多么凄惨！摩押怎样蒙羞转背！这样摩押就成了它四围众人讥笑和惊骇的对象。"
verses.textZhCuv: 摩押何等毁坏！何等哀号！何等羞愧转背！这样，摩押必令四围的人嗤笑惊骇。」
verses.textEnNiv: "How shattered she is! How they wail! How Moab turns her back in shame! Moab has become an object of ridicule, an object of horror to all those around her."
verses.textEnEsv: How it is broken! How they wail! How Moab has turned his back in shame! So Moab has become a derision and a horror to all that are around him."
verses.textEnNkjv: "They shall wail: ‘How she is broken down! How Moab has turned her back with shame!’ So Moab shall be a derision And a dismay to all those about her."
verses.textEnNlt: How it is shattered! Hear the wailing! See the shame of Moab! It has become an object of ridicule, an example of ruin to all its neighbors."
verses.textEnNasb: "How shattered it is! How they have wailed! How Moab has turned his back—he is ashamed! So Moab will become a laughingstock and an object of terror to all around him."
verses.textEn: "How shattered she is! How they wail! How Moab turns her back in shame! Moab has become an object of ridicule, an object of horror to all those around her."

verses.textZh: 因为耶和华这样说： "看哪！必有一人像大鹰疾飞， 展开翅膀攻击摩押。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为耶和华这样说： "看哪！必有一人像大鹰疾飞， 展开翅膀攻击摩押。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华如此说： 仇敌必如大鹰飞起， 展开翅膀，攻击摩押。
verses.textEnNiv: This is what the Lord says: "Look! An eagle is swooping down, spreading its wings over Moab.
verses.textEnEsv: For thus says the Lord : "Behold, one shall fly swiftly like an eagle and spread his wings against Moab;
verses.textEnNkjv: For thus says the Lord: "Behold, one shall fly like an eagle, And spread his wings over Moab.
verses.textEnNlt: This is what the Lord says: "Look! The enemy swoops down like an eagle, spreading his wings over Moab.
verses.textEnNasb: For this is what the Lord says: "Behold, one will fly swiftly like an eagle And spread out his wings against Moab.
verses.textEn: This is what the Lord says: "Look! An eagle is swooping down, spreading its wings over Moab.

verses.textZh: 城市被攻取， 坚垒被占领； 在那日，摩押勇士的心必惊慌， 像临产妇人的心一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 城市被攻取， 坚垒被占领； 在那日，摩押勇士的心必惊慌， 像临产妇人的心一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 加略被攻取，保障也被占据。 到那日，摩押的勇士心中疼痛如临产的妇人。
verses.textEnNiv: Kerioth will be captured and the strongholds taken. In that day the hearts of Moab’s warriors will be like the heart of a woman in labor.
verses.textEnEsv: the cities shall be taken and the strongholds seized. The heart of the warriors of Moab shall be in that day like the heart of a woman in her birth pains;
verses.textEnNkjv: Kerioth is taken, And the strongholds are surprised; The mighty men’s hearts in Moab on that day shall be Like the heart of a woman in birth pangs.
verses.textEnNlt: Its cities will fall, and its strongholds will be seized. Even the mightiest warriors will be in anguish like a woman in labor.
verses.textEnNasb: "Kerioth has been captured And the strongholds have been seized, So the hearts of the warriors of Moab on that day Will be like the heart of a woman in labor.
verses.textEn: Kerioth will be captured and the strongholds taken. In that day the hearts of Moab’s warriors will be like the heart of a woman in labor.

verses.textZh: 摩押必被摧毁，不再成为一个民族， 因为它向耶和华妄自尊大。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩押必被摧毁，不再成为一个民族， 因为它向耶和华妄自尊大。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩押必被毁灭，不再成国， 因她向耶和华夸大。
verses.textEnNiv: Moab will be destroyed as a nation because she defied the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: Moab shall be destroyed and be no longer a people, because he magnified himself against the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: And Moab shall be destroyed as a people, Because he exalted himself against the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: Moab will no longer be a nation, for it has boasted against the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: "Moab will be destroyed from being a people Because he has become arrogant toward the Lord.
verses.textEn: Moab will be destroyed as a nation because she defied the Lord .

verses.textZh: 摩押的居民哪！ 恐惧、陷阱、圈套都落在你们身上了。" 这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩押的居民哪！ 恐惧、陷阱、圈套都落在你们身上了。" 这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华说：摩押的居民哪， 恐惧、陷坑、网罗都临近你。
verses.textEnNiv: Terror and pit and snare await you, you people of Moab," declares the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: Terror, pit, and snare are before you, O inhabitant of Moab! declares the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: Fear and the pit and the snare shallbe upon you, O inhabitant of Moab," says the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: "Terror and traps and snares will be your lot, O Moab," says the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: "Terror, pit, and snare are coming upon you, Inhabitant of Moab," declares the Lord.
verses.textEn: Terror and pit and snare await you, you people of Moab," declares the Lord .

verses.textZh: "那逃避恐惧的，必跌进陷阱； 那从陷阱中出来的，必被圈套困着。 因为我必使摩押受惩罚的年日临到它。" 这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: "那逃避恐惧的，必跌进陷阱； 那从陷阱中出来的，必被圈套困着。 因为我必使摩押受惩罚的年日临到它。" 这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 躲避恐惧的必坠入陷坑； 从陷坑上来的必被网罗缠住； 因我必使追讨之年临到摩押。 这是耶和华说的。
verses.textEnNiv: "Whoever flees from the terror will fall into a pit, whoever climbs out of the pit will be caught in a snare; for I will bring on Moab the year of her punishment," declares the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: He who flees from the terror shall fall into the pit, and he who climbs out of the pit shall be caught in the snare. For I will bring these things upon Moab, the year of their punishment, declares the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: "He who flees from the fear shall fall into the pit, And he who gets out of the pit shall be caught in the snare. For upon Moab, upon it I will bring The year of their punishment," says the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: "Those who flee in terror will fall into a trap, and those who escape the trap will step into a snare. I will see to it that you do not get away, for the time of your judgment has come," says the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: "The one who flees from the terror Will fall into the pit, And the one who climbs up out of the pit Will be caught in the snare; For I will bring upon her, upon Moab, The year of their punishment," declares the Lord.
verses.textEn: "Whoever flees from the terror will fall into a pit, whoever climbs out of the pit will be caught in a snare; for I will bring on Moab the year of her punishment," declares the Lord .

verses.textZh: "在希实本的隐蔽处， 难民精疲力尽地站着； 因为有火从希实本发出， 有火焰从西宏的宫中冒出来， 吞灭了摩押的前额， 和吵闹的人的头顶。
verses.textZhCnvs: "在希实本的隐蔽处， 难民精疲力尽地站着； 因为有火从希实本发出， 有火焰从西宏的宫中冒出来， 吞灭了摩押的前额， 和吵闹的人的头顶。
verses.textZhCuv: 躲避的人无力站在希实本的影下； 因为有火从希实本发出， 有火焰出于西宏的城， 烧尽摩押的角和哄嚷人的头顶。
verses.textEnNiv: "In the shadow of Heshbon the fugitives stand helpless, for a fire has gone out from Heshbon, a blaze from the midst of Sihon; it burns the foreheads of Moab, the skulls of the noisy boasters.
verses.textEnEsv: "In the shadow of Heshbon fugitives stop without strength, for fire came out from Heshbon, flame from the house of Sihon; it has destroyed the forehead of Moab, the crown of the sons of tumult.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Those who fled stood under the shadow of Heshbon Because of exhaustion. But a fire shall come out of Heshbon, A flame from the midst of Sihon, And shall devour the brow of Moab, The crown of the head of the sons of tumult.
verses.textEnNlt: "The people flee as far as Heshbon but are unable to go on. For a fire comes from Heshbon, King Sihon’s ancient home, to devour the entire land with all its rebellious people.
verses.textEnNasb: "In the shadow of Heshbon The fugitives stand without strength; For a fire has spread out from Heshbon And a flame from the midst of Sihon, And it has devoured the forehead of Moab And the scalps of the loud revelers.
verses.textEn: "In the shadow of Heshbon the fugitives stand helpless, for a fire has gone out from Heshbon, a blaze from the midst of Sihon; it burns the foreheads of Moab, the skulls of the noisy boasters.

verses.textZh: 摩押啊，你有祸了！ 基抹的人民灭亡了！ 因为你的众子都被掳去了， 你的众女儿也都被掳去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩押啊，你有祸了！ 基抹的人民灭亡了！ 因为你的众子都被掳去了， 你的众女儿也都被掳去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩押啊，你有祸了！ 属基抹的民灭亡了！ 因你的众子都被掳去， 你的众女也被掳去。
verses.textEnNiv: Woe to you, Moab! The people of Chemosh are destroyed; your sons are taken into exile and your daughters into captivity.
verses.textEnEsv: Woe to you, O Moab! The people of Chemosh are undone, for your sons have been taken captive, and your daughters into captivity.
verses.textEnNkjv: Woe to you, O Moab! The people of Chemosh perish; For your sons have been taken captive, And your daughters captive.
verses.textEnNlt: "What sorrow awaits you, O people of Moab! The people of the god Chemosh are destroyed! Your sons and your daughters have been taken away as captives.
verses.textEnNasb: "Woe to you, Moab! The people of Chemosh have perished; For your sons have been taken away captive, And your daughters into captivity.
verses.textEn: Woe to you, Moab! The people of Chemosh are destroyed; your sons are taken into exile and your daughters into captivity.

verses.textZh: 但日后，我必使被掳的摩押人归回。" 这是耶和华的宣告。 有关摩押的宣判到这里为止。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但日后，我必使被掳的摩押人归回。" 这是耶和华的宣告。 有关摩押的宣判到这里为止。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华说： 到末后，我还要使被掳的摩押人归回。 摩押受审判的话到此为止。
verses.textEnNiv: "Yet I will restore the fortunes of Moab in days to come," declares the Lord . Here ends the judgment on Moab.
verses.textEnEsv: Yet I will restore the fortunes of Moab in the latter days, declares the Lord ." Thus far is the judgment on Moab.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Yet I will bring back the captives of Moab In the latter days," says the Lord. Thus far is the judgment of Moab.
verses.textEnNlt: But I will restore the fortunes of Moab in days to come. I, the Lord , have spoken!" This is the end of Jeremiah’s prophecy concerning Moab.
verses.textEnNasb: "Yet I will restore the fortunes of Moab In the latter days," declares the Lord. This is the extent of the judgment on Moab.
verses.textEn: "Yet I will restore the fortunes of Moab in days to come," declares the Lord . Here ends the judgment on Moab.

verses.textZh: 论到亚扪， 耶和华这样说： "以色列没有子孙吗？ 没有后嗣吗？ 为甚么米勒公竟承受了迦得为业呢？ 它的人民为甚么住在迦得的城市里呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 论到亚扪， 耶和华这样说： "以色列没有子孙吗？ 没有后嗣吗？ 为甚么米勒公竟承受了迦得为业呢？ 它的人民为甚么住在迦得的城市里呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 论亚扪人。耶和华如此说： 以色列没有儿子吗？ 没有后嗣吗？ 玛勒堪为何得迦得之地为业呢？ 属他的民为何住其中的城邑呢？
verses.textEnNiv: Concerning the Ammonites: This is what the Lord says: "Has Israel no sons? Has Israel no heir? Why then has Molek taken possession of Gad? Why do his people live in its towns?
verses.textEnEsv: Concerning the Ammonites. Thus says the Lord : "Has Israel no sons? Has he no heir? Why then has Milcom dispossessed Gad, and his people settled in its cities?
verses.textEnNkjv: Against the Ammonites. Thus says the Lord: "Has Israel no sons? Has he no heir? Why then does Milcom inherit Gad, And his people dwell in its cities?
verses.textEnNlt: This message was given concerning the Ammonites. This is what the Lord says: "Are there no descendants of Israel to inherit the land of Gad? Why are you, who worship Molech, living in its towns?
verses.textEnNasb: Concerning the sons of Ammon. This is what the Lord says: "Does Israel have no sons? Or has he no heirs? Why then has Malcam taken possession of Gad, And his people settled in its cities?
verses.textEn: Concerning the Ammonites: This is what the Lord says: "Has Israel no sons? Has Israel no heir? Why then has Molek taken possession of Gad? Why do his people live in its towns?

verses.textZh: 因此，看哪！日子快到 ， 我必使战争的吶喊声响起， 有敌人来攻击亚扪的拉巴； 拉巴必成为一片废墟， 属它的乡镇 必被火焚烧。 那时以色列人必从侵略他们的人的手中收回土地。" 这是耶和华说的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，看哪！日子快到 ， 我必使战争的吶喊声响起， 有敌人来攻击亚扪的拉巴； 拉巴必成为一片废墟， 属它的乡镇 必被火焚烧。 那时以色列人必从侵略他们的人的手中收回土地。" 这是耶和华说的。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华说： 日子将到，我必使人听见打仗的喊声， 是攻击亚扪人拉巴的喊声。 拉巴要成为乱堆； 属她的乡村 要被火焚烧。 先前得以色列地为业的， 此时以色列倒要得他们的地为业。 这是耶和华说的。
verses.textEnNiv: But the days are coming," declares the Lord , "when I will sound the battle cry against Rabbah of the Ammonites; it will become a mound of ruins, and its surrounding villages will be set on fire. Then Israel will drive out those who drove her out," says the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore, behold, the days are coming, declares the Lord , when I will cause the battle cry to be heard against Rabbah of the Ammonites; it shall become a desolate mound, and its villages shall be burned with fire; then Israel shall dispossess those who dispossessed him, says the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore behold, the days are coming," says the Lord, "That I will cause to be heard an alarm of war In Rabbah of the Ammonites; It shall be a desolate mound, And her villages shall be burned with fire. Then Israel shall take possession of his inheritance," says the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: In the days to come," says the Lord , "I will sound the battle cry against your city of Rabbah. It will become a desolate heap of ruins, and the neighboring towns will be burned. Then Israel will take back the land you took from her," says the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: "Therefore behold, the days are coming," declares the Lord, "When I will cause an alarm of war to be heard Against Rabbah of the sons of Ammon; And it will become a desolate heap, And her towns will be set on fire. Then Israel will take possession of his possessors," Says the Lord.
verses.textEn: But the days are coming," declares the Lord , "when I will sound the battle cry against Rabbah of the Ammonites; it will become a mound of ruins, and its surrounding villages will be set on fire. Then Israel will drive out those who drove her out," says the Lord .

verses.textZh: "希实本哪，你要哀号！因为艾城已被毁灭。 拉巴的居民 ，你们要呼喊， 要腰束麻布，要哀哭， 要在城墙内跑来跑去。 因为米勒公，以及事奉它的祭司和领袖， 都必一同被掳去。
verses.textZhCnvs: "希实本哪，你要哀号！因为艾城已被毁灭。 拉巴的居民 ，你们要呼喊， 要腰束麻布，要哀哭， 要在城墙内跑来跑去。 因为米勒公，以及事奉它的祭司和领袖， 都必一同被掳去。
verses.textZhCuv: 希实本哪，你要哀号， 因为爱地变为荒场。 拉巴的居民 哪，要呼喊， 以麻布束腰； 要哭号，在篱笆中跑来跑去； 因玛勒堪和属他的祭司、 首领要一同被掳去。
verses.textEnNiv: "Wail, Heshbon, for Ai is destroyed! Cry out, you inhabitants of Rabbah! Put on sackcloth and mourn; rush here and there inside the walls, for Molek will go into exile, together with his priests and officials.
verses.textEnEsv: "Wail, O Heshbon, for Ai is laid waste! Cry out, O daughters of Rabbah! Put on sackcloth, lament, and run to and fro among the hedges! For Milcom shall go into exile, with his priests and his officials.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Wail, O Heshbon, for Ai is plundered! Cry, you daughters of Rabbah, Gird yourselves with sackcloth! Lament and run to and fro by the walls; For Milcom shall go into captivity With his priests and his princes together.
verses.textEnNlt: "Cry out, O Heshbon, for the town of Ai is destroyed. Weep, O people of Rabbah! Put on your clothes of mourning. Weep and wail, hiding in the hedges, for your god Molech, with his priests and officials, will be hauled off to distant lands.
verses.textEnNasb: "Wail, Heshbon, for Ai has been destroyed! Cry out, daughters of Rabbah, Put on sackcloth and mourn, And move about inside the walls; For Malcam will go into exile Together with his priests and his leaders.
verses.textEn: "Wail, Heshbon, for Ai is destroyed! Cry out, you inhabitants of Rabbah! Put on sackcloth and mourn; rush here and there inside the walls, for Molek will go into exile, together with his priests and officials.

verses.textZh: 背道的居民 哪！ 你们为甚么因有山谷， 就是你们那肥沃的山谷而夸口呢？ 你们十分倚靠自己的财宝，说： ‘有谁敢来攻击我们呢？’
verses.textZhCnvs: 背道的居民 哪！ 你们为甚么因有山谷， 就是你们那肥沃的山谷而夸口呢？ 你们十分倚靠自己的财宝，说： ‘有谁敢来攻击我们呢？’
verses.textZhCuv: 背道的民 哪， 你们为何因有山谷， 就是水流的山谷夸张呢？ 为何倚靠财宝说： 谁能来到我们这里呢？
verses.textEnNiv: Why do you boast of your valleys, boast of your valleys so fruitful? Unfaithful Daughter Ammon, you trust in your riches and say, ‘Who will attack me?’
verses.textEnEsv: Why do you boast of your valleys, O faithless daughter, who trusted in her treasures, saying, ‘Who will come against me?’
verses.textEnNkjv: Why do you boast in the valleys, Your flowing valley, O backsliding daughter? Who trusted in her treasures, saying, ‘Who will come against me?’
verses.textEnNlt: You are proud of your fertile valleys, but they will soon be ruined. You trusted in your wealth, you rebellious daughter, and thought no one could ever harm you.
verses.textEnNasb: "How you boast about the valleys! Your valley is flowing away, You backsliding daughter Who trusts in her treasures, saying, ‘Who can come against me?’
verses.textEn: Why do you boast of your valleys, boast of your valleys so fruitful? Unfaithful Daughter Ammon, you trust in your riches and say, ‘Who will attack me?’

verses.textZh: 看哪！我必使你们因四围的列国而恐慌， 这是主万军之耶和华的宣告； 你们必被赶逐，各自逃命， 没有人把四散奔逃的人聚集起来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 看哪！我必使你们因四围的列国而恐慌， 这是主万军之耶和华的宣告； 你们必被赶逐，各自逃命， 没有人把四散奔逃的人聚集起来。
verses.textZhCuv: 主－万军之耶和华说： 我要使恐吓从四围的人中临到你们； 你们必被赶出， 各人一直前往， 没有人收聚逃民。
verses.textEnNiv: I will bring terror on you from all those around you," declares the Lord, the Lord Almighty. "Every one of you will be driven away, and no one will gather the fugitives.
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, I will bring terror upon you, declares the Lord God of hosts, from all who are around you, and you shall be driven out, every man straight before him, with none to gather the fugitives.
verses.textEnNkjv: Behold, I will bring fear upon you," Says the Lord God of hosts, "From all those who are around you; You shall be driven out, everyone headlong, And no one will gather those who wander off.
verses.textEnNlt: But look! I will bring terror upon you," says the Lord, the Lord of Heaven’s Armies. "Your neighbors will chase you from your land, and no one will help your exiles as they flee.
verses.textEnNasb: "Behold, I am going to bring terror upon you," Declares the Lord God of armies, "From all directions around you; And you will be driven away one after another, With no one to gather the fugitives together.
verses.textEn: I will bring terror on you from all those around you," declares the Lord, the Lord Almighty. "Every one of you will be driven away, and no one will gather the fugitives.

verses.textZh: 但我日后必使被掳的亚扪人归回。" 这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但我日后必使被掳的亚扪人归回。" 这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 后来我还要使被掳的亚扪人归回。 这是耶和华说的。
verses.textEnNiv: "Yet afterward, I will restore the fortunes of the Ammonites," declares the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: "But afterward I will restore the fortunes of the Ammonites, declares the Lord ."
verses.textEnNkjv: But afterward I will bring back The captives of the people of Ammon," says the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: But I will restore the fortunes of the Ammonites in days to come. I, the Lord , have spoken."
verses.textEnNasb: "But afterward I will restore The fortunes of the sons of Ammon," Declares the Lord.
verses.textEn: "Yet afterward, I will restore the fortunes of the Ammonites," declares the Lord .

verses.textZh: 论到以东， 万军之耶和华这样说： "提幔再没有智慧吗？ 聪明人已经计穷才尽吗？ 他们的智慧都消失了吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 论到以东， 万军之耶和华这样说： "提幔再没有智慧吗？ 聪明人已经计穷才尽吗？ 他们的智慧都消失了吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 论以东。万军之耶和华如此说： 提幔中再没有智慧吗？ 明哲人不再有谋略吗？ 他们的智慧尽归无有吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Concerning Edom: This is what the Lord Almighty says: "Is there no longer wisdom in Teman? Has counsel perished from the prudent? Has their wisdom decayed?
verses.textEnEsv: Concerning Edom. Thus says the Lord of hosts: "Is wisdom no more in Teman? Has counsel perished from the prudent? Has their wisdom vanished?
verses.textEnNkjv: Against Edom. Thus says the Lord of hosts: "Is wisdom no more in Teman? Has counsel perished from the prudent? Has their wisdom vanished?
verses.textEnNlt: This message was given concerning Edom. This is what the Lord of Heaven’s Armies says: "Is there no wisdom in Teman? Is no one left to give wise counsel?
verses.textEnNasb: Concerning Edom. This is what the Lord of armies says: "Is there no longer any wisdom in Teman? Has good advice been lost by the prudent? Has their wisdom decayed?
verses.textEn: Concerning Edom: This is what the Lord Almighty says: "Is there no longer wisdom in Teman? Has counsel perished from the prudent? Has their wisdom decayed?

verses.textZh: 底但的居民哪！ 你们要转身逃跑，藏在隐蔽的地方， 因为我惩罚以扫的时候， 必使灾祸临到他身上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 底但的居民哪！ 你们要转身逃跑，藏在隐蔽的地方， 因为我惩罚以扫的时候， 必使灾祸临到他身上。
verses.textZhCuv: 底但的居民哪，要转身逃跑， 住在深密处； 因为我向以扫追讨的时候， 必使灾殃临到他。
verses.textEnNiv: Turn and flee, hide in deep caves, you who live in Dedan, for I will bring disaster on Esau at the time when I punish him.
verses.textEnEsv: Flee, turn back, dwell in the depths, O inhabitants of Dedan! For I will bring the calamity of Esau upon him, the time when I punish him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Flee, turn back, dwell in the depths, O inhabitants of Dedan! For I will bring the calamity of Esau upon him, The time that I will punish him.
verses.textEnNlt: Turn and flee! Hide in deep caves, you people of Dedan! For when I bring disaster on Edom, I will punish you, too!
verses.textEnNasb: "Flee away, turn back, dwell in the depths, You inhabitants of Dedan, For I will bring the disaster of Esau upon him At the time I punish him.
verses.textEn: Turn and flee, hide in deep caves, you who live in Dedan, for I will bring disaster on Esau at the time when I punish him.

verses.textZh: 收取葡萄的若来到你那里， 岂不剩下一些葡萄吗？ 盗贼若在夜间来到你那里， 岂不是只偷他们所要的吗 ？
verses.textZhCnvs: 收取葡萄的若来到你那里， 岂不剩下一些葡萄吗？ 盗贼若在夜间来到你那里， 岂不是只偷他们所要的吗 ？
verses.textZhCuv: 摘葡萄的若来到他那里， 岂不剩下些葡萄呢？ 盗贼若夜间而来， 岂不毁坏直到够了呢？
verses.textEnNiv: If grape pickers came to you, would they not leave a few grapes? If thieves came during the night, would they not steal only as much as they wanted?
verses.textEnEsv: If grape gatherers came to you, would they not leave gleanings? If thieves came by night, would they not destroy only enough for themselves?
verses.textEnNkjv: If grape-gatherers came to you, Would they not leave some gleaning grapes? If thieves by night, Would they not destroy until they have enough?
verses.textEnNlt: Those who harvest grapes always leave a few for the poor. If thieves came at night, they would not take everything.
verses.textEnNasb: "If grape pickers came to you, Would they not leave gleanings? If thieves came by night, They would destroy only what was sufficient for them.
verses.textEn: If grape pickers came to you, would they not leave a few grapes? If thieves came during the night, would they not steal only as much as they wanted?

verses.textZh: 但是我要使以扫赤裸， 揭露他藏匿的地方， 以致他不能隐藏。 他的后裔、他的兄弟和他的邻居都必灭亡，
verses.textZhCnvs: 但是我要使以扫赤裸， 揭露他藏匿的地方， 以致他不能隐藏。 他的后裔、他的兄弟和他的邻居都必灭亡，
verses.textZhCuv: 我却使以扫赤露， 显出他的隐密处； 他不能自藏。 他的后裔、弟兄、邻舍尽都灭绝； 他也归于无有。
verses.textEnNiv: But I will strip Esau bare; I will uncover his hiding places, so that he cannot conceal himself. His armed men are destroyed, also his allies and neighbors, so there is no one to say,
verses.textEnEsv: But I have stripped Esau bare; I have uncovered his hiding places, and he is not able to conceal himself. His children are destroyed, and his brothers, and his neighbors; and he is no more.
verses.textEnNkjv: But I have made Esau bare; I have uncovered his secret places, And he shall not be able to hide himself. His descendants are plundered, His brethren and his neighbors, And he is no more.
verses.textEnNlt: But I will strip bare the land of Edom, and there will be no place left to hide. Its children, its brothers, and its neighbors will all be destroyed, and Edom itself will be no more.
verses.textEnNasb: "But I have stripped Esau bare, I have uncovered his hiding places So that he will not be able to conceal himself; His offspring have been destroyed along with his brothers And his neighbors, and he no longer exists.
verses.textEn: But I will strip Esau bare; I will uncover his hiding places, so that he cannot conceal himself. His armed men are destroyed, also his allies and neighbors, so there is no one to say,

verses.textZh: 没有人会说：‘你撇下你的孤儿， 我必使他们存活； 你的寡妇可以倚靠我。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 没有人会说：‘你撇下你的孤儿， 我必使他们存活； 你的寡妇可以倚靠我。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 你撇下孤儿，我必保全他们的命； 你的寡妇可以倚靠我。
verses.textEnNiv: ‘Leave your fatherless children; I will keep them alive. Your widows too can depend on me.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: Leave your fatherless children; I will keep them alive; and let your widows trust in me."
verses.textEnNkjv: Leave your fatherless children, I will preserve them alive; And let your widows trust in Me."
verses.textEnNlt: But I will protect the orphans who remain among you. Your widows, too, can depend on me for help."
verses.textEnNasb: "Leave your orphans behind, I will keep them alive; And let your widows trust in Me."
verses.textEn: ‘Leave your fatherless children; I will keep them alive. Your widows too can depend on me.’ "

verses.textZh: 耶和华这样说："看哪！原不该喝那杯的，尚且一定要喝，难道你可以完全免受刑罚吗？你必不能免受刑罚，你一定要喝那杯。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华这样说："看哪！原不该喝那杯的，尚且一定要喝，难道你可以完全免受刑罚吗？你必不能免受刑罚，你一定要喝那杯。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华如此说：「原不该喝那杯的一定要喝。你能尽免刑罚吗？你必不能免，一定要喝！」
verses.textEnNiv: This is what the Lord says: "If those who do not deserve to drink the cup must drink it, why should you go unpunished? You will not go unpunished, but must drink it.
verses.textEnEsv: For thus says the Lord : "If those who did not deserve to drink the cup must drink it, will you go unpunished? You shall not go unpunished, but you must drink.
verses.textEnNkjv: For thus says the Lord: "Behold, those whose judgment was not to drink of the cup have assuredly drunk. And are you the one who will altogether go unpunished? You shall not go unpunished, but you shall surely drink ofit.
verses.textEnNlt: And this is what the Lord says: "If the innocent must suffer, how much more must you! You will not go unpunished! You must drink this cup of judgment!
verses.textEnNasb: For this is what the Lord says: "Behold, those who were not sentenced to drink the cup will certainly drink it, so are you the one who will be held completely blameless? You will not be held blameless, but you will certainly drink it.
verses.textEn: This is what the Lord says: "If those who do not deserve to drink the cup must drink it, why should you go unpunished? You will not go unpunished, but must drink it.

verses.textZh: 因为我曾指着自己起誓，波斯拉必成为令人惊骇、被人羞辱和咒诅的对象；它必变成荒野，它一切的城镇都必永远变成荒场。"这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为我曾指着自己起誓，波斯拉必成为令人惊骇、被人羞辱和咒诅的对象；它必变成荒野，它一切的城镇都必永远变成荒场。"这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华说：「我指着自己起誓，波斯拉必令人惊骇、羞辱、咒诅，并且荒凉。她的一切城邑必变为永远的荒场。」
verses.textEnNiv: I swear by myself," declares the Lord , "that Bozrah will become a ruin and a curse, an object of horror and reproach; and all its towns will be in ruins forever."
verses.textEnEsv: For I have sworn by myself, declares the Lord , that Bozrah shall become a horror, a taunt, a waste, and a curse, and all her cities shall be perpetual wastes."
verses.textEnNkjv: For I have sworn by Myself," says the Lord, "that Bozrah shall become a desolation, a reproach, a waste, and a curse. And all its cities shall be perpetual wastes."
verses.textEnNlt: For I have sworn by my own name," says the Lord , "that Bozrah will become an object of horror and a heap of ruins; it will be mocked and cursed. All its towns and villages will be desolate forever."
verses.textEnNasb: For I have sworn by Myself," declares the Lord, "that Bozrah will become an object of horror, a disgrace, a wasteland, and a curse; and all its cities will become permanent ruins."
verses.textEn: I swear by myself," declares the Lord , "that Bozrah will become a ruin and a curse, an object of horror and reproach; and all its towns will be in ruins forever."

verses.textZh: 我从耶和华那里听见了一个信息， 有一位使者被派往列国去，说： "你们要聚集去攻击以东， 要起来争战！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我从耶和华那里听见了一个信息， 有一位使者被派往列国去，说： "你们要聚集去攻击以东， 要起来争战！"
verses.textZhCuv: 我从耶和华那里听见信息， 并有使者被差往列国去，说： 你们聚集来攻击以东， 要起来争战。
verses.textEnNiv: I have heard a message from the Lord ; an envoy was sent to the nations to say, "Assemble yourselves to attack it! Rise up for battle!"
verses.textEnEsv: I have heard a message from the Lord , and an envoy has been sent among the nations: "Gather yourselves together and come against her, and rise up for battle!
verses.textEnNkjv: I have heard a message from the Lord, And an ambassador has been sent to the nations: "Gather together, come against her, And rise up to battle!
verses.textEnNlt: I have heard a message from the Lord that an ambassador was sent to the nations to say, "Form a coalition against Edom, and prepare for battle!"
verses.textEnNasb: I have heard a message from the Lord, And a messenger is being sent among the nations, saying, "Gather yourselves together and come against her, And rise up for battle!"
verses.textEn: I have heard a message from the Lord ; an envoy was sent to the nations to say, "Assemble yourselves to attack it! Rise up for battle!"

verses.textZh: "看哪！我必使你在列国中成为弱小的， 在世人中被藐视。
verses.textZhCnvs: "看哪！我必使你在列国中成为弱小的， 在世人中被藐视。
verses.textZhCuv: 我使你在列国中为最小， 在世人中被藐视。
verses.textEnNiv: "Now I will make you small among the nations, despised by mankind.
verses.textEnEsv: For behold, I will make you small among the nations, despised among mankind.
verses.textEnNkjv: "For indeed, I will make you small among nations, Despised among men.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord says to Edom, "I will cut you down to size among the nations. You will be despised by all.
verses.textEnNasb: "For behold, I have made you small among the nations, Despised among people.
verses.textEn: "Now I will make you small among the nations, despised by mankind.

verses.textZh: 你那令人战栗的威风， 你心中的傲气欺骗了你； 你这住在岩石的隐密处， 雄据山岭高处的啊！ 你虽如鹰在高处搭窝， 我也必把你从那里拉下来。" 这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你那令人战栗的威风， 你心中的傲气欺骗了你； 你这住在岩石的隐密处， 雄据山岭高处的啊！ 你虽如鹰在高处搭窝， 我也必把你从那里拉下来。" 这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 住在山穴中据守山顶的啊， 论到你的威吓， 你因心中的狂傲自欺； 你虽如大鹰高高搭窝， 我却从那里拉下你来。 这是耶和华说的。
verses.textEnNiv: The terror you inspire and the pride of your heart have deceived you, you who live in the clefts of the rocks, who occupy the heights of the hill. Though you build your nest as high as the eagle’s, from there I will bring you down," declares the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: The horror you inspire has deceived you, and the pride of your heart, you who live in the clefts of the rock, who hold the height of the hill. Though you make your nest as high as the eagle’s, I will bring you down from there, declares the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: Your fierceness has deceived you, The pride of your heart, O you who dwell in the clefts of the rock, Who hold the height of the hill! Though you make your nest as high as the eagle, I will bring you down from there," says the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: You have been deceived by the fear you inspire in others and by your own pride. You live in a rock fortress and control the mountain heights. But even if you make your nest among the peaks with the eagles, I will bring you crashing down," says the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: "As for the terror you cause, The arrogance of your heart has deceived you, You who live in the clefts of the rock, Who occupy the height of the hill. Though you make your nest as high as an eagle’s, I will bring you down from there," declares the Lord.
verses.textEn: The terror you inspire and the pride of your heart have deceived you, you who live in the clefts of the rocks, who occupy the heights of the hill. Though you build your nest as high as the eagle’s, from there I will bring you down," declares the Lord .

verses.textZh: "以东必成为令人惊骇的地方；每一个经过那里的，都必因这地所遭受的一切创伤而惊骇，并且嗤笑它。
verses.textZhCnvs: "以东必成为令人惊骇的地方；每一个经过那里的，都必因这地所遭受的一切创伤而惊骇，并且嗤笑它。
verses.textZhCuv: 「以东必令人惊骇；凡经过的人就受惊骇，又因她一切的灾祸嗤笑。
verses.textEnNiv: "Edom will become an object of horror; all who pass by will be appalled and will scoff because of all its wounds.
verses.textEnEsv: "Edom shall become a horror. Everyone who passes by it will be horrified and will hiss because of all its disasters.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Edom also shall be an astonishment; Everyone who goes by it will be astonished And will hiss at all its plagues.
verses.textEnNlt: "Edom will be an object of horror. All who pass by will be appalled and will gasp at the destruction they see there.
verses.textEnNasb: "Edom will become an object of horror; everyone who passes by it will be appalled and will hiss at all its wounds.
verses.textEn: "Edom will become an object of horror; all who pass by will be appalled and will scoff because of all its wounds.

verses.textZh: 以东必倾覆，像所多玛、蛾摩拉，和它们的城镇一样 ，必没有人住在那里，也必没有人在那里寄居。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以东必倾覆，像所多玛、蛾摩拉，和它们的城镇一样 ，必没有人住在那里，也必没有人在那里寄居。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华说：必无人住在那里，也无人在其中寄居，要像所多玛、蛾摩拉，和邻近的城邑倾覆的时候一样。
verses.textEnNiv: As Sodom and Gomorrah were overthrown, along with their neighboring towns," says the Lord , "so no one will live there; no people will dwell in it.
verses.textEnEsv: As when Sodom and Gomorrah and their neighboring cities were overthrown, says the Lord , no man shall dwell there, no man shall sojourn in her.
verses.textEnNkjv: As in the overthrow of Sodom and Gomorrah And their neighbors," says the Lord, "No one shall remain there, Nor shall a son of man dwell in it.
verses.textEnNlt: It will be like the destruction of Sodom and Gomorrah and their neighboring towns," says the Lord . "No one will live there; no one will inhabit it.
verses.textEnNasb: Like the overthrow of Sodom and Gomorrah with its neighbors," says the Lord, "no one will live there, nor will anyone of mankind reside in it.
verses.textEn: As Sodom and Gomorrah were overthrown, along with their neighboring towns," says the Lord , "so no one will live there; no people will dwell in it.

verses.textZh: 看哪！狮子怎样从约旦河边的丛林走上来，攻击常绿的牧场，照样，我必在眨眼之间把以东赶走，使它离开这地；谁蒙拣选，我就派谁治理这地。谁能和我相比呢？谁可以把我传来审讯呢？哪一个牧人能在我面前站立得住呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 看哪！狮子怎样从约旦河边的丛林走上来，攻击常绿的牧场，照样，我必在眨眼之间把以东赶走，使它离开这地；谁蒙拣选，我就派谁治理这地。谁能和我相比呢？谁可以把我传来审讯呢？哪一个牧人能在我面前站立得住呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 仇敌必像狮子从约旦河边的丛林上来，攻击坚固的居所。转眼之间，我要使以东人逃跑，离开这地。谁蒙拣选，我就派谁治理这地。谁能比我呢？谁能给我定规日期呢？有何牧人能在我面前站立得住呢？
verses.textEnNiv: "Like a lion coming up from Jordan’s thickets to a rich pastureland, I will chase Edom from its land in an instant. Who is the chosen one I will appoint for this? Who is like me and who can challenge me? And what shepherd can stand against me?"
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, like a lion coming up from the jungle of the Jordan against a perennial pasture, I will suddenly make him run away from her. And I will appoint over her whomever I choose. For who is like me? Who will summon me? What shepherd can stand before me?
verses.textEnNkjv: "Behold, he shall come up like a lion from the floodplain of the Jordan Against the dwelling place of the strong; But I will suddenly make him run away from her. And who is a chosen manthat I may appoint over her? For who is like Me? Who will arraign Me? And who is that shepherd Who will withstand Me?"
verses.textEnNlt: I will come like a lion from the thickets of the Jordan, leaping on the sheep in the pasture. I will chase Edom from its land, and I will appoint the leader of my choice. For who is like me, and who can challenge me? What ruler can oppose my will?"
verses.textEnNasb: Behold, one will come up like a lion from the thicket of the Jordan to a perennially watered pasture; for in an instant I will chase him away from it, and I will appoint over it whoever is chosen. For who is like Me, and who will summon Me into court? And who then is the shepherd who can stand against Me?"
verses.textEn: "Like a lion coming up from Jordan’s thickets to a rich pastureland, I will chase Edom from its land in an instant. Who is the chosen one I will appoint for this? Who is like me and who can challenge me? And what shepherd can stand against me?"

verses.textZh: 因此，你们要听耶和华筹谋对付以东的计划，和他为了提幔的居民所定下的策略。他们羊群中最小的也必被拉去，他们的牧场也必因临到它们的灾祸而荒废。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，你们要听耶和华筹谋对付以东的计划，和他为了提幔的居民所定下的策略。他们羊群中最小的也必被拉去，他们的牧场也必因临到它们的灾祸而荒废。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要听耶和华攻击以东所说的谋略和他攻击提幔居民所定的旨意。仇敌定要将他们群众微弱的拉去，定要使他们的居所荒凉。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore, hear what the Lord has planned against Edom, what he has purposed against those who live in Teman: The young of the flock will be dragged away; their pasture will be appalled at their fate.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore hear the plan that the Lord has made against Edom and the purposes that he has formed against the inhabitants of Teman: Even the little ones of the flock shall be dragged away. Surely their fold shall be appalled at their fate.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore hear the counsel of the Lord that He has taken against Edom, And His purposes that He has proposed against the inhabitants of Teman: Surely the least of the flock shall draw them out; Surely He shall make their dwelling places desolate with them.
verses.textEnNlt: Listen to the Lord ’s plans against Edom and the people of Teman. Even the little children will be dragged off like sheep, and their homes will be destroyed.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore hear the plan of the Lord which He has planned against Edom, and His purposes which He has in mind against the inhabitants of Teman: they will certainly drag them off, even the little ones of the flock; He will certainly make their pasture desolate because of them.
verses.textEn: Therefore, hear what the Lord has planned against Edom, what he has purposed against those who live in Teman: The young of the flock will be dragged away; their pasture will be appalled at their fate.

verses.textZh: 因他们倒下的响声，地就震动；并且有哀叫的声音，在红海那里也听得到。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因他们倒下的响声，地就震动；并且有哀叫的声音，在红海那里也听得到。
verses.textZhCuv: 因他们仆倒的声音，地就震动。人在红海那里必听见呼喊的声音。
verses.textEnNiv: At the sound of their fall the earth will tremble; their cry will resound to the Red Sea.
verses.textEnEsv: At the sound of their fall the earth shall tremble; the sound of their cry shall be heard at the Red Sea.
verses.textEnNkjv: The earth shakes at the noise of their fall; At the cry its noise is heard at the Red Sea.
verses.textEnNlt: The earth will shake with the noise of Edom’s fall, and its cry of despair will be heard all the way to the Red Sea.
verses.textEnNasb: The earth has quaked at the noise of their downfall. There is an outcry! The noise of it has been heard at the Red Sea.
verses.textEn: At the sound of their fall the earth will tremble; their cry will resound to the Red Sea.

verses.textZh: 看哪！必有一人像大鹰飞扑而来，展开翅膀攻击波斯拉；在那日，以东勇士的心必惊慌，像临产妇人的心一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 看哪！必有一人像大鹰飞扑而来，展开翅膀攻击波斯拉；在那日，以东勇士的心必惊慌，像临产妇人的心一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 仇敌必如大鹰飞起，展开翅膀攻击波斯拉。到那日，以东的勇士心中疼痛如临产的妇人。」
verses.textEnNiv: Look! An eagle will soar and swoop down, spreading its wings over Bozrah. In that day the hearts of Edom’s warriors will be like the heart of a woman in labor.
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, one shall mount up and fly swiftly like an eagle and spread his wings against Bozrah, and the heart of the warriors of Edom shall be in that day like the heart of a woman in her birth pains."
verses.textEnNkjv: Behold, He shall come up and fly like the eagle, And spread His wings over Bozrah; The heart of the mighty men of Edom in that day shall be Like the heart of a woman in birth pangs.
verses.textEnNlt: Look! The enemy swoops down like an eagle, spreading his wings over Bozrah. Even the mightiest warriors will be in anguish like a woman in labor.
verses.textEnNasb: Behold, He will mount up and swoop like an eagle, and spread out His wings against Bozrah; and the hearts of the warriors of Edom on that day will be like the heart of a woman in labor.
verses.textEn: Look! An eagle will soar and swoop down, spreading its wings over Bozrah. In that day the hearts of Edom’s warriors will be like the heart of a woman in labor.

verses.textZh: 论到大马士革，耶和华说： "哈马和亚珥拔纷乱不安， 因为他们听到了坏消息； 他们的心融化，焦虑慌张， 像不能平静的海洋。
verses.textZhCnvs: 论到大马士革，耶和华说： "哈马和亚珥拔纷乱不安， 因为他们听到了坏消息； 他们的心融化，焦虑慌张， 像不能平静的海洋。
verses.textZhCuv: 论大马士革。 哈马和亚珥拔蒙羞， 因他们听见凶恶的信息就消化了。 海上有忧愁，不得平静。
verses.textEnNiv: Concerning Damascus: "Hamath and Arpad are dismayed, for they have heard bad news. They are disheartened, troubled like the restless sea.
verses.textEnEsv: Concerning Damascus: "Hamath and Arpad are confounded, for they have heard bad news; they melt in fear, they are troubled like the sea that cannot be quiet.
verses.textEnNkjv: Against Damascus. "Hamath and Arpad are shamed, For they have heard bad news. They are fainthearted; Thereis trouble on the sea; It cannot be quiet.
verses.textEnNlt: This message was given concerning Damascus. This is what the Lord says: "The towns of Hamath and Arpad are struck with fear, for they have heard the news of their destruction. Their hearts are troubled like a wild sea in a raging storm.
verses.textEnNasb: Concerning Damascus: "Hamath and Arpad are put to shame, For they have heard bad news; They despair. There is anxiety at the sea, It cannot be calmed.
verses.textEn: Concerning Damascus: "Hamath and Arpad are dismayed, for they have heard bad news. They are disheartened, troubled like the restless sea.

verses.textZh: 大马士革失去勇气，转身逃跑； 但恐慌抓住它， 忧虑痛苦把它捉住， 像正在生产的妇人的痛苦一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大马士革失去勇气，转身逃跑； 但恐慌抓住它， 忧虑痛苦把它捉住， 像正在生产的妇人的痛苦一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 大马士革发软，转身逃跑。 战兢将她捉住； 痛苦忧愁将她抓住， 如产难的妇人一样。
verses.textEnNiv: Damascus has become feeble, she has turned to flee and panic has gripped her; anguish and pain have seized her, pain like that of a woman in labor.
verses.textEnEsv: Damascus has become feeble, she turned to flee, and panic seized her; anguish and sorrows have taken hold of her, as of a woman in labor.
verses.textEnNkjv: Damascus has grown feeble; She turns to flee, And fear has seized her. Anguish and sorrows have taken her like a woman in labor.
verses.textEnNlt: Damascus has become feeble, and all her people turn to flee. Fear, anguish, and pain have gripped her as they grip a woman in labor.
verses.textEnNasb: "Damascus has become helpless; She has turned away to flee, And panic has gripped her; Distress and labor pains have seized her Like a woman in childbirth.
verses.textEn: Damascus has become feeble, she has turned to flee and panic has gripped her; anguish and pain have seized her, pain like that of a woman in labor.

verses.textZh: 著名的城市， 我所欢喜的市镇， 怎么竟被撇弃呢！
verses.textZhCnvs: 著名的城市， 我所欢喜的市镇， 怎么竟被撇弃呢！
verses.textZhCuv: 我所喜乐可称赞的城， 为何被撇弃了呢？
verses.textEnNiv: Why has the city of renown not been abandoned, the town in which I delight?
verses.textEnEsv: How is the famous city not forsaken, the city of my joy?
verses.textEnNkjv: Why is the city of praise not deserted, the city of My joy?
verses.textEnNlt: That famous city, a city of joy, will be forsaken!
verses.textEnNasb: "How the city of praise has not been deserted, The town of My joy!
verses.textEn: Why has the city of renown not been abandoned, the town in which I delight?

verses.textZh: 它的年轻人必仆倒在它的街道上， 到那日，所有的战士都必被消灭。" 这是万军之耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 它的年轻人必仆倒在它的街道上， 到那日，所有的战士都必被消灭。" 这是万军之耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 她的少年人必仆倒在街上； 当那日，一切兵丁必默默无声。 这是万军之耶和华说的。
verses.textEnNiv: Surely, her young men will fall in the streets; all her soldiers will be silenced in that day," declares the Lord Almighty.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore her young men shall fall in her squares, and all her soldiers shall be destroyed in that day, declares the Lord of hosts.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore her young men shall fall in her streets, And all the men of war shall be cut off in that day," says the Lord of hosts.
verses.textEnNlt: Her young men will fall in the streets and die. Her soldiers will all be killed," says the Lord of Heaven’s Armies.
verses.textEnNasb: "Therefore, her young men will fall in her streets, And all the men of war will perish on that day," declares the Lord of armies.
verses.textEn: Surely, her young men will fall in the streets; all her soldiers will be silenced in that day," declares the Lord Almighty.

verses.textZh: "我要焚烧大马士革的城墙， 烧毁便．哈达的堡垒。"
verses.textZhCnvs: "我要焚烧大马士革的城墙， 烧毁便．哈达的堡垒。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我必在大马士革城中使火着起， 烧灭便‧哈达的宫殿。
verses.textEnNiv: "I will set fire to the walls of Damascus; it will consume the fortresses of Ben-Hadad."
verses.textEnEsv: And I will kindle a fire in the wall of Damascus, and it shall devour the strongholds of Ben-hadad."
verses.textEnNkjv: "I will kindle a fire in the wall of Damascus, And it shall consume the palaces of Ben-Hadad."
verses.textEnNlt: "And I will set fire to the walls of Damascus that will burn up the palaces of Ben-hadad."
verses.textEnNasb: "I will set fire to the wall of Damascus, And it will devour the fortified palace of Ben-hadad."
verses.textEn: "I will set fire to the walls of Damascus; it will consume the fortresses of Ben-Hadad."

verses.textZh: 论到巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒所击败的基达，以及夏琐诸国，耶和华这样说： "起来，上去攻击基达， 消灭东方人！
verses.textZhCnvs: 论到巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒所击败的基达，以及夏琐诸国，耶和华这样说： "起来，上去攻击基达， 消灭东方人！
verses.textZhCuv: 论巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒所攻打的基达和夏琐的诸国。耶和华如此说： 迦勒底人哪，起来上基达去， 毁灭东方人。
verses.textEnNiv: Concerning Kedar and the kingdoms of Hazor, which Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon attacked: This is what the Lord says: "Arise, and attack Kedar and destroy the people of the East.
verses.textEnEsv: Concerning Kedar and the kingdoms of Hazor that Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon struck down. Thus says the Lord : "Rise up, advance against Kedar! Destroy the people of the east!
verses.textEnNkjv: Against Kedar and against the kingdoms of Hazor, which Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon shall strike. Thus says the Lord: "Arise, go up to Kedar, And devastate the men of the East!
verses.textEnNlt: This message was given concerning Kedar and the kingdoms of Hazor, which were attacked by King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylon. This is what the Lord says: "Advance against Kedar! Destroy the warriors from the East!
verses.textEnNasb: Concerning Kedar and the kingdoms of Hazor, which Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon defeated. This is what the Lord says: "Arise, go up to Kedar And devastate the people of the east.
verses.textEn: Concerning Kedar and the kingdoms of Hazor, which Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon attacked: This is what the Lord says: "Arise, and attack Kedar and destroy the people of the East.

verses.textZh: 夺去他们的帐棚和羊群， 带走他们的幔子、一切器具和骆驼； 人必向他们呼叫： ‘四围都是惊慌。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 夺去他们的帐棚和羊群， 带走他们的幔子、一切器具和骆驼； 人必向他们呼叫： ‘四围都是惊慌。’
verses.textZhCuv: 他们的帐棚和羊群都要夺去， 将幔子和一切器皿，并骆驼为自己掠去。 人向他们喊着说： 四围都有惊吓。
verses.textEnNiv: Their tents and their flocks will be taken; their shelters will be carried off with all their goods and camels. People will shout to them, ‘Terror on every side!’
verses.textEnEsv: Their tents and their flocks shall be taken, their curtains and all their goods; their camels shall be led away from them, and men shall cry to them: ‘Terror on every side!’
verses.textEnNkjv: Their tents and their flocks they shall take away. They shall take for themselves their curtains, All their vessels and their camels; And they shall cry out to them, ‘Fear is on every side!’
verses.textEnNlt: Their flocks and tents will be captured, and their household goods and camels will be taken away. Everywhere shouts of panic will be heard: ‘We are terrorized at every turn!’
verses.textEnNasb: "They will take away their tents and their flocks; They will carry off for themselves Their tent curtains, all their goods and their camels, And they will call out to one another, ‘Horror on every side!’
verses.textEn: Their tents and their flocks will be taken; their shelters will be carried off with all their goods and camels. People will shout to them, ‘Terror on every side!’

verses.textZh: 夏琐的居民哪！你们要逃跑， 快快逃命，藏在隐蔽的地方， 因为巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒筹谋计划对付你们， 定下策略攻击你们。" 这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 夏琐的居民哪！你们要逃跑， 快快逃命，藏在隐蔽的地方， 因为巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒筹谋计划对付你们， 定下策略攻击你们。" 这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华说： 夏琐的居民哪，要逃奔远方， 住在深密处； 因为巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒设计谋害你们， 起意攻击你们。
verses.textEnNiv: "Flee quickly away! Stay in deep caves, you who live in Hazor," declares the Lord . "Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon has plotted against you; he has devised a plan against you.
verses.textEnEsv: Flee, wander far away, dwell in the depths, O inhabitants of Hazor! declares the Lord . For Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon has made a plan against you and formed a purpose against you.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Flee, get far away! Dwell in the depths, O inhabitants of Hazor!" says the Lord. "For Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon has taken counsel against you, And has conceived a plan against you.
verses.textEnNlt: Run for your lives," says the Lord . "Hide yourselves in deep caves, you people of Hazor, for King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylon has plotted against you and is preparing to destroy you.
verses.textEnNasb: "Run away, flee! Dwell in the depths, You inhabitants of Hazor," declares the Lord; "For Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon has formed a plan against you And devised a scheme against you.
verses.textEn: "Flee quickly away! Stay in deep caves, you who live in Hazor," declares the Lord . "Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon has plotted against you; he has devised a plan against you.

verses.textZh: "起来！上去攻打那安逸无虑的国家 ； 这国没有城门，也没有门闩； 他们是独自居住的。
verses.textZhCnvs: "起来！上去攻打那安逸无虑的国家 ； 这国没有城门，也没有门闩； 他们是独自居住的。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华说： 迦勒底人哪，起来！ 上安逸无虑的居民那里去； 他们是无门无闩、独自居住的。
verses.textEnNiv: "Arise and attack a nation at ease, which lives in confidence," declares the Lord , "a nation that has neither gates nor bars; its people live far from danger.
verses.textEnEsv: "Rise up, advance against a nation at ease, that dwells securely, declares the Lord , that has no gates or bars, that dwells alone.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Arise, go up to the wealthy nation that dwells securely," says the Lord, "Which has neither gates nor bars, Dwelling alone.
verses.textEnNlt: "Go up and attack that complacent nation," says the Lord . "Its people live alone in the desert without walls or gates.
verses.textEnNasb: "Arise, go up against a nation which is at ease, Which lives securely," declares the Lord. "It has no gates or bars; They dwell alone.
verses.textEn: "Arise and attack a nation at ease, which lives in confidence," declares the Lord , "a nation that has neither gates nor bars; its people live far from danger.

verses.textZh: 他们的骆驼必成为掠物， 他们无数的牲畜必成为掳物。 我必把那些剃除了鬓发的人分散到四方去， 我必使灾祸从四面八方临到他们。" 这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们的骆驼必成为掠物， 他们无数的牲畜必成为掳物。 我必把那些剃除了鬓发的人分散到四方去， 我必使灾祸从四面八方临到他们。" 这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们的骆驼必成为掠物； 他们众多的牲畜必成为掳物。 我必将剃周围头发的人分散四方 ， 使灾殃从四围临到他们。 这是耶和华说的。
verses.textEnNiv: Their camels will become plunder, and their large herds will be spoils of war. I will scatter to the winds those who are in distant places and will bring disaster on them from every side," declares the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: Their camels shall become plunder, their herds of livestock a spoil. I will scatter to every wind those who cut the corners of their hair, and I will bring their calamity from every side of them, declares the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: Their camels shall be for booty, And the multitude of their cattle for plunder. I will scatter to all winds those in the farthest corners, And I will bring their calamity from all its sides," says the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: Their camels and other livestock will all be yours. I will scatter to the winds these people who live in remote places. I will bring calamity upon them from every direction," says the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: "Their camels will become plunder, And their many livestock for spoils, And I will scatter to all the winds those who cut the corners of their hair; And I will bring their disaster from every side," declares the Lord.
verses.textEn: Their camels will become plunder, and their large herds will be spoils of war. I will scatter to the winds those who are in distant places and will bring disaster on them from every side," declares the Lord .

verses.textZh: "夏琐必成为野狗的巢穴， 永远荒凉； 必没有人住在那里， 也必没有人在那里寄居。"
verses.textZhCnvs: "夏琐必成为野狗的巢穴， 永远荒凉； 必没有人住在那里， 也必没有人在那里寄居。"
verses.textZhCuv: 夏琐必成为野狗的住处， 永远凄凉； 必无人住在那里， 也无人在其中寄居。
verses.textEnNiv: "Hazor will become a haunt of jackals, a desolate place forever. No one will live there; no people will dwell in it."
verses.textEnEsv: Hazor shall become a haunt of jackals, an everlasting waste; no man shall dwell there; no man shall sojourn in her."
verses.textEnNkjv: "Hazor shall be a dwelling for jackals, a desolation forever; No one shall reside there, Nor son of man dwell in it."
verses.textEnNlt: "Hazor will be inhabited by jackals, and it will be desolate forever. No one will live there; no one will inhabit it."
verses.textEnNasb: "Hazor will become a haunt of jackals, A desolation forever; No one will live there, Nor will anyone of mankind reside in it."
verses.textEn: "Hazor will become a haunt of jackals, a desolate place forever. No one will live there; no people will dwell in it."

verses.textZh: 犹大王西底家开始执政的时候，耶和华论到以拦的话临到耶利米先知，说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 犹大王西底家开始执政的时候，耶和华论到以拦的话临到耶利米先知，说：
verses.textZhCuv: 犹大王西底家登基的时候，耶和华论以拦的话临到先知耶利米说：
verses.textEnNiv: This is the word of the Lord that came to Jeremiah the prophet concerning Elam, early in the reign of Zedekiah king of Judah:
verses.textEnEsv: The word of the Lord that came to Jeremiah the prophet concerning Elam, in the beginning of the reign of Zedekiah king of Judah.
verses.textEnNkjv: The word of the Lord that came to Jeremiah the prophet against Elam, in the beginning of the reign of Zedekiah king of Judah, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: This message concerning Elam came to the prophet Jeremiah from the Lord at the beginning of the reign of King Zedekiah of Judah.
verses.textEnNasb: The word of the Lord that came to Jeremiah the prophet concerning Elam, at the beginning of the reign of Zedekiah king of Judah, saying:
verses.textEn: This is the word of the Lord that came to Jeremiah the prophet concerning Elam, early in the reign of Zedekiah king of Judah:

verses.textZh: "万军之耶和华这样说： 看哪！我要折断以拦的弓， 就是他们战斗力强的武器。
