verses.textZhCnvs: "万军之耶和华这样说： 看哪！我要折断以拦的弓， 就是他们战斗力强的武器。
verses.textZhCuv: 「万军之耶和华如此说：我必折断以拦人的弓，就是他们为首的权力。
verses.textEnNiv: This is what the Lord Almighty says: "See, I will break the bow of Elam, the mainstay of their might.
verses.textEnEsv: Thus says the Lord of hosts: "Behold, I will break the bow of Elam, the mainstay of their might.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Thus says the Lord of hosts: ‘Behold, I will break the bow of Elam, The foremost of their might.
verses.textEnNlt: This is what the Lord of Heaven’s Armies says: "I will destroy the archers of Elam— the best of their forces.
verses.textEnNasb: "This is what the Lord of armies says: ‘Behold, I am going to break the bow of Elam, The finest of their might.
verses.textEn: This is what the Lord Almighty says: "See, I will break the bow of Elam, the mainstay of their might.

verses.textZh: 我要使四风从天的四边刮到以拦身上， 把他们分散到四方， 以致没有一个国家没有以拦难民的踪迹。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要使四风从天的四边刮到以拦身上， 把他们分散到四方， 以致没有一个国家没有以拦难民的踪迹。
verses.textZhCuv: 我要使四风从天的四方刮来，临到以拦人，将他们分散四方 。这被赶散的人没有一国不到的。」
verses.textEnNiv: I will bring against Elam the four winds from the four quarters of heaven; I will scatter them to the four winds, and there will not be a nation where Elam’s exiles do not go.
verses.textEnEsv: And I will bring upon Elam the four winds from the four quarters of heaven. And I will scatter them to all those winds, and there shall be no nation to which those driven out of Elam shall not come.
verses.textEnNkjv: Against Elam I will bring the four winds From the four quarters of heaven, And scatter them toward all those winds; There shall be no nations where the outcasts of Elam will not go.
verses.textEnNlt: I will bring enemies from all directions, and I will scatter the people of Elam to the four winds. They will be exiled to countries around the world.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘I will bring upon Elam the four winds From the four ends of heaven, And will scatter them to all these winds; And there will be no nation To which the outcasts of Elam will not go.
verses.textEn: I will bring against Elam the four winds from the four quarters of heaven; I will scatter them to the four winds, and there will not be a nation where Elam’s exiles do not go.

verses.textZh: 我必使以拦人在他们的仇敌面前惊慌， 在寻索他们性命的人面前恐惧； 我必使灾祸，就是我的烈怒，临到他们身上； 我必差遣刀剑追赶他们， 直到把他们灭绝。" 这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必使以拦人在他们的仇敌面前惊慌， 在寻索他们性命的人面前恐惧； 我必使灾祸，就是我的烈怒，临到他们身上； 我必差遣刀剑追赶他们， 直到把他们灭绝。" 这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华说：「我必使以拦人在仇敌和寻索其命的人面前惊惶；我也必使灾祸，就是我的烈怒临到他们，又必使刀剑追杀他们，直到将他们灭尽。
verses.textEnNiv: I will shatter Elam before their foes, before those who want to kill them; I will bring disaster on them, even my fierce anger," declares the Lord . "I will pursue them with the sword until I have made an end of them.
verses.textEnEsv: I will terrify Elam before their enemies and before those who seek their life. I will bring disaster upon them, my fierce anger, declares the Lord . I will send the sword after them, until I have consumed them,
verses.textEnNkjv: For I will cause Elam to be dismayed before their enemies And before those who seek their life. I will bring disaster upon them, My fierce anger,’ says the Lord; ‘And I will send the sword after them Until I have consumed them.
verses.textEnNlt: I myself will go with Elam’s enemies to shatter it. In my fierce anger, I will bring great disaster upon the people of Elam," says the Lord . "Their enemies will chase them with the sword until I have destroyed them completely.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘So I will shatter Elam before their enemies And before those who seek their lives; And I will bring disaster upon them, Even My fierce anger,’ declares the Lord, ‘And I will send the sword after them Until I have consumed them.
verses.textEn: I will shatter Elam before their foes, before those who want to kill them; I will bring disaster on them, even my fierce anger," declares the Lord . "I will pursue them with the sword until I have made an end of them.

verses.textZh: "我必在以拦设立我的宝座， 除灭那里的君王和领袖 。
verses.textZhCnvs: "我必在以拦设立我的宝座， 除灭那里的君王和领袖 。
verses.textZhCuv: 我要在以拦设立我的宝座，从那里除灭君王和首领。这是耶和华说的。
verses.textEnNiv: I will set my throne in Elam and destroy her king and officials," declares the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: and I will set my throne in Elam and destroy their king and officials, declares the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: I will set My throne in Elam, And will destroy from there the king and the princes,’ says the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: I will set my throne in Elam," says the Lord , "and I will destroy its king and officials.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Then I will set My throne in Elam, And eliminate from there the king and officials,’ Declares the Lord.
verses.textEn: I will set my throne in Elam and destroy her king and officials," declares the Lord .

verses.textZh: 但日后我必使被掳的以拦人归回。" 这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但日后我必使被掳的以拦人归回。" 这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 「到末后，我还要使被掳的以拦人归回。这是耶和华说的。」
verses.textEnNiv: "Yet I will restore the fortunes of Elam in days to come," declares the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: "But in the latter days I will restore the fortunes of Elam, declares the Lord ."
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘But it shall come to pass in the latter days: I will bring back the captives of Elam,’ says the Lord."
verses.textEnNlt: But I will restore the fortunes of Elam in days to come. I, the Lord , have spoken!"
verses.textEnNasb: ‘But it will come about in the last days That I will restore the fortunes of Elam,’ " Declares the Lord.
verses.textEn: "Yet I will restore the fortunes of Elam in days to come," declares the Lord .

verses.textZh: 以下是耶和华藉耶利米先知论到巴比伦，就是迦勒底人的地所说的话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以下是耶和华藉耶利米先知论到巴比伦，就是迦勒底人的地所说的话。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华藉先知耶利米论巴比伦和迦勒底人之地所说的话。
verses.textEnNiv: This is the word the Lord spoke through Jeremiah the prophet concerning Babylon and the land of the Babylonians :
verses.textEnEsv: The word that the Lord spoke concerning Babylon, concerning the land of the Chaldeans, by Jeremiah the prophet:
verses.textEnNkjv: The word that the Lord spoke against Babylon and against the land of the Chaldeans by Jeremiah the prophet.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord gave Jeremiah the prophet this message concerning Babylon and the land of the Babylonians.
verses.textEnNasb: The word which the Lord spoke concerning Babylon, the land of the Chaldeans, through Jeremiah the prophet:
verses.textEn: This is the word the Lord spoke through Jeremiah the prophet concerning Babylon and the land of the Babylonians :

verses.textZh: "你们要在列国中传扬和宣告， 要竖起旗帜宣扬， 不可隐瞒，说： ‘巴比伦被攻取了！ 彼勒蒙羞， 米罗达惊慌； 巴比伦的神像都蒙羞，它的偶像都惊慌。’
verses.textZhCnvs: "你们要在列国中传扬和宣告， 要竖起旗帜宣扬， 不可隐瞒，说： ‘巴比伦被攻取了！ 彼勒蒙羞， 米罗达惊慌； 巴比伦的神像都蒙羞，它的偶像都惊慌。’
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要在万国中传扬报告， 竖立大旗； 要报告，不可隐瞒，说： 巴比伦被攻取， 彼勒蒙羞， 米罗达惊惶。 巴比伦的神像都蒙羞； 她的偶像都惊惶。
verses.textEnNiv: "Announce and proclaim among the nations, lift up a banner and proclaim it; keep nothing back, but say, ‘Babylon will be captured; Bel will be put to shame, Marduk filled with terror. Her images will be put to shame and her idols filled with terror.’
verses.textEnEsv: "Declare among the nations and proclaim, set up a banner and proclaim, conceal it not, and say: ‘Babylon is taken, Bel is put to shame, Merodach is dismayed. Her images are put to shame, her idols are dismayed.’
verses.textEnNkjv: "Declare among the nations, Proclaim, and set up a standard; Proclaim—do not conceal it— Say, ‘Babylon is taken, Bel is shamed. Merodach is broken in pieces; Her idols are humiliated, Her images are broken in pieces.’
verses.textEnNlt: This is what the Lord says: "Tell the whole world, and keep nothing back. Raise a signal flag to tell everyone that Babylon will fall! Her images and idols will be shattered. Her gods Bel and Marduk will be utterly disgraced.
verses.textEnNasb: "Declare and proclaim among the nations. Proclaim it and lift up a flag, Do not conceal it. Say, ‘Babylon has been captured, Bel has been put to shame, Marduk has been shattered; Her idols have been put to shame, her images have been shattered.’
verses.textEn: "Announce and proclaim among the nations, lift up a banner and proclaim it; keep nothing back, but say, ‘Babylon will be captured; Bel will be put to shame, Marduk filled with terror. Her images will be put to shame and her idols filled with terror.’

verses.textZh: 因为有一个国家从北方来攻击它， 使它的地荒凉； 没有人在那里居住， 人畜都逃跑无踪。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为有一个国家从北方来攻击它， 使它的地荒凉； 没有人在那里居住， 人畜都逃跑无踪。
verses.textZhCuv: 「因有一国从北方上来攻击她，使她的地荒凉，无人居住，连人带牲畜都逃走了。」
verses.textEnNiv: A nation from the north will attack her and lay waste her land. No one will live in it; both people and animals will flee away.
verses.textEnEsv: "For out of the north a nation has come up against her, which shall make her land a desolation, and none shall dwell in it; both man and beast shall flee away.
verses.textEnNkjv: For out of the north a nation comes up against her, Which shall make her land desolate, And no one shall dwell therein. They shall move, they shall depart, Both man and beast.
verses.textEnNlt: For a nation will attack her from the north and bring such destruction that no one will live there again. Everything will be gone; both people and animals will flee.
verses.textEnNasb: For a nation has come up against her from the north; it will make her land an object of horror, and there will be no inhabitant in it. Whether people or animals, they have wandered off, they have gone!
verses.textEn: A nation from the north will attack her and lay waste her land. No one will live in it; both people and animals will flee away.

verses.textZh: 到那些日子、那时候 ， 以色列人必和犹大人一同来， 边走边哭， 要寻找耶和华他们的神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 到那些日子、那时候 ， 以色列人必和犹大人一同来， 边走边哭， 要寻找耶和华他们的神。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华说：「当那日子、那时候，以色列人要和犹大人同来，随走随哭，寻求耶和华－他们的神。
verses.textEnNiv: "In those days, at that time," declares the Lord , "the people of Israel and the people of Judah together will go in tears to seek the Lord their God.
verses.textEnEsv: "In those days and in that time, declares the Lord , the people of Israel and the people of Judah shall come together, weeping as they come, and they shall seek the Lord their God.
verses.textEnNkjv: "In those days and in that time," says the Lord, "The children of Israel shall come, They and the children of Judah together; With continual weeping they shall come, And seek the Lord their God.
verses.textEnNlt: "In those coming days," says the Lord , "the people of Israel will return home together with the people of Judah. They will come weeping and seeking the Lord their God.
verses.textEnNasb: "In those days and at that time," declares the Lord, "the sons of Israel will come, they and the sons of Judah as well; they will go along weeping as they go, and it will be the Lord their God whom they will seek.
verses.textEn: "In those days, at that time," declares the Lord , "the people of Israel and the people of Judah together will go in tears to seek the Lord their God.

verses.textZh: 他们要询问往锡安的路，又面向锡安，说： ‘来吧！我们要以那永不可忘记的约与耶和华连合。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们要询问往锡安的路，又面向锡安，说： ‘来吧！我们要以那永不可忘记的约与耶和华连合。’
verses.textZhCuv: 他们必访问锡安，又面向这里，说：『来吧，你们要与耶和华联合为永远不忘的约。』
verses.textEnNiv: They will ask the way to Zion and turn their faces toward it. They will come and bind themselves to the Lord in an everlasting covenant that will not be forgotten.
verses.textEnEsv: They shall ask the way to Zion, with faces turned toward it, saying, ‘Come, let us join ourselves to the Lord in an everlasting covenant that will never be forgotten.’
verses.textEnNkjv: They shall ask the way to Zion, With their faces toward it, saying, ‘Come and let us join ourselves to the Lord In a perpetual covenant That will not be forgotten.’
verses.textEnNlt: They will ask the way to Jerusalem and will start back home again. They will bind themselves to the Lord with an eternal covenant that will never be forgotten.
verses.textEnNasb: They will ask for the way to Zion, turning their faces in its direction; they will come so that they may join themselves to the Lordin an everlasting covenant that will not be forgotten.
verses.textEn: They will ask the way to Zion and turn their faces toward it. They will come and bind themselves to the Lord in an everlasting covenant that will not be forgotten.

verses.textZh: 我的子民成了迷失的羊， 他们的牧人使他们走错了路， 使他们在山上徘徊； 他们从大山走到小山， 忘记了他们安歇之处。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的子民成了迷失的羊， 他们的牧人使他们走错了路， 使他们在山上徘徊； 他们从大山走到小山， 忘记了他们安歇之处。
verses.textZhCuv: 「我的百姓作了迷失的羊，牧人使他们走差路，使他们转到山上。他们从大山走到小山，竟忘了安歇之处。
verses.textEnNiv: "My people have been lost sheep; their shepherds have led them astray and caused them to roam on the mountains. They wandered over mountain and hill and forgot their own resting place.
verses.textEnEsv: "My people have been lost sheep. Their shepherds have led them astray, turning them away on the mountains. From mountain to hill they have gone. They have forgotten their fold.
verses.textEnNkjv: "My people have been lost sheep. Their shepherds have led them astray; They have turned them away on the mountains. They have gone from mountain to hill; They have forgotten their resting place.
verses.textEnNlt: "My people have been lost sheep. Their shepherds have led them astray and turned them loose in the mountains. They have lost their way and can’t remember how to get back to the sheepfold.
verses.textEnNasb: "My people have become lost sheep; Their shepherds have led them astray. They have made them turn aside on the mountains. They have gone from mountain to hill, They have forgotten their resting place.
verses.textEn: "My people have been lost sheep; their shepherds have led them astray and caused them to roam on the mountains. They wandered over mountain and hill and forgot their own resting place.

verses.textZh: 所有遇见他们的都吞吃他们； 他们的敌人说：‘我们没有罪， 因为他们得罪了耶和华，那真正的居所； 耶和华是他们列祖的盼望。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 所有遇见他们的都吞吃他们； 他们的敌人说：‘我们没有罪， 因为他们得罪了耶和华，那真正的居所； 耶和华是他们列祖的盼望。’
verses.textZhCuv: 凡遇见他们的，就把他们吞灭。敌人说：『我们没有罪；因他们得罪那作公义居所的耶和华，就是他们列祖所仰望的耶和华。』
verses.textEnNiv: Whoever found them devoured them; their enemies said, ‘We are not guilty, for they sinned against the Lord , their verdant pasture, the Lord , the hope of their ancestors.’
verses.textEnEsv: All who found them have devoured them, and their enemies have said, ‘We are not guilty, for they have sinned against the Lord , their habitation of righteousness, the Lord , the hope of their fathers.’
verses.textEnNkjv: All who found them have devoured them; And their adversaries said, ‘We have not offended, Because they have sinned against the Lord, the habitation of justice, The Lord, the hope of their fathers.’
verses.textEnNlt: All who found them devoured them. Their enemies said, ‘We did nothing wrong in attacking them, for they sinned against the Lord , their true place of rest, and the hope of their ancestors.’
verses.textEnNasb: "All who found them have devoured them; And their adversaries have said, ‘We are not guilty, Since they have sinned against the Lordwho is the habitation of righteousness, The Lord, the hope of their fathers.’
verses.textEn: Whoever found them devoured them; their enemies said, ‘We are not guilty, for they sinned against the Lord , their verdant pasture, the Lord , the hope of their ancestors.’

verses.textZh: 我的子民哪！你们要从巴比伦中间逃跑， 从迦勒底人的地出来； 要像公山羊走在羊群前面。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的子民哪！你们要从巴比伦中间逃跑， 从迦勒底人的地出来； 要像公山羊走在羊群前面。
verses.textZhCuv: 「我民哪，你们要从巴比伦中逃走，从迦勒底人之地出去，要像羊群前面走的公山羊。
verses.textEnNiv: "Flee out of Babylon; leave the land of the Babylonians, and be like the goats that lead the flock.
verses.textEnEsv: "Flee from the midst of Babylon, and go out of the land of the Chaldeans, and be as male goats before the flock.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Move from the midst of Babylon, Go out of the land of the Chaldeans; And be like the rams before the flocks.
verses.textEnNlt: "But now, flee from Babylon! Leave the land of the Babylonians. Like male goats at the head of the flock, lead my people home again.
verses.textEnNasb: "Wander away from the midst of Babylon And go out from the land of the Chaldeans; Be like male goats at the head of the flock.
verses.textEn: "Flee out of Babylon; leave the land of the Babylonians, and be like the goats that lead the flock.

verses.textZh: 因为，看哪！我必激动强国从北方之地联群而来， 攻击巴比伦； 他们要列阵攻打巴比伦； 巴比伦就必被攻取。 他们的箭必像善战的勇士， 不会空手而回。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为，看哪！我必激动强国从北方之地联群而来， 攻击巴比伦； 他们要列阵攻打巴比伦； 巴比伦就必被攻取。 他们的箭必像善战的勇士， 不会空手而回。
verses.textZhCuv: 因我必激动联合的大国从北方上来攻击巴比伦，他们要摆阵攻击她；她必从那里被攻取。他们的箭好像善射之勇士的箭，一枝也不徒然返回。
verses.textEnNiv: For I will stir up and bring against Babylon an alliance of great nations from the land of the north. They will take up their positions against her, and from the north she will be captured. Their arrows will be like skilled warriors who do not return empty-handed.
verses.textEnEsv: For behold, I am stirring up and bringing against Babylon a gathering of great nations, from the north country. And they shall array themselves against her. From there she shall be taken. Their arrows are like a skilled warrior who does not return empty-handed.
verses.textEnNkjv: For behold, I will raise and cause to come up against Babylon An assembly of great nations from the north country, And they shall array themselves against her; From there she shall be captured. Their arrows shallbe like those of an expert warrior; None shall return in vain.
verses.textEnNlt: For I am raising up an army of great nations from the north. They will join forces to attack Babylon, and she will be captured. The enemies’ arrows will go straight to the mark; they will not miss!
verses.textEnNasb: "For behold, I am going to rouse and bring up against Babylon A contingent of great nations from the land of the north, And they will draw up their battle lines against her; From there she will be taken captive. Their arrows will be like an expert warrior Who does not return empty-handed.
verses.textEn: For I will stir up and bring against Babylon an alliance of great nations from the land of the north. They will take up their positions against her, and from the north she will be captured. Their arrows will be like skilled warriors who do not return empty-handed.

verses.textZh: 迦勒底必成为掠物， 掳掠它的都必心满意足。" 这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 迦勒底必成为掠物， 掳掠它的都必心满意足。" 这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 迦勒底必成为掠物；凡掳掠她的都必心满意足。这是耶和华说的。」
verses.textEnNiv: So Babylonia will be plundered; all who plunder her will have their fill," declares the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: Chaldea shall be plundered; all who plunder her shall be sated, declares the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: And Chaldea shall become plunder; All who plunder her shall be satisfied," says the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: Babylonia will be looted until the attackers are glutted with loot. I, the Lord , have spoken!
verses.textEnNasb: " Chaldea will become plunder; All who plunder her will have enough," declares the Lord.
verses.textEn: So Babylonia will be plundered; all who plunder her will have their fill," declares the Lord .

verses.textZh: "抢夺我产业的啊！ 你们虽然欢喜快乐， 像踹谷的母牛犊跳跃， 像雄壮的马嘶叫；
verses.textZhCnvs: "抢夺我产业的啊！ 你们虽然欢喜快乐， 像踹谷的母牛犊跳跃， 像雄壮的马嘶叫；
verses.textZhCuv: 抢夺我产业的啊， 你们因欢喜快乐， 且像踹谷撒欢的母牛犊， 又像发嘶声的壮马。
verses.textEnNiv: "Because you rejoice and are glad, you who pillage my inheritance, because you frolic like a heifer threshing grain and neigh like stallions,
verses.textEnEsv: "Though you rejoice, though you exult, O plunderers of my heritage, though you frolic like a heifer in the pasture, and neigh like stallions,
verses.textEnNkjv: "Because you were glad, because you rejoiced, You destroyers of My heritage, Because you have grown fat like a heifer threshing grain, And you bellow like bulls,
verses.textEnNlt: "You rejoice and are glad, you who plundered my chosen people. You frisk about like a calf in a meadow and neigh like a stallion.
verses.textEnNasb: "Because you are glad, because you are jubilant, You who pillage My heritage, Because you skip about like a threshing heifer And neigh like stallions,
verses.textEn: "Because you rejoice and are glad, you who pillage my inheritance, because you frolic like a heifer threshing grain and neigh like stallions,

verses.textZh: 但你们的母亲必极度羞愧， 生你们的必受耻辱。 看哪！她要在列国中沦为最弱小的， 成为旷野、旱地、沙漠。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 但你们的母亲必极度羞愧， 生你们的必受耻辱。 看哪！她要在列国中沦为最弱小的， 成为旷野、旱地、沙漠。"
verses.textZhCuv: 你们的母巴比伦就极其抱愧， 生你们的必然蒙羞。 她要列在诸国之末， 成为旷野、旱地、沙漠。
verses.textEnNiv: your mother will be greatly ashamed; she who gave you birth will be disgraced. She will be the least of the nations— a wilderness, a dry land, a desert.
verses.textEnEsv: your mother shall be utterly shamed, and she who bore you shall be disgraced. Behold, she shall be the last of the nations, a wilderness, a dry land, and a desert.
verses.textEnNkjv: Your mother shall be deeply ashamed; She who bore you shall be ashamed. Behold, the least of the nations shallbe a wilderness, A dry land and a desert.
verses.textEnNlt: But your homeland will be overwhelmed with shame and disgrace. You will become the least of nations— a wilderness, a dry and desolate land.
verses.textEnNasb: Your mother will be greatly ashamed, She who gave you birth will be humiliated. Behold, she will be the least of the nations, A wilderness, a dry land and a desert.
verses.textEn: your mother will be greatly ashamed; she who gave you birth will be disgraced. She will be the least of the nations— a wilderness, a dry land, a desert.

verses.textZh: 因耶和华的烈怒，巴比伦必没有人居住， 完全荒废； 每一个住过巴比伦的， 都必因这地遭受的一切创伤而惊骇， 并且嗤笑它。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因耶和华的烈怒，巴比伦必没有人居住， 完全荒废； 每一个住过巴比伦的， 都必因这地遭受的一切创伤而惊骇， 并且嗤笑它。
verses.textZhCuv: 因耶和华的忿怒，必无人居住， 要全然荒凉。 凡经过巴比伦的要受惊骇， 又因她所遭的灾殃嗤笑。
verses.textEnNiv: Because of the Lord ’s anger she will not be inhabited but will be completely desolate. All who pass Babylon will be appalled; they will scoff because of all her wounds.
verses.textEnEsv: Because of the wrath of the Lord she shall not be inhabited but shall be an utter desolation; everyone who passes by Babylon shall be appalled, and hiss because of all her wounds.
verses.textEnNkjv: Because of the wrath of the Lord She shall not be inhabited, But she shall be wholly desolate. Everyone who goes by Babylon shall be horrified And hiss at all her plagues.
verses.textEnNlt: Because of the Lord ’s anger, Babylon will become a deserted wasteland. All who pass by will be horrified and will gasp at the destruction they see there.
verses.textEnNasb: "Because of the wrath of the Lord she will not be inhabited, But she will be completely desolate; Everyone who passes by Babylon will be horrified And will hiss because of all her wounds.
verses.textEn: Because of the Lord ’s anger she will not be inhabited but will be completely desolate. All who pass Babylon will be appalled; they will scoff because of all her wounds.

verses.textZh: 所有拉弓的啊！ 你们要在巴比伦四围列阵； 射箭攻击它，不要吝啬箭枝， 因为它得罪了耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所有拉弓的啊！ 你们要在巴比伦四围列阵； 射箭攻击它，不要吝啬箭枝， 因为它得罪了耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 所有拉弓的，你们要在巴比伦的四围摆阵， 射箭攻击她。 不要爱惜箭枝， 因她得罪了耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: "Take up your positions around Babylon, all you who draw the bow. Shoot at her! Spare no arrows, for she has sinned against the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: Set yourselves in array against Babylon all around, all you who bend the bow; shoot at her, spare no arrows, for she has sinned against the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: "Put yourselves in array against Babylon all around, All you who bend the bow; Shoot at her, spare no arrows, For she has sinned against the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: "Yes, prepare to attack Babylon, all you surrounding nations. Let your archers shoot at her; spare no arrows. For she has sinned against the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: "Draw up your battle lines against Babylon on every side, All of you who bend the bow; Shoot at her, do not spare your arrows, For she has sinned against the Lord.
verses.textEn: "Take up your positions around Babylon, all you who draw the bow. Shoot at her! Spare no arrows, for she has sinned against the Lord .

verses.textZh: 你们要在它的四周吶喊攻击它； 它投降了， 它城墙的支柱倒塌了， 它的城墙拆毁了。 因为这是耶和华的报复； 你们要向巴比伦报复， 它怎样待人，你们也要怎样待它。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要在它的四周吶喊攻击它； 它投降了， 它城墙的支柱倒塌了， 它的城墙拆毁了。 因为这是耶和华的报复； 你们要向巴比伦报复， 它怎样待人，你们也要怎样待它。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要在她四围呐喊； 她已经投降。 外郭坍塌了， 城墙拆毁了， 因为这是耶和华报仇的事。 你们要向巴比伦报仇； 她怎样待人，也要怎样待她。
verses.textEnNiv: Shout against her on every side! She surrenders, her towers fall, her walls are torn down. Since this is the vengeance of the Lord , take vengeance on her; do to her as she has done to others.
verses.textEnEsv: Raise a shout against her all around; she has surrendered; her bulwarks have fallen; her walls are thrown down. For this is the vengeance of the Lord : take vengeance on her; do to her as she has done.
verses.textEnNkjv: Shout against her all around; She has given her hand, Her foundations have fallen, Her walls are thrown down; For it is the vengeance of the Lord. Take vengeance on her. As she has done, so do to her.
verses.textEnNlt: Shout war cries against her from every side. Look! She surrenders! Her walls have fallen. It is the Lord ’s vengeance, so take vengeance on her. Do to her as she has done to others!
verses.textEnNasb: "Raise your battle cry against her on every side! She has given herself up, her towers have fallen, Her walls have been torn down. For this is the vengeance of the Lord: Take vengeance on her; As she has done to others, so do to her.
verses.textEn: Shout against her on every side! She surrenders, her towers fall, her walls are torn down. Since this is the vengeance of the Lord , take vengeance on her; do to her as she has done to others.

verses.textZh: 你们要把播种的，和在收割的时候手持镰刀的， 都从巴比伦剪除； 因为欺压者的刀剑， 他们各人必归回自己的本族， 各自逃回自己的故乡。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要把播种的，和在收割的时候手持镰刀的， 都从巴比伦剪除； 因为欺压者的刀剑， 他们各人必归回自己的本族， 各自逃回自己的故乡。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要将巴比伦撒种的 和收割时拿镰刀的都剪除了。 他们各人因怕欺压的刀剑， 必归回本族，逃到本土。
verses.textEnNiv: Cut off from Babylon the sower, and the reaper with his sickle at harvest. Because of the sword of the oppressor let everyone return to their own people, let everyone flee to their own land.
verses.textEnEsv: Cut off from Babylon the sower, and the one who handles the sickle in time of harvest; because of the sword of the oppressor, every one shall turn to his own people, and every one shall flee to his own land.
verses.textEnNkjv: Cut off the sower from Babylon, And him who handles the sickle at harvest time. For fear of the oppressing sword Everyone shall turn to his own people, And everyone shall flee to his own land.
verses.textEnNlt: Take from Babylon all those who plant crops; send all the harvesters away. Because of the sword of the enemy, everyone will run away and rush back to their own lands.
verses.textEnNasb: "Eliminate the sower from Babylon And the one who wields the sickle at the time of harvest; From the sword of the oppressor Each of them will turn back to his own people And each of them will flee to his own land.
verses.textEn: Cut off from Babylon the sower, and the reaper with his sickle at harvest. Because of the sword of the oppressor let everyone return to their own people, let everyone flee to their own land.

verses.textZh: 以色列是被赶散的羊，它被狮子赶逐。先是亚述王把它吞灭，现在巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒要咬碎它的骨头。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列是被赶散的羊，它被狮子赶逐。先是亚述王把它吞灭，现在巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒要咬碎它的骨头。
verses.textZhCuv: 「以色列是打散的羊，是被狮子赶出的。首先是亚述王将他吞灭，末后是巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒将他的骨头折断。」
verses.textEnNiv: "Israel is a scattered flock that lions have chased away. The first to devour them was the king of Assyria; the last to crush their bones was Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon."
verses.textEnEsv: "Israel is a hunted sheep driven away by lions. First the king of Assyria devoured him, and now at last Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon has gnawed his bones.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Israel is like scattered sheep; The lions have driven him away. First the king of Assyria devoured him; Now at last this Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon has broken his bones."
verses.textEnNlt: "The Israelites are like sheep that have been scattered by lions. First the king of Assyria ate them up. Then King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylon cracked their bones."
verses.textEnNasb: "Israel is a scattered flock, the lions have driven them away. The first one who devoured him was the king of Assyria, and this last one who has gnawed his bones is Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon.
verses.textEn: "Israel is a scattered flock that lions have chased away. The first to devour them was the king of Assyria; the last to crush their bones was Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon."

verses.textZh: 因此，万军之耶和华神这样说："看哪！我必惩罚巴比伦王和他的国土，像我以前惩罚亚述王一样，
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，万军之耶和华神这样说："看哪！我必惩罚巴比伦王和他的国土，像我以前惩罚亚述王一样，
verses.textZhCuv: 所以万军之耶和华－以色列的神如此说：「我必罚巴比伦王和他的地，像我从前罚亚述王一样。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore this is what the Lord Almighty, the God of Israel, says: "I will punish the king of Babylon and his land as I punished the king of Assyria.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore, thus says the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel: Behold, I am bringing punishment on the king of Babylon and his land, as I punished the king of Assyria.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore thus says the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel: "Behold, I will punish the king of Babylon and his land, As I have punished the king of Assyria.
verses.textEnNlt: Therefore, this is what the Lord of Heaven’s Armies, the God of Israel, says: "Now I will punish the king of Babylon and his land, just as I punished the king of Assyria.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore this is what the Lord of armies, the God of Israel says: ‘Behold, I am going to punish the king of Babylon and his land, just as I punished the king of Assyria.
verses.textEn: Therefore this is what the Lord Almighty, the God of Israel, says: "I will punish the king of Babylon and his land as I punished the king of Assyria.

verses.textZh: 我必领以色列回到它的牧场，它必在迦密和巴珊吃草，又在以法莲山地和基列地吃得饱足。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必领以色列回到它的牧场，它必在迦密和巴珊吃草，又在以法莲山地和基列地吃得饱足。
verses.textZhCuv: 我必再领以色列回他的草场，他必在迦密和巴珊吃草，又在以法莲山上和基列境内得以饱足。」
verses.textEnNiv: But I will bring Israel back to their own pasture, and they will graze on Carmel and Bashan; their appetite will be satisfied on the hills of Ephraim and Gilead.
verses.textEnEsv: I will restore Israel to his pasture, and he shall feed on Carmel and in Bashan, and his desire shall be satisfied on the hills of Ephraim and in Gilead.
verses.textEnNkjv: But I will bring back Israel to his home, And he shall feed on Carmel and Bashan; His soul shall be satisfied on Mount Ephraim and Gilead.
verses.textEnNlt: And I will bring Israel home again to its own land, to feed in the fields of Carmel and Bashan, and to be satisfied once more in the hill country of Ephraim and Gilead.
verses.textEnNasb: And I will bring Israel back to his pasture and he will graze on Carmel and Bashan, and his desire will be satisfied in the hill country of Ephraim and Gilead.
verses.textEn: But I will bring Israel back to their own pasture, and they will graze on Carmel and Bashan; their appetite will be satisfied on the hills of Ephraim and Gilead.

verses.textZh: 到那些日子，那时候，人要寻查以色列的罪孽，却无所发现；要查究犹大的罪恶，却一无所见；因为我必赦免我留下的那些人。"这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 到那些日子，那时候，人要寻查以色列的罪孽，却无所发现；要查究犹大的罪恶，却一无所见；因为我必赦免我留下的那些人。"这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华说：「当那日子、那时候，虽寻以色列的罪孽，一无所有；虽寻犹大的罪恶，也无所见；因为我所留下的人，我必赦免。」
verses.textEnNiv: In those days, at that time," declares the Lord , "search will be made for Israel’s guilt, but there will be none, and for the sins of Judah, but none will be found, for I will forgive the remnant I spare.
verses.textEnEsv: In those days and in that time, declares the Lord , iniquity shall be sought in Israel, and there shall be none, and sin in Judah, and none shall be found, for I will pardon those whom I leave as a remnant.
verses.textEnNkjv: In those days and in that time," says the Lord, "The iniquity of Israel shall be sought, but thereshallbe none; And the sins of Judah, but they shall not be found; For I will pardon those whom I preserve.
verses.textEnNlt: In those days," says the Lord , "no sin will be found in Israel or in Judah, for I will forgive the remnant I preserve.
verses.textEnNasb: In those days and at that time,’ declares the Lord, ‘search will be made for the wrongdoing of Israel, but there will be none; and for the sins of Judah, but they will not be found; for I will forgive those whom I leave as a remnant.’
verses.textEn: In those days, at that time," declares the Lord , "search will be made for Israel’s guilt, but there will be none, and for the sins of Judah, but none will be found, for I will forgive the remnant I spare.

verses.textZh: "你们要攻击米拉大翁的地， 上去攻击她， 又攻击比割的居民， 屠杀他们，把他们彻底消灭， 照着我吩咐你们的一切执行。" 这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你们要攻击米拉大翁的地， 上去攻击她， 又攻击比割的居民， 屠杀他们，把他们彻底消灭， 照着我吩咐你们的一切执行。" 这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华说：上去攻击米拉大翁之地， 又攻击比割的居民。 要追杀灭尽， 照我一切所吩咐你的去行。
verses.textEnNiv: "Attack the land of Merathaim and those who live in Pekod. Pursue, kill and completely destroy them," declares the Lord . "Do everything I have commanded you.
verses.textEnEsv: "Go up against the land of Merathaim, and against the inhabitants of Pekod. Kill, and devote them to destruction, declares the Lord , and do all that I have commanded you.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Go up against the land of Merathaim, against it, And against the inhabitants of Pekod. Waste and utterly destroy them," says the Lord, "And do according to all that I have commanded you.
verses.textEnNlt: "Go up, my warriors, against the land of Merathaim and against the people of Pekod. Pursue, kill, and completely destroy them, as I have commanded you," says the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: "Against the land of Merathaim, go up against it, And against the inhabitants of Pekod. Kill and completely destroy them," declares the Lord, "And do according to everything that I have commanded you.
verses.textEn: "Attack the land of Merathaim and those who live in Pekod. Pursue, kill and completely destroy them," declares the Lord . "Do everything I have commanded you.

verses.textZh: 境内有战争的声音， 和极大的毁灭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 境内有战争的声音， 和极大的毁灭。
verses.textZhCuv: 境内有打仗和大毁灭的响声。
verses.textEnNiv: The noise of battle is in the land, the noise of great destruction!
verses.textEnEsv: The noise of battle is in the land, and great destruction!
verses.textEnNkjv: A sound of battle is in the land, And of great destruction.
verses.textEnNlt: "Let the battle cry be heard in the land, a shout of great destruction.
verses.textEnNasb: "The noise of battle is in the land, And great destruction.
verses.textEn: The noise of battle is in the land, the noise of great destruction!

verses.textZh: 击打全地的大锤，怎么被砍断毁掉！ 巴比伦在列国中，怎么成了令人惊骇的对象呢！
verses.textZhCnvs: 击打全地的大锤，怎么被砍断毁掉！ 巴比伦在列国中，怎么成了令人惊骇的对象呢！
verses.textZhCuv: 全地的大锤何竟砍断破坏？ 巴比伦在列国中何竟荒凉？
verses.textEnNiv: How broken and shattered is the hammer of the whole earth! How desolate is Babylon among the nations!
verses.textEnEsv: How the hammer of the whole earth is cut down and broken! How Babylon has become a horror among the nations!
verses.textEnNkjv: How the hammer of the whole earth has been cut apart and broken! How Babylon has become a desolation among the nations!
verses.textEnNlt: Babylon, the mightiest hammer in all the earth, lies broken and shattered. Babylon is desolate among the nations!
verses.textEnNasb: "How the hammer of the whole earth Has been cut off and broken! How Babylon has become An object of horror among the nations!
verses.textEn: How broken and shattered is the hammer of the whole earth! How desolate is Babylon among the nations!

verses.textZh: "巴比伦哪！我设下网罗捉拿你， 你被捉住，仍不自觉； 你被发现，也被抓住， 因为你和耶和华争斗。"
verses.textZhCnvs: "巴比伦哪！我设下网罗捉拿你， 你被捉住，仍不自觉； 你被发现，也被抓住， 因为你和耶和华争斗。"
verses.textZhCuv: 巴比伦哪，我为你设下网罗， 你不知不觉被缠住。 你被寻着，也被捉住； 因为你与耶和华争竞。
verses.textEnNiv: I set a trap for you, Babylon, and you were caught before you knew it; you were found and captured because you opposed the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: I set a snare for you and you were taken, O Babylon, and you did not know it; you were found and caught, because you opposed the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: I have laid a snare for you; You have indeed been trapped, O Babylon, And you were not aware; You have been found and also caught, Because you have contended against the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: Listen, Babylon, for I have set a trap for you. You are caught, for you have fought against the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: "I set a trap for you and you were also caught, Babylon, While you yourself were not aware; You have been found and also seized Because you have engaged in conflict with the Lord."
verses.textEn: I set a trap for you, Babylon, and you were caught before you knew it; you were found and captured because you opposed the Lord .

verses.textZh: 耶和华打开了自己的军械库， 拿出他忿怒的武器； 因为主万军之耶和华 在迦勒底人的地有事要作。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华打开了自己的军械库， 拿出他忿怒的武器； 因为主万军之耶和华 在迦勒底人的地有事要作。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华已经开了武库， 拿出他恼恨的兵器； 因为主－万军之耶和华 在迦勒底人之地有当做的事。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord has opened his arsenal and brought out the weapons of his wrath, for the Sovereign Lord Almighty has work to do in the land of the Babylonians.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord has opened his armory and brought out the weapons of his wrath, for the Lord God of hosts has a work to do in the land of the Chaldeans.
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord has opened His armory, And has brought out the weapons of His indignation; For this is the work of the Lord God of hosts In the land of the Chaldeans.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord has opened his armory and brought out weapons to vent his fury. The terror that falls upon the Babylonians will be the work of the Sovereign Lord of Heaven’s Armies.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord has opened His armory And has brought out the weapons of His indignation, For it is a work of the Lord God of armies In the land of the Chaldeans.
verses.textEn: The Lord has opened his arsenal and brought out the weapons of his wrath, for the Sovereign Lord Almighty has work to do in the land of the Babylonians.

verses.textZh: 你们要从四面八方攻击巴比伦， 打开它的谷仓， 把它堆起来好象堆谷物一样； 把它彻底消灭， 甚么都不留下。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要从四面八方攻击巴比伦， 打开它的谷仓， 把它堆起来好象堆谷物一样； 把它彻底消灭， 甚么都不留下。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要从极远的边界来攻击她， 开她的仓廪， 将她堆如高堆， 毁灭净尽，丝毫不留。
verses.textEnNiv: Come against her from afar. Break open her granaries; pile her up like heaps of grain. Completely destroy her and leave her no remnant.
verses.textEnEsv: Come against her from every quarter; open her granaries; pile her up like heaps of grain, and devote her to destruction; let nothing be left of her.
verses.textEnNkjv: Come against her from the farthest border; Open her storehouses; Cast her up as heaps of ruins, And destroy her utterly; Let nothing of her be left.
verses.textEnNlt: Yes, come against her from distant lands. Break open her granaries. Crush her walls and houses into heaps of rubble. Destroy her completely, and leave nothing!
verses.textEnNasb: Come to her from the farthest border; Open up her barns, Pile her up like heaps of grain And completely destroy her, Let nothing be left to her.
verses.textEn: Come against her from afar. Break open her granaries; pile her up like heaps of grain. Completely destroy her and leave her no remnant.

verses.textZh: 要击杀它所有的公牛， 使他们下去被屠杀！ 他们有祸了！因为他们的日子， 就是他们受惩罚的时候，来到了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 要击杀它所有的公牛， 使他们下去被屠杀！ 他们有祸了！因为他们的日子， 就是他们受惩罚的时候，来到了。
verses.textZhCuv: 要杀她的一切牛犊， 使他们下去遭遇杀戮。 他们有祸了， 因为追讨他们的日子已经来到。 （
verses.textEnNiv: Kill all her young bulls; let them go down to the slaughter! Woe to them! For their day has come, the time for them to be punished.
verses.textEnEsv: Kill all her bulls; let them go down to the slaughter. Woe to them, for their day has come, the time of their punishment.
verses.textEnNkjv: Slay all her bulls, Let them go down to the slaughter. Woe to them! For their day has come, the time of their punishment.
verses.textEnNlt: Destroy even her young bulls— it will be terrible for them, too! Slaughter them all! For Babylon’s day of reckoning has come.
verses.textEnNasb: Put all her bulls to the sword; Let them go down to the slaughter! Woe be upon them, for their day has come, The time of their punishment.
verses.textEn: Kill all her young bulls; let them go down to the slaughter! Woe to them! For their day has come, the time for them to be punished.

verses.textZh: 听哪！从巴比伦的地逃出得以脱险的人， 在锡安述说耶和华我们神的报复， 就是为他的殿而施行的报复。
verses.textZhCnvs: 听哪！从巴比伦的地逃出得以脱险的人， 在锡安述说耶和华我们神的报复， 就是为他的殿而施行的报复。
verses.textZhCuv: 有从巴比伦之地逃避出来的人，在锡安扬声报告耶和华－我们的神报仇，就是为他的殿报仇。）
verses.textEnNiv: Listen to the fugitives and refugees from Babylon declaring in Zion how the Lord our God has taken vengeance, vengeance for his temple.
verses.textEnEsv: "A voice! They flee and escape from the land of Babylon, to declare in Zion the vengeance of the Lord our God, vengeance for his temple.
verses.textEnNkjv: The voice of those who flee and escape from the land of Babylon Declares in Zion the vengeance of the Lord our God, The vengeance of His temple.
verses.textEnNlt: Listen to the people who have escaped from Babylon, as they tell in Jerusalem how the Lord our God has taken vengeance against those who destroyed his Temple.
verses.textEnNasb: There is a sound of fugitives and refugees from the land of Babylon, To declare in Zion the vengeance of the Lord our God, Vengeance for His temple.
verses.textEn: Listen to the fugitives and refugees from Babylon declaring in Zion how the Lord our God has taken vengeance, vengeance for his temple.

verses.textZh: "要召集弓箭手去攻击巴比伦， 要召集所有拉弓的； 要在巴比伦的四围安营攻击它， 不容一人逃脱。 要照着它的所作所为报应它， 它怎样待人，你们也要怎样待它； 因它狂傲地敌对耶和华， 与以色列的圣者为敌。
verses.textZhCnvs: "要召集弓箭手去攻击巴比伦， 要召集所有拉弓的； 要在巴比伦的四围安营攻击它， 不容一人逃脱。 要照着它的所作所为报应它， 它怎样待人，你们也要怎样待它； 因它狂傲地敌对耶和华， 与以色列的圣者为敌。
verses.textZhCuv: 「招集一切弓箭手来攻击巴比伦。要在巴比伦四围安营，不要容一人逃脱，照着她所做的报应她；她怎样待人，也要怎样待她，因为她向耶和华－以色列的圣者发了狂傲。
verses.textEnNiv: "Summon archers against Babylon, all those who draw the bow. Encamp all around her; let no one escape. Repay her for her deeds; do to her as she has done. For she has defied the Lord , the Holy One of Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: "Summon archers against Babylon, all those who bend the bow. Encamp around her; let no one escape. Repay her according to her deeds; do to her according to all that she has done. For she has proudly defied the Lord , the Holy One of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Call together the archers against Babylon. All you who bend the bow, encamp against it all around; Let none of them escape. Repay her according to her work; According to all she has done, do to her; For she has been proud against the Lord, Against the Holy One of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: "Send out a call for archers to come to Babylon. Surround the city so none can escape. Do to her as she has done to others, for she has defied the Lord , the Holy One of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: "Summon many against Babylon, All those who bend the bow: Encamp against her on every side, Let there be no escape . Repay her according to her work; According to all that she has done, so do to her; For she has become arrogant against the Lord, Against the Holy One of Israel.
verses.textEn: "Summon archers against Babylon, all those who draw the bow. Encamp all around her; let no one escape. Repay her for her deeds; do to her as she has done. For she has defied the Lord , the Holy One of Israel.

verses.textZh: 所以，它的年轻人必仆倒在它的街道上， 到那一天，它所有的战士都必被消灭。" 这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以，它的年轻人必仆倒在它的街道上， 到那一天，它所有的战士都必被消灭。" 这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以她的少年人必仆倒在街上。当那日，一切兵丁必默默无声。这是耶和华说的。」
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore, her young men will fall in the streets; all her soldiers will be silenced in that day," declares the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore her young men shall fall in her squares, and all her soldiers shall be destroyed on that day, declares the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore her young men shall fall in the streets, And all her men of war shall be cut off in that day," says the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: Her young men will fall in the streets and die. Her soldiers will all be killed," says the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: "Therefore her young men will fall in her streets, And all her men of war will perish on that day," declares the Lord.
verses.textEn: Therefore, her young men will fall in the streets; all her soldiers will be silenced in that day," declares the Lord .

verses.textZh: "傲慢的人哪！我必敌对你 ， 因为你的日子，就是我惩罚你的时候，来到了。
verses.textZhCnvs: "傲慢的人哪！我必敌对你 ， 因为你的日子，就是我惩罚你的时候，来到了。
verses.textZhCuv: 主－万军之耶和华说： 你这狂傲的啊，我与你反对， 因为我追讨你的日子已经来到。
verses.textEnNiv: "See, I am against you, you arrogant one," declares the Lord, the Lord Almighty, "for your day has come, the time for you to be punished.
verses.textEnEsv: "Behold, I am against you, O proud one, declares the Lord God of hosts, for your day has come, the time when I will punish you.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Behold, I am against you, O most haughty one!" says the Lord God of hosts; "For your day has come, The time that I will punish you.
verses.textEnNlt: "See, I am your enemy, you arrogant people," says the Lord, the Lord of Heaven’s Armies. "Your day of reckoning has arrived— the day when I will punish you.
verses.textEnNasb: "Behold, I am against you, arrogant one," Declares the Lord God of armies, "For your day has come, The time when I will punish you.
verses.textEn: "See, I am against you, you arrogant one," declares the Lord, the Lord Almighty, "for your day has come, the time for you to be punished.

verses.textZh: 那傲慢的必绊跌仆倒， 没有人扶他起来； 我必在他的城镇中放火， 吞灭他四围的一切。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 那傲慢的必绊跌仆倒， 没有人扶他起来； 我必在他的城镇中放火， 吞灭他四围的一切。"
verses.textZhCuv: 狂傲的必绊跌仆倒，无人扶起。 我也必使火在他的城邑中着起来， 将他四围所有的尽行烧灭。
verses.textEnNiv: The arrogant one will stumble and fall and no one will help her up; I will kindle a fire in her towns that will consume all who are around her."
verses.textEnEsv: The proud one shall stumble and fall, with none to raise him up, and I will kindle a fire in his cities, and it will devour all that is around him.
verses.textEnNkjv: The most proud shall stumble and fall, And no one will raise him up; I will kindle a fire in his cities, And it will devour all around him."
verses.textEnNlt: O land of arrogance, you will stumble and fall, and no one will raise you up. For I will light a fire in the cities of Babylon that will burn up everything around them."
verses.textEnNasb: "The arrogant one will stumble and fall With no one to raise him up; And I will set fire to his cities, And it will devour all his surroundings."
verses.textEn: The arrogant one will stumble and fall and no one will help her up; I will kindle a fire in her towns that will consume all who are around her."

verses.textZh: 万军之耶和华这样说： "以色列人被压迫， 犹大人也一样受到欺压； 所有俘掳他们的都紧紧抓住他们， 不肯释放他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 万军之耶和华这样说： "以色列人被压迫， 犹大人也一样受到欺压； 所有俘掳他们的都紧紧抓住他们， 不肯释放他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 万军之耶和华如此说：「以色列人和犹大人一同受欺压；凡掳掠他们的都紧紧抓住他们，不肯释放。
verses.textEnNiv: This is what the Lord Almighty says: "The people of Israel are oppressed, and the people of Judah as well. All their captors hold them fast, refusing to let them go.
verses.textEnEsv: "Thus says the Lord of hosts: The people of Israel are oppressed, and the people of Judah with them. All who took them captive have held them fast; they refuse to let them go.
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus says the Lord of hosts: "The children of Israel were oppressed, Along with the children of Judah; All who took them captive have held them fast; They have refused to let them go.
verses.textEnNlt: This is what the Lord of Heaven’s Armies says: "The people of Israel and Judah have been wronged. Their captors hold them and refuse to let them go.
verses.textEnNasb: This is what the Lord of armies says: "The sons of Israel are oppressed, And the sons of Judah as well; And all who took them captive have held them firmly, They have refused to let them go.
verses.textEn: This is what the Lord Almighty says: "The people of Israel are oppressed, and the people of Judah as well. All their captors hold them fast, refusing to let them go.

verses.textZh: 但他们的救赎主大有能力， 万军之耶和华是他的名； 他必认真地为他们的案件申辩， 好使那地得到安宁， 却使巴比伦的居民惶乱不安。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但他们的救赎主大有能力， 万军之耶和华是他的名； 他必认真地为他们的案件申辩， 好使那地得到安宁， 却使巴比伦的居民惶乱不安。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们的救赎主大有能力，万军之耶和华是他的名。他必伸清他们的冤，好使全地得平安，并搅扰巴比伦的居民。」
verses.textEnNiv: Yet their Redeemer is strong; the Lord Almighty is his name. He will vigorously defend their cause so that he may bring rest to their land, but unrest to those who live in Babylon.
verses.textEnEsv: Their Redeemer is strong; the Lord of hosts is his name. He will surely plead their cause, that he may give rest to the earth, but unrest to the inhabitants of Babylon.
verses.textEnNkjv: Their Redeemer is strong; The Lord of hosts is His name. He will thoroughly plead their case, That He may give rest to the land, And disquiet the inhabitants of Babylon.
verses.textEnNlt: But the one who redeems them is strong. His name is the Lord of Heaven’s Armies. He will defend them and give them rest again in Israel. But for the people of Babylon there will be no rest!
verses.textEnNasb: "Their Redeemer is strong, the Lord of armies is His name; He will vigorously plead their case So that He may bring rest to their land, But turmoil to the inhabitants of Babylon.
verses.textEn: Yet their Redeemer is strong; the Lord Almighty is his name. He will vigorously defend their cause so that he may bring rest to their land, but unrest to those who live in Babylon.

verses.textZh: 刀剑必攻击迦勒底人， 攻击巴比伦的居民， 攻击它的领袖和智慧人。" 这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 刀剑必攻击迦勒底人， 攻击巴比伦的居民， 攻击它的领袖和智慧人。" 这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华说： 有刀剑临到迦勒底人和巴比伦的居民， 并她的首领与智慧人。
verses.textEnNiv: "A sword against the Babylonians!" declares the Lord — "against those who live in Babylon and against her officials and wise men!
verses.textEnEsv: "A sword against the Chaldeans, declares the Lord , and against the inhabitants of Babylon, and against her officials and her wise men!
verses.textEnNkjv: "A sword is against the Chaldeans," says the Lord, "Against the inhabitants of Babylon, And against her princes and her wise men.
verses.textEnNlt: "The sword of destruction will strike the Babylonians," says the Lord . "It will strike the people of Babylon— her officials and wise men, too.
verses.textEnNasb: "A sword against the Chaldeans," declares the Lord, "And against the inhabitants of Babylon And against her leaders and her wise men!
verses.textEn: "A sword against the Babylonians!" declares the Lord — "against those who live in Babylon and against her officials and wise men!

verses.textZh: "刀剑必攻击胡说八道的假先知， 他们必变成愚昧； 刀剑必攻击它的勇士， 他们必惊惶失措；
verses.textZhCnvs: "刀剑必攻击胡说八道的假先知， 他们必变成愚昧； 刀剑必攻击它的勇士， 他们必惊惶失措；
verses.textZhCuv: 有刀剑临到矜夸的人， 他们就成为愚昧； 有刀剑临到她的勇士， 他们就惊惶。
verses.textEnNiv: A sword against her false prophets! They will become fools. A sword against her warriors! They will be filled with terror.
verses.textEnEsv: A sword against the diviners, that they may become fools! A sword against her warriors, that they may be destroyed!
verses.textEnNkjv: A sword is against the soothsayers, and they will be fools. A sword is against her mighty men, and they will be dismayed.
verses.textEnNlt: The sword will strike her wise counselors, and they will become fools. The sword will strike her mightiest warriors, and panic will seize them.
verses.textEnNasb: "A sword against the oracle priests, and they will become fools! A sword against her warriors, and they will be shattered!
verses.textEn: A sword against her false prophets! They will become fools. A sword against her warriors! They will be filled with terror.

verses.textZh: 刀剑必攻击它的马匹和战车， 攻击它境内所有外族的人， 他们必像妇女一样柔弱； 刀剑必攻击它的一切宝库， 它们必被抢掠；
verses.textZhCnvs: 刀剑必攻击它的马匹和战车， 攻击它境内所有外族的人， 他们必像妇女一样柔弱； 刀剑必攻击它的一切宝库， 它们必被抢掠；
verses.textZhCuv: 有刀剑临到她的马匹、车辆， 和其中杂族的人民； 他们必像妇女一样。 有刀剑临到她的宝物， 就被抢夺。
verses.textEnNiv: A sword against her horses and chariots and all the foreigners in her ranks! They will become weaklings. A sword against her treasures! They will be plundered.
verses.textEnEsv: A sword against her horses and against her chariots, and against all the foreign troops in her midst, that they may become women! A sword against all her treasures, that they may be plundered!
verses.textEnNkjv: A sword is against their horses, Against their chariots, And against all the mixed peoples who are in her midst; And they will become like women. A sword is against her treasures, and they will be robbed.
verses.textEnNlt: The sword will strike her horses and chariots and her allies from other lands, and they will all become like women. The sword will strike her treasures, and they all will be plundered.
verses.textEnNasb: "A sword against their horses, against their chariots, And against all the foreigners who are in the midst of her, And they will become women! A sword against her treasures, and they will be plundered!
verses.textEn: A sword against her horses and chariots and all the foreigners in her ranks! They will become weaklings. A sword against her treasures! They will be plundered.

verses.textZh: 干旱 必攻击它的河流， 它们必干涸； 因为这是偶像的地， 人必因可怕的偶像迷失本性。
verses.textZhCnvs: 干旱 必攻击它的河流， 它们必干涸； 因为这是偶像的地， 人必因可怕的偶像迷失本性。
verses.textZhCuv: 有干旱临到她的众水， 就必干涸； 因为这是有雕刻偶像之地， 人因偶像而颠狂。
verses.textEnNiv: A drought on her waters! They will dry up. For it is a land of idols, idols that will go mad with terror.
verses.textEnEsv: A drought against her waters, that they may be dried up! For it is a land of images, and they are mad over idols.
verses.textEnNkjv: A drought is against her waters, and they will be dried up. For it is the land of carved images, And they are insane with their idols.
verses.textEnNlt: A drought will strike her water supply, causing it to dry up. And why? Because the whole land is filled with idols, and the people are madly in love with them.
verses.textEnNasb: "A drought on her waters, and they will be dried up! For it is a land of idols, And they go insane at frightful images.
verses.textEn: A drought on her waters! They will dry up. For it is a land of idols, idols that will go mad with terror.

verses.textZh: 旷野的走兽和豺狼必住在那里， 鸵鸟也必住在其中； 那地永远再没有人居住， 世世代代不再有人住在那里，
verses.textZhCnvs: 旷野的走兽和豺狼必住在那里， 鸵鸟也必住在其中； 那地永远再没有人居住， 世世代代不再有人住在那里，
verses.textZhCuv: 「所以旷野的走兽和豺狼必住在那里，鸵鸟也住在其中，永无人烟，世世代代无人居住。」
verses.textEnNiv: "So desert creatures and hyenas will live there, and there the owl will dwell. It will never again be inhabited or lived in from generation to generation.
verses.textEnEsv: "Therefore wild beasts shall dwell with hyenas in Babylon, and ostriches shall dwell in her. She shall never again have people, nor be inhabited for all generations.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Therefore the wild desert beasts shall dwell there with the jackals, And the ostriches shall dwell in it. It shall be inhabited no more forever, Nor shall it be dwelt in from generation to generation.
verses.textEnNlt: "Soon Babylon will be inhabited by desert animals and hyenas. It will be a home for owls. Never again will people live there; it will lie desolate forever.
verses.textEnNasb: "Therefore the desert creatures will live there with the jackals; The ostriches also will live in it. It will never again be inhabited Nor lived in from generation to generation.
verses.textEn: "So desert creatures and hyenas will live there, and there the owl will dwell. It will never again be inhabited or lived in from generation to generation.

verses.textZh: 就像神倾覆的所多玛、蛾摩拉， 和它们邻近的城镇一样； 必没有人住在那里， 也必没有人在那里寄居。" 这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 就像神倾覆的所多玛、蛾摩拉， 和它们邻近的城镇一样； 必没有人住在那里， 也必没有人在那里寄居。" 这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华说：「必无人住在那里，也无人在其中寄居，要像我倾覆所多玛、蛾摩拉，和邻近的城邑一样。
verses.textEnNiv: As I overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah along with their neighboring towns," declares the Lord , "so no one will live there; no people will dwell in it.
verses.textEnEsv: As when God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah and their neighboring cities, declares the Lord , so no man shall dwell there, and no son of man shall sojourn in her.
verses.textEnNkjv: As God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah And their neighbors," says the Lord, "So no one shall reside there, Nor son of man dwell in it.
verses.textEnNlt: I will destroy it as I destroyed Sodom and Gomorrah and their neighboring towns," says the Lord . "No one will live there; no one will inhabit it.
verses.textEnNasb: "As when God overthrew Sodom And Gomorrah with its neighbors," declares the Lord, "No one will live there, Nor will anyone of mankind reside in it.
verses.textEn: As I overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah along with their neighboring towns," declares the Lord , "so no one will live there; no people will dwell in it.

verses.textZh: "看哪！有一个民族从北方而来， 有一大国和许多君王被激动， 从地极来到。
verses.textZhCnvs: "看哪！有一个民族从北方而来， 有一大国和许多君王被激动， 从地极来到。
verses.textZhCuv: 看哪，有一种民从北方而来， 并有一大国和许多君王被激动，从地极来到。
verses.textEnNiv: "Look! An army is coming from the north; a great nation and many kings are being stirred up from the ends of the earth.
verses.textEnEsv: "Behold, a people comes from the north; a mighty nation and many kings are stirring from the farthest parts of the earth.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Behold, a people shall come from the north, And a great nation and many kings Shall be raised up from the ends of the earth.
verses.textEnNlt: "Look! A great army is coming from the north. A great nation and many kings are rising against you from far-off lands.
verses.textEnNasb: "Behold, a people is coming from the north, And a great nation and many kings Will be roused from the remote parts of the earth.
verses.textEn: "Look! An army is coming from the north; a great nation and many kings are being stirred up from the ends of the earth.

verses.textZh: 他们紧握弓和枪， 性情残忍，毫无怜悯； 他们的声音像海洋怒吼； 巴比伦的居民哪！ 他们骑着战马， 在战场上如同一人，列阵攻击你们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们紧握弓和枪， 性情残忍，毫无怜悯； 他们的声音像海洋怒吼； 巴比伦的居民哪！ 他们骑着战马， 在战场上如同一人，列阵攻击你们。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们拿弓和枪， 性情残忍，不施怜悯； 他们的声音像海浪匉訇。 巴比伦城 啊， 他们骑马， 都摆队伍如上战场的人， 要攻击你。
verses.textEnNiv: They are armed with bows and spears; they are cruel and without mercy. They sound like the roaring sea as they ride on their horses; they come like men in battle formation to attack you, Daughter Babylon.
verses.textEnEsv: They lay hold of bow and spear; they are cruel and have no mercy. The sound of them is like the roaring of the sea; they ride on horses, arrayed as a man for battle against you, O daughter of Babylon!
verses.textEnNkjv: They shall hold the bow and the lance; They are cruel and shall not show mercy. Their voice shall roar like the sea; They shall ride on horses, Set in array, like a man for the battle, Against you, O daughter of Babylon.
verses.textEnNlt: They are armed with bows and spears. They are cruel and show no mercy. As they ride forward on horses, they sound like a roaring sea. They are coming in battle formation, planning to destroy you, Babylon.
verses.textEnNasb: "They seize their bow and javelin; They are cruel and have no mercy. Their voice roars like the sea; And they ride on horses, Drawn up like a man for the battle Against you, daughter of Babylon.
verses.textEn: They are armed with bows and spears; they are cruel and without mercy. They sound like the roaring sea as they ride on their horses; they come like men in battle formation to attack you, Daughter Babylon.

verses.textZh: 巴比伦王听了有关他们的消息， 手就发软； 痛苦紧紧抓住他， 他疼痛好象正在生产的妇人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 巴比伦王听了有关他们的消息， 手就发软； 痛苦紧紧抓住他， 他疼痛好象正在生产的妇人。
verses.textZhCuv: 巴比伦王听见他们的风声， 手就发软， 痛苦将他抓住， 疼痛仿佛产难的妇人。
verses.textEnNiv: The king of Babylon has heard reports about them, and his hands hang limp. Anguish has gripped him, pain like that of a woman in labor.
verses.textEnEsv: "The king of Babylon heard the report of them, and his hands fell helpless; anguish seized him, pain as of a woman in labor.
verses.textEnNkjv: "The king of Babylon has heard the report about them, And his hands grow feeble; Anguish has taken hold of him, Pangs as of a woman in childbirth.
verses.textEnNlt: The king of Babylon has heard reports about the enemy, and he is weak with fright. Pangs of anguish have gripped him, like those of a woman in labor.
verses.textEnNasb: "The king of Babylon has heard the report about them, And his hands hang limp; Distress has gripped him, Agony like a woman in childbirth.
verses.textEn: The king of Babylon has heard reports about them, and his hands hang limp. Anguish has gripped him, pain like that of a woman in labor.

verses.textZh: 看哪！狮子怎样从约旦河边的丛林走上来， 攻击常绿的牧场， 照样，我必在眨眼之间把巴比伦赶走，使它离开这地； 谁蒙拣选，我就派谁治理这地。 谁能和我相比呢？谁可以把我传来审讯呢？ 哪一个牧人能在我面前站立得住呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 看哪！狮子怎样从约旦河边的丛林走上来， 攻击常绿的牧场， 照样，我必在眨眼之间把巴比伦赶走，使它离开这地； 谁蒙拣选，我就派谁治理这地。 谁能和我相比呢？谁可以把我传来审讯呢？ 哪一个牧人能在我面前站立得住呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 「仇敌必像狮子从约旦河边的丛林上来，攻击坚固的居所。转眼之间，我要使他们逃跑，离开这地。谁蒙拣选，我就派谁治理这地。谁能比我呢？谁能给我定规日期呢？有何牧人能在我面前站立得住呢？
verses.textEnNiv: Like a lion coming up from Jordan’s thickets to a rich pastureland, I will chase Babylon from its land in an instant. Who is the chosen one I will appoint for this? Who is like me and who can challenge me? And what shepherd can stand against me?"
verses.textEnEsv: "Behold, like a lion coming up from the thicket of the Jordan against a perennial pasture, I will suddenly make them run away from her, and I will appoint over her whomever I choose. For who is like me? Who will summon me? What shepherd can stand before me?
verses.textEnNkjv: "Behold, he shall come up like a lion from the floodplain of the Jordan Against the dwelling place of the strong; But I will make them suddenly run away from her. And who is a chosen manthat I may appoint over her? For who is like Me? Who will arraign Me? And who is that shepherd Who will withstand Me?"
verses.textEnNlt: "I will come like a lion from the thickets of the Jordan, leaping on the sheep in the pasture. I will chase Babylon from its land, and I will appoint the leader of my choice. For who is like me, and who can challenge me? What ruler can oppose my will?"
verses.textEnNasb: "Behold, one will come up like a lion from the thicket of the Jordan to a perennially watered pasture; for in an instant I will chase them away from it, and I will appoint over it whoever is chosen. For who is like Me, and who will summon Me into court? And who then is the shepherd who can stand against Me?"
verses.textEn: Like a lion coming up from Jordan’s thickets to a rich pastureland, I will chase Babylon from its land in an instant. Who is the chosen one I will appoint for this? Who is like me and who can challenge me? And what shepherd can stand against me?"

verses.textZh: 因此，你们要听耶和华筹谋对付巴比伦的计划， 和他为了攻击迦勒底人的地所定下的策略。 他们羊群中最小的也必被拉去， 他们的牧场也必因临到它们的灾祸而荒废。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，你们要听耶和华筹谋对付巴比伦的计划， 和他为了攻击迦勒底人的地所定下的策略。 他们羊群中最小的也必被拉去， 他们的牧场也必因临到它们的灾祸而荒废。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要听耶和华攻击巴比伦所说的谋略和他攻击迦勒底人之地所定的旨意。仇敌定要将他们群众微弱的拉去，定要使他们的居所荒凉。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore, hear what the Lord has planned against Babylon, what he has purposed against the land of the Babylonians: The young of the flock will be dragged away; their pasture will be appalled at their fate.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore hear the plan that the Lord has made against Babylon, and the purposes that he has formed against the land of the Chaldeans: Surely the little ones of their flock shall be dragged away; surely their fold shall be appalled at their fate.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore hear the counsel of the Lord that He has taken against Babylon, And His purposes that He has proposed against the land of the Chaldeans: Surely the least of the flock shall draw them out; Surely He will make their dwelling place desolate with them.
verses.textEnNlt: Listen to the Lord ’s plans against Babylon and the land of the Babylonians. Even the little children will be dragged off like sheep, and their homes will be destroyed.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore hear the plan of the Lord which He has planned against Babylon, and His purposes which He has in mind against the land of the Chaldeans: they will certainly drag them off, even the little ones of the flock; He will certainly make their pasture desolate because of them.
verses.textEn: Therefore, hear what the Lord has planned against Babylon, what he has purposed against the land of the Babylonians: The young of the flock will be dragged away; their pasture will be appalled at their fate.

verses.textZh: 因巴比伦陷落的响声， 地就震动； 列国都听见它的哀叫声。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因巴比伦陷落的响声， 地就震动； 列国都听见它的哀叫声。
verses.textZhCuv: 因巴比伦被取的声音，地就震动，人在列邦都听见呼喊的声音。」
verses.textEnNiv: At the sound of Babylon’s capture the earth will tremble; its cry will resound among the nations.
verses.textEnEsv: At the sound of the capture of Babylon the earth shall tremble, and her cry shall be heard among the nations."
verses.textEnNkjv: At the noise of the taking of Babylon The earth trembles, And the cry is heard among the nations.
verses.textEnNlt: The earth will shake with the shout, "Babylon has been taken!" and its cry of despair will be heard around the world.
verses.textEnNasb: At the shout, "Babylon has been conquered!" the earth quakes, and an outcry is heard among the nations.
verses.textEn: At the sound of Babylon’s capture the earth will tremble; its cry will resound among the nations.

verses.textZh: 耶和华这样说： "看哪！我必激动毁灭者的心， 去攻击巴比伦和住在立加米的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华这样说： "看哪！我必激动毁灭者的心， 去攻击巴比伦和住在立加米的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华如此说： 我必使毁灭的风刮起， 攻击巴比伦和住在立加米的人。
verses.textEnNiv: This is what the Lord says: "See, I will stir up the spirit of a destroyer against Babylon and the people of Leb Kamai.
verses.textEnEsv: Thus says the Lord : "Behold, I will stir up the spirit of a destroyer against Babylon, against the inhabitants of Leb-kamai,
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus says the Lord: "Behold, I will raise up against Babylon, Against those who dwell in Leb Kamai, A destroying wind.
verses.textEnNlt: This is what the Lord says: "I will stir up a destroyer against Babylon and the people of Babylonia.
verses.textEnNasb: This is what the Lord says: "Behold, I am going to stir up The spirit of a destroyer against Babylon And against the inhabitants of Leb-kamai.
verses.textEn: This is what the Lord says: "See, I will stir up the spirit of a destroyer against Babylon and the people of Leb Kamai.

verses.textZh: 我必打发外族人去巴比伦簸扬它， 扬净它的地； 在它遭祸的日子， 他们必从四围攻击它。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必打发外族人去巴比伦簸扬它， 扬净它的地； 在它遭祸的日子， 他们必从四围攻击它。
verses.textZhCuv: 我要打发外邦人来到巴比伦， 簸扬她，使她的地空虚。 在她遭祸的日子， 他们要周围攻击她。
verses.textEnNiv: I will send foreigners to Babylon to winnow her and to devastate her land; they will oppose her on every side in the day of her disaster.
verses.textEnEsv: and I will send to Babylon winnowers, and they shall winnow her, and they shall empty her land, when they come against her from every side on the day of trouble.
verses.textEnNkjv: And I will send winnowers to Babylon, Who shall winnow her and empty her land. For in the day of doom They shall be against her all around.
verses.textEnNlt: Foreigners will come and winnow her, blowing her away as chaff. They will come from every side to rise against her in her day of trouble.
verses.textEnNasb: "I will send foreigners to Babylon so that they may winnow her And devastate her land; For they will be opposed to her on every side On the day of her disaster.
verses.textEn: I will send foreigners to Babylon to winnow her and to devastate her land; they will oppose her on every side in the day of her disaster.

verses.textZh: 不要容拉弓的拉他的弓， 也不要容战士穿上盔甲站起来； 不要顾惜巴比伦的年轻人， 要把它的全军灭绝。
verses.textZhCnvs: 不要容拉弓的拉他的弓， 也不要容战士穿上盔甲站起来； 不要顾惜巴比伦的年轻人， 要把它的全军灭绝。
verses.textZhCuv: 拉弓的，要向拉弓的和贯甲挺身的射箭。 不要怜惜她的少年人； 要灭尽她的全军。
verses.textEnNiv: Let not the archer string his bow, nor let him put on his armor. Do not spare her young men; completely destroy her army.
verses.textEnEsv: Let not the archer bend his bow, and let him not stand up in his armor. Spare not her young men; devote to destruction all her army.
verses.textEnNkjv: Against her let the archer bend his bow, And lift himself up against her in his armor. Do not spare her young men; Utterly destroy all her army.
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t let the archers put on their armor or draw their bows. Don’t spare even her best soldiers! Let her army be completely destroyed.
verses.textEnNasb: "Let not him who bends his bow bend it, Nor let him rise up in his coat of armor. Do not spare her young men; Devote all her army to destruction.
verses.textEn: Let not the archer string his bow, nor let him put on his armor. Do not spare her young men; completely destroy her army.

verses.textZh: 它的全军必在迦勒底人的地被杀倒下， 在它的街道上被刺死。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 它的全军必在迦勒底人的地被杀倒下， 在它的街道上被刺死。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们必在迦勒底人之地被杀仆倒， 在巴比伦的街上被刺透。
verses.textEnNiv: They will fall down slain in Babylon, fatally wounded in her streets.
verses.textEnEsv: They shall fall down slain in the land of the Chaldeans, and wounded in her streets.
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus the slain shall fall in the land of the Chaldeans, And those thrust through in her streets.
verses.textEnNlt: They will fall dead in the land of the Babylonians, slashed to death in her streets.
verses.textEnNasb: "They will fall down dead in the land of the Chaldeans, And pierced through in their streets."
verses.textEn: They will fall down slain in Babylon, fatally wounded in her streets.

verses.textZh: 但以色列和犹大却不会被他们的神万军之耶和华遗弃，虽然他们的地在以色列圣者面前充满了罪恶。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但以色列和犹大却不会被他们的神万军之耶和华遗弃，虽然他们的地在以色列圣者面前充满了罪恶。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列和犹大虽然境内充满违背以色列圣者的罪， 却没有被他的神－万军之耶和华丢弃。
verses.textEnNiv: For Israel and Judah have not been forsaken by their God, the Lord Almighty, though their land is full of guilt before the Holy One of Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: For Israel and Judah have not been forsaken by their God, the Lord of hosts, but the land of the Chaldeans is full of guilt against the Holy One of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: For Israel is not forsaken, nor Judah, By his God, the Lord of hosts, Though their land was filled with sin against the Holy One of Israel."
verses.textEnNlt: For the Lord of Heaven’s Armies has not abandoned Israel and Judah. He is still their God, even though their land was filled with sin against the Holy One of Israel."
verses.textEnNasb: For neither Israel nor Judah has been forsaken By his God, the Lord of armies, Although their land is full of guilt Before the Holy One of Israel.
verses.textEn: For Israel and Judah have not been forsaken by their God, the Lord Almighty, though their land is full of guilt before the Holy One of Israel.

verses.textZh: 你仍要从巴比伦境内逃出来， 各自逃命！ 不要因它的罪孽灭亡； 因为这是耶和华报复的时候， 他必向巴比伦施行应得的报应。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你仍要从巴比伦境内逃出来， 各自逃命！ 不要因它的罪孽灭亡； 因为这是耶和华报复的时候， 他必向巴比伦施行应得的报应。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要从巴比伦中逃奔， 各救自己的性命！ 不要陷在她的罪孽中一同灭亡； 因为这是耶和华报仇的时候， 他必向巴比伦施行报应。
verses.textEnNiv: "Flee from Babylon! Run for your lives! Do not be destroyed because of her sins. It is time for the Lord ’s vengeance; he will repay her what she deserves.
verses.textEnEsv: "Flee from the midst of Babylon; let every one save his life! Be not cut off in her punishment, for this is the time of the Lord ’s vengeance, the repayment he is rendering her.
verses.textEnNkjv: Flee from the midst of Babylon, And every one save his life! Do not be cut off in her iniquity, For this is the time of the Lord’s vengeance; He shall recompense her.
verses.textEnNlt: Flee from Babylon! Save yourselves! Don’t get trapped in her punishment! It is the Lord ’s time for vengeance; he will repay her in full.
verses.textEnNasb: Flee from the midst of Babylon, And each of you save his life! Do not perish in her punishment, For this is the Lord’s time of vengeance; He is going to repay to her what she deserves.
verses.textEn: "Flee from Babylon! Run for your lives! Do not be destroyed because of her sins. It is time for the Lord ’s vengeance; he will repay her what she deserves.

verses.textZh: 巴比伦曾是耶和华手中的金杯， 使全地都喝醉； 列国喝了它的酒， 就都疯狂乱性。
verses.textZhCnvs: 巴比伦曾是耶和华手中的金杯， 使全地都喝醉； 列国喝了它的酒， 就都疯狂乱性。
verses.textZhCuv: 巴比伦素来是耶和华手中的金杯， 使天下沉醉； 万国喝了她的酒就颠狂了。
verses.textEnNiv: Babylon was a gold cup in the Lord ’s hand; she made the whole earth drunk. The nations drank her wine; therefore they have now gone mad.
verses.textEnEsv: Babylon was a golden cup in the Lord ’s hand, making all the earth drunken; the nations drank of her wine; therefore the nations went mad.
verses.textEnNkjv: Babylon was a golden cup in the Lord’s hand, That made all the earth drunk. The nations drank her wine; Therefore the nations are deranged.
verses.textEnNlt: Babylon has been a gold cup in the Lord ’s hands, a cup that made the whole earth drunk. The nations drank Babylon’s wine, and it drove them all mad.
verses.textEnNasb: Babylon has been a golden cup in the hand of the Lord, Intoxicating all the earth. The nations have drunk of her wine; Therefore the nations are going insane.
verses.textEn: Babylon was a gold cup in the Lord ’s hand; she made the whole earth drunk. The nations drank her wine; therefore they have now gone mad.

verses.textZh: 巴比伦必突然倾覆毁灭， 你们要为它哀号！ 拿乳香来消除它的痛楚， 也许可以治好它。
verses.textZhCnvs: 巴比伦必突然倾覆毁灭， 你们要为它哀号！ 拿乳香来消除它的痛楚， 也许可以治好它。
verses.textZhCuv: 巴比伦忽然倾覆毁坏； 要为她哀号； 为止她的疼痛， 拿乳香或者可以治好。
verses.textEnNiv: Babylon will suddenly fall and be broken. Wail over her! Get balm for her pain; perhaps she can be healed.
verses.textEnEsv: Suddenly Babylon has fallen and been broken; wail for her! Take balm for her pain; perhaps she may be healed.
verses.textEnNkjv: Babylon has suddenly fallen and been destroyed. Wail for her! Take balm for her pain; Perhaps she may be healed.
verses.textEnNlt: But suddenly Babylon, too, has fallen. Weep for her. Give her medicine. Perhaps she can yet be healed.
verses.textEnNasb: Suddenly Babylon has fallen and been broken; Wail over her! Bring balm for her pain; Perhaps she may be healed.
verses.textEn: Babylon will suddenly fall and be broken. Wail over her! Get balm for her pain; perhaps she can be healed.

verses.textZh: 我们本想医治巴比伦，但它没有治好。 我们离开它，各归本地去吧！ 因为它的刑罚极大，上达于天， 直到云霄。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们本想医治巴比伦，但它没有治好。 我们离开它，各归本地去吧！ 因为它的刑罚极大，上达于天， 直到云霄。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们想医治巴比伦， 她却没有治好。 离开她吧！我们各人归回本国； 因为她受的审判通于上天，达到穹苍。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘We would have healed Babylon, but she cannot be healed; let us leave her and each go to our own land, for her judgment reaches to the skies, it rises as high as the heavens.’
verses.textEnEsv: We would have healed Babylon, but she was not healed. Forsake her, and let us go each to his own country, for her judgment has reached up to heaven and has been lifted up even to the skies.
verses.textEnNkjv: We would have healed Babylon, But she is not healed. Forsake her, and let us go everyone to his own country; For her judgment reaches to heaven and is lifted up to the skies.
verses.textEnNlt: We would have helped her if we could, but nothing can save her now. Let her go; abandon her. Return now to your own land. For her punishment reaches to the heavens; it is so great it cannot be measured.
verses.textEnNasb: We applied healing to Babylon, but she was not healed; Abandon her and let’s each go to his own country, For her judgment has reached to heaven And it rises to the clouds.
verses.textEn: " ‘We would have healed Babylon, but she cannot be healed; let us leave her and each go to our own land, for her judgment reaches to the skies, it rises as high as the heavens.’

verses.textZh: 耶和华已为我们伸冤； 来吧！我们要在锡安宣扬耶和华我们神的作为。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华已为我们伸冤； 来吧！我们要在锡安宣扬耶和华我们神的作为。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华已经彰显我们的公义。 来吧！我们可以在锡安 报告耶和华－我们神的作为。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘The Lord has vindicated us; come, let us tell in Zion what the Lord our God has done.’
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord has brought about our vindication; come, let us declare in Zion the work of the Lord our God.
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord has revealed our righteousness. Come and let us declare in Zion the work of the Lord our God.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord has vindicated us. Come, let us announce in Jerusalem everything the Lord our God has done.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord has brought about our vindication; Come and let’s recount in Zion The work of the Lord our God!
verses.textEn: " ‘The Lord has vindicated us; come, let us tell in Zion what the Lord our God has done.’

verses.textZh: 你们要磨尖箭头，拿起盾牌 ； 耶和华定意要毁灭巴比伦， 所以激动玛代诸王的心； 这是耶和华的报复， 就是为他的殿而施行的报复。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要磨尖箭头，拿起盾牌 ； 耶和华定意要毁灭巴比伦， 所以激动玛代诸王的心； 这是耶和华的报复， 就是为他的殿而施行的报复。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要磨尖了箭头， 抓住盾牌。 耶和华定意攻击巴比伦，将她毁灭，所以激动了米底亚君王的心；因这是耶和华报仇，就是为自己的殿报仇。
verses.textEnNiv: "Sharpen the arrows, take up the shields! The Lord has stirred up the kings of the Medes, because his purpose is to destroy Babylon. The Lord will take vengeance, vengeance for his temple.
verses.textEnEsv: "Sharpen the arrows! Take up the shields! The Lord has stirred up the spirit of the kings of the Medes, because his purpose concerning Babylon is to destroy it, for that is the vengeance of the Lord , the vengeance for his temple.
verses.textEnNkjv: Make the arrows bright! Gather the shields! The Lord has raised up the spirit of the kings of the Medes. For His plan is against Babylon to destroy it, Because it is the vengeance of the Lord, The vengeance for His temple.
verses.textEnNlt: Sharpen the arrows! Lift up the shields! For the Lord has inspired the kings of the Medes to march against Babylon and destroy her. This is his vengeance against those who desecrated his Temple.
verses.textEnNasb: Sharpen the arrows, fill the quivers! The Lord has stirred up the spirit of the kings of the Medes, Because His plan is against Babylon to destroy it; For it is the vengeance of the Lord, vengeance for His temple.
verses.textEn: "Sharpen the arrows, take up the shields! The Lord has stirred up the kings of the Medes, because his purpose is to destroy Babylon. The Lord will take vengeance, vengeance for his temple.

verses.textZh: 你们要竖起旗帜，攻击巴比伦的城墙， 并要加强防卫，设立防哨，布下埋伏； 因为耶和华不但定意， 也必作成他攻击巴比伦居民的话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要竖起旗帜，攻击巴比伦的城墙， 并要加强防卫，设立防哨，布下埋伏； 因为耶和华不但定意， 也必作成他攻击巴比伦居民的话。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要竖立大旗， 攻击巴比伦的城墙； 要坚固了望台， 派定守望的设下埋伏； 因为耶和华指着巴比伦居民所说的话、 所定的意，他已经作成。
verses.textEnNiv: Lift up a banner against the walls of Babylon! Reinforce the guard, station the watchmen, prepare an ambush! The Lord will carry out his purpose, his decree against the people of Babylon.
verses.textEnEsv: "Set up a standard against the walls of Babylon; make the watch strong; set up watchmen; prepare the ambushes; for the Lord has both planned and done what he spoke concerning the inhabitants of Babylon.
verses.textEnNkjv: Set up the standard on the walls of Babylon; Make the guard strong, Set up the watchmen, Prepare the ambushes. For the Lord has both devised and done What He spoke against the inhabitants of Babylon.
verses.textEnNlt: Raise the battle flag against Babylon! Reinforce the guard and station the watchmen. Prepare an ambush, for the Lord will fulfill all his plans against Babylon.
verses.textEnNasb: Lift up a signal flag against the walls of Babylon; Post a strong guard, Station sentries, Set up an ambush! For the Lord has both planned and performed What He spoke concerning the inhabitants of Babylon.
verses.textEn: Lift up a banner against the walls of Babylon! Reinforce the guard, station the watchmen, prepare an ambush! The Lord will carry out his purpose, his decree against the people of Babylon.

verses.textZh: 你这住在众水旁， 多有财宝的啊！ 你的结局到了， 你被剪除的时刻到了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你这住在众水旁， 多有财宝的啊！ 你的结局到了， 你被剪除的时刻到了。
verses.textZhCuv: 住在众水之上多有财宝的啊， 你的结局到了！ 你贪婪之量满了！
verses.textEnNiv: You who live by many waters and are rich in treasures, your end has come, the time for you to be destroyed.
verses.textEnEsv: O you who dwell by many waters, rich in treasures, your end has come; the thread of your life is cut.
verses.textEnNkjv: O you who dwell by many waters, Abundant in treasures, Your end has come, The measure of your covetousness.
verses.textEnNlt: You are a city by a great river, a great center of commerce, but your end has come. The thread of your life is cut.
verses.textEnNasb: You who live by many waters, Abundant in treasures, Your end has come, The measure of your end.
verses.textEn: You who live by many waters and are rich in treasures, your end has come, the time for you to be destroyed.

verses.textZh: 万军之耶和华指着自己起誓，说： "我必使敌人充满你，像蝗虫一样布满你的全地， 他们必对你发出胜利的吶喊。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 万军之耶和华指着自己起誓，说： "我必使敌人充满你，像蝗虫一样布满你的全地， 他们必对你发出胜利的吶喊。"
verses.textZhCuv: 万军之耶和华指着自己起誓说： 我必使敌人充满你，像蚂蚱一样； 他们必呐喊攻击你。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord Almighty has sworn by himself: I will surely fill you with troops, as with a swarm of locusts, and they will shout in triumph over you.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord of hosts has sworn by himself: Surely I will fill you with men, as many as locusts, and they shall raise the shout of victory over you.
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord of hosts has sworn by Himself: "Surely I will fill you with men, as with locusts, And they shall lift up a shout against you."
