verses.textEnNlt: The Lord of Heaven’s Armies has taken this vow and has sworn to it by his own name: "Your cities will be filled with enemies, like fields swarming with locusts, and they will shout in triumph over you."
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord of armies has sworn by Himself: "I will certainly fill you with a population like locusts, And they will cry out with shouts of victory over you."
verses.textEn: The Lord Almighty has sworn by himself: I will surely fill you with troops, as with a swarm of locusts, and they will shout in triumph over you.

verses.textZh: 耶和华用自己的能力创造了大地， 用自己的智慧坚立了世界， 又用自己的聪明展开了诸天。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华用自己的能力创造了大地， 用自己的智慧坚立了世界， 又用自己的聪明展开了诸天。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华用能力创造大地， 用智慧建立世界， 用聪明铺张穹苍。
verses.textEnNiv: "He made the earth by his power; he founded the world by his wisdom and stretched out the heavens by his understanding.
verses.textEnEsv: "It is he who made the earth by his power, who established the world by his wisdom, and by his understanding stretched out the heavens.
verses.textEnNkjv: He has made the earth by His power; He has established the world by His wisdom, And stretched out the heaven by His understanding.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord made the earth by his power, and he preserves it by his wisdom. With his own understanding he stretched out the heavens.
verses.textEnNasb: It is He who made the earth by His power, Who established the world by His wisdom, And by His understanding He stretched out the heavens.
verses.textEn: "He made the earth by his power; he founded the world by his wisdom and stretched out the heavens by his understanding.

verses.textZh: 他一发声，空中诸水就澎湃； 他使云雾从地极上腾； 他造了闪电和雷雨， 又使风从他的仓库里吹出来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他一发声，空中诸水就澎湃； 他使云雾从地极上腾； 他造了闪电和雷雨， 又使风从他的仓库里吹出来。
verses.textZhCuv: 他一发声，空中便有多水激动； 他使云雾从地极上腾。 他造电随雨而闪， 从他府库中带出风来。
verses.textEnNiv: When he thunders, the waters in the heavens roar; he makes clouds rise from the ends of the earth. He sends lightning with the rain and brings out the wind from his storehouses.
verses.textEnEsv: When he utters his voice there is a tumult of waters in the heavens, and he makes the mist rise from the ends of the earth. He makes lightning for the rain, and he brings forth the wind from his storehouses.
verses.textEnNkjv: When He utters His voice— Thereis a multitude of waters in the heavens: "He causes the vapors to ascend from the ends of the earth; He makes lightnings for the rain; He brings the wind out of His treasuries."
verses.textEnNlt: When he speaks in the thunder, the heavens roar with rain. He causes the clouds to rise over the earth. He sends the lightning with the rain and releases the wind from his storehouses.
verses.textEnNasb: When He utters His voice, there is a roar of waters in the heavens, And He makes the clouds ascend from the end of the earth. He makes lightning for the rain And brings out wind from His storehouses.
verses.textEn: When he thunders, the waters in the heavens roar; he makes clouds rise from the ends of the earth. He sends lightning with the rain and brings out the wind from his storehouses.

verses.textZh: 人人都是顽梗无知； 所有的金匠都因偶像羞愧， 因为他们铸造的像都是虚假，没有气息。
verses.textZhCnvs: 人人都是顽梗无知； 所有的金匠都因偶像羞愧， 因为他们铸造的像都是虚假，没有气息。
verses.textZhCuv: 各人都成了畜类，毫无知识。 各银匠都因他的偶像羞愧； 他所铸的偶像本是虚假的， 其中并无气息，
verses.textEnNiv: "Everyone is senseless and without knowledge; every goldsmith is shamed by his idols. The images he makes are a fraud; they have no breath in them.
verses.textEnEsv: Every man is stupid and without knowledge; every goldsmith is put to shame by his idols, for his images are false, and there is no breath in them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Everyone is dull-hearted, without knowledge; Every metalsmith is put to shame by the carved image; For his molded image is falsehood, And thereis no breath in them.
verses.textEnNlt: The whole human race is foolish and has no knowledge! The craftsmen are disgraced by the idols they make, for their carefully shaped works are a fraud. These idols have no breath or power.
verses.textEnNasb: Every person is stupid, devoid of knowledge; Every goldsmith is put to shame by his idols, For his cast metal images are deceitful, And there is no breath in them.
verses.textEn: "Everyone is senseless and without knowledge; every goldsmith is shamed by his idols. The images he makes are a fraud; they have no breath in them.

verses.textZh: 偶像都是虚无的，是荒谬可笑的作品； 到了讨罪的时候，它们必被除灭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 偶像都是虚无的，是荒谬可笑的作品； 到了讨罪的时候，它们必被除灭。
verses.textZhCuv: 都是虚无的，是迷惑人的工作， 到追讨的时候，必被除灭。
verses.textEnNiv: They are worthless, the objects of mockery; when their judgment comes, they will perish.
verses.textEnEsv: They are worthless, a work of delusion; at the time of their punishment they shall perish.
verses.textEnNkjv: They are futile, a work of errors; In the time of their punishment they shall perish.
verses.textEnNlt: Idols are worthless; they are ridiculous lies! On the day of reckoning they will all be destroyed.
verses.textEnNasb: They are worthless, a work of mockery; At the time of their punishment they will perish.
verses.textEn: They are worthless, the objects of mockery; when their judgment comes, they will perish.

verses.textZh: 那作雅各产业的并不像这些偶像， 因为他是万物的创造者； 以色列是属他的民族， 万军之耶和华是他的名。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那作雅各产业的并不像这些偶像， 因为他是万物的创造者； 以色列是属他的民族， 万军之耶和华是他的名。
verses.textZhCuv: 雅各的分不像这些， 因他是造作万有的主； 以色列也是他产业的支派。 万军之耶和华是他的名。
verses.textEnNiv: He who is the Portion of Jacob is not like these, for he is the Maker of all things, including the people of his inheritance— the Lord Almighty is his name.
verses.textEnEsv: Not like these is he who is the portion of Jacob, for he is the one who formed all things, and Israel is the tribe of his inheritance; the Lord of hosts is his name.
verses.textEnNkjv: The Portion of Jacob is not like them, For He is the Maker of all things; And Israelis the tribe of His inheritance. The Lord of hosts is His name.
verses.textEnNlt: But the God of Israel is no idol! He is the Creator of everything that exists, including his people, his own special possession. The Lord of Heaven’s Armies is his name!
verses.textEnNasb: The portion of Jacob is not like these; For He is the Maker of everything, And of the tribe of His inheritance; The Lord of armies is His name.
verses.textEn: He who is the Portion of Jacob is not like these, for he is the Maker of all things, including the people of his inheritance— the Lord Almighty is his name.

verses.textZh: 耶和华说："你是我的铁锤， 作我的兵器； 我用你们打碎列国， 用你毁灭万邦。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华说："你是我的铁锤， 作我的兵器； 我用你们打碎列国， 用你毁灭万邦。
verses.textZhCuv: 你是我争战的斧子和打仗的兵器； 我要用你打碎列国， 用你毁灭列邦；
verses.textEnNiv: "You are my war club, my weapon for battle— with you I shatter nations, with you I destroy kingdoms,
verses.textEnEsv: "You are my hammer and weapon of war: with you I break nations in pieces; with you I destroy kingdoms;
verses.textEnNkjv: "You are My battle-ax and weapons of war: For with you I will break the nation in pieces; With you I will destroy kingdoms;
verses.textEnNlt: "You are my battle-ax and sword," says the Lord . "With you I will shatter nations and destroy many kingdoms.
verses.textEnNasb: He says, "You are My war-club, My weapon of war; And with you I shatter nations, And with you I destroy kingdoms.
verses.textEn: "You are my war club, my weapon for battle— with you I shatter nations, with you I destroy kingdoms,

verses.textZh: 我用你打碎战马和骑马的， 用你打碎战车和坐战车的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我用你打碎战马和骑马的， 用你打碎战车和坐战车的。
verses.textZhCuv: 用你打碎马和骑马的； 用你打碎战车和坐在其上的；
verses.textEnNiv: with you I shatter horse and rider, with you I shatter chariot and driver,
verses.textEnEsv: with you I break in pieces the horse and his rider; with you I break in pieces the chariot and the charioteer;
verses.textEnNkjv: With you I will break in pieces the horse and its rider; With you I will break in pieces the chariot and its rider;
verses.textEnNlt: With you I will shatter armies— destroying the horse and rider, the chariot and charioteer.
verses.textEnNasb: "With you I shatter the horse and his rider, And with you I shatter the chariot and its rider,
verses.textEn: with you I shatter horse and rider, with you I shatter chariot and driver,

verses.textZh: 我用你打碎男人和妇女， 用你打碎老年人和少年人， 用你打碎少男和少女。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我用你打碎男人和妇女， 用你打碎老年人和少年人， 用你打碎少男和少女。
verses.textZhCuv: 用你打碎男人和女人； 用你打碎老年人和少年人； 用你打碎壮丁和处女；
verses.textEnNiv: with you I shatter man and woman, with you I shatter old man and youth, with you I shatter young man and young woman,
verses.textEnEsv: with you I break in pieces man and woman; with you I break in pieces the old man and the youth; with you I break in pieces the young man and the young woman;
verses.textEnNkjv: With you also I will break in pieces man and woman; With you I will break in pieces old and young; With you I will break in pieces the young man and the maiden;
verses.textEnNlt: With you I will shatter men and women, old people and children, young men and young women.
verses.textEnNasb: And with you I shatter man and woman, And with you I shatter the old man and youth, And with you I shatter the young man and virgin,
verses.textEn: with you I shatter man and woman, with you I shatter old man and youth, with you I shatter young man and young woman,

verses.textZh: 我用你打碎牧人和他的羊群， 用你打碎农夫和他的耕牛， 用你打碎省长和总监。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我用你打碎牧人和他的羊群， 用你打碎农夫和他的耕牛， 用你打碎省长和总监。
verses.textZhCuv: 用你打碎牧人和他的群畜； 用你打碎农夫和他一对牛； 用你打碎省长和副省长。
verses.textEnNiv: with you I shatter shepherd and flock, with you I shatter farmer and oxen, with you I shatter governors and officials.
verses.textEnEsv: with you I break in pieces the shepherd and his flock; with you I break in pieces the farmer and his team; with you I break in pieces governors and commanders.
verses.textEnNkjv: With you also I will break in pieces the shepherd and his flock; With you I will break in pieces the farmer and his yoke of oxen; And with you I will break in pieces governors and rulers.
verses.textEnNlt: With you I will shatter shepherds and flocks, farmers and oxen, captains and officers.
verses.textEnNasb: And with you I shatter the shepherd and his flock, And with you I shatter the farmer and his team, And with you I shatter governors and officials.
verses.textEn: with you I shatter shepherd and flock, with you I shatter farmer and oxen, with you I shatter governors and officials.

verses.textZh: "但我必在你们眼前报复巴比伦和迦勒底所有的居民在锡安所作的一切恶事。"这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: "但我必在你们眼前报复巴比伦和迦勒底所有的居民在锡安所作的一切恶事。"这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华说：「我必在你们眼前报复巴比伦人和迦勒底居民在锡安所行的诸恶。」
verses.textEnNiv: "Before your eyes I will repay Babylon and all who live in Babylonia for all the wrong they have done in Zion," declares the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: "I will repay Babylon and all the inhabitants of Chaldea before your very eyes for all the evil that they have done in Zion, declares the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: "And I will repay Babylon And all the inhabitants of Chaldea For all the evil they have done In Zion in your sight," says the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: "I will repay Babylon and the people of Babylonia for all the wrong they have done to my people in Jerusalem," says the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: "But I will repay Babylon and all the inhabitants of Chaldea for all their evil that they have done in Zion before your eyes," declares the Lord.
verses.textEn: "Before your eyes I will repay Babylon and all who live in Babylonia for all the wrong they have done in Zion," declares the Lord .

verses.textZh: "行毁灭的山哪， 就是毁灭全地的山哪！ 我要和你作对， 我要伸手攻击你， 使你从山岩上滚下来， 使你成为烧毁了的山。" 这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: "行毁灭的山哪， 就是毁灭全地的山哪！ 我要和你作对， 我要伸手攻击你， 使你从山岩上滚下来， 使你成为烧毁了的山。" 这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华说： 你这行毁灭的山哪， 就是毁灭天下的山， 我与你反对。 我必向你伸手， 将你从山岩滚下去， 使你成为烧毁的山。
verses.textEnNiv: "I am against you, you destroying mountain, you who destroy the whole earth," declares the Lord . "I will stretch out my hand against you, roll you off the cliffs, and make you a burned-out mountain.
verses.textEnEsv: "Behold, I am against you, O destroying mountain, declares the Lord , which destroys the whole earth; I will stretch out my hand against you, and roll you down from the crags, and make you a burnt mountain.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Behold, I am against you, O destroying mountain, Who destroys all the earth," says the Lord. "And I will stretch out My hand against you, Roll you down from the rocks, And make you a burnt mountain.
verses.textEnNlt: "Look, O mighty mountain, destroyer of the earth! I am your enemy," says the Lord . "I will raise my fist against you, to knock you down from the heights. When I am finished, you will be nothing but a heap of burnt rubble.
verses.textEnNasb: "Behold, I am against you, mountain of destruction That destroys the whole earth," declares the Lord, "And I will stretch out My hand against you, And roll you down from the rocky cliffs, And I will make you a burnt out mountain.
verses.textEn: "I am against you, you destroying mountain, you who destroy the whole earth," declares the Lord . "I will stretch out my hand against you, roll you off the cliffs, and make you a burned-out mountain.

verses.textZh: "人必不从你那里取石头作房角石， 也不从你那里取石头作基石， 因为你必永远荒凉。" 这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: "人必不从你那里取石头作房角石， 也不从你那里取石头作基石， 因为你必永远荒凉。" 这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 人必不从你那里取石头为房角石， 也不取石头为根基石； 你必永远荒凉。 这是耶和华说的。
verses.textEnNiv: No rock will be taken from you for a cornerstone, nor any stone for a foundation, for you will be desolate forever," declares the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: No stone shall be taken from you for a corner and no stone for a foundation, but you shall be a perpetual waste, declares the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: They shall not take from you a stone for a corner Nor a stone for a foundation, But you shall be desolate forever," says the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: You will be desolate forever. Even your stones will never again be used for building. You will be completely wiped out," says the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: "They will not take from you even a stone for a corner Nor a stone for foundations, But you will be desolate forever," declares the Lord.
verses.textEn: No rock will be taken from you for a cornerstone, nor any stone for a foundation, for you will be desolate forever," declares the Lord .

verses.textZh: "你们要在地上竖起旗帜， 在列国中吹号角， 使列国作好准备攻击巴比伦， 把亚拉腊、米尼、亚实基拿等国召来攻击她， 又指派元帅来攻击她， 使马匹像蝗虫汹涌上来。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你们要在地上竖起旗帜， 在列国中吹号角， 使列国作好准备攻击巴比伦， 把亚拉腊、米尼、亚实基拿等国召来攻击她， 又指派元帅来攻击她， 使马匹像蝗虫汹涌上来。
verses.textZhCuv: 要在境内竖立大旗， 在各国中吹角， 使列国预备攻击巴比伦， 将亚拉腊、米尼、亚实基拿各国招来攻击她； 又派军长来攻击她， 使马匹上来如蚂蚱，
verses.textEnNiv: "Lift up a banner in the land! Blow the trumpet among the nations! Prepare the nations for battle against her; summon against her these kingdoms: Ararat, Minni and Ashkenaz. Appoint a commander against her; send up horses like a swarm of locusts.
verses.textEnEsv: "Set up a standard on the earth; blow the trumpet among the nations; prepare the nations for war against her; summon against her the kingdoms, Ararat, Minni, and Ashkenaz; appoint a marshal against her; bring up horses like bristling locusts.
verses.textEnNkjv: Set up a banner in the land, Blow the trumpet among the nations! Prepare the nations against her, Call the kingdoms together against her: Ararat, Minni, and Ashkenaz. Appoint a general against her; Cause the horses to come up like the bristling locusts.
verses.textEnNlt: Raise a signal flag to the nations. Sound the battle cry! Mobilize them all against Babylon. Prepare them to fight against her! Bring out the armies of Ararat, Minni, and Ashkenaz. Appoint a commander, and bring a multitude of horses like swarming locusts!
verses.textEnNasb: Lift up a signal flag in the land, Blow a trumpet among the nations! Consecrate the nations against her, Summon against her the kingdoms of Ararat, Minni, and Ashkenaz; Appoint an officer against her, Bring up the horses like bristly locusts.
verses.textEn: "Lift up a banner in the land! Blow the trumpet among the nations! Prepare the nations for battle against her; summon against her these kingdoms: Ararat, Minni and Ashkenaz. Appoint a commander against her; send up horses like a swarm of locusts.

verses.textZh: 你们要使列国作好准备攻击她， 使玛代诸王， 和她的省长、总监， 以及他们辖下各地的人民都作好准备攻击她。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要使列国作好准备攻击她， 使玛代诸王， 和她的省长、总监， 以及他们辖下各地的人民都作好准备攻击她。
verses.textZhCuv: 使列国和米底亚君王，与省长和副省长， 并他们所管全地之人，都预备攻击她。
verses.textEnNiv: Prepare the nations for battle against her— the kings of the Medes, their governors and all their officials, and all the countries they rule.
verses.textEnEsv: Prepare the nations for war against her, the kings of the Medes, with their governors and deputies, and every land under their dominion.
verses.textEnNkjv: Prepare against her the nations, With the kings of the Medes, Its governors and all its rulers, All the land of his dominion.
verses.textEnNlt: Bring against her the armies of the nations— led by the kings of the Medes and all their captains and officers.
verses.textEnNasb: Consecrate the nations against her, The kings of the Medes, Their governors and all their officials, And every land under their control.
verses.textEn: Prepare the nations for battle against her— the kings of the Medes, their governors and all their officials, and all the countries they rule.

verses.textZh: 大地震动翻腾， 因为耶和华攻击巴比伦所定的旨意立定不移， 要使巴比伦的地荒凉， 没有人居住。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大地震动翻腾， 因为耶和华攻击巴比伦所定的旨意立定不移， 要使巴比伦的地荒凉， 没有人居住。
verses.textZhCuv: 地必震动而瘠苦； 因耶和华向巴比伦所定的旨意成立了， 使巴比伦之地荒凉，无人居住。
verses.textEnNiv: The land trembles and writhes, for the Lord ’s purposes against Babylon stand— to lay waste the land of Babylon so that no one will live there.
verses.textEnEsv: The land trembles and writhes in pain, for the Lord ’s purposes against Babylon stand, to make the land of Babylon a desolation, without inhabitant.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the land will tremble and sorrow; For every purpose of the Lord shall be performed against Babylon, To make the land of Babylon a desolation without inhabitant.
verses.textEnNlt: The earth trembles and writhes in pain, for everything the Lord has planned against Babylon stands unchanged. Babylon will be left desolate without a single inhabitant.
verses.textEnNasb: So the land quakes and writhes, For the plans of the Lord against Babylon stand, To make the land of Babylon A desolation without inhabitants.
verses.textEn: The land trembles and writhes, for the Lord ’s purposes against Babylon stand— to lay waste the land of Babylon so that no one will live there.

verses.textZh: 巴比伦的勇士停止作战， 留在堡垒里面； 他们的勇士消退， 变成像妇人一样软弱。 巴比伦的房屋被火焚烧， 她的门闩都被折断。
verses.textZhCnvs: 巴比伦的勇士停止作战， 留在堡垒里面； 他们的勇士消退， 变成像妇人一样软弱。 巴比伦的房屋被火焚烧， 她的门闩都被折断。
verses.textZhCuv: 巴比伦的勇士止息争战， 藏在坚垒之中。 他们的勇力衰尽，好像妇女一样。 巴比伦的住处有火着起， 门闩都折断了。
verses.textEnNiv: Babylon’s warriors have stopped fighting; they remain in their strongholds. Their strength is exhausted; they have become weaklings. Her dwellings are set on fire; the bars of her gates are broken.
verses.textEnEsv: The warriors of Babylon have ceased fighting; they remain in their strongholds; their strength has failed; they have become women; her dwellings are on fire; her bars are broken.
verses.textEnNkjv: The mighty men of Babylon have ceased fighting, They have remained in their strongholds; Their might has failed, They became like women; They have burned her dwelling places, The bars of her gate are broken.
verses.textEnNlt: Her mightiest warriors no longer fight. They stay in their barracks, their courage gone. They have become like women. The invaders have burned the houses and broken down the city gates.
verses.textEnNasb: The warriors of Babylon have ceased fighting, They stay in the strongholds; Their strength is exhausted, They are becoming like women; Their homes are set on fire, The bars of her gates are broken.
verses.textEn: Babylon’s warriors have stopped fighting; they remain in their strongholds. Their strength is exhausted; they have become weaklings. Her dwellings are set on fire; the bars of her gates are broken.

verses.textZh: 驿卒一个接一个跑来， 报信的也相继而至， 向巴比伦王报告， 他的京城已经完全被攻取了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 驿卒一个接一个跑来， 报信的也相继而至， 向巴比伦王报告， 他的京城已经完全被攻取了。
verses.textZhCuv: 跑报的要彼此相遇， 送信的要互相迎接， 报告巴比伦王说： 城的四方被攻取了，
verses.textEnNiv: One courier follows another and messenger follows messenger to announce to the king of Babylon that his entire city is captured,
verses.textEnEsv: One runner runs to meet another, and one messenger to meet another, to tell the king of Babylon that his city is taken on every side;
verses.textEnNkjv: One runner will run to meet another, And one messenger to meet another, To show the king of Babylon that his city is taken on all sides;
verses.textEnNlt: The news is passed from one runner to the next as the messengers hurry to tell the king that his city has been captured.
verses.textEnNasb: One courier runs to meet another, And one messenger to meet another, To tell the king of Babylon That his city has been captured from end to end;
verses.textEn: One courier follows another and messenger follows messenger to announce to the king of Babylon that his entire city is captured,

verses.textZh: 渡口已经被占据了， 生满芦苇的沼泽也被火烧了， 军兵都惊慌失措。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 渡口已经被占据了， 生满芦苇的沼泽也被火烧了， 军兵都惊慌失措。"
verses.textZhCuv: 渡口被占据了， 苇塘被火烧了， 兵丁也惊慌了。
verses.textEnNiv: the river crossings seized, the marshes set on fire, and the soldiers terrified."
verses.textEnEsv: the fords have been seized, the marshes are burned with fire, and the soldiers are in panic.
verses.textEnNkjv: The passages are blocked, The reeds they have burned with fire, And the men of war are terrified.
verses.textEnNlt: All the escape routes are blocked. The marshes have been set aflame, and the army is in a panic.
verses.textEnNasb: The river crossing places have been seized, And they have burned the marshes with fire, And the men of war are terrified.
verses.textEn: the river crossings seized, the marshes set on fire, and the soldiers terrified."

verses.textZh: 因为万军之耶和华以色列的神这样说： "巴比伦城 好象正被踹平的禾场， 再过片时，她被收割的时候就到了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为万军之耶和华以色列的神这样说： "巴比伦城 好象正被踹平的禾场， 再过片时，她被收割的时候就到了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 万军之耶和华－以色列的神如此说： 巴比伦 城好像踹谷的禾场； 再过片时，收割她的时候就到了。
verses.textEnNiv: This is what the Lord Almighty, the God of Israel, says: "Daughter Babylon is like a threshing floor at the time it is trampled; the time to harvest her will soon come."
verses.textEnEsv: For thus says the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel: The daughter of Babylon is like a threshing floor at the time when it is trodden; yet a little while and the time of her harvest will come."
verses.textEnNkjv: For thus says the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel: "The daughter of Babylon is like a threshing floor When it is time to thresh her; Yet a little while And the time of her harvest will come."
verses.textEnNlt: This is what the Lord of Heaven’s Armies, the God of Israel, says: "Babylon is like wheat on a threshing floor, about to be trampled. In just a little while her harvest will begin."
verses.textEnNasb: For this is what the Lord of armies, the God of Israel says: "The daughter of Babylon is like a threshing floor At the time that it is tread down; In just a little while the time of harvest will come for her."
verses.textEn: This is what the Lord Almighty, the God of Israel, says: "Daughter Babylon is like a threshing floor at the time it is trampled; the time to harvest her will soon come."

verses.textZh: 以色列人说："巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒吞灭了我们， 使我们十分混乱， 又使我们成为空的器皿； 他像怪兽把我们吞下，他的肚塞满了我们的美物， 他却把我们吐出去。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列人说："巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒吞灭了我们， 使我们十分混乱， 又使我们成为空的器皿； 他像怪兽把我们吞下，他的肚塞满了我们的美物， 他却把我们吐出去。"
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列人说： 巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒吞灭我，压碎我， 使我成为空虚的器皿。 他像大鱼将我吞下， 用我的美物充满他的肚腹， 又将我赶出去。
verses.textEnNiv: "Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon has devoured us, he has thrown us into confusion, he has made us an empty jar. Like a serpent he has swallowed us and filled his stomach with our delicacies, and then has spewed us out.
verses.textEnEsv: "Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon has devoured me; he has crushed me; he has made me an empty vessel; he has swallowed me like a monster; he has filled his stomach with my delicacies; he has rinsed me out.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon Has devoured me, he has crushed me; He has made me an empty vessel, He has swallowed me up like a monster; He has filled his stomach with my delicacies, He has spit me out.
verses.textEnNlt: "King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylon has eaten and crushed us and drained us of strength. He has swallowed us like a great monster and filled his belly with our riches. He has thrown us out of our own country.
verses.textEnNasb: "Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon has devoured me, he has crushed me, He has set me down like an empty vessel; He has swallowed me like a monster, He has filled his stomach with my delicacies; He has washed me away.
verses.textEn: "Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon has devoured us, he has thrown us into confusion, he has made us an empty jar. Like a serpent he has swallowed us and filled his stomach with our delicacies, and then has spewed us out.

verses.textZh: 锡安的居民要说： "愿巴比伦以强暴待我们 的罪归到巴比伦身上。" 耶路撒冷要说： "愿流我血的罪归到迦勒底的居民身上。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 锡安的居民要说： "愿巴比伦以强暴待我们 的罪归到巴比伦身上。" 耶路撒冷要说： "愿流我血的罪归到迦勒底的居民身上。"
verses.textZhCuv: 锡安的居民要说： 巴比伦以强暴待我， 损害我的身体， 愿这罪归给她。 耶路撒冷人要说： 愿流我们血的罪归到迦勒底的居民。
verses.textEnNiv: May the violence done to our flesh be on Babylon," say the inhabitants of Zion. "May our blood be on those who live in Babylonia," says Jerusalem.
verses.textEnEsv: The violence done to me and to my kinsmen be upon Babylon," let the inhabitant of Zion say. "My blood be upon the inhabitants of Chaldea," let Jerusalem say.
verses.textEnNkjv: Let the violence done to me and my flesh be upon Babylon," The inhabitant of Zion will say; "And my blood be upon the inhabitants of Chaldea!" Jerusalem will say.
verses.textEnNlt: Make Babylon suffer as she made us suffer," say the people of Zion. "Make the people of Babylonia pay for spilling our blood," says Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNasb: "May the violence done to me and to my flesh be upon Babylon," The inhabitant of Zion will say; And, "May my blood be upon the inhabitants of Chaldea," Jerusalem will say.
verses.textEn: May the violence done to our flesh be on Babylon," say the inhabitants of Zion. "May our blood be on those who live in Babylonia," says Jerusalem.

verses.textZh: 因此，耶和华这样说： "看哪！我必为你的案件申诉， 为你报仇； 我必使巴比伦的河水枯竭， 使它们的水源干涸。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，耶和华这样说： "看哪！我必为你的案件申诉， 为你报仇； 我必使巴比伦的河水枯竭， 使它们的水源干涸。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以，耶和华如此说： 我必为你伸冤，为你报仇； 我必使巴比伦的海枯竭，使她的泉源干涸。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore this is what the Lord says: "See, I will defend your cause and avenge you; I will dry up her sea and make her springs dry.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore thus says the Lord : "Behold, I will plead your cause and take vengeance for you. I will dry up her sea and make her fountain dry,
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore thus says the Lord: "Behold, I will plead your case and take vengeance for you. I will dry up her sea and make her springs dry.
verses.textEnNlt: This is what the Lord says to Jerusalem: "I will be your lawyer to plead your case, and I will avenge you. I will dry up her river, as well as her springs,
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore this is what the Lord says: "Behold, I am going to plead your case And take vengeance for you; And I will dry up her sea And make her fountain dry.
verses.textEn: Therefore this is what the Lord says: "See, I will defend your cause and avenge you; I will dry up her sea and make her springs dry.

verses.textZh: 巴比伦必变成乱堆， 成为野狗的巢穴， 成为令人惊骇和嗤笑的对象， 没有人居住。
verses.textZhCnvs: 巴比伦必变成乱堆， 成为野狗的巢穴， 成为令人惊骇和嗤笑的对象， 没有人居住。
verses.textZhCuv: 巴比伦必成为乱堆，为野狗的住处， 令人惊骇、嗤笑， 并且无人居住。
verses.textEnNiv: Babylon will be a heap of ruins, a haunt of jackals, an object of horror and scorn, a place where no one lives.
verses.textEnEsv: and Babylon shall become a heap of ruins, the haunt of jackals, a horror and a hissing, without inhabitant.
verses.textEnNkjv: Babylon shall become a heap, A dwelling place for jackals, An astonishment and a hissing, Without an inhabitant.
verses.textEnNlt: and Babylon will become a heap of ruins, haunted by jackals. She will be an object of horror and contempt, a place where no one lives.
verses.textEnNasb: "Babylon will become a heap of ruins, a haunt of jackals, An object of horror and hissing, without inhabitants.
verses.textEn: Babylon will be a heap of ruins, a haunt of jackals, an object of horror and scorn, a place where no one lives.

verses.textZh: 巴比伦人必像少壮狮子一起吼叫， 又像幼狮咆哮。
verses.textZhCnvs: 巴比伦人必像少壮狮子一起吼叫， 又像幼狮咆哮。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们要像少壮狮子咆哮， 像小狮子吼叫。
verses.textEnNiv: Her people all roar like young lions, they growl like lion cubs.
verses.textEnEsv: "They shall roar together like lions; they shall growl like lions’ cubs.
verses.textEnNkjv: They shall roar together like lions, They shall growl like lions’ whelps.
verses.textEnNlt: Her people will roar together like strong lions. They will growl like lion cubs.
verses.textEnNasb: "They will roar together like young lions, They will growl like lions’ cubs.
verses.textEn: Her people all roar like young lions, they growl like lion cubs.

verses.textZh: 他们食欲大动的时候，我必为他们摆设筵席， 使他们喝醉，狂欢乱叫， 然后永远沉睡，不再醒来 。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们食欲大动的时候，我必为他们摆设筵席， 使他们喝醉，狂欢乱叫， 然后永远沉睡，不再醒来 。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们火热的时候， 我必为他们设摆酒席， 使他们沉醉，好叫他们快乐， 睡了长觉，永不醒起。 这是耶和华说的。
verses.textEnNiv: But while they are aroused, I will set out a feast for them and make them drunk, so that they shout with laughter— then sleep forever and not awake," declares the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: While they are inflamed I will prepare them a feast and make them drunk, that they may become merry, then sleep a perpetual sleep and not wake, declares the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: In their excitement I will prepare their feasts; I will make them drunk, That they may rejoice, And sleep a perpetual sleep And not awake," says the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: And while they lie inflamed with all their wine, I will prepare a different kind of feast for them. I will make them drink until they fall asleep, and they will never wake up again," says the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: "When they become heated up, I will serve them their banquet And make them drunk, so that they may rejoice in triumph, And may sleep a perpetual sleep And not wake up," declares the Lord.
verses.textEn: But while they are aroused, I will set out a feast for them and make them drunk, so that they shout with laughter— then sleep forever and not awake," declares the Lord .

verses.textZh: 我必使他们像羊羔， 像公绵羊和公山羊一样下到屠宰之地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必使他们像羊羔， 像公绵羊和公山羊一样下到屠宰之地。
verses.textZhCuv: 我必使他们像羊羔、 像公绵羊和公山羊下到宰杀之地。
verses.textEnNiv: "I will bring them down like lambs to the slaughter, like rams and goats.
verses.textEnEsv: I will bring them down like lambs to the slaughter, like rams and male goats.
verses.textEnNkjv: "I will bring them down Like lambs to the slaughter, Like rams with male goats.
verses.textEnNlt: "I will bring them down like lambs to the slaughter, like rams and goats to be sacrificed.
verses.textEnNasb: "I will bring them down like lambs to the slaughter, Like rams together with male goats.
verses.textEn: "I will bring them down like lambs to the slaughter, like rams and goats.

verses.textZh: 示沙克怎么竟被攻取！ 全地所称赞的怎么竟被占领！ 巴比伦在列国中怎么竟成了令人惊骇的对象！
verses.textZhCnvs: 示沙克怎么竟被攻取！ 全地所称赞的怎么竟被占领！ 巴比伦在列国中怎么竟成了令人惊骇的对象！
verses.textZhCuv: 示沙克 何竟被攻取？ 天下所称赞的何竟被占据？ 巴比伦在列国中何竟变为荒场？
verses.textEnNiv: "How Sheshak will be captured, the boast of the whole earth seized! How desolate Babylon will be among the nations!
verses.textEnEsv: "How Babylon is taken, the praise of the whole earth seized! How Babylon has become a horror among the nations!
verses.textEnNkjv: "Oh, how Sheshach is taken! Oh, how the praise of the whole earth is seized! How Babylon has become desolate among the nations!
verses.textEnNlt: "How Babylon is fallen— great Babylon, praised throughout the earth! Now she has become an object of horror among the nations.
verses.textEnNasb: "How Sheshak has been captured, And the praise of the whole earth has been seized! How Babylon has become an object of horror among the nations!
verses.textEn: "How Sheshak will be captured, the boast of the whole earth seized! How desolate Babylon will be among the nations!

verses.textZh: 大海上涨漫过巴比伦， 它被汹涌的波浪淹没。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大海上涨漫过巴比伦， 它被汹涌的波浪淹没。
verses.textZhCuv: 海水涨起，漫过巴比伦； 她被许多海浪遮盖。
verses.textEnNiv: The sea will rise over Babylon; its roaring waves will cover her.
verses.textEnEsv: The sea has come up on Babylon; she is covered with its tumultuous waves.
verses.textEnNkjv: The sea has come up over Babylon; She is covered with the multitude of its waves.
verses.textEnNlt: The sea has risen over Babylon; she is covered by its crashing waves.
verses.textEnNasb: "The sea has come up over Babylon; She has been engulfed by its roaring waves.
verses.textEn: The sea will rise over Babylon; its roaring waves will cover her.

verses.textZh: 它的城镇变为荒凉， 成为干旱的地和沙漠， 没有人住在里面， 也没有人经过。
verses.textZhCnvs: 它的城镇变为荒凉， 成为干旱的地和沙漠， 没有人住在里面， 也没有人经过。
verses.textZhCuv: 她的城邑变为荒场、旱地、沙漠， 无人居住，无人经过之地。
verses.textEnNiv: Her towns will be desolate, a dry and desert land, a land where no one lives, through which no one travels.
verses.textEnEsv: Her cities have become a horror, a land of drought and a desert, a land in which no one dwells, and through which no son of man passes.
verses.textEnNkjv: Her cities are a desolation, A dry land and a wilderness, A land where no one dwells, Through which no son of man passes.
verses.textEnNlt: Her cities now lie in ruins; she is a dry wasteland where no one lives or even passes by.
verses.textEnNasb: "Her cities have become an object of horror, A dry land and a desert, A land in which no one lives And through which no one of mankind passes.
verses.textEn: Her towns will be desolate, a dry and desert land, a land where no one lives, through which no one travels.

verses.textZh: 我必惩罚巴比伦的彼勒， 使它从口中吐出它所吞噬的； 列国必不再归附它， 巴比伦的城墙也倒塌了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必惩罚巴比伦的彼勒， 使它从口中吐出它所吞噬的； 列国必不再归附它， 巴比伦的城墙也倒塌了。
verses.textZhCuv: 我必刑罚巴比伦的彼勒， 使他吐出所吞的。 万民必不再流归他那里； 巴比伦的城墙也必坍塌了。
verses.textEnNiv: I will punish Bel in Babylon and make him spew out what he has swallowed. The nations will no longer stream to him. And the wall of Babylon will fall.
verses.textEnEsv: And I will punish Bel in Babylon, and take out of his mouth what he has swallowed. The nations shall no longer flow to him; the wall of Babylon has fallen.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will punish Bel in Babylon, And I will bring out of his mouth what he has swallowed; And the nations shall not stream to him anymore. Yes, the wall of Babylon shall fall.
verses.textEnNlt: And I will punish Bel, the god of Babylon, and make him vomit up all he has eaten. The nations will no longer come and worship him. The wall of Babylon has fallen!
verses.textEnNasb: "I will punish Bel in Babylon, And I will make what he has swallowed come out of his mouth; And the nations will no longer stream toward him. Even the wall of Babylon has fallen down!
verses.textEn: I will punish Bel in Babylon and make him spew out what he has swallowed. The nations will no longer stream to him. And the wall of Babylon will fall.

verses.textZh: 我的子民哪！你们要从它那里出来， 各自逃命， 躲避耶和华的烈怒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的子民哪！你们要从它那里出来， 各自逃命， 躲避耶和华的烈怒。
verses.textZhCuv: 我的民哪，你们要从其中出去！ 各人拯救自己，躲避耶和华的烈怒。
verses.textEnNiv: "Come out of her, my people! Run for your lives! Run from the fierce anger of the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: "Go out of the midst of her, my people! Let every one save his life from the fierce anger of the Lord !
verses.textEnNkjv: "My people, go out of the midst of her! And let everyone deliver himself from the fierce anger of the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: "Come out, my people, flee from Babylon. Save yourselves! Run from the Lord ’s fierce anger.
verses.textEnNasb: "Come out from her midst, My people, And each of you save yourselves From the fierce anger of the Lord.
verses.textEn: "Come out of her, my people! Run for your lives! Run from the fierce anger of the Lord .

verses.textZh: 你们不要心惊胆怯， 也不要因在境内听到的谣言惧怕； 因为今年有谣言传来， 明年也会有谣言传来， 境内有强暴的事， 官长互相攻击。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们不要心惊胆怯， 也不要因在境内听到的谣言惧怕； 因为今年有谣言传来， 明年也会有谣言传来， 境内有强暴的事， 官长互相攻击。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们不要心惊胆怯， 也不要因境内所听见的风声惧怕； 因为这年有风声传来； 那年也有风声传来， 境内有强暴的事， 官长攻击官长。
verses.textEnNiv: Do not lose heart or be afraid when rumors are heard in the land; one rumor comes this year, another the next, rumors of violence in the land and of ruler against ruler.
verses.textEnEsv: Let not your heart faint, and be not fearful at the report heard in the land, when a report comes in one year and afterward a report in another year, and violence is in the land, and ruler is against ruler.
verses.textEnNkjv: And lest your heart faint, And you fear for the rumor that willbe heard in the land (A rumor will come one year, And after that, in another year A rumor willcome, And violence in the land, Ruler against ruler),
verses.textEnNlt: But do not panic; don’t be afraid when you hear the first rumor of approaching forces. For rumors will keep coming year by year. Violence will erupt in the land as the leaders fight against each other.
verses.textEnNasb: "Now, so that your heart does not grow faint, And you are not afraid at the report that will be heard in the land— For the report will come in one year, And after that another report in another year, And violence will be in the land With ruler against ruler—
verses.textEn: Do not lose heart or be afraid when rumors are heard in the land; one rumor comes this year, another the next, rumors of violence in the land and of ruler against ruler.

verses.textZh: 因此，你看，日子快到， 我必惩罚巴比伦的偶像； 巴比伦全地都必蒙羞， 所有被刺杀的人都必倒在境内。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，你看，日子快到， 我必惩罚巴比伦的偶像； 巴比伦全地都必蒙羞， 所有被刺杀的人都必倒在境内。
verses.textZhCuv: 日子将到，我必刑罚巴比伦雕刻的偶像。 她全地必然抱愧； 她被杀的人必在其中仆倒。
verses.textEnNiv: For the time will surely come when I will punish the idols of Babylon; her whole land will be disgraced and her slain will all lie fallen within her.
verses.textEnEsv: "Therefore, behold, the days are coming when I will punish the images of Babylon; her whole land shall be put to shame, and all her slain shall fall in the midst of her.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore behold, the days are coming That I will bring judgment on the carved images of Babylon; Her whole land shall be ashamed, And all her slain shall fall in her midst.
verses.textEnNlt: For the time is surely coming when I will punish this great city and all her idols. Her whole land will be disgraced, and her dead will lie in the streets.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore behold, days are coming When I will punish the idols of Babylon; And her whole land will be put to shame. And all her slain will fall in her midst.
verses.textEn: For the time will surely come when I will punish the idols of Babylon; her whole land will be disgraced and her slain will all lie fallen within her.

verses.textZh: 那时天地和其中的一切， 都必因巴比伦的倾覆欢呼， 因为行毁灭的要从北方来攻击她。" 这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时天地和其中的一切， 都必因巴比伦的倾覆欢呼， 因为行毁灭的要从北方来攻击她。" 这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时，天地和其中所有的， 必因巴比伦欢呼， 因为行毁灭的要从北方来到她那里。 这是耶和华说的。
verses.textEnNiv: Then heaven and earth and all that is in them will shout for joy over Babylon, for out of the north destroyers will attack her," declares the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: Then the heavens and the earth, and all that is in them, shall sing for joy over Babylon, for the destroyers shall come against them out of the north, declares the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the heavens and the earth and all that is in them Shall sing joyously over Babylon; For the plunderers shall come to her from the north," says the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the heavens and earth will rejoice, for out of the north will come destroying armies against Babylon," says the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: "Then heaven and earth and everything that is in them Will shout for joy over Babylon, Because the destroyers will come to her from the north," Declares the Lord.
verses.textEn: Then heaven and earth and all that is in them will shout for joy over Babylon, for out of the north destroyers will attack her," declares the Lord .

verses.textZh: "巴比伦必因以色列被刺杀的人而倒下， 就如全地被刺杀的人因巴比伦而倒下。
verses.textZhCnvs: "巴比伦必因以色列被刺杀的人而倒下， 就如全地被刺杀的人因巴比伦而倒下。
verses.textZhCuv: 巴比伦怎样使以色列被杀的人仆倒， 照样她全地被杀的人也必在巴比伦仆倒。
verses.textEnNiv: "Babylon must fall because of Israel’s slain, just as the slain in all the earth have fallen because of Babylon.
verses.textEnEsv: Babylon must fall for the slain of Israel, just as for Babylon have fallen the slain of all the earth.
verses.textEnNkjv: As Babylon hascaused the slain of Israel to fall, So at Babylon the slain of all the earth shall fall.
verses.textEnNlt: "Just as Babylon killed the people of Israel and others throughout the world, so must her people be killed.
verses.textEnNasb: Indeed, Babylon is to fall for the slain of Israel, As the slain of all the earth have also fallen for Babylon.
verses.textEn: "Babylon must fall because of Israel’s slain, just as the slain in all the earth have fallen because of Babylon.

verses.textZh: 那些已逃脱了刀剑的人哪！ 走吧！不要站着， 要从远方记念耶和华， 心中惦念耶路撒冷。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那些已逃脱了刀剑的人哪！ 走吧！不要站着， 要从远方记念耶和华， 心中惦念耶路撒冷。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们躲避刀剑的要快走， 不要站住！ 要在远方记念耶和华， 心中追想耶路撒冷。
verses.textEnNiv: You who have escaped the sword, leave and do not linger! Remember the Lord in a distant land, and call to mind Jerusalem."
verses.textEnEsv: "You who have escaped from the sword, go, do not stand still! Remember the Lord from far away, and let Jerusalem come into your mind:
verses.textEnNkjv: You who have escaped the sword, Get away! Do not stand still! Remember the Lord afar off, And let Jerusalem come to your mind.
verses.textEnNlt: Get out, all you who have escaped the sword! Do not stand and watch—flee while you can! Remember the Lord , though you are in a far-off land, and think about your home in Jerusalem."
verses.textEnNasb: You who have escaped the sword, Go! Do not stay! Remember the Lord from far away, And let Jerusalem come to your mind.
verses.textEn: You who have escaped the sword, leave and do not linger! Remember the Lord in a distant land, and call to mind Jerusalem."

verses.textZh: 我们因听见辱骂而蒙羞， 满面惭愧； 因为外族人进入了耶和华殿的圣所。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们因听见辱骂而蒙羞， 满面惭愧； 因为外族人进入了耶和华殿的圣所。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们听见辱骂就蒙羞，满面惭愧， 因为外邦人进入耶和华殿的圣所。
verses.textEnNiv: "We are disgraced, for we have been insulted and shame covers our faces, because foreigners have entered the holy places of the Lord ’s house."
verses.textEnEsv: ‘We are put to shame, for we have heard reproach; dishonor has covered our face, for foreigners have come into the holy places of the Lord ’s house.’
verses.textEnNkjv: We are ashamed because we have heard reproach. Shame has covered our faces, For strangers have come into the sanctuaries of the Lord’s house.
verses.textEnNlt: "We are ashamed," the people say. "We are insulted and disgraced because the Lord ’s Temple has been defiled by foreigners."
verses.textEnNasb: We are ashamed because we have heard rebuke; Disgrace has covered our faces, Because strangers have entered The holy places of the Lord’s house.
verses.textEn: "We are disgraced, for we have been insulted and shame covers our faces, because foreigners have entered the holy places of the Lord ’s house."

verses.textZh: 因此，看哪！日子快到， 这是耶和华的宣告。 我必惩罚巴比伦的偶像， 在巴比伦全境到处都有被刺伤的人在唉哼。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，看哪！日子快到， 这是耶和华的宣告。 我必惩罚巴比伦的偶像， 在巴比伦全境到处都有被刺伤的人在唉哼。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华说： 日子将到，我必刑罚巴比伦雕刻的偶像， 通国受伤的人必唉哼。
verses.textEnNiv: "But days are coming," declares the Lord , "when I will punish her idols, and throughout her land the wounded will groan.
verses.textEnEsv: "Therefore, behold, the days are coming, declares the Lord , when I will execute judgment upon her images, and through all her land the wounded shall groan.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Therefore behold, the days are coming," says the Lord, "That I will bring judgment on her carved images, And throughout all her land the wounded shall groan.
verses.textEnNlt: "Yes," says the Lord , "but the time is coming when I will destroy Babylon’s idols. The groans of her wounded people will be heard throughout the land.
verses.textEnNasb: "Therefore behold, the days are coming," declares the Lord, "When I will punish her idols, And the mortally wounded will groan throughout her land.
verses.textEn: "But days are coming," declares the Lord , "when I will punish her idols, and throughout her land the wounded will groan.

verses.textZh: 即使巴比伦升到天上， 即使它在高处建造难以进侵的堡垒， 但必有行毁灭的从我这里去攻击它。" 这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 即使巴比伦升到天上， 即使它在高处建造难以进侵的堡垒， 但必有行毁灭的从我这里去攻击它。" 这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 巴比伦虽升到天上， 虽使她坚固的高处更坚固， 还有行毁灭的从我这里到她那里。 这是耶和华说的。
verses.textEnNiv: Even if Babylon ascends to the heavens and fortifies her lofty stronghold, I will send destroyers against her," declares the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: Though Babylon should mount up to heaven, and though she should fortify her strong height, yet destroyers would come from me against her, declares the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: Though Babylon were to mount up to heaven, And though she were to fortify the height of her strength, Yet from Me plunderers would come to her," says the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: Though Babylon reaches as high as the heavens and makes her fortifications incredibly strong, I will still send enemies to plunder her. I, the Lord , have spoken!
verses.textEnNasb: "Though Babylon ascends to the heavens, And though she fortifies her lofty stronghold, Destroyers will come from Me to her," declares the Lord.
verses.textEn: Even if Babylon ascends to the heavens and fortifies her lofty stronghold, I will send destroyers against her," declares the Lord .

verses.textZh: "听啊！有哀号的声音从巴比伦传出， 有大毁灭的声音从迦勒底人的地发出。
verses.textZhCnvs: "听啊！有哀号的声音从巴比伦传出， 有大毁灭的声音从迦勒底人的地发出。
verses.textZhCuv: 有哀号的声音从巴比伦出来； 有大毁灭的响声从迦勒底人之地发出。
verses.textEnNiv: "The sound of a cry comes from Babylon, the sound of great destruction from the land of the Babylonians.
verses.textEnEsv: "A voice! A cry from Babylon! The noise of great destruction from the land of the Chaldeans!
verses.textEnNkjv: The sound of a cry comes from Babylon, And great destruction from the land of the Chaldeans,
verses.textEnNlt: "Listen! Hear the cry of Babylon, the sound of great destruction from the land of the Babylonians.
verses.textEnNasb: The sound of an outcry from Babylon, And of great destruction from the land of the Chaldeans!
verses.textEn: "The sound of a cry comes from Babylon, the sound of great destruction from the land of the Babylonians.

verses.textZh: 因为耶和华正在毁灭巴比伦， 使城中喧闹的声音灭绝。 敌军好象洪水，波浪澎湃， 发出吶喊的声音。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为耶和华正在毁灭巴比伦， 使城中喧闹的声音灭绝。 敌军好象洪水，波浪澎湃， 发出吶喊的声音。
verses.textZhCuv: 因耶和华使巴比伦变为荒场， 使其中的大声灭绝。 仇敌仿佛众水， 波浪匉訇，响声已经发出。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord will destroy Babylon; he will silence her noisy din. Waves of enemies will rage like great waters; the roar of their voices will resound.
verses.textEnEsv: For the Lord is laying Babylon waste and stilling her mighty voice. Their waves roar like many waters; the noise of their voice is raised,
verses.textEnNkjv: Because the Lord is plundering Babylon And silencing her loud voice, Though her waves roar like great waters, And the noise of their voice is uttered,
verses.textEnNlt: For the Lord is destroying Babylon. He will silence her loud voice. Waves of enemies pound against her; the noise of battle rings through the city.
verses.textEnNasb: For the Lord is going to destroy Babylon, And He will make her loud noise vanish from her. And their waves will roar like many waters; The clamor of their voices sounds forth.
verses.textEn: The Lord will destroy Babylon; he will silence her noisy din. Waves of enemies will rage like great waters; the roar of their voices will resound.

verses.textZh: 因为有一位行毁灭的来攻击巴比伦， 巴比伦的勇士被擒住， 他们的弓弩折断了， 因为耶和华是报应的神， 他必报复巴比伦。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为有一位行毁灭的来攻击巴比伦， 巴比伦的勇士被擒住， 他们的弓弩折断了， 因为耶和华是报应的神， 他必报复巴比伦。
verses.textZhCuv: 这是行毁灭的临到巴比伦。 巴比伦的勇士被捉住， 他们的弓折断了； 因为耶和华是施行报应的神， 必定施行报应。
verses.textEnNiv: A destroyer will come against Babylon; her warriors will be captured, and their bows will be broken. For the Lord is a God of retribution; he will repay in full.
verses.textEnEsv: for a destroyer has come upon her, upon Babylon; her warriors are taken; their bows are broken in pieces, for the Lord is a God of recompense; he will surely repay.
verses.textEnNkjv: Because the plunderer comes against her, against Babylon, And her mighty men are taken. Every one of their bows is broken; For the Lordis the God of recompense, He will surely repay.
verses.textEnNlt: Destroying armies come against Babylon. Her mighty men are captured, and their weapons break in their hands. For the Lord is a God who gives just punishment; he always repays in full.
verses.textEnNasb: For the destroyer is coming against her, against Babylon, And her warriors will be captured, Their bows shattered; For the Lord is a God of retribution, He will fully repay.
verses.textEn: A destroyer will come against Babylon; her warriors will be captured, and their bows will be broken. For the Lord is a God of retribution; he will repay in full.

verses.textZh: 我必使巴比伦的领袖和智慧人， 省长、总监和勇士都喝醉， 永远沉睡，不再醒来。" 这是君王的宣告， 万军之耶和华是他的名。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必使巴比伦的领袖和智慧人， 省长、总监和勇士都喝醉， 永远沉睡，不再醒来。" 这是君王的宣告， 万军之耶和华是他的名。
verses.textZhCuv: 君王－名为万军之耶和华的说： 我必使巴比伦的首领、 智慧人、省长、副省长，和勇士都沉醉， 使他们睡了长觉，永不醒起。
verses.textEnNiv: I will make her officials and wise men drunk, her governors, officers and warriors as well; they will sleep forever and not awake," declares the King, whose name is the Lord Almighty.
verses.textEnEsv: I will make drunk her officials and her wise men, her governors, her commanders, and her warriors; they shall sleep a perpetual sleep and not wake, declares the King, whose name is the Lord of hosts.
verses.textEnNkjv: "And I will make drunk Her princes and wise men, Her governors, her deputies, and her mighty men. And they shall sleep a perpetual sleep And not awake," says the King, Whose name is the Lord of hosts.
verses.textEnNlt: I will make her officials and wise men drunk, along with her captains, officers, and warriors. They will fall asleep and never wake up again!" says the King, whose name is the Lord of Heaven’s Armies.
verses.textEnNasb: "I will make her leaders and her wise men drunk, Her governors, her officials, and her warriors, So that they will sleep a perpetual sleep and not wake up," Declares the King, whose name is the Lord of armies.
verses.textEn: I will make her officials and wise men drunk, her governors, officers and warriors as well; they will sleep forever and not awake," declares the King, whose name is the Lord Almighty.

verses.textZh: 万军之耶和华这样说： "巴比伦宽阔的城墙必被夷为平地， 它高大的城门必被焚烧； 万民所劳碌的都必成空， 万族所辛劳的都付诸一炬。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 万军之耶和华这样说： "巴比伦宽阔的城墙必被夷为平地， 它高大的城门必被焚烧； 万民所劳碌的都必成空， 万族所辛劳的都付诸一炬。"
verses.textZhCuv: 万军之耶和华如此说： 巴比伦宽阔的城墙必全然倾倒； 她高大的城门必被火焚烧。 众民所劳碌的必致虚空； 列国所劳碌的被火焚烧， 他们都必困乏。
verses.textEnNiv: This is what the Lord Almighty says: "Babylon’s thick wall will be leveled and her high gates set on fire; the peoples exhaust themselves for nothing, the nations’ labor is only fuel for the flames."
verses.textEnEsv: "Thus says the Lord of hosts: The broad wall of Babylon shall be leveled to the ground, and her high gates shall be burned with fire. The peoples labor for nothing, and the nations weary themselves only for fire."
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus says the Lord of hosts: "The broad walls of Babylon shall be utterly broken, And her high gates shall be burned with fire; The people will labor in vain, And the nations, because of the fire; And they shall be weary."
verses.textEnNlt: This is what the Lord of Heaven’s Armies says: "The thick walls of Babylon will be leveled to the ground, and her massive gates will be burned. The builders from many lands have worked in vain, for their work will be destroyed by fire!"
verses.textEnNasb: This is what the Lord of armies says: "The broad wall of Babylon will be completely demolished, And her high gates will be set on fire; So the peoples will labor for nothing, And the nations become exhausted only for fire."
verses.textEn: This is what the Lord Almighty says: "Babylon’s thick wall will be leveled and her high gates set on fire; the peoples exhaust themselves for nothing, the nations’ labor is only fuel for the flames."

verses.textZh: 犹大王西底家执政的第四年，玛西雅的孙子、尼利亚的儿子西莱雅和王同去巴比伦的时候，耶利米先知有话吩咐西莱雅，他是掌管住宿事务的官员。
verses.textZhCnvs: 犹大王西底家执政的第四年，玛西雅的孙子、尼利亚的儿子西莱雅和王同去巴比伦的时候，耶利米先知有话吩咐西莱雅，他是掌管住宿事务的官员。
verses.textZhCuv: 犹大王西底家在位第四年，上巴比伦去的时候，玛西雅的孙子、尼利亚的儿子西莱雅与王同去（西莱雅是王宫的大臣），先知耶利米有话吩咐他。
verses.textEnNiv: This is the message Jeremiah the prophet gave to the staff officer Seraiah son of Neriah, the son of Mahseiah, when he went to Babylon with Zedekiah king of Judah in the fourth year of his reign.
verses.textEnEsv: The word that Jeremiah the prophet commanded Seraiah the son of Neriah, son of Mahseiah, when he went with Zedekiah king of Judah to Babylon, in the fourth year of his reign. Seraiah was the quartermaster.
verses.textEnNkjv: The word which Jeremiah the prophet commanded Seraiah the son of Neriah, the son of Mahseiah, when he went with Zedekiah the king of Judah to Babylon in the fourth year of his reign. And Seraiah was the quartermaster.
verses.textEnNlt: The prophet Jeremiah gave this message to Seraiah son of Neriah and grandson of Mahseiah, a staff officer, when Seraiah went to Babylon with King Zedekiah of Judah. This was during the fourth year of Zedekiah’s reign.
verses.textEnNasb: The command that Jeremiah the prophet gave Seraiah the son of Neriah, the grandson of Mahseiah, when he went with Zedekiah the king of Judah to Babylon in the fourth year of his reign. (And Seraiah was quartermaster.)
verses.textEn: This is the message Jeremiah the prophet gave to the staff officer Seraiah son of Neriah, the son of Mahseiah, when he went to Babylon with Zedekiah king of Judah in the fourth year of his reign.

verses.textZh: 耶利米把一切将要临到巴比伦的灾祸，就是这一切论到巴比伦的话，都写在一卷书上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶利米把一切将要临到巴比伦的灾祸，就是这一切论到巴比伦的话，都写在一卷书上。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶利米将一切要临到巴比伦的灾祸，就是论到巴比伦的一切话，写在书上。
verses.textEnNiv: Jeremiah had written on a scroll about all the disasters that would come upon Babylon—all that had been recorded concerning Babylon.
verses.textEnEsv: Jeremiah wrote in a book all the disaster that should come upon Babylon, all these words that are written concerning Babylon.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Jeremiah wrote in a book all the evil that would come upon Babylon, all these words that are written against Babylon.
verses.textEnNlt: Jeremiah had recorded on a scroll all the terrible disasters that would soon come upon Babylon—all the words written here.
verses.textEnNasb: Jeremiah wrote on a single scroll all the disaster which would come against Babylon, that is, all these words which have been written concerning Babylon.
verses.textEn: Jeremiah had written on a scroll about all the disasters that would come upon Babylon—all that had been recorded concerning Babylon.

verses.textZh: 耶利米对西莱雅说："你到了巴比伦以后，一定要宣读这一切话，
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶利米对西莱雅说："你到了巴比伦以后，一定要宣读这一切话，
verses.textZhCuv: 耶利米对西莱雅说：「你到了巴比伦务要念这书上的话；
verses.textEnNiv: He said to Seraiah, "When you get to Babylon, see that you read all these words aloud.
verses.textEnEsv: And Jeremiah said to Seraiah: "When you come to Babylon, see that you read all these words,
verses.textEnNkjv: And Jeremiah said to Seraiah, "When you arrive in Babylon and see it, and read all these words,
verses.textEnNlt: He said to Seraiah, "When you get to Babylon, read aloud everything on this scroll.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Jeremiah said to Seraiah, "As soon as you come to Babylon, see that you read all these words aloud,
verses.textEn: He said to Seraiah, "When you get to Babylon, see that you read all these words aloud.

verses.textZh: 然后你要说：‘耶和华啊！论到这地方，你曾经亲自说过要把它剪除，使这地永远荒凉，没有人畜居住。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 然后你要说：‘耶和华啊！论到这地方，你曾经亲自说过要把它剪除，使这地永远荒凉，没有人畜居住。’
verses.textZhCuv: 又说：『耶和华啊，你曾论到这地方说：要剪除，甚至连人带牲畜没有在这里居住的，必永远荒凉。』
verses.textEnNiv: Then say, ‘ Lord , you have said you will destroy this place, so that neither people nor animals will live in it; it will be desolate forever.’
verses.textEnEsv: and say, ‘O Lord , you have said concerning this place that you will cut it off, so that nothing shall dwell in it, neither man nor beast, and it shall be desolate forever.’
verses.textEnNkjv: then you shall say, ‘O Lord, You have spoken against this place to cut it off, so that none shall remain in it, neither man nor beast, but it shall be desolate forever.’
verses.textEnNlt: Then say, ‘ Lord , you have said that you will destroy Babylon so that neither people nor animals will remain here. She will lie empty and abandoned forever.’
verses.textEnNasb: and say, ‘You, Lord, have promised concerning this place to cut it off, so that there will be nothing living in it, whether man or animal; but it will be a permanent desolation.’
verses.textEn: Then say, ‘ Lord , you have said you will destroy this place, so that neither people nor animals will live in it; it will be desolate forever.’

verses.textZh: 你宣读完这书卷以后，要把一块石头和书拴在一起，丢进幼发拉底河里，
verses.textZhCnvs: 你宣读完这书卷以后，要把一块石头和书拴在一起，丢进幼发拉底河里，
verses.textZhCuv: 你念完了这书，就把一块石头拴在书上，扔在幼发拉底河中，
verses.textEnNiv: When you finish reading this scroll, tie a stone to it and throw it into the Euphrates.
verses.textEnEsv: When you finish reading this book, tie a stone to it and cast it into the midst of the Euphrates,
verses.textEnNkjv: Now it shall be, when you have finished reading this book, that you shall tie a stone to it and throw it out into the Euphrates.
verses.textEnNlt: When you have finished reading the scroll, tie it to a stone and throw it into the Euphrates River.
verses.textEnNasb: And as soon as you finish reading this scroll, you shall tie a stone to it and throw it into the middle of the Euphrates,
verses.textEn: When you finish reading this scroll, tie a stone to it and throw it into the Euphrates.

verses.textZh: 然后说：‘巴比伦必因耶和华 所要降给它的灾祸，照样沉下去，不再浮上来；它的人民也必灭没。’"耶利米的话到此为止。
verses.textZhCnvs: 然后说：‘巴比伦必因耶和华 所要降给它的灾祸，照样沉下去，不再浮上来；它的人民也必灭没。’"耶利米的话到此为止。
verses.textZhCuv: 说：『巴比伦因耶和华所要降与她的灾祸，必如此沉下去，不再兴起，人民也必困乏。』」 耶利米的话到此为止。
verses.textEnNiv: Then say, ‘So will Babylon sink to rise no more because of the disaster I will bring on her. And her people will fall.’ " The words of Jeremiah end here.
verses.textEnEsv: and say, ‘Thus shall Babylon sink, to rise no more, because of the disaster that I am bringing upon her, and they shall become exhausted.’" Thus far are the words of Jeremiah.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then you shall say, ‘Thus Babylon shall sink and not rise from the catastrophe that I will bring upon her. And they shall be weary.’ " Thus far are the words of Jeremiah.
verses.textEnNlt: Then say, ‘In this same way Babylon and her people will sink, never again to rise, because of the disasters I will bring upon her.’" This is the end of Jeremiah’s messages.
verses.textEnNasb: and say, ‘Just so shall Babylon sink down and not rise again, because of the disaster that I am going to bring upon her; and they will become exhausted.’ " To this point are the words of Jeremiah.
verses.textEn: Then say, ‘So will Babylon sink to rise no more because of the disaster I will bring on her. And her people will fall.’ " The words of Jeremiah end here.

verses.textZh: 西底家登基的时候是二十一岁，他在耶路撒冷作王十一年；他母亲名叫哈慕他，是立拿人耶利米的女儿。
verses.textZhCnvs: 西底家登基的时候是二十一岁，他在耶路撒冷作王十一年；他母亲名叫哈慕他，是立拿人耶利米的女儿。
verses.textZhCuv: 西底家登基的时候年二十一岁，在耶路撒冷作王十一年。他母亲名叫哈慕她，是立拿人耶利米的女儿。
verses.textEnNiv: Zedekiah was twenty-one years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem eleven years. His mother’s name was Hamutal daughter of Jeremiah; she was from Libnah.
verses.textEnEsv: Zedekiah was twenty-one years old when he became king, and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Hamutal the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah.
verses.textEnNkjv: Zedekiah was twenty-one years old when he became king, and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Hamutal the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah.
verses.textEnNlt: Zedekiah was twenty-one years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem eleven years. His mother was Hamutal, the daughter of Jeremiah from Libnah.
verses.textEnNasb: Zedekiah was twenty-one years old when he became king, and he reigned for eleven years in Jerusalem; and his mother’s name was Hamutal the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah.
verses.textEn: Zedekiah was twenty-one years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem eleven years. His mother’s name was Hamutal daughter of Jeremiah; she was from Libnah.

verses.textZh: 他行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，像约雅敬一切所行的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，像约雅敬一切所行的。
verses.textZhCuv: 西底家行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，是照约雅敬一切所行的。
verses.textEnNiv: He did evil in the eyes of the Lord , just as Jehoiakim had done.
verses.textEnEsv: And he did what was evil in the sight of the Lord , according to all that Jehoiakim had done.
verses.textEnNkjv: He also did evil in the sight of the Lord, according to all that Jehoiakim had done.
verses.textEnNlt: But Zedekiah did what was evil in the Lord ’s sight, just as Jehoiakim had done.
verses.textEnNasb: He did evil in the sight of the Lord, in accordance with everything that Jehoiakim had done.
verses.textEn: He did evil in the eyes of the Lord , just as Jehoiakim had done.

verses.textZh: 因为耶和华的怒气向耶路撒冷和犹大发作，直到他把他们从自己的面前赶走。后来，西底家背叛了巴比伦王。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为耶和华的怒气向耶路撒冷和犹大发作，直到他把他们从自己的面前赶走。后来，西底家背叛了巴比伦王。
verses.textZhCuv: 因此耶和华的怒气在耶路撒冷和犹大发作，以致将人民从自己的面前赶出。
verses.textEnNiv: It was because of the Lord ’s anger that all this happened to Jerusalem and Judah, and in the end he thrust them from his presence. Now Zedekiah rebelled against the king of Babylon.
verses.textEnEsv: For because of the anger of the Lord it came to the point in Jerusalem and Judah that he cast them out from his presence. And Zedekiah rebelled against the king of Babylon.
verses.textEnNkjv: For because of the anger of the Lordthis happened in Jerusalem and Judah, till He finally cast them out from His presence. Then Zedekiah rebelled against the king of Babylon.
verses.textEnNlt: These things happened because of the Lord ’s anger against the people of Jerusalem and Judah, until he finally banished them from his presence and sent them into exile. Zedekiah rebelled against the king of Babylon.
verses.textEnNasb: For because of the anger of the Lordthis came about in Jerusalem and Judah, until He drove them out from His presence. And Zedekiah revolted against the king of Babylon.
verses.textEn: It was because of the Lord ’s anger that all this happened to Jerusalem and Judah, and in the end he thrust them from his presence. Now Zedekiah rebelled against the king of Babylon.

verses.textZh: 西底家作王第九年十月十日，巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒率领他的全军来攻打耶路撒冷；他们在城外安营，又在四周筑垒攻城。
verses.textZhCnvs: 西底家作王第九年十月十日，巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒率领他的全军来攻打耶路撒冷；他们在城外安营，又在四周筑垒攻城。
verses.textZhCuv: 西底家背叛巴比伦王。他作王第九年十月初十日，巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒率领全军来攻击耶路撒冷，对城安营，四围筑垒攻城。
verses.textEnNiv: So in the ninth year of Zedekiah’s reign, on the tenth day of the tenth month, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon marched against Jerusalem with his whole army. They encamped outside the city and built siege works all around it.
verses.textEnEsv: And in the ninth year of his reign, in the tenth month, on the tenth day of the month, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came with all his army against Jerusalem, and laid siege to it. And they built siegeworks all around it.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now it came to pass in the ninth year of his reign, in the tenth month, on the tenth day of the month, that Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon and all his army came against Jerusalem and encamped against it; and they built a siege wall against it all around.
verses.textEnNlt: So on January 15, during the ninth year of Zedekiah’s reign, King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylon led his entire army against Jerusalem. They surrounded the city and built siege ramps against its walls.
verses.textEnNasb: Now it came about in the ninth year of his reign, on the tenth day of the tenth month, that Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came, he and all his army, against Jerusalem, camped against it, and built a bulwark all around it.
verses.textEn: So in the ninth year of Zedekiah’s reign, on the tenth day of the tenth month, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon marched against Jerusalem with his whole army. They encamped outside the city and built siege works all around it.

verses.textZh: 于是，城被围困，直到西底家王第十一年。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是，城被围困，直到西底家王第十一年。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是城被围困直到西底家王十一年。
verses.textEnNiv: The city was kept under siege until the eleventh year of King Zedekiah.
verses.textEnEsv: So the city was besieged till the eleventh year of King Zedekiah.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the city was besieged until the eleventh year of King Zedekiah.
verses.textEnNlt: Jerusalem was kept under siege until the eleventh year of King Zedekiah’s reign.
verses.textEnNasb: So the city was under siege until the eleventh year of King Zedekiah.
verses.textEn: The city was kept under siege until the eleventh year of King Zedekiah.

verses.textZh: 四月九日，城里饥荒非常严重，甚至那地的人民都断了粮食。
verses.textZhCnvs: 四月九日，城里饥荒非常严重，甚至那地的人民都断了粮食。
verses.textZhCuv: 四月初九日，城里有大饥荒，甚至百姓都没有粮食。
verses.textEnNiv: By the ninth day of the fourth month the famine in the city had become so severe that there was no food for the people to eat.
verses.textEnEsv: On the ninth day of the fourth month the famine was so severe in the city that there was no food for the people of the land.
verses.textEnNkjv: By the fourth month, on the ninth day of the month, the famine had become so severe in the city that there was no food for the people of the land.
verses.textEnNlt: By July 18 in the eleventh year of Zedekiah’s reign, the famine in the city had become very severe, and the last of the food was entirely gone.
verses.textEnNasb: On the ninth day of the fourth month the famine was so severe in the city that there was no food for the people of the land.
verses.textEn: By the ninth day of the fourth month the famine in the city had become so severe that there was no food for the people to eat.

verses.textZh: 城终于被攻破了，所有的战士就在夜间从靠近王的花园的两墙中间的那门，逃跑出城。那时迦勒底人在四围攻城；他们就往亚拉巴的方向逃走。
verses.textZhCnvs: 城终于被攻破了，所有的战士就在夜间从靠近王的花园的两墙中间的那门，逃跑出城。那时迦勒底人在四围攻城；他们就往亚拉巴的方向逃走。
verses.textZhCuv: 城被攻破，一切兵丁就在夜间从靠近王园两城中间的门，出城逃跑；迦勒底人正在四围攻城。他们就往亚拉巴逃去。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the city wall was broken through, and the whole army fled. They left the city at night through the gate between the two walls near the king’s garden, though the Babylonians were surrounding the city. They fled toward the Arabah,
verses.textEnEsv: Then a breach was made in the city, and all the men of war fled and went out from the city by night by the way of a gate between the two walls, by the king’s garden, and the Chaldeans were around the city. And they went in the direction of the Arabah.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the city wall was broken through, and all the men of war fled and went out of the city at night by way of the gate between the two walls, which was by the king’s garden, even though the Chaldeans were near the city all around. And they went by way of the plain.
verses.textEnNlt: Then a section of the city wall was broken down, and all the soldiers fled. Since the city was surrounded by the Babylonians, they waited for nightfall. Then they slipped through the gate between the two walls behind the king’s garden and headed toward the Jordan Valley.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the city was breached, and all the warriors fled and left the city at night by way of the gate between the two walls which was by the king’s garden, though the Chaldeans were all around the city. And they went by way of the Arabah.
verses.textEn: Then the city wall was broken through, and the whole army fled. They left the city at night through the gate between the two walls near the king’s garden, though the Babylonians were surrounding the city. They fled toward the Arabah,

verses.textZh: 迦勒底人的军队追赶，在耶利哥的原野上把西底家追上了；他的全军都离开他四散了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 迦勒底人的军队追赶，在耶利哥的原野上把西底家追上了；他的全军都离开他四散了。
verses.textZhCuv: 迦勒底的军队追赶西底家王，在耶利哥的平原追上他。他的全军都离开他四散了。
verses.textEnNiv: but the Babylonian army pursued King Zedekiah and overtook him in the plains of Jericho. All his soldiers were separated from him and scattered,
verses.textEnEsv: But the army of the Chaldeans pursued the king and overtook Zedekiah in the plains of Jericho, and all his army was scattered from him.
verses.textEnNkjv: But the army of the Chaldeans pursued the king, and they overtook Zedekiah in the plains of Jericho. All his army was scattered from him.
verses.textEnNlt: But the Babylonian troops chased King Zedekiah and overtook him on the plains of Jericho, for his men had all deserted him and scattered.
verses.textEnNasb: But the army of the Chaldeans pursued the king and overtook Zedekiah in the desert plains of Jericho, and all his army was scattered from him.
verses.textEn: but the Babylonian army pursued King Zedekiah and overtook him in the plains of Jericho. All his soldiers were separated from him and scattered,

verses.textZh: 他们把王擒住，把他解到哈马地的利比拉巴比伦王那里；他就宣判他的罪。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们把王擒住，把他解到哈马地的利比拉巴比伦王那里；他就宣判他的罪。
verses.textZhCuv: 迦勒底人就拿住王，带他到在哈马地利比拉的巴比伦王那里；巴比伦王便审判他。
verses.textEnNiv: and he was captured. He was taken to the king of Babylon at Riblah in the land of Hamath, where he pronounced sentence on him.
verses.textEnEsv: Then they captured the king and brought him up to the king of Babylon at Riblah in the land of Hamath, and he passed sentence on him.
verses.textEnNkjv: So they took the king and brought him up to the king of Babylon at Riblah in the land of Hamath, and he pronounced judgment on him.
verses.textEnNlt: They captured the king and took him to the king of Babylon at Riblah in the land of Hamath. There the king of Babylon pronounced judgment upon Zedekiah.
verses.textEnNasb: Then they captured the king and brought him up to the king of Babylon at Riblah in the land of Hamath, and he passed sentence on him.
verses.textEn: and he was captured. He was taken to the king of Babylon at Riblah in the land of Hamath, where he pronounced sentence on him.

verses.textZh: 巴比伦王在利比拉，当着西底家眼前杀了他的众子，也杀了犹大所有的领袖，
verses.textZhCnvs: 巴比伦王在利比拉，当着西底家眼前杀了他的众子，也杀了犹大所有的领袖，
verses.textZhCuv: 巴比伦王在西底家眼前杀了他的众子，又在利比拉杀了犹大的一切首领，
verses.textEnNiv: There at Riblah the king of Babylon killed the sons of Zedekiah before his eyes; he also killed all the officials of Judah.
verses.textEnEsv: The king of Babylon slaughtered the sons of Zedekiah before his eyes, and also slaughtered all the officials of Judah at Riblah.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the king of Babylon killed the sons of Zedekiah before his eyes. And he killed all the princes of Judah in Riblah.
verses.textEnNlt: The king of Babylon made Zedekiah watch as he slaughtered his sons. He also slaughtered all the officials of Judah at Riblah.
verses.textEnNasb: And the king of Babylon slaughtered the sons of Zedekiah before his eyes, and he also slaughtered all the commanders of Judah in Riblah.
verses.textEn: There at Riblah the king of Babylon killed the sons of Zedekiah before his eyes; he also killed all the officials of Judah.

verses.textZh: 并且把西底家的眼睛弄瞎，然后用铜炼锁住他。巴比伦王把他带到巴比伦去，关在牢里，直到他去世的日子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 并且把西底家的眼睛弄瞎，然后用铜炼锁住他。巴比伦王把他带到巴比伦去，关在牢里，直到他去世的日子。
verses.textZhCuv: 并且剜了西底家的眼睛，用铜链锁着他，带到巴比伦去，将他囚在监里，直到他死的日子。
verses.textEnNiv: Then he put out Zedekiah’s eyes, bound him with bronze shackles and took him to Babylon, where he put him in prison till the day of his death.
verses.textEnEsv: He put out the eyes of Zedekiah, and bound him in chains, and the king of Babylon took him to Babylon, and put him in prison till the day of his death.
verses.textEnNkjv: He also put out the eyes of Zedekiah; and the king of Babylon bound him in bronze fetters, took him to Babylon, and put him in prison till the day of his death.
verses.textEnNlt: Then he gouged out Zedekiah’s eyes and bound him in bronze chains, and the king of Babylon led him away to Babylon. Zedekiah remained there in prison until the day of his death.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he blinded the eyes of Zedekiah; and the king of Babylon bound him with bronze shackles and brought him to Babylon and put him in prison until the day of his death.
verses.textEn: Then he put out Zedekiah’s eyes, bound him with bronze shackles and took him to Babylon, where he put him in prison till the day of his death.

verses.textZh: 五月十日，就是巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒第十九年，侍立在巴比伦王面前的护卫长尼布撒拉旦来到耶路撒冷。
verses.textZhCnvs: 五月十日，就是巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒第十九年，侍立在巴比伦王面前的护卫长尼布撒拉旦来到耶路撒冷。
verses.textZhCuv: 巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒十九年五月初十日，在巴比伦王面前侍立的护卫长尼布撒拉旦进入耶路撒冷，
verses.textEnNiv: On the tenth day of the fifth month, in the nineteenth year of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, Nebuzaradan commander of the imperial guard, who served the king of Babylon, came to Jerusalem.
verses.textEnEsv: In the fifth month, on the tenth day of the month—that was the nineteenth year of King Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon—Nebuzaradan the captain of the bodyguard, who served the king of Babylon, entered Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now in the fifth month, on the tenth day of the month ( which was the nineteenth year of King Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon), Nebuzaradan, the captain of the guard, who served the king of Babylon, came to Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNlt: On August 17 of that year, which was the nineteenth year of King Nebuchadnezzar’s reign, Nebuzaradan, the captain of the guard and an official of the Babylonian king, arrived in Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNasb: Now on the tenth day of the fifth month, which was the nineteenth year of King Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon, Nebuzaradan the captain of the bodyguard, who was in the service of the king of Babylon, came to Jerusalem.
verses.textEn: On the tenth day of the fifth month, in the nineteenth year of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, Nebuzaradan commander of the imperial guard, who served the king of Babylon, came to Jerusalem.

verses.textZh: 他放火焚烧耶和华的殿和王宫，以及耶路撒冷一切房屋，一切高大的房屋，他都放火烧了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他放火焚烧耶和华的殿和王宫，以及耶路撒冷一切房屋，一切高大的房屋，他都放火烧了。
verses.textZhCuv: 用火焚烧耶和华的殿和王宫，又焚烧耶路撒冷的房屋，就是各大户家的房屋。
verses.textEnNiv: He set fire to the temple of the Lord , the royal palace and all the houses of Jerusalem. Every important building he burned down.
verses.textEnEsv: And he burned the house of the Lord , and the king’s house and all the houses of Jerusalem; every great house he burned down.
verses.textEnNkjv: He burned the house of the Lord and the king’s house; all the houses of Jerusalem, that is, all the houses of the great, he burned with fire.
verses.textEnNlt: He burned down the Temple of the Lord , the royal palace, and all the houses of Jerusalem. He destroyed all the important buildings in the city.
verses.textEnNasb: And he burned the house of the Lord, the king’s house, and all the houses of Jerusalem; even every large house he burned with fire.
verses.textEn: He set fire to the temple of the Lord , the royal palace and all the houses of Jerusalem. Every important building he burned down.

verses.textZh: 跟随护卫长的迦勒底人全军拆毁了耶路撒冷周围所有的城墙。
verses.textZhCnvs: 跟随护卫长的迦勒底人全军拆毁了耶路撒冷周围所有的城墙。
verses.textZhCuv: 跟从护卫长迦勒底的全军就拆毁耶路撒冷四围的城墙。
verses.textEnNiv: The whole Babylonian army, under the commander of the imperial guard, broke down all the walls around Jerusalem.
verses.textEnEsv: And all the army of the Chaldeans, who were with the captain of the guard, broke down all the walls around Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNkjv: And all the army of the Chaldeans who were with the captain of the guard broke down all the walls of Jerusalem all around.
verses.textEnNlt: Then he supervised the entire Babylonian army as they tore down the walls of Jerusalem on every side.
verses.textEnNasb: So the entire army of the Chaldeans who were with the captain of the guard tore down all the walls around Jerusalem.
verses.textEn: The whole Babylonian army, under the commander of the imperial guard, broke down all the walls around Jerusalem.

verses.textZh: 至于人民中最贫穷的、城中剩下的人民，和已经向巴比伦王投降的人，以及剩下的技工，护卫长尼布撒拉旦都掳了去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 至于人民中最贫穷的、城中剩下的人民，和已经向巴比伦王投降的人，以及剩下的技工，护卫长尼布撒拉旦都掳了去。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时护卫长尼布撒拉旦将民中最穷的和城里所剩下的百姓，并已经投降巴比伦王的人，以及大众所剩下的人，都掳去了。
verses.textEnNiv: Nebuzaradan the commander of the guard carried into exile some of the poorest people and those who remained in the city, along with the rest of the craftsmen and those who had deserted to the king of Babylon.
verses.textEnEsv: And Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard carried away captive some of the poorest of the people and the rest of the people who were left in the city and the deserters who had deserted to the king of Babylon, together with the rest of the artisans.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard carried away captive some of the poor people, the rest of the people who remained in the city, the defectors who had deserted to the king of Babylon, and the rest of the craftsmen.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Nebuzaradan, the captain of the guard, took as exiles some of the poorest of the people, the rest of the people who remained in the city, the defectors who had declared their allegiance to the king of Babylon, and the rest of the craftsmen.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard took into exile some of the poorest of the people, the rest of the people who were left in the city, the deserters who had deserted to the king of Babylon, and the rest of the craftsmen.
verses.textEn: Nebuzaradan the commander of the guard carried into exile some of the poorest people and those who remained in the city, along with the rest of the craftsmen and those who had deserted to the king of Babylon.

verses.textZh: 至于那地最贫穷的人，护卫长尼布撒拉旦把他们留下，去修理葡萄园和耕种田地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 至于那地最贫穷的人，护卫长尼布撒拉旦把他们留下，去修理葡萄园和耕种田地。
verses.textZhCuv: 但护卫长尼布撒拉旦留下些民中最穷的，使他们修理葡萄园，耕种田地。
verses.textEnNiv: But Nebuzaradan left behind the rest of the poorest people of the land to work the vineyards and fields.
verses.textEnEsv: But Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard left some of the poorest of the land to be vinedressers and plowmen.
verses.textEnNkjv: But Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard left some of the poor of the land as vinedressers and farmers.
verses.textEnNlt: But Nebuzaradan allowed some of the poorest people to stay behind to care for the vineyards and fields.
verses.textEnNasb: But Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard left some of the poorest of the land to be vinedressers and farmers.
verses.textEn: But Nebuzaradan left behind the rest of the poorest people of the land to work the vineyards and fields.

verses.textZh: 耶和华殿的铜柱，以及耶和华殿的铜座和铜海，迦勒底人都打碎了，把所有的铜都运到巴比伦去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华殿的铜柱，以及耶和华殿的铜座和铜海，迦勒底人都打碎了，把所有的铜都运到巴比伦去。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华殿的铜柱并殿内的盆座和铜海，迦勒底人都打碎了，将那铜运到巴比伦去了，
verses.textEnNiv: The Babylonians broke up the bronze pillars, the movable stands and the bronze Sea that were at the temple of the Lord and they carried all the bronze to Babylon.
verses.textEnEsv: And the pillars of bronze that were in the house of the Lord , and the stands and the bronze sea that were in the house of the Lord , the Chaldeans broke in pieces, and carried all the bronze to Babylon.
verses.textEnNkjv: The bronze pillars that were in the house of the Lord, and the carts and the bronze Sea that were in the house of the Lord, the Chaldeans broke in pieces, and carried all their bronze to Babylon.
verses.textEnNlt: The Babylonians broke up the bronze pillars in front of the Lord ’s Temple, the bronze water carts, and the great bronze basin called the Sea, and they carried all the bronze away to Babylon.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the bronze pillars which belonged to the house of the Lord and the stands and the bronze sea, which were in the house of the Lord, the Chaldeans smashed to pieces and carried all their bronze to Babylon.
verses.textEn: The Babylonians broke up the bronze pillars, the movable stands and the bronze Sea that were at the temple of the Lord and they carried all the bronze to Babylon.

verses.textZh: 他们又把锅、铲子、烛剪、碗、碟子，和敬拜用的一切铜器都拿去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们又把锅、铲子、烛剪、碗、碟子，和敬拜用的一切铜器都拿去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 又带去锅、铲子、蜡剪、盘子、调羹，并所用的一切铜器、
verses.textEnNiv: They also took away the pots, shovels, wick trimmers, sprinkling bowls, dishes and all the bronze articles used in the temple service.
verses.textEnEsv: And they took away the pots and the shovels and the snuffers and the basins and the dishes for incense and all the vessels of bronze used in the temple service;
